Have your evidence of location ready before you file: old photographs, utility connections, witnesses, anything dated. SECOND, AND IT CAUSES REAL DISPUTES: NEIGHBOURING PLOTS ARE NOT MEASURED AS PART OF THE PROCESS, WHICH CREATES A RISK OF OVERLAPPING REGISTRATIONS. Talk to your neighbours before filing, and if you can, agree boundaries between you first — a registered overlap is far harder to undo than an unregistered disagreement. THE LIMITS: this is legislation, not an organisation, and it has been amended repeatedly — most recently in December 2025 — so confirm the current text and fees. The agency that operates the registry appears elsewhere in this map for a different purpose entirely, as a COMPANY registry for finding firms and their directors; its land function is what matters here.

trackers.name: National heritage committee — the people who can answer a structural condemnation, and the resources centre behind them
trackers.desc: OLD BUILDINGS ARE RARELY DEMOLISHED BECAUSE SOMEONE ARGUES THEY ARE WORTHLESS. THEY ARE DEMOLISHED BECAUSE SOMEONE PRODUCES A REPORT SAYING THEY ARE STRUCTURALLY UNSOUND AND BEYOND SAVING. THIS IS THE NATIONAL COMMITTEE OF THE INTERNATIONAL BODY THAT ADVISES ON WORLD HERITAGE, AND IT RUNS TRAINING IN THE STRUCTURAL ANALYSIS AND CONSERVATION OF HISTORIC BUILDINGS — which makes it the one organisation in this country's listing equipped to meet that report on its own ground. ITS TECHNICAL DEPTH IS DOCUMENTED RATHER THAN CLAIMED. It has run an intensive week-long course on structural analysis and conservation of historic structures built on the methodology of the international scientific committee for structural analysis and restoration of architectural heritage; and A WOOD CONSERVATION COURSE DEVELOPED AND DELIVERED WITH NORWAY'S DIRECTORATE FOR CULTURAL HERITAGE IN NOVEMBER 2024, using the curriculum and methodology of the intergovernmental conservation centre's international wood conservation course. IN A COUNTRY WHOSE HISTORIC HOUSING IS LARGELY TIMBER, A BODY THAT TEACHES WOOD CONSERVATION TO INTERNATIONAL CURRICULUM IS THE ADDRESS FOR ANY ARGUMENT ABOUT WHETHER A WOODEN BUILDING CAN BE SAVED. IT ALSO OPERATES A HERITAGE RESOURCES CENTRE, which is where its courses are held — so there is a physical place, a library of practice and a body of trained people, not merely a committee name. WHAT TO ASK FOR, AND BE SPECIFIC: whether it will review the structural report relied on to condemn your building; whether any of its trained conservation specialists will inspect; and whether it will state, in writing and in its own name, what conservation of the structure would require and cost. THE LAST ONE MATTERS MOST — an owner or authority claiming a building cannot be saved is answered by a costed conservation method, not by objection. ITS INTERNATIONAL AFFILIATION IS ITSELF USEFUL. A national committee of the body that advises on world heritage speaks a language that ministries and international funders recognise, and its opinion travels further than a local petition. Where a site has any claim to national or international significance, an assessment from this quarter is the document to obtain first. THE LIMITS: it is a professional and scientific body, not a campaign group or a law firm. It will assess, train and advise; it will not litigate, buy land, or run your campaign, and nothing found shows it opposing developments as such. Its work is buildings and monuments rather than landscape or ecology. Use it with the free registration route, the cadastral map and the environmental legal resources recorded separately for this country — and note that this file has also logged a second heritage organisation here, an arts and culture centre recognised by a European heritage prize jury, which works with communities on traditional knowledge and crafts.

trackers.name: Treaty compliance committee — a member of the public can file against the state, and forest licensing has been challenged this way
trackers.desc: A COMMUNICATION TO THIS COMMITTEE MAY BE BROUGHT BY ONE OR MORE MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC ABOUT ANY STATE PARTY'S COMPLIANCE WITH THE TREATY ON ACCESS TO ENVIRONMENTAL INFORMATION, PUBLIC PARTICIPATION AND ACCESS TO JUSTICE. You do not need an organisation, a lawyer, or a domestic court victory to file. AND THIS COUNTRY HAS BEEN THERE BEFORE ON EXACTLY THE ISSUE THAT DECIDES LAND FIGHTS: a communication concerning it dealt with PUBLIC PARTICIPATION IN DECISION-MAKING ON THE ISSUANCE OF LICENCES FOR LONG-TERM FOREST USE. If your problem is that a long-term licence over land was granted without the public being properly involved, THAT IS A PATH ALREADY WALKED HERE. THE DATES ARE PUBLISHED AND CURRENT: SUBMISSIONS REACHING THE SECRETARIAT BY 28 SEPTEMBER 2026 ARE CONSIDERED FOR PRELIMINARY ADMISSIBILITY AT THE MEETING IN THE WEEK OF 9 TO 13 NOVEMBER 2026, if complete, in the REQUIRED FORMAT and needing no translation. English, French or Russian are accepted and the secretariat translates the latter two — BUT TRANSLATION COSTS YOU THE DEADLINE. ITS FINDINGS ALSO DEFINE WHAT THE STATE MUST DISCLOSE, WHICH IS USEFUL BEFORE YOU EVER FILE: government decrees on LAND USE AND PLANNING, feasibility studies, financial agreements, RENTAL CONTRACTS FOR LAND HELD BY A STATE FORESTRY FUND, and raw monitoring data have all been treated as environmental information. QUOTE THAT WHEN YOU ARE REFUSED — the refusal itself then becomes the evidence for a communication. WHAT SINKS SUBMISSIONS: anonymity; duplicating a pending case; trying to re-argue litigation lost at home; being brought by a state body; and above all INSUFFICIENT SUPPORTING INFORMATION. Build the file as you go — every request, refusal, notice period and hearing date — because the committee judges what you attach, not what you assert. THE LIMIT: this improves a state's compliance; IT IS NOT A REDRESS PROCEDURE FOR INDIVIDUAL RIGHTS and will not cancel a licence. It produces findings and recommendations, monitored over years. Pair it with the national information centre, the free registration route and the heritage committee recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Procurement dispute board — half its members chosen by civil society, and it can annul a tender
trackers.desc: THE PREVIOUS ROUND ASKED WHO SUPERVISES PROCUREMENT RATHER THAN WHERE IT IS PUBLISHED. HERE IS THE STRONGEST ANSWER IN THE REGION: A DISPUTE RESOLUTION BOARD OF SIX MEMBERS, COMPOSED ON A PARITY PRINCIPLE OF AGENCY REPRESENTATIVES AND OF THE NON-GOVERNMENTAL SECTOR — THREE AGENCY STAFF AND THREE CIVIL SOCIETY REPRESENTATIVES. AND THE THREE CIVIL SOCIETY MEMBERS ARE NOT APPOINTED BY THE STATE'S CHOICE OF FRIENDLY FACES: THEY ARE SELECTED BY THE BROADEST POSSIBLE COMPOSITION OF THE NON-GOVERNMENTAL SECTOR, BY ROTATION, FOR ONE YEAR, WITH THE RESULTING LIST PUT TO THE AGENCY CHAIR FOR APPROVAL. HALF THE BODY THAT DECIDES PROCUREMENT COMPLAINTS IS CHOSEN BY THE NGO SECTOR ITSELF, AND THE SEATS ROTATE ANNUALLY. THIS FILE HAS EXAMINED PROCUREMENT IN TWELVE COUNTRIES AND FOUND NOTHING COMPARABLE — and for an organisation working on land and development, A SEAT ON THAT BOARD IS OBTAINABLE THROUGH THE SECTOR'S OWN SELECTION PROCESS RATHER THAN THROUGH GOVERNMENT FAVOUR. WHAT THE BOARD CAN DO IS THE OTHER HALF OF THE POINT: IT CONSIDERS THE COMPLAINTS OF INTERESTED PARTIES AND, WHERE NECESSARY, OBLIGES THE PROCURING ORGANISATION TO CHANGE OR ENTIRELY ANNUL THE RESULTS OF THE TENDER. A BOARD THAT CAN CANCEL A TENDER OUTCOME, HALF OF WHOSE MEMBERS COME FROM CIVIL SOCIETY. THAT IS A REAL REMEDY, NOT A CONSULTATION — and it sits inside an agency that is an independent legal entity of public law accountable to the government rather than to any purchasing ministry. NOW THE FIGURE THAT DECIDES WHETHER AN ORDINARY GROUP CAN USE IT. FROM 1 SEPTEMBER 2026 THE FEE FOR LODGING A COMPLAINT IS TWO PER CENT OF THE ESTIMATED VALUE OF THE PROCUREMENT — OR OF THE SIMPLIFIED PROCUREMENT VALUE — BUT NOT LESS THAN FIVE HUNDRED AND NOT MORE THAN ONE THOUSAND LARI. THE CEILING IS THE WHOLE STORY. HOWEVER LARGE THE CONTRACT — A ROAD, A DAM ACCESS TRACK, A LANDFILL — A COMPLAINT COSTS AT MOST ONE THOUSAND. WITHOUT A CAP, TWO PER CENT OF A MAJOR WORKS CONTRACT WOULD PUT THE PROCEDURE OUT OF REACH OF EVERY COMMUNITY IN THE COUNTRY; WITH IT, THE PROCEDURE IS AFFORDABLE PRECISELY WHERE THE STAKES ARE HIGHEST. Note also the floor: five hundred is charged even on small procurements, so a complaint about a minor contract costs proportionately more. PRACTICALLY: ESTABLISH WHETHER YOUR ORGANISATION QUALIFIES AS AN INTERESTED PARTY BEFORE A TENDER IS DECIDED, NOT AFTER — and if it does not, find a bidder or a sector organisation that does. Complaints run to procurement deadlines, and this file has recorded five times that the apparatus for acting must exist before there is anything to act on. THE LIMITS: this is a procurement remedy, NOT AN ENVIRONMENTAL OR PLANNING ONE — it can undo how a contract was awarded, but it cannot decide that a project should not happen. Whether a community organisation that is not a bidder counts as an interested party WAS NOT VERIFIED and is the first thing to check. Fee figures are those announced for the coming change. This country already holds one of the largest listings in this map. Read it with the environmental litigators, the legal aid centre and the public information routes recorded separately here.

trackers.name: Young lawyers' association — free legal aid with an administrative-law line, and an office built around pipeline-affected residents
trackers.desc: THE BRIEF ASKS FOR THE BEST LOCAL ANTI-DEVELOPMENT LAWYERS. HERE IS AN ORGANISATION THAT HAS BEEN DOING EXACTLY THAT WORK SINCE 1994, DESCRIBED AS ONE OF THE LARGEST AND MOST TRUSTED RIGHTS ORGANISATIONS IN THE COUNTRY — AND ONE OF ITS REGIONAL OFFICES SPENT YEARS ON PRECISELY THE SITUATION THIS MAP EXISTS FOR. THE MAIN DIRECTION OF THAT OFFICE'S WORK WAS PROTECTING THE PROPERTY RIGHTS, THE LABOUR RIGHTS AND THE SAFE ENVIRONMENT OF THE POPULATION LIVING NEAR A MAJOR INTERNATIONAL OIL PIPELINE, ACROSS A COVERAGE ZONE OF SEVEN NAMED MUNICIPALITIES. A LAW OFFICE ORGANISED AROUND THE PEOPLE WHOSE LAND A PIPELINE CROSSES IS A DIFFERENT THING FROM A FIRM THAT WILL TAKE SUCH A CASE. IT MEANS THE PRECEDENTS, THE COMPANY'S PATTERNS, THE COMPENSATION ARGUMENTS AND THE LOCAL OFFICIALS ARE ALREADY KNOWN — AND IT MEANS SOMEONE HAS ALREADY LOST AND WON THESE ARGUMENTS BEFORE YOU ARRIVE. WHEN LOOKING FOR COUNSEL, ASK WHICH OFFICE HANDLED THE LAST BIG LINEAR PROJECT IN YOUR REGION. WHAT THE ORGANISATION OFFERS GENERALLY IS EQUALLY CONCRETE: DEVELOPING THE SYSTEM OF FREE LEGAL AID; COURT REPRESENTATION OF CITIZENS WHOSE RIGHTS HAVE BEEN VIOLATED AND STRATEGIC LITIGATION; AND PROMOTING FREEDOM OF INFORMATION AND TRANSPARENCY — WHICH IS THE HALF THAT GETS DOCUMENTS OUT OF AUTHORITIES. FREE LEGAL CONSULTATION AND ADVOCACY ARE A MAIN ACTIVITY, PROVIDED WITHIN ITS AREAS OF EXPERTISE, AND IN A NUMBER OF CASES THE ASSISTANCE EXTENDS TO REPRESENTATION IN LOCAL AND INTERNATIONAL COURTS. NOTE BOTH LIMITS IN THAT SENTENCE: WITHIN ITS EXPERTISE, AND IN A NUMBER OF CASES. IT IS NOT A GENERAL LEGAL SERVICE, AND A CASE HAS TO FIT WHAT THEY WORK ON. TWO SEPARATE FREE-CONSULTATION TELEPHONE LINES ARE PUBLISHED — ONE FOR CRIMINAL MATTERS AND ONE FOR CIVIL AND ADMINISTRATIVE MATTERS. THE ADMINISTRATIVE LINE IS THE ONE A LAND, PERMIT OR PLANNING DISPUTE USES, AND RINGING THE RIGHT NUMBER MATTERS MORE THAN MOST PEOPLE REALISE: THE CRIMINAL LINE WILL SEND YOU AWAY. AND THE NETWORK IS PHYSICAL RATHER THAN NOMINAL: THE CAPITAL PLUS SIX REGIONAL OFFICES, WITH STREET ADDRESSES PUBLISHED FOR EACH. GO TO THE ONE COVERING YOUR MUNICIPALITY — this file has recorded in several countries that the office nearest the court that will hear the matter is the one to approach. THE LIMITS: it is a HUMAN RIGHTS ORGANISATION, NOT AN ENVIRONMENTAL ONE — its route into a land dispute runs through property, procedure and information rights rather than ecology, and a case framed only as harm to nature may not fit. CAPACITY IS FINITE AND FREE REPRESENTATION IS SELECTIVE; whether it currently takes new land cases, and on what terms, WAS NOT VERIFIED, and the pipeline work is described as the office's focus over past years rather than now. Civil society organisations in this country have come under sustained political pressure. Read it with the procurement dispute board, the environmental litigation routes and the public information rules recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Environmental information and education centre — legal counselling for citizens, and someone monitoring whether the public was really consulted in an EIA
trackers.desc: OF EVERY CENTRE IN THIS NETWORK, THIS ONE HAS THE MOST USEFUL JOB DESCRIPTION. IT FACILITATES ACCESS TO INFORMATION ON ENVIRONMENTAL ISSUES, PROVIDES TRAININGS ON THE CONVENTION, MONITORS PUBLIC PARTICIPATION DURING THE ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT ASSESSMENT PROCESS, AND PROVIDES LEGAL COUNSELLING TO CITIZENS ON ENVIRONMENTAL MATTERS. TWO OF THOSE FOUR ARE EXACTLY WHAT A COMMUNITY NEEDS AND CAN LEAST AFFORD. LEGAL COUNSELLING FOR CITIZENS ON ENVIRONMENTAL MATTERS — FREE ADVICE FROM A BODY WHOSE SUBJECT IS THE ENVIRONMENT RATHER THAN GENERAL LAW. AND MONITORING OF PUBLIC PARTICIPATION DURING THE ASSESSMENT PROCESS — SOMEBODY WHOSE JOB IS WATCHING WHETHER PEOPLE WERE ACTUALLY CONSULTED. THAT SECOND FUNCTION IS RARE ENOUGH TO BE WORTH SPELLING OUT. THE COMMONEST DEFECT IN AN ASSESSMENT IS NOT BAD SCIENCE BUT A CONSULTATION THAT HAPPENED ON PAPER ONLY — A NOTICE NOBODY SAW, A MEETING AT AN IMPOSSIBLE HOUR, A DOCUMENT AVAILABLE FOR INSPECTION IN A CITY THREE HOURS AWAY. A BODY THAT MONITORS PARTICIPATION AS A MATTER OF ROUTINE IS THE WITNESS TO THAT, AND ITS OBSERVATIONS ARE NOT A COMPLAINT FROM AN AFFECTED PARTY BUT A RECORD FROM A NEUTRAL ONE. SO IF AN ASSESSMENT FOR A SCHEME IS RUNNING NOW, TELL THIS CENTRE BEFORE THE CONSULTATION PERIOD CLOSES, NOT AFTER. A MONITOR CAN ONLY RECORD WHAT IT WAS PRESENT FOR. ITS INSTITUTIONAL HISTORY MATTERS FOR HOW MUCH WEIGHT IT CARRIES: ESTABLISHED IN 2005 AS A JOINT INITIATIVE OF AN INTERNATIONAL ORGANISATION AND THE ENVIRONMENT MINISTRY, IT WAS TRANSFORMED IN 2013 INTO AN INDEPENDENT STATE ENTITY — A LEGAL ENTITY OF PUBLIC LAW — WHOSE DAILY WORK IS GUIDED BY THE CONVENTION'S PRINCIPLES OF ACCESS TO INFORMATION, PUBLIC PARTICIPATION AND ACCESS TO JUSTICE. THE CENTRE WAS INSTITUTIONALISED RATHER THAN LEFT AS A DONOR PROJECT, WHICH MEANS IT HAS STANDING AND A BUDGET LINE AND WILL PROBABLY STILL EXIST NEXT YEAR — THE OPPOSITE OF MOST OF THE PROJECT-FUNDED BODIES IN THIS FILE. IT ALSO MEANS IT IS A STATE ENTITY, WITH THE LIMITS THAT IMPLIES. THE LIMITS: IT IS NOW A STATE BODY, NOT AN INDEPENDENT ADVOCATE — it advises, informs and monitors, and it will not campaign against a government-backed project. Its counselling is legal advice, NOT REPRESENTATION: it will not appear in court for you. WHETHER THE COUNSELLING IS FREE AND WHAT IT COVERS IN PRACTICE WERE NOT VERIFIED, and this entry rests on the network's own country page rather than the centre's service pages. Civil society in this country is under sustained political pressure. Read it with the young lawyers' association, the procurement dispute board and the public information routes recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Environmental watchdog — published comments on scoping reports, suits to annul ministerial orders, and a library of its own submissions
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HAS TOLD COMMUNITIES OVER AND OVER TO OBJECT TO AN ASSESSMENT AND HAS RARELY BEEN ABLE TO SHOW THEM WHAT AN OBJECTION LOOKS LIKE. THIS ORGANISATION PUBLISHES ITS OWN, IN A LIBRARY, PROJECT BY PROJECT — FORMAL COMMENTS ON THE SCOPING REPORTS AND IMPACT ASSESSMENTS OF NAMED SCHEMES. AND THE THREE DEFECTS IT NAMES ON A TRANSNATIONAL PIPELINE ARE THE STANDARD DEFECTS OF ALMOST ANY ASSESSMENT ANYWHERE: THAT THE ALTERNATIVES WERE BARELY EXAMINED; THAT THE ASSESSMENT RESTED ON MANAGEMENT PLANS MOST OF WHICH HAD STILL TO BE DEVELOPED; AND THAT NO COMPARISON WAS GIVEN OF THE ECONOMIC COST OF EACH ROUTE ALTERNATIVE. THOSE THREE SENTENCES ARE A TEMPLATE. AN ASSESSMENT THAT PROMISES MANAGEMENT PLANS LATER IS ASKING TO BE APPROVED ON A PROMISE; ONE THAT COMPARES NO COSTS BETWEEN ROUTES HAS NOT ACTUALLY CONSIDERED THE ROUTES. CHECK ANY DOCUMENT PUT IN FRONT OF YOU FOR EXACTLY THESE THREE THINGS, AND READ THIS ORGANISATION'S SUBMISSIONS FOR THE WORDING. IT ALSO LITIGATES, AND WITH PARTNERS THIS FILE HAS ALREADY RECORDED. TOGETHER WITH THE YOUNG LAWYERS' ASSOCIATION IT WENT TO THE CITY COURT SEEKING ANNULMENT OF A MINISTERIAL ORDER THAT HAD APPROVED A TWO HUNDRED AND SIX MEGAWATT CASCADE. WITH A HUMAN RIGHTS CENTRE IT WENT TO THE SAME COURT ON BEHALF OF LOCAL RESIDENTS OVER A LARGE HYDROPOWER PROJECT. SUING TO ANNUL THE MINISTERIAL ORDER IS THE SAME MOVE THIS FILE RECORDED IN CENTRAL ASIA AS SUING TO ANNUL THE HEARING: THE TARGET IS THE PERMISSION, NOT THE CONSTRUCTION. AND ON BEHALF OF LOCAL RESIDENTS IS THE COMBINATION THAT KEEPS RECURRING — RESIDENTS SUPPLY STANDING AND FACTS, THE ORGANISATION SUPPLIES COUNSEL AND CONTINUITY. WHEN LITIGATION IS NOT THE ROUTE, IT PETITIONS — AND IT PETITIONS SEVERAL OFFICES AT ONCE. OVER A ROAD PROJECT IT ADDRESSED THE PRIME MINISTER, THE INFRASTRUCTURE MINISTER AND THE PUBLIC DEFENDER TOGETHER, ON THE HEALTH OF THE AFFECTED POPULATION AND THE INFRINGEMENT OF THEIR CONSTITUTIONAL RIGHTS. ADDRESSING THE OMBUDSMAN ALONGSIDE THE MINISTERS IS THE PART TO COPY: IT PUTS A NEUTRAL OFFICE ON NOTICE AT THE SAME MOMENT AS THE DECIDING ONES, SO THAT SILENCE FROM THE MINISTRY IS ITSELF RECORDED SOMEWHERE INDEPENDENT. ITS MINING WORK NAMES THE PATTERN PLAINLY: DECISIONS — LAWS, SUBORDINATE ACTS AND MINING LICENCES ALIKE — ARE TAKEN WITHOUT THE PARTICIPATION OF THE INTERESTED PUBLIC OR OF THE COMMUNITIES WHOSE LIVING ENVIRONMENT THEY AFFECT; AND AN INTERNATIONAL DEVELOPMENT BANK SUPPORTING THE POLICY WORK FAILED TO APPLY ITS OWN PARTICIPATION STANDARDS, WHICH REST ON THE ACCESS-TO-INFORMATION CONVENTION. THAT LAST FINDING IS USABLE ANYWHERE A DEVELOPMENT BANK IS INVOLVED: THE BANK'S OWN STANDARDS ARE A SECOND SET OF RULES, ENFORCEABLE THROUGH ITS OWN COMPLAINT CHANNELS, AND A FAILURE TO MEET THEM IS A SEPARATE GRIEVANCE FROM ANYTHING IN NATIONAL LAW. THE LIMITS: this is A RESEARCH AND ADVOCACY ORGANISATION WITH FINITE CAPACITY — it litigates selectively and usually alongside legal partners rather than alone, so an approach should say what makes a case of wider significance. SEVERAL OF THE SUBMISSIONS AND REPORTS CITED HERE ARE SOME YEARS OLD, and whether it is currently taking new matters WAS NOT VERIFIED. Civil society in this country is under sustained political pressure. Read it with the young lawyers' association, the environmental information centre and the procurement dispute board recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Regional environmental NGO network — country directories of organisations, institutional strengthening, and twenty land-management projects
trackers.desc: THE MOST USEFUL THING THIS NETWORK PUBLISHES IS A LIST OF OTHER PEOPLE. IT MAINTAINS AN ELECTRONIC BULLETIN AND NGO COUNTRY DIRECTORIES, AND ITS STATED AIM IS TO ESTABLISH AN EASILY ACCESSIBLE ENVIRONMENTAL INFORMATION SPACE ACROSS THE REGION. A COUNTRY DIRECTORY OF ENVIRONMENTAL ORGANISATIONS IS EXACTLY WHAT A COMMUNITY NEEDS AND CANNOT ASSEMBLE. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED IN SEVERAL COUNTRIES THAT THE FIRST PROBLEM IS NOT PERSUADING ANYONE BUT FINDING OUT WHO EXISTS — AND A DIRECTORY MAINTAINED BY A NETWORK IS MORE CURRENT THAN ANY SEARCH. THE ORGANISATION WAS ESTABLISHED IN 1998 BY ENVIRONMENTAL NGOs IN THREE SOUTH CAUCASUS COUNTRIES, AND OPERATES FIVE OFFICES ACROSS THE REGION WITH THIRTY FULL-TIME STAFF. IT WORKS WITH COMMUNITIES, GOVERNMENTS AND BUSINESSES ALIKE. A REGIONAL BODY WITH OFFICES IN THREE COUNTRIES MATTERS FOR A PARTICULAR KIND OF PROBLEM: A RIVER, A PIPELINE, A MINE OR A MIGRATION ROUTE THAT CROSSES A BORDER. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED A CROSS-BORDER CIVIL MOVEMENT ELSEWHERE AND NOTED THAT SUCH THINGS NEED NO PERMISSION TO EXIST — HERE ONE ALREADY DOES, WITH STAFF ON BOTH SIDES. TWO OF ITS SPECIALISMS ARE UNUSUAL AND WORTH ASKING ABOUT BY NAME. THE FIRST IS CIVIL SOCIETY DEVELOPMENT AND INSTITUTIONAL STRENGTHENING — HELP FOR ORGANISATIONS TO BECOME PROPERLY CONSTITUTED AND CAPABLE, WHICH IS THE THING FUNDERS REQUIRE AND NOBODY TEACHES. THE SECOND IS COMPLIANCE MANAGEMENT. THAT MEANS CHECKING WHETHER WHAT WAS PROMISED IS BEING DONE — THE CONDITIONS ON A PERMIT, THE COMMITMENTS IN AN ASSESSMENT, THE STANDARDS A LENDER IMPOSED. THIS FILE HAS SAID REPEATEDLY THAT PROJECTS ARE APPROVED ON PROMISES AND THAT NOBODY CHECKS THEM AFTERWARDS; COMPLIANCE MANAGEMENT IS THE NAME OF THE SKILL THAT DOES. ITS SUBSTANTIVE RECORD IS ON THE RIGHT GROUND TOO: UP TO TWENTY PROJECTS RELATED TO SUSTAINABLE LAND MANAGEMENT AND CLIMATE-SMART AGRICULTURE, ALONGSIDE DISASTER RISK REDUCTION AND WORK ON BUILDING CLIMATE-RESILIENT COMMUNITIES. DISASTER RISK REDUCTION IS A DOOR WORTH USING WHERE A DEVELOPMENT INCREASES A HAZARD. IN MOUNTAIN COUNTRIES, CUTTING A SLOPE, DIVERTING A STREAM OR CLEARING FOREST RAISES LANDSLIDE AND FLOOD RISK TO HOUSES BELOW — AND A RISK ARGUMENT REACHES AUTHORITIES THAT AN ECOLOGICAL ARGUMENT DOES NOT. ITS WORK ALSO SPANS AGRICULTURE AND RURAL DEVELOPMENT, DEMOCRACY AND GOOD GOVERNANCE, EDUCATION AND YOUTH, AND PUBLIC HEALTH — SO A REQUEST DOES NOT HAVE TO BE FRAMED AS CONSERVATION TO FIT ITS PROGRAMME. THE LIMITS: this is A PROFESSIONALISED NGO WORKING WITH GOVERNMENTS AND BUSINESSES AS WELL AS COMMUNITIES — it implements donor-funded projects, IT IS NOT A CAMPAIGNING BODY, AND IT WILL NOT LITIGATE. WHETHER IT TAKES REQUESTS FROM INDIVIDUAL COMMUNITIES OUTSIDE ITS PROJECT AREAS WAS NOT VERIFIED, AND THE DIRECTORIES AND BULLETIN DESCRIBED COME FROM AN INTERNATIONAL CLEARINGHOUSE LISTING THAT MAY BE OUT OF DATE - check they are still maintained before relying on them. Staff and office counts come from partner profiles rather than the organisation's own current pages. Read it with the environmental watchdog's published submissions, the young lawyers' association, the environmental information centre and the procurement dispute board recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Rural development agency — co-financing to plant orchards, build nurseries and cold stores, with cooperatives eligible
trackers.desc: THE PROBLEM THIS PROGRAMME NAMES IS THE ONE THIS FILE HAS RECORDED EVERYWHERE: PEOPLE CANNOT TAKE ON NEW GROUND BECAUSE THE RETURN PERIOD ON PERENNIAL CROPS IS SO LONG. THE STATE'S ANSWER IS CO-FINANCING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF ORCHARDS AND PLANTATIONS. THAT MATTERS BEYOND FARMING INCOME. AN ORCHARD IS THE CHEAPEST DURABLE PROOF THAT GROUND IS IN USE — IT IS VISIBLE FROM THE ROAD, IT IS DATED BY THE PLANTING, AND IT TAKES YEARS TO ESTABLISH, WHICH MAKES IT EXPENSIVE TO WRITE OFF AS EMPTY LAND. WHO MAY APPLY IS BROAD ENOUGH TO MATTER: A CITIZEN NATURAL PERSON OR INDIVIDUAL ENTREPRENEUR, OR AN ENTERPRISE ESTABLISHED IN THE COUNTRY INCLUDING A REGISTERED AGRICULTURAL COOPERATIVE. AND THE COOPERATIVE CONDITION IS THE DETAIL TO PLAN AROUND, BECAUSE IT SHAPES WHO CAN COMBINE: THE LAND PLOTS OWNED BY THE MEMBERS MUST BE ADJACENT AND HAVE A SINGLE PERIMETER, CONFIRMED BY CADASTRAL DOCUMENTATION. A SINGLE PERIMETER MEANS NEIGHBOURS, NOT SCATTERED RELATIVES. SO THE COOPERATIVE TO FORM IS THE ONE ALONG A CONTIGUOUS BLOCK OF GROUND — WHICH, USEFULLY, IS ALSO THE BLOCK A PROJECT WOULD HAVE TO ACQUIRE WHOLE, AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED THAT FRAGMENTED OWNERSHIP IS ACQUIRED PARCEL BY PARCEL WHILE A UNIFIED BLOCK IS HARDER TO PICK APART. THE NURSERY COMPONENT IS THE PART THAT OUTLASTS ANY ONE ORCHARD: CO-FINANCING THE CREATION OR DEVELOPMENT OF NURSERIES AND THE CREATION, EXPANSION, MODERNISATION OR RE-EQUIPPING OF IN-VITRO PLANT LABORATORIES, IN ALL MUNICIPALITIES AND SELF-GOVERNING CITIES — WITH THE STATED AIM OF INCREASING LOCAL, PHYTOSANITARILY CLEAN PLANTING MATERIAL SO THAT SEEDLINGS CHEAPER THAN IMPORTS CAN BE OFFERED. THIS FILE RECORDED A NURSERY COOPERATIVE IN ANOTHER COUNTRY THAT RAISED SEEDLING SURVIVAL FROM A QUARTER TO THREE QUARTERS. HERE THE STATE WILL PAY PART OF THE COST OF BUILDING THAT CAPACITY — SO A REGION THAT KEEPS LOSING PLANTED TREES SHOULD BE ASKING FOR A NURSERY, NOT ONLY FOR MORE SEEDLINGS. THERE IS ALSO CO-FINANCING FOR COLD STORES FOR BERRY CROPS FOR AGRICULTURAL COOPERATIVES, WHICH REQUIRES AN EXTRACT FROM THE PUBLIC REGISTER PROVING OWNERSHIP OF THE PLOT WHERE THE STORE WILL BE BUILT, AND A CERTIFICATE FROM THE AGRICULTURAL SCIENTIFIC-RESEARCH CENTRE ON THE TECHNICAL PARAMETERS AND THE STORAGE SPECIFICS OF THE PLANNED CROPS. STORAGE IS WHAT DECIDES PRICE. A COOPERATIVE THAT CAN HOLD ITS FRUIT FOR WEEKS SELLS INTO A DIFFERENT MARKET THAN ONE SELLING AT THE GATE ON HARVEST DAY — AND THIS PAYLOAD HAS FOUND ACROSS THE REGION THAT PRICE, NOT YIELD, IS WHAT DECIDES WHETHER A HOLDING SURVIVES. TWO PRACTICAL WARNINGS FROM THE PROGRAMME'S OWN PAGES: THE PLANTING DEADLINE IS FIXED BY AGRICULTURAL SEASON RATHER THAN BY CONVENIENCE, AND APPLICATION WINDOWS CLOSE AT A STATED DATE AND TIME — SO THE APPLICATION MUST BE FINISHED WEEKS BEFORE THE GROUND IS READY. THE LIMITS: this is CO-FINANCING, NOT A GRANT — THE APPLICANT MUST FIND ITS OWN SHARE, WHICH IS WHERE THE POOREST FAIL, AND THE COOPERATIVE ROUTE REQUIRES REGISTERED OWNERSHIP AND CADASTRAL DOCUMENTATION THAT MANY RURAL FAMILIES DO NOT HAVE. IT IS AN AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT AGENCY, NOT AN ADVOCATE: IT WILL NOT OPPOSE A PROJECT, AND FUNDING AN ORCHARD DOES NOT PROTECT THE GROUND UNDER IT. DEADLINES AND WINDOWS CITED COME FROM PARTICULAR PROGRAMME CYCLES AND SEVERAL OF THE PAGES CONSULTED WERE FROM EARLIER YEARS - check the current call before relying on any date. Read it with the legal aid service's administrative representation, the public defender's recommendations, the environmental watchdog and the regional NGO network recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: National mining agency — who holds the extraction licence over your ground, and who inspects its conditions
trackers.desc: WHEN A QUARRY, A MINE OR A DRILLING RIG APPEARS, THE FIRST QUESTION IS WHO HOLDS THE RIGHT AND WHAT ITS CONDITIONS ARE. THIS IS THE AGENCY THAT KNOWS: IT IS THE LEGAL SUCCESSOR OF THE ENVIRONMENT MINISTRY'S NATIONAL ENVIRONMENTAL AGENCY IN EVERYTHING CONNECTED WITH THE MANAGEMENT OF USEFUL MINERALS — INCLUDING THE CONTRACTUAL RELATIONS ATTACHED TO THEM AND THE REGULATION FEE. AND IT INHERITED THE ENFORCEMENT SIDE TOO: IT IS ALSO THE SUCCESSOR OF THE MINISTRY'S ENVIRONMENTAL SUPERVISION DEPARTMENT IN EVERYTHING CONNECTED WITH CHECKING THE CONDITIONS OF MINERAL EXTRACTION AND SUBSOIL USE LICENCES. ONE BODY THAT BOTH ISSUES AND POLICES IS A WEAKNESS AND AN OPPORTUNITY. THE WEAKNESS IS OBVIOUS. THE OPPORTUNITY IS THAT A SINGLE LETTER CAN ASK BOTH QUESTIONS AT ONCE — WHO HOLDS THE LICENCE OVER THIS GROUND, AND WHAT CONDITIONS WERE ATTACHED TO IT — AND THE SAME OFFICE IS ANSWERABLE FOR BOTH ANSWERS. THE CONDITIONS ARE WHERE COMMUNITIES WIN OR LOSE. A GOVERNMENT DECREE APPROVES THE RULE FOR CARRYING OUT STATE CONTROL WHEN CHECKING THE FULFILMENT OF THE CONDITIONS OF A MINERAL EXTRACTION OR SUBSOIL USE LICENCE — SO INSPECTION IS A DEFINED PROCEDURE, NOT A FAVOUR, AND ASKING WHEN THE LAST CHECK WAS CARRIED OUT AND WHAT IT FOUND IS A LEGITIMATE REQUEST. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED ACROSS THE REGION THAT PERMITTED OPERATIONS BREACH THEIR OWN CONDITIONS ROUTINELY — DEPTH, AREA, HOURS, DUST, HAUL ROUTES, REHABILITATION — AND THAT A BREACH OF CONDITIONS IS FAR EASIER TO ACT ON THAN AN ARGUMENT THAT THE LICENCE SHOULD NEVER HAVE BEEN GRANTED. ONE FEATURE OF THE LICENCE ITSELF EXPLAINS WHY THE NAME ON THE PAPER MAY NOT MATCH THE COMPANY ON THE GROUND: THE HOLDER IS ENTITLED TO DIVIDE THE USE LICENCE, OR TO TRANSFER IT IN WHOLE OR IN PART TO ANOTHER PERSON, INCLUDING BY INHERITANCE. SO ASK NOT ONLY WHO HOLDS THE LICENCE BUT WHETHER IT HAS BEEN DIVIDED OR TRANSFERRED, AND TO WHOM. A COMMUNITY THAT NEGOTIATED WITH ONE OPERATOR CAN FIND ITSELF FACING ANOTHER WHO NEVER MADE THOSE PROMISES. AND THERE IS A SECOND REGISTER TO CHECK, WHICH TIES THE LICENCE TO ACTUAL GROUND: THE LAND ATTACHMENT ESTABLISHED FOR SUBSOIL USE OBJECTS IS ENTERED BY THE AGENCY INTO THE STATE SUBSOIL FUND AND RECORDED, AND SUCH ATTACHMENTS ARE REGISTERED IN THE PUBLIC REGISTRY. THAT MEANS THE PUBLIC PROPERTY REGISTRY MAY SHOW A SUBSOIL ATTACHMENT OVER LAND A FAMILY THINKS IS SIMPLY THEIRS — SO WHEN CHECKING A PARCEL, ASK SPECIFICALLY WHETHER ANY SUBSOIL ATTACHMENT IS REGISTERED AGAINST IT, NOT ONLY WHO THE OWNER IS. THE LIMITS: THIS IS THE LICENSING AND SUPERVISING AUTHORITY, NOT AN ADVOCATE - IT GRANTED THE RIGHTS IT POLICES, AND IT WILL NOT OPPOSE AN OPERATION IT AUTHORISED. WHETHER IT PUBLISHES A SEARCHABLE PUBLIC REGISTER OR MAP OF LICENCES, WHAT A CITIZEN MUST DO TO OBTAIN LICENCE DETAILS, AND WHETHER INSPECTION REPORTS ARE RELEASABLE WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED - those three questions decide how usable this route is, and they should be put to the agency in writing. THE AGENCY'S FUNCTIONS COME FROM ITS OWN SITE, THE INSPECTION RULE AND THE LAND ATTACHMENT PROVISIONS FROM GOVERNMENT DECREES PUBLISHED IN THE NATIONAL LEGAL DATABASE AND A MINISTRY FILE, AND THE LICENCE TRANSFER RULE FROM THE LICENSING LAW - all of which have been amended repeatedly. Read it with the legal aid service's administrative representation, the public defender's own-initiative power, the environmental watchdog's published submissions and the rural development agency's co-financing recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Regional Environmental Centre for the Caucasus — assistance to environmental NGOs, offices in three capitals, and NGO seats on its board
trackers.desc: ITS MISSION CONTAINS A SENTENCE WORTH QUOTING IN THE FIRST LINE OF ANY APPROACH: OFFERING ASSISTANCE TO ALL ENVIRONMENTAL NGOs AND OTHER STAKEHOLDERS, DEVELOPING A FREE EXCHANGE OF INFORMATION IN LINE WITH THE PRINCIPLES OF THE AARHUS CONVENTION, AND INCREASING PUBLIC PARTICIPATION IN THE DECISION-MAKING PROCESS. ASSISTANCE TO ALL ENVIRONMENTAL NGOs IS AN OPEN DOOR WRITTEN INTO A CHARTER. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED MANY BODIES THAT HELP THEIR OWN MEMBERS OR THEIR OWN GRANTEES; ONE WHOSE STATED PURPOSE IS TO ASSIST ANY ENVIRONMENTAL ORGANISATION IN THE REGION IS A DIFFERENT PROPOSITION FOR A VILLAGE GROUP WITH NO CONNECTIONS. ITS STANDING COMES FROM ITS FOUNDING: AN INDEPENDENT NON-PROFIT ESTABLISHED IN 1999 WITHIN THE ENVIRONMENT FOR EUROPE PROCESS BY THE GOVERNMENTS OF AZERBAIJAN, ARMENIA AND GEORGIA TOGETHER WITH THE EUROPEAN UNION, WITH ITS CHARTER SIGNED THAT SEPTEMBER — AND HEADQUARTERS IN TBILISI WITH COUNTRY OFFICES IN YEREVAN AND BAKU. THREE CAPITALS MATTERS IN A REGION WHERE BORDERS ARE CLOSED AND TWO OF THE FOUNDING STATES HAVE BEEN AT WAR. A BODY THAT STILL OPERATES IN ALL THREE IS ONE OF THE FEW PLACES WHERE A COMMUNITY IN ONE COUNTRY CAN REACH EXPERTISE OR ALLIES IN ANOTHER. THE BOARD COMPOSITION IS THE PART A COMMUNITY CAN ACTUALLY USE: IT IS DIRECTED BY A BOARD COMPRISING REPRESENTATIVES FROM THE GOVERNMENTS OF THE THREE FOUNDING STATES, REPRESENTATIVES OF NGOs FROM ALL THREE STATES, A DONOR REPRESENTATIVE AND A SCIENCE OR BUSINESS REPRESENTATIVE. NGO SEATS ON A BOARD THAT ALSO SEATS THREE GOVERNMENTS AND A DONOR IS A ROUTE UPWARD. FIND WHICH ORGANISATION HOLDS YOUR COUNTRY'S NGO SEAT AND PUT YOUR CASE TO IT — THAT IS A SHORTER PATH TO A MINISTER THAN ANY LETTER, AND THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED THE SAME LOGIC IN THE RESOURCE TRANSPARENCY BOARDS OF TWO OTHER COUNTRIES. IT HAS MONEY HISTORY TOO, AND THE SHAPE OF IT IS INSTRUCTIVE: IT INITIATED A SMALL GRANTS PROGRAMME AND FUNDED FIFTEEN PROJECTS RANGING FROM AWARENESS AND EDUCATION TO LOW-COST POLLUTION REDUCTION AND ENVIRONMENTAL IMPROVEMENTS IN LOCAL ENVIRONMENTAL ACTION PLAN CITIES — INCLUDING SMALL GRANTS FOR LOCAL GOVERNMENTS TO ENCOURAGE PARTNERSHIP WITH BUSINESS OR NGOs, AS WELL AS GRANTS FOR NGOs — WITH PROJECTS ADDRESSING DRINKING WATER SUPPLY AND IRRIGATION SYSTEMS. GRANTS TO LOCAL GOVERNMENTS CONDITIONAL ON PARTNERING WITH NGOs IS THE MODEL TO ASK FOR BY NAME. IT GIVES A MAYOR A REASON TO WORK WITH A COMMUNITY GROUP RATHER THAN AROUND IT — AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED REPEATEDLY THAT THE MUNICIPALITY IS THE BODY THAT DECIDES MOST LAND QUESTIONS. A SEPARATE PROGRAMME ASSISTED COASTAL COMMUNITIES TO DEVELOP ALTERNATIVE AND SUSTAINABLE SOURCES OF LIVELIHOOD, WHICH IS THE FRAMING TO USE WHERE A COMMUNITY IS BEING ASKED TO GIVE UP AN EXISTING USE. AND ITS TECHNICAL LINE IS DIRECTLY RELEVANT TO STOPPING PROJECTS: IT HAS RUN STRATEGIC ENVIRONMENTAL ASSESSMENT CAPACITY BUILDING IN THE SOUTH CAUCASUS, AND SUB-REGIONAL TRAINING FOR INSPECTORATES ON IMPROVING ENVIRONMENTAL COMPLIANCE ASSURANCE. STRATEGIC ENVIRONMENTAL ASSESSMENT IS THE STAGE AT WHICH PLANS AND PROGRAMMES ARE TESTED BEFORE INDIVIDUAL PROJECTS ARE EVEN PROPOSED. A BODY THAT TRAINED THE REGION'S OFFICIALS IN IT IS THE ONE TO ASK WHETHER A PLAN AFFECTING YOUR AREA SHOULD HAVE HAD ONE. THE LIMITS: THIS IS AN INTERGOVERNMENTAL CREATION - ITS FOUNDERS AND BOARD INCLUDE THE THREE GOVERNMENTS, SO IT IS A NEUTRAL PLATFORM AND CATALYST BY ITS OWN DESCRIPTION, NOT AN ADVOCATE AGAINST A STATE PROJECT. THE GRANT PROGRAMMES DESCRIBED ARE HISTORICAL - THEY BELONG TO NAMED PAST PROJECTS AND THE SITE PAGES READ AS AN ORGANISATIONAL HISTORY, SO WHETHER ANY GRANT WINDOW IS OPEN NOW WAS NOT ESTABLISHED AND MUST BE ASKED. ITS RECENT PUBLIC ACTIVITY VISIBLE IN THIS SEARCH RAN TO 2023 AND 2024, SO CURRENT CAPACITY IS UNCONFIRMED. Read it with the legal aid service's administrative representation, the public defender's own-initiative power, the national mining agency and the rural development agency's co-financing recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Independent Accountability Mechanism of the US development finance agency — it hears project workers too, and accepts a non-local representative
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE FIFTH DEVELOPMENT FINANCE COMPLAINT OFFICE IN THIS FILE, AND IT IS SHAPED DIFFERENTLY IN THREE WAYS THAT MATTER. FIRST, WHO IT SERVES: PROJECT-AFFECTED COMMUNITIES, PROJECT SPONSORS AND PROJECT WORKERS. PROJECT WORKERS. NO OTHER OFFICE RECORDED HERE NAMES THEM — AND THE PEOPLE BUILDING A DAM OR A PLANT OFTEN KNOW BEFORE ANYONE ELSE WHAT IS BEING POURED INTO THE RIVER, WHAT THE SURVEY REALLY SHOWED AND WHOSE LAND WAS CLEARED WITHOUT NOTICE. SECOND, THE GROUNDS REACH FURTHER: CONCERNS ABOUT ADVERSE ENVIRONMENTAL, SOCIAL, WORKER RIGHTS OR HUMAN RIGHTS IMPACTS OF A SUPPORTED PROJECT. HUMAN RIGHTS NAMED EXPLICITLY IS RARE IN THIS FAMILY OF MECHANISMS. WHERE A CLEARANCE INVOLVED INTIMIDATION, DETENTION OR THE SILENCING OF OBJECTORS, THAT IS ARGUABLE HERE RATHER THAN HAVING TO BE DRESSED AS AN ENVIRONMENTAL COMPLAINT. THIRD, AND MOST USEFUL WHERE ORGANISING IS DANGEROUS: WHERE THERE IS CLEAR EVIDENCE THAT THERE IS NO ADEQUATE OR APPROPRIATE REPRESENTATION IN THE COUNTRY WHERE THE PROJECT IS LOCATED, AND EXPLICIT EVIDENCE OF REPRESENTATIVE AUTHORITY IS PROVIDED, A NON-LOCAL REPRESENTATIVE MAY FILE THE REQUEST. THAT LETS AN ORGANISATION ABROAD CARRY A COMMUNITY'S CASE WHEN NO ONE INSIDE THE COUNTRY CAN SAFELY DO IT. THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED COUNTRIES WHERE INDEPENDENT ORGANISATION BARELY EXISTS; THIS IS THE ONLY MECHANISM SO FAR THAT WRITES A ROUTE AROUND THAT PROBLEM INTO ITS RULES. THE TWO SERVICES ARE THE FAMILIAR PAIR — HELPING THE PARTIES RESOLVE A CONFLICT, AND INVESTIGATING HOW THE AGENCY APPLIED ITS POLICIES — BUT THE FREEDOM IS GREATER: REQUESTS CAN BE MADE FOR PROBLEM-SOLVING OR COMPLIANCE REVIEW, BOTH OF THEM, AND IN EITHER ORDER, AND IF YOU ARE UNCERTAIN YOUR REQUEST NEED NOT SPECIFY, BECAUSE THE OFFICE OFFERS GUIDANCE. COMPARE THAT WITH THE PRIVATE-SECTOR OMBUDSMAN RECORDED SEPARATELY IN THIS FILE, WHICH REQUIRES ANYONE WANTING BOTH TO TRY DISPUTE RESOLUTION FIRST. HERE THE ORDER IS YOURS — SO A COMMUNITY CAN SEEK A FINDING AND STILL NEGOTIATE AFTERWARDS. THE OFFICE IS INDEPENDENT IN STRUCTURE AS WELL AS NAME: CREATED IN 2005, MANDATED BY THE STATUTE THAT ESTABLISHED THE AGENCY, OPERATING SEPARATELY FROM ITS FINANCING OPERATIONS, WITH ITS DIRECTOR REPORTING DIRECTLY TO THE BOARD. ON CONFIDENTIALITY THE RULES ARE THE SAME AS ELSEWHERE AND SHOULD BE FOLLOWED EXACTLY: COMMUNITY MEMBERS WORRIED ABOUT DISCLOSURE CAN ASK FOR THEIR DETAILS TO BE KEPT CONFIDENTIAL, THE REQUEST MUST BE MADE AT THE TIME OF FILING WITH A REASON, AND ANONYMOUS REQUESTS ARE NOT ACCEPTED. THE TIMING RULE IS THE ONE TO ACT ON QUICKLY, BECAUSE IT IS TIGHTER THAN THE OTHERS: A PROJECT IS SUPPORTED FROM WHEN THE AGENCY CLEARLY INDICATES INTEREST IN FINANCING OR INSURING IT — ORDINARILY WHEN A COMMITMENT LETTER IS ISSUED OR AN INSURANCE CONTRACT SIGNED — AND SUPPORT ENDS WITH FINAL DISBURSEMENT. SO THE WINDOW CLOSES WHEN THE LAST MONEY IS PAID OUT, NOT YEARS LATER. IF A PROJECT NEAR YOU IS FINANCED THIS WAY, THE TIME TO FILE IS WHILE CONSTRUCTION MONEY IS STILL FLOWING — WHICH IS ALSO WHEN THE AGENCY HAS THE MOST LEVERAGE OVER ITS CLIENT. WHAT IT WILL NOT TAKE: REQUESTS FROM INELIGIBLE REQUESTERS OR WITHOUT THE MINIMUM INFORMATION, CONCERNS ABOUT CORRUPTION OR OTHER CRIMINAL ACTIVITIES, AND ANYTHING FROM COMMERCIAL COMPETITORS TO THE PROJECT. FILING IS ORDINARY: BY EMAIL TO A PUBLISHED ACCOUNTABILITY ADDRESS, BY A REQUEST FORM SENT AS AN ATTACHMENT, OR BY LETTER TO THE AGENCY'S OFFICES, WITH A DOWNLOADABLE TEMPLATE PROVIDED. THE LIMITS: THIS REACHES ONLY PROJECTS THIS ONE AGENCY FINANCES OR INSURES, AND IT REVIEWS HOW THE AGENCY APPLIED ITS POLICIES - IT DOES NOT DISCIPLINE THE COMPANY OR THE GOVERNMENT AND CANNOT ORDER COMPENSATION OR STOP A PROJECT. THE PROBLEM-SOLVING WINDOW ENDS AT FINAL DISBURSEMENT, WHICH IS EARLIER THAN EVERY OTHER MECHANISM RECORDED HERE. ITS POLICY FRAMEWORK HAS BEEN UNDER DEVELOPMENT AND A DRAFT TERMS OF REFERENCE WAS STILL OUT FOR COMMENT IN 2024, SO PROCEDURES MAY HAVE CHANGED. THE AGENCY IS AN INSTRUMENT OF ONE GOVERNMENT'S FOREIGN POLICY, WHICH SHAPES WHICH PROJECTS EXIST TO COMPLAIN ABOUT AND MAY MAKE COMPLAINING POLITICALLY SENSITIVE IN SOME COUNTRIES IN THIS PAYLOAD. Read it with the legal aid service's administrative representation, the national mining agency, the regional environmental centre and the rural development agency recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Global crowdfunding platform for nonprofits — open to any registered organisation, with a forty-donor entry test
trackers.desc: THIS FILE RECORDS NO WAY OF RAISING MONEY AT ALL FOR FIVE OF ITS TWENTY-THREE COUNTRIES. THIS PLATFORM IS OPEN TO ALL OF THEM: ANY REGISTERED NONPROFIT, ANYWHERE IN THE WORLD, IS ELIGIBLE TO APPLY — PROVIDED IT CAN SHOW A TRACK RECORD OF PROJECT IMPLEMENTATION AND PASS A DUE DILIGENCE PROCESS. THE ENTRY TEST IS THE PART TO PLAN AROUND, AND IT IS NOT ABOUT WRITING: AN ACCELERATOR PROGRAMME PUTS THE ORGANISATION INTO A CAMPAIGN, TYPICALLY THREE WEEKS, IN WHICH IT MUST RAISE AT LEAST FIVE THOUSAND DOLLARS FROM A MINIMUM OF FORTY DIFFERENT DONORS TO GRADUATE AND SECURE A PERMANENT FUNDRAISING SPOT. FORTY DIFFERENT DONORS MATTERS MORE THAN THE FIVE THOUSAND DOLLARS. ONE WEALTHY BACKER WILL NOT GET YOU THROUGH — THE TEST IS WHETHER FORTY PEOPLE WILL GIVE, WHICH FOR A VILLAGE ASSOCIATION MEANS THE DIASPORA, FORMER RESIDENTS, TEACHERS, TRADERS AND FRIENDS ABROAD. LIST THEM BEFORE APPLYING; THAT LIST IS THE APPLICATION. WHAT GRADUATION BUYS IS ONGOING RATHER THAN ONE-OFF: PERMANENT MEMBERSHIP WITH CONTINUING OPPORTUNITIES TO ATTRACT NEW CORPORATE AND INDIVIDUAL DONORS, INCLUSION IN A PRESS RELEASE, A CUSTOM MEDIA KIT AND FURTHER PROMOTION FOR TOP PERFORMERS — PLUS A BONUS DAY IN WHICH PARTICIPANTS COMPETE FOR A SHARE OF A TWENTY THOUSAND DOLLAR INCENTIVE FUND AND TWO THOUSAND-DOLLAR PRIZES. THE COSTS ARE STATED PLAINLY AND SHOULD BE BUDGETED: NO APPLICATION FEE AND NO SUBSCRIPTION FEE, BUT THE PLATFORM RETAINS A NONPROFIT SUPPORT FEE OF FIVE TO TWELVE PER CENT ON DONATIONS PLUS A THREE PER CENT PROCESSING FEE, WITH ONE ACCOUNT RECORDING TWELVE PLUS THREE ON THE FIRST FIVE THOUSAND. SO ROUGHLY A SEVENTH OF EARLY MONEY GOES IN FEES. THAT IS THE PRICE OF REACHING DONORS OUTSIDE THE COUNTRY — WORTH IT WHERE NO DOMESTIC FUNDING EXISTS, AND NOT WORTH IT WHERE A LOCAL BENEFACTOR WOULD GIVE DIRECTLY. THE ROUTE IN IS SLOWER THAN IT LOOKS AND SHOULD BE STARTED EARLY: AN ONBOARDING PROGRAMME BEGINS WITH AN INTEREST SURVEY THAT IS NOT ITSELF AN APPLICATION, SMALL COHORTS ARE INVITED EVERY TWO MONTHS, AND A DIGITAL FUNDRAISING-READY WORKBOOK MUST BE COMPLETED BEFORE THE DUE DILIGENCE APPLICATION EVEN OPENS. THE DOCUMENTS ASKED OF ORGANISATIONS OUTSIDE THE UNITED STATES ARE ORDINARY: LEGAL DOCUMENTS, FINANCIAL RECORDS, PROGRAMME MATERIALS SHOWING WHAT YOU DO AND WHOM YOU HELP, LISTS OF SENIOR STAFF AND BOARD MEMBERS, AND A LETTER OF REFERENCE FROM A SUPPORTER. AND ONE DETAIL REMOVES A BARRIER THIS FILE HAS SEEN DEFEAT APPLICANTS REPEATEDLY: WHERE DOCUMENTS ARE NOT IN ENGLISH, TRANSLATIONS ARE REQUIRED BUT UNOFFICIAL ONES ARE ACCEPTED, INCLUDING MACHINE TRANSLATIONS. THE OBLIGATIONS AFTERWARDS ARE REAL: QUARTERLY PROJECT REPORTS, EMAILED TO DONORS AND PUBLISHED ON THE PROJECT PAGE, AND A FULL DUE DILIGENCE RENEWAL EVERY TWO YEARS. THOSE QUARTERLY REPORTS ARE ALSO A PUBLIC, DATED RECORD OF WHAT HAPPENED ON THE GROUND, HOSTED OUTSIDE THE COUNTRY — THE SAME SECOND FUNCTION THIS FILE HAS NOTED FOR OTHER REPORTING REQUIREMENTS, AND WORTH WRITING WITH THAT IN MIND. THE LIMITS: ONLY REGISTERED ORGANISATIONS WITH A TRACK RECORD QUALIFY - AN INFORMAL VILLAGE COMMITTEE CANNOT JOIN, AND THE PLATFORM SAYS PLAINLY THAT MEMBERSHIP DOES NOT AUTOMATICALLY BRING DONORS. VETTING INCLUDES COMPLIANCE WITH ANTI-TERROR AND INTERNATIONAL PHILANTHROPY GUIDELINES, WHICH CAN EXCLUDE ORGANISATIONS IN SANCTIONED OR CONFLICT-AFFECTED COUNTRIES RECORDED IN THIS PAYLOAD. RECEIVING FOREIGN DONATIONS IS RESTRICTED OR POLITICALLY DANGEROUS IN SEVERAL OF THESE COUNTRIES, AND A PUBLIC PROJECT PAGE NAMING A DISPUTE MAY ITSELF CARRY RISK. THE FEE FIGURES AND ACCELERATOR TERMS COME FROM THE PLATFORM'S OWN PAGES AND SUPPORT ARTICLES ALONGSIDE THIRD-PARTY FUNDING DIRECTORIES, AND TERMS CHANGE - check the current pages before planning a campaign. Read it with the regional environmental centre's NGO board seats, the legal aid service's administrative representation, the national mining agency and the rural development agency's co-financing recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Certified valuers — the published list with certificate numbers, the accredited body that certifies them, and the grounds for revoking one
trackers.desc: MOST LAND CASES IN THIS FILE END IN AN ARGUMENT ABOUT MONEY, AND A STATE FIGURE CAN ONLY BE MET WITH ANOTHER FIGURE. THIS IS WHERE THE PEOPLE WHO PRODUCE THAT SECOND FIGURE ARE FOUND: THE CERTIFICATION SCHEME PROVIDES FOR A LIST OF CERTIFIED MEMBERS SHOWING NAME AND SURNAME AND CERTIFICATE NUMBER. A CERTIFICATE NUMBER IS THE PART TO WRITE DOWN. IT LETS A HOUSEHOLD CHECK THAT THE PERSON VALUING ITS LAND IS ACTUALLY CERTIFIED, AND IT LETS THE SAME CHECK BE RUN ON WHOEVER PRODUCED THE OFFER THEY ARE DISPUTING. WHAT THE QUALIFICATION MEANS IS DEFINED RATHER THAN ASSUMED: A CERTIFIED VALUER IS A PERSON WHO KNOWS, UNDERSTANDS AND CAN CORRECTLY APPLY THE RECOGNISED METHODS AND RULES NECESSARY TO REACH A RELIABLE VALUATION, WHO HAS SUCCESSFULLY COMPLETED THE CERTIFICATION PROGRAMME AND HOLDS THE CORRESPONDING CERTIFICATE. AND THE CHAIN BEHIND IT IS CHECKABLE: THE CERTIFYING BODY IS A LEGAL PERSON ACCREDITED BY THE UNIFIED NATIONAL ACCREDITATION BODY, WHICH CERTIFIES INDIVIDUALS AND MONITORS WHETHER THE ACTIVITY OF THOSE IT CERTIFIED CONFORMS TO THE REQUIREMENTS, WITH RECERTIFICATION CONFIRMING QUALIFICATION ONCE A CERTIFICATE EXPIRES. THIS FILE SPENT SEVERAL ROUNDS LEARNING TO ASK WHO ACCREDITS THE LABORATORY. THE SAME QUESTION APPLIES TO THE VALUER, AND HERE IT HAS THE SAME ANSWER: A NATIONAL ACCREDITATION BODY SITS BEHIND THE CERTIFICATE. THE GROUNDS FOR TAKING A CERTIFICATE AWAY ARE THE MOST USEFUL PART FOR ANYONE FACING A VALUATION THEY BELIEVE IS DISHONEST: A CERTIFICATE IS CANCELLED WHERE THE DEFECT COMMITTED CANNOT BE REMEDIED; WHERE THE DEFECT WAS CAUSED BY THE VALUER'S BAD-FAITH CONDUCT; WHERE THE VALUER DISREGARDS THE STANDARD AND THE REQUIREMENTS OF THE CERTIFICATION BODY; AND WHERE THE CERTIFICATE HAS BEEN SUSPENDED THREE TIMES. BAD-FAITH CONDUCT AND DISREGARD OF THE STANDARD ARE NAMED GROUNDS, WHICH MEANS A COMPLAINT ABOUT A VALUATION HAS AN ADDRESS: THE BODY THAT ISSUED THE CERTIFICATE AND MONITORS THE HOLDER. THAT IS A CHEAPER FIRST STEP THAN LITIGATION AND IT PUTS THE VALUER'S OWN LICENCE IN QUESTION RATHER THAN JUST THE NUMBER. KNOW WHICH SCHEME APPLIES BEFORE HIRING: THERE ARE SEPARATE CERTIFICATION SCHEMES FOR IMMOVABLE PROPERTY VALUATION AND FOR MOVABLE PROPERTY VALUATION, EACH WITH RULES GOVERNING THE EXAMINATIONS THROUGH WHICH THE QUALIFICATION IS AWARDED. THE MARKET SIDE IS ORDINARY AND CHEAP ENOUGH TO MATTER: AN APPRAISERS' UNION OFFERS VALUATION OF IMMOVABLE PROPERTY, MOVABLE PROPERTY AND BUSINESSES TO BOTH LEGAL AND NATURAL PERSONS, AND COMMERCIAL LISTINGS ADVERTISE CERTIFIED REAL-ESTATE VALUATION FROM AROUND A HUNDRED LARI NATIONWIDE, FOR PURPOSES THAT EXPLICITLY INCLUDE COURT DISPUTES. A HUNDRED LARI IS LESS THAN A DAY'S LEGAL FEE ANYWHERE IN THIS PAYLOAD. SEVERAL HOUSEHOLDS FACING THE SAME SCHEME CAN SHARE ONE VALUER ACROSS SEVERAL PLOTS, AND A VALUATION OBTAINED FOR COURT PURPOSES BEFORE AN OFFER IS ACCEPTED IS WORTH MORE THAN ANY AMOUNT OF ARGUING AFTERWARDS. THE LIMITS: A VALUER IS A PAID PROFESSIONAL, NOT AN ALLY - THE SAME CERTIFIED PEOPLE VALUE FOR BANKS, DEVELOPERS AND THE STATE, AND SOME WILL NOT ACT AGAINST A REPEAT CLIENT, SO ASK DIRECTLY WHO ELSE THEY WORK FOR. WHETHER THE LIST OF CERTIFIED VALUERS IS PUBLISHED OPENLY ONLINE, AND WHERE, WAS NOT ESTABLISHED - THE SCHEME PROVIDES FOR THE LIST, WHICH IS NOT THE SAME AS SEEING IT. WHETHER A PRIVATE VALUATION IS ADMITTED IN AN EXPROPRIATION OR COMPENSATION PROCEEDING, AND WHAT WEIGHT IT CARRIES AGAINST A STATE-COMMISSIONED ONE, WERE NOT ESTABLISHED EITHER AND ARE THE QUESTIONS FOR A LAWYER. THE HUNDRED-LARI FIGURE COMES FROM A COMMERCIAL SERVICES LISTING, NOT A TARIFF, AND THE SCHEME TEXTS COME FROM CERTIFICATION BODIES' OWN PAGES. Read it with the national agency of public registry's records, the regional environmental centre's NGO board seats, the legal aid service's administrative representation and the crowdfunding platform recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Village support programme — money to each village by population, with the projects chosen at the settlement's own assembly
trackers.desc: A COVERAGE COUNT PUT THIS COUNTRY AMONG THE THREE WEAKEST FOR LOCAL-LEVEL RESOURCES. THIS IS AS LOCAL AS STATE MONEY GETS: A VILLAGE SUPPORT PROGRAMME IN THE STATE BUDGET UNDER WHICH THE POPULATION OF A VILLAGE AGREES AT ASSEMBLIES ON THE VILLAGE'S NEEDS, AND THE WORKS ARE THEN PROCURED WITH THE PROGRAMME'S HELP. THE ASSEMBLY DECIDES, NOT THE OFFICE. GENERAL ASSEMBLIES OF THE SETTLEMENT AND CONSULTATIONS ARE HELD IN THE ADMINISTRATIVE UNITS FOR THE PURPOSE OF SELECTING WHICH PROJECTS ARE FINANCED - WHICH MAKES THIS ONE OF THE VERY FEW PUBLIC FUNDS IN THIS ENTIRE PAYLOAD WHERE THE SPENDING DECISION IS TAKEN IN A ROOM A VILLAGER CAN WALK INTO. THE SHARE IS NOT DISCRETIONARY EITHER: EACH VILLAGE RECEIVES THE SUM FOR CARRYING OUT AN INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECT ACCORDING TO THE SIZE OF ITS POPULATION. A POPULATION-BASED FORMULA MEANS THE QUESTION IS NEVER WHETHER YOUR VILLAGE GETS MONEY BUT WHAT IT IS SPENT ON. THAT IS AN ENTIRELY DIFFERENT ARGUMENT, AND IT IS WON BY TURNING UP TO ONE MEETING. THE TIMETABLE IS PUBLISHED AND SHORT, WHICH IS WHY IT IS MISSED: IN ONE MUNICIPALITY'S 2026 CYCLE, PRELIMINARY PROJECT PROPOSALS WERE RECEIVED UP TO AND INCLUDING THE NINTH OF FEBRUARY, MEETINGS WITH THE POPULATION BEGAN ON THE TENTH, AND THE PROGRAMME WAS REPORTED COMPLETE IN EARLY MARCH. PROPOSALS CLOSE BEFORE THE MEETINGS START. A COMMUNITY THAT WAITS FOR THE MEETING TO SUGGEST SOMETHING HAS ALREADY MISSED THE STAGE THAT MATTERS - THE PROPOSAL GOES IN FIRST, IN WRITING, IN THE WEEKS BEFORE. WHO SITS IN THOSE MEETINGS IS WORTH KNOWING BEFORE ATTENDING: IN ONE MUNICIPALITY THEY WERE ATTENDED BY THE MAYOR WITH HIS DEPUTIES, THE DEPUTY CHAIRS OF THE COUNCIL AND REPRESENTATIVES OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT, ACROSS NAMED ADMINISTRATIVE UNITS. THAT IS THE ENTIRE LOCAL EXECUTIVE IN ONE ROOM, IN YOUR VILLAGE, ONCE A YEAR. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED COMMUNITIES SPENDING MONTHS TRYING TO REACH ONE OFFICIAL - HERE THEY COME TO THE VILLAGE, AND A LAND OR WATER PROBLEM CAN BE RAISED IN FRONT OF ALL OF THEM AT ONCE. THE PROGRAMME IS NOT SMALL: A MINISTRY PAGE RECORDS THREE THOUSAND THREE HUNDRED AND ONE PROJECTS PROCURED WITH FOUR HUNDRED AND SIXTY-FIVE COMPLETED, AND UP TO FORTY MILLION IN NATIONAL CURRENCY ALLOCATED. AND ITS KNOWN WEAKNESS IS THE MOST USEFUL THING TO ARRIVE ARMED WITH: PUBLIC-INTEREST REPORTING ON AN EARLIER ROUND NOTED THE FINANCING OF UNSUSTAINABLE PROJECTS - FOR EXAMPLE GRAVELLING WORK ALONE, WHICH REQUIRED THE SAME WORKS AGAIN THE FOLLOWING YEAR. A VILLAGE THAT PROPOSES SOMETHING WHICH LASTS - A WATER LINE, A CULVERT, A FENCE AROUND A SPRING, TREES ON AN ERODING SLOPE - IS PROPOSING THE FIX TO A PROBLEM THE PROGRAMME ITSELF HAS ADMITTED. THAT IS A STRONGER PITCH THAN NEED ALONE, AND IT PUTS DURABLE INFRASTRUCTURE ON GROUND A COMMUNITY WANTS TO KEEP. THE LIMITS: THIS IS INFRASTRUCTURE MONEY DECIDED ANNUALLY, NOT LAND OR LEGAL FUNDING - IT WILL NOT BUY GROUND, PAY A LAWYER OR STOP A PROJECT, AND THE SUMS PER VILLAGE ARE SMALL. THE ASSEMBLY'S DECISION IS TAKEN INSIDE A MUNICIPAL PROCESS: WHO MAY ATTEND, WHETHER A QUORUM IS REQUIRED, HOW DISAGREEMENTS ARE RESOLVED AND WHETHER THE MINUTES ARE PUBLISHED WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED, AND THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS ELSEWHERE THAT SUCH MEETINGS CAN BE CONVENED THINLY AND MINUTED SELECTIVELY. THE DATES AND THE ATTENDANCE COME FROM TWO INDIVIDUAL MUNICIPALITIES' OWN 2026 NOTICES AND WILL DIFFER ELSEWHERE - EVERY MUNICIPALITY PUBLISHES ITS OWN CALENDAR, SO THE LOCAL ONE IS THE ONLY ONE THAT MATTERS. THE PROJECT AND MONEY TOTALS COME FROM A MINISTRY PAGE OF UNCERTAIN DATE, AND THE CRITICISM FROM A BROADCASTER'S REPORT ON AN EARLIER ROUND OF THE RULES. Read it with the certified valuers and certification scheme, the biodiversity centre's community rangers, the valley movement and the crowdfunding platform recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Regional local democracy agency — trains councils and community groups together, partners the lawyers' association branch, and sat on a city spatial plan working group
trackers.desc: THE MOST USEFUL THING ABOUT THIS ORGANISATION IS WHO IT SITS WITH: ITS LOCAL PARTNERS ARE THE CITY THAT HOSTS IT, THE CAPITAL CITY, THE NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF LOCAL AUTHORITIES OF THE COUNTRY, AND THE LOCAL BRANCH OF THE YOUNG LAWYERS' ASSOCIATION - THE LAST OF WHICH THIS PAYLOAD ALREADY RECORDS SEPARATELY AS A FREE LEGAL AID PROVIDER. A REGIONAL AGENCY THAT WORKS WITH BOTH THE MUNICIPALITIES' ASSOCIATION AND THE LAWYERS' ASSOCIATION IS A BRIDGE BETWEEN THE TWO THINGS A COMMUNITY NEEDS AND CANNOT USUALLY GET TOGETHER: ACCESS TO THE COUNCIL AND ACCESS TO COUNSEL. IT IS NOT NEW OR SMALL: IT HAS OPERATED FROM THE COUNTRY'S SECOND CITY SINCE 2007 AND IMPLEMENTED MORE THAN FIFTY PROJECTS PROMOTING LOCAL DEVELOPMENT IN A DEMOCRATIC AND INCLUSIVE SOCIETY, INCLUDING INITIATIVES TO SUPPORT AND INTEGRATE INTERNALLY DISPLACED PEOPLE BASED IN THAT CITY. ITS MANDATE IS EXPLICITLY TWO-SIDED: CAPACITY-BUILDING PROGRAMMES FOR LOCAL AUTHORITIES AND FOR NON-GOVERNMENTAL ORGANISATIONS, PROMOTING ACTIVE CITIZENSHIP AND GOOD GOVERNANCE, PROMOTING WOMEN'S AND YOUTH RIGHTS, AND SUPPORTING CROSS-BORDER AND REGIONAL COOPERATION. TRAINING THE COUNCIL AND THE COMMUNITY GROUP IN THE SAME ROOM IS RARE AND VALUABLE. IT MEANS THE OFFICIALS A VILLAGE HAS TO PERSUADE HAVE SAT THROUGH THE SAME SESSIONS ON PARTICIPATION THAT THE VILLAGE HAS. THE SCALE OF THAT TRAINING IS DOCUMENTED: IN A JOINT PROJECT WITH THE NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF LOCAL AUTHORITIES AND A EUROPEAN ASSOCIATION, A CASCADE APPROACH CREATED A GROUP OF TRAINERS IN THE SOUTH-EAST AND ANOTHER IN THE NORTH-WEST, WHO THEN APPROACHED AND COACHED HUNDREDS OF NON-GOVERNMENTAL ORGANISATIONS AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT REPRESENTATIVES IN PRACTICES OF CITIZENS' PARTICIPATION. THERE ARE THEREFORE TRAINED PEOPLE IN TWO REGIONS OF THE COUNTRY WHO ALREADY KNOW HOW THIS WORKS. ASKING WHO THEY ARE IS FASTER THAN LEARNING IT FROM SCRATCH. THE PRECEDENT MOST WORTH COPYING IS ABOUT A PLAN: BY ORDER OF THE MAYOR OF THAT CITY, A SPECIAL WORKING GROUP WAS CREATED TO OVERSEE THE DEVELOPMENT OF THE CITY SPATIAL URBAN DEVELOPMENT PLAN AND ALL RELATED DOCUMENTS, CONSISTING OF ALL MAJOR STAKEHOLDERS AND REPRESENTATIVES OF DIFFERENT SEGMENTS OF SOCIETY INCLUDING LOCAL ADMINISTRATION, FIELD EXPERTS, YOUTH, ACADEMIA AND CIVIL SOCIETY ORGANISATIONS. A SPATIAL PLAN DECIDES WHAT MAY BE BUILT WHERE FOR A DECADE. A MAYORAL ORDER PUTTING CIVIL SOCIETY ONTO THE GROUP THAT OVERSEES ITS DRAFTING IS THE SINGLE BEST MOMENT TO BE INSIDE - AND IT IS A PRECEDENT THAT CAN BE NAMED WHEN ANOTHER CITY BEGINS ITS OWN PLAN. THERE IS ALSO A CURRENT PROGRAMME TO ATTACH TO: A EUROPEAN ORGANISATION'S PROJECT RUNNING INTO 2026 SUPPORTS LOCAL AUTHORITIES, THEIR NATIONAL ASSOCIATION AND CIVIL SOCIETY ORGANISATIONS TO BETTER ENGAGE CITIZENS, TO ACTIVELY USE EXISTING PARTICIPATORY FORMS AND TO PILOT AND INSTITUTIONALISE INNOVATIVE CITIZEN PARTICIPATION MECHANISMS - THROUGH CASCADE TRAININGS, EXPERT SUPPORT, PEER EXCHANGES AND SUPPORT TO LOCAL INITIATIVES AND PARTNERSHIPS, WITH WOMEN, YOUTH AND VULNERABLE GROUPS PRIORITISED. SUPPORT TO LOCAL INITIATIVES AND PARTNERSHIPS IS A FUNDING LINE FOR SOMETHING A COMMUNITY ALREADY WANTS TO DO, AND THE PROGRAMME RESTS ON A CHARTER OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT AND ITS ADDITIONAL PROTOCOL ON THE RIGHT TO PARTICIPATE IN THE AFFAIRS OF A LOCAL AUTHORITY - A STANDARD WORTH NAMING WHEN A COUNCIL REFUSES TO CONSULT. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A CAPACITY-BUILDING AND CIVIC ORGANISATION, NOT A LAND, LEGAL OR CAMPAIGNING ONE - IT TRAINS, CONVENES AND RUNS PROJECTS, AND NOTHING RECORDED HERE SHOWS IT OPPOSING A DEVELOPMENT OR REPRESENTING ANYONE IN A DISPUTE; ITS CLOSENESS TO MUNICIPALITIES AND TO ITS HOST CITY IS THE SOURCE OF ITS ACCESS AND ALSO ITS LIMIT. IT IS PROJECT-FUNDED THROUGH EUROPEAN PARTNERS, SO ITS ACTIVITIES DEPEND ON WHICH PROJECT IS RUNNING, AND ITS PROFILE MATERIAL IS DRAWN FROM VOLUNTEERING AND PARTNER-FINDING PLATFORMS RATHER THAN ITS OWN CURRENT SITE - WHETHER IT IS STILL ACTIVE ON THE SAME SCALE, WHAT SERVICES IT OFFERS A VILLAGE TODAY AND HOW TO CONTACT IT WERE NOT ESTABLISHED. THE SPATIAL PLAN WORKING GROUP IS DESCRIBED BY A CONSULTANCY THAT WORKED ON THE PLAN UNDER A FOREIGN-FUNDED GOVERNANCE PROGRAMME. Read it with the young lawyers' association's free legal aid, the certified valuers scheme, the village support programme's assemblies and the biodiversity centre's community rangers recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Rural communities development agency — 1,200 members, offices in eight regions, and staff who help write district and community development plans
trackers.desc: THE SERVICE IN THIS ORGANISATION'S LIST THAT MATTERS MOST TO THIS FILE IS ONE LINE LONG: ASSISTANCE IN REGIONAL, DISTRICT AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT PLANNING. PLANS DECIDE WHAT MAY BE BUILT AND WHERE, YEARS BEFORE A BULLDOZER APPEARS. AN ORGANISATION THAT HELPS RURAL COMMUNITIES WRITE THEM - RATHER THAN OBJECT TO THEM AFTERWARDS - IS DOING THE WORK THIS PAYLOAD HAS FOUND ALMOST NOBODY DOING. IT IS A MEMBERSHIP BODY, AND THE NUMBERS ARE PUBLISHED: ITS MEMBERS ARE TWELVE HUNDRED PHYSICAL PERSONS AND SEVENTY-FOUR LEGAL ENTITIES. SEVENTY-FOUR ORGANISATIONS INSIDE ONE RURAL MEMBERSHIP BODY IS A READY-MADE COALITION. A VILLAGE GROUP JOINING DOES NOT ONLY GAIN A SERVICE PROVIDER - IT GAINS SEVENTY-THREE OTHER ORGANISATIONS WITH A REASON TO CARE. ITS VISION IS UNUSUALLY EXPLICIT ABOUT OWNERSHIP: RURAL COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT IN WHICH ORGANISED GROUPS OF LOCAL RESIDENTS, BOTH WOMEN AND MEN, ARE RESPONSIBLE STEWARDS OF THEIR RESOURCES, POSSESSING RIGHTS OF OWNERSHIP AND RESPONSIBILITIES AS GROUPS AND AS INDIVIDUALS, AND USING ECOLOGICALLY SOUND METHODS IN PRODUCING, PROCESSING AND MARKETING THEIR PRODUCTS TO MAXIMISE RETURNS TO THE COMMUNITY. ORGANISED GROUPS HOLDING RIGHTS OF OWNERSHIP OVER THEIR OWN RESOURCES IS THE SENTENCE THE WHOLE BRIEF THIS FILE WORKS TO IS TRYING TO MAKE TRUE. WHO IT SETS OUT TO SUPPORT INCLUDES A GROUP THIS FILE RARELY SEES NAMED ALONGSIDE FARMERS: THE RURAL POOR, REFUGEES, MIGRANTS, INTERNALLY DISPLACED PEOPLE, YOUTH, MEDIA, LOCAL GOVERNMENTS, THE PRIVATE SECTOR AND OTHER ORGANISATIONS - THROUGH ADVOCACY, PARTICIPATION AND EDUCATIONAL ACTIVITIES. SUPPORTING LOCAL GOVERNMENTS AND COMMUNITY GROUPS FROM THE SAME OFFICE IS THE BRIDGE ARRANGEMENT THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED WORKING ELSEWHERE IN THIS COUNTRY, AND IT IS WHY SUCH BODIES GET INTO PLANNING ROOMS. ITS SERVICE LIST IS LONG AND PRACTICAL: MOBILISATION OF COMMUNITIES; SAFE DRINKING WATER AND BASIC SANITATION; ENVIRONMENTALLY SAFE PRODUCTION AND PROCESSING; SKILLS AND CAPACITIES FOR SUSTAINABLE LIVELIHOODS; ALTERNATIVE INCOME GENERATION INCLUDING OFF-FARM ACTIVITIES, SMALL BUSINESSES AND THE TRANSFER OF AFFORDABLE TECHNOLOGIES; POST-HARVEST HANDLING THROUGH ORGANISING COLLECTING CENTRES; DIVERSIFICATION ACCORDING TO LOCAL AND REGIONAL MARKET DEMAND; VALUE-ADDED CHAINS; WOMEN'S BUSINESS INITIATIVES; AGRO AND ECO TOURISM; SUSTAINABLE MANAGEMENT OF NATURAL RESOURCES INCLUDING RENEWABLE ENERGY AND WASTE MANAGEMENT; AND INFORMATION DISSEMINATION. ORGANISING COLLECTING CENTRES IS THE QUIET ONE. A COLLECTING CENTRE IS WHERE SMALL PRODUCERS POOL A HARVEST BIG ENOUGH TO SELL - THE MISSING LINK BETWEEN GROWING SOMETHING AND EARNING FROM IT, AND THE REASON MOST VILLAGE PRODUCE IS SOLD AT THE GATE FOR NOTHING. THE EXPERTISE BEHIND IT IS SMALL BUT SPECIFIC: PERMANENT STAFF OF NINE OFFICERS - EXPERTS IN RURAL FARMING SYSTEMS, PLANNING AND MANAGEMENT, AN IRRIGATION SPECIALIST, A SOCIAL WORKER, MARKETING EXPERTS, ENVIRONMENTAL EXPERTS AND EXPERTS IN RENEWABLE ENERGY AND POST-HARVEST HANDLING - WITH OVER TWENTY VOLUNTEERS FROM SCIENTIFIC AND RESEARCH INSTITUTIONS. AN IRRIGATION SPECIALIST AND A PLANNING EXPERT IN THE SAME NINE-PERSON ORGANISATION IS EXACTLY THE PAIRING A VILLAGE FIGHTING OVER WATER AND A LAND-USE PLAN NEEDS, AND CANNOT HIRE. IT REACHES BEYOND ONE VALLEY: IT CARRIES OUT ITS ACTIVITIES THROUGH AFFILIATED OFFICES AND PARTNER ORGANISATIONS IN EIGHT NAMED REGIONS OF THE COUNTRY - AND ITS PRINCIPAL INSTITUTIONAL PARTNERS INCLUDE THREE MINISTRIES, A GREENS MOVEMENT, TWO UNIVERSITIES, A MOUNTAIN FEDERATION, AN ECOLOGICAL FARMERS' ASSOCIATION AND A FARMERS' SERVICING CENTRE. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A DEVELOPMENT AND CAPACITY ORGANISATION, NOT A LEGAL OR LAND-BUYING ONE - IT WILL NOT LITIGATE, BUY GROUND OR OPPOSE A PROJECT, AND ITS PARTNERSHIP WITH THREE MINISTRIES MEANS IT WORKS WITH THE STATE RATHER THAN AGAINST IT. NINE PERMANENT STAFF ACROSS EIGHT REGIONS IS THIN COVER, AND WHAT AN AFFILIATED OFFICE ACTUALLY IS IN EACH REGION WAS NOT ESTABLISHED. THE MEMBERSHIP FIGURES, STAFF LIST AND SERVICE LIST COME FROM A PROFESSIONAL NETWORK PROFILE AND A EUROPEAN WOMEN'S NETWORK MEMBER PAGE RATHER THAN THE ORGANISATION'S OWN CURRENT SITE, AND NEITHER CARRIES A DATE - ONE PARTNER MINISTRY IS NAMED IN A FORM THAT HAS SINCE BEEN REORGANISED, WHICH SUGGESTS THE PROFILE IS SEVERAL YEARS OLD. WHETHER IT IS STILL ACTIVE AT THIS SCALE, HOW A COMMUNITY JOINS AND WHAT MEMBERSHIP COSTS WERE NOT ESTABLISHED. Read it with the regional local democracy agency and its trainer cascade, the village support programme's assemblies, the certified valuers scheme and the biodiversity centre's community rangers recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Bar association's advocate register and open committees, and the legal aid service's regional bureaus for civil and administrative cases
trackers.desc: TWO COUNTRIES' BARS WERE CHECKED BEFORE THIS ONE AND BOTH WERE ALREADY HELD. THIS ONE ADDS THREE THINGS A COMMUNITY CAN USE, AND THE FIRST IS THE PLAINEST: THE ASSOCIATION PUBLISHES A REGISTER OF ADVOCATES. A PUBLIC REGISTER IS THE FRAUD CHECK AND THE STARTING POINT - IT CONFIRMS THE PERSON TAKING YOUR MONEY IS ENTITLED TO PRACTISE, WHICH THIS FILE HAS RECORDED AS THE SIMPLEST PRECAUTION ALMOST NOBODY TAKES. THE SECOND IS THAT ITS COMMITTEES ARE OPEN TO ITS MEMBERS EACH YEAR: THE ASSOCIATION RUNS AN OPEN CALL FOR MEMBERS TO JOIN ITS COMMITTEES FOR 2026, THE ACTIVE ONES INCLUDING A YOUNG ADVOCATES COMMITTEE AND A JUSTICE AND COURT REFORMS COMMITTEE WHOSE AIM IS TO ENSURE THE LEGAL PROFESSION'S INVOLVEMENT IN ESTABLISHING A RELIABLE, TRANSPARENT AND QUALITY JUSTICE SYSTEM. AN ANNUAL OPEN CALL MEANS A SYMPATHETIC LAWYER CAN BE ASKED TO JOIN A COMMITTEE AND CARRY A SUBJECT INTO IT. THAT IS HOW AN ENVIRONMENT OR PLANNING COMMITTEE COMES TO EXIST WHERE THERE IS NONE - AND THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS BARS IN TWO OTHER COUNTRIES THAT ALREADY HAVE ONE. THE THIRD IS WHERE THE FREE LAWYERS ACTUALLY SIT. A LEGAL AID SERVICE OPERATES WITH A STAFF TABLE OF TWO HUNDRED AND TWENTY-FIVE POSITIONS OF WHICH A HUNDRED AND EIGHTY ARE FILLED, AND IT PROVIDES LEGAL AID AND CONSULTATIONS ACROSS ALMOST THE ENTIRE TERRITORY OF THE COUNTRY. ITS DEPARTMENTS ARE LISTED, AND ONE OF THEM IS THE REASON THIS ENTRY EXISTS: LEGAL CONSULTATION AND QUALITY ASSESSMENT ON CIVIL AND ADMINISTRATIVE CASES, SEPARATE FROM THE EQUIVALENT DEPARTMENT FOR CRIMINAL CASES - ALONGSIDE ANALYTICS, A REGISTER OF INVITED PUBLIC ADVOCATES, CASE-PROGRAMME MANAGEMENT AND INTERNAL AUDIT. ADMINISTRATIVE CASES ARE PLANNING PERMISSIONS, PERMITS, EXPROPRIATIONS AND REFUSALS BY OFFICIALS. A STATE LEGAL AID SERVICE WITH A DEPARTMENT DEDICATED TO THEM IS FAR CLOSER TO WHAT THIS FILE'S COMMUNITIES NEED THAN THE CRIMINAL-ONLY SCHEMES RECORDED ELSEWHERE. THAT THE SERVICE IS GENUINELY REGIONAL IS CONFIRMED FROM AN UNEXPECTED PLACE - THE BAR'S OWN FEE RULES, WHICH GIVE A CONCESSION TO MEMBERS WHO PRACTISE AS PUBLIC ADVOCATES OF THE LEGAL AID SERVICE'S REGIONAL BUREAUS, ON PRODUCTION OF AN IDENTITY DOCUMENT AND A CERTIFICATE FROM THE SERVICE CONFIRMING THAT WORK, THE ORDINARY MEMBERSHIP FEE BEING TWO HUNDRED IN NATIONAL CURRENCY. SO THERE ARE PUBLIC ADVOCATES ATTACHED TO REGIONAL BUREAUS, AND THE BAR SUBSIDISES THEM. THE QUESTION FOR A COMMUNITY IS SIMPLY WHICH BUREAU COVERS ITS REGION AND WHO THE PUBLIC ADVOCATE THERE IS. WHAT A PRO BONO SCHEME ACTUALLY DELIVERS IS ALSO ON THE RECORD, AND THE NUMBERS ARE WORTH CARRYING: THE ASSOCIATION COMPLETED A TWO-YEAR FREE LEGAL AID PROJECT FOR PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES AND PALLIATIVE CARE PATIENTS, UNDER WHICH NINE ADVOCATES WERE SELECTED AND RETRAINED, THIRTY-THREE CITIZENS RECEIVED QUALIFIED LEGAL AID, AND THE COURT DISPUTES CONCLUDED SUCCESSFULLY IN THE BENEFICIARIES' FAVOUR - WITH THE SUPPORT OF AN OPEN SOCIETY FOUNDATION. NINE TRAINED LAWYERS, THIRTY-THREE CLIENTS, TWO YEARS. THAT IS THE HONEST SCALE OF A FUNDED PRO BONO PROJECT, AND IT IS THE MODEL A COMMUNITY ORGANISATION COULD PROPOSE FOR ITS OWN SUBJECT - SELECT AND RETRAIN A HANDFUL OF ADVOCATES IN LAND AND ADMINISTRATIVE LAW, AND FUND THEM FOR TWO YEARS. THE ASSOCIATION IS ALSO WATCHING THE LAW ITSELF: ITS EXECUTIVE COUNCIL PRESENTED TO A PARLIAMENTARY COMMITTEE CHAIR ITS POSITION ON THE COUNTRY'S LAW ON LEGAL AID AND THE RISKS THE ASSOCIATION SEES IN IT. THE LIMITS: THE BAR IS THE PROFESSION'S GOVERNING BODY AND ITS COMMITTEES ARE FOR MEMBERS, NOT FOR THE PUBLIC - NOTHING RECORDED HERE SHOWS AN ENVIRONMENT OR LAND COMMITTEE AMONG THEM, OR ANY ROUTE FOR A COMMUNITY TO ADDRESS ONE. THE LEGAL AID SERVICE IS A STATE BODY, SO ITS ADVOCATES ACTING AGAINST STATE OR MUNICIPAL DECISIONS IS A CONFLICT THIS PAYLOAD HAS FLAGGED IN OTHER COUNTRIES, AND WHETHER ITS CIVIL AND ADMINISTRATIVE DEPARTMENT TAKES LAND, PLANNING OR ENVIRONMENTAL CASES, WHAT THE ELIGIBILITY THRESHOLD IS AND WHERE THE REGIONAL BUREAUS SIT WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED. THE COMPLETED PRO BONO PROJECT WAS FOR A DIFFERENT BENEFICIARY GROUP ENTIRELY AND IS OVER. THE PAGES SEEN ARE THE ASSOCIATION'S OWN, SEVERAL OF THEM NAVIGATION-HEAVY WITH LITTLE TEXT, AND THE STAFFING FIGURES APPEAR ON AN UNDATED EXPLANATORY PAGE. Read it with the young lawyers' association's free legal aid, the regional local democracy agency, the rural communities development agency and the certified valuers scheme recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Municipal development fund — public-law investor in local infrastructure, buying through electronic tenders a community can read
trackers.desc: THIS FUND'S STATED PURPOSE IS UNUSUALLY DIRECT ABOUT WHOM IT EXISTS TO STRENGTHEN: IT IS A LEGAL ENTITY OF PUBLIC LAW WHOSE AIM IS TO PROMOTE THE STRENGTHENING OF THE INSTITUTIONAL AND FINANCIAL CAPACITIES OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT BODIES, THE INVESTMENT OF FUNDS IN LOCAL INFRASTRUCTURE AND SERVICES, AND THE IMPROVEMENT OF THE BASIC ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL CONDITION OF THE LOCAL POPULATION. INSTITUTIONAL AND FINANCIAL CAPACITY OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT IS THE THING THIS FILE HAS FOUND MISSING IN ALMOST EVERY COUNTRY IT COVERS. A NATIONAL BODY WHOSE JOB IS BUILDING IT IS ONE A SMALL MUNICIPALITY SHOULD BE ASKING WHAT IT OFFERS. HOW IT SPENDS IS PUBLIC, AND THAT IS THE PART A COMMUNITY CAN USE: IT ANNOUNCES ELECTRONIC TENDERS - INCLUDING ONE FOR THE DESIGN AND REHABILITATION OF TWENTY PUBLIC SCHOOLS IN VARIOUS MUNICIPALITIES, UNDER WHICH THE SCHOOLS' BASIC INFRASTRUCTURE IS TO BE PUT IN ORDER AND PARTICULAR ATTENTION GIVEN TO IMPROVING ENGINEERING COMMUNICATIONS - THE RENEWAL OF HEATING, VENTILATION AND WATER SUPPLY SYSTEMS. A TENDER NAMES THE SITES, THE SCOPE AND THE MONEY BEFORE THE WORK STARTS. FOR A VILLAGE WHOSE SCHOOL HAS NO HEATING OR CLEAN WATER, THE FIRST QUESTION IS WHETHER IT IS AMONG THE TWENTY - AND THE SECOND IS WHEN THE NEXT SUCH TENDER IS ANNOUNCED. WHAT LOCAL JOURNALISTS HAVE ALREADY DONE WITH THESE PUBLICATIONS IS THE MODEL WORTH COPYING: A REGIONAL OUTLET REPORTED THAT TWENTY-FIVE MILLION WAS SPENT ON A NAMED PUBLIC AVENUE IN ONE COASTAL CITY IN THE PREVIOUS YEAR AND THAT ITS REHABILITATION BEGAN AGAIN IN 2026 - RECORDING THAT SCAFFOLDING AND WORK TOOLS AWAIT VISITORS, THAT IT IS NOT KNOWN WHEN THE WORKS WILL FINISH, AND THAT IT IS NOT KNOWN WHETHER THEY COVER THE FULL RENEWAL OF THE DEFECTS OR ONLY THE PLACES FROM WHICH WATER RUNS INTO THE COMMERCIAL PREMISES BENEATH THE FOOTBRIDGES. THAT REPORT WAS FILED UNDER THE TAGS OF ELECTRONIC TENDER AND THIS FUND. TWENTY-FIVE MILLION SPENT, THE SAME STRUCTURE UNDER SCAFFOLDING AGAIN A YEAR LATER, AND NOBODY ABLE TO SAY WHAT THE NEW WORK COVERS - THAT IS WHAT READING TENDERS LETS A COMMUNITY ASK, AND IT IS THE SAME QUESTION TO ASK ABOUT A SEA WALL, A DRAIN OR A ROAD. THE MUNICIPAL SIDE OF THE PAPERWORK IS EQUALLY READABLE: ONE MUNICIPALITY'S 2026 BUDGET DRAFT CAPITAL ANNEX SETS OUT, PROJECT BY PROJECT, THE PURCHASE OF DESIGN AND COST-ESTIMATE DOCUMENTATION, THE COSTS OF SUPERVISION OF DESIGN WORKS, AND A LINE FOR DESIGN, EXPERT AND CONSTRUCTION-TECHNICAL SUPERVISION SERVICES - ALONGSIDE STATED EXPECTED RESULTS SUCH AS SAFE MOVEMENT FOR TRANSPORT AND PEDESTRIANS AND AN EQUALLY ACCESSIBLE ENVIRONMENT FOR PEOPLE WITH DISABILITIES AND THOSE USING PUSHCHAIRS. A CAPITAL ANNEX THAT NAMES THE EXPECTED RESULT OF EACH PROJECT IS A PROMISE THAT CAN BE CHECKED AFTERWARDS. COPY THE LINE, KEEP IT, AND ASK AT THE END OF THE YEAR WHETHER THE STATED RESULT WAS ACHIEVED. ONE COORDINATION HABIT FROM THE SAME COUNTRY IS WORTH DEMANDING ANYWHERE: IN ONE CITY THE MAYOR, THE CHAIRMAN OF THE NATIONAL ENERGY AND WATER SUPPLY REGULATORY COMMISSION AND THE UTILITY COMPANIES REVIEWED THE PROJECTS CARRIED OUT IN 2025 AND PLANNED THOSE FOR 2026, WITH THE REGULATOR'S CHAIRMAN STATING THAT FOR PROJECTS TO BE CARRIED OUT WITH QUALITY AND IN ORDER, THE UNDERGROUND COMMUNICATIONS MUST FIRST BE REPLACED AND ONLY THEN SHOULD THE MUNICIPALITY PUT THE ABOVE-GROUND INFRASTRUCTURE IN ORDER. PIPES BEFORE PAVEMENT IS THE CHEAPEST ADVICE IN THIS ENTIRE PAYLOAD, AND THE ONE MOST OFTEN IGNORED - A RESURFACED STREET DUG UP AGAIN WITHIN A YEAR IS MONEY A COMMUNITY WILL NOT SEE TWICE. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A STATE FUND THAT INVESTS IN AND CONTRACTS FOR MUNICIPAL INFRASTRUCTURE, NOT A COMMUNITY BODY OR AN ADVOCATE - IT BUILDS WHAT GOVERNMENT AND LENDERS FINANCE, AND NOTHING RECORDED HERE SHOWS IT PROTECTING LAND OR CONSULTING RESIDENTS ON WHAT SHOULD BE BUILT. HOW MUNICIPALITIES OR COMMUNITIES PROPOSE PROJECTS TO IT, WHAT SHARE A MUNICIPALITY MUST CONTRIBUTE, AND WHETHER ITS PROJECT LISTS AND CONTRACT AWARDS ARE PUBLISHED IN FULL WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED - AND ITS OWN SITE WAS NOT READ FOR THIS ENTRY, THE DESCRIPTION COMING FROM ITS PARENT MINISTRY'S AGENCY PAGE. THE SCHOOL TENDER AND THE AVENUE REPORT COME FROM NEWS OUTLETS OF 2026, THE BUDGET ANNEX FROM ONE MUNICIPALITY'S DRAFT, AND THE COORDINATION MEETING FROM A CITY HALL RELEASE OF DECEMBER 2025 - NONE OF THEM INDEPENDENT AUDITS. Read it with the village support programme's assemblies, the regional local democracy agency, the rural communities development agency and the bar's advocate register recorded separately for this country.

trackers.desc: Moldova's civic freedom-of-information request platform, built on the Alaveteli/mySociety software: you file an access-to-information request to a public authority through the site, and both the request and the authority's response — or its silence — are published in a public archive. USE IT: the archive shows which authorities answer and which do not, which is evidence in itself.

trackers.name: Eco-TIRAS — Asociaţia Internaţională a Păstrătorilor Râului
trackers.desc: The association of more than fifty environmental organisations across Moldova, including Transnistria, and Ukraine, built around the transboundary Dniester basin and registered under Moldovan law. WHO TO ENLIST: use it as the switchboard — if there is a local group anywhere in the basin, it is probably a member, and reaching the network is faster than finding one cold. You CAN: draw on its compilation of Moldovan environmental legislation, published in volumes on its own site, and on its scientific capacity, which is unusual for an NGO here — it developed a methodology for assessing hydropower impacts on river ecosystems and has surveyed riverbank erosion. It sits on the Dniester river commission it helped create, so it has a seat where basin decisions are taken. For activists: it has form on access to information, having pursued a case internationally under the Aarhus Convention after a state service demanded a very large fee for environmental data — worth citing if you are quoted a price for records.

trackers.name: EcoContact — Centrul Aarhus Chișinău / free environmental legal aid
trackers.desc: WHO TO ENLIST: the association that has hosted Moldova's Aarhus environmental consultancy and information centre since 2013, and whose stated strategic aim is increasing public access to justice on environmental interests. It gives free legal assistance on environmental matters and has supported court actions on access to information, public participation and the protection of natural resources — reportedly more than fifty consultations across 2024-2025 — and it does not wait to be visited: in 2024 its teams reached 182 of the 187 localities in its target districts to offer free legal help on the spot. WHO IT SUITS: rural communities above all, and local councils, since it also drafts local environmental regulations covering grazing, mowing, recording of offences and transparency in decision-making. Two things that improve your odds: it runs the environmental-cases programme for judges and prosecutors at the National Institute of Justice, so the bench has been trained on exactly these questions, and it moderates a platform of over 230 environmental organisations and experts if the expertise you need is not in-house.

trackers.name: Fondul Național pentru Mediu — the fund that replaced the one you will find first
trackers.desc: CHECK THE NAME BEFORE YOU APPLY. Searching for Moldovan environmental funding surfaces the Fondul Ecologic Național across many government pages — created by Government Decision 988 of 26.09.98 under Law 1515/1993 — but it has been superseded. Law 54/2022 and Government Decision 711/2022 established the Fondul Național pentru Mediu within the state budget, exclusively for projects in environmental protection, climate change and sustainable management of natural resources. Its size is set by the annual state budget law and its money runs through the single treasury account. It is administered by the supervisory committee of ONIPM, the National Office for Implementation of Environmental Projects, which now issues the calls. AN EXISTING COMMITMENT DID NOT LAPSE: programmes the old fund's administrative council had already decided to finance — including drinking water and sanitation projects — transferred to the new Fund's administrator. The stated reason for reform was that the old arrangement limited environmental activity, and that better management would bring more transparency, equality and equity.

trackers.name: ONIPM — where the calls are actually announced
trackers.desc: WATCH THIS, NOT A STANDING WINDOW. ONIPM announces numbered calls approved by its supervisory committee — for example Apel nr. 04/2025, aimed at selecting investment projects to develop, modernise and extend recycling infrastructure for plastic, paper and packaging waste. Each call targets a defined theme, so the question is not whether the fund is open but whether a call matching your work is live. ELIGIBILITY SHAPE, from the predecessor fund: local public administration bodies, institutions, enterprises and civil society organisations of Moldova could apply, with restrictions on organisations already holding a grant — check the current regulation for the equivalent rule before assuming a second application is possible. ANOTHER ROUTE: a UNDP-GEF project on conservation and sustainable management of wetlands, focused on high nature value areas in the Prut basin and working with the Prutul de Jos Biosphere Reserve — the kind of programme a local group partners with rather than applies to.

trackers.name: Energy Community — private bodies may complain, and refusal is appealable
trackers.desc: A COMPLAINT MECHANISM WHERE REFUSAL BY THE GATEKEEPER CAN BE TAKEN OVER ITS HEAD — which is rare, and is the reason to know about this. Under Article 90 of the Energy Community Treaty, private bodies may approach the Secretariat with complaints about a Party's non-compliance, and under Article 12.2 of the Consolidated Rules the Secretariat initiates procedures in response to a complaint by a private body as well as on its own initiative. AND IF THE SECRETARIAT DECLINES: the revised Rules give the complainant the right to approach the Permanent High Level Group directly, which may hear the complaint directly or initiate a preliminary procedure — in most systems recorded in this map, a secretariat declining to act ends the matter. The PHLG can also take interim measures in matters of urgency under Article 47(c) — that is what matters when works are already under way, so ask for it expressly. THE ENVIRONMENTAL ACQUIS IS IN SCOPE, including the EIA Directive as amended by 2014/52, which was to be transposed by 1 January 2019. CHECK THE TRANSPOSITION DEADLINE FOR THE DIRECTIVE YOU RELY ON — failure to transpose by the stated date is itself the non-compliance, and is a far simpler case than arguing about how a rule was applied. THE REALISTIC WIN CONDITION: a case opens with an Opening Letter, escalates to a Reasoned Opinion giving two months to rectify, then to the Ministerial Council — but a case closes whenever the Party complies, and many are recorded as complied with before any decision was adopted. The opening of proceedings is the lever, not the final decision. YOU CAN ALSO JOIN AN EXISTING CASE: interested third parties may access the case file and submit written observations, provided they substantiate their legitimate interest. Case law from Opening Letters is published with dates and numbers, so precedent is visible. Write to the Energy Community Secretariat, Am Hof 4, 1010 Vienna. ONE MORE ROUTE: the amended Rules provide for cooperation with national authorities and courts, giving concrete assistance to national courts on the interpretation of Energy Community law — a domestic judge unsure how an EU-derived rule applies can be pointed at it.

trackers.name: Espoo points of contact — a named official, and ‘were you notified?’
trackers.desc: A NAMED OFFICIAL, A DIRECT EMAIL, AND A QUESTION WITH A DOCUMENTARY ANSWER. The UNECE publishes the points of contact regarding notification under article 3 of the Espoo Convention on EIA in a transboundary context: notifications of activities likely to cause significant adverse transboundary impact shall be transmitted to the relevant points of contact. WHY THIS MATTERS FOR AN ORDINARY LAND CASE: if a project sits near a border, the affected country's point of contact should have been notified — so ask both points of contact whether notification was given. It is a cheap, precise question, and failure to notify is a procedural defect in the consent. The list gives each Party's named official, department, postal address, telephone and email: Czechia's sits in the Department of EIA and Integrated Prevention at the Ministry of the Environment; Denmark's is the Agency for Green Transition and Aquatic Environment using the functional address espoo@sgav.dk; Croatia's is a Director at the Ministry of Economy and Sustainable Development; Canada's is the President of the Impact Assessment Agency. PREFER A FUNCTIONAL ADDRESS WHERE ONE IS LISTED — named officials move. AND NOTE A ROUTING PATTERN: some Parties route notification through their Ministry for Foreign Affairs c/o their Permanent Mission in Geneva rather than an environment ministry — where that is so, the environment ministry may not hold the file and the foreign-ministry route is the correct one. A SECOND DIRECTORY, AND A SECOND ROUTE TO THE SAME DOCUMENT: the EEA publishes a list of Eionet national focal points covering 32 member countries and 8 cooperating countries (Albania, Bosnia, Kosovo, North Macedonia, Moldova, Montenegro, Serbia, Ukraine). Data are reported upwards — from stakeholder, to competent authority, to the EEA, to the Commission — so if your national authority has reported something, the EEA holds it too. Where a national body is unresponsive or its figures look wrong, the same data sits one level up in a body with no stake in the local decision. CONFIRM YOUR COUNTRY APPEARS ON THE LIST before relying on it. SCOPE: Espoo governs transboundary notification and Eionet governs data reporting — for the domestic EIA procedure itself, see the EIA Directive entry recorded separately.

trackers.name: ELAW — free attorneys and scientists who will critique the developer's EIA
trackers.desc: IT WILL READ THE DEVELOPER'S EIA AND TELL YOU WHAT IS WRONG WITH IT — which is the thing a community cannot produce alone and usually cannot afford. ELAW is a global alliance of attorneys, scientists and other advocates, founded 1989 in Eugene, Oregon by public interest lawyers from ten countries, that provides legal and scientific support to grassroots advocates to challenge destructive projects. FOUR CONCRETE FORMS OF HELP: legal support to local public interest lawyers; scientific support, including critiquing environmental assessments; economic insights on projects; and security expertise — ‘ELAW helps environmental lawyers improve their security so they can work without fear.
