This file carries Adam Teva V'Din for litigation, Bimkom for planning representation and counter-plans, SPNI for open-space objections, Zalul for discharge and Green Course for field campaigning — most of which are members of this umbrella, which is exactly the point. TWO VERIFICATION NOTES: the membership figure varies across sources from over 100 to 130 to over 150 as the body has grown, so use its own current number; and the planning-council provision comes from the organisation's own history page and dates from 1975, so confirm it still stands in current law before relying on it.

trackers.name: Adalah — a legal centre with a named land and planning practice, and an objection that shrank a plan rather than stopping it
trackers.desc: THE OUTCOME MOST WORTH STUDYING IS NOT A CANCELLED SCHEME BUT A SHRUNKEN ONE: an objection this centre brought resulted in the area covered by the plan being reduced to 13,532 dunams. Objectors are usually told the choice is approval or refusal. It is often neither. A plan whose footprint is cut is a plan that no longer reaches your land, and reducing the boundary is a far easier ask of a committee than killing a scheme outright. WHAT IT OFFERS DIRECTLY, IN ITS OWN WORDS: it brings impact litigation and other legal interventions before Israeli courts and state authorities, and it provides legal consultation to individuals, non-governmental organisations and institutions. Consultation to individuals is the access point; land and planning rights is one of its named practice areas, with its own published list of pending cases. THE PAIRING IS THE PATTERN TO COPY, AND THIS FILE HAS NOW SEEN IT ACROSS MORE THAN A DECADE OF CASES: it files planning objections and appeals JOINTLY WITH A PLANNING ORGANISATION rather than alone — objections and appeals to district and national planning committees submitted together with Bimkom, recorded here separately, and in some matters with a regional council and residents named as co-objectors. A lawyer arguing planning law beside a planner arguing planning merit is a materially stronger filing than either alone, and both bodies are in this file. Documented results include a precedent-setting magistrates' court decision cancelling fifty-one demolition orders affecting the homes of some five hundred residents of one village, and a supreme court decision requiring a community town to allocate a plot to applicants its admissions committee had rejected. It also litigates against land-allocation criteria and procedures of state land bodies. It holds UN special consultative status and trains legal apprentices and new lawyers in human rights litigation. THE SCOPE LIMIT DECIDES WHETHER IT IS YOUR ROUTE, AND IT IS EXPLICIT IN THE NAME: this is a legal centre for Arab minority rights in Israel. Its land and planning work concerns discrimination in planning, land allocation, demolition and village recognition. A conservation objection with no such dimension sits outside that mandate — for those, this file carries Adam Teva V'Din for environmental litigation, SPNI for open-space planning objections and Bimkom for planning representation. Note also that several of the documented cases run from 2004 to 2012 with appeals continuing for years afterwards; treat litigation here as a long instrument, as this file has recorded for Israeli environmental cases generally.

trackers.name: ACAP — recognised by the Interior Ministry as able to file planning objections in its own name, not only on behalf of an affected owner
trackers.desc: THE THING TO ASK ABOUT FIRST IS STANDING, BECAUSE IT IS WHAT MOST OBJECTORS LACK: this centre was recognised by the Ministry of the Interior in January 2004 as a public organisation with the legal right to intervene in official planning procedures and to file objections to national, district and local plans as an independent legal entity. An objection filed by a body with recognised standing does not depend on finding an owner whose land is directly affected and willing to put their name to it — which is often the point at which a community campaign stalls. Ask whether it will file, and on what basis. WHAT IT SUPPLIES IS PLANNERS, WHICH IS THE OTHER HALF OF WHAT AN OBJECTION NEEDS. The record of its work shows objections filed by named urban and regional planners working alongside an attorney from the legal centre also recorded in this file — the pairing that file has now documented across more than a decade. Its own described method is to monitor state plans and decisions systematically, respond and challenge them, and advocate amendments according to alternatives it develops itself, alongside research into planning problems affecting the communities it serves. That is counter-planning as a standing function rather than a one-off effort. ONE PROCEDURAL ATTACK FROM ITS CASE RECORD IS WORTH CARRYING ANYWHERE: in the Harish matter it argued that detailed plans were being advanced while objections to the master plan remained undiscussed and the master plan itself unapproved, and that doing so grossly violates the public's right to object and breaches the authorities' duty to address objections seriously. If a developer is pushing detailed applications while your objection to the overarching plan is still unheard, that sequencing is itself a ground. Its documented practice runs from an objection to a master plan in 2010, through rejection and an appeal to the national planning council in 2011, a further objection to a detailed housing plan in 2013, to a 2020 Supreme Court petition after which the government moved to include nine previously excluded localities in a national housing priority policy. Based in Eilaboun in the Galilee, established December 2000. SCOPE LIMIT: like the legal centre it works with, its mandate concerns the planning, land, housing and development interests of Arab citizens of Israel, so an objection without that dimension sits outside it — SPNI and Bimkom, both in this file, are the routes for open-space and general planning objections. VERIFICATION CAVEAT: this entry rests on the co-filing record published by its legal partner, which is independent and canonical, plus a domain named consistently across third-party profiles; the organisation's own site was not read directly this round, so confirm the Ministry recognition and current contact details at source before relying on them.

trackers.name: Council for Conservation of Heritage Sites — it exists to cover what the Antiquities Law does not, and it keeps its own list
trackers.desc: FIND OUT WHAT YOUR ANTIQUITIES LAW DOES NOT COVER, BECAUSE THAT IS USUALLY WHERE THE DEMOLITIONS HAPPEN. This body was created for buildings and sites from the year 1700 onwards — precisely the stock that Israel's Antiquities Law leaves out. Most heritage statutes in this region protect the ancient and abandon the recent, and the recent is what stands in the way of a development. IT MAINTAINS ITS OWN LIST OF HERITAGE SITES, SEPARATE FROM THE GOVERNMENT'S NATIONAL HERITAGE PROGRAMME. A non-governmental register is not a legal protection, but it is a documented, citable status obtainable without a ministerial decision — and this file has recorded elsewhere how easily a ministerial listing can be struck by decree. WHAT IT WILL ACTUALLY DO FOR A BUILDING: its engineering and planning department begins every project with an engineering review — when the structure was built, its physical condition, its architectural style, its structural details — followed by formal documentation. That review is the evidence base an objection needs, and the department was built around architects and engineers who arrived in the early 1990s and were trained specifically for conservation work. AND IT WORKS THROUGH DISTRICTS, WHICH IS HOW YOU REACH IT: district offices initiate projects to prevent demolition and deterioration, carry out physical conservation, promote adaptive reuse, and maintain ongoing dialogue with PLANNING AUTHORITIES, local governments and residents so that conservation becomes part of planning rather than an objection to it. Adaptive reuse is the argument that wins where preservation alone loses: a building with a working future is harder to demolish than one preserved empty. ITS OWN ORIGIN IS THE LESSON MOST WORTH CARRYING: public anger at demolitions began in the 1960s when a landmark Tel Aviv school was torn down for the city's first skyscraper, but by its own account the protests did not gain real influence until this organisation was established in 1984. Outrage without an institution does not change outcomes. Founded by the Society for the Protection of Nature in Israel, recorded separately in this file, following a Knesset committee decision, and independent since January 2008. THE SCOPE LIMIT MATTERS AND IS STATED IN ITS OWN MATERIALS: its remit is sites connected to the country's path to independence and national story, so a structure outside that frame may fall outside what it takes on — establish that before relying on it. It is funded partly from government budgets and partly from donations, which a reviewer weighing independence should note.

trackers.name: Movement for Freedom of Information — it sues authorities that refuse documents, and turns single disclosures into standing publication duties
trackers.desc: THE PRECEDENT THAT MATTERS MOST FOR A DEVELOPMENT FIGHT: a district court ordered a public body to disclose documents concerning an agreement with a private party, holding that THE PUBLIC HAS A RIGHT TO KNOW AGREEMENTS MADE BETWEEN PUBLIC ENTITIES AND PRIVATE PARTIES. If your municipality has signed something with a developer and will not show it to you, that is the case to cite — and this is the organisation that brought it. AND THE SECOND LESSON IS THE ONE MOST CAMPAIGNS MISS: ASK FOR THE CLASS OF DOCUMENT TO BE PUBLISHED ROUTINELY, NOT JUST FOR YOUR COPY. This organisation sought the conflict-of-interest agreements of members of parliament, was refused, won in court — and that category of information is now uploaded automatically to the government's website. One case removed the need for anyone to ask again. That is a far larger prize than a single file and it costs the same litigation. WHAT IT EXISTS FOR: the country's freedom of information law dates from 1998 and is described by the organisation's own director as formally progressive, but it was set up specifically to promote the law's IMPLEMENTATION — on the view that a culture of secrecy and bureaucratic exhaustion is where requests actually die. The gap between a good statute and an answered request is the problem it works on, which is the same gap this file has recorded in Lebanon, Turkiye and Central Asia. ITS METHOD IS SIMPLE AND REPEATABLE: submit the request, and when refused, take the authority to court. Its published examples include winning disclosure against a prisons authority after a refusal on privacy grounds, and winning twice against a religious authority over a list of practitioners found negligent — refusals dressed as privacy protection are its ordinary business. THE LIMITS: it is a transparency organisation, not an environmental or planning one. It will not object to your scheme, assess it, or represent you at a committee — for those this file records planners, a legal centre and a planning-rights body in Israel. Use it for the documents, and use the documents with them. Nothing found shows it acting on a land or development matter specifically, so approach it as a freedom-of-information question rather than as an environmental one — which is how the request should be framed anyway.

trackers.name: Keren Sheli — it funds a fight, not just a project, and unregistered groups can apply
trackers.desc: ITS OWN TERMS SAY AN APPLICATION MAY BE OF THE NATURE OF A STRUGGLE, or of positive initiated activity. Most funders in this file pay for surveys, restoration or capacity; this one will pay for the campaign itself — and it says so in writing, which is what a group needs when explaining to a funder that it intends to oppose something. UNREGISTERED GROUPS MAY APPLY. Both registered non-profit associations AND non-profit organisings or groups that are NOT registered as associations can approach it — which removes the barrier this file has documented repeatedly across the region, where registration is the gate that stops a village group before it starts. AND IT DELIBERATELY EXCLUDES THE WELL-RESOURCED: it does not support organisations with a significant budget, and gives priority to GROUPS AT THE START OF THEIR PATH and to the social and geographic periphery, as well as to groups that cooperate with environmental organisations. A new committee of neighbours is the intended applicant, not an established body. THERE IS AN EMERGENCY WINDOW, AND IT IS DEFINED IN THE TERMS THAT ACTUALLY MATTER: in exceptional cases the fund will consider emergency requests of up to 20,000 shekels where an emergency organising faces an environmental threat that is IMMEDIATE, IRREVERSIBLE, ON A SHORT TIMELINE AND OF SIGNIFICANT SCOPE. That is the machinery-arrives-next-week case, and almost nothing else in this payload has a route for it. Ordinary grants run to 25,000 shekels, and come with professional accompaniment and individually tailored consulting hours rather than money alone. TWO ROUNDS A YEAR, IN WINTER AND SUMMER — check the current dates rather than assuming, and note that calls are published in Hebrew and in Arabic. The fund is a partnership of environmental funds operating through the New Israel Fund and administered through its empowerment and training centre, which has worked with grassroots organisations since 1982 and describes its own mandate as reaching constituencies on the economic and geographic periphery and building coalitions among them — so the consulting hours come from people who do that work. ONE THING TO WEIGH FOR YOURSELF: the fund operates through a foundation that is itself a subject of public political contention in Israel. This file records that as a fact for an applicant to consider in their own circumstances, not as a judgement either way — the same treatment given to the politically framed bodies recorded elsewhere in this payload.

trackers.name: Negev Coexistence Forum — it trains residents to document demolitions, and works to the residents' own committees
trackers.desc: ITS FIRST PROGRAMME IS A DOCUMENTATION NETWORK BUILT OUT OF THE AFFECTED POPULATION ITSELF: residents — women, children, teenagers and men — are trained to record home demolitions, arrests, demonstrations and daily conditions, through photography and video projects, and everyone who takes part joins a standing human rights defenders network. This file has repeatedly found that campaigns lose because nothing was recorded at the time. Training the people who are present to document what happens, and making that training a route into an organised network rather than a one-off workshop, is the most transferable thing here. AND IT WORKS TO A STATED PRINCIPLE THAT DECIDES WHO IS IN CHARGE: it operates on a do-no-harm basis in close coordination with RESIDENTS' GROUPS, whom it describes as its strongest partners and allies — alongside the legal centre, the planning body and the capacity-building centre recorded separately in this file, which makes it a hub connecting a community to all three. THE CONSTITUENCY BODY BEHIND IT IS WHERE THE STRUCTURAL LESSON SITS, AND IT IS WORTH COPYING ANYWHERE A POPULATION HAS NO AUTHORITY OF ITS OWN: a regional council for the unrecognised villages, established in 1997, is a democratically elected body representing forty-five villages whose residents belong to no municipality and so cannot elect representatives. Each village elects a local committee; the committees form the general assembly; the assembly elects a chairperson and executive committee every four years. That ladder turns a dispersed population into a body with which a ministry, a court or a funder can deal. It has no verified address of its own and is reached through the organisations that work with it, including this one. WHAT IT PUBLISHES IS THE EVIDENCE BASE: annual counts of demolitions — 2,586 structures recorded in one year, a rise of thirteen per cent on the year before — alongside accounts of land-ploughing operations across thousands of dunams reaching named villages, and of police conduct during them. Year-on-year counts turn individual events into a documented trend, which is what an advocacy case needs. Its second programme is campaigning and advocacy aimed at changing state policy; a third strand trains women in digital skills so they can help others in their villages access rights administered online. ITS RECORD ALSO SHOWS THE SMALLER WINS THAT KEEP A COMMUNITY IN PLACE: one village obtained approval for temporary portable structures to house essential services, in that case schooling. THE SCOPE LIMIT: it works in the Negev and on the rights of the Bedouin population there. It is not a general environmental or planning body, and a reader outside that context should use the planning and legal bodies recorded elsewhere in this file.

trackers.name: RCUV — an elected council of forty-five villages, and it warns what recognition can cost
trackers.desc: WHEN A COMMUNITY IS OFFERED RECOGNITION, ASK WHAT THE BOUNDARY EXCLUDES AND WHAT IS SIGNED AWAY TO GET IT. This council argued of one partial-recognition scheme that the recognition it offered came at the price of RENOUNCING CONSIDERABLE VILLAGE LAND CLAIMS, and that drawing boundaries around the area of habitation alone — zoning out most of the grazing ground — would leave settlements unable to grow or support themselves, without business districts or the services that make recognition real. Its counter-position was to seek recognition of all the villages together with their land claims, framed with a ratio worth borrowing: the land in dispute amounts to no more than two per cent of the region, while the population concerned is more than a quarter of it. A SMALL SHARE OF LAND SET AGAINST A LARGE SHARE OF PEOPLE IS AN ARGUMENT ANY DISPERSED COMMUNITY CAN MAKE, AND IT IS HARDER TO REFUSE THAN A PLEA. WHAT IT IS, AND WHY THE STRUCTURE IS THE MODEL: established in 1997, it is a grassroots organisation AND A DEMOCRATICALLY ELECTED BODY representing forty-five villages and, on one account, close to a hundred thousand people who belong to no municipality and therefore cannot elect representatives in the ordinary way. The residents of each village elect a local committee; those committees form the general assembly; the assembly elects a chairperson and executive committee every four years. Any dispersed population that no single authority represents can build that ladder, and it produces a body that courts, ministries and funders can deal with. IT LITIGATES AS A CO-PETITIONER RATHER THAN ALONE, WHICH IS HOW A COMMUNITY BODY REACHES A SUPREME COURT: it has joined petitions with the legal centre, the planning-rights body and other organisations recorded separately in this file — including proceedings over services in named villages and over discrimination in remote learning provision. The pairing this map has recorded repeatedly — a constituency body supplying standing and facts, a legal centre supplying the argument — is visible here in its most complete form. AND IT BUILT ITS OWN MEDIA DEPARTMENT IN LATE 2023 BECAUSE OF A GAP IT IDENTIFIED IN ITS OWN COVERAGE: it reports reaching millions through social media and initiating hundreds of stories in Israeli and international outlets, while noting that MOST OF THAT COVERAGE DID NOT ADDRESS LAND ISSUES. Getting attention and getting attention for the land question are different problems, and a campaign should measure the second. It takes donations directly and publishes its projects. THE SCOPE: it represents the unrecognised villages of the Negev and nothing else. A reader outside that context should take the structure and the two arguments, and use the planning and legal bodies recorded elsewhere in this file.

trackers.name: MedPAN — a Mediterranean fund this country is actually eligible for
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY IS NAMED ON ITS PUBLISHED ELIGIBLE LIST, WHICH MATTERS BECAUSE MOST CONSERVATION FUNDING EXCLUDES IT. This file has recorded two international funds that bar high-income economies outright and a third whose reach effectively does the same; a marine trust fund recorded in the previous round does not list this country among its priority countries either. This one does. WHAT IT OFFERS: calls for small projects of up to around twenty-five thousand euros for a single marine protected area, or up to around forty-five thousand where three or more areas cooperate — open both to the organisations managing an area AND to other bodies, including scientific institutions and NGOs, working with the responsible management authority. Given the strength of this country's marine research institutions, the cooperation category and the science route are the realistic openings. IT IS ALSO A NETWORK OF AROUND EIGHTY TO A HUNDRED MEMBER ORGANISATIONS THAT MANAGE OR ARE CREATING MEDITERRANEAN PROTECTED AREAS, WITH MEMBERSHIP OPEN TO BODIES CONTRIBUTING TO THE CREATION OF ONE — so a group campaigning for a coastal designation can join before it has obtained anything, and can reach practitioners in neighbouring countries facing the same coast and the same pressures. IT RUNS TRAINING FOR PROTECTED-AREA MANAGERS, HOLDS LARGE REGIONAL WORKSHOPS, MANAGES A MEDITERRANEAN PROTECTED-AREAS DATABASE AND PUBLISHES A STATUS REPORT EVERY FOUR YEARS. THE LIMITS: marine and coastal only, so an inland dispute is outside it; past calls have required the applicant to match around a quarter of the cost; and it funds management and protection rather than objection, litigation or campaigning against a scheme.

trackers.name: Farmers' Federation of Israel — the umbrella body of farmers, and why nobody can buy the land here
trackers.desc: BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE, KNOW THAT BUYING THE LAND IS NOT AN OPTION IN THIS COUNTRY. A Basic Law provides that the ownership of Israel lands SHALL NOT BE TRANSFERRED EITHER BY SALE OR IN ANY OTHER MANNER — long-term leasing is permitted, selling is not. No conservation purchaser, no land trust and no community buy-out can acquire such land. The routes that remain are the ones this file has recorded elsewhere in the region: leasehold, designation, use rights and agreement. Establish the tenure of the ground you are defending first, because it decides which half of this map applies to you. NOW THE BODY: an umbrella organisation of the country's farmers, grown out of an association of agricultural villages founded in 1920 and among the oldest agricultural organisations here. ITS FUNCTION IS THE ONE THIS CATEGORY EXISTS FOR: it is concerned with the professional, economic and social problems of its members and REPRESENTS THEM BEFORE GOVERNMENT AGENCIES. Its structure reaches the ground — local branches in the form of AGRICULTURAL COMMITTEES OR COOPERATIVES across dozens of villages, thousands of member families, and separate associations for particular branches of farming, alongside affiliated supply, marketing and mutual funds. THAT MATTERS FOR A LAND DISPUTE BECAUSE THE VILLAGE-LEVEL AGRICULTURAL COMMITTEE IS THE BODY THAT ALREADY SPEAKS FOR THE GROWERS OF ONE PLACE, and a national federation behind it is what turns a local objection into a sectoral one. Its secretary-general appears at national agricultural conferences on reforms affecting the sector, so it is active and audible. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE REAL. It is a sectoral representative body that works with government on marketing, taxation and transport rather than an environmental objector, and nothing found shows it opposing a development scheme. Its membership is private farmers, so tenants and labourers may not be covered as they are under the Turkish chambers recorded elsewhere in this file. AND NO WEBSITE COULD BE REACHED — this entry points at its own public page; much of the published description of its structure is decades old and should be verified. ONE HISTORICAL NOTE WITH PRACTICAL FORCE: the cooperative village model here — community ownership of land, individual ownership of homes, cooperative enterprise — was studied by a visiting delegation who went home and founded the first COMMUNITY LAND TRUST. The vehicle communities elsewhere use to hold land collectively was exported from this country, even though this country's own law forbids the sale that such a trust would need.

trackers.name: Planning information site — file your objection here, and read the committee's minutes first
trackers.desc: THIS IS NOT A MAP. IT IS WHERE OBJECTIONS ARE ACTUALLY FILED. The site allows SUBMITTING OBJECTIONS ONLINE FOR PLANS THAT HAVE BEEN DEPOSITED, and it was built by the planning administration's own digital division FOR TRANSPARENCY AND TO MAKE INFORMATION ACCESSIBLE TO THE GENERAL PUBLIC as well as to professional bodies. Every other entry recorded for this country tells a community who might help; this one is the door itself. BEFORE YOU OBJECT, KNOW THE TWO REQUIREMENTS AND THE EXCEPTION THAT MATTERS MOST. You must prepare a file setting out THE REASON for the objection, and you must hold A LAWYER'S AFFIDAVIT — EXCEPT FOR NATIONAL INFRASTRUCTURE PLANS, WHERE NO AFFIDAVIT IS REQUIRED. That exception is the single most useful fact in this entry: the largest schemes, the ones a village is least able to fund a fight against, are the ones it can object to without paying a lawyer to swear an affidavit. You then verify your identity through the government identification system, and the objection form is presented with guidance. READ THE COMMITTEE BEFORE YOU WRITE TO IT. The site publishes THE CONTACT DETAILS OF THE PLANNING COMMITTEES and information about their deliberations — INCLUDING AGENDAS, MINUTES AND DECISIONS. An objection written after reading the minutes of how similar plans were handled, and addressed to the committee that will hear it, is a different document from one written blind. YOU CAN ALSO SEARCH PLANS, APPLICATIONS AND APPEALS. Appeals matter: seeing whether anyone has already appealed a similar decision tells you whether the ground has been tested and on what argument. NOW THE WARNING, AND IT CAN COST YOU EVERYTHING. DATA ON PLANS UNDER LOCAL COMMITTEE AUTHORITY WERE RECEIVED FROM THOSE COMMITTEES AS THEY SUPPLIED THEM, DO NOT CONSTITUTE AN OFFICIAL OR LEGALLY BINDING PUBLICATION, AND ARE UPDATED ONLY SO FAR AS THE LOCAL COMMITTEE PASSED THE INFORMATION ON. The information is provided as it stands and the state accepts no responsibility for errors. AN OBJECTION PERIOD MISSED BECAUSE THE PORTAL WAS STALE IS NOT RECOVERABLE — so confirm the deposit date and the closing date directly with the local committee, using the contact details the site itself publishes, and do it early. USE IT WITH THE LEGAL AND PLANNING ORGANISATIONS RECORDED SEPARATELY FOR THIS COUNTRY, which are the bodies that can draft the objection and supply the affidavit where one is needed.

trackers.name: National hydrological committee chair — a named route into the water authority
trackers.desc: THE CHAIRPERSON OF THE NATIONAL HYDROLOGICAL COMMITTEE SITS IN BOTH THE NATIONAL COMMISSION AND THE WATER AUTHORITY, with a published address and with correspondence copied to a secretariat that publishes TWO TELEPHONE NUMBERS. THAT MATTERS BECAUSE THE WATER AUTHORITY IS THE BODY THAT DECIDES ALLOCATION. This is a named route into it through a scientific committee rather than through a complaints desk — and a technical enquiry addressed to a committee chairperson is answered by a different part of an institution than a grievance addressed to its public counter. WHAT TO ASK: which body holds the abstraction and allocation records for a named stream, spring or aquifer; whether monitoring data exists for a site; and what the committee has published on the basin in question. THE ANSWER TO THE FIRST QUESTION IS OFTEN THE WHOLE PROBLEM — communities lose water arguments because they do not know which office holds the numbers. AND THE COMMITTEE ITSELF IS A MAP. The programme recommends that national committees be MULTI-STAKEHOLDER IN MEMBERSHIP — scientists, water managers, government bodies, professional associations and CIVIL SOCIETY — so asking who the members are identifies every institution in the country working on water, and asking whether civil society is represented is asking for what the programme says should be there. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE PLAIN. THE CHAIRPERSON IS AN OFFICIAL OF THE WATER AUTHORITY, WHICH IS FREQUENTLY THE COUNTERPARTY IN A WATER DISPUTE — this is a route to data and to people, not to sympathy. The committee runs under government authority. Frame everything as a request for records and for the identity of the record-holder, and take the dispute itself to the planning objection route, the legal organisations and the environmental groups recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Cooperative societies register — the body that actually holds the land lease, and the model rules you can adopt
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY WAS THE LAST IN THIS MAP WITH ONLY ONE ROUTE TO HOLDING LAND, AND THE GAP WAS REAL RATHER THAN A TAGGING ERROR — ITS LISTING HOLDS CAMPAIGNERS, PLANNERS, LAWYERS AND A FARMERS' UMBRELLA, BUT NOTHING THAT HOLDS GROUND. HERE IS THE VEHICLE ITS OWN COUNTRYSIDE RUNS ON: THE ALLOCATION AGREEMENT IS A LEASE SIGNED BETWEEN A COOPERATIVE SOCIETY AND THE STATE LAND AUTHORITY, and the allocation is the TOTAL UNIT OF LAND ASSIGNED TO THAT SOCIETY — for agriculture, industry, employment, commerce, leisure and other designations, with an individual holding inside it being the land designated to a member for residence and livelihood. IN THE RURAL SECTOR HERE, THE COOPERATIVE SOCIETY IS THE ENTITY THAT HOLDS THE LAND. A group of people cannot lease state land as a crowd; a registered society can. THE TYPES ARE FIXED BY REGULATION AND CHOOSING THE RIGHT ONE IS THE FIRST DECISION. AN AGRICULTURAL COOPERATIVE SOCIETY covers bodies engaged in settlement or agriculture, or whose members wholly or partly are — and it is expressly SUITABLE FOR SOCIAL, SETTLEMENT AND BUSINESS AIMS ALIKE, which is unusually wide. A COMMUNITY SETTLEMENT SOCIETY organises members' settlement as a community and runs community life as its own statute provides. AND THERE IS A WATER SUPPLY SOCIETY WHOSE WHOLE PURPOSE IS REGULATING THE SUPPLY OF WATER TO ITS MEMBERS — which is the form to examine wherever a community's fight is about a spring, a well or an irrigation source. REGISTRATION IS SIMPLER THAN COMMUNITIES EXPECT, AND ONE PROVISION SAVES MONTHS: A SOCIETY MAY ADOPT THE MODEL RULES THE REGISTRAR HAS APPROVED FOR SOCIETIES OF ITS TYPE INSTEAD OF DRAFTING ITS OWN. This file has warned repeatedly that a statute drafted badly closes doors for years; here the state supplies a tested one free. Founders submit two signed copies of the statute and appoint one person to negotiate the registration. KNOW ALSO THAT THE REGISTRAR DETERMINES THE SOCIETY'S TYPE AND NOTIFIES IT IN WRITING — AND MAY LATER CHANGE IT, amending the register and issuing a corrected certificate. THE TYPE IS NOT PURELY YOUR CHOICE, so match your stated objects to the type you want before filing, and keep the notification, because the classification governs what the society may do with its land. THERE IS A PUBLIC DATABASE FOR FINDING ANY REGISTERED SOCIETY. USE IT BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE: find out which society already holds the allocation covering the ground you care about, because the lease-holder is the party a developer must deal with, and its members are the people whose votes decide. ONE MORE STRUCTURE WORTH KNOWING: AN AUDIT UNION IS A REGISTERED ASSOCIATION OF SOCIETIES WHOSE MAIN PURPOSE IS AUDITING THE ACCOUNTS OF ITS MEMBER SOCIETIES, alongside supervision and education in cooperation — a route to independent scrutiny of how a society is being run, which matters when a society's leadership is the one agreeing to a development. THE LIMITS: this is a legal form and a registry, not an organisation that will help you — nobody here advises or funds. Most land is state land leased through this system rather than owned, so a society holds a lease and its terms govern everything. And the same form is used by settlements of every political description; recording it here is a statement about a legal vehicle, not about any of them.

trackers.name: Open spaces fund — one per cent of state land revenue, spent on protecting open land
trackers.desc: THE FUNDING MODEL IS THE REASON TO RECORD THIS AND THE REASON TO LOOK FOR IT ELSEWHERE: THE FUND IS FINANCED BY ONE PER CENT OF THE STATE LAND AUTHORITY'S REVENUES, FIXED IN REGULATIONS. A SET SHARE OF WHAT THE STATE EARNS FROM LAND IS SPENT ON PROTECTING OPEN LAND — so the money grows as development proceeds, which makes it the rare fund that is not exhausted by the pressure it exists to answer. It was established in 2009 and is operated and financed by the land authority itself, under regulations made in 2011, and governed by a NINE-MEMBER BOARD representing institutions named in those regulations. WHAT IT PAYS FOR IS BROAD AND EXPLICIT: THE PRESERVATION, ENVIRONMENTAL DEVELOPMENT AND CULTIVATION OF OPEN SPACES OUTSIDE BUILT-UP URBAN AREAS — INCLUDING OPEN SPACES IMPORTANT FOR BIODIVERSITY AND ECOLOGICAL SYSTEMS, parks and recreation areas — AND ASSISTANCE TO BODIES WORKING TOWARDS THOSE AIMS. It also funds THE REHABILITATION OF QUARRIES AND ABANDONED SITES, which is the answer for a community living beside a worked-out pit nobody will restore. IT BUDGETS SURVEYS AS WELL AS WORKS. That is the line to ask about first: a funded survey of what an open area actually contains is cheaper than a project, far easier to approve, and produces the documentation that every later argument depends on. THE SCALE IS REAL — IN ONE YEAR A HUNDRED MILLION SHEKELS WENT TO NINETY-THREE ENVIRONMENTAL PROJECTS — AND IT DISTRIBUTES THROUGH PUBLISHED CALLS FOR PROPOSALS, three of them in a single year in one instance, one specifically for PRACTICAL ACTIONS IN OPEN SPACES. BUT READ THE ELIGIBILITY BEFORE PLANNING ANYTHING: THE APPLICANTS NAMED IN THAT CALL WERE LOCAL AUTHORITIES, GOVERNMENT MINISTRIES, GOVERNMENT COMPANIES AND STATUTORY BODIES. A COMMUNITY DOES NOT APPLY — ITS LOCAL AUTHORITY DOES. So the work is to arrive at the council with a specific, costed proposal for a named open area and ask it to submit, exactly as this file recorded for a municipal heritage fund in another country. A regional council with open land in its area and no cost to itself has little reason to refuse. AND USE THE PUBLISHED DECISIONS, WHICH INCLUDE PROJECTS REJECTED FOR FAILING THRESHOLD CONDITIONS. READING WHY OTHERS WERE REFUSED IS THE FASTEST WAY TO LEARN WHAT A COMPLIANT APPLICATION LOOKS LIKE, and it costs nothing. THE LIMITS: it is operated by the authority that manages state land and sells development rights, so it funds preservation within the state's own planning framework and will not fund opposition to a plan. Its money follows government priorities and its board is institutional. AND IT PAYS FOR WORKS AND SURVEYS ON OPEN LAND — IT DOES NOT BUY LAND OR PAY LEGAL COSTS. Read it with the planning objection routes and the cooperative land vehicle recorded separately for this country.THE FUND'S PURCHASE MECHANISM HAS ITS OWN PUBLISHED CALL, AND ITS TERMS ARE THE PART A COMMUNITY CAN ACT ON: ASSISTANCE IN FINANCING THE PURCHASE OF LAND IN OPEN SPACES, WITH A GUIDELINES FILE SETTING OUT WHO MAY APPLY AND WHAT THE APPLICATION MUST PROVE. WHO MAY APPLY IS NOT INDIVIDUALS: LOCAL AUTHORITIES INCLUDING MUNICIPALITIES, LOCAL COUNCILS AND REGIONAL COUNCILS, ALONGSIDE GOVERNMENTAL BODIES WITH NATIONAL RESPONSIBILITY AND STATUTORY AUTHORITIES — AND LOCAL AUTHORITIES MAY SUBMIT ONE AREA EACH. SO THE COMMUNITY'S CAMPAIGN IS TO PERSUADE ITS OWN COUNCIL TO SPEND THAT SINGLE SUBMISSION ON ITS VALLEY. THAT IS WON IN A COUNCIL MEETING RATHER THAN AGAINST A DEVELOPER, AND IT IS A FAR CHEAPER FIGHT THAN ANY OBJECTION. THE APPLICATION MUST CONTAIN A GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF THE AREA INTENDED FOR PURCHASE, THE ADVANTAGES OF BUYING IT FOR CONSERVATION, AND A FULL STATUTORY REVIEW OF EXISTING AND IN-PROCESS LAND DESIGNATIONS AT ALL PLANNING LEVELS — NATIONAL, DISTRICT AND LOCAL MASTER PLANS. START THAT STATUTORY REVIEW NOW, WHETHER OR NOT A PURCHASE EVER HAPPENS. KNOWING WHAT IS ALREADY PLANNED FOR YOUR GROUND AT EVERY LEVEL, INCLUDING WHAT IS STILL IN PROCESS, IS EXACTLY THE INFORMATION THAT ARRIVES TOO LATE IN MOST CASES — AND AN IN-PROCESS DEVELOPMENT DESIGNATION MAKES LAND BOTH MORE URGENT TO BUY AND MORE EXPENSIVE, WHICH TELLS YOU HOW FAST TO MOVE. DECISIONS ARE REGIONAL: THE FUND'S MANAGEMENT EXAMINES THE DATA, SETS PRIORITIES AND DEFINES ANNUAL PURCHASE BUDGETS BY REGION, FOLLOWED BY A TRANSACTION FORMATION STAGE. THE COMPETITION IS THEREFORE WITH OTHER AREAS IN YOUR OWN REGION — ASK WHAT THIS YEAR'S REGIONAL PRIORITIES ARE BEFORE THE COUNCIL DRAFTS ANYTHING. ONE CAVEAT ON THE CALL ITSELF: THE PUBLISHED ONE IS FROM A PARTICULAR YEAR AND ITS DEADLINE HAS PASSED — IT IS RECORDED AS A RECURRING MECHANISM WHOSE CURRENT TERMS MUST BE CHECKED, AND IT IS ASSISTANCE IN FINANCING RATHER THAN FULL FUNDING.

trackers.name: State legal aid — free representation on an income test, and the significance test a land case should aim at
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY'S LISTING HELD PLANNERS, A LEGAL CENTRE, A FREEDOM-OF-INFORMATION LITIGATOR AND OBJECTION ROUTES — AND NO ANSWER FOR SOMEONE WHO CANNOT PAY A LAWYER. UNDER THE LEGAL AID LAW, PEOPLE OF LOW INCOME ARE ENTITLED TO FREE OR SUBSIDISED REPRESENTATION, ON AN INCOME AND PROPERTY TEST. BUT THERE IS A SECOND TEST, AND IT IS THE ONE A COMMUNITY SHOULD AIM AT: THE MATTER MUST BE A CASE OF SUBSTANTIAL LEGAL AND SOCIAL SIGNIFICANCE. A DISPUTE THAT AFFECTS A WHOLE VILLAGE, A SHARED WATER SOURCE OR AN AREA OF OPEN LAND IS EXACTLY THE KIND OF CLAIM THAT ARGUMENT FITS — so an application should set out the public significance as carefully as the poverty. HOW TO APPLY, PRECISELY: a detailed form to the legal aid department, with personal details, FINANCIAL DOCUMENTS, and a full explanation of the legal proceeding required. Attach income confirmations, payslips and an affidavit of financial position. THERE IS A TELEPHONE LINE FOR THE LEGAL AID DIVISION for questions before you file. NOW THE PART ALMOST NOBODY IS TOLD, AND IT DECIDES THE QUALITY OF WHAT YOU GET. APPOINTED LAWYERS COME FROM A POOL OF EXTERNAL LAWYERS THAT EACH BUREAU RECRUITS AND MANAGES, AND MEMBERSHIP OF THAT POOL IS A THRESHOLD CONDITION FOR BEING APPOINTED. The bureaus keep CLOSE AND CONTINUOUS SUPERVISION over the pool and deliberately keep it SMALL AND HIGH-QUALITY so that supervision can be effective — which means the lawyer you are assigned is being watched by the body that appointed them. AND A RULE WORTH KNOWING IF YOUR CASE IS QUIETLY HANDED ON: A LAWYER IN THE POOL MAY NOT TRANSFER A LEGAL AID CASE TO A LAWYER WHO IS NOT IN THE POOL — NOT EVEN A PARTNER OR AN EMPLOYEE IN THE SAME FIRM. If a different person turns up to handle your matter, ask whether they are in the pool. Replacement of an assigned lawyer may also be examined depending on circumstances, though it may not be granted, AND THERE IS AN ONLINE PUBLIC ENQUIRIES FORM FOR RAISING IT. IF YOU ARE REFUSED, THE ROUTE DOES NOT END. Those found ineligible are directed to free or nominal-fee assistance from other organisations — including the bar association's PRO BONO PROGRAMME and UNIVERSITY LEGAL CLINICS, and this file records a planning-focused body and a legal centre with a land and planning practice separately for this country. THE LIMITS: eligibility turns first on personal poverty, so a community that is not individually poor will not qualify however important its case — in that situation the significance argument belongs to the pro bono programme and the clinics instead. Legal aid also covers defined categories of proceeding, and planning objections may not be among them; ASK THE HOTLINE WHETHER YOUR TYPE OF PROCEEDING IS COVERED BEFORE ASSEMBLING THE PAPERWORK.

trackers.name: Nature and parks authority — the department that promotes declarations, and the route by which a reserve can be shrunk
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY'S LISTING HELD PLANNERS, LAWYERS, A FREEDOM-OF-INFORMATION ROUTE AND SEVERAL WATCHDOGS — AND NOTHING ABOUT THE ONE ACT THAT PROTECTS GROUND PERMANENTLY. THE AUTHORITY'S PLANNING AND DEVELOPMENT DIVISION HAS THREE DEPARTMENTS, AND THE FIRST OF THEM, THE LAND DEPARTMENT, DEALS MAINLY WITH PROMOTING THE DECLARATION OF NATURE RESERVES AND NATIONAL PARKS. THERE IS A DEPARTMENT WHOSE JOB IS GETTING LAND DECLARED — THAT IS WHERE A COMMUNITY WITH A SITE SHOULD WRITE. KNOW WHICH CATEGORY YOU ARE ASKING FOR, BECAUSE IT DETERMINES WHAT EVIDENCE MATTERS: A NATURE RESERVE PROTECTS FAUNA, FLORA, SOIL, WATER BODIES OR LANDSCAPE VALUES FOR SCIENTIFIC AND CONSERVATION PURPOSES, WHILE A NATIONAL PARK COVERS SITES OF HISTORIC, NATIONAL OR TOURIST VALUE. Species records and habitat surveys support the first; historical documentation and visitor value support the second. Gathering the wrong evidence wastes years. AND YEARS IS THE RIGHT UNIT. DECLARATION IS A LONG AND COMPLEX PROCESS THAT USUALLY TAKES MANY YEARS: A PLAN IS PREPARED, SENT TO THE PLANNING ADMINISTRATION IN THE INTERIOR MINISTRY FOR THE DECLARATION PROCEDURES, AND THE FINAL STAGE IS A MINISTERIAL SIGNATURE. Declarations arrive in batches — recent rounds covered five and six sites at once, one totalling about 2,200 dunams — SO A SITE IS BEST ADVANCED ALONGSIDE OTHERS RATHER THAN ALONE. THE OBSTACLE IS DOCUMENTED BY THE STATE AUDIT OFFICE AND WORTH CITING WHEN PRESSING: DECLARATION PLANNING HAS BEEN DELAYED BECAUSE PLANNING COMMITTEES DEMANDED A FINANCIAL INDEMNITY UNDERTAKING FROM THE AUTHORITY AS A CONDITION OF CONTINUING THE PROCESS — the auditor recommended that question be settled so it stops blocking planning, and also found permissions to operate and supervise inside declared areas delayed by years. IF A DECLARATION STALLS, THE INDEMNITY DEMAND IS THE FIRST THING TO ASK ABOUT. NOW THE PART THAT MATTERS WHEN A RESERVE ALREADY EXISTS AND A SCHEME WANTS PART OF IT. A DECLARATION CAN BE CANCELLED — BUT ONLY THROUGH A NAMED SEQUENCE: THE NATIONAL PARKS AND NATURE RESERVES COUNCIL, THE AGREEMENT OF THE ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION MINISTER, EACH LOCAL AUTHORITY WHOSE AREA IS INCLUDED, AND THE APPROVAL OF THE PARLIAMENTARY INTERIOR AND ENVIRONMENT COMMITTEE. AND THE CANCELLATION MUST BE PUBLISHED. EVERY ONE OF THOSE IS A CHOKEPOINT WITH A DIFFERENT AUDIENCE — a council, a minister, a municipality, and a parliamentary committee that sits in public. A COMMUNITY DEFENDING A RESERVE SHOULD KNOW THAT EXCISIONS ARE ALSO EXAMINED WITHIN THE PLANNING PROCESS, so the planning objection routes recorded separately here run in parallel with the political ones. THE LIMITS: this is the state authority that manages protected areas, NOT A CAMPAIGN GROUP — it promotes declarations it judges worthwhile and will not adopt a site because residents want it. Declaration takes years and does not stop a scheme in the meantime. It also both protects areas and develops them for visitors, which is not always what neighbours want. Read it with the planning-objection, legal and open-landscape routes recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Crowdfunding for public and legal fights — the platform built for it, the commission rates, and why the supporter list matters more than the money
trackers.desc: THE BRIEF ASKS HOW A COMMUNITY RAISES MONEY TO FIGHT A PROJECT. IN THIS COUNTRY ONE CROWDFUNDING GROUP RUNS FOUR PLATFORMS, AND ONE OF THEM EXISTS SPECIFICALLY TO RAISE SUPPORT FOR ADVANCING PUBLIC AND LEGAL STRUGGLES. The others handle general projects, donation-based giving, and matching investors with businesses — SO CHOOSE THE ONE BUILT FOR CAMPAIGNS RATHER THAN THE ONE BUILT FOR PRODUCTS. THE MODELS AND WHAT THEY COST DECIDE WHETHER A CAMPAIGN IS WORTH RUNNING. ONE PLATFORM OFFERS THREE TRACKS: ALL-OR-NOTHING, WHERE THE ENTIRE TARGET MUST BE RAISED WITHIN THE SET TIME, AT SIX PER CENT PLUS TAX; FLEXIBLE, WHERE THE PROJECT RECEIVES WHATEVER WAS RAISED EVEN IF THE TARGET IS MISSED, AT NINE PER CENT PLUS TAX; AND A STANDING-ORDER TRACK WITH NO DEADLINE AND NO TARGET, FOR RECURRING SUPPORT. THE FLEXIBLE TRACK COSTS THREE POINTS MORE AND REMOVES THE RISK OF RAISING NOTHING. FOR A LEGAL FIGHT, WHERE COSTS ARRIVE IN STAGES AND THE TOTAL IS UNKNOWN AT THE START, THAT IS USUALLY THE RIGHT TRADE — and the standing-order track is the one to use for an ongoing watch that will run for years rather than weeks. IT WORKS FOR PUBLIC CAMPAIGNS, NOT ONLY FOR PRODUCTS: ONE MOVEMENT SET A TARGET OF SIXTY THOUSAND AND RAISED 105,277 FROM 1,013 PEOPLE; ANOTHER CAMPAIGN RAISED MORE THAN A HUNDRED AND FIFTY THOUSAND FROM ABOUT 660 SUPPORTERS. Campaigns on contested public questions have succeeded here where organisers expected them to fail. AND THE ORGANISER'S OWN CORRECTION IS THE MOST VALUABLE LINE IN THIS ENTRY: THEY INSISTED THE PEOPLE WHO GAVE WERE SUPPORTERS, NOT DONORS — BECAUSE THE MONEY MATTERED, BUT THE SUPPORT MATTERED NO LESS. A THOUSAND NAMED PEOPLE WHO PAID SOMETHING TOWARDS OPPOSING A SCHEME ARE A CONSTITUENCY, AND THE LIST IS EVIDENCE OF PUBLIC CONCERN THAT CAN BE PUT IN FRONT OF A PLANNING BODY, A COUNCIL OR A COURT. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED OBJECTION ROUTES IN EVERY COUNTRY THAT ASK HOW MANY PEOPLE OBJECT; A FUNDING CAMPAIGN PRODUCES THAT NUMBER AS A BY-PRODUCT, with names, amounts and dates attached. SO RUN THE CAMPAIGN EVEN IF THE SUM IS MODEST, AND KEEP THE SUPPORTER LIST AS CAREFULLY AS THE MONEY. Several other platforms operate in the same market, giving a choice of route, and SOME OFFER PAID CONSULTING AND CAMPAIGN MANAGEMENT alongside the platform — worth considering only where the sum at stake justifies the fee. THE CAUTIONS ARE REAL. PLATFORMS HAVE REFUSED OR HALTED CAMPAIGNS ON CONTESTED SUBJECTS UNDER PUBLIC PRESSURE, so a campaign touching a politically charged dispute may be removed after launch — read the platform's terms before building a strategy on it, and keep the supporter list somewhere you control. AT LEAST ONE PLATFORM DESCRIBED IN OLDER SOURCES HAS SINCE CLOSED, so confirm a platform is operating and check its current commission before committing. Commission figures here come from published reporting and were not re-verified. Read this with the planning-objection and legal routes recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Government procurement administration — forthcoming central tenders announced in advance, and monthly reports with an as-at date
trackers.desc: THE PROCUREMENT ADMINISTRATION SITS INSIDE THE ACCOUNTANT GENERAL'S DIVISION AT THE FINANCE MINISTRY AND RUNS THE STATE PROCUREMENT SITE. ITS OWN DESCRIPTION OF ITS TASK IS THE MOST USEFUL SENTENCE ON THE PAGE: PROCUREMENT IS CARRIED OUT BY CONTRACTING WITH SUPPLIERS SUBJECT TO THE MANDATORY TENDERS LAW, AND THE CENTRAL CHALLENGE IS HOW TO ENSURE AN EQUAL AND TRANSPARENT PROCESS. EQUALITY AND TRANSPARENCY ARE THE STATED OBJECTS OF THE SYSTEM, NOT CONCESSIONS TO BE ARGUED FOR. THAT IS THE LANGUAGE TO USE WHEN AN AUTHORITY TREATS A CONTRACT AS ITS PRIVATE BUSINESS, and this file has now found the same stated purpose in three separate procurement systems. THE EARLY WARNING IS HERE TOO: THE ADMINISTRATION ANNOUNCES, AS THE TENDER PUBLISHER, THAT IT INTENDS TO PUBLISH IN THE COMING WEEKS A CENTRAL TENDER FOR NAMED GOODS OR SERVICES. AN INTENTION TO TENDER, PUBLISHED BEFORE THE TENDER — the third country in this thread with that artefact, after a future-competitions list and a compulsory pre-tender plan. AND IT PUBLISHES CHANGES, WHICH ARE OFTEN MORE INFORMATIVE THAN THE ORIGINAL NOTICES: A RECORDED ANNOUNCEMENT STATES THAT THE DIGITAL TENDER BOX FOR A NUMBERED TENDER WAS CANCELLED AND REPUBLISHED. A CANCELLED AND REISSUED TENDER USUALLY MEANS THE REQUIREMENT, THE TERMS OR THE FIELD OF BIDDERS HAS CHANGED — and the fact of cancellation is public even when the reason is not. THE REPORTS ARE UPDATED MONTHLY AND EACH CARRIES AN EXPLICIT AS-AT DATE. THAT IS A SMALL THING WITH REAL VALUE: A READER CAN TELL HOW CURRENT A PUBLISHED FIGURE IS, AND CAN COMPARE TWO MONTHS' REPORTS TO SEE WHAT MOVED — which is how spending patterns become visible without anyone having to disclose anything extra. ONE STATED PRIORITY IS WORTH USING DIRECTLY: THE DIVISION SAYS IT ATTACHES GREAT IMPORTANCE TO INCLUDING AND ENCOURAGING MICRO, SMALL AND MEDIUM BUSINESSES IN GOVERNMENT PROCUREMENT. A LOCAL COOPERATIVE, NURSERY, SURVEYOR OR CONTRACTOR THAT WANTS WORK ON ITS OWN GROUND IS THE CATEGORY THE SYSTEM SAYS IT WANTS TO INCLUDE — and this payload has now recorded small-business preference in three countries, which converts opposition into a claim to participate. THE LIMITS: this is the central purchasing administration — IT EXISTS TO CONTRACT, NOT TO CONSULT, AND NOTHING HERE CREATES A RIGHT TO OBJECT to a tender or an award. It covers government ministries; local authority and statutory corporation procurement runs elsewhere, and a community's local scheme may not appear here at all. Whether award results, values and winners are published on the same site WAS NOT VERIFIED. Read it with the planning-objection routes, the nature and parks authority and the legal aid and crowdfunding routes recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Environmental defence association — lawyers, planners and scientists in one body, with cancelled schemes on the record
trackers.desc: THE BRIEF ASKS FOR THE BEST LOCAL ANTI-DEVELOPMENT LAWYERS. THE STRONGEST ANSWER IN THIS COUNTRY IS NOT A FIRM BUT AN ASSOCIATION FOUNDED IN 1990 THAT COMBINES SCIENTIFIC, LEGAL, PLANNING AND PROFESSIONAL EXPERTISE IN ONE BODY — AND WHICH STATES THAT IT WORKS ALONGSIDE CITIZENS, COMPANIES AND OTHER ASSOCIATIONS. LAWYERS, PLANNERS AND SCIENTISTS UNDER ONE ROOF IS EXACTLY WHAT AN OBJECTION NEEDS AND EXACTLY WHAT A COMMUNITY CANNOT ASSEMBLE FOR ITSELF. A PLANNING OBJECTION FAILS FOR WANT OF A PLANNER AS OFTEN AS FOR WANT OF A LAWYER, and hiring the three separately is beyond almost any village. WHAT IT DOES IS SET OUT PLAINLY: FORMULATING NATIONAL PLANS ON ENVIRONMENTAL QUESTIONS, PROVIDING PUBLIC INFORMATION, DRAFTING NEW LEGISLATION AND VERIFYING THAT EXISTING LAW IS APPLIED, AND ADVANCING LEGAL STRUGGLES WHILE WORKING ALONGSIDE THE COMMUNITY. THE RECORD IS SPECIFIC, WHICH IS WHY IT BELONGS HERE RATHER THAN A MISSION STATEMENT. IN 2000 A PETITION TO THE SUPREME COURT COMPELLED THE NATIONAL FORESTRY BODY TO CARRY OUT WIDE-SCALE PLANNING AND TO PREPARE AND APPROVE DETAILED PLANS FOR ALL THE FOREST AREAS UNDER ITS MANAGEMENT — AFTER YEARS OF AFFORESTATION AND DEVELOPMENT WORKS CARRIED OUT WITHOUT DETAILED PLANS, WHICH HAD SERIOUSLY DAMAGED FAUNA, FLORA AND SOIL. THAT CASE IS WORTH UNDERSTANDING BEYOND ITS COUNTRY: A BODY THAT MANAGES LAND FOR CONSERVATION PURPOSES WAS ITSELF FOUND TO BE DEVELOPING WITHOUT THE PLANS THE LAW REQUIRED. THE QUESTION OF WHETHER THE STEWARD HAS ITS OWN APPROVED PLANS IS ONE ALMOST NOBODY ASKS. IN 2002 ITS LEGAL ACTIVITY, TOGETHER WITH RESIDENTS, LED TO THE CANCELLATION OF AN ELECTRICITY COMPANY'S PLAN FOR A SUBSTATION NEXT TO HOMES; AND IN THE SAME YEAR IT PETITIONED AFTER PLANNING INSTITUTIONS ADVANCED A SCHEME FOR SOME FIVE THOUSAND RESIDENTS WITHOUT PUBLIC OPEN SPACES. NOTE THE PATTERN: THE WINS COME WHERE THE ORGANISATION ACTS TOGETHER WITH THE PEOPLE WHO LIVE THERE, not on their behalf. AND ONE OUTCOME OUTLIVED ALL THE CASES: A 2003 SUPREME COURT JUDGMENT BEARING THIS ORGANISATION'S NAME IS CITED IN THE PLANNING-LAW LITERATURE AS AUTHORITY FOR THE IMPORTANCE OF PUBLIC PARTICIPATION AT THE VARIOUS STAGES OF PLANNING. A COMMUNITY ARGUING THAT IT SHOULD HAVE BEEN CONSULTED IS ARGUING FROM A NAMED PRECEDENT RATHER THAN FROM PRINCIPLE. IT STILL WORKS THIS WAY NOW: IN A CONTESTED SCHEME ON A HEAVILY CONTAMINATED SITE, RESIDENTS' OBJECTIONS WERE BACKED BY COOPERATION WITH THIS ORGANISATION AND WITH THE NATURE PROTECTION SOCIETY, ALONGSIDE PRIVATE COUNSEL FROM A COMMERCIAL FIRM — WHICH IS THE COMBINATION TO AIM FOR: THE ASSOCIATION FOR EXPERTISE AND STANDING, PAID COUNSEL FOR THE FILING, AND THE RESIDENTS AS THE CLIENTS. THE LIMITS: it is a national association with its own priorities and cannot take every case — approach it early with a documented file rather than late with a crisis, and expect it to choose cases with wider significance. THIS ENTRY RESTS ON ENCYCLOPEDIC AND PRESS SOURCES RATHER THAN THE ORGANISATION'S OWN MATERIALS, AND THE CASES CITED ARE OLDER EXAMPLES; current capacity, intake criteria and whether it charges were NOT VERIFIED. Read it with the planning-objection route, the crowdfunding platforms and the nature and parks authority recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: University law clinics — free representation of resident groups in planning and building proceedings, lawyers leading, students assisting
trackers.desc: THE BRIEF ASKS FOR THE BEST LOCAL ANTI-DEVELOPMENT LAWYERS. IN THIS COUNTRY SOME OF THEM SIT IN UNIVERSITY LAW FACULTIES AND WORK FOR NOTHING. ONE ENVIRONMENTAL CLINIC STATES THAT IT REPRESENTS GROUPS OF RESIDENTS, PRIVATE CITIZENS AND ORGANISATIONS IN LEGAL PROCEEDINGS — INCLUDING PLANNING AND BUILDING PROCEEDINGS, CLASS ACTIONS AND INDIVIDUAL CIVIL SUITS. PLANNING AND BUILDING PROCEEDINGS, NAMED EXPLICITLY. THAT IS THE FORUM WHERE A SCHEME IS APPROVED OR REFUSED, AND A CLINIC THAT ALREADY APPEARS THERE FOR RESIDENT GROUPS IS THE SHORTEST ROUTE TO COMPETENT REPRESENTATION THIS FILE HAS FOUND ANYWHERE IN THE REGION. ITS STATED PURPOSE IN THOSE SUITS IS WORTH QUOTING BACK WHEN INSTRUCTING ANYONE: TO QUANTIFY THE ENVIRONMENTAL DAMAGE AND TO ENSURE THAT THE POLLUTER ACTUALLY PAYS. QUANTIFYING THE DAMAGE IS THE STEP MOST COMMUNITY CASES SKIP — AND IT IS WHAT TURNS A COMPLAINT INTO A CLAIM. IT ALSO WORKS ON POLICY: ADVANCING BILL PROPOSALS, PUBLISHING POSITION PAPERS AND PROVIDING LEGAL OPINIONS — AND IT PUBLISHES A NAMED CONTACT LAWYER, WHICH MEANS THERE IS A PERSON TO WRITE TO RATHER THAN A FACULTY ADDRESS. A SECOND UNIVERSITY RUNS A CLINIC FOR ENVIRONMENTAL JUSTICE WHOSE STUDENTS, UNDER THE GUIDANCE OF LAWYERS, HANDLE MATTERS ADVANCING THE RIGHT TO A HEALTHY ENVIRONMENT AND THE PUBLIC INTEREST IN PREVENTING POLLUTION AND CONSERVING NATURAL RESOURCES — BY REPRESENTING COMMUNITY AND ENVIRONMENTAL ORGANISATIONS AND LOW-INCOME POPULATIONS. NOTE WHO IT REPRESENTS: COMMUNITY ORGANISATIONS AND PEOPLE WITHOUT MEANS. A VILLAGE ASSOCIATION IS EXACTLY THE CLIENT THESE CLINICS EXIST FOR, WHICH IS THE OPPOSITE OF THE COMMERCIAL BAR. A THIRD UNIVERSITY RUNS NINE CLINICS INCLUDING ONE FOR CLIMATE AND ENVIRONMENT AND ONE FOR REPRESENTING POPULATIONS OF THE PERIPHERY — THE SECOND MATTERS BECAUSE RURAL AND OUTLYING COMMUNITIES ARE PRECISELY WHERE LAND IS TAKEN AND WHERE COUNSEL IS SCARCE. A FOURTH RUNS A CLINIC FOR ENVIRONMENTAL REGULATION WHOSE ASSISTANCE IS GIVEN TO ENVIRONMENTAL ORGANISATIONS AND TO COMMUNITIES. AND ONE CLINIC ADDRESSES THE DEMOLITION-AND-REBUILD PROBLEM DIRECTLY: A CLINIC FOR HOUSING, COMMUNITY AND LAW WORKING ON URBAN RENEWAL, INCLUDING EVACUATION-AND-REBUILDING SCHEMES — WHERE RESIDENTS ARE MOVED OUT SO THAT DENSER BUILDING CAN REPLACE THEIR HOMES. THE COMMON FORM ACROSS ALL OF THEM IS THE PART TO UNDERSTAND BEFORE APPROACHING: REPRESENTATION IS BY QUALIFIED LAWYERS WITH STUDENTS ASSISTING, NOT BY STUDENTS ALONE. THE CLINICS ALSO FILE PETITIONS OF PRINCIPLE, PUBLISH POSITION PAPERS AND DRAFT BILLS — SO A CASE THAT RAISES A GENERAL QUESTION IS MORE ATTRACTIVE TO THEM THAN ONE THAT AFFECTS ONLY ONE PLOT. FRAME THE APPROACH AROUND WHAT THE CASE WOULD SETTLE FOR EVERYONE. THE LIMITS: CLINICS ARE TEACHING PROGRAMMES AND RUN ON THE ACADEMIC YEAR — capacity is limited, intake happens in cycles, and a case arriving mid-semester may wait. THEY CHOOSE CASES WITH WIDER SIGNIFICANCE and cannot take everything. WHICH CLINICS ARE OPERATING IN ANY GIVEN YEAR, AND ON WHAT TERMS THEY ACCEPT NEW MATTERS, WERE NOT VERIFIED; the descriptions come from faculty pages and a public legal-aid directory. Read it with the environmental defence association, the planning-objection routes and the crowdfunding platforms recorded separately for this country.THREE THINGS WERE NOT RECORDED HERE, AND THE FIRST IS THAT THERE IS MORE THAN ONE DOOR. A SECOND UNIVERSITY RUNS A CLINIC FOR ENVIRONMENTAL JUSTICE WHOSE STUDENTS WORK UNDER LAWYERS' SUPERVISION ON REPRESENTING COMMUNITY AND ENVIRONMENTAL ORGANISATIONS AND LOW-INCOME POPULATIONS — ACROSS HIGH COURT PETITIONS, ADMINISTRATIVE PETITIONS, CIVIL SUITS, THE DRAFTING AND PROMOTION OF BILLS, AND ONGOING LEGAL ADVICE — AND A THIRD RUNS AN ENVIRONMENTAL REGULATION CLINIC GIVING LEGAL ASSISTANCE TO ORGANISATIONS AND COMMUNITIES THAT SUFFER ENVIRONMENTAL PROBLEMS AND APPROACH IT, INCLUDING REPRESENTATION BEFORE AUTHORITIES, PRACTICALLY ORIENTED LEGAL RESEARCH AND APPEARANCES IN COURT. SO IF ONE CLINIC HAS NO CAPACITY, ASK THE OTHERS — SEVERAL FACULTIES RUN THEM AND THEY DO NOT ALL HAVE ROOM IN THE SAME YEAR. AND REPRESENTATION BEFORE AUTHORITIES IS THE PHRASE TO ASK FOR: MOST CASES ARE LOST AT THE PERMIT STAGE, BEFORE ANY JUDGE IS INVOLVED. THE SECOND IS ABOUT CAPACITY AND WHY IT MOVES: CLINICAL ACTIVITY RESTS ALMOST ENTIRELY ON DONATIONS, AND THE WORK IS DELIVERED BY CLINICIANS — LAWYERS WHO SUPERVISE THE STUDENTS AND APPEAR IN COURT FOR THE CLIENTS — INSIDE THE ACADEMIC CALENDAR. APPROACH EARLY IN THE ACADEMIC YEAR AND ASK WHICH CLINIC IS TAKING NEW MATTERS. THE THIRD IS THE ROUTE TO USE WHEN NO CLINIC CAN ACT: A 1992 STATUTE LETS A LIMITED NUMBER OF BODIES RECOGNISED BY THE ENVIRONMENT MINISTRY BRING CIVIL SUITS AGAINST POLLUTING PLANTS AND OBTAIN A COURT ORDER TO STOP THE NUISANCE, AND A 2019 AMENDMENT WIDENED THE CASES IN WHICH THOSE ORGANISATIONS CAN SUE. THAT ROUTE DOES NOT REQUIRE THE RESIDENT TO PROVE PERSONAL DAMAGE — WHICH IS THE OBSTACLE THAT DEFEATS MOST INDIVIDUAL ENVIRONMENTAL CLAIMS. SO THE QUESTION TO PUT IS NOT ONLY WILL YOU TAKE MY CASE, BUT WHICH RECOGNISED ORGANISATION COULD SUE ON THE PUBLIC'S BEHALF.

trackers.name: Nature protection society — 65,000 members, a published national list of threatened open spaces, and staff who track the fast-track planning routes
trackers.desc: THE MOST USEFUL THING THIS ORGANISATION PRODUCES IS A LIST. IT PUBLISHES A THREATS TO OPEN SPACES REPORT: A LONG CATALOGUE OF BUILDING PLANS, INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECTS AND TOURISM INITIATIVES THAT THREATEN NATURAL AREAS — WRITTEN EXPRESSLY TO RAISE AWARENESS OF UNRESTRAINED DEVELOPMENT AND TO CAUSE THE PUBLIC TO OBJECT TO PLANS THAT HARM THEM. SO THE FIRST QUESTION FOR ANY COMMUNITY HERE IS WHETHER ITS OWN GROUND IS ALREADY ON A NATIONAL LIST. IF IT IS, THE CASE THAT THE PLACE MATTERS HAS BEEN MADE BY THE COUNTRY'S LARGEST MEMBERSHIP ORGANISATION BEFORE YOU SAID A WORD — AND IF IT IS NOT, ASKING TO BE ADDED IS A SMALL REQUEST WITH A LARGE EFFECT. AND THE REPORT IS HONEST ABOUT LOSING. IT NAMES FIGHTS ALREADY LOST — PROJECTS THAT SURVIVED EVERY PROTEST AND EVERY FORMAL OBJECTION AND ARE NOW CREATING FACTS ON THE GROUND. A LIST THAT INCLUDES ITS OWN DEFEATS IS TELLING YOU THE REAL ODDS, WHICH IS THE SAME QUALITY THIS FILE FOUND IN A LITIGATOR'S PUBLISHED COURT PRACTICE ELSEWHERE. THE BODY BEHIND IT WAS FOUNDED IN 1953 AND IS THE OLDEST AND LARGEST ENVIRONMENTAL ORGANISATION IN THE COUNTRY, WITH MORE THAN SIXTY-FIVE THOUSAND INDIVIDUAL AND FAMILY MEMBERS. ITS STATED PURPOSE COVERS THE ENVIRONMENT, NATURE AND LANDSCAPE VALUES, AND THE HISTORICAL AND CULTURAL HERITAGE OF PEOPLE — NATURE AND HERITAGE TOGETHER, WHICH THIS FILE HAS REPEATEDLY FOUND TO BE THE COMBINATION THAT COVERS A WHOLE PLACE RATHER THAN HALF OF IT. SIXTY-FIVE THOUSAND MEMBERS IS THE REAL ASSET. A COMMUNITY OF FORTY HOUSEHOLDS THAT PERSUADES THIS ORGANISATION HAS BORROWED A CONSTITUENCY, AND MEMBERSHIP ORGANISATIONS ARE ANSWERABLE TO MEMBERS — SO A LOCAL BRANCH OR A GROUP OF MEMBERS RAISING YOUR CASE INTERNALLY IS OFTEN FASTER THAN A LETTER TO ITS HEAD OFFICE. WHAT IT HAS ACTUALLY WON IS WORTH KNOWING BEFORE ASKING: MORE PUBLIC OPEN GREEN SPACES SUCH AS URBAN PARKS, AND LEGISLATION PROTECTING THE COAST AND THE SEA THAT PRESERVES THE PUBLIC'S RIGHT TO ENJOY THEM AND SETS PRINCIPLES FOR COASTAL DEVELOPMENT — WITH A DEDICATED MARINE ARM CREATED TO CARRY THAT WORK. A COASTAL COMMUNITY IS THEREFORE RAISING SOMETHING THE ORGANISATION HAS ALREADY LEGISLATED ON. AND IT STAFFS THE PLANNING SIDE PROPERLY, WHICH IS RARE. IT HAS A NAMED COORDINATOR FOR ENERGY AND INFRASTRUCTURE PLANNING, WHO IN 2026 PUBLICLY OPPOSED A PROPOSAL TO CLASSIFY DATA CENTRES AS NATIONAL INFRASTRUCTURE AND PUSH THEM THROUGH AN ACCELERATED PLANNING TRACK — WARNING OF A DESTRUCTIVE DOMINO EFFECT FOR OPEN SPACES, AND ARGUING THAT PRIVATE COMMERCIAL FACILITIES SHOULD NOT SHELTER UNDER THE UMBRELLA OF NATIONAL INFRASTRUCTURE. WATCH FOR THAT MOVE EVERYWHERE: THE RECLASSIFICATION OF A PRIVATE PROJECT AS NATIONAL INFRASTRUCTURE IS WHAT REMOVES IT FROM ORDINARY DISTRICT PLANNING AND FROM THE OBJECTIONS THAT GO WITH IT. THE FIGHT IS OFTEN OVER THE CLASSIFICATION, NOT THE BUILDING — and an organisation with a planning coordinator is the one that sees it coming. THE LIMITS: this is A MEMBERSHIP AND ADVOCACY ORGANISATION, NOT A LAW FIRM OR A LAND-PURCHASE BODY — it petitions courts selectively and cannot take every case, and its own report shows how many fights are lost even with its backing. THE ENTRY IS ANCHORED TO A NEWS ARTICLE rather than the organisation's own pages, and the threats report's current edition and contents WERE NOT VERIFIED. Its remit is national and its priorities are its own. Read it with the environmental defence association, the university legal clinics and the planning objection routes recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Open-space survey institute — it asks residents what they know, publishes draft chapters for comment, and its surveys underpin planning
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HAS TOLD COMMUNITIES OVER AND OVER TO GET THEIR LOCAL KNOWLEDGE INTO AN OFFICIAL DOCUMENT BEFORE A PLAN IS DRAWN. HERE IS AN INSTITUTE THAT ASKS FOR IT. ON A SURVEY BEGUN IN JANUARY 2026, WITH A FINAL DRAFT PLANNED FOR THAT SEPTEMBER, THE INSTITUTE STATES PLAINLY THAT IT WOULD BE GLAD TO RECEIVE INFORMATION ABOUT NATURAL, LANDSCAPE, HERITAGE AND OTHER UNIQUE VALUES KNOWN TO LOCAL PEOPLE — THAT THE SURVEY'S MAP LAYERS WILL BE AVAILABLE ON A DEDICATED SITE THROUGH A FREE MAPPING APPLICATION — AND THAT THE CHAPTERS WILL BE PUBLISHED AS THE WORK PROCEEDS, WITH COMMENTS, ADDITIONS AND CORRECTIONS WELCOME. A DRAFT PUBLISHED CHAPTER BY CHAPTER, WITH AN OPEN INVITATION TO CORRECT IT, IS THE SINGLE CHEAPEST POINT OF INFLUENCE RECORDED ANYWHERE IN THIS FILE. THE SPRING NOBODY MAPPED, THE OLD TERRACE WALL, THE ORCHID SLOPE, THE PLACE THE GAZELLES CROSS — IF IT IS NOT IN THE SURVEY IT WILL NOT BE IN THE PLAN, AND THIS IS THE WINDOW IN WHICH IT COSTS NOTHING TO ADD. THE SURVEYS ARE NOT ACADEMIC EXERCISES: THEY ARE PREPARED AS BACKGROUND FOR SUSTAINABLE PLANNING, AT DISTRICT LEVEL, AT REGIONAL LEVEL FOR A PARTICULAR COUNCIL, AND AS FOCUSED SURVEYS FOR SPECIFIC PLACES SUCH AS STREAMS OR FOR SINGLE ISSUES SUCH AS ENDEMIC PLANTS AT RISK OF EXTINCTION. SO ASK TWO QUESTIONS: IS THERE A SURVEY COVERING MY AREA, AND IS ONE IN PROGRESS. THE INSTITUTE PUBLISHES A SURVEY INDEX WITH NATIONAL, NORTHERN, CENTRAL AND SOUTHERN SECTIONS AND A LIST OF SURVEYS CURRENTLY IN WORK — AN EXISTING SURVEY IS EVIDENCE YOU CAN CITE TOMORROW; ONE IN PROGRESS IS EVIDENCE YOU CAN STILL SHAPE. THE INSTITUTE HAS THE WEIGHT TO MAKE THAT WORTH DOING: ABOUT FORTY-FIVE NATURE AND LANDSCAPE SURVEYS ACROSS BROAD PARTS OF THE COUNTRY OVER TWO DECADES, MORE THAN SEVENTY STUDIES AND POLICY DOCUMENTS COVERING PLANNING AND BUILDING, NATURAL SYSTEMS, AGRICULTURE, RECREATION, GOVERNANCE AND LAND MANAGEMENT, AND A TEAM OF TWENTY-FIVE EXPERT SURVEYORS IN BOTANY, ZOOLOGY, ECOSYSTEMS AND DATA ANALYSIS, WORKING FROM A UNIVERSITY NATURAL HISTORY MUSEUM. AND ITS METHODS ARE PUBLIC, WHICH MATTERS MORE THAN IT SOUNDS: IT HAS PUBLISHED OFFICIAL SURVEY GUIDES — A MAPPING GUIDE AND A SURVEYOR'S GUIDE — AND DEVELOPED INDICES FOR BOTANICAL, ZOOLOGICAL AND ECOLOGICAL VALUE, A MODEL FOR ASSESSING THE CONTINUITY OF OPEN SPACES, AND PROTOCOLS FOR SURVEYING ENDANGERED PLANT SPECIES. PUBLISHED PROTOCOLS LET A COMMUNITY COLLECT IN THE SAME FORMAT THE PROFESSIONALS USE. RECORDS GATHERED TO THE SURVEYOR'S GUIDE ARE FAR HARDER TO SET ASIDE THAN A LIST OF SIGHTINGS — AND THE CONTINUITY MODEL IS THE ARGUMENT AGAINST FRAGMENTATION, WHICH IS WHAT ROADS, FENCES AND SCATTERED BUILDING ACTUALLY DO TO OPEN GROUND. ONE SURVEY DESCRIPTION SHOWS HOW THAT ARGUMENT IS MADE IN PRACTICE: A REGION WHOSE OPEN SPACES FORM SOME SEVENTY PER CENT OF ITS AREA, DESCRIBED AS AN IMPORTANT LINK IN THE NATIONAL NETWORK OF ECOLOGICAL CORRIDORS CONNECTING THREE PARTS OF A REGION AND ALLOWING THE MOVEMENT OF ANIMALS AND THE DISPERSAL OF PLANTS BETWEEN VALUABLE AND PROTECTED AREAS. THE LIMITS: this is A RESEARCH AND SURVEY INSTITUTE, NOT AN ADVOCATE OR A LITIGATOR — it produces the evidence base, IT DOES NOT OBJECT TO PLANS, and its surveys are commissioned by public bodies whose priorities set the scope. A SURVEY RECORDING A VALUE DOES NOT PROTECT IT. WHETHER PUBLIC CONTRIBUTIONS ARE ACCEPTED ON EVERY SURVEY, AND HOW THEY ARE WEIGHED, WAS NOT VERIFIED — the invitation quoted comes from one survey page. Read it with the nature protection society's threats list, the environmental defence association, the university legal clinics and the planning objection routes recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Forest and open-space research fund — three-year grants whose stated goals include citizen science and spring and stream restoration
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HAS TOLD COMMUNITIES REPEATEDLY THAT EVIDENCE IS WHAT WINS AND THAT NOBODY PAYS FOR IT. HERE IS A FUND THAT DOES: A NATIONAL LAND AND FORESTRY BODY RUNS AN OPEN CALL SUPPORTING RESEARCH AS A MEANS OF FACING ITS OWN CHALLENGES IN SUSTAINABILITY, ENVIRONMENT AND THE MANAGEMENT OF OPEN SPACES — AT ONE HUNDRED AND FIFTY THOUSAND SHEKELS A YEAR FOR THREE YEARS. THREE YEARS OF FUNDING IS THE PART THAT MATTERS. A ONE-YEAR GRANT BUYS A SNAPSHOT; THREE YEARS BUYS A TREND — AND THIS FILE HAS SAID IN A DOZEN COUNTRIES THAT WHOEVER HOLDS THE EARLIER MEASUREMENT WINS THE ARGUMENT ABOUT CHANGE. THE PUBLISHED RESEARCH GOALS READ LIKE A LIST OF WHAT COMMUNITIES ACTUALLY NEED PROVED: FOREST AND OPEN-SPACE MANAGEMENT; ECOLOGICAL RESTORATION AND ECOSYSTEM SERVICES; THE RESTORATION AND MANAGEMENT OF STREAMS, SPRINGS AND WET HABITATS; PROPAGATION, ORCHARDS AND FOREST HEALTH; PEOPLE AND ENVIRONMENT, INCLUDING PLANNING AND PUBLIC RECEPTION IN FORESTS AND OPEN SPACES; MITIGATION OF THE CLIMATE CRISIS; AND CITIZEN SCIENCE IN FORESTS AND OPEN SPACES. CITIZEN SCIENCE IS NAMED AS A FUNDING GOAL IN ITS OWN RIGHT. THAT IS THE LINE A COMMUNITY GROUP SHOULD READ TWICE: WORK DONE BY RESIDENTS COUNTING, MAPPING AND MONITORING IS NOT A LESSER SUBSTITUTE FOR RESEARCH HERE — IT IS A CATEGORY THE FUNDER HAS ASKED TO RECEIVE PROPOSALS ABOUT. AND SPRINGS AND WET HABITATS ARE NAMED SEPARATELY FROM STREAMS. A SPRING IS USUALLY THE FIRST THING LOST TO A DEVELOPMENT AND THE LAST THING ANYONE HAS DATA ON — IF YOURS IS THREATENED, THE RESTORATION AND MANAGEMENT OF SPRINGS IS AN EXPLICIT FUNDING PRIORITY, NOT A NICHE INTEREST. THE PRACTICAL ROUTE IS THROUGH A UNIVERSITY: PROPOSALS GO IN THROUGH UNIVERSITY RESEARCH AUTHORITIES, WHICH PUBLISH THEIR OWN INTERNAL DEADLINES AHEAD OF THE FUNDER'S. SO THE MOVE IS NOT TO APPLY BUT TO FIND THE ACADEMIC. A COMMUNITY THAT BRINGS A RESEARCHER A SITE, LOCAL KNOWLEDGE, ACCESS AND VOLUNTEERS IS OFFERING THE THREE THINGS FIELDWORK IS SHORT OF — AND THE RESEARCHER BRINGS THE ELIGIBILITY, THE METHOD AND THE INSTITUTIONAL SIGNATURE. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED UNIVERSITY LABORATORIES AND SURVEY INSTITUTES SEPARATELY FOR THIS COUNTRY; THIS IS HOW THEIR TIME GETS PAID FOR. NOTE ALSO WHAT THE FUNDER IS: THE BODY THAT MANAGES FORESTS AND OPEN SPACES IS PAYING FOR RESEARCH INTO HOW THEY SHOULD BE MANAGED. FINDINGS IT FUNDED ARE HARDER FOR IT TO DISMISS LATER — AND PLANNING AND PUBLIC RECEPTION BEING ON ITS OWN LIST MEANS QUESTIONS ABOUT HOW THE PUBLIC IS TREATED IN THOSE SPACES ARE INSIDE ITS RESEARCH AGENDA, NOT AN ATTACK ON IT. THE LIMITS: this is A RESEARCH GRANT PROGRAMME, NOT A LEGAL, LAND-PURCHASE OR CAMPAIGN FUND — IT WILL NOT PAY FOR AN OBJECTION, A LAWYER OR A PURCHASE, and research takes years while a bulldozer takes days. ELIGIBILITY RUNS THROUGH ACADEMIC INSTITUTIONS, so a community cannot apply alone. THE CALL AND ITS FIGURES ARE FOR A PARTICULAR YEAR AND THE ANCHOR IS ONE UNIVERSITY'S NOTICE OF IT — amounts, goals and deadlines change annually, so check the current call. THE FUNDER IS ALSO A MAJOR LAND MANAGER WHOSE OWN FORESTRY DECISIONS ARE CONTESTED. Read it with the open-space survey institute, the nature protection society's threats list and the university legal clinics recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Sustainability centre courses — training for activists and for council managers, with scholarships for those who cannot pay
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HAS RECORDED SURVEY INSTITUTES, LITIGATORS AND MEMBERSHIP ORGANISATIONS FOR THIS COUNTRY. WHAT IT HAD NOT RECORDED IS WHERE A RESIDENT LEARNS TO DO ANY OF IT — AND THIS CENTRE TEACHES BOTH THE ACTIVISTS AND THE OFFICIALS THEY WILL BE DEALING WITH. ITS COURSE FOR LOCAL AUTHORITIES IS THE ONE TO NOTICE: DEVELOPMENT AND PROSPERITY IN THE AUTHORITY DURING A CLIMATE CRISIS, ON SYSTEMIC RESPONSE AND EMBEDDING INNOVATIVE TOOLS, RUN JOINTLY WITH A FORUM OF LARGE CITIES AND THE REGIONAL GOVERNMENT CENTRE AND AIMED AT MANAGEMENT LEVELS IN LOCAL AUTHORITIES. KNOWING THAT THE PLANNER ACROSS THE TABLE HAS SAT THROUGH THAT COURSE CHANGES HOW YOU ARGUE. THIS FILE HAS SAID IN NINE COUNTRIES THAT MUNICIPALITIES DECIDE LAND USE — A COMMUNITY THAT KNOWS WHAT ITS COUNCIL'S MANAGERS WERE TAUGHT, AND IN WHOSE VOCABULARY, CAN PUT ITS CASE IN TERMS THEY HAVE ALREADY ACCEPTED. THE CENTRE ALSO WORKS DIRECTLY WITH REGIONS: WITH AN AREA ENVIRONMENTAL UNIT, THE REGIONAL GOVERNMENT CENTRE AND THE ENVIRONMENT MINISTRY IT BUILT A PREPAREDNESS PROGRAMME EXPOSING COUNCIL DEPARTMENT HEADS TO THE CLIMATE CRISIS, ITS CONSEQUENCES FOR THEIR OWN AREA, AND HOW TO PREPARE TOGETHER. A PROGRAMME BUILT AROUND CONSEQUENCES FOR THEIR OWN AREA IS AN OPENING FOR A LOCAL GROUP. ASK THE ENVIRONMENTAL UNIT COVERING YOUR REGION WHETHER IT HAS RUN ONE, AND ASK TO CONTRIBUTE WHAT YOU KNOW ABOUT FLOODING, WATER OR HEAT WHERE YOU LIVE — THE MATERIAL FOR SUCH SESSIONS COMES FROM SOMEWHERE, AND IT MAY AS WELL COME FROM YOU. FOR ACTIVISTS THEMSELVES THERE IS AN ONLINE COURSE ON PROMOTING CHANGE AND IMPACT IN SOCIETY AND THE ENVIRONMENT, RUN WITH A SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT GOALS COMMUNITY AND TAUGHT BY ENVIRONMENTAL ECONOMISTS AND PRACTITIONERS. AND THE SENTENCE THAT MATTERS MOST IS ABOUT MONEY: THE CENTRE STATES A REDUCED LAUNCH PRICE UNTIL A GIVEN DATE, AND THAT IF YOU CANNOT AFFORD THE FEE THERE ARE SCHOLARSHIPS — WRITE TO US BY EMAIL AND WE WILL TRY TO HELP. SCHOLARSHIPS OFFERED IN PLAIN LANGUAGE, WITH AN EMAIL ADDRESS, ARE RARER THAN THEY SHOULD BE. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED TRAINING AFTER TRAINING THAT A VILLAGE GROUP COULD NOT ATTEND BECAUSE NOBODY ASKED ABOUT THE FEE. ASK — THE WORST ANSWER IS NO, AND THE OFFER IS PUBLISHED. ONE FURTHER THING WORTH KNOWING ABOUT HOW THIS SECTOR OPERATES HERE: THE NATIONAL LAND AND FORESTRY FUND'S CLIMATE AND SUSTAINABILITY DIVISION HAS INVITED NON-PROFITS TO SUBMIT PROPOSALS FOR CLIMATE AND SUSTAINABILITY FUNDING, WITH THE SELECTED PROJECT RECEIVING AN INVESTMENT OF ONE MILLION SHEKELS ON A PUBLISHED SUBMISSION DEADLINE. A SINGLE-WINNER CALL AT THAT SIZE IS WORTH ENTERING ONLY WITH A PARTNER THAT HAS WON THINGS BEFORE — WHICH IS PRECISELY WHY KNOWING THE TRAINING NETWORK MATTERS: THE ORGANISATIONS THAT RUN THESE COURSES ARE THE ONES THAT KNOW WHICH CALLS ARE WINNABLE. THE LIMITS: this is A TRAINING AND CONSULTANCY ORGANISATION, NOT AN ADVOCATE, A FUNDER OR A LITIGATOR — IT WILL NOT OPPOSE A PROJECT, AND ITS CLOSE WORKING RELATIONSHIP WITH LOCAL AUTHORITIES MEANS IT IS UNLIKELY TO TAKE A COMMUNITY'S SIDE AGAINST A COUNCIL IT ADVISES. COURSES ARE PAID, THE SCHOLARSHIP OFFER IS DISCRETIONARY, AND THE COURSE DATES AND PRICES CITED ARE FROM PARTICULAR CYCLES. THE FUNDING CALL DESCRIBED HAS A CLOSED DEADLINE AND IS RECORDED AS AN EXAMPLE OF WHAT RECURS, NOT AS AN OPEN OPPORTUNITY. Read it with the open-space survey institute, the nature protection society's threats list, the environmental defence association and the forest and open-space research fund recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Regional cities union for environmental quality — activist courses in member authorities, and support for residents' own initiatives
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HAS RECORDED NATIONAL BODIES AND MINISTRIES FOR THIS COUNTRY. THE LAYER IT HAD MISSED IS THE REGIONAL ONE: UNIONS OF CITIES FOR ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY, WHICH COVER A GROUP OF NEIGHBOURING LOCAL AUTHORITIES AND WORK INSIDE THEM. WHAT MAKES ONE USEFUL TO A COMMUNITY IS PLAIN IN ITS OWN DESCRIPTION OF ITS WORK: RUNNING ACTIVIST COURSES IN THE MEMBER AUTHORITIES, AND A PROJECT OF RESIDENTS' OWN COMMUNITY ENVIRONMENTAL INITIATIVES IN THEIR LOCALITIES. AN ACTIVIST COURSE PAID FOR AND HOSTED BY A PUBLIC BODY IS AN UNUSUAL THING TO FIND, AND IT IS THE CHEAPEST ENTRY POINT THIS FILE HAS RECORDED FOR THIS COUNTRY. IT ALSO SOLVES THE PROBLEM OF ISOLATION: THE OTHER PEOPLE IN THE ROOM ARE RESIDENTS OF NEIGHBOURING TOWNS WITH THE SAME PROBLEMS, WHICH IS HOW A REGIONAL NETWORK ACTUALLY FORMS. THE RESIDENTS' INITIATIVES PROJECT IS THE SECOND DOOR. IT MEANS A GROUP DOES NOT HAVE TO PERSUADE THE UNION TO ADOPT ITS IDEA — THERE IS AN EXISTING PROGRAMME WHOSE PURPOSE IS TO BACK WHAT RESIDENTS THEMSELVES PROPOSE IN THEIR OWN LOCALITY. ITS OTHER WORK SHOWS WHAT SUCH BODIES CAN DELIVER PHYSICALLY: LARGE-SCALE EDUCATIONAL AND COMMUNITY PROJECTS INCLUDING ELECTRONIC WASTE COLLECTION IN SCHOOLS, AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF LEARNING GARDENS IN SCHOOLS AND KINDERGARTENS. A LEARNING GARDEN IS A SMALL THING THAT PUTS GROUND UNDER PUBLIC PROTECTION AND UNDER DAILY OBSERVATION — AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED IN SEVERAL COUNTRIES THAT LAND WITH A NAMED PURPOSE AND A CONSTITUENCY IS HARDER TO REALLOCATE THAN LAND THAT IS MERELY EMPTY. GREEN CERTIFICATION IS THE LADDER THAT CARRIES THE MONEY: CERTIFICATION PROCESSES FOR EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS RUN FROM KINDERGARTEN THROUGH TO HIGHER EDUCATION AND ARE USED AS A MEANS OF IMPLEMENTING ENVIRONMENTAL SUBJECTS AND ENCOURAGING INVOLVEMENT AND RESPONSIBILITY. AND THE FUNDING BEHIND ALL OF IT IS STATED: MINISTRY SUPPORT TO LOCAL AUTHORITIES CONCENTRATES ON THREE PROGRAMMES — GREEN SCHOOL AND KINDERGARTEN CERTIFICATION, LOCAL INITIATIVES, AND SUPPORT THAT REACHES COMMUNITY ORGANISING THROUGH THE LOCAL AUTHORITY — WITH MORE THAN A HUNDRED AND FIFTY AUTHORITIES SUPPORTED IN ONE YEAR TO A TOTAL OF ELEVEN AND A HALF MILLION SHEKELS, AND MORE THAN TWO HUNDRED AND FIFTY REQUESTS SUBMITTED THE FOLLOWING YEAR. THAT SECOND FIGURE IS THE WARNING INSIDE THE OPPORTUNITY: DEMAND IS RISING FASTER THAN THE MONEY. A GROUP THAT WANTS ITS INITIATIVE FUNDED SHOULD GET IT INTO THE AUTHORITY'S SUBMISSION EARLY IN THE CYCLE, AND SHOULD ASK THE UNION WHICH OF THE THREE PROGRAMMES ITS IDEA FITS BEFORE WRITING ANYTHING. ONE WORKED EXAMPLE SHOWS HOW LONG IT TAKES AND HOW FAR IT REACHES: KINDERGARTEN TEACHERS IN TWO VILLAGES COMPLETED THREE YEARS OF CONTINUING COURSES, SUPPORTED BY THE ENVIRONMENT AND EDUCATION MINISTRIES AND GUIDED BY A NATIONAL GREEN NETWORK, THEN RAN PROJECTS IN THEIR KINDERGARTENS AND WITH THE COMMUNITY — WITH EACH TEACHER REACHING MORE THAN THIRTY CHILDREN. THE LIMITS: this is A STATUTORY BODY OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES THEMSELVES, NOT AN INDEPENDENT ADVOCATE — IT WILL NOT OPPOSE A DEVELOPMENT ITS MEMBER COUNCILS HAVE APPROVED, and its education and community work is not a route for contesting a permit. THE UNION DESCRIBED COVERS ONE REGION ONLY; whether an equivalent exists where you live must be checked. THE FUNDING FIGURES COME FROM A PARLIAMENTARY COMMITTEE TRANSCRIPT AND ARE NOT CURRENT-YEAR, and the programme names may have changed. Read it with the open-space survey institute, the sustainability centre's courses and scholarships, the nature protection society's threats list and the forest research fund recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Agriculture investment administration — a support track that pays for grazing open spaces, and draft rules open to public comment
trackers.desc: ONE TRACK IN THIS SYSTEM PAYS FOR EXACTLY WHAT THIS MAP EXISTS TO PROTECT: DIRECT SUPPORT FOR OPEN SPACES THROUGH THE GRAZING OF ANIMALS. A STATE THAT PAYS HERDERS TO KEEP LANDSCAPES OPEN HAS ACCEPTED THE ARGUMENT THIS FILE HAS BEEN MAKING ACROSS TWENTY-THREE COUNTRIES: THAT GRAZED, WORKED, INHABITED GROUND IS A PUBLIC GOOD RATHER THAN A WASTE OF DEVELOPMENT LAND. WHERE SUCH A TRACK EXISTS, A HERDING COMMUNITY IS NOT ASKING FOR CHARITY — IT IS DELIVERING A SERVICE THE STATE HAS ALREADY PRICED. IT SITS INSIDE AN INVESTMENT ADMINISTRATION IN THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY THAT PUBLISHES SUPPORT PROCEDURES WITH SUBMISSION WINDOWS FOR EACH YEAR — ONE 2026 WINDOW RUNNING FROM MID-MARCH TO THE END OF APRIL — WITH APPLICATIONS MADE THROUGH THE MINISTRY'S ONLINE SUPPORT SYSTEM WITH ALL REQUIRED DOCUMENTS ATTACHED. KNOW HOW IT IS JUDGED BEFORE YOU WRITE: REQUESTS ARE EXAMINED BY AN ENGINEER AND THEN BROUGHT TO THE SUPPORT COMMITTEE FOR APPROVAL. AN ENGINEER READS IT FIRST. THAT MEANS DIMENSIONS, SPECIFICATIONS AND DRAWINGS DECIDE MORE THAN NARRATIVE — AND A COMMUNITY APPLICATION WRITTEN AS A STORY ABOUT NEED WILL LOSE TO ONE WRITTEN AS A BUILDABLE SPECIFICATION. THE MOST STRATEGIC FEATURE IS EARLIER THAN THE APPLICATION, AND ALMOST NOBODY USES IT: DRAFT SUPPORT PROCEDURES ARE PUBLISHED FOR PUBLIC COMMENT, WITH A STATED DEADLINE AND AN EMAIL ADDRESS FOR COMMENTS. THAT IS THE STAGE WHERE ELIGIBILITY RULES ARE STILL MOVEABLE. IF A DRAFT PROCEDURE WOULD EXCLUDE SMALLHOLDERS, TENANTS OR A PARTICULAR REGION, THE TIME TO SAY SO IS WHILE IT IS OPEN FOR COMMENT — AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED IN COUNTRY AFTER COUNTRY THAT COMMUNITIES ARRIVE AFTER THE RULES ARE FIXED AND THEN SPEND YEARS ARGUING ABOUT AN OUTCOME THEY COULD HAVE SHAPED IN A FORTNIGHT. WATCH THAT PAGE, NOT ONLY THE CALLS PAGE. ONE ORGANISATION IN A REGION CAN TAKE ON THE JOB OF READING EVERY DRAFT PROCEDURE AND SENDING COMMENTS — IT IS FREE, IT IS IN WRITING, AND IT PUTS A COMMUNITY'S NAME INTO THE FILE BEFORE ANY MONEY IS ALLOCATED. ONE MORE TRACK WORTH KNOWING WHERE FARM POLLUTION IS THE COMPLAINT: A PROCEDURE SUPPORTING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF CENTRAL FACILITIES FOR TREATING AGRICULTURAL WASTE, PROMOTED JOINTLY BY THE AGRICULTURE AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION MINISTRIES, WITH A BUDGET OF FORTY-TWO AND A HALF MILLION SHEKELS ACROSS THREE YEARS. THAT IS THE CONSTRUCTIVE ANSWER TO A DISPUTE ABOUT SLURRY, PLASTIC OR CARCASSES: RATHER THAN ONLY REPORTING A NEIGHBOUR, A REGION CAN ASK FOR THE CENTRAL TREATMENT FACILITY THE STATE IS ALREADY FUNDING. THE LIMITS: these are AGRICULTURAL SUPPORT TRACKS FOR PRODUCERS, NOT CONSERVATION PAYMENTS TO COMMUNITIES — THE GRAZING TRACK SUPPORTS FARMERS WHO GRAZE, AND WHETHER PASTORALISTS WITHOUT REGISTERED HOLDINGS QUALIFY WAS NOT ESTABLISHED, WHICH IS THE QUESTION THAT DECIDES WHO IT REACHES. WINDOWS, BUDGETS AND TRACK NAMES CHANGE EVERY CYCLE AND SEVERAL ITEMS HERE COME FROM EARLIER YEARS.
