THE SOURCE IS A FARMERS' FEDERATION NEWS PAGE SUMMARISING MINISTRY PROCEDURES RATHER THAN THE PROCEDURES THEMSELVES - read the actual procedure before relying on any figure or date. Read it with the open spaces fund and its land-purchase call, the open-space survey institute, the regional cities environmental union and the forest research fund recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Natural damage insurance fund — owned with fourteen farmer organisations, most of the premium paid by the state, and cover plot by plot
trackers.desc: THE OWNERSHIP IS THE FIRST THING WORTH KNOWING: THIS FUND HAS OPERATED SINCE 1967 AND WAS ESTABLISHED AS AN INSURANCE COMPANY BY THE GOVERNMENT TOGETHER WITH FOURTEEN AGRICULTURAL ORGANISATIONS — FARMERS' FEDERATIONS, GROWERS' ORGANISATIONS AND PRODUCTION COUNCILS — COVERING BOTH PLANT AND ANIMAL BRANCHES. AN INSURER PART-OWNED BY THE FARMERS' OWN BODIES IS A DIFFERENT ANIMAL FROM A COMMERCIAL ONE. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED FARMER-SHAREHOLDER FUNDS IN ONE OTHER COUNTRY AND NOTED THE SAME LOGIC: WHERE THE INSURED HELP OWN THE INSURER, THE TERMS ARE SET WITH THEM RATHER THAN AGAINST THEM. THE STATE CARRIES MOST OF THE COST: EIGHTY PER CENT OF THE NATURAL DISASTER PREMIUM AND THIRTY-FIVE PER CENT OF THE NATURAL DAMAGE PREMIUM, WITH THE EIGHTY PER CENT SHARE APPLYING TO SOME CROPS OUTRIGHT. THE STRUCTURE IS TWO LAYERS AND THE SECOND DEPENDS ON THE FIRST. NATURAL DAMAGE INSURANCE COVERS WEATHER CAUSING QUANTITATIVE AND QUALITATIVE DAMAGE TO FRUIT, AND ALLOWS EACH PLOT TO BE INSURED INDIVIDUALLY ACCORDING TO ITS EXPECTED YIELD, AT A COMPENSATION LEVEL REFLECTING THE GROWER'S REAL PRODUCTION CAPACITY. PLOT-BY-PLOT COVER MATTERS FOR A SMALLHOLDER WITH SCATTERED GROUND: THE GOOD PARCEL AND THE MARGINAL ONE NEED NOT BE INSURED AT THE SAME LEVEL, AND A FAMILY CAN AFFORD REAL COVER ON THE PIECE THAT CARRIES THE HOUSEHOLD. THE SECOND LAYER, NATURAL DISASTER INSURANCE FOR BEARING ORCHARDS, CAN ONLY BE BOUGHT ON TOP OF THE FIRST — AND IT COVERS WHAT THE FIRST DOES NOT: CLIMATIC EVENTS OUTSIDE THE BASIC POLICY, DISEASE OR PEST ATTACK ON A REGIONAL SCALE, AND DAMAGE TO THE TREES THEMSELVES. REGIONAL DISEASE AND PEST COVER IS THE UNUSUAL PART. AN OUTBREAK THAT SWEEPS A VALLEY IS EXACTLY THE EVENT THAT RUINS EVERY FAMILY AT ONCE AND THEREFORE CANNOT BE ABSORBED LOCALLY — AND TREES THEMSELVES BEING INSURABLE MEANS A DESTROYED ORCHARD IS REPLANTABLE RATHER THAN FINAL. PLANT NON-BEARING ORCHARDS INTO COVER IMMEDIATELY: THE FUND ADVISES INSURING YOUNG ORCHARDS CLOSE TO PLANTING, BECAUSE THE COLLECTIVE BASIC POLICY DOES NOT INCLUDE THEM — AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED THAT THE FIRST YEARS ARE WHEN A PLANTING IS MOST EASILY LOST AND HARDEST TO REPLACE. KNOW WHAT THE COLLECTIVE POLICY MISSES, BECAUSE MANY GROWERS ASSUME THEY ARE COVERED: THE BASIC COVER BOUGHT BY A PRODUCTION COUNCIL FOR ITS REGISTERED GROWERS EXCLUDES SEVERAL FRUIT SPECIES — AMONG THEM WALNUT, PEAR, PEACH, NECTARINE, POMEGRANATE, PLUM, LOQUAT AND FIG — AS WELL AS NON-BEARING ORCHARDS. TWO CONDITIONS DECIDE WHETHER A POLICY WORKS AT ALL. JOINING THE EXTENDED COVER REQUIRES ENTERING THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY PLOT IDENTIFIER ON THE FORM — SO THE REGISTRATION MUST BE RIGHT BEFORE THE SEASON — AND THE INSURANCE DOES NOT COVER GREENHOUSE AND NET-HOUSE STRUCTURES THEMSELVES, WHICH MUST BE INSURED SEPARATELY. THE 2026 TERMS IMPROVED IN A WAY THAT MATTERS MOST TO SMALL LOSSES: THE DEDUCTIBLE ON EXTENDED NATURAL DAMAGE COVER FELL TO SIX PER CENT FROM TEN, WITH NO ENTRY THRESHOLD FOR COMPENSATION. NO ENTRY THRESHOLD MEANS A MODERATE HAILSTORM PAYS RATHER THAN FALLING BELOW A FLOOR — AND MODERATE REPEATED LOSSES, NOT CATASTROPHES, ARE WHAT GRIND SMALL GROWERS OUT OF FARMING. THE LIMITS: THIS IS INSURANCE AGAINST WEATHER, DISEASE AND PESTS - IT DOES NOT COVER EXPROPRIATION, POLLUTION, CONSTRUCTION DAMAGE OR LOSS OF ACCESS, WHICH ARE THE HARMS THIS MAP EXISTS FOR. IT REQUIRES REGISTRATION WITH THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY AND, FOR THE COLLECTIVE POLICY, MEMBERSHIP OF A PRODUCTION COUNCIL - EXCLUDING INFORMAL AND UNREGISTERED GROWERS. PREMIUMS, DEDUCTIBLES, COVERED SPECIES AND STATE SHARES CHANGE EVERY SEASON AND DIFFER BY CROP; THE FIGURES HERE COME FROM A FARMING TRADE PORTAL'S COVERAGE OF THE FUND'S OWN ANNOUNCEMENTS rather than from policy documents - confirm with the fund before buying. Read it with the agriculture investment administration's grazing track, the open spaces fund's land-purchase call, the open-space survey institute and the regional cities environmental union recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Field-service laboratories and the state extension advisers — accredited soil, water and plant testing, with a published list of advisers
trackers.desc: FIVE ROUNDS OF THIS FILE HAVE LOOKED FOR LABORATORIES; THIS IS THE FIRST WHERE THE ACCREDITATION IS STATED, WHICH IS WHAT DECIDES WHETHER A RESULT SURVIVES CHALLENGE. A FIELD-SERVICE LABORATORY FOR AGRICULTURE AND ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY HOLDS ABOUT FORTY YEARS OF EXPERIENCE IN SOIL, PLANT AND WATER TESTING UNDER THE PROFESSIONAL MANAGEMENT OF THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY, AND IS ACCREDITED TO THE INTERNATIONAL STANDARD FOR TESTING LABORATORIES BY THE NATIONAL ACCREDITATION AUTHORITY. ACCREDITATION UNDER THAT STANDARD IS THE ANSWER TO THE QUESTION EVERY OPPONENT ASKS: WHO SAYS YOUR NUMBER IS RIGHT. AND THERE IS A SECOND LAYER HERE — ITS WATER AND EFFLUENT TESTS ARE RECOGNISED BY THE HEALTH MINISTRY. HEALTH MINISTRY RECOGNITION MATTERS WHERE THE COMPLAINT IS ABOUT DRINKING WATER, IRRIGATION WITH TREATED EFFLUENT OR A DISCHARGE. A RESULT FROM A RECOGNISED LABORATORY REACHES A REGULATOR THAT MUST ACT; A RESULT FROM AN UNRECOGNISED ONE STARTS AN ARGUMENT ABOUT THE LABORATORY INSTEAD OF THE POLLUTION. IT HAS ALSO WIDENED ITS RANGE: IT NOW CARRIES OUT TESTS OF PESTICIDE RESIDUES, MAINLY FOR FARMERS EXPORTING ABROAD. RESIDUE TESTING BUILT FOR EXPORTERS IS AVAILABLE TO ANYONE WHO PAYS, AND IT IS THE TEST THAT ANSWERS SPRAY DRIFT ONTO A NEIGHBOURING FIELD, A SCHOOL YARD OR A WATER SOURCE — A COMPLAINT THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED IN SEVERAL COUNTRIES WITH NOWHERE TO SEND A SAMPLE. THE LABORATORY DESCRIBES ITS OWN PURPOSE IN TERMS THAT MAKE THE REQUEST EASY: SUPPORTING FARMERS AND BACKING FIELD ADVISERS' RECOMMENDATIONS IN SOIL, PLANT AND WATER, PUTTING GUIDANCE IN QUANTITATIVE TERMS AND ASSISTING SENSIBLE USE OF WATER, FERTILISERS AND MANURES — SO THAT A FARMER USING IT REGULARLY SAVES ON INPUTS WHILE HELPING ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY BY PREVENTING WASTE AND THE POLLUTION OF WATER AND SOIL. PREVENTING POLLUTION OF WATER AND SOIL IS THEIR PHRASE, NOT AN ACTIVIST'S. QUOTE IT WHEN ASKING. ALONGSIDE THE LABORATORIES SIT THE PEOPLE: THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY'S EXTENSION AND PROFESSION SERVICE IS CHARGED WITH PRODUCING OBJECTIVE AGRICULTURAL KNOWLEDGE FREE OF INTERESTS AND CONVEYING IT TO FARMERS, AND IT PUBLISHES A LIST OF ITS ADVISERS ON THE GOVERNMENT PORTAL, WITH COURSES, STUDY DAYS AND CONFERENCES OPEN TO FARMERS AND TO THE GENERAL PUBLIC ACROSS THE COUNTRY. A PUBLISHED LIST OF NAMED PUBLIC ADVISERS BY BRANCH AND REGION IS RARE AND WORTH SAVING. KNOWLEDGE FREE OF INTERESTS IS THE STANDARD THEY SET THEMSELVES — USEFUL WHEN THE ONLY OTHER AVAILABLE ADVICE COMES FROM THE COMPANY SELLING THE INPUT OR BUILDING THE PROJECT. ONE WARNING ABOUT DEPENDING ON IT: A TREASURY DRAFT REPORTED IN 2024 AIMED AT CLOSING THE EXTENSION SERVICE AND REPLACING IT WITH OUTSOURCED GUIDANCE, WITH BUDGET AND STAFF CUTS SCHEDULED ACROSS 2025 TO 2027, WHICH THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY OPPOSED ON THE GROUND THAT SMALL AND MEDIUM FARMS WOULD BE HARMED. A STATE AUDIT SEPARATELY FOUND NO DOCUMENTATION OF WHO RECEIVED ADVISERS' SERVICES OR HOW LONG FARMERS WAITED FOR A RESPONSE — SO PUT REQUESTS IN WRITING AND KEEP YOUR OWN RECORD OF WHEN YOU ASKED, BECAUSE THE SERVICE MAY NOT. THERE IS A PRIVATE ROUTE TOO: AN AGRICULTURAL TECHNOLOGY COMPANY RUNS ITS OWN SOIL, WATER AND PLANT NUTRITION LABORATORY DESCRIBED AS A FIELD SERVICE, ALONGSIDE A RESEARCH FARM, PUBLISHING MONTHLY SCHEDULES OF WHICH TESTS ARE BEING RUN AND NOTICES OF WHEN IT IS CLOSED TO RECEIVING WORK. THE LIMITS: THESE ARE AGRICULTURAL SERVICES FOR PRODUCTION, RUN OR SUPERVISED BY THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY AND BY REGIONAL COUNCILS - THEY TEST AND ADVISE, THEY DO NOT ADJUDICATE, AND NOTHING SUGGESTS THEY WILL TAKE A SIDE AGAINST A STATE OR MUNICIPAL PROJECT. WHETHER A NON-FARMER OR A RESIDENT WITHOUT AGRICULTURAL LAND CAN SUBMIT SAMPLES, WHAT TESTS COST, AND WHETHER REPORTS NAME METHOD AND ACCREDITATION SCOPE WERE NOT ESTABLISHED. THE LABORATORY DESCRIPTIONS COME FROM A REGIONAL COUNCIL'S OWN PAGES OF 2019 AND A COMPANY SITE, SO ACCREDITATION STATUS AND SERVICES SHOULD BE RECONFIRMED BEFORE RELYING ON THEM, AND THE EXTENSION SERVICE'S FUTURE WAS UNDER ACTIVE BUDGETARY THREAT AT THE TIME REPORTED. Read it with the planning objection route and its standing rules, the freedom of information unit, the environmental protection ministry's enforcement and the land registry recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Council of Land Appraisers, the register, and the deciding appraiser — the route that raises compensation in about 55 per cent of cases
trackers.desc: WHEN AN AUTHORITY OFFERS TOO LITTLE, THE QUESTION IS WHO CAN PRODUCE A FIGURE THAT BINDS IT. HERE THAT PERSON EXISTS AS AN OFFICE: A DECIDING APPRAISER — A LAND APPRAISER APPOINTED BY THE JUSTICE MINISTER TO A QUASI-JUDICIAL ROLE, SUBJECT TO STRICT OCCUPATIONAL RESTRICTIONS SIMILAR TO A JUDGE'S. WHAT THAT OFFICE DECIDES COVERS ALMOST EVERY MONEY QUESTION IN A LAND FIGHT: DISPUTES BETWEEN THE LOCAL AUTHORITY AND THE CITIZEN OVER A BETTERMENT LEVY OR OVER COMPENSATION FOLLOWING A REDUCTION IN LAND VALUE; THE AMOUNT OF EXPROPRIATION COMPENSATION; APPEALS ON VALUATIONS PREPARED BY THE STATE LAND ADMINISTRATION; AND ADVISORY OPINIONS TO PLANNING APPEAL COMMITTEES AND TO COURTS. THE NUMBERS ARE THE REASON TO USE IT RATHER THAN ARGUE: COUNCIL DATA PUT THE PROCESS AT ABOUT SIX MONTHS ON AVERAGE, AND ABOUT FIFTY-FIVE PER CENT OF DECIDING VALUATIONS AWARD COMPENSATION HIGHER THAN THE COMMITTEE OFFERED — WITH ABOUT THREE HUNDRED AND FIFTY DECIDING APPRAISERS APPOINTED IN 2025 IN CLAIMS FOR REDUCTION IN LAND VALUE ALONE. A BETTER-THAN-EVEN CHANCE OF A HIGHER FIGURE, IN SIX MONTHS, IS BETTER ODDS THAN ANY LITIGATION RECORDED IN THIS FILE. AND THE VOLUME SHOWS IT IS ROUTINE RATHER THAN EXCEPTIONAL. HOW IT STARTS IS EQUALLY PLAIN: THE APPRAISER IS APPOINTED BY THE COUNCIL CHAIR WHERE THERE IS A DISPUTE BETWEEN THE OWNER AND THE LOCAL COMMITTEE OVER THE AMOUNT OF COMPENSATION, AFTER THE COMMITTEE HAS REJECTED THE CLAIM OR OFFERED LESS THAN THE CLAIMANT DEMANDED — SO A REFUSAL OR A LOW OFFER IS NOT THE END OF THE ROAD BUT THE TRIGGER FOR IT. TWO CONDITIONS TO WEIGH BEFORE STARTING: THE VALUATION BINDS BOTH SIDES UNLESS ONE APPEALS TO AN APPEALS COMMITTEE, AND THE APPRAISER'S FEE IS SPLIT BETWEEN THE PARTIES — SO THE COST IS SHARED WITH THE AUTHORITY, NOT CARRIED ALONE, BUT THE RESULT CAN GO EITHER WAY. THERE IS A SEPARATE AND SIMPLER RIGHT WORTH KNOWING FOR ANYONE DEALING WITH THE STATE LAND AUTHORITY: A CITIZEN REQUIRED TO PAY ACCORDING TO A LAND VALUATION IS ENTITLED TO APPEAL IT BY ATTACHING A COUNTER-VALUATION PREPARED BY AN APPRAISER OF THEIR OWN. THE PEOPLE WHO CAN WRITE THAT COUNTER-VALUATION ARE A CLOSED AND CHECKABLE GROUP: THE LAW PERMITS THE PREPARATION OF A LAND VALUATION ONLY BY AN APPRAISER ENTERED IN THE REGISTER OF LAND APPRAISERS, WHICH IS KEPT BY THE COUNCIL'S CHAIR OR A MEMBER THEY APPOINT. SO ASK FOR THE REGISTRATION BEFORE THE ENGAGEMENT. AN UNREGISTERED PERSON'S VALUATION IS NOT MERELY WEAKER — IT IS WORK THE LAW RESERVES TO SOMEBODY ELSE. THE COUNCIL ALSO HANDLES COMPLAINTS, AND THE DISCIPLINARY ROUTE HAS TEETH: WHERE A COMPLAINT IS FILED AGAINST AN APPRAISER OR AN INDICTMENT IS BROUGHT, THE COMMITTEE MAY SUSPEND THEIR REGISTRATION UNTIL PROCEEDINGS END, AFTER HEARING THEM, WITH THE SUSPENSION LAPSING IF NOTHING IS CONCLUDED WITHIN THREE MONTHS UNLESS EXTENDED. AND THE PROFESSIONAL BODY PUBLISHES THE ONE DOCUMENT ANYONE COMMISSIONING AN OPINION SHOULD READ FIRST: GUIDELINES FOR WRITING AN EXPERT OPINION SUBMITTED TO A COURT, ALONGSIDE THE PROFESSION'S GOVERNING LAW, AN ANNUAL CONFERENCE AND TRAINING DAYS. THE LIMITS: THIS IS THE MACHINERY FOR ARGUING ABOUT PRICE, NOT FOR STOPPING A SCHEME - A DECIDING APPRAISER SETS WHAT IS PAID, NOT WHETHER THE TAKING OR THE PLAN GOES AHEAD, AND USING IT MAY MEAN ACCEPTING THAT THE LOSS WILL HAPPEN. THE FEE IS SPLIT BUT STILL PAYABLE, AND THE BINDING VALUATION CAN COME IN BELOW WHAT WAS HOPED. THE SUCCESS RATE, THE SIX-MONTH AVERAGE AND THE 2025 APPOINTMENT COUNT COME FROM A LAW FIRM'S ARTICLE CITING COUNCIL DATA RATHER THAN FROM THE COUNCIL DIRECTLY, AND THE DESCRIPTION OF THE OFFICE FROM AN ENCYCLOPAEDIA ENTRY AND A PROPERTY-INDUSTRY GUIDE ALONGSIDE THE APPRAISERS' ASSOCIATION'S OWN PAGES. WHETHER THE REGISTER IS PUBLICLY SEARCHABLE, AND WHETHER RESIDENTS WITHOUT REGISTERED TITLE CAN USE ANY OF THIS, WERE NOT ESTABLISHED - THE SECOND QUESTION MATTERS MOST FOR THE COMMUNITIES THIS FILE IS WRITTEN FOR. Read it with the planning objection route and its standing rules, the field-service laboratories and extension advisers, the freedom of information unit and the land registry recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Regional forestry nurseries — open to the public, with a free basket of seedlings, herbs and trees for any community that asks
trackers.desc: ONE SENTENCE IN THIS ORGANISATION'S OWN MATERIAL IS THE WHOLE RESOURCE: EVERY COMMUNITY CAN REQUEST SEEDLINGS FROM IT, COME TO THE NURSERY AND RECEIVE A BASKET OF SEEDLINGS, HERBS AND TREES, ALL WITHOUT PAYMENT. THREE NURSERIES SERVE THE COUNTRY — SOUTH, NORTH AND CENTRE — AND BETWEEN THEM THEY DISTRIBUTE HUNDREDS OF THOUSANDS OF SEEDLINGS. THEY ARE OPEN TO THE PUBLIC AND FOR ACTIVITIES, WITH GUIDED SESSIONS FOR EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS AND FOR PEOPLE WITH SPECIAL NEEDS, AND CHILDREN ARE TAKEN THROUGH THE WHOLE PROCESS FROM SEED TO SEEDLING. A NURSERY THAT LETS PEOPLE IN IS ALSO A PLACE TO LEARN WHAT WILL SURVIVE ON YOUR GROUND. THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED PLANTING SCHEMES ACROSS THE REGION THAT FAILED BECAUSE NOBODY ASKED THAT QUESTION FIRST. ORDERING IS ORDINARY AND SEASONAL: SEEDLING BASKETS ARE REQUESTED THROUGH AN ONLINE FORM BY REGION — AND STOCK RUNS OUT, WITH ONE SEASON'S CENTRAL AND SOUTHERN BASKETS EXHAUSTED WHILE THE NORTHERN REGION WAS STILL TAKING ORDERS. SO ORDER EARLY AND ORDER FROM THE REGION THAT STILL HAS STOCK. THE FORM IS THE WHOLE PROCEDURE; THERE IS NO REGISTRATION, NO ORGANISATION REQUIRED AND NO FEE. THE DISTRIBUTION CLUSTERS AROUND THE NEW YEAR OF THE TREES, WHEN THE ORGANISATION SUPPLIES TOOLS, SEEDLINGS AND EXPLANATORY ACTIVITIES, RUNS PLANTING WITH ITS OWN FORESTERS IN FORESTS AND PARKS ACROSS THE COUNTRY, AND OPENS ITS NURSERIES FOR TOURS — WITH FAMILIES ON GUIDED WALKS EACH RECEIVING A SEEDLING TO PLANT AT HOME OR IN A POT. THE PEOPLE WHO ACTUALLY COLLECT THE BASKETS ARE THE MODEL TO COPY: IN ONE REPORTED CASE THE AGRICULTURAL MANAGER OF A YOUTH VILLAGE SIMPLY TURNED UP AT THE NURSERY TO TAKE SEEDLINGS FOR PLANTING WITH HIS BOARDING SCHOOL'S PUPILS. THE ORGANISATION BEHIND THE NURSERIES HAS BEEN OPERATING SINCE 1901 AND STATES THAT IT WORKS FOR ECOLOGICAL AND SOCIAL DEVELOPMENT IN ITS FORESTS AND LANDS AND FOR ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION — DEVELOPING FORESTS, WALKING ROUTES AND CYCLE PATHS AND ESTABLISHING PICNIC AREAS AND LOOKOUTS — HAVING PLANTED FORESTS COVERING ABOUT A MILLION DUNAMS, WITH THE RANGE OF SPECIES WIDENING SINCE THE 1970s TOWARDS MORE BROADLEAVED AND NATIVE KINDS. THAT SHIFT TOWARDS NATIVE AND BROADLEAVED SPECIES IS WORTH ASKING ABOUT AT THE COUNTER, BECAUSE IT DECIDES WHAT IS IN THE BASKET: A COMMUNITY WANTING WHAT BELONGS ON ITS OWN GROUND SHOULD ASK FOR NATIVE STOCK BY NAME RATHER THAN TAKE THE DEFAULT. NOW THE PART A COMMUNITY MUST WEIGH BEFORE ACCEPTING ANYTHING. THE SAME ORGANISATION DESCRIBES ITS PURPOSE IN NATIONAL AND SETTLEMENT TERMS — STRENGTHENING THE BOND BETWEEN A PEOPLE AND ITS LAND, COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT IN TWO PERIPHERAL REGIONS, AND TAKING ROOT AND ADDING A HOLD ON THE GROUND. PLANTING AS A HOLD ON THE GROUND IS EXACTLY WHAT THIS FILE HAS RECORDED ELSEWHERE AS A TOOL OF DISPOSSESSION AS WELL AS OF CARE. AFFORESTATION BY THIS BODY HAS BEEN USED IN LAND DISPUTES, AND FOR SOME COMMUNITIES IN THIS COUNTRY ITS TREES HAVE ARRIVED ON GROUND THEY CLAIM AS THEIR OWN. THE HONEST POSITION IS THEREFORE THIS: THE SEEDLINGS ARE REAL, FREE AND AVAILABLE TO ANYONE WHO ASKS, AND FOR A HOUSEHOLD OR A SCHOOL THAT IS A STRAIGHTFORWARD GOOD. FOR A COMMUNITY IN A LAND DISPUTE, WHERE THE TREES COME FROM AND WHO PLANTS THEM ON WHOSE GROUND IS A QUESTION TO SETTLE BEFORE THE BASKET IS COLLECTED. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A NATIONAL FORESTRY AND LAND ORGANISATION WITH A STATED IDEOLOGICAL PURPOSE, NOT A NEUTRAL NURSERY SERVICE - IT HOLDS AND MANAGES LAND, ITS PLANTING HAS BEEN CONTESTED IN LAND DISPUTES, AND ACCEPTING ITS TREES CARRIES A MEANING IN SOME PLACES THAT IT DOES NOT IN OTHERS. WHETHER BASKETS ARE AVAILABLE OUTSIDE THE FESTIVAL SEASON, WHETHER THERE IS A LIMIT PER COMMUNITY, AND WHETHER PLANTING STOCK IS SUPPLIED FOR PRIVATE OR UNREGISTERED LAND WERE NOT ESTABLISHED. THE FREE-BASKET WORDING COMES FROM AN INTERVIEW PUBLISHED ON A RELIGIOUS NEWS SITE IN 2024 AND THE ORDER FORM FROM THE ORGANISATION'S OWN EDUCATION PAGES FOR AN EARLIER SEASON, SO CURRENT TERMS SHOULD BE CHECKED. Read it with the field-service laboratories and extension advisers, the planning objection route, the land appraisers' council and the freedom of information unit recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Nature protection society and the green movement — planners and district coordinators who file objections, and a 1,200-signature objection filed with residents
trackers.desc: THE BRIEF THIS FILE WORKS TO ASKS FOR ORGANISATIONS THAT HELP LOCALS STOP PROJECTS. TWO HERE DO EXACTLY THAT, AND ONE OF THEM IS THE OLDEST AND LARGEST ENVIRONMENTAL ORGANISATION IN THE COUNTRY: A SOCIETY FOR THE PROTECTION OF NATURE FOUNDED IN 1953, A PUBLIC NON-PROFIT ASSOCIATION WITH MORE THAN SIXTY-FIVE THOUSAND MEMBER INDIVIDUALS AND FAMILIES. WHAT MATTERS IS NOT ITS AGE BUT ITS STAFF: A PROFESSIONAL ARM OF FIELD PEOPLE, PLANNERS AND PROFESSIONAL COORDINATORS WHO ACT BEFORE THE PLANNING INSTITUTIONS. PLANNERS WHO APPEAR BEFORE PLANNING COMMITTEES ARE THE SCARCEST THING IN THIS ENTIRE PAYLOAD. AN OBJECTION WRITTEN BY SOMEBODY WHO KNOWS THE COMMITTEE'S OWN LANGUAGE IS WORTH MORE THAN A THOUSAND ANGRY LETTERS, AND THIS ORGANISATION EMPLOYS THEM BY DISTRICT. ONE OF ITS DISTRICT COORDINATORS WROTE THE OBJECTION IN A CASE WORTH COPYING: IT ARGUED THAT THE OPEN AREAS MUST NOT BE HARMED, CITED A THREATENED FALCON WHOSE LARGEST POPULATION IN THE COUNTRY NESTS THERE, AND POINTED TO A SURVEY SHOWING A SIGNIFICANT DECLINE IN ITS NESTING - SUGGESTING THE CAUSE WAS THE DISAPPEARANCE OF THE OPEN GROUND THE BIRD HUNTS OVER. THAT IS THE SHAPE OF A WINNING OBJECTION: A NAMED SPECIES, A NATIONAL SUPERLATIVE, AND A SURVEY SHOWING CHANGE OVER TIME. THE ARGUMENT IS NOT THAT BUILDING IS UGLY BUT THAT A SPECIFIC POPULATION WILL GO. AND THE SOCIETY CAN PRODUCE THE EVIDENCE ITSELF: IT RUNS AN URBAN NATURE SURVEYS UNIT WITH A NAMED MANAGER, AND IN ONE CONTESTED AREA ITS SURVEY FOUND HUNDREDS OF PLANT SPECIES AND A WIDE RANGE OF ANIMALS INCLUDING RED-LISTED SPECIES IN DANGER OF EXTINCTION, ALONGSIDE BURIAL CAVES - HAVING ACCOMPANIED THE RESIDENTS ACTIVE IN THAT STRUGGLE FOR YEARS. ACCOMPANIED THE RESIDENTS FOR YEARS IS THE PHRASE TO ASK FOR BY NAME. THIS IS AN ORGANISATION THAT ATTACHES ITSELF TO A LOCAL FIGHT AND SUPPLIES THE SURVEY, THE PLANNER AND THE OBJECTION RATHER THAN ISSUING A STATEMENT. IT ALSO WORKS WATER: A RIVER PLANNING COORDINATOR IN ITS STREAM REHABILITATION UNIT ACCOMPANIES STATUTORY FLOOD-RISK PLANS PROMOTED BY THE PLANNING ADMINISTRATION AND DRAINAGE AUTHORITIES, AND SUBMITS POSITION PAPERS AND EXPERT OPINIONS TO PLANNING COMMITTEES AND MINISTRIES TO PROTECT AND REHABILITATE COASTAL STREAMS UNDER DEVELOPMENT PRESSURE. ITS RECORD SHOWS WHAT PATIENCE BUYS: A WILD FLOWERS CAMPAIGN THAT HAD DOZENS OF PLANT SPECIES DECLARED PROTECTED AND ACTUALLY CHANGED PUBLIC BEHAVIOUR, AND A SEVEN-YEAR COASTAL STRUGGLE THAT ENDED IN A COASTAL PROTECTION LAW. SEVEN YEARS ENDING IN A STATUTE IS THE HONEST TIMESCALE FOR CHANGING WHAT IS ALLOWED, RATHER THAN STOPPING ONE SCHEME - AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED FEW COMPARABLE WINS ANYWHERE IN THE REGION. THE SECOND ORGANISATION IS YOUNGER AND WORKS DIFFERENTLY: A GREEN MOVEMENT WITH COMMUNITY CELLS AND ITS OWN OFFICES, WHICH REPORTED IN APRIL 2026 THAT A DETERMINED COMMUNITY OF LOCAL RESIDENTS HAD SET OUT TO STOP DESTRUCTIVE BUILDING, AND THAT THE MOVEMENT MOBILISED AND FILED AN OBJECTION TOGETHER WITH THEM SIGNED BY MORE THAN TWELVE HUNDRED RESIDENTS. THEIR OWN REASONING IS THE USEFUL PART: SO MANY SIGNATURES WOULD PROVE TO THE COMMITTEE THAT THE PUBLIC AND THE RESIDENTS WOULD NOT LET VITAL AND RARE NATURE BE DESTROYED FOR THE PROFIT AND CONVENIENCE OF CONTRACTORS AND DECISION-MAKERS. SO THE DIVISION OF LABOUR IS CLEAR AND COPYABLE ANYWHERE: THE OLD SOCIETY BRINGS THE PLANNER, THE SURVEY AND THE SPECIES; THE MOVEMENT BRINGS THE SIGNATURES AND THE PEOPLE. A COMMUNITY THAT RECRUITS BOTH HAS THE TWO THINGS A PLANNING COMMITTEE COUNTS. THE LIMITS: THESE ARE OBJECTION AND ADVOCACY ORGANISATIONS, NOT LAND BUYERS OR LAWYERS - THEY WORK THROUGH PLANNING PROCEDURES AND PUBLIC PRESSURE, AND NEITHER WILL PURCHASE GROUND OR FUND LITIGATION. THE LARGER SOCIETY IS A NATIONAL INSTITUTION WITH STATE RECOGNITION AND HAS BEEN CRITICISED FOR CLOSENESS TO STATE PLANNING BODIES, AND ITS ATTENTION IS FINITE: WHETHER IT WILL TAKE A PARTICULAR CASE, AND ON WHAT CRITERIA, WAS NOT ESTABLISHED - NOR WAS WHETHER EITHER ORGANISATION WORKS WITH COMMUNITIES OUTSIDE ITS USUAL CONSTITUENCY, WHICH IN THIS COUNTRY IS A REAL QUESTION AND ONE THIS ENTRY CANNOT ANSWER. THE EXAMPLES CITED COME FROM NEWSPAPER REPORTS OF 2020 AND 2022, THE MOVEMENT'S OWN MONTHLY SUMMARY OF APRIL 2026, AND AN ENCYCLOPAEDIA ENTRY - NOT FROM A SERVICE PAGE DESCRIBING HOW TO REQUEST HELP. Read it with the planning objection route and its standing rules, the land appraisers' council and deciding appraiser, the field-service laboratories and the freedom of information unit recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Municipal environmental units and towns' associations — about 60 local bodies that sample, monitor and can charge factories, listed with contact details
trackers.desc: THE ROUND OPENED ELSEWHERE, LOOKING FOR VILLAGE CREDIT COOPERATIVES, AND FOUND FOOTBALL TABLES AND A STATUTE - SO NOTHING WAS RECORDED THERE. HERE IT FOUND THE DENSEST MUNICIPAL ENVIRONMENTAL NETWORK IN THE PAYLOAD: ABOUT SIXTY ENVIRONMENTAL UNITS AND TOWNS' ASSOCIATIONS FOR ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY SPREAD ACROSS THE COUNTRY, COVERING SOME SEVENTY-FIVE PER CENT OF LOCAL AUTHORITIES, EMPLOYING MORE THAN THREE HUNDRED AND FIFTY PEOPLE. THEY COME IN THREE KINDS, AND THE DIFFERENCE DECIDES WHO YOU WRITE TO: AN URBAN ENVIRONMENTAL UNIT IS A DEPARTMENT INSIDE THE LOCAL AUTHORITY; A REGIONAL ENVIRONMENTAL UNIT IS A DEPARTMENT SUBORDINATE TO ONE AUTHORITY BUT HANDLING THE ENVIRONMENTAL AFFAIRS OF SEVERAL AUTHORITIES THAT FUND IT; AND A TOWNS' ASSOCIATION FOR ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY IS A CORPORATION ESTABLISHED BY ORDER OF THE INTERIOR MINISTER, MANAGED BY A COUNCIL OF REPRESENTATIVES OF THE MEMBER AUTHORITIES, WHICH ALSO FINANCE IT. THE ASSOCIATIONS ARE THE ONES THAT MATTER WHEN THE PROBLEM IS BIGGER THAN ONE TOWN: THEY SERVE A GROUP OF AUTHORITIES AND DEAL WITH LARGE ENVIRONMENTAL MATTERS SUCH AS MAJOR POLLUTERS, SAMPLING AND MONITORING - AND BY LAW THEY MAY IMPOSE FEES ON FACTORIES. A LOCAL BODY THAT TAKES SAMPLES AND CAN CHARGE THE FACTORY IS THE COMBINATION THIS FILE HAS BEEN CHASING COUNTRY BY COUNTRY. IT MEANS THE MONITORING DOES NOT DEPEND ON A COMMUNITY RAISING MONEY FOR A LABORATORY - IT IS SOMEBODY'S JOB, PAID FOR PARTLY BY THE POLLUTERS THEMSELVES. THE SCALE IS PUBLISHED: EIGHTEEN REGIONAL UNITS SERVING SEVENTY AUTHORITIES, AND TEN TOWNS' ASSOCIATIONS WITH A HUNDRED AND THREE MEMBER AUTHORITIES SERVING ABOUT THREE MILLION RESIDENTS, ALONGSIDE FIVE SANITATION ASSOCIATIONS - WHILE A POLICY INSTITUTE COUNTS FORTY-FIVE UNITS, NINETEEN OF THEM REGIONAL, COVERING TWO HUNDRED AND ONE AUTHORITIES AND EIGHT AND A HALF MILLION RESIDENTS. AND EACH ASSOCIATION'S ESTABLISHING ORDER DEFINES ITS FUNCTIONS AND POWERS IN ENVIRONMENTAL MATTERS - SO THE FIRST DOCUMENT TO ASK FOR IS THE ORDER THAT CREATED YOURS, BECAUSE IT SAYS WHAT IT CAN BE MADE TO DO. FINDING YOURS IS EASY AND FREE: A PUBLIC DATASET AND A NATIONAL MAP LAYER LIST THE UNITS AND ASSOCIATIONS, A POLICY INSTITUTE PUBLISHES A CHECKER FOR WHETHER YOUR AUTHORITY HAS A UNIT OR BELONGS TO AN ASSOCIATION, AND A CONTACT-DETAILS TABLE IS PUBLISHED BY DISTRICT. A PUBLISHED CONTACT TABLE FOR SIXTY LOCAL ENVIRONMENTAL BODIES IS THE SINGLE MOST USEFUL DOCUMENT IN THIS ENTRY. MOST COMMUNITIES IN THIS FILE CANNOT FIND ONE OFFICIAL WHO ANSWERS FOR POLLUTION - HERE THE LIST IS PUBLIC AND ORGANISED BY DISTRICT. THEY ARE ALSO FUNDED IN A WAY THAT CREATES LEVERAGE: A SUPPORT LIST OF ABOUT A HUNDRED AND TEN MILLION IN NATIONAL CURRENCY FOR THE UNITS WAS PUBLISHED, WITH UP TO ONE AND A HALF MILLION MORE FOR EQUIPMENT PURCHASE AND CALIBRATION AND MAINTENANCE SERVICES, EACH WINNING UNIT RECEIVING UP TO EIGHTY-FIVE THOUSAND OR NINETY PER CENT OF THE EXPENDITURE, WHICHEVER IS LOWER - AND A FURTHER SMALL SUPPORT AT THE END OF 2026 FOR SOME UNITS, SUBJECT TO THE QUALITY OF THEIR CONDUCT. MONEY FOR MONITORING EQUIPMENT, AWARDED UNIT BY UNIT AND CONDITIONAL ON PERFORMANCE, IS SOMETHING A RESIDENT CAN ASK ABOUT DIRECTLY: WHAT DID THIS UNIT RECEIVE, WHAT DID IT BUY, AND WHAT IS IT MEASURING WITH IT. THE LIMITS: THESE ARE ARMS OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES THEMSELVES, FUNDED BY THEM AND BY THE ENVIRONMENT MINISTRY - A UNIT WILL NOT USUALLY ACT AGAINST ITS OWN COUNCIL'S PLANNING DECISIONS, AND WHERE THE POLLUTER IS A MUNICIPAL FACILITY OR A COUNCIL-BACKED SCHEME THE CONFLICT IS OBVIOUS. ABOUT A QUARTER OF LOCAL AUTHORITIES HAVE NO UNIT AT ALL, AND THE TWO SOURCE COUNTS DIFFER - THE MINISTRY SAYS ABOUT SIXTY UNITS AND A POLICY INSTITUTE FORTY-FIVE PLUS TEN ASSOCIATIONS - SO THE COVERAGE FIGURES SHOULD BE TREATED AS APPROXIMATE. WHETHER A UNIT WILL TAKE A COMPLAINT FROM A RESIDENT, WHAT IT DOES WITH SAMPLING RESULTS AND WHETHER THOSE RESULTS ARE PUBLISHED WERE NOT ESTABLISHED. THE STRUCTURE AND NUMBERS COME FROM THE MINISTRY'S LOCAL GOVERNMENT DEPARTMENT PAGE, AN ENVIRONMENTAL TRADE SITE'S GLOSSARY AND NEWS ITEMS, AND A LOCAL POLICY INSTITUTE'S GUIDE OF DECEMBER 2025. Read it with the planning objection route, the land appraisers' council and deciding appraiser, the field-service laboratories and extension advisers and the regional forestry nurseries recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: District planning committees with environmental organisations' seats, and the district public-inquiries coordinators above the local unit
trackers.desc: THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED OBJECTION AND CONSULTATION ROUTES IN EVERY COUNTRY IT COVERS. THIS COUNTRY HAS SOMETHING DIFFERENT: ENVIRONMENTAL ORGANISATIONS HAVE REPRESENTATIVES ON THE DISTRICT COMMITTEES FOR PLANNING AND BUILDING. A STANDING SEAT INSIDE THE COMMITTEE THAT DECIDES DISTRICT PLANS IS A VOICE IN THE ROOM RATHER THAN A LETTER TO IT. FOR A COMMUNITY FACING A SCHEME, THE FIRST QUESTION IS THEREFORE NOT WHERE TO SEND AN OBJECTION BUT WHICH ORGANISATION HOLDS THAT SEAT ON ITS DISTRICT COMMITTEE, AND HOW TO GET ITS ATTENTION BEFORE THE SITTING. THE COMPLAINT LADDER BELOW IT IS PUBLISHED AND SHORT. WHERE AN ENVIRONMENTAL NUISANCE IS SUSPECTED, THE APPROACH IS TO THE ENVIRONMENTAL UNIT IN THE LOCAL AUTHORITY OR TO THE TOWNS' ASSOCIATION HANDLING ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY - THE BODIES THIS FILE RECORDED SEPARATELY, SIXTY OF THEM COVERING THREE QUARTERS OF LOCAL AUTHORITIES. AND IF NOTHING HAPPENS THERE IS A NAMED NEXT STEP: IF THE NUISANCE CONTINUES, THE APPROACH IS TO THE PUBLIC INQUIRIES COORDINATORS AT THE ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION MINISTRY IN THE RELEVANT DISTRICT. A COORDINATOR OF PUBLIC INQUIRIES SITTING AT DISTRICT LEVEL IS THE MISSING RUNG IN MOST COUNTRIES IN THIS FILE - THE PERSON WHOSE JOB IS RESIDENTS' COMPLAINTS, CLOSE ENOUGH TO VISIT AND SENIOR ENOUGH TO OVERRIDE A TOWN. WHO MAY USE IT IS UNRESTRICTED: EVERY PERSON IN THE COUNTRY IS ENTITLED TO REPORT AN ENVIRONMENTAL NUISANCE TO THE AUTHORITIES. THE GUIDANCE ALSO ANSWERS THE CASE THIS FILE MEETS CONSTANTLY - WHERE THE NUISANCE IS NOT DEALT WITH AS REQUIRED BY THE LOCAL AUTHORITY, OR WHERE THE LOCAL AUTHORITY IS ITSELF THE SOURCE. THAT IS PRECISELY WHEN THE DISTRICT COORDINATOR MATTERS. AND THERE IS A ROUTE THAT DOES NOT DEPEND ON ANY OFFICIAL AT ALL: IT IS POSSIBLE TO FILE A PRIVATE SUIT OR A CLASS ACTION OVER THE HARM AGAINST WHOEVER CAUSED THE ENVIRONMENTAL NUISANCE. A CLASS ACTION OVER AN ENVIRONMENTAL NUISANCE IS THE STRONGEST PRIVATE INSTRUMENT RECORDED IN THIS REGION - IT SPREADS THE COST ACROSS EVERYONE HARMED RATHER THAN RESTING ON ONE HOUSEHOLD, WHICH IS THE USUAL REASON COMMUNITIES DO NOT SUE. ONE COASTAL PRECEDENT IN THE PARLIAMENTARY RECORD IS WORTH KEEPING FOR ANY SHORE FIGHT: A RESEARCH PAPER ON A HOLIDAY-VILLAGE DEVELOPMENT RECORDS THAT SEVERAL CONDITIONS HAD TO BE FULFILLED BEFORE DEVELOPMENT WORKS COULD BEGIN, THAT THE WHOLE STRIP OF THAT SHORE IS OPEN TO THE PUBLIC AND CAN BE WALKED ALONG ITS ENTIRE LENGTH, AND THAT THE HOUSING UNITS IN THE HOLIDAY VILLAGE WOULD SERVE HOTEL PURPOSES ONLY. CONDITIONS PRECEDENT, PUBLIC ACCESS ALONG THE WHOLE SHORE, AND A USE RESTRICTED TO HOTELS ARE THREE THINGS TO CHECK AGAINST WHAT IS ACTUALLY BUILT - AND A PARLIAMENTARY RESEARCH PAPER IS A CITABLE PLACE TO FIND THEM. FOR THE GROUP ITSELF THERE IS SUPPORT: A NATIONAL FOUNDATION'S CAPACITY-BUILDING ARM PROVIDES ASSISTANCE THROUGH PROFESSIONALS IN ORGANISATIONAL CONSULTING, RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT, CAMPAIGN MANAGEMENT AND STRATEGY, AND WORK WITH MEDIA AND DECISION-MAKERS, WITH COACHING FOR PROJECT MANAGERS AND LEARNING AND NETWORKING EVENTS TAILORED TO THE ENVIRONMENTAL PUBLIC ACROSS THE COUNTRY. THE LIMITS: THE SEAT ON THE DISTRICT COMMITTEE BELONGS TO ENVIRONMENTAL ORGANISATIONS, NOT TO RESIDENTS - WHICH ORGANISATIONS HOLD IT, HOW THEY ARE CHOSEN, WHETHER THEY CONSULT AFFECTED COMMUNITIES AND HOW MANY VOTES THEY CARRY WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED, AND THE PAPER RECORDING THE SEAT IS A PARLIAMENTARY RESEARCH DOCUMENT WITHOUT A VISIBLE DATE. THE COMPLAINT LADDER COMES FROM A PUBLIC RIGHTS-GUIDE SITE WHICH STATES PLAINLY THAT ITS INFORMATION IS GENERAL, IS NOT BINDING AND IS NOT A SUBSTITUTE FOR LEGAL ADVICE. THE COASTAL DETAIL RELATES TO ONE SPECIFIC SITE AND SAYS NOTHING ABOUT ANY OTHER, AND THE CAPACITY-BUILDING ARM SERVES CIVIL SOCIETY ORGANISATIONS RATHER THAN INDIVIDUALS. NONE OF THIS TOUCHES PLANNING IN THE OCCUPIED TERRITORY, WHERE A DIFFERENT SYSTEM APPLIES AND WHICH THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS SEPARATELY. Read it with the municipal environmental units and towns' associations, the land appraisers' council and deciding appraiser, the regional forestry nurseries and the planning objection route recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Membership nature society with in-house lawyers and regional coordinators — the combination that got a 10,000-unit plan returned to the planning table
trackers.desc: THE MOST USEFUL THING IN THIS ENTRY IS A WIN AND THE EXACT COMBINATION THAT PRODUCED IT. A PLAN FOR THOUSANDS OF HOUSING UNITS, WITH AN OPTION TO EXPAND TO TEN THOUSAND AND PARTLY DESIGNED ON ENVIRONMENTALLY SENSITIVE LAND, WAS MET BY A BROAD PUBLIC PARTICIPATION PROCESS THE SOCIETY LED, SEEKING TO STOP A HURRIED AND UNLAWFUL PLANNING PROCESS THAT GAVE NO ANSWER TO THE NATURE VALUES AND SENSITIVITIES PRESENT ON THE GROUND. THE LEGAL WORK OF THE SOCIETY'S OWN LAWYERS, ITS NATURE CONSERVATION COORDINATOR FOR THE SOUTH AND ITS NATIONAL PLANNING TEAM SUCCEEDED IN PERSUADING THE COURT TO STOP THE PLAN'S ADVANCEMENT AND RETURN IT TO THE PLANNING TABLE. THREE ROLES, NOT ONE: A LAWYER WHO LITIGATES, A REGIONAL COORDINATOR WHO KNOWS THE GROUND AND THE RESIDENTS, AND A NATIONAL PLANNING TEAM THAT READS THE SCHEME AS A PLANNER WOULD. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED COMMUNITIES WITH ONE OF THE THREE AND WATCHED THEM LOSE - THE SOCIETY ITSELF CALLS THE RESULT A SIGNIFICANT ACHIEVEMENT ILLUSTRATING THE POWER OF THE CONNECTION BETWEEN RESIDENTS, LEGAL PROFESSIONALISM AND CIVIC ACTION. RETURNED TO THE PLANNING TABLE IS ALSO THE REALISTIC SHAPE OF VICTORY. THE SCHEME WAS NOT KILLED; IT WAS SENT BACK TO BE DONE PROPERLY, WHICH IS WHAT MOST COMMUNITIES IN THIS PAYLOAD ACTUALLY NEED AND RARELY GET. THE BODY IS OLD AND LARGE ENOUGH TO CARRY THAT WORK: FOUNDED IN 1953, THE OLDEST AND LARGEST ENVIRONMENTAL ORGANISATION IN THE COUNTRY AND ONE OF THE OLDEST NATURE CONSERVATION ORGANISATIONS IN THE WORLD, A PUBLIC ASSOCIATION OPERATING NOT FOR PROFIT, WITH MORE THAN SIXTY-FIVE THOUSAND INDIVIDUAL AND FAMILY MEMBERS AND A STATE PRIZE AWARDED IN 1980. SIXTY-FIVE THOUSAND MEMBER HOUSEHOLDS IS THE ASSET BEHIND EVERY OBJECTION IT FILES. MEMBERSHIP IS THE CHEAPEST THING A SUPPORTER CAN DO AND THE THING THAT MAKES THE LAWYERS POSSIBLE. ITS REGISTERED PURPOSE IS BROAD ENOUGH TO COVER ALMOST ANY SITE: TO TAKE PART IN EVERY ACTION NECESSARY IN ORDER TO PRESERVE THE VALUES OF THE NATURE AND LANDSCAPE OF THE LAND - RECORDED WITH ITS REGISTRATION NUMBER ON A PUBLIC NON-PROFIT TRANSPARENCY PORTAL. ITS OLDER RESULTS SHOW WHAT PERSISTENCE BUYS: APPROVAL OF A GOVERNMENT PLAN FOR A NATURAL PARK IN THE SOUTH OF ONE METROPOLIS AND THE PREVENTION OF A REAL-ESTATE COMBINATION ON THAT LAND; LEGISLATION OF A LAW PROTECTING THE COAST AND SEA THAT SAFEGUARDS THE PUBLIC'S RIGHT TO ENJOY THEM AND SETS PRINCIPLES FOR COASTAL DEVELOPMENT AND CONSERVATION; MORE PUBLIC OPEN AND GREEN SPACES SUCH AS URBAN PARKS SERVING BOTH CITY RESIDENTS AND THOSE AROUND THEM; AND PROTECTION OF OPEN SPACES AT NAMED HILLS AND RIDGES. A LAW THAT FIXES THE PUBLIC'S RIGHT TO REACH ITS OWN COASTLINE IS THE SINGLE MOST TRANSFERABLE THING ON THAT LIST FOR THE GULF AND MEDITERRANEAN COMMUNITIES THIS PAYLOAD SERVES. ITS OBJECTION PRACTICE IS WORTH COPYING IN FORM: IN ONE VALLEY DISPUTE, RESIDENTS OF THE VILLAGES AND COLLECTIVE SETTLEMENTS OF THE AREA JOINED WITH RESIDENTS OF THE NEARBY TOWN WHO ALSO OPPOSED THE HARM, AND THE SOCIETY SUBMITTED AN OBJECTION TO THE GEOGRAPHIC COMMITTEE EXPLAINING THAT THE OPEN SPACES MUST NOT BE HARMED - THE LAND FORMING ALMOST ENTIRELY AN ECOLOGICAL CORRIDOR RUNNING NORTH-SOUTH AND EAST-WEST. VILLAGE RESIDENTS AND TOWN RESIDENTS OBJECTING TOGETHER, WITH THE CORRIDOR ARGUMENT CARRIED BY THE ORGANISATION, IS THE DIVISION OF LABOUR THAT WORKS: LOCALS SUPPLY THE STANDING AND THE NUMBERS, THE ORGANISATION SUPPLIES THE ECOLOGICAL CASE. OTHER GROUPS FILE ALONGSIDE IT ON DIFFERENT GROUNDS - IN ANOTHER DISPUTE A PLANNERS' RIGHTS ASSOCIATION OBJECTED WITH TWO OTHER ORGANISATIONS, ARGUING THAT ESTABLISHING A NEW SETTLEMENT IS CONTRARY TO LAW BECAUSE A PLANNING LAW OF 1966 REQUIRES COMPREHENSIVE PLANNING OF THE SETTLEMENT AS A WHOLE. AND ITS OWN REPORT DOES WATCHDOG WORK TOO, RECORDING THAT A NAMED FUEL COMPANY DESCRIBED AS A SERIAL ENVIRONMENTAL OFFENDER AND POLLUTER ENJOYS HISTORICAL CONFIDENTIALITY EXCEPTIONAL IN ITS BREADTH. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A NATIONAL MEMBERSHIP ORGANISATION THAT CHOOSES ITS CASES - IT IS NOT A LEGAL AID SERVICE, IT WILL NOT TAKE EVERY VILLAGE'S PLAN, AND HOW A COMMUNITY ASKS IT TO INTERVENE, WHAT IT COSTS AND HOW ITS REGIONAL COORDINATORS ARE CONTACTED WERE NOT ESTABLISHED. ITS WORK IS CONDUCTED INSIDE ONE STATE'S PLANNING SYSTEM AND SAYS NOTHING ABOUT PLANNING IN THE OCCUPIED TERRITORY, WHERE A DIFFERENT SYSTEM APPLIES AND WHICH THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS SEPARATELY - ONE OF THE DISPUTES CITED HERE CONCERNS A SETTLEMENT PLAN BEYOND THE GREEN LINE, WHERE THE ORGANISATIONS OBJECTING RAISED PLANNING AND ECOLOGICAL GROUNDS RATHER THAN THE LAWFULNESS OF SETTLEMENT ITSELF. THE COURT ACHIEVEMENT IS DESCRIBED IN THE SOCIETY'S OWN ANNUAL REPORT FOR 2025, PUBLISHED JUNE 2026, WITHOUT THE CASE NAME OR THE COURT NAMED IN WHAT WAS SEEN. Read it with the municipal environmental units and towns' associations, the district planning committees' environmental seats, the land appraisers' council and the regional forestry nurseries recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Bar's volunteer legal aid for those the state scheme excludes — first meeting at the nearest rights centre, and a fee committee that binds the lawyer
trackers.desc: THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED STATE LEGAL AID SCHEMES IN A DOZEN COUNTRIES AND FOUND THE SAME HOLE IN NEARLY ALL OF THEM: A HOUSEHOLD TOO POOR TO PAY A LAWYER BUT NOT POOR ENOUGH TO QUALIFY. THIS BAR ADDRESSES THAT HOLE DIRECTLY - IT IS COMMITTED TO GIVING LEGAL ASSISTANCE TO PEOPLE OF LIMITED MEANS WHO ARE NOT ENTITLED TO ASSISTANCE FROM THE STATE, GIVING ADVICE AND REPRESENTATION TO APPLICANTS WHO CANNOT HIRE A LAWYER BY THEIR OWN MEANS AND ARE FOUND ELIGIBLE. A PROGRAMME DEFINED BY WHO THE STATE SCHEME LEAVES OUT IS THE EXACT COMPLEMENT TO THE CATEGORY LISTS THIS FILE HAS RECORDED ELSEWHERE - INCLUDING ONE COUNTRY WHERE LAND AND ENVIRONMENTAL DISPUTES APPEAR IN NO CATEGORY AT ALL. WHAT IT COVERS IS CIVIL LAW, WITH A LIST THAT NAMES FAMILY STATUS MATTERS AND INSOLVENCY AND ECONOMIC REHABILITATION - BUT THE LIST IS EXPRESSLY NOT EXHAUSTIVE, EVERY APPLICATION BEING EXAMINED ON ITS MERITS BY THE PROGRAMME TEAM, WITH THE DECISION MADE ACCORDING TO THE SPECIFIC CASE. EXPRESSLY NOT EXHAUSTIVE IS THE PHRASE THAT MATTERS TO A COMMUNITY WHOSE PROBLEM IS LAND, NUISANCE OR PLANNING. THE PROGRAMME DOES NOT PROMISE THOSE SUBJECTS, BUT IT DOES NOT EXCLUDE THEM EITHER - AND AN APPLICATION IS FREE. THE ROUTE IN IS UNUSUALLY WELL DESCRIBED: VOLUNTEER STUDENTS RECEIVE THE CALLS, CONDUCT A TELEPHONE INTERVIEW, UPDATE THE APPLICANT'S DETAILS IN THE SYSTEM AND CLARIFY WHAT THE LEGAL ISSUE IS, AND APPLICATIONS MAY ALSO BE MADE THROUGH A PUBLISHED PRO BONO E-MAIL ADDRESS. KNOWING THAT THE FIRST VOICE IS A STUDENT VOLUNTEER, NOT A LAWYER, CHANGES HOW A CALLER SHOULD PREPARE: STATE THE LEGAL QUESTION IN ONE SENTENCE, HAVE THE DATES AND DOCUMENTS TO HAND, AND MAKE THE ISSUE EASY TO CLASSIFY - BECAUSE CLASSIFICATION IS WHAT THAT CALL IS FOR. IF THE APPLICATION IS FOUND SUITABLE, AN INITIAL CONSULTATION IS ARRANGED WITH A VOLUNTEER LAWYER AT THE RIGHTS CENTRE NEAREST THE APPLICANT'S PLACE OF RESIDENCE, THERE BEING A NATIONWIDE LIST OF SUCH CENTRES - AND AT THAT MEETING THE VOLUNTEER LAWYER EXAMINES THE CASE AND DECIDES WHETHER TO RECOMMEND REPRESENTATION UNDER THE PROGRAMME. A NETWORK OF RIGHTS CENTRES SPREAD ACROSS THE COUNTRY, WITH THE MEETING HELD AT THE ONE NEAREST HOME, IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A SCHEME THAT EXISTS AND ONE A RURAL HOUSEHOLD CAN ACTUALLY REACH. ASK FOR THAT LIST FIRST. THE SECOND HALF OF THIS ENTRY PROTECTS PEOPLE WHO DO PAY. WHERE A DISPUTE ARISES BETWEEN A CLIENT AND THEIR LAWYER OVER FEES, THE CLIENT MAY APPROACH THE BAR'S FEE COMMITTEE - A STATUTORY BODY WHOSE FUNCTIONS ARE DEFINED IN THE BAR ASSOCIATION LAW OF 1961. AND IN CASES OF A FEE CONTINGENT ON THE RESULT, IF THE COMMITTEE DECIDES THE FEE IS EXCESSIVE IT MUST FIX THE APPROPRIATE FEE, AND ITS DETERMINATION BINDS THE LAWYER. A BINDING RULING ON AN EXCESSIVE SUCCESS FEE IS THE STRONGEST CLIENT PROTECTION THIS FILE HAS RECORDED ANYWHERE. COMMUNITIES THAT WIN COMPENSATION - FOR EXPROPRIATED LAND, FOR A REDUCTION IN VALUE, FOR DAMAGE - ARE EXACTLY WHERE CONTINGENT FEES BITE HARDEST. THE ORDINARY PRACTICE AROUND FEES IS ALSO WORTH KNOWING: THERE IS NO LEGAL OBLIGATION TO PUT A FEE AGREEMENT IN WRITING, BUT A WRITTEN AND SIGNED AGREEMENT IS DESIRABLE FOR BOTH SIDES TO REDUCE FUTURE DISPUTES; SOME LAWYERS HOLD A FIRST CONSULTATION WITHOUT CHARGE AND ARE PAID ONLY IF ENGAGED; THE COST SHOULD BE CLEAR TO THE CLIENT AT THE FIRST MEETING; AND A MINIMUM RECOMMENDED TARIFF IS SET BY RULES OF THE BAR'S NATIONAL COUNCIL. NO WRITTEN AGREEMENT REQUIRED MEANS EVERY UNWRITTEN ONE IS A FUTURE ARGUMENT. GET IT IN WRITING BEFORE THE FIRST HEARING, NOT AFTER. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A VOLUNTEER PROGRAMME WITH ELIGIBILITY DECIDED CASE BY CASE ON ECONOMIC CRITERIA - IT IS NOT A RIGHT, ITS NAMED SUBJECTS ARE FAMILY AND INSOLVENCY MATTERS RATHER THAN LAND OR ENVIRONMENT, AND NOTHING RECORDED HERE SHOWS IT TAKING A PLANNING OR NUISANCE CASE; WHETHER IT WOULD, WHAT THE INCOME THRESHOLDS ARE, HOW LONG THE WAIT IS AND WHETHER REPRESENTATION EXTENDS TO APPEALS WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED. A GROUP RATHER THAN AN INDIVIDUAL MAY NOT FIT ITS MODEL AT ALL. THE DESCRIPTION COMES FROM A PUBLIC RIGHTS-GUIDE SITE WHICH STATES THAT ITS INFORMATION IS GENERAL AND NOT A SUBSTITUTE FOR LEGAL ADVICE, AND THE FEE COMMITTEE MATERIAL FROM A COMMERCIAL REAL-ESTATE PUBLICATION'S 2025 GUIDE RATHER THAN FROM THE BAR ITSELF - THE BAR'S OWN SITE OPENS WITH A USE-RESTRICTION NOTICE ON ITS DATABASE. Read it with the district planning committees' environmental seats, the municipal environmental units and towns' associations, the membership nature society's court win and the land appraisers' council recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: EcoPeace Middle East
trackers.desc: Founded in 1994 as Friends of the Earth Middle East and still a member of Friends of the Earth International, EcoPeace is staffed and directed jointly by Jordanians, Palestinians and Israelis, with its own offices in Amman, Ramallah and Tel Aviv and a national director in each. WHO TO ENLIST: the office in your own country. Its Good Water Neighbors programme works with communities on either side of a shared water problem, pairing them across the border rather than treating each in isolation. You CAN get community-level organising support and technical and advocacy weight on water, sewage and Jordan Valley development. You CAN'T get a litigator — EcoPeace works by cross-border cooperation, research and advocacy, not by suing proponents, so a community that needs a permit or an approval challenged in court should look elsewhere. For activists: in Jordan and Palestine this was the only substantial environmental organisation with an office and a named national director that could be verified on its own domain. SIDE CHECK BEFORE YOU APPROACH IT, BECAUSE THIS ORGANISATION IS SOMETIMES THE ORIGINATOR OF A SCHEME RATHER THAN AN OBJECTOR TO ONE. The vision for a major regional water-and-energy exchange project originated with this organisation in 2015, and its own country director publicly advocated for that project while hundreds protested against it in the capital — with opposition drawn from unions, political parties, veterans' associations and members of parliament. Whatever view a reader takes of that dispute, the practical point for this map is unchanged and matches what this file has recorded of a law firm in Turkiye and a marine society in Jordan: AN ORGANISATION CAN BE ENVIRONMENTAL AND STILL BE ON THE SIDE OF THE PROJECT YOU ARE FIGHTING. Establish where it stands on your specific scheme before sharing your strategy with it, and do not assume that an environmental mandate means an oppositional one. Its actual strength is cross-border work on shared water between communities on different sides of a boundary, which is a real and unusual capability — use it for that.

trackers.name: Audit Bureau
trackers.desc: Supreme audit institution of Jordan, auditing government accounts and the use of public money. HOW THIS DIFFERS: an audit body reports AFTER money is spent — use it to find documented waste, irregularity and misspending already uncovered, not live tenders; for who is winning contracts now use the procurement portal, and for aggregate budget totals the statistical office.

trackers.name: Companies Control Department
trackers.desc: National company / corporate registry. — Holds to account: state firms & government-linked companies — find their registration, directors and filings.

trackers.name: Department of Statistics
trackers.desc: Jordan's national statistical office, publishing official national accounts and government-finance statistics — government revenue, expenditure, deficit and public debt. HOW THIS DIFFERS: this gives AGGREGATE national totals, not project-level detail — use it for the big picture, not to see who won a specific contract (use the procurement portal) or what one project cost. Here you can trace how the public budget is allocated and spent in Jordan.

trackers.name: JONEPS e-Procurement
trackers.desc: National public-procurement portal. Here you can trace which firms win government contracts and tenders in Jordan, and for how much.

trackers.name: Financial Disclosure Department (Ministry of Justice)
trackers.desc: National asset-declaration body; Jordan’s Financial Disclosure Department collects officials’ sealed declarations, opened only on complaint, Jordan.

trackers.name: Jordanian Constitutional Court
trackers.desc: Jordanian Constitutional Court — supreme court in Jordan (Wikidata record).

trackers.name: Article 23 delegation — a voluntary society can hold ministerial powers
trackers.desc: THE ROUTE JORDAN ACTUALLY USES. Article 23 lets the Ministry, with Cabinet approval, delegate any of its tasks or powers to ministries, institutions and relevant voluntary societies in environmental protection — provided the delegation is in writing and specific. That is how the Royal Society for the Conservation of Nature enforces wildlife law by delegation from the Ministry of Agriculture, works with the environmental police, and has issued hunting licences since 1973. SO THE QUESTION IS WHO HOLDS THE WRITTEN DELEGATION for your subject and area — ask for it by name, because the law requires it to be written and specific. BUT ARTICLE 24 IS A REAL GATE ON ORGANISING: licensing and renewal of licensing of non-governmental societies working in environmental protection happens only after prior approval of the Ministry. The renewal limb is the one groups forget — diary the date and start ministry approval early. A DEFINITION WORTH USING: degradation means reducing the environment's value, distorting its nature, depleting its resources or harming living organisms or antiquities — antiquities sit inside the environmental definition of harm.

trackers.name: Special protection area — the category for a threatened species, not a view
trackers.desc: PICK THE RIGHT CATEGORY BEFORE YOU ARGUE. The nature reserves and national parks regulation defines: national park — land, water, shores, oases, forests or heritage areas that the Council of Ministers decides is one, so a site need not be wilderness; protected land — deliberately broad, any land the Council decides is protected; and special protection area — an area hosting a distinctive ecosystem or wildlife threatened with extinction. That last is the category to seek when your argument is a specific threatened species or a distinctive ecosystem rather than scenic value. WHO DECIDES: the Council of Ministers, on the Minister's recommendation — so the recommendation is the step to influence. The competent body that establishes or manages a reserve is appointed the same way, which is how a non-state body can run one. Article 21 requires the specifications and conditions for any reserve to be set by regulation, so the standards are written and checkable. CONTEXT: RSCN founded 1966, first reserve Shaumari 1975, Dibbeen sixth in 2004 at around 1,200 km²; Fifa 2011; Burqu, Dhuheikeh and Dumaitha 2018. RSCN has an elected 11-member board, elected every 4 years — a membership you can join and a board you can stand for.

trackers.name: Environment Protection Fund — currently disbursing, chaired by the Minister
trackers.desc: AN ACTIVE GRANT WINDOW, NOT A DORMANT ONE. The Board of the Environment Protection Fund meets at the Ministry of Environment and is chaired by the Minister of Environment, and has approved financing for a package of environmental and development projects covering sustainable agriculture and green economy work — aimed at protecting the environment, ensuring sustainability of natural resources, and enhancing the participation of local communities in achieving sustainable environmental development. TWO THINGS FOLLOW: approvals are being reported currently, so the fund is disbursing; and local community participation is an express objective of what the board has just funded, so a community-participation framing matches its stated priorities rather than arguing against them. The board being chaired by the Minister tells you the level at which decisions are made — ministry relationships matter alongside a paper application. Approvals are announced through Petra, the Jordan News Agency, which is a way to track what has actually been funded before you draft. DO NOT CONFUSE IT with the Saudi صندوق البيئة (Environment Fund), a different country's body covering ‘environment and meteorology’ that surfaces on the same search terms.

trackers.name: GEF endorsement runs through Planning, not Environment
trackers.desc: APPROACHING THE WRONG MINISTRY LOSES TIME. Jordan's GEF Operational Focal Point sits in the Ministry of Planning and International Cooperation, not the environment ministry — the Secretary General, focal point since 17 March 2021 — and a working contact is published: Head of Division, World Bank Division, International Cooperation Department, Amman; tel +962 6 4644466 ext 644; email maher.abdelrahim@mop.gov.jo. A GEF project needs that focal point's endorsement. Jordan sits in a constituency with Afghanistan, Iraq, Lebanon, Pakistan, Syria and Yemen, and financing for national and regional projects is inclusive of all participating countries. UNDER GEF-8 STAR FULL FLEXIBILITY, funds may be drawn across biodiversity, climate change and land degradation, with the source focal area endorsed by the Operational Focal Point — so which envelope your project is charged to is that person's decision, and worth discussing before submission. Jordan is also a Green Climate Fund country with a National Designated Authority. OTHER BODIES: JOHUD (created by royal decree 1977) is the largest development NGO, with a network of 51 community centres and, since 1979, special legal status with administrative and financial independence — its mandate is poverty, women, youth and water scarcity, not primarily environmental, so approach it on a livelihood or water framing. EcoPeace Middle East works across Amman, Bethlehem and Tel Aviv.

trackers.name: ICCA Registry and Protected Planet — and registration is not a precondition
trackers.desc: CHECK WHETHER YOUR SITE IS ALREADY IN A REGISTRY BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE — it may carry a designation nobody locally mentioned. The World Database on Protected and Conserved Areas at protectedplanet.net is a joint UNEP and IUCN product managed by UNEP-WCMC, drawing on almost 500 data providers in 245 countries, updated monthly and downloadable; it underpins the UN List of Protected Areas. THE OECM ROUTE IS THE ONE MOST COMMUNITIES MISS: a site qualifies as an other effective area-based conservation measure if it delivers sustained, positive conservation outcomes EVEN THOUGH IT MAY BE MANAGED PRIMARILY FOR OTHER REASONS — so a grazing commons, a sacred site or a watershed managed for water supply can qualify without being managed primarily for conservation. Land that is worked rather than preserved is not excluded. But note the exclusivity: a site can be a protected area or an OECM — it is not possible to meet both, so ask which is being proposed. THE ICCA REGISTRY IS THE ONE COMMUNITIES FILL IN THEMSELVES: at iccaregistry.org, communities themselves provide data, case studies, maps, photos and stories, and its operators state it is meant to be used to enhance advocacy and recognition — not merely as an inventory. Documenting a territory there creates a citable, third-party-hosted record. THE SENTENCE THAT MATTERS MOST: UNEP-WCMC states these territories must be recognised and respected ‘whether or not they have been reported to the ICCA Registry’ — registration is NOT a precondition of rights, and anyone arguing a claim is weaker for being unregistered is arguing against the registry operator's own position. AND USE THE SCALE FIGURE CAREFULLY: over 1,500 sites are reported under indigenous and community governance — just 1 percent of all recorded sites, with UNEP-WCMC adding that no one knows how many ICCAs exist globally. That 1 percent measures how little has been recorded, not how little communities conserve. Filter Protected Planet by governance type to find such sites; UNEP-WCMC's manual Global Databases to Support ICCAs gives guidance on contributing data.

trackers.name: RSCN — an NGO you can approach that carries state enforcement power and proposes new reserves
trackers.desc: THE INVERSION: THIS IS A NON-GOVERNMENTAL BODY THAT ENFORCES THE LAW. The Royal Society for the Conservation of Nature enforces the Wildlife Protection Act under a special mandate from the Ministry of Agriculture and works alongside the environmental police unit, the Rangers — so a report to RSCN behaves more like a report to a regulator than a letter to a charity, and it is one of very few organisations in the Middle East holding that kind of public mandate. WHAT IT HOLDS: ten protected areas — Shaumari, Azraq, Wadi Mujib, Ajloun, Dana, Dibeen, Yarmouk, Fifa, Burqu and Dahek — covering 4,656 square kilometres. THE DOOR FOR A COMMUNITY IS THE PIPELINE: RSCN states that additional sites are proposed as locations for new reserves in coming years. Land that enters that pipeline is being assessed by the body that will manage it, which is a far stronger position than objecting to a plan after it is filed — approach RSCN about the site itself, early, rather than about the project. CHECK YOUR FIGURES AGAINST RSCN'S OWN PAGES: several widely-copied third-party profiles still describe seven reserves covering about 1,200 square kilometres, which is badly out of date; RSCN's own What We Do page gives ten and 4,656. Quoting the stale figure at a hearing hands the other side an easy correction. THE LIMIT, AND IT MATTERS: RSCN holds its mandate from the government. It is at its strongest against hunting, overgrazing, encroachment and unlicensed works, and a community should not assume it will front a fight against a development the state itself is backing. Founded 1966, based in Amman.THREE THINGS ABOUT THIS SOCIETY BELONG WITH THE ABOVE, AND THE FIRST IS THE LEGAL FOOTING THE REST RESTS ON: THE GOVERNMENT DELEGATED TO IT THE RESPONSIBILITY OF PROTECTING WILDLIFE AND BIOLOGICAL DIVERSITY IN ALL AREAS OF THE KINGDOM, AND IT IS DESCRIBED AS AMONG THE FIRST INSTITUTIONS TO HOLD SUCH A DELEGATION NOT ONLY IN THE MIDDLE EAST BUT WORLDWIDE. IN ALL AREAS OF THE KINGDOM IS THE PHRASE TO USE WHEN ASKING ABOUT A SITE IT DOES NOT ALREADY HOLD. THE DELEGATION IS NOT CONFINED TO THE EXISTING RESERVES — GROUND THAT MATTERS FOR WILDLIFE ANYWHERE FALLS INSIDE WHAT THIS BODY WAS ASKED TO PROTECT. SECOND, THE SCALE AND THE NAMES: IT ESTABLISHED AND MANAGES ELEVEN RESERVES — DANA AND MUJIB BIOSPHERES, AZRAQ WETLAND, SHAUMARI, DIBEEN AND AJLOUN FORESTS, WADI RUM, YARMOUK FORESTS, FIFA, BURQU AND DHAHEK — AND IS WORKING ON FIVE MORE AT BURQU, GHOR FIFA, QATAR, JABAL MAS'UDA AND THE YARMOUK RIVER. THE NEAREST RESERVE'S STAFF KNOW THE LOCAL ECOLOGY AND THE LOCAL POLITICS AND CAN BE REACHED WITHOUT GOING TO THE CAPITAL. THIRD, MEMBERSHIP IS OPEN: THE SOCIETY INVITES PEOPLE TO JOIN AND TO BECOME A FRIEND OF THE SOCIETY, WITH AN ELECTRONIC SERVICES PAGE COVERING MEMBERSHIP AND WILDLIFE TRADE PERMITS, AND A NATURE SHOP WHOSE PRODUCTS SUPPORT THE LOCAL COMMUNITY. MEMBERS CAN ASK THINGS OF AN ORGANISATION THAT STRANGERS CANNOT — THE CHEAPEST STANDING A VILLAGE GROUP CAN BUY IN A BODY THAT ALREADY HOLDS LAND. AND ITS REGIONAL FORUM FOR RESERVE LEADERS TEACHES WHAT A COMMUNITY NEEDS IF IT WANTS TO HOLD GROUND ITSELF: WRITING MANAGEMENT PLANS, HABITAT MANAGEMENT, MANAGEMENT EFFECTIVENESS, LOCAL COMMUNITY PARTICIPATION AND ECOTOURISM.

trackers.name: BirdLife Hima Fund — grants for Important Bird Areas, but you apply through RSCN, not directly
trackers.desc: THIS IS ONE OF VERY FEW DOCUMENTED GRANT WINDOWS FOR LAND PROTECTION ANYWHERE IN THIS REGION, AND JORDAN IS ONE OF ONLY FOUR COUNTRIES BIRDLIFE NAMES AS HAVING RECEIVED ONE. BirdLife records that the Hima Fund launched in 2011 with four approved grants to Partners in Jordan, Lebanon, Qatar and Oman, to reinforce or revitalise Himas at four sites. The fund was established in Qatar in 2008 and endowed by a one million dollar donation from Sheikha Jawaher Bint Hamad Bin Suhaim Al-Thani, with the stated purpose of conserving Important Bird Areas and their threatened species in the Middle East. THE ROUTE IS INDIRECT AND THIS IS THE PART PEOPLE GET WRONG: the grants went to BirdLife Partners, not to communities. In Jordan the BirdLife Partner is the Royal Society for the Conservation of Nature, already recorded in this file — so a community with a threatened bird habitat approaches RSCN and asks it to carry the application, rather than applying to Doha. WHAT THE FUND BUYS IS THE HIMA MODEL, NOT A PURCHASE: the Hima is a traditional land designation under which a defined community controls access and use, and may forbid hunting, wood cutting and destruction of trees and shrubs within it — so frame the site as a community-managed protected area, not as a piece of land to be bought. THE CAVEAT THAT MATTERS MOST AND WEAKENS THIS ENTRY: no evidence of grant-making after the early 2010s was found during verification. The founding donation, the establishment and the first four grants are documented; a current, open application window is not. Establish that the fund is still disbursing before building a timetable around it, and ask RSCN, which would know. DO NOT ASSUME A WIDER REMIT MEANS A WIDER FUND: press reporting from 2010 lists twelve countries the fund was geared toward; BirdLife's own page names four that received grants. This entry exists in those four only.

trackers.name: Justice Center for Legal Aid — because Jordan's statutory right to a free lawyer stops at ten years' imprisonment
trackers.desc: START FROM THE FACT JCLA ITSELF PUBLISHES: JORDANIAN LAW GRANTS THE RIGHT TO FREE LEGAL ASSISTANCE ONLY TO THOSE FACING A SENTENCE OF TEN OR MORE YEARS' IMPRISONMENT. For anyone fighting a development, a quarry, an expropriation or a permit, that means there is no statutory route to a lawyer whatsoever, and the courts being formally open to all is not the same as being usable. JCLA is the body that fills the gap: founded 2008, the first legal aid organisation in the country, now operating clinics across all twelve governorates, and by one account defending more clients than Jordan's other twelve legal aid organisations combined. Roughly 375 consultations a month and representation for about 150 people across 200 cases. THE CONSULTATION AND THE REPRESENTATION ARE TWO DIFFERENT DOORS. Any poor or vulnerable person may visit a clinic for advice; representation requires passing three checks, revised annually — a means check on whether you could afford a private lawyer, a check that the case falls within JCLA's areas, and for civil and family matters a check on whether the case has reasonable prospects of success and whether representation is actually necessary to a good outcome. The assessment is applied regardless of nationality, gender or legal status, and neither the centre nor the assigned attorney charges the beneficiary. THE TRAP, AND READ IT BEFORE YOU BUILD A PLAN: JCLA's published areas of representation are civil, criminal and family or sharia law. Administrative law — which is the category a challenge to a planning decision or an environmental permit falls into — is not among them. A civil claim framed around damage, nuisance or compensation may fit where an administrative challenge does not, so ask how your matter would be classified at the first consultation rather than after. One encouraging sign not confirmed on JCLA's own pages: the InforMEA environmental legal protection directory lists JCLA, which suggests environmental matters are within reach — treat that as a question to put, not a fact. Contact info@jcla-org.com; use the clinic locator on the site rather than a published count, since sources give both 21 and 24 clinics. JORDAN HAS AN ACCESS TO INFORMATION LAW AND ITS GATE IS LEGITIMATE INTEREST — which is the difference between this route and the equivalent elsewhere, and the thing to prepare for. Law No. 47 of 2007, the first of its kind in the region, allows a request to be made by ANYONE WITH A LEGITIMATE INTEREST in the information sought, with the process taking up to thirty days. That threshold is judged by the body you are asking. In Israel, by comparison, the law lets any citizen ask without showing an interest at all. SO IN JORDAN, WRITE THE INTEREST INTO THE REQUEST ITSELF: your address, your land, your water source, your grazing, the specific decision that affects you. Do not leave the authority to decide whether you have one. KNOW TWO FURTHER THINGS BEFORE RELYING ON IT. The law was substantially amended in March 2024 — twenty existing articles revised and seven new ones added — so any guidance written before then is out of date, and independent legal analysis of those amendments has identified fundamental deficiencies in the law and in its procedural mechanisms. Check the current text rather than a summary. And the body overseeing the provision of information is a council composed of officials from security and interior ministries among others, which is worth knowing when a refusal is framed in terms of classification. THIS FILE FOUND NO JORDANIAN ORGANISATION THAT FILES INFORMATION REQUESTS ON BEHALF OF COMMUNITIES, which is why the route is recorded here, attached to the country's free legal aid service, rather than as a body of its own. A lawyer obtained through legal aid is the realistic way to frame and pursue a request and to challenge a refusal.

trackers.name: Ministry of Awqaf and the Awqaf Council — waqf land carries an expropriation consent gate ordinary land does not
trackers.desc: THE LEVER: JORDANIAN WAQF LAND CANNOT BE EXPROPRIATED IN THE ORDINARY WAY. Article 24 of the Awqaf, Islamic Affairs and Holy Places Law provides that, notwithstanding anything in any other legislation, no waqf land may be expropriated except for fair compensation and with the approval of the Awqaf Council — and that where waqf land is expropriated, no part of its area may be deducted free of charge. Two consequences a land defence should act on. First, there is a body whose consent is required, which means there is a body that can be petitioned to withhold it — that is a door ordinary private landowners facing a road, a dam or a zone simply do not have. Second, the free-of-charge deduction that public-purpose takings normally rely on does not apply, so the arithmetic of a scheme crossing waqf land is worse for the developer than across neighbouring plots. ESTABLISH FIRST WHETHER THE LAND IS ACTUALLY WAQF, BECAUSE THE REGISTRATION LEAVES A TRACE: on a valid charitable waqf the Department of Lands and Survey registers the property and issues the title deed in the name of the General Custodian of Islamic Awqaf; on a family or shared waqf a waqf annotation is entered on the reverse of the register sheet recording that the whole parcel is dedicated as family or shared waqf, in the terms of the waqf deed. Check the register sheet before assuming, and check it for neighbouring parcels too. THE ROUTE THAT PUTS LAND BEYOND ORDINARY DEALING: dedicating land as charitable waqf, with charitable Islamic awqaf and the transactions relating to them exempted from taxes, fees and stamp duties. THE COUNTERWEIGHT, AND IT MUST BE READ: the Ministry's own investment arm buys and sells non-waqf real estate with waqf funds, and the Ministry may take financing or issue Sharia-compliant funding instruments — this is an institution with a development portfolio, not a conservation body, and on another site it may be the developer. VERIFY THE CURRENT TEXT BEFORE RELYING ON ARTICLE 24: Law 32 of 2001 was amended in 2025, and a legal database rendering of the provision carries the free-of-charge protection without the Awqaf Council approval requirement, which may reflect the amended wording. Take the article as it now stands from the Ministry's own legislation pages rather than from this entry. Founded 1968; Jordanian waqf administration ran under the Ottoman Awqaf Administration Regulation of 1280 AH until 1946.

trackers.name: JREDS — got the Aqaba master plan amended and the change gazetted, so it is permanent
trackers.desc: THE TACTIC THAT WORKED WAS AMENDING THE PLAN, NOT FIGHTING A PROJECT — AND GETTING THE AMENDMENT GAZETTED SO IT COULD NOT BE QUIETLY UNDONE. Jordan's entire coastline is 27 kilometres. Since the Aqaba Special Economic Zone Authority was established in 2001 the country lost around 10 kilometres of shore to investment, leaving roughly 5 kilometres of public-access beachfront. JREDS built a coalition of more than seventy organisations and some 2,300 people — including 1,441 young people aged 18 to 25 and 871 school students — running awareness workshops on beach access and on the zone authority's development plans, and taking people on field visits to see the state of the public beaches for themselves. The result: the authority's Board of Commissioners accepted the proposed amendments to the master plan, and the changes were issued in the Official Gazette by the cabinet, making them permanent. A plan amendment published in the gazette outlives the campaign that won it, in a way that a promise from a board does not. The campaign also brought the seven largest environmental organisations in Jordan into one coalition, and its next stage was legislative advocacy to write public beach access into national law. WHO THEY ARE: founded in 1993 by Jordanian diving enthusiasts and registered in 1995 under the Ministry of Interior as the first specialised Jordanian organisation for marine conservation; IUCN member; three programmes covering marine conservation, outreach and advocacy, and sustainable development. Offices in Aqaba. NOW THE PART YOU MUST WEIGH BEFORE ENLISTING THEM, AND IT IS UNCOMFORTABLE: their published partner and funder list includes the Aqaba Development Corporation, the Aqaba Container Terminal, a large potash company and a named coastal resort project — that is, coastal developers and a port operator in the very zone whose master plan they campaigned to amend, alongside international agencies. Reported income also includes fees from hotels and beaches. That does not erase the gazetted amendment, which happened; it means you should establish where they stand on your specific site before assuming alignment, and expect their advocacy to aim at regulating development rather than stopping it. SCOPE LIMIT: this is a marine and coastal body. For inland Jordan the file carries RSCN for protected areas and the Justice Center for Legal Aid for counsel. SOURCING NOTE: the coalition figures and the gazette outcome come from a human rights practice platform's case study rather than from jreds.org, and the funder list from a network member profile — confirm both with JREDS before quoting them.

trackers.name: CEPF Mediterranean Basin — live calls with published deadlines, and Jordan is named eligible in both
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE ONLY FUND IN THIS FILE WITH DATED, OPEN CALLS RATHER THAN A DOCUMENTED PAST, AND JORDAN IS NAMED ELIGIBLE IN BOTH OF THEM. A large-grants call for letters of inquiry opened on 1 July 2026 and closes on 18 September 2026 at midnight Washington time, with grants from fifty thousand to a hundred and eighty thousand US dollars, restricted to two strategic directions: traditional land use practices, and preservation of threatened plant species. A separate small-grants call ran from 9 February to 15 March 2026 with grants of twenty to fifty thousand dollars from a total pot of five hundred and forty thousand, restricted to conservation of threatened freshwater biodiversity, with projects to start on 1 August 2026 and finish by 30 September 2027. Read those strategic directions carefully before framing anything: a Jordanian project about grazing, terracing or other traditional land use fits the large-grants window, one about a spring or a wadi fits the freshwater window, and one that fits neither will not be funded however good it is. THE ELIGIBILITY BAR IS ORGANISATIONAL AND IT IS STRICT: applicants must be legally registered entities with their own bank accounts and authorisation under national law to receive charitable funding. Individuals cannot apply and must work through such an organisation. LOCAL AND NATIONAL NGOS ARE EXPLICITLY PRIORITISED in the small-grants call, which is unusual and favours exactly the kind of body this map exists to connect people to. Letters of inquiry go through the ConservationGrants portal in English or French; the regional implementation team is BirdLife International with the Slovenian bird society DOPPS, reachable on a published team address, and the team ran language webinars with session times given for Amman. WATCH THE CALLS PAGE RATHER THAN THE FUND: windows open for roughly five to ten weeks and then shut, and applications after the deadline are refused whatever the reason. CEPF is a joint initiative of the French Development Agency, Conservation International, the European Union, the Global Environment Facility, the Government of Japan and the World Bank; the global fund belongs elsewhere in this map and only the Mediterranean window is recorded here.

trackers.name: GEF Small Grants Programme Jordan — grants direct to community organisations, running here since 1992, with a national coordinator you can approach
trackers.desc: THIS FUND GOES DIRECTLY TO COMMUNITY-BASED ORGANISATIONS RATHER THAN THROUGH A NATIONAL INTERMEDIARY, AND IT HAS BEEN IN JORDAN SINCE NOVEMBER 1992 — more than two hundred projects funded in its first two decades alone. It supports local community members, community-based organisations and civil society organisations, working across the environmental focal areas of biodiversity, climate change mitigation and adaptation, land degradation and sustainable forest management, international waters and chemicals. Land degradation and sustainable land management is the direction most likely to fit a land-defence project. THE STRUCTURE IS THE ACCESS POINT AND IT IS UNUSUALLY REACHABLE: the programme runs in a decentralised, country-driven way through a National Coordinator and a National Steering Committee, so decisions are made in Amman by people you can meet rather than in a foreign capital, and proposals must align with the Jordan Country Programme Strategy — read that document before drafting, because alignment with it is an explicit assessment criterion alongside meeting the programme's own criteria and being proposed by a national community or non-governmental organisation. GRANT SIZES ARE OFTEN MISQUOTED, SO TAKE THEM FROM THE GEF ITSELF: the core global programme funds grants up to seventy-five thousand US dollars, with up to a hundred and fifty thousand for strategic projects intended to scale a proven approach across a landscape. The widely repeated figure of fifty thousand is the older ceiling and still appears on many UNDP pages; the practical average has historically run well below either, around twenty to twenty-five thousand. A separate CSO Challenge Programme launched in June 2026, led by IUCN with ten million dollars available and grants up to three hundred thousand, but its eligible-country list could not be verified on a canonical source this round and must be checked on thegef.org before anyone relies on it. ONE FIGURE WORTH KNOWING IF YOUR GROUP IS WOMEN-LED: UNDP reports that 55 per cent of the community organisations benefiting from Jordan's programme are led by women. CURRENCY CAVEAT: the Jordan page's published project count runs to June 2014, so confirm the programme is currently accepting proposals and identify the current National Coordinator before preparing anything. The global programme belongs elsewhere in this map; only the Jordan country programme is recorded here. AN UNREGISTERED VILLAGE GROUP CAN BE FUNDED DIRECTLY. The programme states on its own grantees page that, in cooperation with UNOPS, it has developed Memoranda of Agreement allowing grants to be awarded to community-based groups that are not formally registered, without having to go through an intermediary non-governmental organisation. That removes the barrier that stops most village campaigns before they start, and it is specific to this programme — the other funds recorded in this file do require a registered entity with its own bank account. Ask the National Coordinator about a Memorandum of Agreement explicitly; it is not something a general enquiry will surface. Two further points from the programme's own material: National Coordinators and SGP staff are UN-contracted rather than government-employed, specifically to protect their neutrality and objectivity in grant-making, which matters when the project you are objecting to is a government one; and the GEF now describes the programme as operating with five implementing agencies, naming UNDP, FAO and Conservation International among them, so the body hosting a country programme is not necessarily UNDP. Programme-wide it reports close to 30,000 grants and 1.54 billion dollars of GEF funds across 136 countries.

trackers.name: Royal Botanic Garden — 180 hectares held and restored, and the herders who opposed it ended up with more pasture
trackers.desc: THE EVIDENCE HERE ANSWERS THE OBJECTION EVERY PROPOSED RESERVE MEETS. When this garden was established the local sheep and goat herders feared it would take their grazing and their livelihoods. Grazing was stopped on the site in 2008 for three years, agreed with those communities, so that the recovery of the vegetation could be measured and a sustainable grazing level calculated from what was actually observed. A herder from a neighbouring village is on record saying that once the site was fenced and protected the plant cover grew, that in summer they began finding good pasture there, and that they could graze for longer. If you are told a protected area will cost the village its pasture, this is the case to cite: a measured three-year exclosure that ended with more grazing, not less, and a number attached to how much the land can carry. WHAT IT HOLDS: 180 hectares — 1,800 dunums — at Tal Ar-Rumman about 25 kilometres north of Amman above the King Talal dam, with more than 300 metres of elevation change across the site, which is why it can represent a large share of Jordan's flora. The site was declared an environmentally important site by the Ministry of Environment in 2014, so the land carries a designation as well as an owner. Five Jordanian habitats are being re-created on it — deciduous oak, pine, juniper, Jordan Valley and freshwater. WHAT IT CAN GIVE A CAMPAIGN: a seed bank holding over 1,200 accessions of more than 400 species, representing over sixteen per cent of Jordan's native plant species, built with training from the Millennium Seed Bank and intended for habitat re-establishment and restoration; and a herbarium whose specimens have been scanned at high resolution to form the region's first online herbarium. If you need to establish what grew on a site before it was cleared, or to restore it afterwards, that is where the material and the records are. Its community rangeland rehabilitation work is reported to have raised and diversified incomes for local livestock owners, and it welcomes volunteers. A non-governmental non-profit founded in the mid-2000s on the initiative of a member of the royal family who also founded the Jordanian marine conservation society recorded elsewhere in this file — worth knowing, since the two are the country's strongest non-state conservation bodies and share a founder. THE LIMITS: it is one site and a research and restoration institution, not a litigator, a funder or a national campaigner, and its royal patronage places it firmly within the establishment. It will supply seed, records, restoration expertise and the grazing precedent; it will not object to your scheme. Founding year is given as both 2005 and 2008 across sources; the garden's own material and the earlier listings favour 2005.THE SEED BANK IS MENTIONED ABOVE; HOW IT COLLECTS IS THE PART WORTH COPYING, BECAUSE THE METHOD IS PUBLISHED. BOTANISTS SET AN ANNUAL PLAN OF EXPLORATION TRIPS THAT IDENTIFIES BOTH THE TARGET PLANTS AND THEIR LOCATIONS. FIELD TOURS THEN COLLECT ACROSS THE COUNTRY TO STANDARDS OF SAMPLE QUALITY, DIVERSITY AND VIABILITY. AND PRECISE DATA IS RECORDED ABOUT EVERY PLANT COLLECTED — STATED TO BE NECESSARY NOT ONLY FOR RESEARCH BUT FOR PLANTING HABITATS WITH THE AIM OF RESTORING OR REHABILITATING THEM. SO THE COLLECTION RECORD IS BUILT FROM THE START TO SUPPORT REPLANTING A PLACE, NOT MERELY TO STORE MATERIAL. A COMMUNITY THAT WANTS ITS OWN GROUND RESTORED SHOULD ASK WHETHER THE SITE APPEARS IN THAT YEAR'S EXPLORATION PLAN — AND IF IT DOES NOT, ASK FOR IT TO BE ADDED, WITH THE SPECIES IT HOLDS NAMED. COLLECTION BEGAN IN 2009 AT THE GARDEN AND ITS SURROUNDINGS, WHERE THE NATURALLY GROWING PLANTS AMOUNT TO MORE THAN A THIRD OF ALL SPECIES IN THE COUNTRY, AND LATER EXPANDED NATIONWIDE UNDER DEFINED PROTOCOLS. THAT FIGURE IS AN ARGUMENT IN ITSELF: A SINGLE UNDEVELOPED HILLSIDE CAN CARRY A THIRD OF A COUNTRY'S FLORA, WHICH IS WHAT ORDINARY UNPROTECTED GROUND IS WORTH. AND THERE IS A LIVE PROJECT WITH A FUNDING SOURCE THIS FILE HAS NOT RECORDED ANYWHERE ELSE. THE GARDEN IS RESTORING RANGELANDS AND CONSERVING NATIVE PLANT SEED IN THE BADIA, IN TWO NAMED AREAS, WITH PHASE ONE COMPLETE: MORE THAN A HUNDRED PLANT SPECIES CONSERVED AND PROCESSED, MORE THAN TWO THOUSAND SEED SAMPLES DRIED FOR STORAGE, NEARLY TWO HUNDRED SPECIES DOCUMENTED, AND BIOLOGICAL AND GENETIC ANALYSES ON SELECTED SAMPLES. THE PROJECT IS FUNDED BY THE ENVIRONMENT MINISTRY'S ENVIRONMENTAL COMPENSATION PROGRAMME. COMPENSATION MONEY — PAID BECAUSE ENVIRONMENTAL DAMAGE WAS DONE — IS PAYING FOR RANGELAND RESTORATION AND SEED CONSERVATION. THAT IS A FUNDING STREAM TIED TO HARM, AND IT IS THE ONE TO ASK ABOUT WHEN A PROJECT HAS ALREADY DAMAGED GROUND NEARBY. WHERE COMPENSATION IS PAID INTO A NAMED PROGRAMME RATHER THAN A GENERAL BUDGET, A COMMUNITY CAN ASK WHAT THAT PROGRAMME HAS FUNDED, WHETHER ITS OWN AREA QUALIFIES, AND WHO DECIDES — and the answer here is that it funds restoration carried out by a botanic garden, not by the polluter.

trackers.name: Rasheed — Jordan's transparency chapter, whose own strategy is helping communities act on specific grievances
trackers.desc: ITS OWN PUBLISHED STRATEGY IS THE REASON TO RECORD IT: it commits to helping individuals, communities, civil society organisations and social movements ACT ON SPECIFIC CORRUPTION PROBLEMS IDENTIFIED IN THEIR COMMUNITIES, and to take action on specific grievances — not only to publish indices. That matters because this file has established that Jordan's conservation bodies are royally chartered and do not object to schemes, and that organised opposition runs through unions and parties rather than through organisations a village can approach. This is the first Jordanian entry here whose stated purpose includes acting on a community's own grievance. It is a non-profit founded at the end of 2013 by anti-corruption activists, and has served as the Transparency International chapter in Jordan since April 2014, based in Amman. It also states an aim of establishing and leading a watchdog coalition.
