trackers.desc: THE MOST EXPENSIVE PART OF FIGHTING A PROJECT IS NOT THE LAWYER — IT IS THE EXPERT WHO CAN SHOW THE ASSESSMENT IS WRONG. THIS ALLIANCE SUPPLIES THAT: ITS SCIENCE TEAM CRITIQUES ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT ASSESSMENTS, SUBMITS EXPERT TESTIMONY TO COURTS, AND HELPS PARTNERS EDUCATE CLIENTS AND COMMUNITIES ABOUT TECHNICAL MATTERS. A CRITIQUE OF AN IMPACT ASSESSMENT IS THE SINGLE MOST USEFUL DOCUMENT IN AN OBJECTION. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED COUNTRY AFTER COUNTRY WHERE THE ASSESSMENT IS WRITTEN BY A CONSULTANT THE DEVELOPER PAID AND NOBODY INDEPENDENT EVER READS IT. THE FULL LIST OF WHAT PARTNERS CAN ASK FOR IS UNUSUALLY CONCRETE: STRATEGIC SUPPORT AS THEY DEVELOP CASES AND STRENGTHEN ENVIRONMENTAL LAWS; SCIENTIFIC EQUIPMENT AND TRAINING TO MONITOR ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS; SCIENTIFIC ASSESSMENT OF ENVIRONMENTAL DATA TO IDENTIFY TOXINS AND THEIR SOURCE; MODEL LAWS AND REGULATIONS SUCH AS LAWS PROTECTING WATER QUALITY; ENVIRONMENTAL AND HUMAN RIGHTS RECORDS OF MULTINATIONAL CORPORATIONS; AND EXPERT SCIENTIFIC TESTIMONY TO SUPPORT CASES AGAINST POLLUTERS. SCIENTIFIC EQUIPMENT AND TRAINING TO MONITOR CONDITIONS IS THE ITEM COMMUNITIES OVERLOOK. INSTRUMENTS IN LOCAL HANDS PRODUCE A RECORD NOBODY CAN DISMISS AS ANECDOTE — AND IDENTIFYING TOXINS AND THEIR SOURCE IS PRECISELY THE STEP THAT TURNS A COMPLAINT ABOUT SMELL OR SICKNESS INTO A CASE. THE RECORDS OF MULTINATIONAL CORPORATIONS ARE WORTH ASKING FOR EARLY. A COMPANY ARRIVING WITH A CLEAN LOCAL FACE OFTEN HAS A DOCUMENTED HISTORY ELSEWHERE, AND AN ALLIANCE SPANNING EIGHTY-EIGHT COUNTRIES IS THE PLACE THAT HISTORY LIVES. THE LAW TEAM WORKS THE OTHER SIDE: COLLABORATING WITH LAWYERS PROTECTING COMMUNITIES AND THE ENVIRONMENT, HELPING PARTNERS BRING ENFORCEMENT ACTIONS, CRITIQUE PROPOSED STATUTES, ADVANCE POLICIES AND REPLICATE MODEL LAWS. REPLICATING MODEL LAWS MATTERS FOR ANYONE TRYING TO CHANGE A RULE RATHER THAN STOP ONE PROJECT: SOMEBODY IN ANOTHER COUNTRY HAS ALREADY DRAFTED WHAT YOU NEED, AND THIS IS THE NETWORK THAT WILL SEND IT TO YOU. THERE ARE ALSO GUIDEBOOKS TO USE BEFORE ASKING FOR ANYTHING: ON ENVIRONMENTAL SAMPLING, ON EVALUATING A PROJECT'S ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT ASSESSMENT, AND ONE AIMED AT HELPING ADVOCATES AND THE COMMUNITIES THEY REPRESENT CHALLENGE OIL AND GAS PROJECTS THAT ARE UNACCEPTABLE ON ENVIRONMENTAL OR SOCIAL GROUNDS. KNOW THE ACCESS ROUTE, BECAUSE IT DECIDES HOW YOU APPROACH: THE ALLIANCE WORKS THROUGH PARTNERS — PUBLIC INTEREST LAWYERS AND ADVOCATES IN THEIR OWN COUNTRIES — RATHER THAN WITH COMMUNITIES DIRECTLY. SO THE ASK IS NOT FOR THEM TO TAKE YOUR CASE. IT IS FOR A LOCAL LAWYER OR ORGANISATION ALREADY HELPING YOU TO CONTACT THE NETWORK AND REQUEST SCIENTIFIC AND LEGAL BACKUP — AND THE SCALE SHOWS THIS IS ROUTINE: ADVOCATES CALL ON THE NETWORK FOR MORE THAN FOUR HUNDRED PROJECTS IN A SINGLE YEAR. IT ALSO RUNS FELLOWSHIPS, HAVING BROUGHT NEARLY THREE HUNDRED ADVOCATES FOR ONE-ON-ONE TRAINING WITH ITS ATTORNEYS AND SCIENTISTS, EACH FELLOWSHIP DESIGNED AROUND THE FELLOW'S OWN NEEDS — WHICH IS THE LONGER-TERM ROUTE TO HAVING SOMEBODY LOCAL WHO CAN DO THIS WORK WITHOUT HELP. AND ITS OWN STATEMENT OF THE PROBLEM IS THE HONEST FRAME FOR EVERY ENTRY IN THIS FILE: THE IMBALANCE OF POWER AND RESOURCES IS THE BIGGEST CHALLENGE TO ITS WORK, BECAUSE COMPANIES THAT EXPLOIT NATURAL RESOURCES HAVE LOTS OF MONEY AND POWER WHILE COMMUNITIES WHO WANT TO PROTECT ECOSYSTEMS AND THEIR TRADITIONAL WAYS OF LIFE OFTEN HAVE LIMITED RESOURCES. THE LIMITS: THIS IS SUPPORT FOR ADVOCATES, NOT A LAW FIRM FOR COMMUNITIES - IT WILL NOT REPRESENT YOU, BUY LAND OR FUND A CAMPAIGN, AND WITHOUT A LOCAL LAWYER OR ORGANISATION WILLING TO BE THE PARTNER THERE IS NO ROUTE IN. IT IS BASED ABROAD AND ITS ASSISTANCE ARRIVES AS DOCUMENTS, ANALYSIS, EQUIPMENT AND TESTIMONY RATHER THAN PEOPLE ON THE GROUND. WHETHER IT CURRENTLY HAS PARTNERS IN THIS COUNTRY, AND WHETHER FOREIGN TECHNICAL SUPPORT WOULD BE POLITICALLY ACCEPTABLE HERE, WERE NOT ESTABLISHED - and this payload records three other countries where it is already recorded, which is where to look for how the relationship works in practice. THE DESCRIPTION COMES FROM THE ALLIANCE'S OWN SITE AND A CHARITY REGISTRY PROFILE ALONGSIDE PARTNER AND DIRECTORY LISTINGS OF VARIOUS YEARS. Read it with the bar association's legal aid, the agricultural risk fund's inspection committees, the embassy direct aid grants and the accountability mechanism of the European bank recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Conservation union's West Asia office — membership open to local organisations, protected area expansion, and a native-species nursery
trackers.desc: THIS PAYLOAD COVERS TWENTY-THREE COUNTRIES. ONE OFFICE, IN THIS CAPITAL, COVERS THIRTEEN OF THEM: A REGIONAL OFFICE FOR WEST ASIA ESTABLISHED IN 2004, COMPRISING IRAQ, JORDAN, LEBANON, PALESTINE, SYRIA, YEMEN AND IRAN TOGETHER WITH BAHRAIN, OMAN, KUWAIT, QATAR, SAUDI ARABIA AND THE UNITED ARAB EMIRATES - WITH A PUBLISHED STREET ADDRESS. THE THING THAT MAKES IT USABLE RATHER THAN MERELY IMPRESSIVE IS ITS STRUCTURE: IT IS A MEMBERSHIP UNION COMPOSED OF BOTH GOVERNMENTS AND NON-GOVERNMENTAL ORGANISATIONS, CREATED IN 1948, WITH MORE THAN FOURTEEN HUNDRED MEMBER ORGANISATIONS AND AROUND SIXTEEN THOUSAND EXPERTS. A SMALL LOCAL ASSOCIATION CAN SIT IN THE SAME UNION AS ITS OWN ENVIRONMENT MINISTRY, WITH THE SAME STANDING TO SPEAK. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED SCORES OF COMMUNITIES WHO COULD NOT GET A MEETING WITH A DIRECTORATE — SHARED MEMBERSHIP OF A UNION IS ONE OF THE FEW ROOMS WHERE BOTH SIDES ARE MEMBERS. THE OFFICE SAYS SO ITSELF: IT IS ONLY AS STRONG AS THE UNDIVIDED POWER OF ITS MEMBERS, THE PAST TEN YEARS HAVE SEEN SUBSTANTIAL GROWTH IN THE NUMBER OF MEMBERS IN THE REGION, AND IT WORKS THROUGH NATIONAL COMMITTEES OF THOSE MEMBERS. A NATIONAL COMMITTEE IS THE PRACTICAL DOOR. IT IS A STANDING GROUP OF MEMBER ORGANISATIONS IN ONE COUNTRY, AND ASKING WHO CHAIRS IT AND WHEN IT MEETS IS A SMALLER, ANSWERABLE QUESTION THAN ASKING AN INTERNATIONAL BODY FOR HELP. WHAT IT OFFERS IS STATED IN TERMS A COMMUNITY CAN USE: BRIDGING NATIONAL, REGIONAL AND GLOBAL EFFORTS; ENGAGING GOVERNMENTS AND CIVIL SOCIETY THROUGH MULTI-STAKEHOLDER FORUMS; FACILITATING KNOWLEDGE EXCHANGE THROUGH REGIONAL NETWORKS; PROVIDING A NEUTRAL SPACE FOR DIALOGUE ON COMPLEX ENVIRONMENTAL AND DEVELOPMENT ISSUES; AND PROMOTING THE TESTING AND ADOPTION OF INNOVATIVE CONSERVATION TOOLS. A NEUTRAL SPACE FOR DIALOGUE IS EXACTLY WHAT IS MISSING WHERE A COMMUNITY AND A PROJECT ARE TALKING PAST EACH OTHER — AND AN INVITATION FROM A BODY THAT ALSO HAS THE MINISTRY AS A MEMBER IS HARDER TO REFUSE THAN ONE FROM THE VILLAGE. ITS WORK IS NOT ABSTRACT. IN ONE PROJECT COMBINING FOREST LANDSCAPE RESTORATION, LIVELIHOOD ENHANCEMENT AND PROTECTED AREA EXPANSION, THE OFFICE - WITH A TOURISM DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY AND THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY - REVITALISED A NAMED NURSERY TO PROPAGATE NATIVE TREE SPECIES, SUPPORTING RESTORATION OF JUNIPER FORESTS ON THE RIDGES ABOVE A WORLD HERITAGE SITE, WITH INCOME-GENERATION FOR LOCAL COMMUNITIES, PARTICULARLY WOMEN AND YOUTH. PROTECTED AREA EXPANSION AS A LIVE PROGRAMME IS THE SENTENCE TO CARRY TO ANY SITE THAT DESERVES PROTECTION. THIS PAYLOAD HAS SPENT ROUNDS ASKING HOW GROUND GETS ADDED TO A NETWORK — HERE IS AN OFFICE WHOSE PROJECTS DO IT, PAIRED WITH A NURSERY THAT GROWS THE RIGHT TREES FOR THE PLACE. ITS EXPERT SIDE IS REACHABLE TOO: THE PROTECTED AREAS COMMISSION IS A NETWORK OF SOME TWO AND A HALF THOUSAND MEMBERS IN A HUNDRED AND FORTY COUNTRIES WORKING ON PROTECTED AREA PLANNING, POLICY ADVICE AND INVESTMENT. AND IN AUGUST 2026 THE OFFICE WAS WORKING WITH THE WATER AND IRRIGATION MINISTRY, THE VALLEY AUTHORITY, THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY AND THE LOCAL ADMINISTRATION MINISTRY — WHICH TELLS A COMMUNITY WHICH DOORS IT IS ALREADY BEHIND. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A CONVENING AND TECHNICAL UNION, NOT A FUNDER OF LAST RESORT OR AN ADVOCATE - IT WILL NOT BUY LAND, TAKE A CASE OR OPPOSE A GOVERNMENT THAT IS ALSO ITS MEMBER, AND ITS NEUTRALITY BETWEEN MEMBERS IS PRECISELY WHY IT CANNOT TAKE A COMMUNITY'S SIDE IN A DISPUTE. MEMBERSHIP HAS ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA, DUES AND AN APPLICATION PROCESS THAT WERE NOT ESTABLISHED HERE, AND SMALL UNREGISTERED GROUPS MAY NOT QUALIFY AT ALL. THE COUNTRY LIST, THE STRUCTURE AND THE PROJECT COME FROM THE UNION'S OWN PAGES AND A RECRUITMENT NOTICE DATED 2025 AND 2026; WHAT THE OFFICE ACTUALLY DOES IN EACH OF THE THIRTEEN COUNTRIES, AND WHETHER IT OPERATES AT ALL IN THE MOST CLOSED OF THEM, WAS NOT ESTABLISHED. Read it with the conservation society holding eleven reserves, the bar association's legal aid, the environmental law alliance and the embassy direct aid grants recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Cooperative corporation's governorate directorates — they sit at your founding meeting and hand you the forms, with a new fund and institute from 2026
trackers.desc: THE HARDEST STEP FOR EVERY COMMUNITY IN THIS FILE IS BECOMING AN ORGANISATION THAT CAN HOLD MONEY AND SIGN THINGS. IN THIS COUNTRY THERE IS A CORPORATION WITH BRANCHES IN ALL THE GOVERNORATES WHOSE JOB IS TO GET YOU THROUGH THAT STEP. THE PROCEDURE IS PUBLISHED AND SHORT: GO TO THE COOPERATION DIRECTORATE IN THE GOVERNORATE WHERE THE SOCIETY'S SEAT WILL BE AND SUBMIT AN APPLICATION EXPRESSING THE WISH TO ESTABLISH A COOPERATIVE SOCIETY; FIX A DATE FOR THE FOUNDING MEETING, WHICH AN EMPLOYEE OF THE DIRECTORATE ATTENDS AND AT WHICH HE SUPPLIES THE FORMS; HOLD THE FOUNDING BODY MEETING AND APPROVE THE INTERNAL STATUTE; SIGN THE APPLICATION, THE FOUNDING CONTRACT AND THE STATUTE AND MINUTE THE MEETING; THEN SUBMIT EVERYTHING TO THE GOVERNORATE DIRECTORATE FOR AUDIT AND REFERRAL ONWARDS. AN OFFICIAL SITS IN THE ROOM AT YOUR FIRST MEETING AND BRINGS THE PAPERWORK WITH HIM. THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED DOZENS OF FUNDS THAT REQUIRE A REGISTERED ORGANISATION AND ALMOST NOTHING THAT HELPS PEOPLE CREATE ONE - THIS IS THAT HELP, IN THE GOVERNORATE, FOR FREE. AND IT IS OPEN WIDELY: THE SERVICE IS FOR NATURAL AND LEGAL PERSONS WISHING TO REGISTER A COOPERATIVE SOCIETY - INDIVIDUALS, NOT ONLY EXISTING BODIES. THE CORPORATION BEHIND THE DIRECTORATES IS SUBSTANTIAL: ESTABLISHED UNDER THE COOPERATION LAW OF 1997, WITH LEGAL PERSONALITY AND FINANCIAL AND ADMINISTRATIVE INDEPENDENCE, ABLE TO OWN MOVABLE AND IMMOVABLE PROPERTY, CONCLUDE CONTRACTS, ACCEPT GIFTS AND DONATIONS, AND TO SUE AND BE SUED - REPRESENTED BY THE ATTORNEY GENERAL OR THE CIVIL PUBLIC ADVOCATE, AND ABLE TO APPOINT ANY LAWYER. A BODY THAT MAY OWN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY, ACCEPT DONATIONS AND APPOINT LAWYERS IS DESCRIBED IN THE SAME TERMS AS THE LAND TRUSTS THIS FILE HAS BEEN HUNTING - AND ITS COOPERATIVES INHERIT THE SAME CAPACITY WHEN THEY ARE REGISTERED. TWO THINGS WERE ADDED IN 2026, AND BOTH MATTER TO A NEW SOCIETY. THE CABINET APPROVED A REGULATION ESTABLISHING A COOPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT FUND AS A BANKING AND FINANCING WINDOW FOR COOPERATIVES - ATTRACTING FINANCIAL SUPPORT FROM DONOR BODIES, ORGANISING THE MECHANISM FOR GRANTING SUPPORT TO BENEFICIARIES, AND REGULATING LOANS TO COOPERATIVES TO ENSURE THE SUSTAINABILITY OF THEIR PROJECTS AND THE FAIR DISTRIBUTION OF SUPPORT. A FINANCING WINDOW BUILT FOR COOPERATIVES ANSWERS THE SECOND BARRIER AFTER REGISTRATION - A BANK THAT WILL DEAL WITH A VILLAGE BODY AT ALL. ASK WHETHER IT IS OPERATING YET AND WHAT IT LENDS AGAINST. THE SECOND IS A COOPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT INSTITUTE, TO BUILD THE CAPACITIES OF COOPERATIVES AND THEIR MEMBERS ACCORDING TO INTERNATIONAL TRAINING CURRICULA APPROVED BY THE INTERNATIONAL LABOUR ORGANISATION AND ADAPTED TO THE LOCAL CONTEXT, AND TO PREPARE FEASIBILITY STUDIES AND STATISTICS FOR THE SECTOR. FEASIBILITY STUDIES PREPARED BY THE INSTITUTE ARE THE DOCUMENT A COMMUNITY CANNOT WRITE AND EVERY FUNDER DEMANDS. THAT IS THE SINGLE MOST USEFUL THING TO ASK THIS BODY FOR. ITS OWN STATED DIRECTION IS WORTH QUOTING BACK WHEN A DIRECTORATE IS SLOW: THE CORPORATION'S BUDGET PROGRAMME FOR 2026 TO 2028 DESCRIBES ITS TARGET AS INDEPENDENT, SELF-RELIANT COOPERATIVES PROVIDING EFFECTIVE SERVICES TO THEIR MEMBERS, AND INCLUDES CREATING A DIRECTORATE FOR AUDITING COOPERATIVES' ACCOUNTS. THE LIMITS: THIS IS THE STATE'S COOPERATIVE REGULATOR AS WELL AS ITS PROMOTER - IT REGISTERS, SUPERVISES AND AUDITS SOCIETIES, AND A COOPERATIVE FORMED THROUGH IT IS A SUPERVISED BODY, NOT AN INDEPENDENT ONE; NOTHING RECORDED HERE SHOWS IT SUPPORTING ANY SOCIETY THAT OPPOSED A PROJECT. THE NUMBER OF MEMBERS REQUIRED TO FOUND A SOCIETY, THE FEES, THE CAPITAL AND THE TIME THE PROCESS TAKES WERE NOT ESTABLISHED - NOR WAS WHETHER NON-JORDANIANS MAY BE FOUNDERS. THE FUND AND THE INSTITUTE WERE APPROVED IN A CABINET REGULATION OF 2026 AND MAY NOT YET BE OPERATING; THAT ACCOUNT COMES FROM A NEWS AGENCY REPORT AND THE CORPORATION'S OWN BUDGET DOCUMENT, WHILE THE REGISTRATION STEPS COME FROM THE NATIONAL SERVICES PORTAL RATHER THAN THE CORPORATION'S SITE. Read it with the conservation society holding eleven reserves, the conservation union's regional office, the bar association's legal aid and the environmental law alliance recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Neighbourhood committees and governorate councils — the local bodies to reach, at the moment their composition stopped being directly elected
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY'S LOCAL TIER CHANGED SHAPE THIS SUMMER, AND ANYONE PLANNING TO USE IT SHOULD KNOW HOW: ON THE NINETEENTH OF AUGUST 2026 THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES APPROVED A LOCAL ADMINISTRATION LAW RESHAPING THE GOVERNORATE COUNCILS ACCORDING TO A FORMULA BASED ON ELECTED BACKGROUNDS THROUGH AN INSTITUTIONAL VOTING MECHANISM AND INSTITUTIONAL REPRESENTATION, INSTEAD OF THE DIRECT ELECTION ON WHICH THE PREVIOUS EXPERIMENT WAS BUILT. THAT IS THE SECOND COUNTRY IN THIS FILE WITHIN THREE MONTHS TO REPLACE A DIRECTLY ELECTED LOCAL COUNCIL WITH A COMPOSED ONE. THE PRACTICAL CONSEQUENCE IS THE SAME BOTH TIMES: THE PERSON WHO USED TO NEED YOUR DISTRICT'S VOTES NO LONGER DOES, SO WRITTEN, DATED, WELL-DOCUMENTED REQUESTS MATTER MORE THAN NUMBERS AT A MEETING. WHAT THE COUNCILS ARE MEANT TO BECOME IS STILL WORTH USING: A PLATFORM FOR DEVELOPMENT AND INVESTMENT PLANNING AT GOVERNORATE LEVEL, ALIGNED WITH A NEEDS DIRECTORY AND WITH NATIONAL PLANS AND PROJECT FOLLOW-UP - WITH GUARANTEED REPRESENTATION FOR THE LESS DEVELOPED AREAS AND FOR ALL GEOGRAPHIC AREAS WITHIN THE GOVERNORATE. GUARANTEED REPRESENTATION FOR THE LESS DEVELOPED AREAS IS THE CLAUSE A REMOTE VILLAGE SHOULD QUOTE. IT MEANS SOMEBODY ON THAT COUNCIL IS THERE PRECISELY BECAUSE PLACES LIKE YOURS EXIST - AND THE FIRST QUESTION IS WHICH MEMBER HOLDS THAT SEAT. THE SMALLER BODY MATTERS MORE FOR DAILY LIFE, AND IT IS BEING REVIVED: PLANS AND BUDGETS ARE TO BE LINKED TO THE NEEDS DIRECTORY, TO NEIGHBOURHOOD COMMITTEES AND TO ORGANISED COMMUNITY PARTICIPATION, AND THE MINISTER IS REPORTED AS PURSUING THE ACTIVATION OF THE NEIGHBOURHOOD COMMITTEES. A NEIGHBOURHOOD COMMITTEE WHOSE INPUT IS FORMALLY TIED TO A BUDGET LINE IS THE SMALLEST BODY IN THIS COUNTRY WITH A CLAIM ON PUBLIC MONEY. IF ONE EXISTS WHERE YOU LIVE, JOIN IT; IF IT DOES NOT, ASK THE MUNICIPALITY WHEN IT WILL BE FORMED, BECAUSE THE MINISTRY HAS SAID IT IS ACTIVATING THEM. JOINT PROJECTS BETWEEN NEIGHBOURING MUNICIPALITIES AND GOVERNORATE COUNCILS ARE ALSO PERMITTED - WHICH IS THE ROUTE FOR SOMETHING TOO BIG FOR ONE TOWN, LIKE A LANDFILL, A WATER LINE OR A SHARED PROTECTED AREA. THE CRITICISM IS ON THE PUBLIC RECORD AND IS WORTH CARRYING INTO ANY MEETING: COMMENTARY ON THE DRAFT WARNED THAT THE EXPANSION OF CENTRAL SUPERVISION COULD EMPTY DECENTRALISATION OF ITS REAL CONTENT, SINCE MODERN LOCAL ADMINISTRATION RESTS ON GIVING LOCAL UNITS RELATIVE INDEPENDENCE TO DECIDE ACCORDING TO LOCAL NEEDS. THE SAME COMMENTARY OBJECTED THAT ESSENTIAL MATTERS WERE LEFT TO LATER REGULATIONS - INCLUDING THE ADMINISTRATIVE STRUCTURE OF MUNICIPALITIES, THE CONDITIONS AND POWERS OF THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR, AND THE ORGANISATION OF THE NEIGHBOURHOOD COMMITTEES AND COMMUNITY PARTICIPATION THEMSELVES. WHEN THE RULES FOR NEIGHBOURHOOD COMMITTEES ARE STILL TO BE WRITTEN, THAT IS THE MOMENT TO WRITE TO THE MINISTRY ABOUT WHAT THEY SHOULD CONTAIN - HOW MEMBERS ARE CHOSEN, HOW OFTEN THEY MEET, AND WHETHER THEIR MINUTES ARE PUBLISHED. THE MINISTER IS REPORTED RECEIVING OPINIONS AND OBSERVATIONS THROUGH THE LEGISLATION AND OPINION BUREAU. ONE POLITICAL CURRENT HAS ALREADY DONE EXACTLY THAT, SUBMITTING PROPOSALS TO THE PARLIAMENTARY ADMINISTRATIVE COMMITTEE - INCLUDING CONVERTING THE JOINT SERVICES COUNCILS INTO PART OF THE GOVERNORATE COUNCILS, AND LIMITING THE UNIVERSITY DEGREE REQUIREMENT TO THE MAYOR ALONE RATHER THAN IMPOSING IT ON COUNCIL MEMBERS, TO PRESERVE CITIZENS' RIGHT TO CHOOSE THEIR REPRESENTATIVES. THAT DEGREE REQUIREMENT IS WORTH NOTICING: A RULE THAT ONLY GRADUATES MAY SIT ON A MUNICIPAL COUNCIL WOULD DISQUALIFY MOST FARMERS, HERDERS AND FISHERMEN IN THIS ENTIRE PAYLOAD FROM REPRESENTING THEIR OWN VILLAGES. THE LIMITS: THIS DESCRIBES BODIES IN TRANSITION - THE LAW PASSED THE LOWER HOUSE IN AUGUST 2026 AND ITS DETAIL SITS IN REGULATIONS NOT YET ISSUED, SO HOW GOVERNORATE COUNCILS ARE COMPOSED IN PRACTICE, WHETHER NEIGHBOURHOOD COMMITTEES EXIST YET IN ANY GIVEN TOWN, HOW MEMBERS JOIN THEM AND WHAT THEY MAY DECIDE WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED. THE COUNCILS ARE PLANNING AND SERVICE PLATFORMS, NOT LAND DEFENDERS, AND THE SAME REFORM STRENGTHENS APPOINTED EXECUTIVE DIRECTORS ALONGSIDE THEM. THE ACCOUNT COMES FROM CABINET AND PARLIAMENTARY REPORTING BY FOUR NEWS OUTLETS AND ONE PARTY'S SUBMISSION BETWEEN MAY AND AUGUST 2026, NOT FROM THE TEXT OF THE LAW OR FROM ANY COUNCIL'S OWN PUBLICATION. Read it with the cooperative corporation's governorate directorates, the conservation society holding eleven reserves, the conservation union's regional office and the bar association's legal aid recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Energy, water and environment business association — its sector who's-who directory and the national skills council it runs
trackers.desc: THIS ENTRY IS RECORDED FOR ONE REASON: IT IS WHERE A COMMUNITY FINDS OUT WHO ACTUALLY DOES WATER, WASTE AND ENERGY WORK IN THIS COUNTRY. THE ASSOCIATION'S MEMBERSHIP RUNS TO ALMOST A HUNDRED PRIVATE SECTOR INSTITUTIONAL BODIES - COMPANIES PRACTISING IN THE SECTOR, TOP BANKS AND GREEN LEASING COMPANIES, INTERNATIONAL FUNDING INSTITUTES, INTERNATIONAL DONORS AND LEGAL ENTITIES. WITHIN THAT IT INCLUDES A LARGE SEGMENT OF RENEWABLE ENERGY AND ENERGY EFFICIENCY COMPANIES WITH ALMOST ALL THE LARGE DEVELOPERS, WATER AND WASTE MANAGEMENT COMPANIES WITH SIGNIFICANT IN-DEPTH EXPERIENCE, AND ALMOST ALL THE LARGE COMPANIES CURRENTLY IMPLEMENTING CORPORATE SOCIAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL RESPONSIBILITY PROJECTS IN THE COUNTRY. ALMOST ALL THE LARGE DEVELOPERS IN ONE MEMBERSHIP LIST CUTS BOTH WAYS, AND A COMMUNITY SHOULD READ IT BOTH WAYS: IT IS A DIRECTORY OF PEOPLE WHO CAN BUILD A WATER SCHEME, AND IT IS ALSO A DIRECTORY OF THE FIRMS THAT TURN UP WITH SOLAR AND WIND PROJECTS LOOKING FOR LAND. THE DIRECTORY IS PUBLISHED, NOT PRIVATE: AN ANNUAL WHO'S WHO OF THE COUNTRY'S ENERGY, WATER AND ENVIRONMENT SECTOR IS DISTRIBUTED THROUGH PROFESSIONAL ASSOCIATIONS INCLUDING THIS ONE AND A GREEN BUILDING COUNCIL, COVERING GREEN CONSTRUCTION TECHNOLOGY, WATER AND WASTEWATER, RENEWABLE ENERGY AND CIRCULAR ECONOMY, AND LISTING INDIVIDUAL COMPANIES BY NAME. A NAMED LIST OF THE FIRMS IN A SECTOR IS THE DOCUMENT THIS FILE HAS SPENT HUNDREDS OF ROUNDS RECOMMENDING PEOPLE LOOK FOR - IT ANSWERS WHO IS BEHIND A PROJECT, WHO COULD BUILD AN ALTERNATIVE, AND WHOSE NAME APPEARS ON BOTH SIDES. ITS SECOND USE IS TRAINING: IT IS THE EXECUTIVE ARM OF THE NATIONAL SECTOR SKILLS COUNCIL FOR WATER AND ENERGY, WORKS WITH AN ACCREDITATION AND QUALITY ASSURANCE COMMISSION, AND IN DECEMBER 2025 CONVENED THE WATER AND ENERGY SECTOR COUNCIL TO REVIEW A CAPACITY BUILDING PROJECT UNDER THAT INITIATIVE. A SKILLS COUNCIL WITH ACCREDITATION BEHIND IT DECIDES WHAT COUNTS AS A QUALIFIED WATER OR ENERGY TECHNICIAN. FOR A VILLAGE WANTING ITS OWN PEOPLE TRAINED TO MAINTAIN A PUMP, A SOLAR ARRAY OR A TREATMENT UNIT, THAT IS THE BODY THAT SETS THE STANDARD AND KNOWS WHERE THE COURSES ARE. ITS WORK IS PRACTICAL AND SMALL-SCALE AS WELL AS STRATEGIC: IN JANUARY 2026, WITH A TREATMENT AND RECYCLING COMPANY, IT LAUNCHED A WORKSHOP ON SORTING WASTE AT SOURCE IN THE WORKPLACE AT ITS OWN OFFICES, WITH PARTICIPATION FROM SEVERAL MEMBERS, PARTICULARLY FROM BANKING. ITS FOUR STATED PILLARS ARE ADVOCACY AND RESEARCH, BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT, EDUCATION AND CAPACITY DEVELOPMENT, AND COMMUNICATION AND NETWORKING - AND IT DESCRIBES ITS NICHE AS A PLATFORM INCLUSIVE ENOUGH TO INVOLVE MANY PUBLIC, PRIVATE, NON-GOVERNMENTAL, RESEARCH AND INNOVATION REPRESENTATIVES WHO TOGETHER DISCUSS AND SHAPE THE FUTURE DEVELOPMENT OF THOSE SECTORS. NON-GOVERNMENTAL REPRESENTATIVES ARE NAMED IN THAT DESCRIPTION. A COMMUNITY ORGANISATION WITH A WATER OR WASTE PROBLEM CAN THEREFORE ASK TO BE IN THE ROOM WHERE THE SECTOR'S DIRECTION IS DISCUSSED, RATHER THAN HEARING ABOUT IT AFTERWARDS. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE FUNDAMENTAL: THIS IS AN INDUSTRY BODY, NOT AN ADVOCATE FOR COMMUNITIES - ITS MEMBERS INCLUDE THE DEVELOPERS AND FINANCIERS WHOSE PROJECTS THIS FILE EXISTS TO SCRUTINISE, AND IT WILL NOT OPPOSE A SCHEME, TAKE A CASE OR SPEAK AGAINST A MEMBER. ITS VALUE HERE IS AS A DIRECTORY, A SKILLS ROUTE AND A ROOM, NOTHING MORE. MEMBERSHIP IS INSTITUTIONAL AND WHETHER A SMALL VILLAGE ASSOCIATION COULD JOIN, WHAT IT WOULD COST, AND WHETHER THE WHO'S WHO IS FREELY AVAILABLE OR SOLD WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED. THE ACCOUNT COMES FROM THE ASSOCIATION'S OWN NEWS PAGE OF JANUARY 2026, A UNIVERSITY PAGE, A JOBS PLATFORM PROFILE, TWO SECTOR DIRECTORIES AND A REGIONAL ENERGY PORTAL - SEVERAL UNDATED. Read it with the cooperative corporation's governorate directorates, the conservation society holding eleven reserves, the conservation union's regional office and the neighbourhood committees recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Societies register and its support fund — signatures authenticated at the nearest directorate, and a fund that may own property
trackers.desc: EVERY FUND, GRANT AND MEMBERSHIP RECORDED IN THIS PAYLOAD ASKS FOR A REGISTERED ORGANISATION. THIS IS THE COUNTER WHERE ONE IS MADE IN THIS COUNTRY - AND THE MOST USEFUL FACT IS THAT IT IS NOT ONLY IN THE CAPITAL: THE FOUNDERS' SIGNATURES ON THE REGISTRATION APPLICATION ARE AUTHENTICATED BY THEIR PERSONAL ATTENDANCE BEFORE THE OFFICER OF THE REGISTRATION AND PUBLICATION UNIT AT THE SOCIETIES REGISTER DEPARTMENT, OR BEFORE THE RESPONSIBLE OFFICER AT THE SOCIAL DEVELOPMENT DIRECTORATE NEAREST TO THEM, OR BEFORE A NOTARY PUBLIC, OR BY A LOCAL BANK'S AUTHENTICATION OF THE SIGNATURES. FOUR PLACES TO SIGN, THREE OF THEM LOCAL, ONE OF THEM A BANK BRANCH. FOR A VILLAGE WHOSE FOUNDERS CANNOT ALL TRAVEL TO THE CAPITAL ON THE SAME DAY, THAT SINGLE PROVISION IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN AN ORGANISATION EXISTING AND NOT. THE PAPERS ARE FEW BUT DATED: THE APPLICATION MUST CARRY ORIGINAL RECENTLY DATED CERTIFICATES OF NON-CONVICTION AND A COPY OF EACH FOUNDER'S IDENTITY DOCUMENT, AND CERTIFICATES ISSUED MORE THAN SIX MONTHS BEFORE SUBMISSION ARE NOT ACCEPTED; NON-CITIZENS ATTACH A COPY OF THEIR PASSPORT AND RESIDENCE PERMIT. THE SIX-MONTH RULE IS THE TRAP. FOUNDERS WHO COLLECT THEIR CERTIFICATES EARLY AND THEN SPEND A YEAR ARGUING ABOUT THE STATUTE WILL HAVE TO COLLECT THEM AGAIN - SO GATHER THEM LAST, NOT FIRST. THAT NON-CITIZENS ARE PROVIDED FOR AT ALL IS WORTH NOTICING IN A REGION WHERE THIS FILE HAS REPEATEDLY RECORDED THEM EXCLUDED FROM MEMBERSHIP AND FROM VOTING. WHO DECIDES ON REGISTRATION IS ALSO PUBLISHED: THE REGISTER IS ADMINISTERED AND SUPERVISED BY A BOARD CHAIRED BY THE MINISTER, WHOSE MEMBERS INCLUDE REPRESENTATIVES OF SEVERAL MINISTRIES NAMED FROM AMONG FIRST-CATEGORY EMPLOYEES OF NOT LESS THAN THE SECOND GRADE, AND FOUR PEOPLE WITH EXPERIENCE IN THE CHARITABLE OR VOLUNTARY WORK SECTOR APPOINTED BY THE CABINET ON THE MINISTER'S NOMINATION FOR TWO RENEWABLE YEARS. FOUR SEATS ON THE BOARD THAT REGISTERS EVERY ASSOCIATION IN THE COUNTRY BELONG TO PEOPLE FROM THE VOLUNTARY SECTOR ITSELF. KNOWING WHO CURRENTLY HOLDS THEM IS WORTH MORE TO A GROUP FACING REFUSAL THAN ANY APPEAL LETTER. THERE IS ALSO MONEY ATTACHED, AND ITS POWERS ARE UNUSUAL: A SOCIETIES SUPPORT FUND IS ESTABLISHED IN THE MINISTRY WITH THE AIM OF SUPPORTING SOCIETIES, ENJOYING LEGAL PERSONALITY AND FINANCIAL AND ADMINISTRATIVE INDEPENDENCE, AND MAY OWN MOVABLE AND IMMOVABLE PROPERTY. A SUPPORT FUND THAT MAY OWN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY IS A BODY THAT COULD IN PRINCIPLE HOLD LAND OR PREMISES FOR THE SECTOR IT SERVES. WHAT IT ACTUALLY FUNDS, ON WHAT TERMS AND WHETHER A NEW VILLAGE ASSOCIATION CAN APPLY ARE THE QUESTIONS TO PUT TO IT FIRST. ONE PROCEDURAL RULE IS WORTH KNOWING BEFORE IT BITES: IF NOTIFICATION OF A SOCIETY PROVES IMPOSSIBLE BY ORDINARY MEANS, NOTIFICATION MAY BE MADE BY PUBLICATION ONCE IN TWO LOCAL DAILY NEWSPAPERS AT THE SOCIETY'S EXPENSE, AND THAT PUBLICATION COUNTS AS LEGAL NOTIFICATION. AN ASSOCIATION CAN THEREFORE BE LAWFULLY NOTIFIED OF SOMETHING SERIOUS THROUGH A NEWSPAPER IT NEVER READS, AND BILLED FOR IT. THE ANSWER IS THE COMPANION RULE: NO CHANGE IN A SOCIETY'S CORRESPONDENCE ADDRESS COUNTS UNTIL THE REGISTRAR AND THE COMPETENT MINISTRY ARE NOTIFIED IN WRITING - SO KEEP THE ADDRESS CURRENT AND KEEP THE PROOF THAT YOU FILED IT. THE LIMITS: THIS IS THE STATE'S REGISTRATION AND SUPERVISION MACHINERY, NOT AN ALLY - THE SAME BOARD THAT REGISTERS A SOCIETY CAN REFUSE OR DISSOLVE ONE, THE MINISTER CHAIRS IT, AND THIS COUNTRY'S ASSOCIATIONS LAW HAS BEEN REPEATEDLY CRITICISED BY CIVIL SOCIETY FOR THE BREADTH OF THAT CONTROL. WHAT REGISTRATION COSTS, HOW MANY FOUNDERS ARE REQUIRED, HOW LONG A DECISION TAKES, WHETHER REFUSAL CAN BE APPEALED AND WHETHER AN ENVIRONMENTAL OR LAND PURPOSE IS ACCEPTED WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED - THE FIRST FOUR SHOULD BE ASKED AT THE NEAREST DIRECTORATE BEFORE ANYTHING IS SIGNED. THE PROCEDURE COMES FROM A MINISTRY PAGE AND THE BOARD, FUND AND NOTIFICATION PROVISIONS FROM A COMMERCIAL LAW FIRM'S CONSOLIDATED TEXT OF THE ASSOCIATIONS LAW AS AMENDED TO 2025, NOT FROM THE OFFICIAL GAZETTE. Read it with the cooperative corporation's governorate directorates and its founding meeting, the neighbourhood committees and governorate councils, the conservation union's regional office and the energy and water business association recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Cities and villages development bank — long-term loans, co-investment with municipalities, loan guarantees, and municipal training including environmental
trackers.desc: THE FUNCTION IN THIS BANK'S DESCRIPTION THAT A COMMUNITY SHOULD SEIZE ON IS NOT LENDING BUT PARTNERSHIP: FROM THE BEGINNING OF 2010 IT BEGAN FINANCING PARTICIPATORY INVESTMENT PROJECTS GENERATING INCOME IN PARTNERSHIP WITH THE MUNICIPALITIES - SEVEN PROJECTS STUDIED WITH A TOTAL VALUE OF FIVE MILLION DINARS, AND FOUR APPROVED IN NAMED MUNICIPALITIES, TWO OF THEM IN ONE TOWN, WORTH ABOUT ONE AND A HALF MILLION. A MUNICIPALITY THAT OWNS A SHARE OF AN INCOME-GENERATING PROJECT HAS ITS OWN MONEY, AND THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED, IN THIS SAME COUNTRY, A COUNCIL BUDGET WHERE SALARIES DWARFED EVERYTHING SPENT ON ACTUAL WORKS. OWN INCOME IS WHAT BREAKS THAT. FOUR PROJECTS APPROVED OUT OF SEVEN STUDIED IS ALSO AN HONEST RATIO. A COUNCIL PROPOSING ONE SHOULD EXPECT SCRUTINY, AND SHOULD ARRIVE WITH THE FEASIBILITY WORK DONE - WHICH IS EXACTLY WHAT THE BANK SAYS IT HELPS WITH. ITS FULL LIST OF FUNCTIONS IS WORTH READING SLOWLY: IT PROVIDES THE LONG-TERM FINANCING NECESSARY FOR THE SERVICE AND PRODUCTIVE PROJECTS EXECUTED BY LOCAL AUTHORITIES, HAVING FINANCED SUCH PROJECTS IN ALL THE KINGDOM'S CITIES AND VILLAGES; IT ADMINISTERS AND GUARANTEES THE LOANS THOSE AUTHORITIES CONCLUDE WITH ANY OTHER PARTY AIMED AT PROVIDING BASIC SERVICES; IT ASSISTS THEM IN DETERMINING THE PRIORITIES OF THEIR PRODUCTIVE PROJECTS IN THE LIGHT OF ECONOMIC FEASIBILITY; AND IT MANAGES THE FUNDS OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES THAT ARE COLLECTED BY THE GOVERNMENT. THAT LAST FUNCTION IS THE ONE NOBODY NOTICES AND THE ONE THAT MATTERS MOST: THE BANK HOLDS MUNICIPALITIES' OWN MONEY, COLLECTED ON THEIR BEHALF BY THE GOVERNMENT. A RESIDENT ASKING WHAT THEIR COUNCIL RECEIVED, WHEN, AND WHAT WAS DEDUCTED FOR LOAN REPAYMENTS IS ASKING A QUESTION THIS INSTITUTION CAN ANSWER. GUARANTEEING LOANS THE COUNCIL TAKES FROM OTHERS IS THE OTHER QUIET POWER - IT MEANS THE BANK KNOWS THE FULL DEBT POSITION OF EVERY LOCAL AUTHORITY, WHICH IS THE FIRST THING TO ESTABLISH BEFORE A COUNCIL CLAIMS IT CANNOT AFFORD A WATER LINE OR A PARK. TRAINING IS NOT OPTIONAL FOR IT BUT WRITTEN INTO ITS LAW: ARTICLE FIVE PROVIDES THAT THE BANK SHALL GIVE THE NECESSARY ASSISTANCE TO THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES TO PROVIDE EXPERTISE AND TECHNICAL SKILLS, INCLUDING TRAINING THE TECHNICIANS THOSE AUTHORITIES NEED. AND THE COURSES INCLUDE THE RIGHT SUBJECT: IT RUNS A NORTHERN TRAINING CENTRE IN ONE CITY IN COOPERATION WITH THAT CITY'S MUNICIPALITY, WITH PROGRAMMES SUITED TO THE FIELDS OF MUNICIPAL WORK - ADMINISTRATIVE, ENVIRONMENTAL, COMPUTING, TECHNICAL, FINANCIAL, DEVELOPMENTAL AND ENGINEERING. A STATUTORY DUTY TO TRAIN MUNICIPAL TECHNICIANS, WITH ENVIRONMENTAL COURSES ALREADY ON THE LIST, IS THE ROUTE TO GETTING A COUNCIL'S OWN STAFF TAUGHT WHAT A COMMUNITY WANTS THEM TO KNOW - AND IT IS FREE OF CHARGE TO THE COMMUNITY BECAUSE IT IS THE BANK'S OBLIGATION, NOT A FAVOUR. ITS CURRENT DIRECTION IS PUBLISHED: ITS 2026 NEWS RECORDS THE BANK DISCUSSING WITH A BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT CENTRE OPPORTUNITIES FOR COOPERATION IN GREEN FINANCE AND LOCAL DEVELOPMENT, DISCUSSING COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COOPERATION WITH A CULTURAL CENTRE, AND DISCUSSING INVESTMENT COOPERATION WITH TWO NAMED MUNICIPALITIES. GREEN FINANCE APPEARING IN A MUNICIPAL BANK'S 2026 MEETINGS IS THE MOMENT TO PUT A SOLAR, WATER-SAVING OR WASTE PROJECT IN FRONT OF A COUNCIL - AND THERE IS PRECEDENT: AN AGREEMENT WITH A EUROPEAN INVESTMENT BANK WAS SIGNED TO REDUCE THE FINANCIAL BURDENS ON MUNICIPALITIES BY CUTTING THE ELECTRICITY BILL IN THE MUNICIPAL SECTOR, FINANCED AT LOW INTEREST RATES. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A LENDER TO COUNCILS, NOT A GRANT-MAKER OR A COMMUNITY BODY - ITS MONEY ARRIVES AS DEBT THAT MUNICIPALITIES REPAY, AND A HEAVILY INDEBTED COUNCIL IS LESS ABLE, NOT MORE, TO FUND WHAT RESIDENTS WANT; THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS SEPARATELY THAT REDUCING COUNCIL INDEBTEDNESS IS A STATED MINISTRY TARGET IN THE NEIGHBOURING TERRITORY. A RESIDENTS' GROUP CANNOT BORROW FROM IT AND REACHES IT ONLY THROUGH ITS OWN COUNCIL. THE PARTNERSHIP PROJECT FIGURES DESCRIBE PROJECTS APPROVED FROM 2010 AND MAY LONG PREDATE THE PRESENT, THE TRAINING CENTRE DESCRIPTION AND THE ARTICLE FIVE DUTY COME FROM A GOVERNMENT PORTAL PAGE WITH NO VISIBLE DATE, AND THE CAPITAL AND RESERVE FIGURES COME FROM A COMMERCIAL DIRECTORY - WHAT THE BANK LENDS TODAY, ON WHAT TERMS, AND WHETHER THE TRAINING CENTRE STILL OPERATES WERE NOT ESTABLISHED. Read it with the neighbourhood committees and governorate councils, the cooperative corporation's governorate directorates, the societies register and support fund and the energy and water business association recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Lebanon — Commercial Register (Ministry of Justice)
trackers.desc: National company registry; the Ministry of Justice Commercial Register offers a free public search by name or record number, returning address, activities, officers, registration date & legal form, Lebanon. — Holds to account: state firms & government-linked companies — find their registration, directors and filings.

trackers.name: Court of Audit
trackers.desc: Supreme audit institution of Lebanon, auditing government accounts and the use of public money. HOW THIS DIFFERS: an audit body reports AFTER money is spent — use it to find documented waste, irregularity and misspending already uncovered, not live tenders; for who is winning contracts now use the procurement portal, and for aggregate budget totals the statistical office.

trackers.name: The Gherbal Initiative (مبادرة غربال)
trackers.desc: Lebanese transparency initiative (since 2018) monitoring enforcement of the 2017 Right to Access Information Law. Files freedom-of-information requests to public administrations, runs a citizen/journalist request hotline, and publishes the state budget and administrations' financial data in interactive, user-friendly formats.

trackers.name: The Legal Agenda
trackers.desc: Beirut-based nonprofit research, media and advocacy organisation (founded 2009) whose Civil Observatory for an Independent and Transparent Judiciary monitors court cases, trials and judicial policy, paired with strategic litigation and investigative reporting on the courts. CHECK WHOSE PROJECT THE ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT STUDY WAS ACTUALLY WRITTEN FOR. That is the step that carried the Ramlet al-Baida case and it costs nothing to repeat anywhere: when a contractor obtained a Beirut municipality permit to build over 20,000 square metres two metres from public coastal land on the capital's last remaining public beach, among the grounds advanced for revoking the permit was that the environmental impact study relied on dated from 2013 and had been prepared for a different project by a different contractor. Before arguing anything else, establish whether the assessment supporting your opponent's permit was written for their scheme at all. THIS ORGANISATION LITIGATES AND REPRESENTS, NOT ONLY MONITORS: it carries a Litigation section on its own site setting out its cases, it acted with the Green Line Association on Ramlet al-Baida, and it joined Green Line, Nahnoo and the National Campaign for the Protection of the Dalieh of Raouche in bringing a review. In the El Mina fake-property case in Tripoli it represented the activists directly, using the Access to Information Law, where the authority's failure to answer the request constituted an implicit rejection that could itself be challenged — silence is an appealable decision, not a dead end. THE TRAP, AND IT IS BRUTAL: WINNING A SUSPENSION IS NOT WINNING. The State Council suspended the Ramlet al-Baida permit and then in April 2017 went back on its own decision without any explanation and without ruling on the merits, allowing the company to finish building; the request to rescind that reversal remained pending. Plan for the possibility that an interim victory is undone without reasons. WHERE THIS FIGHT IS ALREADY RUNNING, because allied campaigns are the cheapest evidence you will find: Anfeh's salt pools against a mall, the Armenian graves at Byblos against a private ocean resort, Tabarja against a tourism project and marina, Bourj Hammoud, the Dalieh of Raouche against a mall, chalets and a yacht marina, Sidon against reclamation over two historic sites, Adloun's historic beach against a yacht project, and Kfar Abida. Legal Agenda's own assessment is that Lebanon's environmental laws and decrees are seldom used by the administration or in litigation against investment projects — the tools exist and are lying unused. CONTACT: Beni Kanaan Street, Joseph Mouawad Building, first floor, Badaro, Beirut; +961 1 383 606; info@legal-agenda.com. Pair with SPNL, already in this file, where the answer is a Hima rather than a courtroom.

trackers.name: Lebanon — Court of Audit (Diwan al-Muhasaba)
trackers.desc: Supreme audit institution; judicial body exercising external control over public funds and protecting the state’s & citizens’ financial rights, Lebanon.

trackers.name: Lebanon — Ministry of Finance
trackers.desc: National budget authority; the Budget Directorate (DGF) prepares the State budget and publishes fiscal & public-debt data, Lebanon. Here you can trace how the public budget is allocated and spent in Lebanon.

trackers.name: Hima — a village with no municipal council still has a route
trackers.desc: THE MOST ACCESSIBLE DESIGNATION ROUTE IN THIS ENTIRE MAP. Under Protected Areas Framework Law 130/2019, a Hima — one of four categories alongside nature reserves, natural sites and natural parks — is established by decision of the municipal council, or joint councils where it spans several municipalities. AND IN VILLAGES WITH NO MUNICIPAL COUNCIL AT ALL, the Hima is designated by the district commissioner (Qa'im Maqam) on a proposal from the village chief (Mukhtar). Almost every route recorded here assumes a functioning local authority; Lebanon provides an explicit fallback for villages that have none. A Hima designation requires only the consent of the local municipality. The council — or commissioner — then develops a management plan; across municipalities, a committee formed by the commissioner or governor does. THE TEMPLATE TO COPY: Hima Aaiha, Lebanon's 40th, formalised by Municipal Decision No. 4/2025, adopted unanimously in a legally convened session on 9 August 2025, over public state land, cadastral parcel No. 2327, based on environmental and scientific studies. A numbered decision, a unanimous vote, a named parcel, a scientific basis. AND IT IS NOT EXCLUSIONARY: Hima exist for sustainable hunting, fishing, grazing and water use — 25 covering 6 percent of Lebanese territory.

trackers.name: The framework law's decrees were never issued — which is why Hima works
trackers.desc: KNOW THE GAP BEFORE YOU RELY ON THE LAW. Law 130/2019 foresees a minimum of five application decrees and two ministerial decisions — none of which have been adopted to date, and the law details management only for nature reserves. The framework is enacted but its implementing instruments are not. That is precisely why the Hima route matters in practice: it runs on a municipal decision, not on a decree that has never been issued. IF YOUR SITE IS PRIVATE LAND: a nature reserve on private property is established after the written consent of all owners, by contract between the state (the Minister of Environment) and the owners, for not less than 20 years, renewable, defining the scope, the surrounding belt zone and management — reserves on public land are established by a law instead. Note that natural sites are still governed by the law of 8 July 1939 on protection of landscapes, reading ‘Ministry of National Economy’ as Ministry of Environment. TARGETS TO QUOTE: by 2030, at least 20 percent of natural terrestrial and marine ecosystems protected with all ecosystem types represented, and nature reserve coverage raised to at least 5 percent of Lebanon's area. A Hima proposal also wants a local Hima committee of community members, environmental activists and municipal representatives.

trackers.name: Lebanon Reforestation Initiative — registered, and it does quarry restoration
trackers.desc: A DELIVERY PARTNER WITH A REGISTRATION NUMBER YOU CAN QUOTE. LRI is a not-for-profit NGO registered at the Lebanese Ministry of Interior under no. 1186 of 16 June 2014 — useful when a counterparty asks whether a partner is properly constituted. It began in 2010 as a project funded by USAID and managed by the US Forest Service International Programs, and has since supported planting of more than 850,000 native tree seedlings nationwide, improved the native seedling production sector, and contributed to best practice in reforestation, fire prevention, forest management, quarry restoration and climate resilience. QUARRY RESTORATION IS A NAMED CAPABILITY — which matters, since quarrying is among the most common land-damage complaints in Lebanon and few bodies have restoration experience for it. It works across all of Lebanon in five programme areas: landscape management, climate resilience, outreach and capacity development, advocacy, and R&D. BE CLEAR WHAT IT IS: this is a technical and delivery partner, not a grant window — approach it for partnership on restoration work and for its advocacy capacity, not to apply for money. For a community-scale grant in Lebanon, see the GEF Small Grants Programme; for the designation route, see the Hima entry recorded separately in this map.

trackers.name: ICCA Registry and Protected Planet — and registration is not a precondition
trackers.desc: CHECK WHETHER YOUR SITE IS ALREADY IN A REGISTRY BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE — it may carry a designation nobody locally mentioned. The World Database on Protected and Conserved Areas at protectedplanet.net is a joint UNEP and IUCN product managed by UNEP-WCMC, drawing on almost 500 data providers in 245 countries, updated monthly and downloadable; it underpins the UN List of Protected Areas. THE OECM ROUTE IS THE ONE MOST COMMUNITIES MISS: a site qualifies as an other effective area-based conservation measure if it delivers sustained, positive conservation outcomes EVEN THOUGH IT MAY BE MANAGED PRIMARILY FOR OTHER REASONS — so a grazing commons, a sacred site or a watershed managed for water supply can qualify without being managed primarily for conservation. Land that is worked rather than preserved is not excluded. But note the exclusivity: a site can be a protected area or an OECM — it is not possible to meet both, so ask which is being proposed. THE ICCA REGISTRY IS THE ONE COMMUNITIES FILL IN THEMSELVES: at iccaregistry.org, communities themselves provide data, case studies, maps, photos and stories, and its operators state it is meant to be used to enhance advocacy and recognition — not merely as an inventory. Documenting a territory there creates a citable, third-party-hosted record. THE SENTENCE THAT MATTERS MOST: UNEP-WCMC states these territories must be recognised and respected ‘whether or not they have been reported to the ICCA Registry’ — registration is NOT a precondition of rights, and anyone arguing a claim is weaker for being unregistered is arguing against the registry operator's own position. AND USE THE SCALE FIGURE CAREFULLY: over 1,500 sites are reported under indigenous and community governance — just 1 percent of all recorded sites, with UNEP-WCMC adding that no one knows how many ICCAs exist globally. That 1 percent measures how little has been recorded, not how little communities conserve. Filter Protected Planet by governance type to find such sites; UNEP-WCMC's manual Global Databases to Support ICCAs gives guidance on contributing data.

trackers.name: SPNL — a Hima needs only your municipality's consent, not the national government
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE SHORTEST ROUTE TO PROTECTED STATUS ANYWHERE IN THIS REGION: SPNL STATES THAT, UNLIKE OTHER PROTECTED AREAS WHICH ARE GOVERNMENT-MANAGED, A HIMA DESIGNATION REQUIRES ONLY THE CONSENT OF THE LOCAL MUNICIPALITY. Your own council can place part of the municipal land under protection by its own decree, in partnership with SPNL, without waiting on a ministry. It has been done repeatedly and the decrees are dated and attributed: Kayfoun on 29 November 2017 under a council led by Ali Dagher, the first Hima in Mount Lebanon; Aitanit on 22 December 2017 under Assaad Najem; Hammana on 14 November 2018 under Bachir Farhat. In 2025 Al-Abadiyah, Kornayel and Btekhnay joined the network. AND IT IS NOT A SYMBOLIC LABEL: 27 Himas are now recorded in the World Database on Protected Areas, and Hima sites appear on the map of Lebanon's protected areas produced jointly by UNDP, the Ministry of Environment, the Ministry of Agriculture and SPNL — so a municipal decree converts into an internationally registered designation you can cite against a developer. A Hima can also be declared for a specific use rather than blanket prohibition: SPNL has declared Himas for sustainable hunting, fishing, grazing and water use, which is what makes councils willing to sign. Director General Assad Serhal; SPNL is the BirdLife International partner in Lebanon and has worked on this since 2004, mostly across Important Bird and Biodiversity Areas. Framework referenced by SPNL: Protected Areas Law 130/2019. TWO HONEST CAVEATS. SPNL itself describes operating under extremely challenging political, security and economic conditions, and has reported continuing its bird monitoring amid escalation in Lebanon — capacity is real but strained. And this entry does not establish what happens to a Hima if a later municipal council wishes to undo the decree; ask SPNL that question directly before treating the designation as permanent. THE COMMITTEE THAT RUNS A LEBANESE RESERVE IS MADE OF MUNICIPALITIES, WHICH MEANS YOUR MAYOR ALREADY SITS ON IT. At the Tannourine cedar reserve, created by law in February 1999 and operating from 2000, the managing committee was formed of the municipalities of Tannourine, Hadath el Jebbeh, Qanat and Kfour el Arbeh under the supervision of the Ministry of Environment, and the person heading that committee has also been the president of Tannourine municipality. There is no separate body to find and no national office to petition: the councils are the management. THAT MATTERS BEYOND HIMA, BECAUSE IT MEANS THE MUNICIPAL ROUTE RUNS THROUGH BOTH FORMS OF PROTECTION IN LEBANON — a council can declare a Hima on its own consent, and councils collectively run the state reserves. WHAT THE RESERVE LAW ACTUALLY PROHIBITS IS WORTH KNOWING BEFORE YOU ARGUE ABOUT ANYTHING ELSE: inside the forest it bars any activity harmful to the environment, and names hunting, GRAZING, lighting fires, camping, and the cutting of trees or plants, except for scientific purposes. That is a specific list rather than a general duty, and grazing being on it is the point most likely to divide a village. The threats the reserve's own people name are sand extraction, quarries and tree cutting. AND THE OPERATING PRINCIPLE ITS MANAGER STATES IS THE ONE THIS FILE HAS NOW RECORDED IN FIVE COUNTRIES: as long as the local community benefits, it will embrace the reserve — hence the work of drawing the surrounding belt of farmers and residents into tourism, agricultural and social activity, and some 48 kilometres of walking trails linking the parts of the reserve, including routes kept open for snow in winter.

trackers.name: BirdLife Hima Fund — grants for Important Bird Areas, applied for through SPNL
trackers.desc: LEBANON IS THE ONE COUNTRY WHERE THIS FUND AND A WORKING LOCAL MECHANISM LINE UP EXACTLY. BirdLife records that the Hima Fund launched in 2011 with four approved grants to Partners in Jordan, Lebanon, Qatar and Oman, and separately notes that in Lebanon the Himas are emerging as a support system for the network of protected areas. Read that alongside the SPNL entry already in this file: a Lebanese municipality can declare a Hima on its own consent, and the Hima Fund is money attached to precisely that designation. The fund was established in Qatar in 2008 on a one million dollar donation from Sheikha Jawaher Bint Hamad Bin Suhaim Al-Thani, to conserve Important Bird Areas and threatened species across the Middle East. THE APPLICATION ROUTE IS THROUGH THE PARTNER, NOT DIRECT: grants go to BirdLife Partners, and in Lebanon that is SPNL, which led the Hima revival from 2004 across sites including Ebel es-Saqi, Kfar Zabad, Aanjar, Qoleileh, Mansouri, Hermel and Aandqet. Approach SPNL and ask it to carry the application. THE HONEST CAVEAT: no evidence of grant-making after the early 2010s was found during verification — the endowment, the establishment and the first four grants are documented, an open application window today is not. SPNL is the body that would know, and it also operates under the severe political, security and economic constraints noted in its own entry. ANTI-FANOUT NOTE: press reporting lists twelve countries the fund was geared toward; BirdLife names four that received grants, and this entry exists in those four only.

trackers.name: NAHNOO — has stopped two projects outright, and publishes the case where hard evidence was not enough
trackers.desc: READ THE WIN AND THE LOSS TOGETHER, BECAUSE THE CONTRAST IS THE LESSON. On its own campaigns page NAHNOO records that it joined the Civil Campaign to Protect the Dalieh of Raouche, which emerged in March 2013 to press for Dalieh's preservation as a publicly accessible shared space and its classification as a natural reserve — the campaign first got the fence blocking the entrance removed, and then, through grassroots initiatives, public discussions and debates, managed to stop the construction project. In Tarik El-Jdide it led a campaign with residents against a municipal decision on a local playground and stopped that project too. Against those, it records plainly that Ramlet al-Baida fell to illegal privatisation and the Eden Bay Resort was built directly on the shore even though NAHNOO had provided hard evidence of violations by the developer and of corruption in the Governor's office of the time. The inversion a campaign should take from its own account: the two sites that were saved were saved by sustained public mobilisation, and the site that was lost was lost despite the documentary case being made. Build the evidence, but do not assume it decides anything by itself. WHAT IT HOLDS THAT YOU CAN USE: a published map of violations along the Beirut coast, and studies including its Horsh Beirut work — the campaign that reopened the capital's largest park to the public after decades in which access was effectively rationed. WHAT IT IS: a youth-led organisation describing itself as a research, capacity-building and advocacy platform for participatory public policy-making, working on good governance, public spaces and cultural heritage, and rallying volunteers across Lebanon. THE COALITION IS THE PART TO ASK ABOUT FOR ANY COASTAL SITE: NAHNOO is part of The Coast for All, which campaigns to preserve and restore Lebanon's public coast and has petitioned to amend Law 64/2017 so that the right to occupy marine public property is restricted to the Lebanese state and encroachments are limited. Its coastal work names Adloun, one of the few remaining sea turtle nesting grounds on the Lebanese coast and the site of an ancient Phoenician port town. Route by the kind of fight: NAHNOO for mobilisation and public-space claims, The Legal Agenda for litigation, SPNL where the answer is a Hima declared by your own municipality — all three are in this file. NAME THE BENEFICIARIES, NOT ONLY THE VIOLATORS. An earlier Beirut association that fought the same public-space battles is recorded as challenging a seafront development alongside residents by DENOUNCING THE ABUSIVE PRACTICES AND NAMING AND SHAMING BOTH THE VIOLATORS AND THE BENEFICIARIES. Most campaigns identify who broke the rule. Identifying who profits from it is a different exercise and a harder one to answer, and this file has recorded the same instinct in Kazakhstan, where campaigners calculated what a failed project had cost the public purse, and in Georgia, where the question was who was related to whom. AND THE PRECEDENT ON THE BEIRUT SEAFRONT IS WORTH CARRYING BECAUSE IT SHOWS WHAT THE COMBINATION ACHIEVES: that association's campaign against the privatisation of public beaches, together with the protests of Beirut residents, is credited with forcing the halt of a development being built by the prime minister of the day at Ramlet el-Bayda — and with the site remaining accessible as a public beach. Advocacy supplied the argument and residents supplied the pressure; neither is recorded as having succeeded alone. The same association petitioned over the city's remaining green spaces including the pine forest this entry concerns. IT APPEARS TO BE LARGELY INACTIVE NOW and is not recorded separately in this file, which is itself a warning: the organisations that won a city's landmark environmental battles may not be there when the next one starts, and the record of how they won is more durable than they are.THERE IS NOW AN OUTCOME WORTH ADDING, AND IT IS THE RAREST KIND IN THIS ENTIRE MAP. IN SEPTEMBER 2025 THE FIRST PHASE OF REHABILITATION OF THE CAPITAL'S LARGEST GREEN SPACE WAS OPENED — UNDER A EUROPEAN-FUNDED PROGRAMME IMPLEMENTED BY AN INTERNATIONAL LABOUR AGENCY TOGETHER WITH THE SOCIAL AFFAIRS MINISTRY AND THE MUNICIPALITY, AND CARRIED OUT IN CLOSE COORDINATION AND PARTNERSHIP WITH THIS ORGANISATION AND ONE OTHER LOCAL BODY. THE ORGANISATION THAT CAMPAIGNED FOR THE PARK TO BE OPENED TO EVERYONE ENDED UP AS A NAMED PARTNER IN THE WORKS. This payload records many campaigns and very few that finish with the campaigners inside the delivery — which is the position from which a group can shape what is actually built rather than only object to it. THE OFFICIAL FRAMING IS USEFUL TO QUOTE ELSEWHERE: the minister said the project's importance lies not in rehabilitating a park but in the message that THE CITY DESERVES TO RECOVER ITS PUBLIC SPACES and that everyone has the right to meet in a safe, inclusive space — with accessibility standards for disabled people, older people and children treated as a matter of justice and equality. AND THE GOVERNOR NAMED THE THREATS THE PARK HAD FACED: PRESSURE ON ITS INFRASTRUCTURE, ATTEMPTED ENCROACHMENTS, FIRES, AND SCARCITY OF FUNDS. The works answered them concretely — improved facilities, a cycle path, STRENGTHENED LIGHTING AND GUARDING, and increased planted area — with the stated aim of making the site a model of INCLUSIVE, SUSTAINABLE AND PARTICIPATORY rehabilitation of public space that also provides decent work. LIGHTING AND GUARDING ARE THE UNGLAMOROUS ASKS THAT ACTUALLY STOP ENCROACHMENT, AND THEY ARE THE ONES A COMMUNITY CAN PUT IN A FUNDING PROPOSAL.

trackers.name: Public Works Studio — the people who pull the cadastral records and put lawyers next to planners
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE BODY THAT WILL ESTABLISH WHO ACTUALLY OWNS THE LAND UNDER A LEBANESE PROJECT, WHICH IS USUALLY THE QUESTION EVERY CAMPAIGN STALLS ON. Public Works Studio describes itself as a multidisciplinary research and advocacy organisation of engineers, designers, researchers and lawyers engaged critically and creatively in questions of urbanism and spatial justice in Lebanon, with particular focus on environmental and housing rights, the right to integrated development and to accessible public space. That combination — planners and lawyers working from land records rather than from press coverage — is rare anywhere and close to unique in this region. WHAT ITS WORK LOOKS LIKE IN PRACTICE: its study of religious waqf land in Lebanon works from cadastral registry data against historical figures, reporting that Dar al-Fatwa and Sunni community waqf held 1,974 properties in 1989 — 52.7 per cent in the North governorate, 15.9 in the Beqaa, 13.1 in Mount Lebanon, 12.2 in the South and 6.1 in Beirut — and setting the 379 properties then recorded for Beirut and Mount Lebanon against 184 in the 2024 data. Note how it handles the discrepancy, because that is the standard to hold any researcher to: it states plainly that the gap may mean the holdings shrank, or that the database it obtained was incomplete, or both. THE FINDING THAT SHOULD CHANGE HOW A LEBANESE CAMPAIGN PLANS: its research documents a waqf evicting occupants from several surrounding houses it owns, left empty, in an area undergoing rapid real-estate development, and further live suits between long-standing tenants and a waqf following rent rises and revaluation of the leased property. In Lebanon the endowment can be the developer. Do not assume that land held by a religious endowment is land protected from development, and check the register before building an argument on it. Pair with The Legal Agenda for litigation, NAHNOO for public-space mobilisation and SPNL where a municipal Hima is the answer — all three already in this file.

trackers.name: AFDC — three nurseries, standing agreements with municipalities, and it publishes its land data in GIS formats you can download
trackers.desc: THE UNUSUAL THING THIS ORGANISATION OFFERS IS DATA YOU CAN ACTUALLY TAKE AWAY: its own site serves downloadable geospatial datasets — CSV, KML, GeoJSON, GeoTIFF, shapefiles — with API links for GeoServices, WMS and WFS. Very few organisations anywhere in this file publish their mapping in formats a community or its consultant can open, overlay on a proposed scheme and hand to a planner. Start there before commissioning anything. AND IT WORKS THROUGH MUNICIPALITIES, WHICH IN LEBANON IS THE DECISIVE RELATIONSHIP: it runs afforestation and reforestation with municipalities and Municipal Unions, and operates three of its own nurseries, with seedling supply arranged through the Ministry of Agriculture. Read that alongside the Hima route recorded elsewhere in this file — a Lebanese council can protect land by its own decree, and a council that is already planting with a partner organisation is a council that has a working relationship to build on. Established in the early 1990s, IUCN member, active in more than fifteen locations across Mount Lebanon, North Lebanon and South Lebanon, based at Jdeideh. Its four programmes cover conservation, sustainable development, outreach and advocacy, and research; forest fire and desertification work is central to it. ITS SITE-SELECTION CRITERIA, DEVELOPED WITH THE NATIONAL REFORESTATION PARTNERSHIP IT BELONGS TO, ARE WORTH READING AS A CHECKLIST FOR YOUR OWN SITE: priority goes to land at higher risk of erosion or landslide and to sites with previous fire history and no natural regeneration, and requirements include an engaged municipality and an active community — and, in Lebanon, land clear of landmines. That partnership also works on landscape-scale biocorridors in the north, Rachaya and the Chouf to link existing forest stands and protect watersheds, and publishes forest mapping showing the gaps in those corridors. If your threatened land sits in a mapped corridor gap, that is a documented national conservation priority rather than a local claim. THE LIMIT, PLAINLY: this is not an oppositional body. It works in partnership with the ministries of agriculture, environment, education and interior, and its frame is restoration and rural livelihoods rather than stopping schemes. It will not object to a project for you — for that Lebanon carries The Legal Agenda for litigation, NAHNOO for public-space mobilisation and SPNL where a Hima is the answer. Founding year is given as both 1993 and 1994 across sources; take it from AFDC if it matters.

trackers.name: Al-Shouf Cedar Society — a non-governmental body managing 5% of Lebanon, with 22 villages inside the boundary
trackers.desc: IF YOUR VILLAGE SITS INSIDE A BIOSPHERE RESERVE, THERE IS ALREADY AN INSTITUTION WITH A MANAGEMENT MANDATE OVER THE LAND AROUND YOU — AND IN THE SHOUF, TWENTY-TWO VILLAGES ARE INSIDE THE BOUNDARY. UNESCO declared the Shouf Biosphere Reserve in July 2005 covering roughly 50,000 hectares, about five per cent of the total area of Lebanon, taking in the Al-Shouf Cedar Nature Reserve established in 1996, the Ammiq Wetland — a Ramsar site and one of the last remaining wetlands in the Middle East — and those twenty-two villages on the eastern and western sides of the Barouk and Niha mountains. The biosphere model matters here because it is not a fence: it works through core, buffer and transition zones, and the buffer and transition zones are where people live and farm. A scheme proposed in a buffer zone is proposed inside a managed landscape with a named administering body, which is a completely different starting position from open countryside. Establish which zone your land is in first. THE MODEL THAT MAKES VILLAGES DEFEND THE DESIGNATION RATHER THAN RESENT IT IS WORTH COPYING: the society has run a rural development project since February 1999 that has supported some forty families to produce more than seventy products, sold at the reserve entrances which receive upwards of eighty thousand visitors a year. Conservation that pays households is conservation that survives a change of council. It also brings outside money into buffer-zone municipalities through partnerships — an irrigation project funded by the European Union and a Swedish foundation, implemented with Italian and academic partners, ran in the municipality of Mrusti inside the buffer zone and at Ammiq. WHAT IT HOLDS THAT AN OBJECTION NEEDS: it is on the IUCN Green List, and a biodiversity survey begun in 2022 recorded forty-four habitats of which forty-two are natural or semi-natural, and 161 bird species including six internationally threatened. That is a current, independent baseline for a very large area. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE THE FAMILIAR ONES: this is a management body for a state-declared protected area, listed by the Ministry of Environment, not an oppositional organisation. Its income depends substantially on visitors, so it has its own interest in access and tourism infrastructure — the same tension this file recorded for SABUKO in Georgia. For a fight, Lebanon's entries in this file route to The Legal Agenda for litigation, NAHNOO for public-space mobilisation and SPNL where a municipal Hima is the answer. Reserve area is given as 550 square kilometres in some sources and around 500, or 50,000 hectares, by the society and the IUCN Green List; use the latter.

trackers.name: CEPF Mediterranean Basin — open calls naming Lebanon, and the traditional-land-use direction fits the Hima model exactly
trackers.desc: ONE OF THE TWO OPEN STRATEGIC DIRECTIONS IS TRADITIONAL LAND USE PRACTICES, WHICH IS A NEAR-EXACT DESCRIPTION OF THE HIMA — the community land designation recorded elsewhere in this file that a Lebanese municipality can declare on its own consent. A Lebanese application built around reviving or extending a Hima is not straining to fit this fund; it is what the direction was written for. The large-grants call for letters of inquiry opened 1 July 2026 and closes 18 September 2026 at midnight Washington time, with grants of fifty thousand to a hundred and eighty thousand US dollars under that direction and one on preservation of threatened plant species. A small-grants call earlier in 2026 offered twenty to fifty thousand dollars from a five hundred and forty thousand dollar pot, restricted to threatened freshwater biodiversity — relevant for springs, rivers and the wetland sites in the country's protected-area network. ELIGIBILITY IS ORGANISATIONAL: applicants must be legally registered with their own bank account and national authorisation to receive charitable funding; individuals cannot apply. Local and national NGOs are explicitly prioritised in the small-grants call. Letters of inquiry go via the ConservationGrants portal in English or French; the regional implementation team is BirdLife International with DOPPS, and webinar times were published for Lebanon. CEPF'S OWN 2024 PROFILE STATES THE CONTEXT PLAINLY RATHER THAN GLOSSING IT: it records that the evolution of the security and geopolitical situation in the Middle East, particularly in Palestine and Lebanon, has affected inhabitants and organisations. The fund is operating in that knowledge, which is worth knowing when judging whether an application is realistic. Watch the open-calls page; windows run roughly five to ten weeks and late applications are refused for any reason.

trackers.name: APJM — Lebanese law would not allow a reserve on private land, so it leased the mountain from the endowments and the municipality instead
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE MOST DIRECTLY USEFUL PRECEDENT IN THIS FILE FOR ANYONE TOLD THEY CANNOT PROTECT LAND THEY DO NOT OWN. Lebanese legislation did not recognise nature reserves on private land. Rather than abandon the site or wait for the law to change, this association negotiated and funded a ten-year lease contract with the religious endowments to rent large parts of the mountain, and separately leased public municipal common land — macha'a — which the Ministry of Agriculture then designated a Protected Forest in 2008. Two different tenures assembled into one reserve, and not a hectare bought. If you are working where conservation ownership is impossible, that is the shape of the answer: find who holds the land, offer a funded lease, and get a public designation attached to the part that is common. READ IT AGAINST THE OTHER LEBANESE ENDOWMENT FINDING IN THIS FILE, WHERE AN ENDOWMENT WAS DOCUMENTED EVICTING TENANTS IN A DEVELOPMENT CORRIDOR. The endowment is neither ally nor adversary. It is a landlord, and whoever arrives with a funded offer decides what the land becomes. WHAT THE ORGANISATION IS AND WHAT IT HOLDS: a Lebanese non-governmental non-profit founded in 2007, managing the 6,500-hectare Jabal Moussa Biosphere Reserve in Keserwan, which entered the UNESCO Man and the Biosphere network in 2009. Its stated mission pairs conservation with empowering local communities to achieve their own socio-economic development, and its published philosophy is that successful management depends on the participation of the surrounding villages — the same bargain this file has now recorded in Turkish, Georgian, Armenian and other Lebanese cases. The reserve holds at least 727 plant species, 26 endemic to Lebanon and six found only on this mountain, is a Global Important Bird Area with more than 137 migratory and soaring bird species recorded, and shelters wolves, hyenas and rock hyraxes. Offices in Jounieh. THE LIMITS: it manages one mountain. It is not a litigator, a funder or a national body, and it will not take on a scheme elsewhere — but it is the organisation to ask how the lease was structured, what it cost and how the endowments were approached, which is knowledge no statute will give you. SOURCING NOTE: the lease arrangements are documented in a country profile on privately protected areas published by a land conservation network rather than on the association's own pages; confirm the terms with APJM before relying on them. ASK WHO OWNS THE LAND BEFORE ASKING WHO WILL PROTECT IT, BECAUSE IN THIS COUNTRY A CHURCH HAS DECLARED ITS OWN FOREST A PROTECTED ENVIRONMENT AND THEN CONSIDERED DOING IT AGAIN FOR A WHOLE VALLEY. One church declared a forest it owns protected in 2000; the success of that led it to look at making a second, larger declaration over a valley WHERE IT HOLDS MOST OF THE LAND AND ONLY ABOUT FIVE PER CENT IS IN PRIVATE HANDS — a valley then under threat from roads, restaurants and hotel development. Meetings raised the prospect of the state formally recognising both declarations. THAT IS A ROUTE AVAILABLE WHEREVER A RELIGIOUS BODY IS THE LANDOWNER, AND IT NEEDS NO PURCHASE, NO LEASE AND NO LEGISLATION: the owner simply declares, and the declaration can later be recognised. This file has recorded that religious endowments across this region behave as landlords who lease to whoever arrives with a funded offer; this is the same kind of owner choosing to protect instead. If the land you are defending is church, monastery or endowment land, THE DECISION-MAKER IS THE RELIGIOUS AUTHORITY, NOT THE MINISTRY, and there is precedent in this country for asking it directly. A SECOND, HARDER LESSON FROM THE SAME PLACE: WHEN THAT VALLEY AND ITS CEDAR GROVE WERE PUT FORWARD FOR WORLD HERITAGE LISTING, THE NATURAL CRITERIA WERE REFUSED BECAUSE THE NOMINATED AREA WAS TOO SMALL TO RETAIN ITS INTEGRITY. It was inscribed as a cultural landscape instead. Nominating only the core of a site loses the natural case; include the catchment, the slopes and the buffer, or expect to be told the area cannot sustain itself. AND NOTE WHAT PROTECTION HAS NOT PREVENTED THERE: despite church ownership, a listing, and a national natural site designation dating from a law of 1939, the valley's integrity is recorded as at risk from ENCROACHMENT OF SETTLEMENTS, ILLEGAL BUILDING AND INCONSISTENT CONSERVATION ACTIVITY. Layered designations do not enforce themselves — which is why this file records bodies that monitor and object alongside those that designate.

trackers.name: Save Beirut Heritage — a 24-hour demolition hotline, and it moved the power to permit demolition from the municipality to the minister
trackers.desc: THE STRUCTURAL WIN IS THE PART TO COPY: this group was the driving force behind a government decision that old houses cannot be demolished unless the Minister of Culture signs the demolition order. Permission had previously been given by Beirut municipality. Moving a permit power up from a municipality to a minister does not save any particular building, but it changes who must be persuaded and creates a single national point of accountability where there were dozens of local ones. If demolition in your area is signed off locally, that is the change to aim at. AND THE SERVICE IS AS CONCRETE AS ANYTHING IN THIS FILE: a twenty-four-hour hotline residents can call if they fear a building is about to be demolished or damaged by construction, published along with contact emails, backed by a membership in the thousands that began as a public group. It asks people to watch buildings and report, and it publicises the methods developers use to get old buildings taken down — which is the practical knowledge a resident needs to recognise what is happening next door before it is finished. THE OUTCOME IS QUANTIFIED, WHICH IS RARE: working with the Ministry of Culture the group reports having reviewed 250 demolition permits and stopped the demolition of 150 buildings in a single year, and states that without that intervention roughly a quarter of Beirut's remaining architectural heritage would have been lost in that year alone. Its own figures put the stock at about 1,600 traditional buildings counted in a 1990s census against roughly 300 standing now. KNOW WHAT YOU ARE UP AGAINST, BECAUSE THIS GROUP HAS DOCUMENTED BOTH ROUTES AROUND PROTECTION: in March 2017 a Culture Minister issued a decree striking a listed eighteenth-century house from the general inventory of historical buildings ahead of its demolition by the owners, and a separate building was dismantled after a high administrative body allowed the owner to proceed against the Ministry of Culture's decision. A listing can be removed by decree and can be overridden on appeal. Read this with the Lebanese heritage law finding recorded elsewhere in this file: classification obliges the state to compensate the owner, which is why classification is resisted. AFTER THE 2020 PORT EXPLOSION THE GROUP REPORTED THAT AGENTS WERE APPROACHING DAMAGED PROPERTIES WITHIN TWO DAYS. Where a disaster weakens owners, expect acquisition attempts immediately, and expect the response to need to be as fast. WHAT IT IS NOT: not a litigator, not a funder, and not a landholder. Much of its work runs through social channels rather than a maintained website, so treat the hotline and the direct contacts as the reliable route in.

trackers.name: Beirut Heritage Initiative — owners AND tenants can file a request, and it pairs the engineers' order with the bar association
trackers.desc: THE INTAKE IS OPEN TO TENANTS AS WELL AS OWNERS, WHICH IS RARE AND MATTERS: its own site states it is always ready to receive new requests from owners or tenants in need of help. In most property disputes a tenant has no standing and nowhere to go; here the request form does not ask which you are. AND THE STRUCTURE IS THE THING TO COPY. It is organised around a team of experts with complementary skills including the Order of Engineers and Architects of Beirut AND THE BEIRUT BAR ASSOCIATION, together with specialist heritage organisations — a planner, a lawyer and a conservation specialist assembled in advance rather than hunted for one at a time. A community that cannot afford to retain three professions can approach one body that already contains them. IT WAS CREATED TO BRIDGE TWO GAPS AT ONCE, AND NAMING THE SECOND ONE IS THE INSIGHT: funding AND COORDINATION between the owners and residents of damaged heritage structures and the public departments whose permits are needed for reconstruction — specifically the Directorate General of Antiquities and the Office of the Governor of Beirut. Money alone does not repair a protected building; somebody has to get the permit. If your problem looks like a funding problem, check whether it is actually a permissions problem. THE WORKING METHOD IS WORTH TAKING WHEREVER RESOURCES ARE SHORT: it identifies PRIORITY CLUSTERS and concentrates repairs there rather than spreading thin, expressly to maximise impact with scarce resources, and sequences work in three phases — emergency propping and sheltering, partial repairs, then full reconstruction. Its published project counts run into the hundreds of buildings across two Beirut districts, on stock built between the 1860s and the 1930s, against roughly a thousand historic buildings damaged in the 2020 port explosion. It states it is funded exclusively by people choosing to contribute, takes donations and volunteers directly, publishes its own annual report, and works alongside a wide stakeholder network including national heritage bodies, an Arab architecture centre, international monuments and museums councils, the Blue Shield and the demolition-watch group recorded separately in this file. THE LIMITS: it is Beirut, it is built heritage, and it is restoration rather than opposition. It will not fight a development for you — but where a building's survival depends on repair and a permit rather than on a court case, this is the body that does both, and the collective model behind it is the most transferable thing in this entry.

trackers.name: Lebanon Eco Movement — sixty member organisations, and a hotline for reporting environmental violations
trackers.desc: IT RUNS AN ENVIRONMENTAL OBSERVATORY TO MONITOR VIOLATIONS ACROSS LEBANON, WITH A HOTLINE TO REPORT THEM. That is the most directly usable thing in this entry: a national number to call when something is happening on the ground, which this file has otherwise found in Lebanon only for building demolition. AND IT OPPOSES PROJECTS RATHER THAN ONLY ADVOCATING: it is recorded as actively taking steps AGAINST THE CONSTRUCTION OF DAMS that threaten the environment, against unlawful poaching, and for the preservation of the Lebanese coastal shore — and it contributed to the campaign that closed a major landfill. THE REASON IT MATTERS MOST HERE IS THE ONE THIS FILE HAS BEEN CIRCLING FOR EIGHTY ROUNDS: LEBANON'S LOCAL ENVIRONMENTAL BODIES ARE LARGELY UNREACHABLE ONLINE. A coastal litigator, the northern cedar forest committees and a heritage association were each verified as real, active and constituted, and none could be given an address. A NETWORK OF AROUND SIXTY MEMBER ORGANISATIONS FROM ALL OVER LEBANON IS THE WAY TO REACH THEM — ask the movement which of its members covers your district, rather than searching for that member yourself. Its eleven founding organisations are named in the record and include heritage, coastal, development and regional associations, which indicates the spread. It was founded in 2012 when those eleven gathered in a forest outside the capital with twenty more environmental organisations. ITS STATED OBJECTIVES INCLUDE TWO A COMMUNITY CAN USE DIRECTLY: strengthening the capacities of its member organisations, and organising advocacy campaigns toward the Lebanese authorities — so a small local association can join and be carried by a national body rather than campaigning alone, which is the failure mode an independent analysis identified for isolated campaigns in Georgia and which applies just as well here. It also participates in national environmental policy planning and sits in Mediterranean and regional networks. THE ADDRESS PROBLEM APPLIES TO THE FEDERATION ITSELF, WHICH IS WORTH STATING PLAINLY: no domain of its own was reached this round, and the contact given here is its own public page, followed by tens of thousands of people. A Lebanese civil society directory carries its current procurement notices, which indicates it is operating; two of the fullest profiles of it sit on aggregator sites this file does not use and were refused. Confirm the hotline number at source before relying on it.

trackers.name: Mada — it could not get the park, so it worked on the legal framework for parks
trackers.desc: WHEN THE PROTECTION YOU WANT DOES NOT EXIST IN LAW, BUILD THE LAW. This organisation spent its early years working towards a natural park across the Akkar, Hermel and Donnieh highlands, with development and conservation goals SET JOINTLY WITH LOCAL AUTHORITIES AND COMMUNITIES. When the park became a longer-term ambition, it continued working on ELABORATING THE LEGAL FRAMEWORK FOR PARKS. Treating a missing legal category as the obstacle, and building it, is a different response from abandoning a campaign or waiting for one — and this file has recorded elsewhere that Lebanese law would not recognise a nature reserve on private land at all, which is exactly the kind of gap such work addresses. IT IS THE ONLY BODY IN THIS FILE WORKING IN THE NORTHERN HIGHLANDS. Every other Lebanese entry operates in Beirut, the Shouf, Keserwan or nationally; this one was born in Akkar and Hermel in 1999 and was among the first organisations to work in Akkar at all, registered under a numbered interior ministry decree in October 2000 and a member of the international conservation union. If your land is in the north, this is the organisation that has been there longest. IT SUPPORTS OTHER PEOPLE'S INITIATIVES RATHER THAN ONLY RUNNING ITS OWN: through a platform it provides TECHNICAL SUPPORT TO CIVIL INITIATIVES to help them develop and reach their potential — which matters in a country where this file has documented constituted local bodies that cannot even be given an address. AND IT BUILDS A TOOL WORTH ASKING YOUR MUNICIPALITY FOR BY NAME: participatory LOCAL DEVELOPMENT PLANS covering economy, society, environment and governance, developed bottom-up with the community and described as both a roadmap for the municipality AND AN INSTRUMENT OF ACCOUNTABILITY FOR THE COMMUNITY. A plan your council has adopted, with an environment pillar you helped write, is something to hold it to afterwards. It works through what it calls a territorial approach, has conducted studies and socio-economic assessments of the region's vulnerability, natural assets and cultural heritage, and publishes its reports and MAPS on its own site. THE LIMITS: it is a development agency, not an objector — it works with municipalities and institutions rather than against them, and nothing found shows it opposing a scheme. Its priorities shifted with the refugee crisis from 2011, and much of its current work is agriculture, food systems, education and livelihoods. Note a date discrepancy: one professional-network profile gives its founding as 2020, twenty years out; its own site and its registration decree give 1999 and 2000.

trackers.name: AUB Nature Conservation Center — it ran participatory contamination research across six municipalities and published it
trackers.desc: ASK YOUR NEAREST UNIVERSITY WHETHER IT WILL TAKE YOUR SITUATION AS A RESEARCH PROJECT. This centre published a study of multisource groundwater contamination across SIX MUNICIPALITIES near a landfill, expressly as part of a PUBLIC PARTICIPATORY RESEARCH PROJECT — peer-reviewed, citable evidence about named communities' water, produced with those communities rather than about them. That is a different kind of asset from a consultant's report: it is independent, it is published, and it does not disappear when a project ends. NOW THE WARNING, AND IT MAY BE THE MOST IMPORTANT THING HERE: ITS RESEARCH RECORDS THAT IMPORTANT PLANT AREAS, DESIGNATED FOR THEIR BIODIVERSITY VALUE, ARE NOT ALWAYS OFFICIALLY PROTECTED, AND OFTEN FALL WITHIN MIXED PRIVATE AND PUBLIC LAND OWNERSHIP. If you have been told your area is designated, establish which designation it is, under what law, who it binds and what it actually prevents — a scientific designation and a legal protection are not the same thing, and this file has recorded elsewhere that a legal category can be removed administratively before a project appears.
