The same work examined using international protected-area management categories as a tool to assess local preferences for managing such an area, which is the practical follow-on: if the designation binds nobody, what management would. WHAT ELSE IT HAS BUILT THAT A COMMUNITY CAN USE: aerial green maps of EIGHTY VILLAGES, developed with the tourism and interior ministries and since turned into a digital platform — a baseline record of what was there, which is the thing communities almost never have when a scheme is announced. It has also published national guidelines for native tree nursery management, setting standards for seedling production for restoration work. AND IT GIVES MUNICIPALITIES A REASON TO ACT: an annual Biodiversity Village Award offering participating municipalities recognition for the best green practices. A council that wants an award is easier to move than one that only fears an objection. Founded in 2001 under the university provost's office, drawing faculty from multiple disciplines, describing itself as the leading transdisciplinary academic centre on nature conservation in the region, and stating that it operates with municipalities, universities, non-governmental organisations and government authorities. ITS RESEARCH REPOSITORY IS PUBLIC and its volunteering is open — anyone can apply with a statement of interest, including for fieldwork. THE LIMITS: it is an academic centre, not an advocate. It will not object to a scheme, and its cooperation with ministries and municipalities means it is unlikely to front opposition to a state-backed one. Approach it for evidence, mapping, baselines and standards — and take the objection to the bodies recorded elsewhere in this file.

trackers.name: The MedFund — recurring costs of marine protected area management, funded for five years
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY IS BOTH A PUBLISHED PRIORITY INTERVENTION COUNTRY AND A NAMED BENEFICIARY OF A LARGER PROGRAMME THIS FUND EXECUTES: a multi-year project financing twenty nationally designated and newly designated marine protected areas across six countries, covering close to 220,000 hectares, with this one among them. WHAT MAKES IT UNUSUAL IS WHAT IT PAYS FOR: the RECURRENT MANAGEMENT COSTS of marine protected areas, granted to their management and co-management structures FOR FIVE YEARS. Most funders pay for projects and refuse running costs; this file recorded one that says so explicitly. A protected area that cannot pay its staff after the project ends is the problem this fund was built to solve, and in a country where this file has documented reserves and municipal protected areas established with little money behind them, that is the binding constraint. IT WORKS AS AN ENDOWMENT — raising and investing capital and granting the INTEREST — which is why it can commit for five years at a time. GRANTS GO TO NGOs AND TO NATIONAL PROTECTED AREA MANAGEMENT AUTHORITIES ALIKE, AND CO-MANAGEMENT STRUCTURES QUALIFY — which matters here, because this file has recorded that the workable model in this country is a community or association managing land it does not own, under municipal or endowment arrangements. APPLY IN TWO STAGES: a short expression of interest by one deadline, then a full application some weeks later. THE LIMITS: marine areas only, so an inland site does not qualify; the area must already be designated or formally in the designation process, making this a fund for sustaining protection rather than obtaining it; and it funds management rather than objection or litigation. The larger programme it executes also builds the capacity of protected area managers and is run alongside a network of Mediterranean protected area managers, which is worth asking about as a route to peers doing the same work in neighbouring countries.

trackers.name: Save the Bisri Valley — the campaign that got a World Bank loan cancelled, and how
trackers.desc: THE LOAN WAS CANCELLED BECAUSE PRECONDITIONS WERE UNMET, NOT BECAUSE THE ECOLOGY WAS PERSUASIVE. In September 2020 the World Bank cancelled 244 million dollars of undisbursed funds for a dam in this valley, after the government failed to complete AN ECOLOGICAL COMPENSATION PLAN and ARRANGEMENTS FOR THE OPERATION AND MANAGEMENT of the dam — both PRECONDITIONS OF THE LOAN. If a lender finances the scheme you are facing, obtain the loan agreement, find the conditions precedent, and check whether they have been satisfied. An unmet condition is a lever no argument about habitat can match, and this is the only documented cancellation of its kind in this file. BE EQUALLY CLEAR ABOUT WHAT DID NOT WORK: the campaign submitted a REQUEST FOR INSPECTION to the Bank's own accountability panel in 2019 AND IT WAS NOT ACCEPTED. This payload records international complaint mechanisms for many countries; here one refused the case while the campaign won by other routes. Use the mechanism, but do not build the strategy on it. WHAT THE CAMPAIGN ACTUALLY DID, AND ALL OF IT IS COPYABLE: a public petition addressed to the lender rather than the government; WEEKLY WALKING TOURS of the valley to show citizens what was at stake; a protest camp of tents in the pine forest; disrupting a talk by a Bank vice-president at a university; a lawsuit against the Bank, with media coverage of the lawsuit itself treated as part of the campaign; and turning the Bank's own anti-corruption messaging against it online. THE DECISIVE POLITICAL MOVE WAS LOCAL: MUNICIPALITIES WITHDREW THEIR SUPPORT FOR THE DAM. Mayors changing position is what makes a project politically expensive, and this file has recorded elsewhere that a council can be moved by recognition as well as by objection. THE ARGUMENTS THAT LANDED WERE TECHNICAL AND FINANCIAL, NOT SENTIMENTAL: that the site sits on an ACTIVE SEISMIC FAULT with the risk of reservoir-induced earthquakes; that the rock is porous and karstic so the reservoir would not hold the expected water and sealing it would cost hundreds of millions more; that OTHER RECENTLY BUILT DAMS IN THIS COUNTRY HAD FAILED FOR THE SAME REASON; that six million square metres of natural and agricultural land and more than fifty historical sites would be lost; and a plain comparison of the cost against hospitals, teaching and jobs. IT WAS CO-FOUNDED IN 2018 BY A NATIONAL CAMPAIGN FOR THE VALLEY AND BY THE LEBANESE ENVIRONMENTAL FEDERATION RECORDED SEPARATELY IN THIS FILE, and both it and that federation were funded by a small international grantmaker also recorded here — five thousand dollars each. This win was financed by two resources already in this map. THE LIMITS: it is a campaign, not a service; it achieved its aim in 2020 and its current activity is not established here; and it is reachable through its public accounts rather than an office.THREE THINGS ABOUT HOW THIS CAMPAIGN WAS RESOURCED AND WHERE IT STOOD WERE NOT RECORDED HERE. THE FIRST IS THE MONEY: IT RECEIVED FIVE THOUSAND DOLLARS FROM A SMALL GRASSROOTS GRANTS FUND IN JANUARY 2020 TO PRESSURE THE LENDER TO WITHDRAW FINANCING AND TO PROMOTE MEDIA COVERAGE OF ITS LAWSUIT. FIVE THOUSAND DOLLARS AGAINST A PROJECT COSTED AT SIX HUNDRED AND SEVENTEEN MILLION. THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS THAT SAME FUND'S APPLICATION ROUTE FOR SEVERAL COUNTRIES — THIS IS WHAT ITS GRANTS CAN DO WHEN SPENT ON PRESSURING THE FINANCIER RATHER THAN ON EQUIPMENT. THE SECOND IS WHERE THEY STOOD: SIT-INS AND CAMPS IN THE VALLEY WITH ACTIVISTS FROM AROUND THE COUNTRY, AND PROTESTS ABROAD — INCLUDING BY EXPATRIATES OUTSIDE THE LENDER'S LONDON OFFICE. THE DIASPORA CAN STAND WHERE THE DECISION IS MADE WHILE THE VILLAGE HOLDS THE GROUND. THIS FILE RECORDS DIASPORA FUNDING ROUTES IN SEVERAL COUNTRIES WITHOUT NOTING THAT THE DIASPORA IS ALSO A PLACE TO STAND. THE THIRD IS THE STRUCTURE THAT CARRIED IT: THE CAMPAIGN WAS CO-FOUNDED IN 2018 BY A NATIONAL CAMPAIGN TO PROTECT THE VALLEY AND AN ECO MOVEMENT COALITION, AND ITS FIRST ACT WAS A PUBLIC PETITION IN NOVEMBER 2018 URGING THE LENDER TO CANCEL THE DAM, CALLING IT DESTRUCTIVE AND LAND-GREEDY AND CITING HARMS TO NATURAL HABITAT, CULTURAL HERITAGE AND SAFETY — A LOCAL CAMPAIGN PLUS A NATIONAL COALITION, AIMED NOT AT THE MINISTRY BUT AT THE FINANCIER. AND THE SEQUENCE IS WORTH DATING PRECISELY, BECAUSE IT SHOWS HOW LONG IT TOOK: THE FORMAL REQUEST FOR INSPECTION WENT IN IN JUNE 2019 AND WAS REFUSED; PARTIAL SUSPENSION FOLLOWED ON 26 JUNE 2020; AND THE CANCELLATION CAME ON 5 SEPTEMBER 2020, AFTER CONCERNS THE LENDER SAYS IT HAD RAISED REPEATEDLY SINCE EARLY JANUARY.

trackers.name: Faith Plans — the route by which a church, monastery or endowment commits its own land to protection
trackers.desc: IF THE LAND YOU ARE DEFENDING BELONGS TO A CHURCH, A MONASTERY OR A RELIGIOUS ENDOWMENT, THIS IS THE STRUCTURED ROUTE FOR ASKING ITS OWNER TO PROTECT IT. It is a framework through which faith communities commit to using their ASSETS, INVESTMENTS AND INFLUENCE for people and planet, with a dedicated site carrying ideas, resources, case studies and a sign-up through which a faith group develops its own plan. IT DESCENDS DIRECTLY FROM THE PROGRAMME THAT ALREADY WORKED IN THIS COUNTRY: it builds on a 2009 faith commitments programme run by the same predecessor organisation whose earlier work led a church here to declare a forest it owns a protected environment, and then to consider doing the same for an entire valley. That predecessor no longer operates; this framework is its live descendant, created jointly with a major conservation organisation's beliefs and values programme and supported by faith networks, secular environmental groups and United Nations bodies. Groups with a combined reach reported at over 150 million people have signed up to develop plans. WHY THIS MATTERS MORE HERE THAN ALMOST ANYWHERE: this file established that Lebanese law would not permit a nature reserve on private land, and that the workable routes are endowment leases, municipal commons and management without ownership — and that a religious endowment behaves as a LANDLORD who leases to whoever arrives with a funded offer. A faith plan is the instrument for turning that same landlord into a protector, and it requires no purchase, no legislation and no ministry. APPROACH IT THROUGH THE RELIGIOUS AUTHORITY, NOT AS A COMMUNITY GROUP. The framework is designed for faith institutions to adopt; your part is to persuade the diocese, the endowment board or the monastery to sign up and to put your valley, forest or spring into its plan. Bring the case studies from the site with you — an authority that sees peers elsewhere doing this is easier to move than one asked to invent it. DO NOT CONFUSE IT WITH ITS PARENT BODY, WHICH DOES SOMETHING ELSE: that organisation works on FAITH-CONSISTENT INVESTING, helping religious institutions align stock market portfolios with their values, and offers free and paid services to faith-based asset owners. It is not a land protection service and approaching it about a threatened forest would be a wasted letter. THE LIMITS: it is a commitment framework, not a funder, a regulator or an enforcer. A plan binds nobody legally, and this file recorded in R177 that in the very valley concerned, church ownership, a world heritage listing and a national designation dating from 1939 together have not prevented encroachment, illegal building and inconsistent conservation. A declaration is a beginning, not an outcome.

trackers.name: fundahope — run your own fundraiser, including a permanent one people subscribe to monthly
trackers.desc: THIS PAYLOAD HOLDS MORE THAN NINETY FUNDING ENTRIES AND ALMOST ALL OF THEM REQUIRE APPLYING TO SOMEBODY. THIS ONE YOU RUN YOURSELF. A campaign is started by writing your story, setting a goal, uploading the requested documents and submitting — and campaigns may be launched by INDIVIDUALS, ENTITIES OR NGOs, so a registered organisation is not strictly required. This file's most repeated finding across twenty-three countries is that communities are blocked by lacking a constituted body; here an individual may begin. THE FEATURE THAT MATTERS MOST FOR LAND IS NOT THE CAMPAIGN BUT THE PERMANENT FUNDRAISER: a long-term fundraiser WITH NO DEFINED GOAL, where supporters can SUBSCRIBE FOR MONTHLY DONATIONS instead of giving once. That is recurring income. This map has recorded a standing local endowment, a community foundation and a member-funded cooperative as the most durable ways to pay for defending ground, because a one-off appeal buys one fight and a monthly income buys persistence. A PERMANENT FUNDRAISER IS THE VERSION OF THAT WHICH REQUIRES NO ENDOWMENT AND NO LAWYER. AND THE DISTRIBUTION TOOLS FIT PLACES WHERE MOST SUPPORTERS ARE NOT ONLINE: every campaign carries social sharing links, A QR CODE AND A PRINTABLE FLYER — so it can be pinned in a shop, handed out at a meeting or printed on a notice, and reach flows from how widely it is shared rather than from the platform's own audience. IT WORKS AT REAL SCALE AND IT IS CURRENT: one campaign raised over fifty-one thousand dollars toward a hundred-and-forty-thousand-dollar medical cost, another supported a hundred and twenty-five people, and a fundraiser begun in 2024 was still running and raising in 2026. Organisations using it describe reaching international donors without red tape or financial constraints, which matters where the diaspora is larger and better resourced than the community at home. THE DISCLAIMER YOU MUST CARRY: THE PLATFORM STATES IT HAS NO DIRECT OR INDIRECT LINK WITH THE PURPOSE OR CONTENT OF POSTED FUNDRAISERS. It hosts; it does not vouch, verify the cause or guarantee delivery. Campaigns can be reported and it says it investigates. That cuts both ways: nobody screens you, and nobody screens the others — so publish your own accounts, name who holds the money, and show what was bought. THE OTHER LIMITS: platform and payment fees apply and should be checked before setting a target; success depends on your own network rather than on the site; and a public campaign is a public statement of what you are trying to stop.

trackers.name: Orders of Engineers and Architects — two regional bodies, and the four questions to put to them
trackers.desc: THE ENGINEERING PROFESSION HERE IS ORGANISED IN TWO SEPARATE ORDERS BY REGION, AND WHICH ONE COVERS YOU DECIDES WHERE EVERY QUESTION GOES. One is seated in the capital; the other covers the second city and the north of the country. EACH HAS ITS OWN OFFICIAL SITE AND PUBLISHES ITS OWN LAWS AND INTERNAL REGULATIONS. Establish which order your area falls under before writing to anybody, because a request sent to the wrong one is simply outside its jurisdiction. NOW THE HONEST PART, AND IT SHAPES HOW THIS ENTRY SHOULD BE USED. THIS FILE VERIFIED THE EXISTENCE, SEATS AND PUBLISHED RULES OF BOTH ORDERS AND DID NOT VERIFY THEIR SERVICES. What follows are the four questions that examining the equivalent bodies in four neighbouring countries showed to be worth asking — THEY ARE QUESTIONS TO PUT TO THE ORDER, NOT CLAIMS ABOUT WHAT IT OFFERS. FIRST: MUST A NAMED SUPERVISING ENGINEER BE APPOINTED ON CONSTRUCTION WORKS, AND WHO IS IT ON THE SCHEME NEAR YOU? In four neighbouring countries the answer is yes, the person is registered with the order, and the order can receive a complaint about their professional conduct — a route that exists even where the permit itself cannot be challenged. SECOND: WHAT RANK OR CLASSIFICATION DOES A PROFESSIONAL HOLD, AND WHAT DOES IT PERMIT? Elsewhere in this region rank decides what an engineer may lawfully sign, supervise or chair, and instructing someone whose rank does not cover the work wastes time you cannot recover. THIRD: IS THERE A LICENSED TESTING AND INSPECTION SPECIALISM? In a neighbouring country that is a recognised, licensed category of engineering office — which converts the problem of proving physical harm from a favour asked of a university into an ordinary commercial service. FOURTH: ARE FEE SCALES PUBLISHED, AND ARE THERE REDUCED OR FREE FEES FOR REGISTERED SOCIETIES AND COOPERATIVES? One neighbouring order publishes both a scale and a route to free design and supervision for a society that holds land in its own name. WHY IT IS WORTH ASKING HERE PARTICULARLY: these orders are large, elected, professionally independent bodies of long standing, and in a country where building safety and reconstruction have been sustained public questions, an order that publishes its own laws is a place where a technical answer can be obtained on the record. THE LIMITS: an order regulates its members and will not oppose a project; its services cost money; this entry records the structure and the questions rather than confirmed services; and a reviewer should verify the four points above before publication and rewrite this entry with the answers.

trackers.name: The bar's judicial aid — a free lawyer, why it underperforms, and the one lever you hold
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY HELD ONE ENTRY IN THIS MAP FOR LEGAL HELP AND IT WAS NOT A WAY TO GET A LAWYER. The bar runs a JUDICIAL AID scheme with its own section and a published set of questions and answers, and that is the route to a free lawyer here. KNOW WHICH BAR YOU BELONG TO BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE. THERE ARE TWO. One registers lawyers holding offices in every governorate EXCEPT THE NORTH; the other covers the north. NOBODY MAY PRACTISE LAW IN THIS COUNTRY WITHOUT BEING REGISTERED IN ONE OF THEM, and no one may be registered in both — so an approach to the wrong bar is wasted, and a person offering to act for you who is on neither roll is not a lawyer. NOW THE PART THAT WILL SAVE YOU DISAPPOINTMENT, BECAUSE A PUBLISHED INVESTIGATION SET IT OUT PLAINLY: THE AID IS CARRIED BY TRAINEE LAWYERS, AND THE BAR'S ROLE IS LIMITED TO ASSIGNING ONE AND HANDING OVER THE FILE WITH A ONE-PAGE FORM for recording how the case proceeds. THE COMMITTEE FOLLOWS THE FILE IN FORM RATHER THAN IN SUBSTANCE, and in most cases nobody reads that form at all. The consequence falls hardest on aided litigants precisely because, unlike paying clients, THEY USUALLY DO NOT KNOW WHAT THEY ARE ENTITLED TO EXPECT. SO HERE IS THE LEVER, AND IT IS THE MOST USEFUL SENTENCE IN THIS ENTRY: IF AN AIDED LITIGANT COMPLAINS, THE COMMITTEE CAN ASK THE ASSIGNED LAWYER FOR HIS REASONS AND APPOINT ANOTHER LAWYER TO COMPLETE THE FILE. Complaint is therefore not a gesture — it is the mechanism by which a neglected file gets a new advocate. Keep your own dated record of every hearing, every filing and every unanswered call, because that record is what a complaint rests on. THE BAR PUBLISHES MORE THAT IS WORTH USING: A LAWYERS' DIRECTORY for finding and checking a named advocate; A DIRECTORY OF COURTS AND OFFICIAL ADMINISTRATIONS, which answers the question of which office holds what; the national laws and an electronic library; and A HUMAN RIGHTS INSTITUTE inside the bar with its own statute, activities and publications. Its published committee list for the current year includes a committee following the cases of refugees and foreign workers — SO ASK WHICH COMMITTEE COVERS YOUR SUBJECT, because a committee is easier to interest than an institution. THE LIMITS: judicial aid is means-tested and its conditions must be read from the bar's own answers; a trainee advocate is a real advocate but an inexperienced one; and the bar regulates the profession rather than campaigning — for the substance of a planning or environmental fight, use it alongside the urban research studio and the heritage initiative recorded separately for this country.WHAT THIS BAR'S OWN MEMBERS HAVE ORGANISED THEMSELVES INTO WAS NOT RECORDED HERE, AND IT ANSWERS THE BRIEF'S REQUEST FOR LOCAL ATTORNEYS DIRECTLY: AMONG ITS LISTED COMMITTEES FOR 2025-2026 ARE AN ENVIRONMENT COMMITTEE; A COMMITTEE FOR PLANNING, DESIGN AND PROJECTS; A COMMITTEE ON ADMINISTRATIVE DECENTRALISATION; AND A COMMITTEE FOR THE DEFENCE OF PUBLIC FREEDOMS AND HUMAN RIGHTS - ALONGSIDE ONE FOR MODERNISING THE LAWS AND REGULATIONS RELATING TO ASSOCIATIONS, ONE ON POPULATION AND DEVELOPMENT, AND OTHERS ON PRISONS, CONSUMER PROTECTION, CHILDREN'S RIGHTS AND THE FOLLOW-UP OF REFUGEE AND FOREIGN WORKER CASES. LAWYERS WHO HAVE PUT THEIR HANDS UP FOR THE ENVIRONMENT AND FOR PLANNING ARE ALREADY NAMED SOMEWHERE. THE ASK IS NOT FIND ME A LAWYER BUT WHO CHAIRS THE ENVIRONMENT COMMITTEE THIS YEAR, AND WHEN DOES IT MEET. THE DECENTRALISATION COMMITTEE IS THE ONE NOBODY THINKS TO ASK FOR, AND IT MATTERS HERE: THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS THAT UNIONS OF MUNICIPALITIES IN THIS COUNTRY ADMINISTER THE COMMON LANDS, SO LAWYERS ORGANISED AROUND ADMINISTRATIVE DECENTRALISATION ARE THE ONES WHO KNOW HOW THOSE BODIES WORK — AND THE ASSOCIATIONS COMMITTEE IS WHO TO ASK WHEN A GROUP CANNOT GET REGISTERED. THE BAR ALSO PUBLISHES A DIRECTORY OF THE COURTS AND OFFICIAL ADMINISTRATIONS, SEARCHABLE BY LETTER AND BY LOCATION, ALONGSIDE ITS JUDICIAL AID QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS, AN INFORMATICS CENTRE, A LAWYERS' INSTITUTE AND A HUMAN RIGHTS INSTITUTE — WHICH ANSWERS THE FIRST QUESTION IN EVERY DISPUTE IN THIS FILE: WHERE DOES THIS GET FILED, AND WHICH OFFICE HOLDS THE PAPER. AND ONE FIGURE SHARPENS WHAT THIS ENTRY ALREADY SAYS ABOUT THE AID SCHEME UNDERPERFORMING: THE AID COMMITTEE'S OWN STATISTICAL REPORT SHOWS APPLICATIONS FOR THE ASSIGNMENT OF LAWYERS FALLING FROM SEVEN HUNDRED AND SIXTY-FIVE FILES IN 2000 TO FOUR HUNDRED AND TEN IN 2011 — SO A COMMUNITY THAT APPLIES IS NOT JOINING A QUEUE OF THOUSANDS, IT IS DOING SOMETHING ALMOST NOBODY DOES.

trackers.name: Heritage protection association — a national NGO with a named sites officer
trackers.desc: THIS FILE ESTABLISHED AT R329 THAT HERITAGE DESIGNATION IS ONE OF THE VERY FEW GROUNDS THAT HALTS CONSTRUCTION OUTRIGHT, AND THAT HERITAGE SOCIETIES ARE OFTEN OLDER AND BETTER DOCUMENTED THAN THE ENVIRONMENTAL BODIES THIS PAYLOAD HAS BEEN CHASING. HERE IS ONE FOR THIS COUNTRY: a cultural heritage non-governmental organisation founded in 2010, based in a district of the mountain region, serving the country as a whole. THE DETAIL THAT MAKES IT USABLE IS ITS STRUCTURE: ITS PUBLISHED OFFICERS INCLUDE A SITES OFFICER WHO IS ALSO THE ASSOCIATION'S OFFICIAL REPRESENTATIVE, alongside a president, vice-president and secretary general. AN ORGANISATION WITH A NAMED PERSON RESPONSIBLE FOR SITES IS AN ORGANISATION YOU CAN WRITE TO ABOUT A PARTICULAR PLACE — and this file has found repeatedly that the difference between a body that helps and one that does not is whether someone owns the subject internally. WHAT TO ASK FOR: whether the association already holds a record of the site you are worried about; whether it will inspect and document it; and whether it will write to the authorities in its own name. A heritage association's letter about a specific building or site carries weight that a residents' letter does not, because it comes from a body whose whole purpose is judging such things. AND USE IT WITH WHAT THIS COUNTRY ALREADY HAS IN THIS MAP: the urban research studio, the heritage initiative through which owners AND TENANTS can file, the public-space organisation whose campaigns are recorded separately, and the bar's judicial aid route. A documented heritage claim is the strongest thing to put in front of any of them. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE REAL. THE RECORD REACHED FOR THIS BODY IS AN ENCYCLOPAEDIA ENTRY GIVING ITS FOUNDING, LOCATION AND OFFICERS RATHER THAN ITS OWN ACCOUNT OF CURRENT WORK — CONFIRM THAT IT IS STILL ACTIVE AND WHO NOW HOLDS THE SITES ROLE BEFORE RELYING ON IT. It is a heritage body, so it will speak to the historic and cultural value of a place and not to its ecology or to planning law. And it does not hold land or provide lawyers.

trackers.name: International legal representation — it has filed on this country, including on transnational repression
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY'S LISTING IS RICH IN CAMPAIGNERS, PLANNERS, HERITAGE BODIES AND LAWYERS — AND HELD NOTHING ABOUT PROTECTION FOR THE PEOPLE WHO USE THEM. THIS ORGANISATION REPRESENTS INDIVIDUALS SUBJECTED TO SEVERE VIOLATIONS BEFORE INTERNATIONAL PROTECTION MECHANISMS, chiefly UNITED NATIONS SPECIAL PROCEDURES AND TREATY BODIES, and engages domestic and regional mechanisms where they are effective and accessible. IT HAS FILED ON THIS COUNTRY IN A UNIVERSAL PERIODIC REVIEW SUBMISSION RAISING TORTURE, REFOULEMENT AND TRANSNATIONAL REPRESSION — the last of those meaning pressure that follows people across borders. IT ALSO MAINTAINS A COUNTRY PAGE, so its existing record here can be read before approaching. WHAT IT OFFERS A COMMUNITY IS PRECISE: LEGAL ASSISTANCE AND REPRESENTATION AT THE INTERNATIONAL LEVEL, working with VICTIMS, FAMILIES AND THEIR OWN LAWYERS. This file records here the bar's judicial aid scheme and its weaknesses, and an urban research studio that pulls the cadastral record. THIS IS THE STEP AFTER THOSE — for when the domestic route has been exhausted or has failed, and someone has been detained, prosecuted or silenced for what they did. IT ALSO WORKS STRUCTURALLY, documenting patterns and root causes rather than single incidents, which means a series of similar cases — several communities facing the same treatment — IS MORE USE TO IT THAN ONE, and more likely to produce a finding that helps everyone. THE LIMITS: its subject is severe human rights violations, so it engages with what is done to people, not with permits or plans. INTERNATIONAL MECHANISMS PRODUCE FINDINGS AND PRESSURE OVER MONTHS OR YEARS, NOT ORDERS THAT STOP WORK. And it is a foreign organisation whose work is published. Read it with the bar aid and legal entries recorded separately here.

trackers.name: The environmental NGO umbrella — sixty-plus members, and a stated purpose of helping new organisations form
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HAS RECORDED LEBANESE ORGANISATIONS SINGLY — A NATURE PROTECTION SOCIETY RUNNING PROTECTED AREAS, A FORESTRY AND NURSERY BODY, A CEDAR SOCIETY, LEGAL AND FUNDING ROUTES. MORE THAN SIXTY OF THE COUNTRY'S ENVIRONMENTAL ORGANISATIONS SIT INSIDE ONE DEMOCRATIC UMBRELLA, ESTABLISHED IN 1992 AND OFFICIALLY LICENSED BY THE INTERIOR MINISTRY — and the society already recorded here was among its founders. ITS STATED AIMS INCLUDE ONE THIS PAYLOAD HAS BEEN LOOKING FOR ACROSS HUNDREDS OF ENTRIES: ENCOURAGING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF NEW ENVIRONMENTAL ORGANISATIONS IN THE COUNTRY. A GROUP OF NEIGHBOURS WITH A THREATENED VALLEY AND NO LEGAL FORM CAN ASK A BODY WHOSE OWN CONSTITUTION COMMITS IT TO HELPING THEM COME INTO EXISTENCE. Ask for that help by name. THE SECOND AIM IS ALMOST AS USEFUL: COORDINATING AMONG MEMBERS TO SPREAD INFORMATION AND TO CONTACT MINISTRIES AND NATIONAL AND INTERNATIONAL ORGANISATIONS IN ORDER TO BOOST ACTION. AN UMBRELLA WRITING TO A MINISTRY ON BEHALF OF SIXTY ORGANISATIONS IS A DIFFERENT LETTER FROM A VILLAGE WRITING ALONE, and the umbrella already knows which official to write to. ITS OWN PROJECTS ARE PRACTICAL — REFORESTATION, THE ESTABLISHMENT OF SANCTUARIES, AND AWARENESS CAMPAIGNS — so a community with land to plant or a site worth protecting is offering it work it already does. BUT THE MOST INSTRUCTIVE THING IT HAS DONE IS THIS: IT COMMISSIONED A LEGAL EXPERT TO ANALYSE EVERY LAW, DECREE AND MINISTERIAL DECISION GOVERNING MARINE PROTECTED AREAS, AND TO DRAFT A LAW OR DECREE ESTABLISHING AN EFFECTIVE PROTECTED-AREA NETWORK. IT DID NOT ASK A MINISTRY FOR A LAW; IT COMMISSIONED THE DRAFT AND PUT IT FORWARD, backed by an evidence-based national campaign and a published assessment produced with a university institute. THAT IS A TEMPLATE ANY COALITION CAN COPY: PAY FOR THE LEGAL ANALYSIS, PRODUCE THE DRAFT INSTRUMENT, AND ARRIVE WITH THE TEXT RATHER THAN THE COMPLAINT. It has also worked in cooperation with a named municipality — the local-authority partnership this file has recommended repeatedly. AND ITS SITE DOUBLES AS A NOTICEBOARD OF OPEN FUNDING WINDOWS, POSTING SMALL GRANTS PROGRAMME ROUNDS AND CLIMATE FUND CALLS. For a member organisation that is a free grants alert; for a non-member it is still a public list of what is currently open in this country. THE LIMITS: it is a coordinating umbrella, not a litigator or a land buyer — it will not fight a permit for you, and this file has recorded separately the Lebanese legal routes that can. Membership brings obligations as well as access. Its current membership list, the status of the draft protected-area instrument and its capacity during the country's financial crisis were not verified in this round.

trackers.name: Land affairs directorate — the property page, the marker you can register on it, and the registrar who personally decides
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY HELD MORE THAN TWENTY ENTRIES — A CONSERVATION SOCIETY, A FORESTRY BODY, AN NGO UMBRELLA, LEGAL AND FUNDING ROUTES — AND NO WAY TO FIND OUT WHO OWNS A PARCEL. A TAG AUDIT ACROSS ALL TWENTY-THREE COUNTRIES FOUND THAT HOLE; THE ENTRY COUNT HAD HIDDEN IT. THE LAND AFFAIRS DIRECTORATE RUNS SEVENTEEN REGISTRY SECRETARIATS ACROSS THE GOVERNORATES AND DISTRICTS, AND PUBLISHES THE ADDRESS AND CONTACT DETAILS OF EVERY ONE AND OF ITS STAFF. ONE LINE ABOUT HOW IT WORKS IS WORTH MORE THAN THE REST: THE REGISTRAR IS THE HIGHEST AUTHORITY IN THE SECRETARIAT, IS PERSONALLY AND SOLELY RESPONSIBLE FOR DECISIONS ON ALL PROPERTY OPERATIONS, AND IS THE ONLY PERSON WHO CAN ACCEPT OR REFUSE ANY OPERATION OR REQUEST ACCORDING TO LAW. ONE NAMED OFFICIAL DECIDES — NOT A COMMITTEE, NOT A QUEUE. Write to that person, by name, and keep the reply. THE SERVICE MOST COMMUNITIES DO NOT KNOW EXISTS IS IN THE PUBLISHED FEE LIST: PLACING A MARKER ON THE PROPERTY PAGE, AND LIFTING ONE, ARE LISTED AND PRICED TRANSACTIONS ALONGSIDE SALE, SUBDIVISION AND PARTITION. A MARKER REGISTERED ON THE PROPERTY PAGE IS HOW A CLAIM, A DISPUTE OR A RESTRICTION BECOMES VISIBLE TO EVERY FUTURE BUYER, LENDER AND NOTARY. IT IS THE CHEAPEST WAY TO MAKE A CONTESTED PARCEL DIFFICULT TO TRADE QUIETLY — and the fee is published, so the cost is knowable before you ask. TWO FEATURES MAKE THIS USABLE FROM A VILLAGE RATHER THAN ONLY FROM THE CAPITAL. THE DIRECTORATE PUBLISHES THE TIME LIMITS FOR COMPLETING TRANSACTIONS AND A MODEL APPLICATION FORM FOR A PROPERTY CERTIFICATE — SO A DELAY CAN BE MEASURED AGAINST THE STATED PERIOD RATHER THAN ENDURED. AND THE PROPERTY PAGE CAN BE REQUESTED, AND A PAPER COPY COLLECTED, THROUGH A MONEY-TRANSFER COMPANY'S BRANCH NETWORK, giving the governorate, district, cadastral zone, property number, section and block. THAT LAST POINT IS THE PRACTICAL BREAKTHROUGH: THE RECORD CAN BE OBTAINED AT A SHOPFRONT IN YOUR OWN TOWN. GET THE CADASTRAL IDENTIFIERS FOR THE PARCEL YOU ARE WATCHING — zone, number, section, block — because everything in this system is keyed to them. THE SITE ALSO CARRIES FORMS FOR EVERY DOCUMENT REQUIRED FOR ANY TRANSACTION, AND A ROUTE TO COMPLAIN ABOUT ANY EMPLOYEE. AND NOTE THE HARD REQUIREMENT THAT MAKES THIS UNAVOIDABLE: COMPLETING ANY PROPERTY TRANSACTION IN OFFICIAL DEPARTMENTS REQUIRES THE OFFICIAL PROPERTY CERTIFICATE ISSUED BY THIS DIRECTORATE — so a developer's paperwork must pass through here too, and what it says is checkable. THE LIMITS: this is a registrar, not an advocate — it records rights and will not adjudicate a competing claim, which is court work, and the legal routes recorded separately for this country are where that goes. Registering a marker has legal consequences and should be done with advice, not casually. Fees are payable at the finance treasury of the relevant governorate. Published turnaround times and service availability have been affected by the country's financial crisis and were not verified in this round.

trackers.name: Environment ministry impact assessment — the authorised-consultant list, and what counts as environment
trackers.desc: THE MOST IMMEDIATELY USABLE THING HERE IS A LIST. A MINISTERIAL DECISION DESIGNATES THE COMPANIES AUTHORISED TO PREPARE ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT ASSESSMENTS AND INITIAL ENVIRONMENTAL EXAMINATIONS — SO WHEN A DEVELOPER PRODUCES A STUDY, THE FIRST QUESTION IS WHETHER THE FIRM THAT WROTE IT APPEARS ON THAT LIST. A study by an unauthorised consultant is a defect in the paperwork before anyone argues about its contents. THE SYSTEM HAS TWO INSTRUMENTS, AND KNOWING WHICH APPLIES DECIDES WHAT YOU CAN DEMAND: AN INITIAL ENVIRONMENTAL EXAMINATION, AND A FULL ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT ASSESSMENT. Both come from a 2012 decree that covers PUBLIC AND PRIVATE PROJECTS ALIKE and is aimed at avoiding significant environmental consequences AT CONSTRUCTION, DURING OPERATION AND AT DISMANTLING — that third stage is one communities routinely forget to raise. AND THE DEFINITION OF ENVIRONMENT IS WIDER THAN ALMOST ANYONE ASSUMES: IT EXPRESSLY INCLUDES THE SOCIAL ENVIRONMENT ALONGSIDE THE PHYSICAL, CHEMICAL AND BIOLOGICAL ONE, matching the definition in the environment protection law. SOCIAL IMPACT IS INSIDE THE SCOPE OF THE ASSESSMENT, NOT OUTSIDE IT. Displacement, loss of livelihood, severance of a village from its land — these are assessable effects under the decree's own definition, and objections framed that way are not off-topic. HOW A PROJECT ENTERS THE SYSTEM IS WORTH TRACKING BECAUSE IT SHOWS WHERE TO ASK: THE OWNER APPLIES TO THE COMPETENT OFFICIAL ADMINISTRATION FOR A CLASSIFICATION STATEMENT ON AN APPROVED FORM, AND THAT ADMINISTRATION REGISTERS THE REQUEST AND REFERS IT TO THE ENVIRONMENT MINISTRY — except where the matter falls to industrial licensing committees or the governorate health councils. IF YOU CANNOT GET AN ANSWER FROM ONE BODY, THE CLASSIFICATION REQUEST WAS REGISTERED WITH ANOTHER, AND THAT REGISTRATION IS A RECORD. TWO PRECEDENTS FROM PRACTICE ARE WORTH CARRYING INTO ANY ARGUMENT. FIRST, A MINISTER REQUESTED AN INITIAL EXAMINATION EVEN WHERE THE BODY BEHIND THE WORKS CLAIMED IT WAS GOVERNED BY ITS OWN SPECIAL LEGISLATION — the claim of exemption did not end the matter. SECOND, WHEN LEGAL OPINIONS CONFLICTED ON WHETHER A FULL ASSESSMENT WAS REQUIRED, THE QUESTION WAS REFERRED TO THE STATE'S LEGISLATION AND CONSULTATIONS AUTHORITY — AND THE ARGUMENT FOR REQUIRING ONE WAS THAT THE PROJECT ABUTTED AN ENVIRONMENTAL RESERVE, A SENSITIVE AREA. ADJACENCY TO A PROTECTED SITE IS ITSELF A GROUND FOR DEMANDING THE FULL ASSESSMENT, and where opinions differ there is a named body that settles the question. THE MINISTRY ALSO PUBLISHES THE DECREE, THE REVIEW MECHANISM FOR EXAMINATION REPORTS AND THE FEE CIRCULAR, SO THE PROCEDURE AND ITS COSTS ARE READABLE BEFORE YOU ENGAGE WITH IT. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE SERIOUS. INDEPENDENT LEGAL COMMENTARY IN THIS COUNTRY HAS QUESTIONED WHETHER ASSESSMENT FUNCTIONS AS PROTECTION OR AS MANAGEMENT OF DAMAGE, and has documented the ministry being sidelined in practice; this entry records the tool, not a guarantee that it works. Nothing here obliges the ministry to refuse a project. Public consultation arrangements under the decree were NOT VERIFIED in this round. Read it with the environmental NGO umbrella and the legal routes recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Million-tree planting for wages — paid forestry work, and the trained network it leaves behind
trackers.desc: EVERY PLANTING PROGRAMME RECORDED IN THIS FILE SO FAR HAS ASKED FOR VOLUNTEERS. THIS ONE PAYS. A FOOD-AGENCY INITIATIVE WITH PARTNERS SET OUT TO PLANT MORE THAN A MILLION TREES WHILE BRINGING LEBANESE AND SYRIAN REFUGEES TOGETHER AND HELPING THEM EARN INCOME — IN A COUNTRY THEN IN ITS THIRD YEAR OF SEVERE ECONOMIC COLLAPSE, WITH FORTY-SIX PER CENT OF PEOPLE FOOD INSECURE. PLANTING AS PAID WORK IS WHAT MAKES REFORESTATION SURVIVE WHERE NOBODY CAN AFFORD UNPAID DAYS. A COMMUNITY PROPOSING TO RESTORE GROUND IN A POOR AREA SHOULD LOOK FIRST FOR THE FOOD-SECURITY AND CASH-FOR-WORK BUDGETS RATHER THAN THE ENVIRONMENTAL ONES — this file has now found labour-intensive works funded as employment in four countries, and the trees are incidental to the funder but permanent on the ground. WHO DID THE WORK MATTERS AS MUCH AS THE COUNT: MORE THAN FIVE THOUSAND SEVEN HUNDRED OF THE PARTICIPANTS WERE WOMEN, AND FOR MANY OF THEM IT WAS THE FIRST TIME THEY HAD PLANTED ANYTHING OR DONE ANY FORESTRY WORK AT ALL. ONE PARTICIPANT DESCRIBES WORKING AMONG A HUNDRED MEN, THE GROUP COMING TO FEEL LIKE A FAMILY, AND THE PARTICIPANTS STAYING IN TOUCH AFTER THE PROJECT ENDED, CALLING EACH OTHER AT THE FEAST TO CHECK IN. THAT IS THE PART TO PLAN FOR DELIBERATELY. A PAID PLANTING SEASON LEAVES BEHIND A TRAINED AND CONNECTED GROUP OF PEOPLE WHO NOW KNOW HOW TO PLANT, WHERE THE SITES ARE, AND EACH OTHER. THE NETWORK OUTLASTS THE PROJECT AND IS WORTH MORE THAN THE SEEDLINGS — so keep the list of participants, and keep meeting after the money stops. AND HERE ARE THE FOREST NUMBERS TO HAVE BEFORE ANY ARGUMENT ABOUT CLEARING GROUND. FORESTS COVER ABOUT ONE HUNDRED AND THIRTY-SEVEN THOUSAND HECTARES, SOME THIRTEEN PER CENT OF THE COUNTRY, WITH A FURTHER HUNDRED AND SIX THOUSAND HECTARES OF OTHER WOODED LAND, ABOUT TEN PER CENT — ROUGHLY TWENTY-THREE PER CENT IN ALL. FIFTY-SEVEN PER CENT OF THE COVER IS BROADLEAF, MAINLY OAK, AND THIRTY-ONE PER CENT CONIFERS. THE RATE COMPARISON IS THE SENTENCE TO USE: DEFORESTATION RUNS AT ABOUT NOUGHT POINT FOUR PER CENT A YEAR AGAINST REFORESTATION AT ABOUT NOUGHT POINT EIGHT THREE PER CENT, AGAINST A NATIONAL PLAN TO REACH TWENTY PER CENT FOREST COVER WITHIN TWENTY YEARS. A SCHEME THAT REMOVES WOODED GROUND IS THEREFORE MEASURABLE AGAINST A PUBLISHED NATIONAL TARGET, AND THE OTHER WOODED LAND CATEGORY MATTERS BECAUSE IT IS THE SCRUB AND OPEN WOODLAND THAT PLANNERS TREAT AS EMPTY. NOW THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE HEAVY. THE PROGRAMME ACCOUNT DATES FROM AN EARLIER PERIOD, AND THE COUNTRY IS UNDER WAR CONDITIONS IN 2026 WITH A NATIONAL RESPONSE PLAN IN FORCE: WHETHER THIS PLANTING PROGRAMME IS RUNNING NOW WAS NOT VERIFIED, and access, safety and funding priorities will govern everything. It is an aid programme, NOT A LAND-PROTECTION BODY — planting creates no right to object and no security of tenure. The forest figures come from an assessment now some years old. Read it with the environment ministry's assessment route, the conservation society and the crowdfunding platform recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Environmental network of around sixty organisations — one number for the whole country, and training for municipal work
trackers.desc: A COMMUNITY THAT DOES NOT KNOW WHICH ORGANISATION COVERS ITS DISTRICT USUALLY GUESSES, OR GIVES UP. HERE IS THE ALTERNATIVE: A LARGE NETWORK OF ENVIRONMENTAL ORGANISATIONS AND ASSOCIATIONS JOINING AROUND SIXTY NGOs FROM ALL OF THE COUNTRY, WITH A WIDE RANGE OF EXPERTISE — AND A SINGLE PUBLISHED TELEPHONE NUMBER. SIXTY ORGANISATIONS BEHIND ONE NUMBER. THAT IS THE MOST EFFICIENT FIRST CALL RECORDED FOR THIS COUNTRY: ASK THE NETWORK WHICH OF ITS MEMBERS WORKS IN YOUR AREA AND ON YOUR SUBJECT, RATHER THAN WRITING TO ORGANISATIONS ONE AT A TIME AND WAITING. ITS MISSION NAMES BOTH HALVES OF WHAT THIS MAP DEFENDS: PRESERVING THE COUNTRY'S NATURAL AND CULTURAL HERITAGE, BY ADVOCATING LOCAL COMMUNITIES TO WORK MORE ON PRESERVING IT. NATURAL AND CULTURAL TOGETHER MATTERS MORE THAN IT SOUNDS. GROUND UNDER THREAT IS OFTEN BOTH A HABITAT AND A PLACE PEOPLE HAVE USED FOR CENTURIES — A SPRING, A TERRACE SYSTEM, A GRAZING ROUTE, A SHRINE IN A WOOD. A BODY WHOSE REMIT COVERS BOTH CAN TAKE THE WHOLE CASE, WHERE A PURELY ECOLOGICAL ORGANISATION WOULD TAKE HALF OF IT. AND WHAT IT ACTUALLY DOES ON THE GROUND IS THE PART WORTH COPYING ANYWHERE. IT RAN A SERIES OF TRAININGS FOR YOUNG PEOPLE OF A NAMED TOWN ON MUNICIPAL WORK AND THE TASKS THEY COULD TAKE UP TO STRENGTHEN TRANSPARENCY IN THE COMING MUNICIPAL ELECTIONS — FRAMED AROUND THE ROLE OF YOUNG PEOPLE IN FIGHTING CORRUPTION AND STRENGTHENING PARTICIPATION IN MUNICIPAL WORK. AN ENVIRONMENTAL NETWORK TRAINING RESIDENTS FOR MUNICIPAL WORK IS LAND DEFENCE AT ITS ROOT. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED IN NINE COUNTRIES THAT MUNICIPALITIES DECIDE LAND USE — THEY ZONE, THEY LEASE, THEY PERMIT, THEY SELL. TEACHING PEOPLE TO CONTEST AND WATCH A MUNICIPAL ELECTION REACHES THE DECISION EARLIER THAN ANY OBJECTION FILED AFTERWARDS. SO THE INSTRUCTION IS TWO-PART AND BOTH HALVES ARE CHEAP: ASK THE NETWORK WHO COVERS YOUR AREA, AND ASK WHETHER IT WILL RUN ITS MUNICIPAL TRAINING IN YOUR TOWN. THE SECOND REQUEST IS FOR SOMETHING THE ORGANISATION ALREADY DOES, WHICH IS ALWAYS THE EASIEST THING TO GET. THE LIMITS: this is A NETWORK OF ASSOCIATIONS, NOT A LAW FIRM, A FUNDER OR A REGULATOR — it convenes, trains and advocates, and it will not litigate for you. WHICH SIXTY ORGANISATIONS BELONG TO IT, AND WHICH REMAIN ACTIVE, WERE NOT VERIFIED, and the membership description comes from a civil society directory rather than a current member list. The country is in its third year of severe economic deterioration and has been at war, both of which affect what any organisation can currently deliver. Read it with the paid planting programme, the environment ministry's assessment route and the crowdfunding platform recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: The two bar associations — which one covers your governorate, and the rule that lets you check any lawyer
trackers.desc: BEFORE PAYING ANY LAWYER, A COMMUNITY NEEDS TO KNOW THE PERSON IS ACTUALLY ENTITLED TO ACT. IN THIS COUNTRY THAT CHECK IS UNUSUALLY SIMPLE, BECAUSE THERE ARE ONLY TWO BAR ASSOCIATIONS AND MEMBERSHIP IS BOTH COMPULSORY AND EXCLUSIVE. NO ONE MAY PRACTISE LAW HERE UNLESS THEIR NAME IS REGISTERED IN ONE OF THE TWO BARS. AND NO ADVOCATE MAY BE REGISTERED IN BOTH OF THEM, OR IN ONE OF THEM AND A FOREIGN BAR AT THE SAME TIME. SO THERE ARE ONLY TWO REGISTERS TO CHECK, AND THE ANSWER IS BINARY. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED IMPERSONATION UNITS AND FAKE-LAWYER WARNINGS IN THREE OTHER COUNTRIES; HERE THE VERIFICATION COSTS ONE TELEPHONE CALL, AND THE EXCLUSIVITY RULE MEANS ANYONE CLAIMING MEMBERSHIP OF BOTH IS MISREPRESENTING THEMSELVES. WHICH BAR TO CALL DEPENDS ON GEOGRAPHY, AND THE DIVISION IS PRECISE: ADVOCATES WHO KEEP THEIR OFFICES IN ALL THE GOVERNORATES EXCEPT THE NORTHERN ONE ARE REGISTERED IN THE CAPITAL'S BAR, WHILE THOSE WITH OFFICES IN THE NORTHERN GOVERNORATE ARE REGISTERED IN THE BAR OF THE SECOND CITY. THAT MATTERS PRACTICALLY FOR ANY COMMUNITY IN THE NORTH: THE BAR THAT SERVES YOU IS NOT THE ONE IN THE CAPITAL. GOING TO THE WRONG BODY WASTES WEEKS, AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED COMMUNITIES LOSING TIME EXACTLY THAT WAY IN FOUR OTHER COUNTRIES. THE PROFESSION'S OWN DEFINITION IS WORTH QUOTING WHEN INSTRUCTING SOMEONE. LEGAL PRACTICE IS DIRECTED AT ACHIEVING THE MESSAGE OF JUSTICE BY GIVING LEGAL OPINION AND DEFENDING RIGHTS — AND AN ADVOCATE IS NOT BOUND TO FOLLOW THE CLIENT'S INSTRUCTIONS EXCEPT SO FAR AS THEY ACCORD WITH CONSCIENCE AND WITH THE CLIENT'S INTEREST. THAT SECOND CLAUSE CUTS BOTH WAYS AND SHOULD BE UNDERSTOOD BEFORE A DISPUTE ARISES: YOUR LAWYER MAY DECLINE TO DO WHAT YOU ASK IF THEY JUDGE IT AGAINST YOUR INTEREST. SO AGREE THE STRATEGY IN WRITING AT THE OUTSET, AND ASK WHAT THEY WILL NOT DO. TWO STRUCTURAL FACTS ARE WORTH KNOWING WHEN MONEY IS DISCUSSED. EACH OF THE TWO BARS HAS A MUTUAL AID FUND ESTABLISHED BY STATUTE, AND BOTH HAVE RETIREMENT FUNDS; AND A PROPORTIONAL FEE IS COLLECTED FOR THE BARS UNDER A PUBLISHED DECISION. A PROPORTIONAL FEE COLLECTED FOR THE BAR MEANS PART OF WHAT YOU PAY IS FIXED BY RULE RATHER THAN NEGOTIATION. ASK FOR THE FEE TO BE BROKEN DOWN — WHAT IS THE ADVOCATE'S, WHAT IS THE BAR'S, AND WHAT IS COURT COST. A COMMUNITY THAT UNDERSTANDS THAT SPLIT IS FAR HARDER TO OVERCHARGE. ONE CORRECTION TO ANYTHING YOU READ ELSEWHERE IN THIS FILE: THE CAPITAL'S BAR DOES OPERATE A JUDICIAL AID SCHEME, RECORDED SEPARATELY HERE ALONG WITH WHY IT UNDERPERFORMS. WHAT IS NOT ESTABLISHED IS WHETHER THE SECOND CITY'S BAR RUNS AN EQUIVALENT — SO A NORTHERN COMMUNITY SHOULD ASK ITS OWN BAR DIRECTLY RATHER THAN ASSUMING EITHER WAY. THE LIMITS: this is THE STRUCTURE OF THE PROFESSION, NOT ITSELF A LEGAL AID SERVICE, AND NOTHING IN IT OBLIGES ANY ADVOCATE TO TAKE A CASE. The framework comes from a justice ministry information page citing statutes of 1966 to 1996 and may have been amended. The country is in severe economic crisis and has been at war, which affects fees, availability and court timetables. Read it with the environmental network of sixty organisations, the paid planting programme and the crowdfunding platform recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Reforestation NGO and its seed laboratory — 320,000 native trees planted and protected, and nurseries that sell hardy native stock
trackers.desc: THE WORD THAT MATTERS IN THIS ORGANISATION'S OWN DESCRIPTION IS THE THIRD ONE: IT HAS PLANTED, NURTURED AND PROTECTED MORE THAN THREE HUNDRED AND TWENTY THOUSAND NATIVE TREES IN NEWLY PLANTED FORESTS ACROSS THE COUNTRY. PLANTED, NURTURED AND PROTECTED. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED PLANTING SCHEMES IN A DOZEN COUNTRIES AND ALMOST NONE OF THEM SAY WHAT HAPPENS AFTER THE PHOTOGRAPH. ASK ANY BODY OFFERING YOU SEEDLINGS THE SAME QUESTION: WHO WATERS THEM IN YEAR TWO, AND WHO FENCES THEM AGAINST GRAZING? AN ORGANISATION THAT NAMES NURTURE AND PROTECTION AS PART OF ITS WORK IS ANSWERING IT. IT IS AN NGO ESTABLISHED IN 2008 WITH A REGISTRATION NUMBER, WHOSE MISSION IS TO PARTICIPATE IN RESTORING THE COUNTRY'S WOODLAND AND TO PROMOTE SUSTAINABLE REFORESTATION — AND IT SITS IN A LINE GOING BACK TO THE FIRST REFORESTATION ORGANISATION IN THE COUNTRY, FOUNDED IN 1934. THE TECHNICAL ASSET IS THE ONE TO ASK ABOUT: IT RUNS A SEED GERMINATION AND CONSERVATION LABORATORY IN PARTNERSHIP WITH A UNIVERSITY. A GERMINATION AND CONSERVATION LABORATORY MEANS SEED CAN BE TESTED AND STORED RATHER THAN GUESSED AT. THIS FILE HAS TOLD COMMUNITIES REPEATEDLY TO TEST VIABILITY BEFORE ACCEPTING SEED AND TO ASK WHERE PROVENANCE COMES FROM — HERE IS A LABORATORY THAT CAN ANSWER BOTH, AND ONE ATTACHED TO A UNIVERSITY RATHER THAN TO A CONTRACTOR. ITS NAMED PROJECT SHOWS WHAT SCALE AND WHAT PARTNERS ARE POSSIBLE: MORE THAN TEN THOUSAND TREES — CEDAR, CAROB, WILD ALMOND, LAUREL AND OAK AMONG THEM — PLANTED WITH THE HELP OF THE ARMY AND OF INTERNATIONAL FORCES ON A SITE OF ABOUT THREE HUNDRED AND FIFTY THOUSAND SQUARE METRES IN A SOUTHERN TOWN. THE ARMY AS A PLANTING PARTNER IS WORTH NOTING PRECISELY BECAUSE IT IS UNGLAMOROUS: IT SUPPLIES LABOUR, TRANSPORT AND ACCESS TO GROUND THAT CIVILIANS CANNOT EASILY REACH, AND ITS INVOLVEMENT MAKES A PLANTING UNCONTROVERSIAL IN A CONTESTED AREA. AND THERE IS A PLACE TO BUY STOCK. A CEDAR FOREST FRIENDS COMMITTEE UPGRADED ITS NATIVE-ORIGIN TREE NURSERY — BETTER CONTAINERS, GREENHOUSES AND IRRIGATION, AND BETTER SEED PREPARATION, PLANTING, STORAGE, TRANSPORT AND PLANNING — PRODUCING HARDY SEEDLINGS WITH STRONG ROOTS THAT SURVIVE BEING PLANTED, AND IT SELLS SEEDLINGS FROM ITS NURSERIES TO ORGANISATIONS PLANTING IN THE AREA. ROOT QUALITY IS THE WHOLE GAME IN DRY-SUMMER COUNTRIES, AND IT IS SET IN THE NURSERY, NOT ON THE HILLSIDE. ASK WHAT CONTAINER THE SEEDLINGS WERE GROWN IN AND HOW OLD THEY ARE BEFORE ACCEPTING A DONATION OF STOCK — CHEAP SEEDLINGS WITH SPIRALLED ROOTS DIE IN THE SECOND SUMMER AND TAKE THE VOLUNTEERS' MORALE WITH THEM. THE LIMITS: this is A REFORESTATION AND EDUCATION ORGANISATION, NOT AN ADVOCATE, A FUNDER OR A LITIGATOR — it restores woodland, IT WILL NOT OPPOSE A DEVELOPMENT, and planting on ground you do not control secures nothing by itself. THE PLANTING FIGURE AND THE LABORATORY PARTNERSHIP COME FROM THE ORGANISATION'S OWN PAGES DATED SEVERAL YEARS AGO, and current capacity was not verified; the nursery sales description comes from OLDER COVERAGE OF A DIFFERENT COMMITTEE. The country is in severe economic crisis and has been at war, which affects every organisation recorded for it. Read it with the environmental network of sixty organisations, the paid planting programme, the crowdfunding platform and the two bar associations recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: National NGO with centres in every region — needs assessment, natural biopesticides and waste sorting, plus the farm infrastructure grant call
trackers.desc: THE MOST USEFUL THING ABOUT THIS ORGANISATION IS ITS METHOD, NOT ITS SIZE. ITS STRATEGY BEGINS WITH COMMUNITY WORK, DEFINED AS THE ASSESSMENT OF COMMUNITY NEEDS, AND RUNS THROUGH SERVICE-PROVIDING INSTITUTIONS THAT OFFER SPECIALISED SERVICES WITH AND FOR BENEFICIARIES. AN ORGANISATION THAT STARTS BY ASSESSING WHAT A COMMUNITY SAYS IT NEEDS IS ONE A VILLAGE CAN APPROACH WITHOUT A PROPOSAL ALREADY WRITTEN. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED MANY BODIES THAT ARRIVE WITH A PROGRAMME AND LOOK FOR SOMEWHERE TO PUT IT; THE ASSESSMENT-FIRST METHOD IS THE OPPOSITE, AND IT IS THE ONE WORTH SEEKING OUT. IT RUNS NINE PROGRAMMES — AGRICULTURE, ENVIRONMENT, MOBILITY, HEALTH, RESPONSIBLE TOURISM, CULTURAL, SOCIAL SUPPORT, YOUTH EMPOWERMENT AND EMPLOYMENT — FROM CENTRES DISTRIBUTED ACROSS ALL THE COUNTRY'S REGIONS, AND IT IS CERTIFIED TO AN INTERNATIONAL PROJECT-MANAGEMENT STANDARD. CENTRES IN EVERY REGION MEANS THERE IS ONE NEAR YOU, AND NINE PROGRAMMES MEANS A REQUEST DOES NOT HAVE TO BE FRAMED AS ENVIRONMENTAL TO BE HEARD — THE SAME BODY HANDLES EMPLOYMENT, MOBILITY AND SOCIAL SUPPORT, WHICH IS OFTEN THE HONEST DESCRIPTION OF WHAT A COMMUNITY LOSING ITS LAND ACTUALLY NEEDS. ITS LAND WORK IS PRACTICAL AND UNUSUAL. IT MANAGES AN ESTATE OF TWO AND A THIRD SQUARE KILOMETRES RUNNING NEARLY EXCLUSIVELY ON SOLAR ENERGY, USING FERTIGATION, AND IT IS THE ONLY PRODUCER OF NATURAL BIOPESTICIDES IN THE REGION. A DOMESTIC SOURCE OF NATURAL BIOPESTICIDES MATTERS WHERE IMPORTS ARE UNAFFORDABLE AND SPRAY DRIFT IS A RECURRING COMPLAINT — THIS FILE HAS RECORDED PESTICIDE DISPUTES IN SIX COUNTRIES, AND THE USUAL ANSWER IS THAT THERE IS NO ALTERNATIVE PRODUCT. HERE THERE IS ONE, MADE LOCALLY. IT ALSO RUNS SECONDARY WASTE SORTING CENTRES AND A NETWORK THAT TREATS MORE THAN EIGHTY PER CENT OF THE COUNTRY'S HOSPITAL WASTE, WHICH MADE IT A KEY PLAYER IN SHAPING THE NATIONAL WASTE MANAGEMENT STRATEGY — SO ON WASTE QUESTIONS IT IS BOTH AN OPERATOR AND A VOICE IN POLICY. AND THERE IS MONEY MOVING SEPARATELY THAT ANY FARMER SHOULD KNOW ABOUT: THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY AND A STATE GREEN PLAN, WITH AN INTERNATIONAL FOOD AGENCY AND EUROPEAN FUNDING, HAVE CALLED FOR APPLICATIONS FOR GRANTS TO INVEST IN AGRICULTURAL INFRASTRUCTURE, ENCOURAGING VULNERABLE FARMERS FROM ALL REGIONS TO APPLY. AGRICULTURAL INFRASTRUCTURE IS THE CATEGORY THAT COVERS THE THINGS THAT KEEP LAND USABLE — TERRACES, WATER RESERVOIRS, ACCESS TRACKS, RECLAMATION. A GRANT RATHER THAN A LOAN IS RARE IN THIS COUNTRY'S PRESENT ECONOMY, AND VULNERABLE FARMERS FROM ALL REGIONS IS AN UNUSUALLY OPEN ELIGIBILITY LINE — ASK THE GREEN PLAN OFFICE WHETHER A ROUND IS OPEN AND WHAT IT COUNTS AS INFRASTRUCTURE. THE LIMITS: this is A SERVICE-DELIVERING NGO, NOT AN ADVOCATE OR A LITIGATOR — IT WILL NOT OPPOSE A DEVELOPMENT, and its programme descriptions and the estate figures come from ITS OWN PAGES AND A PARTNER NETWORK PROFILE, several of the projects listed being years old. THE GRANT CALL IS FROM A PARTICULAR ROUND WITH ITS OWN DEADLINE AND MAY BE CLOSED — it is recorded as a recurring route rather than an open one. The country is in severe economic crisis and has been at war, which affects what any organisation can currently deliver and where it can reach. Read it with the environmental network of sixty organisations, the reforestation NGO and seed laboratory, the paid planting programme and the two bar associations recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Reforestation initiative and its native nursery cooperative — survival raised from a quarter to three quarters, paid forestry work, and municipal pine-nut revenue
trackers.desc: ONE PAIR OF NUMBERS IN THIS PROGRAMME'S RECORD IS WORTH MORE THAN EVERYTHING THIS FILE HAS WRITTEN ABOUT PLANTING: SEEDLING SURVIVAL AFTER THREE YEARS ROSE TO BETWEEN SEVENTY AND NINETY PER CENT, AGAINST A PREVIOUS NATIONAL AVERAGE OF ABOUT TWENTY-FIVE PER CENT. THAT IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A PLANTING DAY AND A FOREST. THREE QUARTERS OF THE TREES A COMMUNITY PLANTS SURVIVING, INSTEAD OF ONE QUARTER, IS NOT ENTHUSIASM — IT IS NURSERY TECHNIQUE, AND THE TECHNIQUE IS WRITTEN DOWN. THE PROGRAMME INTRODUCED ADVANCED GROWING CONTAINERS, GREENHOUSES AND IRRIGATION SYSTEMS TO NATIVE TREE NURSERIES, TOGETHER WITH DETAILED TECHNICAL PROCEDURE AND PROTOCOL MANUALS, AND PROVIDED EXTENSION SERVICES TO NURSERY MANAGERS ON BOTH TECHNICAL AND BUSINESS MANAGEMENT QUESTIONS. THEN IT DID THE THING THAT LASTS: IT HELPED THE NURSERY MANAGERS FORM THEIR OWN COOPERATIVE OF NATIVE TREE PRODUCERS, WHOSE NINE NURSERIES NOW GROW SEVERAL HUNDRED THOUSAND NATIVE SEEDLINGS A YEAR TO PUBLISHED FOREST SERVICE GUIDELINES. A COOPERATIVE OF NURSERIES IS A NATIONAL SEED AND SEEDLING SYSTEM OWNED BY THE GROWERS. IT MEANS A COMMUNITY ANYWHERE IN THE COUNTRY CAN BUY STOCK GROWN TO A KNOWN STANDARD RATHER THAN WHATEVER A CONTRACTOR DELIVERS — AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED CHEAP, ROOT-BOUND SEEDLINGS FAILING IN THEIR SECOND SUMMER ACROSS THE WHOLE REGION. SO THE TWO QUESTIONS TO ASK BEFORE ACCEPTING ANY DONATED TREES ARE: WHICH NURSERY GREW THEM, AND TO WHAT PROTOCOL. HERE BOTH HAVE ANSWERS. THE WORK IS PAID, WHICH MATTERS AS MUCH AS THE TREES: PLANTING, FOREST MANAGEMENT AND FIRE PREVENTION REACHED MORE THAN A HUNDRED AND FIFTY COMMUNITIES AND SUPPORTED THREE THOUSAND FAMILIES WITH SEASONAL WORK IN SIX MONTHS — TWELVE THOUSAND FAMILIES CUMULATIVELY — ACROSS MORE THAN THREE THOUSAND HECTARES OF MANAGED LAND. PAID SEASONAL FORESTRY WORK IS HOW RESTORATION SURVIVES A COLLAPSING ECONOMY. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED VOLUNTEER PLANTING SCHEMES THAT DIED WITH THEIR FUNDING; WAGES KEEP PEOPLE ON THE SITE THROUGH THE YEARS WHEN THE TREES ACTUALLY NEED TENDING. AND THERE IS A REVENUE MODEL WORTH COPYING EXACTLY: AT ONE SITE THE PLANTED PINES ALREADY SHADE PICNICKING FAMILIES, AND WHEN THE TREES REACH TEN YEARS THE MUNICIPALITY WILL LEAD THE HARVESTING OF PINE NUTS. A MUNICIPALITY WITH A HARVEST COMING IN TEN YEARS HAS A REASON TO PROTECT THAT HILLSIDE FROM FIRE, GRAZING AND DEVELOPMENT THAT NO CONSERVATION ARGUMENT SUPPLIES. THAT IS THE STRONGEST FORM OF PROTECTION RECORDED IN THIS FILE: MAKE THE LOCAL AUTHORITY THE BENEFICIARY. ON FIRE — THE THREAT THAT UNDOES RESTORATION IN AN AFTERNOON — IT RAN AN ADVOCACY PROJECT ON FOREST FIRE PREVENTION WITH LOCAL ADVOCATES IN MORE THAN FIFTY MUNICIPALITIES, AND LAUNCHED A FIRE PATROL PHONE APPLICATION FOR DETECTION AND EARLY WARNING. AND FOR YOUNG PEOPLE THERE IS A YOUTH CONSERVATION CORPS: SIX MONTHS OF LEADERSHIP DEVELOPMENT AND JOB-SKILLS TRAINING FOR EIGHTEEN TO TWENTY-FOUR YEAR OLDS, WHOSE PARTICIPANTS HAVE DONE REAL FIELD SCIENCE INCLUDING CAMERA-TRAP AND FOOTPRINT SURVEYS THAT CONFIRMED A RARE MAMMAL'S PRESENCE IN A NATURE RESERVE. THE LIMITS: this is A RESTORATION AND TRAINING ORGANISATION, NOT AN ADVOCATE AGAINST DEVELOPMENT — IT PLANTS, TRAINS AND PREVENTS FIRES, AND WILL NOT OPPOSE A QUARRY OR A ROAD. IT GREW FROM A FOREIGN GOVERNMENT PROGRAMME AND HAS DEPENDED ON FOREIGN FUNDING, WHICH IN THIS COUNTRY CARRIES POLITICAL ASSOCIATIONS AND IS VULNERABLE TO DONOR WITHDRAWAL. SEVERAL FIGURES COME FROM PROGRAMME REPORTING OF DIFFERENT YEARS AND DO NOT RECONCILE EXACTLY - the planting totals and hectares quoted are as reported at different dates - and the nursery cooperative's current membership and output were not verified. The country is in severe economic crisis and has been at war. Read it with the reforestation NGO and seed laboratory, the environmental network of sixty organisations, the national NGO with centres in every region and the two bar associations recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Regional crowdfunding platform — the all-or-nothing model, five per cent taken only from successful campaigns
trackers.desc: THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED GRANTS, LOANS, STATE FUNDS AND SUBSIDIES ACROSS TWENTY-THREE COUNTRIES AND NOT ONE WAY FOR ORDINARY PEOPLE TO RAISE MONEY FROM THE PUBLIC. THIS IS THAT ROUTE: A REGIONAL CROWDFUNDING PLATFORM, DESCRIBED AS THE ARAB WORLD'S LEADING ONE, BUILT ON THE ALL-OR-NOTHING MODEL. THE MECHANICS ARE THE PART TO UNDERSTAND BEFORE USING IT: THE CAMPAIGNER SETS A FUNDING TARGET AND A PERIOD OF UP TO ABOUT TWO MONTHS, AND IF THE TARGET IS NOT REACHED IN THAT TIME THE MONEY IS RETURNED TO THE DONORS. ALL-OR-NOTHING CUTS BOTH WAYS AND MOST FIRST-TIME CAMPAIGNS GET IT WRONG. IT PROTECTS DONORS, WHO RISK NOTHING IF THE CAMPAIGN FAILS — BUT IT MEANS A TARGET SET TOO HIGH RETURNS EVERY DINAR RAISED AND LEAVES THE GROUP WITH NOTHING. SET THE TARGET AT WHAT THE FIRST NECESSARY STEP COSTS, NOT AT THE FULL PRICE OF THE LAND. THE FEE IS STATED AND CONDITIONAL: THE PLATFORM TAKES FIVE PER CENT OF DONATIONS, AND ONLY FROM SUCCESSFUL PROJECTS — SO A FAILED CAMPAIGN COSTS THE ORGANISERS THEIR TIME RATHER THAN THEIR MONEY. IT IS REWARDS-BASED RATHER THAN DONATION-BASED: CAMPAIGNERS OFFER A BENEFIT MATCHING EACH PAYMENT LEVEL, WITH THE BENEFITS GROWING AS THE AMOUNT RISES. THAT SUITS A LAND CAMPAIGN BETTER THAN IT SOUNDS. A VILLAGE HAS THINGS TO OFFER THAT COST IT ALMOST NOTHING — A NAMED TREE, A SHARE OF THE HARVEST, A DAY AT THE SITE, A PLACE ON A PLAQUE — AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED REPEATEDLY THAT PEOPLE GIVE MORE WHEN THEY RECEIVE SOMETHING TIED TO THE PLACE ITSELF. TWO PRACTICAL LESSONS FROM HOW THESE PLATFORMS WORK. FIRST, THE RETURN-IF-UNMET RULE IS WHAT FORCES CONTINUOUS PROMOTION: A CAMPAIGN IS NOT A PAGE YOU POST, IT IS SIX WEEKS OF DAILY ASKING, AND GROUPS THAT TREAT IT OTHERWISE FAIL AT ABOUT THE HALFWAY MARK. SECOND, RESEARCH ON THE REGION FOUND THAT MIDDLE EASTERN CAMPAIGNS RECEIVED LOWER CONTRIBUTION RATES THAN COMPARABLE CAMPAIGNS ELSEWHERE — SO A GROUP HERE SHOULD PLAN FOR A DIASPORA AUDIENCE AND FOR PAYMENT METHODS THAT WORK ACROSS BORDERS, NOT ONLY FOR NEIGHBOURS. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE SERIOUS: THE DETAILED RULES DESCRIBED HERE COME FROM EXPLAINERS SEVERAL YEARS OLD, AND ALTHOUGH A 2026 COMPANY DATABASE STILL LISTS THE PLATFORM, ITS CURRENT OPERATING STATUS WAS NOT CONFIRMED — CHECK THAT IT IS LIVE, AND WHAT ITS FEE AND RULES ARE NOW, BEFORE PLANNING ANY CAMPAIGN AROUND IT. CROWDFUNDING IN THIS REGION ALSO RAISES REAL LEGAL QUESTIONS THIS ENTRY DOES NOT ANSWER: WHETHER A GROUP MAY LAWFULLY SOLICIT PUBLIC DONATIONS WITHOUT A PERMIT, HOW FOREIGN FUNDS ARE TREATED, AND WHO IS LIABLE FOR TAX vary by country and several countries in this payload restrict foreign funding of associations. RAISING MONEY PUBLICLY ALSO MAKES A CAMPAIGN VISIBLE, WHICH IS NOT ALWAYS SAFE. Read it with the national NGO with centres in every region, the reforestation initiative and nursery cooperative, the environmental network and the two bar associations recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Regional genebank — landraces and wild relatives held in trust, requestable by farmers under the Plant Treaty agreement
trackers.desc: THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED NURSERIES, SEEDLING HANDOUTS AND SEED PROGRAMMES ACROSS TWENTY-THREE COUNTRIES, BUT NEVER THE PLACE WHERE THE OLD VARIETIES THEMSELVES ARE KEPT. THIS IS THAT PLACE: A REGIONAL GENEBANK HOLDING CEREALS, FOOD LEGUMES AND THEIR WILD RELATIVES, WITH A HIGH PROPORTION OF LANDRACES AND WHAT IS DESCRIBED AS THE WORLD'S LARGEST COLLECTION OF CROP WILD RELATIVES FROM THE FERTILE CRESCENT. AND THE SENTENCE THAT MAKES IT A RESOURCE RATHER THAN A MUSEUM: THE MATERIAL IS HELD IN TRUST AS INTERNATIONAL PUBLIC GOODS, TO BE MADE AVAILABLE UPON REQUEST TO RESEARCHERS, PRIVATE INDIVIDUALS, GRADUATE STUDENTS, FARMERS AND OTHERS AROUND THE WORLD. FARMERS ARE NAMED IN THAT LIST. AND THE GENEBANK STATES THAT IT DISTRIBUTES AROUND SIX THOUSAND SAMPLES EVERY YEAR FOR RESEARCH, BREEDING AND EDUCATION AND FOR DIRECT USE BY FARMERS — SO ASKING IS NOT PRESUMPTUOUS, IT IS THE MECHANISM WORKING AS DESIGNED. WHY THIS MATTERS FOR LAND RATHER THAN ONLY FOR FARMING: WHEN A COMMUNITY LOSES ITS SEED — THROUGH WAR, DROUGHT, DISPLACEMENT OR ONE BAD YEAR — THE VARIETY ADAPTED TO ITS OWN SOIL AND RAINFALL USUALLY GOES WITH IT, AND WHAT COMES BACK IS COMMERCIAL SEED BRED FOR SOMEWHERE ELSE. A GENEBANK IS WHERE THE ADAPTED VARIETY CAN BE ASKED FOR BACK. THE PAPERWORK IS FIXED AND WORTH KNOWING BEFORE ASKING: EXCHANGE IS UNDER THE STANDARD MATERIAL TRANSFER AGREEMENT ADOPTED UNDER THE INTERNATIONAL TREATY ON PLANT GENETIC RESOURCES FOR FOOD AND AGRICULTURE, AND THAT AGREEMENT IS COMPULSORY TO ACCESS THE MATERIALS. THAT TREATY AGREEMENT IS ALSO A PROTECTION: MATERIAL RECEIVED UNDER IT CARRIES CONDITIONS ON WHAT RECIPIENTS MAY DO WITH IT, WHICH IS THE OPPOSITE OF THE PRIVATE SEED CONTRACTS THIS FILE HAS RECORDED ELSEWHERE THAT FORBID SAVING AND REPLANTING. FINDING WHAT EXISTS IS PUBLIC: PASSPORT DATA ARE AVAILABLE THROUGH A SEED REQUEST SYSTEM, A TRAIT-SEARCH APPLICATION AND A GLOBAL PORTAL WHERE ACCESSIONS FROM GENEBANKS AROUND THE WORLD CAN BE FOUND AND ORDERED. SO A COMMUNITY CAN SEARCH BY WHERE MATERIAL WAS COLLECTED. IF SEED WAS GATHERED FROM YOUR VALLEY DECADES AGO, IT MAY BE SITTING IN THAT DATABASE UNDER YOUR VILLAGE'S NAME — AND THAT SEARCH IS FREE AND CAN BE DONE FROM A PHONE. THE COLLECTION IS DELIBERATELY REDUNDANT: IT IS SAFETY-DUPLICATED IN PARTNER GENEBANKS OF OTHER INTERNATIONAL CENTRES AND IN TWO NATIONAL GENEBANKS, WITH A COPY SENT TO A GLOBAL SEED VAULT — AND THE COLLECTION ITSELF WAS MOVED OUT OF A NEIGHBOURING COUNTRY WHEN CONFLICT APPROACHED ITS ORIGINAL SITE. THAT HISTORY IS THE ARGUMENT FOR DEPOSITING, NOT ONLY REQUESTING. A VILLAGE VARIETY LODGED IN A SYSTEM WITH FOUR COPIES IN FOUR COUNTRIES SURVIVES THINGS THAT A SINGLE FAMILY'S SEED STORE DOES NOT — AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED SEED LOST TO EXACTLY THOSE EVENTS IN FOUR COUNTRIES. THERE IS ALSO AN ON-FARM SIDE: A COMMUNITY-DRIVEN APPROACH FOR PROMOTING IN-SITU AND ON-FARM CONSERVATION OF LANDRACES AND WILD RELATIVES IN NON-TROPICAL DRYLANDS — WHICH IS THE PROGRAMME TO ASK ABOUT IF A COMMUNITY WANTS ITS OWN VARIETIES CONSERVED WHERE THEY GROW RATHER THAN ONLY IN A FREEZER. THE LIMITS: A GENEBANK SENDS SMALL RESEARCH QUANTITIES, NOT PLANTING STOCK - GENEBANK PRACTICE TYPICALLY DISTRIBUTES ON THE ORDER OF FIFTY SEEDS PER ACCESSION, SO WHAT ARRIVES MUST BE MULTIPLIED OVER SEASONS BEFORE IT CAN FEED ANYONE, AND THAT TAKES LAND, SKILL AND TIME. REQUESTS MAY REQUIRE IMPORT PERMITS AND PHYTOSANITARY CERTIFICATES DEPENDING ON THE DESTINATION COUNTRY. THE DISTRIBUTION FIGURES AND ACCESS TERMS COME FROM THE CENTRE'S OWN PAGES AND A PUBLISHED REVIEW ARTICLE, AND SOME NEWS ITEMS CITED ARE SEVERAL YEARS OLD; the centre operates in a country in economic crisis and war has already forced one relocation of this collection. Read it with the reforestation initiative and its nursery cooperative, the seed germination and conservation laboratory, the national NGO with centres in every region and the crowdfunding platform recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Housing Monitor — report an eviction threat by phone or form, and a legal task force intervenes, negotiates or represents you
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE SIMPLEST THING IN THE WHOLE PAYLOAD: A NUMBER TO REPORT AN EVICTION THREAT TO, AND LAWYERS AT THE OTHER END OF IT. RESIDENTS REPORT BY A PUBLISHED PHONE AND MESSAGING NUMBER OR BY FILLING THE FORM THAT MATCHES THE VIOLATION — THE CATEGORIES INCLUDING EVICTION NOTICE, ACCUMULATED RENT AND DOLLARISATION OF RENT. WHAT HAPPENS NEXT IS NOT A LEAFLET. A RIGHT TO HOUSING LEGAL TASK FORCE INTERVENES DIRECTLY TO HELP RESIDENTS FILE A COMPLAINT OR CLAIM, OR TO NEGOTIATE WITH THE LANDLORD ON THEIR BEHALF — AND IN SOME CASES TO PROVIDE FULL LEGAL REPRESENTATION IN COURT. NEGOTIATING WITH THE LANDLORD ON THE TENANT'S BEHALF IS THE INTERVENTION THAT WORKS BEFORE ANYTHING IS FILED. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED THE SAME METHOD IN HUMANITARIAN LEGAL AID ELSEWHERE, AND IT IS THE ONE THING THAT REACHES THE PERSON ACTUALLY DOING THE EVICTING. THE OUTCOMES ARE PUBLISHED, WHICH IS RARE: SIX HUNDRED AND THREE REPORTS OF HOUSING INJUSTICE RECEIVED, OF WHICH FOUR HUNDRED AND SEVENTY-TWO WERE ANSWERED WITH TARGETED INTERVENTIONS, THE EVICTION OF NINETY-TWO HOUSEHOLDS PREVENTED AND BETTER HOUSING SECURITY NEGOTIATED FOR HUNDREDS MORE. NINETY-TWO HOUSEHOLDS KEPT IN THEIR HOMES IS A HARDER NUMBER THAN ANYTHING ELSE IN THIS PAYLOAD. IT ALSO SHOWS THE RATIO HONESTLY — NOT EVERY REPORT LEADS TO AN INTERVENTION, AND NOT EVERY INTERVENTION SAVES THE HOME. THE FOLLOW-UP IS THE PART OTHER SERVICES SKIP: THE MONITOR PERFORMS ROUTINE FOLLOW-UPS WITH CALLERS EVEN AFTER THE LEGAL INTERVENTION HAS HAPPENED, TO MAKE SURE THREATS ARE NOT RENEWED AND TO PREVENT NEW ONES — AND CASES THAT ENDED IN EVICTION CONTINUE TO RECEIVE LEGAL AND SOCIAL SUPPORT. ONE WORKED TACTIC IS WORTH CARRYING ANYWHERE THAT LANDLORDS CUT SERVICES TO FORCE PEOPLE OUT. WHERE A LANDLORD CUT OFF THE WATER, THE TWO OPTIONS WERE A PETITION BEFORE THE JUDGE OF SUMMARY PROCEEDINGS OR A COMPLAINT BEFORE THE PUBLIC PROSECUTION — AND BECAUSE THE SUMMARY COURT WAS RUNNING LATE, THE PENAL ROUTE WAS THE ONE RECOMMENDED. THAT IS THE PRACTICAL LESSON: CUTTING WATER OR POWER TO DRIVE SOMEBODY OUT IS USUALLY A CRIMINAL MATTER AS WELL AS A CIVIL ONE, AND THE CRIMINAL ROUTE CAN BE FASTER WHEN THE CIVIL COURTS ARE BLOCKED. ASK WHICH IS MOVING FASTER BEFORE CHOOSING. THERE IS ALSO AN ORGANISING LAYER, WHICH IS WHY THIS BELONGS IN A MAP ABOUT STOPPING PROJECTS RATHER THAN ONLY ABOUT RENT: THE MONITOR AIMS TO DEPLOY A NETWORK OF SOCIAL WORKERS IN NEIGHBOURHOODS TO IDENTIFY VULNERABILITIES LOCALLY AND ORGANISE NEIGHBOURHOOD MEETINGS THAT ARTICULATE COMMUNITY-BASED DEMANDS, AND IT WORKS WITH A GRASSROOTS NATIONAL COMMITTEE TO PROTECT THE RIGHT TO HOUSING AND TENANTS' RIGHTS TO MONITOR PRESSING EVICTION CASES AND FORM LINKAGES WITH LAWYERS. MOBILISING TENANTS AROUND SHARED GRIEVANCES IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A HUNDRED PRIVATE PROBLEMS AND ONE CAMPAIGN. WHERE A DEVELOPER IS CLEARING A WHOLE STREET, REPORT AS A STREET, NOT AS INDIVIDUALS. AND THE MONITOR PUBLISHES LEGAL MEMOS WRITTEN FOR RESIDENTS RATHER THAN LAWYERS — INCLUDING ONE AFTER A BUILDING COLLAPSE CRISIS SETTING OUT THE RIGHTS GUARANTEED AT EVERY STAGE OF EVICTION, FROM PRIOR NOTICE TO DIGNIFIED RELOCATION AND GUARANTEED RETURN. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A BEIRUT-CENTRED PROJECT OF A RESEARCH AND ADVOCACY STUDIO, NOT A NATIONAL LEGAL AID SERVICE - ITS NEIGHBOURHOOD WORK AND CASE LOAD ARE CONCENTRATED IN THE CAPITAL AND SOME NORTHERN CASES, AND CAPACITY DEPENDS ON PROJECT FUNDING IN A COLLAPSED ECONOMY. IT IS BUILT FOR TENANTS AND URBAN HOUSING RIGHTS: A RURAL COMMUNITY FACING A QUARRY OR A DAM IS NOT ITS CORE CASELOAD, THOUGH THE STUDIO'S WIDER WORK COVERS SPATIAL JUSTICE AND ENVIRONMENTAL RIGHTS. FULL COURT REPRESENTATION IS DESCRIBED AS EXCEPTIONAL RATHER THAN ROUTINE. SEVERAL FIGURES AND THE WORKED TACTIC COME FROM ITS OWN LEGAL REPORTS OF EARLIER YEARS and an award citation; the phone number and form categories are from its current pages but should be confirmed before relying on them. Read it with the studio's cadastral and planning work, the reforestation initiative's nursery cooperative, the regional genebank and the crowdfunding platform recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: European bank complaints mechanism — the only one with an outside ombudsman to appeal to, open to non-citizens
trackers.desc: FIVE OTHER DEVELOPMENT FINANCE COMPLAINT OFFICES IN THIS FILE END WITH THEMSELVES. THIS ONE DOES NOT: ON THE BASIS OF A MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING WITH THE EUROPEAN OMBUDSMAN, THE BANK HAS A TWO-TIER COMPLAINTS MECHANISM — AN INTERNAL DIVISION AND AN EXTERNAL OMBUDSMAN — WHICH IT DESCRIBES AS MAKING THE MECHANISM UNIQUE AMONGST MULTILATERAL DEVELOPMENT INSTITUTIONS. AN OUTSIDE BODY TO APPEAL TO IS THE THING EVERY OTHER MECHANISM LACKS. IF THE BANK'S OWN DIVISION BRUSHES A COMPLAINT ASIDE, THERE IS SOMEWHERE ELSE TO GO — AND CRUCIALLY, BOTH EU AND NON-EU CITIZENS MAY REFER THEIR COMPLAINT TO THAT OMBUDSMAN. WHO MAY COMPLAIN IS EQUALLY OPEN: ANY NATURAL OR LEGAL PERSON ALLEGING MALADMINISTRATION BY THE GROUP IN ITS DECISIONS, ACTIONS OR OMISSIONS — INDIVIDUALS, COMMUNITIES, CIVIL SOCIETY ORGANISATIONS AND OTHER INTERESTED PARTIES. AND MALADMINISTRATION IS BROADER THAN HARM: IT COVERS UNNECESSARY DELAY, REFUSAL TO PROVIDE ACCESS TO DOCUMENTS, POOR RECORD-KEEPING, DISCRIMINATION, FAILURE TO REPLY, CONFLICTS OF INTEREST, UNFAIR PROCEDURES, LACK OF TRANSPARENCY AND WEAK REASONING IN A DECISION — AND A COMPLAINT NEED NOT EXPOSE CORRUPTION TO BE VALID. REFUSAL TO PROVIDE ACCESS TO DOCUMENTS AND FAILURE TO REPLY ARE THE COMMONEST EXPERIENCES IN THIS ENTIRE FILE. HERE THEY ARE NOT PRELIMINARIES TO A COMPLAINT — THEY ARE THE COMPLAINT. THE CLOCK IS TIGHT AND UNUSUALLY DEFINED: COMPLAINTS MUST BE SUBMITTED WITHIN ONE YEAR FROM THE DATE WHEN THE ISSUES DESCRIBED COULD REASONABLY BE KNOWN. REASONABLY BE KNOWN, NOT WHEN THEY HAPPENED. FOR A VILLAGE THAT ONLY DISCOVERED A DOCUMENT OR A DECISION LATE, THAT WORDING IS THE ARGUMENT FOR ADMISSIBILITY — SO RECORD THE DATE YOU FOUND OUT AND HOW. THE CONFIDENTIALITY DEFAULT RUNS THE OPPOSITE WAY TO EVERY OTHER OFFICE HERE AND MUST BE HANDLED DELIBERATELY: FOR THE SAKE OF TRANSPARENCY, COMPLAINTS ARE CONSIDERED NON-CONFIDENTIAL, MEANING THE GROUP MAY DISCLOSE WHAT YOU COMMUNICATE TO THE PARTIES HANDLING IT — BUT COMPLAINANTS HAVE THE RIGHT TO INDICATE THAT THEIR COMPLAINT SHOULD BE TREATED CONFIDENTIALLY. SO SAY IT EXPLICITLY IN THE FIRST LINE IF YOU NEED IT. THERE IS ONE PROTECTION THAT APPLIES ANYWAY: REPORTS DO NOT DISCLOSE THE IDENTITY OF THE COMPLAINANT EVEN WHERE CONFIDENTIALITY WAS NOT REQUESTED — BUT THE CASE ITSELF, WITH A SUMMARY AND CONCLUSIONS, IS PUBLISHED UNLESS FULL CONFIDENTIALITY WAS ASKED FOR. ON SAFETY THE COMMITMENT IS SHORT AND WORTH QUOTING: THE GROUP IS BOUND TO ENSURE THAT COMPLAINANTS ARE NOT SUBJECT TO ANY FORM OF RETALIATION OR DISCRIMINATION FOR EXERCISING THEIR RIGHT TO COMPLAIN. THE PUBLISHED WEAKNESSES BELONG HERE TOO: ACCOUNTABILITY SPECIALISTS RECORD THAT THE MECHANISM'S REPORTING LINE IS NOT INDEPENDENT FROM BANK MANAGEMENT SINCE IT REPORTS TO THE INSPECTOR GENERAL, THAT IT DOES NOT GIVE REGULAR UPDATES ON ITS MONITORING OF AGREEMENTS AND RECOMMENDATIONS, AND THAT THE OMBUDSMAN'S RECOMMENDATIONS ARE NOT LEGALLY BINDING. SO THE APPEAL IS REAL BUT SOFT: THE OMBUDSMAN REVIEWS WHETHER THE MECHANISM ACTED FAIRLY AND IN LINE WITH ITS POLICIES, AND WHERE MALADMINISTRATION IS FOUND MAY RECOMMEND ACTION AND ASK THE INSTITUTION FOR AN OPINION WITHIN THREE MONTHS. USE IT FOR PRESSURE AND FOR THE RECORD, NOT FOR AN ORDER. THE LIMITS: THIS REACHES ONLY THIS BANK GROUP'S PROJECTS, POLICIES AND ACTIVITIES, AND IT JUDGES THE BANK'S ADMINISTRATION - NOT THE GOVERNMENT, THE CONTRACTOR OR THE HARM ITSELF. THE ONE-YEAR DEADLINE IS SHORTER THAN SEVERAL OTHER MECHANISMS RECORDED HERE, AND THE NON-CONFIDENTIAL DEFAULT IS THE OPPOSITE OF THEIRS - BOTH TRAPS FOR ANYONE ASSUMING THE OFFICES WORK ALIKE. THE POLICY WAS UNDER REVIEW FROM JUNE 2025, WENT TO PUBLIC CONSULTATION IN MARCH 2026 AND THE CONSULTATION CLOSED ON 19 MAY 2026 WITH SUBMISSIONS STILL BEING REVIEWED - SO THE RULES DESCRIBED ARE THOSE OF A POLICY NOW BEING REPLACED, and the revised version should be checked before filing. THE ACCOUNT COMES FROM THE BANK'S OWN PAGES AND POLICY DOCUMENT ALONGSIDE AN ACCOUNTABILITY TOOLKIT UPDATED IN JANUARY 2026 AND A GENERAL GUIDE TO OMBUDSMAN COMPLAINTS. Read it with the housing monitor's eviction reporting line, the reforestation initiative's nursery cooperative, the regional genebank and the crowdfunding platform recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Unions of municipalities — mayors' councils with legal personality that administer the common lands, and the joint units villages can share
trackers.desc: ONE PHRASE IN THE MUNICIPALITIES LAW MAKES THIS THE MOST IMPORTANT LOCAL BODY IN THE COUNTRY FOR ANYONE DEFENDING GROUND: AMONG A UNION'S TASKS IS ADMINISTERING THE COMMON LANDS - THE MASHA'A - LYING WITHIN THE UNION'S SCOPE, ALONGSIDE UNDERTAKING PUBLIC PROJECTS OF COMMON BENEFIT AND APPROVING ITS OWN BUDGET. COMMON LAND IS WHAT DISAPPEARS FIRST AND QUIETEST. KNOWING THAT A NAMED BODY ADMINISTERS IT - AND THAT THE BODY IS A COUNCIL OF YOUR OWN AND YOUR NEIGHBOURS' MAYORS - IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A GRIEVANCE AND AN ADDRESS. THE BODY IS SUBSTANTIAL: A UNION OF MUNICIPALITIES IS COMPOSED OF A NUMBER OF MUNICIPALITIES, ENJOYS LEGAL PERSONALITY AND FINANCIAL INDEPENDENCE, AND EXERCISES THE POWERS SET OUT IN THE MUNICIPALITIES LAW OF 1977 - AND ITS COUNCIL IS COMPOSED OF THE PRESIDENTS OF THE MEMBER MUNICIPALITIES. A COUNCIL MADE OF MAYORS IS A ROOM WHERE EVERY SEAT IS HELD BY SOMEBODY ELECTED IN A VILLAGE. A MUNICIPAL COUNCIL MAY ALSO, ON ITS PRESIDENT'S PROPOSAL, SEND ONE OF ITS OWN MEMBERS INSTEAD FOR THE UNION'S TERM - SO A VILLAGE THAT WANTS A PARTICULAR PERSON IN THAT ROOM HAS A ROUTE TO PUT THEM THERE. UNIONS CAN ALSO BE CREATED FROM BELOW: A UNION IS ESTABLISHED BY DECREE IN THE COUNCIL OF MINISTERS ON THE INTERIOR MINISTER'S PROPOSAL, EITHER ON HIS OWN INITIATIVE OR AT THE REQUEST OF THE MUNICIPALITIES. AT THE REQUEST OF THE MUNICIPALITIES MATTERS BECAUSE HUNDREDS ARE OUTSIDE ANY UNION: ONE COUNT RECORDS FIFTY-THREE UNIONS COMPRISING SIX HUNDRED AND TWENTY-SEVEN MUNICIPALITIES OUT OF MORE THAN A THOUSAND, LEAVING THREE HUNDRED AND EIGHTY-SIX INSIDE NO UNION AT ALL. IF YOUR VILLAGE IS ONE OF THOSE THREE HUNDRED AND EIGHTY-SIX, THE NEIGHBOURING VILLAGES FACING THE SAME QUARRY OR THE SAME RIVER CAN ASK FOR A UNION TO BE CREATED - AND THE COMMON LANDS BETWEEN THEM WOULD THEN HAVE AN ADMINISTRATOR ACCOUNTABLE TO THEIR OWN MAYORS. THE MONEY PROBLEM MUST BE UNDERSTOOD BEFORE ANY OF THIS IS ATTEMPTED: UNION REVENUES ARE EFFECTIVELY LIMITED TO THEIR SHARE OF THE INDEPENDENT MUNICIPAL FUND AND THE PROCEEDS OF SOME COMMON LANDS, THE STATE ALLOCATES NOTHING TO UNIONS IN ITS BUDGET, AND MEMBER MUNICIPALITIES MOSTLY ABSTAIN FROM CONTRIBUTING BECAUSE THEY HAVE LITTLE MONEY AND BECAUSE MANY UNIONS HAVE NO REAL JOINT PROJECTS. THE PROCEEDS OF SOME COMMON LANDS BEING A UNION'S OWN INCOME IS THE FACT TO WATCH IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. IT GIVES A CASH-STARVED UNION A REASON TO LEASE OR EXPLOIT THE MASHA'A - AND IT GIVES RESIDENTS A REASON TO ASK WHAT THOSE PROCEEDS WERE AND WHERE THEY WENT. AT THE SINGLE-VILLAGE LEVEL THE POWERS ARE BROAD: THE MUNICIPAL COUNCIL HAS COMPETENCE OVER EVERY WORK OF PUBLIC CHARACTER OR BENEFIT, MAY EXPRESS ITS RECOMMENDATIONS AND WISHES ON ALL SUBJECTS OF MUNICIPAL INTEREST AND MAKE OBSERVATIONS AND PROPOSALS ON PUBLIC NEEDS, AND MAY PLAN, STRAIGHTEN AND WIDEN ROADS, CREATE PUBLIC GARDENS AND SQUARES, AND ESTABLISH MARKETS, PARKS, PLAYGROUNDS, MUSEUMS, CLINICS, LIBRARIES, POPULAR HOUSING, SEWERS AND WASTE DISPOSAL FACILITIES. AND TWO OR THREE SMALL VILLAGES CAN SHARE WHAT NONE COULD AFFORD ALONE: ADMINISTRATIVE, FINANCIAL AND TECHNICAL UNITS, POLICE, GUARDS, FIRE AND AMBULANCE SERVICES MAY BE ESTABLISHED JOINTLY BETWEEN TWO OR MORE MUNICIPALITIES, WITH SHARED STAFF APPOINTED BETWEEN THEM. A SHARED MUNICIPAL GUARD OR FIRE UNIT IS THE CHEAPEST PROTECTION A CLUSTER OF VILLAGES CAN BUY - AND THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED FIRES AND ILLEGAL QUARRYING IN THIS COUNTRY THAT NOBODY LOCAL WAS EQUIPPED TO ANSWER. THE ENVIRONMENT MINISTRY IS ALSO CURRENTLY OPEN TO MUNICIPALITIES: IT OPENED A TRAINING COURSE FOR THEM ON ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT IN JANUARY 2026, MET A NAMED UNION AND SEVERAL OF ITS DEPARTMENT HEADS ABOUT WASTE PROBLEMS, AND PUBLISHED A DECISION ANNOUNCING CONTRIBUTIONS TO NON-PROFIT BODIES TO CARRY OUT ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES. THE LIMITS: UNIONS ARE CHRONICALLY UNDERFUNDED AND MANY EXIST ON PAPER WITH NO JOINT PROJECTS - THEIR OWN ANALYSTS SAY SO. THEY ARE ALSO CREATURES OF THE MUNICIPALITIES THAT COMPOSE THEM: WHERE THOSE MUNICIPALITIES WANT THE QUARRY OR THE LANDFILL, THE UNION IS ON THE OTHER SIDE FROM THE RESIDENTS, AND THE UNION'S ADMINISTRATION OF COMMON LAND IS ITSELF A ROUTE BY WHICH THAT LAND IS LEASED OUT. THE UNION AND MUNICIPALITY COUNTS DIFFER BETWEEN SOURCES - 53 UNIONS AND 627 MUNICIPALITIES IN ONE, 42 AND 598 IN ANOTHER - AND BOTH DATE FROM AROUND 2015, SO CURRENT FIGURES AFTER THE 2025 MUNICIPAL ELECTIONS WERE NOT ESTABLISHED. THE POWERS COME FROM THE 1977 LAW AS DESCRIBED IN A RESEARCH STUDY, A MAGAZINE ARTICLE, AN ARMY INFORMATION PAGE AND A BUSINESS NEWS ANALYSIS, NOT FROM THE TEXT ITSELF.
