CHECK WHICH BODY COVERS YOUR SITE TYPE BEFORE YOU FILE: responsibility for natural sites and natural assets was moved away from the culture ministry to the environment ministry's own conservation commissions, so a purely natural site may belong to a different council from a cultural one, and this entry does not establish the current division. Ask the regional council which one takes your application.

trackers.name: Doğa Koruma Merkezi — the outfit that maps which areas are conservation priorities, and will do it for your area
trackers.desc: WHAT THIS ORGANISATION CAN GIVE A CAMPAIGN IS A PRIORITY MAP THAT SOMEONE ELSE MADE. DKM brought Systematic Conservation Planning to Türkiye and has applied it across the Mediterranean, South-Eastern Anatolia, Black Sea and Aegean regions, the Lower Caucasus and the Anatolian Diagonal — the method exists to identify, from data rather than from argument, which areas must be conserved to hold a region's biodiversity. If your valley falls inside one of those analyses, the case that it matters has already been made by a body with standing, and you are citing rather than asserting. Ask them what their planning outputs say about your area before commissioning anything. WHAT ELSE IT HOLDS THAT IS DIRECTLY CITABLE: the Red Book of Butterflies of Türkiye, practitioner and planner guides for integrating biodiversity into forest management plans, and a post-fire guide to biodiversity-focused ecosystem restoration — the last matters because burnt ground is routinely reclassified and rebuilt, and a published restoration standard is what an objection to that needs. It also completed monitoring of how Mediterranean forest and maquis recovered after the fires, funded through a wildfire emergency fund. WHO: a foundation based in Ankara, operating since 2004 and formally constituted in 2012, IUCN member, part of Butterfly Conservation Europe and Climate Action Network Europe. THE HONEST LIMIT, AND IT IS THE SAME TEST THIS FILE APPLIED WHEN DECLINING A COMPARABLE BODY IN GEORGIA: no community-facing programme was found. DKM's published partners are the General Directorate of Forestry and the General Directorate of Nature Conservation and National Parks, and it describes developing alternatives to classical conservation in coordination with public and private sector partners — which is the language of an institutional adviser, not a campaigner. It is recorded here as a supplier of evidence and planning, on the same footing as ACBK in Kazakhstan and NACRES in Georgia, and not as a body that will oppose a project for you. For that in Türkiye, this file already carries Çevre Hukuku Ağı for lawyers and Doğa Derneği for the Key Nature Areas inventory.

trackers.name: Yeşil Artvin Derneği — took a mining licence to court with the provincial bar association and had it revoked outright
trackers.desc: THE THING TO COPY IS WHO THEY BROUGHT WITH THEM: the association went to court in 2005 TOGETHER WITH THE ARTVIN BAR ASSOCIATION to seek revocation of the Cerattepe mining licence. Operations were suspended in July 2005, the licence was revoked outright in October 2008, the company blockaded its tunnel and left, and the revocation was upheld by the Council of State. A provincial bar association joining as co-claimant is a different proposition from a village hiring a lawyer — it brings standing, institutional weight and counsel at once, and every Turkish province has one. Ask your baro to join, not merely to represent. THE SECOND TACTIC, ALSO DOCUMENTED: mass co-claimants. On 26 September 2013, 281 people filed to annul the environmental impact decision. Earlier, roughly ten thousand signatures were gathered and taken to Ankara by bus to be handed to the environment minister in person. AND THE PART THAT MUST BE READ ALONGSIDE THE WIN, BECAUSE THIS FILE WILL NOT SELL A VICTORY THAT DID NOT HOLD: they lost the second round. After the licence areas were retendered, a ten-thousand-strong demonstration in April 2013, sit-ins from May 2013 and a watch that ran continuously for 245 days were ended by police using tear gas and rubber bullets, with six people detained; mining companies now work the site. A revoked licence can be reissued under a new tender, and the association's own framing is that the fight did not end with the court win. WHAT THEY DO NOW, WHICH IS WHY THEY ARE A RESOURCE RATHER THAN A CASE STUDY: continuous work across Cerattepe, Yukarı Maden Köyü, Cankurtaran, Arhavi, Şavşat, Murgul, Yusufeli and Maçahel against mining, hydro and wind projects and forest clearance — site inspections, scientific reports prepared with academics, and litigation that has produced decisions at the Constitutional Court as well as the administrative courts. They also inspect and publish: after examining the Hod mine site they warned publicly that stream beds were being filled with waste rock, raising landslide and pollution risk. Chaired by Nur Neşe Karahan, with a board that includes the association's own lawyer. Contact info@yesilartvindernegi.org, telephone +90 466 212 70 80, Atatürk Caddesi, Artvin centre. SAFETY CONTEXT, STATED BECAUSE IT CHANGES WHAT IS SAFE TO DO: this association is listed on a human rights defenders platform, describes itself as having spent a year under heavy pressure, and its members have faced prosecution — in one instance for occupying forest land over a wooden watch hut built by the community. Expect the counter-suit as part of the terrain.

trackers.name: Sivil Toplum için Destek Vakfı — its project grant programme takes applications at any time, and the second year is where the match bites
trackers.desc: THE PROJECT GRANT PROGRAMME HAS NO APPLICATION WINDOW — organisations may apply whenever they like, and applications are considered at board meetings held roughly every two months. For a campaign that cannot time its need to a funding round, that is the whole point of this foundation. THE TRAP IS IN YEAR TWO, AND YOU SHOULD BUDGET FOR IT BEFORE YOU APPLY IN YEAR ONE: no co-financing is required on a first application, but where an organisation was supported by one of the foundation's programmes the previous year, a second-year application in the same frame carries an expected in-kind or cash match equal to the grant requested. Plan the match a year ahead or the follow-on will not happen. WHAT THE APPLICATION WANTS, so you can prepare it: the completed project programme form, detailed CVs for the two people who would be first-degree responsible for the work, a one-year budget for the organisational development you are proposing showing what you are asking the foundation for, and a detailed timetable. Downloadable form versions are published so you can draft offline. ONE BUDGET RULE THAT CATCHES COALITIONS: giving grants onward to third parties, cash support and scholarships are not eligible budget lines — you cannot use a grant to fund the smaller groups around you, though you can budget for the staff needed to run such support. Keep invoices for three years; the foundation may require a financial audit. Applications are assessed with independent experts, the advisory board, foundation members and the board. Contact kurumsal@siviltoplumdestek.org. THE HONEST LIMIT, AND IT IS SIGNIFICANT FOR THIS MAP: there is no standing environmental or land-defence fund here. The thematic funds published run to children's access after the earthquakes, organisational strengthening and human resources, and culture and arts — each with its own hard deadline and ceiling, so check the news page rather than assuming. Environmental money has come through one-off vehicles: a forest fires emergency fund, run with corporate and individual donors, financed Doğa Koruma Merkezi's monitoring of how Mediterranean forest and maquis recovered after the fires — that organisation is also in this file. So the realistic route for a land campaign is the general project or organisational programmes rather than a themed environment window. Note also that grants go to sivil toplum kuruluşları; an unincorporated village campaign will in practice need a registered association or foundation to apply, which is worth confirming with them before drafting.

trackers.name: Ekoloji Birliği — the federation of around eighty local resistance organisations, and it refuses company and state money by rule
trackers.desc: THE FOUNDING RULE IS WHY THIS IS WORTH JOINING RATHER THAN JUST READING: the ecology organisations that formed it decided to accept no material aid, support or donation from companies, from the official organs of the state other than municipalities, or from bodies that are extensions of either wearing an NGO's appearance — and not to draw on grant funds at all. A village facing a company-backed project can therefore be certain the federation cannot be bought out from under it, which is not something most environmental bodies can promise. Read that alongside the grantmaking foundation recorded elsewhere in this file: the two occupy deliberately opposite positions on funding, and a campaign may need both, from different directions. WHAT IT ACTUALLY IS: a union of local ecology organisations, not a head office. Formed at Eskişehir on 24-25 March 2018 by around fifty-five local organisations, after a process begun at Bergama in November 2017 by eleven convening groups; the founding declaration carried fifty-four signatures and by 2023 it reported around eighty component organisations across the country. Its main body is an assembly of all components meeting every six months, with an elected coordination between meetings, and it states organisational independence from political structures. IT CONVENES WHERE THE FIGHT IS — the 2023 assembly was held in Akbelen Forest, where resistance to a coal mine had by then run about two years — which is the practical offer: if your struggle is isolated, this is how eighty other organisations arrive at it. ONE WARNING FROM ITS OWN REPORTING THAT EVERY COMMUNITY SHOULD READ: at İkizköy, villagers objected that the energy company seeking to move their olive trees had set up an advisory board with the village headmen and signed a protocol with a nature conservation association. Expect the company to try to buy or borrow the legitimacy of a conservation body and of your own elected headmen, and to present the result as consent. Live campaign fronts include Akbelen and İkizköy against coal, and Gediz river pollution. THE HONEST CAVEATS: this is an avowedly oppositional and anti-capitalist formation by its own declaration, which may be a cost for a community that needs to work with a particular municipality or ministry, and it has been criticised from inside its own circles for forming some sub-assemblies from the top down rather than out of local need. It is a solidarity and mobilisation network, not a source of lawyers, money or land — for those this file carries Çevre Hukuku Ağı, the Sivil Toplum için Destek Vakfı and Yeşil Artvin Derneği's bar-association tactic. USE THE FEDERATION AS A DIRECTORY, NOT ONLY AS A MOVEMENT. Most of its member associations have no website at all, and the federation's own pages carry their court results and statements under each organisation's name — which makes it the practical way to find out whether a body already exists in your province and what it has won. A worked example: the environmental association in Ordu, which has no site of its own, appears there with a record that includes a stay of execution against its own metropolitan municipality's coastal landfill scheme granted with the route of objection closed, a regional appeal court finding the association right and the municipality at fault over shore filling, the annulment of zoning plans that blocked a hydroelectric scheme, and a challenge to an assessment-not-required decision for a bentonite mine. THREE THINGS FROM THAT RECORD ARE WORTH CARRYING WHEREVER YOU ARE. First, a municipality can lose twice and simply reapply: a fishing-shelter project that courts had annulled on two occasions came back with a fresh impact application, and the association's answer was to say plainly that it would sue again. Litigation against a determined public authority is a repeating obligation, not a single event. Second, winning and being obeyed are different things — that association states that cases it won over park projects are being ignored, which matches what this file has recorded in Istanbul and on the Black Sea. Third, and most usable: it organises ordinary residents to attend the court's on-site expert examination in numbers, arranging a minibus, a named meeting point and time, a convoy and advance registration. The expert examination is the stage where a case is effectively decided, access to the site can be obstructed, and turning up in numbers with the court's own expert panel present is something a community can do without a lawyer. Ask the federation which of its members covers your province, and ask that member when its next site examination falls.

trackers.name: KuzeyDoğa — it took a lake the villagers called a puddle to Ramsar status in five years, and the first step was counting birds
trackers.desc: THE SEQUENCE IS THE MOST USEFUL THING IN THIS ENTRY AND IT IS REPEATABLE ANYWHERE WITH A WETLAND: a first bird count in 2004 recorded more than forty thousand birds at Kuyucuk Lake; the report led to the lake being declared a Wildlife Development Area in 2005; continued research and local support led the national parks directorate to declare it Turkey's thirteenth Ramsar site in 2009, the first in Eastern Anatolia; a five-year management plan followed. Five years from a count to an internationally recognised designation. If you have an unprotected wetland, the count is the cheapest possible starting point and the national designation is the achievable intermediate step — do not attempt to jump straight to the international one. THE SECOND HALF OF WHY IT WORKED IS THE PART CAMPAIGNS USUALLY SKIP: when the work began, the people of the three villages around the lake regarded it as a puddle where animals drank. The organisation's own account is that it is now a bird area, an ecotourism site, a festival ground and a research and environmental education centre. The designation was made to pay the villages, and that is what made it hold. IT ALSO BUILT TURKEY'S FIRST WILDLIFE CORRIDOR, WHICH IS THE ANSWER WHEN YOUR PROBLEM IS FRAGMENTATION RATHER THAN A SINGLE SITE: a corridor reconnecting Sarıkamış forest with the Artvin and Şavşat forests, initiated in 2008, formalised by protocol with the ministry responsible for forestry in 2011 and implemented from 2012, with afforestation continued by the ministry itself — reported at some 162 kilometres and 28,500 hectares between Sarıkamış and Posof. A protocol with a ministry is a different instrument from an objection, and this is a body that has obtained one. Its other results include locating the Aras river bird area on the Kars-Iğdır border, where roughly half of Turkey's land vertebrate species have been recorded and which the ministry judged worthy of Nature Conservation Area status, and establishing a wildlife rehabilitation centre with Kafkas University. Founded in Kars in January 2008 out of a biodiversity project begun in 2003, with a named academic president; it works with volunteers and runs a bird ringing and education centre. THE LIMITS: it works in partnership with ministries and universities rather than against them, so it is not the body to front opposition to a state-backed scheme; it is regional, centred on Kars, Iğdır, Ardahan and Artvin; and it neither litigates, funds nor owns land. DOMAIN NOTE: an agency staging copy of this site is live at a fikirmedya subdomain and serves the same pages. Use kuzeydoga.net. Several of the figures above come from an interview published by a Turkish grantmaking foundation also recorded in this file rather than from the organisation's own pages; confirm them at source if quoting.

trackers.name: TMMOB Chamber of City Planners — it sues zoning plans and national regulations in its own name, and it has an office in your province
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE BODY THAT ACTUALLY BRINGS THE CASES, AND IT DOES SO IN ITS OWN NAME RATHER THAN NEEDING AN AFFECTED RESIDENT TO STAND UP. The Chamber describes its litigation as conducted within the framework of its constitutional powers against interventions in living spaces that are rent-driven and contrary to the public interest. For a community, that removes the problem that stops most objections: you do not have to find the neighbour who will put their name on a case. AND IT WINS AGAINST REGULATIONS, NOT ONLY INDIVIDUAL PLANS. A case it brought produced a stay of execution against a provisional article inserted into the national Planned Areas Zoning Regulation, the court accepting that the change conflicted with the requirement that minimum standards for urban social and technical infrastructure be observed when plans are made or altered; another produced a stay against parts of the Value Increase Share Regulation. If the rule being used against your neighbourhood is national, this is the body that attacks the rule itself. IT IS EVERYWHERE AND IT IS ACTIVE NOW: provincial representatives and branches file locally — in one eastern province in 2026 the Chamber's provincial representation challenged revision zoning plans covering roughly 500 hectares together with the Presidential Decision declaring the area an Urban Transformation and Development Project Area, seeking a stay first and annulment after, while the Chamber of Architects' branch in the same city sued over a separate plan change. Look up your provincial branch rather than writing to Ankara. Cases turn on court-appointed expert reports, and the Chamber pays the expert fee — in one Istanbul case the report found the plans contrary to urban planning principles, planning techniques and the public interest, which is the language that wins. NOW THE WARNING, AND IT IS THE MOST IMPORTANT THING HERE: WINNING DOES NOT NECESSARILY STOP THE BUILDING. On one Istanbul project beside a forest, zoning plans were annulled six times and the Chamber of Architects sued the seventh; the Council of State had earlier stayed a plan on the ground that it was prepared without detailed ground surveys despite earthquake risk. Construction continued regardless, the developer relying on a further revised plan. Expect the plan to be reissued in a new form after each annulment, and treat litigation as one front rather than the whole campaign — the same pattern this file recorded where a revoked mining licence was simply retendered. WHO: the Chamber of City Planners of the Union of Chambers of Turkish Engineers and Architects, publishing its active cases and their procedural history on its own site. Read with the Chamber of Architects, which litigates in parallel, and with the provincial bar association route recorded elsewhere in this file — a bar joining as co-claimant alongside a chamber is a formidable combination. ASK THE CHAMBERS FOR A REPORT ON YOUR SITE, BECAUSE THEY PRODUCE THEM AND THEY COVER EVERY DISCIPLINE AT ONCE. For a threatened lake in Burdur province the union of chambers produced a comprehensive study addressing the geological, meteorological, environmental AND LEGAL dimensions of the threat together — drought and drying, mining and quarrying, tourism pressure, and a construction scheme, in one document. A community that can hand a decision-maker a single report signed by engineers, planners and lawyers is in a different position from one presenting separate complaints, and this is the body that can assemble it. A CHAMBER EXPERT ALSO SPOKE AT THE PUBLIC WORKSHOP THAT LAUNCHED THAT CAMPAIGN, alongside an academic, an architect and the campaign's own lawyer — so the chambers will send people to a community event, not only file papers in Ankara. THE SEQUENCE THAT CAMPAIGN FOLLOWED IS WORTH COPYING EXACTLY, BECAUSE IT ENDS WITH SOMETHING THAT LASTS: residents met weekly; they instructed lawyers and lodged an objection seeking cancellation of the scheme, then brought a lawsuit; they formed a named platform; they held a public workshop with scientists and professionals and published its conclusions at a press event on the shore; and THEN, on a decision taken at that workshop to give the struggle continuity, they constituted a formal association. The association came last, not first. Meetings, objection, lawsuit and platform all happened before anyone registered anything — and the registered body existed to carry on what the platform had already started. Environmentalists from five neighbouring provinces attended that workshop and brought their own experience, which is how a local fight acquires people who have already lost or won one.TWO THINGS WERE NOT RECORDED HERE, AND BOTH CHANGE WHAT A COMMUNITY DOES WITH THIS CHAMBER. THE FIRST IS THE CLOCK. APPROVED PLANS ARE DISPLAYED FOR ONE MONTH, SIMULTANEOUSLY AT THE MUNICIPALITY'S NOTICE PLACES AND ON THE ADMINISTRATION'S WEBSITE, AND OBJECTIONS MAY BE MADE ONLY WITHIN THAT MONTH — SO SOMEBODY IN THE VILLAGE SHOULD BE CHECKING THE MUNICIPALITY'S WEBSITE WEEKLY, BECAUSE THE DISPLAY PERIOD IS WHAT EVERYTHING TURNS ON AND IT PASSES UNNOTICED WHERE NOBODY IS WATCHING. A RECENT EXAMPLE SHOWS WHAT THE CHAMBER DOES INSIDE THAT WINDOW: A PROVINCIAL REPRESENTATION OBJECTED TO A MASTER AND IMPLEMENTATION PLAN CHANGE FOR A BUS TERMINAL APPROVED BY A METROPOLITAN MUNICIPALITY IN 2026, ARGUING IT CONTRAVENED THE DEVELOPMENT LAW AND A NAMED ARTICLE OF THE SPATIAL PLANS MAKING REGULATION AND THAT THE PLAN SHOULD BE REASSESSED FOR INFRASTRUCTURE STANDARDS. AN OBJECTION WRITTEN BY PLANNERS CITES THE REGULATION BY ARTICLE NUMBER — THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A COMPLAINT AND A CASE. THE SECOND IS THE STAGE THAT USUALLY DECIDES A PLAN CASE: THE EXPERT PANEL REPORT, WHICH ASSESSES CONFORMITY WITH URBANISM PRINCIPLES, COMPATIBILITY WITH HIGHER-SCALE PLANS, THE PUBLIC INTEREST, PLANNING PRINCIPLES, GROUND CONDITIONS AND DISASTER RISK. AND HERE IS THE PART ALMOST NOBODY USES: PARTIES MAY OBJECT TO THAT REPORT, REQUEST AN ADDITIONAL REPORT OR A FRESH EXAMINATION, AND REQUEST EXPERTS WHOSE EXPERTISE MATCHES THE SUBJECT OF THE CASE. ASK FOR A HYDROGEOLOGIST WHERE THE ISSUE IS WATER, OR AN AGRONOMIST WHERE IT IS SOIL — A PANEL WITHOUT THE RIGHT SPECIALIST WILL NOT SEE THE HARM YOU ARE DESCRIBING, AND THE COURT LEANS HEAVILY ON WHAT THE PANEL WRITES. ONE FURTHER BODY WORTH KNOWING FROM THE SAME CASE LAW: A FEDERATION OF VILLAGE HEADMEN HAS BEEN NAMED ALONGSIDE PROFESSIONAL CHAMBERS AS ABLE TO CHALLENGE PLANS IN THE PUBLIC INTEREST — SO WHERE A VILLAGE'S OWN HEADMAN IS WILLING, HIS FEDERATION IS A SECOND ROUTE THAT DOES NOT DEPEND ON INDIVIDUALS PROVING PERSONAL LOSS.

trackers.name: ÇEHAV — the activist-lawyer formation that has fought the same power stations for thirty years, and drafts case petitions collectively
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE CLOSEST THING IN THIS ENTIRE REGION TO A STANDING POOL OF ANTI-DEVELOPMENT LAWYERS, AND IT IS ORGANISED SO THAT ONE COMMUNITY'S LAWYER IS NOT ALONE. Environment and Ecology Movement Lawyers formed in 2011, carrying on from the Izmir Environment Movement Lawyers of the 1990s — a lineage in which the legal fight against two lignite power stations begun in 1993 has now run for more than thirty years, most recently over the felling of the Akbelen forest. WHAT IT ACTUALLY DOES FOR ITS MEMBERS, IN A MEMBER'S OWN DESCRIPTION: lawyers answer each other's legal questions in solidarity, run case processes jointly, organise the bringing of cases against regulations, and DRAFT CASE PETITIONS TOGETHER. For a village lawyer facing a mining company's firm, a collectively drafted petition and a network that has litigated the same regulation elsewhere is the difference between a filing and a real case. It is deliberately non-hierarchical — a civil initiative of activist-lawyers rather than a bureaucratic body — and its members also sit on the national bar association's environment and urban law commission. THE MOST USEFUL THING IT HAS PUBLISHED IS A REFRAME THAT KEEPS COMMUNITIES IN THE FIGHT: losing an environmental case should not be treated as defeat, because bringing the case forces an environmental impact report you suspect was never properly examined to be INSPECTED AND AUDITED THROUGH THE COURT. Litigation as an audit mechanism rather than a win-or-lose gamble is what makes a long legal struggle survivable, and this file has recorded three Turkish cases where the paperwork was overturned and the machinery kept working. IT ALSO PRODUCES MATERIAL A COMMUNITY CAN USE WITHOUT A LAWYER: a member wrote a Guide for Citizens to Following the Environmental Impact Assessment Process, and the formation co-produces a regular radio programme and podcast on ecology cases in which its lawyers walk through disputes from different regions. Its members have authored reports on citizen lawsuits over a named mining struggle, on climate protection cases in Turkiye, and on the political ecology of mining. HOW TO REACH IT, AND THE HONEST PROBLEM: four separate attempts across this work found NO WEBSITE. It operates through its own public page and through its members' own practices. That is the contact point given here for want of any other, and it is a departure from this file's rule of recording only bodies with their own domain — made deliberately, because this is the single most on-target body for anyone seeking environmental lawyers in this region and four declines would have been a worse error than one flagged exception.

trackers.name: Ekoloji Kolektifi — it sues the regulations, and it killed the 24-hectare trick companies used to escape impact assessment
trackers.desc: THE SINGLE MOST USEFUL THING THIS ASSOCIATION HAS ESTABLISHED IS THAT SPLITTING A SITE TO STAY UNDER A THRESHOLD DOES NOT WORK, AND YOU SHOULD CHECK WHETHER IT IS BEING DONE TO YOU. A change to the environmental impact assessment regulation meant open-pit mining needed full assessment at 25 hectares and above, so companies holding much larger licence areas were applying in respect of 24 hectares to obtain an assessment-not-required decision and escape the process. This association challenged it, and the Council of State agreed and stayed the change — holding that an operation with an assessment-not-required decision for 24 hectares must go through the full process if it works even one additional hectare inside the same licence area. IF A QUARRY OR MINE NEAR YOU HAS AN ASSESSMENT-NOT-REQUIRED DECISION, COMPARE THE DECLARED WORKING AREA WITH THE LICENCE AREA. That gap is a case. IT ATTACKS RULES RATHER THAN ONLY PROJECTS, WHICH IS WHAT MAKES IT WORTH APPROACHING BEFORE YOUR OWN DISPUTE IS LOST: it has filed for annulment of an amendment to the mining regulation, of a regulation implementing a presidential decree that granted an implicit amnesty to unlawful structures in forests, and of a regulation permitting thermal power stations to pollute — the last brought as sea mucilage spread through the Marmara and into the Aegean. Its lawyers also act in individual cases, including an action by fourteen residents and a professional chamber to annul a favourable impact decision for a thermal power station unit. WHAT IT GIVES A COMMUNITY THAT CANNOT AFFORD LITIGATION: it publishes its case documents and analysis, and it translated the Dutch Urgenda climate judgment into Turkish with commentary expressly so that people in Turkiye could use it. A body that translates foreign precedent for domestic use is a body that expects others to litigate, not only itself. It grew out of a law faculty environmental society formed in 1997 that acted against a hydroelectric scheme in 1999, took its present name in 2002 and became a registered association in 2007 — so it has institutional continuity and standing to sue in its own name. ITS MEMBERS OVERLAP WITH THE ACTIVIST-LAWYER FORMATION RECORDED SEPARATELY IN THIS FILE, WHICH HAS NO WEBSITE. If you cannot reach that formation, reach this association; several of the same lawyers are here and this one has a door.

trackers.name: Akdeniz Koruma Derneği — it got fishing banned in named coves, then hired the fishermen as the wardens
trackers.desc: IT DID THE TWO HALVES OF PROTECTION, AND THE SECOND HALF IS THE ONE ALMOST EVERYONE SKIPS. In 2012, working through the responsible ministry, it had six named coves in Gökova Bay placed under protection with fishing prohibited. Then it built the enforcement — because, in its own projects coordinator's words, the biggest deficiency in areas closed to fishing was the ABSENCE OF ACTIVE INSPECTION AND CONTROL. THE ANSWER WAS TO PUT THE COASTAL FISHERMEN AT THE FRONT OF THE PROTECTION RATHER THAN OUTSIDE IT: former fishers were trained and employed as marine rangers, patrolling the closed areas, informing others, and referring breaches to the responsible law-enforcement bodies — a system this organisation developed and ran for the first time in Turkiye from 2013. One long-standing local fisher now patrols voluntarily in his own boat. The people with the strongest reason to break the rule became the people paid to uphold it. AND IT PROVES THE PROTECTION WORKS BY MEASURING INSIDE AND OUTSIDE THE CLOSED AREAS AT THE SAME TIME — monk seals, sandbar sharks, seagrass, macroalgae and corals, fish biomass, sea temperature and daily catch data recorded with the local fisheries cooperatives. That simultaneous comparison is the evidence a community needs when told a restriction is pointless. Reported results include a large fall in illegal fishing, recovering ecological diversity, fishing brought to European common-policy quality standards, and rising incomes for those fishing there. IT NOW COVERS GÖKOVA, KAŞ-KEKOVA AND DATÇA-BOZBURUN AND PUBLISHES MAPS OF THE CLOSED AREAS FOR EACH, so anyone can see exactly where the boundaries fall. It also runs projects for women fishers, works with authorised public institutions against illegal fishing and marine pollution, and remains active with field results published into 2026. Founded by a named marine conservationist whose work has been recognised by two Whitley Awards and the Goldman Environmental Prize for Asia. THE LIMITS: it is a conservation and enforcement body working WITH ministries, not against them, and nothing found shows it opposing a coastal development scheme. Approach it for the model, for the monitoring method, and for its experience of getting an area formally closed — not to fight a marina or a hotel. Founding year appears as both 2010 and 2012 across sources.

trackers.name: TMMOB — thirteen professional chambers filed against one project together, and fifteen cases against it in all
trackers.desc: THE SCALE IS THE POINT. Against a single Istanbul scheme, the union and TWELVE NAMED MEMBER CHAMBERS filed together for suspension of execution and annulment of the zoning plans — mechanical, geophysics, civil, electrical, landscape architecture, agricultural, environmental, geology, city planning, survey and cadastre, chemical engineering and architecture. Further filings followed and THE TOTAL NUMBER OF CASES BROUGHT AGAINST THAT ONE PROJECT REACHED FIFTEEN. A community facing a large scheme does not want one profession's opinion; it wants every discipline that can find a fault in the plan, filing at once. This is the body that assembles that. AND THE SEQUENCE ITS BRANCHES FOLLOW IS THE ONE TO COPY, BECAUSE IT STARTS WITH SOMETHING ANY RESIDENT CAN DO: plans are put on public suspension for one month with objections due to the provincial directorate by a stated date. A chamber branch objects within that window; when the ministry rejects the objection, IT THEN SUES. One branch did exactly that in 2026 over a plan change on a named parcel, announcing that its technical and legal assessment stood and that it would follow the case to the end. Watch for the suspension period, object inside it, and treat rejection as the start rather than the end. THE GROUNDS THAT ITS FILINGS ACTUALLY USE ARE WORTH BORROWING: irreversible loss of water, dune, forest and wildlife; conflict with the constitution; landslide risk; protection of a historic silhouette; the public cost of the scheme; and construction pressure — alongside the standard argument that a plan is contrary to urbanism principles, planning essentials and the public interest. Concrete physical risks and public cost sit better with a court than aesthetics. IT REACHES THE WHOLE COUNTRY AND IT IS SUING NOW: provincial branches and provincial coordination boards file locally and against ministries directly — in 2026 one branch challenged three separate plans for a ski centre prepared by the ministry itself. Find your provincial branch or coordination board rather than writing to Ankara. A confederation of all the chambers of engineers, architects and city planners in the country, formed in 1954, headquartered in Ankara, with a named secretary general; membership of the relevant chamber is compulsory for practising professionals, which is why the chambers can speak for an entire discipline. It publishes its filings and their procedural history on its own site. READ IT WITH THE CHAMBER OF CITY PLANNERS RECORDED SEPARATELY HERE, which sues national regulations in its own name, and with the warning attached to that entry: plans annulled six times were reissued and construction continued. THE UNION'S OWN RECORD OF FIFTEEN CASES AGAINST ONE PROJECT IS THE SAME LESSON FROM THE OTHER SIDE — THIS IS ATTRITION, NOT A SINGLE HEARING.

trackers.name: Kuzey Ormanları Savunması — it counted 13 million felled trees against the impact report's 2.5 million
trackers.desc: THE METHOD IS THE RESOURCE: THIS MOVEMENT PUBLISHED THAT AT LEAST 13 MILLION TREES HAD BEEN FELLED FOR A MAJOR AIRPORT PROJECT SINCE 2012, AGAINST THE 2.5 MILLION STATED IN THE PROJECT'S OWN ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT ASSESSMENT. An impact assessment is a document full of countable claims. Counting them yourself and publishing the difference attacks the developer's own evidence rather than merely disagreeing with its conclusion — and elsewhere this file records Turkish lawyers explaining that bringing a case is what forces such a report to be examined and audited by a court. It also documented that an airport and a bridge together destroyed 6,422 hectares of forest. WHAT IT IS, IN ITS OWN WORDS: a movement of free and voluntary individuals, organised to stop ANY urban or rural project, whatever its scale or justification, that is not grounded in nature, reason and science — INDEPENDENT OF EVERY ECONOMIC, POLITICAL AND IDEOLOGICAL ORGANISATION, taking its decisions in forums open to everyone's participation. That combination of open participation and declared independence is rare and it is the reason a community can join rather than merely petition. ITS TERRITORY IS THE LAST FORESTS, WATER BASINS AND FARMLAND ALONG THE BLACK SEA AND MARMARA — Edirne, Kırklareli, Tekirdağ, Istanbul, Kocaeli, Yalova, Sakarya and Düzce, with northern Bursa, Balıkesir and Çanakkale. If your land is in that arc, this is a standing structure you can walk into. AND IT RUNS A SYSTEMATIC MONITORING REGISTER, WHICH IS THE THING MOST CAMPAIGNS LACK: an associated research association has tracked threats and destruction across those eleven provinces since April 2020 and publishes QUARTERLY REPORTS — 317 recorded threats, acts of destruction and defences in one three-month period, 436 in another. A dispute that appears in a quarterly register alongside hundreds of others stops looking like a local complaint and starts looking like a pattern. THE SAME ASSOCIATION PUBLISHES AN ADVOCACY GUIDE WRITTEN FOR ORDINARY CITIZENS trying to know, protect and defend these forests — ask for it before you ask for anything else. ITS MONITORING CATCHES THE THINGS PAPERWORK MISSES: a sand quarry continuing to operate despite a governor's suspension order, and gold exploration drilling begun across some five hundred hectares WITHOUT AN IMPACT ASSESSMENT APPLICATION HAVING BEEN MADE AT ALL. KNOW THE RISK: four of its participants were detained at a press statement protesting an increase in the capacity of a wind power plant. This file records elsewhere that a Turkish association president and a case lawyer were summoned to a gendarmerie post after a company complained; presence carries exposure, and the protection routes recorded here for defenders are worth knowing in advance.

trackers.name: IUCN NL Land Acquisition Fund — money to buy the land, or to take a long lease over it
trackers.desc: THIS IS A FUND WHOSE ENTIRE PURPOSE IS PAYING FOR LAND. It gives grants of up to around a hundred thousand euros to LOCALLY REGISTERED non-profit organisations to acquire threatened nature — by PURCHASE OR BY LONG-TERM LEASE — in order to create reserves and reconnect habitat. AND IT DOES NOT REQUIRE YOU TO BUY ANYTHING: it states expressly that it also supports projects in which organisations acquire THE LONG-TERM MANAGEMENT RIGHTS OF AN AREA WITHOUT ANY TRANSFER OF OWNERSHIP TITLE — long-term leases or conservation agreements. That matters more here than anywhere, because this file established after auditing the whole region that outright purchase is rare and that the workable routes are leases, agreements and statutory use-rights. This fund pays for those. THE OWNERSHIP AND THE RESPONSIBILITY STAY WITH THE LOCAL ORGANISATION, NOT THE FUNDER — its stated model is that the reserve is held by the local body, which knows the context and involves the community. WHAT IT PRIORITISES, WHICH IS HOW YOU FRAME THE APPLICATION: land hosting species listed as critically endangered, endangered or vulnerable on the international red list; areas of high biodiversity value such as important bird areas and zero-extinction sites; and — the one most useful against a scheme that cuts a landscape in half — LAND THAT SECURES CONNECTIVITY, meaning corridors and stepping stones between fragmented habitats. A road, canal or quarry that severs a corridor is precisely the situation this fund was built for. ELIGIBILITY IS SPECIFIC AND CHECKABLE: you must be locally registered as a non-profit, non-governmental or civil society organisation in Africa, Asia, Latin America or the Pacific; be directly responsible for preparing and running the project; and HAVE A BANK ACCOUNT IN THE ORGANISATION'S OWN NAME in the country where it is established or where the project runs. That last condition rules out an informal village group applying alone — partner with a registered body. Applications run on an annual call with a published spring deadline. ITS TRACK RECORD IS LONG: running since 2001, with well over a hundred and fifty projects funded across more than forty countries and roughly sixty thousand hectares secured, backed by a national lottery and a group of foundations and private donors. THE HONEST LIMITS: its eligible regions are broad but its published examples are overwhelmingly tropical, and no project in this country or its neighbours was found among them — so treat this as a route that is open on the stated criteria rather than one with a demonstrated record here. Ask the fund directly before investing effort. It also funds acquisition, not litigation, campaigning or objection.

trackers.name: The MedFund — five years of funding for the running costs of a marine protected area
trackers.desc: IT PAYS THE RECURRENT COSTS OF RUNNING A PROTECTED AREA, WHICH ALMOST NO FUNDER WILL. Its grants go to the MANAGEMENT AND CO-MANAGEMENT STRUCTURES of Mediterranean marine protected areas, expressly to help cover their recurring management costs, AND SUPPORT IS GRANTED FOR FIVE YEARS. Every other fund in this file pays for projects and refuses overheads — one states outright that it will not fund core running costs. A reserve that wins designation and then cannot pay its wardens is the failure this fund exists to prevent. IT CAN DO THIS BECAUSE IT IS AN ENDOWMENT RATHER THAN A GRANT PROGRAMME: a conservation trust fund that raises and invests capital and awards grants out of the INTEREST it earns, which is why it can commit for five years rather than one. THIS COUNTRY IS ON ITS PUBLISHED LIST OF PRIORITY INTERVENTION COUNTRIES, AND IT HAS ALREADY COMMITTED FUNDING TO A MARINE PROTECTED AREA HERE — in the same gulf where this file recorded a marine conservation society that obtained a fishing ban over named coves and hired former fishers as rangers. That is not a coincidence to gloss over: it shows what a fundable applicant looks like here, and that organisation is the obvious first conversation for anyone attempting this. WHO CAN APPLY: management and co-management structures — so grants go to NGOs as well as to national protected area authorities, and a CO-MANAGEMENT arrangement between a community body and the state qualifies. This file has recorded co-management repeatedly as the form community land protection actually takes in this region. THE PROCESS IS TWO-STAGE: a short expression of interest first, then a full application some weeks later, on published dates. Do not write a full proposal before the first stage. THE LIMITS: it funds MARINE protected areas only, so a terrestrial site does not qualify; the area must be a designated or formally proposed protected area, so this is a fund for holding ground already won rather than for winning it; and it funds management, not opposition, litigation or campaigning. Created in 2015 by two states, a third government and a foundation, and based in Monaco, with backing from several international environment facilities and development agencies.

trackers.name: İkizköy Direniyor — villagers who kept a tent watch for 738 days and beat an "outside EIA scope" ruling
trackers.desc: THEY WON THE ARGUMENT THAT NO ASSESSMENT WAS NEEDED. The Council of State's Fourth Chamber OVERTURNED an administrative court ruling that the mine fell OUTSIDE THE SCOPE of environmental impact assessment, on the ground of INCOMPLETE EXAMINATION, and ordered an expert report. Being told a project is outside assessment scope is where many communities stop; this is documented proof that the determination itself can be attacked, and that the higher court will send it back for an expert examination. THEIR STRONGEST ARGUMENT IS ONE ANY COMMUNITY CAN CHECK: the forest, the farmland and the olive groves are being destroyed FOR A COAL RESERVE THAT WILL BE EXHAUSTED IN FOUR YEARS. Weigh the lifespan of what is extracted against the permanence of what is lost, and put the figure in the objection. THEY COMBINED COURTS AND PRESENCE, WHICH THIS FILE HAS FOUND WORKS WHERE NEITHER ALONE DOES: SIX LAWSUITS, including a stay-of-execution action against the forestry directorate, alongside A TENT WATCH IN THE FOREST THAT RAN FOR 738 DAYS and prevented felling for over two years. When cutting began in 2021 their protests stopped it. It resumed only when cutters entered before six in the morning under police escort, and thousands of trees went in ten days. KNOW THE INSTRUMENT USED AGAINST THEM, BECAUSE IT IS THE ONE TO WATCH FOR: URGENT EXPROPRIATION BY PRESIDENTIAL DECREE, published in the official gazette, taking 190 parcels across three villages — more than two thousand dunums of farmland and olive groves — for lignite mining. The forest itself had earlier been allocated to the power company by ministerial signature. Urgent expropriation moves faster than ordinary procedure; the decree is public and the parcel numbers are listed. WHAT ELSE THEY DID: collected more than a hundred and seventeen thousand signatures and DELIVERED THE PETITION TO THE MINISTRY IN PERSON, and marched from the forest to the administrative court on hearing days, joined by environmental associations, unions, political parties and a provincial bar president. THE VILLAGES ACTED TOGETHER RATHER THAN SEPARATELY — three neighbouring villages facing the same mine, litigating and marching jointly, which is what made a local dispute into a national one. THE HONEST PART: the trees were cut anyway. The watch delayed the mine for two years, the litigation continues, and the expropriation proceeded. Read this as a record of what worked and what did not, from people still fighting, with their own site, information notes prepared for parliament, and an open invitation to others to join them.

trackers.name: Buluşum — a no-commission donation platform, and the aid-collection rule that governs any fundraising here
trackers.desc: BEFORE ANY PLATFORM, UNDERSTAND THE GATE: collecting public donations in this country is governed by the aid collection law, and legal analysis records that donation-based crowdfunding operates on GREY LEGAL GROUND because no specific legislation covers it. UNDER THAT LAW ONLY CERTAIN BODIES MAY COLLECT AID AT ALL — natural persons, ASSOCIATIONS, institutions, FOUNDATIONS, sports clubs, newspapers and magazines — and only for public-benefit purposes: realising their own aims, helping people in need, or carrying out or supporting a public service. THE TWO SAFE STRUCTURES ARE NAMED IN THAT SAME ANALYSIS AND THIS IS THE PRACTICAL ADVICE: either raise the money THROUGH A BODY THAT ALREADY HOLDS DONATION-COLLECTION PERMISSION — checking first that it actually holds one, since only certain bodies are exempt from needing it — or ESTABLISH AN ASSOCIATION OR FOUNDATION with that authority and run the fundraising through it. A village committee that has not formed a body cannot lawfully collect public donations here, which is the sharpest version of a pattern this file has now recorded in three countries: the barrier between a community and money is usually legal form, not merit. NOW THE PLATFORM ITSELF, AND ITS TERMS ARE UNUSUALLY FAVOURABLE. It is donation-based rather than reward-based, run by a corporate foundation as a NON-PROFIT, publishes ONLY PROJECTS THAT BENEFIT SOCIETY, vets every project through an advisory board before publication, AND TAKES NO COMMISSION FROM SUCCESSFUL PROJECTS. IT ALSO OPERATES ON A KEEP-IT-ALL BASIS — you receive what is raised even if the target is not reached. That matters more than it sounds: most crowdfunding runs all-or-nothing, so a campaign that raises seventy per cent of a land purchase returns every lira to the donors. For a community raising money against a deadline, keep-it-all is the difference between partial funding and none. THE HONEST WARNING: ITS VOLUME IS VERY LOW. Academic study records only around fifteen campaigns published on it in total since it began in 2015. This is a selective, small platform rather than a busy marketplace — which is why its success rate is high, and why acceptance is not to be assumed. Approach it early, and have a second route ready. THE ALTERNATIVES IN THIS COUNTRY ARE REWARD-BASED RATHER THAN DONATION-BASED, meaning supporters expect something in return, and at least one general platform accepts both donation and reward campaigns. Check each one's commission and whether it is all-or-nothing before choosing, because those two terms decide what a partly successful campaign is worth.

trackers.name: TÜSEV — it publishes how to form and run the association or foundation you need before anything else works
trackers.desc: BEFORE A COMMUNITY CAN HOLD LAND, TAKE A GRANT OR LAWFULLY COLLECT A DONATION IN THIS COUNTRY, IT USUALLY NEEDS TO BE AN ASSOCIATION OR A FOUNDATION. This body exists to build the legal and fiscal infrastructure for exactly those, and it publishes the guidance for forming and running one. Founded in 1993 by twenty-three leading foundations and associations and now working with more than a hundred trustees, its stated first purpose is creating an enabling and supportive LEGAL AND FISCAL environment for civil society organisations. TWO OF ITS PUBLICATIONS ARE THE DOCUMENTS A GROUP ACTUALLY NEEDS: A LEGAL LEGISLATION GUIDE FOR ASSOCIATIONS, and a guide to THE TAX REGULATIONS APPLYING TO ASSOCIATIONS AND FOUNDATIONS — the second of which covers not only the body's own tax position but THE POSITION OF THE PEOPLE WHO DONATE TO IT. Donor tax treatment decides how much a local fundraising appeal actually raises, and this file has recorded three funding routes in this region that a community cannot use at all without the right legal form. IT ALSO MONITORS WHETHER ORGANISING IS GETTING HARDER: since 2021 it has run a FREEDOM OF ASSOCIATION MONITORING PROJECT jointly with a civil society development association, funded by the European Union delegation, raising awareness of the legal and fiscal rules affecting organisations. This file has documented a foreign representatives law shutting down civil society in Kyrgyzstan and a transparency bill contested in Georgia; a standing national monitor of association law is the early warning for the same thing here. AND IT HELPED BUILD SOMETHING A DISTRICT COULD COPY: it supported the establishment of the country's FIRST SOCIAL INVESTMENT FOUNDATION, a local donors' foundation in a named province — a community foundation that pools local giving and grants it out. For a district facing repeated development pressure, a standing local fund is a stronger position than a campaign that fundraises from scratch each time. It also works to increase the number of grant-making organisations in the country and to promote participatory grant-making models. THE LIMITS: it is an infrastructure and policy body, not a law firm, a funder or an objector. It will not register your association for you, advise on your specific case, or oppose a project — and most of its guidance is published in Turkish. Use it for the rules, the tax position and the model; use the chambers, the lawyers' formation and the village movements recorded elsewhere in this file for the fight itself.

trackers.name: Chambers of Agriculture — you are already a member by law, and they sit in your district
trackers.desc: IF YOU FARM, YOU ARE ALREADY A MEMBER. Registration with a chamber of agriculture is COMPULSORY BY LAW for every person carrying out farming, so a farmer facing expropriation, a quarry or a road does not need to join anything — they need to use a body they already belong to. AND THE LAW'S DEFINITION OF FARMER INCLUDES PEOPLE WITHOUT TITLE: owners, TENANTS, SHARECROPPERS AND PARTNERS all count, provided the activity is continuous or covers at least one planting or growing season, and inland fishing counts as farming too. This file has recorded across the region that those who lose land are frequently not those who own it; here the representative body's own founding statute covers them. CHAMBERS SIT AT DISTRICT LEVEL, with representations opened below that through the nearest chamber — so the body is local, not national. THE DUTY THAT MAKES IT USEFUL AGAINST A SCHEME: the union is required to EXAMINE LEGISLATION CONCERNING AGRICULTURE AND PRODUCERS AND CONVEY ITS VIEWS ON IT TO THE RELEVANT AUTHORITIES, to report to government on how agricultural policy is working out, and to prepare and PUBLISH general reports. A body with a statutory duty to comment on rules affecting producers is a body that can be asked to comment on a plan, a permit regime or an expropriation. AND THE DISTRICT REPRESENTATIONS HAVE A DUTY THAT IS EVEN MORE DIRECTLY USABLE: to collect information about agriculture and farming in their district, TO CARRY OUT NECESSARY INVESTIGATIONS AND STATISTICAL WORK THERE, and to report what they gather to the chamber SO THAT THE NECESSARY MEASURES CAN BE TAKEN. That is a formal route for getting your problem investigated and recorded by an official body — ask the district representation to conduct the investigation its own regulations require. CHAMBERS ALSO HOLD FARMERS' AGRICULTURAL INSURANCE AND REGISTRATION RECORDS under the social security law, which makes them a source of OFFICIAL PROOF OF WHO FARMS WHAT — the documentation a compensation claim or an objection needs. The union belongs to the world farmers' organisation and the European agriculture federation, and runs farmer training through advisory associations it established. THE LIMITS: it exists to work with government on agricultural policy, not to oppose development, and nothing found shows it objecting to a project. Part of its funding comes as shares of revenue from state-linked institutions. DO NOT CONFUSE IT WITH THE UNION OF CHAMBERS OF ENGINEERS AND ARCHITECTS RECORDED SEPARATELY IN THIS FILE, which does litigate — they are different bodies, and the strongest position is to use both: the engineers to challenge the plan, the agricultural chamber to document the farming it destroys.

trackers.name: Bolu Donors' Foundation — a standing local endowment that makes grants, and a model you can copy
trackers.desc: IT IS A FUND THAT ALREADY EXISTS, WHICH IS A DIFFERENT THING FROM A CAMPAIGN. Founded in 2008 by THIRTY-TWO DONORS who together put up MORE THAN A MILLION LIRA OF ENDOWMENT CAPITAL, it allocates grants to civil society organisations in its province and runs its own projects with partners. This file has recorded crowdfunding platforms, international grant windows and small-grant schemes; all of them require a community to start from nothing each time a scheme appears. A LOCAL ENDOWMENT DOES NOT. IT FUNDS FROM THREE STREAMS AND THE THIRD IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS FOR A LAND DISPUTE: income generated by the endowment itself; general donations to the foundation; and CONDITIONAL DONATIONS EARMARKED FOR A SPECIFIC PROJECT. A supporter who wants to help one particular valley can give money tied to that purpose, through a body that already has legal standing, a bank account and permission to receive donations — which this file has identified across the whole region as the barrier that stops communities dead. ITS GRANT PROGRAMME WAS WELCOMED FOR A REASON WORTH KNOWING: the number of funds reaching civil society organisations in this country is low AND THE ACTIVITY AREAS OTHER FUNDERS SUPPORT ARE RESTRICTIVE. A local foundation answerable to its own province can fund what national and international donors will not. AND IT CAN BE COPIED, WHICH IS THE REAL VALUE OF THIS ENTRY. The national third sector foundation recorded separately in this file advised its founding team on COMMUNICATION, RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT, GOVERNANCE, AND LEGAL AND FINANCIAL PROCESSES; it ran a support programme to spread the model to other regions; and it states that anyone attempting to establish a donors' foundation may take technical support from it. Thirty-two committed people and a founding endowment is the entry price, and a district facing repeated development pressure has both more often than it realises. ONE OBSTACLE, REPORTED BY THE FOUNDATION ITSELF, CONFIRMS WHAT THIS FILE RECORDED ABOUT THE LAW HERE: SMS giving, automatic payments and ONLINE DONATION COLLECTION each require SEPARATE PERMISSION and carry their own bureaucratic procedures. Budget time for that, and read it with the entry on this country's aid collection rules. THE LIMITS ARE REAL. It serves ONE PROVINCE, and remains the only foundation of its kind in the country — so for most readers this is a model rather than a funder. It was founded by thirty-two business people, so a campaign against a locally powerful commercial interest is unlikely to be funded by it. And its purpose is the province's development broadly, not land defence.

trackers.name: Parcel inquiry — free, no login, and the boundary downloads as a map file
trackers.desc: IT IS COMPLETELY PUBLIC AND FREE, WITH NO REGISTRATION OR LOGIN, on the web and as a mobile application. Search by province, district, neighbourhood, block and parcel numbers — or, for urban property, BY STREET ADDRESS — and it returns the official land registry and cadastral information for that parcel. CHECK THE PARCELS AROUND YOURS, NOT ONLY YOUR OWN. Schemes are assembled quietly, plot by plot, and a single buyer accumulating neighbouring parcels is the earliest warning a community can get that something is coming. This map records corporate ownership databases and satellite imagery for this region; it has never until now recorded the register that says who owns the field next door. THE FEATURE THAT MULTIPLIES EVERYTHING ELSE: THE PARCEL DATA DOWNLOADS AS PDF, KML OR GEOJSON, and the system will also generate a route to the parcel through common mapping services. Those file formats import directly into the free satellite imagery browser and the offline community mapping application recorded elsewhere in this file. LAY THE PARCEL BOUNDARY OVER DATED SATELLITE IMAGERY AND YOU CAN SHOW WHAT CHANGED INSIDE A SPECIFIC BOUNDARY AND WHEN — which is the difference between saying trees were cleared and proving that they were cleared on a named parcel between two dates. NOW THE AGENCY'S OWN CAVEATS, WHICH YOU MUST CARRY: the location information is presented in APPROXIMATE COORDINATES AND FOR TESTING PURPOSES; the information is not to be used as official or commercial property data; and IF THERE IS ANY MISMATCH BETWEEN THE RECORDS YOU HOLD AND WHAT IS DISPLAYED, THE MATTER MUST BE TAKEN TO THE CADASTRAL OFFICE. So treat it as a locating and screening tool, not as proof of title — for proof you need a registry extract from the office itself. THE OTHER LIMITS: it shows what has been registered, so unregistered or disputed holdings may not appear as their occupants would describe them; and personal ownership details are not the same as the parcel data shown, so establishing WHO owns a plot may still require a formal request. Use it first, free, before spending anything on searches.

trackers.name: Heritage foundation and the union of historic towns — the grant fund your municipality can apply to, and the inventories already written
trackers.desc: THERE IS MONEY HERE THAT ALMOST NOBODY OUTSIDE MUNICIPAL OFFICES KNOWS ABOUT. THE UNION OF HISTORIC TOWNS COLLECTS DUES FROM ITS MEMBER MUNICIPALITIES AND DISTRIBUTES THAT INCOME BACK TO THEM THROUGH GRANT PROGRAMMES, PROVIDING FINANCIAL SUPPORT FOR CONSERVATION PROJECTS. In 2025 an assessment round opened in June considered 129 PROJECTS SUBMITTED BY MEMBER MUNICIPALITIES, and the union now numbers 480 MEMBER MUNICIPALITIES, having been founded in July 2000 by 52 historic-town councils. SO THE FIRST QUESTION FOR ANYONE TRYING TO SAVE A BUILDING, A STREET OR AN OLD QUARTER HERE IS SIMPLE: IS MY MUNICIPALITY A MEMBER, AND HAS IT APPLIED? A community cannot apply itself — but it can walk into the town hall with a specific proposal and ask the council to submit it, and a council that pays dues into a fund it never draws from is easy to persuade. THE FOUNDATION BEHIND THE UNION HAS BEEN WORKING SINCE 1990 ON NATURAL AND CULTURAL HERITAGE, ON A VOLUNTEER BASIS, AND ITS METHOD IS TO BRING THE PUBLIC, LOCAL, CIVIL AND PRIVATE SIDES TOGETHER around an agreed goal, timetable, road map, action plan and resource plan. That is the shape of a campaign that ends in something built rather than something merely opposed. AND IT HOLDS THE DOCUMENTS. CITY CULTURE INVENTORIES HAVE BEEN PREPARED FOR ADANA, AMASYA, ANTALYA, BATTALGAZI, BURDUR, GAZIANTEP, GUMUSHANE, GURUN, IZMIR, KARAMAN, KILIS, MARDIN, MUGLA, ORDU, TEKIRDAG AND USAK, alongside inventories published by the culture ministry and an academy of sciences project — and these CONTINUALLY UPDATED INVENTORIES ARE AVAILABLE TO RESEARCHERS AT THE FOUNDATION'S INFORMATION AND DOCUMENTATION CENTRE, a specialised archive, library and research unit that is among the country's leading reference points on historic cities. IF YOUR CITY IS ON THAT LIST, THE DOCUMENTATION OF WHAT YOU ARE DEFENDING ALREADY EXISTS AND WAS MADE BEFORE ANY DISPUTE. THE UNION ALSO CHANGED THE LAW RATHER THAN ONLY WORKING INSIDE IT: it took an active part in the legal reforms after 2000, helped create funding for repairing historic and cultural assets, AND WAS INSTRUMENTAL IN ESTABLISHING THE CONSERVATION PLAN AND PROJECT BOARDS THAT LOCAL AUTHORITIES NEED — so the municipal conservation office you may be dealing with exists partly because of this campaign. THERE IS ALSO TRAINING: an academy runs programmes built around the needs of technical staff working in member municipalities and conservation areas, using case analyses, practical application, seminars, workshops and FIELD VISITS — ask whether your municipality's technical staff have attended, because an untrained conservation officer is a common reason good rules produce bad outcomes. And multi-province CULTURE-PRIORITISED REGIONAL ROAD MAPS set out development strategies for whole regions. THE LIMITS: this works WITH AND THROUGH MUNICIPALITIES. If your own council is the body promoting the scheme you oppose, this route is far weaker, and the foundation is not a litigator, does not buy land and will not take a side against a member council. Pair it with the environmental law network, the chambers and the protection boards recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Human rights association with an ecology commission — branches, a violation form, and a reporting chain that reaches villages
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY'S LISTING IS THE RICHEST IN THE MAP — LITIGATING CHAMBERS, ACTIVIST LAWYERS, AN ECOLOGY FEDERATION OF EIGHTY GROUPS, A VILLAGE THAT KEPT A TENT WATCH FOR 738 DAYS — AND IT HELD NOTHING ABOUT WHAT HAPPENS TO THE PEOPLE DOING ALL THAT. THIS ASSOCIATION IS THE ANSWER, AND IT HAS SOMETHING NO OTHER PROTECTION BODY IN THIS FILE HAS: AN ECOLOGY AND RIGHT TO LIFE COMMISSION. A HUMAN RIGHTS ASSOCIATION WITH A STANDING ECOLOGY COMMISSION IS THE BRIDGE BETWEEN DEFENDING LAND AND DEFENDING THE PEOPLE WHO DEFEND IT — the two things this payload has kept in separate boxes for four hundred entries. HOW YOU USE IT IS SIMPLE AND IMMEDIATE: YOU CAN REPORT A RIGHTS VIOLATION YOU HAVE FACED, THROUGH AN APPLICATION FORM CARRIED ON ITS BRANCH PAGES. Its stated work is to INVESTIGATE, ESTABLISH, DOCUMENT AND REPORT violations and to announce them to the public and to the authorities — which is exactly the documentation function this file has told communities to build, done by an organisation that has done it for forty years. AND THE STRUCTURE REACHES FURTHER THAN THE CITIES. IT WORKS THROUGH BRANCHES AND DISTRICT REPRESENTATIVES; WHERE THERE IS NO BRANCH YOU APPLY TO THE NEAREST ONE; AND DISTRICT REPRESENTATIVES REPORT VIOLATIONS OCCURRING IN THEIR DISTRICT UP TO THE BRANCH. For a village facing a mine, a quarry or a dam, that is a reporting chain that ends in a national organisation and a published record. MEMBERSHIP IS OPEN AND THE PROCESS IS TIME-BOUND, WHICH MATTERS BECAUSE MEMBERSHIP IS ITSELF A FORM OF COVER: branch boards must decide an application WITHIN THIRTY DAYS and notify in writing; a refusal can be APPEALED WITHIN FIFTEEN DAYS to the central executive and then to the general assembly. Every member has the right to take part in the association's activities and governance, and the statute carries an express non-discrimination clause covering language, ethnicity, belief, sex, disability and sexual orientation. IT ALSO PUBLISHES OBSERVATION REPORTS OF DEMONSTRATIONS AND THEMATIC REGIONAL MONITORING. IF YOUR CAMPAIGN INVOLVES GATHERINGS — and in this country most land campaigns eventually do — AN OBSERVER'S REPORT OF WHAT ACTUALLY HAPPENED AT A PROTEST IS THE DOCUMENT THAT ANSWERS THE OFFICIAL ACCOUNT. Ask a branch in advance whether it will observe, rather than asking afterwards for a statement. THE LIMITS: it is a human rights association, not a land or planning organisation — it engages where people are detained, prosecuted, injured or silenced, not where a permit is issued. It is a contested actor in national politics and association with it carries its own political weight, which a community should weigh deliberately. Read it with the activist-lawyer formation, the ecology federation and the chambers recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Chamber of architects — it sues to annul development plans, through provincial branches, and wins
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE PARALLEL BODY TO THE CITY PLANNERS' CHAMBER ALREADY RECORDED HERE, AND IT DOES THE ONE THING THIS MAP EXISTS TO FIND: IT GOES TO COURT TO CANCEL DEVELOPMENT PLANS, THROUGH PROVINCIAL BRANCHES, AND IT WINS. IT HAS STANDING TO CHALLENGE PLANS THAT INDIVIDUAL RESIDENTS OFTEN DO NOT, AND IT USES IT CONSTANTLY. THE RECORD IS RECENT AND SPECIFIC. IN AUGUST 2026 A COURT ANNULLED A REGIONAL AREA PLAN COVERING A MAJOR HERITAGE LANDSCAPE, in a case brought jointly with the planners' chamber, holding the plan CONTRARY TO URBANISM PRINCIPLES, PLANNING BASES AND ZONING LEGISLATION. The court had already suspended it, on an expert report finding that the plan CONTRADICTED ITS OWN DATA, ITS OWN AIMS AND ITS OWN CONSERVATION PRINCIPLES. THAT REASONING IS THE MOST TRANSFERABLE THING IN THIS ENTRY. THE EXPERTS DID NOT SAY THE AREA NEEDED NO PLAN — THEY SAID THIS PLAN CONTRADICTED ITSELF. A COMMUNITY ARGUING AGAINST A SCHEME IS USUALLY STRONGEST NOT WHEN IT OPPOSES PLANNING AS SUCH, BUT WHEN IT SHOWS THE PLAN FAILS ITS OWN STATED OBJECTIVES. OTHER OUTCOMES SHOW THE RANGE: A METROPOLITAN ROOF-STOREY PLAN NOTE ANNULLED because the necessary research was not done, the required reports were not produced, AND A WHOLESALE ZONING CHANGE CANNOT LAWFULLY BE MADE BY A PLAN NOTE. SUSPENSION of zoning changes opening AGRICULTURAL AND FOREST LAND to a run of ecotourism projects, brought together with the agricultural engineers' chamber. ANNULMENT of ministry plans over a twelve-dönüm site because THE AREA'S NATURAL STRUCTURE HAD NOT BEEN EXAMINED. AND ANNULMENT OF A HELIPORT PLAN on a protected island shoreline. TWO THINGS HERE CAN BE COPIED DIRECTLY BY A COMMUNITY ANYWHERE. FIRST: THE CHAMBER ITSELF HAD A BUILDING REGISTERED AS CULTURAL PROPERTY, AND WHEN NEIGHBOURING OWNERS SUCCEEDED IN HAVING THAT REGISTRATION CANCELLED, THE BRANCH SUED AND WON A SUSPENSION. Registration can be applied for by an organisation on a building it does not own — and a cancelled registration can itself be challenged. SECOND, AND THIS IS THE CHEAPEST ROUTE IN THIS ENTIRE MAP: WHERE THE CHAMBERS AND TWO MUNICIPALITIES EACH SUED SEPARATELY OVER A COASTAL PLAN, THE LOCAL CIVIL INITIATIVE JOINED THE CHAMBERS' CASE AS AN INTERVENOR RATHER THAN BRINGING ITS OWN. JOINING AN EXISTING CASE COSTS A FRACTION OF STARTING ONE, PUTS THE COMMUNITY'S EVIDENCE IN FRONT OF THE COURT, AND LETS THE CHAMBER'S LAWYERS CARRY THE LEGAL ARGUMENT. Ask the nearest branch whether it has already filed against the plan affecting you — and if it has, ask to intervene. PRACTICALLY: FIND THE PROVINCIAL BRANCH, NOT THE HEADQUARTERS. The cases above were run by named branches in several different provinces, each acting on local plans. Take them the plan reference, the notice-board dates and the site facts; the deadline for challenging a plan runs from its public display, so approach during the display period rather than after. THE LIMITS: it is a professional chamber, not a community organisation — it litigates on planning and heritage grounds in the professional interest, and it will not take on a matter that has no planning defect merely because residents object. It does not buy land or fund campaigns. Its cases take years, and suspensions and annulments can be appealed. Read it with the planners' chamber, the activist-lawyer formation and the ecology federation recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: National nature association — and the statute clause that lets an association buy a wetland or a wood
trackers.desc: THE BRIEF'S FIRST QUESTION IS WHO CAN BUY THE PROPERTY. IN THIS COUNTRY THE ANSWER IS SITTING IN THE STANDARD STATUTE OF AN ORDINARY MEMBERSHIP ASSOCIATION, AND IT APPEARS WORD FOR WORD IN THE STATUTES OF SEPARATE, UNRELATED ASSOCIATIONS: THE ASSOCIATION BUYS OR RENTS THE IMMOVABLE PROPERTY NEEDED FOR ITS PURPOSES, ESTABLISHES RIGHTS OVER IT, AND ACCEPTS AND OR PURCHASES LAND ALLOCATED FOR USE AS WETLAND, FOREST, SHELTER, NURSERY OR PARK. AN ORDINARY ASSOCIATION HERE CAN BUY A WETLAND OR A WOOD. NOT A FOUNDATION WITH AN ENDOWMENT, NOT AN INTERNATIONAL TRUST — A MEMBERSHIP ASSOCIATION THAT A GROUP OF NEIGHBOURS CAN ESTABLISH. AND BECAUSE THE WORDING IS A MODEL CLAUSE THAT SEVERAL ASSOCIATIONS SHARE, A NEW GROUP CAN PUT IT INTO ITS OWN STATUTE AT FOUNDING, WHEN IT COSTS NOTHING. A GROUP WHOSE STATUTE OMITS THE POWER TO ACQUIRE AND HOLD IMMOVABLE PROPERTY CANNOT SIMPLY BUY LAND LATER WHEN A PARCEL COMES UP FOR SALE — it must amend its statute first, which takes a general assembly and time it will not have. THIS IS THE SINGLE CHEAPEST PREPARATION A COMMUNITY CAN MAKE. THE ASSOCIATION ANCHORED HERE IS THE COUNTRY'S ESTABLISHED NATIONAL NATURE CONSERVATION BODY, BASED IN THE CAPITAL AND ENTITLED TO OPEN BRANCHES AND REPRESENTATIONS AT HOME AND ABROAD. ITS STATED PURPOSE REACHES FURTHER THAN MOST: STEPPE AND MOUNTAIN ECOSYSTEMS, FORESTS, AGRICULTURAL LANDS, SOIL AND WATER RESOURCES, MEADOWS AND PASTURES, SEAS, LAKES, RIVERS, WETLANDS AND CAVES — their protection and use within ecosystem integrity — together with public education through training, panels and seminars. MEADOWS, PASTURES AND CAVES ARE NAMED EXPLICITLY. THOSE ARE EXACTLY THE CATEGORIES THAT FALL OUTSIDE FOREST AND PROTECTED-AREA LAW ACROSS THIS REGION, and a community whose commons is grazing land or whose site is a cave system has an organisation whose own objects cover it. IT CAN ALSO OPEN A BRANCH WHERE YOU ARE. JOINING OR HOSTING A BRANCH OF AN ESTABLISHED NATIONAL ASSOCIATION IS FASTER AND SAFER THAN FOUNDING A NEW BODY — the constitution, the bank account and the standing already exist, a point this file has now recorded in four countries. ONE FURTHER FACT FROM THIS ROUND IS WORTH USING WHEREVER YOU RAISE MONEY: THE COUNTRY'S LARGEST CONSERVATION FOUNDATION HOLDS A NUMBERED REGISTRATION WITH THE DIRECTORATE GENERAL OF FOUNDATIONS AND WAS GRANTED TAX EXEMPTION BY A COUNCIL OF MINISTERS DECISION, WITH THE RESULT THAT DONATIONS MADE TO IT MAY BE DEDUCTED FROM THE DONOR'S TAX BASE. ASK ANY BODY YOU FUNDRAISE THROUGH WHETHER IT HOLDS TAX-EXEMPT STATUS — the same donation is worth materially more through a body that does, and businesses will give to one that does when they will not give to one that does not. THE LIMITS: this country already holds more entries in this map than any other, and this addition widens that gap. The association is a conservation and education body, NOT A LITIGATOR — the chambers and activist-lawyer formations recorded separately here are for that. Buying land requires money the association will not have for your site, so the clause matters chiefly for what YOUR OWN organisation is empowered to do. Statute wording and current activity were read from published texts and were not verified with the association itself.

trackers.name: Public procurement authority — the citizen query tools, the searchable ban list, and the standing rule that sinks most complaints
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE FULLEST PROCUREMENT DISCLOSURE FOUND IN TWENTY-THREE COUNTRIES, AND THE PART THAT MATTERS SITS IN A SECTION OF THE PLATFORM ADDRESSED TO CITIZENS RATHER THAN BIDDERS. WHAT CAN BE SEARCHED THERE: WHETHER A PERSON OR FIRM IS BARRED FROM PARTICIPATING IN TENDERS; THE BOARD'S DECISION RECORDS, IN THREE SEPARATE CLASSES — DISPUTE DECISIONS, REGULATORY DECISIONS AND COURT DECISIONS — WITH THE BOARD'S MEETING DATES PUBLISHED IN ADVANCE; WHETHER A CONTRACT WAS TRANSFERRED TO A DIFFERENT FIRM; THE STATUS OF AN APPEAL-COMPLAINT; A TENDER SEARCH WITH AN AT-A-GLANCE VIEW; AND THE PUBLIC PROCUREMENT BULLETIN ARCHIVE, DOWNLOADABLE. THE DECISIONS THEMSELVES, AND THE COURT RULINGS ON THEM, ARE PUBLIC AND SEARCHABLE. A COMMUNITY CAN READ HOW COMPLAINTS ABOUT THE SORT OF CONTRACT THAT AFFECTS IT WERE DECIDED, AND WHETHER THE COURTS AGREED — which is the same advantage this file recorded where hearings are broadcast, obtained here in writing and at any hour. THE CONTRACT-TRANSFER QUERY DESERVES ITS OWN NOTE: A CONTRACT WON BY ONE COMPANY AND PERFORMED BY ANOTHER IS A PATTERN COMMUNITIES OFTEN SUSPECT AND CANNOT PROVE. HERE IT IS A SEARCHABLE FACT. THE CALCULATION TOOLS ARE PUBLISHED TOO, AND ONE IS USEFUL BEYOND BIDDING: THE LIMIT-VALUE CALCULATION — THE THRESHOLD BELOW WHICH A BID IS TREATED AS ABNORMALLY LOW. A WINNING PRICE FAR BENEATH THAT LINE IS THE ARITHMETIC SIGN OF A JOB THAT CANNOT BE DONE PROPERLY FOR THE MONEY, and the tool that computes it is open to anyone. THE APPEAL ROUTE IS AN APPEAL-COMPLAINT TO THE AUTHORITY, WITH A PUBLISHED APPLICATION FEE PAID THROUGH NAMED BANKS AND PUBLISHED RULES ON REFUND OF THAT FEE. WHERE THE BOARD ORDERS A CORRECTIVE ACTION, THE RECORD APPEARS IN THE DECISIONS SECTION AT MIDNIGHT THE SAME DAY, WITH THE FULL TEXT FOLLOWING ONCE THE PARTIES HAVE BEEN NOTIFIED — so an outcome is visible before the reasoning is. NOW THE RULE THAT SINKS MORE COMPLAINTS THAN ANY OTHER, AND IT IS THE MOST TRANSFERABLE THING IN THIS ENTRY: TO COMPLAIN ABOUT A QUALIFICATION CRITERION IN A TENDER NOTICE, YOU MUST HAVE DOWNLOADED OR PURCHASED THE TENDER DOCUMENT FIRST. OTHERWISE THE COMPLAINT IS REJECTED FOR LACK OF STANDING — AND BUYING THE DOCUMENT AFTERWARDS DOES NOT CURE THE DEFECT. SO THE DOCUMENT MUST BE TAKEN BEFORE THE OBJECTION IS MADE, NOT AFTER IT IS REFUSED. THIS FILE HAS NOW RECORDED, IN SIX SEPARATE FORMS — DEPOSITS, TOKENS, POWERS OF ATTORNEY, PREQUALIFICATION, ACCOUNTS, AND NOW DOCUMENT PURCHASE — THAT THE APPARATUS FOR ACTING MUST EXIST BEFORE THERE IS ANYTHING TO ACT ON. THE LIMITS: this is a procurement remedy, NOT A PLANNING OR ENVIRONMENTAL ONE — it governs how a contract was awarded, not whether a project should proceed. The standing rule shows how tightly participation is defined, and WHETHER A RESIDENT OR ASSOCIATION THAT IS NOT A BIDDER MAY COMPLAIN AT ALL WAS NOT VERIFIED — the same unresolved question flagged in five other countries in this thread. Fees change annually. Read it with the chamber of architects' annulment cases and the ecology-law and activist-lawyer routes recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Erosion and natural assets foundation — sapling donations, and a standing protocol for planting forests on state forest land
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE LARGEST ENVIRONMENTAL FOUNDATION IN THE COUNTRY AND IT WAS MISSING FROM THIS FILE. ITS NAME STATES ITS PURPOSE — COMBATING EROSION, AFFORESTATION AND THE PROTECTION OF NATURAL ASSETS — AND IT DESCRIBES ITS WORK AS THE PROTECTION OF ALL NATURAL ASSETS, SOIL ABOVE ALL. SOIL ABOVE ALL IS AN UNUSUAL EMPHASIS AND A USEFUL ONE. MOST CONSERVATION BODIES IN THIS FILE ORGANISE AROUND SPECIES, WATER OR FORESTS; A FOUNDATION WHOSE FIRST SUBJECT IS THE GROUND ITSELF IS THE NATURAL ALLY WHERE THE LOSS IS TOPSOIL, TERRACING, GRAZING LAND OR AGRICULTURAL SOIL RATHER THAN TREES OR WILDLIFE. HOW IT TAKES MONEY MATTERS FOR A COMMUNITY THAT WANTS TO RAISE SOME. IT ACCEPTS ONE-OFF AND REGULAR DONATIONS BY CARD OR BANK TRANSFER WITH THE DONOR SETTING THE AMOUNT; IT RUNS SAPLING DONATION CATEGORIES, WHERE A GIVER PAYS FOR TREES RATHER THAN FOR A BUDGET LINE; AND IT ACCEPTS IN-KIND DONATIONS FROM COMPANIES, WHOSE NAMES IT PUBLISHES. THE SAPLING DONATION IS THE MODEL WORTH COPYING ANYWHERE. PEOPLE WHO WILL NOT GIVE TO AN ORGANISATION WILL BUY A TREE, BECAUSE THE THING BOUGHT IS VISIBLE AND COUNTABLE — and this file has recorded planting as the safest and most fundable physical act in six countries. THE PUBLISHED LIST OF CORPORATE IN-KIND DONORS IS ALSO WORTH READING: IT SHOWS WHICH COMPANIES IN THE COUNTRY WILL GIVE MATERIALS RATHER THAN MONEY, WHICH IS OFTEN WHAT A LOCAL PROJECT ACTUALLY NEEDS. AND THERE IS A ROUTE ONTO STATE LAND: THE FOUNDATION HOLDS A PROTOCOL WITH THE GENERAL DIRECTORATE OF FORESTRY ON THE ESTABLISHMENT OF MEMORIAL FORESTS, LATER AMENDED BY A SUPPLEMENTARY PROTOCOL. A STANDING AGREEMENT BETWEEN A CIVIL FOUNDATION AND THE STATE FORESTRY ADMINISTRATION MEANS PLANTING ON PUBLIC FOREST LAND HAS AN ESTABLISHED CHANNEL RATHER THAN NEEDING A NEW PERMISSION EACH TIME. FOR A COMMUNITY THAT WANTS TREES ON GROUND IT DOES NOT OWN, ASKING THE FOUNDATION THAT ALREADY HOLDS THE PROTOCOL IS FASTER THAN APPROACHING THE FORESTRY DIRECTORATE ALONE. ONE FINDING FROM THE SEARCH THAT PRODUCED THIS ENTRY IS WORTH RECORDING PLAINLY: LOOKING FOR ORGANISATIONS THAT BUY LAND FOR CONSERVATION IN THIS COUNTRY FOUND DONATION-FUNDED FOUNDATIONS INSTEAD. NO LAND-PURCHASE PROGRAMME SURFACED — which matches what this file has found across the region, where conservation bodies plant, lease, survey and litigate far more often than they buy. THE LIMITS: this entry records THE FOUNDATION, ITS DONATION ROUTES AND THE FORESTRY PROTOCOL ONLY. ITS PROGRAMMES, REGIONAL BRANCHES, VOLUNTEER STRUCTURE AND WHETHER IT SUPPORTS COMMUNITIES OPPOSING SPECIFIC PROJECTS WERE NOT EXAMINED THIS ROUND and should be checked before relying on it. A large foundation with corporate donors will weigh which disputes it enters. Read it with the nature association's land-purchase statute clause, the chamber of architects' annulment cases and the public procurement authority recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Small grants programme tiers and the coastal environment fund — money for advocacy, legal strengthening and access to data
trackers.desc: MOST ENVIRONMENTAL FUNDING PAYS FOR TREES, SURVEYS OR EDUCATION. THIS ONE NAMES SOMETHING RARER AMONG ITS PRIORITIES: PROJECTS AIMING TO SUPPORT AND STRENGTHEN CONSERVATION ORGANISATIONS LEGALLY AND INSTITUTIONALLY — INCLUDING ADVOCACY, NETWORK-BUILDING, AND DEVELOPING THE ABILITY TO ACCESS ACCURATE DATA AND INFORMATION IN THE AREAS WHERE THEY WANT TO MOBILISE CONSERVATION ACTION. LEGAL AND INSTITUTIONAL STRENGTHENING, ADVOCACY AND ACCESS TO DATA ARE THE THREE THINGS THIS FILE HAS SAID COMMUNITIES LACK AND NOBODY FUNDS. HERE THEY ARE WRITTEN INTO A FUNDER'S OWN PRIORITY LIST — SO A PROPOSAL TO PUT A GROUP ON A PROPER LEGAL FOOTING, OR TO BUILD THE CAPACITY TO GET AND READ OFFICIAL DATA, IS NOT A DIVERSION FROM THE FUND'S PURPOSE BUT ONE OF ITS STATED AIMS. THE FUND SUPPORTS ORGANISATIONS WORKING ON NATURE, BIODIVERSITY, MARINE AND COASTAL CONSERVATION IN THE COUNTRY'S SOUTHERN AND WESTERN COASTAL REGIONS, INCLUDING ISLANDS, COASTAL AREAS AND WETLANDS, AND IS NOW IN ITS FIFTH ROUND — A FUND THAT HAS RUN FIVE TIMES IS ONE WHOSE NEXT ROUND CAN BE PLANNED FOR. ITS OTHER PRIORITY IS WORTH READING FOR THE VOCABULARY ALONE: INNOVATIVE APPROACHES PROMOTING HOLISTIC, CROSS-SECTORAL, LOCAL-TO-NATIONAL, TRANSPARENT, ADAPTIVE, INCLUSIVE AND PARTICIPATORY MANAGEMENT OF COASTAL USE, INCLUDING SMALL-SCALE FISHERIES. SMALL-SCALE FISHERIES NAMED INSIDE A CONSERVATION FUND MEANS FISHING FAMILIES ARE INTENDED BENEFICIARIES, NOT OBSTACLES. A COASTAL COMMUNITY WHOSE LIVELIHOOD IS AT RISK FROM A PORT, A MARINA OR A RECLAMATION SHOULD WRITE ITS PROPOSAL IN THOSE WORDS. ELIGIBILITY IS THE PART TO CHECK FIRST, AND IT IS ACHIEVABLE: ASSOCIATIONS, FOUNDATIONS, NON-PROFIT COOPERATIVES, UNIONS AND FEDERATIONS ESTABLISHED IN THE COUNTRY, ACTIVE IN THE FIELD FOR AT LEAST ONE YEAR. ONE YEAR OF ACTIVITY IS THE THRESHOLD THAT CATCHES PEOPLE OUT. A GROUP FORMED THE MONTH A PROJECT IS ANNOUNCED CANNOT APPLY — WHICH IS THE STRONGEST ARGUMENT THIS FILE HAS FOUND FOR CONSTITUTING AN ASSOCIATION BEFORE THERE IS A CRISIS, AND KEEPING SOME RECORD OF ITS ACTIVITY FROM THE START. THERE IS A SECOND FUND WITH SMALLER, FASTER TIERS: A SMALL GRANTS PROGRAMME OPERATING IN A HUNDRED AND TWENTY-SEVEN COUNTRIES, OFFERING PROJECT DEVELOPMENT GRANTS UP TO FIVE THOUSAND DOLLARS, PUBLICATION AND MEETING PROJECTS UP TO TEN THOUSAND, AND IMPLEMENTATION PROJECTS UP TO SEVENTY-FIVE THOUSAND, WITH A PUBLISHED DEADLINE AND LATE APPLICATIONS ROLLED INTO THE NEXT ROUND. THE PROJECT DEVELOPMENT TIER IS THE ONE NEWCOMERS MISS. FIVE THOUSAND DOLLARS TO WRITE A PROPER PROPOSAL IS HOW A VILLAGE GROUP BECOMES ABLE TO ASK FOR SEVENTY-FIVE — AND A PUBLICATION AND MEETING GRANT PAYS FOR EXACTLY THE GATHERING AND THE PRINTED CASE THAT THIS FILE KEEPS RECOMMENDING.
