AND CONTRACTUAL CONSERVATION BINDS YOU TOO: an agreement to keep land in ecologically sustainable use restricts what your own people may do with it, so read what is prohibited, for how long, and what happens if the community changes its mind. NOTE ON THE ADDRESS: this entry points at a published case study of the fund's work in this country rather than the fund's own site, which was not established here.

trackers.name: ICCA Consortium — it names this country's own customary system, and takes unregistered members
trackers.desc: THE INTERNATIONAL FRAMEWORK ALREADY HAS A PLACE FOR THIS COUNTRY'S OWN TRADITION. The territories and areas conserved by Indigenous peoples and local communities that this association upholds expressly include systems called YERLI QORUKH, alongside himas, qoroq and others. A community defending land it has always looked after is not proposing something imported; it is claiming a category that already exists internationally under its own name. AND MEMBERSHIP DOES NOT REQUIRE STATE RECOGNITION. Member organisations DO NOT NEED TO BE FORMALLY RECOGNISED BY STATE GOVERNMENTS, and eligible members expressly include traditional communities and THEIR CUSTOMARY NETWORKS, ASSOCIATIONS AND FEDERATIONS, and SELF-INITIATED GROUPINGS. That matters especially here, where this file has recorded that domestic organisations cannot safely be named and where almost every other entry is a foreign institution or a tool used alone — this one can be joined by people who have registered nothing. WHAT IT IS: an international membership association of Indigenous peoples, local communities and supporting organisations documenting, sustaining and DEFENDING territories of life, with over a hundred and sixty member organisations, around four hundred honorary members across eighty countries, and regional coordinators and national focal points who can be contacted directly. IT PUBLISHES A SEQUENCE TO FOLLOW: understand and strengthen your territory; communicate it; CREATE A CRITICAL MASS OF SUPPORT; REGISTER IT; SECURE LEGAL OR POLICY RECOGNITION. Registration runs through a registry managed by a United Nations conservation monitoring centre, is made VOLUNTARILY BY THE CUSTODIANS, and can lead to a territory being counted among the world's recognised protected and conserved areas — which is a designation that outside institutions understand. THE CAUTION IS THE SAME ONE THIS FILE HAS GIVEN ABOUT EVERY MAPPING AND REGISTRATION TOOL: REGISTERING A TERRITORY PUBLISHES ITS LOCATION AND ITS CUSTODIANS. Read it alongside the digital security helpline recorded separately for this country, and note that the consortium's own steps place registration late, after support has been built, rather than at the start. THE OTHER LIMITS: it does not fund, litigate or represent; members must be not-for-profit; and any legal recognition is granted by the state rather than by the consortium.

trackers.name: The Commissioner for Human Rights — it can go to court against a state body on your behalf
trackers.desc: ITS MANDATE DESCRIBES THE OTHER SIDE OF A LAND DISPUTE ALMOST EXACTLY. It exists to restore rights violated by STATE BODIES, MUNICIPALITIES, and LEGAL ENTITIES IN STATE OR MUNICIPAL OWNERSHIP OR WHOSE CONTROLLING STAKE BELONGS TO THE STATE OR A MUNICIPALITY — including public legal entities and budget organisations — and their officials. The permitting authority, the municipality and a state-controlled developer all fall inside that. AND IT HAS A POWER ALMOST NOTHING ELSE IN THIS MAP HAS: IT MAY APPLY TO THE COURT FOR THE RESTORATION OF RIGHTS VIOLATED BY A DECISION, AN ACTION OR AN INACTION of a state body, a municipality, another institution or an official. Inaction is included — which covers a request ignored, a hearing never held, an inspection never carried out. SOMEBODY ELSE CAN COMPLAIN FOR YOU. A complaint may be lodged by a THIRD PERSON OR A NON-GOVERNMENTAL ORGANISATION with the consent of the person whose rights were violated, and WITHOUT that consent where it cannot be obtained. In a country where this file has declined throughout to name domestic organisations because doing so can expose people, a channel that accepts a complaint filed on someone's behalf is worth knowing about. Complaints are accepted from citizens, foreigners, stateless persons AND LEGAL ENTITIES. ITS OTHER POWERS WHEN IGNORED: escalating to the higher instance of the body concerned or to other state bodies; REFERRING THE MATTER FOR A CRIMINAL CASE where signs of a crime appear; appealing through cassation; PUBLISHING THE RESULTS OF ITS INSPECTIONS IN THE MASS MEDIA; and, where a violation is of SPECIAL PUBLIC IMPORTANCE and its own means are insufficient, applying to the President and speaking with a report before parliament. Publication and escalation are what make an ignored complaint costly. IT IS NOT ONLY IN THE CAPITAL: it operates regional centres in several named cities. Established at the end of 2001 under a constitutional law, with a published telephone number. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE REAL. It is a state institution, and it CANNOT EXAMINE the President, members of parliament or judges. Its independence in practice is a judgement this file does not make for you — and this payload records a digital security helpline for this country precisely because of documented risk. Weigh what a written complaint discloses, and consider having an organisation file it rather than a household.

trackers.name: Environmental Defender Law Center — pro bono lawyers, a funded expert, and money for litigation expenses
trackers.desc: IT DOES THREE THINGS, ALL WITHOUT CHARGE, AND THE SECOND CLOSES THE GAP THIS FILE HAS FOUND IN ALMOST EVERY COUNTRY. It FINDS LAWYERS — enlisting private firms to act pro bono for communities facing harm from projects affecting their health, land and way of life, for people CHARGED OR IMPRISONED IN POLITICALLY MOTIVATED PROSECUTIONS, and for land claims. IT PROVIDES RESOURCES — advising LOCAL lawyers running domestic cases, preparing and submitting legal briefs, and giving ACCESS TO EXPERT NETWORKS where experts frequently work pro bono or at reduced fee AND IT IS OFTEN ABLE TO FUND THEIR EXPENSES. A community here can describe what a scheme is doing to its water, its air or its ground; what it cannot do is pay a qualified person to prove it. THIS IS THE BODY THAT FINDS THAT PERSON AND PAYS FOR THEM. AND IT GIVES GRANTS FOR THE EXPENSES OF LITIGATION — a programme running since 2010, roughly a hundred grants made, aimed at the costs of public interest cases against those responsible for resource development projects. Expenses rather than fees are what kill cases: filing costs, translation, travel, expert reports. ITS METHOD IS WORTH ADOPTING EVEN IF IT NEVER TAKES YOUR CASE: it INTERNATIONALISES the issue, showing decision-makers that the acts complained of breach international human rights norms AND THE GOVERNMENT'S OWN TREATY OBLIGATIONS. This file has recorded that this country is party to conventions on environmental information and participation; an argument framed against commitments the state has itself accepted travels further than one framed as objection. WHY IT SUITS THIS COUNTRY PARTICULARLY: this chat has declined throughout to name domestic organisations here because doing so can expose people, and it records a digital security helpline and an ombudsman with power to go to court. AN OUTSIDE BODY THAT RECRUITS LAWYERS AND FUNDS EXPERTS WITHOUT REQUIRING A LOCAL ORGANISATION TO EXIST IS THE KIND OF SUPPORT THAT FITS THAT SITUATION. THE LIMITS. It works in developing countries and specialises in cases of INTERNATIONAL SIGNIFICANCE where a strategy can later be replicated — a purely local dispute with no wider bearing may not qualify. It is funded by foundation grants and donations and based abroad, so approaching it is a foreign contact, which in this country is a decision to weigh alongside the security guidance recorded here. Contact is by email, and eligibility and how to apply must be asked directly.

trackers.name: BankTrack — find out which banks finance the project, then use their own complaint channels
trackers.desc: THIS MAP TELLS COMMUNITIES HOW TO COMPLAIN TO A PROJECT'S FINANCIERS AND HAS NEVER TOLD THEM HOW TO FIND OUT WHO THE FINANCIERS ARE. This organisation does that, and says so plainly: it offers RESEARCH SUPPORT, ASSISTING IN RESEARCHING THE FINANCIAL ARCHITECTURE OF SPECIFIC DEALS AND SECTORS, and states it is ready to assist COMMUNITIES AND THE ORGANISATIONS REPRESENTING THEM in dealing with banks financing activities that directly affect their rights and interests. IT ALSO KEEPS A PUBLIC DATABASE LINKING NAMED BANKS TO NAMED PROJECTS AND COMPANIES, so the financing behind a scheme near you may already be mapped before you ask. This country's listing holds two corporate accountability organisations that help communities bring complaints; what none of them supplies is THE NAME OF THE LENDER, and that name is what makes those channels usable. ONCE YOU HAVE IT, THEIR GUIDE TELLS YOU WHERE TO TAKE IT: banks' OWN GRIEVANCE MECHANISMS, their WHISTLEBLOWING CHANNELS, OECD NATIONAL CONTACT POINTS, UN SPECIAL PROCEDURES, the independent accountability mechanisms of development banks, industry-level mechanisms, and a dedicated complaints channel for projects financed under the Equator Principles — with guidance on the extent and LIMITS OF BANKS' DUTIES OF CONFIDENTIALITY. Confidentiality is the standard refusal, and knowing its limits is the difference between accepting it and answering it. THEY ALSO RECORD WHAT BANKS ACTUALLY SAY: a response-tracking database scores how banks replied to specific allegations, including one that answered by citing client confidentiality and declining to comment on data linked to its clients. Read those before writing, so the reply does not surprise you. AND THEY WILL MAKE THE SCHEME VISIBLE: they offer space to profile a company or project alongside its financiers, and a community can ask to be listed in the RESISTANCE section of a given deal. THE LIMITS, AND THE FIRST IS A DECISION ONLY YOU CAN MAKE. BEING PROFILED IS PUBLIC. In a country where this file has declined throughout to name domestic organisations because visibility endangers people, asking to appear in a public campaign listing is a serious step — read this with the digital security helpline recorded separately here, and note that RESEARCH SUPPORT AND A PRIVATE ENQUIRY REQUIRE NO PUBLIC PROFILE AT ALL. They target COMMERCIAL banks rather than the state, and they campaign rather than litigate.

trackers.name: Caucasus Nature Fund — it pays the running costs, which is what nobody funds
trackers.desc: THIS FILE CAN NOW TELL A COMMUNITY IN EVERY COUNTRY OF THIS REGION HOW TO GET LAND PROTECTED. IT HAS ALMOST NOTHING ON WHO PAYS FOR IT AFTERWARDS — the wardens, the fences, the fuel, the plans. THIS FUND EXISTS FOR EXACTLY THAT: its mission is LONG-TERM FUNDING FOR OPERATING COSTS, improved management and the sustainable development of the region's protected areas. It supports EIGHTEEN PROTECTED AREAS across this country and its two neighbours, from an endowment of around twenty-four million euro, and it was founded in 2007 by an international conservation organisation, a European development ministry and a global wildlife fund. ITS DESIGN IS THE PART TO UNDERSTAND BEFORE APPROACHING IT, BECAUSE IT IS BOTH A LEVER AND A VULNERABILITY. THE FUND WORKS THROUGH PUBLIC-PRIVATE PARTNERSHIPS WITH THE THREE GOVERNMENTS BY MATCHING, BUT NOT EXCEEDING, THE STATE BUDGETS — so each side commits long-term support and neither can quietly withdraw. The lever is that a government cutting its protected-area budget also loses the matching money, which is an argument to put in public. The vulnerability is that the fund follows official priorities: IT WILL NOT PAY FOR A SITE THE STATE DOES NOT FUND, so it cannot be used to protect ground the authorities have decided to develop. WHAT THAT MEANS PRACTICALLY FOR A COMMUNITY HERE. If the ground you are defending lies inside or beside an existing protected area, this is where the money for managing it comes from, and a case for strengthening that area's management is a case this fund is built to hear. If your ground is outside the protected area system, the contractual conservation fund recorded separately for this country — which pays communities to hold land under agreement — is the nearer instrument. THE LIMITS, PLAINLY. IT FUNDS PROTECTED AREAS RATHER THAN LAND PURCHASE, and mostly state ones. It is headquartered in Germany with programme offices in the two neighbouring capitals AND HAS NO OFFICE IN THIS COUNTRY, so an approach goes through the region rather than locally. And a fund whose method is matching government budgets is a partner of the government, not an opponent of it — read that alongside everything else this file records about naming yourself in this country.TWO THINGS THIS ENTRY DID NOT RECORD, AND THE SECOND IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS TO A COMMUNITY WITH NO PARK NEARBY. FIRST, WHAT THE MATCHING GRANTS ACTUALLY BUY: OPERATING COSTS INCLUDING SALARY SUPPLEMENTS, ESSENTIAL EQUIPMENT AND MAINTENANCE — ALONGSIDE MANAGEMENT PLANS, BIODIVERSITY MONITORING SYSTEMS AND ECOTOURISM PROGRAMMES THAT SUPPORT LOCAL LIVELIHOODS. SALARY SUPPLEMENTS ARE THE RAREST LINE IN THIS ENTIRE FILE. ALMOST EVERY FUNDER RECORDED HERE PAYS FOR PROJECTS; THIS ONE HELPS PAY THE WAGES OF THE PEOPLE WHO GUARD THE LAND — CURRENTLY SUPPORTING THE WORK AND LIVELIHOODS OF AROUND EIGHT HUNDRED AND FIFTY PARK EMPLOYEES ACROSS FIVE PROTECTED AREAS IN ONE COUNTRY AND SIXTEEN IN ANOTHER, WITH FUNDING ALSO REACHING MONITORING, CAPACITY BUILDING AND COMMUNITY ENGAGEMENT IN AND AROUND THOSE AREAS. THE FUND HAS GROWN FROM SEVEN AND A HALF MILLION EUROS AT ITS START IN 2008 TO MORE THAN EIGHTY-FIVE MILLION IN ASSETS, RUNNING AN ANNUAL PROGRAMME OF JUST UNDER FOUR MILLION. AND ITS FIRST ACT IS WORTH KNOWING BECAUSE IT SHOWS WHAT IT WILL DO QUICKLY: SIXTY THOUSAND EUROS OF EMERGENCY FUNDING FOR FIREFIGHTING EQUIPMENT FOR A NATIONAL PARK AFTER FIRES, IN ITS FIRST YEAR. SECOND, AND MORE USEFUL WHERE THERE IS NO PROTECTED AREA YET: THE SAME EUROPEAN DEVELOPMENT MINISTRY THAT CAPITALISED THIS FUND ALSO FINANCES THE DEVELOPMENT OF NEW PROTECTED AREAS AND MAJOR PROTECTED-AREA INFRASTRUCTURE THROUGH SEPARATE OPEN PROGRAMMES FOR ALL THREE COUNTRIES OF THE REGION, AND FINANCES TRANSBOUNDARY COOPERATION THROUGH A JOINT SECRETARIAT. SO THE MONEY TO CREATE A PROTECTED AREA IS HELD SEPARATELY FROM THE MONEY TO RUN ONE. A COMMUNITY WHOSE GROUND HAS NO STATUS SHOULD ASK ABOUT THE OPEN PROGRAMME, NOT THE TRUST FUND — the fund matches the budgets of areas that already exist, while the open programme pays for bringing new ones into being. ASKING THE WRONG ONE WASTES A YEAR.

trackers.name: National hydrological committee chair — a named hydrometeorologist at the state university
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HAS REFUSED THROUGHOUT TO NAME DOMESTIC ORGANISATIONS IN THIS COUNTRY, BECAUSE NAMING THEM CAN EXPOSE PEOPLE. AN ACADEMIC POST IS DIFFERENT: THE CHAIRPERSON OF THE NATIONAL HYDROLOGICAL COMMITTEE HOLDS THE CHAIR OF HYDROMETEOROLOGY AT THE STATE UNIVERSITY, and is published as this country's contact for the international water science programme. That is an institution and a professional post, not an activist — the same boundary this file drew when recording a bar's assistance office and a constitutional complaints commission in another restricted country. WHAT HYDROMETEOROLOGY ACTUALLY HOLDS IS THE POINT. Rainfall series, river flow records, flood frequency, drought history — THE DATA UNDERNEATH ANY CLAIM ABOUT A WATERCOURSE. A scheme proposed on a floodplain, a diversion that will change a flow, an abstraction that will lower a water table: each of those is an argument about numbers that already exist in a university department. This file has said in almost every country that communities cannot afford to prove harm. A UNIVERSITY CHAIR HOLDS THE MEASUREMENTS ALREADY, and a request for published records costs nothing. ASK FOR WHAT IS ALREADY PUBLISHED, AS THIS FILE LEARNED A ROUND EARLIER: an existing record cannot be dismissed as evidence commissioned by objectors, and a flood series held by a state university is the state's own science. AND ASK WHO ELSE SITS ON THE COMMITTEE. The programme's council recommends that these national committees be MULTI-STAKEHOLDER IN MEMBERSHIP, including not only scientists and water managers but government bodies, professional associations AND CIVIL SOCIETY — so asking which civil society bodies are members, or asking to be included, is asking for what the programme itself says should exist. In a country where independent organisations are hard to identify at all, THE COMMITTEE'S MEMBERSHIP LIST IS A MAP OF WHO WORKS ON WATER HERE. THE LIMITS. The committee is constituted and runs under the authority of the national government, so it is not independent; the chairperson is an academic who will not advocate for anyone; and no direct telephone number was published in what was reached, so an approach goes through the university's hydrometeorology department. Frame the request as a technical question about records for a named place, and read this alongside the digital security helpline recorded separately for this country before making contact.

trackers.name: Bar legal aid centre — an address, a telephone, an email and opening hours
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY'S LISTING HELD A STATE COMMISSIONER AND AN INTERNATIONAL PRO BONO NETWORK AND NO DOMESTIC WAY TO REACH A LAWYER. THE BAR'S PRESIDIUM CREATED A LEGAL AID AND TRAINING CENTRE THAT HAS OPERATED SINCE 26 DECEMBER 2019, AND IT PUBLISHES A STREET ADDRESS IN THE CAPITAL, A TELEPHONE NUMBER, AN EMAIL ADDRESS ON THE BAR'S OWN DOMAIN, AND OPENING HOURS OF HALF PAST NINE TO FOUR ON WEEKDAYS. Very few entries in this entire payload carry all four. THERE IS A SECOND DOOR AT THE SAME HOURS: THE JUSTICE ACADEMY'S LAW CLINIC. Two separate places to ask, in a country where this file has been able to name almost nothing domestic. WHAT TO TAKE WITH YOU, BECAUSE ARRIVING WITHOUT IT WASTES THE VISIT: AN APPLICATION REQUESTING FREE LEGAL AID, AND A DOCUMENT PROVING THAT YOU FALL WITHIN A CONCESSION CATEGORY — an income certificate, a disability certificate, a veteran's document or the equivalent. THE CONCESSION CATEGORY IS THE GATE, so establish which category you might fall into before you go, and take the paper that proves it. THE ENTITLEMENT IS CONSTITUTIONAL, WHICH IS WORTH SAYING IN THE APPLICATION ITSELF: ARTICLE 61 OF THE CONSTITUTION GUARANTEES EVERYONE THE RIGHT TO HIGH-QUALITY LEGAL AID AND, IN THE CASES PROVIDED BY LAW, LEGAL AID FREE OF CHARGE AT STATE EXPENSE. Note the words HIGH-QUALITY: the guarantee is not merely of a lawyer but of a competent one. AND THE STATE HAS PUT MONEY BEHIND IT. A PRESIDENTIAL ORDER PROVIDED FOR PREMISES FOR THE COLLEGIUM'S STRUCTURES IN THE CAPITAL AND IN THE REGIONS, AND FOR TRIPLING THE SUM PAID FOR STATE-FUNDED LEGAL AID. That matters more than it sounds: this file found next door that assigned counsel underperform largely because assignment pays badly, so a threefold increase is the single most likely thing to improve the service a person actually receives. NOW THE SCALE PROBLEM, AND IT IS SEVERE. REPORTING CITES ONE LAWYER PER TEN THOUSAND PEOPLE IN CRIMINAL MATTERS, and a dedicated free legal aid law remains AT CONCEPT STAGE, discussed as covering FOUR REGIONS INITIALLY. Expect scarcity, apply early, and ask at both doors rather than one. THE OTHER LIMITS: this is the bar's own centre and a state-funded scheme, so it is not independent; the contact details published for the centre should be confirmed by telephone before travelling; and a concession-category gate means an ordinary landowner in a property dispute may not qualify — ASK WHICH CATEGORIES AND WHICH CASE TYPES ARE COVERED BEFORE BUILDING ANY PLAN ON IT.THE DIRECTORY BEHIND THIS BAR WAS NOT RECORDED HERE, AND IT IS THE PART THAT ANSWERS WHICH LAWYER: ITS SITE LISTS INDIVIDUAL ADVOCATES WITH THE BUREAU THEY WORK IN, THE FOREIGN LANGUAGES THEY KNOW, THE LENGTH OF THEIR PRACTICE IN YEARS, THEIR EDUCATION, AND THEIR SPECIALISED FIELDS OF LAW — WITH PROPERTY AND THINGS LAW AMONG THOSE FIELDS, ALONGSIDE INHERITANCE, LABOUR AND FAMILY LAW. A COMMUNITY FIGHTING A PROJECT DOES NOT NEED A LAWYER, IT NEEDS A PROPERTY LAWYER WITH YEARS BEHIND THEM — AND HERE THAT CAN BE ESTABLISHED BEFORE THE FIRST TELEPHONE CALL. THE LANGUAGES COLUMN MATTERS TOO, BECAUSE A CASE THAT MAY END UP BEFORE AN INTERNATIONAL BODY NEEDS SOMEBODY WHO CAN WORK IN A SECOND LANGUAGE. THE BUREAUX THEMSELVES ARE PUBLISHED WITH THE NAME OF EACH DIRECTOR, A STREET ADDRESS AND TELEPHONE NUMBERS — NUMBERED BUREAUX ACROSS THE CAPITAL'S DISTRICTS AND BUREAUX IN OTHER CITIES — SO THE NEAREST ONE CAN BE FOUND WITHOUT AN INTRODUCTION. AND ONE CHANGE MATTERS MORE TO A LAND CASE THAN ANYTHING ELSE HERE: AMENDMENTS TO THE CIVIL PROCEDURE CODE NOW PROVIDE FOR ADVOCATES' SERVICES IN CIVIL CASES AT THE EXPENSE OF THE STATE. CIVIL, NOT ONLY CRIMINAL. LAND, PROPERTY, EVICTION AND COMPENSATION DISPUTES ARE CIVIL MATTERS. THE STING TO UNDERSTAND FIRST: A COURT MAY DECIDE IN ITS FINAL RULING THAT THE SUM PAID TO THE ADVOCATE BE RECOVERED FROM THE PARTY AGAINST WHOM JUDGMENT WAS GIVEN, IN PROPORTION TO THE PART OF THE CLAIM UPHELD, AND PAID INTO THE STATE BUDGET — THE STATE FRONTS THE COST AND RECOVERS IT FROM THE LOSER, WHICH ALSO MEANS LOSING CARRIES A BILL.

trackers.name: State support agency for NGOs — an annual grant cycle with published ceilings, and a round that only coalitions could enter
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY'S LISTING HELD ONLY FOREIGN GRANT WINDOWS. THERE IS A DOMESTIC ONE, IT RUNS ON A FIXED ANNUAL CYCLE, AND THE DATES ARE PUBLISHED: SMALL, MEDIUM AND LARGE COMPETITIONS FOR 2026 OPENED FOR DOCUMENTS ON 22 SEPTEMBER 2025, CLOSED ON 22 OCTOBER 2025, and results were to be announced IN THE FIRST QUARTER OF 2026 after expert review. An organisation that misses the autumn window waits a year, so the date matters more than the wording of any proposal. THE CEILINGS ARE PUBLISHED TOO. In a joint competition with the ecology ministry the MEDIUM COMPETITION CARRIED UP TO 30,000 MANAT AND THE LARGE UP TO 50,000, each with an implementation period of UP TO SIX MONTHS. SIX MONTHS IS THE PLANNING CONSTRAINT: this funds a season of work — a survey, a planting, a monitoring round, a training programme — not a multi-year defence of a site. Design the project to finish. AND THE CONDITION WORTH KNOWING BEFORE YOU START IS THE MOST UNUSUAL THING IN THIS ENTRY: IN THAT ENVIRONMENTAL ROUND, ORGANISATIONS COULD TAKE PART ONLY AS A COALITION. The funder required them to combine before it would consider them at all. Where a funder demands coalitions, THE RELATIONSHIPS ARE THE ELIGIBILITY — and they cannot be built in the month before a deadline. If your group is alone, the useful work between now and the next window is finding the two or three other bodies you could apply with. ENVIRONMENTAL THEMES REACH THIS FUNDER MAINLY THROUGH JOINT COMPETITIONS WITH THE ECOLOGY MINISTRY rather than as a standing window, so watch both bodies' announcements rather than only the agency's. THE AGENCY DOES THREE OTHER THINGS WORTH KNOWING: it CONDUCTS EXPERT REVIEW of the projects submitted to it, which means a rejected proposal has been assessed and the assessment can be asked about; it ALLOCATES FUNDS FOR NGOs TO TAKE PART IN INTERNATIONAL EVENTS, which is a separate and much smaller ask than a project grant and a way to put a local problem in front of an outside audience; and it MONITORS THAT STATE-BUDGET GRANTS ARE USED FOR THEIR STATED PURPOSE, so reporting obligations are real. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE THE SAME ONES THIS FILE ATTACHES TO EVERYTHING IN THIS COUNTRY. IT IS A STATE AGENCY DISBURSING STATE-BUDGET MONEY ON THEMES THE GOVERNMENT SETS; nothing found shows it funding work that opposes a development. Applying identifies your organisation and its members. And grants go to registered non-governmental organisations, so an unregistered group must first constitute itself or join a coalition with a body that already has. Read this with the digital security helpline recorded separately here.CORRECTION AND COMPLETION OF THE FIGURES ABOVE. THERE ARE THREE TIERS, NOT TWO, AND THE IMPLEMENTATION PERIODS DIFFER BETWEEN THEM: SMALL GRANTS UP TO 15,000 MANAT WITH UP TO SIX MONTHS TO IMPLEMENT; MEDIUM UP TO 30,000 WITH UP TO NINE MONTHS; LARGE UP TO 50,000 WITH UP TO TWELVE MONTHS. THE SMALL TIER IS THE ONE A COMMUNITY ORGANISATION SHOULD LOOK AT FIRST — it is the least contested, the reporting burden is smallest, and a completed small grant is the record that makes a later medium bid credible. AND THE STRATEGIC RULE: AN ORGANISATION CHOOSES FOR ITSELF WHICH TIER ITS PROPOSAL FITS AND MAY SUBMIT DIFFERENT PROJECTS TO ALL THREE COMPETITIONS — BUT ONLY ONE PROJECT PER ORGANISATION MAY BE FINANCED IN A CALENDAR YEAR. So submitting to several tiers costs nothing and raises the chance of one success; submitting the same idea twice does not. THE PAPERWORK IS FIXED AND SHOULD BE ASSEMBLED BEFORE THE WINDOW OPENS: the CHARTER, the REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE and an EXTRACT FROM THE STATE REGISTER OF LEGAL PERSONS; the TAX REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE; the identity document of the authorised representative; BANK ACCOUNT DETAILS; a financial justification of the budget for medium and large bids; and, for those tiers, disclosure of whether the organisation has received grants from bodies on a list fixed by presidential decree. THE COALITION REQUIREMENT FLAGGED EARLIER NOW HAS ITS RULES: ONE ORGANISATION MAY BELONG TO ONLY ONE COALITION; a coalition may bid in all three competitions but ONLY ONE OF ITS PROJECTS WILL BE FUNDED; any foreign partner must be described in full — country, field of work, experience, website; the coalition's staff must have INTERNATIONAL PROJECT MANAGEMENT EXPERIENCE; AND A LETTER OF SUPPORT FROM THE FOREIGN PARTNER MUST ACCOMPANY THE BID. THAT LETTER IS THE LONG-LEAD ITEM — request it months ahead, not in the final week. FOUR THINGS GET A BID EXCLUDED OUTRIGHT, AND THE FIRST IS THE ONE COMMUNITIES TRIP OVER: A PROJECT THAT DOES NOT MATCH THE ORGANISATION'S OWN CHARTER OBJECTIVES. The others are projects contradicting the constitution, the laws or the governing decisions; PROJECTS OF THE SAME CONTENT ALREADY FINANCED FROM THE STATE BUDGET IN EARLIER ROUNDS; and bids from organisations that have been DEPRIVED OF THE RIGHT TO COMPETE FOR BREACHING GRANT OBLIGATIONS. READ THAT FIRST EXCLUSION AGAINST WHAT THIS FILE HAS SAID ABOUT STATUTES SINCE R367: THE OBJECTS WRITTEN INTO A CHARTER DECIDE WHAT CAN LATER BE FUNDED. An organisation whose charter does not mention the environment cannot be funded for environmental work here, however good the project. AND THE THEMES FOR THE CURRENT CYCLE INCLUDE THE PROTECTION OF THE ENVIRONMENT AND HEALTH — so environmental work is inside the announced priorities, not an exception to them.FOUR PROCEDURAL FACTS WERE NOT RECORDED HERE, AND EACH ONE DECIDES WHETHER AN APPLICATION SURVIVES. FIRST, THE SMALL WINDOW EXISTS AND IS THE ONE TO USE FIRST: UP TO FIFTEEN THOUSAND MANAT OVER SIX MONTHS, BESIDE THE MEDIUM AND LARGE WINDOWS. AND THE ORGANISATION DECIDES FOR ITSELF WHICH COMPETITION ITS PROPOSAL FITS, WITH NO RESTRICTION ON SUBMITTING DIFFERENT PROJECTS TO ALL THREE — SO A GROUP WITH ONE STRONG IDEA AND TWO MODEST ONES SHOULD ENTER EVERY WINDOW RATHER THAN STAKING EVERYTHING ON THE LARGEST. SECOND, SUBMISSION IS ELECTRONIC ONLY, THROUGH THE AGENCY'S APPLICATION SECTION DURING A STATED ONE-MONTH WINDOW — DOCUMENTS DELIVERED IN PERSON, BY POST OR BY EMAIL ARE NOT ACCEPTED. THAT RULE HAS NO SECOND ROUTE. A RURAL GROUP WITHOUT RELIABLE INTERNET SHOULD PLAN THE UPLOAD DAYS IN ADVANCE RATHER THAN THE DEADLINE DAY, BECAUSE A FAILED CONNECTION ON THE LAST AFTERNOON ENDS THE APPLICATION. THIRD, SCORING IS PUBLISHED: AFTER A TECHNICAL EXPERTISE STAGE, PROJECTS ARE ASSESSED ON A HUNDRED-POINT SYSTEM AGAINST STATED CRITERIA, WITH RESULTS ANNOUNCED IN THE FOLLOWING QUARTER. ASK FOR THE CRITERIA AND STRUCTURE THE PROPOSAL IN THEIR ORDER RATHER THAN YOUR OWN. FOURTH, AND THE ONE TO ACT ON YEARS EARLY: JOINT ENVIRONMENTAL COMPETITIONS WITH THE ENVIRONMENT MINISTRY HAVE DEMANDED EVIDENCE OF MEDIA COVERAGE — AT LEAST TEN SEPARATE ITEMS OVER THREE YEARS FOR THE MEDIUM WINDOW AND TWENTY OVER FIVE YEARS FOR THE LARGE — ALONGSIDE THE COALITION REQUIREMENT. THAT IS THE QUIET BARRIER, AND IT CANNOT BE ANSWERED INSIDE THE MONTH A CALL IS OPEN. A GROUP THAT WANTS ENVIRONMENTAL FUNDING HERE SHOULD BE GETTING ITS WORK REPORTED SOMEWHERE PUBLISHABLE NOW AND KEEPING THE LINKS. ONE FURTHER EXCLUSION WORTH CHECKING BEFORE BUILDING ANY COALITION: ORGANISATIONS THAT WON EARLIER COMPETITIONS BUT DID NOT COMPLETE THEIR OBLIGATIONS, AND THOSE WITH DEBTS TO THE AGENCY, ARE BARRED FROM ENTERING — ONE PARTNER'S ARREARS CAN SINK AN OTHERWISE STRONG BID.

trackers.name: State nurseries that give saplings to citizens, and the planting campaign to join
trackers.desc: THIS FILE ASKED TWO ROUNDS AGO WHERE RESTORATION PLANTS COME FROM. HERE IS THE PLAINEST ANSWER IT HAS FOUND: IN A SINGLE SPRING SEASON, MORE THAN 121,000 TREE SAPLINGS GROWN IN THE ENVIRONMENT MINISTRY'S OWN NURSERIES WERE DISTRIBUTED TO CITIZENS, TO EXECUTIVE AUTHORITIES, AND TO STATE AND PRIVATE ORGANISATIONS. CITIZENS ARE NAMED AS RECIPIENTS — the trees exist, they are grown at public expense, and they are handed out. ASK THE FORESTRY SERVICE WHICH NURSERY SERVES YOUR DISTRICT, WHAT SPECIES IT HOLDS, WHEN DISTRIBUTION OPENS, AND WHAT A COMMUNITY GROUP MUST DO TO RECEIVE A CONSIGNMENT. That is a request for something already budgeted, not a favour. THE CAMPAIGN AROUND IT IS THE WAY IN. A JOINT PLANTING CAMPAIGN RUN BY THE ENVIRONMENT MINISTRY WITH A PUBLIC UNION PUT MORE THAN 400,000 FOREST TREES INTO OPEN AREAS OF THE STATE FOREST FUND IN ONE SPRING AND SOWED MORE THAN FOUR TONNES OF SEED to assist forest restoration — with state bodies, private companies, media, VOLUNTEERS AND CIVIL SOCIETY REPRESENTATIVES all named as taking part. A community that wants its own degraded hillside or riverbank planted is asking to be included in something that already exists and already counts its results. THE CIVIL VEHICLE IS A PUBLIC UNION FOUNDED IN JULY 2011 for environmental awareness, work with young people and education. Two of its projects are worth copying anywhere. IT PLANTS FRUIT ORCHARDS IN THE REGIONS AND HANDS THEM OVER FREE OF CHARGE FOR THE USE OF LOW-INCOME FAMILIES — restoration that produces food and income for named households, which is the form hardest for any authority to refuse. AND IT PLANTS TREES CHOSEN TO SUIT THE SOIL AND CLIMATE of the area rather than whatever is available, which is the difference between a plantation that survives and one that dies in its second summer. It also works on restoring green cover in residential courtyards, and holds observer membership of the United Nations climate convention process. AND THE ROUTES IN THIS MAP NOW JOIN UP. This file recorded at R363 the state agency that runs grant competitions for organisations here. A LOCAL ECOLOGICAL UNION HAS USED EXACTLY THAT AGENCY'S FINANCIAL SUPPORT TO RUN A TREE-PLANTING ACTION ON A RIVER. SO THE FULL SEQUENCE IS AVAILABLE: A GRANT FROM THE AGENCY, SAPLINGS FROM THE MINISTRY'S NURSERIES, AND A NATIONAL CAMPAIGN TO PLANT UNDER — none of which requires a community to buy anything. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE THE SAME ONES THIS FILE ATTACHES TO EVERYTHING IN THIS COUNTRY. These are state and state-linked bodies; planting happens where the authorities agree, and nothing here will be turned against a development the government supports. Participation is public and identifies those who take part. AND PLANTING IS NOT PROTECTION — trees on ground without status can be cleared, so ask what status the planted area will have before choosing where to put them.TWO THINGS BELONG WITH THIS. THE FIRST IS THE SIGN-UP: THE ORGANISATION RUNS A VOLUNTEER PAGE INVITING ANYONE TO JOIN — TO TAKE PART IN TREE PLANTING, BEACH CLEANING OR ORGANISING ENVIRONMENTAL EVENTS, AND TO LEARN SKILLS, BUILD CONNECTIONS AND DEVELOP LEADERSHIP — ALONGSIDE SHORELINE CLEAN-UP ACTIONS ITS FOUNDER TAKES PART IN. A COMMUNITY TRYING TO HOLD GROUND NEEDS TWO THINGS IT CANNOT BUY: HANDS, AND WITNESSES. AN ORGANISED NETWORK THAT ALREADY TRAVELS TO PLANT AND CLEAN IS BOTH, AND ASKING IT TO BRING AN ACTION TO YOUR HILLSIDE OR YOUR STRETCH OF COAST IS ASKING FOR SOMETHING IT ALREADY DOES — WITH PHOTOGRAPHS AND A DATE AS THE BY-PRODUCT, WHICH IS EVIDENCE THAT LAND IS IN USE AND CARED FOR. THE SECOND IS THE SET OF FIGURES IT PUBLISHES, WHICH FRAME EVERY LAND ARGUMENT IN THIS COUNTRY: TWELVE NATIONAL PARKS, NINE STATE NATURE RESERVES AND TWENTY-FOUR STATE NATURE SANCTUARIES MAKE UP 11.59 PER CENT OF THE TERRITORY; A FURTHER 14.02 PER CENT SITS INSIDE THE FOREST FUND; AND SPECIALLY PROTECTED NATURAL AREAS ALTOGETHER COME TO 25.61 PER CENT OF THE COUNTRY. THOSE PERCENTAGES ARE A TOOL, NOT TRIVIA. THE FIRST QUESTION ABOUT ANY THREATENED PARCEL IS WHICH CATEGORY IT ALREADY FALLS IN — BECAUSE IF IT IS INSIDE THE FOREST FUND OR A SANCTUARY, THE ASK CHANGES FROM PLEASE PROTECT THIS TO YOU ALREADY DID.

trackers.name: The environment ministry's public council — a seat civil society elects, and who may stand for it
trackers.desc: IN THE MOST RESTRICTED COUNTRIES THIS FILE HAS RECORDED WHAT THE STATE OFFERS AND LITTLE THAT COMMUNITIES CONTROL. HERE IS A STATUTORY BODY ATTACHED TO THE ENVIRONMENT MINISTRY WHOSE MEMBERS ARE ELECTED BY CIVIL SOCIETY INSTITUTIONS, UNDER A 2013 LAW ON PUBLIC PARTICIPATION AND A 2014 REGULATION SETTING OUT HOW THE ELECTION RUNS. AND THE COMPOSITION OF THE ELECTION COMMISSION IS THE PART THAT MATTERS: IT HAS NINE MEMBERS — FOUR FROM THE AUTHORITY AND FIVE FROM CIVIL SOCIETY INSTITUTIONS, and for a ministry those five come from bodies SPECIALISED IN THAT FIELD. CIVIL SOCIETY HOLDS THE MAJORITY ON THE COMMISSION THAT RUNS THE ELECTION. That is a real, written allocation of control, and it is worth knowing before assuming the process is decorative. WHO MAY STAND IS WIDER THAN ANYONE EXPECTS: ANY CAPABLE CITIZEN AGED SIXTEEN OR OVER with knowledge or experience in ecology and natural resources — expressly regardless of race, nationality, language, religion, sex, origin, PROPERTY STATUS, position, belief, or membership of any party, union or association. A SIXTEEN-YEAR-OLD FROM A VILLAGE WITH REAL KNOWLEDGE OF ITS RIVER OR PASTURE IS ELIGIBLE, and so is someone with no property and no institutional position. THE NOMINATION RULES REWARD ORGANISATION. EACH CIVIL SOCIETY INSTITUTION — NGOs, public associations, trade unions, committees, FOUNDATIONS — MAY NOMINATE ONLY ONE CANDIDATE, so a coalition must agree on a single name rather than splitting its vote. AND THIS IS THE PROVISION MOST GROUPS MISS: INSTITUTIONS THAT NOMINATE NOBODY MAY STILL TAKE PART IN THE ELECTION, by registering their representatives with the commission TEN DAYS BEFORE THE VOTE. A SMALL LOCAL BODY WITH NO CANDIDATE OF ITS OWN STILL HAS A VOTE — which means a network of village associations can decide who sits on the council. WHAT THE COUNCIL CAN THEN DO: MAKE PROPOSALS ON DRAFT LEGAL ACTS concerning state policy in its field, and COLLECT, GENERALISE AND SUBMIT CIVIL SOCIETY PROPOSALS ON SOCIALLY SIGNIFICANT ISSUES to central and local executive and self-government bodies. It may form COMMITTEES, COMMISSIONS, EXPERT GROUPS AND WORKING GROUPS, AND DRAW IN EXPERTS, SCIENTIFIC ORGANISATIONS AND INTERNATIONAL ORGANISATIONS. A COUNCIL WORKING GROUP IS A LAWFUL WAY TO PUT OUTSIDE EXPERTISE IN FRONT OF A MINISTRY. NOTE ALSO THAT THESE COUNCILS EXIST AT LOCAL EXECUTIVE AND SELF-GOVERNMENT LEVEL TOO, not only at ministries — which is the level most land disputes are decided at, and the level where a village body's five-member share of a commission is most achievable. THE LIMITS, STATED PLAINLY AND PARTLY BY THE COUNCILS THEMSELVES: THIS IS A CONSULTATIVE BODY. It advises, proposes and submits; it does not decide, and it cannot stop a project. A council chair has been quoted saying the country has good laws and that the gap is the absence of mechanisms. Elections are organised by the authority the council will advise, and membership is public. USE IT AS A ROUTE FOR EVIDENCE AND PROPOSALS, ALONGSIDE THE ENVIRONMENTAL INFORMATION CENTRE AND THE GRANT AGENCY RECORDED SEPARATELY HERE — not as a substitute for them.

trackers.name: REC Caucasus — its stated mission is to offer assistance to environmental NGOs, and it has an office in Baku
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE FIRST ENTRY IN THIS FILE FOR AZERBAIJAN WITH A PHYSICAL OFFICE IN THE COUNTRY — the other three are foreign application portals reachable only by email. The centre is headquartered in Tbilisi with country offices in Yerevan and Baku. ITS MISSION IS UNUSUALLY EXPLICIT ABOUT WHOM IT SERVES: to develop free exchange of information IN LINE WITH THE PRINCIPLES OF THE AARHUS CONVENTION, to OFFER ASSISTANCE TO ALL ENVIRONMENTAL NGOS AND OTHER STAKEHOLDERS, and to increase public participation in decision-making — promoting cooperation among non-governmental organisations, governments, business and local communities alike. That is a stated commitment to assist civil society, not merely to advise ministries, and it is worth quoting back when asking for help. WHAT IT ACTUALLY PROVIDES: advisory services on environmental topics through training, experience sharing and education, and programmes that strengthen the capacity of non-governmental organisations, local governments and other environmental stakeholders. It reports around sixty medium and large projects across the region since its establishment. Its governance includes an international advisory council of eleven representatives drawn from the three South Caucasus countries and from international donors, and it sits as a permanent member of the energy and environment platform of the European Union's Eastern Partnership Civil Society Forum — which is a route by which a regional environmental concern can reach a European process. Constituted under the Environment for Europe process following the 1995 Sofia ministerial conference, with its charter signed in September 1999 by the governments of Azerbaijan, Armenia and Georgia together with the European Union, and registered in March 2000. Funded over time by the European Commission, the governments of Germany, the Netherlands and Norway, the Global Environment Facility, the German development agency, the German development bank, the OSCE, the United States development agency and others. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE THE SAME AS FOR ITS CENTRAL ASIAN COUNTERPART: this is a body founded by governments, and it convenes, trains and advises rather than opposing anything. It will not campaign against a project, and in Azerbaijan specifically a reader should weigh carefully what any approach involves. Use it for information, for training, for contacts across the three countries, and as a route into regional and European environmental processes.

trackers.name: State property service — register a right of way over someone else's land, and check what encumbers your own
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY HAD THE FEWEST ENTRIES IN THE MAP AND NOTHING AT ALL ABOUT LAND RIGHTS. THE MOST USEFUL SERVICE HERE IS NOT THE REGISTER ITSELF BUT ONE THAT CREATES A RIGHT: SERVITUDES CAN BE REGISTERED ON THE STATE REGISTER OF IMMOVABLE PROPERTY. A SERVITUDE IS A REGISTERED RIGHT OVER SOMEBODY ELSE'S LAND — A PATH TO A SPRING, A TRACK TO PASTURE, A ROUTE TO A FIELD, ACCESS TO A WATER SOURCE. ONCE REGISTERED IT BINDS THE LAND ITSELF, NOT MERELY THE NEIGHBOUR WHO SIGNED IT: the next owner, and a developer who buys the plot, takes it subject to that right. THAT IS THE SINGLE MOST DURABLE THING A COMMUNITY IN THIS COUNTRY CAN DO ABOUT ACCESS, AND MOST PEOPLE RELY INSTEAD ON CUSTOM AND GOODWILL, WHICH SURVIVE NEITHER A SALE NOR A FENCE. HOW IT IS DONE: THE APPLICATION GOES THROUGH THE ELECTRONIC SERVICES PORTAL, ACCOMPANIED BY A NOTARIALLY CERTIFIED SERVITUDE CONTRACT AND AN IDENTITY DOCUMENT, WITH A STATE DUTY AND SERVICE FEE PAID. Once executed, AN ENCUMBRANCE EXTRACT IS PREPARED RECORDING THE SERVITUDE, and the applicant is notified by message. THE HARD PART IS THE NOTARISED AGREEMENT WITH THE LANDOWNER — negotiate that while relations are good, not after a sale is announced. THE REGISTER SIDE MATTERS TOO. THE SERVICE HANDLES STATE REGISTRATION AND CANCELLATION OF OWNERSHIP RIGHTS, AND REGISTRATION AND CANCELLATION OF ENCUMBRANCES — so it is where you learn what already burdens a parcel, including mortgages and existing servitudes. FOR A COMMUNITY FACING A DEVELOPMENT, WHAT ENCUMBERS THE DEVELOPER'S LAND IS AS INFORMATIVE AS WHO OWNS IT. EXTRACTS ARE ELECTRONIC AND IMMEDIATE: they are placed on the national electronic government portal and A RIGHTS-HOLDER CAN OBTAIN THEIR EXTRACT IN REAL TIME through a personal account. Of forty-one electronic services offered, TWENTY-SIX CONCERN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY REGISTRATION, and the same operations can be done at the one-stop public service centres for those who do not use the portal. ONE DOCUMENT REQUIREMENT IS WORTH KNOWING BECAUSE IT WORKS BOTH WAYS: REGISTERING A HOUSE REQUIRES A DOCUMENT CONFIRMING OWNERSHIP, LEASE OR USE RIGHT OVER THE LAND PLOT, TOGETHER WITH THE ARCHITECTURAL-PLANNING SECTION OF THE CONSTRUCTION PROJECT. A BUILDING CANNOT BE REGISTERED WITHOUT AN ESTABLISHED RIGHT TO THE GROUND BENEATH IT — which is a question worth asking about any structure appearing next to you. THE LIMITS: this is a state registration service, not an advocate — it records and certifies, and it will not tell you whether an entry is correct or help you contest one. Registering a servitude requires the landowner's agreement, so it is a route where relations permit, not against a hostile owner. Duties and fees apply and were not itemised here. In this country, dealings with state bodies are visible. Read it with the bar's legal aid centre and the pro bono defenders' network recorded separately here.

trackers.name: Cultural heritage state service — protection zones being drawn now, and how a site gets onto the list
trackers.desc: THE TIMING IS THE WHOLE POINT OF THIS ENTRY. THE PROTECTION ZONES AROUND MONUMENTS IN THIS COUNTRY ARE BEING DRAWN RIGHT NOW: IN ONE REPORTING YEAR 110 MONUMENT PASSPORTS AND 72 PROTECTION ZONES WERE APPROVED, WITH 155 FURTHER PASSPORTS AND 108 PROTECTION-ZONE PROJECTS IN PREPARATION. A ZONE THAT HAS NOT YET BEEN DRAWN IS A ZONE WHOSE BOUNDARY CAN STILL BE INFLUENCED. AND A PROTECTION ZONE IS EXACTLY WHAT A COMMUNITY WANTS: IN LAW IT IS AN ADDITIONAL REGULATION ZONE ESTABLISHED AROUND THE AREA WHERE A MONUMENT STANDS, SET ACCORDING TO THE CHARACTER OF THAT MONUMENT, SO AS NOT TO HARM ITS APPEARANCE. IT REGULATES THE GROUND AROUND THE BUILDING, NOT ONLY THE BUILDING. WHO TO APPROACH: A STATE SERVICE FOR THE PROTECTION, DEVELOPMENT AND RESTORATION OF CULTURAL HERITAGE, RESTRUCTURED BY PRESIDENTIAL DECREE IN 2019 EXPRESSLY TO STRENGTHEN STATE CONTROL OVER PROTECTED MONUMENTS, AND OPERATING THROUGH FIVE NAMED REGIONAL DIRECTORATES. FIND THE DIRECTORATE COVERING YOUR DISTRICT RATHER THAN WRITING TO THE CAPITAL. HOW A SITE GETS ONTO THE LIST IS THE MOST ACTIONABLE PART: THE SERVICE'S STAFF COLLECT MATERIALS AND SUBMIT THEM TO AN EXPERT COUNCIL, WHICH DECIDES WHETHER NEWLY IDENTIFIED EXAMPLES ARE TAKEN UNDER STATE PROTECTION. ONE SITTING CONSIDERED 76 NEWLY IDENTIFIED EXAMPLES ACROSS TWO CITIES AND NINE DISTRICTS, AND 51 NEW EXAMPLES WERE ADDED TO THE LIST IN A SINGLE YEAR. MATERIALS ARE COLLECTED AND SUBMITTED — SO SUPPLY THEM. Photographs, measurements, the history of the structure and its architectural or archaeological significance are what the council reads, and a district office with a file already assembled has far less work to do than one starting from nothing. KNOW ALSO THAT LISTING CAN BE UNDONE: REMOVAL OF A MONUMENT FROM THE APPROVED LIST IS CARRIED OUT BY THE EXECUTIVE AUTHORITY ON A PROPOSAL, TAKING INTO ACCOUNT THE OPINION OF A DESIGNATED SCIENTIFIC ORGANISATION. THE SAME EXPERT OPINION THAT SUPPORTS A LISTING GOVERNS ITS REMOVAL, which tells you where to direct evidence if a listing near you is challenged. THERE IS A SEPARATE AND STRONGER TRACK FOR NATURE, AND IT DESERVES ITS OWN ENQUIRY: NATURAL MONUMENTS ARE REGISTERED BY THE ECOLOGY MINISTRY WITH MARKER SIGNS PLACED IN THE FIELD, AND EACH RECEIVES A PASSPORT RECORDING ITS SIGNIFICANCE, NAME, LOCATION, DATE OF ESTABLISHMENT AND THE STATE ACT ON THE LAND-USE RIGHTS OF THE OWNER, USER OR LESSEE OF THE LAND IT STANDS ON. AND HANDING NATURAL MONUMENTS INTO MANAGEMENT, USE OR LEASE IS PROHIBITED. THAT PASSPORT TIES A PROTECTED NATURAL FEATURE TO A NAMED LANDHOLDER ON AN OFFICIAL DOCUMENT — which is precisely the link a community needs when a tree, spring or rock formation is threatened by whoever holds the ground. THE LIMITS: this is a state service that lists, zones and restores; IT IS NOT AN ALLY AND WILL NOT OPPOSE A DEVELOPMENT, and listing decisions rest with an executive authority on expert advice. Approaching official bodies in this country is visible. The figures come from official reporting of a particular year and were not re-verified for currency; confirm the current programme with the regional directorate. Read it with the pro bono lawyers' network and the public council recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Union of architects — and the national year of urban planning that opens the door to it
trackers.desc: WHERE INDEPENDENT ORGANISING IS CONSTRAINED, THE PROFESSIONS STILL HAVE BODIES. THIS COUNTRY HAS A UNION OF ARCHITECTS WITH ITS OWN BUILDING, AN ACTIVE SECRETARIAT THAT HOLDS EXPANDED SESSIONS AND TAKES DECISIONS, A PROGRAMME OF EVENTS — INCLUDING ONE ON SUSTAINABLE ARCHITECTURE HELD AT ITS OWN PREMISES — AND TIES TO THE NATIONAL ARCHITECTURE AND CONSTRUCTION UNIVERSITY. AND THE MOMENT TO APPROACH IT IS NOW, FOR A REASON THAT WILL NOT REPEAT: 2026 HAS BEEN DECLARED THE YEAR OF URBAN PLANNING AND ARCHITECTURE BY PRESIDENTIAL ORDER. READ WHAT THE ORDER SAYS THE YEAR IS FOR, BECAUSE IT IS THE LANGUAGE TO USE IN ANY APPROACH: THE PROTECTION OF HISTORICALLY FORMED CITIES AND OF WHOLE URBAN-PLANNING SYSTEMS; PLANNED WORK ON THE RESTORATION OF ARCHITECTURAL MONUMENTS IN CITIES; AND THE INSTITUTIONAL ARRANGEMENTS THAT GIVE CONTINUITY TO ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN-PLANNING ACTIVITY. It names state-protected fortresses, caravanserais, mosques, temples and mausoleums as carrying the traditions of national architecture. WHOLE URBAN-PLANNING SYSTEMS, NOT SINGLE BUILDINGS. A COMMUNITY WHOSE OLD QUARTER, MARKET STREET OR MAHALLA IS THREATENED AS A UNIT IS DESCRIBING PRECISELY WHAT THE YEAR SAYS IT EXISTS TO PROTECT — and this file recorded in another country that settlement-level designation is stronger than listing buildings one by one. A NATIONAL YEAR CARRIES BUDGETS, EVENT PROGRAMMES, RESTORATION SCHEDULES AND OFFICIAL ATTENTION, AND IT LASTS TWELVE MONTHS. THE ACTION IS SIMPLE AND TIME-LIMITED: ASK THE UNION AND THE RELEVANT AUTHORITY HOW SITES ARE PROPOSED FOR THE YEAR'S PROGRAMME, AND SUBMIT YOURS — with photographs, measurements and whatever history you hold. Officials under instruction to fill a year's calendar are far more receptive than officials with nothing to deliver. AND THE TWO PROGRAMMES RUN TOGETHER. THIS FILE RECORDED SEPARATELY THAT THE HERITAGE SERVICE HERE IS DRAWING MONUMENT PROTECTION ZONES RIGHT NOW, WITH OVER A HUNDRED ZONE PROJECTS IN PREPARATION AND SEVENTY-TWO ALREADY APPROVED IN A SINGLE YEAR. A SITE PUT FORWARD DURING THE NATIONAL YEAR IS BEING PUT FORWARD WHILE THE ZONES ARE STILL BEING DRAWN — make both requests in the same submission: recognition, and a protection zone around it. THE UNION IS ALSO WHERE TO FIND AN ARCHITECT WHO WILL READ A DRAWING. As with the engineers' society recorded in another Gulf country, asking a professional body which of its members works on historic fabric is a different and cheaper request than asking a firm to quote for a study. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE HEAVY. THIS IS A PROFESSIONAL UNION OPERATING ALONGSIDE THE STATE IN A COUNTRY WHERE INDEPENDENT ORGANISING IS SEVERELY CONSTRAINED AND APPROACHING OFFICIAL BODIES IS VISIBLE. IT WILL NOT OPPOSE A DEVELOPMENT, and a national year is a promotional programme as much as a protective one — restoration under it may mean rebuilding rather than conservation. Membership terms, and whether it accepts public proposals at all, WERE NOT VERIFIED. Read it with the heritage service, the pro bono lawyers' network and the public council recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: State property auctions — dated land notices, online bidding, and published results showing address and price
trackers.desc: THE PREVIOUS ROUND RECORDED THAT COMMON LAND IS SOLD BY PUBLISHED AUCTION IN ONE COUNTRY. HERE THE SAME IS TRUE AND THE SYSTEM IS TIGHTER: THE STATE PROPERTY SERVICE PUBLISHES A RUNNING LIST OF AUCTION ANNOUNCEMENTS WITH EXACT DATES AND TIMES, INCLUDING NOTICES ON THE HOLDING OF LAND COMPETITIONS AND AUCTIONS, alongside sales of listed taxpayer property and goods transferred into state ownership. SO THE FIRST HABIT IS THE SAME AS BEFORE: READ THE NOTICE LIST. A DATED ANNOUNCEMENT THAT LAND IS GOING TO COMPETITION IS THE EARLIEST WARNING A COMMUNITY WILL GET, AND IT COSTS NOTHING TO CHECK. PARTICIPATION IS OPEN AND ELECTRONIC: AUCTIONS RUN LIVE AND ONLINE THROUGH ONE SYSTEM, AND TO JOIN AN ELECTRONIC AUCTION YOU ENTER THE ELECTRONIC SERVICES PORTAL AS THE AUCTION BEGINS AND SELECT THE ELECTRONIC AUCTION SERVICE, REGISTERING WITH DATA ISSUED BY THE AUCTION CENTRE. THAT MATTERS BECAUSE A COMMUNITY BODY WITH MONEY BEHIND IT CAN BID FOR THE LAND ITSELF — the brief's first ask — rather than only objecting to whoever else does. AND THE RESULTS SIDE IS WHERE THIS SYSTEM GIVES MORE THAN MOST: RESULTS MUST BE PUBLISHED WITHIN FIFTEEN DAYS IN THE OFFICIAL NEWSPAPER AND ON THE OFFICIAL WEBSITE, STATING THE ADDRESS OF THE OBJECT SOLD AND THE AMOUNT PAYABLE TO THE STATE BUDGET. FOR LEASES, THE SAME FIFTEEN-DAY PUBLICATION GIVES THE ADDRESS AND THE RENT TO BE PAID. WHAT WAS SOLD, WHERE IT IS, AND WHAT THE STATE RECEIVED FOR IT — ALL THREE, IN PRINT, WITHIN A FORTNIGHT. AN UNDERVALUED DISPOSAL IS VISIBLE IN THAT PUBLICATION, AND SO IS A PATTERN OF DISPOSALS TO THE SAME BUYER. This file has spent many entries asking who acquired land and for how much; here the answer is published as a matter of course. FOR LEASES THERE IS A FURTHER DOCUMENT WORTH ASKING FOR: THE COMPETITION PROTOCOL, WHICH RECORDS THE COMMISSION MEMBERS, THE CONDITIONS, THE PARTICIPANTS' OFFERS AND THE WINNER, IS APPROVED WITHIN THREE DAYS, AND IS ITSELF THE DOCUMENT CONFIRMING THE RIGHT TO CONCLUDE THE LEASE. IT NAMES WHO DECIDED AND WHAT EVERY BIDDER OFFERED. AND ONE PLAIN STATEMENT FROM THE SAME SERVICE IS WORTH CARRYING INTO ANY DISPUTE ABOUT CREEPING DEVELOPMENT: BUILDING INDIVIDUAL RESIDENTIAL HOUSES ON LAND DESIGNATED AS AGRICULTURAL IS UNLAWFUL, BECAUSE AGRICULTURAL LAND IS DESIGNATED FOR AGRICULTURAL NEEDS. WHERE HOUSES ARE APPEARING ON FARMLAND, THAT IS NOT A GREY AREA — and the designation of a given parcel is a checkable fact through the same service's registry, recorded separately in this file. THE LIMITS: this is the body that SELLS AND LEASES state property; it publishes what it does but it is not an ally, and nothing here creates a right to object to a disposal. Bidding requires money and formal registration. Foreign persons face separate restrictions on acquiring land. Approaching state bodies in this country is visible. Read it with the property registration service, the pro bono lawyers' network and the public council recorded separately here.

trackers.name: Ecological society since 1996 — an assessment specialist, a monitor, a sociologist and a journalist on one team
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HAS FOUND FEWER INDEPENDENT ORGANISATIONS IN THIS COUNTRY THAN IN ALMOST ANY OTHER. HERE IS ONE: AN ECOLOGICAL SOCIETY DESCRIBING ITSELF AS NON-GOVERNMENTAL, NON-POLITICAL AND NON-COMMERCIAL, CREATED IN APRIL 1996 BY A GROUP OF SCIENTISTS, ENGINEERS, DOCTORS, SOCIOLOGISTS, LAWYERS, ECONOMISTS AND JOURNALISTS WORKING IN DIFFERENT FIELDS OF ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION. THIRTY YEARS OF CONTINUOUS EXISTENCE, AND LAWYERS AMONG ITS FOUNDERS. BUT THE PART WORTH READING TWICE IS THE LIST OF ROLES ON ITS PROJECT TEAM, BECAUSE IT NAMES EXACTLY THE SPECIALISMS A COMMUNITY CANNOT AFFORD TO HIRE SEPARATELY. AN ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT ASSESSMENT SPECIALIST. AN ECOLOGICAL MONITORING SPECIALIST. A RECYCLING-STRATEGY SPECIALIST. A FINANCIAL MANAGER AND AN ENVIRONMENTAL ECONOMIST. A PROJECT MANAGER FOR CAPACITY BUILDING. A SOCIOLOGIST. AN ECOLOGIST. A PUBLIC INFORMATION OFFICER. AN INVENTORY SPECIALIST. AND A JOURNALIST. THAT IS A COMPLETE OBJECTION TEAM IN ONE ORGANISATION. THE ASSESSMENT SPECIALIST READS THE DEVELOPER'S DOCUMENT; THE MONITOR MEASURES WHAT IS ACTUALLY HAPPENING; THE SOCIOLOGIST ESTABLISHES WHAT THE AFFECTED PEOPLE SAY, WHICH IS WHAT PLANNERS DISMISS AS ANECDOTE WHEN A COMMUNITY SAYS IT; THE ECONOMIST PUTS A FIGURE ON THE LOSS; THE PUBLIC INFORMATION OFFICER AND THE JOURNALIST MAKE IT PUBLIC. THE SOCIOLOGIST IS THE ROLE MOST COMMUNITIES NEVER THINK TO LOOK FOR AND MOST NEED. A SURVEY OF AFFECTED HOUSEHOLDS CONDUCTED BY A NAMED SOCIAL SCIENTIST IS EVIDENCE; THE SAME COMPLAINTS COLLECTED INFORMALLY ARE NOT. ASK ANY ORGANISATION YOU APPROACH WHETHER IT HAS ONE. APPROACH IT WITH A SPECIFIC TECHNICAL QUESTION RATHER THAN A CAMPAIGN. A BODY THAT DESCRIBES ITSELF AS NON-POLITICAL IN A COUNTRY LIKE THIS ONE IS SIGNALLING THE TERMS ON WHICH IT CAN WORK, AND THOSE TERMS ARE WORTH RESPECTING IF YOU WANT ITS HELP: ASSESSMENT REVIEW, MONITORING DATA, AN INVENTORY, A SURVEY — NOT A PROTEST. PUBLIC SOURCES ALSO NAME OTHER BODIES OF THE SAME KIND IN THIS COUNTRY — A NATURE PROTECTION SOCIETY, AN ECOLOGICAL UNION, A GREENS MOVEMENT AND A FORESTERS' SOCIETY. THIS FILE HAS NOT VERIFIED ANY OF THEM, AND THEY ARE RECORDED HERE AS LEADS TO TEST RATHER THAN AS RESOURCES. THE LIMITS: THIS ENTRY RESTS ON A PROJECT PAGE HOSTED BY AN INTERNATIONAL PARTNER RATHER THAN ON THE SOCIETY'S OWN SITE, AND THE TEAM LIST DESCRIBES ONE PROJECT'S STAFFING RATHER THAN A STANDING ROSTER — WHETHER THOSE SPECIALISTS ARE STILL ENGAGED, AND WHETHER THE SOCIETY ACCEPTS APPROACHES FROM COMMUNITIES, WERE NOT VERIFIED. Independent organising in this country is constrained and approaching institutions is visible. Read it with the state property auctions, the union of architects and the unified procurement portal recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: District hygiene and epidemiology centres — an environmental protection section and a chemical laboratory in every district
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HAS RECORDED HOW FEW INDEPENDENT BODIES EXIST IN THIS COUNTRY. HERE IS A STATE ONE THAT SITS IN EVERY DISTRICT AND CONTAINS SOMETHING USEFUL: A HYGIENE AND EPIDEMIOLOGY CENTRE WHOSE SANITARY DEPARTMENT INCLUDES SECTIONS FOR CHILDREN AND ADOLESCENTS, COMMUNAL HYGIENE, NUTRITION HYGIENE, LABOUR — AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION — WITH A SANITARY-CHEMICAL LABORATORY ATTACHED. AN ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION SECTION INSIDE A DISTRICT HEALTH CENTRE, WITH A CHEMICAL LABORATORY IN THE SAME BUILDING. THAT IS A LOCAL OFFICE WITH BOTH A MANDATE AND AN INSTRUMENT, IN A COUNTRY WHERE REACHING THE CAPITAL IS OFTEN THE ONLY OTHER OPTION. THE SECOND DEPARTMENT IS EPIDEMIOLOGICAL, CONTAINING PARASITOLOGICAL AND ENTOMOLOGICAL SECTIONS AND A BACTERIOLOGICAL LABORATORY. AND THE LABORATORIES ARE DESCRIBED PLAINLY BY THE DISTRICTS THEMSELVES: THE SANITARY-CHEMICAL LABORATORY STUDIES THE CHEMICAL COMPOSITION OF THE SAMPLES TAKEN, AND THE BACTERIOLOGICAL LABORATORY EXAMINES MAINLY SAMPLES OF WATER AND FOOD PRODUCTS — ONE DISTRICT LISTING FOUR DOCTORS AND SEVEN LABORATORY STAFF FOR THAT WORK ALONE. SO WATER AND FOOD TESTING EXISTS AT DISTRICT LEVEL, STAFFED, WITH NAMED SECTIONS. WHERE A WELL, A SPRING, A SUPPLY PIPE OR PRODUCE FROM AFFECTED LAND IS THE ISSUE, THIS IS THE NEAREST LABORATORY IN THE COUNTRY — AND THE ONE MOST ACCUSTOMED TO ROUTINE PUBLIC WORK. THE NATIONAL BODY ABOVE THEM IS A PUBLIC LEGAL ENTITY WHOSE STATED MAIN ACTIVITY IS PROTECTING AND STRENGTHENING THE HEALTH OF THE POPULATION FROM THE NEGATIVE EFFECTS OF ENVIRONMENTAL FACTORS. THAT PHRASE IS THE FRAME TO USE: NOT DAMAGE TO NATURE, BUT AN ENVIRONMENTAL FACTOR AFFECTING PEOPLE'S HEALTH — WHICH IS THE SUBJECT THIS BODY IS OBLIGED TO CARE ABOUT. AND THERE ARE PUBLISHED HOTLINE NUMBERS — ONE FOR THE MINISTRY AND ONE FOR THE REPUBLICAN CENTRE — GIVEN OUT PUBLICLY FOR CITIZENS AND BUSINESSES TO CALL. A TELEPHONE LINE PUBLISHED BY A NATIONAL HEALTH BODY IS A LOW-RISK FIRST CONTACT IN A COUNTRY WHERE APPROACHES TO INSTITUTIONS ARE VISIBLE, BECAUSE THE SUBJECT IS PUBLIC HEALTH RATHER THAN OPPOSITION. ONE PRACTICAL NOTE ON HOW TO ASK. THE SECTIONS ARE NAMED: COMMUNAL HYGIENE COVERS WATER SUPPLY AND SETTLEMENT CONDITIONS, NUTRITION HYGIENE COVERS FOOD, LABOUR COVERS WORKPLACE EXPOSURE, AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION COVERS THE REST. ADDRESS THE SECTION, NOT THE CENTRE — this file has recorded the same lesson about directorates in two other countries. THE LIMITS: this is A HEALTH REGULATOR, NOT AN ENVIRONMENTAL ONE. Harm to habitat, landscape or species is outside its remit unless it reaches people, and it will not oppose a project. WHETHER ITS DISTRICT LABORATORIES ACCEPT SAMPLES OR REQUESTS FROM RESIDENTS, AND AT WHAT COST, WAS NOT VERIFIED — the descriptions come from district executive authority pages and the ministry's own page, not from a service list. Independent organising in this country is constrained and any approach is visible. Read it with the state property auctions, the ecological society and the unified procurement portal recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Ornithological society — the 53 Important Bird Areas it mapped, member-network monitoring, and the expert who writes industry's bird chapters
trackers.desc: THIS SOCIETY DID THE ONE THING THAT MAKES A PLACE ARGUABLE: IT IDENTIFIED AND PUBLISHED THE COUNTRY'S IMPORTANT BIRD AREAS, IN VOLUMES COVERING EVERY REGION. THERE ARE FIFTY-THREE OF THEM, TOGETHER ABOUT NINE PER CENT OF THE NATIONAL TERRITORY — AND EIGHTEEN OF THEM, A THIRD, ARE WETLANDS IN THE LOWLANDS AND ALONG THE CASPIAN COAST. SO THE FIRST QUESTION FOR ANY THREATENED SITE HERE IS WHETHER IT IS INSIDE OR BESIDE ONE OF THE FIFTY-THREE. THAT IS A PUBLISHED, MAPPED, INTERNATIONALLY RECOGNISED DESIGNATION PRODUCED BY A NATIONAL SCIENTIFIC BODY — NOT AN OPINION A DEVELOPER CAN WAVE AWAY, AND IT EXISTS ALREADY, WITHOUT A COMMUNITY COMMISSIONING ANYTHING. THE WETLAND FIGURES ARE THE ONES TO QUOTE: THESE AREAS HOLD MORE THAN ONE MILLION WINTERING WATERBIRDS, INCLUDING GLOBALLY THREATENED SPECIES SUCH AS THE DALMATIAN PELICAN, THE WHITE-HEADED DUCK, THE LESSER WHITE-FRONTED GOOSE, THE FERRUGINOUS DUCK AND THE MARBLED TEAL. AND THE SOCIETY MONITORS THE WAY THIS FILE HAS REPEATEDLY RECOMMENDED: THROUGH ITS OWN LOCAL NETWORKS AND MEMBERS, WITH THE HELP OF ORNITHOLOGISTS AND OF NATIONAL PARK AND RESERVE STAFF. THAT MEANS THERE ARE PEOPLE IN THE REGIONS ALREADY COUNTING, AND A COMMUNITY'S OWN RECORDS HAVE SOMEWHERE TO GO. NOW THE PART THAT IS UNUSUAL ANYWHERE IN THIS FILE. THE SOCIETY'S SPECIALIST ORNITHOLOGIST IS NAMED IN THE ENVIRONMENTAL AND SOCIAL IMPACT ASSESSMENTS FOR OFFSHORE OIL PROJECTS AS THE EXPERT WHO PREPARED THE BIRDS SECTION — ALONGSIDE NAMED NATIONAL EXPERTS ON FISHERIES AND ON CASPIAN SEALS. THE SAME SMALL GROUP OF SPECIALISTS WRITES THE WILDLIFE CHAPTERS OF THE ASSESSMENTS THAT JUSTIFY MAJOR PROJECTS. THAT IS NOT A SCANDAL — IN A SMALL COUNTRY THERE MAY BE NO ONE ELSE QUALIFIED — BUT IT MEANS TWO THINGS. THE EXPERTISE IS REACHABLE, THROUGH A MEMBERSHIP SOCIETY RATHER THAN A CONSULTANCY. AND WHEN AN ASSESSMENT SAYS A SITE IS NOT SENSITIVE, YOU CAN READ WHO SAID SO AND WHAT THEY ACTUALLY WROTE ELSEWHERE. READ THE ASSESSMENT'S OWN BIRD CHAPTER BEFORE ARGUING WITH IT. THESE DOCUMENTS STATE WHICH IMPORTANT BIRD AREAS LIE NEAREST THE CONTRACT AREA AND IN WHICH DIRECTION, AND ONE STATES THAT THE MOST PRODUCTIVE FEEDING GROUNDS ARE IN SHALLOW WATER ROUGHLY BETWEEN NOUGHT AND FIFTEEN KILOMETRES FROM SHORE. THAT LAST SENTENCE IS A DEVELOPER'S OWN EXPERT SAYING WHERE THE BIRDS FEED. FOR ANY NEARSHORE SCHEME — A PORT, A RECLAMATION, A PIPELINE LANDFALL, A COASTAL ROAD — IT IS THE MOST USEFUL LINE IN THE WHOLE DOCUMENT, AND IT CAME FROM THEIR SIDE OF THE TABLE. THE SOCIETY ALSO PUBLISHES SPECIES AND SITE STUDIES, INCLUDING WORK ON CRITICALLY ENDANGERED BIRDS AND ON THE ECOLOGICAL CONDITION OF NAMED LAKES, AND CONTRIBUTED TO THE NATIONAL RED BOOK — WHICH THIS FILE HAS RECORDED AS THE STRONGEST RECOGNITION ROUTE IN THE REGION. THE LIMITS: this is A SCIENTIFIC MEMBERSHIP SOCIETY, NOT AN ADVOCATE OR A LITIGATOR — it surveys, publishes and advises, and its members work for industry as well as for conservation, so it will not campaign against a project. THE KEY PUBLICATIONS CITED DATE FROM AROUND 2010 AND 2011 AND THE SITE LIST MAY HAVE CHANGED; check for a current edition. THE ENTRY IS ANCHORED TO A PUBLICATION RECORD RATHER THAN THE SOCIETY'S OWN SITE, and whether it accepts records or enquiries from the public WAS NOT VERIFIED. Read it with the ecological society, the district hygiene centres and the environment ministry route recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Ombudsman's environmental section — regional centres, a 24/7 line, jurisdiction over municipalities, and an annual free legal aid campaign with the bar
trackers.desc: MOST OMBUDSMEN IN THIS FILE ARE GENERALISTS. THIS ONE HAS A DEDICATED SECTION FOR THE PROTECTION OF THE ENVIRONMENT INSIDE ITS APPARATUS, ALONGSIDE SECTIONS FOR CHILDREN'S RIGHTS, GENDER EQUALITY, RIGHTS IN THE ARMY AND LAW-ENFORCEMENT BODIES, AND TORTURE PREVENTION — STAFFED BY SPECIALISED LAWYERS, EXPERTS AND MONITORING PROFESSIONALS. A NAMED ENVIRONMENTAL SECTION MEANS AN ENVIRONMENTAL COMPLAINT DOES NOT HAVE TO BE TRANSLATED INTO SOMETHING ELSE TO BE HEARD. ADDRESS IT TO THAT SECTION BY NAME — THIS FILE HAS RECORDED REPEATEDLY THAT LETTERS ADDRESSED TO A BUILDING GO NOWHERE AND LETTERS ADDRESSED TO A NAMED UNIT GET ANSWERED. TWO POINTS OF JURISDICTION MATTER MORE THAN ANYTHING ELSE HERE. COMPLAINTS ARE CONSIDERED ABOUT THE UNLAWFUL ACTS OR OMISSIONS OF STATE BODIES, OF MUNICIPALITIES, AND OF LEGAL AND NATURAL PERSONS — AND THEY MAY BE BROUGHT NOT ONLY BY CITIZENS, FOREIGNERS AND STATELESS PERSONS BUT BY LEGAL ENTITIES. MUNICIPALITIES ARE INSIDE THE JURISDICTION. THIS FILE HAS FOUND IN NINE COUNTRIES THAT MUNICIPALITIES ZONE, LEASE AND PERMIT — AND HERE IS AN INDEPENDENT OFFICE THAT WILL EXAMINE WHAT ONE DID OR FAILED TO DO. AND BECAUSE LEGAL ENTITIES MAY COMPLAIN, A REGISTERED COMMUNITY ASSOCIATION CAN FILE IN ITS OWN NAME RATHER THAN EXPOSING A SINGLE HOUSEHOLD. THE ACCESS ROUTES ARE UNUSUALLY WIDE: POST AND EMAIL; A CALL CENTRE OPERATING TWENTY-FOUR HOURS A DAY, SEVEN DAYS A WEEK ON A SHORT NUMBER; ONLINE DIRECT APPLICATION AND INFORMATION REQUEST FORMS; THE E-GOVERNMENT PORTAL; OFFICIAL SOCIAL ACCOUNTS; RECEPTIONS HELD AT THE APPARATUS AND AT REGIONAL CENTRES; AND STAFF MEETINGS WITH POPULATION GROUPS IN THE CITIES AND DISTRICTS. NOTE THE SEPARATE INFORMATION REQUEST FORM. IT IS A DIFFERENT INSTRUMENT FROM A COMPLAINT: USE IT TO ESTABLISH FACTS — WHAT WAS DECIDED, BY WHOM, ON WHAT DATE — BEFORE FILING ANYTHING THAT DEPENDS ON THOSE FACTS. AND THE OFFICE COMES TO THE REGIONS RATHER THAN WAITING: THERE ARE REGIONAL CENTRES IN SIX NAMED CITIES, AND STAFF HOLD RECEPTIONS AND MEETINGS WITH POPULATION GROUPS IN DISTRICTS, GIVING EXPLANATIONS AND LEGAL ADVICE ON THE SPOT. ASK THE NEAREST REGIONAL CENTRE WHEN ITS NEXT RECEPTION IN YOUR DISTRICT IS — A COMPLAINT MADE IN PERSON AT A RECEPTION IS REGISTERED THE SAME AS ANY OTHER. THE VOLUME SHOWS THIS IS A WORKING CHANNEL RATHER THAN A CEREMONIAL ONE: NEARLY THIRTY THOUSAND APPLICATIONS IN A SINGLE YEAR. THERE IS ALSO A DATE WORTH DIARISING: A FREE LEGAL AID CAMPAIGN IS RUN EACH YEAR JOINTLY WITH THE UN OFFICE AND THE BAR ASSOCIATION AROUND THE NATIONAL HUMAN RIGHTS DAY, RUNNING FOR ROUGHLY A MONTH FROM LATE JUNE. A MONTH-LONG FREE LEGAL AID CAMPAIGN INVOLVING THE BAR IS THE CHEAPEST ACCESS TO A QUALIFIED LAWYER THIS FILE HAS RECORDED FOR THIS COUNTRY. IT RECURS ANNUALLY, SO A COMMUNITY THAT MISSES IT CAN PREPARE ITS PAPERS FOR THE NEXT ONE. THE LIMITS: an ombudsman EXAMINES, RECOMMENDS AND REPORTS — IT DOES NOT ANNUL DECISIONS OR STOP PROJECTS, and nothing here creates a right to object. ITS INDEPENDENCE OPERATES WITHIN A CONSTRAINED POLITICAL SYSTEM and this file has recorded civil society here working under pressure. WHETHER ENVIRONMENTAL COMPLAINTS ARE ACTED ON, AND WITH WHAT OUTCOME, WAS NOT VERIFIED — the application count says nothing about results; and the campaign dates come from an earlier year's announcement. Read it with the ornithological society's bird-area inventory, the ecological society, the district hygiene centres and the environment ministry route recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: One-stop centres — the land extract with the parcel plan and measurement, the older papers that still prove entitlement, and the price of speed
trackers.desc: A PARCEL IS DEFENDED WITH THREE DOCUMENTS: THE EXTRACT SHOWING THE REGISTERED RIGHT, THE PLAN SHOWING WHERE THE PARCEL IS, AND THE MEASUREMENT SHOWING HOW BIG IT IS. THIS SERVICE ISSUES ALL THREE TOGETHER — THE EXTRACT ON INITIAL OR REPEAT STATE REGISTRATION OF OWNERSHIP RIGHTS OVER A LAND PARCEL, WITH THE PLAN AND THE MEASUREMENT OF THAT PARCEL — AND IT IS AVAILABLE AT ALL THE ONE-STOP CENTRES. GET THEM BEFORE THERE IS A DISPUTE, NOT AFTER. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED IN COUNTRY AFTER COUNTRY THAT FAMILIES DISCOVER THE GAP IN THEIR PAPERS ONLY WHEN SOMEBODY ELSE PRODUCES BETTER ONES — AND A PLAN AND MEASUREMENT OBTAINED IN A QUIET YEAR COSTS A FRACTION OF WHAT URGENCY COSTS. THE MOST VALUABLE PART FOR OLDER HOLDINGS IS THE LIST OF DOCUMENTS THAT CAN FOUND A REGISTRATION. IT INCLUDES LEASE CONTRACTS, ORDERS AND DISPOSITIONS ISSUED TO CITIZENS FOR GARDEN PLOTS BEFORE A DATE IN 2007; THE MEMBERSHIP BOOKLET OF A COLLECTIVE GARDENING ASSOCIATION, OR AN EXTRACT FROM THE MINUTES OF ITS MEMBERS' MEETING; ACTS ON THE ALIENATION, LEASE, USE OR MORTGAGE OF STATE OR MUNICIPAL PROPERTY; FINAL PROTOCOLS OF OPEN AUCTIONS; AND NOTARISED CONTRACTS, INHERITANCE CERTIFICATES AND SPOUSAL-SHARE CERTIFICATES. A MEMBERSHIP BOOKLET FROM A GARDENING ASSOCIATION, OR A LINE IN THE MINUTES OF A MEETING DECADES AGO, CAN THEREFORE BE THE FOUNDATION OF A REGISTERED RIGHT. HOUSEHOLDS THROW SUCH THINGS AWAY BECAUSE THEY LOOK INFORMAL. FIND THEM, KEEP THEM DRY, AND TAKE THEM IN. KNOW THE DELAY CLAUSE BEFORE YOU PLAN AROUND A DATE: REGISTRATION MAY BE EXTENDED BY UP TO FIVE WORKING DAYS WHERE BOUNDARY-MARKING AND INVENTORY WORK IS REQUIRED — WHICH IS EXACTLY THE SITUATION OF ANY PARCEL WHOSE EDGES ARE UNCERTAIN, AND THAT DESCRIBES MOST RURAL LAND IN DISPUTE. AND KNOW WHAT SPEED COSTS, BECAUSE IT IS STEEP: FOR ONE PROPERTY TYPE IN THE CAPITAL THE FEE RISES FROM ABOUT FOUR HUNDRED AND SIXTY UNITS FOR FIFTEEN WORKING DAYS TO SIX HUNDRED AND NINETY FOR TEN, NINE HUNDRED AND TWENTY FOR FIVE, AND ONE THOUSAND THREE HUNDRED AND EIGHTY FOR TWO — WITH LOWER SCALES OUTSIDE THE CAPITAL. THAT PRICE CURVE IS THE ARGUMENT FOR ACTING EARLY IN ONE SENTENCE: THE SAME DOCUMENT COSTS ROUGHLY THREE TIMES AS MUCH WHEN YOU NEED IT IN TWO DAYS. A COMMUNITY THAT HEARS A PROJECT IS COMING SHOULD ORDER ITS PAPERS ON THE SLOW TARIFF THAT WEEK. ONE ACCESS NOTE RECORDED AS THE SERVICE STATES IT: FAMILIES OF THE FALLEN AND PEOPLE WOUNDED IN WAR MAY COME TO THE CENTRES DIRECTLY WITH THEIR DOCUMENTS WITHOUT TAKING AN ONLINE QUEUE NUMBER. THE LIMITS: this is A REGISTRATION AND DOCUMENT SERVICE, NOT AN ADVISER OR AN ADVOCATE — IT RECORDS RIGHTS, IT DOES NOT DEFEND THEM, AND AN EXTRACT PROVES WHAT THE REGISTER SAYS RATHER THAN WHAT IS FAIR. FEES ARE REAL AND RISE WITH URGENCY; THE FIGURES QUOTED ARE FOR ONE PROPERTY TYPE AND CITY AND SHOULD BE CHECKED FOR YOUR OWN CASE. WHETHER A PERSON WHO IS NOT THE RIGHT-HOLDER CAN OBTAIN AN EXTRACT FOR A NEIGHBOURING PARCEL WAS NOT VERIFIED - which is what a community usually wants to know about a developer's holding. Read it with the ombudsman's environmental section, the state grant competitions, the ornithological society and the district hygiene laboratories recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Agrarian credit and development agency — irrigation and machinery concessions for family farms, and the subsidy recipient list published by village
trackers.desc: ONE RULE HERE IS WORTH MORE TO A COMMUNITY THAN ANY SUBSIDY: THE LIST OF FARMERS WHO RECEIVED SUBSIDIES, BROKEN DOWN BY DISTRICT OR CITY AND BY VILLAGE, IS PLACED ON THE AGENCY'S OFFICIAL WEBSITE NO LATER THAN THE TWENTY-FIFTH OF DECEMBER EACH YEAR. A PUBLISHED RECIPIENT LIST BY VILLAGE IS AN ACCOUNTABILITY DOCUMENT, NOT JUST AN ADMINISTRATIVE ONE. IT SHOWS WHETHER THE MONEY REACHED SMALLHOLDERS OR A FEW LARGE HOLDINGS, WHETHER YOUR VILLAGE APPEARS AT ALL, AND WHO IN IT DID — AND THIS FILE HAS SAID REPEATEDLY THAT THE HARDEST THING TO OBTAIN ANYWHERE IS WHO ACTUALLY GOT THE MONEY. HERE IT IS PUBLISHED ON A FIXED DATE. SO CHECK LAST YEAR'S LIST BEFORE APPLYING. IF NOBODY IN YOUR DISTRICT APPEARS, THAT IS EITHER A GAP TO EXPLOIT OR A WARNING THAT THE ROUTE DOES NOT REACH YOU — AND EITHER WAY IT IS A CONCRETE THING TO PUT TO THE AGENCY AND TO THE LOCAL AUTHORITY. WHAT THE MONEY BUYS IS DEFINED NARROWLY AND USEFULLY: CONCESSIONS ON AGRICULTURAL MEANS OF PRODUCTION, WHICH ARE AGRICULTURAL MACHINERY, TECHNOLOGICAL EQUIPMENT, IRRIGATION SYSTEM SETS AND EQUIPMENT, AND BREEDING ANIMALS. IRRIGATION SETS BEING A NAMED CATEGORY IS THE PART THAT DECIDES WHETHER LAND STAYS FARMED. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED ACROSS THE REGION THAT GROUND IS LOST WHEN IT STOPS BEING WATERED, AND HERE THE EQUIPMENT ITSELF IS WHAT THE CONCESSION COVERS — NOT A VAGUE DEVELOPMENT GRANT. AND FAMILY PEASANT FARMS ARE NAMED ALONGSIDE ENTREPRENEURSHIP SUBJECTS AS RECIPIENTS, SO A HOUSEHOLD HOLDING IS INSIDE THE SCHEME RATHER THAN OUTSIDE IT. KNOW WHERE TO APPLY, BECAUSE IT IS NOT THE AGENCY: CREDITS AND CONCESSIONS ARE DELIVERED THROUGH AUTHORISED BANKS AND NON-BANK CREDIT AND LEASING ORGANISATIONS, ACTING IN THEIR OWN NAME AND AT THEIR OWN RISK, AND APPLICANTS APPLY FORMALLY TO THE CREDIT ORGANISATION. THAT MATTERS FOR TWO REASONS. THE BANK, NOT THE STATE, DECIDES ON YOUR FILE — SO THE USUAL BANK REQUIREMENTS OF SECURITY AND RECORDS APPLY. AND IF ONE AUTHORISED ORGANISATION REFUSES YOU, ANOTHER MAY NOT: ASK THE AGENCY FOR THE LIST OF AUTHORISED ORGANISATIONS RATHER THAN TREATING THE FIRST REFUSAL AS FINAL. THERE IS A SEPARATE STATE GUARANTEE FOR CREDITS TO BUY MODERN IRRIGATION SYSTEMS, AVAILABLE TO PRODUCERS WHO HAVE CONTRACTED WITH THE MINISTRY FOR FOOD WHEAT PRODUCTION — SO A PRODUCTION CONTRACT CAN UNLOCK A GUARANTEE THAT MAKES A BANK LEND. AND ONE PROCEDURAL STEP CATCHES PEOPLE OUT: FARMERS MUST DECLARE THEIR PLANTINGS ON A NAMED ELECTRONIC PLATFORM TO OBTAIN THE ONE-OFF SUBSIDY FOR FRUIT ORCHARDS. AN UNDECLARED ORCHARD IS AN UNSUBSIDISED ORCHARD, AND DECLARATION ALSO PUTS YOUR PLANTING INTO A STATE DATABASE WITH A DATE — WHICH THIS FILE HAS FOUND IS EXACTLY THE EVIDENCE THAT MATTERS WHEN SOMEBODY LATER CLAIMS THE GROUND WAS EMPTY. THE LIMITS: this is CREDIT AND SUBSIDY FOR PRODUCTION, NOT A CONSERVATION OR LEGAL FUND — IT WILL NOT PAY FOR AN OBJECTION OR A PURCHASE, AND THE CREDIT ELEMENT MUST BE REPAID TO A BANK THAT BEARS ITS OWN RISK. THE RULES DESCRIBED COME FROM PUBLISHED GOVERNMENT PROCEDURES AND THE AGENCY'S OWN PAGES; CURRENT SUBSIDY RATES, DEADLINES AND WHICH CROPS QUALIFY WERE NOT VERIFIED, and platform names change. Whether the recipient list is published in a usable, searchable form was also not verified - only that publication is required. Read it with the ombudsman's environmental section, the state grant competitions, the land extract service and the ornithological society recorded separately for this country.ONE DECISION OF THE AGRARIAN SUBSIDY COUNCIL IS UNLIKE ANYTHING ELSE IN THIS FILE, AND IT WAS NOT RECORDED HERE: FOR THE FIRST TIME, A SUBSIDY WILL BE PAID FOR LEAVING RAINFED LAND FALLOW, THROUGH A FALLOW LAND COEFFICIENT APPLIED FOR THE 2026 FARMING YEAR. EVERY OTHER AGRICULTURAL PAYMENT RECORDED ACROSS TWENTY-THREE COUNTRIES REWARDS PRODUCTION. THIS ONE REWARDS REST — AND RESTING DRYLAND IS THE OLDEST SOIL CONSERVATION MEASURE THERE IS, ABANDONED ALMOST EVERYWHERE BECAUSE A FAMILY CANNOT AFFORD A YEAR WITHOUT A CROP. IT APPLIES IN FOUR NAMED DISTRICTS, ON RAINFED AREAS WHERE THE LISTED CROPS WERE SOWN IN EACH OF THE LAST THREE CONSECUTIVE YEARS AND WERE DECLARED IN THE NATIONAL ELECTRONIC AGRICULTURE INFORMATION SYSTEM. THE CONDITION IS THE LESSON: THE PAYMENT GOES TO LAND WITH A DECLARED CROPPING HISTORY. A HOLDING THAT NEVER DECLARED ITS PLANTINGS CANNOT PROVE THE THREE YEARS AND THEREFORE CANNOT BE PAID TO REST — WHICH IS ONE MORE REASON TO DECLARE EVERY SEASON IN THE SYSTEM, AS THIS ENTRY ALREADY URGES FOR THE ORCHARD SUBSIDY. THE SAME DECISION SET, FOR THE 2026 CROP YEAR, THE SOWING, PRODUCE AND SEED COEFFICIENTS BY CROP AND BY REGION, THE SEED AND SEEDLING QUOTAS AND THE SOWING REQUIREMENTS — SO THE COUNCIL'S ANNUAL DECISION IS THE DOCUMENT THAT DETERMINES WHAT EVERY CROP IS WORTH IN SUPPORT TERMS THAT YEAR. READ IT BEFORE CHOOSING WHAT TO SOW. A COMMUNITY THAT PLANS ITS SEASON AROUND THE PUBLISHED COEFFICIENTS IS MAKING THE SAME DECISION THE STATE HAS ALREADY PRICED, RATHER THAN DISCOVERING AFTERWARDS THAT ITS CROP CARRIED THE LOWEST SUPPORT IN THE TABLE. AND IF YOUR DISTRICT IS NOT AMONG THE FOUR, THE PRECEDENT IS STILL USABLE: THE STATE HAS NOW ACCEPTED IN PRINCIPLE THAT RESTING EXHAUSTED DRYLAND IS WORTH PAYING FOR, WHICH IS AN ARGUMENT TO PUT TO THE COUNCIL FOR YOUR OWN AREA RATHER THAN A FAVOUR TO ASK FOR.

trackers.name: Agrarian insurance fund — non-commercial and voluntary, half the premium paid by the state, with public premium calculators and an appeals board
trackers.desc: TWO WORDS IN THIS FUND'S OWN DESCRIPTION DECIDE WHETHER A SMALLHOLDER SHOULD TRUST IT: IT IS A MECHANISM THAT IS NOT COMMERCIAL IN PURPOSE AND OPERATES ON THE PRINCIPLE OF VOLUNTARINESS. NON-COMMERCIAL MEANS THE BODY IS NOT TRYING TO PROFIT FROM THE PREMIUM, AND VOLUNTARY MEANS NOBODY IS COMPELLED INTO IT — WHICH MATTERS BECAUSE THIS FILE HAS RECORDED SCHEMES ELSEWHERE THAT FARMERS JOINED UNDER PRESSURE AND COULD NOT LEAVE. THE STATE PAYS FIFTY PER CENT OF THE CALCULATED PREMIUM, AND FARMERS DO NOT HAVE TO TAKE ANYONE'S WORD FOR WHAT THAT PREMIUM IS: THEY CAN CALCULATE PREMIUMS AND PAYMENTS FOR CROP AREAS AND FARM ANIMALS THEMSELVES, THROUGH A CROP CALCULATOR AND A LIVESTOCK CALCULATOR ON THE FUND'S OFFICIAL WEBSITE. A PUBLIC CALCULATOR IS THE MOST UNDERRATED TRANSPARENCY TOOL IN THIS ENTIRE PAYLOAD. IT LETS A FAMILY WORK OUT THE COST BEFORE MEETING AN AGENT, COMPARE WHAT IT IS QUOTED AGAINST WHAT THE SYSTEM SAYS, AND PLAN A SEASON WITHOUT ASKING PERMISSION — AND IT MAKES OVERCHARGING VISIBLE. THE SYSTEM IS NOT MARGINAL: IN A SHORT PERIOD IT EXPANDED TO ALL REGIONS AND CAME TO COVER ABOUT NINETY-FIVE PER CENT OF PRODUCTION VOLUME, WITH REGIONAL BRANCHES OPENING SO THAT COVER AND CLAIMS CAN BE HANDLED LOCALLY RATHER THAN FROM THE CAPITAL. WHAT MATTERS WHEN A CLAIM IS REFUSED IS THAT THE LAW PROVIDES FOR AN APPEALS BOARD. MOST INSURANCE ENTRIES IN THIS FILE END AT THE ASSESSOR'S OPINION. A NAMED APPEAL BODY MEANS A REFUSAL IS NOT THE LAST WORD — ASK, AT THE MOMENT OF REFUSAL, HOW TO PUT THE MATTER TO THAT BOARD AND WITHIN WHAT PERIOD. THE SECOND CHECK ON A BAD ASSESSMENT IS THE ASSESSOR HIMSELF: INDEPENDENT EXPERTS IN AGRARIAN INSURANCE MUST HOLD A CERTIFICATE OBTAINED BY EXAMINATION, WITH REGISTRATION AND EXAMINATION DATES PUBLISHED BY THE STATE EXAMINATION CENTRE. SO THE PERSON WHO VALUES YOUR LOSS IS CERTIFIED AND TRACEABLE. ASK FOR THE EXPERT'S NAME AND CERTIFICATE — THIS FILE RECORDED THE SAME PRINCIPLE WITH VALUERS IN ANOTHER COUNTRY, WHERE THE COMPLAINT ROUTE RUNS THROUGH THE PROFESSIONAL BODY RATHER THAN THE INSTITUTION THAT HIRED HIM. ONE STRUCTURAL DETAIL WORTH KNOWING FOR THE LONG RUN: THE FUND DIRECTS ITS PROFIT INTO LONG-TERM INSURANCE RESERVES AND INTO COVERING PART OF THE INSURED'S NEXT PREMIUMS, AS WELL AS PART OF THE PREMIUMS PAYABLE FROM THE STATE BUDGET — SO A GOOD YEAR FOR THE FUND IS SUPPOSED TO REDUCE WHAT FARMERS PAY NEXT SEASON. THE LIMITS: THIS IS INSURANCE AGAINST NAMED AGRICULTURAL RISKS - IT DOES NOT COVER EXPROPRIATION, POLLUTION OR CONSTRUCTION DAMAGE, AND IT PAYS ONLY WHERE A POLICY WAS BOUGHT BEFORE THE LOSS. WHICH RISKS ARE COVERED, WHAT THE EXCLUSIONS AND DEDUCTIBLES ARE, AND WHETHER HOLDERS WITHOUT REGISTERED LAND CAN INSURE AT ALL WERE NOT ESTABLISHED - the law leaves the risk list and rules to insurance rules approved by a designated body, so the detail lives in documents not read here. THE COVERAGE FIGURE COMES FROM THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY'S OWN ANNOUNCEMENT and the structural provisions from the agrarian insurance law as republished in an international legal database. Read it with the agrarian credit and development agency's subsidy recipient list, the land extract service, the ombudsman's environmental section and the state grant competitions recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Genetic resources system — the list of traditional brand plants with their areas, and the rule that their cultivation must continue and expand
trackers.desc: ONE ITEM IN THIS COUNTRY'S GENETIC RESOURCES RULES IS A LAND PROTECTION TOOL DISGUISED AS AN AGRICULTURAL ONE: THE CABINET APPROVED A LIST OF TRADITIONAL CULTURAL BRAND PLANTS BELONGING TO THE REPUBLIC AND THE AREAS IN WHICH THEY ARE DISTRIBUTED — AND, SEPARATELY, A RULE ON CONTINUING THE CULTIVATION OF THOSE PLANTS IN THOSE AREAS AND ON EXPANDING THEM. READ THAT AGAIN AS A COMMUNITY FACING A PROJECT. IF YOUR VALLEY IS INSIDE A DEFINED AREA FOR A LISTED TRADITIONAL PLANT, THE STATE HAS ALREADY DECLARED THAT CULTIVATION THERE SHOULD CONTINUE AND THE AREA SHOULD GROW — WHICH IS A POSITION THAT SITS AWKWARDLY BESIDE PAVING IT OVER. SO THE FIRST QUESTION IS FACTUAL AND CHEAP TO ASK: IS OUR DISTRICT LISTED AS AN AREA FOR ANY BRAND PLANT, AND WHICH ONE. THIS FILE HAS SPENT HUNDREDS OF ROUNDS LOOKING FOR OFFICIAL DESIGNATIONS A COMMUNITY CAN POINT AT WITHOUT COMMISSIONING ANYTHING, AND THIS IS ONE. THE SAME CABINET DECISION APPROVES THE ARCHITECTURE AROUND IT: RULES ON FORMING, PROTECTING AND USING THE NATIONAL COLLECTIONS; RULES ON ORGANISING STATE CONTROL OVER THEIR PROTECTION AND EFFECTIVE USE; THE RIGHTS AND DUTIES OF GENETIC RESOURCE BANKS; AND THE STATUTE OF THE NATIONAL GENEBANK. STATE CONTROL BEING A NAMED FUNCTION MATTERS: IT MEANS THERE IS SOMEBODY WHOSE JOB IS TO SUPERVISE WHETHER THESE RESOURCES ARE BEING PROTECTED, AND THEREFORE SOMEBODY TO WRITE TO WHEN AN OLD ORCHARD, A LANDRACE FIELD OR A WILD RELATIVE POPULATION IS ABOUT TO BE DESTROYED. THE INSTITUTE BEHIND THE SYSTEM WORKS ON CULTIVATED PLANTS AND THEIR WILD ANCESTORS, DISAPPEARING AND ENDANGERED SPECIES, ABORIGINAL VARIETIES AND FORMS, AND LOCAL BREEDS OF FARM ANIMALS — INVENTORYING AND PASSPORTING THEM, COLLECTING, RESTORING, MULTIPLYING AND EVALUATING THEM, AND CONSERVING THEM BOTH EX SITU AND IN SITU. IN SITU IS THE WORD TO USE. CONSERVATION IN PLACE MEANS PROTECTING THE POPULATION WHERE IT GROWS RATHER THAN TAKING SEED TO A FREEZER — AND A NATIONAL BODY WITH AN IN SITU MANDATE IS THE NATURAL ALLY OF A COMMUNITY TRYING TO KEEP A HILLSIDE OF WILD WHEAT RELATIVES OR AN OLD ORCHARD STANDING.
