NOTE ALSO WHAT A COLLECTION CAN LAWFULLY BE: SEED, POLLEN, SPORE, DNA AND RNA, IN VITRO, AND FIELD COLLECTIONS. A FIELD COLLECTION IS LAND. THAT CATEGORY IS THE ONE TO ASK ABOUT IF A VILLAGE WANTS ITS OWN ORCHARD OR VINE PLOT RECOGNISED AS PART OF THE NATIONAL EFFORT RATHER THAN AS ORDINARY FARMLAND — AND THE RULES REQUIRE THAT WHERE THE OWNERS OF A NATIONAL COLLECTION CHANGE ITS PURPOSE, OR INTEND TO, THEY MUST NOTIFY THE SCIENTIFIC-TECHNICAL COUNCIL AND THE NATIONAL COORDINATING INSTITUTE IN WRITING. THAT NOTIFICATION DUTY IS A BRAKE. A DESIGNATED FIELD COLLECTION CANNOT QUIETLY BECOME SOMETHING ELSE WITHOUT TWO NATIONAL BODIES BEING TOLD IN WRITING — WHICH IS MORE PROCEDURAL PROTECTION THAN MOST FARMLAND IN THIS PAYLOAD ENJOYS. HOW MATERIAL ENTERS THE SYSTEM IS ALSO AN OPENING: SAMPLES ARE COLLECTED BY SCIENTIFIC EXPEDITIONS, AFTER STUDYING THE HERBARIUM FUND AND ASSESSING GAPS IN THE COLLECTIONS AND THE VIABILITY OF EXISTING SAMPLES, WITH THE SEED HANDED TO THE NATIONAL GENEBANK. A COMMUNITY THAT KNOWS OF A SURVIVING LOCAL VARIETY CAN OFFER IT TO THE NEXT EXPEDITION RATHER THAN WAITING TO BE FOUND. AND THERE IS MONEY BEHIND IT GOING FORWARD: A STATE PROGRAMME FOR 2026 TO 2030 PROVIDES FOR CREATING IMPROVED BANKS AND COLLECTIONS OF THE GENETIC RESOURCES OF LOCAL ANIMAL BREEDS AND PLANT SPECIES, WITH A WORKING GROUP AND AN ASSESSMENT OF THE CURRENT SITUATION — SO THE NEXT FEW YEARS ARE WHEN LOCAL BREEDS AND VARIETIES CAN BE PUT FORWARD. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A SCIENTIFIC AND REGULATORY SYSTEM, NOT A PROTECTION ORDER - A LISTED BRAND PLANT AREA IS A POLICY COMMITMENT ABOUT CULTIVATION, NOT A BAR ON DEVELOPMENT, AND NOTHING HERE STOPS A PERMIT BY ITSELF. WHETHER THE LIST AND THE CONTINUATION RULE ARE ACTIVELY ENFORCED, WHICH DISTRICTS THEY NAME, AND WHETHER A FARMER OR VILLAGE CAN HAVE A FIELD COLLECTION RECOGNISED WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED - those are the three questions to put to the national coordinating institute. THE RULES COME FROM A CABINET DECISION REPUBLISHED IN AN INTERNATIONAL LEGAL DATABASE AND FROM THE NATIONAL LEGAL PORTAL, THE INSTITUTE'S DESCRIPTION FROM A MINISTRY PDF, AND THE 2026-2030 COMMITMENT FROM A NEWS AGENCY REPORT OF THE STATE PROGRAMME. Read it with the agrarian credit agency's subsidy list and fallow payment, the agrarian insurance fund, the land extract service and the ombudsman's environmental section recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Conservation Leadership Programme — team awards for early-career nationals, with continuation funding up to fifty thousand dollars
trackers.desc: THIS FUNDS THE PEOPLE A COMMUNITY NEEDS AND RARELY HAS: A TEAM OF EARLY-CAREER CONSERVATIONISTS FROM THE COUNTRY ITSELF, WITH A FIRST PROJECT GRANT OF UP TO FIFTEEN THOUSAND DOLLARS, RISING THROUGH CONTINUATION AWARDS TO TWENTY-FIVE THOUSAND AND LEADERSHIP AWARDS TO FIFTY THOUSAND. THE LADDER IS THE POINT, NOT THE FIRST RUNG. A TEAM THAT DELIVERS ONE SMALL PROJECT WELL BECOMES ELIGIBLE FOR LARGER AWARDS AND JOINS A GLOBAL ALUMNI NETWORK OFFERING FUNDING, TRAINING AND MENTORSHIP — WHICH IS HOW A DISTRICT ENDS UP WITH THREE PEOPLE WHO KNOW HOW TO RUN A SURVEY, WRITE A PROPOSAL AND SPEAK AT A HEARING. THE TEAM RULE IS STRICT AND WORTH READING TWICE: A MINIMUM OF THREE MEMBERS, ALL EARLY IN THEIR CAREERS WITH NO MORE THAN FIVE YEARS OF PROFESSIONAL CONSERVATION EXPERIENCE, AND ALL NATIONALS OF THE COUNTRY WHERE THE PROJECT WILL TAKE PLACE — ALTHOUGH ONE MEMBER CAN BE A NON-NATIONAL IF CLEARLY JUSTIFIED. NATIONALS OF THE PROJECT COUNTRY IS THE OPPOSITE OF THE USUAL ARRANGEMENT, IN WHICH FOREIGN RESEARCHERS ARRIVE, COLLECT AND LEAVE. HERE THE MONEY AND THE TRAINING STAY WITH PEOPLE WHO LIVE THERE — AND THE ONE FOREIGN SLOT IS THE PLACE FOR A SPECIALIST YOU GENUINELY NEED. THE MONEY RULE IS UNUSUALLY FAIR: THE FUNDING REQUESTED MUST NOT EXCEED FIFTEEN THOUSAND DOLLARS AND MUST COVER AT LEAST FIFTY PER CENT OF THE TOTAL BUDGET. SO THE CO-FUNDING BURDEN IS CAPPED AT HALF RATHER THAN BEING OPEN-ENDED — UNLIKE SEVERAL FUNDS RECORDED IN THIS FILE WHERE THE APPLICANT'S SHARE IS THE LARGER ONE AND THE POOREST ARE QUIETLY EXCLUDED. THE PROJECT SHAPE IS MODEST AND ACHIEVABLE: THREE TO TWELVE MONTHS, COMBINING ECOLOGICAL RESEARCH, CONSERVATION ACTION AND COMMUNITY ENGAGEMENT, PRODUCING TANGIBLE AND MEASURABLE OUTCOMES. WHAT QUALIFIES IS BROADER THAN A RED LIST ENTRY: SPECIES LISTED AS CRITICALLY ENDANGERED, ENDANGERED OR VULNERABLE — OR DATA DEFICIENT — OR WHERE THERE IS INFORMATION INDICATING THE NEED FOR URGENT CONSERVATION ACTION. DATA DEFICIENT AND URGENT-ACTION SPECIES ARE THE DOOR FOR PLACES NOBODY HAS SURVEYED. IF THE ANIMAL OR PLANT ON THE THREATENED GROUND HAS NEVER BEEN ASSESSED, THAT IS A REASON TO APPLY RATHER THAN A DISQUALIFICATION — THE SAME OPENING THIS FILE RECORDED IN TWO OTHER GLOBAL FUNDS. THE THEMES REACH BEYOND BIOLOGY AND INTO THE THINGS A LAND FIGHT ACTUALLY INVOLVES: CLIMATE IMPACT AND ADAPTATION, HABITAT RESTORATION AND MANAGEMENT, SOCIAL DEVELOPMENT AND WELLBEING, INDIGENOUS COMMUNITY PARTICIPATION, AND ENVIRONMENTAL POLICY. ENVIRONMENTAL POLICY AND COMMUNITY PARTICIPATION AS FUNDED THEMES MEAN A PROJECT CAN LEGITIMATELY INCLUDE WORK ON HOW DECISIONS ABOUT THE PLACE ARE MADE, NOT ONLY ON COUNTING WHAT LIVES THERE. KNOW THE EXCLUSIONS BEFORE INVESTING EFFORT: THE PROJECT MUST BE IN AN ELIGIBLE LOW- OR MIDDLE-INCOME COUNTRY; HIGH-INCOME COUNTRIES AND COUNTRIES UNDER SANCTIONS OR RESTRICTED-PARTY REGIMES ARE NOT ELIGIBLE; APPLICATIONS MUST BE IN ENGLISH THROUGH THE ONLINE PORTAL AND EMAILED ONES ARE REFUSED; AND ACADEMIC RESEARCH FOR A DEGREE DOES NOT QUALIFY UNLESS IT CLEARLY GOES BEYOND THE DEGREE REQUIREMENTS. THE SANCTIONS EXCLUSION MATTERS ACROSS THIS PAYLOAD: SEVERAL COUNTRIES RECORDED HERE ARE LIKELY OUTSIDE IT ALTOGETHER, AND THE ELIGIBLE-COUNTRY LIST IN THE APPLICATION GUIDELINES IS THE FIRST THING TO CHECK RATHER THAN THE LAST. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A CAPACITY AND SPECIES FUND, NOT A LAND OR LEGAL FUND - IT WILL NOT BUY GROUND, PAY A LAWYER OR FINANCE OPPOSITION TO A DEVELOPMENT, AND ITS AWARDS ARE SMALL AND SHORT. THE FIVE-YEAR EXPERIENCE CAP EXCLUDES THE EXPERIENCED LOCAL FIGURES A COMMUNITY OFTEN RELIES ON, AND THE ENGLISH-ONLY ONLINE APPLICATION EXCLUDES ANYONE WITHOUT THAT LANGUAGE OR CONNECTIVITY. THE 2026 ROUND CLOSED ON 9 JANUARY 2026 AND ROUNDS RUN ANNUALLY, SO THE PRACTICAL STEP IS PREPARING FOR THE NEXT CALL. SEVERAL FIGURES AND RULES HERE COME FROM GRANT-AGGREGATOR AND OPPORTUNITY LISTINGS ALONGSIDE THE PROGRAMME'S OWN PAGE AND GUIDELINES - the eligible-country list and current amounts should be read in the programme's own guidelines. Read it with the agrarian insurance fund's calculators, the agrarian credit agency's subsidy list and fallow payment, the genetic resources system's brand plants and the land extract service recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Agrochemistry laboratories in eleven regions — soil and plant analysis including heavy metals, with the soil science institute behind them
trackers.desc: EVERY LAND ARGUMENT IN THIS FILE EVENTUALLY NEEDS A LABORATORY, AND MOST COUNTRIES HERE HAVE ONE IN THE CAPITAL IF THAT. THIS COUNTRY HAS ELEVEN: AGROCHEMISTRY LABORATORIES FOR THE ANALYSIS OF SOILS AND PLANTS HAVE BEEN OPENED IN ELEVEN REGIONS OF THE REPUBLIC, ONE OF THEM INSTALLED IN THE SOIL SCIENCE AND AGROCHEMISTRY DEPARTMENT OF THE AGRONOMY FACULTY OF THE STATE AGRARIAN UNIVERSITY. ELEVEN REGIONAL LABORATORIES MEANS SAMPLES DO NOT HAVE TO TRAVEL TO THE CAPITAL, WHICH IS OFTEN WHAT KILLS A TEST — COST, TIME AND THE CHAIN OF CUSTODY ALL GET WORSE WITH DISTANCE. WHAT THEY MEASURE COVERS BOTH HALVES OF A LAND CASE: ALL THE MACRO AND MICRO ELEMENTS NECESSARY FOR PLANT LIFE; THE SOIL'S AGROCHEMICAL, BIOLOGICAL, WATER-PHYSICAL, AIR AND THERMAL PROPERTIES; AND THE HEAVY METALS AND TOXIC SUBSTANCES CONTAINED IN SOILS AND PLANTS. HEAVY METALS AND TOXIC SUBSTANCES IS THE PHRASE TO ASK FOR BY NAME. FERTILITY TESTING PROVES GROUND IS PRODUCTIVE AND ANSWERS AN IDLE-LAND CLAIM; CONTAMINATION TESTING PROVES SOMEBODY PUT SOMETHING THERE — AND THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED COMMUNITIES ACROSS THE REGION UNABLE TO PROVE EITHER FOR WANT OF A LABORATORY. BEHIND THEM SITS A SOIL SCIENCE AND AGROCHEMISTRY INSTITUTE UNDER THE SCIENCE AND EDUCATION MINISTRY, WITH A PUBLISHED SERVICE TELEPHONE AND A PROFESSOR AT ITS HEAD, WHICH IS REBUILDING ITS SOIL MUSEUM AND RUNS SCIENTIFIC COUNCILS INCLUDING A COUNCIL OF YOUNG SCIENTISTS AND SPECIALISTS. A COUNCIL OF YOUNG SCIENTISTS IS THE PART TO APPROACH. EARLY-CAREER RESEARCHERS NEED FIELD SITES AND PUBLISHABLE MATERIAL, AND A CONTESTED PIECE OF GROUND WITH A COMMUNITY WILLING TO HOST SAMPLING IS EXACTLY THAT — THE SAME TRADE THIS FILE RECOMMENDED WITH YOUTH FIELD TEAMS IN A GULF SOCIETY. THERE IS A SECOND LABORATORY ROUTE THROUGH THE UNIVERSITIES: A STATE UNIVERSITY'S ECOLOGY AND SOIL SCIENCE FACULTY RUNS FIVE DEPARTMENTS — INCLUDING ECOLOGICAL CHEMISTRY, GEOGRAPHICAL ECOLOGY, BIOECOLOGY, AND SOIL SCIENCE AND REAL ESTATE CADASTRE — WITH STUDENTS WORKING IN AN ECOLOGICAL CHEMISTRY AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION RESEARCH LABORATORY UNDER THE UNIVERSITY'S RESEARCH AND INNOVATION CENTRE OF EXCELLENCE. SOIL SCIENCE AND REAL ESTATE CADASTRE TAUGHT IN ONE DEPARTMENT IS A USEFUL ACCIDENT: THOSE GRADUATES UNDERSTAND BOTH WHAT THE GROUND IS AND HOW ITS OWNERSHIP IS RECORDED, WHICH IS THE COMBINATION A LAND DISPUTE NEEDS AND ALMOST NOBODY HAS. THE STATE SIDE OF LAND IS A LAND AND CARTOGRAPHY COMMITTEE FORMED IN 2001, CHARGED WITH IMPLEMENTING THE LAND CADASTRE, MONITORING AND REFORMS, RESTORING AND INCREASING LAND PRODUCTIVITY, AND SETTING TERRITORIAL UNITS. ONE MORE LEAD IS WORTH FOLLOWING BECAUSE IT NAMES A RISK DIRECTLY: THE AGRARIAN CREDIT AND DEVELOPMENT AGENCY LISTS A PROJECT ON STRENGTHENING THE AGRICULTURAL LAND MARKET TO SOLVE THE PROBLEM OF ABANDONED LANDS AND IMPROVE LAND CONSOLIDATION PROCEDURES — CONSOLIDATION AND ABANDONMENT ARE THE TWO WORDS THAT PRECEDE SMALLHOLDINGS CHANGING HANDS, AND ANYONE HOLDING A SMALL PLOT SHOULD READ WHAT IS PROPOSED BEFORE IT ARRIVES. THE LIMITS: THESE ARE STATE AND UNIVERSITY INSTITUTIONS SERVING AGRICULTURE POLICY AND TEACHING, NOT COMMUNITIES IN DISPUTE - WHETHER AN INDIVIDUAL OR A VILLAGE CAN SUBMIT SAMPLES, WHAT ANALYSIS COSTS, HOW LONG IT TAKES AND WHETHER A RESULT IS ISSUED IN A FORM USABLE AS EVIDENCE WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED - THOSE ARE THE FOUR QUESTIONS TO ASK THE NEAREST LABORATORY. THE ELEVEN-REGION FIGURE COMES FROM A UNIVERSITY LABORATORY PAGE DESCRIBING A STATE PROGRAMME RATHER THAN FROM A LIST OF LOCATIONS, SO WHERE THEY ARE AND WHETHER ALL STILL OPERATE WAS NOT VERIFIED. TESTING GROUND NEAR A STATE OR INVESTOR PROJECT IS SENSITIVE IN THIS COUNTRY AND THE RESULT MAY NOT BE RELEASED TO THE PERSON WHO ASKED. Read it with the agrarian insurance fund's calculators, the agrarian credit agency's subsidy list and fallow payment, the genetic resources system's brand plants and the land extract service recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Civil society challenge fund and the small grants programme — up to $300,000 for scaling, and grants paid straight to community organisations
trackers.desc: A BATCH CHECK OF TEN CONSERVATION FINANCE BODIES SHOWED THE MAIN COMMUNITY GRANTS PROGRAMME RECORDED FOR ONLY FOUR OF THIS PAYLOAD'S COUNTRIES - AND ITS NEW CHALLENGE FUND NOWHERE AT ALL. THAT FUND IS LARGE AND ITS FIRST CALL IS AIMED AT THIS REGION: GRANTS OF UP TO THREE HUNDRED THOUSAND DOLLARS FOR PROJECTS LASTING UP TO TWENTY-FOUR MONTHS, WITH TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE, PARTNERSHIPS AND CAPACITY BUILDING ALONGSIDE THE MONEY. NINE OF THE COUNTRIES IN THIS FILE APPEAR ON ITS PUBLISHED ELIGIBLE LIST: ARMENIA, AZERBAIJAN, GEORGIA, KAZAKHSTAN, THE KYRGYZ REPUBLIC, TAJIKISTAN, TURKMENISTAN, UZBEKISTAN AND TURKEY. WHAT IT FUNDS IS NOT A NEW IDEA BUT AN EXISTING ONE SPREAD FURTHER: PROJECTS THAT SCALE, REPLICATE OR ADAPT SUCCESSFUL CONSERVATION AND SUSTAINABILITY MODELS ACROSS COMMUNITIES AND REGIONS. THAT IS THE OPPOSITE OF WHAT MOST FUNDS ASK FOR, AND IT SUITS A COMMUNITY THAT HAS ALREADY DONE SOMETHING SMALL AND WORKING - A NURSERY, A PATROL, A WATER SCHEME, A COOPERATIVE. THE PROPOSAL IS NOT WE HAVE AN IDEA BUT THIS WORKED HERE AND CAN WORK IN TWENTY MORE VILLAGES. THE FIVE PRIORITY AREAS COVER MOST OF WHAT THIS FILE RECORDS: COMMUNITY-BASED MANAGEMENT OF THREATENED ECOSYSTEMS AND SPECIES; SUSTAINABLE AGRICULTURE OR FISHERIES AND FOOD SECURITY; LOW-CARBON ENERGY ACCESS; CHEMICALS AND WASTE MANAGEMENT; AND SUSTAINABLE URBAN SOLUTIONS. THE ENTRY REQUIREMENT IS THE USUAL ONE AND MUST BE SETTLED FIRST: A LEGALLY REGISTERED CIVIL SOCIETY ORGANISATION WITH AN ORGANISATIONAL BANK ACCOUNT. THE PROCESS IS TWO-STAGE, WHICH LOWERS THE COST OF TRYING: A CONCEPT NOTE FIRST, SETTING OUT THE SOLUTION, ITS IMPACT AND ITS POTENTIAL FOR SCALING - AND ONLY SHORTLISTED APPLICANTS WRITE A FULL PROPOSAL. THE SELECTION COMMITTEE INCLUDES REPRESENTATIVES OF CIVIL SOCIETY, INDIGENOUS PEOPLES, YOUTH AND WOMEN'S ORGANISATIONS AS WELL AS THE FUNDERS. TWO TRAPS ARE WORTH MORE THAN ANY ADVICE ABOUT PROPOSAL WRITING: THE CONCEPT NOTE TEMPLATE WAS UPDATED ON THE TWENTY-EIGHTH OF JULY 2026 AND APPLICANTS MUST USE THE LATEST VERSION, AND THE FORM MUST BE DOWNLOADED AND COMPLETED IN A PDF READER ON A COMPUTER - NOT IN A WEB BROWSER OR ON A PHONE - OR ANSWERS MAY NOT SAVE. A VILLAGE ORGANISATION WORKING FROM A PHONE IS THE EXACT APPLICANT THIS FUND SAYS IT WANTS AND THE EXACT APPLICANT THAT WOULD LOSE ITS WORK TO THAT FORM. FIND A COMPUTER. DEADLINES DIFFER BETWEEN THE SOURCES THAT REPORT THIS CALL - THE SEVENTH OF AUGUST, THE THIRTY-FIRST OF JULY AND THE FIFTEENTH OF SEPTEMBER 2026 ALL APPEAR - SO THE CALL DOCUMENT ON THE PROGRAMME'S OWN PORTAL IS THE ONLY DATE TO TRUST. BEHIND THE CHALLENGE FUND SITS THE PROGRAMME THAT MOST COMMUNITIES SHOULD ACTUALLY START WITH, BECAUSE IT PAYS THEM DIRECTLY: RUNNING SINCE 1992 IN OVER A HUNDRED AND TWENTY-FIVE COUNTRIES, IT MAKES GRANTS STRAIGHT TO COMMUNITY-BASED ORGANISATIONS AND NON-GOVERNMENTAL ORGANISATIONS - A MAXIMUM OF SEVENTY-FIVE THOUSAND DOLLARS PER REGULAR GRANT, TYPICALLY TWENTY-FIVE TO FIFTY THOUSAND, AND UP TO A HUNDRED AND FIFTY THOUSAND FOR STRATEGIC PROJECTS. ITS TERMS ARE THE PART TO PLAN AROUND: IT USUALLY ASKS FIFTY PER CENT CO-FUNDING, ACCEPTS APPLICATIONS AT ANY TIME THROUGH ITS COUNTRY TEAMS, AND JUDGES PROPOSALS AGAINST A COUNTRY PROGRAMME STRATEGY - SO READ THAT STRATEGY BEFORE WRITING A WORD. AND IT IS NOT A PILOT: CLOSE TO THIRTY THOUSAND GRANTS AND MORE THAN A BILLION AND A HALF DOLLARS TO LOCAL COMMUNITIES AND CIVIL SOCIETY ORGANISATIONS ACROSS A HUNDRED AND THIRTY-SIX COUNTRIES SINCE 1992. THE LIMITS: BOTH WINDOWS REQUIRE A REGISTERED ORGANISATION WITH ITS OWN BANK ACCOUNT, WHICH THIS FILE HAS RECORDED AS THE SINGLE COMMONEST BARRIER FOR THE COMMUNITIES IT SERVES - AND THE FIFTY PER CENT CO-FUNDING NORM ON THE SMALLER WINDOW EXCLUDES GROUPS WITH NOTHING TO MATCH. NEITHER PAYS FOR LAND PURCHASE, LITIGATION OR OPPOSING A PROJECT: THESE ARE ENVIRONMENTAL PROJECT FUNDS, AND A PROPOSAL FRAMED AS STOPPING A DEVELOPMENT WILL NOT FIT THE PRIORITY AREAS. WHETHER A COUNTRY PROGRAMME IS ACTIVE IN THE COUNTRY THIS IS FILED UNDER, AND WHO ITS NATIONAL COORDINATOR IS, WERE NOT ESTABLISHED - THE ELIGIBLE LIST FOR THE CHALLENGE CALL IS NOT THE SAME THING AS AN ACTIVE COUNTRY TEAM. GRANT FIGURES AND DEADLINES COME FROM AGGREGATOR SITES AND THE FACILITY'S OWN PAGES DATED JULY AND AUGUST 2026 AND DISAGREE WITH EACH OTHER. Read it with the agrochemistry laboratories in eleven regions, the bar directory and legal aid centre, the state nurseries and planting campaign and the land extract service recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Municipalities and their neighbourhood committees — 1,607 elected bodies that own land, and what one member can force onto the agenda
trackers.desc: A COUNT OF THE WHOLE PAYLOAD PUT THIS COUNTRY LAST FOR LOCAL COVERAGE - ONLY A QUARTER OF ITS ENTRIES WERE PROVINCIAL OR LOCAL. THIS IS THE MOST LOCAL THING IT HAS: 1,607 ELECTED MUNICIPALITIES, REDUCED BY MERGER FROM THE 2,700 ORIGINALLY CREATED, WITH ELECTIONS EVERY FIVE YEARS. THEY ARE NOT ADVISORY. MUNICIPAL LAND IS GOVERNED BY ITS OWN LAWS - ONE ON THE TERRITORIES AND LANDS OF MUNICIPALITIES AND ONE ON THE MANAGEMENT OF MUNICIPAL LANDS - AND SUCH LAND IS SEPARATED OUT OF STATE OWNERSHIP AND GIVEN INTO THE ADMINISTRATION OF THE MUNICIPALITY ITSELF. THAT IS A LANDOWNER WITHIN WALKING DISTANCE. WHERE THE GROUND IN QUESTION IS MUNICIPAL, THE DECISION ABOUT IT IS TAKEN BY PEOPLE WHO LIVE IN THE SAME PLACE AND STOOD FOR ELECTION THERE - WHICH IS NOT TRUE OF ANY MINISTRY IN THIS FILE. THE RIGHTS OF A SINGLE MEMBER ARE PUBLISHED, AND THEY ARE THE PRACTICAL HEART OF THIS ENTRY: TO ELECT AND BE ELECTED TO THE MUNICIPALITY'S PERMANENT AND OTHER COMMISSIONS; TO PROPOSE QUESTIONS FOR DISCUSSION AT MEETINGS OF THE MUNICIPALITY AND ITS ORGANS; TO SPEAK, MAKE PROPOSALS, AMENDMENTS AND OBSERVATIONS; TO PUT QUESTIONS TO SPEAKERS AND TO CANDIDATES PROPOSED FOR APPOINTMENT; TO REQUEST A WRITTEN REFERENCE; TO VOTE; AND TO PREPARE DRAFT DECISIONS FOR DISCUSSION AT MEETINGS. ONE MEMBER CAN PUT A QUESTION ON THE AGENDA AND DRAFT THE DECISION THAT ANSWERS IT. A COMMUNITY THAT GETS ONE OF ITS OWN ELECTED - OR SIMPLY PERSUADES ONE SITTING MEMBER - HAS A ROUTE THAT COSTS NOTHING AND DOES NOT DEPEND ON A LAWYER. THE RULE THAT MATTERS MOST WHEN LAND IS BEING HANDED OUT IS THIS: LEASE RIGHTS OVER MUNICIPAL LANDS MAY BE GRANTED ONLY THROUGH OPEN LAND AUCTIONS OR COMPETITIONS, UNDER RULES APPROVED BY A PRESIDENTIAL DECREE OF OCTOBER 2013 - AND A LESSEE MAY SUBLET ONLY WITH THE MUNICIPALITY'S CONSENT. ONLY THROUGH OPEN AUCTIONS MEANS A QUIET ALLOCATION TO A DEVELOPER IS NOT MERELY UNFAIR BUT IRREGULAR. THE QUESTIONS THAT FOLLOW ARE SHORT: WAS THERE AN AUCTION, WHEN WAS IT ADVERTISED, WHO BID, AND ON WHAT TERMS - AND A SITTING MEMBER CAN ASK THEM INSIDE THE ROOM. THE SUBLEASE CONSENT RULE IS THE SECOND LEVER. A COMPANY THAT TOOK A PLOT AND PASSED IT ON NEEDED THE MUNICIPALITY'S AGREEMENT TO DO SO, AND WHETHER IT WAS GIVEN IS A RECORD THE MUNICIPALITY HOLDS. THERE IS ALSO A RESIDENCE TEST WORTH KNOWING BEFORE ANYONE APPLIES FOR GROUND: LAND MAY BE ALLOCATED INTO CITIZENS' OWNERSHIP FOR BUILDING AN INDIVIDUAL DWELLING WHERE THEY PERMANENTLY RESIDE IN THE MUNICIPALITY AND HAVE BEEN REGISTERED AT THEIR PLACE OF RESIDENCE THERE FOR AT LEAST FIVE YEARS. FIVE YEARS OF REGISTRATION IS THE KIND OF CONDITION THAT DECIDES CASES QUIETLY. ANYONE WHO MOVED BACK TO A VILLAGE RECENTLY, OR WHOSE REGISTRATION SITS ELSEWHERE, SHOULD FIX THAT BEFORE IT MATTERS. AND BELOW THE MUNICIPALITY THERE IS ANOTHER LAYER MOST PEOPLE NEVER USE: A MODEL REGULATION EXISTS FOR THE NEIGHBOURHOOD COMMITTEES OF MUNICIPALITIES, ALONGSIDE REGULATIONS ON PERMANENT AND OTHER COMMISSIONS AND ON COORDINATION COUNCILS FOR LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT. A NEIGHBOURHOOD COMMITTEE IS THE SMALLEST FORMAL BODY IN THIS ENTIRE PAYLOAD FOR THIS COUNTRY - AND A MODEL REGULATION MEANS THERE IS A TEMPLATE FOR CREATING ONE RATHER THAN A NEGOTIATION ABOUT WHETHER IT MAY EXIST. THE LIMITS: MUNICIPALITIES HERE ARE WEAK IN PRACTICE - THEY HOLD A SMALL SHARE OF LAND AND BUDGET BESIDE THE EXECUTIVE POWER STRUCTURE THAT RUNS DISTRICTS, AND THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS THAT LOCAL EXECUTIVE AUTHORITIES, NOT MUNICIPALITIES, TAKE MOST DECISIONS THAT MATTER. THE LAST MUNICIPAL ELECTIONS RECORDED IN THE SOURCE SEEN WERE IN 2019, SO CURRENT MANDATES AND ANY LATER MERGERS WERE NOT ESTABLISHED. THE MEMBER RIGHTS AND THE MUNICIPALITY COUNT COME FROM A JUSTICE MINISTRY FREQUENTLY-ASKED-QUESTIONS PAGE AND A NATIONAL LIBRARY COMPILATION OF THE LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT LAWS; THE LAND AUCTION AND RESIDENCE RULES COME FROM A NEWS AGENCY SUMMARY AND A COMMERCIAL LEGAL EXPLAINER, NOT FROM THE CODES THEMSELVES, AND THE EXPLAINER'S CLAIMS ABOUT OPEN MEETINGS, PUBLISHED CONTRACTS AND ANNUAL REPORTS SHOULD BE TREATED AS ASPIRATION UNTIL TESTED. Read it with the bar directory and legal aid centre, the agrochemistry laboratories in eleven regions, the state nurseries and planting campaign and the challenge fund recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Regional ecology departments and their monitoring posts — the offices that sample soil in eleven named cities and report monthly
trackers.desc: THE PREVIOUS TWO ROUNDS OF THIS RUN LEANED ON STATUTES RATHER THAN BODIES. THIS ONE IS A NETWORK OF OFFICES WITH ADDRESSES AND A SAMPLING ROUND: SOIL SAMPLES TAKEN AFTER RAINFALL ARE MONITORED FOR CONTAMINATION BY ATMOSPHERIC POLLUTANTS AT REGIONAL POSTS IN ELEVEN NAMED PLACES - THE CAPITAL, SUMQAYIT, PIRALLAHI, QUBA, GANJA, LANKARAN, SABIRABAD, NEFTCHALA, SHEKI, ZAQATALA AND MINGACHEVIR. ELEVEN NAMED POSTS MEANS A COMMUNITY CAN ASK A SPECIFIC OFFICE FOR A SPECIFIC PLACE'S RESULTS, RATHER THAN WRITING TO A MINISTRY IN THE CAPITAL AND WAITING. WHAT THEY TEST FOR IS SPECIFIC ENOUGH TO NAME IN A REQUEST: CONTAMINATION OF ENTERPRISE SITES AND SURROUNDING SOILS BY INDUSTRIAL AND TECHNOGENIC WASTE - HEAVY METALS INCLUDING NICKEL, LEAD, MANGANESE, CHROMIUM, ZINC, COPPER, CADMIUM, IRON, COBALT, MOLYBDENUM AND ALUMINIUM - IN THREE LARGE INDUSTRIAL CITIES; AND CONTAMINATION OF AGRICULTURAL SOILS BY ORGANOCHLORINE AND ORGANOPHOSPHATE PESTICIDES AND HERBICIDES, IN THREE DISTRICTS EACH YEAR, IN SPRING AND AUTUMN. THREE DISTRICTS A YEAR IS THE DETAIL A FARMING COMMUNITY SHOULD SEIZE. THE DISTRICTS ARE CHOSEN, WHICH MEANS THEY CAN BE ASKED FOR - AND ASKING TO BE ONE OF THE THREE IS A SMALLER REQUEST THAN ASKING FOR A SPECIAL INVESTIGATION. THE DATA MOVES ON A KNOWN RHYTHM: INFORMATION ON THE ECOLOGICAL CONDITION OF SOILS AND THEIR CONTAMINATION BY SOLID INDUSTRIAL TOXIC AND DOMESTIC WASTE ARRIVES REGULARLY EVERY MONTH FROM THE REGIONAL ECOLOGY DEPARTMENTS. MONTHLY REPORTS EXIST WHETHER OR NOT ANYONE READS THEM. A REQUEST FOR THE LAST TWELVE MONTHS OF ONE DISTRICT'S SOIL REPORTS IS A NARROW, ANSWERABLE ASK - AND THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED THAT NARROW ASKS SUCCEED WHERE BROAD ONES DIE. THE DEPARTMENTS' OWN DUTIES REACH FURTHER THAN TESTING: CONTROLLING THE PREPARATION OF INITIAL REPORTS ON THE DISCHARGE OF POLLUTANTS INTO THE ENVIRONMENT; SUPERVISING WORKS TO BRING RIVERS, WATERCOURSES, LAKES AND OTHER WATER BODIES INTO A CONDITION THAT REGULATES THE REGION'S ECOLOGICAL BALANCE; AND SUPERVISING WORK TO PROTECT SOILS FROM POLLUTION BY DOMESTIC, TOXIC AND CHEMICAL SUBSTANCES AND FROM DAMAGE DURING MINERAL EXTRACTION, AND TO RETURN THEM TO USABLE CONDITION. RETURNING DAMAGED SOIL TO USABLE CONDITION AFTER MINERAL EXTRACTION IS A DUTY SOMEBODY HOLDS IN EVERY REGION OF THIS COUNTRY. WHERE A QUARRY OR A PIT HAS BEEN ABANDONED, THAT DUTY HAS A NAMED OFFICE ATTACHED TO IT. THEY ARE ALSO TASKED WITH FARMLAND ITSELF: ENSURING THE TIMELY APPLICATION OF AGROTECHNICAL, MELIORATIVE AND HYDROTECHNICAL MEASURES TO RAISE SOIL FERTILITY, ELIMINATE THE SOURCES OF SOIL EROSION, ESTABLISH FIELD-PROTECTION FOREST BELTS, AND KEEP HYDROTECHNICAL AND BANK-STRENGTHENING STRUCTURES WORKING. FIELD-PROTECTION FOREST BELTS AND BANK-STRENGTHENING STRUCTURES ARE EXACTLY WHAT ERODING VILLAGES ASK FOR AND ARE TOLD IS NOBODY'S JOB. HERE IT IS WRITTEN AS THE REGIONAL DEPARTMENT'S JOB. AT CITY LEVEL THERE IS ALSO A PLANNING DOCUMENT WORTH READING: A GREEN CITY ACTION PLAN FOR ONE REGIONAL CITY WAS PREPARED WITH A EUROPEAN DEVELOPMENT BANK, CONTAINING A MAPPED LAND USE AND PLANNING SECTOR, PEDESTRIAN NETWORK EXAMPLES AND SITE-SELECTION PHOTOGRAPHS. A BANK-BACKED CITY PLAN WITH LAND-USE MAPS IS BOTH A SOURCE OF MAPS AND A COMMITMENT WITH A LENDER ATTACHED - AND THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS THAT BANK'S COMPLAINTS MECHANISM SEPARATELY. THE LIMITS, AND THIS ONE IS FLAT: THESE ARE THE MINISTRY'S OWN REGIONAL ARMS, NOT INDEPENDENT MONITORS - THEY REPORT UPWARDS, NOT TO RESIDENTS, AND WHETHER A MEMBER OF THE PUBLIC CAN OBTAIN THEIR SOIL DATA, WHAT IT COSTS AND IN WHAT FORM IT IS RELEASED WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED. A PUBLIC ENCYCLOPAEDIA ENTRY ON THIS COUNTRY'S ENVIRONMENTAL PROBLEMS RECORDS THAT NON-GOVERNMENTAL ORGANISATIONS LEGALLY EMPOWERED TO COLLECT INFORMATION FROM OIL REFINERIES ARE FREQUENTLY BLOCKED OR DISMISSED AND THAT DATA IS COLLECTED NON-TRANSPARENTLY - WHICH IS THE HONEST CONTEXT FOR EVERY REQUEST DESCRIBED HERE. THE DUTIES COME FROM A REGIONAL DEPARTMENT'S OWN REGULATION PUBLISHED ON THE MINISTRY'S SITE AND THE MONITORING PROGRAMME FROM THE MINISTRY'S MONITORING PAGE, NEITHER DATED IN WHAT WAS SEEN. Read it with the agrochemistry laboratories in eleven regions, the municipalities and neighbourhood committees, the bar directory and legal aid centre and the challenge fund recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Municipal associations, a published municipal budget line by line, and the free handbooks sent to every council
trackers.desc: THIS PAYLOAD ALREADY RECORDS THIS COUNTRY'S MUNICIPALITIES AND THEIR LAND POWERS. WHAT WAS MISSING IS HOW A RESIDENT CHECKS ONE - AND THE ANSWER IS THAT SOME PUBLISH THEIR SPENDING LINE BY LINE: ONE MUNICIPALITY'S REPORT SETS OUT 87,504 MANAT ON SALARIES OF MEMBERS WORKING PERMANENTLY AND OF MUNICIPAL EMPLOYEES, 18,302 IN SALARY SUPPLEMENTS, 939 ON COMMUNAL SERVICES, 21,408.40 ON OTHER MAINTENANCE COSTS, 15,630 ON SOCIAL ASSISTANCE PAYMENTS, 16,857 ON CONSTRUCTION, IMPROVEMENT AND REPAIR WORKS, 1,800 TO A NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF SETTLEMENT MUNICIPALITIES, AND 2,450.60 ON OTHER EXPENSES. SET THOSE FIGURES BESIDE EACH OTHER AND THE PICTURE IS PLAIN: MORE THAN A HUNDRED THOUSAND MANAT ON SALARIES AND SUPPLEMENTS AGAINST SIXTEEN THOUSAND ON ACTUAL CONSTRUCTION AND REPAIR. A COMMUNITY ASKING WHY THERE IS NO MONEY FOR ITS WATER LINE CAN ASK THAT QUESTION WITH NUMBERS. THE SMALLEST LINE IS THE MOST USEFUL: EIGHTEEN HUNDRED MANAT PAID TO A NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF SETTLEMENT MUNICIPALITIES. THAT IS PROOF THE ASSOCIATION EXISTS, THAT THIS COUNCIL BELONGS TO IT, AND THAT MEMBERSHIP IS A BUDGETED ANNUAL FEE - SO THE QUESTION TO ANY COUNCIL IS WHICH ASSOCIATION IT PAYS AND WHAT IT GETS BACK. THE ASSOCIATIONS THEMSELVES ARE REAL AND REACHABLE: A NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF CITY MUNICIPALITIES WITH A NAMED CHAIRMAN, AND A SEPARATE ONE FOR SETTLEMENT MUNICIPALITIES, DESCRIBED AS CONTRIBUTING TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF RELATIONS BETWEEN MUNICIPALITIES AND VARIOUS STATE BODIES - THE PRESIDENTIAL ADMINISTRATION AND ITS TERRITORIAL-ORGANISATIONAL ISSUES DEPARTMENT, THE NATIONAL ASSEMBLY, ITS REGIONAL ISSUES COMMITTEE AND THE JUSTICE MINISTRY. AN ASSOCIATION THAT DEALS WITH THE PRESIDENTIAL ADMINISTRATION ON BEHALF OF MUNICIPALITIES IS THE HIGHEST DOOR A VILLAGE COUNCIL HAS, AND ITS OWN COUNCIL ALREADY PAYS THE SUBSCRIPTION. THE SIZE OF THE COUNCIL A COMMUNITY IS DEALING WITH IS FIXED AND KNOWABLE: FIVE MEMBERS WHERE FEWER THAN FIVE HUNDRED PEOPLE LIVE, SEVEN UP TO A THOUSAND, NINE UP TO FIVE THOUSAND, ELEVEN UP TO TEN THOUSAND, THIRTEEN UP TO TWENTY THOUSAND, FIFTEEN UP TO FIFTY THOUSAND AND SEVENTEEN UP TO A HUNDRED THOUSAND. IN A SETTLEMENT OF FOUR HUNDRED PEOPLE, FIVE MEMBERS DECIDE. THREE OF THEM ARE A MAJORITY - AND THAT IS THE SMALLEST NUMBER OF PEOPLE A COMMUNITY ANYWHERE IN THIS PAYLOAD HAS TO PERSUADE. THE TIMING IS FIXED TOO: NEW ELECTIONS ARE CALLED AT THE LATEST A HUNDRED AND TWENTY DAYS BEFORE A COUNCIL'S POWERS END, WHICH IS THE WINDOW IN WHICH CANDIDATES WILL LISTEN. THERE IS ALSO A SHELF OF FREE MATERIAL WRITTEN FOR THESE COUNCILS THAT ANYONE CAN ASK FOR: A MUNICIPALITIES WORK CENTRE PREPARED, WITH A GERMAN INTERNATIONAL COOPERATION AGENCY'S FINANCIAL AND TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE, COLLECTIONS OF LEGISLATIVE DOCUMENTS ON MUNICIPALITIES' PARTICIPATION IN DEVELOPING ENTREPRENEURSHIP, COLLECTIONS OF LEGAL ACTS ON ORGANISING ARCHIVE WORK IN MUNICIPALITIES, AND COLLECTIONS OF METHODOLOGICAL DOCUMENTS - WITH TWENTY-FIVE METHODOLOGICAL AIDS AND RECOMMENDATIONS PREPARED AND SENT TO MUNICIPALITIES IN A SINGLE YEAR. THE COLLECTION ON ARCHIVE WORK IS THE ONE TO ASK FOR IF A COUNCIL CLAIMS IT CANNOT FIND AN OLD DECISION, A LEASE OR A PLAN. THERE ARE PUBLISHED RULES ON HOW ITS PAPERS SHOULD BE KEPT. AND THERE IS A MANUAL ON THE MONEY: A METHODOLOGICAL GUIDE TO CALCULATING, PAYING AND ACCOUNTING FOR LOCAL MUNICIPAL TAXES AND CHARGES WAS APPROVED BY AN ORDER OF THE STATE TAX SERVICE IN NOVEMBER 2022. ONE NAMED MUNICIPALITY DESCRIBES ITS OWN WORK IN A SENTENCE WORTH QUOTING BACK TO ANY COUNCIL: THE GREAT MAJORITY OF THE PROJECTS IT IMPLEMENTS CONSIST PRECISELY OF EXECUTING VOTERS' APPEALS. THE LIMITS: THIS COUNTRY'S MUNICIPALITIES REMAIN WEAK BESIDE THE EXECUTIVE POWER STRUCTURE THAT RUNS DISTRICTS, AS THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS ELSEWHERE, AND THE ASSOCIATIONS ARE DESCRIBED IN OFFICIAL AND CEREMONIAL TERMS - NOTHING RECORDED HERE SHOWS EITHER CHALLENGING A STATE DECISION. THE BUDGET FIGURES ARE ONE COUNCIL'S OWN REPORT ON A MUNICIPAL NEWS SITE, NOT AN AUDIT, AND SAY NOTHING ABOUT ANY OTHER COUNCIL; WHETHER MOST MUNICIPALITIES PUBLISH SUCH REPORTS AT ALL WAS NOT ESTABLISHED. THE HANDBOOK PROGRAMME AND THE MERGER FIGURES COME FROM A PARLIAMENTARY REPORT OF 2020 AND A STATE NEWS AGENCY ITEM, SO CURRENT AVAILABILITY WAS NOT CONFIRMED, AND THE COUNCIL-SIZE FORMULA COMES FROM A NATIONAL LIBRARY COMPILATION OF THE MUNICIPAL LAWS. Read it with the municipalities and neighbourhood committees, the regional ecology departments' monitoring posts, the agrochemistry laboratories and the bar directory recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Social development fund's micro-projects for settlements of 100 to 1,000 people, and the single window for state grants to organisations and municipalities
trackers.desc: THE MOST USEFUL NUMBER IN THIS ENTRY IS THE SIZE OF PLACE THE MONEY IS AIMED AT: THE PROJECT TAKES AS ITS TARGET THE DISPLACED COMMUNITIES SETTLED ON THE COUNTRY'S TERRITORY, MAINLY THOSE WITH POPULATIONS OF BETWEEN A HUNDRED AND A THOUSAND PEOPLE. MOST FUNDS RECORDED IN THIS PAYLOAD ARE BUILT FOR DISTRICTS OR CITIES. A PROGRAMME DESIGNED AROUND SETTLEMENTS OF A HUNDRED TO A THOUSAND IS BUILT FOR THE SCALE AT WHICH MOST OF THE COMMUNITIES IN THIS FILE ACTUALLY LIVE. WHAT IT PAYS FOR IS EQUALLY CONCRETE: MICRO-PROJECTS FOR THE RESTORATION OF SOCIAL INFRASTRUCTURE - MEDICAL POINTS, KINDERGARTENS, SCHOOLS AND COMMUNITY CENTRES - AND OF ECONOMIC INFRASTRUCTURE - GRAVEL ROADS AND WATER AND ELECTRICITY SUPPLY NETWORKS - TOGETHER WITH SANITATION FACILITIES, ALONGSIDE MICRO-CREDIT PROGRAMMES. A COMMUNITY CENTRE IS ON THAT LIST, AND IT IS THE ONE WORTH ASKING FOR. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED, COUNTRY AFTER COUNTRY, THAT THE MISSING THING IS NOT ONLY MONEY BUT A ROOM TO MEET IN THAT NOBODY ELSE CONTROLS. THE SECOND HALF OF THIS ENTRY IS ABOUT WHERE STATE MONEY FOR ORGANISATIONS NOW GOES. IN JUNE 2026 THE CABINET APPROVED RULES UNDER WHICH BODIES FINANCED FROM THE STATE BUDGET THAT MAY GIVE GRANTS TO LEGAL AND PHYSICAL PERSONS AND TO MUNICIPALITIES - INCLUDING A YOUTH FOUNDATION, A SMALL AND MEDIUM BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT AGENCY AND A SOCIAL SERVICES AGENCY - CARRY OUT ALL TYPES OF FINANCING OF NON-GOVERNMENTAL ORGANISATIONS, BY COMPETITION AND OUTSIDE COMPETITION AND INCLUDING STATE ORDERS AND SUBSIDIES, JOINTLY WITH THE AGENCY FOR STATE SUPPORT TO NON-GOVERNMENTAL ORGANISATIONS ON A SINGLE-WINDOW BASIS. THAT MUNICIPALITIES ARE NAMED AS BODIES THAT MAY RECEIVE THOSE GRANTS IS THE PART A VILLAGE SHOULD ACT ON: ITS OWN COUNCIL IS AN ELIGIBLE APPLICANT, NOT ONLY A SPECTATOR - AND THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS SEPARATELY THAT COUNCILS HERE PUBLISH BUDGETS WHERE CONSTRUCTION AND REPAIR IS THE SMALLEST LINE. A SINGLE WINDOW ALSO MEANS A SINGLE PLACE TO ASK WHAT IS AVAILABLE AND WHEN - AND ONE PLACE WHOSE DECISIONS CAN BE COMPARED YEAR ON YEAR, WHICH IS WHAT MAKES REFUSALS ARGUABLE. THE HONEST DIFFICULTY IS DOCUMENTED BY AN OUTSIDE INSTITUTION: ALONGSIDE REGISTERED ORGANISATIONS THERE ARE ALSO UNREGISTERED ONES, MOST OF THEM LOCATED IN RURAL AREAS, AND ONE OF THE MAIN REASONS THEY REMAIN UNREGISTERED IS THE WEAKNESS OF THEIR KNOWLEDGE BASE. THAT SENTENCE DESCRIBES THE EXACT POPULATION THIS FILE SERVES - RURAL GROUPS THAT EXIST BUT ARE NOT REGISTERED, AND THEREFORE CANNOT REACH ANY OF THE MONEY DESCRIBED ABOVE. THE STATED PRIORITIES FOR STATE SUPPORT NEVERTHELESS INCLUDE DEVELOPMENT IN RURAL AREAS AND SUPPORT FOR DISPLACED PERSONS, WHICH IS THE HEADING UNDER WHICH SUCH A GROUP SHOULD APPROACH. ONE FURTHER PROVISION IS WORTH CARRYING INTO ANY PLANTING SCHEME: A CABINET DOCUMENT OF 2026 CLASSIFYING GREEN ECONOMIC ACTIVITIES STATES THAT AFFORESTATION PROJECTS MUST INVOLVE LOCAL COMMUNITIES AND PROTECT THEIR RIGHTS WITHOUT CAUSING DISPLACEMENT, AND THAT GREEN TECHNOLOGY SUPPLY CHAINS MUST ENSURE SAFE WORKING CONDITIONS AND PREVENT LABOUR EXPLOITATION. AFFORESTATION THAT DISPLACES PEOPLE IS A PATTERN THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS ACROSS THE REGION - TREES PLANTED ON GRAZING LAND, FENCES FOLLOWING THE SEEDLINGS. A GOVERNMENT DOCUMENT SAYING PLAINLY THAT SUCH PROJECTS MUST INVOLVE LOCAL COMMUNITIES AND NOT DISPLACE THEM IS A SENTENCE TO QUOTE WHEN THE PLANTERS ARRIVE. THE LIMITS: THE FUND DESCRIBED HERE SERVES DISPLACED COMMUNITIES UNDER A FOREIGN-FINANCED PROJECT, NOT VILLAGES GENERALLY, AND THE DOCUMENT SETTING OUT ITS SCOPE IS A RESETTLEMENT POLICY FRAMEWORK PREPARED FOR A 2015 ADDITIONAL FINANCING PHASE - WHETHER THE PROJECT IS STILL RUNNING, WHAT REPLACED IT AND WHETHER ANY OF IT REACHES NON-DISPLACED RURAL SETTLEMENTS WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED. THE SINGLE-WINDOW RULE IS AN ADMINISTRATIVE REORGANISATION OF STATE FUNDING, AND CENTRALISING ALL STATE FINANCING OF ORGANISATIONS THROUGH ONE AGENCY CUTS BOTH WAYS IN A COUNTRY WHERE THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS INDEPENDENT GROUPS FACING REGISTRATION AND FUNDING DIFFICULTY. THE CIVIL SOCIETY OBSERVATIONS COME FROM A DEVELOPMENT BANK BRIEF WITH NO VISIBLE DATE AND ITS GRANT FIGURES DESCRIBE A PERIOD ENDING IN 2011. Read it with the municipalities and neighbourhood committees, the municipal associations and published budgets, the regional ecology departments' monitoring posts and the challenge fund recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Rivers without Boundaries (RwB)
trackers.desc: An international coalition of NGOs and experts working to save transnational rivers across north-east Asia, with its own named Mongolia coordinator. WHO TO ENLIST: the place to start when the threat is a dam, a reservoir or placer gold mining in a river basin. It runs independent hydropower assessments, maps threatened basins including the Selenga, Kherlen, Onon and the Mongolian Great Lakes, and tracks where mining licences sit relative to water-protection zones. You CAN: draw on its river-by-river document files and on its record of backing Mongolian herder movements pressing for enforcement of the 2009 law restricting mining near rivers, headwaters and forests. For activists: its work extends into Russia and China too, but Mongolia is the country for which it names a coordinator on its own site, so that is where this entry sits — ask about elsewhere.

trackers.name: General Authority for State Registration
trackers.desc: National — state register of legal entities (companies), Mongolia. — Holds to account: state firms & government-linked companies — find their registration, directors and filings.

trackers.name: Mongolian National Audit Office
trackers.desc: Supreme audit institution of Mongolia, auditing government accounts and the use of public money. HOW THIS DIFFERS: an audit body reports AFTER money is spent — use it to find documented waste, irregularity and misspending already uncovered, not live tenders; for who is winning contracts now use the procurement portal, and for aggregate budget totals the statistical office.

trackers.name: Mongolia EITI Register
trackers.desc: National beneficial-ownership register: official database of the natural persons who ultimately own or control companies and legal entities. Publicly searchable.

trackers.name: IAAC
trackers.desc: Mongolia's Independent Authority Against Corruption, which also publishes officials' asset declarations.

trackers.name: General Authority for State Registration
trackers.desc: National beneficial-ownership register: official database of the natural persons who ultimately own or control companies and legal entities. Publicly searchable.

trackers.name: EITI Mongolia
trackers.desc: National Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative body — discloses oil, gas and mining revenues, contracts and licences in Mongolia.

trackers.name: Resource Contracts Mongolia (Il Tod Geree)
trackers.desc: Mongolia's public repository of mining and petroleum contracts and licences. Here you can trace who holds public concessions over land, resources or infrastructure in Mongolia.

trackers.name: Supreme Court of Mongolia
trackers.desc: Official site of Mongolia's highest court with judgments and judicial information. · Find here: information and judgments of the Supreme Court of Mongolia.

trackers.name: Supreme Court of Mongolia
trackers.desc: Supreme Court of Mongolia — supreme court (Mongolia).

trackers.name: Government e-Procurement
trackers.desc: National public-procurement portal. Here you can trace which firms win government contracts and tenders in Mongolia, and for how much.

trackers.name: Nukhurlul — herder communities named themselves into the civil code
trackers.desc: AN ORIGIN WORTH KNOWING. Nukhurlul is the name the early herder communities in the Gobi gave themselves — and during the 2000–2004 legislative period, South Gobi members of parliament introduced community organisations into Mongolia's civil law under that chosen name, as rural civil society organisations. Communities self-organised, named themselves, and the legislature adopted both the institution and the name; elsewhere in this map communities apply into categories drawn up for them. WHAT RECOGNITION UNLOCKED: it allowed contracts on communal land management to be made between local government and the communities, giving them legal standing to contract with the soum — not a designation, but the capacity to hold an agreement. Community organisations now protect wetlands, local protected areas and prehistoric sites. THE ASSESSED OUTCOME, in respondents' words: through the process they learned to express opinions and talk to the governor, and learned to have a stronger voice — many active communities made the soum governor listen and influenced pasture management plans. EXPECT THIS QUESTION IN THE ROOM: the assessment literature asks whether donor support has built a parallel structure to the territorial administrative structure, and whether local government sees community organisations as a threat. WHERE TO ENGAGE: soum and bag levels, aimag and soum khurals, and buffer zone councils, whose head sits within the Soum Khural.

trackers.name: Eternal Mongolia and GEF — a third of the money is outside protected areas
trackers.desc: TWO ROUTES, AND THE LARGER ONE TARGETS COMMUNITIES DIRECTLY. Eternal Mongolia is a Project Finance for Permanence partnership between The Nature Conservancy and the Government of Mongolia toward the country's 30x30 goals, mobilising about USD 198 million over 15 years. Its three targets: safeguard an additional 14.4 million hectares; strengthen management of the protected area network; and extend sustainable community-managed practices to 34 million hectares OUTSIDE protected areas, with a 2040 goal of secure community-based natural resource management involving up to 24,000 herder households. So a herder community is a target participant, not a bystander — the largest single component is community-managed land beyond the park boundaries. WATCH THE LAW REVISION: the Mongolia Nature's Legacy Foundation supports revisions to the Protected Areas Law so the 30x30 goal has clear legal frameworks and stable financing, and Mongolia approved its first Climate Change Law in the State Great Khural. FOR SMALLER, FASTER MONEY: the GEF Small Projects Programme, implemented by UNDP, gives up to USD 50,000 over up to 18 months for biodiversity conservation and sustainable agriculture — open to NGOs, CSOs and local community groups.

trackers.name: Put 'environmental protection' in your charter — a court said so
trackers.desc: THE STANDING TRAP THAT LOST A CASE BEFORE IT WAS HEARD. CHRD challenged extraction licences in Khuvsgul aimag and the court rejected its standing to sue, emphasising the absence of the words ‘environmental protection’ in its charter. Across this map the wording of an organisation's own constitution decides funding eligibility in six European countries — in Mongolia it decides access to the court itself. If your organisation might ever litigate, put environmental protection in the charter before you need it; Mongolian civil society's own recommendation was to create a legal environment allowing NGOs to sue. THE SECOND OBSTACLE IS MONEY FOR EXPERTS: expert evidence is unavoidable in environmental cases, and although the court is authorised to pay for it, it is often reluctant — in an administrative case on cancelling a uranium licence the court appointed an expert on its own initiative and the expert refused to work because the court did not pay. Budget for your own expert rather than relying on the court. WHO LITIGATES: CHRD has run public interest litigation on mining since 2005, around 40 cases on illegal licences, inadequate environmental impact assessment, water law breaches, mines left without rehabilitation and toxic contamination — and won cancellation of two illegally issued licences on the Burenkhaan phosphate deposit in 2014.

trackers.name: The Munkhbayar precedent — and what the petition actually asked for
trackers.desc: A SUPREME COURT ORDER TO ENFORCE. On 20 October 2011 the Supreme Court ruled that the government must enforce its 2009 resolution restricting mining, in a case filed by the United Movement of Mongolian Rivers & Lakes. The statute behind it prohibits mining at headwaters of rivers, protected zones of water reservoirs and forested areas, and was designed to protect up to 25 percent of Mongolia's natural ecosystems. THE PETITION IS A TEMPLATE WORTH STUDYING: it asked for assessment of damage to named river basins within 2 months, public notification of that assessment, recovery of damages from the respondent, restoration carried out by the petitioner organisation itself under contract to the respondent, enforcement of the Law, and revocation of the licences of entities operating there. Asking to be contracted to do the restoration is an unusual and powerful ask. AFTERWARDS the government began real implementation — the first batch of licences was revoked, protection zones approved, damage evaluated — and UMMRL then helped delineate the protection zones and negotiate them with local populations. BUT WINNING DID NOT END IT: after Munkhbayar's Goldman Prize for pressuring 35 of 37 operations in the Onggi basin, new companies received new licences for the same protected areas. TWO DOCUMENTS TO OBTAIN: the EIA report, and the annual environmental management plan that licence holders must file with the ministry by 1 November each year, covering subcontractor activities — a dated, ministry-held document is the most checkable obligation in the regime.

trackers.name: ICCA Registry and Protected Planet — and registration is not a precondition
trackers.desc: CHECK WHETHER YOUR SITE IS ALREADY IN A REGISTRY BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE — it may carry a designation nobody locally mentioned. The World Database on Protected and Conserved Areas at protectedplanet.net is a joint UNEP and IUCN product managed by UNEP-WCMC, drawing on almost 500 data providers in 245 countries, updated monthly and downloadable; it underpins the UN List of Protected Areas. THE OECM ROUTE IS THE ONE MOST COMMUNITIES MISS: a site qualifies as an other effective area-based conservation measure if it delivers sustained, positive conservation outcomes EVEN THOUGH IT MAY BE MANAGED PRIMARILY FOR OTHER REASONS — so a grazing commons, a sacred site or a watershed managed for water supply can qualify without being managed primarily for conservation. Land that is worked rather than preserved is not excluded. But note the exclusivity: a site can be a protected area or an OECM — it is not possible to meet both, so ask which is being proposed. THE ICCA REGISTRY IS THE ONE COMMUNITIES FILL IN THEMSELVES: at iccaregistry.org, communities themselves provide data, case studies, maps, photos and stories, and its operators state it is meant to be used to enhance advocacy and recognition — not merely as an inventory. Documenting a territory there creates a citable, third-party-hosted record. THE SENTENCE THAT MATTERS MOST: UNEP-WCMC states these territories must be recognised and respected ‘whether or not they have been reported to the ICCA Registry’ — registration is NOT a precondition of rights, and anyone arguing a claim is weaker for being unregistered is arguing against the registry operator's own position. AND USE THE SCALE FIGURE CAREFULLY: over 1,500 sites are reported under indigenous and community governance — just 1 percent of all recorded sites, with UNEP-WCMC adding that no one knows how many ICCAs exist globally. That 1 percent measures how little has been recorded, not how little communities conserve. Filter Protected Planet by governance type to find such sites; UNEP-WCMC's manual Global Databases to Support ICCAs gives guidance on contributing data.

trackers.name: National Human Rights Commission of Mongolia — a group can complain, and it can inspect unannounced
trackers.desc: A complaint may be lodged by a group, not only an individual, and by non-governmental organisations and trade unions through their representatives, in person, in writing or by e-mail — which is the form a herder community facing a licence, a haul road or a mine actually takes. Foreign nationals and stateless persons may complain too. The power that matters most here is inspection: commissioners may carry out scheduled and unscheduled inspections of premises where rights may be violated, on the basis of complaints and information received, and they then monitor whether their demands are implemented. Commissioners must also explain to a complainant what rights and duties they have in seeking restoration of a violated right, so an approach is worth making even where the complaint is not taken up. Two limits to plan around. The Commission issues proposals and recommendations to authorities, officials and legal entities — it does not make orders, so the output is pressure and a public record rather than an injunction. And commissioners may transfer a complaint concerning a criminal or civil case or dispute to whichever authority has jurisdiction, which means a matter framed as a private land dispute can be routed straight back out; frame it as a rights violation by a public body or a company. It has engaged this subject directly, running a national conference on mining sector development and human rights that included a session on the cultural and economic rights of herders in relation to mining. Established under the 2000 Law, operating since February 2001, with the Law renewed on 23 January 2020. It publishes at two official addresses — mn-nhrc.org/eng and en.nhrcm.gov.mn — with the complaint procedure on the first and staff contacts at nhrcm.gov.mn. Neither redirects to the other.

trackers.name: The environmental rehabilitation guarantee account — Mongolia's mining bond, held locally
trackers.desc: A mining or exploration licence holder must lodge money against its own environmental plan, and the account is held by the governor of the soum or district where the work is. Under the Minerals Law the deposit is an amount equal to half the licence holder's environmental protection budget for the year, paid into a special bank account opened by the local governor, and separate rules govern supervision of the transactions on that account. This is the most locally held compliance deposit recorded anywhere in this file — not a national fund and not a central bureau, but an account at the lowest tier of government, in the place the mine is. If the work is not done, the money is used to do it. Where a project implementer fails to implement, or fails fully to implement, the measures in its environmental management plan and its mine closure management plan, the central environmental authority together with the governor at the relevant level and the environment department arranges for the rehabilitation to be carried out by an authorised professional organisation, and any additional sum required is recovered from the implementer without dispute. The deposit is returned only if the obligations are met. The governor's supervisory powers are worth reading alongside it. The Minerals Law gives the provincial governor power to ensure licensed ground is used only for its stated purpose and to halt activity where there is a violation, to supervise how a licence holder is meeting its obligations on environmental protection, rehabilitation, public health and payments into the local budget, and to decide that particular land be taken for local special needs under the Land Law. Three questions follow, all addressed locally. Has this year's deposit been paid into the governor's account; what do the environmental management plan and the mine closure plan actually commit the operator to; and has the governor exercised the supervision the law gives them. All three are questions for a soum or district administration rather than a ministry, which is what makes them askable. Both the Minerals Law and the account supervision rules are published on the state legal information database.

trackers.name: Nökhörlöl partnerships — the bag-level route to a community natural resource agreement
trackers.desc: The establishment route runs through the smallest unit of government, which is what makes it reachable. Under the environmental protection law the citizens' assembly of a bag or khoroo discusses and approves a proposal, submitted by the governor of that bag, regarding the establishment of a Partnership. The same assemblies supervise the protection and use of natural resources in public use and consider their governor's report on environmental protection. A community wanting formal standing over the ground it uses therefore starts with its own bag governor and its own neighbours, not with a ministry. Once established, the Partnership has a management plan and the soum owes it something. The law places a duty at soum level to facilitate implementation of the Partnership's management plan, to conduct professional training, and to report the outcome to the soum citizens' representative assembly. That reporting line matters: performance under the plan is put before an elected body on a recurring basis, which gives a community a regular, public occasion to raise what is not being done. Legal standing came first, and it is what allows a contract. Community organisations under this name were recognised in Mongolian civil law as rural civil society organisations, which allowed contracts on communal land management to be made between local government and communities and gave those communities legal personality; a later amendment to the environmental protection law regulates the organisational form, tenure rights and responsibilities of user groups for forest resources. In practice communities have signed co-management contracts with soum governors covering seasonal pasture use and rotation schedules, and those contracts have settled disputes over summer pasture between local stakeholders. Be clear what the contract is not. Pastureland cannot be owned, and the constitution places all land and natural resources under state protection, so a Partnership agreement secures recognised use and management rather than title. Read this alongside the rehabilitation guarantee account also recorded here: both are addressed to the soum administration, and a community that has a Partnership and a management plan is in a considerably better position when it asks that administration about a licence holder's obligations.

trackers.name: Bar Association public-interest committee — pro bono cases registered, allocated and monitored
trackers.desc: Public interest work is the committee's stated purpose, not a side activity. The association's committee for lawyers' publicly useful professional activity exists to carry out the profession's social responsibility, to increase the reach of legal assistance and to organise activity protecting the public interest, with a stated mission of developing Mongolian lawyers' pro bono work systematically and strengthening social justice by protecting the public interest. A land, pasture or pollution matter affecting a community sits inside that purpose rather than at the edge of it. It runs a system, which changes what you ask for. The committee organises the voluntary participation of lawyers and law firms and is building a system for the registration, allocation and monitoring of pro bono cases, together with a unified network for access to legal assistance. Ask to have the matter registered as a pro bono case rather than asking one lawyer for a favour: a registered case is allocated and monitored, and a favour is neither. Free advice and referral are the realistic first ask. The committee provides free legal advice and information to citizens, legal services directed at vulnerable groups, and a referral service, and the association runs days on which legal advice is given without charge. For a community that does not yet know whether it has a case, the referral service is the door, and it costs nothing to use. Two things to check before you rely on any of it. Membership of this committee is voluntary, so its reach depends on which lawyers and firms have joined — ask which are participating in your aimag rather than assuming national coverage. And advocacy law firms register with the association, with registration requiring the lawyers' licence certificates and professional liability insurance, so whether a firm is registered and insured is a checkable fact. A separate committee handles legal assistance and advocacy services for citizens without the means to pay. Read this with the rehabilitation guarantee account and partnership entries recorded here: both are addressed to the soum administration, and this is who can help put the request.

trackers.name: Орон нутгийн хөгжлийн сан — soum money the rules require citizens to prioritise
trackers.desc: The money sits at soum and district level, and the priorities must come from residents. The operating rules for the local development fund provide that investments, programmes, projects and measures financed from it must be supported and prioritised by the proposals of that locality's citizens — and, more usefully still, that the funded list must necessarily include those items which drew the most proposals from the bags and khoroos furthest from the soum or district centre. Distance from the centre is protected by rule rather than left to goodwill, which is the opposite of how most local budgets behave. Environmental protection is a named eligible function, and so are the studies. The listed functions include protecting the environment and improving surroundings and green space, drinking water supply and sanitation, pasture management and livestock development, capacity training for household income, and the preparation of soum and district development plans together with feasibility studies and design estimates for projects. A community can therefore seek money both for protection work on the ground and for the technical documents it needs in order to argue a case at all. The assembly minute is the instrument, so get the item into it. The published forms run from open surveys, discussions and group interviews, through a preliminary list of proposals for the bag or khoroo citizens' general assembly, to summary minutes of the assembly's discussion and vote certified by stamp and delivered to the soum or district governor's office within the set period; that list is then carried into the soum or district budget proposal and submitted to the citizens' representative assembly. An item that is not in the certified minute is not in the process. One requirement cuts both ways. Anything financed from the fund must have a design and estimate, technical and economic justification as the law requires, an environmental status assessment carried out, and the other relevant permits. That is a bar a community's own proposal has to clear — and equally a checkable requirement against any other project drawing on the same fund. Items approved with verified performance but not financed within the year must be carried into the consolidated list, so completed work is not quietly lost.

trackers.name: Мэргэжлийн хяналтын ерөнхий газар — the inspectors for mining impact, and the form a joint complaint must take
trackers.desc: Mining's environmental impact is inspected by one national agency with local departments. Through the state electronic services portal the general agency for specialized inspection delivers around forty services in ten categories to citizens and businesses, and among them are the monitoring, restoration and control of the environmental impacts of mining, nuclear and radiation safety inspection, and the control and transport sheets for the use of explosives. That matters because it identifies the body a community actually calls about a mine: not the ministry that issued the licence and not a court, but the inspectorate whose job is to go and look. A joint complaint has a stated form, and meeting it removes an excuse. A written complaint must give the complainant's surname, name and address of residence and must be signed; where a legitimate reason prevents someone signing, another person may sign on their behalf; and where citizens submit a complaint jointly, either all of them sign it or their representative signs and attaches the document proving authority to represent them. A community complaint drafted to that rule cannot be sent back on form, which is the cheapest obstacle to remove. There is an appeal against the decision on your complaint. A complainant who does not accept the decision has the right to appeal: to the higher administrative body or official above the body or official that issued the administrative act; where no higher body exists, to the body that issued it; or to the administrative body whose function is the review of complaints. Work out which of those three applies before writing, because addressing the wrong one costs the time the answer would have taken. Local departments publish contact detail down to the room. Aimag inspection departments publish the room numbers and working telephone numbers of their officers, together with the name, position, duties, working rules, telephone and citizen reception hours of the officer responsible for state service and correspondence. Name the officer and the reception hour rather than addressing the agency in general. Read this with the rehabilitation guarantee account and local development fund entries recorded for this country: this is the body that inspects what that money is supposed to cover.

trackers.name: Байгаль орчин, хэмжил зүйн төв лаборатори — a state laboratory that tests at a citizen's request, with 21 aimag labs
trackers.desc: It analyses samples at the request of citizens, not only of companies and agencies. The central environmental and metrological laboratory, monitoring environmental quality nationally since 1976, publishes an annual account of the work it carried out at the request of citizens and business entities: in a single recent year that included analyses of clean water samples, well over a thousand measurements each of sulphur dioxide and nitrogen dioxide in air, of dust and particulates, and of noise, together with hundreds of soil heavy metal samples and smaller numbers of agrochemical and petroleum product samples, with the results sent on to the relevant organisations. A herder or a soum resident is a named category of requester here, which is rarer across this research than it ought to be. The network reaches the provinces. It runs through 21 local laboratories in the aimags, 36 fixed stations monitoring ambient air quality, surface water monitoring covering 18 lakes and 191 points on 94 rivers, 58 points at 29 wastewater treatment facilities, 390 soil quality monitoring points, and further points for radioactivity and acid precipitation. Ask the aimag laboratory before assuming the only door is in the capital, which is the same lesson this file records for Bhutan. The published counts tell you what is routine. Where a laboratory reports doing a particular measurement by the hundred or the thousand each year, a request for that parameter is ordinary work rather than a favour being asked, and knowing which parameters those are is worth more than a general enquiry. Its work feeds the fee and assessment systems. The laboratory frames its analyses within named statutes on hydrometeorology and environmental monitoring, environmental impact assessment, water, water pollution fees, land, air and air pollution fees — so a measurement is not an isolated number but an input to systems that already charge for pollution. Read this with the specialized inspection agency and rehabilitation guarantee account entries recorded for this country: the laboratory measures, the inspectorate acts, and the guarantee account is the money that is supposed to pay for restoration. Apply the standing instruction recorded here as well — ask what the laboratory is accredited for and ask for the measurement uncertainty with the figure.

trackers.name: Хууль зүйн туслалцааны төв — advice for anyone, and free representation that now reaches land and property cases
trackers.desc: Advice is open to everyone; representation is for defined clients. The legal aid centre under the justice ministry works through state advocates performing two functions: giving legal advice, which is open to any person facing a legal problem whether or not they can pay, and providing advocacy services free of charge to the clients the law defines. A community unsure of its position should therefore ask for advice first, because that door does not turn on means at all. Land and immovable property cases are inside the scope of free representation. The revised law on legal assistance widened state advocacy beyond indigent accused persons, and the categories now include participants without means in administrative cases where rights of immovable property or land ownership have been violated, alongside under eighteen victims of sexual and child offences, victims of domestic violence and trafficking without means, child maintenance matters, child witnesses and children at risk. For the purposes of this research that is the sentence that matters: a household without means contesting an administrative decision over its land sits inside the statutory client list rather than outside it. Branches in every aimag, and a procedure that sets standards. The centre operates branches across all provinces, and the procedure for providing legal assistance requires centre and branch staff and state advocates to deal with the client respectfully, give a clear answer to the question asked, explain it in terms the client understands, and put it in writing where necessary; advice is also given in answer to requests made by email and by telephone. Ask for the answer in writing, because the procedure contemplates exactly that. Two further provisions worth knowing. Foreign nationals and stateless people without means may be given assistance within a defined scope under a joint procedure of the justice and foreign affairs ministers; and advocates other than state advocates may follow the same rules when acting without charge for a person who cannot pay. Read this with the bar association's pro bono committee and the specialized inspection agency entries already recorded for this country.

trackers.name: egazar — everything about a parcel except whose it is, with kiosks and a five-day rule
trackers.desc: Everything is open except whose land it is. The land administration agency states that all information in the unified cadastral system has been made open apart from the answer to the question whose land this is, because the privacy law requires a possessor's name to be kept confidential. What that leaves is substantial: through the system a person can obtain a parcel's area and permitted purpose, the administrative decree behind it, the contract term and whether it has expired, payment and charge records, and whether a pledge is registered against it — printed as a certificate or reference. It is the most precisely drawn line in this file, and the exact inverse of Taiwan's, where the open class of transcript names a corporate holder in full. Four ways in, including a machine in the district. Requests and references may be made through the electronic land system, its mobile application, the land service kiosk machines, or the national electronic services portal. The agency reports installing kiosks across the country from 2022 onwards, dozens in each of the following years. Where a household has no reliable connection, the kiosk is the access route, and it sits closer than the aimag centre. References, certificates and cadastral maps can be downloaded — and a suspended right is recorded. The system issues references, certificates and cadastral maps, and lists a pledge certificate among its services where land has been pledged. The cadastral database records pledges, the granting of possessed land to others for use, rights restored or suspended by a court decision, and changes to the name of a citizen or legal entity. Where a project's paperwork appears suddenly, whether a right was suspended or restored by a court is a recorded fact and can be asked for. Five working days. Land requests are received and resolved through the electronic system, with published rules requiring requests for certificates of possession or use to be decided within five working days. Read this with the specialized inspection agency, the central laboratory, the local development fund and the legal aid entries already recorded for this country.

trackers.name: Шилэн данс — concession and procurement decisions published, and a citizen's right to demand an audit
trackers.desc: What must be published includes the decisions behind a project. The transparency law requires covered bodies to post on the government's glass account portal, among other things, any decision creating a public-private partnership agreement or a concession, or committing budget, property, assets or money, or creating a debt or a receivable — and the audit reports, conclusions and other inspection results on procurement activity. For a community facing a project let by concession or tender, the decision that created it and the audit of the procurement that followed are both meant to be published rather than requested. The duty is personal, and it reaches the person who interfered. The law names who bears the obligation to deliver this information to citizens: the authorised official who took or signed the decision on the concession, partnership, expenditure, debt or procurement; the official who interfered from outside with that authorised official exercising their powers; and the officials who placed the first and second signatures on the payment order. Writing to a named official who carries a statutory duty is a different act from writing to an institution. Citizen oversight is its own article. Where an organisation or official has not accepted the position on implementation, on violations and shortcomings in glass account information, or on demands made about it, a citizen or a legal person may complain to the state audit body under the law on petitions and complaints — and may ask that body to issue an audit conclusion on the activities of the organisation concerned. A request for an audit is a heavier instrument than a request for an answer. And compliance is already being scored. The audit body may audit glass account information on its own initiative, and implementation of this law is used as a key indicator when an organisation's or an official's work report is appraised and when a higher body carries out an inspection. A complaint about non-publication therefore lands on a measure somebody is already being judged by. Read this with the cadastral system, the specialized inspection agency, the central laboratory and the local development fund entries already recorded for this country.

trackers.name: Төрийн аудитын байгууллага — a contractor performing a state function is an audited entity
trackers.desc: A private body that has taken over a state function by contract is an audited entity. The public audit law defines the parties subject to audit as budget organisations, special funds, state and locally owned legal entities and entities with state or local ownership participation, and entities which have assumed state functions on the basis of legislation or of a contract. Where a service, a facility or a scheme has been contracted out to a company, the contract therefore does not put it beyond the reach of state audit — a point worth making in writing when an agency says the operator is private. Local budget drafts receive an audit conclusion, sent to the council that votes on them. The audit body issues conclusions on the annual budget drafts submitted by the government to parliament and by aimag and capital governors to their citizens' representative khurals, addressing how budget revenue might be increased, expenditure reduced and the efficiency of budget financing improved, and delivers those conclusions to the parliament, the government and the local khurals. A project sitting inside a local budget can therefore be questioned before it is approved, in a document that reaches the same council that will vote. State-linked companies file for audit on a fixed date. State and locally owned entities and those with state or local participation must submit their year-end financial statements to the audit body by a date set in law for audit, so the accounts of a state-linked developer are examined on a calendar rather than only when something goes wrong. Findings that touch rights carry a right to respond. Where the results of an audit report may affect the rights and legitimate interests of the audited party, the audit body must provide the opportunity to submit opinions, requests, explanations and complaints, and reports are issued with conclusions and recommendations. The audit body's own site carries a section on citizen participation in state audit alongside its published audit reports and a channel for suggestions. Read this with the glass account transparency duty, the anti-corruption authority, the cadastral system and the legal aid centre entries already recorded for this country.

trackers.name: Local protection by the soum khural — the research-based proposal, the boundary and regime decision, and the buffer zone council
trackers.desc: A soum or aimag council can place part of its own territory under local protection. The law on special protected areas provides that proposals to take a defined part of a territory into state special protection or into local protection, to change its category, or to fix its boundaries, are prepared on the basis of research and submitted to the citizens' representative khural of that level for discussion, and that the khural decides to take the area under local protection and establishes its boundaries and its protection regime. A community that wants a pasture, a spring, a forest or a mountain protected is therefore asking a body its own neighbours elect, sitting in the soum centre, rather than petitioning a ministry in the capital. The proposal must rest on research, and that is the statutory hook. The requirement that the proposal be prepared on the basis of research means an application without survey, mapping or documentation is not in the form the law contemplates — and equally that evidence assembled by a community is exactly what the provision calls for. The mapping, testing and survey resources recorded elsewhere in this file are what that evidence looks like in practice. Land can also be taken into local special needs. The land law allows land to be placed in the special needs of an aimag, the capital or a soum on the submission of the governor of that level, with the area, the boundaries and the rules of use fixed by the decision. That is a second and parallel instrument to local protection, and it is worth establishing early which of the two an authority intends to use, because the procedure and the consequences differ. Where an area is already protected, the buffer zone council is the seat to occupy. The law on buffer zones of special protected areas provides for a non-staff buffer zone council to broaden the participation of local citizens in regulating development in the buffer zone and in the rational use, protection and restoration of natural wealth; buffer zone management plans address citizens' employment and social questions; and the protected area administration may conclude contracts with organisations permitted to carry out research, and may license and monitor the activities that the protection regime allows. Read this with the environmental rehabilitation guarantee account, the nökhörlöl partnerships, the local development fund and the inspection agency entries already recorded for this country.

trackers.name: МБОИЗ — the national environmental NGO council, with a branch in all twenty-one provinces
trackers.desc: There is a branch council in every province. The council describes itself as founded in 2008 at the first national congress of environmental non-governmental organisations, as independent of the state, non-profit, and existing to serve its members, with branch councils in all twenty-one provinces. More than seven hundred organisations are registered as members nationwide, of which over a hundred and sixty are actively operating. A village group facing a mine or a road therefore does not have to start alone or travel to the capital to find anyone: there is a provincial body whose stated purpose is to serve organisations like it. Its stated job is to supply information and capacity to those members. Its published purpose is to help halt the degradation of the country's nature and leave a healthy and safe environment to future generations, by providing information to environmental organisations and citizens, supporting and strengthening their activity, and working for active civic participation, equal multi-party partnership and strong oversight within a partnership between the state and civil society. That is a support organisation rather than a campaigning one, which is worth knowing before approaching it. The governing structure is elective and periodic. Its supreme body is a national congress convened once every two years, which elects the president, the governing council and the control council, and which adopts the charter together with the recommendations and policy documents addressed to the state, to non-governmental organisations and to citizens. A recommendation adopted by a congress of several hundred member organisations is a document a single local group can cite in its own dealings with an authority. It joins petitions alongside others. Published accounts record it acting together with two other organisations, researchers and students in December 2024 to lodge an electronic petition with parliament's public petitions committee, asking for a working group to be formed and for the reopening of a border crossing to be removed from the government's action programme, in order to keep a Gobi protected area intact. Its office address in the capital, telephone number, email address and a donation route are published. Read this with the local protection route, the nökhörlöl partnerships, the local development fund and the inspection agency entries already recorded for this country.

trackers.name: ХЭҮК and the Human Rights Defenders Committee — an organisation may complain for you, and a committee issues written conclusions
trackers.desc: A complaint can be oral, and an organisation can bring it. Published guidance on complaining to the commission records that a complaint is made in Mongolian, orally or in writing, within one year of the day the right or freedom was violated or of the day the person learned of the violation; that a non-governmental organisation or a trade union may complain through its representative; that a person without full legal capacity may complain themselves or through a legal representative, parent or guardian; and that foreign citizens and stateless persons present in the country enjoy the same right to complain as citizens. The one-year clock and the organisational route are the two facts to fix before anything is drafted — the first because it runs from knowledge as well as from the act, the second because it lets a group carry a complaint that no individual wants to sign. There is a statutory committee for defenders. Under the law on the legal status of human rights defenders, a non-staff human rights defenders committee operates under the commission, with the function of issuing conclusions on whether a defender's rights have been violated. For people who have taken a public position against a mine, a road or a licence, that is a named body whose specific job is to reach a finding about what happened to them. Its work runs on risk assessment and a database. The committee's published functions include submitting to the commission conclusions reached on the basis of a risk assessment; monitoring and researching the implementation of the defenders law and the situation of defenders, and having that reflected in the annual report on the state of human rights and freedoms in the country; and building a database of complaints and information. A defender's file that ends in a written conclusion and an entry in a national report is a different kind of record from a complaint left in a police station. What the commission is. It was established by the statute of December 2000 — six chapters and twenty-six articles covering the commission's and its members' powers, its principles, structure and organisation, and the procedure for making and deciding complaints where an enterprise, organisation, official or individual is considered to have violated the rights and freedoms guaranteed by the constitution, by law or by international treaty — and it has been the country's national human rights institution since 2001. Read this with the local protection route through the soum council, the national environmental NGO council, the nökhörlöl partnerships and the inspection agency entries already recorded for this country.

trackers.name: Land taken for state special needs — the six things that must be agreed in advance, including the replacement plot's quality
trackers.desc: Six things must be agreed before the land goes. The law on allocating land to citizens for ownership requires that, where a citizen's owned land is to be exchanged or taken back with compensation on the basis of state special needs, the owner and the state land administration body agree in advance on: the assets the owner has spent on that land and the extent of the loss the owner will suffer; the size of the land being taken; the location, size, condition and quality of the land given in exchange; the conditions and the period for vacating; the obligations and responsibilities each side carries in connection with the vacating; and the amount of compensation together with the procedure and the period for paying it. That is a checklist an owner can hold an authority to before signing anything, and each item left blank is a concession made by default.
