IT IS A NON-PROFIT COORDINATING BODY FOUNDED IN 1996, COVERING THE WEST BANK AND GAZA, DESCRIBED AS THE ONLY SUCH NETWORK IN THE TERRITORIES, WITH ABOUT FIFTEEN MEMBER ORGANISATIONS. ITS MEMBERS BETWEEN THEM COVER LAND DEFENCE, SUSTAINABLE AGRICULTURE, WATER CONSERVATION, BIODIVERSITY, PUBLIC HEALTH AND CULTURAL HERITAGE PRESERVATION — and they include the applied research institute already recorded here, alongside agricultural work committees. A COMMUNITY THAT DOES NOT KNOW WHICH ORGANISATION FITS ITS PROBLEM SHOULD PUT THE PROBLEM TO THE NETWORK AND LET IT ROUTE THE REQUEST. WHAT IT OFFERS DIRECTLY IS WORTH KNOWING: ADVOCACY AND AWARENESS WORK, CAPACITY BUILDING AND TRAINING, AND ENVIRONMENTAL SERVICES, PLUS COORDINATION BETWEEN ITS MEMBERS AND WITH LOCAL GOVERNMENT AGENCIES AND INTERNATIONAL ENVIRONMENTAL ORGANISATIONS. THE TRAINING IS THE PART COMMUNITIES UNDER-USE — a village that wants to document water loss or land degradation properly can be taught to do it rather than waiting for someone to come and do it. IT IS FUNDED AND OPERATING, WHICH MATTERS WHEN DECIDING WHETHER TO APPROACH: IT HAS HELD A MULTI-YEAR EUROPEAN UNION GRANT OF SEVEN HUNDRED AND FIFTY THOUSAND EUROS FOR A COMMUNITY-EMPOWERMENT ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION PROJECT, delivered with named international and local implementing partners. AN ORGANISATION MID-PROJECT HAS STAFF, A BUDGET LINE AND A REASON TO WORK WITH COMMUNITIES. IT ALSO JOINED FRIENDS OF THE EARTH INTERNATIONAL IN 2008, WHICH GIVES A LOCAL CASE A ROUTE ONTO A GLOBAL PLATFORM — the same federation whose national members this file has recorded in other countries in the region. AND A PRACTICAL DETAIL: IT SHARES A STREET ADDRESS IN THE SAME CITY WITH THE AGRICULTURAL RELIEF COMMITTEES ALREADY RECORDED IN THIS FILE. ONE VISIT REACHES BOTH, which matters where movement between towns is slow and uncertain. NOW THE CAVEAT, STATED PLAINLY BECAUSE IT AFFECTS WHO CAN SAFELY WORK WITH IT. THIS NETWORK IS POLITICALLY ENGAGED AND CONTESTED: IT CAMPAIGNS AGAINST NAMED COMPANIES AND INSTITUTIONS, A MONITORING ORGANISATION CHARACTERISES ITS WORK AS POLITICAL RATHER THAN ENVIRONMENTAL, AND THIRD PARTIES HAVE MADE ALLEGATIONS ABOUT THE AFFILIATIONS OF ONE MEMBER ORGANISATION. THIS ENTRY RECORDS THE DISPUTE AND ADOPTS NEITHER SIDE'S FRAMING. WHAT THAT MEANS PRACTICALLY: A GROUP WHOSE FUNDING OR PERMITS DEPEND ON DONORS SENSITIVE TO THOSE ALLEGATIONS SHOULD APPROACH A SINGLE MEMBER ORGANISATION DIRECTLY RATHER THAN THE NETWORK, and several of those members are already recorded separately here for exactly that reason. Membership lists and current activity were not verified in this round.

trackers.name: Weekly record of agricultural interventions — who is working in your district, on what, with whose money
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HAS RECORDED DIRECTORIES OF ORGANISATIONS IN SEVERAL COUNTRIES. A DIRECTORY TELLS YOU WHO EXISTS. THIS TELLS YOU WHO IS WORKING IN YOUR DISTRICT THIS WEEK: A GOVERNMENT COMMUNICATION CENTRE PUBLISHES A WEEKLY REPORT ON THE DEVELOPMENTAL INTERVENTIONS CARRIED OUT BY THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY AND ITS PARTNERS, DATED WEEK BY WEEK. LOOK AT WHAT A SINGLE ENTRY CONTAINS: IN A NAMED NEIGHBOURHOOD, UNDER THE SUPERVISION OF A HIGHER AGRICULTURAL EMERGENCY COMMITTEE, A NAMED LOCAL ORGANISATION REHABILITATED AND BROUGHT BACK INTO OPERATION AGRICULTURAL WELLS AND INSTALLED WATER LINES, FUNDED BY A NAMED INTERNATIONAL AGENCY, FOR SIXTY FARMERS. WHO DID IT, WHERE, WHO PAID FOR IT, AND HOW MANY HOUSEHOLDS BENEFITED — IN ONE LINE. A COMMUNITY READING A FEW WEEKS OF THESE REPORTS LEARNS WHICH ORGANISATIONS OPERATE IN ITS OWN GOVERNORATE, WHICH DONORS ARE FUNDING THAT WORK RIGHT NOW, AND WHAT SCALE OF PROJECT IS BEING APPROVED. That is the information every fundraising and partnership decision depends on, and it is published for nothing. USE IT BACKWARDS, WHICH IS THE POINT MOST PEOPLE MISS: FIND A PROJECT LIKE THE ONE YOU NEED, NOTE THE IMPLEMENTING ORGANISATION AND THE FUNDER, AND APPROACH THAT ORGANISATION SAYING YOU HAVE SEEN THE WORK IT DID IN THE NEIGHBOURING DISTRICT AND HAVE THE SAME NEED. AN ORGANISATION WITH A LIVE PROJECT AND A LIVE DONOR RELATIONSHIP CAN EXTEND WHAT IT IS ALREADY DOING FAR MORE EASILY THAN IT CAN START SOMETHING NEW. THE MINISTRY ITSELF STATES THAT IT DELIVERS THIS FIELD AND DEVELOPMENT WORK IN PARTNERSHIP WITH LOCAL AND INTERNATIONAL INSTITUTIONS — so the partnership route is the normal one here, not an exception to be argued for. AND ONE PROGRAMME IN THE SAME REPORTS BEARS DIRECTLY ON HOW LAND IS LOST: A JOINT PLAN WITH THE CIVIL DEFENCE TO PROTECT AGRICULTURAL LANDS AND FORESTS FROM FIRES DURING THE SUMMER, WITH FIELD READINESS REINFORCED. FIRE IS ONE OF THE COMMONEST WAYS FARMLAND AND WOODLAND ARE LOST, AND ONCE BURNT, LAND IS FAR EASIER TO RECLASSIFY AND BUILD ON. THERE IS A NAMED JOINT PLAN AND A NAMED PARTNER SERVICE: ASK BEFORE THE SEASON WHAT THE PLAN COVERS IN YOUR AREA, WHERE THE FIREBREAKS AND WATER POINTS ARE, AND HOW A VILLAGE REPORTS A RISK — this file has recorded fire nowhere else as a land-loss mechanism, and it should have. THE LIMITS: this is government reporting of government and partner activity — IT RECORDS WHAT WAS DONE, NOT WHAT WAS REFUSED, and it will not include organisations working outside official partnerships. Coverage of areas outside the reporting authority's reach is limited, and in this country access and permissions are severely constrained. The reports are weekly and individual entries date quickly; READ THE RECENT ONES RATHER THAN RELYING ON THE EXAMPLE HERE. Read it with the environmental NGO network, the land research and documentation bodies and the legal routes recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Public procurement council and unified portal — where a project is advertised before anyone announces it locally
trackers.desc: AN AUDIT RUN THIS ROUND FOUND THAT TWENTY OF THE TWENTY-THREE COUNTRIES IN THIS MAP HAVE NO PROCUREMENT OR TENDER RESOURCE RECORDED AT ALL. THAT IS NOW THE LARGEST STRUCTURAL GAP IN THE PAYLOAD, AND IT MATTERS FOR ONE REASON: A PROJECT APPEARS IN A TENDER NOTICE BEFORE IT IS ANNOUNCED LOCALLY. A ROAD, A LANDFILL, A QUARRY ACCESS TRACK, A DRAINAGE SCHEME OR A SURVEY CONTRACT IS ADVERTISED WITH ITS SCOPE, ITS LOCATION AND ITS TIMETABLE WHILE IT IS STILL ONLY A PROCUREMENT — months before machinery appears and long before any consultation. READING TENDERS IS THE EARLIEST WARNING SYSTEM AVAILABLE TO A COMMUNITY, AND IT IS FREE. HERE THE MACHINERY EXISTS: A HIGHER COUNCIL FOR PUBLIC PROCUREMENT POLICIES, A NON-MINISTERIAL GOVERNMENT INSTITUTION ANSWERING TO THE CABINET, WITH A STATED AIM OF BUILDING A MODERN PUBLIC PROCUREMENT SYSTEM — AND A UNIFIED PUBLIC PROCUREMENT PORTAL ON WHICH THE COUNCIL HAS RUN TRAINING COURSES. SO THERE IS ONE PLACE WHERE GOVERNMENT WORKS AND PURCHASING ARE ADVERTISED, AND A BODY WHOSE JOB IS TO MAKE THAT SYSTEM WORK. START THERE, AND ASK THE COUNCIL DIRECTLY WHERE NOTICES FOR YOUR GOVERNORATE APPEAR AND HOW FAR IN ADVANCE THEY MUST BE PUBLISHED. WHAT TO ASK FOR IS WORTH KNOWING PRECISELY, BECAUSE A NEIGHBOURING COUNTRY'S RULES SPELL IT OUT: GOVERNMENT ENTITIES THERE ARE REQUIRED TO PUBLISH THEIR WORKS AND PURCHASES THROUGH THE UNIFIED PORTAL, EXPRESSLY IN ORDER TO PREVENT DISCRIMINATION BETWEEN COMPETITORS AND TO MAKE INFORMATION AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC SUFFICIENTLY IN ADVANCE OF BID SUBMISSION DEADLINES. INFORMATION TO THE PUBLIC, IN ADVANCE, IS A STATED PURPOSE OF THESE PORTALS — NOT A BY-PRODUCT. THAT IS THE SENTENCE TO QUOTE WHEN AN AUTHORITY TREATS A TENDER AS ITS OWN BUSINESS, and this file has repeatedly found that the strongest arguments are made from the system's own stated objects. TWO FURTHER RULES FROM THE SAME NEIGHBOURING FRAMEWORK ARE WORTH TESTING FOR LOCALLY, BECAUSE THEY CUT BOTH WAYS: AWARD PRIORITY TO LOCAL SMALL AND MEDIUM ENTERPRISES WHERE COMPETING OFFERS TIE ON OVERALL EVALUATION, AND LOCAL CONTENT REQUIREMENTS FOR THOSE DEALING WITH GOVERNMENT. WHERE SUCH RULES EXIST, A LOCAL COOPERATIVE OR CONTRACTOR HAS A CLAIM ON WORK BEING DONE ON ITS OWN GROUND — and the community gains a stake in how the work is carried out rather than only opposing it. THE LIMITS: this is the procurement authority, not an ally — it exists to make purchasing orderly, not to stop projects, and nothing here gives a right to object to a contract. Portal coverage, publication periods and whether notices are searchable by location WERE NOT VERIFIED, and procurement in this territory is severely constrained by access and by donor conditions. The comparative rules cited come from ANOTHER COUNTRY and are offered as what to ask for, not as local law. Read it with the weekly interventions record and the land documentation bodies recorded separately here.

trackers.name: Reclamation consortium — the associations and the growers' cooperative that do the work, as partners not beneficiaries
trackers.desc: THE NUMBER FIRST, BECAUSE IT SETS THE SCALE: CULTIVATED AREA IN THE STRIP FELL FROM NINE THOUSAND THREE HUNDRED HECTARES TO FOUR HUNDRED. WHAT FOLLOWS IS AN EMERGENCY EFFORT TO SAVE WHAT REMAINS OF THE FOOD BASKET, AND THE BODIES DOING IT ARE NAMED. A LAND RECLAMATION AND CULTIVATION PROJECT RUNS UNDER THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY IN PARTNERSHIP WITH A GAZA AGRICULTURE GROUP ASSOCIATION, AN AGRICULTURAL RELIEF ASSOCIATION, AND THE AGRICULTURAL COOPERATIVE SOCIETY FOR GRAPE AND VEGETABLE PRODUCERS — WITH SUPPORT FROM AN INTERNATIONAL AID ORGANISATION. NOTE THE THIRD PARTNER. A PRODUCER COOPERATIVE FOR NAMED CROPS IS NOT A BENEFICIARY OF THIS PROJECT BUT AN IMPLEMENTING PARTNER IN IT. THAT IS THE STRONGEST POSITION A GROWERS' GROUP CAN HOLD — it decides how the work is done and who receives it, rather than queuing for a share. SO THE INSTRUCTION FOR ANY COMMUNITY OF GROWERS IS SPECIFIC: FORM OR JOIN THE COOPERATIVE FOR YOUR CROP, AND ASK TO BE A PARTNER IN THE NEXT PROJECT RATHER THAN A LIST OF NAMES INSIDE SOMEONE ELSE'S. This file has recorded cooperatives in a dozen countries as vehicles for holding land and money; here one is a delivery partner alongside a ministry and an international funder. WHAT THE PROJECT ACTUALLY DELIVERS IS WORTH COPYING AS A TEMPLATE: SUPPORT TO ONE HUNDRED FARMERS ACROSS UP TO ONE THOUSAND DUNAMS, COMPRISING EQUIPMENT AND LABOUR, THE DIGGING OF NEW WELLS, THE REPAIR OF DAMAGED WELLS, AND THE INSTALLATION OF WATER TRANSPORT LINES TO THE AGRICULTURAL LAND. THOSE ARE THE SAME FOUR ITEMS THIS FILE FOUND TO BE THE MOST FUNDABLE ANYWHERE: WELLS, WATER LINES, EQUIPMENT AND LABOUR, ALL SPENT ON LAND PEOPLE ALREADY HOLD. A PROPOSAL BUILT FROM THOSE FOUR ASKS FOR NOTHING NEW AND NOTHING CONTESTED, which is precisely why it gets funded when land purchase and construction do not. AND THE WORK LEAVES EVIDENCE: A REPAIRED WELL AND A NEW WATER LINE ARE DATED, PHOTOGRAPHED, FUNDER-DOCUMENTED PROOF THAT A SPECIFIC PARCEL WAS BROUGHT BACK INTO PRODUCTION — the same double outcome recorded for terraces and cisterns in another country in this map. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE HEAVY. THIS IS EMERGENCY AGRICULTURAL RECOVERY IN A TERRITORY UNDER WAR CONDITIONS: ACCESS, PERMISSIONS AND THE SAFETY OF THE PEOPLE DOING THE WORK GOVERN EVERYTHING, and one of the partner organisations is already recorded elsewhere in this file. Project partners, funding and capacity change from season to season and WERE NOT VERIFIED BEYOND THE REPORTED PROJECT; treat the named bodies as a starting point for enquiry rather than a standing offer. Read it with the weekly interventions record, the environmental NGO network and the land documentation bodies recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: University water and environment institute — laboratory tests at cost price, accepting samples from associations and municipalities
trackers.desc: ALMOST EVERY OBJECTION RECORDED IN THIS FILE THAT FAILED, FAILED FOR WANT OF EVIDENCE. HERE IS THE ANSWER, AND IT IS ORDINARY: A UNIVERSITY WATER AND ENVIRONMENTAL STUDIES INSTITUTE THAT CARRIES OUT COMPREHENSIVE TESTS ON SAMPLES OF WATER, WASTEWATER, AGRICULTURAL AND INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTS AND OTHERS — AT COST PRICE ONLY. AND THE NEXT CLAUSE IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS MOST: ITS LABORATORIES RECEIVE SAMPLES FROM ALL GOVERNMENTAL AND PRIVATE INSTITUTIONS, FROM ENVIRONMENTAL ASSOCIATIONS AND FROM MUNICIPALITIES. ENVIRONMENTAL ASSOCIATIONS AND MUNICIPALITIES ARE NAMED AS SENDERS. THAT MEANS A VILLAGE COUNCIL OR A REGISTERED LOCAL ASSOCIATION CAN SEND WATER FROM ITS OWN WELL, ITS OWN SPRING OR THE DITCH BELOW A FACTORY, AND GET BACK A LABORATORY RESULT FROM A UNIVERSITY — AT COST, NOT AT COMMERCIAL RATES. THAT IS THE SINGLE MOST PRACTICAL THING IN THIS ENTIRE PAYLOAD. A COMPLAINT SAYING THE WATER SMELLS IS DISMISSED; A LABORATORY REPORT FROM A NAMED UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE IS NOT. AND BECAUSE THE INSTITUTE ALSO MONITORS DRINKING WATER QUALITY ACROSS MANY AREAS OF THE COUNTRY, IT MAY ALREADY HOLD EARLIER READINGS FOR YOUR AREA — WHICH IS THE BASELINE THIS FILE HAS SAID REPEATEDLY DECIDES ARGUMENTS ABOUT CHANGE. SO ASK TWO THINGS TOGETHER: WHAT IT WOULD COST TO TEST SAMPLES NOW, AND WHETHER THE INSTITUTE HOLDS ANY EARLIER RESULTS FOR THE SAME SOURCE. THE SECOND COSTS NOTHING AND MAY BE WORTH MORE THAN THE FIRST. ITS RESEARCH COVERS DRINKING WATER SOURCE MANAGEMENT, WASTEWATER TREATMENT, RENEWABLE ENERGY, WATER QUALITY MONITORING AND — DIRECTLY TO THE POINT — THE IMPACT OF AGRICULTURAL AND INDUSTRIAL ACTIVITIES ON WATER QUALITY. A COMMUNITY DOWNSTREAM OF A FACTORY, A QUARRY OR AN INTENSIVE FARM IS RAISING THE INSTITUTE'S OWN SUBJECT. IT ALSO PROVIDES RESEARCH INFORMATION TO INSTITUTIONS FREE OR AT COST, AND RUNS TRAINING COURSES IN ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AND WATER TREATMENT FOR ALL SEGMENTS OF THE LOCAL COMMUNITY — NAMING FARMERS, WOMEN AND TEACHERS AS ITS AUDIENCES. TRAINING FARMERS AND TEACHERS IS HOW A TESTING RELATIONSHIP BECOMES A STANDING ONE. A COMMUNITY THAT SENDS PEOPLE ON A COURSE IS KNOWN TO THE INSTITUTE BEFORE IT EVER NEEDS AN URGENT SAMPLE ANALYSED. THE LIMITS: this is A UNIVERSITY LABORATORY AND RESEARCH INSTITUTE, NOT AN ADVOCATE — it produces results, not objections, and it will not campaign. AT COST PRICE IS NOT FREE, and WHAT A TEST ACTUALLY COSTS, WHAT SAMPLING PROTOCOL IT REQUIRES FOR A RESULT TO BE DEFENSIBLE, AND WHETHER LABORATORY ACCREDITATION COVERS THE PARAMETER YOU NEED WERE NOT VERIFIED — ask all three before sampling, because a badly taken sample is worthless. Access and movement in this territory constrain everything. Read it with the hydrologists' group already recorded here, the reclamation consortium and the environmental NGO network recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Agricultural work committees union — village committees that set the priorities, a local seed bank, and land reclamation with legal awareness
trackers.desc: MOST ORGANISATIONS IN THIS FILE DECIDE WHAT COMMUNITIES NEED. THIS ONE IS BUILT THE OTHER WAY ROUND: IT FORMED AGRICULTURAL COMMITTEES ACROSS BOTH TERRITORIES WHICH IDENTIFY THE PRIORITIES OF FARMERS AND HELP THE INSTITUTION IMPLEMENT ITS PROGRAMMES. LOCAL COMMITTEES THAT SET THE PRIORITIES IS THE STRUCTURE TO COPY. THE DIRECTION OF TRAVEL IS FROM THE VILLAGE UPWARD RATHER THAN FROM THE OFFICE OUTWARD — AND IT MEANS A COMMUNITY'S FIRST TASK IS TO FORM OR JOIN THE COMMITTEE, NOT TO PETITION THE HEADQUARTERS. IT WAS FOUNDED IN 1986 ON THE INITIATIVE OF A GROUP OF AGRICULTURAL ENGINEERS, REGISTERED UNDER THE ASSOCIATIONS LAW, AND RAN ENTIRELY ON VOLUNTEERS AT THE START. THAT ORIGIN — PROFESSIONALS PLUS VOLUNTEERS, NO BUDGET — IS THE MOST REPLICABLE FOUNDING STORY THIS FILE HAS RECORDED. WHAT IT DOES COVERS THE WHOLE PROBLEM: AGRICULTURAL LAND DEVELOPMENT AND RECLAMATION, WATER HARVESTING, CAPACITY BUILDING, STRENGTHENING RURAL WOMEN'S LIVELIHOODS, LEGAL AWARENESS PROGRAMMES, AND EMERGENCY RESPONSE — PLANNED ON AN EXPLICITLY HUMAN RIGHTS-BASED APPROACH. LEGAL AWARENESS SITTING IN THE SAME ORGANISATION AS RECLAMATION AND WATER HARVESTING IS THE COMBINATION THAT MATTERS. THE SAME BODY THAT HELPS CLEAR AND WATER A FIELD CAN TELL THE FARMER WHAT PAPERS PROTECT IT — AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED OVER AND OVER THAT WORKING THE LAND AND DOCUMENTING THE WORK ARE THE TWO HALVES OF HOLDING IT. THE SEED WORK IS THE HEART OF IT. THE UNION PROPAGATES AND IMPROVES MORE THAN THIRTY-FIVE VARIETIES OF LOCAL VEGETABLE AND FIELD CROPS AND CONSERVES THEIR GENETIC ASSETS IN A SEED BANK, TO PROTECT LOCAL SEED FROM LOSS AND SECURE FARMERS' SOVEREIGNTY OVER THEIR OWN FOOD. IT HAS INCREASED THE AREA SOWN WITH LOCAL SEED, INCREASED THE NUMBER OF DISTRIBUTION CENTRES, AND RUNS LABORATORY TESTS ON THE SEED. A SEED BANK HELD BY A FARMERS' UNION RATHER THAN A MINISTRY IS A DIFFERENT INSTRUMENT FROM THE STATE COLLECTIONS RECORDED ELSEWHERE IN THIS FILE: THE VARIETIES ARE THE ONES PEOPLE ACTUALLY GROW, THE DISTRIBUTION CENTRES PUT THEM BACK IN FIELDS, AND SOVEREIGNTY OVER FOOD IS STATED AS THE PURPOSE. ASK FOR THE VARIETY LIST AND THE NEAREST DISTRIBUTION CENTRE. ITS STANDING IS EXTERNAL AS WELL AS LOCAL: IT WON AN INTERNATIONAL EQUATOR PRIZE, HONOURED BY THE ENVIRONMENT QUALITY AUTHORITY AND A UNITED NATIONS AGENCY, AND IT BELONGS TO AN ARAB FOOD SOVEREIGNTY NETWORK AND TO THE INTERNATIONAL UNION FOR CONSERVATION OF NATURE. NOW THE PART THAT MUST BE READ BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE. THE UNION WAS CLOSED BY THE OCCUPATION AUTHORITIES IN 2021 AND HAS BEEN THE TARGET OF SUSTAINED INCITEMENT CAMPAIGNS; A NATIONAL NGO NETWORK PUBLICLY PROTESTED THE CLOSURE AND THE ARREST OF STAFF AT A SISTER ORGANISATION. ITS RECLAMATION WORK IS IN THE AREA WHERE FARMERS FACE VIOLATIONS BY SOLDIERS AND SETTLERS. SO ASSOCIATION CARRIES RISK HERE, AND THAT RISK IS NOT ABSTRACT — IT HAS ALREADY MATERIALISED ONCE. ANYONE APPROACHING SHOULD ESTABLISH ITS CURRENT LEGAL STATUS AND OPERATING CAPACITY FIRST, WHICH THIS FILE HAS NOT VERIFIED, AND SHOULD WEIGH WHAT ASSOCIATION MEANS FOR THEM. THE LIMITS: it is A DEVELOPMENT AND FARMING ORGANISATION, NOT A LAW FIRM — legal awareness is education, not representation. THE PROGRAMME AND SEED DESCRIPTIONS COME FROM ITS OWN PAGES AND FROM COVERAGE OF AN AWARD SOME YEARS OLD, AND ITS CURRENT PROGRAMMES, FUNDING AND STATUS WERE NOT VERIFIED. Read it with the water and environment institute's cost-price laboratory, the hydrologists' group, the reclamation consortium and the environmental NGO network recorded separately for this territory.WHAT THIS WORK LOOKS LIKE AFTER DESTRUCTION WAS NOT RECORDED HERE, AND IT IS THE PART A COMMUNITY REBUILDING ANYWHERE SHOULD READ: A LAND RECLAMATION AND CULTIVATION PROJECT LED BY THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY IN GAZA, IN PARTNERSHIP WITH THREE NAMED AGRICULTURAL ASSOCIATIONS - AMONG THEM AN AGRICULTURAL RELIEF SOCIETY AND A COOPERATIVE SOCIETY FOR GRAPE AND VEGETABLE PRODUCERS - AND SUPPORTED BY AN INTERNATIONAL ORGANISATION, AIMS TO ASSIST A HUNDRED FARMERS ACROSS UP TO A THOUSAND DUNUMS: PROVIDING EQUIPMENT AND LABOUR, DRILLING NEW WELLS, MAINTAINING DAMAGED WELLS, AND INSTALLING WATER TRANSMISSION LINES TO THE FIELDS. A HUNDRED FARMERS AND A THOUSAND DUNUMS IS SMALL AGAINST WHAT WAS LOST, AND THE SOURCE SAYS SO: THE CULTIVATED AREA IS REPORTED TO HAVE FALLEN FROM NINE THOUSAND THREE HUNDRED HECTARES TO ONLY FOUR HUNDRED, THE LAND EITHER DESTROYED OR ACCESS-RESTRICTED. THE OBSTACLES ARE LISTED WITHOUT EUPHEMISM AND TRANSFER TO ANY POST-DESTRUCTION PLAN: THE DANGER OF WAR REMNANTS, SHORTAGES OF EQUIPMENT, GENERATORS AND DIESEL, AND SEED PRICES BOTH HIGH AND SCARCE. SEED SCARCITY AFTER A WAR IS THE QUIET EMERGENCY — AND THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS INDIGENOUS SEED-SAVING WORK ELSEWHERE IN THIS TERRITORY, WHICH IS THE SAME PROBLEM SEEN FROM THE OTHER END. ONE MORE PRACTICE OF THIS ORGANISATION BELONGS BESIDE IT: IT TRAINS WOMEN AND YOUNG PEOPLE IN FOOD PROCESSING BY ADOPTING THEIR COOPERATIVES, PROVIDING THE BASIC SUPPLIES TO CARRY PROJECTS OUT AND THEN MARKETING THE PRODUCTS — TAKING ON A COOPERATIVE THAT ALREADY EXISTS RATHER THAN CREATING ONE AND HANDING IT OVER, AND CARRYING IT THROUGH SUPPLY AND SALE, WHICH IS WHERE MOST VILLAGE ENTERPRISES IN THIS FILE FAIL.

trackers.name: Agricultural relief organisation — wells dug and repaired, land reclaimed, farm roads rebuilt, through cooperatives
trackers.desc: THIS IS AN ORGANISATION THAT DOES PHYSICAL WORK ON LAND, WHICH IS RARER IN THIS FILE THAN ADVICE. FOUNDED IN 1983 AS A SPECIALISED VOLUNTARY FRAMEWORK INSIDE THE VOLUNTARY MOVEMENT, IT IS A NATIONAL AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT BODY WHOSE STATED AIMS INCLUDE STRENGTHENING FARMERS' STEADFASTNESS ON THEIR LAND AND REACHING POOR AND MARGINALISED GROUPS. WHAT IT DELIVERS IS CONCRETE AND RECENT. WITH THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY, AND FINANCED BY AN ARAB DEVELOPMENT FUND, IT COMPLETED THE REHABILITATION OF A ONE AND A HALF KILOMETRE AGRICULTURAL ROAD IN A NAMED LOCALITY. AN AGRICULTURAL ACCESS ROAD IS NOT A SMALL THING WHERE LAND IS LOST BY BEING UNREACHABLE. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED REPEATEDLY THAT GROUND WHICH CANNOT BE REACHED STOPS BEING FARMED, AND GROUND THAT STOPS BEING FARMED IS THE EASIEST TO RECLASSIFY AND TAKE. IN THE BESIEGED TERRITORY IT IS ONE OF SEVERAL PARTNERS IN A MINISTRY-LED LAND RECLAMATION AND CULTIVATION PROJECT SUPPORTING ONE HUNDRED FARMERS ACROSS UP TO A THOUSAND DUNAMS — PROVIDING EQUIPMENT AND LABOUR, DIGGING NEW WELLS, REPAIRING DAMAGED ONES, AND INSTALLING WATER TRANSPORT LINES TO THE FIELDS. NOTE THE PARTNERSHIP SHAPE, BECAUSE IT IS THE MODEL TO COPY: A MINISTRY LEADS, AND THE DELIVERY PARTNERS ARE A LOCAL AGRICULTURAL GROUP ASSOCIATION, THIS ORGANISATION, AND A GRAPE AND VEGETABLE PRODUCERS' COOPERATIVE, WITH AN INTERNATIONAL BODY FUNDING. A COOPERATIVE THAT EXISTS ALREADY IS THE UNIT THAT GETS INCLUDED — WHICH IS WHY FORMING ONE BEFORE THE MONEY ARRIVES MATTERS MORE THAN ANY APPLICATION. IT ALSO SITS ALONGSIDE THREE SISTER BODIES WORTH KNOWING BY NAME: THE GENERAL UNION OF FARMERS AND AGRICULTURAL COOPERATORS, THE OIL AND OLIVE COUNCIL, AND THE FARMERS' UNION. THIS FILE HAS SAID THAT ASKING AN ORGANISATION WHAT IT IS A MEMBER OF OPENS DOORS; HERE THE ADJACENT DOORS ARE ALREADY LISTED. THE HONEST CONTEXT IS SEVERE. CULTIVABLE AREA IN THE TERRITORY IS REPORTED TO HAVE FALLEN FROM AROUND NINE THOUSAND THREE HUNDRED HECTARES TO FOUR HUNDRED, AND RECOVERY NEEDS IN AGRICULTURE AND FOOD ALONE ARE ESTIMATED ABOVE TEN BILLION DOLLARS. THE PROJECTS RUN AGAINST WAR DEBRIS HAZARDS, SHORTAGES OF EQUIPMENT, GENERATORS AND FUEL, AND SEED THAT IS SCARCE AND EXPENSIVE. SO THE REALISTIC ASK HERE IS SMALL AND SPECIFIC: A WELL REPAIRED, A WATER LINE RUN TO A PARTICULAR FIELD, A TRACK MADE PASSABLE. THOSE ARE THE UNITS THIS ORGANISATION ACTUALLY DELIVERS, AND EACH ONE KEEPS A PARTICULAR FAMILY ON A PARTICULAR PIECE OF GROUND — WHICH IS WHAT STEADFASTNESS MEANS IN PRACTICE. THE LIMITS: this is A DEVELOPMENT AND SERVICE ORGANISATION, NOT A LITIGATOR OR A LAND-PURCHASE BODY — it will not fight a confiscation in court, and nothing here creates a right to object. ITS CAPACITY IS DONOR-DEPENDENT and the projects described were externally financed; whether it is accepting new requests, and in which areas, WAS NOT VERIFIED. Access, permits and movement restrictions govern what can be done where, and conditions differ completely between areas. Read it with the agricultural work committees union, the applied research institute, the university testing institute and the land research centre recorded separately for this country.THE SOURCE THIS ENTRY RESTS ON IS ITSELF A RESOURCE, AND IT APPEARS EVERY WEEK. THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY PUBLISHES A DATED WEEKLY SUMMARY OF THE DEVELOPMENTAL INTERVENTIONS IT AND ITS PARTNERS CARRIED OUT, NAMING THE VILLAGES, THE NUMBER OF FARMERS, THE AREAS AND THE FUNDERS. ONE WEEK'S LIST SHOWS WHAT THAT MEANS IN PRACTICE: REHABILITATION OF GRAPE FARMS IN FOUR NAMED VILLAGES TARGETING FORTY-SEVEN FARMERS OVER ONE HUNDRED AND THIRTY DUNAMS; TRAINING FOR FIFTEEN WOMEN FARMERS IN MAKING OIL-BASED OINTMENTS AND SOAP; THE ASSESSMENT OF TWENTY-SEVEN OLIVE PRESSES; A PRODUCTION LINE FUNDED AT FIFTY-FIVE THOUSAND SHEKELS; AND, IN THE BESIEGED TERRITORY, THE REHABILITATION AND OPERATION OF AGRICULTURAL WELLS AND INSTALLATION OF WATER LINES FOR SIXTY FARMERS. READ IT AS A FUNDING MAP RATHER THAN AS NEWS. EACH ITEM NAMES A PLACE, A NUMBER OF BENEFICIARIES AND A FUNDER — SO A VILLAGE CAN SEE WHICH PROGRAMMES ARE ACTIVE NEARBY, WHICH ORGANISATION DELIVERS THEM, AND WHO PAID. THAT IS THE INFORMATION COMMUNITIES USUALLY LACK WHEN THEY ASK TO BE INCLUDED IN SOMETHING. AND THE PATTERN TO COPY IS THE ASK: A NEIGHBOURING VILLAGE'S NAMED PROJECT IS THE PRECEDENT FOR YOUR OWN REQUEST. QUOTE IT — THE SAME INTERVENTION, THE SAME PARTNER, THE NEXT VILLAGE. TWO FURTHER ITEMS FROM THE SAME BULLETIN ARE WORTH KNOWING. THE MINISTRY WORKS WITH CIVIL DEFENCE ON A JOINT PLAN TO PROTECT AGRICULTURAL LAND AND FORESTS FROM FIRE DURING THE SUMMER — SO FIRE PROTECTION FOR ORCHARDS AND WOODLAND IS AN EXISTING JOINT PROGRAMME TO ASK ABOUT BEFORE THE DRY SEASON, NOT AN EMERGENCY TO IMPROVISE DURING IT. AND THERE IS AN URGENT RESPONSE PROGRAMME UNDER WHICH THE MINISTER MET FARMERS HARMED BY ATTACKS AND DISTRIBUTED OLIVE SEEDLINGS. WHERE TREES HAVE BEEN DESTROYED, REPLACEMENT SEEDLINGS ARE ALREADY BEING HANDED OUT UNDER A NAMED PROGRAMME — ASK FOR IT BY NAME, AND ASK WHAT EVIDENCE OF THE LOSS IT REQUIRES. IN THE BESIEGED TERRITORY THE WORK IS COORDINATED THROUGH A HIGHER AGRICULTURAL EMERGENCY COMMITTEE, WHICH IS THE BODY TO ADDRESS THERE RATHER THAN INDIVIDUAL AGENCIES.

trackers.name: Farmers' union with branches in every governorate — a registered federation of sixteen associations, and the market route for produce
trackers.desc: THIS FILE KEEPS RETURNING TO ONE FINDING: THE UNIT THAT GETS INCLUDED IS THE ONE THAT ALREADY EXISTS. HERE IS A FEDERATION A FARMER CAN JOIN — SIXTEEN AGRICULTURAL ASSOCIATIONS UNDER ONE UNION, WITH BRANCHES IN ALL THE GOVERNORATES, FOUNDED IN 1993 AND RE-ESTABLISHED IN 2004 WITH AN INTERIOR MINISTRY REGISTRATION NUMBER. THE REGISTRATION NUMBER MATTERS AS MUCH AS THE BRANCHES. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED IN SEVERAL COUNTRIES THAT UNREGISTERED GROUPS CANNOT SIGN, CANNOT HOLD FUNDS AND CANNOT BE NAMED AS PROJECT PARTNERS. A REGISTERED UNION WITH A PRESENCE IN EVERY GOVERNORATE IS A READY-MADE LEGAL PERSONALITY STANDING BEHIND A VILLAGE THAT HAS NONE. ITS STATED PURPOSES ARE BUILDING THE CAPACITIES OF FARMERS' ORGANISATIONS AND CREATING SUSTAINABLE AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT TO LAY THE FOUNDATIONS OF MODERN AGRICULTURAL INSTITUTIONS. SO A GROUP OF GROWERS ASKING FOR HELP TO CONSTITUTE ITSELF PROPERLY IS ASKING FOR THE THING THE UNION EXISTS TO DO — WHICH IS AN EASIER REQUEST THAN ASKING IT TO FIGHT SOMETHING. IT ALSO SITS INSIDE A KNOWN LANDSCAPE: THE UNION IS ONE OF SOME TWENTY-FOUR ORGANISATIONS WORKING IN THE AGRICULTURAL SECTOR. THAT NUMBER IS USEFUL IN ITSELF — IF ONE BODY WILL NOT TAKE A CASE, THERE ARE TWO DOZEN DOORS, AND THIS FILE HAS ALREADY RECORDED THE AGRICULTURAL WORK COMMITTEES UNION, THE AGRICULTURAL RELIEF ORGANISATION AND THE RESEARCH INSTITUTES SEPARATELY. THE SECOND HALF OF THIS ENTRY IS ABOUT MONEY, BECAUSE INCOME IS WHAT KEEPS PEOPLE ON LAND. A JOINT INITIATIVE OF THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY AND AN INTERNATIONAL DONOR CREATED A LOCAL MARKET TO DISPLAY, PROMOTE AND MARKET DOMESTIC AGRICULTURAL PRODUCE TO THE DOMESTIC PUBLIC — LAUNCHED WITH TWENTY-EIGHT FARMERS IN A PUBLIC PARK, UNDER A BUY-LOCAL CAMPAIGN, WITH FRESH AND ORGANIC FRUIT, VEGETABLES, DAIRY AND PRESERVES. AND NOTE WHO WAS SELLING: A LARGE PART OF THE PARTICIPATING FARMERS LIVE IN THE AREA WHERE THEY FACE WATER SHORTAGES, DIFFICULTY REACHING THEIR LAND, AND SETTLER ATTACKS. THE MARKET WAS DELIBERATELY BUILT AROUND FARMERS UNDER EXACTLY THAT PRESSURE. SO A COMMUNITY IN THAT POSITION IS NOT ASKING FOR AN EXCEPTION WHEN IT ASKS FOR A MARKET STALL, TRANSPORT OR A PLACE IN A BUY-LOCAL CAMPAIGN — IT IS THE INTENDED BENEFICIARY OF A ROUTE THAT ALREADY RUNS. AND A FARMER WHO CAN SELL AT A FAIR PRICE CAN AFFORD THE DAYS OF UNPAID WORK THAT DEFENDING LAND ACTUALLY TAKES, WHICH IS A CONNECTION THIS FILE HAS MADE IN SIX OTHER COUNTRIES. ASK THE UNION BRANCH IN YOUR GOVERNORATE TWO THINGS: WHICH OF ITS SIXTEEN ASSOCIATIONS COVERS YOUR CROP OR YOUR AREA, AND WHICH DONOR-FUNDED PROJECTS ARE CURRENTLY OPERATING THERE. BOTH ARE ANSWERABLE FROM ITS OWN RECORDS. THE LIMITS: this is A SECTORAL MEMBERSHIP FEDERATION, NOT A LITIGATOR OR A LAND-PURCHASE BODY — it builds capacity, represents and markets; IT WILL NOT FIGHT A CONFISCATION IN COURT. THE ENTRY IS ANCHORED TO AN ENCYCLOPAEDIA RECORD RATHER THAN THE UNION'S OWN SITE, and its current membership, branch activity and capacity WERE NOT VERIFIED. THE MARKET INITIATIVE DESCRIBED DATES FROM SEVERAL YEARS AGO and whether it still runs was not established. Access, permits and movement restrictions govern what is possible where, and conditions differ completely between areas. Read it with the agricultural work committees union, the agricultural relief organisation, the applied research institute and the university testing institute recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Land seizure monitoring service — every order published with its number, area, locality and map, and the reason residents are not told
trackers.desc: THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT THING THIS SERVICE RECORDS IS NOT A CASE BUT A PROCEDURE: SEIZURE ORDERS ARE NOT COMMUNICATED DIRECTLY TO THE AFFECTED RESIDENTS, SO THAT THEY CANNOT OBJECT AND STOP THE PROCESS. THEY ARE DISTRIBUTED INSTEAD TO ADMINISTRATIVE AND SETTLEMENT BODIES — AN INFRASTRUCTURE BRANCH OFFICE, A RESPONSIBLE OFFICER, REGIONAL COUNCIL OFFICES, AND THE LOCAL COMMITTEE OF EACH SITE TARGETED FOR EXPANSION. IF NOTICE NEVER ARRIVES, WAITING FOR IT IS THE MISTAKE. THIS FILE HAS SAID IN A DOZEN COUNTRIES THAT COMMUNITIES LOSE BECAUSE THEY LEARN TOO LATE; HERE LATENESS IS BUILT INTO THE METHOD, AND THE ONLY ANSWER IS TO WATCH A SOURCE THAT PUBLISHES THE ORDERS INDEPENDENTLY. THIS IS THAT SOURCE. IT PUBLISHES SEIZURES CASE BY CASE, EACH WITH THE DATE, THE ORDER'S NUMBER AND TITLE, THE AREA IN DUNAMS, THE VILLAGE OR GOVERNORATE, THE STATED PURPOSE AND AN ATTACHED MAP — FROM SEVEN AND A FIFTH DUNAMS IN ONE CITY TO THREE HUNDRED DUNAMS AROUND A NAMED HILL, AND ONE GOVERNORATE WITH ONE HUNDRED AND EIGHTEEN THOUSAND DUNAMS THREATENED WITH ISOLATION. AN ORDER NUMBER IS WHAT MAKES A CHALLENGE POSSIBLE. A LAWYER CANNOT ACT ON A RUMOUR THAT LAND IS BEING TAKEN; THEY CAN ACT ON A NUMBERED, DATED INSTRUMENT COVERING A DEFINED AREA — SO CHECK THIS SERVICE FOR YOUR OWN LOCALITY BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE, AND TAKE THE REPORT AND ITS MAP TO WHOEVER ADVISES YOU. ONE OPERATIONAL DETAIL DESERVES ITS OWN WARNING: SOME ORDERS REQUIRE THE REMOVAL OF ALL PLANTS AND TREES FROM THE TARGETED LAND WITHIN SEVEN DAYS OF TAKING EFFECT. SEVEN DAYS IS SHORTER THAN ANY LEGAL PROCESS IN THIS FILE. IT MEANS THE VEGETATION EVIDENCE — THE OLIVES, THE TERRACES, THE GRAZING — CAN BE GONE BEFORE A CASE BEGINS, WHICH IS WHY DATED PHOTOGRAPHS, SPECIES RECORDS AND TREE COUNTS TAKEN NOW, BEFORE ANY ORDER EXISTS, ARE WORTH MORE HERE THAN ANYWHERE ELSE THIS FILE COVERS. AND DO NOT BE REASSURED BY AN EXPIRY DATE. TEMPORARY SEIZURE ORDERS CARRY AN END DATE, BUT THE RECORD SHOWS THEY ARE USUALLY RENEWED AUTOMATICALLY — SO A TEMPORARY TAKING SHOULD BE TREATED AS PERMANENT UNTIL PROVED OTHERWISE, AND THE RENEWAL DATE ITSELF DIARISED. THE SERVICE ALSO TRACKS THE AGGREGATE PICTURE, WHICH MATTERS FOR ANYONE ARGUING PATTERN RATHER THAN INCIDENT: ONE SET OF ORDERS EXCLUDED THIRTEEN THOUSAND THREE HUNDRED AND SEVENTY DUNAMS FROM NINE SITES WHILE ADDING SEVENTEEN THOUSAND THREE HUNDRED AND SEVENTY DUNAMS AROUND SEVENTEEN OTHERS. THAT KIND OF PAIRED FIGURE IS THE EVIDENCE A JOURNALIST OR AN INTERNATIONAL BODY CAN USE WHEN A SINGLE VILLAGE'S LOSS CANNOT CARRY THE ARGUMENT — AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED SEPARATELY THAT A RECORD WHICH LEAVES THE COUNTRY IS HARDER TO ERASE. THE LIMITS: this is A MONITORING AND DOCUMENTATION SERVICE, NOT A LAWYER, A FUNDER OR AN ADVOCATE — IT RECORDS WHAT HAS HAPPENED AND CANNOT STOP IT, and publication has not prevented the seizures it documents. IT IS PRODUCED BY PALESTINIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTIONS AND WRITTEN FROM THAT PERSPECTIVE; the orders it describes are Israeli military instruments whose text a reader should obtain and verify independently before relying on any detail. COVERAGE DEPENDS ON WHAT REACHES THE MONITORS, so absence from the site is not proof that no order exists. Read it with the applied research institute, the land research centre, the agricultural work committees union and the agricultural relief organisation recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Development and training centre — capacity building for grassroots groups, four branch offices, and a five-partner agricultural programme running to 2029
trackers.desc: THE GOAL TO READ FIRST IS THE SECOND ONE ON THIS ORGANISATION'S OWN LIST: TO DEVELOP AND ENHANCE THE CAPACITIES OF NON-GOVERNMENTAL, COMMUNITY-BASED AND GRASSROOTS ORGANISATIONS SO THEY CAN FULFIL THEIR MISSIONS — WORKING HAND IN HAND WITH GRASSROOTS GROUPS AND COMMITTEES IN THE POOREST AND MOST MARGINALISED AREAS, GUIDED BY COMMUNITY PARTICIPATION AND THE INVESTMENT OF LOCAL RESOURCES. A BODY WHOSE STATED PURPOSE INCLUDES MAKING SMALL GROUPS CAPABLE IS THE ONE TO APPROACH BEFORE ANY FUNDER. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED IN A DOZEN COUNTRIES THAT GRANTS REQUIRE REGISTRATION, ACCOUNTS AND REPORTING THAT A VILLAGE COMMITTEE DOES NOT HAVE — CAPACITY BUILDING IS THE NAME OF THE HELP THAT CLOSES THAT GAP. IT IS AN INDEPENDENT DEVELOPMENT AND TRAINING INSTITUTION ESTABLISHED IN JANUARY 1989 AND REGISTERED AS A NON-PROFIT, WITH A MAIN OFFICE AND FOUR BRANCH OFFICES — TWO IN THE BESIEGED TERRITORY AND TWO IN THE NORTH — WHICH MATTERS IN A PLACE WHERE MOVEMENT BETWEEN AREAS IS THE BINDING CONSTRAINT ON EVERY ORGANISATION. ITS PROGRAMMES COVER WOMEN'S DEVELOPMENT, AGRICULTURAL AND FOOD SECURITY, COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT, YOUTH, AN ENVIRONMENT PROTECTION PROGRAMME, AND CAPACITY BUILDING — SO A REQUEST CAN BE FRAMED THROUGH WHICHEVER PROGRAMME FITS RATHER THAN FORCED INTO AN ENVIRONMENTAL ONE. THE BIGGEST THING TO KNOW ABOUT IS A PROGRAMME THAT RUNS UNTIL 2029. LAUNCHED BY THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY WITH FOREIGN CONSULATE FUNDING, IT IS IMPLEMENTED BY FIVE MAIN PARTNERS — THIS CENTRE, A HYDROLOGY GROUP, A LAND RESEARCH CENTRE, AN APPLIED RESEARCH INSTITUTE AND AN INTERNATIONAL COOPERATIVE BODY — IN PARTNERSHIP WITH THE MINISTRY, AND FOCUSES ON DEVELOPING AGRICULTURAL INFRASTRUCTURE AND STRENGTHENING SUSTAINABLE FOOD SYSTEMS ACROSS SEVERAL GOVERNORATES. A PROGRAMME WITH THREE YEARS LEFT TO RUN IS THE OPPOSITE OF THE CLOSED CALLS THIS FILE KEEPS RECORDING. ASK WHICH GOVERNORATES AND WHICH VILLAGES ARE INSIDE IT, AND WHETHER THE LIST IS FIXED OR STILL BEING BUILT — MULTI-YEAR PROGRAMMES ADD COMMUNITIES AS THEY GO. AND NOTE WHO THE FIVE PARTNERS ARE, BECAUSE THIS FILE HAS RECORDED FOUR OF THEM SEPARATELY: THE HYDROLOGY GROUP, THE LAND RESEARCH CENTRE AND THE APPLIED RESEARCH INSTITUTE ALL APPEAR ELSEWHERE IN THIS PAYLOAD AS EVIDENCE AND MAPPING BODIES. ONE APPROACH REACHES A CONSORTIUM THAT HOLDS WATER DATA, LAND DOCUMENTATION AND RESEARCH CAPACITY AT ONCE. ONE FINANCIAL DETAIL IS WORTH COPYING RATHER THAN JUST NOTING: THE CENTRE DEPENDS NOT ONLY ON DONOR FUNDING BUT ON THE REVENUES OF ITS OWN COURSES, PUBLICATIONS AND CONSULTANCIES. EARNED INCOME IS WHAT LETS AN ORGANISATION SURVIVE A FUNDING GAP, AND IT IS THE MODEL A COMMUNITY GROUP SHOULD ASK ABOUT WHEN IT IS BEING HELPED TO BECOME CAPABLE — TRAINING, PUBLICATIONS AND ADVICE ARE THINGS A LOCAL COMMITTEE CAN EVENTUALLY SELL TOO. THE LIMITS: this is A DEVELOPMENT AND TRAINING ORGANISATION, NOT A LITIGATOR OR A LAND-PURCHASE BODY — IT BUILDS CAPACITY AND INFRASTRUCTURE, IT DOES NOT FIGHT CONFISCATIONS IN COURT. ITS WORK AND ITS PARTNERS ARE POLITICALLY CONTESTED: SOME PARTNER ORGANISATIONS IN THIS SECTOR HAVE BEEN THE SUBJECT OF DONOR INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT DESIGNATIONS, AND ASSOCIATION CARRIES CONSEQUENCES A COMMUNITY SHOULD WEIGH FOR ITSELF. PROGRAMME DETAIL COMES FROM THE CENTRE'S OWN ANNOUNCEMENTS AND PARTNER DIRECTORIES; branch offices and programme lists were not confirmed as current, AND ACCESS, PERMITS AND MOVEMENT RESTRICTIONS GOVERN WHAT IS POSSIBLE WHERE. Read it with the agricultural relief organisation and the ministry's weekly bulletin, the farmers' union, the land seizure monitoring service and the applied research institute recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Water authority licensing — wells, rehabilitation and drilling contractors, a fourteen-day study period, and the four-year abandonment rule
trackers.desc: ONE DEFINITION IN THIS SYSTEM DESERVES TO BE KNOWN BY EVERY FAMILY THAT HAS BEEN KEPT OFF ITS LAND: AN ABANDONED WELL IS ONE FROM WHICH GROUNDWATER HAS NOT BEEN EXTRACTED FOR FOUR CONSECUTIVE YEARS OR MORE. FOUR YEARS OF NOT PUMPING CAN THEREFORE CHANGE WHAT YOUR WELL IS CALLED. FOR HOUSEHOLDS BLOCKED FROM THEIR LAND BY ACCESS RESTRICTIONS, DISPLACEMENT OR DAMAGE, THAT IS A CLOCK RUNNING QUIETLY — SO RECORD EVERY EXTRACTION YOU DO MANAGE, KEEP DATED EVIDENCE OF USE, AND ASK THE AUTHORITY IN WRITING HOW INTERRUPTED USE IS TREATED BEFORE THE FOURTH YEAR PASSES. THE AUTHORITY ITSELF ISSUES WRITTEN PERMISSION FOR ANY NATURAL OR LEGAL PERSON TO DRILL A WELL, TO REHABILITATE ONE, TO EXTRACT GROUNDWATER, OR TO OPERATE AS A WELL-DRILLING CONTRACTOR. THAT LAST CATEGORY IS THE CHEAP CHECK NOBODY MAKES: DRILLING CONTRACTORS THEMSELVES REQUIRE A LICENCE. BEFORE PAYING ANYONE TO SINK A WELL, ASK FOR THEIR CONTRACTOR LICENCE — AN UNLICENSED DRILLER CAN LEAVE A FAMILY WITH AN UNLICENSABLE HOLE AND NO RECOURSE, AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED THE SAME PATTERN WITH UNLICENSED SURVEYORS AND ENGINEERS ELSEWHERE. THE DOCUMENTS REQUIRED ARE WORTH ASSEMBLING EARLY BECAUSE TWO OF THEM ARE USEFUL WHATEVER HAPPENS TO THE APPLICATION: A SURVEY PLAN APPROVED BY A LICENSED SURVEYOR SHOWING THE COORDINATES OF THE PROPOSED WELL — AND OF THE EXISTING WELL WHERE THE APPLICATION IS FOR A REPLACEMENT — AND A HYDROGEOLOGICAL STUDY CERTIFIED BY THE GEOLOGISTS' SYNDICATE. A COORDINATE PLAN AND A CERTIFIED HYDROGEOLOGICAL STUDY ARE EXACTLY THE EVIDENCE THIS FILE HAS BEEN TELLING COMMUNITIES TO OBTAIN: ONE FIXES WHERE THE WATER POINT IS BEYOND ARGUMENT, THE OTHER SAYS WHAT THE AQUIFER BENEATH IT IS DOING. BOTH OUTLIVE THE LICENCE DECISION. THE SYNDICATE CERTIFICATION IS ALSO A ROUTE TO A QUALIFIED PERSON: IF THE STUDY MUST BE CERTIFIED BY THE GEOLOGISTS' SYNDICATE, THE SYNDICATE IS WHERE TO ASK WHICH OF ITS MEMBERS DO THIS WORK. THERE IS A TIMETABLE TO HOLD THEM TO: THE AUTHORITY STUDIES THE APPLICATION AGAINST HYDROLOGICAL, HYDROGEOLOGICAL OR ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS WITHIN FOURTEEN DAYS OF RECEIVING IT. FOURTEEN DAYS IS SHORT AND MEASURABLE. LODGE THE APPLICATION WITH A DATED RECEIPT, AND IF NOTHING COMES BACK, THE MISSED PERIOD IS ITSELF THE SUBJECT OF THE NEXT LETTER — A COMPLAINT ABOUT A BROKEN DEADLINE IS EASIER TO PRESS THAN A COMPLAINT ABOUT A DECISION. AND NOTE WHAT REHABILITATION MEANS HERE: LICENSING COVERS NOT ONLY NEW WELLS BUT THE REPAIR AND CLEANING OF EXISTING ONES. A DISUSED WELL IS OFTEN CHEAPER TO BRING BACK THAN A NEW ONE IS TO SINK, AND IT ARRIVES WITH A HISTORY OF USE ATTACHED TO IT. THE LIMITS: this is A REGULATOR ISSUING PERMISSIONS, NOT A FUNDER OR AN ADVOCATE — IT WILL NOT PAY FOR A WELL AND WILL NOT DEFEND ONE. ITS WRIT DOES NOT REACH EVERYWHERE: IN AREAS UNDER OTHER CONTROL, DRILLING PERMISSION IS DECIDED BY A DIFFERENT AUTHORITY ENTIRELY AND A PALESTINIAN LICENCE MAY NOT PROTECT THE WELL - which is the central obstacle this entry cannot solve. APPLICANTS MUST BE PALESTINIAN. THE PROCEDURE AND DEFINITIONS COME FROM PUBLISHED REGULATIONS OF 2020 AND THEIR IMPLEMENTING INSTRUCTIONS, DESCRIBING WHAT THE AUTHORITY DOES RATHER THAN ANY ENTITLEMENT, and current forms, fees and processing reality were not verified. Read it with the agricultural relief organisation's well work, the land seizure monitoring service, the development and training centre and the farmers' union recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Risk mitigation and agricultural insurance fund — the governorate damage assessment committees, the political-crisis clause, and its record of not paying
trackers.desc: THE USABLE PART FIRST: THE FUND PUBLISHES THE NUMBERS OF THE DAMAGE ASSESSMENT COMMITTEES FOR FARMERS IN THE GOVERNORATES. A PUBLISHED COMMITTEE NUMBER IS WHAT TURNS A LOSS INTO A FILE. THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED IN SEVERAL COUNTRIES THAT COMPENSATION FOLLOWS ASSESSMENT AND ASSESSMENT FOLLOWS A CALL MADE WHILE THE DAMAGE IS STILL VISIBLE — SO THE NUMBER FOR YOUR OWN GOVERNORATE IS WORTH SAVING BEFORE THE FROST, NOT AFTER IT. THE FUND ITSELF WAS ESTABLISHED BY A DECREE-LAW OF 2013, SPECIALISED IN COMPENSATION FOR NATURAL DISASTERS AND IN AGRICULTURAL INSURANCE IN ALL ITS FORMS, WITH AN INDEPENDENT FINANCIAL PERSONALITY AND ANNUAL OPERATING AND DEVELOPMENT ALLOCATIONS IN THE STATE BUDGET. ONE CLAUSE IN ITS LAW HAS NO EQUIVALENT ANYWHERE ELSE IN THIS FILE: THE DETERMINATION OF AGRICULTURAL LOSSES RESULTING FROM POLITICAL CRISES, THE MECHANISM FOR DISBURSEMENT AND THE RATE OF COMPENSATION ARE AGREED BETWEEN THE FUND AND THE GOVERNMENT. EVERY OTHER AGRICULTURAL SCHEME THIS FILE HAS RECORDED COVERS HAIL, FROST AND DROUGHT AND EXCLUDES EVERYTHING HUMAN. HERE LOSSES FROM POLITICAL CRISIS ARE INSIDE THE FRAME, WHICH IS THE CATEGORY MOST FARMERS IN THIS TERRITORY ACTUALLY SUFFER — SO WHEN LOSSES ARE DOCUMENTED, THEY SHOULD BE DOCUMENTED IN THAT LANGUAGE AND SUBMITTED, EVEN WHERE PAYMENT IS UNCERTAIN. AND ANY AGRICULTURAL COMPENSATION THE GOVERNMENT DECIDES OUTSIDE ITS STATUTORY CONTRIBUTION IS DISBURSED THROUGH THIS FUND UNDER ITS MECHANISMS — SO IT IS THE CHANNEL THROUGH WHICH DONOR OR EMERGENCY MONEY FOR FARMERS IS SUPPOSED TO FLOW, WHICH IS A REASON TO BE REGISTERED WITH IT BEFORE ANY SUCH ROUND OPENS. NOW THE PART THAT MATTERS MORE THAN THE STRUCTURE, BECAUSE THIS FILE RECORDS RESOURCES HONESTLY: THE FUND HAS A DOCUMENTED RECORD OF NOT PAYING. REPORTING DESCRIBES FARMERS WAITING YEARS FOR IT TO BE ACTIVATED, THE FUND COUNTING LOSSES SINCE ITS ESTABLISHMENT WITHOUT COMPENSATING THEM, AND THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY ANSWERING THAT THE MONEY WAS NOT AVAILABLE. ONE FROST WAVE WHOSE LOSSES IN A SINGLE GOVERNORATE WERE OFFICIALLY ESTIMATED AT ABOUT FORTY-FIVE MILLION SHEKELS WAS MET WITH NYLON SHEETING INSTEAD OF THE PLASTIC HOUSES THAT HAD BEEN DESTROYED, AND ONE FARMER RECORDED THAT HIS LAST CASH COMPENSATION HAD BEEN YEARS EARLIER. SO USE THE COMMITTEE, BUT DO NOT PLAN AROUND THE PAYMENT. FILE THE ASSESSMENT BECAUSE IT COSTS A PHONE CALL AND BECAUSE AN OFFICIAL DAMAGE RECORD IS EVIDENCE THAT OUTLIVES THE SEASON — THIS FILE HAS RECORDED ASSESSMENTS BEING USED YEARS LATER BY DONORS, COURTS AND SUCCESSOR PROGRAMMES — BUT SEEK THE ACTUAL RELIEF FROM THE AGRICULTURAL RELIEF ORGANISATION, THE UNION AND THE EMERGENCY PROGRAMMES RECORDED SEPARATELY IN THIS PAYLOAD. AND IF YOU ARE ORGANISING RATHER THAN CLAIMING, THE FUND'S OWN LAW IS THE LEVER: IT REQUIRES A CABINET-ISSUED REGULATION SETTING THE CROPS SUBJECT TO COMPULSORY INSURANCE, THE INSURED PERILS, THE PREMIUMS, THE BASES FOR CALCULATING COMPENSATION AND THE BASES FOR VALUING CROPS. ASKING WHETHER THAT REGULATION EXISTS, AND WHAT IT SAYS ABOUT VALUING CROPS, IS A SHARPER QUESTION THAN ASKING WHY NOBODY WAS PAID — BECAUSE THE VALUATION BASIS IS WHERE COMPENSATION IS QUIETLY SET AT A FRACTION OF THE LOSS. THE LIMITS: THIS IS RECORDED AS AN ASSESSMENT AND FILING ROUTE, NOT AS A SOURCE OF MONEY - THE PUBLISHED RECORD SHOWS LOSSES COUNTED AND COMPENSATION NOT PAID, AND A FAMILY THAT DELAYS OTHER HELP WHILE WAITING WOULD BE WORSE OFF FOR IT. THE FUND OPERATES IN A TERRITORY UNDER OCCUPATION AND FISCAL CRISIS, WHERE ITS BUDGET DEPENDS ON REVENUES THAT ARE THEMSELVES WITHHELD. THE COMMITTEE NUMBERS COME FROM A NEWS SITE REPUBLISHING THE FUND'S ANNOUNCEMENT AND THE CRITICAL ACCOUNT FROM A NEWS AGENCY REPORT THAT IS SEVERAL YEARS OLD - the current position may be better or worse, and the fund's own current publications should be checked. Read it with the agricultural relief organisation and the ministry's weekly bulletin, the farmers' union, the land seizure monitoring service and the water authority's licensing recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Franklinia Foundation — grants for saving particular threatened trees, up to three years, in the Mediterranean basin and beyond
trackers.desc: THIS FOUNDATION PAYS FOR ONE THING AND PAYS FOR IT PROPERLY: IN SITU CONSERVATION OF GLOBALLY THREATENED TREE SPECIES, THROUGH CONCRETE ON-THE-GROUND ACTIONS TACKLING THE PRIMARY THREATS, RUNNING UP TO THREE YEARS. THREE YEARS IS LONG ENOUGH TO MATTER. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED GRANT AFTER GRANT LASTING ONE SEASON, WHICH IS TOO SHORT TO FENCE A STAND, RAISE SEEDLINGS FROM ITS OWN SEED AND SEE THEM SURVIVE A SUMMER — THE ACTUAL WORK OF SAVING A TREE POPULATION. THE ELIGIBILITY TEST IS SPECIES-BASED AND SHOULD BE CHECKED BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE: ONLY PROJECTS AIMING TO IMPROVE THE CONSERVATION STATUS OF TREE SPECIES LISTED AS VULNERABLE, ENDANGERED OR CRITICALLY ENDANGERED ON THE INTERNATIONAL RED LIST QUALIFY, WITH PRIORITY TO THE TWO HIGHEST CATEGORIES. SO THE FIRST TASK IS TO FIND OUT WHAT GROWS ON THE THREATENED GROUND AND WHAT ITS GLOBAL STATUS IS. AND THERE IS A DOOR FOR UNSTUDIED PLACES: WHERE A SPECIES IS THREATENED BUT ITS ASSESSMENT IS NOT YET PUBLISHED, DETAILED INFORMATION JUSTIFYING THAT STATUS MUST BE PROVIDED — WHICH MEANS A LOCAL BOTANIST'S EVIDENCE CAN SUBSTITUTE FOR A PUBLISHED LISTING. WHO MAY APPLY IS THE MAIN LIMIT, AND IT IS STRICT: ANY ORGANISATION WITH WELL-ESTABLISHED EXPERTISE AND EFFICIENCY IN PLANT CONSERVATION — INDIVIDUALS ARE NOT ELIGIBLE, AND NO MORE THAN ONE PROJECT MAY BE SUBMITTED PER ORGANISATION PER CALL. SO A VILLAGE GROUP APPLIES THROUGH A BOTANICAL PARTNER RATHER THAN ALONE — AND THAT IS ALSO WHAT THE FOUNDATION WANTS: PROJECTS WHERE CONSERVATION ORGANISATIONS COLLABORATE WITH AND BENEFIT FROM THE EXPERTISE OF BOTANISTS AND BOTANICAL GARDENS ARE EXPRESSLY FAVOURED. THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS BOTANICAL INSTITUTES, HERBARIA AND UNIVERSITY BOTANY DEPARTMENTS IN SEVERAL COUNTRIES OF THIS REGION. THIS IS THE MONEY THAT GIVES THEM A REASON TO WORK ON YOUR HILLSIDE RATHER THAN SOMEBODY ELSE'S. BUDGET FOR THE MATCH BEFORE WRITING: A MINIMUM OF TWENTY TO FIFTY PER CENT CO-FUNDING IS REQUIRED, AND THE FOUNDATION FAVOURS REASONABLE BUDGETS IN RELATION TO THE ACTIVITIES PROPOSED. THE GEOGRAPHIC PREFERENCE FAVOURS EXACTLY THE PLACES THIS FILE COVERS: IT CAN FUND PROJECTS ALL OVER THE WORLD BUT FAVOURS AREAS WITH HIGH BIOLOGICAL DIVERSITY AND AREAS WHERE NEEDS ARE IMPORTANT AND FUNDING OPPORTUNITIES ARE LIMITED — AND A CALL FOR THE MEDITERRANEAN BASIN CLOSED IN MARCH 2026, WITH PARTNER PROGRAMMES ELSEWHERE RUNNING GRANTS FROM FIFTY TO TWO HUNDRED THOUSAND DOLLARS. ONE MORE PREFERENCE IS WORTH BUILDING INTO A PROPOSAL: PROJECTS SHOULD SUPPORT EXISTING THREATENED TREE SPECIES CONSERVATION ACTION PLANS, FOREST LANDSCAPE STRATEGIES OR CONSERVATION ACTIONS IN KEY BIODIVERSITY AREAS WHERE TREE SPECIES ARE TRIGGER SPECIES, AND MUST SHOW A WILLINGNESS TO COLLABORATE, SHARE LESSONS AND DATA, AND CONTRIBUTE TO COORDINATION AT NATIONAL LEVEL. THAT LAST REQUIREMENT IS AN OPPORTUNITY DISGUISED AS AN OBLIGATION. A PROJECT THAT PUBLISHES ITS DATA CREATES A PERMANENT PUBLIC RECORD OF WHAT GREW ON THAT GROUND AND IN WHAT NUMBERS — WHICH IS EXACTLY THE EVIDENCE A COMMUNITY NEEDS WHEN THE SAME GROUND IS PROPOSED FOR CLEARANCE YEARS LATER. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A SPECIES FUND, NOT A LAND FUND OR A CAMPAIGN FUND - IT WILL NOT BUY GROUND, PAY LAWYERS OR OPPOSE A PROJECT, AND IF NOTHING ON YOUR GROUND IS A GLOBALLY THREATENED TREE THERE IS NOTHING TO APPLY FOR. INDIVIDUALS CANNOT APPLY AT ALL, AND UNREGISTERED COMMUNITY GROUPS ARE UNLIKELY TO MEET THE WELL-ESTABLISHED EXPERTISE TEST WITHOUT A PARTNER. THE CO-FUNDING REQUIREMENT EXCLUDES THE POOREST APPLICANTS UNLESS A PARTNER CARRIES IT. CALL DEADLINES AND REGIONAL WINDOWS CHANGE EACH YEAR AND THE MEDITERRANEAN ONE CITED HERE HAS CLOSED - CHECK THE FOUNDATION'S OWN CALL PAGE FOR WHAT IS OPEN NOW. SEVERAL DETAILS COME FROM GRANT-AGGREGATOR LISTINGS OF DIFFERENT YEARS RATHER THAN THE FOUNDATION'S CURRENT TEXT. Read it with the agricultural relief organisation, the risk mitigation fund's damage committees, the land research and monitoring bodies and the water authority's licensing recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Community foundation with community-led grants — money decided by the people who live there, and a diaspora giving arm
trackers.desc: ALMOST EVERY FUNDER IN THIS FILE DECIDES ELSEWHERE WHAT A COMMUNITY NEEDS. THIS ONE INVERTS THAT: ITS METHOD IS COMMUNITY-LED GRANTS, SUPPORTING CREATIVE AND APPROPRIATE CIVIL SOCIETY INITIATIVES — PARTICULARLY THE EFFORTS OF LOCAL COMMUNITIES TO USE AND BENEFIT FROM THE RESOURCES AVAILABLE TO THEM. THE RESOURCES AVAILABLE TO THEM IS THE PHRASE THAT MATTERS FOR LAND. IT MEANS THE GRANT IS FOR MAKING SOMETHING OF WHAT YOU ALREADY HAVE — THE SPRING, THE TERRACES, THE OLIVES, THE STONE — WHICH IS ALSO THE STRONGEST ARGUMENT AGAINST LOSING IT. ITS PRINCIPLE IS STATED IN A SENTENCE WORTH QUOTING BACK IN ANY APPLICATION: MOBILISING AND USING ALL NECESSARY LOCAL RESOURCES, MATERIAL AND NON-MATERIAL, TO EMPOWER AND CREATE AN INDEPENDENT, RESPONSIBLE CIVIL SOCIETY IN WHICH TRANSPARENCY AND ACCOUNTABILITY PREVAIL — PROCEEDING FROM BELIEF IN THE PEOPLE'S RIGHT TO CONTROL THEIR OWN RESOURCES IN ORDER TO ACHIEVE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT. NON-MATERIAL RESOURCES ARE COUNTED HERE, WHICH IS RARE. LABOUR, KNOWLEDGE, LAND ACCESS, A HALL, A TRACTOR AND A FAMILY'S TIME ARE ALL CONTRIBUTIONS — AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED FUND AFTER FUND WHOSE MATCHING REQUIREMENT EXCLUDES THE POOR BECAUSE IT COUNTS ONLY CASH. THE ENVIRONMENT IS ONE OF ITS FOUR NAMED AREAS, ALONGSIDE THE LOCAL ECONOMY, THE SOCIAL AND THE CULTURAL — SO A PROPOSAL ABOUT WATER, TREES, WASTE OR GRAZING SITS INSIDE ITS STATED PURPOSE RATHER THAN AT ITS EDGE. AND IT HAS A SECOND FUNCTION MOST FOUNDATIONS LACK: IT AIMS TO STRENGTHEN COMMUNITY GIVING BOTH INSIDE THE COUNTRY AND IN THE DIASPORA, ON THE VIEW THAT EVERY INDIVIDUAL HAS SOMETHING TO OFFER THROUGH THEIR TALENTS, RESOURCES AND ENERGIES. THAT IS THE ROUTE TO MONEY THAT DOES NOT COME WITH A FOREIGN DONOR'S CONDITIONS. A VILLAGE WITH RELATIVES ABROAD HAS A FUNDING BASE ALREADY, AND A FOUNDATION THAT ORGANISES DIASPORA GIVING IS THE STRUCTURE THAT TURNS SCATTERED REMITTANCES INTO A PROJECT WITH ACCOUNTS. ITS OWN ORIGIN IS WORTH KNOWING BECAUSE IT SHOWS THE MODEL IS DELIBERATE: FOUNDED IN 2006 THROUGH FOUNDING MEETINGS IN JERICHO AND RAMALLAH, AND NAMED WITH THE WORD FOR A GRAPEVINE — CHOSEN BECAUSE MOST HOUSES HAVE ONE AND, IF YOU CARE FOR IT, IT FEEDS AND SHELTERS YOU. TWO OTHER ROUTES SURFACED ALONGSIDE IT AND ARE WORTH ASKING ABOUT IN THE SAME WEEK: A DEVELOPMENT CENTRE FOR CIVIL ORGANISATIONS OFFERING INSTITUTIONAL FUNDING, COMMUNITY INITIATIVE GRANTS AND EMERGENCY GRANTS FOR URGENT NEEDS; AND A LEGAL AID CENTRE THAT HAS FUNDED A LOCAL GRASSROOTS ORGANISATION TO BUILD ITS FINANCIAL AND ADMINISTRATIVE CAPACITY AND LEAD ADVOCACY CAMPAIGNS ON THE RIGHT TO DEVELOPMENT ACROSS THIRTEEN NAMED COMMUNITIES IN FOUR GOVERNORATES. THAT LAST ONE IS THE SHAPE TO ASK FOR IF YOUR PROBLEM IS ORGANISATIONAL RATHER THAN MATERIAL: A GRANT WHOSE PURPOSE IS TO MAKE A SMALL LOCAL BODY ABLE TO MANAGE MONEY AND RUN A CAMPAIGN, RATHER THAN TO BUY ANYTHING. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A SMALL COMMUNITY FOUNDATION IN ONE OF THE MOST CONSTRAINED PLACES IN THIS PAYLOAD - ITS GRANTS ARE MODEST, ITS OWN FUNDING DEPENDS ON DONORS AND DIASPORA GIVING, AND IT CANNOT BUY LAND, PAY LITIGATION OR PROTECT ANYONE. WHETHER IT IS CURRENTLY MAKING GRANTS, WHAT THE AMOUNTS AND DEADLINES ARE, AND WHETHER UNREGISTERED VILLAGE GROUPS CAN RECEIVE THEM WERE NOT ESTABLISHED - the description here comes from its own about and homepage text, some of it published in earlier years, not from a current call. MOVEMENT, ACCESS AND BANKING CONSTRAINTS IN THIS TERRITORY AFFECT EVERY TRANSFER, AND THE TWO OTHER ROUTES MENTIONED ARE RECORDED AS LEADS FROM A SINGLE SEARCH RATHER THAN RESEARCHED. Read it with the risk mitigation fund's damage committees, the agricultural relief organisation, the land research bodies and the threatened-tree foundation recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Agricultural engineers' syndicate — branches in every city, laboratory access through a ministry agreement, and a land project framed as consolidating ownership
trackers.desc: THE PREVIOUS ROUND RECORDED A SYNDICATE OF AGRONOMISTS IN A NEIGHBOURING COUNTRY AND NOTED THAT THIS ONE HAD SIGNED A LAND-PROTECTION AGREEMENT. IT IS WORTH RECORDING IN ITS OWN RIGHT, STARTING WITH REACH: A NON-PROFIT PROFESSIONAL SYNDICATE FOUNDED IN 1966 AND RE-ESTABLISHED AS A PALESTINIAN SYNDICATE IN 2010, WHOSE BRANCHES ARE SPREAD ACROSS ALL PALESTINIAN CITIES. BRANCHES IN EVERY CITY MEANS A QUALIFIED AGRONOMIST WITHIN REACH OF ALMOST ANY VILLAGE. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED REPEATEDLY THAT THE SCARCEST RESOURCE IN A LAND DISPUTE IS SOMEBODY LOCAL WHO CAN WRITE A TECHNICAL REPORT. ITS STATED OBJECTIVES REACH BEYOND MEMBERS' INTERESTS: REGULATING THE PRACTICE OF THE PROFESSION; CONTRIBUTING TO THE MAKING OF AGRICULTURAL POLICIES, LAWS AND REGULATIONS; AND CONTRIBUTING TO THE SUPPORT OF RESEARCH AND OF SPECIALISED ASSOCIATIONS IN THE AGRICULTURAL FIELD. CONTRIBUTING TO LAWS AND REGULATIONS IS THE OBJECT TO CITE WHEN A RULE RATHER THAN A SINGLE PROJECT IS THE PROBLEM — IT MAKES A SUBMISSION PART OF THE SYNDICATE'S OWN PURPOSE. THE MOST PRACTICAL THING IT HOLDS IS ACCESS TO EQUIPMENT: A MEMORANDUM WITH THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY COVERS TRAINING AND QUALIFICATION PROGRAMMES, THE EXCHANGE OF TECHNICAL CONSULTATIONS ON AGRICULTURAL ISSUES, AND THE USE OF AVAILABLE CAPACITIES IN CARRYING OUT AGRICULTURAL AND TRAINING ACTIVITIES — HALLS, CENTRES, LABORATORIES AND AGRICULTURAL STATIONS. LABORATORIES AND AGRICULTURAL STATIONS ARE WHERE SOIL, WATER AND PLANT SAMPLES GET TESTED. A COMMUNITY THAT CANNOT AFFORD A COMMERCIAL LAB CAN ASK WHETHER A SYNDICATE MEMBER CAN HAVE SAMPLES RUN UNDER THAT ARRANGEMENT — AND THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED THE COST OF TESTING DEFEATING COMMUNITIES ACROSS THE REGION. ITS STANDING MAKES SUCH ASKS EASIER: THE AGRICULTURE MINISTER HAS DESCRIBED THE SYNDICATE AS THE AUTHENTIC PROFESSIONAL ARM OF THE MINISTRY AND ITS STRATEGIC PARTNER IN SHAPING POLICIES AND LEGISLATION, SPEAKING AT A CEREMONY THAT ALSO INAUGURATED ITS NEW TRAINING HALL. IT IS ALSO BUILDING RESEARCH LINKS: IN JUNE 2026 A DELEGATION FROM ITS JERUSALEM CENTRE, LED BY ITS HEAD AND INCLUDING NAMED ENGINEERS, SIGNED A MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING AND JOINT COOPERATION WITH AN APPLIED RESEARCH INSTITUTE, WITH THE DIRECTOR OF A GOVERNORATE AGRICULTURE DIRECTORATE PRESENT. THAT RESEARCH INSTITUTE IS ALREADY RECORDED SEPARATELY IN THIS PAYLOAD FOR ITS MONITORING OF LAND LOSS. A SYNDICATE WITH BRANCHES EVERYWHERE PLUS AN INSTITUTE THAT DOCUMENTS TAKINGS IS A COMBINATION A VILLAGE CAN ASK BOTH HALVES OF. AND THE SYNDICATE DOES LAND WORK OF ITS OWN. ITS ACTIVITY REPORT DESCRIBES THE LARGEST PROJECT IN ONE GOVERNORATE — EIGHTY-NINE PLOTS OF LAND, OF WHICH EIGHTY-THREE WERE ALLOCATED TO ENGINEERS AND THE REST TO PUBLIC SERVICE AREAS, GREEN SPACES AND ROADS — COMPLETED THROUGH ALL TECHNICAL AND ADMINISTRATIVE STAGES AND ALL FOLLOW-UP WITH THE COMPETENT MINISTRIES TO OBTAIN THE NECESSARY LICENCES. THE FRAMING IS THE INSTRUCTIVE PART: IT IS DESCRIBED AS SUPPORTING SUSTAINABLE URBAN ORGANISATION AND CONTRIBUTING TO THE PROTECTION OF PALESTINIAN LANDS AND THE CONSOLIDATION OF THEIR OWNERSHIP. PLANNING, LICENSING AND REGISTERING LAND IS TREATED HERE AS AN ACT OF PROTECTION — WHICH IS EXACTLY THE ARGUMENT THIS FILE HAS RECORDED WORKING WHERE UNREGISTERED LAND IS THE VULNERABILITY. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A PROFESSIONAL SYNDICATE AND A PARTNER OF THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY - IT SERVES ITS MEMBERS, SHAPES POLICY AND TRAINS, AND WILL NOT LITIGATE FOR A COMMUNITY OR CONFRONT MILITARY OR SETTLEMENT AUTHORITIES ON ITS BEHALF. ITS LAND PROJECT ALLOCATED PLOTS TO ITS OWN MEMBERS, WHICH IS A MEMBERS' BENEFIT SCHEME AS MUCH AS A PROTECTION MEASURE, AND SHOULD NOT BE READ AS A SERVICE OPEN TO OTHERS. WHETHER NON-MEMBERS CAN OBTAIN TECHNICAL REPORTS OR LABORATORY ACCESS, AND AT WHAT COST, WAS NOT ESTABLISHED. ITS REACH IS LIMITED BY THE SAME MOVEMENT AND ACCESS CONSTRAINTS AS EVERYTHING ELSE RECORDED FOR THIS TERRITORY, PARTICULARLY IN AREAS UNDER FULL EXTERNAL CONTROL. THE ACCOUNT COMES FROM AN ENCYCLOPAEDIA ENTRY, THE MINISTRY'S NEWS PAGES, A RESEARCH INSTITUTE'S ANNOUNCEMENT AND THE SYNDICATE'S OWN MONTHLY ACTIVITY REPORT. Read it with the community foundation's community-led grants, the risk mitigation fund's damage committees, the land research bodies and the threatened-tree foundation recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Biodiversity institute and natural history museum — a reserve, a herbarium, molecular and taxonomy laboratories, and thirty community plots
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY HAD NO BODY RECORDED THAT HOLDS OR WORKS GROUND FOR CONSERVATION. THIS ONE DOES, AND IT DOES IT ON VOLUNTEER EFFORT AND LOCAL DONATIONS: AN INSTITUTE FOR BIODIVERSITY AND SUSTAINABILITY ESTABLISHED IN 2014 WITH A UNIVERSITY'S SUPPORT, WITH A MUSEUM OF NATURAL HISTORY, AN ETHNOGRAPHY EXHIBIT, A BOTANIC GARDEN WITH AN INTEGRATED WATER AND LAND ECOSYSTEM, A COMMUNITY GARDEN, AN ANIMAL REHABILITATION CENTRE, A BIODIVERSITY CENTRE, A HERBARIUM, A MOLECULAR LABORATORY AND A TAXONOMY LABORATORY. A HERBARIUM AND A TAXONOMY LABORATORY IN THE SAME BUILDING IS THE COMBINATION THAT ANSWERS WHAT GROWS HERE AND WHY IT MATTERS. THIS FILE HAS SPENT ROUNDS LOOKING FOR PLACES THAT CAN IDENTIFY A PLANT AND PROVE IT WAS THERE — A HERBARIUM IS A DATED, PHYSICAL RECORD OF EXACTLY THAT, AND IT OUTLIVES EVERY CAMPAIGN. IT ALSO WORKS REAL GROUND BEYOND ITS OWN GARDENS: IT APPLIES CONSERVATION SCIENCE IN A NAMED RESERVE, AL-ARQOUB, AND OFFERS SUPPORTERS FIELD VISITS THERE WITH ITS TEAM. AND IT SHARES LAND DIRECTLY: ITS COMMUNITY GARDEN SUPPORTS UP TO THIRTY INDIVIDUAL PLOTS, PROMOTING FOOD SOVEREIGNTY, WITH ORGANIC PRODUCE FROM THE BOTANICAL GARDEN USED AT ITS EVENTS. THIRTY PLOTS IS A SMALL NUMBER AND A REAL ONE. IT IS ALSO A MODEL A VILLAGE CAN COPY WITHOUT PERMISSION FROM ANYONE: GROUND HELD BY AN INSTITUTION, WORKED BY HOUSEHOLDS, PRODUCING FOOD THAT PROVES THE LAND IS IN USE. THE WAY IN IS VOLUNTEERING, AND IT IS DESCRIBED IN UNUSUALLY PRACTICAL TERMS: VOLUNTEERS PARTICIPATE IN RESEARCH PROJECTS AND MAINTAIN THE BOTANICAL AND COMMUNITY GARDENS AND THE AQUAPONICS AND HYDROPONICS SYSTEMS, WITH DIRECTIONS PUBLISHED DOWN TO WHICH BUS TO TAKE AND WHAT A TAXI SHOULD COST — AND SINCE TRAVEL BECAME DIFFICULT, REMOTE VOLUNTEERING INCLUDING WORK ON RESEARCH PAPERS. REMOTE RESEARCH VOLUNTEERING IS THE PART TO NOTICE IF YOU CANNOT REACH A PLACE. SOMEBODY ELSEWHERE CAN HELP WRITE UP THE SURVEY OF YOUR HILLSIDE, AND THIS IS AN INSTITUTION THAT ALREADY ACCEPTS THAT ARRANGEMENT. ITS OUTREACH GOES OUTWARD RATHER THAN WAITING: A MOBILE MUSEUM FUNDED BY A EUROPEAN DONOR TAKES EDUCATION TO MARGINALISED COMMUNITIES, HAVING VISITED FOURTEEN SCHOOLS IN TWO GOVERNORATES IN A SINGLE YEAR WITH DOZENS MORE PLANNED, AND ITS VOLUNTEERS VISIT MARGINALISED COMMUNITIES INCLUDING A NAMED HAMLET. A BODY THAT ALREADY TRAVELS TO MARGINALISED HAMLETS IS A BODY THAT CAN BE ASKED TO COME TO YOURS — AND ITS ARRIVAL BRINGS SCIENTISTS, RECORDS AND WITNESSES TO A PLACE THAT USUALLY HAS NONE. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A RESEARCH, EDUCATION AND CONSERVATION INSTITUTE, NOT A LAND TRUST OR A LAW FIRM - IT WILL NOT BUY YOUR LAND, PAY A LAWYER OR CONFRONT MILITARY OR SETTLEMENT AUTHORITIES, AND WHETHER IT OWNS OR LEASES THE RESERVE IT WORKS IN, OR COULD HOLD LAND FOR OTHERS, WAS NOT ESTABLISHED. IT IS SMALL, RUNS ON VOLUNTEERS AND DONATIONS, AND HAS SOUGHT MATCHED GIFTS TO KEEP GOING. ITS REACH IS BOUNDED BY THE SAME MOVEMENT AND ACCESS RESTRICTIONS AS EVERYTHING ELSE RECORDED FOR THIS TERRITORY, AND ITS FOUNDER IS A PUBLIC POLITICAL FIGURE, SO ASSOCIATION CARRIES A CHARGE IN SOME SETTINGS. THE ACCOUNT COMES FROM ITS OWN VOLUNTEER AND ABOUT PAGES, A UNIVERSITY CENTRE PAGE AND A SUPPORTING FOUNDATION'S DESCRIPTION, SOME OF IT DATING FROM 2022 AND 2025. Read it with the community foundation's community-led grants, the agricultural engineers' syndicate with branches in every city, the land research bodies and the threatened-tree foundation recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Palestinian Bar Association — the roll of practising lawyers, and permission for an outside Arab lawyer to plead jointly in one case
trackers.desc: THREE OTHER COUNTRIES' BARS WERE CHECKED THIS ROUND AND ALL WERE ALREADY IN THIS FILE. THIS ONE WAS NOT, AND IT CARRIES A PROVISION NONE OF THE OTHERS DO: AN ARAB LAWYER BELONGING TO ONE OF THE ARAB BAR ASSOCIATIONS MAY PLEAD JOINTLY WITH A LOCAL LAWYER REGISTERED ON THE ROLL OF PRACTISING LAWYERS, BEFORE THE COURTS, IN A PARTICULAR CASE, WITH PERMISSION GRANTED BY THE COUNCIL — OR BY THE HEAD OF THE BAR IF THE COUNCIL CANNOT CONVENE — AFTER VERIFYING THE APPLICANT'S STANDING AND SUBJECT TO RECIPROCITY. IN A PARTICULAR CASE IS THE PHRASE THAT MAKES IT USEFUL. A COMMUNITY FACING SOMETHING TOO BIG OR TOO SPECIALISED FOR THE LAWYERS AVAILABLE LOCALLY CAN BRING IN COUNSEL FROM ANOTHER ARAB COUNTRY FOR THAT CASE ALONE, PROVIDED A REGISTERED LOCAL LAWYER APPEARS ALONGSIDE. THAT IS A REAL ANSWER TO A PROBLEM THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED EVERYWHERE: THE EXPERTISE EXISTS IN THE REGION, BUT NOT IN THE DISTRICT WHERE THE BULLDOZER IS. THE PERMISSION IS DISCRETIONARY AND RECIPROCAL, SO THE ASK SHOULD GO TO THE COUNCIL EARLY AND IN WRITING, NAMING THE CASE AND THE LOCAL LAWYER. THERE IS A SECOND, PERMANENT ROUTE ALONGSIDE IT: AN ARAB LAWYER RESIDING PERMANENTLY IN THE COUNTRY AND REGISTERED WITH ONE OF THE ARAB BARS MAY ASK TO HAVE HIS NAME ENTERED ON THE REGISTER ON A BASIS OF RECIPROCITY. THE BAR ITSELF IS CONSTITUTED UNDER A LAW OF 1999 REGULATING THE PROFESSION: ITS PRINCIPAL SEAT IS IN JERUSALEM AND IT MAY OPEN OTHER BRANCHES, IT HAS LEGAL PERSONALITY AND FINANCIAL INDEPENDENCE, AND ITS AFFAIRS ARE RUN BY A COUNCIL ELECTED BY THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY. ITS OBJECTIVES ARE WORTH QUOTING WHEN ASKING IT FOR ANYTHING, BECAUSE TWO OF THEM REACH BEYOND ITS MEMBERS: ENTRENCHING THE PRINCIPLE OF THE RULE OF LAW AND RESPECT FOR HUMAN RIGHTS; AND ORGANISING MEMBERS' EFFORTS TO DEVELOP LEGAL THOUGHT IN THE SERVICE OF RIGHT, JUSTICE AND PROGRESS, AND CONTRIBUTING TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF LEGISLATION SO AS TO FACILITATE JUSTICE WITHOUT MATERIAL IMPEDIMENTS OR ADMINISTRATIVE COMPLICATIONS. WITHOUT MATERIAL IMPEDIMENTS MEANS WITHOUT COST BARRIERS. A BAR THAT HAS WRITTEN THAT INTO ITS OWN PURPOSE CAN BE ASKED, IN THOSE WORDS, WHAT IT DOES FOR PEOPLE WHO CANNOT PAY — AND THE ANSWER, WHATEVER IT IS, IS ON THE RECORD. ITS STRUCTURE TELLS YOU WHOM TO APPROACH: THE COUNCIL HAS FIFTEEN MEMBERS INCLUDING THE HEAD OF THE BAR — NINE FROM THE NORTHERN GOVERNORATES AND SIX FROM THE SOUTHERN — ELECTED AT TWO SEPARATE ELECTORAL CENTRES. NINE AND SIX, ELECTED SEPARATELY NORTH AND SOUTH, MEANS THERE ARE COUNCIL MEMBERS ELECTED BY LAWYERS FROM YOUR OWN PART OF THE COUNTRY. THOSE ARE THE MEMBERS TO WRITE TO, NOT THE INSTITUTION IN THE ABSTRACT. IT IS CONTACTABLE IN ORDINARY WAYS: A TELEPHONE, A FAX, AN EMAIL ADDRESS AND A WEBSITE, WITH AN ELECTRONIC SERVICES PORTAL ALONGSIDE. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A PROFESSIONAL BODY REGULATING LAWYERS, NOT A LEGAL AID PROVIDER - WHETHER IT RUNS A FREE LEGAL AID SCHEME, PUBLISHES A SEARCHABLE ROLL OF PRACTISING LAWYERS OR LISTS THEIR SPECIALISMS WAS NOT ESTABLISHED, AND THE ELECTRONIC SERVICES PORTAL WAS SEEN ONLY AS A LOGIN PAGE. ITS SEAT IS IN A CITY MOST OF THE POPULATION IT SERVES CANNOT REACH, AND ITS REACH IS BOUNDED BY THE SAME MOVEMENT RESTRICTIONS AND BY THE DIVISION BETWEEN NORTHERN AND SOUTHERN GOVERNORATES REFLECTED IN ITS OWN ELECTORAL STRUCTURE. THE JOINT-PLEADING AND RECIPROCITY PROVISIONS COME FROM THE 1999 LAW AND THE BAR'S INTERNAL REGULATION AS PUBLISHED IN A UNIVERSITY LAW DATABASE AND AN OFFICIAL GAZETTE PORTAL - WHETHER PERMISSION IS GRANTED IN PRACTICE, AND WHICH ARAB BARS ARE TREATED AS RECIPROCATING, WERE NOT ESTABLISHED. Read it with the agricultural engineers' syndicate with branches in every city, the biodiversity institute's herbarium and plots, the community foundation's community-led grants and the land research bodies recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Joint services councils and the municipal lending fund — cluster bodies for village groups, and the fund that brings them equipment
trackers.desc: A SINGLE VILLAGE HERE RARELY HAS THE MONEY OR THE MACHINERY FOR ANYTHING. THE ANSWER IN THIS TERRITORY IS A JOINT SERVICES COUNCIL - INCLUDING COUNCILS FOR PLANNING AND DEVELOPMENT THAT SERVE A WHOLE RURAL CLUSTER, ONE OF WHICH, COVERING THE COUNTRYSIDE EAST OF A NAMED CITY, WAS USED AS THE MODEL CASE IN AN ANTI-CORRUPTION ORGANISATION'S INTEGRITY INDEX FOR SUCH COUNCILS. THAT AN INTEGRITY ORGANISATION HAS BUILT AN INDEX FOR THESE COUNCILS TELLS A COMMUNITY TWO THINGS AT ONCE: THE COUNCILS HANDLE ENOUGH MONEY TO BE WORTH WATCHING, AND SOMEBODY INDEPENDENT IS ALREADY WATCHING THEM. THE INDEX ITSELF IS A DOCUMENT TO ASK FOR BEFORE APPROACHING ONE. WHAT REACHES THEM IS REAL AND PHYSICAL: IN AUGUST 2025 THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT MINISTER HANDED OVER SOLID-WASTE COLLECTION MACHINERY TO FIVE JOINT SERVICES COUNCILS - THOSE OF HEBRON, BETHLEHEM, JERUSALEM, NABLUS AND TUBAS. THE CHAIN BEHIND THAT DELIVERY IS THE PART TO LEARN: IT WAS FINANCED BY A EUROPEAN GOVERNMENT THROUGH ITS INTERNATIONAL COOPERATION AGENCY AND IMPLEMENTED BY THE MUNICIPAL DEVELOPMENT AND LENDING FUND, WITHIN THE FOURTH PHASE OF A MUNICIPAL DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMME, UNDER ITS THIRD WINDOW FOR PROJECTS MITIGATING CLIMATE CHANGE. A THIRD WINDOW FOR CLIMATE MITIGATION IS A NAMED FUNDING DOOR WITH A NAMED IMPLEMENTER. A CLUSTER OF VILLAGES THAT WANTS EQUIPMENT SHOULD ASK ITS JOINT COUNCIL WHICH WINDOW OF THAT PROGRAMME IT HAS APPLIED UNDER, AND WHAT THE NEXT PHASE IS FUNDING. THE FUND ITSELF IS A LENDING BODY FOR LOCAL AUTHORITIES AND IS PUBLICLY SCRUTINISED - THE SAME INTEGRITY ORGANISATION PUBLISHES CORRUPTION-RISK ANALYSIS OF ITS WORK, WHICH MEANS ITS PROCEDURES AND WEAK POINTS ARE DESCRIBED IN A DOCUMENT ANYONE CAN READ. THE MINISTRY'S OWN TARGETS FOR 2025 TO 2027 SHOW WHERE THE PRESSURE IS: THREE GOALS COVERING GOOD GOVERNANCE, FINANCIAL SUSTAINABILITY AND LOCAL ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT, AND PUBLIC SERVICES, WITH THIRTEEN INTENDED RESULTS INCLUDING IMPROVED FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT IN LOCAL BODIES AND JOINT COUNCILS, REDUCED INDEBTEDNESS OF BOTH, AND AN ENABLING ENVIRONMENT ENCOURAGING INVESTMENT IN THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT SECTOR. REDUCED INDEBTEDNESS AS AN OFFICIAL TARGET MEANS THESE COUNCILS ARE IN DEBT. A COUNCIL IN DEBT IS ONE UNDER PRESSURE TO LEASE, SELL OR CONCEDE - AND THAT IS WHERE A COMMUNITY'S LAND USUALLY GOES. THERE ARE ALSO RULES THAT APPLY TO THE PEOPLE INSIDE THEM: A CABINET DECISION OF 2023 ISSUED A CODE OF CONDUCT AND JOB ETHICS FOR THE EMPLOYEES OF LOCAL BODIES AND JOINT SERVICES COUNCILS, AND REGULATIONS OF 2023 AND 2024 GOVERN THE MANAGEMENT OF CONSTRUCTION AND DEMOLITION WASTE. CONSTRUCTION AND DEMOLITION WASTE HAS ITS OWN REGULATION HERE FOR AN OBVIOUS REASON, AND ANY COMMUNITY LIVING BESIDE RUBBLE DUMPING SHOULD ASK ITS JOINT COUNCIL WHICH SITE IS LICENSED AND WHO MONITORS IT. AND THE COUNCILS SIT UNDER LOCAL BODIES WHOSE COMPOSITION WAS BEING RESET AS THIS WAS WRITTEN: LOCAL COUNCIL ELECTIONS ARE GOVERNED BY A LAW OF 2025 AMENDED TWICE IN 2026, WITH A 2026 REGULATION DETERMINING THE LOCAL BODIES AND THE NUMBER OF MEMBERS OF THEIR COUNCILS. THE LIMITS: JOINT SERVICES COUNCILS ARE SERVICE AND INFRASTRUCTURE BODIES - WASTE, WATER, PLANNING - NOT LAND DEFENDERS, AND NOTHING RECORDED HERE SHOWS ONE RESISTING A CONFISCATION, A DEMOLITION OR A SETTLEMENT EXPANSION, WHICH ARE THE DOMINANT LAND THREATS IN THIS TERRITORY AND LIE ENTIRELY OUTSIDE THEIR POWERS. HOW MANY COUNCILS EXIST, WHICH VILLAGES EACH COVERS, HOW THEIR BOARDS ARE COMPOSED AND WHETHER RESIDENTS MAY ATTEND WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED. THE EQUIPMENT HANDOVER COMES FROM THE OFFICIAL NEWS AGENCY IN AUGUST 2025, THE INTEGRITY INDEX FROM AN ANTI-CORRUPTION ORGANISATION'S REPORT LIST, AND THE STRATEGIC TARGETS AND REGULATIONS FROM THE MINISTRY'S OWN PAGES - NONE FROM A COUNCIL'S OWN PUBLICATION. Read it with the biodiversity institute's herbarium and community plots, the bar association's joint-pleading permission, the community foundation's community-led grants and the agricultural engineers' syndicate recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Community foundation where the village votes on the grants — open meetings, a monitoring committee, and funds in a village's name
trackers.desc: THE BRIEF THIS FILE WORKS TO ASKS FOR ORGANISATIONS THAT RAISE MONEY FOR A COMMUNITY. THIS ONE GOES FURTHER: THE COMMUNITY DECIDES WHO GETS IT. ITS METHOD IS COMMUNITY-CONTROLLED GRANTMAKING - SMALL UNRESTRICTED GRANTS MOBILISED FOR GRASSROOTS GROUPS IN VILLAGES AND REFUGEE CAMPS, WITH COMMUNITY ORGANISERS ENSURING EVERYONE KNOWS OF AN OPEN PUBLIC MEETING AND IS INVITED, AND THE COMMUNITY THEN VOTING FOR THE ORGANISATIONS AND PROJECTS THAT RECEIVE THE FUNDS. UNRESTRICTED IS THE WORD THAT MATTERS. ALMOST EVERY FUND IN THIS PAYLOAD PAYS FOR WHAT THE FUNDER WANTED; THIS ONE PAYS FOR WHAT THE VILLAGE VOTED FOR, WHICH IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN BEING FUNDED AND BEING DIRECTED. AND THE ACCOUNTABILITY RUNS THE RIGHT WAY: ONCE THE COMMUNITY HAS VOTED, A COMMUNITY MONITORING COMMITTEE IS ESTABLISHED TO OVERSEE THE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE GRANT - IT BEING THE COMMUNITY'S RIGHT TO HOLD THE GRANT RECIPIENTS ACCOUNTABLE. A MONITORING COMMITTEE OF NEIGHBOURS WATCHING A NEIGHBOUR SPEND IS THE ONLY ACCOUNTABILITY MECHANISM IN THIS ENTIRE FILE THAT NEEDS NO AUDITOR, NO MINISTRY AND NO DONOR OFFICER. ITS PROGRAMMES ARE NAMED FOR WHO DECIDES: ONE IS CALLED THE VILLAGE DECIDES; ANOTHER, WOMEN SUPPORTING WOMEN, IS RUN ENTIRELY BY WOMEN AND EXTENDS FUNDING SOLELY TO WOMEN'S ORGANISATIONS OR INDIVIDUALS TO BENEFIT THEIR LOCAL COMMUNITY, BRINGING WOMEN TOGETHER TO MOBILISE LOCAL RESOURCES FOR PROJECTS OF THEIR OWN CHOICE; A THIRD IS A YOUTH-CONTROLLED GRANTMAKING PROGRAMME ESTABLISHED IN 2016 - AND ONE VILLAGE PROGRAMME COVERS THE ENTIRE VILLAGE INCLUDING MEN, WOMEN, CHILDREN, YOUTH AND PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES. THE SUMS ARE SMALL AND THE REACH IS WIDE: IN 2022 IT PROVIDED OVER A HUNDRED AND TWENTY THOUSAND DOLLARS IN GRANTS ACROSS FORTY-THREE INITIATIVES IN THE WEST BANK, GAZA AND JERUSALEM. FORTY-THREE INITIATIVES FROM ONE HUNDRED AND TWENTY THOUSAND DOLLARS MEANS AN AVERAGE GRANT OF UNDER THREE THOUSAND. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED FUNDS OF THREE HUNDRED THOUSAND WITH TWO-STAGE APPLICATIONS AND BANK-ACCOUNT REQUIREMENTS THAT NO VILLAGE GROUP COULD MEET - THIS IS THE OTHER END, AND FOR MOST COMMUNITIES IT IS THE REACHABLE END. THE MOST COPYABLE IDEA IS THE NAMED FUND: IT PROMOTES FUNDS IN THE NAME OF COMPANIES, FAMILIES, VILLAGES OR CAUSES WHICH, UNLIKE DONOR-ADVISED FUNDS COMMON ELSEWHERE, ARE DESCRIBED AS A TRUE PARTNERSHIP BETWEEN CONTRIBUTORS AND THE COMMUNITY. A FUND IN A VILLAGE'S OWN NAME IS THE VEHICLE A DIASPORA CAN GIVE TO WITHOUT THE MONEY DISAPPEARING INTO A GENERAL BUDGET - AND THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED DIASPORA GIVING ROUTES IN SEVERAL COUNTRIES WITHOUT FINDING THE CONTAINER THAT KEEPS IT LOCAL. IT DOES NOT DEPEND ENTIRELY ON DONORS EITHER: IT HAS OPENED A COMMUNITY STORE, ORGANISED EDUCATIONAL PAID TRAVEL PROGRAMMES DRAWING ON THE DIASPORA, AND BUILT A GUESTHOUSE AND COMMUNITY SPACE THAT IS REGULARLY RENTED OUT. A GUESTHOUSE THAT EARNS RENT AND A SHOP THAT EARNS MARGIN ARE HOW A COMMUNITY FOUNDATION SURVIVES A YEAR WHEN THE GRANTS STOP. THAT IS THE MODEL WORTH STUDYING, NOT JUST THE GRANTS. ITS VOLUNTEER TRADITION IS FORMALISED TOO: GUIDED BY A PRINCIPLE OF INFORMAL COMMUNITY GIVING, IT ORGANISES REGULAR VOLUNTEER DAYS WHERE INFORMAL ASSOCIATIONS CAN PARTNER WITH IT AND ITS ESTABLISHED VOLUNTEER NETWORK TO COMPLETE A SMALL PROJECT OF THEIR CHOOSING. INFORMAL ASSOCIATIONS - GROUPS WITH NO REGISTRATION - CAN PARTNER FOR A PROJECT. THAT ANSWERS THE BARRIER THIS FILE HAS RECORDED MORE OFTEN THAN ANY OTHER. AND ITS CURRENT WORK IS EXACTLY ON THE GROUND THIS FILE DEFENDS: IT HOSTED AN INDIGENOUS SEEDS GERMINATION EVENT AT A HOME-PRODUCTION COOPERATIVE, LED BY A NAMED WOMAN, TEACHING NATURAL CHEMICAL-FREE PLANTING WITH COMPOST AND PEAT MOSS THROUGH EVERY STAGE - PART OF PROTECTING AND PROMOTING INDIGENOUS SEED VARIETIES ESSENTIAL TO FOOD SOVEREIGNTY IN THE FACE OF ONGOING THREATS TO AGRICULTURE. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A GRANTMAKING AND COMMUNITY-PHILANTHROPY ORGANISATION, NOT A LAND OR LEGAL ONE - IT WILL NOT BUY A PARCEL, FIGHT A CONFISCATION OR TAKE A CASE, AND ITS GRANTS ARE SMALL BY DESIGN. HOW A COMMUNITY GETS ITSELF INTO A GRANT ROUND, WHETHER THE PROGRAMMES ARE OPEN ACROSS THE WHOLE TERRITORY, AND WHAT THEY LOOK LIKE AFTER THE DESTRUCTION IN GAZA WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED - THE MOST RECENT FIGURES SEEN ARE FROM 2022 AND THE MOST RECENT ACTIVITY FROM LATE 2024 AND AFTER. THE ACCOUNT COMES FROM THE FOUNDATION'S OWN PAGES AND FROM SIX EXTERNAL PROFILES AND CASE STUDIES DATED BETWEEN 2014 AND 2024, SEVERAL OF THEM OLDER THAN THIS FILE PREFERS. Read it with the joint services councils and the municipal lending fund, the biodiversity institute's herbarium and community plots, the bar association's joint-pleading permission and the agricultural engineers' syndicate recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Municipal lending fund's published allocation formula — green space, waste, water and a complaints system decide what a council receives
trackers.desc: THIS PAYLOAD RECORDED THIS FUND EARLIER FOR DELIVERING SOLID-WASTE MACHINERY TO JOINT SERVICES COUNCILS. WHAT IT DID NOT RECORD IS THE FORMULA - AND THE FORMULA IS THE USEFUL PART: ALLOCATION RESTS ON THREE MAIN CRITERIA, PERFORMANCE AT FIFTY PER CENT, THE POPULATION OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITY AT TWENTY PER CENT, AND THE EXTENT OF NEED AT THIRTY PER CENT. A PUBLISHED FORMULA MEANS A RESIDENT CAN WORK OUT WHY THEIR TOWN GOT LESS THAN THE NEXT ONE - AND CAN SEE THAT HALF THE ANSWER IS NOT POVERTY OR SIZE BUT HOW THE COUNCIL ITSELF PERFORMS. THE NEED INDICATORS ARE NAMED, AND THEY ARE THE THINGS THIS FILE SPENDS ITS TIME ON: THEY ARE COLLECTED THROUGH THE CENTRAL BUREAU OF STATISTICS, WHICH THE FUND CONTRACTS TO GATHER SPECIFIED INFORMATION FOR ALL MUNICIPALITIES - THE CONDITION OF THE ROADS, THE AREA OF GREEN PLACES AND PLAYING FIELDS, THE SOLID WASTE SERVICE, THE LEVEL OF THE WATER SERVICE, AND THE AVAILABILITY OF A HEADQUARTERS FOR THE MUNICIPALITY. THE AREA OF GREEN PLACES IS A FUNDING INDICATOR. A COMMUNITY DEFENDING A PARK, AN ORCHARD OR AN OPEN SPACE CAN THEREFORE ARGUE THAT LOSING IT LOWERS THE TOWN'S SCORE AND ITS SHARE OF NATIONAL MONEY - WHICH IS AN ARGUMENT A MAYOR UNDERSTANDS EVEN WHEN CONSERVATION IS NOT. THAT THE STATISTICS BUREAU COLLECTS THESE FIGURES UNDER CONTRACT ALSO MEANS THE NUMBERS EXIST, TOWN BY TOWN, AND CAN BE ASKED FOR: HOW MUCH GREEN SPACE IS THIS MUNICIPALITY RECORDED AS HAVING, AND WHEN WAS IT LAST MEASURED. ONE PERFORMANCE TOOL IS WORTH MORE TO A RESIDENT THAN ANY OTHER: AMONG THEM IS THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A COMPLAINTS SYSTEM IN THE MUNICIPALITY, INCLUDING THE DISCLOSURE OF GRIEVANCE PROCEDURES ON THE MUNICIPALITY'S SOCIAL MEDIA PAGE AND OR WITHIN ITS BULLETIN. THE COUNCIL IS PAID MORE FOR HAVING A PUBLISHED COMPLAINTS PROCEDURE. SO ASKING WHERE THE GRIEVANCE PROCEDURE IS PUBLISHED IS NOT A FAVOUR TO REQUEST - IT IS A CHECK ON SOMETHING THE COUNCIL IS ALREADY BEING FUNDED TO PROVIDE. THE SYSTEM REWARDS IMPROVEMENT RATHER THAN ONLY SIZE: THE PERFORMANCE ALLOCATION IS DISTRIBUTED ACCORDING TO THE CLASSIFICATION EACH MUNICIPALITY HAS OBTAINED, WITH CLASSIFICATIONS RECORDED FOR 2017, 2019 AND 2021, AND THE PROGRAMME WORKS CONTINUOUSLY WITH MUNICIPALITIES OF LOW CLASSIFICATION TO HELP THEM RISE TO HIGHER GRADES. A SMALL, POORLY RATED COUNCIL IS THEREFORE ENTITLED TO HELP CLIMBING, NOT JUST TO A SMALLER CHEQUE. THAT IS THE REQUEST A VILLAGE COUNCIL SHOULD MAKE, AND THE FOURTH PHASE OF THE PROGRAMME RUNS THROUGH 2026 WITH ITS ALLOCATION MECHANISM PUBLISHED. ALL OF THIS ARRIVES AT A MOMENT WHEN THE COUNCILS THEMSELVES HAVE JUST CHANGED: VOTERS WENT TO THE BALLOT BOXES ON THE TWENTY-FIFTH OF APRIL 2026 TO ELECT LOCAL AUTHORITY COUNCILS, AND THE ELECTORAL SCENE SAW A RETREAT IN THE PRESENCE OF THE ORGANISED PARTY LISTS THAT TRADITIONALLY TOOK PART, AND A RISE OF LOCAL AND CONSENSUS LISTS PRESENTING THEMSELVES UNDER SERVICE AND DEVELOPMENT NAMES RATHER THAN POLITICAL IDENTITIES. LISTS THAT RAN ON SERVICES RATHER THAN POLITICS ARE LISTS THAT CAN BE HELD TO SERVICES. THE FIRST YEAR OF A NEW COUNCIL ELECTED ON THAT BASIS IS WHEN A WATER, WASTE OR GREEN-SPACE DEMAND IS MOST LIKELY TO BE HEARD. ONE STRUCTURAL NOTE FOR VILLAGES THAT HAVE BEEN MERGED: A REGULATION OF 2026 PROVIDES THAT JOINT MUNICIPALITIES ARE ADMINISTERED BY A COUNCIL FORMED OF THE HEADS AND MEMBERS OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES CONSTITUTING THEM, WITH THE NUMBER OF MEMBERS AND THEIR PROPORTION OF REPRESENTATION FIXED BY CABINET DECISION. PROPORTION OF REPRESENTATION IS WHERE A SMALL VILLAGE INSIDE A JOINT MUNICIPALITY WINS OR LOSES ITS VOICE, AND IT IS SET BY A CABINET DECISION THAT CAN BE ASKED FOR. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A GOVERNMENT-LINKED FUND CHANNELLING DONOR MONEY TO COUNCILS, NOT A BODY A COMMUNITY CAN APPLY TO - THE MONEY GOES TO MUNICIPALITIES, AND A RESIDENTS' GROUP REACHES IT ONLY BY PERSUADING ITS OWN COUNCIL. THE CLASSIFICATION YEARS NAMED END IN 2021 AND THE PROGRAMME PHASE DESCRIBED ENDS IN 2026, SO BOTH THE CURRENT FORMULA AND THE NEXT PHASE SHOULD BE CHECKED. WHETHER THE STATISTICS BUREAU'S PER-MUNICIPALITY FIGURES ARE PUBLISHED, WHETHER A RESIDENT MAY OBTAIN THEM, AND HOW THE FORMULA HAS BEEN APPLIED IN GAZA SINCE THE DESTRUCTION WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED. THE ELECTION ACCOUNT COMES FROM A NEWSPAPER ANALYSIS OF JULY 2026 WHICH ALSO RECORDS FIELD MEASURES AGAINST CANDIDATES AND SUPPORTERS DURING THE CAMPAIGN. Read it with the joint services councils and the municipal lending fund's machinery deliveries, the community foundation where the village votes, the agricultural work committees and the biodiversity institute's herbarium recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Federal Board of Supreme Audit
trackers.desc: National — supreme audit institution of Iraq. Here you can trace how the public budget is allocated and spent in Iraq.

trackers.name: Iraq — Companies Registration Directorate (Ministry of Trade)
trackers.desc: National corporate registry; the General Directorate of Company Registration at the Ministry of Trade is Iraq’s Companies’ Registrar, registering LLCs, joint-stock & foreign companies and branches under the Companies Law No. 21 of 1997 (as amended), Iraq. — Holds to account: state firms & government-linked companies — find their registration, directors and filings.

trackers.name: Supreme Court of Iraq
trackers.desc: Supreme Court of Iraq — supreme court in Iraq (Wikidata record).

trackers.name: Kuwait Regional Convention (ROPME) — and its Judicial Commission
trackers.desc: THE ONE BINDING ENVIRONMENTAL INSTRUMENT COVERING ALL EIGHT GULF STATES. The Kuwait Regional Convention for Cooperation on the Protection of the Marine Environment from Pollution was signed 24 April 1978 and entered into force 1 July 1979 — 30 articles, described as the basic legal instrument binding the eight States of the Region. ALL EIGHT ARE FULL PARTIES: ROPME records ‘no signatories without ratification, acceptance, approval or accession’, so unlike some regional instruments there is no signed-but-unratified state to argue about.
