ARTICLE II fixes the Sea Area by coordinates, from Ras Dharbat Ali (16°39'N, 53°3'30"E) to Ras Al Fasteh (25°04'N, 61°25'E) — a treaty boundary you can check a project location against. Use the term ‘ROPME Sea Area’: it was coined by the Plenipotentiaries to achieve unanimity, cooperating in spite of existing geopolitical boundaries, and it is the name all eight accepted. THE ORGAN MOST PEOPLE DO NOT KNOW EXISTS: alongside the Council and Secretariat, ROPME has a Judicial Commission, established March 1989, of 6 nationals of Member States highly qualified in international law. In a region with almost no environmental litigation route, a standing judicial commission under a ratified convention is the most significant legal fact available — though this entry does not assert that individuals may petition it; establish who may seise it first. AN EVIDENCE SOURCE THAT NEEDS NO SITE ACCESS: ROPME's scientific bodies include a Remote Sensing Unit, alongside RIIS and MEMAC. WHICH PROTOCOL FITS YOUR ISSUE: oil-spill emergency response; land-based sources of pollution — the limb for a coastal development, discharge or reclamation; and transboundary movement of hazardous wastes. Development is named as a stressor in ROPME's own statement of purpose. At stake: over 20 species of dolphin and whale, all five subtropical turtle species, and more than 1,000 fish species, most endemic.

trackers.name: Nature Iraq — it mapped 82 Key Biodiversity Areas with the environment ministry, and it is the region's only Waterkeeper member
trackers.desc: THE FIRST QUESTION FOR ANY IRAQI SITE IS WHETHER IT IS ONE OF THE 82. Nature Iraq ran the Key Biodiversity Areas programme with the Iraqi Ministry of Environment and BirdLife International, surveying the country in the field from 2004 to 2010, and identified eighty-two sites as globally important for biological diversity. If your land is one of them, the case that it matters has been made jointly with the ministry itself rather than by you, which is a fundamentally stronger position than an unsupported objection. Ask what the survey recorded at your location. ON RIVERS IT IS BLUNTER THAN ALMOST ANY ORGANISATION IN THIS FILE, AND ITS OWN WORDS ARE THE REASON TO CALL IT: it states that government decision-makers view the rivers as abstract resources they can pollute, divert, drain and trade away without regard to the communities and ecosystems destroyed in their wake, and that its water resources projects exist to inform local communities what is happening and what they can do to influence those decisions. That is an organisation that says out loud what a dam or diversion actually is. It is also the only Middle Eastern member of the Waterkeeper Alliance, a network built specifically around defending particular rivers and waterways, which gives an Iraqi river dispute an international channel that does not otherwise exist in this region. WHO AND WHERE: an Iraqi non-governmental organisation registered in Iraq and the Kurdistan Region, accredited to the United Nations Environment Programme, an IUCN member and Iraq's first and only BirdLife International affiliate, created in the early 2000s. Offices in Sulaimani, Baghdad and Chubayish in the marshes, and it runs two field camps — one on Peramagroon Mountain, one at Chibayish near the proposed Mesopotamian Marshlands National Park. Contact info@natureiraq.org and the published Iraqi telephone numbers; it states that volunteers are welcome. Its stated goals include building the capacity of Iraqi institutions, developing a scientific database of environmental conditions through monitoring and research, and promoting community-based environmental centres and clubs. TWO THINGS TO WEIGH: much of the KBA fieldwork dates from 2004 to 2010, and a separate body, the Iraqi Organization for Conservation of Nature, has conducted later surveys — so ask which organisation holds the current data for your area. And this is a research, monitoring and advocacy organisation rather than a litigator or a landholder; it will document your site and speak publicly, not take a case. THE ANSWER TO THAT QUESTION IS NOW ESTABLISHED: the current surveys are run by the Iraqi Organization for Conservation of Nature, founded in 2004, which has continued Key Biodiversity Area fieldwork since the earlier programme ended and is documented conducting surveys at the Khor Az-Zubair tidal mudflats in 2022 and in the Najaf desert in 2023, published in 2024. It has also run more than a decade of long-term environmental study at the Dalmaj wetland, including invasive species monitoring, and has worked on field surveys arranged with the Arab Regional Centre for World Heritage in Bahrain, which is recorded separately in this file. IT HAS NO WEBSITE and so cannot be given an entry of its own here, but it is the body to ask for current data on an Iraqi site — its team publishes in ornithological and conservation journals under named Iraqi authors, which is the practical way to reach it. Ask both organisations: the earlier programme identified the eighty-two areas, the later one knows what is there now. ASK FOR THE UNPUBLISHED INTERNAL REPORTS. The organisation that runs Iraq's current field surveys cites its own UNPUBLISHED INTERNAL REPORTS as a source in its peer-reviewed papers — which means detailed survey material exists for named sites that has never been published and will not be found by searching. A request for the internal report on your area is a different and better question than a request for a publication list. AND IT HAS PUT ON RECORD, IN PRINT, THAT INTERNATIONAL FIGURES FOR IRAQ WERE WRONG: it stated its disagreement with the estimates in an international study, saying the numbers representing Iraq were not accurate and did not reflect the actual pressure of illegal hunting on birds in the country. If a developer's assessment rests on international datasets for Iraq, the people conducting the surveys may be able to contradict those figures in a citable publication — which attacks the evidence rather than the conclusion. THE SURVEYS ARE ARRANGED JOINTLY, AND ONE OF THE PARTNERS IS A DOMESTIC ACADEMIC ROUTE WORTH KNOWING: field surveys have been arranged with the Bahrain-based regional World Heritage centre recorded separately in this file AND WITH THE COLLEGE OF SCIENCE OF AN IRAQI UNIVERSITY. A university science faculty that already participates in national biodiversity survey work is the most reachable source of expert evidence in a country where this file could record almost nothing else — approach the faculty, not only the organisation. THE SURVEY COVERAGE IS NATIONAL RATHER THAN REGIONAL: documented fieldwork spans the Zakho and Dhouk areas in the north, Muthanna and Maissan in the south, the Najaf desert, the tidal mudflats at Khour Az-Zubair and the Al-Dalmaj wetlands, across seasons and years. Whatever part of Iraq your site is in, there is a reasonable chance somebody has surveyed near it and written it up.ONE PRACTICAL CAPABILITY WAS NOT RECORDED HERE, AND IT IS THE ONE A COMMUNITY WITH A POLLUTED RIVER NEEDS MOST: THE WATERKEEPER'S SECOND PROGRAMME AREA IS WATER QUALITY PROTECTION — MONITORING THE CONTAMINANTS THAT POLLUTE WATERWAYS AND SEEKING SOLUTIONS TO KEEP THEM HEALTHY FOR BOTH THE NATURAL ENVIRONMENT AND THE HUMAN COMMUNITIES THAT DEPEND ON THEM. AND THE ORGANISATION'S OWN LINEAGE INCLUDES AN ENVIRONMENTAL LABORATORY THAT STARTED INSIDE IT BEFORE BECOMING A PRIVATE TESTING SERVICE. SO THIS IS WHERE TO ASK HOW TO GET A WATER SAMPLE TESTED PROPERLY, AND BY WHOM. AN UNTESTED SUSPICION MOVES NOBODY; A DATED LABORATORY RESULT FROM A COMPETENT LAB MOVES REGULATORS — AND A GROUP THAT HAS RUN ITS OWN MONITORING FOR YEARS KNOWS WHICH LABS ARE COMPETENT AND WHAT A DEFENSIBLE SAMPLE LOOKS LIKE. ITS WATER PROGRAMME ALSO STATES ITS OWN PURPOSE IN TERMS WORTH QUOTING BACK WHEN WRITING TO IT: THAT DECISION-MAKERS TREAT RIVERS AS ABSTRACT RESOURCES TO POLLUTE, DIVERT, DRAIN AND TRADE AWAY WITHOUT REGARD TO THE COMMUNITIES AND ECOSYSTEMS DESTROYED, AND THAT ITS PROJECTS EXIST TO INFORM LOCAL COMMUNITIES ABOUT WHAT IS HAPPENING AND WHAT THEY CAN DO TO INFLUENCE THOSE DECISIONS. A COMMUNITY DOWNSTREAM OF A PLANNED DAM OR DIVERSION IS EXACTLY WHO THAT DESCRIBES, AND SHOULD SAY SO PLAINLY IN ITS FIRST LETTER. ONE CURRENCY WARNING TO CARRY: MUCH OF THE PUBLISHED PROGRAMME MATERIAL IS YEARS OLD, SO ASK WHETHER THE WATERKEEPER POST IS STILL FILLED AND WHICH BASINS IT NOW COVERS BEFORE BUILDING A PLAN AROUND IT.

trackers.name: Rufford Small Grants — Iraq is named eligible, and an individual can apply without an organisation behind them
trackers.desc: IRAQ IS NAMED ON THE FOUNDATION'S OWN ELIGIBILITY PAGE, AND THE APPLICANT CAN BE A PERSON. That matters in a country this map records under a restriction against listing local organisations: a researcher or community member can seek funding in their own name without a registered body, and this file names no Iraqi organisation in doing so. NO DEADLINES — applications go in at any time of year, which suits work that has to fit around conditions rather than a funding calendar. The focus is people early in a conservation career, particularly current or recent MSc and PhD students, though others may apply against the published criteria; undergraduates are excluded. CHECK THE SPECIES TEST BEFORE YOU WRITE: the foundation considers work on any species not listed as Least Concern globally on the IUCN Red List, and also species not yet assessed but believed globally threatened. Projects on threatened habitats, human-wildlife conflict or community education qualify without a species focus at all — relevant where the issue is a marsh, a river or a landscape rather than an animal. STAGED FUNDING: up to £7,000 first, then a second grant, a Booster and a Completion Grant, reaching around £18,000, each stage conditional on finishing the last and filing updates and a final report which are then published on the applicant's own page. PLAN AROUND THE RULES: one application per twelve months, twelve months' wait after a rejection, the foundation covering between half and all of the cost, and evidence of co-funding required if others are contributing. Pure research without conservation benefit and self-funded expeditions are excluded. Pair with the Key Biodiversity Areas record held by the Iraqi organisation recorded elsewhere in this file: a project inside one of the eighty-two identified sites has a far stronger case than one that is not.

trackers.name: Humat Dijlah — a national river movement whose stated purpose is protecting water bodies from dams
trackers.desc: ITS OWN STATED AIM IS STRENGTHENING THE PROTECTION OF IRAQI RIVERS, MARSHES AND WATER BODIES FROM THE DANGERS OF DAMS — which makes it one of the few bodies in this entire payload that exists to oppose infrastructure rather than to manage land around it. It describes itself as a social environmental movement operating at NATIONAL SCALE, run by a river protectors association, working through monitoring, advocacy AND THE IMPLEMENTATION OF TECHNICAL PROJECTS. THE TECHNICAL SIDE IS WHAT DISTINGUISHES IT FROM A CAMPAIGN. Its published public policy work sets out concrete methods — ENGINEERING SURVEYS to assess technologies for Iraqi agricultural land, ECONOMIC FEASIBILITY STUDIES, surveys of current irrigation practice, farmer training, and seeking partnerships with financiers to fund the alternative. This file has recorded across several countries that a worked alternative plan beats objection alone; this organisation builds them. IT ALSO NAMES THE DOMESTIC BODIES IT COORDINATES WITH, WHICH IS A MAP OF WHO ELSE MATTERS HERE: agricultural associations, the ENGINEERS SYNDICATE, and the WATER CONSUMERS ASSOCIATION. A syndicate of engineers and an association of water users are precisely the kinds of body that can carry technical objections and represent affected users, and this file has recorded professional chambers doing exactly that in Turkiye. IT ORGANISES PUBLIC ACTION AS WELL AS PAPERS — street events in Baghdad with artists to raise awareness of threats to the Tigris and Euphrates — and its leadership sits on the steering committee of a regional campaign to protect the water resources and heritage of the wider river basin, which is the route to allies in neighbouring countries facing the same dams from the other side of the border. THE LIMITS: it is an advocacy and technical organisation, not a law practice, and nothing found shows it litigating. Its central subject is water — rivers, marshes and dams — so a land dispute unconnected to water fits it poorly. For a community whose river, marsh or irrigation supply is threatened by a dam or diversion, it is the strongest domestic body recorded here.THREE THINGS THIS ENTRY DID NOT RECORD, AND THE FIRST IS THE MOST TRANSFERABLE: THE MOVEMENT SIGNED THE FIRST MEMORANDUM OF COOPERATION BETWEEN TWO ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION MOVEMENTS OF DIFFERENT COUNTRIES IN THIS REGION. TWO CIVIL MOVEMENTS IN DIFFERENT COUNTRIES SIGNING A COOPERATION MEMORANDUM WITH EACH OTHER — NOT WITH A MINISTRY, NOT WITH A DONOR. WHERE A RIVER, A DUST SOURCE OR A DAM CROSSES A BORDER, THAT IS THE INSTRUMENT: AN AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE PEOPLE'S ORGANISATIONS ON BOTH SIDES, WHICH NEEDS NOBODY'S PERMISSION TO EXIST. SECOND, IT NAMES SPECIFIC POLLUTERS RATHER THAN CONDITIONS. IT IDENTIFIED THAT A HOSPITAL STANDING ON THE RIVER BANK IN THE CAPITAL LEAKS THE WASTE OF A THOUSAND PATIENTS A DAY INTO THE RIVER — A SINGLE NAMED BUILDING, A COUNTABLE FIGURE, AND A DISCHARGE POINT THAT CAN BE PHOTOGRAPHED. THAT IS THE FORM A POLLUTION CLAIM MUST TAKE TO TRAVEL. NOT THE RIVER IS DIRTY, BUT THIS BUILDING, THIS MANY PEOPLE, THIS OUTFALL. AND NOTE THE COURAGE OF NAMING A PUBLIC HOSPITAL: THE MOVEMENT DID NOT PICK THE EASY TARGET. THIRD, IT WARNS ON NAMED SCHEMES BEFORE THEY ARE BUILT — INCLUDING WATER TRANSFER PROJECTS THREATENING A NAMED TRIBUTARY — AND ITS MEMBERS ARGUE PUBLICLY THAT SHARED RIVERS SHOULD BE SUBJECT TO INTERNATIONAL NORMS AND SHARED ACCORDING TO THE POPULATIONS LIVING ALONG THEIR COURSE AND THE OPTIMAL USE OF THEIR RESOURCES. THAT LAST FORMULATION IS WORTH BORROWING WHEREVER AN UPSTREAM STATE OR PROVINCE TAKES WATER: THE CLAIM IS NOT OWNERSHIP BUT PROPORTION — SHARE BY THE NUMBER OF PEOPLE WHO LIVE ON THE RIVER. ITS MEMBERS ARE QUOTED BY NAME IN THE NATIONAL PRESS ON WATER POLICY, AND IT ORGANISES VISIBLY AS WELL AS TECHNICALLY — HERITAGE BOATS ON THE RIVER IN THE CAPITAL, AND ONLINE SEMINARS ON CLIMATE SUBJECTS. A MOVEMENT THAT IS ALREADY A PRESS CONTACT ON WATER IS A ROUTE TO COVERAGE AS WELL AS TO EXPERTISE.

trackers.name: Waterkeepers Iraq — a named river keeper in the north, working on dam prevention and removal
trackers.desc: ITS PROGRAMME INCLUDES THE PREVENTION AND REMOVAL OF DAMS THAT DAMAGE RIVERS AND THEIR COMMUNITIES, stated as an explicit area of work alongside water allocation, transboundary water issues, long-range planning and WATER-RELATED LEGISLATION. Very few bodies in this payload name dam prevention as a function; this one does. IT IS BASED IN THE NORTH, IN SULAIMANI, AND STAFFS A NAMED RIVER KEEPER FOR THE UPPER TIGRIS — a single person with responsibility for a defined stretch of river, which is a different and more reachable thing than a national organisation. That matters in a country where this file's other entries operate nationally or from the capital: if your water is in the Kurdistan region or the upper basin, there is a named post whose job is that water. IT MONITORS CONTAMINANTS THAT POLLUTE WATERWAYS and seeks solutions to protect water quality for both the natural environment and the communities depending on it — which is evidence work, and this file has recorded repeatedly that contamination measured and documented is what changes a case. ITS STATED PURPOSE INCLUDES SUPPORTING LOCAL COMMUNITIES IN THE SUSTAINABLE USE of rivers and streams, and its outreach is aimed at community, scientific and government audiences alike. KNOW ITS SCALE BEFORE YOU APPROACH: its own description says it currently has ONE WATERKEEPER ON STAFF, with jurisdiction intended to expand to further waterways and basins as the organisation develops. That is a small body with a wide mandate, so expect to bring your own capacity rather than to hand a problem over. THE OTHER LIMITS: water and rivers only; it is an advocacy and monitoring organisation rather than a legal one; and nothing found shows it litigating or representing anyone. Use it alongside the national river movement recorded above and, where a lender or foreign company is involved, the international accountability routes recorded for this country.WHAT THIS ENTRY DID NOT RECORD IS THAT THE ORGANISATION HAS ALREADY PUBLISHED THE DOCUMENTS A COMMUNITY WOULD OTHERWISE HAVE TO COMMISSION. ITS PROJECT LIST INCLUDES AN ENVIRONMENTAL LAW AND ADVOCACY PROJECT, A RIVER WATCH PROGRAMME, THREAT ASSESSMENTS FOR TWO NAMED RIVERS — ONE OF THEM CARRYING ACTION PLANNING — AND A RIVER ECOSYSTEM HEALTH PROJECT CONTAINING A DAM CASE STUDY AND A GRAVEL MINING CASE STUDY. DAMS AND GRAVEL MINING ARE THE TWO COMMONEST RIVER-DESTROYING ACTIVITIES IN THIS REGION, AND EACH ALREADY HAS ITS OWN PUBLISHED CASE STUDY HERE. A COMMUNITY FACING EITHER DOES NOT NEED TO BUILD ITS ARGUMENT FROM NOTHING — ASK FOR THE CASE STUDY, AND FOR THE THREAT ASSESSMENT FORMAT, WHICH IS THE TEMPLATE FOR DOCUMENTING WHAT IS HAPPENING TO A RIVER. THE ORGANISATION ALSO PUBLISHES ITS WATER DATA: SURVEY DATA, RIVER-WATCH DATA, WATER-QUALITY DATA AND A REPORT CARD. A REPORT CARD IS THE SINGLE MOST USEFUL FORMAT IN THIS FILE FOR AN ORDINARY READER — IT TURNS MEASUREMENTS INTO A GRADE THAT A COUNCILLOR, A JOURNALIST OR A NEIGHBOUR CAN UNDERSTAND WITHOUT TRAINING. AND IT ASKS FOR PEOPLE, NOT JUST ATTENTION: IT INVITES ALL INTERESTED INDIVIDUALS AND GROUPS THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY TO BECOME THE EYES, EARS AND VOICES THAT MONITOR AND ADVOCATE FOR THEIR LOCAL WATERWAYS, AND IT WELCOMES VOLUNTEERS. THAT IS AN OPEN INVITATION TO JOIN AN EXISTING MONITORING NETWORK RATHER THAN START ONE. THE ALLIANCE IT BELONGS TO HAS MORE THAN THREE HUNDRED AND FIFTY RIVER, BAY AND COASTAL ADVOCATES WORLDWIDE, AND THIS BODY BECAME AN INDEPENDENT REGISTERED ORGANISATION IN DECEMBER 2014 — so a local group joining it inherits a method, a name and international company, none of which it could build alone. ITS WATER PROGRAMME'S OWN DESCRIPTION NAMES THE WORK PLAINLY: TRANSBOUNDARY WATER ISSUES, WATER POLICY AND LONG-RANGE PLANNING, WATER-RELATED LEGISLATION, THE ALLOCATION OF WATER, AND THE PREVENTION AND REMOVAL OF DAMS THAT DAMAGE RIVERS AND THEIR COMMUNITIES. REMOVAL, NOT ONLY PREVENTION — which is worth knowing where a damaging structure already stands.THE MOST USEFUL THING THIS ORGANISATION HAS PRODUCED IS NOT A CAMPAIGN BUT A METHOD, AND IT WAS NOT RECORDED HERE: A THREAT ASSESSMENT OF A HUNDRED AND TWENTY KILOMETRE RIVER, FROM ITS SOURCE TO ITS CONFLUENCE, CARRIED OUT OVER TWO MONTHS BY TWO FIELD WORKERS USING CAR, BOAT AND DRONE. TWO PEOPLE AND TWO MONTHS IS WITHIN REACH OF A VILLAGE ASSOCIATION, AND IT PRODUCED WHAT NO OFFICIAL BODY HAD: 245 IMMINENT THREATS IDENTIFIED INSIDE THE BASIN OR BESIDE IT, AND THE FINDING THAT THE RIVER IS UNDRINKABLE, NONSWIMMABLE AND UNFISHABLE. THE CRITERIA WERE BORROWED RATHER THAN INVENTED, WHICH IS WHY THE RESULT HOLDS UP — ADAPTED FROM AN INTERNATIONAL BIRD CONSERVATION ORGANISATION'S 2006 STANDARD FOR ASSESSING THREATS TO AREAS OF CONSERVATION CONCERN — AND THE ANALYSIS ENDED IN ACTION PLANS RATHER THAN A COMPLAINT. THE ASK TO THIS ORGANISATION IS THEREFORE PRECISE: SHARE THE CRITERIA AND THE SURVEY FORM, AND SHOW US HOW THREATS WERE RECORDED FROM A BOAT AND A DRONE. ITS CURRENT DOCUMENTATION IS ALSO WORTH KNOWING: A TOXIC OIL SPILL IN A DISTRICT OF THE SAME PROVINCE THREATENING THE DRINKING WATER OF MORE THAN TWO MILLION PEOPLE, A WAVE OF SPILLS FROM LATE OCTOBER 2025 ACROSS SEVERAL NAMED SUB-DISTRICTS, AND INSPECTION TRIPS MONITORING POLLUTION ALONG THE ROADS BETWEEN THREE CITIES WITH THE KEY FINDINGS PUBLISHED. PUBLISHED FINDINGS WITH DATES AND PLACES ARE WHAT AN OBJECTION, A LENDER'S COMPLAINT OFFICE OR A JOURNALIST NEEDS — SO A COMMUNITY DOWNSTREAM OF SOMETHING SIMILAR SHOULD ASK WHETHER ITS STRETCH CAN BE ADDED TO THE NEXT INSPECTION TRIP. AND THE WAY THIS WORK SPREAD IS THE TRANSFERABLE PART: WORKSHOPS LED UNIVERSITY STUDENTS TO START THEIR OWN ENVIRONMENTAL GROUPS, WHICH COVERS MORE GROUND THAN ONE ORGANISATION SERVING A WHOLE COUNTRY.

trackers.name: The farmers' cooperative federations — statutory bodies whose job includes defending farmers' rights
trackers.desc: THERE IS A STATUTORY FEDERATION WHOSE PUBLISHED FUNCTIONS INCLUDE DEFENDING FARMERS' RIGHTS, AND IT HAS LOCAL FEDERATIONS IN THE GOVERNORATES. The law establishes a general federation of agricultural cooperative societies representing the cooperative farming movement across all its branches, with among its listed responsibilities caring for farmers' interests and DEFENDING THEIR RIGHTS, and with local federations operating at province level. If your land is farmland or orchard, you are not starting from nothing: there is a body that already exists to speak for you, and it is organised where you live rather than only in the capital. ITS STANDING IS DEMONSTRATED, NOT ASSUMED. Its president was received by parliament's agriculture committee, together with water ministry officials, TO DISCUSS AN AMENDMENT TO THE LAW ON IMPLEMENTING IRRIGATION PROJECTS — the law that governs how land is taken for water schemes. A federation that is invited to help redraft the expropriation law is a federation whose letter carries weight. THE ARGUMENT ITS DELEGATES MADE IS THE ONE TO REUSE ANYWHERE SUBSTITUTE LAND IS OFFERED: they said that compensating a farmer with alternative land that is UNFIT FOR AGRICULTURE would make the statute A DISPLACEMENT LAW RATHER THAN A LAW GUARANTEEING THE FARMER'S RIGHTS. The test is not whether land was given but whether it can be farmed — demand a soil and water assessment of any replacement plot before accepting it. AND KNOW THAT COMPENSATION MONEY HAS BEEN APPROPRIATED: the committee recorded securing 1.3 TRILLION DINARS for farmer compensation within the internal loan law and including it in a budget year, while complaining that the finance ministry was delaying payment. Ask which allocation covers your case and whether it has been released — a delayed payment is a different fight from an unfunded one. ONE MEMBER OF THE COMMITTEE ARGUED FOR INVOLVING THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY AND THE FARMERS' SOCIETIES ALONGSIDE THE WATER MINISTRY IN IMPLEMENTING PROJECTS, to stop powers overlapping. That is an opening to ask your local federation to be formally included in a scheme's implementation. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE SERIOUS. Farming societies and federations publicly complain of HAVING NO COMMUNICATION CHANNELS WITH GOVERNMENT and of demands going unanswered, so weight is not the same as access. The founding statute dates from an earlier political era and its language reflects that. AND NO WEBSITE FOR THE FEDERATION COULD BE FOUND — this entry points at the official parliamentary record of its appearance; reach it through the local federation in your governorate or through the agriculture directorate. THE THREAT IT NAMES IS THE ONE THIS MAP EXISTS FOR: orchards being bulldozed and converted into housing projects.

trackers.name: International Center for Community Land Trusts — how a community comes to own its land permanently
trackers.desc: A COMMUNITY LAND TRUST IS A NONPROFIT THAT HOLDS THE LAND PERMANENTLY WHILE THE PEOPLE ON IT OWN ONLY WHAT STANDS THERE. Its board is made up of resident members, wider community members and public representatives, so no single owner and no future council can sell the ground out from under it. Such trusts run RURAL AND URBAN AGRICULTURE PROJECTS AND CONSERVE LAND AND GREEN SPACES as well as housing. This file recorded that orchards in this country are being bulldozed and converted into housing projects; a trust is the vehicle built precisely to stop land passing from the people who use it to whoever can pay most for it. THIS CENTRE EXISTS TO HELP PEOPLE BUILD ONE. It was established to promote and support such trusts and similar strategies of community-led development on community-owned land IN COUNTRIES THROUGHOUT THE WORLD, and it provides TRAINING, REFERRAL AND TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE to organisers and practitioners, alongside case studies, directories and guides. START WITH WHAT IS FREE ON ITS OWN SITE: a start-up manual setting out the organisational and operational choices in founding a trust — including WHO SPONSORS IT, which is the first decision and the one that shapes everything after. It also runs a global summit of free online events over several weeks each year, bringing together practitioners, residents, organisers and researchers, and keeps the recordings; and it has published jointly with a national bar association on the part LAWYERS play in establishing trusts, which is the document to hand a lawyer who has never set one up. BEFORE ANY OF THAT, ESTABLISH TWO THINGS. Whether the land can lawfully be sold at all — this file has recorded a Basic Law in one country of this region forbidding the sale of state land outright, and a rule in another confining sale of valley farmland to a single public buyer. And whether you can form the nonprofit that would hold it: a trust needs a registered legal entity, which this file has identified as the commonest barrier between communities and land or money across the whole region. THE LIMITS: it is a support and knowledge organisation, not a funder — IT WILL NOT BUY YOUR LAND, and someone still has to pay for the ground. Its materials and case studies come overwhelmingly from North America and Europe, and no activity in this region was established; ask it directly what it can offer here, since referral is one of its stated services.

trackers.name: ELAW — scientific and legal backing for whichever lawyer takes a river or contamination case here
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY HAS BODIES THAT PRODUCE TECHNICAL WORK AND NO LAWYER TO USE IT. This file recorded a national river movement here that runs ENGINEERING SURVEYS AND ECONOMIC FEASIBILITY STUDIES and builds alternative irrigation proposals, and a northern waterkeeper that MONITORS CONTAMINANTS AND WORKS ON WATER LEGISLATION. Neither is a law practice, and no environmental legal route exists in this map for this country. This alliance is what fills that gap from the other side. IT IS A GLOBAL NETWORK OF ATTORNEYS AND SCIENTISTS SUPPLYING LEGAL, SCIENTIFIC, SECURITY AND ORGANISATIONAL EXPERTISE TO PUBLIC INTEREST LAWYERS — more than three hundred advocates in over eighty countries, handling upwards of four hundred requests a year. ITS SCIENCE TEAM DOES FOUR THINGS THAT MATTER PRECISELY HERE: it CRITIQUES ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT ASSESSMENTS, SUBMITS EXPERT TESTIMONY TO COURTS, builds systems to MONITOR ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS, and RECOMMENDS CLEANER ALTERNATIVES TO PROPOSED PROJECTS. A community facing a dam, a diversion or an oilfield discharge needs an independent critique of the assessment and an expert who will stand behind it; a movement that has already surveyed the ground needs someone to turn that into evidence a court accepts. AND IT DOES THE INTRODUCTION THAT NOBODY ELSE MAKES: it FACILITATES ENGAGEMENT BETWEEN LOCAL SCIENTISTS AND LOCAL LAWYERS. This file recorded that a university science faculty here holds unpublished internal reports and contradicted international figures in print, and separately that a farmers' federation argued the compensation law in parliament. THE SCIENTISTS, THE AFFECTED USERS AND THE ADVOCATES IN THIS COUNTRY ARE ALL RECORDED AND NONE OF THEM IS CONNECTED TO THE OTHERS. ITS LAW TEAM HELPS PARTNERS BRING ENFORCEMENT ACTIONS, critique draft legislation and REPLICATE MODEL LAWS FROM OTHER JURISDICTIONS — directly usable where a river body is already working on water legislation. It also works explicitly on DEFENDING DEFENDERS and the safety of advocates under attack. HOW TO USE IT: IT WORKS THROUGH PARTNERS — PUBLIC INTEREST LAWYERS IN THEIR OWN COUNTRIES — NOT DIRECTLY WITH COMMUNITIES. Find or instruct a local advocate first, then have them request support, which is provided at no cost to the partner. THE LIMITS: it will not represent you, fund litigation or campaign, and whether it has partners in this country was not established — ask before relying on it. It is also a DIFFERENT ORGANISATION from the similarly named environmental defender law centre recorded elsewhere in this file, which places pro bono lawyers rather than supplying expertise to lawyers who already have the case.

trackers.name: Grassroots Justice Network — find the legal empowerment people here, or train your own
trackers.desc: IT HAS A MEMBER DIRECTORY, AND THIS COUNTRY HAS NO LAWYER RECORDED ANYWHERE IN THIS MAP. The network gathers more than seventeen thousand six hundred members across a hundred and eighty-nine countries — community paralegals and the organisations that deploy them — and its directory can be reached by joining or as a guest by giving an email address. This file searched a whole legal sector in this country and could not name one reachable organisation; a directory of justice defenders is the shortest remaining route to whoever is actually working here. ITS LAND WORK IS DESCRIBED IN THE EXACT TERMS OF THIS MAP: increasing LAND TENURE SECURITY, gaining RECOGNITION FOR COMMUNITY LAND RIGHTS, and SIGNIFICANTLY REDUCING ENVIRONMENTAL AND SOCIAL HARM IN MINING, AGRICULTURAL OR DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS. BUT THE MODEL IS WORTH MORE HERE THAN THE DIRECTORY, BECAUSE IT IS WHAT A COMMUNITY CAN BUILD WHEN THERE ARE NO LAWYERS. COMMUNITY PARALEGALS are ordinary people trained in basic law AND in mediation, organising, education and advocacy — a frontline that can, in the network's own words, squeeze justice out of even broken systems. ITS STATED POSTURE IS THE OPPOSITE OF THE EXPERT SERVICE: rather than treating affected people as victims who need someone to solve the problem for them, paralegals BUILD POWER AMONG THE PEOPLE THEY WORK WITH. For a district where the technical bodies recorded elsewhere in this file hold surveys and contaminant data but nobody can take a case, training two or three local people in the relevant law is a more realistic step than waiting for a lawyer who does not exist. AND ONE PRACTICE IN THAT MODEL IS DIRECTLY COPYABLE WHATEVER ELSE YOU DO: PARALEGALS TRACK DATA ON THE PROCESS AND RESULT OF EVERY CASE. A single refused permit application is an anecdote; forty of them, recorded with dates, officials and outcomes, is evidence of a pattern — and this file has recorded across the region that patterns move institutions where individual complaints do not. THE CONVENOR ALSO RUNS A COMMUNITY LAND PROTECTION PROGRAMME supporting organisations to help rural communities PROTECT, DOCUMENT AND STEWARD their collectively managed lands, and maintains a library of practical resources and online spaces where members meet. THE LIMITS, PLAINLY: the convening organisation trains and deploys paralegals in six countries and NONE OF THEM IS IN THIS REGION — expect a network, a method and a library, not a team arriving. Reaching the directory means giving an email address to a foreign organisation, which is a decision to weigh in some places. And it is a network, not a law firm: it will not take your case.

trackers.name: Global Fund for Community Foundations — it pays to build the local fund, not just the project
trackers.desc: EVERY OTHER FUNDER IN THIS MAP PAYS FOR A PROJECT. THIS ONE PAYS TO BUILD THE BODY THAT WILL FUND YOUR PROJECTS AFTERWARDS. It gives small grants and technical support to community philanthropy organisations — community foundations, WOMEN'S FUNDS, ENVIRONMENTAL FUNDS, grassroots grantmakers and national public foundations — to strengthen their GRANTMAKING SYSTEMS, GOVERNANCE AND MANAGEMENT STRUCTURES, FUND DEVELOPMENT AND SUSTAINABILITY and communications. AND ITS PRIORITY RULE POINTS STRAIGHT AT THIS COUNTRY: PRIORITY IS GIVEN TO THOSE COUNTRIES WHERE ACCESS TO OTHER FUNDING OPPORTUNITIES IS LIMITED. This file has recorded here a farmers' federation with parliamentary standing, river movements running their own engineering surveys, agricultural cooperatives, and a compensation scheme with committees — and no local fund of any kind. The pieces of a community foundation exist; what is missing is the vehicle. ENVIRONMENTAL ISSUES ARE NAMED IN WHAT IT WILL SUPPORT: strengthening these bodies to respond to complex, sensitive or apparently intractable issues at community level, expressly including environmental issues, alongside social cohesion and community divisions, women's, youth and minority rights, and marginalised communities. In a country where this file recorded orchards being converted to housing and rivers dammed upstream, a local fund that can grant money to the affected village without waiting for a foreign call is a different kind of asset. ITS OWN RATIONALE IS THE BEST ARGUMENT FOR LOCAL MONEY THIS FILE HAS FOUND: community philanthropy BUILDS ON ASSETS THAT ALREADY EXIST WITHIN COMMUNITIES rather than depending only on what comes from outside — and when local resources are brought to the table, A FLATTER POWER DYNAMIC IS CREATED and traditional donor-beneficiary imbalances are challenged. That is the reason to raise money locally even when foreign money is available: it changes who decides. HOW TO APPROACH IT: it works through concept notes and publishes its eligibility guidelines; grants are small and normally run for an initial year with follow-on possible. CHECK THE PUBLISHED GUIDELINES FOR CURRENT AMOUNTS AND TERMS — the only sources stating a figure were aggregators this file does not use. THE LIMITS: applicants must be organisations that make grants or mobilise local resources, not a village committee with a single dispute; it does not fund land purchases, litigation or campaigns directly; and it works in developing and emerging economies, so eligibility depends on the country as well as the applicant.

trackers.name: High Commission for Human Rights — complaints kept confidential, and violations from before 2008 still count
trackers.desc: ITS FOUNDING LAW REQUIRES IT TO RECEIVE COMPLAINTS WHILE MAINTAINING COMPLETE CONFIDENTIALITY OF THE NAMES OF THOSE WHO SUBMIT THEM. Almost no other channel recorded anywhere in this map carries that protection in its constituting text. For a household in a district where the counterparty is a ministry, a governor or a state-linked company, confidentiality is the difference between complaining and not. AND THE SECOND CLAUSE MATTERS AS MUCH: ITS SCOPE COVERS VIOLATIONS THAT OCCURRED BEFORE THE LAW CAME INTO FORCE AS WELL AS AFTER IT. Land taken years ago, an orchard cleared before 2008, a displacement never compensated — none of that is automatically out of time here, which is unusual and worth testing. COMPLAINTS MAY COME FROM INDIVIDUALS, FROM GROUPS, AND FROM CIVIL SOCIETY ORGANISATIONS. A village association, a farmers' body or a river movement can file on behalf of the people affected, which is the same feature that makes these institutions usable where households fear exposure. IT DOES MORE THAN RECEIVE: it CONDUCTS PRELIMINARY INVESTIGATIONS into violations on the basis of information, and VERIFIES THE ACCURACY of the complaints it receives. An institution that investigates is one that can be asked to go and look. IT IS REQUIRED TO OPEN OFFICES AND BRANCHES IN THE REGIONS AND IN THE GOVERNORATES, so this is not only a Baghdad body — ask where your governorate office is. AND IT REPORTS PUBLICLY: an ANNUAL REPORT TO PARLIAMENT giving a general assessment of the human rights situation, PUBLISHED IN THE VARIOUS MEDIA. A pattern of complaints from one district can surface in a document parliament receives, which is a route this file has recorded working elsewhere — forty recorded refusals are evidence where one is an anecdote. WHAT IT IS: an independent commission formed under a 2008 law, aiming to guarantee the protection of human rights and the rights and freedoms set out in the constitution, in law, and in the international treaties Iraq has ratified. THE LIMITS, PLAINLY. It investigates, verifies and reports; NO POWER TO BRING PROCEEDINGS IN COURT WAS FOUND, unlike the equivalent institution in another country recorded in this file. It is established by statute and funded accordingly, and its effectiveness is contested. It is not a substitute for a lawyer — and this country still has none recorded here. Use it for the confidential complaint, the investigation and the public record; use the farmers' federation, the legal empowerment network and the scientific support alliance recorded separately for the rest.

trackers.name: Save the Tigris — it got the Marshes onto the World Heritage list, and it researches the dams
trackers.desc: IT CAN POINT TO A RESULT, WHICH ALMOST NOTHING ELSE IN THIS MAP CAN. After several years of campaigning, THE IRAQI MARSHES WERE INSCRIBED ON THE UNESCO WORLD HERITAGE LIST IN 2016. The campaign began in March 2012 as a coalition of Mesopotamian and international activists formed to protect the Tigris from dams and other megaprojects, focused first on a large dam in a neighbouring country that would drown an ancient town, and on the marshes themselves. IT PRODUCES THE TECHNICAL ARGUMENTS A COMMUNITY COULD NEVER FUND. It conducts ITS OWN ORIGINAL RESEARCH on dams, pollution and water harvesting — including RESEARCH ON EVAPORATION IN DAM RESERVOIRS, which is the argument that a reservoir in this climate loses more water than it secures. It publishes project-specific DAM WATCH REPORTS, one in March 2025 investigating the risks posed by a named dam, and in May 2026 a report on the ECONOMIC LIFE OF THE INHABITANTS of the central and western Hammar marshes — on how recurring drought and declining water threaten traditional livelihoods, cultural heritage and the resilience of the marsh communities. THAT LAST KIND OF REPORT IS THE ONE COMMUNITIES MOST OFTEN LACK: evidence that a water change costs people their living, written down and published by someone other than themselves. AND IT SUPPLIES A LEGAL FRAME ANY COMMUNITY IN A SHARED-RIVER DISPUTE CAN BORROW. It argues that dams built without consultation and without assessment of their impacts breach the established international norms on the use of international watercourses — EQUITABLE AND REASONABLE UTILISATION, PARTICIPATION, AND THE OBLIGATION NOT TO CAUSE SIGNIFICANT HARM to those who depend on the water. Three named principles are a stronger objection than an appeal about damage. ITS COALITION CONTAINS A LEGAL ROUTE: alongside ecology movements and heritage initiatives in a neighbouring country, its international partners include AN ENVIRONMENTAL DEFENDERS LAW CENTRE and European organisations specialising in rivers and dams. It also convenes a Mesopotamian water forum and facilitates cross-border information sharing, which matters where the decision harming your district is taken in another country. KNOW TWO THINGS BEFORE YOU APPROACH IT. It now operates as a FOUNDATION BASED IN EUROPE rather than as an Iraqi organisation, though it grew from and works with Iraqi groups — including the river association recorded separately in this file, whose director served as its coordinator in this country. And in July 2025 IT WAS EXPELLED FROM A UNESCO WORLD HERITAGE COMMITTEE SESSION, which tells you both how far its reach extends and what it meets there. THE LIMITS: it is research and advocacy, not legal representation, and its scale is the basin rather than the single village — bring it a problem that connects to the river system, and take a purely local dispute to the bodies recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Lifeline — emergency money for legal representation when your organisation is prosecuted
trackers.desc: THE QUALIFYING TEST NAMES THE THING THAT ACTUALLY HAPPENS TO COMMUNITY GROUPS. An emergency is assessed on need, urgency, and whether the organisation faces significant security risks, loss of property or equipment, injury or imprisonment of staff, AND OR PROSECUTION OR OTHER LEGAL PROCEEDINGS. A lawsuit brought against a river association, a farmers' body or a village committee because of what it said or documented is itself a qualifying emergency — and this file has recorded that pattern across five countries. WHAT THE EMERGENCY GRANT PAYS FOR IS LISTED PLAINLY: security, medical expenses, LEGAL REPRESENTATION, PRISON VISITS, TRIAL MONITORING, temporary relocation, equipment replacement and other urgently needed expenses. This payload holds more than eighty funding entries and almost none of them will pay a lawyer or send someone to sit in a courtroom. THIS ONE WILL. TWO FURTHER WINDOWS ARE WORTH KNOWING. ADVOCACY GRANTS are highly flexible and can fund STRATEGIC LITIGATION, policy and legal advocacy, coalition building, awareness campaigns and security and protection training. RESILIENCY GRANTS pay for PREVENTION — including MAPPING AND COORDINATING CIVIL SOCIETY ACCESS TO PRO BONO SERVICES, joint protection strategies, contingency plans, organisational risk assessments and legal technical assistance. That second one is the round of funding to seek BEFORE anything happens: building the list of lawyers who will act, while nobody is yet in trouble. IT IS A CONSORTIUM OF SEVEN INTERNATIONAL ORGANISATIONS LED BY A FREEDOM ORGANISATION, WITH EMERGENCY REQUESTS HANDLED THROUGH IT AND THROUGH A DEFENDERS' ORGANISATION; a third consortium member also receives requests and forwards them. It is supported by around twenty government and foundation donors. THE LIMITS, AND THE FIRST ONE MATTERS MOST HERE. IT FUNDS CIVIL SOCIETY ORGANISATIONS — human rights groups, journalist associations, student groups, unions and similar — SO AN UNREGISTERED VILLAGE COMMITTEE MAY NOT QUALIFY AS AN APPLICANT. This file established that lacking a registered entity is the commonest barrier in this region; here it bites again, and the answer is to apply through an existing organisation that supports you. IT ALSO DOES NOT FUND CORE COSTS, PROGRAMMES, LONG-TERM SUPPORT OR FINANCIAL HARDSHIP — only the emergency — and it is funded by donor governments, so association with it is a political fact in some places.

trackers.name: OECD Watch — complain about a foreign company in the country where it is headquartered
trackers.desc: THE RULE THAT MAKES THIS USABLE HERE: A COMPLAINT CAN BE FILED AGAINST A MULTINATIONAL HEADQUARTERED IN A COUNTRY THAT FOLLOWS THE OECD GUIDELINES, EVEN WHERE THE HARM HAPPENS IN A COUNTRY THAT DOES NOT. Those governments must each maintain a non-judicial complaints office, and that office is obliged to handle complaints about the conduct of companies based there. A community facing a foreign oil, engineering or construction company therefore has a forum outside this country, reached without a lawyer and usually without cost. THIS NETWORK EXISTS TO HELP CIVIL SOCIETY USE IT, AND WHAT IT SUPPLIES IS PRACTICAL: guidance broken into SEVEN STAGES of the process, A MODEL COMPLAINT LETTER written for these offices, and a COMPLAINTS DATABASE you can filter by issue, sector and region to read what happened in cases like yours before you write a word. They invite contact for advice on drafting and strategy. THEIR GUIDANCE ON EVIDENCE IS THE MOST TRANSFERABLE PART: collect WITNESS STATEMENTS, COMPANY POLICIES, SCIENTIFIC TESTS and published articles or reports showing the harm and its connection to the company — and collect information about the company itself, INCLUDING WHERE IT IS HEADQUARTERED, because that determines which office hears you. This file records for this country a farmers' federation, a river campaign that produces its own dam research, and a legal empowerment network; all of them generate exactly the material this process runs on. CHECK THE OFFICE BEFORE YOU FILE. The network evaluates these offices against THIRTY-EIGHT PERFORMANCE INDICATORS, and one official report found that THIRTY-ONE PER CENT OF THEM HAD NOT RECEIVED A SINGLE CASE IN OVER FIVE YEARS. Some are serious; some are dormant. Read the evaluation of the specific office before investing months. AND WEIGH THE CONFIDENTIALITY TRADE-OFF IN ADVANCE: confidentiality can protect complainants and encourage dialogue, but it MAY RESTRICT YOUR ABILITY TO SPEAK PUBLICLY about the case. Campaigning is permitted so long as confidential documents and mediation details are not disclosed — check that office's transparency rules before filing rather than after. THE LIMITS, IN THEIR OWN WORDS: THE STANDARDS ARE VOLUNTARY, THE OFFICES CANNOT REQUIRE A COMPANY TO TAKE PART OR TO REMEDY ANYTHING, and complaints SOMETIMES THOUGH NOT OFTEN result in remedy — more often they raise awareness and shift future conduct. Their own advice is that complaints succeed when embedded in a wider strategy with media, allies and investors, which is how this should be used: as one instrument among several, not as the remedy.

trackers.name: Bar register — verify the lawyer, check which courts they may enter, and know the fee floor
trackers.desc: THE BAR'S OFFICIAL SITE CARRIES A REGISTER OF LAWYERS, SO ADMISSION CAN BE VERIFIED BEFORE A CASE AND A FEE ARE HANDED OVER. Everything else this map records for this country — a foreign environmental law alliance, a legal empowerment network, a national complaints commission, an international complaints route — tells a reader where to seek help. NONE OF THEM LETS YOU CHECK THE PERSON IN FRONT OF YOU. BUT THE MORE USEFUL THING ON THIS SITE IS THE QUESTION IT TEACHES YOU TO ASK. LAWYERS HERE HOLD GRADES OF AUTHORITY THAT GOVERN WHICH COURTS THEY MAY APPEAR BEFORE, and the bar council has recently CHANGED THE MECHANISMS FOR GRANTING THAT AUTHORITY AND ADDED TWO DISTINCT AUTHORITIES under the law. ASK WHICH AUTHORITY YOUR LAWYER HOLDS BEFORE INSTRUCTING THEM. A land or administrative case may end up before a court their grade does not admit them to, and discovering that late means starting again with someone else, after limitation periods have run. This file has recorded the same structure in another country's profession law, where a claim above a stated value could not be brought except through a lawyer; here the constraint is not the claim's value but THE LAWYER'S RANK. AND THE BAR PUBLISHES A FEE FLOOR, WHICH ALMOST NO PROFESSIONAL BODY IN THIS REGION DOES: MINIMUM MONTHLY RETAINERS OF THREE HUNDRED THOUSAND DINARS FOR IRAQI COMPANIES AND SIX HUNDRED THOUSAND FOR FOREIGN COMPANIES. Two things follow. You can tell whether a quoted fee is inside professional norms rather than guessing. And you can estimate what the company on the other side is paying its own counsel each month — which is a useful figure when deciding whether to fight, to seek the free routes recorded separately here, or to apply to the litigation-expenses funders this file records for other countries. THE BAR IS REACHABLE: its official public page carries a following of more than three hundred thousand, and it publishes its rules of admission and practice alongside the register. THE LIMITS. A REGISTER CONFIRMS ADMISSION, NOT COMPETENCE, INDEPENDENCE OR WILLINGNESS — it will not tell you who has run an environmental or land case, and no specialism field was found. The published fees are minimums for company retainers, not a guide to what an individual should pay. And the bar is a professional body that regulates lawyers rather than an advocate for anyone. Use it to check the person, ask about their authority, and sense-check the money — and use the legal empowerment network and the complaints commission recorded separately for the case itself.THE REGISTER ANSWERS WHETHER A LAWYER IS REAL. TWO THINGS THIS ENTRY DID NOT RECORD ANSWER WHERE TO GET ONE WITHOUT MONEY, AND WHAT HAPPENS WHEN SOMEBODY IS NOT REAL AT ALL. FIRST, THE ASSIGNMENT ROUTE. THERE ARE ASSIGNMENT BODIES IN THE LAWYERS' CHAMBERS AT EVERY APPEAL COURT PRESIDENCY — IN THE CAPITAL AND IN ALL THE GOVERNORATES — WITH THEIR OWN THREE-YEAR ELECTORAL TERMS. THE BAR COUNCIL HAS MOVED TO FORM A COMMITTEE TO SET PROCEDURAL RULES FOR THE ASSIGNMENT OF LAWYERS, AND THE CABINET HAS APPROVED AMENDMENTS TO LAWYERS' FEES AND TO ASSIGNMENT WAGES. ASSIGNMENT WAGES MEANS THE STATE PAYS THE ASSIGNED ADVOCATE. SO A PERSON WHO CANNOT PAY DOES NOT GO TO THE BAR'S HEADQUARTERS — THEY GO TO THE ASSIGNMENT BODY OF THE CHAMBER AT THEIR OWN APPEAL COURT, WHICH EXISTS IN EVERY GOVERNORATE. THAT IS A LOCAL DOOR, NOT A CAPITAL ONE. SECOND, THE BAR RUNS A DEPARTMENT THAT AUDITS LAWYERS' FILES AND PURSUES IMPERSONATORS OF THE LEGAL PROFESSION AND FORGERS, WITH THE COUNCIL ISSUING DECISIONS ON ITS SUPERVISOR'S RECOMMENDATIONS. A UNIT WHOSE WHOLE SUBJECT IS FAKE LAWYERS. LAND DISPUTES ATTRACT PREDATORS — PEOPLE WHO TAKE FEES FROM VILLAGERS TO FILE CASES THAT ARE NEVER FILED — AND HERE THERE IS BOTH A REGISTER TO CHECK A NAME AGAINST AND A DEPARTMENT TO REPORT A FALSE ONE TO. CHECK THE NAME BEFORE PAYING ANYTHING, AND REPORT WHAT YOU FIND. AND ONE PUBLISHED FIGURE IS USEFUL FOR A DIFFERENT REASON: THE BAR SETS MINIMUM MONTHLY RETAINERS FOR COMPANIES — THREE HUNDRED THOUSAND DINARS FOR NATIONAL COMPANIES AND SIX HUNDRED THOUSAND FOR FOREIGN ONES. THAT IS A PRICE FLOOR, AND IT TELLS A COMMUNITY WHAT THE COMPANY ACROSS THE TABLE IS EXPECTED TO BE PAYING ITS OWN LAWYERS EVERY MONTH — WHICH IS THE HONEST MEASURE OF THE MISMATCH, AND THE ARGUMENT FOR SEEKING ASSIGNED OR SHARED COUNSEL RATHER THAN TRYING TO MATCH IT.THE PART NOT RECORDED HERE IS THE LOCAL STRUCTURE BEHIND THE REGISTER: DELEGATION BODIES OF THE LAWYERS' CHAMBERS EXIST IN ALL THE APPEAL PRESIDENCIES, AND THE BAR HAS DELIBERATELY INVOLVED THEM IN THE ROUTE INTO MEMBERSHIP BECAUSE OF THE DIFFICULTY FOR APPLICANTS FROM THE GOVERNORATES OF TRAVELLING TO THE CAPITAL. A LAWYERS' BODY AT THE APPEAL COURT IN YOUR OWN GOVERNORATE IS THE NEAREST ORGANISED GROUP OF ADVOCATES A COMMUNITY CAN APPROACH — AND THE BAR ITSELF TREATS THOSE BODIES AS THE CONTACT POINT FOR PEOPLE WHO CANNOT REACH THE CAPITAL. THEY ARE ELECTED IN THE OPEN: ONE GOVERNORATE'S DELEGATION BODY WAS ELECTED UNDER THE SUPERVISION OF A JUDICIAL COMMITTEE FROM THE APPEAL COURT, HEADED BY A NAMED JUDGE WITH TWO OTHERS AS MEMBERS, IN THE PRESENCE OF THE PRESIDENT OF THE BAR, ITS SECRETARY, ITS FINANCIAL SECRETARY, TWO COUNCIL MEMBERS AND THE PRESIDENT OF THE APPEAL COURT, WITH WIDE PARTICIPATION BY LAWYERS. THE BAR'S OWN ELECTIONS SHOW THE SAME GEOGRAPHY AND DOUBLE AS A MAP OF WHERE ORGANISED LEGAL LIFE EXISTS: VOTING TAKES PLACE IN THE CAPITAL AT THE BAR'S HEADQUARTERS, AND IN THE OTHER GOVERNORATES AT THE SEATS OF THE APPEAL COURTS - OR AT THE CRIMINAL COURTS WHERE THERE IS NO APPEAL COURT. IF YOUR DISTRICT HAS NEITHER, THE NEAREST ONE IS WHERE YOUR LAWYERS ARE. AND ONE ADMINISTRATIVE NOTE FOR ANYONE CHECKING CREDENTIALS THIS YEAR: AFTER THE REPLACEMENT OF THE CIVIL STATUS IDENTITY WITH A UNIFIED NATIONAL CARD, LAWYERS RENEWING THEIR BAR IDENTITY ARE ASKED TO BRING A COPY OF THAT CARD SO THEIR PERSONAL FILE CAN BE UPDATED.

trackers.name: Engineers Union — licensed testing offices, engineer ranks, and a disciplinary route that ends in court
trackers.desc: THE MOST USEFUL THING HERE IS A LICENSED CATEGORY MOST PEOPLE DO NOT KNOW EXISTS: OFFICES FOR TESTING AND INSPECTION ARE A RECOGNISED ENGINEERING SPECIALISM, licensed and classified by the union. A community that needs a structure examined, a material tested or works inspected does not need a favour from a university — IT NEEDS A LICENSED TESTING AND INSPECTION OFFICE, and the union is where the licensed ones are listed. PETROLEUM ENGINEERING IS ANOTHER LICENSED SPECIALISM, covering the identification, evaluation, development and drilling of oil and gas fields, which matters where the project in dispute is a field or a pipeline. SECOND, AND THIS IS A REAL REMEDY: A DISCIPLINARY COMMITTEE INSIDE THE UNION DECIDES COMPLAINTS AGAINST ENGINEERING OFFICES — brought by the union's own offices committee OR BY THOSE CONTRACTING WITH THE OFFICE — where the office has breached the law, the instructions, or THE RULES OF PROFESSIONAL CONDUCT, or has departed from its stated objectives. THE COMMITTEE IMPOSES PENALTIES, AND ITS DECISION IS APPEALABLE TO THE COURT OF CASSATION WITHIN THIRTY DAYS OF NOTIFICATION. A professional complaint with a defined forum, defined grounds and an appeal to the highest court is a stronger instrument than most of the complaint channels recorded anywhere in this file. AND THE UNION CAN STRIKE AN OFFICE OFF THE REGISTER ALTOGETHER if it does work conflicting with the union's law, regulations or instructions. THIRD, ASK THE RANK BEFORE YOU ENGAGE ANYONE. A LICENSED-RANK ENGINEER MAY DO ANY WORK WITHIN HIS SPECIALISM WITHOUT LIMIT, INCLUDING CHAIRING ARBITRATION AND PLANNING COMMITTEES; ONLY A CONSULTANT-RANK OFFICE MAY REGISTER IN MORE THAN ONE SPECIALISM, and must employ engineers in each. This file recorded that advocates in this country hold GRADES OF AUTHORITY deciding which courts they may enter; THE SAME STRUCTURE RUNS THROUGH ENGINEERING, so in this country rank is the first question for both professions. Promotion to consultant requires five years plus a higher degree, or three specialism courses, OR DOCUMENTED SUPERVISION OF NAMED PROJECTS — so a senior engineer's record of supervised projects is itself checkable. THE OFFICES COMMITTEE THAT LICENSES ALL THIS IS REQUIRED TO INCLUDE PRIVATE SECTOR REPRESENTATION, with members of consultant rank drawn from different specialisms. THE LIMITS, AND THE FIRST ONE DECIDES WHO CAN USE THE COMPLAINT. THE DISCIPLINARY ROUTE IS DESCRIBED FOR THE OFFICES COMMITTEE AND FOR THOSE CONTRACTING WITH THE OFFICE — A NEIGHBOUR WHO HAS NO CONTRACT MAY NOT HAVE STANDING, and would need to bring the matter to the offices committee to refer. The union regulates engineers and will not oppose a project; engaging an office costs money; and this is a professional route to evidence and accountability, not to stopping a scheme.

trackers.name: The waqf diwans — an endowment that can buy land, and the trap of which diwan you fall under
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HAS RECORDED ENDOWMENTS IN SIX COUNTRIES AS A WAY TO HOLD LAND. HERE, FOR THE FIRST TIME, AN ENDOWMENT CAN ALSO BUY IT: the diwan's board decides on REQUESTS BY TRUSTEES TO PURCHASE PROPERTY FOR THE WAQF, TO REPAIR IT, OR TO CONSTRUCT NEW BUILDINGS FOR IT. An existing endowment with income can therefore acquire ground, on its trustee's application — which turns endowment from a way of freezing what you already own into a way of getting more. THE MONEY IS GUARDED IN A WAY WORTH KNOWING: endowed funds may be put into investment projects ONLY AFTER ECONOMIC FEASIBILITY IS ESTABLISHED AND WITH REGARD TO THE CONDITION OF THE ENDOWER. The endower's condition binds the investment decision, so a condition written into the endowment deed is not decoration. THE BOARD ALSO DECIDES ON RECEIVING AND ADMINISTERING CHARITABLE INSTITUTIONS ESTABLISHED BY BENEFACTORS, and on approving the establishment of such institutions — so a benefactor who builds something can have it taken into the endowment system rather than left to heirs. The parallel diwan operates a directorate whose stated task is DEVELOPING AND INVESTING WAQF FUNDS AND PROPERTIES AND FOLLOWING UP THE AFFAIRS OF TRUSTEES AND ENDOWERS — a department that exists to deal with endowers. NOW THE STRUCTURAL FACT THAT DECIDES EVERYTHING ELSE, AND NOBODY SHOULD ENDOW ANYTHING HERE WITHOUT UNDERSTANDING IT. AFTER 2003 THE MINISTRY OF ENDOWMENTS WAS DISSOLVED AND ITS FUNCTIONS SPLIT AMONG SEPARATE DIWANS BY CONFESSION, each with its own founding law. WHICH DIWAN YOUR ENDOWMENT FALLS UNDER CHANGES WHAT YOU MAY CREATE. AND THE DIFFERENCE IS NOT SMALL. LEGISLATION PERMITTED THE LIQUIDATION OF FAMILY AND MIXED ENDOWMENTS UNDER ONE DIWAN AND BARRED APPROVING NEW ONES THERE. UNDER THE OTHER, A FAMILY ENDOWMENT CONVERTS INTO A CHARITABLE ONE — ACCORDING TO ANALYSIS IN THE COUNTRY, EVEN WITHOUT THE ENDOWER'S KNOWLEDGE. A family that endows land expecting to keep control of its use may find the endowment has become charitable and passed into the diwan's administration. ASK, BEFORE SIGNING, WHICH DIWAN APPLIES, WHETHER THE FORM YOU WANT MAY LAWFULLY BE CREATED THERE, AND WHAT HAPPENS TO IT IF THE LAW CHANGES AGAIN. THE OTHER LIMITS ARE SERIOUS TOO: the same analysis describes a substantial political contest over endowment revenues since 2003, with the institutions politicised. These are state diwans, not community bodies. AND THE PROTECTION THIS FILE VALUES IN ENDOWMENT — THAT LAND CANNOT BE TAKEN BY LONG OCCUPATION OR SOLD ON — SHOULD BE VERIFIED HERE SPECIFICALLY rather than assumed from the neighbouring country where this file recorded it.

trackers.name: Tree-planting foundations and the nurseries that supply them — restoration a community can actually start
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY'S LISTING HELD SEVENTEEN ENTRIES AND NOTHING ABOUT PUTTING LAND BACK. THE MOST USEFUL FACT HERE IS THE SMALLEST ONE: AGRICULTURAL NURSERIES SUPPLY SEEDLINGS AT REDUCED PRICES, and they are the reason ordinary planting campaigns here are affordable at all. FIND YOUR NEAREST NURSERY AND ASK ITS PRICE FOR QUANTITY BEFORE YOU ASK ANYONE FOR MONEY — a costed planting proposal built on real nursery prices is a fundable document; an aspiration is not. AND THERE IS A CIVIL FOUNDATION SHOWING WHAT THAT BUILDS TO. It began a planting campaign in a war-damaged northern city in 2017 and has since put in MORE THAN FIFTY THOUSAND TREES across that province, under named campaigns for a green city and a green road. That is not a state programme — it is an organisation that started in a ruined place with nothing and now plants at scale, which is the most transferable example in this entry. THE STATE SIDE IS WORTH KNOWING BECAUSE IT IS WHERE THE MONEY AND SEEDLINGS SIT: a national initiative launched in 2023 to plant five million trees had reached three million by that summer according to the agriculture minister, following an earlier initiative for a million fruit trees. CIVIL AND ENVIRONMENTAL ORGANISATIONS RUN THE PUBLIC EDUCATION AROUND THESE CAMPAIGNS, so a local group asking to join an existing national initiative is asking for something already funded and already counted. THE SCALE OF WHAT IS BEING FOUGHT: 6,694,641 HECTARES ARE CLASSIFIED AS DESERTIFIED — FIFTEEN PER CENT OF THE COUNTRY — and official estimates put the first phase of restoration at AT LEAST THREE HUNDRED MILLION TREES, with WATER AVAILABILITY THE MAIN OBSTACLE. That last point is the one to design around: planting without a secured water source fails, and a proposal that answers the water question before the tree question is the one that survives. THE TECHNIQUE WORTH COPYING COMES FROM THE SOUTHERN MARSHES, WHERE A PILOT CONSTRUCTED WETLAND USES REEDS TO TREAT SEWAGE, restoring ecosystems while solving a sanitation problem. THIS FILE RECORDED AT R350 THAT REMOVING THE PRETEXT IS STRONGER THAN OPPOSING THE ACT — a reed bed that treats a village's wastewater removes the argument that a wetland is a health hazard to be filled, and creates habitat while doing it. AND THE PRECEDENT BEHIND ALL OF IT: the southern marshes covered around twenty thousand square kilometres until the 1970s and were then almost entirely drained — AND CAME BACK IN PART BECAUSE OF INITIATIVES LAUNCHED BY RESIDENTS THEMSELVES TO REOPEN THE WATERWAYS. By May 2026 rising water had brought herders and fishers back to areas they had abandoned. WHAT COMMUNITIES DID THERE IS THE ANSWER TO ANYONE WHO SAYS A PLACE IS TOO FAR GONE. THE LIMITS: this entry rests on national press reporting rather than the foundation's own account, so CONFIRM THE ORGANISATION IS STILL ACTIVE AND WHERE IT WORKS before approaching it. Planting is not protection — trees can be cleared unless the ground has status, so pair this with the endowment route and the biodiversity mapping recorded separately for this country. And nothing here addresses who owns the land you plant on.THE MOSUL FOUNDATION DESCRIBED ABOVE HAS SINCE GONE FURTHER THAN ANY OTHER LOCAL BODY IN THIS COUNTRY'S LISTING: IN JULY 2025 THE UNITED NATIONS GRANTED IT INTERNATIONAL OBSERVER STATUS UNDER THE CONVENTION TO COMBAT DESERTIFICATION, one of two bodies from this country to receive it. WHAT THAT STATUS DOES, IN THE ORGANISATION'S OWN ACCOUNT, IS WORTH UNDERSTANDING BECAUSE OTHER GROUPS CAN SEEK IT: it is INTERNATIONAL RECOGNITION OF LOCAL ENVIRONMENTAL WORK ON THE GROUND; it opens A WINDOW FOR INTERNATIONAL COMMUNICATION; and it allows participation in SHAPING GLOBAL POLICIES and in ISSUING JOINT STATEMENTS WITH OTHER INTERNATIONAL ORGANISATIONS. AND WHAT IT INTENDS TO USE IT FOR IS THE MODEL: CARRYING THE VOICE OF AFFECTED AREAS — naming its own province, which suffers worsening desertification and drought — INTO INTERNATIONAL DISCUSSION; DEFENDING THE COUNTRY'S RIGHT TO FINANCIAL AND TECHNICAL SUPPORT FOR COMBATING DESERTIFICATION; building partnerships with more advanced organisations to apply practical solutions locally; TRAINING YOUNG VOLUNTEERS; and supporting agricultural and water initiatives. THE LESSON FOR ANY COMMUNITY ORGANISATION IN THIS FILE: A LOCAL BODY THAT PLANTS TREES IN ONE PROVINCE CAN HOLD OBSERVER STATUS IN A UNITED NATIONS TREATY PROCESS. Accreditation of that kind is applied for, not conferred by luck, and it converts fieldwork into standing — ask what the accreditation requirements are for the conventions that cover your problem, whether desertification, wetlands, migratory species or heritage.

trackers.name: NGO directorate — where organisations are registered, and where grant calls are published
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY'S LISTING HELD RIVER MOVEMENTS, BIODIVERSITY MAPPING, COOPERATIVE FEDERATIONS, ENDOWMENT DIWANS AND A BAR REGISTER — AND NO ANSWER TO THE FIRST QUESTION A NEW GROUP ASKS: HOW DO WE BECOME AN ORGANISATION? THIS IS THE GOVERNMENT DEPARTMENT THAT REGISTERS NON-GOVERNMENTAL ORGANISATIONS, and registration is the precondition for almost everything else this file records for this country. BUT THE REASON TO WATCH IT IS THE SECOND FUNCTION: IT PUBLISHES GRANT OPPORTUNITIES. One notice invited non-governmental organisations, civil society organisations, LAW FACULTIES AND BAR ASSOCIATIONS — already registered with the government — to apply to a SMALL GRANTS PROGRAMME AIMED AT CAPACITY BUILDING, funded by an international development agency under an access-to-justice programme. READ WHO WAS ELIGIBLE THERE: LAW FACULTIES AND BAR ASSOCIATIONS. This file has recorded a bar register and university legal clinics for this country as places to find a lawyer; THAT NOTICE SHOWS THEY ARE ALSO FUNDABLE APPLICANTS. A community that wants legal capacity in its province can propose a project TO a law faculty or a bar association rather than only asking one for help — the money exists to build exactly that capacity, and the institution applies for it. THE REGISTRAR ALSO ANNOUNCES COOPERATION WITH FOREIGN ORGANISATIONS OPERATING IN THE COUNTRY, framed around building civil society capacity and delivering services to citizens — so its announcements are the public record of which international bodies are working here and under what arrangements. FOR ANYONE TRYING TO FIND A PARTNER WITH MONEY, THAT LIST IS THE STARTING POINT. WHAT TO DO: CHECK THE REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS BEFORE PLANNING ANYTHING THAT NEEDS A LEGAL PERSON, and then watch the announcements page as a funding source rather than a bureaucratic one. Where a call names your kind of body — an association, a faculty, a union — that is an invitation, and this file has found repeatedly that communities never see these notices because they look for grants on funders' sites rather than on their own government's registrar. THE LIMITS: it is a state registration authority, so it approves, monitors and can refuse; registration brings supervision as well as standing. Its grant notices are third-party programmes with their own deadlines and eligibility, and calls close. AND REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS AND PROCESSING TIMES WERE NOT VERIFIED IN THIS ROUND — confirm them directly. Use it with the bar register, the engineers union and the cooperative federations recorded separately here.

trackers.name: Proving who owns a parcel — the route for unregistered land and for registers that burned
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY'S LISTING HELD ENDOWMENT DIWANS, COOPERATIVE FEDERATIONS, RIVER MOVEMENTS AND A REGISTRAR OF ORGANISATIONS — AND NO WAY TO ANSWER THE FIRST QUESTION IN ANY LAND DISPUTE: WHO OWNS THIS GROUND, AND HOW DO I PROVE IT IS MINE. THERE IS A NAMED GOVERNMENT SERVICE FOR EXACTLY THAT, AND IT IS BUILT FOR THE HARDEST CASES — PROPERTIES NEVER ENTERED IN THE REGISTERS, AND PROPERTIES WHOSE REGISTERS AND FILES WERE BURNED IN THE EVENTS OF 2003 AND 2001. THE PROCEDURE IS THREE STEPS AND WORTH KNOWING EXACTLY. FIRST, GO TO THE REGISTRATION DIRECTORATE COVERING YOUR AREA WITH THE TITLE DEED IF YOU HAVE ONE — OR, IF YOU DO NOT, WITH ANY PRELIMINARY EVIDENCE FOR THE PROPERTY SUCH AS A BUILDING PERMIT OR ELECTRICITY RECEIPTS. SECOND, THE DIRECTORATE WRITES TO THE COMPETENT COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE FOR A JUDICIAL DECISION. THIRD, ONCE THAT DECISION IS FINAL, YOU RETURN TO THE DIRECTORATE AND THE PROPERTY IS REGISTERED. READ WHAT COUNTS AS EVIDENCE THERE, BECAUSE IT IS THE MOST IMPORTANT LINE: ELECTRICITY RECEIPTS. A HOUSEHOLD THAT HAS PAID ITS POWER BILL FOR TWENTY YEARS HOLDS PROOF OF OCCUPATION IT PROBABLY THINKS IS WORTHLESS. This payload has now found utility or tax records named as ownership evidence in three separate countries — KEEP THE BILLS, AND GET COPIES FROM THE UTILITY IF YOURS ARE GONE, because the supplier holds the other half of the record. THE LAW ADDS SOMETHING A CLAIMANT SHOULD PREPARE FOR: AN OWNERSHIP-CONFIRMATION COMMITTEE INSPECTS THE PROPERTY ON SITE, applies the descriptions in the deed or register copy TO THE ACTUAL GROUND, AND VERIFIES WHO IS IN POSSESSION where that is needed, recording rights for and against the property in a report. THE DECISION IS MADE ON THAT REPORT — SO THE SITE VISIT IS THE MOMENT THE CASE IS DECIDED, and, as this file found in two other countries, BEING PRESENT WHEN THE COMMITTEE COMES IS NOT OPTIONAL. AND IF THE DECISION GOES AGAINST YOU, OBJECTION IS BY FILING A CASE IN THE COMPETENT COURT — not by appealing inside the department, which matters for timing and for what kind of help you need. The bar register and the free legal routes recorded separately here are the ones to use at that point. THE SYSTEM IS ALSO MOVING ONLINE: AN ELECTRONIC DEED, A PROPERTY MAP, AND SERVICES FOR OPENING A PROPERTY STATEMENT, ORGANISING TRANSACTIONS AND MAKING OWNER REQUESTS have been launched, starting in six named registration directorates. A PROPERTY MAP AND A PROPERTY STATEMENT ARE EXACTLY WHAT A COMMUNITY NEEDS WHEN A DEVELOPER CLAIMS GROUND — ask whether your directorate is among those already live. THE LIMITS: this route ends in a court decision, so it takes time and costs money, and it establishes title rather than stopping a project. Coverage of the electronic services is partial and expanding. And in areas where registers were destroyed, competing claims over the same parcel are common — gather your evidence before anyone else does, because the committee decides on what it is shown.TWO PROVISIONS OF THE REGISTRATION LAW WERE NOT RECORDED HERE, AND THE FIRST PROTECTS A FAMILY FROM ITSELF: REGISTRATION IN THE NAMES OF SOME HEIRS ONLY IS NOT PERMITTED WITHOUT THE OTHERS' CONSENT, UNLESS THE APPLICANT HOLDS DOCUMENTS SUPPORTING THEIR OWN RIGHT. THAT EXISTS BECAUSE THE ATTEMPT IS COMMON. ONE BRANCH OF A FAMILY QUIETLY REGISTERING THE WHOLE HOLDING IS A WAY LAND IS LOST FROM INSIDE RATHER THAN FROM OUTSIDE — SO AN HEIR SHOULD ASK THE DIRECTORATE WHETHER ANY CLAIM IS ALREADY PENDING OVER THE FAMILY'S PARCEL, RATHER THAN ASSUMING SILENCE MEANS NOTHING IS MOVING. THE SECOND IS A SHORTER ROUTE WHERE A COURT HAS ALREADY SPOKEN: REGISTRATION MAY BE CARRIED OUT ANEW ON THE BASIS OF A FINAL JUDGMENT OF OWNERSHIP, WITHOUT THE CEREMONIES THE LAW OTHERWISE REQUIRES — SO AN OLD JUDGMENT IN A FAMILY'S FAVOUR IS WORTH FINDING BEFORE STARTING A FRESH CLAIM. ONE CAVEAT ON ALL OF IT: THE POSSESSION AND HEIRSHIP RULES COME FROM A 1971 REGISTRATION LAW AS PUBLISHED IN A REGIONAL GOVERNMENT LAW LIBRARY. THE LAW HAS BEEN AMENDED SINCE, AND PROCEDURES DIFFER BETWEEN THE FEDERAL AREA AND THE AUTONOMOUS REGION — CONFIRM AT YOUR OWN DIRECTORATE WHICH VERSION APPLIES.

trackers.name: ARC-WH — it built the World Heritage nomination file for the southern marshlands, and the file is the instrument
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE BODY THAT HELPED PUT IRAQ'S SOUTHERN MARSHLANDS ON THE WORLD HERITAGE LIST, AND IT DID IT BY RUNNING THE CAPACITY-BUILDING WORKSHOPS FOR THE NOMINATION FILE AT ITS OWN HEADQUARTERS. That matters more here than almost anywhere, because the marshes are threatened by water decisions taken upstream and outside the country — a threat no Iraqi permit process, court or objection can reach, and one of the few that an international designation can. If the place you are defending faces a cross-border or upstream threat, the World Heritage route is not a formality; it may be the only forum with standing over it. WHAT IT IS: a Category 2 Centre under the auspices of UNESCO, established as an autonomous and independent legal entity, based in Manama and serving nineteen Arab States Parties in implementing the 1972 World Heritage Convention — with the declared purpose of ensuring heritage sites are identified, protected, monitored and sustainably managed. ITS THREE STATED FUNCTIONS INCLUDE PROVIDING LOGISTIC AND FINANCIAL SUPPORT to World Heritage stakeholders in the region, alongside disseminating information and building capacity. Practical help and money, not only advice. ASK ABOUT THE TENTATIVE LIST BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE. The centre works on inventories, TENTATIVE LISTS and harmonisation to achieve balanced representation of cultural AND NATURAL sites. A place must sit on its country's Tentative List before it can ever be nominated; that listing is a national decision, far more achievable than inscription, and it puts a site on an international record years before any nomination concludes. For a marsh, a wetland or a mountain in Iraq that nobody has yet documented, that is the realistic first step. Its governing board includes representatives of the three advisory bodies that assess nominations — the international councils on monuments and sites and on museums, and the international conservation union — so the expertise that judges a file is present in the room. THE LIMIT, AND IT DECIDES HOW YOU USE THIS: it serves STATES PARTIES, not communities. A village cannot commission it. The route in is to get your national heritage authority to seek its support, or to reach it through a body that already works with it — in Iraq, the survey organisation recorded in this file has worked on field surveys arranged with this centre, which makes it the practical intermediary. Founding date appears as both 2010 and 2012 across its own and UNESCO's materials.

trackers.name: Antiquities and heritage authority — approval is required to build beside a site, and silence counts as refusal
trackers.desc: ONE RULE HERE IS THE OPPOSITE OF EVERY OTHER PERMIT SYSTEM IN THIS MAP AND IS WORTH KNOWING BY HEART: THE ANTIQUITIES AUTHORITY MUST GIVE ITS OPINION ON A BUILDING PERMIT APPLICATION WITHIN SIXTY DAYS, AND IF IT DOES NOT, THE LAPSE OF THAT PERIOD IS DEEMED A DECISION OF REFUSAL. SILENCE REFUSES THE PERMIT. Everywhere else this file has looked, an authority that says nothing lets the project through; here, delay defeats it. THE UNDERLYING REQUIREMENT IS BROAD: BUILDING PERMITS FOR PLACES ADJOINING ARCHAEOLOGICAL SITES INSIDE INHABITED AREAS MAY BE ISSUED ONLY AFTER THE AUTHORITY'S APPROVAL, and the permit must carry whatever conditions the authority thinks necessary so that the building DOES NOT OVERSHADOW THE ANTIQUITY OR SPOIL ITS APPEARANCE AND SECURES AN APPROPRIATE PROTECTIVE PERIMETER, having regard to the archaeological and historical surroundings. SO THE FIRST QUESTION ABOUT A SCHEME NEXT TO ANY OLD SITE IS WHETHER THE ANTIQUITIES AUTHORITY WAS ASKED AT ALL — AND IF IT WAS, WHETHER IT ANSWERED WITHIN SIXTY DAYS. Both are documentary facts, and either answer helps you. THERE IS ALSO A POWER TO BURDEN THE LAND AROUND A SITE: THE SUPREME PLANNING COUNCIL MAY, ON THE MINISTER'S PROPOSAL, IMPOSE EASEMENT RIGHTS OVER PROPERTIES NEIGHBOURING ARCHAEOLOGICAL SITES AND BUILDINGS, WITHIN THE ANTIQUITY'S PERIMETER, TO PRESERVE THEIR CHARACTER OR GENERAL APPEARANCE, AGAINST FAIR COMPENSATION — the decision naming the properties, the scope of the right and the restrictions on the owner. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED SERVITUDES ELSEWHERE AS SOMETHING A COMMUNITY NEGOTIATES; HERE THE STATE CAN IMPOSE THEM TO PROTECT A SETTING, AND COMPENSATION IS PAYABLE. AND THE EMERGENCY LEVER IS THE PART TO USE WHEN MACHINERY IS ALREADY ON SITE: THE MINISTER OR HIS DELEGATE ISSUES A DECISION TO STOP ENCROACHMENT WORKS ON ANY ARCHAEOLOGICAL SITE OR PROPERTY IMMEDIATELY UPON A VIOLATION REPORT BEING DRAWN UP, pending a removal decision. THE TRIGGER IS THE WRITTEN VIOLATION REPORT — so the practical task is to get one drawn up, which is what reporting to the authority's local office is for. THE BODY ITSELF IS A GENERAL AUTHORITY FOR ANTIQUITIES AND HERITAGE, ESTABLISHED BY LAW IN 2000 AND LINKED TO THE CULTURE MINISTRY, WITH LEGAL PERSONALITY AND FINANCIAL AND ADMINISTRATIVE INDEPENDENCE, charged with discovering, REGISTERING, protecting and maintaining sites across the country. NOW THE PART THAT KEEPS THIS HONEST. AN INVESTIGATION PUBLISHED SHORTLY BEFORE THIS ENTRY REPORTS THAT INVESTORS BUY PROPERTY SHARES INSIDE LANDS CONTAINING ARCHAEOLOGICAL SITES AT LOW PRICES, ESTABLISH THEIR OWNERSHIP LEGALLY, AND ONLY THEN APPLY FOR APPROVALS — and that in one governorate approvals for SAND QUARRIES were granted WITHOUT PRIOR EXCAVATION OR REFERRAL TO THE AUTHORITY AT ALL. The authority did not answer the outlet's request for comment. THAT IS THE REAL CONTEST: THE LAW IS STRONG AND THE PRACTICE IS BEING ROUTED AROUND IT. WHICH MEANS THE USEFUL ACT IS DOCUMENTARY — ESTABLISH EARLY WHETHER A REFERRAL WAS MADE, whether an excavation preceded the approval, and who bought which share and when. Read this with the land-ownership route and the free legal routes recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Regional Arabic crowdfunding — five per cent on success, and the payout question to settle first
trackers.desc: OUTSIDE ONE COUNTRY, THIS FILE HAD RECORDED NO WAY FOR AN ARABIC-SPEAKING COMMUNITY TO RAISE MONEY FROM THE PUBLIC FOR A CAMPAIGN. A REGIONAL PLATFORM BASED IN LEBANON TAKES PROJECT PITCHES FROM ARAB CREATORS FOR FUNDING BY SUPPORTERS ANYWHERE IN THE WORLD, AND IS LISTED ON A UNITED NATIONS REGIONAL COMMISSION'S SMALL-BUSINESS FINANCING PORTAL. ITS COMMISSION IS THE LOWEST RECORDED ANYWHERE IN THIS PAYLOAD: FIVE PER CENT, AND ONLY ON SUCCESSFUL PROJECTS. Set against the six and nine per cent plus tax recorded in another country's platforms, that is a material difference on any sum a community is likely to raise — AND THE RATE IS THE FIRST THING TO COMPARE WHEN CHOOSING BETWEEN PLATFORMS. IT RUNS THE ALL-OR-NOTHING MODEL: A TARGET AND A DEADLINE, WITH REWARD TIERS THAT RISE WITH THE PLEDGE. THAT MODEL PUNISHES OVER-AMBITIOUS TARGETS — miss it and you keep nothing — so set the figure at what the campaign genuinely needs for its next stage, not at the total cost of the fight. AND THE REWARD TIERS ARE WORTH THINKING ABOUT PROPERLY FOR A LAND CAMPAIGN, BECAUSE WHAT A COMMUNITY HAS TO OFFER IS PARTICULAR: A NAMED PLACE, ITS PRODUCE, ITS CRAFT, ITS RECORDS. Small pledges can be acknowledged publicly; larger ones can bring a visit, a share of a harvest, or a copy of the documentation the campaign produces — things a village can give and a distant supporter cannot buy elsewhere. THE PLATFORM'S OWN RECORDED SUCCESSES INCLUDE A CITY-BASED CAMPAIGN THAT RAISED MONEY FOR SMALL BUSINESSES HIT BY AN ECONOMIC CRISIS — A PLACE-BASED COLLECTIVE APPEAL RATHER THAN A SINGLE PRODUCT. That is the shape a community defending a valley or a coastline should copy: the place is the project. THERE ARE ALTERNATIVES IN THE SAME MARKET — a creative-projects platform running since 2012, another general Arabic platform, and an EQUITY-BASED REGIONAL PLATFORM for ventures rather than causes. IF ONE PLATFORM REFUSES A CAMPAIGN, ANOTHER MAY TAKE IT, and this file recorded last round that platforms do refuse campaigns on contested subjects. NOW THE TWO CAUTIONS, AND THEY ARE SERIOUS ENOUGH TO CHECK BEFORE ANY WORK IS DONE. FIRST, MOST OF THE MATERIAL DESCRIBING THIS PLATFORM IS SEVERAL YEARS OLD AND ITS CURRENT OPERATING STATUS WAS NOT ESTABLISHED IN THIS ROUND — confirm it is live and check the current commission before building a plan on it. SECOND, AND THIS IS THE ONE THAT STRANDS CAMPAIGNS: REGIONAL PLATFORMS COMMONLY RESTRICT WHICH COUNTRIES THEY CAN PAY OUT TO. A CAMPAIGN CAN BE ACCEPTED, SUCCEED, AND THE MONEY STILL BE UNREACHABLE where banking or sanctions arrangements do not permit transfer. SETTLE THE PAYOUT QUESTION IN WRITING WITH THE PLATFORM BEFORE LAUNCHING, and ask specifically how funds reach a recipient in your country and what documents the recipient must hold. Read this with the endowment, cooperative and NGO-registration routes recorded separately for this country, which are the vehicles that can receive money lawfully.

trackers.name: Municipal property auctions — the notice, the deposits, and the route by which an association takes premises without bidding
trackers.desc: THE MOST VALUABLE THING IN THIS ENTRY IS THE ROUTE THAT AVOIDS THE AUCTION ALTOGETHER. MUNICIPAL PROPERTY MAY BE LEASED WITHOUT PUBLIC AUCTION TO GOVERNMENT INTERESTS, OFFICIAL AND SEMI-OFFICIAL INSTITUTIONS, TRADE UNIONS, FEDERATIONS, ORGANISATIONS AND ASSOCIATIONS — FOR USE AS OFFICES OR HEADQUARTERS FOR THE PURPOSES SET OUT IN THEIR FOUNDING INSTRUMENTS — with the monthly rent assessed by a committee and subject to ministerial approval. A REGISTERED ASSOCIATION CAN TAKE MUNICIPAL PREMISES WITHOUT BIDDING AGAINST ANYONE. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED PREMISES AS AN OBSTACLE FOR COMMUNITY GROUPS ACROSS TWENTY-THREE COUNTRIES AND HAS NOT FOUND THIS ROUTE ANYWHERE ELSE. Note the condition it turns on: THE PURPOSES STATED IN THE FOUNDING INSTRUMENT — so an association whose constitution names environmental protection, heritage or agricultural work can ask for premises for that purpose, and one whose constitution is vague cannot. FOR EVERYTHING ELSE THERE IS THE PUBLIC AUCTION, AND ITS TIMETABLE IS PRECISE. THE CITY AUTHORITY PUBLISHES A NUMBERED NOTICE THROUGH ITS PROPERTY DEPARTMENT AND VALUATION SECTION, LISTING THE PROPERTIES AND THE PERIOD OFFERED AGAINST EACH ITEM, WITH THE AUCTION HELD AT ELEVEN IN THE MORNING ON THE THIRTIETH DAY FOLLOWING PUBLICATION IN A NAMED HALL — AND IF THAT DAY FALLS ON AN OFFICIAL HOLIDAY, THE FIRST WORKING DAY AFTER IT. THIRTY DAYS FROM PUBLICATION IS THE WHOLE WINDOW. THAT IS THE PERIOD IN WHICH A COMMUNITY MUST DECIDE, RAISE ITS DEPOSIT AND ASSEMBLE ITS DOCUMENTS — which is why the previous round recorded that the money and the constituted body must exist before the notice appears. THE NOTICE ALSO TELLS BIDDERS TO INSPECT THE PROPERTIES BEFORE ENTERING THE AUCTION. TAKE THAT LITERALLY: THE INSPECTION IS THE ONLY LAWFUL OPPORTUNITY TO SEE WHAT IS ACTUALLY THERE, AND IT IS OPEN TO ANYONE CONSIDERING BIDDING. WHAT IT COSTS TO TAKE PART IS PUBLISHED: FOR A SALE, LEGAL SECURITIES OF TWENTY PER CENT OF THE ESTIMATED TOTAL PRICE, BROUGHT WITHIN THIRTY DAYS OF PUBLICATION.
