FOR A LEASE, MAINTENANCE SECURITIES OF TEN PER CENT OF THE ANNUAL RENT, RETURNED AFTER THE CONTRACT ENDS IF NOTHING IS OWED. THE DOCUMENTS REQUIRED INCLUDE A CERTIFICATE OF NON-CONVICTION FROM THE CRIMINAL EVIDENCE DIRECTORATE, A RESIDENCE CARD AND CIVIL STATUS IDENTITY — and the certificate takes time to obtain, so get it before a notice appears rather than after. TWO FURTHER TERMS MATTER: THE SUCCESSFUL BIDDER BEARS THE SERVICE FEES AND ALL EXPENSES, so the hammer price is not the whole cost; AND CERTAIN PUBLIC EMPLOYEES ARE BARRED FROM PARTICIPATING, which is worth knowing when the winner turns out to be connected to the authority selling. THE LIMITS: these are the terms of disposal, not a right to object — the municipality is the landlord and the seller. Notices appear in newspapers and on institutional pages rather than in one central place, so watching requires knowing which bodies publish; state banks, universities and municipalities all run their own. Terms differ between authorities and the figures here come from particular notices. Read it with the property-proof route, the antiquities authority and the free legal routes recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Government contracts department — the blacklist that moves in public, the annual contracting plan, and the duty to publish in two languages
trackers.desc: THE PLANNING MINISTRY'S CIRCULARS FOR A SINGLE MONTH INCLUDE ONE ON THE INCLUSION OF COMPANIES AND OFFICES IN THE BLACKLIST AND ANOTHER ON THEIR REMOVAL FROM IT — EACH NUMBERED AND DATED. SO THE DEBARMENT LIST MOVES IN PUBLIC. YOU CAN SEE NOT ONLY WHO IS BARRED FROM GOVERNMENT WORK BUT WHEN THEY WERE BARRED AND WHEN THEY WERE LET BACK — which is a different and more useful thing than a static list, because it dates the decision and lets a community ask what changed. THIS IS THE SECOND DEBARMENT LIST THIS FILE HAS RECORDED, AND THE FIRST WHOSE MOVEMENTS ARE THEMSELVES PUBLISHED. THE SAME PAGE CARRIES THE INSTRUCTIONS FOR IMPLEMENTING GOVERNMENT CONTRACTS AND THEIR CONTROLS, THE AUTHORITY TO EXCEPT A CONTRACT FROM THE CONDITIONS OF THE STANDARD DOCUMENTS, AND A REQUIREMENT THAT FINANCIAL COMPETENCE BE CHECKED THROUGH THE CENTRAL BANK'S DIGITAL PLATFORM. THE EXCEPTION CIRCULAR IS THE ONE TO NOTICE: WHERE A CONTRACT DEPARTS FROM THE STANDARD DOCUMENTS, SOMEBODY HAD TO AUTHORISE THAT DEPARTURE. THE RULES LIBRARY CONTAINS SOMETHING THIS FILE HAS SEEN NOWHERE ELSE: GUIDES TO THE COMMON ERRORS OF THE CONTRACTORS SECTION AND OF THE AGREEMENTS DIVISION — THE MINISTRY PUBLISHING WHAT APPLICANTS HABITUALLY GET WRONG. A LOCAL COOPERATIVE PREPARING A BID OR A CLASSIFICATION APPLICATION SHOULD READ THE ERRORS GUIDE BEFORE THE RULES, because it is the shortest route to a complete file. ALONGSIDE IT SIT THE CONTRACTOR CLASSIFICATION INSTRUCTIONS, THE WHITE LIST CONTROLS, AND THE LICENSING RULES FOR NON-GOVERNMENTAL CONSULTING OFFICES — so both the contractors and the consultants who write studies are licensed and graded here, as this file has now found in six countries. WHAT THE CONTRACTING GUIDE REQUIRES OF THE AUTHORITY IS WHERE A COMMUNITY GETS ITS LEVERAGE. NEEDS MUST BE DETERMINED THROUGH A TECHNICAL AND ECONOMIC FEASIBILITY STUDY, WITHIN AN ANNUAL CONTRACTING PLAN. THE ANNOUNCEMENT MUST BE PUBLISHED IN ARABIC AND KURDISH AT LEAST, AND IN A FURTHER LANGUAGE WHERE BIDS FROM OUTSIDE THE COUNTRY ARE EXPECTED. FULL INFORMATION MUST BE GIVEN — TERMS, CONDITIONS AND THE DELIVERY SCHEDULE — AND ALL THE FACTORS THAT ENABLE BIDDERS TO ESTIMATE THE PRICE MUST BE SHOWN. TWO OF THOSE ARE DIRECTLY USABLE. THE ANNUAL CONTRACTING PLAN MEANS THE YEAR'S INTENDED CONTRACTS EXIST AS A DOCUMENT BEFORE ANY OF THEM IS ADVERTISED — ASK FOR IT BY NAME. AND THE FEASIBILITY STUDY MEANS SOMEONE HAS ALREADY WRITTEN DOWN WHY THE PROJECT IS NEEDED AND WHAT IT WILL COST. BIDDERS MUST ALSO BE GIVEN THE CHANCE TO REQUEST CLARIFICATIONS ABOUT A TENDER, WITH A FIXED PERIOD FOR THE REPLY — a written question-and-answer channel attached to a live tender, of the kind this file recorded in another Gulf country. AND THE AWARD ITSELF PASSES THROUGH A CENTRAL COMMITTEE FOR REVIEW AND RATIFICATION, WITH BID OPENING AND ANALYSIS COMMITTEES BENEATH IT, so there are named bodies rather than a single official. THE LIMITS: this is the ministry that regulates contracting, NOT AN ALLY — nothing here creates a right to object to a project, and the instructions bind authorities rather than giving outsiders standing. Whether the blacklist itself, the annual contracting plans and the feasibility studies are publicly downloadable, or only referenced in circulars, WAS NOT VERIFIED. Read it with the municipal auction routes, the antiquities authority and the ownership-proof route recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Federation of agricultural cooperative societies — local unions in every governorate, and a seat on the district committee that decides farm disputes
trackers.desc: THE MOST USEFUL FACT ABOUT THIS FEDERATION IS NOT WHAT IT SAYS BUT WHERE IT SITS: A REPRESENTATIVE OF THE PEASANT SOCIETIES' FEDERATION IS A MEMBER OF THE COMMITTEE FORMED IN EACH ADMINISTRATIVE UNIT — CHAIRED BY THE HEAD OF THE DISTRICT OR SUB-DISTRICT, WITH A REPRESENTATIVE OF AGRARIAN REFORM — WHICH INVESTIGATES AND DECIDES DISPUTES OVER AGRICULTURAL RELATIONS. THAT COMMITTEE CAN ALSO PLACE TEMPORARY ATTACHMENT ON THE DISPUTED CROPS AND PRESERVE THEM UNTIL THE DISPUTE IS DECIDED, AND ITS DECISIONS MAY BE OBJECTED TO BEFORE THE GOVERNORATE OBJECTIONS COMMITTEE. SO THE FARMERS' OWN BODY HOLDS A SEAT ON THE PANEL THAT DECIDES FARM DISPUTES IN EVERY DISTRICT. THIS FILE HAS SAID REPEATEDLY THAT THE ROUTE FROM A LOCAL PROBLEM TO AN OFFICIAL DECISION RUNS THROUGH WHOEVER HOLDS THE SEAT — HERE THE SEAT BELONGS TO AN ORGANISATION A FARMER CAN JOIN. FIND THE LOCAL UNION FOR YOUR GOVERNORATE AND ASK WHO ITS REPRESENTATIVE ON THE DISTRICT COMMITTEE IS. THAT IS A SHORTER AND MORE PRECISE QUESTION THAN ANYTHING ADDRESSED TO A MINISTRY. THE FEDERATION IS ACTIVE NOW AND ITS AGENDA ALREADY COVERS THE RIGHT SUBJECTS. IN JULY 2026 IT AND A GOVERNORATE AGRICULTURE DIRECTORATE DISCUSSED DEVELOPING JOINT WORK TO SUPPORT AGRICULTURAL PROJECTS, UNIFY EFFORTS TO ADDRESS THE CHALLENGES FACING FARMERS AND REMOVE OBSTACLES — AND ITS DEPUTY HEAD STATED AN INTEREST IN STRENGTHENING PARTNERSHIP WITH THE AGRICULTURE DIRECTORATES IN ALL GOVERNORATES. WHAT ITS LOCAL UNIONS PUT TO MINISTERS IS EXACTLY WHAT THIS MAP IS ABOUT: CONTRACTS AND THE RECLAMATION OF AGRICULTURAL LAND, WATER SCARCITY, AND THE SALINITY OF AGRICULTURAL LAND. A COMMUNITY WHOSE GROUND IS BEING TAKEN, DRIED OUT OR SALTED IS RAISING THE FEDERATION'S OWN SUBJECT, NOT A NEW ONE — AND LAND CONTRACTS ARE ALREADY A STANDING ITEM. IT ALSO RUNS A PUBLIC PAGE FOLLOWED BY TENS OF THOUSANDS, WHICH IN A COUNTRY WHERE OFFICIAL SITES ARE PATCHY IS THE PRACTICAL CHANNEL — the same pattern this file has recorded in five other countries. THE LIMITS: this is a FEDERATION THAT WORKS WITH THE MINISTRY AND THE DIRECTORATES, NOT AGAINST THEM — its language is partnership, obstacles and support, and it will not oppose a state project. ITS SEAT ON THE DISTRICT COMMITTEE CONCERNS DISPUTES OVER AGRICULTURAL RELATIONS — tenancy, cropping and the like — AND WHETHER THAT REACHES A DISPUTE WITH A DEVELOPER OR AN AUTHORITY WAS NOT VERIFIED. The committee structure comes from agrarian legislation of an earlier era and its present operation was not confirmed; the current activity is from press reporting. Read it with the government contracts department, the municipal auction routes and the river movement recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Environmental police directorate and the ministry hotline — judicial investigation of violating projects, and a published count of river encroachments
trackers.desc: MOST ENFORCEMENT BODIES IN THIS FILE INSPECT AND FINE. THIS COUNTRY HAS A POLICE DIRECTORATE FOR THE ENVIRONMENT THAT TAKES PEOPLE TO COURT — AND IT PUBLISHES ITS NUMBERS. IN THE FIRST HALF OF 2026 ALONE, THE ENVIRONMENTAL POLICE DIRECTORATE CONDUCTED JUDICIAL INVESTIGATIONS INTO FOUR HUNDRED AND THIRTY-THREE VIOLATING PROJECTS UNDER THE ENVIRONMENT PROTECTION AND IMPROVEMENT LAW, ARRESTED FORTY-FIVE ACCUSED PERSONS FOR BREACHING ENVIRONMENTAL INSTRUCTIONS AND CONTROLS, AND REFERRED THEM TO THE JUDICIARY. FOUR HUNDRED AND THIRTY-THREE PROJECTS INVESTIGATED IN SIX MONTHS IS A WORKING ENFORCEMENT MACHINE, NOT A PAPER ONE. A COMMUNITY WITH A VIOLATING FACILITY BESIDE IT IS NOT ASKING FOR AN EXCEPTION — IT IS ASKING FOR THE FOUR HUNDRED AND THIRTY-FOURTH CASE. ITS STATED PURPOSES TELL YOU WHAT IT WILL ACT ON: REDUCING AIR, WATER AND SOIL POLLUTANTS, AND PREVENTING TRADE IN ENDANGERED SPECIES. SO POLLUTION AND WILDLIFE TRAFFICKING ARE BOTH INSIDE ITS REMIT, AND A REPORT SHOULD BE FRAMED AS ONE OF THOSE TWO RATHER THAN AS A PLANNING GRIEVANCE. ON THE MINISTRY SIDE, ITS MONITORING TEAMS COUNT THINGS THAT MATTER FOR LAND. IN 2026 THEY RECORDED EIGHTY-SIX ENCROACHMENTS ON RIVERS AND DRAINS WITHIN THE CAPITAL'S BOUNDARIES, AND THE MINISTRY PROPOSED REMEDIES INCLUDING COMPACT AND VERTICAL TREATMENT UNITS, COORDINATING WITH THE WATER RESOURCES MINISTRY TO FIND SUITABLE AREAS INSIDE THE RIVER BASINS. IT ALSO WARNED OF CLOSURE AND FINES. A PUBLISHED COUNT OF ENCROACHMENTS ON RIVERS AND DRAINS IS AN INVENTORY OF EXACTLY THE THING COMMUNITIES REPORT AND ARE TOLD IS UNKNOWN. ASK WHETHER THE ENCROACHMENT BESIDE YOU IS ON THAT LIST — AND IF IT IS NOT, THAT IS THE OMISSION TO PUT IN WRITING, BECAUSE THE LIST IS THE MINISTRY'S OWN. AND IT CAN BE REACHED WITHOUT INTRODUCTION: A HOTLINE NUMBER PUBLISHED FOR USE ACROSS THREE MOBILE NETWORKS, A STREET ADDRESS IN THE CAPITAL, AND AN OFFICIAL PAGE FOLLOWED BY SOME HUNDRED AND TWENTY-NINE THOUSAND PEOPLE. THE PAGE MATTERS AS MUCH AS THE PHONE LINE. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED IN SIX COUNTRIES THAT WHERE OFFICIAL WEBSITES ARE PATCHY, THE MINISTRY'S SOCIAL PAGE IS THE WORKING CHANNEL — AND A REPORT MADE THERE IS VISIBLE TO OTHER READERS IN A WAY A TELEPHONE CALL IS NOT. SO THE SEQUENCE HERE IS: REPORT TO THE ENVIRONMENTAL POLICE AS A POLLUTION OFFENCE WITH DATES AND PHOTOGRAPHS; ASK THE MINISTRY WHETHER THE SITE APPEARS IN ITS ENCROACHMENT MONITORING; AND KEEP THE CASE NUMBER, BECAUSE A JUDICIAL INVESTIGATION PRODUCES A FILE THAT OUTLASTS ANY OFFICIAL'S TENURE. THE LIMITS: this is A POLICE AND REGULATORY ROUTE, NOT A PLANNING ONE — it addresses violations of environmental requirements, NOT WHETHER A PROJECT SHOULD HAVE BEEN APPROVED, and nothing here creates a right to object. THE FIGURES COME FROM AN INTERIOR MINISTRY ANNOUNCEMENT AND PRESS COVERAGE, and outcomes of the referrals are not stated — arrests and referrals are not convictions. Enforcement reach varies sharply between governorates and areas of control. Read it with the river movement, the bar register and assignment bodies, the farmers' federation and the government contracts department recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Regional environment board — its consent gates every project, and its published guidelines include project supervision and laboratory fees
trackers.desc: ONE RULE HERE IS WORTH MORE THAN ANY COMPLAINT ROUTE THIS FILE HAS RECORDED FOR THIS COUNTRY: NO PROJECT MAY BEGIN WORK WITHOUT THE CONSENT OF THE ENVIRONMENT PROTECTION AND IMPROVEMENT BOARD. THAT WAS AGREED AS A COORDINATION ARRANGEMENT BETWEEN THE INVESTMENT AUTHORITY AND THE BOARD, SO THE ENVIRONMENTAL CONSENT SITS UPSTREAM OF THE INVESTMENT APPROVAL RATHER THAN AFTER IT. SO THE FIRST QUESTION ABOUT ANY SCHEME IN THIS REGION IS SIMPLY WHETHER THE BOARD HAS CONSENTED, AND WHEN. IF WORK HAS STARTED WITHOUT THAT CONSENT, THE OBJECTION IS NOT ABOUT ECOLOGY AT ALL — IT IS THAT A REQUIRED APPROVAL IS MISSING, WHICH IS THE KIND OF POINT AN ADMINISTRATION ACTS ON. TWO MORE CONDITIONS COME WITH IT, AND BOTH ARE UNUSUALLY CONCRETE: OWNERS OF HOUSING PROJECTS ARE OBLIGED TO PROVIDE A GREEN BELT, AND SEVENTEEN AND A HALF PER CENT OF THE REAL VALUE OF THE LAND IS TAKEN FROM INVESTORS FOR THE CREATION OF GREEN SPACE. A FIXED PERCENTAGE OF LAND VALUE COLLECTED FOR GREENERY IS A FUND WITH A NUMBER ATTACHED. ASK WHERE THAT MONEY WENT FOR THE DEVELOPMENT NEAR YOU, AND WHETHER THE GREEN BELT IT WAS COLLECTED FOR EXISTS ON THE GROUND — THIS FILE HAS FOUND REPEATEDLY THAT OBLIGATIONS ATTACHED TO APPROVALS ARE THE EASIEST THING TO PROVE UNPERFORMED. THE BOARD PUBLISHES ITS GUIDELINES, AND THE LIST TELLS A COMMUNITY WHAT IT REGULATES. GUIDELINE NUMBER ONE OF 2022 COVERS THE ENVIRONMENTAL SUPERVISION OF PROJECTS; NUMBER TWO COVERS THE KEEPING OF WILD ANIMALS AND BIRDS; NUMBER FOUR COVERS PROTECTION OF THE OZONE LAYER FROM THE GASES THAT AFFECT IT; AND NUMBER FIVE COVERS THE IMPORT, TRANSPORT, STORAGE, COMPLIANT USE AND RE-EXPORT OF RADIOACTIVE SOURCES. ENVIRONMENTAL SUPERVISION OF PROJECTS IS THE ONE TO READ FIRST. A PUBLISHED SUPERVISION GUIDELINE TELLS YOU WHAT THE BOARD IS SUPPOSED TO BE CHECKING DURING CONSTRUCTION AND OPERATION — WHICH CONVERTS A VAGUE SENSE THAT SOMETHING IS WRONG INTO A LIST OF SPECIFIC CHECKS THAT EITHER HAPPENED OR DID NOT. AND ONE GUIDELINE IS QUIETLY THE MOST USEFUL OF ALL: NUMBER FIVE OF 2023, DETERMINING THE FEE RATES FOR LABORATORY INSPECTION. A PUBLISHED PRICE LIST FOR TESTING MEANS THE COST OF ANALYSIS IS KNOWABLE IN ADVANCE, NOT NEGOTIABLE OR OPAQUE — THE SINGLE QUESTION THIS FILE HAS MOST OFTEN BEEN UNABLE TO ANSWER FOR COMMUNITIES. ITS CASEWORK SHOWS IT HANDLES HEAVY INDUSTRY, NOT JUST PAPERWORK: INSPECTION OF DECOMMISSIONED EQUIPMENT AT A STEEL PLANT, CONSENT FOR ESTABLISHING A STORE OF RADIOACTIVE SOURCES, AND SUPERVISING AND PROHIBITING GASES THAT DAMAGE THE OZONE LAYER. THE LIMITS: this is A REGIONAL REGULATOR COVERING ONE REGION OF THE COUNTRY, NOT THE WHOLE OF IT — and its arrangement with the investment authority is framed as FACILITATION FOR ENVIRONMENT-FRIENDLY PROJECTS, so consent is a gate the board operates, not a veto communities hold. NOTHING HERE CREATES A RIGHT TO OBJECT, and whether consent decisions, supervision reports or the green-space fund accounts are obtainable by residents WAS NOT VERIFIED. The green-belt and percentage terms come from a government media statement rather than a published regulation, and may have changed. Read it with the environmental police directorate, the ministry hotline, the bar assignment bodies and the farmers' federation recorded separately for this country.TWO POWERS ADDED IN FEBRUARY 2026 WERE NOT RECORDED HERE, AND THEY CHANGE WHERE A COMPLAINT SHOULD GO. FIRST, THE ENVIRONMENT DIRECTORATES IN FIVE NAMED CITIES AND ADMINISTRATIONS — AND SEPARATELY IN THREE OTHERS, UNDER A SECOND BOARD ORDER OF THE SAME DATE — MAY NOW IMPOSE FINANCIAL PENALTIES FOR ENVIRONMENTAL VIOLATIONS OF UP TO EIGHT MILLION DINARS, ACCORDING TO THE TYPE AND SIZE OF THE VIOLATION AND IN COORDINATION WITH THE INTERNAL SECURITY FORCES IN THEIR AREAS. WHERE A LARGER PENALTY IS NEEDED, THE CASE IS REFERRED TO THE BOARD AS QUICKLY AS POSSIBLE. SO THE FINE CAN NOW BE IMPOSED LOCALLY, WITHOUT THE CASE TRAVELLING. THE ADDRESS FOR A POLLUTING FACTORY, A DUMPING SITE OR A QUARRY IS THE ENVIRONMENT DIRECTORATE IN YOUR OWN CITY — AND STATING THAT THE HARM IS LARGE IS WHAT TRIGGERS REFERRAL UPWARDS RATHER THAN A TOKEN PENALTY. SECOND, THE ENFORCEMENT CHAIN IS NOW SPELLED OUT: THE INTERNAL SECURITY FORCES — SECURITY, POLICE, TRAFFIC POLICE, CIVIL DEFENCE, AND THE FOREST AND ENVIRONMENT POLICE, THE ENVIRONMENT PROTECTION FORCE — COORDINATE FULLY WITH THE COMMITTEE FOR THE PROTECTION AND IMPROVEMENT OF THE ENVIRONMENT, CHAIRED BY THE GOVERNOR OR THE ADMINISTRATOR OF THE INDEPENDENT ADMINISTRATIONS, AND WITH THE ENVIRONMENT DIRECTORATES, TO ARREST ANYONE VIOLATING ENVIRONMENTAL LAWS AND POLLUTING NATURE. THE GOVERNOR CHAIRING THAT COMMITTEE IS THE USEFUL PART: IT PUTS THE HIGHEST LOCAL OFFICEHOLDER IN THE CHAIR OF THE BODY THAT COORDINATES ENFORCEMENT, SO A DELEGATION THAT REACHES THE GOVERNOR'S OFFICE IS REACHING THE COMMITTEE ITSELF. AND ONE CAUTION THAT COMES WITH THE SAME CHAIN: AN ENFORCEMENT SYSTEM THAT ENDS IN ARREST CAN BE TURNED ON VILLAGERS AS EASILY AS ON COMPANIES — FIREWOOD CUTTING AND GRAZING ARE ENVIRONMENTAL OFFENCES TOO.WHO ENFORCES WHAT THIS BOARD DECIDES WAS NOT RECORDED HERE, AND IT CHANGED IN 2026. GOVERNORS AND THE ADMINISTRATORS OF THE INDEPENDENT ADMINISTRATIONS ARE NOW INSTRUCTED TO HOLD A MONTHLY MEETING OF THE ENVIRONMENT PROTECTION AND IMPROVEMENT COMMITTEE, TO DIRECT THEIR TEAMS TO IMPLEMENT THE LAWS AND RULES, TO SPREAD ENVIRONMENTAL AWARENESS CONTINUOUSLY, AND TO IMPOSE PENALTIES ON ANYONE WHO BREACHES THE LAWS AND GUIDELINES AND POLLUTES OR DAMAGES THE ENVIRONMENT. A COMMITTEE THAT MUST MEET EVERY MONTH, CHAIRED BY THE GOVERNOR, IS TWELVE CHANCES A YEAR TO PUT A QUARRY, A DUMP OR A BURNING ORCHARD IN FRONT OF SOMEONE WHO CAN ORDER SOMETHING DONE. MOST COMMUNITIES IN THIS FILE WOULD SETTLE FOR ONE. THE ENFORCERS ARE NAMED TOO: THE INTERNAL SECURITY FORCES - SECURITY, POLICE, TRAFFIC POLICE, CIVIL DEFENCE, AND THE FOREST AND ENVIRONMENT POLICE OR ENVIRONMENT PROTECTION FORCE - ARE TO COORDINATE FULLY WITH THAT COMMITTEE AND WITH THE ENVIRONMENT DEPARTMENTS TO ARREST ANYONE BREACHING THE ENVIRONMENTAL LAWS AND POLLUTING NATURE. A FOREST AND ENVIRONMENT POLICE IS A UNIFORMED BODY TO CALL WHEN TREES ARE CUT OR WASTE IS TIPPED, NOT ONLY A MINISTRY TO WRITE TO. THE ORDER BEHIND IT IS DATED AND NUMBERED, WHICH MAKES IT CITABLE: A LETTER NUMBERED 11255 OF 23 APRIL 2026, SIGNED BY THE INTERIOR MINISTER, DIRECTING THE GOVERNORATES AND INDEPENDENT ADMINISTRATIONS, THE POLICE, CIVIL DEFENCE, THE ENVIRONMENT AND FOREST POLICE AND THE TRAFFIC POLICE TO TAKE PRACTICAL MEASURES IN COORDINATION WITH THIS BOARD AND TO IMPOSE FINANCIAL PENALTIES ACCORDING TO LAW ON ANY PERSON OR PARTY THAT POLLUTES — RESTING ON THE ARGUMENT THAT THE REGION'S ENVIRONMENT AND TOURIST SITES ARE COUNTED AS PART OF PUBLIC PROPERTY THE INTERIOR MINISTRY MUST PROTECT. ONE MEASURED PROGRAMME BELONGS BESIDE IT: TO REDUCE THE DANGER OF FIRE AMONG THE FORESTS, VINEYARDS, ORCHARDS AND FIELDS, THIRTY-FOUR MILLION METRES OF ARTIFICIAL FIREBREAKS HAVE BEEN PUT IN PLACE BY MACHINE ACROSS THE WHOLE REGION, ALONGSIDE CLEARING LAND OF PLANTED MINES — SO THE ASK IN ANY FIRE-PRONE DISTRICT IS HOW MANY METRES WERE CUT HERE, WHEN, AND WHO MAINTAINS THEM.

trackers.name: Water resources ministry and its governorate directorates — a dated national campaign against irrigation encroachments, and the field teams that already remove them
trackers.desc: A COMMUNITY WHOSE WATER IS BEING TAKEN UPSTREAM USUALLY HAS NO IDEA WHEN ANYONE MIGHT ACT. HERE THERE IS A DATE: THE MINISTER DIRECTED THAT THE FIRST OF NOVEMBER 2026 BE ADOPTED AS THE LAUNCH OF A MAJOR NATIONAL CAMPAIGN TO REMOVE ENCROACHMENTS ON THE IRRIGATION SYSTEM — INCLUDING ENCROACHING FISH LAKES — TO ACHIEVE JUSTICE IN WATER DISTRIBUTION AND ENSURE WATER REACHES ALL BENEFICIARIES. A CAMPAIGN WITH A START DATE IS A PLANNING FACT, NOT A PROMISE. IT MEANS THERE IS A WINDOW BEFORE IT IN WHICH TO GET A SPECIFIC ENCROACHMENT ONTO THE LIST, AND A PERIOD AFTER IT IN WHICH REMOVAL TEAMS ARE ACTUALLY IN THE FIELD. SUBMIT THE LOCATION, WITH PHOTOGRAPHS AND THE NAME OF THE CHANNEL, TO THE GOVERNORATE DIRECTORATE BEFORE THE START. THAT ENCROACHING FISH LAKES ARE NAMED IS THE DETAIL TO NOTICE. UNLICENSED FISH PONDS DRAW LARGE VOLUMES OFF IRRIGATION CHANNELS AND ARE A COMMON REASON TAIL-END FARMERS RECEIVE NOTHING — IF THAT IS YOUR PROBLEM, IT IS ALREADY NAMED IN THE MINISTRY'S OWN CAMPAIGN, WHICH MEANS YOU ARE REPORTING A RECOGNISED CATEGORY RATHER THAN ARGUING A NOVEL CASE. AND THE WORK IS NOT WAITING FOR THE CAMPAIGN. GOVERNORATE WATER RESOURCES DIRECTORATES ALREADY RUN FIELD CAMPAIGNS TO REMOVE ENCROACHMENTS ON WATER SHARES, REHABILITATE IRRIGATION STRUCTURES, AND FOLLOW RIVERS AND STREAMS TO REMOVE THE OBSTRUCTIONS THAT AFFECT WATER FLOW. SO THE ADDRESS IS THE DIRECTORATE IN YOUR GOVERNORATE, NOT THE MINISTRY IN THE CAPITAL. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED THE SAME PATTERN ACROSS THE REGION: THE FIELD TEAM THAT ALREADY CLEARS OBSTRUCTIONS IS A FASTER ROUTE THAN ANY NATIONAL OFFICE. THE FRAMING THAT WORKS HERE IS THE MINISTRY'S OWN: JUSTICE IN WATER DISTRIBUTION, AND WATER REACHING ALL BENEFICIARIES ACCORDING TO APPROVED CONTROLS. A COMPLAINT PUT IN THOSE TERMS — OUR SHARE IS NOT ARRIVING BECAUSE OF AN ENCROACHMENT AT A NAMED POINT — MATCHES A STATED OBJECTIVE, WHERE A COMPLAINT ABOUT A NEIGHBOUR DOES NOT. ONE STRUCTURAL POINT FOR THE NORTH: COORDINATION BETWEEN THE MINISTRY AND THE WATER RESOURCES DIRECTORATES IN THE THREE NORTHERN REGION GOVERNORATES RUNS UNDER SEPARATE CABINET INSTRUCTIONS — SO ESTABLISH WHICH ADMINISTRATION HANDLES YOUR CHANNEL BEFORE WRITING, BECAUSE A LETTER TO THE WRONG ONE IS MONTHS LOST. THE LIMITS: this is A STATE WATER ADMINISTRATOR, NOT AN ADVOCATE — it allocates shares and removes obstructions, IT WILL NOT TAKE A SIDE IN A LAND DISPUTE, and nothing here creates a right to object to a project. ENCROACHMENT REMOVAL IS ENFORCEMENT AGAINST SOMEBODY: reporting a powerful neighbour or an armed operator carries risk this entry cannot assess, AND THE COMMUNITY REPORTING IS OFTEN IDENTIFIABLE. THE CAMPAIGN DATE COMES FROM A MINISTERIAL MEETING REPORT AND MAY SLIP OR BE SUPERSEDED; enforcement reach varies sharply between governorates. Read it with the environmental police directorate and ministry hotline, the farmers' federation, the river movement and the bar assignment bodies recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Agricultural cooperative bank and the agricultural initiative — published loan procedures and online applications
trackers.desc: A FARMING COMMUNITY THAT CANNOT BORROW CANNOT REPAIR A PUMP, LEVEL A FIELD OR PLANT A NEW ORCHARD — AND IN THIS COUNTRY THE LENDER FOR THAT WORK IS A STATE AGRICULTURAL COOPERATIVE BANK, WHICH ALSO ADMINISTERS THE GOVERNMENT'S AGRICULTURAL INITIATIVE. WHAT MAKES THIS USABLE RATHER THAN THEORETICAL IS THAT THE ROUTES ARE PUBLISHED ON THE NATIONAL GOVERNMENT SERVICES PORTAL: SUBMITTING AN ELECTRONIC APPLICATION FOR AGRICULTURAL BANK LOANS; THE PROCEDURES FOR OBTAINING LOANS FROM THE HIGHER COMMITTEE FOR THE AGRICULTURAL INITIATIVE; AND THE PROCEDURES FOR OBTAINING AGRICULTURAL INITIATIVE LOANS FROM THE BANK. THREE SEPARATE PUBLISHED PROCEDURES MEANS THE CONDITIONS ARE KNOWABLE BEFORE YOU TRAVEL. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED IN EVERY COUNTRY THAT THE COMMONEST REASON A DESERVING APPLICATION FAILS IS A DOCUMENT NOBODY MENTIONED — READ THE PROCEDURE FIRST, ASSEMBLE THE PAPERS, THEN APPLY. NOTE THAT THE INITIATIVE HAS ITS OWN HIGHER COMMITTEE WITH A SEPARATE LOAN ROUTE FROM THE BANK'S ORDINARY LENDING. THAT IS TWO DOORS, NOT ONE, AND THEY MAY CARRY DIFFERENT CONDITIONS, CEILINGS AND INTEREST TREATMENT — ASK WHICH ONE FITS THE WORK YOU INTEND, AND ASK WHETHER YOU MAY APPLY TO THE OTHER IF REFUSED. THE ELECTRONIC APPLICATION MATTERS FOR A REASON BEYOND CONVENIENCE: A REQUEST SUBMITTED THROUGH A PORTAL EXISTS AS A RECORD WITH A DATE, WHICH AN APPLICATION HANDED ACROSS A COUNTER DOES NOT. KEEP THE REFERENCE, AND CHASE IT AGAINST THE PUBLISHED PROCEDURE RATHER THAN AGAINST WHAT YOU WERE TOLD IN PERSON. THE INITIATIVE IS A LONG-RUNNING GOVERNMENT PROGRAMME RATHER THAN A ONE-OFF, WHICH IS THE POINT FOR PLANNING: A SCHEME THAT HAS OPERATED FOR MORE THAN A DECADE HAS PRECEDENTS, LOCAL BRANCHES AND PEOPLE WHO HAVE USED IT. ASK THE FARMERS' FEDERATION OR THE COOPERATIVE IN YOUR DISTRICT WHO HAS BORROWED SUCCESSFULLY AND WHAT THEY HAD TO PRODUCE — THIS FILE RECORDED BOTH BODIES SEPARATELY FOR THIS COUNTRY. ONE CAUTION FROM THE COUNTRY'S OWN PLANNING RESEARCH: OFFICIAL STUDIES HAVE FOUND SHORTCOMINGS IN FOLLOWING UP AGRICULTURAL LOANS AND IN ESTABLISHING WHETHER THEY WERE USED FOR THE PURPOSE THEY WERE BORROWED FOR, AND HAVE QUESTIONED WHETHER INTERNAL CONTROLS BEFORE, DURING AND AFTER LENDING ARE ADEQUATE. THAT MATTERS TO AN HONEST BORROWER MORE THAN TO A DISHONEST ONE. WHERE FOLLOW-UP IS WEAK, LENDING CAN BE CAPTURED BY PEOPLE WITH CONNECTIONS RATHER THAN LAND — SO A COOPERATIVE APPLYING TOGETHER, WITH ITS PURPOSE DOCUMENTED AND ITS SPENDING RECORDED, IS BOTH MORE LIKELY TO BE FUNDED AND BETTER PROTECTED IF THE PROGRAMME IS LATER AUDITED. THE LIMITS: this is CREDIT, NOT A GRANT — IT MUST BE REPAID, AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED ELSEWHERE THAT DEFAULTED AGRICULTURAL DEBT IS WHAT LOCKS FAMILIES OUT OF FUTURE BORROWING. IT IS A PRODUCTION LENDER, NOT A LAND-DEFENCE OR LEGAL FUND, AND IT WILL NOT FINANCE AN OBJECTION OR A PURCHASE TO PROTECT LAND. CURRENT LOAN CEILINGS, INTEREST TERMS, COLLATERAL REQUIREMENTS AND WHETHER THE INITIATIVE IS STILL OPEN WERE NOT VERIFIED, AND THE PORTAL PAGES REQUIRE SCRIPTING TO VIEW. Read it with the farmers' federation and its district committee seat, the water resources directorates, the environmental police and the government contracts department recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Where farm support now goes — fertiliser subsidy moved to irrigation systems, and the loan categories including solar pumps and desert palm orchards
trackers.desc: THE MOST IMPORTANT THING A FARMER HERE CAN KNOW THIS YEAR IS THAT THE SUPPORT HAS MOVED: THE COUNCIL OF MINISTERS DECIDED TO REMOVE THE SUBSIDY ON FERTILISERS AND TRANSFER IT TO MODERN IRRIGATION SYSTEMS. A HOUSEHOLD BUDGETING ON SUBSIDISED FERTILISER IS BUDGETING ON SOMETHING THAT HAS GONE. THE MONEY IS NOW BEHIND EQUIPMENT INSTEAD — SO THE REQUEST TO MAKE OF THE AGRICULTURE OFFICE IS FOR AN IRRIGATION SYSTEM, NOT FOR INPUTS, AND A GROUP THAT REORGANISES ITS ASK AROUND THAT WILL BE PUSHING AT AN OPEN DOOR. THE MINISTRY DESCRIBES ITS OWN PACKAGE IN THOSE TERMS: INTRODUCING DRIP IRRIGATION AND FIXED AND PIVOT SPRINKLERS TO RATIONALISE WATER CONSUMPTION AND CONFRONT WATER SCARCITY, SUPPORTING PROTECTED AGRICULTURE, AND USING REMOTE SENSING TO MONITOR AGRICULTURAL LAND AND DETERMINE CROPS' NEEDS FOR IRRIGATION, FERTILISING AND PEST CONTROL. REMOTE SENSING IS THE PART WITH A SECOND USE. IF THE MINISTRY IS MONITORING AGRICULTURAL LAND FROM ABOVE, THEN SATELLITE-BASED EVIDENCE OF WHAT WAS GROWING ON A PARCEL AND WHEN EXISTS INSIDE A STATE SYSTEM — AND A COMMUNITY TOLD ITS GROUND WAS IDLE SHOULD ASK WHETHER THAT MONITORING RECORD SAYS OTHERWISE. FOR MONEY, THE CATEGORIES ARE NAMED. A CENTRAL BANK INITIATIVE PROMOTED THROUGH THE AGRICULTURAL COOPERATIVE BANK LISTS WHAT IT WILL FINANCE: POULTRY FIELDS, FEED PLANTS, HATCHERIES, IMPORTED DAIRY CATTLE, HARVESTERS AND AGRICULTURAL MACHINERY, SOLAR-POWERED WATER PUMPS, MODERN IRRIGATION SYSTEMS, AIR-CONDITIONED GLASSHOUSES, AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF PALM ORCHARDS IN DESERT LANDS. SOLAR-POWERED PUMPS AND DESERT PALM ORCHARDS ARE THE TWO ENTRIES TO NOTICE. A SOLAR PUMP ENDS THE FUEL BILL THAT CLOSES DOWN IRRIGATION IN A BAD YEAR — THIS FILE RECORDED THE SAME LOGIC IN A VILLAGE WATER SCHEME ELSEWHERE — AND PALMS ON DESERT GROUND ARE A FUNDED WAY TO PUT A PERMANENT, VISIBLE, DATED CROP ONTO LAND THAT WOULD OTHERWISE BE DESCRIBED AS EMPTY. THE LENDING IS ALSO GEOGRAPHICALLY STEERED: DEVELOPMENT LOANS UNDER THE INITIATIVE ARE DIRECTED AT GOVERNORATES SUFFERING HIGH UNEMPLOYMENT — SO WHERE YOU ARE MAY MATTER AS MUCH AS WHAT YOU PROPOSE, AND IT IS WORTH ASKING THE BRANCH WHETHER YOUR GOVERNORATE IS INSIDE THAT PRIORITY. THE PUBLIC ARGUMENT AROUND ALL THIS IS WORTH BORROWING WHEN YOU WRITE: A FORMER CHAIR OF THE PARLIAMENTARY AGRICULTURE AND WATER COMMITTEE HAS CALLED FOR CONCESSIONAL OR INTEREST-FREE LOANS SO FARMERS CAN BUY MODERN IRRIGATION, AND FOR GOVERNMENT SUPPORT TO BE TIED TO THOSE WHO ADOPT IT — ON THE GROUND THAT IT CUTS WATER USE SUBSTANTIALLY, RAISES OUTPUT PER DUNUM AND LOWERS RUNNING, FERTILISER AND ENERGY COSTS. THOSE THREE CLAIMS ARE THE FRAME AN APPLICATION SHOULD USE. A REQUEST THAT PROMISES LESS WATER, MORE YIELD AND LOWER COSTS IS ANSWERING THE STATE'S OWN STATED PROBLEM RATHER THAN ASKING FOR HELP. THE LIMITS: THE SUBSIDY SHIFT CUTS BOTH WAYS AND THE HARM COMES FIRST — FERTILISER PRICES RISE IMMEDIATELY WHILE IRRIGATION SUPPORT ARRIVES ONLY FOR THOSE WHO CAN NAVIGATE AN APPLICATION, WHICH IS NOT THE POOREST. THE FINANCE IS CREDIT THAT MUST BE REPAID, AND THE INITIATIVE'S PROJECT LIST COMES FROM A BANK NOTICE CITING A CENTRAL BANK LETTER OF AN EARLIER LENDING ROUND, SO CURRENT TERMS, CEILINGS AND WHETHER THE WINDOW IS OPEN MUST BE CHECKED AT A BRANCH. THE MINISTRY'S ACCOUNT OF ITS OWN ACHIEVEMENTS COMES FROM ITS ANNOUNCEMENTS REPORTED IN THE PRESS, AND THE POLICY COMMENTARY FROM A NEWSPAPER COLUMN AND AN INTERVIEW - none of it is a published programme document with eligibility rules. Read it with the agricultural cooperative bank and initiative, the water resources campaign against encroachments, the regional environment board and the conservation NGO's waterkeeper recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Free legal aid for property claims — lawyers and paralegals who process compensation claims and help reclaim housing and land
trackers.desc: THE SENTENCE THAT MAKES THIS USABLE IS ABOUT WHO IS SERVED: LAWYERS AND PARALEGALS WORK WITH ADMINISTRATIVE, JUDICIAL AND SECURITY OFFICIALS TO FACILITATE DISPLACED IRAQIS', REFUGEES' AND VULNERABLE LOCAL COMMUNITY MEMBERS' ACCESS TO OBTAINING LEGAL AND CIVIL DOCUMENTATION, PROCESSING PROPERTY COMPENSATION CLAIMS OR RECLAIMING THEIR HOUSING AND LAND. VULNERABLE LOCAL COMMUNITY MEMBERS ARE NAMED ALONGSIDE THE DISPLACED. THAT MATTERS BECAUSE MOST HUMANITARIAN LEGAL AID IN THIS PAYLOAD STOPS AT PEOPLE WHO FLED — HERE A FAMILY THAT STAYED AND LOST ITS PAPERS OR ITS PLOT IS INSIDE THE SERVICE. PROCESSING THE COMPENSATION CLAIM IS THE PART TO ASK FOR BY NAME, BECAUSE THE STATE ROUTE EXISTS AND IS HARD TO NAVIGATE ALONE: UNDER THE COMPENSATION LEGISLATION OF 2009, AS AMENDED IN 2015 AND 2020, THE FINANCE MINISTRY PAYS COMPENSATION THROUGH THE CONCERNED GOVERNORATES TO SUCCESSFUL CLAIMANTS FOR THEIR DAMAGED PROPERTIES, ON APPROVAL BY THE COMPENSATION COMMITTEE. SO THERE ARE TWO THINGS TO ESTABLISH LOCALLY: WHERE THE COMPENSATION COMMITTEE FOR YOUR GOVERNORATE SITS, AND WHO WILL HELP ASSEMBLE THE CLAIM. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED SEPARATELY THAT THIS COUNTRY'S REGISTRY ACCEPTS ELECTRICITY RECEIPTS AND BUILDING PERMITS AS PROOF WHERE DEEDS ARE MISSING — THE SAME EVIDENCE IS WHAT A COMPENSATION FILE IS BUILT FROM. ONE SERVICE HERE HAS NO PARALLEL ANYWHERE ELSE IN THIS PAYLOAD: SUPPORT TO HOUSEHOLDS AND MINE ACTION ACTORS IN NAVIGATING THE HOUSING AND LAND TENURE ISSUES RELATED TO MINE CLEARANCE. THAT IS THE PROBLEM NOBODY ELSE ADDRESSES — LAND CANNOT BE FARMED UNTIL IT IS CLEARED, CLEARANCE REQUIRES KNOWING WHO OWNS IT, AND OWNERSHIP CANNOT BE PROVEN WHILE THE GROUND IS MINED. A SERVICE THAT SITS BETWEEN THE FAMILY AND THE CLEARANCE ORGANISATION IS WHAT UNLOCKS BOTH. AND THE PROGRAMME'S OWN POLICY LEAVES A DOOR OPEN FOR COLLECTIVE CASES: IT MAY ENGAGE IN PUBLIC INTEREST CASES IF THIS WILL LEAD TO A DIRECT POSITIVE EFFECT FOR A GREATER NUMBER OF INDIVIDUALS. SO A VILLAGE WITH A SHARED PROBLEM — A WHOLE ROW OF DESTROYED HOUSES, A COMMONLY HELD FIELD, A REGISTRY THAT WILL NOT REGISTER ANYONE — SHOULD PRESENT IT AS ONE MATTER AFFECTING MANY RATHER THAN AS TWENTY SEPARATE COMPLAINTS. NOW THE HONEST PART, BECAUSE THE OBSTACLES ARE DOCUMENTED: MULTIPLE LAND REGISTRY OFFICES WERE LOOTED AND CADASTRES AND RECORDS OF PROPERTY RIGHTS DESTROYED; PROPERTY DOCUMENTS REISSUED BY THE OCCUPYING GROUP WERE NOT LEGALLY RECOGNISED BY THE GOVERNMENT; AND LONG PROCESSING TIMES AND THE DIFFICULTY OF CARRYING OUT RESTITUTION REMAIN OBSTACLES TO THE COMPENSATION PROGRAMME, ALONGSIDE CORRUPTION IN THE LAND SYSTEM AND THE LOOTING OF STATE LAND IN THE LIBERATED GOVERNORATES. SO TREAT THE COMPENSATION CLAIM AS A LONG PROCESS TO START NOW RATHER THAN A PAYMENT TO PLAN AROUND, AND KEEP EVERY RECEIPT AND PHOTOGRAPH IN THE MEANTIME — THE FAMILIES WHO EVENTUALLY GET PAID ARE THE ONES WHOSE FILE WAS COMPLETE WHEN THE COMMITTEE FINALLY REACHED IT. THE LIMITS: THIS IS PROJECT-FUNDED HUMANITARIAN LEGAL AID PRESENT ONLY IN THE GOVERNORATES WHERE IT HAS PROGRAMMES - past funding documents name specific governorates - AND SERVICES CAN CLOSE WHEN A GRANT ENDS. ITS FRAME IS DISPLACEMENT AND CONFLICT DAMAGE: A COMMUNITY OPPOSING A NEW DEVELOPMENT PROJECT WITHOUT THAT DIMENSION MAY NOT QUALIFY, AND SHOULD ASK FIRST. THE COUNTRY DESCRIPTION COMES FROM THE ORGANISATION'S OWN PAGE, AND THE COMPENSATION AND REGISTRY-LOOTING DETAIL FROM A LAND GOVERNANCE PORTAL SUMMARY OF EARLIER YEARS - the current state of the compensation programme should be checked with the governorate committee. Read it with the property attribution service for unregistered and burned records, the regional environment board, the conservation NGO's waterkeeper and the agricultural bank recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Resource transparency authority — civil society elects its own seats on the board, and the licensing-round contracts are published
trackers.desc: MOST TRANSPARENCY BODIES IN THIS FILE PUBLISH DATA AT COMMUNITIES. THIS ONE GIVES THEM A VOTE: NON-GOVERNMENTAL ORGANISATIONS ORGANISE GENERAL ELECTIONS TO CHOOSE THEIR REPRESENTATIVES ON THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES THAT GOVERNS RESOURCE TRANSPARENCY. THE BOARD IS FIFTEEN MEMBERS UNDER A 2024 ORDER — FIVE FROM GOVERNMENT AND FIVE FROM INTERNATIONAL AND NATIONAL EXTRACTIVE COMPANIES, WITH CIVIL SOCIETY AS THE THIRD PARTY — AND THE INITIATIVE'S OWN WORDING IS THAT INTERNATIONAL STANDARDS REQUIRE CIVIL SOCIETY TO BE INVOLVED AS A THIRD PARTY EQUAL TO GOVERNMENT AND COMPANIES, AFTER THE PROCESS HAD BEEN CONFINED TO TWO PARTIES AND MANAGED BEHIND CLOSED DOORS. A THIRD OF THE SEATS AT THE TABLE WHERE OIL, GAS AND MINING GOVERNANCE IS DISCUSSED, FILLED BY ELECTION AMONG CIVIL SOCIETY ORGANISATIONS, IS THE MOST DIRECT ACCESS TO POWER THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED ANYWHERE IN TWENTY-THREE COUNTRIES. AND THE CALL IS ADDRESSED TO PEOPLE WHO RUN ORGANISATIONS: IF YOU LEAD A CIVIL SOCIETY ORGANISATION, THIS IS DESCRIBED AS YOUR OPPORTUNITY TO SHARE IN THE DECISION ON STRENGTHENING GOVERNANCE AND TRANSPARENCY IN THOSE SECTORS. SO A VILLAGE ASSOCIATION AFFECTED BY AN OILFIELD OR A QUARRY IS NOT A PETITIONER HERE — IT IS A POTENTIAL VOTER, AND POSSIBLY A CANDIDATE. THIS FILE HAS SAID REPEATEDLY THAT REGISTERING AN ASSOCIATION IN A QUIET YEAR IS THE CHEAPEST PREPARATION A COMMUNITY CAN MAKE; THIS IS ONE OF THE THINGS IT BUYS. THE SECOND ASSET IS DOCUMENTARY AND IMMEDIATE: AT THE INITIATIVE'S REQUEST, THE OIL MINISTRY'S CONTRACTS AND LICENSING DEPARTMENT PUBLISHED COPIES OF THE STANDARD SERVICE CONTRACTS AND THE HYDROCARBON EXPLORATION, DEVELOPMENT AND PRODUCTION CONTRACTS SIGNED IN THE FOUR LICENSING ROUNDS BETWEEN 2009 AND 2012. PUBLISHED CONTRACTS ARE WHERE OBLIGATIONS LIVE — WHAT AN OPERATOR PROMISED ABOUT LOCAL EMPLOYMENT, ENVIRONMENTAL MEASURES, INFRASTRUCTURE AND COMPENSATION. A COMMUNITY THAT READS THE MODEL CONTRACT FOR ITS FIELD CAN ASK WHETHER THOSE CLAUSES ARE BEING HONOURED, WHICH IS A FAR SHARPER QUESTION THAN ASKING A COMPANY TO BE A GOOD NEIGHBOUR. THE HONEST CONTEXT MATTERS TOO, AND THE INITIATIVE STATES IT ITSELF: THE CURRENT CYCLE COMES AMID DECLINING PARTICIPATION BY SOME GOVERNMENT BODIES AND INTERNATIONAL COMPANIES, IN CIRCUMSTANCES IT SAYS REQUIRE REDOUBLED EFFORT TO ENSURE SOUND MANAGEMENT OF THE WEALTH. WITHDRAWAL BY THE OTHER TWO PARTIES IS EXACTLY WHEN THE CIVIL SOCIETY SEATS MATTER MOST — AND ALSO WHEN THEY ARE EASIEST TO WIN, BECAUSE FEWER PEOPLE ARE COMPETING FOR THEM. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A MULTI-STAKEHOLDER TRANSPARENCY BODY, NOT A REGULATOR OR AN ADVOCATE - IT PUBLISHES, CONVENES AND REPORTS, AND CANNOT STOP A PROJECT, REFUSE A LICENCE OR AWARD COMPENSATION. A SEAT ON ITS BOARD IS INFLUENCE, NOT POWER. THE CONTRACTS PUBLISHED COVER LICENSING ROUNDS OF 2009 TO 2012 AND NOT NECESSARILY LATER OR REGIONAL AGREEMENTS, AND THE AUTONOMOUS REGION RUNS ITS OWN ARRANGEMENTS. ELECTION TIMING, ELIGIBILITY RULES AND HOW AN ORGANISATION REGISTERS TO VOTE OR STAND WERE NOT ESTABLISHED - those are the questions to put to the secretariat now rather than when a cycle opens. THE ACCOUNT COMES FROM THE INITIATIVE'S OWN SITE AND ITS NEWS PAGES, WHICH DESCRIBE ITS OWN GOVERNANCE. Read it with the property attribution service for unregistered and burned records, the free legal aid for property claims, the regional environment board and the conservation NGO's waterkeeper recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Global Legal Action Network — lawyers and investigators who build the case outside the country where the harm happens
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HAS RECORDED COUNTRY AFTER COUNTRY WHERE THE COURTS, THE REGULATOR AND THE PROSECUTOR ARE PART OF THE PROBLEM. THIS ORGANISATION'S WHOLE METHOD IS THE ANSWER TO THAT: IT DEVELOPS LEGAL INTERVENTIONS FROM OUTSIDE THE JURISDICTIONS WHERE INDIVIDUALS AND COMMUNITIES SUFFER INJUSTICE, IN PARTNERSHIP WITH INTERNATIONAL AND LOCAL GRASSROOTS ORGANISATIONS. OUTSIDE THE JURISDICTION MEANS THE CASE IS BROUGHT WHERE THE COMPANY IS HEADQUARTERED, WHERE ITS BUYERS ARE, WHERE ITS FINANCIERS SIT OR WHERE ITS DIRECTORS CAN BE REACHED — NOT WHERE THE BULLDOZER IS. THAT IS THE ONE STRUCTURAL ROUTE AROUND A CAPTURED DOMESTIC SYSTEM. IT IS MADE UP OF LAWYERS, INVESTIGATORS AND CAMPAIGNERS WORKING WITH AFFECTED COMMUNITIES TO PURSUE LEGAL ACTIONS ACROSS BORDERS AGAINST STATES AND OTHER POWERFUL ACTORS — A TEAM SPREAD ACROSS MULTIPLE COUNTRIES, WITH A LEGAL ACTION COMMITTEE OF EXPERTS FROM LEGAL PRACTICE, ACADEMIA AND INVESTIGATIVE JOURNALISM WHO VOLUNTEER THEIR EXPERTISE, AND FORMAL CONNECTIONS WITH LAW SCHOOLS. ITS ENVIRONMENTAL WORK IS EXPLICIT: A TRANSNATIONAL LEGAL CONSORTIUM WORKS WITH INVESTIGATIVE PARTNERS TO ASSESS DOMESTIC AND INTERNATIONAL LEGAL AVENUES TO CHALLENGE SERIOUS ENVIRONMENTAL ABUSES, AND TO BUILD INTERVENTIONS COMPELLING ACCOUNTABILITY WITHIN GLOBAL SUPPLY CHAINS FOR GOLD AND OTHER COMMODITIES THAT PUT FORESTS AT RISK. AND ONE OF ITS ROUTES IS ONE ALMOST NO COMMUNITY THINKS OF: USING PUBLIC LAW AND PROCEEDS OF CRIME OR MONEY LAUNDERING LEGISLATION TO HOLD BUSINESSES TO ACCOUNT FOR SYSTEMIC ABUSES IN THEIR SUPPLY CHAINS, ON THE VIEW THAT ECONOMIC CRIMES ARE CLOSELY TIED TO HUMAN RIGHTS VIOLATIONS AND PROVIDE A PROMISING ROUTE FOR INDIRECTLY DEALING WITH ACCOUNTABILITY. SO EVIDENCE THAT LOOKS IRRELEVANT LOCALLY — WHO WAS PAID, WHOSE COMPANY HOLDS THE PERMIT, WHERE THE MATERIAL WAS SOLD — MAY BE THE MOST VALUABLE THING A COMMUNITY HOLDS. THE OWNERSHIP REGISTERS AND PROCUREMENT PORTALS RECORDED ELSEWHERE IN THIS PAYLOAD ARE WHERE THAT EVIDENCE COMES FROM. NOW THE HONEST PART, IN THEIR OWN WORDS: THEIR DIRECTOR NAMES THE BIGGEST DIFFICULTY AS CONNECTING WITH AFFECTED COMMUNITIES IN A TIMELY MANNER, SAYING THEY OFTEN RELY ON MEDIA REPORTS OF OVERSEAS VIOLATIONS, WHICH MAKES THEIR ABILITY TO OFFER ASSISTANCE A LITTLE UNSTRUCTURED — AND THAT THE WORK IS CHALLENGING TO FUND AND PATIENCE IS REQUIRED. THERE IS NO INTAKE FORM AND NO QUEUE. THE PRACTICAL CONSEQUENCE IS THAT A COMMUNITY SHOULD APPROACH THEM DIRECTLY AND EARLY, WITH A DOCUMENTED CASE AND A NAMED COMPANY, RATHER THAN WAITING TO BE FOUND THROUGH A NEWS REPORT THAT MAY NEVER BE WRITTEN. AND EXPECT A PARTNERSHIP RATHER THAN A RESCUE: THEY STATE THAT IT IS IMPORTANT TO WORK CLOSELY WITH AFFECTED COMMUNITIES TO SUPPORT THEIR PRE-EXISTING EFFORTS AND TO GENERATE IMPACTS BEYOND THE LEGAL SPHERE. THAT PHRASE — SUPPORT THEIR PRE-EXISTING EFFORTS — IS THE TEST YOU MUST PASS. THEY JOIN CAMPAIGNS THAT ALREADY EXIST, SO THE ORGANISING COMES FIRST AND THE INTERNATIONAL LAWYERS COME SECOND. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A SMALL ORGANISATION TAKING A HANDFUL OF AMBITIOUS CASES, NOT A SERVICE - MOST APPROACHES WILL NOT BECOME CASES, THE WORK IS SLOW AND ITS OWN STAFF SAY PATIENCE IS REQUIRED. IT PURSUES LITIGATION AGAINST STATES AND CORPORATIONS AND SOME OF ITS ACTIONS ARE POLITICALLY CONTESTED, WITH PARTISAN MONITORING GROUPS CAMPAIGNING AGAINST IT - ASSOCIATION CARRIES A POLITICAL CHARGE THAT A LOCAL GROUP SHOULD WEIGH, PARTICULARLY IN COUNTRIES WHERE FOREIGN LEGAL SUPPORT IS TREATED AS INTERFERENCE. WHETHER IT HAS EVER WORKED IN THIS COUNTRY WAS NOT ESTABLISHED, AND THE ACCOUNT COMES FROM ITS OWN SITE AND PROFILE LISTINGS ALONGSIDE AN INTERVIEW WITH ITS DIRECTOR PUBLISHED BY A CORPORATE ACCOUNTABILITY RESOURCE CENTRE. Read it with the resource transparency authority's elected civil society seats, the free legal aid for property claims, the property attribution service and the environmental law alliance recorded separately in this payload.

trackers.name: Agricultural engineers' syndicate — consultancy services, an elected council and inspection powers over unlicensed agricultural offices
trackers.desc: A COMMUNITY FIGHTING A PROJECT NEEDS SOMEBODY QUALIFIED TO SAY WHAT THE LAND IS AND WHAT WILL HAPPEN TO IT. THIS IS WHERE THOSE PEOPLE ARE ORGANISED: A SYNDICATE OF AGRICULTURAL ENGINEERS FOUNDED IN 1972, WHICH STATES THAT IT CONTRIBUTES TO DEVELOPING AGRICULTURE THROUGH ITS EXPERTISE, ITS CONFERENCES AND ITS CONSULTANCY SERVICES. CONSULTANCY SERVICES IS THE PHRASE TO USE WHEN APPROACHING. YOU ARE NOT ASKING A PROFESSIONAL BODY TO JOIN A CAMPAIGN — YOU ARE ASKING IT FOR THE SERVICE IT ADVERTISES, WHICH IS A DIFFERENT CONVERSATION AND A MUCH EASIER YES. WHAT AN AGRONOMIST'S REPORT DOES IN A LAND FIGHT IS SPECIFIC: IT ESTABLISHES SOIL CLASS, CROPPING HISTORY, IRRIGATION, YIELD AND WHAT THE GROUND IS WORTH IN PRODUCTION — THE FACTS THAT DECIDE WHETHER LAND IS TREATED AS PRODUCTIVE OR AS IDLE, AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED IDLE-LAND RULES USED TO REALLOCATE LAND IN FOUR COUNTRIES OF THIS REGION. IT IS REACHABLE IN THE ORDINARY SENSE: IT PUBLISHES OPENING HOURS ON FOUR NAMED DAYS FROM HALF PAST THREE TO HALF PAST SEVEN IN THE AFTERNOON, WITH THREE DAYS CLOSED, AND A CONTACT PAGE. ITS LEADERSHIP IS CURRENT AND ELECTED: THE COUNCIL WAS CHOSEN ON THE TWENTY-FIRST OF MAY 2026, WITH A NAMED HEAD AND DEPUTY AND FOUR NAMED MEMBERS. A BODY THAT HAS JUST HELD ELECTIONS IS A BODY WHOSE OFFICERS ARE LOOKING FOR THINGS TO DO AND CONSTITUENCIES TO SERVE. THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED THE SAME OPENING IN NEWLY RECONSTITUTED COUNCILS ELSEWHERE — THE FIRST MONTHS OF A TERM ARE WHEN APPROACHES LAND. IT ALSO HAS TEETH THAT MOST PROFESSIONAL BODIES LACK: IN COOPERATION WITH THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY AND WITH SUPPORT FROM THE NATIONAL SECURITY SERVICE, IT HAS RUN INTENSIVE INSPECTION TOURS TO APPLY THE RULES ON PRACTISING THE PROFESSION, INCLUDING REVIEWING AGRICULTURAL OFFICES AND UNLICENSED AGRICULTURAL COMPANIES. SO IF A COMPANY ARRIVES OFFERING AGRICULTURAL SERVICES, LAND CLEARANCE OR PLANTATION SCHEMES, WHETHER IT IS LICENSED IS A QUESTION THIS SYNDICATE ALREADY ASKS AND HAS THE STANDING TO ASK AGAIN. AND THERE IS A PRECEDENT NEXT DOOR WORTH PUTTING IN FRONT OF THEM: THE SISTER SYNDICATE IN A NEIGHBOURING TERRITORY SIGNED A MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING WITH A LAND RESEARCH CENTRE TO STRENGTHEN THE PROTECTION OF LAND AND EMPOWER THE AGRICULTURAL ENGINEER. THAT IS THE ARRANGEMENT TO PROPOSE: A PROFESSIONAL BODY AND A RESEARCH CENTRE AGREEING THAT PROTECTING LAND IS PART OF THE PROFESSION'S WORK. ANOTHER SISTER SYNDICATE RAN TRAINING ON THE INTERNATIONAL STANDARD FOR THE COMPETENCE OF TESTING AND CALIBRATION LABORATORIES — WHICH IS THE OTHER HALF OF EVIDENCE, AND THE SYNDICATES ARE FEDERATED IN AN ARAB UNION THAT PUBLISHES WHAT EACH IS DOING. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A PROFESSIONAL SYNDICATE WHOSE FIRST PURPOSE IS DEFENDING ITS MEMBERS' EMPLOYMENT AND CONDITIONS, NOT DEFENDING LAND - IT WILL NOT CAMPAIGN, LITIGATE OR OPPOSE A STATE PROJECT, AND ITS INSPECTION WORK IS DONE WITH THE MINISTRY AND WITH SECURITY-SERVICE SUPPORT, WHICH IS A RELATIONSHIP A COMMUNITY SHOULD UNDERSTAND BEFORE INVOLVING IT. WHETHER IT PROVIDES CONSULTANCY OR TECHNICAL REPORTS TO NON-MEMBERS, WHAT THAT COSTS, AND WHETHER IT HAS PROVINCIAL BRANCHES REACHABLE OUTSIDE THE CAPITAL WERE NOT ESTABLISHED - those are the three questions to ask. THE ACCOUNT COMES FROM THE SYNDICATE'S OWN SITE AND AN OLDER SELF-DESCRIPTION PAGE, A NEWS ITEM ABOUT ITS INSPECTION TOURS AND THE ARAB UNION'S BULLETIN, AND THE LAND-PROTECTION MEMORANDUM BELONGS TO A SISTER SYNDICATE IN ANOTHER TERRITORY RATHER THAN TO THIS ONE. Read it with the resource transparency authority's elected civil society seats, the free legal aid for property claims, the transnational litigation network and the property attribution service recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Preventative protection for defenders — protection desks, a security course, and the 24-hour emergency mechanism it refers people to
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HAS FLAGGED PERSONAL RISK IN ALMOST EVERY COUNTRY IT COVERS - RANGERS DETAINED, JOURNALISTS SUED, PARALEGALS THREATENED WITH ARREST, PROTEST CAMPS CLEARED - WHILE NAMING ONLY ONE PROTECTION BODY. HERE IS A SECOND, AND A THIRD BEHIND IT: AN INTERNATIONAL NON-PROFIT THAT SUPPORTS DEFENDERS IN DEVELOPING THEIR SECURITY AND PROTECTION MANAGEMENT STRATEGIES, TAKING A PREVENTIVE AND COLLECTIVE VIEW OF PROTECTION RATHER THAN A REACTIVE ONE. PREVENTIVE AND COLLECTIVE IS THE PHRASE THAT MATTERS FOR A VILLAGE. PROTECTION HERE IS NOT A BODYGUARD FOR ONE LEADER BUT A PLAN A GROUP MAKES TOGETHER BEFORE THE TROUBLE ARRIVES — WHICH IS THE ONLY FORM MOST COMMUNITIES IN THIS PAYLOAD COULD EVER USE. WHAT IT OFFERS IS CONCRETE: ACTIONABLE RESEARCH, CAPACITY BUILDING, NETWORK AND ALLIANCE BUILDING, ADVOCACY, CAMPAIGNS AND AD-HOC SUPPORT - THROUGH PERMANENT PROTECTION DESKS BY WHICH IT HAS GIVEN DAILY ADVICE TO AROUND SIX HUNDRED DEFENDERS AND THEIR ORGANISATIONS. ITS TEACHING IS THE PART A REMOTE GROUP CAN USE WITHOUT TRAVELLING: AN E-LEARNING PROGRAMME ON SECURITY AND PROTECTION MANAGEMENT, OFFERED THREE TIMES A YEAR IN THREE LANGUAGES SINCE 2011, DESIGNED FOR ORGANISATIONS, DEFENDERS AND THEIR COMMUNITIES AND FOR HUMANITARIAN WORKERS, WITH RISK ANALYSIS AND PROTECTION PLANS COVERING THE PHYSICAL, DIGITAL AND EMOTIONAL DIMENSIONS OF SECURITY. THE EMOTIONAL DIMENSION BEING TAUGHT ALONGSIDE THE PHYSICAL AND DIGITAL IS UNUSUAL AND RIGHT. THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED CAMPAIGNS THAT RAN FOR ELEVEN MONTHS AND FIGHTS THAT LASTED TEN YEARS - EXHAUSTION IS A SECURITY PROBLEM, NOT A PERSONAL ONE. ITS RESEARCH IS AIMED AT PRECISELY THE PEOPLE THIS FILE SERVES: HOW COMMUNITY-BASED DEFENDERS IN REMOTE RURAL AREAS ORGANISE THEMSELVES AND ACT COLLECTIVELY TO DEFEND THEIR CIVIL AND POLITICAL RIGHTS AND THEIR ECONOMIC, SOCIAL AND CULTURAL RIGHTS, INCLUDING THE DEFENCE OF THEIR ANCESTRAL TERRITORIES - AND BUILDING AN UNDERSTANDING OF CRIMINALISATION BY COMPILING GOOD PRACTICE AND COUNTERSTRATEGIES. COUNTERSTRATEGIES AGAINST CRIMINALISATION IS THE MOST PRACTICAL RESEARCH TOPIC IN THIS ENTIRE PAYLOAD. THE PATTERN IT DESCRIBES - CHARGES BROUGHT AGAINST PEOPLE WHO OPPOSE A PROJECT - APPEARS IN THIS FILE'S RECORDS FOR AT LEAST SIX COUNTRIES. IT IS ALSO HONEST ABOUT ITS LIMITS, WHICH IS WHY THE NEXT PART MATTERS: IT STATES THAT IT DOES NOT PROVIDE EMERGENCY EVACUATION SUPPORT OR EMERGENCY GRANTS FOR DEFENDERS IN IMMINENT DANGER, AND DIRECTS THOSE NEEDING EMERGENCY HELP TO A EUROPEAN MECHANISM'S URGENT HELPDESK, GIVING A 24-HOUR EMERGENCY HOTLINE NUMBER AND ENCRYPTED CONTACT CHANNELS. THAT MECHANISM IS THE ONE TO WRITE DOWN BEFORE IT IS NEEDED: A EUROPEAN UNION DEFENDERS MECHANISM IMPLEMENTED BY A CONSORTIUM OF TWELVE INTERNATIONAL AND REGIONAL ORGANISATIONS, WITH A 24-HOUR HELPLINE AND A SECURE ENCRYPTED CONTACT FORM, WHICH SAYS IT SEEKS OUT DEFENDERS WHO ARE MORE ISOLATED AND LESS CONNECTED AND THOSE AT SPECIFIC RISK - NAMING ENVIRONMENTAL, LAND AND INDIGENOUS PEOPLES' RIGHTS DEFENDERS AND THOSE IN CONFLICT AREAS. ENVIRONMENTAL, LAND AND INDIGENOUS DEFENDERS NAMED EXPLICITLY MEANS A FARMER FIGHTING A QUARRY IS INSIDE THE DEFINITION, NOT OUTSIDE IT. THAT IS NOT OBVIOUS TO MOST PEOPLE WHO NEED IT. AND IT RUNS SOMETHING MOST COMMUNITIES DO NOT KNOW EXISTS: A TEMPORARY RELOCATION PROGRAMME GIVING FINANCIAL SUPPORT FOR RELOCATION IN RESPONSE TO INCREASED OR ANTICIPATED RISK - OR FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS WORKED IN A DIFFICULT ENVIRONMENT FOR A PROLONGED PERIOD AND NEEDS A BREAK - COVERING REST AND RESPITE, PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT, EXPANDING CONTACTS, PSYCHOLOGICAL WELLBEING AND FAMILY SUPPORT. ANTICIPATED RISK AND NEEDING A BREAK ARE BOTH GROUNDS. A COMMUNITY DOES NOT HAVE TO WAIT FOR AN ATTACK TO ASK, AND THE PROGRAMME COVERS THE FAMILY, WHICH IS USUALLY THE REASON PEOPLE REFUSE TO LEAVE. THE LIMITS: NEITHER BODY WILL FIGHT A PROJECT, FUND A CASE OR PROTECT PROPERTY - THEY PROTECT PEOPLE, AND ONLY THOSE WHO QUALIFY AS DEFENDERS UNDER THEIR CRITERIA. THE PROTECTION ORGANISATION WORKS THROUGH DESKS IN PARTICULAR COUNTRIES AND WHETHER IT HAS ANY PRESENCE OR PARTNER IN THIS REGION WAS NOT ESTABLISHED; ITS OWN PAGE STATES THAT THE E-LEARNING COURSE IS SUSPENDED UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, SO THE TRAINING MAY NOT BE AVAILABLE. RELOCATION AND EMERGENCY SUPPORT ARE COMPETITIVE AND ASSESSED, NOT AUTOMATIC, AND FOR PEOPLE WITHOUT PASSPORTS OR EXIT PERMISSION - WHICH THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS ACROSS SEVERAL COUNTRIES - RELOCATION ABROAD MAY BE IMPOSSIBLE. CONTACTING FOREIGN PROTECTION MECHANISMS IS ITSELF TREATED AS HOSTILE ACTIVITY IN SOME STATES COVERED HERE, SO THE ENCRYPTED CHANNELS EXIST FOR A REASON. THE HOTLINE AND PROGRAMME DETAILS COME FROM THE ORGANISATIONS' OWN PAGES DATED BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026 AND SHOULD BE RE-CHECKED BEFORE ANY EMERGENCY. Read it with the transnational litigation network, the agricultural engineers' syndicate, the free legal aid for property claims and the river organisation's threat survey recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Marsh district ecotourism organisation — local field tours that document pollution, and the youth campaign cleaning the same marshes
trackers.desc: THIS ROUND WENT LOOKING FOR VILLAGE-LEVEL ORGANISATIONS AND FOUND, IN ONE COUNTRY, ONLY WELFARE CHARITIES - ORPHANS, WIDOWS, NEEDY FAMILIES - SO NOTHING WAS RECORDED THERE. IN THE MARSHES IT FOUND SOMETHING ELSE: AN IRAQI ORGANISATION WORKING TO DEVELOP ECOTOURISM WITH A SPECIAL FOCUS ON THE MARSHES, NAMED AFTER THE DISTRICT IT WORKS IN, WITH MORE THAN A HUNDRED AND SIXTY-NINE THOUSAND FOLLOWERS ON ITS PUBLIC PAGE. WHAT MAKES IT A RESOURCE RATHER THAN A PAGE IS WHAT IT DOES ON THE WATER: DURING A FIELD TOUR IT CARRIED OUT, IT DOCUMENTED SERIOUS MANIFESTATIONS OF POLLUTION IN THE MARSH AREAS, CONSISTING OF THE DIRECT DISCHARGE OF SEWAGE WATER INTO THE MARSHES. AN ORGANISATION WITH BOATS, A ROUTINE OF FIELD TOURS AND AN AUDIENCE OF A HUNDRED AND SIXTY-NINE THOUSAND IS A DOCUMENTATION SERVICE A COMMUNITY CANNOT BUY. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED RIVER SURVEYS DONE BY TWO PEOPLE WITH A BOAT AND A DRONE FURTHER NORTH - THIS IS THE SAME CAPABILITY IN THE SOUTH, ALREADY ORGANISED. THE ASK IS THEREFORE NARROW AND ANSWERABLE: WILL THE NEXT TOUR PASS THIS STRETCH, WHAT DID YOU SEE, AND WILL YOU PUBLISH IT WITH THE DATE AND THE PLACE. BESIDE IT WORKS A YOUNGER, LOOSER EFFORT IN THE SAME GOVERNORATE: A VOLUNTEER CAMPAIGN TO CLEAN THE MARSHES AND PRESERVE THEIR NATURAL PURITY, UNDER THE SLOGAN THAT THE MARSHES ARE THE HISTORIC RESPONSIBILITY OF EVERYONE. WHAT IS AT STAKE IS NOT SCENERY. THE WATER EXPANSES OF THE SOUTH, ACROSS THREE GOVERNORATES, HAVE BEEN TIED FOR THOUSANDS OF YEARS TO THE LIVES OF THEIR INHABITANTS, WHO BUILT THEIR WAY OF LIFE ON WATER, REEDS, FISHING, BUFFALO HERDING AND MOVEMENT BY CANOE. AND THE LOSSES ARE RECORDED PLAINLY: SEVERE DROUGHT HAS CUT WATER LEVELS, SHRUNK THE FLOODED AREAS, RAISED SALINITY, KILLED LARGE NUMBERS OF BUFFALO AND FISH, AND DRIVEN MANY FAMILIES TO THE CITIES IN SEARCH OF OTHER LIVELIHOODS. THAT IS DISPLACEMENT BY WATER LOSS, AND IT IS THE ARGUMENT THAT REACHES BODIES WHICH DO NOT ANSWER TO ENVIRONMENTAL COMPLAINTS - THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS HOUSING, LAND AND PROPERTY WORK AND HUMANITARIAN FUNDS THAT RESPOND TO DISPLACEMENT WHERE THEY WOULD NOT RESPOND TO A REED BED. THE MONEY IS ALREADY ARRIVING IN THIS DISTRICT, WHICH IS THE PRACTICAL REASON TO BE ORGANISED NOW: A UNITED NATIONS DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMME IS IMPLEMENTING THE COUNTRY'S CLIMATE INVESTMENT PLAN THROUGH MARSH RESTORATION AND SUPPORT FOR COMMUNITY ADAPTATION IN SIX GOVERNORATES INCLUDING THIS ONE; A MIGRATION ORGANISATION IS DOCUMENTING CLIMATE-LINKED DISPLACEMENT AND SUPPORTING RESILIENCE INITIATIVES; AND A FOOD AND AGRICULTURE ORGANISATION WITH A CLIMATE FUND IS INVESTING THIRTY-NINE MILLION DOLLARS IN SUSTAINABLE AGRICULTURE AND RENEWABLE ENERGY. WHEN THAT MUCH RESTORATION MONEY IS COMMITTED TO NAMED GOVERNORATES, THE COMMUNITIES INSIDE THEM SHOULD BE ASKING WHICH VILLAGES THE PROGRAMMES REACH, WHO SELECTS THEM AND WHAT COMMUNITY ADAPTATION MEANS IN PRACTICE - AND THE LOCAL ORGANISATION WITH THE BOATS IS THE ONE ALREADY KNOWN TO THOSE PROGRAMMES. THE LIMITS: THIS IS AN ECOTOURISM AND DOCUMENTATION ORGANISATION, NOT A LEGAL OR LAND BODY - IT WILL NOT LITIGATE, BUY GROUND OR REPRESENT ANYONE, AND ITS INTEREST IN VISITOR NUMBERS MAY NOT ALWAYS ALIGN WITH A COMMUNITY'S. IT WAS SEEN ONLY THROUGH ITS PUBLIC SOCIAL MEDIA PAGE: WHETHER IT IS FORMALLY REGISTERED, WHO LEADS IT, WHETHER IT ACCEPTS REQUESTS FROM OUTSIDE ITS DISTRICT AND HOW TO CONTACT IT OTHER THAN ONLINE WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED. THE VOLUNTEER CAMPAIGN IS A DATED CAMPAIGN OF APRIL 2026 RATHER THAN A STANDING BODY. THE DROUGHT AND FUNDING FIGURES COME FROM PRESS ANALYSES OF JANUARY AND MAY 2026 QUOTING INTERNATIONAL ORGANISATIONS, NOT FROM THE PROGRAMMES THEMSELVES, AND NAMING POLLUTERS IN THIS REGION CARRIES RISK FOR THOSE WHO DO IT. Read it with the river organisation's threat survey, the transnational litigation network, the protection organisations and the agricultural engineers' syndicate recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Higher authority for coordination between provinces — the body that collects property coordinates and registry extracts and chases land allocation
trackers.desc: THIS ROUND BEGAN WITH TWO STRONG RESULTS ABOUT A 2026 LOCAL ADMINISTRATION BILL THAT TURNED OUT TO BELONG TO ANOTHER COUNTRY ENTIRELY - THE ARABIC PHRASE IS IDENTICAL ACROSS THE REGION AND ONLY THE PRIME MINISTER'S NAME GAVE IT AWAY. BOTH WERE DISCARDED. WHAT REMAINED IS BETTER: A HIGHER AUTHORITY FOR COORDINATION BETWEEN THE PROVINCES, CHAIRED BY THE PRIME MINISTER, WITH A GENERAL COORDINATOR FOR PROVINCIAL AFFAIRS AND COMMITTEES THAT VISIT PROVINCES AND PUBLISH WHAT THEY RECOMMEND. WHAT IT ASKS THE PROVINCES FOR IS THE PART A COMMUNITY SHOULD READ TWICE: ITS COMMITTEE RECOMMENDED WRITING TO THE PROVINCES TO SUPPLY THE COORDINATES, THE SITE PLAN AND A COPY OF THE REGISTRY ENTRY FOR PROPERTY LOCATIONS, ALONGSIDE THE INSPECTION MINUTE FOR THE PROPERTIES SELECTED. COORDINATES, SITE PLAN, REGISTRY EXTRACT AND INSPECTION MINUTE ARE THE FOUR DOCUMENTS THAT DECIDE EVERY LAND ARGUMENT IN THIS FILE - AND HERE A NATIONAL BODY IS ORDERING PROVINCES TO PRODUCE THEM FOR NAMED SITES. THAT MEANS THE DOCUMENTS EXIST, IN THE PROVINCE, FOR THE PLOTS BEING ALLOCATED. IT ALSO CHASES THE BLOCKAGES: IT FOLLOWS UP THE OBSTACLES FACING PROVINCES IN ALLOCATING LANDS CONNECTED WITH THE AGRICULTURAL LANDS DEPARTMENT AND STATE PROPERTIES, COMPLETES VISITS TO THE PROVINCES TO SEE WHAT THE SUB-COMMITTEES HAVE DONE, AND WROTE TO THE CABINET ASKING THAT THE DIRECTOR GENERAL OF THE AGRICULTURAL LANDS DEPARTMENT BE GIVEN POWER TO LIFT THE AGRARIAN REFORM HOLD FOR A HOUSING DISTRICT. LIFTING AN AGRARIAN REFORM HOLD IS HOW FARMLAND BECOMES BUILDING LAND IN THIS COUNTRY. A FARMING COMMUNITY THAT LEARNS ITS DISTRICT'S LAND IS ON SUCH A LIST HAS FOUND OUT BEFORE THE BULLDOZERS RATHER THAN AFTER. THE SAME COORDINATOR HAS DISCUSSED WITH ONE GOVERNOR THE ALLOCATION OF LANDS AND THE CONCLUSION OF CONTRACTS FOR RENEWABLE ENERGY PROJECTS - SO SOLAR AND WIND SITES ARE BEING ALLOCATED THROUGH THIS CHANNEL TOO, AND THE SAME QUESTIONS APPLY: WHICH PLOT, WHOSE REGISTRY ENTRY, WHAT INSPECTION MINUTE. NOW THE PART THAT MAKES ALL OF THIS URGENT. ON THE NINTH OF AUGUST 2026 A MEMBER OF PARLIAMENT SUBMITTED A REQUEST TO PLACE ON THE AGENDA A PROPOSAL TO FREEZE THE WORK OF THE PROVINCIAL COUNCILS AND THEIR BUDGETS FOR THE CURRENT CYCLE, RELYING ON PARLIAMENT'S OVERSIGHT AND LEGISLATIVE POWERS AND ON THE 2008 LAW OF PROVINCES NOT INCORPORATED INTO A REGION. IF THE ELECTED PROVINCIAL COUNCILS ARE FROZEN, THE LOCAL TIER THIS FILE HAS SPENT TWENTY-FOUR ROUNDS DOCUMENTING DISAPPEARS IN THIS COUNTRY AND EVERYTHING RUNS THROUGH APPOINTED EXECUTIVES AND THIS COORDINATION AUTHORITY INSTEAD. ANALYSIS PUBLISHED THAT MONTH PUTS IT PLAINLY: THE PROPOSAL REOPENS A FILE THAT HAS BEEN AMONG THE MOST CONFUSED IN THE STATE SINCE 2003 - HOW TO BUILD A LOCAL ADMINISTRATION WITH REAL POWERS WITHOUT DECENTRALISATION BECOMING A NEW ARENA FOR POLITICAL CONFLICT. SO THE PRACTICAL ADVICE IS ABOUT TIMING: WHILE THE COUNCILS SIT, USE THEM - PUT THE QUESTION ABOUT A PLOT, A CONTRACT OR AN ALLOCATION TO YOUR OWN PROVINCIAL COUNCIL MEMBER IN WRITING, AND KEEP THE ANSWER. IF THEY ARE FROZEN, THAT PAPER IS THE LAST RECORD MADE BY AN ELECTED LOCAL BODY. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A CENTRAL COORDINATION BODY CHAIRED BY THE PRIME MINISTER, NOT A LOCAL ONE - IT EXISTS TO MAKE PROVINCES DELIVER GOVERNMENT PRIORITIES, AND ITS INTEREST IN LAND IS ALLOCATION FOR PROJECTS RATHER THAN PROTECTION FROM THEM; NOTHING RECORDED HERE SHOWS IT ACTING ON A RESIDENT'S COMPLAINT. WHETHER MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC MAY REQUEST ANY OF THE DOCUMENTS IT COLLECTS, WHETHER ITS COMMITTEE MINUTES ARE PUBLISHED IN FULL, AND HOW TO CONTACT IT WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED. THE FREEZE PROPOSAL WAS A REQUEST TO PLACE AN ITEM ON THE AGENDA, NOT A DECISION, AND WHAT BECAME OF IT WAS NOT ESTABLISHED. THE ACCOUNT COMES FROM THE AUTHORITY'S OWN NEWS PAGE AND A RESEARCH CENTRE'S ANALYSIS OF AUGUST 2026. Read it with the river organisation's threat survey, the marsh ecotourism organisation, the protection organisations and the agricultural engineers' syndicate recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Agricultural cooperative associations open to land lessees, and the general union that argues publicly over water shares and fees
trackers.desc: THE PROVISION MOST WORTH KNOWING IN THIS ENTRY IS ABOUT WHO MAY JOIN: THE LAW'S OWN STATED REASONS RECORD THAT NECESSITY REQUIRED THE FOUNDING OF AGRICULTURAL COOPERATIVE ASSOCIATIONS FOR THE LESSEES OF LANDS UNDER AN EARLIER LAW, IN ORDER TO CONTRIBUTE TO ORGANISING THEIR PRODUCTION OPERATIONS IN ITS VARIOUS STAGES. COOPERATIVES FOR TENANTS, NOT ONLY FOR OWNERS. THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED AGRICULTURAL COOPERATIVES IN A DOZEN COUNTRIES WHOSE MEMBERSHIP REQUIRES HOLDING A TITLE - WHICH EXCLUDES EXACTLY THE PEOPLE MOST EASILY REMOVED FROM LAND. HERE THE LESSEE HAS A BODY OF HIS OWN. THE PRINCIPLES THE LAW SAYS IT EXISTS TO DEEPEN ARE WORTH QUOTING BACK AT ANY COOPERATIVE BOARD: THE TWO PRINCIPLES OF VOLUNTARINESS IN JOINING AND WITHDRAWING, AND OF DEMOCRATIC ADMINISTRATION - WITH A FORM OF MANAGING THE ASSOCIATION AND THE UNIONS CONSISTENT WITH THAT DIRECTION. VOLUNTARY WITHDRAWAL IS THE HALF PEOPLE FORGET. A FARMER WHO CAN LEAVE IS A FARMER WHOSE COOPERATIVE HAS TO KEEP HIM - AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED COOPERATIVES ELSEWHERE THAT FUNCTION AS COMPULSORY CHANNELS FOR STATE INPUTS INSTEAD. THE LAW ALSO SET OUT TO SIMPLIFY THE STRUCTURE, CHANGING THE MOVEMENT BY REMOVING SOME SUPERFLUOUS LINKS IN THE COOPERATIVE ORGANISATIONS, AND TO GIVE THOSE ORGANISATIONS INDEPENDENCE IN SUPERVISION, ADMINISTRATION AND DIRECTION BY MAKING THE GENERAL UNION OF AGRICULTURAL COOPERATIVE ASSOCIATIONS THE PRINCIPAL BODY SUPERVISING THEM, DIRECTING THEM AND MONITORING THEIR WORK. A UNION THAT SUPERVISES THE COOPERATIVES INSTEAD OF A MINISTRY DOING SO IS THE ARRANGEMENT THAT MAKES A FARMERS' MOVEMENT POSSIBLE - AND IT IS ALSO THE ARRANGEMENT THAT CAN CAPTURE ONE, SO THE QUESTION FOR ANY VILLAGE IS WHO SITS ON THE UNION AND HOW THEY GOT THERE. THAT UNION IS AUDIBLE NOW, AND ON THE RIGHT SUBJECT: ITS DEPUTY HEAD CALLED FOR RECONSIDERATION OF THE AGRICULTURAL PLAN AND FOR SUPPORT TO FARMERS - INCLUDING REDUCING ELECTRICITY AND IRRIGATION FEES AND DEVELOPING ALTERNATIVES FOR IRRIGATION. ELECTRICITY AND IRRIGATION FEES ARE WHAT DECIDE WHETHER A SMALLHOLDER CAN PUMP AT ALL. AN ORGANISATION ALREADY DEMANDING THEIR REDUCTION IS ONE A VILLAGE'S OWN COMPLAINT CAN BE ATTACHED TO RATHER THAN RAISED ALONE. THE NUMBERS BEHIND THAT DEMAND ARE THE HARDEST FACTS IN THIS ENTRY: THE CABINET APPROVED A WINTER AGRICULTURAL PLAN FOR THE 2025-2026 SEASON CUT TO FOUR AND A HALF MILLION DUNUMS BECAUSE OF THE WATER CRISIS, AGAINST FOUR POINT EIGHT MILLION THE PREVIOUS SEASON. AND THE SPLIT IS THE PART EVERY FARMING COMMUNITY HERE SHOULD READ: OF THAT EARLIER PLAN, THREE POINT ONE FOUR MILLION DUNUMS - SOME SEVENTY-EIGHT PER CENT - DEPENDED ON GROUNDWATER, AND ONLY ONE POINT SIX SIX MILLION ON DIRECT IRRIGATION FROM RIVER WATER, WITH SPECIALISTS CALLING THE NEW PLAN THE MOST STRINGENT AND ORGANISED IN RECENT YEARS GIVEN THE DECLINE IN RELEASES FROM THE TWO RIVERS. SEVENTY-EIGHT PER CENT OF THE PLANTED AREA ON GROUNDWATER MEANS THE COUNTRY'S FARMING NOW RESTS ON AQUIFERS RATHER THAN RIVERS. THAT IS THE CONTEXT FOR EVERY WELL PERMIT, EVERY PUMP AND EVERY DISPUTE OVER A NEIGHBOUR'S BOREHOLE - AND IT IS WHY THE UNION'S CALL FOR ALTERNATIVES FOR IRRIGATION IS NOT A SLOGAN. THE PRACTICAL SEQUENCE FOR A VILLAGE IS SHORT: FIND WHETHER AN AGRICULTURAL COOPERATIVE ASSOCIATION COVERS THE AREA, ASK WHETHER LESSEES AS WELL AS OWNERS ARE MEMBERS, ASK WHEN ITS GENERAL ASSEMBLY MEETS, AND PUT THE AREA'S WATER AND FEE PROBLEM THROUGH IT TO THE UNION. THE LIMITS: THIS ENTRY RESTS ON A LAW OF 2002 AND ITS STATED REASONS, READ ON A PRIVATE LEGAL WIKI RATHER THAN AN OFFICIAL GAZETTE - WHETHER THAT LAW REMAINS IN FORCE UNAMENDED, HOW MANY ASSOCIATIONS EXIST, WHERE THEY ARE, WHAT MEMBERSHIP COSTS AND WHETHER THEY FUNCTION AT ALL IN A GIVEN GOVERNORATE WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED. A COOPERATIVE UNION IS A PRODUCERS' BODY, NOT AN ENVIRONMENTAL OR LEGAL ONE: ITS DEMANDS ARE FOR CHEAPER POWER AND MORE WATER, WHICH WILL NOT ALWAYS ALIGN WITH PROTECTING AN AQUIFER OR A MARSH, AND NOTHING RECORDED HERE SHOWS IT DEFENDING LAND AGAINST A PROJECT. THE UNION'S CURRENT DEMAND AND THE PLAN FIGURES COME FROM AN ECONOMIC NEWS SITE'S REPORT OF NOVEMBER 2025, AND NOTHING HERE APPLIES TO THE AUTONOMOUS REGION, WHICH HAS ITS OWN ARRANGEMENTS. Read it with the bar's appeal-court delegation bodies, the marsh ecotourism organisation, the river organisation's threat survey and the inter-provincial coordination authority's property documents recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Ecological Society 'Green Salvation' (Экологическое общество «Зеленое спасение»)
trackers.desc: WHO TO ENLIST: Kazakhstan's veteran environmental-rights organisation, which litigates and publishes an annual review of its own court practice so you can see exactly what it runs and how it fares. It files in the Specialised Inter-district Administrative Court in Almaty both for itself and — the lever worth knowing — in defence of an indeterminate circle of persons, which is how an association carries a claim for a community that could not bring one alone. Its grounds are usually article 4 of the Aarhus Convention on access to timely, complete and reliable environmental information, read with articles 13 and 17 of the Environmental Code and the access-to-information law; it also ran the long campaign over Kok-Zhailau and the national park. WHO IT SUITS: anyone refused environmental information or facing a project pushed through without disclosure. It is Almaty-based and small, so expect reach to be strongest there. IT TOOK A BUFFER ZONE CASE TO THE SUPREME COURT AND WON OUTRIGHT, AND THE SHAPE OF THAT CASE IS THE MOST COPYABLE THING IT HAS DONE. It did not sue a developer. It sued the city administration for FAILING TO ESTABLISH THE BUFFER ZONE of a national park — asking the court to recognise that failure as unlawful inaction. On 31 May 2023 the Supreme Court satisfied its cassation appeal in full and cancelled every lower court decision in the case, a judge noting that the park is of international importance and that the administration should give the most serious attention to its safety. THE PROSECUTOR SUPPORTED THE ORGANISATION'S DEMAND IN COURT, stressing that fifteen years was more than enough time to have done it. Where a protective designation exists on paper but its buffer has never been drawn, the failure to draw it is itself actionable. THE PATH IS WORTH KNOWING BECAUSE IT IS LONG AND ORDINARY: a letter to the city administration in September 2021, forwarded to a department and then forwarded on again; a first-instance loss in April 2022; an appeal dismissed that September; a cassation complaint in October 2022; judgment in May 2023. Twenty months and three courts, starting with a letter anyone could write. ITS FILINGS STACK EVERY AVAILABLE SOURCE RATHER THAN RELYING ON ONE: Article 4 of the Aarhus Convention, Articles 13 and 17 of the Environmental Code, and Articles 6, 7 and 9 of the Law on Access to Information, pleaded together, with claims brought expressly in defence of the interests of an indefinite number of persons as well as of the organisation itself. It wins access-to-information cases repeatedly, including one requiring the city tourism department to release a report it had commissioned under state order on transport access within a national park — so a study paid for with public money and used to justify a scheme is obtainable. AND THE COURTS WILL DISCIPLINE OFFICIALS WHO DO NOT TAKE THE CASE SERIOUSLY: in one matter the court fined the head of a district administration office 73,840 tenge for failing to meet its procedural obligations. Beyond the courts it writes to several authorities at once on a single problem — park administration, the forestry and wildlife committee, the environment ministry, the environmental prosecutor's office and the anti-corruption department together — which is how a stalled matter gets moved. It is represented by a named advocate of the Almaty city bar, and it has also taken a complaint against an international financial institution over an oil and gas project. NOTE ON ITS ADDRESS: older complaint papers and citations give this organisation at greensalvation.org; its current site is the one linked here. Same body. COUNT THE PIECES: A PROJECT SPLIT INTO SMALL OBJECTS IS A PROJECT HIDING ITS CUMULATIVE IMPACT. In the same national park whose buffer zone case is described above, campaigners report that a returned mountain resort scheme has been divided into a set of separate small objects, so that the public cannot assess the combined scale of what is proposed — in their account, instead of one resort the public is sold a collection of small ones while the park becomes a construction site. THIS IS NOT A LOCAL TRICK. In Turkiye, companies holding large licence areas applied in respect of 24 hectares to stay below the 25-hectare threshold that triggers full environmental impact assessment, and the Council of State stayed that arrangement, holding that an operation must undergo full assessment if it works even one additional hectare inside the same licence area. A COMMUNITY FACING A FRAGMENTED SCHEME HERE HAS A DECIDED CASE FROM ANOTHER COUNTRY TO PUT IN FRONT OF A COURT. Ask for the total area, the total investment and the combined footprint of every related application, and object to the fragmentation itself as well as to the pieces. TWO MORE LESSONS FROM THAT CAMPAIGN, WHICH IS THE MOST SUCCESSFUL THIS FILE HAS FOUND ANYWHERE. It ran for eight years and it won — the head of state stated publicly that the project was not needed and it was abandoned. AND SEVEN YEARS LATER IT CAME BACK UNDER A NEW NAME, with public hearings on a fresh impact report. A win against a state-backed scheme is a pause, not a conclusion; the same campaigners are now contesting the successor project and invoking the government's own law-and-order commitments against it. THE TACTIC THAT MADE THE FIRST WIN POSSIBLE IS WORTH COPYING: the campaigners did not only object, they developed and published an ALTERNATIVE PROJECT for the same site — an ecological park with no construction — and put it to the authorities and the public. This file has recorded twice elsewhere that handing a decision-maker a worked alternative changes outcomes in a way that opposition alone does not. They also secured an international anti-award for the scheme at a European tourism fair, which cost nothing and travelled further than a local protest.

trackers.name: ООПТ местного значения — aim at the oblast akimat, not the ministry
trackers.desc: THERE ARE TWO TIERS AND THE NEARER ONE IS LOCAL. Alongside the republican list of ООПТ approved by government decree, the law provides for protected areas of local significance, with местные исполнительные органы of oblasts, cities of republican significance and the capital acting within their competence. For a site of regional rather than national importance, the oblast akimat is the route — as in Albania, Montenegro and Luxembourg, and unlike Tunisia where the municipal route is closed. THE DEFINITION THAT ANSWERS ‘PROTECTION WILL END OUR FARMING’: the law defines традиционное землепользование as historically established types of agricultural activity in the region which do not have a harmful effect on natural complexes and the state nature reserve fund, are adapted to the given ecological system, and are carried out by owners of land plots or land users. Frame your existing use in exactly those four terms — historically established, non-harmful, adapted, and by an owner or land user — because they are the statute's own words. CATEGORIES WORTH KNOWING: государственный памятник природы covers individual unique, irreplaceable objects, the category for a single feature rather than a landscape; and биосферный резерват expressly includes охранные зоны, buffer zones.

trackers.name: Reserved zones, and the mining article to ask about
trackers.desc: TWO PROVISIONS THAT DECIDE HOW YOU ARGUE. 1. LAND CAN BE HELD BEFORE DESIGNATION: a государственная заповедная зона is a protected area with differentiated protection regimes, established to conserve and restore the nature reserve fund and biodiversity on land and waters reserved for future zapovedniks, national parks and reserves — a mechanism in place since 1976. So reservation can protect a site while full designation is still incomplete. 2. DO NOT ASSERT A BAN THE CODE DOES NOT CONTAIN: the Экологический кодекс sets ecological requirements for siting within ООПТ of settlements, industrial, agricultural, energy, transport and defence objects not connected with the purposes and functioning of the ООПТ, and article 255 sets special ecological requirements for subsoil use operations on the territory of state reserved zones. Mining inside a заповедная зона is therefore subject to special requirements rather than simply prohibited — so ask which requirements were applied and how compliance was assessed, which is a question with a documentary answer, instead of claiming a blanket prohibition that can be rebutted in one line.

trackers.name: CAREC — two organisations share the name, neither is a grant fund
trackers.desc: ‘CAREC’ IS TWO DIFFERENT ORGANISATIONS AND YOU WILL PROBABLY APPROACH THE WRONG ONE. The Regional Environmental Centre for Central Asia (carecnet.org / carececo.org) was established following the 4th Pan-European Conference in Aarhus, 1998, operating since 2001 as an independent, non-commercial and non-partisan organisation of international character. Its founders are Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan and Uzbekistan plus UNDP and the European Commission; headquarters in Almaty, with country offices in all five member states (the Kyrgyz office is at 142 Gorky str., office 410, Bishkek 720005). The unrelated Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation (CAREC) Program is an Asian Development Bank programme founded 1997, based in Manila, with 11 members including Afghanistan, Azerbaijan, China and Pakistan. NEITHER IS A COMMUNITY GRANT FUND. The Environmental Centre offers a dialogue platform for environmental NGOs and representation at international forums and thematic networks, and collaborates with NGOs, government and business — a route to partnership, visibility and project consortia, not an application window. The ADB programme's Climate and Sustainability Project Preparatory Fund (US$3m from Korea, US$2m from China) supports preparation of bankable regional projects and its eligible recipients are developing member countries — states, not community groups. Approach the Environmental Centre's country office for partnership; do not send it a grant application expecting an award.

trackers.name: GEF Small Grants Programme — up to US$50,000 direct to communities
trackers.desc: WHERE THE COMMUNITY MONEY ACTUALLY IS. The GEF Small Grants Programme, running since 1992 and implemented by UNDP, reached 135 countries of 144 eligible in GEF-8, which secured US$135 million for the core programme with nearly US$1 million allocated to each participating country — a per-country floor, so the money is not competed for across borders. Grants of up to US$50,000 go directly to local communities, community-based organisations and other non-governmental groups. Focal areas: biodiversity, climate change, land degradation and sustainable forest management, international waters and chemicals. KAZAKHSTAN HAS ONE OF THE MOST MATURE SGP PROGRAMMES — recorded among those upgraded to full-sized projects and managed by UNDP's Communities, Livelihoods and Markets cluster, alongside Brazil, India, Mexico and Pakistan. An upgraded programme is larger and better established, but also more formal — expect fuller documentation than a standard country programme.

trackers.name: ICCA Registry and Protected Planet — and registration is not a precondition
trackers.desc: CHECK WHETHER YOUR SITE IS ALREADY IN A REGISTRY BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE — it may carry a designation nobody locally mentioned. The World Database on Protected and Conserved Areas at protectedplanet.net is a joint UNEP and IUCN product managed by UNEP-WCMC, drawing on almost 500 data providers in 245 countries, updated monthly and downloadable; it underpins the UN List of Protected Areas. THE OECM ROUTE IS THE ONE MOST COMMUNITIES MISS: a site qualifies as an other effective area-based conservation measure if it delivers sustained, positive conservation outcomes EVEN THOUGH IT MAY BE MANAGED PRIMARILY FOR OTHER REASONS — so a grazing commons, a sacred site or a watershed managed for water supply can qualify without being managed primarily for conservation. Land that is worked rather than preserved is not excluded. But note the exclusivity: a site can be a protected area or an OECM — it is not possible to meet both, so ask which is being proposed. THE ICCA REGISTRY IS THE ONE COMMUNITIES FILL IN THEMSELVES: at iccaregistry.org, communities themselves provide data, case studies, maps, photos and stories, and its operators state it is meant to be used to enhance advocacy and recognition — not merely as an inventory. Documenting a territory there creates a citable, third-party-hosted record. THE SENTENCE THAT MATTERS MOST: UNEP-WCMC states these territories must be recognised and respected ‘whether or not they have been reported to the ICCA Registry’ — registration is NOT a precondition of rights, and anyone arguing a claim is weaker for being unregistered is arguing against the registry operator's own position. AND USE THE SCALE FIGURE CAREFULLY: over 1,500 sites are reported under indigenous and community governance — just 1 percent of all recorded sites, with UNEP-WCMC adding that no one knows how many ICCAs exist globally. That 1 percent measures how little has been recorded, not how little communities conserve. Filter Protected Planet by governance type to find such sites; UNEP-WCMC's manual Global Databases to Support ICCAs gives guidance on contributing data.

trackers.name: ACBK — leases land out of hunting use, and writes the expert review of a developer's OVOS
trackers.desc: TWO THINGS IT DOES THAT NO COMMUNITY CAN DO FOR ITSELF. First, it takes ground off the market by holding the lease: ACBK has leased two hunting areas totalling some 340,000 hectares that mattered for saiga calving and migration, which is the same tactic as buying land — acquire the use-right so nobody else can exercise it. Second, and more immediately useful to a campaign, it produces the written expert critique of the developer's own impact assessment. ACBK publishes formal correspondence and specialist reviews on its own site under a Problems and Solutions section, including its objection concerning the Kokzhailau mountain resort planned on former and current lands of the Ile-Alatau State National Nature Park, and a named specialist's review of that project's preliminary OVOS on biodiversity components. That written assessment by a named scientist, addressed to the body deciding, is the thing communities most often cannot produce and most often lose without. WHO TO CONTACT: office 406, Beybitshilik 18, Astana 010000; acbk@acbk.kz; telephone and fax (7172) 91 00 44. Executive Director Vera Voronova. WHAT IT IS NOT: a litigator. ACBK is a research and conservation association, so pair it with counsel rather than expecting it to run your case — this file already carries Ecological Society Green Salvation for Kazakhstan, and the sensible division is that one supplies the evidence and the other files. SOURCING CAVEAT: the 340,000-hectare lease figure comes from Frankfurt Zoological Society, ACBK's partner in the Altyn Dala Conservation Initiative, not from ACBK's own domain, and a widely repeated claim that the 127 Important Bird Areas ACBK inventoried with RSPB all now hold national legal protection could not be confirmed on acbk.kz either — treat both as questions to put to the Astana office rather than facts to quote. A CORRIDOR CAN BE DECLARED WITHOUT TAKING ANYONE'S LAND, AND THIS ORGANISATION MADE THAT HAPPEN. An ecological corridor was established in Kostanay province BY DECREE OF THE PROVINCIAL GOVERNOR, and the lands within it are NOT WITHDRAWN FROM THEIR HOLDERS — the designation constrains what may be done on the land without dispossessing the people on it, and reserve inspectors patrol it. If the first fear in your village is losing the land itself, that is the precedent to put in front of them. This association developed the methodology for identifying ecological corridors, piloted it, and prepared the materials the governor's decree rested on, within a state and United Nations funded steppe ecosystems project — so a province, not a ministry, was the level at which the protection was won. ITS TENURE WORK GOES FURTHER THAN THE LEASES ALREADY DESCRIBED ABOVE: Kazakhstan's first ecopark was created by this association on the basis of TWO HUNTING CONCESSIONS, converting existing commercial use-rights into a protected area. With its direct participation a state nature reserve was created, two ecological corridors established, an existing reserve enlarged, and two areas recognised as World Natural Heritage sites. AND IT HOLDS THE EVIDENCE THAT WORKS AGAINST ROADS, RAILWAYS AND PIPELINES: years of satellite collaring produced movement data used to identify key seasonal areas, to recommend creating and expanding protected areas, and specifically TO ESTABLISH THE EFFECT OF LINEAR INFRASTRUCTURE ON MIGRATION. A community facing a route across open steppe can ask whether it crosses a mapped migration corridor — the maps exist and this is who holds them. Current animal locations are also passed to state inspectors so enforcement can follow the herds.ONE ACHIEVEMENT OF THIS ASSOCIATION IS WORTH MORE TO A COMMUNITY THAN ANYTHING ELSE IT DOES, AND IT WAS NOT RECORDED HERE.
