It also trains people to take local office — by its own account thirteen women who went through its training became deputies of local keneshes across four provinces — which matters because in Kyrgyzstan the local council is where land decisions are taken, and because it develops young advocates in-house, with a named senior lawyer bringing them through real cases. THE LIMITS AND THE GAPS: nothing found this round establishes that it has acted for communities in a mining or land dispute, so treat the environmental route as available on framing rather than proven; and the hotline number was published in the pandemic period, so confirm it is current before relying on it. Pair with BIOM and the independent expertise association, both already in this file for Kyrgyzstan, for the environmental evidence — and remember that on pasture the body with the legal interest is your jayit committee. THIS ORGANISATION IS NOW LITIGATING FOR ITS OWN SECTOR'S SURVIVAL, AND A READER SHOULD KNOW THAT BEFORE RELYING ON IT. A foreign representatives law adopted in March 2024 — passed in its third reading in two minutes without debate — and signed that April requires foreign-funded organisations engaged in broadly defined political activity to register as foreign representatives, label all their materials, and submit to reporting and auditing, with non-compliance punishable by suspension for up to six months or complete shutdown. This organisation submitted a petition to have the law repealed in May 2024 and has separately asked an administrative court to annul the government's implementation decree. TWO THINGS FOLLOW FOR ANYONE PLANNING TO ASK IT FOR HELP. Its capacity may be constrained by circumstances unrelated to your case — monitoring records that some Kyrgyz organisations have chosen to SELF-LIQUIDATE or restrict their work rather than be targeted, and that the law may deter international funders from supporting Kyrgyz organisations at all. And the sector's difficulties are not hypothetical: the organisation behind a well-known Kyrgyz investigative outlet was liquidated by the Supreme Court in 2024, and other outlets have had offices sealed and journalists arrested. ONE THING IS WORTH CARRYING INTO ANY ARGUMENT ABOUT THIS LAW: in October 2024 the Council of Europe's Venice Commission concluded that it FAILS TO MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF KYRGYZSTAN'S OWN CONSTITUTION and of its international treaty obligations for permissible restrictions on associations — naming legality, legitimacy, necessity, proportionality and non-discrimination. That is an authoritative external finding available to anyone contesting the law's application to them. An external protection mechanism is now recorded separately for Kyrgyzstan for the same reason.

trackers.name: CEPF Mountains of Central Asia — small grants averaging about $15,000 direct to community groups, but your project must map to a strategic direction
trackers.desc: THIS IS ONE OF THE FEW FUNDS ANYWHERE IN THIS REGION THAT GIVES MONEY DIRECTLY TO COMMUNITY GROUPS RATHER THAN THROUGH A NATIONAL PARTNER. Eligible applicants are civil society organisations of all sizes — farmers' cooperatives, community groups, indigenous peoples' groups, universities, small businesses and non-governmental organisations alike. Small grants average around fifteen thousand US dollars and are handled by a regional implementation team based in or near the hotspot; larger grants average around a hundred and fifty thousand and are handled by the secretariat, with roughly twenty thousand dollars the dividing line. THE CONDITION THAT DECIDES ELIGIBILITY, AND IT IS NOT NEGOTIABLE: every project must link to one of the strategic directions set out in the hotspot's ecosystem profile. Read the profile before writing anything — a good project that does not map onto a strategic direction is not a fundable project here, and CEPF works to Key Biodiversity Areas and corridors rather than to political boundaries, so what matters is whether your site sits in a priority area. TWO PRACTICAL POINTS THAT CATCH APPLICANTS: individuals cannot apply directly and must work through a civil society organisation — which is the second time this file has found that registering matters, after the Kazakh network that incorporated specifically in order to be able to act — and calls are open only intermittently, typically for six to eight weeks at a time, so subscribe to the newsletter and watch the open calls page rather than checking occasionally. Small-grant applications start with a short letter of inquiry by email, which may be accepted in a local language specified in the call rather than only in English. CEPF is a joint initiative of the French Development Agency, Conservation International, the European Union, the Global Environment Facility, the Government of Japan and the World Bank. VERIFY THE COUNTRY LIST BEFORE YOU PLAN: this entry records the Mountains of Central Asia hotspot, which is among those currently open, but the precise list of countries and the current call status were not confirmed on cepf.net during verification. Check the ecosystem profile and the open calls page first. AND KNOW WHAT IS CLOSED: CEPF's Caucasus investment ran from 2004, committed 8.5 million dollars and awarded 42 grants, and that window has ended — Armenian and Georgian groups will find extensive Caucasus material online that no longer corresponds to an open fund.TIMING NEWS: THE PROGRAMME REPORTS NEARLY ONE HUNDRED PROJECTS IN ITS FIRST PHASE AND A NEW PORTFOLIO STARTING IN 2026, under a five-year programme WORTH UP TO EIGHT MILLION DOLLARS ACROSS THE FIVE COUNTRIES, with a regional implementation team being appointed to run it. THE OPENING OF A CYCLE IS THE MOMENT TO APPROACH — priorities are still being set and the first calls are the least contested. AND THE EXAMPLE IT CITES FROM THIS COUNTRY IS THE ONE TO BUILD ON: COMMUNITY RANGERS MONITORING SNOW LEOPARD. That is villagers paid and equipped to patrol and record — which produces both a livelihood and the dated evidence of what a mountain area holds that every other route in this map depends on. This file records the pasture committees and the forest and land users' association separately here; EITHER COULD HOST SUCH A RANGER PROGRAMME, because both already hold the ground. THE FUND ALSO CITES ADVOCACY FOR MICRO-RESERVES among its results — and this country's listing already records an organisation that got a community micro-reserve into official status. THAT COMBINATION IS THE MODEL: A SMALL GRANT PAYS FOR THE SURVEY AND THE ADVOCACY, AND THE OUTCOME IS A PROTECTED AREA THE COMMUNITY ITSELF MANAGES. ONE STRUCTURAL NOTE: the fund is now acting as EXECUTING AGENCY for a conservation organisation becoming one of two new implementing agencies for the GLOBAL SMALL GRANTS PROGRAMME, which this payload records separately in this country — so the two funding routes are converging.

trackers.name: ICCA Global Support Initiative — funding aimed specifically at territories and areas that communities already conserve themselves
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE STREAM TO ASK FOR WHEN THE LAND YOU ARE DEFENDING IS ALREADY CONSERVED BY YOUR OWN COMMUNITY RATHER THAN BY THE STATE. Within the Small Grants Programme there is a dedicated Global Support Initiative for territories and areas conserved by Indigenous Peoples and local communities — land held and looked after under customary arrangements, without formal protected-area status. Most conservation funding assumes either a state reserve or a private owner; this one is built around the third case, which is the common one across Central Asian pasture, forest and mountain territory. KYRGYZSTAN HAS SEEN A CALL UNDER IT: the United Nations country team published a Small Grants Programme call for proposals on strategic support to Indigenous Peoples and Community Conserved Areas, with applications accepted in Russian on a national template and submitted to a named programme address. Applications in Russian rather than English removes a barrier that quietly excludes most village-level applicants. WHY THIS MATTERS PARTICULARLY HERE: on pasture in Kyrgyzstan the body holding the use-right is the jayit committee, recorded elsewhere in this file, and pasture managed by such a committee is close to the definition this initiative was written for. A jayit committee approaching this stream is not stretching to fit a category; it is the category. The wider programme's rules apply — approach the National Coordinator first with a short concept paper, expect the money in three instalments, and remember that community groups which are not formally registered can be funded through a Memorandum of Agreement without an intermediary organisation, which for an unregistered pasture users' group is the decisive point. TWO CAVEATS. The Kyrgyz call reached dates from 2020, so establish whether the stream is currently open before planning around it — this file has repeatedly found Central Asian programmes that ran, did good work and lapsed. And the initiative is a global one; only its application in this country is recorded here, and a related response initiative appears in the same programme's material, so ask which vehicle is live rather than naming one.

trackers.name: Adilet Legal Clinic — it will register your organisation as a legal entity, which is the step that unlocks everything else
trackers.desc: START HERE IF YOUR GROUP IS NOT REGISTERED, BECAUSE REGISTRATION IS THE BLOCKER AND THIS CLINIC REMOVES IT. Among its listed services are the state registration, re-registration and closure of legal entities. Elsewhere in this file two findings meet at exactly this point: a Kazakh network that spent twenty-three years as an informal group registered in 2020 specifically because conducting public environmental expertise requires legal personality; and the Central Asian hotspot fund requires a registered entity with its own bank account while the small grants programme can reach an unregistered group only through a special memorandum. Registration is what turns a group of neighbours into a body that can commission expertise, hold a grant and appear in a case. THE OTHER SERVICES ARE THE ONES A LAND DISPUTE NEEDS: analysis of documents of legal significance, and disputes arising under contracts — which covers a lease, a concession or a construction agreement. ITS RECORD AGAINST THE STATE IS THE REASON TO TRUST IT WITH SOMETHING DIFFICULT: since 2002 its lawyers are credited with around thirty-three thousand legal consultations, and it won a case with no precedent in the country on behalf of parents of children infected with HIV in hospital, against state bodies. It also obtained citizenship documents for thirty-three residents of a state institution, offered free legal help to medical workers facing persecution over their statements, and publishes legal analyses of draft legislation — the last matters because a body that comments on bills before they pass knows the drafters. Based at Umetaliev Street 39 in Bishkek; it has run more than forty projects funded by United Nations agencies including the refugee and human rights offices, the development programme and the population fund, alongside European and Central Asian foundations. THE NAME IS A SERIOUS HAZARD AND YOU MUST CHECK YOU HAVE THE RIGHT BODY. At least five things answer to Adilet: this clinic; a SEPARATE Kyrgyz foundation with a nearly identical name whose registry entry records the termination of its activity in 2015 and whose company profile still appears in search looking current; a consumer protection society in Astana in another country; a law academy; and a political party in Kazakhstan. Match on this domain and on the Bishkek address, never on the name alone. WHAT IT IS NOT: not an environmental specialist. Its published record is civil rights, health, statelessness and legislative analysis, so frame a land matter as registration, contract or administrative process rather than as ecology — the same framing point this file has made for the Armenian and Georgian rights bodies.

trackers.name: Global Greengrants — you cannot apply to it; an advisor who lives in the region has to find you
trackers.desc: THE FIRST THING TO UNDERSTAND IS THAT THERE IS NO APPLICATION FORM. This fund does not accept unsolicited proposals. Groups are identified and invited by volunteer advisors who live in the region, are part of the movements they fund, and find potential grantees through their own networks; the regional board then decides who is funded. So the work is not writing a proposal — it is becoming known to the people on the Central Asia board, which means being visible in the regional movement, at gatherings, in the federations and networks recorded elsewhere in this file. WHY IT IS WORTH THE TROUBLE: its own account is that this model reaches critical groups most other funders cannot, and it launched a CENTRAL ASIA ADVISORY BOARD IN 2023 expressly to reach areas off the funding radar. Its stated focus areas include resource rights, ecosystem protection and environmental defenders. THE MONEY IS SMALL, FAST AND SUITED TO A VILLAGE RATHER THAN AN INSTITUTION: grants average around five thousand dollars, with many in the five hundred to five thousand range — which is the scale that pays for a survey, a lawyer's expenses, a bus to a hearing or a translation, and it is deliberate: the fund describes small grantmaking as a strategic approach overlooked by larger environmental funders. Across 2023 it made over fourteen hundred grants in more than a hundred and twenty countries. THIS SUITS THE KYRGYZ SITUATION BECAUSE THE BODIES THAT HOLD LAND HERE ARE PASTURE COMMITTEES AND VILLAGE GROUPS, not institutions with grant departments — and a fund that finds its grantees rather than waiting for forms is one of the few that can reach them. THE LIMITS: it names Central Asia as a region it works in but no country individually; it is based in the United States; and being unable to apply means there is no way to be sure of a hearing. Treat it as a reason to be present in the regional movement rather than as a window to watch.WHAT THIS ENTRY DID NOT SAY IS WHY THE EFFORT OF BEING FOUND IS WORTH MAKING: THE FUND'S OWN SUMMARY OF RESULTS STATES THAT ITS GRANT RECIPIENTS HAVE STOPPED LARGE-SCALE DAMS, DEFORESTATION, DIRTY ENERGY DEVELOPMENT, MINING AND POLLUTING INDUSTRIES. ALMOST EVERY OTHER FUNDER IN THIS PAYLOAD STATES OR IMPLIES THAT IT WILL NOT FINANCE OPPOSITION TO A DEVELOPMENT. THIS IS THE ONE WHOSE PUBLISHED OUTCOMES ARE PROJECTS STOPPED — WHICH IS WHY IT IS WORTH BUILDING THE RELATIONSHIPS THAT MAKE A GROUP FINDABLE. THE MONEY IS SMALL AND FAST: TYPICALLY BETWEEN FIVE HUNDRED AND FIVE THOUSAND DOLLARS, AVERAGING ABOUT FOUR THOUSAND EIGHT HUNDRED, WITH MORE THAN FOURTEEN THOUSAND GRANTS MADE IN A HUNDRED AND SIXTY-EIGHT COUNTRIES SINCE 1993. FIVE THOUSAND DOLLARS ARRIVING IN WEEKS BEATS FIFTY THOUSAND ARRIVING AFTER THE PERMIT IS ISSUED. AND THERE IS A DOOR THAT DOES TAKE WRITTEN APPLICATIONS, WHICH THIS ENTRY LACKED: A 2026 SMALL GRANTS PROGRAMME RUN BY AN INTERNATIONAL ANTI-EXTRACTION NETWORK IN PARTNERSHIP WITH THE FUND INVITES APPLICATIONS BY EMAIL TO REGIONAL HUBS FROM GRASSROOTS, INDIGENOUS, COMMUNITY-BASED, WOMEN'S AND YOUTH-LED ORGANISATIONS, ENVIRONMENTAL JUSTICE GROUPS, SMALL CIVIL SOCIETY ORGANISATIONS, SOCIAL MOVEMENTS AND LOCAL ADVOCACY NETWORKS. THE CONDITION IS AFFILIATION: APPLICANTS MUST BE ACTIVE MEMBERS OR PARTNERS OF THAT NETWORK, WITH PREFERENCE FOR THOSE WORKING DIRECTLY WITH FRONTLINE COMMUNITIES AFFECTED BY OIL, GAS, COAL, MINING OR OTHER EXTRACTIVE INDUSTRIES — AND THE FUNDS ARE DISBURSED DIRECTLY BY THE FUND ITSELF. SO A COMMUNITY FACING A MINE OR A GAS FIELD HAS A ROUTE THAT DOES NOT DEPEND ON BEING DISCOVERED: JOIN THE NETWORK FIRST, THEN APPLY THROUGH ITS REGIONAL HUB. MEMBERSHIP TAKES TIME AND THE DEADLINE DOES NOT WAIT, SO JOIN BEFORE THE WINDOW OPENS. ONE PREFERENCE WORTH USING: THE FUND COMMITS TO FINANCING PROJECTS ORGANISED, LED AND PARTICIPATED IN BY WOMEN — WHICH IN THE RURAL COMMUNITIES THIS FILE COVERS IS OFTEN AN ACCURATE DESCRIPTION OF WHO ACTUALLY DOES THE ORGANISING.

trackers.name: CAMP Alatoo — it got a community micro-reserve into official decisions, and it builds the pasture committees' case with data
trackers.desc: IT PUT A PROTECTION CATEGORY AT VILLAGE SCALE INTO OFFICIAL DECISIONS. Its proposals for district pasture management commissions, a COMMUNITY MICRO-RESERVE, resource conflict resolution and support to forest enterprises were taken up by the relevant state bodies and fixed in their decisions. Every other designation route in this file runs at national or provincial level; this one is small enough for a single community to hold, and there is a precedent for creating it. Ask about the micro-reserve first. IT WORKS DIRECTLY WITH THE BODIES THAT HOLD KYRGYZ PASTURE: its work centres on preventing and settling CONFLICTS OVER PASTURE and building the capacity of the jayit committees — recorded separately in this file as the holders of the pasture use-right — across Jalal-Abad, Batken, Osh and Naryn provinces, with the aim of embedding the model in national pasture policy. AND IT SUPPLIES THE THING A COMMITTEE NEEDS TO WIN AN ARGUMENT: numbers. Its specialists, working with forest enterprise staff and committee members, calculated a grazing norm from THREE YEARS OF PASTURE MONITORING DATA, and it has been completing a unified method for monitoring pastures at local level. This file has now recorded the same approach in Georgia and Jordan: a stocking rate derived from measurement is what turns a dispute about grazing into a decision. IT ALSO HELPS COMMITTEES TURN A MANAGEMENT PLAN INTO MONEY: after assessment and specialist consultation, committees drew up project proposals for CO-FINANCING to improve pasture infrastructure as part of their Pasture Management Plan — so the plan is not only a compliance document but the basis of a funding application. KNOW THE FORUM: pasture questions are decided at a District Pasture Commission chaired by a deputy district head, whose membership includes forest enterprise directors, the pasture committees, district administration, agrarian development and the committees' own national association. It handles distribution of State Forest Fund pastures, grazing permits, payment for use and conditions for shepherds moving stock to summer pasture. That is where a pasture dispute is actually resolved. It also works on a national electronic jayit committee system administered by the agriculture ministry's pasture department and intended to cover all 454 committees, which gives a committee an auditable record of stock numbers and pasture condition over time. THE LIMITS: it is a technical and development foundation working with ministries, not a campaigner, and nothing found shows it opposing a project. It also works in Tajikistan.

trackers.name: ProtectDefenders.eu — for when the organisation you would have turned to is itself facing shutdown
trackers.desc: RECORD WHY THIS IS HERE, BECAUSE IT CHANGES HOW YOU SHOULD READ THE OTHER KYRGYZ ENTRIES IN THIS FILE. A law in force since April 2024 requires non-governmental organisations that receive foreign funding and engage in broadly defined political activity to register as foreign representatives, to LABEL ALL THEIR MATERIALS as such, and to submit to reporting and auditing — with non-compliance punishable by suspension of activities for up to six months or COMPLETE SHUTDOWN. Independent monitoring records that some organisations have chosen to self-liquidate or curtail their work rather than be targeted, and that the law may deter international funders from supporting Kyrgyz organisations at all. THAT IS WHY AN EXTERNAL ROUTE MATTERS HERE NOW: the domestic body this file records as the country's free legal aid route for defenders is itself litigating against the law rather than sheltering anyone from it. WHAT THIS MECHANISM OFFERS: separate request channels for INDIVIDUALS and for organisations, so a person needs no registered body behind them — which matters acutely where registration is the thing being weaponised; correspondence accepted officially in RUSSIAN; a 24/7 helpline and an encrypted contact form; and emergency grants capped at €10,000 with an average of about €3,000, rolling and without deadlines, covering urgent protection measures including security, legal costs and relocation. Its three criteria are that you are a defender working consistently with the United Nations declaration, that you face risk because of that work, and that the need is urgent, with LACK OF ACCESS TO OTHER SOURCES OF SUPPORT EXPRESSLY TAKEN INTO ACCOUNT — a Kyrgyz applicant can point directly to the law for that. ITS RELOCATION PROGRAMME PREFERS MOVING A DEFENDER WITHIN THEIR OWN COUNTRY OR SUB-REGION where possible, so they can keep working. HEED ITS OWN WARNING ABOUT ITS OWN MONEY, WHICH IS SHARPER HERE THAN ANYWHERE: payment may come by bank transfer or Western Union and WILL SHOW THE MECHANISM AS THE SOURCE, and it asks recipients to consider the security implications and raise them with the secretariat. In a country where receiving foreign funds is the trigger for the labelling regime, that is not a formality — discuss it before any grant is made. THE LIMITS: it states it cannot support every defender in need and routes requests to partner organisations rather than assessing grant forms centrally; and no casework of its own in Kyrgyzstan could be established.

trackers.name: Whitley Fund for Nature — the step above small grants, awarded to an individual conservation leader
trackers.desc: EVERY OTHER FUND RECORDED FOR THIS COUNTRY IS A SMALL GRANT. This one is £50,000 over a year to a named individual, with CONTINUATION FUNDING OF UP TO £100,000 available afterwards to winners who completed their grant, and a further £60,000 award for outstanding past recipients. Roughly fifty-five per cent of previous winners have gone on to win continuation funding, so it is better understood as an entry point to multi-year support than as a prize. IT IS BUILT FOR THE SITUATION THIS FILE HAS DOCUMENTED IN KYRGYZSTAN: pasture committees, community bodies and conservancies whose work depends on a particular person. Applications must NAME THE TEAM LEADER who would receive the award, and the fund's stated purpose is to raise that person's profile as much as to fund the project — international recognition, communications and media support, and entry to a network of more than two hundred conservation leaders across eighty countries. For someone whose obstacle is being unknown outside their district, that is the substance of the offer rather than a garnish. ELIGIBILITY IS SPECIFIC: nationals of the country where they work, leading grassroots projects, working for or leading a LOCALLY INCORPORATED organisation rather than as in-country staff of a foreign-headquartered body; and the country must not be classified as a high-income economy, which this one is not. WHAT THE APPLICATION MUST SHOW: practical action FOUNDED ON SCIENCE with community involvement at grassroots level; work that is replicable or scalable and already on the cusp of significant impact; clear measurable outcomes with the INDICATORS thought through; and sustainability beyond the award. The fund also expects to provide a significant share of the project cost — in the region of thirty per cent or more — so it is not a top-up. Applications run annually and close in the autumn, are screened by an expert academic panel with international reference checks, and finalists are interviewed. THE LIMIT: this is conservation funding, not campaign funding. It will not pay for objections, litigation or advocacy against a project — for those, use the litigation and defender funds recorded elsewhere in this file.

trackers.name: IUCN NL Land Acquisition Fund — grants for securing land through lease or agreement
trackers.desc: IT WILL FUND LONG-TERM MANAGEMENT RIGHTS OVER AN AREA WITHOUT ANY TRANSFER OF OWNERSHIP — leases and conservation agreements — as well as purchase, in grants of up to around a hundred thousand euros to locally registered non-profit organisations. This country's community land holding runs through statutory use-rights rather than ownership: pasture committees hold and allocate grazing rights under law, and this file recorded a community micro-reserve taken into official decisions and grazing norms set from years of data. A FUND THAT PAYS FOR RIGHTS RATHER THAN TITLE FITS THAT SYSTEM DIRECTLY. WHAT IT LOOKS FOR: land holding critically endangered, endangered or vulnerable red list species; recognised biodiversity sites; ecosystems underrepresented in the protected area network; and land that maintains CONNECTIVITY between fragmented habitats as a corridor or stepping stone. Mountain and pasture ecosystems fragmented by roads, mines or fencing fit the connectivity priority squarely. THE REGISTERED LOCAL ORGANISATION HOLDS WHAT IS ACQUIRED AND CARRIES THE RESPONSIBILITY FOR IT, which is the fund's stated model rather than an exception. ELIGIBILITY TURNS ON THREE CHECKABLE THINGS: local registration as a non-profit, non-governmental or civil society organisation; direct responsibility for preparing and running the project; and A BANK ACCOUNT IN THE ORGANISATION'S OWN NAME in the country of establishment or where the project runs. A pasture committee or informal group without registration should apply through a registered partner. Annual call, spring deadline, running since 2001 with more than a hundred and fifty projects in over forty countries. THE LIMITS: nothing in its published record shows a project in this country or the wider region, and its examples are heavily tropical — so this is a route that is open on its written criteria, not a proven one here. It funds acquisition, not campaigning or litigation. Ask the fund whether it will consider this region before committing effort to a proposal.

trackers.name: Aigine — it has inventoried 1,202 sacred sites, and helped communities recover the right to govern them
trackers.desc: CHECK WHETHER YOUR LAND IS ALREADY IN ITS INVENTORY. It has compiled a record of 1,202 SACRED SITES and 36 pilgrimage practices across this country — springs, caves, mountains, lakes, trees, tombs and mausoleums that people visit as pilgrims. A spring or a tree that a developer's assessment treats as unremarkable may already be documented as a sacred site with recorded custodians and rituals, and that is a materially different thing to defend. WHAT IT ACTUALLY DID THAT MATTERS MOST: IT WAS INSTRUMENTAL IN RECOVERING THE LOCAL GOVERNANCE SYSTEMS FOR THESE SITES — the customary arrangements by which particular families and communities look after particular places. This file has recorded five ways land is held for protection in this region, all requiring title, lease, agreement or statutory right. THIS IS A SIXTH THAT REQUIRES NONE OF THEM: recognised custodianship of a site held as a commons. Scholarship on this country describes such sites as the CORE OF COMMUNITY-CONSERVED AREAS, and states the conditions plainly — a sacred natural site CANNOT BE HELD BY ONE EXCLUSIVE OWNER, and needs some form of PUBLIC PROPERTY STATUS so that it stays open to everyone who would come. ITS PRACTICAL CONSERVATION TOOLS AT ONE SITE COMPLEX ARE COPYABLE AND CHEAP: it FENCED several sacred sites, HUNG SIGNS AT THE ENTRANCES SETTING OUT RULES OF APPROPRIATE BEHAVIOUR, published a book recording the site's description, history and visitors' accounts, built basic facilities for pilgrims, and brought local custodians into workshops and conferences — so that today local people themselves guide visitors and explain the rules. A fence, a sign, a published record and a named custodian together assert a claim that no title deed is needed to make. IT WORKS BY PARTICIPATORY ACTION RESEARCH RATHER THAN BY STUDYING PEOPLE, and it BRIDGES TRADITIONAL PRACTITIONERS AND STATE AGENCIES, which is the connection a community usually cannot make alone. Founded in 2004 in the capital, accredited to the United Nations cultural body for intangible heritage, publishing its field research openly in the national language and in English, and working with a provincial state university's students alongside custodians. THE LIMITS: it is a research and cultural organisation, not an objector or a law practice — nothing found shows it opposing a mine, a road or a dam. Its subject is sacred and cultural sites, so land with no such site is outside it. And its own scholarship warns that the status of these sites is contested domestically, including on religious grounds. Use it to establish what your place is and who has always looked after it; take the objection to the bodies recorded elsewhere in this file.

trackers.name: Mapeo — a free offline app for a community to map its own land and keep the record
trackers.desc: IT WORKS WITH NO INTERNET AND NO SPECIAL EQUIPMENT, AND THE COMMUNITY OWNS THE DATA. With one button a person records a GPS POINT, A PHOTOGRAPH AND A NOTE; storage is decentralised on the devices themselves; and records move between collaborators by DIRECT PHONE-TO-PHONE SYNCHRONISATION rather than through any server. A community that maps its land on somebody else's platform has handed over the record. This one does not. IT WAS BUILT FOR EXACTLY WHAT THIS MAP EXISTS FOR: its own documentation says it exists so that frontline groups can document what is happening in order to take community action, REPORT INFORMATION TO AUTHORITIES, FILE LAWSUITS, launch media campaigns, or CREATE MAPS FOR LAND CLAIMS. THAT MATTERS PARTICULARLY HERE, WHERE THIS FILE RECORDED AN INVENTORY OF MORE THAN TWELVE HUNDRED SACRED SITES AND THE RECOVERY OF THE LOCAL GOVERNANCE SYSTEMS THAT LOOK AFTER THEM — protection through recognised custodianship rather than title. A custodian community with no deed needs its own record of what it holds: where the spring is, which trees, who tends them, what was there before. A dated, photographed, georeferenced record made by the people who hold the place is a different kind of evidence from an assertion. ANYONE CAN LEARN IT: its own materials say a person who has never used a smartphone can learn to collect points and photographs in a few hours. The desktop version needs some computer skill and produces PRINTED OR PDF REPORTS, and exports to the standard mapping formats — so what the community gathers can be handed to a lawyer, an official or a court in a form they accept, and can be imported into the satellite tools recorded elsewhere in this file. IT HAS WORKED WHERE IT MATTERED: an indigenous nation in South America used it for over four years to build territorial data and maps that were used as evidence against their government in opposition to oil development, and they won. A version developed with a United Nations conservation centre and a forest peoples' organisation is aimed specifically at communities documenting territories they conserve, with data staying on the device and any submission to global registries made only voluntarily and after the community's own consent process. THE LIMITS: it is software, not an organisation — nobody will do the work for you, and customising it with your own categories and offline maps takes technical help. Its listed interface translations do not currently include Russian, Kyrgyz or the other languages of this region, though it can be translated into any language. Note also that the organisation behind it now appears under a changed name, so verify the current source before downloading.

trackers.name: Rural Development Fund — survey capacity in every province, and the pasture law explained
trackers.desc: IT HAS FIELD ENUMERATORS AND SUPERVISORS IN EVERY PROVINCE OF THE COUNTRY, AND IT REPORTS IN KYRGYZ AS WELL AS RUSSIAN AND ENGLISH. It designs survey tools, trains and supervises interviewers, runs data entry and analysis, and conducts LEGAL AND ECONOMIC REVIEWS. This file has recorded across the region that what decides a land dispute is documented evidence, and that communities cannot produce it alone. HERE IS A DOMESTIC BODY WITH THE FIELD CAPACITY TO GATHER IT, working in the language people actually speak. IT HAS ALREADY PUBLISHED THE DOCUMENT MOST USEFUL IN A GRAZING DISPUTE: a comprehensive study of past and current land management including AN OVERVIEW OF THE LEGISLATION ON PASTURE ACCESS AND MANAGEMENT, with practical examples of how pasture management works in practice, alongside a national livestock study. Read that before arguing with anyone about grazing rights — it sets out what the law actually provides. AND IT HAS SIGNED COMMITMENTS YOU CAN QUOTE BACK TO IT. Through the global land coalition it belongs to, it is committed to respecting and strengthening the land rights of women and men living in poverty, and to ensuring that NO ONE IS DEPRIVED OF THE USE AND CONTROL OF THE LAND on which their well-being and human dignity depend — INCLUDING THROUGH EVICTION, EXPULSION OR EXCLUSION — with compulsory changes to tenure undertaken ONLY IN LINE WITH INTERNATIONAL LAW AND HUMAN RIGHTS STANDARDS. A signed commitment is a lever: it is a great deal harder for an organisation to decline a request that falls squarely inside a principle it has publicly endorsed. IT ALSO DOES SOMETHING NOTHING ELSE IN THIS PAYLOAD DOES: since 2010 it has run conflict prevention and mitigation work, including peer learning between local governments on managing conflict and strengthening BORDER VILLAGES to handle disputes arising from the use of WATER, PASTURES, LAND AND TIMBER. Where a land dispute is between communities rather than against a company — which this file has recorded as common in the pasture systems here — that mediation experience is the relevant capability. IT IS NETWORKED WITH BODIES ALREADY IN THIS MAP: the national association of pasture committees, and an association of forest and land users. Approach it through them if a direct approach is difficult. Established in 2003, non-profit and non-governmental, with expertise in natural resource management, local governance, social mobilisation and agricultural economics. THE LIMITS: it is a policy and research organisation, not a litigator or an objector — it produces studies, surveys and recommendations, and somebody else must use them. Its work is largely donor-funded and project-based, so its presence in any district depends on a project. AND NO WEBSITE OF ITS OWN COULD BE CONFIRMED: this entry points at its membership record in the global land coalition, which also carries the commitments quoted above.

trackers.name: KAFLU — the association of forest and land users, existing to secure its members' access
trackers.desc: IT IS THE AFFECTED-USER BODY FOR FORESTS, AND ITS STATED PURPOSE IS ACCESS. A professional organisation PROMOTING ITS MEMBERS' INTERESTS in sustainable ecosystem and natural resource management, working to ensure FAIR ACCESS, responsible use and effective conservation for resilient livelihoods and poverty alleviation IN THE COMMUNES — across both the forest and agriculture sectors. This file has proved in eight countries that where no environmental organisation can be found, the union or association of the people whose livelihood the project takes is the body that exists, is legally recognised and is invisible to searches for the wrong noun. THIS IS THAT BODY FOR FOREST AND LAND USERS HERE. IT COMPLETES A SET. This map already records the national association of pasture committees and a rural research organisation with field capacity in every province; all three belong to the same global land-rights coalition, which means they know each other and can be approached through one another. Grazing goes to the pasture committees, forest and farmland use goes here, and the survey and legal-review work goes to the research body. AND IT HAS SIGNED SOMETHING WORTH KNOWING ABOUT: every member of that coalition signs pledges to PROTECT AND EMPOWER BOTH WOMEN AND LAND DEFENDERS within the network. This payload has documented defenders prosecuted, sued, smeared and detained across five countries, with almost no organisation formally committed to protecting them. A member organisation that has signed such a pledge can be asked what it commits them to when one of your people is targeted. THE WIDER COALITION'S COMMITMENTS ARE QUOTABLE TOO: that no one be deprived of the use and control of the land on which their well-being and dignity depend, INCLUDING THROUGH EVICTION, EXPULSION OR EXCLUSION, and that compulsory changes to tenure be made only in line with international law and human rights standards. THE LIMITS: it is a professional and membership association promoting sustainable management and enterprise, not an objector or a litigator, and nothing found shows it opposing a project. Its emphasis on entrepreneurship development in the forest and agriculture sectors means it may see a commercial proposal as an opportunity rather than a threat — establish its position before assuming alignment. AND NOTE THE ADDRESS: no site of its own was confirmed, so this entry points at its membership record in the global coalition, which carries its description and the pledges. A reviewer should look for its own domain.

trackers.name: Unified public discussion portal — draft rules, their progress, and someone who already analyses them
trackers.desc: IT CARRIES DRAFT SUBORDINATE ACTS AS WELL AS DRAFT LAWS, AND THAT IS THE PART THAT MATTERS FOR LAND. Statutes rarely allocate a pasture or licence a quarry; SUBORDINATE ACTS DO — allocation rules, licensing procedures, permitting requirements, category changes. The portal is the single national place where those drafts are put for public discussion, created by a government decree in 2020 and run under the justice ministry. IT ALSO PUBLISHES INFORMATION ON THE PROGRESS OF DRAFTS, NOT ONLY THEIR TEXT — so you can see where an instrument has reached rather than discovering it once adopted, and it offers an advanced search across several thousand instruments. THE STRONGEST REASON TO USE IT IS SOMETHING THIS FILE ALREADY HOLDS: THE LEGAL CLINIC RECORDED SEPARATELY FOR THIS COUNTRY PUBLISHES WRITTEN ANALYSES OF DRAFTS POSTED HERE, citing the portal item by its number and date. So before writing your own comment, look for an existing analysis of the draft that affects you — and if none exists, that clinic is the obvious body to ask for one. A community comment supported by a lawyer's published analysis is a different document from a letter of objection. AND THE RULES OF THE CONSULTATION ARE THEMSELVES PUBLISHED: the procedure for placing a draft on the portal and running the public discussion sits in the centralised legal database. That matters because it converts a complaint that a consultation was unfair into a measurable claim that a written procedure was not followed — which this file has recorded as the difference between an objection that is dismissed and one that must be answered. THE LIMITS. Comments feed rule-making; they do not bind anyone. The portal shows what was posted, so an instrument that never appeared is invisible here — though the published procedure is what tells you whether it should have appeared. IT REQUIRES JAVASCRIPT AND SEVERAL PAGES SIMPLY REFUSE TO LOAD WITHOUT IT, which is a real barrier on an old phone or a slow connection — use a library or a district office computer if needed. And the portal was built with foreign donor support, so its continuity depends on the ministry maintaining it.

trackers.name: Accountability Console — compare the complaint offices before choosing one
trackers.desc: THE FEATURE THAT MATTERS MOST IS THE COMPARISON. This database lets you COMPARE AND ANALYSE THE POLICIES OF THE DIFFERENT ACCOUNTABILITY OFFICES OF INTERNATIONAL FINANCE and produce comparison reports — so a community facing a financed project can see, before committing, which office has rules it can actually satisfy. That matters because of what the same database shows about outcomes: TOO FEW COMPLAINTS GET THROUGH THE SYSTEM AND ACHIEVE A RESULT, AND A HIGH NUMBER ARE CLOSED WITHOUT OUTCOME HAVING BEEN RULED INELIGIBLE. MOST CASES ARE LOST AT THE DOOR, NOT ON THE ARGUMENT. IT ALSO HOLDS EVERY COMPLAINT EVER FILED TO THOSE OFFICES, searchable by institution, sector and region — so you can find complaints about projects like yours, read the documents from those that produced results, and identify which organisations advised them. This file has recorded for this country a legal clinic that analyses draft laws, pasture committees, a forest and land users' association and a defenders' protection mechanism; what none of them supplies is a record of what complaining to a financier has ever actually produced. A COMPLAINT PATHFINDER WALKS THROUGH THE OPTIONS FIRST, which is the right order: choose the forum, check its eligibility rules, then write. ON COST: viewing the complaints list and the mechanisms' policies is open to any member of the public, and premium access runs on a sliding scale with THE FEE WAIVED FOR USERS ON A LIMITED BUDGET — ask for it rather than assuming. THE LIMITS: it covers projects financed INTERNATIONALLY, so a purely domestic scheme is outside its scope; and it is a database and strategy tool, not a representative — it will not file anything for you, though it names the organisations that might.

trackers.name: National planting programme and its public monitoring platform — free saplings from forest nurseries, and a way to check the claims
trackers.desc: THE FOUR RESTORATION ENTRIES BEFORE THIS ONE ALL TOLD A COMMUNITY WHERE TO GET PLANTS. THIS ONE ALSO TELLS IT HOW TO CHECK WHAT THE STATE SAYS IT PLANTED. A DIGITAL PLATFORM IS BEING LAUNCHED FOR REAL-TIME MONITORING OF TREE PLANTING ACROSS THE COUNTRY — ANYONE CAN SELECT A REGION AND SEE HOW THE PROGRAMME IS BEING IMPLEMENTED THERE, and the monitoring is expressly open NOT ONLY TO STATE BODIES BUT TO ALL CITIZENS. IF TREES ARE REPORTED AS PLANTED WHERE YOU LIVE, THAT IS NOW A CHECKABLE CLAIM — and a discrepancy between the platform and the ground is the kind of documented fact this file has spent hundreds of entries teaching communities to gather. THE PROGRAMME ITSELF IS A NATIONAL CAMPAIGN RUNNING SINCE MARCH 2022, ANNUAL, WITH NINE MILLION SAPLINGS PLANNED FOR 2026. Its stated aims include increasing forest land and building environmental responsibility among citizens, which is language a community can quote when asking to be included. THE PLANTS COME FROM THE FOREST ENTERPRISES AND THEIR NURSERIES, AND THE RECORDED ACTIONS SHOW THE SCALE A LOCAL EFFORT ACTUALLY WORKS AT: 555 rosehip saplings on a single hectare at one forest enterprise; A THOUSAND JUNIPER SAPLINGS RAISED IN A FORESTRY NURSERY; 1,500 elm and apricot saplings across three hectares PLANTED BY SIXTY-NINE PEOPLE; two hundred deciduous trees for the international day of forests. THESE ARE VILLAGE-SIZED NUMBERS — ask your district forest enterprise which nursery it runs, what it holds, and whether it will supply a community planting. TWO OPERATIONAL DETAILS WORTH MORE THAN THE HEADLINE FIGURES. FIRST, FULL FENCING WAS ORGANISED AROUND A PLANTING AREA TO PROTECT THE YOUNG PLANTS FROM ANIMALS AND OTHER HARMFUL FACTORS — in a country of grazing livestock, unfenced planting is feeding, not forestry, and the fence should be in the budget before the trees. SECOND, SURVIVAL IS BEING MEASURED: seventy-five per cent of trees planted in one province in 2025 were reported to have taken root. ASK FOR THE SURVIVAL RATE IN YOUR OWN DISTRICT, because it is the number that shows whether planting there is done properly. NOW THE PART A READER DESERVES AND WHICH THE PROGRAMME'S OWN PUBLICITY WILL NOT SUPPLY. CRITICAL REPORTING ON THE SAME CAMPAIGN STATES THAT FOUR YEARS IN THERE ARE NO PRECISE FIGURES FOR HOW MANY TREES HAVE ACTUALLY BEEN PLANTED OR HOW MUCH HAS BEEN SPENT, and that the programme lives largely in ministry reports while the capital keeps losing green space and its air quality worsens. BOTH THINGS CAN BE TRUE: the nurseries and the saplings are real and reachable, and the national totals may be unreliable. THAT IS PRECISELY WHY THE MONITORING PLATFORM MATTERS — use it to check your own area rather than trusting a national figure, and if what it claims is not on the ground, that is a finding worth recording and raising. THE LIMITS: this is a state programme driven from the top, it plants where authorities decide, and it will not be turned against a development the government supports. Municipal headquarters have been created for it in the capital, so in cities the route runs through the mayor's office. Use it with the pasture committees and the forest and land users' association recorded separately here — both of which hold ground where planting could go.

trackers.name: Land and cadastre agency — four property certificates by phone, including the full history of rights and restrictions
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY'S LISTING HAS PASTURE COMMITTEES AND A FOREST USERS' ASSOCIATION THAT HOLD GROUND, AND NO WAY TO FIND OUT WHAT IS ACTUALLY REGISTERED OVER A PARCEL. FOUR CERTIFICATES ARE AVAILABLE WITHOUT VISITING ANY OFFICE, THROUGH THE STATE E-SERVICES PORTAL AND A MOBILE APPLICATION: AN EXTRACT OF RIGHTS AND RESTRICTIONS; THE TECHNICAL PARAMETERS OF THE PROPERTY; THE HISTORY OF RIGHTS AND RESTRICTIONS; AND A CERTIFICATE OF HAVING OR NOT HAVING RIGHTS TO A PROPERTY. THE THIRD ONE IS THE PRIZE, AND NOTHING ELSE IN THIS PAYLOAD OFFERS IT SO PLAINLY: THE HISTORY OF RIGHTS AND RESTRICTIONS GIVES THE CHAIN — WHO HELD THE PARCEL, WHEN IT CHANGED HANDS, AND WHAT ENCUMBRANCES SAT ON IT OVER TIME. A COMMUNITY THAT SUSPECTS LAND WAS QUIETLY TRANSFERRED BEFORE A SCHEME APPEARED CAN ESTABLISH THAT FROM A PHONE, and a dated official history is evidence no meeting minute can match. THE FOURTH IS QUIETLY USEFUL TOO: A CERTIFICATE OF HAVING OR NOT HAVING RIGHTS. That is how you prove a person or company does NOT hold what they claim to hold — the negative is as provable as the positive. REGISTRATION ITSELF IS FASTER AND CHEAPER THAN ALMOST ANYWHERE ELSE RECORDED HERE: AN APPLICATION IS CONSIDERED WITHIN FIVE WORKING HOURS OF BEING REGISTERED AT THE LOCAL BRANCH, at a published fee of roughly a thousand soms, AND THERE IS A PUBLISHED TELEPHONE NUMBER TO CALL IF AN APPLICATION IS SUSPENDED FOR MISSING DOCUMENTS. A HOUSEHOLD THAT HAS NEVER REGISTERED ITS RIGHTS HAS NO GOOD REASON NOT TO. AND THE LEGAL DEFINITION REACHES FURTHER THAN PEOPLE EXPECT, WHICH MATTERS ENORMOUSLY FOR THIS MAP: IMMOVABLE PROPERTY INCLUDES LAND PLOTS, SUBSOIL PLOTS, ISOLATED WATER BODIES, AND EVERYTHING FIRMLY CONNECTED WITH THE LAND — EXPRESSLY INCLUDING FORESTS AND PERENNIAL PLANTINGS. ORCHARDS AND WOODLAND ARE PART OF THE REGISTERED UNIT, NOT SCENERY SITTING ON TOP OF IT. This file has spent rounds on trees that belong to no forest and enjoy no protection; here, established plantings are inside the property itself, and damage to them is damage to registered property. KNOW THE SYSTEM'S OWN DOCUMENTS WHEN ASKING: THE CADASTRAL PLAN, THE REGISTRATION MAPS, THE REGISTRATION CARD, THE REGISTRATION FILE, AND THE JOURNAL OF APPLICATIONS FOR STATE REGISTRATION. THAT LAST ONE IS WORTH ASKING ABOUT SEPARATELY — A JOURNAL OF APPLICATIONS SHOWS WHAT IS BEING APPLIED FOR NOW, not only what has already been decided. THE LIMITS: this is a records and registration agency, not an advocate — it reports what is registered and will not say whether it is right, and challenging an entry is a separate matter for the courts and the legal aid routes recorded separately here. Electronic access requires a personal account on the state portal. Fees and processing times change; the figures here were current when recorded.

trackers.name: Regional grants noticeboard — open calls that fund initiative groups, not only registered organisations
trackers.desc: AN ECOLOGICAL INFORMATION SERVICE FOR THIS REGION MAINTAINS A STANDING GRANTS SECTION — A RUNNING LIST OF OPEN CALLS FOR ENVIRONMENTAL WORK. FOR A COMMUNITY WITH NO FUNDRAISING PLATFORM AND NO LOCAL GRANT-MAKER, A CURATED LIST OF WHAT IS OPEN NOW, IN THE RIGHT LANGUAGE AND FOR THE RIGHT COUNTRIES, IS WORTH MORE THAN ANY SINGLE FUND. AND ONE LISTED PROGRAMME BREAKS THE BARRIER THIS FILE HAS HIT MORE OFTEN THAN ANY OTHER: IT ACCEPTS APPLICATIONS FROM PUBLIC ENVIRONMENTAL ORGANISATIONS AND FROM INITIATIVE GROUPS — with active participation of women, young people, people with disabilities and TRADITIONAL COMMUNITIES — whose work addresses SPECIFIC ENVIRONMENTAL PROBLEMS AND THE DEFENCE OF ENVIRONMENTAL JUSTICE at local, national and regional level. INITIATIVE GROUPS. NOT ONLY REGISTERED ORGANISATIONS. A VILLAGE THAT HAS NEVER INCORPORATED CAN APPLY TO THAT PROGRAMME AS IT STANDS, and the phrase ENVIRONMENTAL JUSTICE in the criteria means a dispute with a project is within scope rather than outside it. A SECOND LISTED PROGRAMME SHOWS THE SHAPE OF THE MONEY AND CONTAINS THE MOST USEFUL TACTICAL FACT HERE: AN INDIVIDUAL GRANT AGREEMENT MAY REACH TWENTY THOUSAND DOLLARS, BUT AN AGREEMENT FOR A COALITION MAY REACH FIFTY THOUSAND, covering a set of interlinked initiatives. ADMINISTRATIVE COSTS ARE CAPPED AT TWENTY PER CENT OF THE BUDGET AND IMPLEMENTATION RUNS TWO TO SIX MONTHS. A COALITION IS WORTH MORE THAN TWICE A SINGLE APPLICANT. TWO VILLAGES FACING THE SAME SCHEME, OR A VILLAGE WITH A REGIONAL ORGANISATION, SHOULD APPLY TOGETHER — and the short implementation window means the proposal must be something deliverable in a season, not a five-year plan. A THIRD, REGIONAL PROGRAMME LISTS ITS ELIGIBLE APPLICANTS BROADLY: NON-GOVERNMENTAL ORGANISATIONS, PUBLIC GROUPS, INDIGENOUS PEOPLES' ORGANISATIONS, WOMEN'S GROUPS, PRIVATE COMPANIES AND OTHER CIVIL SOCIETY BODIES — AND FARMS MAY APPLY. INDIVIDUALS MUST WORK THROUGH A CIVIL SOCIETY ORGANISATION, which is the standard route and the reason to establish a relationship with one before a call opens rather than after. AND ONE LISTING PUBLISHES WHAT WILL NOT BE FUNDED, WHICH SAVES MORE TIME THAN THE CRITERIA DO: CONSTRUCTION AND REPAIR OF BUILDINGS; RESEARCH PROGRAMMES; PARTICIPATION IN TRAINING ABROAD; PRODUCTION PROJECTS; MATERIAL OR HUMANITARIAN AID TO INDIVIDUALS; AND RELIGIOUS OR POLITICAL ACTIVITY. READ THAT LIST BEFORE DRAFTING. A COMMUNITY'S FIRST INSTINCT IS OFTEN TO ASK FOR A BUILDING, A STUDY, OR HELP FOR AFFECTED FAMILIES — AND ALL THREE ARE EXCLUDED. What such programmes do fund is organising, mapping, training, monitoring and public work, so frame the request accordingly. THE LIMITS: this is a noticeboard, not a funder — it lists other people's calls, deadlines pass, and the specific programmes described here may already have closed; treat the figures as the shape of what is typical rather than as live offers. Several of the funders behind these calls are already recorded separately in this map. Verify each call at its own source before working on an application, and check which countries a call covers, since regional programmes vary.

trackers.name: National electronic auction platform — where state and municipal property is sold, and what a community needs ready to bid
trackers.desc: TWO ROUNDS AGO THIS FILE ESTABLISHED THAT COMMON AND STATE LAND IS DISPOSED OF BY PUBLISHED AUCTION, AND THAT A FUNDED COMMUNITY BODY CAN BID FOR IT RATHER THAN ONLY OBJECT. HERE IS THE PLATFORM WHERE THAT HAPPENS IN THIS COUNTRY: A NATIONAL ELECTRONIC AUCTION SYSTEM ON A GOVERNMENT DOMAIN, CARRYING STANDING CATEGORIES FOR STATE PROPERTY AND FOR THE PROPERTY OF THE CAPITAL CITY MAYORALTY. THAT SECOND CATEGORY IS THE ONE MOST COMMUNITIES OVERLOOK. MUNICIPAL PROPERTY — THE LAND A CITY OR VILLAGE ITSELF OWNS — IS SOLD AND LEASED THROUGH THE SAME PUBLIC SYSTEM AS STATE ASSETS, which means the disposal of a local park, yard, depot or field is announced in a place anyone can watch. BE CLEAR ABOUT WHAT THIS ENTRY DOES AND DOES NOT ESTABLISH, BECAUSE IT IS THINNER THAN THE TWO AUCTION ENTRIES RECORDED BEFORE IT. THE PLATFORM EXISTS AND CARRIES THOSE CATEGORIES. WHETHER LAND APPEARS AMONG ITS LOTS, WHAT REGISTRATION REQUIRES, WHAT DEPOSITS AND FEES APPLY, AND WHETHER RESULTS ARE PUBLISHED DID NOT SURFACE AND ARE NOT CLAIMED HERE. Check the platform directly before relying on any of it. WHAT BIDDING GENERALLY REQUIRES IN THIS REGION IS WORTH PREPARING FOR NOW, BECAUSE A NEIGHBOURING COUNTRY PUBLISHES IT: AN APPLICATION TO PARTICIPATE IN THE AUCTION FOR OWNERSHIP OR LEASE OF THE PLOT; A PAYMENT DOCUMENT CONFIRMING THE GUARANTEE DEPOSIT, UNLESS IT IS PAID THROUGH THE GOVERNMENT PAYMENT GATEWAY; AND A DOCUMENT CERTIFYING THE AUTHORITY OF THE REPRESENTATIVE, WITH ORIGINALS PRODUCED TO VERIFY COPIES. THE GUARANTEE DEPOSIT IS THE REAL BARRIER, AND IT IS THE REASON MOST COMMUNITIES NEVER BID. THE MONEY MUST BE AVAILABLE BEFORE THE NOTICE APPEARS, NOT RAISED AFTERWARDS — auctions run to fixed dates, and a fundraising campaign takes longer than the notice period. THIS IS THE ARGUMENT FOR HAVING A CONSTITUTED BODY, A BANK ACCOUNT AND A RESERVE IN PLACE WHILE NOTHING IS HAPPENING, which is what the constitution and fundraising routes recorded across this map are for. AND ONE PERSON MUST BE FORMALLY AUTHORISED TO ACT. THIS FILE RECORDED THE SAME REQUIREMENT AT A STATE PROPERTY ADMINISTRATION IN ANOTHER COUNTRY: AN EXPIRED OR MISSING POWER OF ATTORNEY STOPS A FILE AT THE COUNTER, WHATEVER ITS MERITS. FINALLY, WHAT MAY BE BOUGHT AT ALL DIFFERS BY COUNTRY AND BY LAND CATEGORY: IN THE SAME NEIGHBOURING RULES, THE SALE OF AGRICULTURAL LAND INTO PRIVATE OWNERSHIP WAS SUSPENDED BY SEPARATE LEGISLATION. ESTABLISH WHETHER THE CATEGORY OF LAND YOU CARE ABOUT CAN BE SOLD, LEASED, OR NEITHER, BEFORE BUILDING A PLAN AROUND BUYING IT. THE LIMITS: this is the disposal system, not an ally — it exists to sell and lease public assets, and nothing here creates a right to object to a lot. Verification is thin, as stated. Read it with the land and cadastre agency, the grants noticeboard and the pasture bodies recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: State procurement department — a complaints desk with its own phone line, and a new portal open for public testing now
trackers.desc: MOST PROCUREMENT BODIES IN THIS THREAD OFFER A GENERAL ENQUIRIES ADDRESS AND NOTHING MORE. THIS ONE PUBLISHES A SEPARATE TELEPHONE NUMBER FOR EACH OF ITS SECTIONS — METHODOLOGY, COORDINATION AND REGULATION, ANALYSIS AND INNOVATION, GENERAL — AND, AMONG THEM, A DEPARTMENT FOR WORKING WITH COMPLAINTS AND THE ELECTRONIC CATALOGUE, WITH ITS OWN LINE. A NAMED COMPLAINTS DESK WITH A DIRECT NUMBER IS WORTH MORE THAN A POLICY. IT MEANS A QUESTION ABOUT A TENDER CAN BE PUT TO THE PEOPLE WHOSE JOB IS COMPLAINTS RATHER THAN TO A SWITCHBOARD, and the section names tell you which unit owns which problem before you call. ABOVE THE DESK SITS SOMETHING STRONGER: A MINISTRY ORDER APPROVED INSTRUCTIONS ON THE SELECTION OF AN INDEPENDENT COMMISSION ON COMPLAINTS AND APPEALS, TOGETHER WITH MODEL FORMS FOR THE PROCUREMENT OF GOODS, WORKS, SERVICES AND CONSULTANCY SERVICES. AN INDEPENDENT COMPLAINTS COMMISSION WHOSE SELECTION RULES ARE PUBLISHED — THE THIRD SUCH ARRANGEMENT THIS FILE HAS FOUND IN THE REGION, AFTER A BOARD HALF-CHOSEN BY CIVIL SOCIETY AND AN APPEALS BOARD THAT BROADCASTS ITS HEARINGS. ASK HOW THE COMMISSION IS SELECTED AND WHETHER OUTSIDE MEMBERS ARE ELIGIBLE, because the selection instruction is a published document. AND THERE IS A LIVE OPENING THAT WILL NOT LAST: A NEW STATE PROCUREMENT WEB PORTAL WAS LAUNCHED BY MINISTRY ORDER IN JULY 2026, AND USERS ARE INVITED TO TAKE PART IN ITS TRIAL OPERATION AND TO TEST ITS MODULES AND FUNCTIONS, FOLLOWING A PILOT PROJECT UNDER A CABINET ORDER OF APRIL 2025. AN OPEN INVITATION TO TEST A GOVERNMENT PORTAL IS THE CHEAPEST MOMENT THERE WILL EVER BE TO ASK THAT IT PUBLISH WHAT COMMUNITIES NEED — searchable location fields, plan documents, award results, complaint outcomes. FEEDBACK GIVEN DURING TRIAL OPERATION IS ORDINARY USER TESTING; THE SAME REQUEST AFTER LAUNCH IS A DEMAND. This file has repeatedly recorded that timing decides whether an ask is cheap or impossible, and this is a window measured in months. THE SCOPE REACHES BELOW THE STATE, WHICH MATTERS FOR LOCAL SCHEMES: A MODEL PROCEDURE FRAMES PURCHASES BY MUNICIPAL ENTERPRISES AND BY COMPANIES WHERE FIFTY PER CENT OR MORE OF THE CAPITAL BELONGS TO THE STATE, INCLUDING THEIR SUBSIDIARIES. SO A MUNICIPAL UTILITY OR A PART-STATE COMPANY WORKING ON YOUR GROUND IS INSIDE THE PROCUREMENT FRAME, not outside it. ONE FINANCIAL CONTROL IS WORTH KNOWING: BANK ACCOMPANIMENT OF PROCUREMENT HAS OPERATED SINCE JANUARY 2023 — meaning a bank tracks the money through the contract, which creates a second record of what was actually paid. THE LIMITS: this is the purchasing system and its regulator — NOTHING HERE CREATES A RIGHT TO OBJECT TO A PROJECT. WHETHER A RESIDENT OR COMMUNITY ORGANISATION THAT IS NOT A BIDDER MAY COMPLAIN WAS NOT VERIFIED, the same gap flagged for three neighbouring countries. The portal is in transition between an old and a new system, so links and functions may move. Read it with the land and cadastre agency, the grants noticeboard and the auction platform recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Aarhus information centre — a door with an address, a phone and advice on environmental rights
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HAS RECORDED MANY BODIES THAT CAN BE WRITTEN TO. THIS IS ONE THAT CAN BE WALKED INTO: A REGIONAL INFORMATION CENTRE BUILT AROUND THE CONVENTION ON ACCESS TO ENVIRONMENTAL INFORMATION AND PUBLIC PARTICIPATION, PUBLISHING ITS STREET ADDRESS DOWN TO THE FLOOR AND ROOM NUMBER, WITH A TELEPHONE, A FAX AND AN EMAIL ADDRESS. IT WAS OPENED IN DECEMBER 2004 WITH GRANT SUPPORT FROM THREE INTERNATIONAL ORGANISATIONS, TO PROMOTE THE EFFECTIVE IMPLEMENTATION OF THAT CONVENTION — AND ALONGSIDE AWARENESS WORK, THE CENTRES OF THIS NETWORK PROVIDE ADVISORY SERVICES ON ENVIRONMENTAL RIGHTS. ADVICE ON ENVIRONMENTAL RIGHTS, FROM AN OFFICE WITH A COUNTER, IS EXACTLY WHAT A RESIDENT NEEDS AT THE MOMENT THEY FIRST SEE MACHINERY ON THE GROUND AND DO NOT KNOW WHAT THEY ARE ENTITLED TO ASK FOR. GO THERE BEFORE LOOKING FOR A LAWYER. THE CENTRE ALSO HOSTS REGIONAL MEETINGS TO DISCUSS AND RESOLVE ENVIRONMENTAL PROBLEMS ACROSS AN ENTIRE VALLEY THAT IS SHARED BETWEEN NEIGHBOURING COUNTRIES — SO IT IS A PLACE WHERE A CROSS-BORDER PROBLEM CAN ACTUALLY BE PUT ON A TABLE, which matters where a river, a dust source or a tailings dam sits on the other side of a line. THE NETWORK AROUND IT IS ACTIVE AND CURRENT: A CENTRE IN THE CAPITAL TOOK PART IN A 2026 WORKSHOP LAUNCHING THE COUNTRY'S NEXT CLIMATE TRANSPARENCY REPORTING, AND THE CENTRES TOGETHER RAN A STUDENT DEBATE OLYMPIAD ACROSS FOUR CITIES. THE HEADS OF CENTRES FROM SOUTH-EASTERN EUROPE, THE CAUCASUS AND CENTRAL ASIA MEET ANNUALLY. THAT ANNUAL MEETING IS WORTH KNOWING ABOUT: IT MEANS THE PERSON BEHIND THE COUNTER IS CONNECTED TO EQUIVALENT PEOPLE IN A DOZEN OTHER COUNTRIES, AND A QUESTION THEY CANNOT ANSWER LOCALLY MAY HAVE BEEN ANSWERED SOMEWHERE ELSE IN THAT NETWORK. THE LIMITS: these centres INFORM AND ADVISE; THEY DO NOT LITIGATE, DO NOT DECIDE, AND CREATE NO RIGHT TO OBJECT. Most are established with international donor support and in cooperation with state environmental bodies, so INDEPENDENCE FROM THE AUTHORITIES VARIES AND SHOULD NOT BE ASSUMED. WHETHER THE ADVISORY SERVICE IS FREE, AND WHAT IT COVERS IN PRACTICE, WAS NOT VERIFIED. Read it with the independent expertise association, the state procurement portal and the grants noticeboard recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: City sanitary surveillance centre — published inspection plans and checklists, parasite testing of soil and water, and a counter open to individuals
trackers.desc: TWO ITEMS ON THIS BODY'S OWN WEBSITE ARE WORTH MORE THAN MOST OF THE LABORATORY CAPABILITY BEHIND THEM: IT PUBLISHES ITS INSPECTION PLANS FOR BUSINESS ENTITIES, AND IT PUBLISHES ITS CHECKLISTS. THE INSPECTION PLAN TELLS YOU WHEN A FACILITY IS DUE TO BE INSPECTED. THE CHECKLIST TELLS YOU EXACTLY WHAT THE INSPECTOR WILL LOOK AT WHEN THEY ARRIVE. A COMMUNITY THAT READS BOTH BEFORE AN INSPECTION CAN PUT THE RIGHT FACTS IN FRONT OF THE RIGHT OFFICIAL ON A DATE IT KNOWS IN ADVANCE — AND CAN CHECK AFTERWARDS WHETHER THE ITEMS ON THE LIST WERE ACTUALLY EXAMINED. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED INSPECTION AND ENFORCEMENT BODIES IN MOST OF THESE COUNTRIES; VERY FEW PUBLISH THE SCHEDULE AND THE CRITERIA IN ADVANCE. ASK EVERY REGULATOR WHETHER ITS INSPECTION PLAN AND CHECKLISTS ARE PUBLIC. THE LABORATORIES BEHIND IT COVER THINGS THAT MATTER FOR LAND AND WATER. A PARASITOLOGY LABORATORY EXAMINES FAECES, SAND, SOIL, VEGETABLES AND WATER FOR CONTAMINATION WITH PROTOZOA AND HELMINTHS — AND IDENTIFIES TICK AND MOSQUITO SPECIES. SOIL, VEGETABLES AND WATER TESTED FOR PARASITES IS PRECISELY THE EVIDENCE NEEDED WHERE SEWAGE, SEPTIC OVERFLOW OR SLUDGE REACHES IRRIGATION OR GRAZING GROUND — AND IT IS A HEALTH FINDING, WHICH TRAVELS FURTHER WITH AUTHORITIES THAN AN ENVIRONMENTAL ONE. A SANITARY-HYGIENE LABORATORY EXAMINES FOOD, FOOD RAW MATERIALS AND PROCESSED PRODUCTS, AND A VIROLOGY LABORATORY RUNS POLYMERASE CHAIN REACTION WORK, HEPATITIS MARKERS, FOOD-BORNE INFECTION TESTING AND DETECTION OF GENETICALLY MODIFIED INGREDIENTS IN FOOD. AND THE COUNTER IS OPEN TO ORDINARY PEOPLE: THE CENTRE CARRIES OUT DISINFECTION, DISINSECTION AND DERATISATION WORK ON THE APPLICATIONS OF LEGAL AND NATURAL PERSONS, ON A VOLUNTARY BASIS. NATURAL PERSONS MEANS INDIVIDUALS — SO THIS IS A BODY ACCUSTOMED TO RECEIVING REQUESTS FROM RESIDENTS, NOT ONLY FROM COMPANIES. ITS POWERS ARE THE REASON TO BOTHER. IT MAY TAKE MEASURES TO STOP VIOLATIONS OF LEGISLATION AT SUPERVISED FACILITIES REGARDLESS OF THEIR FORM OF OWNERSHIP OR DEPARTMENTAL AFFILIATION, AND IT ISSUES SANITARY PRESCRIPTIONS AND SANITARY-EPIDEMIOLOGICAL ACTS. REGARDLESS OF FORM OF OWNERSHIP IS THE PHRASE TO NOTICE: A STATE-OWNED PLANT IS NOT EXEMPT FROM A SANITARY PRESCRIPTION. AND A SANITARY ACT IS A DOCUMENT — ONCE ISSUED, IT EXISTS ON A FILE THAT OTHER BODIES AND COURTS CAN BE POINTED TO. SO THE PRACTICAL SEQUENCE HERE IS: READ THE CHECKLIST FOR THE TYPE OF FACILITY; FIND ITS DATE IN THE INSPECTION PLAN; SUBMIT WHAT YOU HAVE THROUGH THE CITIZENS' APPEALS ROUTE BEFORE THAT DATE; AND ASK AFTERWARDS FOR THE SANITARY ACT. THE LIMITS: this is A PUBLIC HEALTH REGULATOR FOR ONE CITY, NOT AN ENVIRONMENTAL BODY AND NOT NATIONAL — a rural community must find the equivalent centre for its own oblast or rayon. Its subject is HUMAN HEALTH: harm to habitat, landscape or species is outside its remit unless it reaches people. WHETHER ITS LABORATORIES ACCEPT SAMPLES FROM RESIDENTS, AND AT WHAT COST, WAS NOT VERIFIED — the application route recorded here is for disinfection services, not for analysis. Read it with the independent expertise association, the Aarhus information centre and the state procurement portal recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Citizen air monitoring network — certified sensors in ten cities, real-time public data, and published guidance on building your own
trackers.desc: ONE SENTENCE FROM THIS ORGANISATION EXPLAINS WHY IT EXISTS AND SHOULD BE CARRIED INTO ANY POLLUTION FIGHT ANYWHERE: THE OFFICIAL STATE FIGURES ARE PUBLISHED FOR THE PAST MONTH, NOT IN REAL TIME, WHICH PREVENTS PEOPLE IN VULNERABLE GROUPS FROM TAKING PREVENTIVE MEASURES. OFFICIAL DATA THAT ARRIVES A MONTH LATE CANNOT PROTECT ANYONE, AND IT CANNOT PROVE ANYTHING ABOUT A PARTICULAR DAY — THE DAY THE PLANT VENTED, THE NIGHT THE TIPPING HAPPENED, THE WEEK THE BURNING STARTED. THAT IS THE GAP INDEPENDENT MONITORING FILLS, AND IT IS WHY THIS ENTRY MATTERS MORE THAN ITS SUBJECT SUGGESTS. THIS ORGANISATION RUNS THE MOST EXTENSIVE INDEPENDENT CITIZEN AIR QUALITY MONITORING NETWORK IN THE COUNTRY: TWENTY-FOUR SENSORS ACROSS TEN NAMED CITIES, WITH FURTHER SENSORS IN TWO NEIGHBOURING COUNTRIES THROUGH PARTNERS. SPECIALISTS MEASURE FINE AND COARSE PARTICULATES WITH CERTIFIED SENSORS ACCORDING TO MONITORING STANDARDS, AND THE READINGS ARE PUBLIC AND LIVE ON A WEBSITE AND MOBILE APPLICATION, WITH A SECOND PLATFORM FOR THE REGION. CERTIFIED SENSORS AND PUBLISHED STANDARDS ARE WHAT SEPARATE EVIDENCE FROM A GADGET. THIS FILE HAS WARNED THAT AN UNACCREDITED READING GETS DISMISSED; HERE THE METHOD IS STATED, WHICH IS THE FIRST THING TO ASK ANY MONITORING GROUP ABOUT. AND IT TEACHES THE METHOD RATHER THAN GUARDING IT: IT PUBLISHES TECHNICAL RECOMMENDATIONS ON THE USE OF LOW-COST AIR QUALITY SENSORS IN THE COUNTRY. A COMMUNITY THAT WANTS ITS OWN READINGS CAN THEREFORE BUILD A NETWORK CORRECTLY RATHER THAN BADLY — WHICH IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN NUMBERS THAT SURVIVE CHALLENGE AND NUMBERS THAT EMBARRASS YOU. ITS WORK GOES BEYOND MEASURING. IT PRODUCES ANNUAL ANALYTICAL REPORTS AND SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH, PURSUES POLICY ADVOCACY, AND MAKES THE DATA ACCESSIBLE TO THE PUBLIC, TO JOURNALISTS, TO DECISION-MAKERS AND TO RESEARCHERS — FOUR AUDIENCES, NAMED. ITS INFORMATION CAMPAIGNS HAVE REACHED SOME THREE MILLION PEOPLE ACROSS THE REGION. SINCE 2022 IT HAS EXTENDED ITS EXPERTISE TO ENERGY EFFICIENCY, RENEWABLE ENERGY, TRANSPORT AND URBAN PLANNING AS INTERSECTING DRIVERS OF AIR POLLUTION — SO A DISPUTE ABOUT A ROAD, A POWER SCHEME OR A ZONING DECISION IS WITHIN ITS SUBJECT, NOT OUTSIDE IT. AND IT SELLS ITS SKILLS AS SERVICES A COMMUNITY CAN ASK FOR: CONSULTATIONS ON RUNNING INFORMATION AND ADVOCACY CAMPAIGNS, EXPERT CONSULTATION IN DRAFTING ENVIRONMENTAL PROGRAMMES, AND TRAININGS FOR SCHOOLCHILDREN AND STUDENTS. ASK FOR THE CAMPAIGN CONSULTATION BEFORE ASKING FOR A SENSOR. A GROUP THAT KNOWS HOW TO PRESENT ITS FIGURES WILL GET FURTHER THAN ONE THAT SIMPLY HAS THEM — and this organisation's own reach shows it knows the difference. THE LIMITS: this is A MONITORING AND ADVOCACY ORGANISATION, NOT A REGULATOR OR A LITIGATOR — citizen readings carry no formal legal standing, and an authority may reject them precisely because they are not the official network. WHETHER IT WILL PLACE A SENSOR ON REQUEST, AND AT WHAT COST, WAS NOT VERIFIED. Its focus is AIR, so water, soil and habitat questions fall outside it. Read it with the independent expertise association, the sanitary surveillance laboratories and the Aarhus information centre recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Pasture committees and the village five-year pasture plan — a user body with autonomy officials resent, and a document with a named officer answerable
trackers.desc: THE MOST TELLING EVIDENCE THAT A BODY HAS REAL POWER OVER LAND IS OFFICIALS COMPLAINING THAT IT WILL NOT TAKE ORDERS. A MEMBER OF PARLIAMENT HERE SAID THE PASTURE COMMITTEES HAD BECOME MONSTERS THAT OBEY NOBODY; THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY SAID THEY OBEYED NEITHER THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES NOR THE DISTRICT GOVERNOR. THIS FILE HAS SPENT HUNDREDS OF ROUNDS LOOKING FOR USER BODIES THAT ACTUALLY CONTROL SOMETHING. HERE IS ONE WHOSE INDEPENDENCE IS RESENTED IN PARLIAMENT — WHICH IS A BETTER TESTIMONIAL THAN ANYTHING ON ITS OWN WEBSITE, AND IT MEANS A LIVESTOCK-KEEPING HOUSEHOLD SHOULD KNOW EXACTLY WHO SITS ON THE COMMITTEE COVERING ITS PASTURES. AND THERE IS A DOCUMENT TO GET HOLD OF. A VILLAGE COUNCIL IS PROPOSING TO APPROVE A PLAN OF MEASURES FOR THE MANAGEMENT AND USE OF PASTURES FOR THE YEARS 2026 TO 2030. ORGANISATION AND COORDINATION OF THE PLAN IS ASSIGNED TO A MUNICIPAL ENTERPRISE, THE MEASURES COVER PASTURE USE, THE IMPROVEMENT OF PASTURE INFRASTRUCTURE, AND THE PROTECTION AND RESTORATION OF PASTURES — AND CONTROL OVER EXECUTION IS PLACED ON THE HEAD OF THE VILLAGE ADMINISTRATION. A FIVE-YEAR PLAN ADOPTED AT VILLAGE LEVEL, NAMING WHO COORDINATES IT AND WHO IS ANSWERABLE FOR ITS EXECUTION, IS THE MOST TRACTABLE PLANNING DOCUMENT IN THIS ENTIRE FILE. IT IS SHORT, IT IS LOCAL, AND IT COMMITS A NAMED OFFICER — SO ASK FOR IT, READ IT, AND KEEP IT. THE TIMING MATTERS TOO. A PLAN IN DRAFT IS A PLAN THAT CAN STILL BE AMENDED. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED OVER AND OVER THAT COMMUNITIES ARRIVE AFTER APPROVAL; A PROPOSAL BEING PUT TO A VILLAGE COUNCIL IS THE RARE MOMENT WHEN A LINE ABOUT A PARTICULAR SPRING, TRACK OR WATERING POINT CAN STILL BE WRITTEN IN. THE THREE THINGS THE PLAN COVERS ARE THE THREE ASKS. PASTURE USE MEANS WHO GRAZES WHERE AND WHEN. IMPROVEMENT OF PASTURE INFRASTRUCTURE MEANS WATERING POINTS, TRACKS AND BRIDGES — AND THIS FILE RECORDED IN A NEIGHBOURING COUNTRY THAT A DEFICIT OF WATERING POINTS, NOT LACK OF GRASS, IS WHAT LEAVES PASTURE UNUSED. PROTECTION AND RESTORATION MEANS DEGRADED GROUND CAN BE PUT IN THE PLAN FOR REPAIR. ONE COMPLAINT FROM PARLIAMENT IS WORTH CARRYING INTO ANY MEETING: THAT FARMERS ARE BEING FORCED TO DRIVE LIVESTOCK TO DISTANT PASTURES WITHOUT ANY CONDITIONS BEING CREATED FOR THEM. THAT IS THE EXACT GRIEVANCE A HERDING COMMUNITY USUALLY HAS, ALREADY STATED ON THE RECORD BY A LEGISLATOR — SO IT IS AN ARGUMENT WITH ESTABLISHED STANDING, NOT A NOVEL COMPLAINT. THE LIMITS, AND THEY CUT BOTH WAYS. A PASTURE COMMITTEE THAT ANSWERS TO NOBODY CAN ALSO BE CAPTURED: THE SAME AUTONOMY THAT PROTECTS IT FROM A GOVERNOR PROTECTS IT FROM ITS OWN MEMBERS IF THEY DO NOT ATTEND. THE PARLIAMENTARY CRITICISM SUGGESTS REFORM PRESSURE IS BUILDING, SO THE ARRANGEMENT MAY CHANGE. THIS ENTRY RESTS ON ONE VILLAGE'S DRAFT DECISION AND ON PRESS REPORTING OF PARLIAMENTARY REMARKS, NOT ON A NATIONAL SERVICE PAGE, AND WHETHER PLANS ARE PUBLISHED OR OBTAINABLE ELSEWHERE WAS NOT VERIFIED. Read it with the independent expertise association, the Aarhus information centre, the citizen air monitoring network and the sanitary surveillance laboratories recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Advocates' chamber free legal aid week — regional chambers in every province, covering access to justice and court proceedings
trackers.desc: A COMMUNITY THAT CANNOT AFFORD A LAWYER USUALLY NEEDS ONE FOR AN HOUR RATHER THAN A YEAR — TO BE TOLD WHETHER IT HAS A CASE, WHICH DOCUMENT MATTERS AND WHAT THE DEADLINE IS. THIS IS THAT HOUR, MADE AVAILABLE NATIONWIDE ON FIXED DATES. THE NATIONAL ADVOCATES' BODY ORGANISES AN INTER-STATE ACTION ACROSS A REGIONAL COMMONWEALTH, DURING WHICH THE REGIONAL BAR CHAMBERS IN ALL PROVINCES OF THE COUNTRY DECLARE DAYS OF FREE LEGAL AID FOR CITIZENS — IN 2026 OVER A NAMED FIVE-DAY PERIOD IN APRIL. THE COVERAGE IS NATIONWIDE BY DESIGN: REGIONAL CHAMBERS IN EVERY PROVINCE, NOT A SINGLE OFFICE IN THE CAPITAL. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED LEGAL AID SCHEMES THAT EXIST ONLY WHERE THE LAWYERS ALREADY ARE; THIS ONE IS ORGANISED THROUGH THE PROVINCIAL STRUCTURES THAT EXIST EVERYWHERE. AND THE SUBJECTS COVERED INCLUDE THE ONE THAT MATTERS MOST: ACCESS TO JUSTICE AND COURT PROCEEDINGS, ALONGSIDE THE PROTECTION OF HUMAN RIGHTS INCLUDING THE RIGHT TO HEALTH PROTECTION, AND OTHER CURRENT LEGAL QUESTIONS. ACCESS TO JUSTICE AND COURT PROCEEDINGS IS BROAD ENOUGH TO COVER A LAND OR POLLUTION MATTER, AND THE OTHER CURRENT LEGAL QUESTIONS CATEGORY MEANS NOTHING IS AUTOMATICALLY OUT OF SCOPE. GO WITH THE QUESTION NARROWED IN ADVANCE — WHAT IS THE DEADLINE TO CHALLENGE THIS DECISION, WHICH COURT, WHAT DOCUMENTS DO I NEED — BECAUSE A FREE CONSULTATION REWARDS PRECISION AND PUNISHES A LONG STORY. THE RIGHT TO HEALTH PROTECTION APPEARING IN THE LIST IS WORTH USING DELIBERATELY. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED ACROSS SEVERAL COUNTRIES THAT AN ENVIRONMENTAL PROBLEM PRESENTED AS A HEALTH PROBLEM TRAVELS FURTHER — AND HERE HEALTH IS EXPRESSLY ONE OF THE ADVERTISED SUBJECTS. THE ACTION IS ANNUAL AND PART OF A MULTI-COUNTRY PROGRAMME, WHICH MEANS IT RECURS. A GROUP THAT MISSES IT SHOULD PREPARE ITS PAPERS AND ITS QUESTION FOR THE NEXT ONE, AND ASK THE REGIONAL CHAMBER IN ADVANCE WHICH DAYS AND WHICH OFFICES ARE TAKING PEOPLE. BEYOND THE WEEK ITSELF, THE CHAMBER PUBLISHES ITS ADDRESS DOWN TO THE FLOOR, WHICH IS THE ROUTE FOR THE TWO ORDINARY REQUESTS ANY COMMUNITY SHOULD MAKE OF A BAR: CONFIRM THAT A PARTICULAR ADVOCATE IS REGISTERED, AND ASK WHICH OF ITS MEMBERS PRACTISE IN LAND, ADMINISTRATIVE OR ENVIRONMENTAL MATTERS. THE LIMITS: this is A SHORT ANNUAL CONSULTATION CAMPAIGN, NOT ONGOING REPRESENTATION — IT DOES NOT PROVIDE A LAWYER TO CONDUCT A CASE, and nothing here creates an entitlement to one. WHETHER ADVICE GIVEN AT THE ACTION CAN LEAD TO A CONTINUING INSTRUCTION, AND ON WHAT TERMS, WAS NOT VERIFIED. THE DATES CITED ARE FOR ONE YEAR ONLY and the next round's dates must be checked with the regional chamber. Read it with the independent expertise association, the citizen air monitoring network, the sanitary surveillance laboratories and the pasture committees recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Forest and land users' association — legal support, help registering lease contracts, community group formation and certification training
trackers.desc: THE SINGLE MOST PRACTICAL THING THIS ASSOCIATION HAS DONE IS THE ONE NOBODY ADVERTISES: ASSISTANCE IN REGISTERING LEASE CONTRACTS AT THE DISTRICT OFFICES OF THE STATE REGISTER. AN UNREGISTERED LEASE IS THE WEAKEST POSITION A LAND USER CAN BE IN. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED ACROSS THE REGION THAT PEOPLE FARM AND GRAZE FOR YEARS ON PAPERS THAT WERE NEVER ENTERED ANYWHERE — AND THAT WHEN THE GROUND IS WANTED, AN UNREGISTERED HOLDER HAS ALMOST NOTHING TO SHOW. HELP GETTING THE CONTRACT INTO THE REGISTER IS WORTH MORE THAN ANY GRANT. THE ASSOCIATION IS A VOLUNTARY NON-PROFIT BODY FOUNDED IN 2010 WHOSE MEMBERS INCLUDE LEGAL AND NATURAL PERSONS — RURAL PRIVATE FOREST AND LAND USERS, NON-GOVERNMENTAL ORGANISATIONS AND SCIENTIFIC INSTITUTIONS — AND IT EXISTS TO REPRESENT AND LOBBY THE RIGHTS AND INTERESTS OF ITS MEMBERS. NATURAL PERSONS IN MEMBERSHIP IS THE DETAIL THAT MATTERS: A SINGLE HOUSEHOLD HOLDING A FOREST PLOT CAN JOIN, NOT ONLY COMPANIES. AND ITS STATED SERVICES INCLUDE INFORMATION, CONSULTANCY AND LEGAL SUPPORT — WHICH IS THE COMBINATION THIS FILE HAS SPENT HUNDREDS OF ROUNDS LOOKING FOR. ITS COMPLETED JOINT FOREST MANAGEMENT WORK SHOWS EXACTLY WHAT IT DELIVERS: A TRAINING PROGRAMME FOR FOREST USERS; CONSULTANCY TO LOCAL COMMUNITIES, TO LESSEES OF FOREST PLOTS AND TO FORESTRY STAFF ON FOREST LEGISLATION; THE LEASE REGISTRATION HELP ABOVE; AND INSTITUTIONAL DEVELOPMENT THROUGH CREATING COMMUNITY GROUPS AND A WORKING GROUP TO DEVELOP FOREST USE PLANS. ADVISING THE COMMUNITY AND THE FORESTRY STAFF IN THE SAME PROGRAMME IS UNUSUAL AND USEFUL. WHERE BOTH SIDES OF A DISPUTE HAVE BEEN TAUGHT THE SAME RULES BY THE SAME BODY, ARGUMENTS NARROW TO FACTS — AND A COMMUNITY THAT KNOWS THE FOREST LEGISLATION AS WELL AS THE RANGER DOES IS IN A DIFFERENT CONVERSATION. THE CERTIFICATION WORK CARRIES A NUMBER WORTH QUOTING: OF SEVENTY-TWO PEOPLE TRAINED FOR INTERNATIONAL FOREST CERTIFICATION, SIXTY LESSEES PASSED THE AUDIT. A PASS RATE ABOVE EIGHT IN TEN, PUBLISHED, IS RARE IN THIS FILE. CERTIFICATION MATTERS BECAUSE IT TURNS A FOREST PLOT FROM SOMETHING A FAMILY HOPES TO KEEP INTO SOMETHING WITH AUDITED MANAGEMENT AND A BUYER — AND AUDITED GROUND IS HARDER TO REALLOCATE QUIETLY. ITS OTHER INITIATIVES POINT THE SAME WAY: ORGANIC PRODUCTION AND THE MARKETING OF WILD-HARVESTED FOREST PRODUCTS, AND RECOMMENDATIONS TO IMPROVE THE FOREST AND LAND CODES. WILD HARVEST WITH A MARKET IS THE MODEL THIS FILE RECORDED IN OMAN WITH FRANKINCENSE — PEOPLE PROTECT WHAT PAYS THEM. SO THE APPROACH IS SPECIFIC: ASK WHETHER YOUR LEASE IS REGISTERED AND WHETHER THEY WILL HELP LODGE IT; ASK WHETHER A COMMUNITY GROUP EXISTS FOR YOUR FOREST AND WHETHER A FOREST USE PLAN HAS BEEN DRAWN; AND ASK WHEN THE NEXT CERTIFICATION TRAINING RUNS. THE LIMITS: this is A SECTORAL MEMBERSHIP ASSOCIATION THAT LOBBIES FOR ITS MEMBERS' BUSINESS INTERESTS, NOT AN ENVIRONMENTAL CAMPAIGNER — ITS MEMBERS ARE FOREST USERS AND LESSEES, so its interest is in secure commercial use rather than in leaving forest alone, AND IT WILL NOT OPPOSE A DEVELOPMENT. MEMBERSHIP TERMS AND FEES, AND WHETHER LEGAL SUPPORT EXTENDS TO NON-MEMBERS, WERE NOT VERIFIED. THE PROJECT RESULTS DESCRIBED ARE FROM A COMPLETED PROJECT REPORTED BY THE ASSOCIATION ITSELF, and its founding date is given differently in different listings. Read it with the pasture committees and village five-year plan, the independent expertise association, the citizen air monitoring network and the advocates' free aid week recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: State concessional agriculture lending — collateral-free up to half a million soms, six per cent for irrigation, three per cent for breeding stock
trackers.desc: ONE LINE IN THIS SYSTEM MATTERS MORE THAN ALL THE BILLIONS AROUND IT: LOANS UP TO FIVE HUNDRED THOUSAND SOMS ARE ISSUED WITHOUT COLLATERAL SECURITY, UNDER A PROGRAMME AIMED AT THE PURCHASE OF SEEDS, FUEL AND LIVESTOCK. COLLATERAL IS WHERE FARM LENDING STOPS EVERYWHERE ELSE IN THIS FILE. A HOUSEHOLD WITH AN UNREGISTERED PLOT, A DISPUTED TITLE OR NOTHING TO PLEDGE IS NORMALLY OUTSIDE CREDIT ENTIRELY — AND THIS IS THE ONLY UNSECURED STATE LINE THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED IN TWENTY-THREE COUNTRIES. THE MAIN PROGRAMME IS LARGE AND CURRENT: A CABINET ORDER OF JANUARY 2026 ALLOCATED NOT LESS THAN TWO AND A HALF BILLION SOMS AT A CONCESSIONAL RATE OF SIX PER CENT A YEAR, DISBURSED THROUGH TWO STATE BANKS. AND WHAT IT FUNDS INCLUDES THE THING THIS FILE HAS BEEN LOOKING FOR ACROSS THE WHOLE REGION: THE INTRODUCTION OF WATER-SAVING IRRIGATION TECHNOLOGIES, INCLUDING DRIP AND SPRINKLER IRRIGATION, ALONGSIDE LIVESTOCK AND CROP PRODUCTION. DRIP IRRIGATION FINANCED AT SIX PER CENT IS WHAT LETS A HOLDING SURVIVE A DRY DECADE. THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED PASTURE COMMITTEES, WATER USERS' ASSOCIATIONS AND RESTORATION PROJECTS FOR THIS COUNTRY — NONE OF THEM PUTS EQUIPMENT IN A FARMER'S HANDS, AND THIS DOES. THE LIVESTOCK LINE IS CHEAPER STILL: THREE PER CENT A YEAR FOR UP TO SIXTY MONTHS, WITH A GRACE PERIOD OF UP TO TWELVE MONTHS — AND ITS ELIGIBLE SUBJECTS INCLUDE PEASANT AND FARMER HOUSEHOLDS AND INDIVIDUAL ENTREPRENEURS, NOT ONLY LARGE BREEDING FARMS. A TWELVE-MONTH GRACE PERIOD IS THE DETAIL THAT DECIDES WHETHER A FAMILY CAN USE LIVESTOCK CREDIT AT ALL, BECAUSE AN ANIMAL BOUGHT THIS SPRING PRODUCES NOTHING UNTIL NEXT YEAR. ASK FOR IT EXPLICITLY — THIS FILE HAS RECORDED THAT REPAYMENT SCHEDULES MISMATCHED TO BIOLOGY ARE HOW AGRICULTURAL DEBT BECOMES DEFAULT. FINANCING IN ACCORDANCE WITH ISLAMIC PRINCIPLES IS OFFERED ALONGSIDE THE INTEREST-BEARING VERSION, WHICH MATTERS FOR HOUSEHOLDS THAT WOULD OTHERWISE NOT BORROW AT ALL. THE SCALE SHOWS THIS IS ROUTINE RATHER THAN EXCEPTIONAL: SIX STATE PROJECTS WORTH SEVEN AND A HALF BILLION SOMS BY EARLY 2026, RISING TO NINE PROJECTS AND THIRTEEN BILLION, WITH EIGHT BILLION REACHING THE SECTOR IN SIX MONTHS — INCLUDING A LINE SPECIFICALLY FOR UNITED COMMODITY PRODUCERS. THAT LAST LINE IS THE ONE FOR COOPERATIVES. WHERE A PROGRAMME NAMES JOINED-UP PRODUCERS AS ITS SUBJECT, A GROUP THAT FORMALISES ITSELF MOVES FROM THE HOUSEHOLD QUEUE INTO A SEPARATE, LESS CROWDED ONE. AND THE STANDING BANK PRODUCT BEHIND THE STATE PROGRAMMES REACHES UP TO FIFTY MILLION SOMS FOR UP TO EIGHTY-FOUR MONTHS AT RATES UP TO TEN PER CENT, COVERING CROP PRODUCTION, LIVESTOCK, FISHERIES, POULTRY AND BEEKEEPING. THE LIMITS: ALL OF THIS IS DEBT. IT MUST BE REPAID WHATEVER THE SEASON DOES, AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED IN FOUR COUNTRIES THAT DEFAULTED AGRICULTURAL LOANS LOCK FAMILIES OUT OF LATER BORROWING AND SOMETIMES COST THEM THE PLEDGED ASSET. THE UNSECURED CEILING, THE RATES AND THE GRACE PERIODS COME FROM MINISTRY AND CABINET ANNOUNCEMENTS REPORTED IN THE PRESS AND FROM A COMMERCIAL BANK-COMPARISON SITE, NOT FROM THE BANKS' OWN CURRENT TERMS - VERIFY EVERY FIGURE AT A BRANCH, since programme numbers change each cycle and one product cited belongs to an earlier round. IT FINANCES PRODUCTION, NOT LEGAL DEFENCE OR LAND PURCHASE, and a state lender will not fund opposition to a state project.
