Read it with the forest and land users' association's lease registration help, the pasture committees, the advocates' free aid week and the citizen air monitoring recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Free legal aid centres — twenty offices with published addresses, giving consultative-legal help at no charge
trackers.desc: THE USEFUL THING HERE IS AN ADDRESS LIST. TWENTY FREE LEGAL AID CENTRES WERE CREATED BY THE JUSTICE MINISTRY UNDER THE LAW ON STATE-GUARANTEED LEGAL AID TO PROVIDE CONSULTATIVE-LEGAL HELP TO CITIZENS ON A FREE BASIS, AND THEIR ADDRESSES ARE PUBLISHED ON A DEDICATED PORTAL THAT ALSO EXPLAINS WHERE TO GET THAT HELP. A PUBLISHED ADDRESS IS WHAT SEPARATES A RIGHT FROM A RUMOUR. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED FREE-AID ENTITLEMENTS IN A DOZEN COUNTRIES WHERE NOBODY COULD SAY WHICH DOOR TO KNOCK ON — HERE THE DOORS ARE LISTED, AND A COMMUNITY CAN FIND THE NEAREST ONE BEFORE IT NEEDS IT. THERE IS ALSO A NAMED PLACE TO COMPLAIN WHEN THE SYSTEM FAILS: A CENTRE FOR THE COORDINATION OF STATE-GUARANTEED LEGAL AID SITS UNDER THE JUSTICE MINISTRY, AND STAFF OF STATE BODIES ARE MADE RESPONSIBLE FOR ORGANISING THE SYSTEM AND INTERACTING WITH THAT CENTRE. SO IF A CENTRE TURNS SOMEONE AWAY, OR IF NO CENTRE COVERS A DISTRICT, THE COORDINATION CENTRE IS THE ADDRESS FOR THAT COMPLAINT — AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED FOR THIS COUNTRY THAT THE ADVOCATES' CHAMBER ALSO RUNS FREE LEGAL AID WEEKS THROUGH ITS REGIONAL CHAMBERS, WHICH IS A SECOND ROUTE WHEN THE FIRST IS CLOSED. KNOW WHO BUILT THEM, BECAUSE IT TELLS YOU WHAT TO EXPECT: THE CENTRES WERE ESTABLISHED WITH THE SUPPORT OF A UNITED NATIONS DEVELOPMENT PROJECT AND A NORDIC MINISTRY'S PROGRAMME ON SUSTAINABLE ACCESS TO JUSTICE FOR LEGAL EMPOWERMENT, A PRIVATE FOUNDATION AND A FOREIGN DEVELOPMENT AGENCY'S GOVERNANCE PROGRAMME. DONOR-BUILT NETWORKS ARE REAL BUT NOT PERMANENT. THE PRACTICAL QUESTION TO ASK AT THE CENTRE IS WHETHER IT IS NOW FUNDED FROM THE STATE BUDGET OR STILL FROM A PROJECT — BECAUSE THAT DETERMINES WHETHER IT WILL STILL BE THERE NEXT YEAR, AND THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED SERVICES IN THREE COUNTRIES THAT CLOSED WHEN A GRANT ENDED. WHAT THEY OFFER IS CONSULTATION RATHER THAN REPRESENTATION, WHICH IS THE HONEST DESCRIPTION: CONSULTATIVE-LEGAL HELP. SO USE THEM FOR THE QUESTIONS THAT DECIDE WHETHER A CASE EXISTS — IS THIS DEADLINE REAL, IS THIS DOCUMENT VALID, WHICH BODY DECIDES THIS — AND EXPECT TO NEED AN ADVOCATE SEPARATELY IF A MATTER GOES TO COURT. AND ASK ONE QUESTION FIRST, BECAUSE IT DECIDES EVERYTHING ELSE: WHETHER LAND AND PROPERTY MATTERS ARE INSIDE THE STATE-GUARANTEED SCHEME AT ALL. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED ACROSS THE REGION THAT FREE AID OFTEN COVERS CRIMINAL DEFENCE AND FAMILY MATTERS AND EXCLUDES PROPERTY DISPUTES — THE ANSWER SHOULD BE OBTAINED BEFORE A HOUSEHOLD BUILDS A PLAN AROUND IT. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A STATE-ORGANISED CONSULTATION NETWORK, NOT AN ADVOCATE FOR COMMUNITIES: IT WILL NOT OPPOSE A PROJECT, AND WHETHER IT WILL ADVISE AGAINST A STATE OR MUNICIPAL DECISION IS UNTESTED HERE. TWENTY CENTRES IS A THIN NETWORK FOR A MOUNTAINOUS COUNTRY, SO THE NEAREST MAY STILL BE A LONG JOURNEY. THE DESCRIPTION AND THE DONOR LIST COME FROM THE PORTAL'S OWN PAGE AND THE CENTRE COUNT MAY BE OUT OF DATE - confirm the current list of addresses and opening arrangements on the portal before travelling. Read it with the advocates' chamber's free legal aid week, the forest and land users' association's lease registration help, the pasture committees and the state concessional lending recorded separately for this country.FOUR THINGS ABOUT THIS SYSTEM WERE NOT RECORDED HERE, AND THE FIRST CHANGES WHAT TO ASK AT THE COUNTER: THE CENTRES ARE STAFFED BY HIGHLY QUALIFIED JURISTS AND ALSO BY ADVOCATES BELONGING TO THE STATE-GUARANTEED LEGAL AID SYSTEM, WHO GIVE ADVICE ACCORDING TO A DRAWN-UP SCHEDULE. PARTICULAR ADVOCATES SIT ON PARTICULAR DAYS. SO THE USEFUL QUESTION IS NOT WHETHER THERE IS A LAWYER BUT WHEN THE NEXT ADVOCATE'S DAY IS AND WHAT TO BRING TO IT. SECOND, THE ENTITLEMENT COMES IN TWO FORMS AND THEY ARE NOT THE SAME THING: THE CONSTITUTION PROVIDES THAT IN CASES ESTABLISHED BY LAW LEGAL AID IS PROVIDED AT THE EXPENSE OF THE STATE, AND THE LAW ON STATE-GUARANTEED LEGAL AID OF DECEMBER 2016 PROVIDES IT AS CONSULTATIVE-LEGAL AID AND AS QUALIFIED LEGAL AID. CONSULTATION TELLS YOU WHERE YOU STAND; QUALIFIED AID IS SOMEBODY ACTING FOR YOU. A GROUP THAT ASKS ONLY FOR ADVICE WILL GET ADVICE — ASK WHICH FORM YOUR MATTER QUALIFIES FOR, AND ON WHAT GROUND. THIRD, ONE ROUTE COSTS NOTHING AND ARRIVES WITHOUT ASKING: IN CERTAIN PROCEEDINGS — FOR INSTANCE WHERE A PERSON'S LEGAL CAPACITY IS AT ISSUE AND THEY HAVE NO REPRESENTATIVE — THE JUDGE APPOINTS AN OFFICIAL REPRESENTATIVE ADVOCATE TO REPRESENT AND DEFEND THEIR INTERESTS, AND IN THOSE CASES THE ADVOCATE IS FREE. FOURTH, AN OBLIGATION HIDES IN THE DEFINITION OF WHO PROVIDES AID: IT REACHES BEYOND ADVOCATES TO OFFICIALS OF STATE BODIES — LEGISLATIVE, EXECUTIVE AND JUDICIAL — AND OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT AND STATE AND MUNICIPAL INSTITUTIONS, AND TO ADVOCATES' ASSISTANTS. LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS BEING PART OF THE LEGAL AID SYSTEM MEANS THE VILLAGE ADMINISTRATION RECORDED SEPARATELY IN THIS PAYLOAD OWES EXPLANATIONS AS WELL AS DECISIONS — A SMALL LEVER, BUT ONE THAT COSTS NOTHING TO PULL.

trackers.name: Historical and cultural heritage law — whole territories can be recognised as reserves or memorial complexes
trackers.desc: MOST HERITAGE PROTECTION IN THIS PAYLOAD ATTACHES TO A BUILDING OR A FIND. THIS ONE REACHES A WHOLE PLACE: ARCHITECTURAL ENSEMBLES AND TERRITORIES REPRESENTING HISTORICAL, MEMORIAL, ARTISTIC OR OTHER CULTURAL VALUE MAY BE RECOGNISED BY THE GOVERNMENT AS HISTORICAL-CULTURAL RESERVES, OR AS HISTORICAL-CULTURAL AND MEMORIAL COMPLEXES. TERRITORIES, NOT ONLY BUILDINGS. THAT IS THE CATEGORY A VALLEY, A PASTURE WITH BURIAL MOUNDS OR AN OLD SETTLEMENT AREA FITS INTO — AND THIS FILE HAS SPENT THE WHOLE SWEEP LOOKING FOR DESIGNATIONS THAT COVER GROUND RATHER THAN OBJECTS. THE ROUTE IS NAMED AND SHORT: RECOGNITION IS BY THE GOVERNMENT, ON THE SUBMISSION OF THE STATE BODY FOR THE PROTECTION OF MONUMENTS, AND WHAT FOLLOWS IS PROTECTION IN THE MANNER DEFINED BY SPECIAL REGULATIONS APPROVED BY THE GOVERNMENT. SO THE ADDRESS FOR A COMMUNITY'S REQUEST IS THE STATE MONUMENTS PROTECTION BODY, NOT THE CABINET. IT IS THAT BODY'S SUBMISSION THAT REACHES THE GOVERNMENT, WHICH MEANS THE WORK IS PERSUADING SPECIALISTS RATHER THAN POLITICIANS — AND SPECIALISTS RESPOND TO DOCUMENTATION. SO THE PRACTICAL PREPARATION IS THE SAME AS THIS FILE HAS RECOMMENDED FOR EVERY OTHER DESIGNATION: PHOTOGRAPH WHAT STANDS, RECORD WHERE IT IS, WRITE DOWN WHAT IS KNOWN LOCALLY ABOUT WHO BUILT IT AND WHEN, AND PUT THAT IN FRONT OF THE MONUMENTS BODY WITH A REQUEST THAT IT MAKE A SUBMISSION. THE DEFINITION IS BROAD ENOUGH TO HELP: HERITAGE MEANS MONUMENTS CONNECTED WITH HISTORICAL EVENTS IN THE LIFE OF THE PEOPLE AND THE DEVELOPMENT OF SOCIETY AND THE STATE, AND WORKS OF MATERIAL AND SPIRITUAL CREATION REPRESENTING HISTORICAL, SCIENTIFIC, ARTISTIC OR OTHER VALUE. SPIRITUAL CREATION AND MEMORIAL VALUE ARE IN THE TEXT. A SHRINE, A SACRED SPRING OR A PLACE ASSOCIATED WITH A REMEMBERED EVENT IS THEREFORE ARGUABLE UNDER THIS LAW EVEN WHERE NOTHING WAS EVER BUILT — WHICH IS THE SITUATION IN MUCH OF THE HIGH PASTURE THIS COUNTRY'S COMMUNITIES DEPEND ON. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A DESIGNATION LAW OF 1999, RECORDED FOR THE CATEGORY IT CREATES AND THE BODY A REQUEST GOES TO - NOTHING IN IT OBLIGES THAT BODY TO MAKE A SUBMISSION, AND RECOGNITION IS A GOVERNMENT DECISION THAT MAY TAKE YEARS OR NEVER COME. WHAT THE SPECIAL REGULATIONS ACTUALLY FORBID INSIDE A RESERVE WAS NOT ESTABLISHED, AND A RESERVE CAN RESTRICT GRAZING AND BUILDING FOR THE PEOPLE INSIDE IT AS WELL AS FOR A DEVELOPER - ask what the regime would mean for your own use before requesting it. THE TEXT WAS READ THROUGH THE JUSTICE MINISTRY'S DATABASE LISTING AND AN INTERNATIONAL ARCHIVE'S COPY, WHICH EXTRACTED IMPERFECTLY, AND ONE VERSION SEEN WAS MARKED AS NO LONGER IN FORCE - the current consolidated text must be checked before relying on any article. Read it with the free legal aid centres, the forest and land users' association's lease registration help, the pasture committees and the state concessional lending recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Business and human rights resource centre — it invites the company to answer your allegation in public, and records the silence if it doesn't
trackers.desc: A COMMUNITY WITH NO LAWYER AND NO COURT CAN STILL PUT A COMPANY ON THE RECORD HERE. SINCE 2005 THIS CENTRE HAS INVITED COMPANIES TO RESPOND TO ALLEGATIONS OF MISCONDUCT RAISED BY CIVIL SOCIETY WHEN IT FINDS NO EVIDENCE THAT THEY HAVE OTHERWISE RESPONDED — AND IT ALWAYS PUBLISHES ANY RESPONSE RECEIVED IN FULL, POSTED TOGETHER WITH THE ORIGINAL REPORT. THE PAIRING IS THE POINT: THE PUBLIC GETS BOTH THE ALLEGATION AND THE COMPANY'S COMMENTS, ON ONE PAGE, PERMANENTLY. THAT IS A KIND OF ACCOUNTABILITY THIS FILE HAS FOUND ALMOST NOWHERE ELSE WITHOUT A COURT. AND SILENCE COUNTS: IN ONE COUNTRY PROGRAMME THE CENTRE APPROACHED MORE THAN A HUNDRED COMPANIES AND RECORDED MORE THAN THREE HUNDRED RESPONSES AND NON-RESPONSES, PUBLISHING THE RECORD. A DOCUMENTED REFUSAL TO ANSWER IS EVIDENCE IN ITS OWN RIGHT — USEFUL WITH LENDERS, BUYERS, JOURNALISTS AND THE ACCOUNTABILITY MECHANISMS RECORDED ELSEWHERE IN THIS PAYLOAD, ALL OF WHOM ASK WHETHER THE COMPANY ENGAGED. THE PROCESS DOES NOT END WITH THE COMPANY'S REPLY: THE CENTRE UPDATES THOSE WHO RAISED THE CONCERNS ON DEVELOPMENTS AND INVITES THEM TO ISSUE REJOINDERS TO COMPANY RESPONSES, WITH BOTH MEANT TO BE SCRUTINISED BY THE WIDER COMMUNITY. SO A VILLAGE GETS THE LAST WORD, IN PUBLIC, AGAINST A CORPORATE STATEMENT — WHICH IS RARE ENOUGH TO BE WORTH PLANNING FOR: KEEP THE DATES, PHOTOGRAPHS AND NAMES THAT WILL MAKE A REJOINDER SPECIFIC. THE PLATFORM ITSELF IS THE OTHER HALF OF THE RESOURCE: NEWS AND ALLEGATIONS ON OVER TWENTY THOUSAND COMPANIES IN MORE THAN A HUNDRED AND EIGHTY COUNTRIES, ON DEDICATED COMPANY PAGES, WITH NAVIGATION IN SEVEN LANGUAGES INCLUDING ARABIC AND RUSSIAN. SO BEFORE THE FIRST MEETING WITH A DEVELOPER, LOOK UP ITS PAGE. A DECADE OF NEWS, CIVIL SOCIETY REPORTS AND ITS OWN DISCLOSURES IS THE CHEAPEST DUE DILIGENCE A COMMUNITY WILL EVER DO, AND IT IS AVAILABLE IN LANGUAGES PEOPLE HERE ACTUALLY READ. OCCASIONALLY IT GOES FURTHER THAN PUBLISHING. THE CENTRE STATES THAT DIALOGUES CAN EXTEND AND THAT IT SOMETIMES TAKES AN ACTIVE ROLE SUPPORTING COMMUNITIES AND ORGANISATIONS — IN ONE CASE SUPPORTING GROUPS WORKING TO FREE AN INDIGENOUS COMMUNITY LEADER AND ENVIRONMENTAL RIGHTS DEFENDER IMPRISONED AFTER LEADING OPPOSITION TO A PROPOSED MINE ON HIS COMMUNITY'S TERRITORY, POSTING THE ALLEGATIONS, SEEKING RESPONSES FROM TWO COMPANIES THAT DID NOT RESPOND, AND ASSISTING THE VILLAGERS IN SUBMITTING THE CASE TO A UN SPECIAL PROCEDURE ON HUMAN RIGHTS DEFENDERS. THAT EXAMPLE IS THE PATTERN TO NOTICE, NOT THE EXCEPTION: PUBLICATION FIRST, THEN THE COMPANY'S SILENCE ON THE RECORD, THEN AN INTERNATIONAL COMPLAINT BUILT ON BOTH. EACH STEP MAKES THE NEXT ONE POSSIBLE. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A TRANSPARENCY AND TRACKING ORGANISATION, NOT A REGULATOR, A COURT OR A FUNDER - IT CANNOT ORDER ANYTHING, AWARD COMPENSATION OR STOP A PROJECT, AND A COMPANY MAY SIMPLY ISSUE A BLAND REPLY. INDEPENDENT COMMENTARY HAS CRITICISED IT FOR WEAK AND TANGENTIAL COMPANY RESPONSES AND THE CENTRE ITSELF HAS ASKED ADVOCATES HOW TO IMPROVE THE MECHANISM. IT PUBLISHES ALLEGATIONS RAISED BY CIVIL SOCIETY, SO A COMMUNITY USUALLY NEEDS A REPORT OR AN ORGANISATION BEHIND IT RATHER THAN A BARE COMPLAINT, AND EXACTLY WHAT IT REQUIRES BEFORE POSTING WAS NOT ESTABLISHED. PUBLICITY ALSO CARRIES RISK: NAMING A COMPANY TIED TO POWERFUL INTERESTS HAS COST PEOPLE THEIR LIBERTY, AS THE CENTRE'S OWN EXAMPLE SHOWS. THE ACCOUNT COMES FROM THE CENTRE'S OWN PAGES ALONGSIDE AN ACADEMIC ANALYSIS AND PARTNER LISTINGS OF EARLIER YEARS. Read it with the free legal aid centres, the grassroots environmental fund's advisors, the forest and land users' association and the pasture committees recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Forestry enterprises as landlords — leskhozy lease forest plots by published competition, and the code's community forestry article
trackers.desc: A TAG SCAN PUT THIS COUNTRY AMONG THE THINNEST IN THE PAYLOAD FOR WAYS OF HOLDING LAND. HERE IS ONE THAT ALREADY EXISTS AND HAS A LANDLORD WITH AN OFFICE: A LESKHOZ - A SEPARATE PRODUCTION AND ECONOMIC UNIT, THE MAIN COMPONENT OF THE STATE FORESTRY BODIES, A LEGAL PERSON WITH FULL ECONOMIC AND FINANCIAL INDEPENDENCE - IS THE LESSOR OF FOREST FUND PLOTS, AND THE LESSEE MAY BE A PHYSICAL OR A LEGAL PERSON. A PHYSICAL PERSON MEANS AN ORDINARY HOUSEHOLD, NOT ONLY A COMPANY OR AN ASSOCIATION. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED ACROSS THE REGION THAT MOST ROUTES TO LAND REQUIRE A REGISTERED ENTITY FIRST - THIS ONE DOES NOT. WHAT YOU GET IS A DEFINED THING RATHER THAN A PROMISE: A FOREST FUND PLOT IS A PLOT OF FOREST, OR OF FOREST LAND NOT COVERED BY FOREST VEGETATION, WHOSE BOUNDARIES ARE MARKED IN NATURE BY SPECIAL SIGNS AND SHOWN IN PLANNING AND CARTOGRAPHIC MATERIALS - AND THE LEASE AGREEMENT SETS THE TERMS, THE CONDITIONS AND THE RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS OF BOTH SIDES. MARKED IN NATURE AND SHOWN ON THE FOREST MAPS IS THE PHRASE TO HOLD THEM TO. A LEASE OVER GROUND WHOSE BOUNDARY MARKERS AND MAP SHEET YOU HAVE SEEN IS A DIFFERENT THING FROM ONE OVER A DESCRIPTION. HOW PLOTS ARE HANDED OUT IS ALSO PUBLIC, WHICH IS THE OPENING: PLOTS ARE PUT TO COMPETITION BY DECISION OF THE LESKHOZY, THE TERRITORIAL FORESTRY BODY APPROVES THE COMPETITION COMMISSIONS ON THE LESKHOZ'S PROPOSAL, AND INFORMATION ABOUT THE COMPETITIONS IS PUBLISHED IN THE MASS MEDIA. PUBLISHED COMPETITIONS MEAN A COMMUNITY CAN WATCH FOR THE PLOT IT CARES ABOUT COMING UP, AND CAN BID FOR IT RATHER THAN LEARN AFTERWARDS WHO GOT IT. WATCHING THE NOTICES IS FREE; DISCOVERING THE OUTCOME LATER COSTS THE FOREST. THE RESTRICTIONS ARE IN THE SAME RULES AND MUST BE READ BEFORE ANYONE CELEBRATES: LEASED PLOTS DO NOT PASS INTO THE LESSEE'S OWNERSHIP WHEN THE LEASE ENDS, AND BUYOUT AND SUBLEASE ARE PROHIBITED. SO THIS IS TENURE, NOT PURCHASE - WHICH IS EXACTLY WHAT THE LAND ACQUISITION FUND RECORDED ELSEWHERE IN THIS PAYLOAD PAYS FOR WHEN IT FUNDS LONG-TERM LEASES RATHER THAN FREEHOLD. ONE RESTRICTION CUTS THE OTHER WAY AND SHOULD WORRY ANY VILLAGE THAT USES A FOREST IT DOES NOT LEASE: THE PRESENCE OF CITIZENS ON LEASED PLOTS, AND THE GATHERING THERE OF WILD FRUITS, BERRIES, NUTS, MUSHROOMS, OTHER FOOD PRODUCTS AND MEDICINAL RAW MATERIAL, MAY BE RESTRICTED. IN THE WALNUT AND PISTACHIO FORESTS OF THIS COUNTRY THAT IS NOT A TECHNICALITY - IT IS THE HARVEST. IF SOMEBODY ELSE LEASES THE STAND YOUR HOUSEHOLD PICKS, YOUR ACCESS BECOMES THEIR DECISION, WHICH IS THE STRONGEST ARGUMENT FOR WATCHING THE COMPETITION NOTICES AND BIDDING TOGETHER. THE CODE ALSO CARRIES AN ARTICLE ON COMMUNITY FOREST MANAGEMENT, ALONGSIDE ARTICLES ON THE SIZE OF LEASE PAYMENTS AND ON HAYMAKING AND LIVESTOCK GRAZING ON STATE FOREST FUND LANDS - SO THE COLLECTIVE ROUTE IS NAMED IN THE LAW AND CAN BE ASKED FOR BY ITS ARTICLE. AND THE FORESTS THEMSELVES ARE CATEGORISED IN A WAY THAT HELPS AN ARGUMENT: SPECIALLY PROTECTIVE AREAS INCLUDE GENETIC RESERVES AND NATURAL MONUMENTS, WALNUT-FRUIT FORESTS, JUNIPER FORESTS AND PISTACHIO FORESTS, DESIGNATED DURING FOREST INVENTORY OR BY SPECIAL DECISION. THE LIMITS: THE LESKHOZ IS A STATE FORESTRY ENTERPRISE WITH ITS OWN INCOME TO EARN, NOT A CONSERVATION PARTNER - IT LEASES TO WHOEVER WINS THE COMPETITION, AND THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS ELSEWHERE THAT COMPETITIONS IN THIS REGION ARE NOT ALWAYS DECIDED ON MERIT. A LEASE GIVES USE, NOT OWNERSHIP, CANNOT BE BOUGHT OUT OR SUBLET, AND CAN END. THE RULES DESCRIBED COME FROM A 2007 GOVERNMENT REGULATION AND THE 1999 FOREST CODE AS AMENDED TO 2024, READ IN A LEGAL DATABASE AND ON A SECTOR PORTAL RATHER THAN FROM A LESKHOZ'S OWN SERVICE PAGE - LEASE TERMS, PAYMENT RATES, THE LENGTH AVAILABLE AND WHETHER HOUSEHOLDS ACTUALLY WIN COMPETITIONS WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED, AND THE COMMUNITY FORESTRY ARTICLE WAS SEEN ONLY AS A TITLE IN THE CODE'S CONTENTS. Read it with the pasture committees, the free legal aid centres and their advocate days, the grassroots environmental fund's advisors and the heritage designation law recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Municipal enterprises in every village administration, their new association, and the union of all local self-governments
trackers.desc: THERE IS NOW A COMPANY IN EVERY VILLAGE ADMINISTRATION IN THIS COUNTRY, AND ALMOST NOBODY IS USING IT: BY PRESIDENTIAL DECREE, MUNICIPAL ENTERPRISES HAVE BEEN CREATED IN ALL LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT BODIES - AN ENTERPRISE BEING A SUBJECT FOUNDED BY THE EXECUTIVE ORGAN OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT ITSELF, THE MUNICIPALITY'S OWN DAUGHTER. A COMPANY OWNED BY THE VILLAGE IS A THING THAT CAN HOLD A BANK ACCOUNT, SIGN A CONTRACT, EMPLOY PEOPLE, BUY EQUIPMENT AND RUN A SERVICE. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED, FUND AFTER FUND, THAT THE MISSING PIECE IS ALWAYS A LEGAL BODY THE VILLAGE CONTROLS - HERE ONE HAS BEEN CREATED FOR EVERY VILLAGE BY DECREE. THE PEOPLE RUNNING THEM SAY PLAINLY WHAT IS WRONG, AND THE ADMISSION IS THE OPENING: ON PAPER THEY EXIST, BUT IN FACT THEIR STAFF DO NOT KNOW HOW TO WORK, WHERE TO BEGIN, OR HOW TO BE OF USE TO THEIR VILLAGE ADMINISTRATION, THEIR DISTRICT AND THEIR RESIDENTS. AN ORGANISATION THAT EXISTS, HAS LEGAL FORM AND DOES NOT KNOW WHAT TO DO IS THE EASIEST INSTITUTION IN THIS ENTIRE PAYLOAD TO INFLUENCE. A GROUP ARRIVING WITH A CONCRETE PROPOSAL - A NURSERY, A WATER LINE, A WASTE ROUND, A GRAZING SCHEME - IS OFFERING THE ANSWER TO A QUESTION ITS OWN DIRECTOR IS ASKING. THE LEGAL TANGLE IS WORTH KNOWING BEFORE PROPOSING ANYTHING: LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT IS GOVERNED BY ITS OWN SECTOR LEGISLATION WHILE THE ENTERPRISES THEMSELVES ARE GOVERNED BY THE CIVIL CODE, AND THE NEW ASSOCIATION ARGUES THAT A SEPARATE LAW ON MUNICIPAL ENTERPRISES IS VITALLY NEEDED. THAT ASSOCIATION IS ITSELF NEW AND WORTH JOINING: AN ASSOCIATION OF MUNICIPAL ENTERPRISES HAS BEEN ESTABLISHED, DESCRIBING ITSELF AS ORDINARY WORKING PEOPLE OF THE REGIONS UNITING TO CHANGE THE SYSTEM FROM INSIDE SO THAT LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT BODIES BECOME GENUINELY STRONG. ITS DESCRIPTION OF THE COUNTRYSIDE IS THE MOST HONEST SENTENCE IN THIS ROUND: IN REMOTE REGIONS THERE IS NOTHING AT ALL APART FROM THE SCHOOL, THE KINDERGARTEN, THE VILLAGE ADMINISTRATION, THE LOCAL POLICEMAN AND THE MUNICIPAL ENTERPRISE. IF THOSE FIVE ARE ALL THAT EXISTS, THEN THE MUNICIPAL ENTERPRISE IS ONE FIFTH OF THE INSTITUTIONAL WORLD OF A REMOTE VILLAGE - AND THE ONLY ONE OF THE FIVE THAT CAN TRADE, HIRE AND OWN. ABOVE THEM SITS A BODY OLDER THAN ANY OF THIS: THE FIRST ASSOCIATION OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT BODIES IN CENTRAL ASIA WAS FORMED IN OCTOBER 1996 AT THE SECOND MEETING OF HEADS OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT, AND AFTER SEVERAL CHANGES IS TODAY THE UNION OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENTS OF THE REPUBLIC, WHICH REPRESENTS AND DEFENDS THE INTERESTS OF ALL VILLAGE ADMINISTRATIONS AND CITY MAYORALTIES. A UNION THAT SPEAKS FOR EVERY VILLAGE ADMINISTRATION IN THE COUNTRY IS THE PLACE TO TAKE A PROBLEM THAT IS NOT ONE VILLAGE'S ALONE - A PASTURE RULE, A WATER TARIFF, A LICENSING PRACTICE THAT HURTS EVERY AYIL OKMOTU THE SAME WAY. AND SOMETHING WIDER IS FORMING AROUND IT: A CENTRAL ASIAN COUNCIL ON LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT AND LOCAL DEVELOPMENT IS DESCRIBED AS CONCEIVED NOT AS A SUPERSTRUCTURE BUT AS A WORKING HUB OF ASSOCIATIONS, RELEVANT MINISTRIES AND MUNICIPALITIES OF FIVE COUNTRIES, WHERE COMMON STANDARDS, SOLUTIONS AND PILOTS ARE BORN. FIVE COUNTRIES OF THIS PAYLOAD SHARING A LOCAL-GOVERNMENT HUB MEANS A SOLUTION THAT WORKS IN ONE VILLAGE HAS A ROUTE TO THE OTHER FOUR - WHICH IS RARE, AND WORTH WATCHING. THE LIMITS: MUNICIPAL ENTERPRISES ARE CREATURES OF THE VILLAGE EXECUTIVE, NOT OF THE RESIDENTS - THEY WERE CREATED BY PRESIDENTIAL DECREE RATHER THAN LOCAL DEMAND, THEIR DIRECTORS ANSWER TO THE ADMINISTRATION, AND AN ENTERPRISE CAN AS EASILY BE THE VEHICLE FOR LEASING OUT COMMON LAND AS FOR PROTECTING IT. THEIR REGULATION IS ADMITTEDLY INCOMPLETE, WHICH CUTS BOTH WAYS. WHAT THESE ENTERPRISES ACTUALLY DO, WHAT THEY MAY OWN, HOW THEIR DIRECTORS ARE APPOINTED AND WHETHER RESIDENTS SEE THEIR ACCOUNTS WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED. THE ACCOUNT COMES FROM A NEWS SITE'S REPORT OF THE ASSOCIATION'S FOUNDING AND FROM AN EARLIER ARTICLE ON A LOCAL COMMUNITIES WEEK, PLUS A POLICY INSTITUTE'S PAGES OF JANUARY 2026 - NOT FROM ANY ENTERPRISE'S OR THE UNION'S OWN PUBLICATIONS, AND THE UNION'S CURRENT ACTIVITY AND MEMBERSHIP TERMS WERE NOT ESTABLISHED. Read it with the pasture committees, the free legal aid centres and their advocate days, the forestry enterprises' lease competitions and the grassroots environmental fund recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Community based tourism association — village groups with their own information centres, homestay networks and shared price policy
trackers.desc: THE PREVIOUS ROUND SEARCHED FOR THIS BODY IN RUSSIAN AND FOUND ONLY TOUR OPERATORS. IT EXISTS, AND IT IS THE MOST DIRECTLY USEFUL VILLAGE ORGANISATION IN THIS COUNTRY: AN UMBRELLA ASSOCIATION UNITING A NUMBER OF DIVERSE DESTINATION COMMUNITIES KNOWN AS CBT GROUPS, REGISTERED ON THE THIRD OF JANUARY 2003 WITH SUPPORT FROM A SWISS COOPERATION ASSOCIATION'S SUPPORT PROJECT, THE UNDERLYING INITIATIVE HAVING BEGUN IN MAY 2000. ITS OBJECT IS THE ARGUMENT THIS FILE KEEPS LOOKING FOR: TO IMPROVE THE LIVING CONDITIONS OF PEOPLE IN REMOTE MOUNTAIN REGIONS BY DEVELOPING RURAL TOURISM WITHOUT HARMING THE NATURAL ENVIRONMENT AND THE CULTURE OF LOCAL PEOPLE, USING LOCAL NATURAL AND RECREATIONAL RESOURCES. WITHOUT HARMING THE ENVIRONMENT AND THE CULTURE IS WRITTEN INTO THE PURPOSE, NOT ADDED AFTERWARDS. THAT IS WHAT SEPARATES THIS FROM THE RESORT DEVELOPMENTS THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS ARRIVING IN MOUNTAIN VALLEYS UNDER THE SAME WORD, TOURISM. WHAT A GROUP ACTUALLY IS ON THE GROUND: EACH HAS TOURIST INFORMATION CENTRES IN ITS LOCATIONS - SOME WITH FORMAL OFFICES, SOME USING THEIR HOMESTAYS AS AN OFFICE - AND THE GROUPS HAVE SET UP A NETWORK OF RESIDENTS WILLING TO OFFER HOMESTAY AND MEALS TO VISITORS, ARRANGING OFF-THE-BEATEN-TRACK TOURS, ORGANISED TREKS AND SKIING TRIPS. A HOUSE THAT DOUBLES AS THE OFFICE IS THE LOWEST-COST ORGANISATION IN THIS ENTIRE PAYLOAD. NO PREMISES, NO STAFF, NO REGISTRATION FEE - A ROOM, A LIST OF NEIGHBOURS WILLING TO HOST, AND A NAME. HOW THE MONEY ARRIVES IS EQUALLY PRACTICAL: THE GROUPS COLLECTIVELY PROMOTE THEIR SERVICES TO INTERNATIONAL TOURISTS THROUGH TOUR OPERATORS, WITH THE OPERATORS ACTING AS COORDINATORS, PACKAGERS AND DISTRIBUTORS. SELLING COLLECTIVELY THROUGH OPERATORS IS WHAT A SINGLE HOUSEHOLD CANNOT DO. IT IS ALSO WHERE THE MARGIN IS DECIDED, WHICH IS WHY THE NEXT FACT MATTERS. THE ASSOCIATION SETS PRICES TOGETHER: ITS CHAPTERS FOLLOW ITS PRINCIPLES AND SUPPORT ITS COMMON BRAND, THE CENTRAL OFFICE PROMOTES A BALANCE BETWEEN REASONABLE PRICES AND THE HIGHEST POSSIBLE QUALITY, AND THE MAIN OFFICE AND CHAPTERS WORK TOGETHER TO FIND CONSISTENT SERVICE AND PRICE POLICIES AS A STRATEGY FOR CREATING THE MOST BENEFIT FOR CONSUMERS AND THE RURAL TOURISM SECTOR TOGETHER. A COMMON PRICE POLICY ACROSS VILLAGES STOPS OPERATORS PLAYING ONE VALLEY OFF AGAINST ANOTHER. THAT IS THE SAME LOGIC AS A FARMERS' COOPERATIVE, APPLIED TO BEDS AND HORSES. MEMBERSHIP IS DEFINED AS LOCAL PEOPLE, AND THE ENTRY ROUTE IS A MEETING: WHEN THE GROUPS WERE FIRST ESTABLISHED, CONSULTANTS VISITED THE RURAL TARGET REGIONS AND INVITED LOCAL PEOPLE TO MEETINGS AT WHICH THE CRITERIA FOR BECOMING LOCAL TOURISM PROVIDERS WERE EXPLAINED, THOSE CRITERIA CENTRING ON A SET OF ECOTOURISM PRINCIPLES. CRITERIA EXPLAINED AT AN OPEN VILLAGE MEETING, RATHER THAN A CONTRACT OFFERED TO ONE FAMILY, IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A COMMUNITY BUSINESS AND A PRIVATE ONE - AND IT IS THE MODEL TO ASK FOR WHEN ANY TOURISM SCHEME ARRIVES. WHAT MEMBER HOUSEHOLDS SELL SHOWS HOW LITTLE CAPITAL IT TAKES: ALONGSIDE BEDS, YURT-BUILDING DEMONSTRATIONS, FELT-MAKING WORKSHOPS, HORSE GAMES, AND BREAD AND FOOD MASTERCLASSES. AND THE SECTOR AROUND IT IS MOVING: A RURAL TOURISM ALLIANCE HAS EXISTED SINCE 2026 WITH STAFF MOVING BETWEEN THE TWO, AND ONE INBOUND OPERATOR STATES A LOCAL-FIRST POLICY PRIORITISING LOCAL GUIDES, DRIVERS, ARTISANS AND FAMILY-RUN GUESTHOUSES, WITH TRANSPARENT PRICING GUARANTEEING A DIGNIFIED INCOME FOR RURAL RESIDENTS. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A TOURISM ASSOCIATION, NOT A LAND OR LEGAL BODY - IT WILL NOT FIGHT A MINE OR A ROAD, AND ITS INCOME MODEL DEPENDS ON VISITORS ARRIVING, WHICH COLLAPSES IN A BAD YEAR AND CONCENTRATES BENEFIT IN HOUSEHOLDS ALREADY OWNING A SPARE ROOM, A HORSE OR A YURT. MEMBERSHIP DEFINED AS LOCAL PEOPLE HAS BEEN OBSERVED IN PRACTICE TO MEAN PREDOMINANTLY ONE ETHNIC GROUP, WHICH A MIXED VILLAGE SHOULD WEIGH. THE NUMBER OF MEMBER GROUPS IS GIVEN VARIOUSLY AS TEN, FOURTEEN, FIFTEEN AND SEVENTEEN ACROSS SOURCES OF DIFFERENT DATES, AND ONE DIRECTORY ENTRY CONTRADICTS ITSELF WITHIN A SINGLE PARAGRAPH - SO THE CURRENT NUMBER AND WHICH VALLEYS ARE COVERED MUST BE CHECKED WITH THE ASSOCIATION. ITS ORIGIN AND MUCH OF ITS FUNDING RUN THROUGH A FOREIGN DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMME, AND WHAT REMAINS IF THAT SUPPORT ENDS WAS NOT ESTABLISHED. Read it with the pasture committees, the municipal enterprises in every village administration, the forestry enterprises' lease competitions and the free legal aid centres recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Community development and investment agency — in all 475 rural districts, training villages to write the plan and then financing the works
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE STRONGEST LOCAL INVESTMENT ROUTE THIS FILE HAS FOUND IN CENTRAL ASIA, AND ITS REACH IS TOTAL: THE AGENCY CARRIES OUT ITS ACTIVITY IN ALL FOUR HUNDRED AND SEVENTY-FIVE RURAL DISTRICTS OF THE COUNTRY AND IN ALL THE SMALL TOWNS - TWENTY-THREE OF THEM - AND THE LARGE CITIES. EVERY RURAL DISTRICT MEANS EVERY VILLAGE ADMINISTRATION IN THIS COUNTRY IS ALREADY INSIDE ITS MAP. A COMMUNITY IS NOT ASKING TO BE INCLUDED, ONLY ASKING WHERE IT STANDS IN THE QUEUE. THE ORDER OF WORK IS THE PART WORTH COPYING: THE TRAINING COMES BEFORE THE MONEY. ITS MAIN TRAINING SUBJECTS ARE THE DEVELOPMENT OF A LOCAL TERRITORY DEVELOPMENT STRATEGY AND INVESTMENT PLAN, AND THE DEVELOPMENT OF SUB-PROJECT AND MICRO-PROJECT PROPOSALS. A VILLAGE THAT HAS BEEN TAUGHT TO WRITE ITS OWN INVESTMENT PLAN AND ITS OWN PROJECT PROPOSAL IS NO LONGER DEPENDENT ON WHOEVER HAPPENS TO ARRIVE WITH A SCHEME - AND THIS PAYLOAD HAS SPENT THREE CONSECUTIVE ROUNDS FINDING THAT THE PLAN, NOT THE PROTEST, IS WHERE LAND IS DECIDED. THE CURRENT MONEY IS LARGE AND ITS SHAPE IS PUBLISHED: UNDER A NATIONAL COMMUNITY INITIATIVE PROJECT RATIFIED IN APRIL, TWENTY-SEVEN MILLION DOLLARS WAS PROVIDED - TWENTY-FIVE MILLION AS AN INTEREST-FREE CREDIT AND TWO MILLION AS A GRANT - WITH A FURTHER SIX AND A HALF MILLION IN NATIONAL CO-FINANCING. IT COVERS FORTY DISTRICTS, IN EACH OF WHICH ONE VILLAGE ADMINISTRATION IS SELECTED, AND THE AGENCY PLANS TO ALLOCATE FOUR HUNDRED AND FIFTY THOUSAND DOLLARS TO EACH OF THOSE FORTY - FOR BUILDING KINDERGARTENS, SCHOOLS AND HOSPITALS, AND IMPROVING HEAT, ELECTRICITY AND WATER SUPPLY AND IRRIGATION SYSTEMS. ONE VILLAGE ADMINISTRATION PER DISTRICT MEANS THE COMPETITION IS AGAINST YOUR NEIGHBOURS, NOT AGAINST THE COUNTRY. THAT IS A CONTEST A PREPARED COMMUNITY CAN WIN, AND THE PREPARATION IS THE TRAINING DESCRIBED ABOVE. WHAT A VILLAGE HAS TO PUT IN IS ALSO VISIBLE, BECAUSE THE AGENCY PUBLISHES IT: IN ONE COMPLETED SUB-PROJECT THE TOTAL COST WAS NINE AND A HALF MILLION IN NATIONAL CURRENCY, OF WHICH THE VILLAGE ADMINISTRATION'S OWN CONTRIBUTION WAS TWO MILLION. ROUGHLY A FIFTH FROM THE VILLAGE'S OWN BUDGET IS THE NUMBER TO PLAN AROUND - AND THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS SEPARATELY THAT EVERY VILLAGE ADMINISTRATION IN THIS COUNTRY NOW HAS A MUNICIPAL ENTERPRISE THAT CAN HOLD MONEY AND SIGN CONTRACTS. IT PUBLISHES THE PAPERWORK ITSELF, DOWN TO THE EQUIPMENT: ONE MICRO-PROJECT DOCUMENT SETS OUT THE INSTALLATION OF A HEATING SYSTEM IN A KINDERGARTEN UNDER CONSTRUCTION, INCLUDING THE PURCHASE OF AN ENERGY-EFFICIENT LONG-BURNING SOLID FUEL BOILER OF A STATED POWER RANGE, A MAXIMUM SYSTEM PRESSURE, WATER HEATING TO A STATED TEMPERATURE, FULL INSULATION AND A REQUIRED CERTIFICATE OF CONFORMITY TO A NAMED STANDARD. A PUBLISHED SPECIFICATION IS A TEMPLATE. A COMMUNITY WRITING ITS FIRST PROPOSAL CAN SEE EXACTLY WHAT LEVEL OF DETAIL IS EXPECTED, AND A COMMUNITY WATCHING A CONTRACTOR CAN CHECK WHAT WAS ACTUALLY SUPPOSED TO BE INSTALLED. ITS WORK REACHES THE THINGS THIS FILE EXISTS FOR: ONE PROJECT CONTRIBUTES TO REDUCING POVERTY AND TO JOINT DEVELOPMENT BY EXPANDING ACCESS TO PASTURES AND VETERINARY SERVICES, AND OTHER TRAINING GIVES PARTICIPANTS THE BASIC CONCEPTS OF EXTREME WEATHER EVENTS, THEIR CAUSES, THEIR POSSIBLE NEGATIVE CONSEQUENCES AND ADAPTATION TECHNOLOGIES. AND IT IS ACTIVE NOW: IN JULY 2026 ITS EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR CONTINUED MONITORING PROJECT IMPLEMENTATION ON A WORKING TRIP TO ONE PROVINCE ALONGSIDE A CITY MAYOR AND TWO PROJECT COORDINATORS, AND IN JUNE 2026 SPECIALISED MACHINERY WAS HANDED OVER TO LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT BODIES UNDER A RURAL WATER SUPPLY AND SANITATION PROJECT. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A STATE IMPLEMENTING AGENCY SPENDING LOANS AND GRANTS FROM INTERNATIONAL FINANCIERS, NOT AN ADVOCATE - IT BUILDS WHAT THE PROGRAMME FUNDS, AND NOTHING RECORDED HERE SHOWS IT OPPOSING A PROJECT OR DEFENDING LAND. THE MONEY IS MOSTLY CREDIT, WHICH THE COUNTRY REPAYS, AND MOST OF THE COUNTRY'S VILLAGE ADMINISTRATIONS WILL NOT BE THE ONE SELECTED IN THEIR DISTRICT. HOW THE FORTY WERE CHOSEN, WHO SELECTS THEM, WHETHER THE TRAINING IS OPEN TO RESIDENTS AS WELL AS OFFICIALS, AND WHAT HAPPENS TO A VILLAGE THAT CANNOT RAISE ITS CO-FINANCING SHARE WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED - THOSE ARE THE FOUR QUESTIONS TO PUT TO THE AGENCY. THE FIGURES COME FROM THE AGENCY'S OWN PAGES AND A NEWS SITE'S 2025 REPORT OF PARLIAMENTARY RATIFICATIONS, AND THE 475-DISTRICT REACH FROM A REGIONAL COMPANY DIRECTORY WITHOUT A DATE. Read it with the municipal enterprises in every village administration, the pasture committees, the community based tourism association and the forestry enterprises' lease competitions recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Water user associations and their thirteen federations — 462 associations over 115,000 irrigated hectares, and the law that lapsed in January 2026
trackers.desc: THE FIRST THING TO SAY IS A WARNING, NOT A RECOMMENDATION: THE LAW ON ASSOCIATIONS OF WATER USERS AND UNIONS OF ASSOCIATIONS OF WATER USERS, ADOPTED IN 2002 AND RE-ISSUED IN A NEW EDITION IN 2013, LOST FORCE FROM THE SECOND OF JANUARY 2026 UNDER A LAW OF JUNE 2025. A VILLAGE JOINING, FOUNDING OR ARGUING WITH ONE OF THESE BODIES IN 2026 IS OPERATING UNDER WHATEVER REPLACED THAT LAW, NOT UNDER THE ONE MOST GUIDES STILL DESCRIBE. THE FIRST QUESTION AT THE DISTRICT WATER OFFICE IS THEREFORE WHICH LAW GOVERNS THE ASSOCIATION NOW, AND WHAT CHANGED FOR MEMBERS. WHAT THE OLD LAW DID IS STILL WORTH KNOWING, BECAUSE THE STRUCTURE IT BUILT EXISTS ON THE GROUND: IT DETERMINED THE LEGAL STATUS AND ORGANISATIONAL FOUNDATIONS OF ASSOCIATIONS OF WATER USERS AS NON-COMMERCIAL ORGANISATIONS CREATED TO ENSURE, IN THE PUBLIC INTEREST, THE OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE OF IRRIGATION SYSTEMS IN RURAL LOCALITIES - WITH ARTICLES ON CREATION, STATE REGISTRATION, FOUNDING DOCUMENTS, MEMBERSHIP, MEMBERS' RIGHTS AND DUTIES, ADMISSION AND TERMINATION OF MEMBERSHIP, THE ORGANS OF MANAGEMENT AND THEIR POWERS, AND REORGANISATION AND LIQUIDATION. THE SCALE IS THE REASON THIS MATTERS: THERE ARE FOUR HUNDRED AND SIXTY-TWO ASSOCIATIONS OF WATER USERS, OF WHICH FOUR HUNDRED AND FIFTY-ONE ARE OFFICIALLY REGISTERED, AND THIRTEEN UNIONS OR FEDERATIONS OF ASSOCIATIONS HAVE PASSED LEGAL REGISTRATION, COVERING A HUNDRED AND FIFTEEN THOUSAND THREE HUNDRED AND THIRTY-EIGHT HECTARES OF IRRIGATED LAND. THIRTEEN FEDERATIONS IS THE FINDING. THIS PAYLOAD RECORDED THE SINGLE ASSOCIATION AS THE UNIT ELSEWHERE - HERE THEY HAVE COMBINED, WHICH IS WHAT LETS WATER USERS ARGUE ABOUT A WHOLE CANAL SYSTEM RATHER THAN ONE OFFTAKE. WHAT THEY WERE CREATED TO TAKE OVER EXPLAINS THEIR TROUBLE: THE UPKEEP AND TECHNICAL SERVICING OF THE ON-FARM IRRIGATION INFRASTRUCTURE THAT PREVIOUSLY BELONGED TO THE COLLECTIVE AND STATE FARMS, ALONGSIDE PHYSICAL REHABILITATION OF ON-FARM IRRIGATION AND COLLECTOR-DRAINAGE INFRASTRUCTURE ACROSS A PROJECT AREA OF A HUNDRED AND TWENTY THOUSAND HECTARES. SMALLHOLDERS INHERITED A SYSTEM BUILT FOR STATE FARMS AND WERE ASKED TO MAINTAIN IT FROM THEIR OWN POCKETS. THAT IS THE STRUCTURAL FACT BEHIND EVERY BROKEN CANAL IN THIS COUNTRY. HOW MEMBERS ACTUALLY PAY IS THE MOST PRACTICAL LINE HERE: PAYMENT FOR IRRIGATION SERVICES IS MADE ABOUT SIXTY PER CENT BY PAYMENT IN KIND AND BY LABOUR SERVICES, AND FORTY PER CENT IN MONEY. LABOUR AND CROP COUNT AS PAYMENT. A HOUSEHOLD WITHOUT CASH IS NOT AUTOMATICALLY EXCLUDED FROM ITS OWN IRRIGATION SYSTEM - AND ANY COMMUNITY DESIGNING A WATER BODY ELSEWHERE SHOULD BUILD THAT IN FROM THE START. THE WEAKNESS IS STATED PLAINLY BY THE SAME SOURCE, AND A MEMBER SHOULD READ IT BEFORE ASSUMING THE BODY WORKS: MOST OF THE COUNCILS OF THE ASSOCIATIONS ARE STILL PASSIVE IN THEIR ACTIVITY AND DO NOT CARRY OUT THEIR MANAGING FUNCTIONS, BECAUSE OF WHICH TRANSPARENT LEADERSHIP IS ABSENT. A PASSIVE COUNCIL IS AN OPENING AS WELL AS A FAILURE. WHERE THE ELECTED BODY DOES NOT MEET, A FEW MEMBERS WHO TURN UP, READ THE ACCOUNTS AND CALL THE ASSEMBLY CAN TAKE IT OVER LAWFULLY - AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED THE SAME DYNAMIC IN COOPERATIVES ACROSS THE REGION. THE CHAIRMEN THEMSELVES HAVE ALREADY TAKEN THE PROBLEM UPWARDS: AT A DISCUSSION ATTENDED BY MEMBERS OF PARLIAMENT AND REPRESENTATIVES OF THE RELEVANT MINISTRIES, THE HEADS OF VILLAGE ADMINISTRATIONS AND THE CHAIRMEN OF WATER USER ASSOCIATIONS SET OUT THEIR PROBLEMS AND ASKED FOR THE SHORTAGE OF IRRIGATION WATER AND THE BROKEN EARTHEN CANALS TO BE RESOLVED - THE FARMERS NOTING THAT WITH PROPER PROVISION OF WATER IN THE GROWING SEASON THEY COULD HARVEST MANY TIMES MORE, AND THAT BECAUSE OF THE SHORTAGE THEY CONTINUE TO BEAR LOSSES. VILLAGE ADMINISTRATION HEADS AND WATER ASSOCIATION CHAIRMEN APPEARING TOGETHER BEFORE PARLIAMENT IS THE ALLIANCE THIS FILE KEEPS RECOMMENDING - AND IN THIS COUNTRY IT HAS ALREADY HAPPENED, WHICH MAKES IT A PRECEDENT RATHER THAN A SUGGESTION. THE LIMITS: THE GOVERNING LAW LAPSED AT THE START OF 2026 AND WHAT REPLACED IT WAS NOT ESTABLISHED, SO EVERY STRUCTURAL DETAIL HERE IS HISTORICAL UNTIL CHECKED. THE ASSOCIATION AND FEDERATION COUNTS, THE HECTARES AND THE PAYMENT SPLIT COME FROM A REGIONAL WATER KNOWLEDGE BASE'S CASE STUDY WITH NO VISIBLE DATE AND DESCRIBE A PROJECT-ERA PICTURE THAT MAY BE MANY YEARS OLD; THE PARLIAMENTARY DISCUSSION REPORT DATES FROM 2019. THESE BODIES ALLOCATE AND MAINTAIN IRRIGATION - THEY ARE NOT CONSERVATION OR LEGAL ORGANISATIONS, THEY WILL NOT OPPOSE AN UPSTREAM DIVERSION OR A MINE, AND THEIR OWN SOURCE RECORDS THEIR COUNCILS AS LARGELY INACTIVE. MEMBERSHIP FOLLOWS LAND USE IN THE SERVICE ZONE, WHICH LEAVES OUT THE LANDLESS. Read it with the pasture committees, the municipal enterprises in every village administration, the community development and investment agency and the community based tourism association recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Friends of the Earth Asia Pacific
trackers.desc: The Asia Pacific regional structure of Friends of the Earth International, formed in 2008, whose member groups work on community-based struggles against destructive projects, particularly mining and other extractive industries, alongside Indigenous peoples, peasant farmers, fisherfolk and trade unions. WHO TO ENLIST: the national member group nearest the project. In this region Friends of the Earth International's own directory names groups in Bangladesh (BELA, the Bangladesh Environmental Lawyers' Association), India, Indonesia (WALHI), Japan, Malaysia (Sahabat Alam Malaysia), Nepal, Papua New Guinea, the Philippines (the Legal Rights and Natural Resources Center), South Korea and Sri Lanka. You CAN: reach an organisation that already works community-side in your own country, and draw regional weight onto a local fight. For activists: in several of these countries the Friends of the Earth affiliate is the most experienced community-side environmental body there is.

trackers.name: Center for Investigative Journalism, Nepal
trackers.desc: Nepal's investigative-journalism center reporting on corruption, kleptocracy and public accountability.

trackers.name: Bolpatra (PPMO e-GP)
trackers.desc: Nepal's electronic government-procurement system. Here you can trace which firms win government contracts and tenders in Nepal, and for how much.

trackers.name: PPMO e-GP (Bolpatra)
trackers.desc: National public-procurement portal. Here you can trace which firms win government contracts and tenders in Nepal, and for how much.

trackers.name: Commission for the Investigation of Abuse of Authority (CIAA)
trackers.desc: Nepal’s constitutional anti-corruption body — investigates and prosecutes abuse of public office and corruption.

trackers.name: Supreme Court of Nepal
trackers.desc: Official Supreme Court site with judgments and the Nepal Kanoon Patrika law reports. · Find here: judgments and case information of the Supreme Court of Nepal.

trackers.name: National Information Commission (Nepal)
trackers.desc: Nepal's National Information Commission oversees the Right to Information Act 2007: it hears RTI appeals and complaints, penalises non-compliance and promotes proactive disclosure, publishing decisions, guidance and annual reports. USE IT: it can penalise a body that ignores a request, not merely order release.

trackers.name: Office of Company Registrar (OCR)
trackers.desc: National company / corporate registry. — Holds to account: state firms & government-linked companies — find their registration, directors and filings. Official company and business register of Nepal — incorporation records.

trackers.name: CFUG handover — the operational plan is a contract, so write it carefully
trackers.desc: HOW A NEPALI COMMUNITY GETS FOREST HANDED OVER TO IT. Under the Forest Act 1993 and Forest Regulations 1995, a Community Forest User Group forms democratically from individuals representing households and registers at the forest office; writes a CFUG constitution defining the rights of users to a particular forest; elects an executive committee that by law must include 33 percent female members; and prepares an operational plan — a forest working plan based partly on a forest resource inventory, typically covering 5 years — for approval by the District Forest Officer. The forest is handed over once that plan is approved. THE PLAN IS THE INSTRUMENT THAT MATTERS: it forms part of the contract between the CFUG and the government, covering growing stock, block division, silvicultural operations, conservation measures and provisions for harvesting, utilisation and sale. A community wanting to prevent a use should get that use excluded in the plan — because the plan is contractual, not advisory. SCALE: about 1.23 million of Nepal's 5.5 million forest hectares is community forest, held by more than 14,000 CFUGs, with several thousand groups awaiting certification.

trackers.name: Read your own constitution — and budget for up to 90 percent tax
trackers.desc: THREE THINGS A NEPALI CFUG MEMBER SHOULD KNOW. 1. THE TAX STRESS IS SEVERE. The Local Government Operation Act 2017 requires community forests to contribute 10 percent of product sales to the local Reserved Fund, and with other enforced and proposed taxes across all three tiers of government the total is estimated at up to 90 percent of a CFUG's annual transactions — FECOFUN, the national federation of community forestry users, has been protesting it. Build any plan against that, not against gross revenue. 2. CHECK WHICH OFFICE IS YOURS. Under the 2015 constitution forest is in the concurrent list, with community forestry the responsibility of local and provincial government; the Divisional Forest Office under the province approves operational plans and transfers forest rights, across 528 forest sub-divisions and 753 local bodies — and who approves is politically live, with CFUGs and local governments favouring local control and forest officers resisting. 3. GET AND READ YOUR CONSTITUTION AND OPERATIONAL PLAN. Research finds elites exercising power because they are more aware of legislation and better able to access information, while many members are hardly aware of their own constitutions and operational plans and do not know their rights. NOTE ALSO a recognised structural flaw: the Department of Forest is both regulator and provider of technical services, which analysts identify as creating conditions for rent seeking — so delays or charges from the same body that approves your plan are a known problem, not bad luck.

trackers.name: ICCA Registry and Protected Planet — and registration is not a precondition
trackers.desc: CHECK WHETHER YOUR SITE IS ALREADY IN A REGISTRY BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE — it may carry a designation nobody locally mentioned. The World Database on Protected and Conserved Areas at protectedplanet.net is a joint UNEP and IUCN product managed by UNEP-WCMC, drawing on almost 500 data providers in 245 countries, updated monthly and downloadable; it underpins the UN List of Protected Areas. THE OECM ROUTE IS THE ONE MOST COMMUNITIES MISS: a site qualifies as an other effective area-based conservation measure if it delivers sustained, positive conservation outcomes EVEN THOUGH IT MAY BE MANAGED PRIMARILY FOR OTHER REASONS — so a grazing commons, a sacred site or a watershed managed for water supply can qualify without being managed primarily for conservation. Land that is worked rather than preserved is not excluded. But note the exclusivity: a site can be a protected area or an OECM — it is not possible to meet both, so ask which is being proposed. THE ICCA REGISTRY IS THE ONE COMMUNITIES FILL IN THEMSELVES: at iccaregistry.org, communities themselves provide data, case studies, maps, photos and stories, and its operators state it is meant to be used to enhance advocacy and recognition — not merely as an inventory. Documenting a territory there creates a citable, third-party-hosted record. THE SENTENCE THAT MATTERS MOST: UNEP-WCMC states these territories must be recognised and respected ‘whether or not they have been reported to the ICCA Registry’ — registration is NOT a precondition of rights, and anyone arguing a claim is weaker for being unregistered is arguing against the registry operator's own position. AND USE THE SCALE FIGURE CAREFULLY: over 1,500 sites are reported under indigenous and community governance — just 1 percent of all recorded sites, with UNEP-WCMC adding that no one knows how many ICCAs exist globally. That 1 percent measures how little has been recorded, not how little communities conserve. Filter Protected Planet by governance type to find such sites; UNEP-WCMC's manual Global Databases to Support ICCAs gives guidance on contributing data.

trackers.name: FECOFUN — a forest users' federation with a chapter at your own local level
trackers.desc: The reason to start here rather than in Kathmandu: the network runs to 7 provinces, 77 districts and 556 local levels, so a community whose forest lies in the path of a road, transmission line or quarry has an organised body at its own tier and not a distant capital-city NGO. It federates 23,026 community forest user groups covering 3,195,323 households and protecting more than 2,425,392 hectares. About 15,000 members hold elected positions across the chapters, with 50 per cent women's representation including in key posts — which matters in practice because the women's committee is usually the first to record what a project is doing to water and fuelwood. Leasehold forestry groups, religious forest groups, buffer-zone groups and traditional forest management groups are affiliated alongside CFUGs. The limit to know before writing: this is a membership federation of forest user groups. If the land at risk is private farmland or an urban plot rather than a community forest handed over under the Forest Act, you are outside its constituency and it will refer you on. Office: Duwakot, Bhaktapur, +977-1-6616408, info@fecofun.org.np.

trackers.name: Pro Public — Nepal's public interest litigators; the Supreme Court halted an airport on their petition
trackers.desc: The demonstration case is the Nijgadh airport. Pro Public members petitioned against the felling of a large number of trees in the Terai forest for the proposed international airport, and Nepal's Supreme Court halted construction while it considered the objections they and other environmental groups had put — which establishes that a writ filed in Kathmandu can stop earthworks in a district. The organisation was founded in 1991 by a consortium of environmental lawyers, journalists, economists, engineers, consumer advocates and women's rights activists, and it works through alternative dispute resolution and negotiation as well as litigation, so an approach can begin below the level of a court case. Environment is one of seven programme areas, not the whole organisation. Natural resources, environmental and climate justice sits alongside democracy and governance, conflict resolution, mental health and psychosocial support, women's empowerment, economic development and rule of law — so ask for the environmental justice team by name, and expect to be in a queue behind other priorities. It complements rather than duplicates FECOFUN: the federation organises the forest users and holds the local chapter, Pro Public files the case, and a community with a threatened community forest usually needs both. Two identification traps. The domain is propublic.org, an unqualified .org that a search for the name buries under ProPublica, the unrelated American newsroom — quote 'Forum for Protection of Public Interest' to surface it. And the address has moved: Friends of the Earth Asia Pacific still lists Gautam Buddha Marga and PO Box 1430, while the organisation's own site gives Sahayog Marg, Nagarjun Galli, House no. 19, second floor, Anamnagar, Kathmandu, PO Box 14307. Use the second.

trackers.name: NTNC — the trust that manages three of Nepal's protected areas, with people living inside them
trackers.desc: In three of Nepal's protected areas the management authority is a trust rather than a ministry, and that changes who a community negotiates with. NTNC directly manages the Annapurna, Manaslu and Gaurishankar Conservation Areas and assists the government across the lowland parks. The Annapurna Conservation Area, launched in 1986, is Nepal's first conservation area and its largest protected area at 7,629 square kilometres, with more than 100,000 residents living inside it — the model was deliberately inclusive rather than exclusionary, and the practical consequence is that residents are parties to management rather than trespassers within it. If your land sits inside one of those three, this is the body to approach about anything proposed there, and the body whose research and monitoring will be cited when the decision is taken. The Gaurishankar mandate has an expiry date, which is worth knowing. The Government of Nepal entrusted management of that conservation area to the Trust for twenty years by a Nepal Gazette notice dated 19 July 2010, so the delegation runs to 2030 and what follows it is a live question rather than a settled one. Manaslu began in 1997 as an ecotourism development project funded by the Government of Nepal and the Asian Development Bank. In the lowlands the Trust runs the Biodiversity Conservation Centre in Chitwan and conservation programmes in Parsa, Bardia and Shuklaphanta, alongside a research and training centre set up in 1989 when the Smithsonian handed over its Terai ecology work. Understand what it is before writing to it. Established in 1982 by a legislative act as an autonomous not-for-profit, formerly the King Mahendra Trust, it describes itself as working closely with the Government of Nepal and has completed more than three hundred projects. It is a manager and a partner, not an opponent: it will bring survey capacity, community programmes and institutional standing to a question, and it will not litigate against the state. For that, pair it with Pro Public; for organising the forest users, with FECOFUN, which its own reporting names among its partners. Head office at Khumaltar, Lalitpur.

trackers.name: ENPHO — an accredited laboratory you can send samples to, plus a field kit and a district mini-lab model
trackers.desc: This is the accredited laboratory most of the region lacks. Operating since 1990, it is accredited under the NEPLAS criteria, based on ISO 17025, by the Nepal Bureau of Standards and Metrology, and it analyses water, wastewater, faecal sludge, soil, compost, air and food. Its water testing is sold as packages covering drinking and household water, regulatory compliance, and customised analytical requirements — and the regulatory compliance package is the one that matters here, because a result produced against a national standard by an accredited laboratory is the form of evidence that survives being disputed. A dedicated faecal sludge and wastewater unit was added on 23 December 2022 with technical support from the NATS laboratory at the Asian Institute of Technology. Its field kit tells you exactly how far it will get you. The ENPHO Field Water Test Kit, introduced in 2001, is portable and covers ten parameters — pH, temperature, ammonia, nitrate, phosphate, iron, chloride, total hardness, free residual chlorine and coliform presence or absence — and each kit runs 80 to 100 physico-chemical tests and 10 bacteriological ones. It exists because samples come from places no laboratory can be reached from. It is explicitly semi-quantitative, which makes it the right tool for screening a whole catchment to find where the problem is and the wrong tool for the number you put in front of a tribunal; for that, send the sample to the laboratory. It also makes an arsenic field kit, a free residual chlorine kit and a body belt incubator. The mini-lab model is the part worth copying anywhere. With CAWST and Global Affairs Canada, ENPHO develops the approach and supports a local organisation to establish a district-level laboratory which that organisation then operates and maintains itself; the first was set up by Shanti Nepal at Nilkantha Municipality in Dhading and opened on 18 October 2019, with others following in Banke and Surkhet. Each covers 12 of the 27 parameters in the national drinking water standard — turbidity, pH, temperature, iron, chloride, nitrate, hardness, ammonia, phosphate, free residual chlorine, E. coli and coliform — so establish whether the contaminant you are chasing is among those twelve before relying on one. Head office at Thapagaun, Kathmandu.

trackers.name: Community and private forest registration — the constitution, the operational plan, and the renewal clock
trackers.desc: Registration comes before handover, and the group writes both governing documents itself. A user group must be constituted and registered at the division forest office before forest is handed to it, and the handover is made under the group's own approved constitution and operational plan. The Act treats the group as an autonomous body with perpetual succession and gives it its own seal, with rights to use and sell forest products under that constitution. Something over twenty-two thousand community forest groups exist, managing roughly a third of the country's forest, so the route is well worn rather than theoretical. The renewal clock starts on the day of handover. The constitution and operational plan are renewed on the cycle stated in them, commonly every five to ten years, which makes the record of what the group actually did during the term the material for its own renewal — the same lesson recorded for Philippine forest agreements, arriving from a different direction. Keep the minutes, the plantings and the patrol records from the first year, not the last. Private forest registration is the route this file has mostly lacked. The Act allows the owner of a private forest to register it and then to develop, protect and manage that forest and to use, sell and distribute its products at prices the owner fixes. Where the ground at risk is privately held and the owner is willing but wants standing rather than a sale, registration turns goodwill into a recognised status — which is the same problem the Taiwanese entrustment model and the Bangladeshi tea estate objective address by other means. Know the limits and the standing duty. The state keeps ownership of the land, and use beyond the approved constitution and operational plan is restricted, so this is recognised management rather than title. The ministry's own reporting records that community-based forest user groups must put at least a quarter of their income from selling forest products back into forest management. And where a religious forest is to be taken back, the Act requires the body, group or community concerned to be given a reasonable opportunity to submit its clarification first.

trackers.name: District Legal Aid Committees — free counsel on an income test, with a committee that must actually decide
trackers.desc: The eligibility test is income, not subject matter. The legal aid act was enacted with the object of making legal assistance available to parties who are economically incapable, and its opening provision sets an income standard, treating a person who earns below that standard as economically incapable. Nothing in that test turns on what the case is about, so a land dispute, an eviction or an environmental claim is not excluded by the eligibility rule itself — which is more than can be said for several of the schemes recorded elsewhere in this file, where free representation attaches only to criminal charges. Committees sit centrally and in the districts, and the decision is theirs. Central and district legal aid committees are constituted for this purpose under the act, and the legislature has given those committees the authority to decide, having regard to the statutory standard, whether free legal aid should be provided in a given case. The application goes to the district committee rather than to a ministry, which puts the decision within reach of the people it concerns. A reported decision answers the obvious brush-off. The Supreme Court's law reports record the rejection of an argument that, because the act itself fixes an income threshold, the committees constituted under it could make no decision at all — the court holding that such a narrow reading, contrary to the spirit of the act, was not lawful. Where a committee treats the threshold as the end of the matter rather than the beginning, that reported case is the authority for saying it must still decide. Read the regulations with the act. The act is accompanied by legal aid regulations setting out the procedure, and both are published by the law commission in full. Read this with the public interest litigation and community forest registration entries already recorded for this country: a district committee is where a forest user group or an affected household finds the lawyer it cannot otherwise pay for.

trackers.name: The Environment Protection Fund, designated laboratories and inspectors — and the fifty per cent added to clean-up costs
trackers.desc: There is a statutory environment protection fund, and the account is the thing to ask for. The environment protection act establishes the fund, and the rules made under the act define the fund by reference to that section. This research has already recorded a Nepali statutory fund where billions were set aside and nothing was disbursed, so the useful request is not whether a fund exists but what it holds, what it has paid out and to whom. Ask for the account rather than the promise. Testing has a designated route, and a designated result carries further. The act provides that the federal government or a provincial government may establish a laboratory for the inspection or testing required for environmental protection and pollution control, or may designate any laboratory recognised by the Government of Nepal to carry out that inspection or testing. Asking which laboratory is designated for your province matters more than finding any laboratory: a designated one produces the result the system was built to accept. Inspectors are appointed under the act. The act provides for environmental inspectors to be appointed or designated, and the rules define them by reference to that provision. Finding the name of the inspector responsible for your area, and addressing correspondence to that person, is the practical step that follows from the appointment being statutory. Clean-up is recovered from whoever discharged the waste, with half again on top. Under the rules, where waste is removed, fifty per cent is added to the cost incurred and the total recovered from the person, institution or industry that discharged it, in accordance with prevailing law. The rules also allow the ministry to engage people trained or experienced in mountaineering or guiding as mountain environment conservators on service contract, to prevent pollution and remove waste in Himalayan and high hill areas — a paid role for local people in precisely the places where enforcement is otherwise thinnest. Read this with the district legal aid and public interest litigation entries recorded for this country.

trackers.name: Malpot and Survey — two offices, two records, and mobile camps that come to the village
trackers.desc: Ownership and boundary are held by two different offices. The land management and archive department maintains the ownership and transaction records through its land records information management system and publishes the formats of deeds and applications used at the land revenue offices; the survey department's district offices carry out cadastral survey and land measurement and preserve and update the land records, describing their service as provided to local governments, government bodies and the general public. A community checking a parcel therefore needs two documents from two places — the ownership record and the survey map — and asking one office for the other's document is the commonest way to lose a week. The department publishes a notice for people intending to buy land, and its daily transactions. Among its published items are a notice addressed to those seeking to buy land, a daily statement of transactions and a monthly statement of revenue collection. The state's own warning to buyers is worth reading before anybody signs, and a published daily transaction record is a way of watching whether land in an area is moving. Complaints are seen at director general level. The department publishes a complaint and grievance channel marked as being looked at by the director general, which is a named tier rather than a general inbox — worth using where a local office has refused or delayed a copy without reasons. And the office comes to the village. The department's own notices record land revenue offices running mobile service camps that reach settlements which previously had to travel to the district headquarters. Across this file the obstacle that defeats a community most often is distance — answered in Bangladesh by union-level intake, in Mongolia by kiosks, in the Philippines by delivery, and here by sending the office out. Ask whether a camp is scheduled before planning the journey. Read this with the forest users' federation, public interest litigators and district legal aid entries already recorded for this country.

trackers.name: राष्ट्रिय सूचना आयोग — quarterly automatic publication, and a commission that can order the file produced
trackers.desc: Every public body must publish its work every three months. Under the right to information act and its rules, each public body is required to make automatic publication of the details of the work it has carried out at three-monthly intervals, and the commission runs a management system for those disclosures. Before making any request, look for the body's own quarterly publication: for a project, the quarter in which the decision was taken is where it is supposed to appear, and its absence from that disclosure is itself something to raise. The commission can order, not merely recommend. Its statutory powers include studying and inspecting the records, documents and other materials of public importance held by a public body; ordering that body to catalogue and organise those records; ordering it to make information public for the information of citizens; and ordering it, within a time the commission fixes, to provide the information the applicant asked for. On appeal it can compel people and papers. In hearing and deciding an appeal the commission may require the head of the body or its information officer to appear before it and give a statement, require documents to be produced, take evidence from witnesses, and demand copies of any document from the public body. A body that has ignored a written request is in a different position once it must send someone to answer questions in person. Follow the ladder, and use the published template. Reported case law records that the application must go first to the information officer and then on appeal to the head of the body before the commission has jurisdiction, so skipping a rung loses the appeal on procedure rather than substance. The commission publishes the format for complaining to the head of an office about an information officer who fails to supply information or supplies wrong information. Read this with the land records offices, the forest users' federation, the company registrar and the district legal aid entries already recorded for this country.

trackers.name: Office of the Auditor General — local bodies audited, and 'evidence not produced' is a published category
trackers.desc: Local governments are audited separately, with their own report. The constitutional audit office prepares separate audit reports on the activities carried out by government at the local, provincial and federal levels, covering in a single year hundreds of local government entities alongside thousands of federal offices and around a thousand provincial ones. A community's own municipality or rural municipality is therefore an audited body whose findings sit in a report of their own, rather than being buried inside a national total. The irregularity categories are published, and one of them is evidence not produced. The annual report breaks the year's total irregularity into amounts to be recovered, amounts that were irregular, amounts for which evidence was not produced, reimbursements not received, revenue arrears not brought forward and advance irregularity, and separately records outstanding revenue arrears and unreimbursed foreign grants and loans. Where a local body cannot show what it did with money, that failure has a name and a figure in the state's own report — which is a sharper thing to cite than a suspicion. The audit plan is announced before the audit. The office records that the annual audit plan and time schedule are communicated to government entities through the chief secretary, and to other concerned parties through the office's own website. A community can therefore know when its municipality is due to be audited, and time its own submissions to that rather than to the report's publication months later. Beneficiaries are involved in performance audits. The office records efforts to make performance audits more qualitative by involving beneficiary groups and stakeholders in the audit process, within a mandate covering the regularity, economy, efficiency, effectiveness and propriety of government expenditure. That is the Philippine participatory audit in a lighter form, and it is the opening through which a community can ask to be heard while an audit is still being carried out. Read this with the land records offices, the information commission, the electronic procurement system and the company registrar entries already recorded for this country.

trackers.name: CIJ Nepal — a leaks platform, fellowships that fund the reporting, and a record on forest money and developers
trackers.desc: There is a leaks platform. The centre's own navigation carries a dedicated leaks section alongside its investigative stories, multimedia and cross-border investigation sections. For a community that has documents — a contract, a clearance, a set of minutes, a payment record — but no reporter, that is somewhere to send them, which is a different and often easier thing than persuading an outlet to take an interest in a place it has never visited. The fellowships are how a story gets funded. The centre describes its method as training and mentoring journalists and incubating new investigative projects, with fellowship and mentorship support under senior journalists, and technical, logistical and editorial support provided to mainstream newsrooms, publishers and editors. An investigation that needs weeks of work usually fails for want of money rather than for want of a story; this is the body whose stated purpose is to pay for those weeks. Its record covers forest money, wildlife and developers. Published output includes reporting on tens of millions of rupees spent planting millions of saplings in a province where forest cover nonetheless continued to decline, on prohibited plants collected from the country's forests reaching cross-border markets, on the deaths of wild elephants in eastern forests over a decade, and on buyers of units in high-rise blocks and housing colonies being ripped off by developers while the authorities looked away. A newsroom that has already followed forest budgets and developer conduct will recognise what a village's documents actually show. Cross-border work is a named capability. The centre organises its coverage under themes including the climate crisis, accountability, kleptocracy, federalism and the justice system, and maintains a cross-border investigation strand; where the owner, the financier or the market for a project lies outside the country, that is the section to approach. It trains, funds and publishes: it does not litigate or represent. Read this with the forest users' federation, the public interest litigators, the information commission and the auditor general entries already recorded for this country.

trackers.name: भूमि बैंक — local-level land banks for idle private land, with a lease the regulations guarantee
trackers.desc: Local governments can now operate a land bank. The land management ministry has issued a procedure on the establishment and operation of land banks under the land use act of 2076 and the land use regulations of 2079 as amended, and has published notice for local levels across the country to take the process forward, with the stated purpose of bringing unused and barren private land into productive use through the local level. The counter a household deals with is therefore the municipality or rural municipality office, not a ministry in the capital — which is the difference between a scheme that is reachable and one that is announced. The instrument is a formal lease, guaranteed by the regulations. Officials describe the arrangement as a formal lease agreement between the side giving land and the side taking it, arranged through the local level, with the lease guaranteed under the land use regulations, and with the further effect of preventing encroachment on the land. A written lease backed by regulation answers the fear that stops most owners from letting anyone use their land: that they will not get it back. Who it is for is stated in the policy. The government's policy and programme for the coming fiscal year records that barren land will be brought into productive use through the land bank system, ensuring access for young people, women, the landless and small and marginalised farmers, and that the tendency to leave cultivable land fallow will be discouraged. Where it exists so far, and how it spreads. Implementation began in two local levels, and the ministry has since approved four named local levels to establish banks; the procedure allows two or more local levels to operate a land bank jointly; and at least one municipality has prepared its own procedure to begin in the coming year. The work at local level is described as identification, recording and management of barren and unused private land so that it can be used for agricultural production. The practical question for any household is whether its own local level has adopted the procedure yet, and that is answered at the local office. Read this with the forest users' federation, the land rights organisations, the information commission and the investigative journalism centre entries already recorded for this country.

trackers.name: स्थानीय तहको योजना तर्जुमा — the annual cycle, the committee the deputy chief convenes, and the guideline the commission publishes
trackers.desc: Nothing is implemented until the annual plan is approved. Published accounts of the process record that a local level selects its plans and programmes and appropriates its budget each year, and only implements after approval — the annual plan formulation process. Formulation is to take account of the constitution's policies, fundamental rights and directive principles, of the local level's own periodic plan, and of provincial and national objectives, strategies and priorities, while reflecting local needs, potentials, problems and challenges. Whatever a community wants funded — a boundary survey, a water source protected, a slope stabilised — has to enter that cycle, and a proposal made outside it has nowhere to land. The route a proposal travels is known, and so is who decides. Published descriptions of the flow record that the sections of the municipality prepare integrated plans in their own fields and send them to the relevant committee; the committee discusses them clause by clause and forwards them with the necessary amendments to the budget and programme formulation committee convened by the deputy chief; that committee discusses them again, amends where needed, and sends them to the executive for approval, with coordination with the chief throughout. Knowing that the deputy chief convenes the deciding committee tells a community who to approach, and at which stage. The planning commission publishes the guideline. The national planning commission publishes a guideline on local level plan formulation, and the pre-planning and budget preparation stage is anchored in the local government operation act of 2074. Citing the guideline's stage — and the section of the act behind it — is what turns a question about why a proposal was dropped into a question the office has to answer. Procurement follows the national act. The same act requires a local level's procurement to be carried out under the public procurement legislation of 2063, so the contracts that follow an approved plan are governed by the national procurement regime rather than by local discretion — which is where the tender records, the blacklisting rules and the audit trail recorded elsewhere in this file become usable. Read this with the local level land banks, the forest users' federation, the information commission and the investigative journalism centre entries already recorded for this country.

trackers.name: CSRC and the land rights forums — the organisation municipalities contract to certify landless families' land
trackers.desc: Municipalities have a statutory duty here, and this organisation does the work. Published accounts record that under the land legislation of 2019 municipal governments must identify landless people and informal settlers, map municipal lands, identify land available for allocation to landless families, and then allocate it. The centre piloted a strategy of rapidly documenting thousands of indigenous families' lands in close partnership with a municipal government and with local youth, and officials from two further municipalities then contracted it to carry out land certification for thousands more families, with the same municipality drafting bylaws to govern local land use. A community can therefore ask its own municipality to commission the same work: there is both a precedent and an organisation that has done it. The numbers are on the record. Published case material records that the centre has supported more than fifty-nine thousand landless and tenant families to formalise their land ownership, and has helped over thirteen thousand couples to acquire joint land ownership titles. Joint titles in both spouses' names are a distinct outcome worth asking for by name, not a variation on the same certificate. The movement structure is village-up, and the forums hold their own funds. The centre acts as secretariat to a national land rights forum, a people's organisation of landless and tenant farmers, with village and district land rights forums that generate their own movement funds locally and largely in kind, drawing on the campaign fund with the centre's support for larger mobilisations; the campaign covered one district in 2003 and fifty-nine districts by 2018, with over thirty per cent of its resources raised locally. A village forum holding its own fund is a member of a movement rather than a branch office of one. What it does, and what it does not. Founded in 1993, it describes its programmes as strengthening community organisations, developing human rights defenders, improving livelihoods and promoting land and agrarian reform on behalf of land-poor farmers, with policy advocacy central and non-violent movements led by land-poor farmers as its stated method; its current focus covers landless people, tenants, former bonded labourers and smallholders. It organises, documents and advocates — it is not a law firm and will not litigate a case for you. Read this with the local level land banks, the annual planning cycle, the forest users' federation and the information commission entries already recorded for this country.

trackers.name: प्राचीन स्मारक संरक्षण — protected monument areas, where even repairing a house needs the archaeology department's approval
trackers.desc: A hundred years, and the definition takes in the ground and the ruins. The archaeology department's published definition under the ancient monument preservation legislation covers a temple, monument, house, shrine, math, gumba, vihara, stupa and the like which is more than a hundred years old and significant from the standpoint of history, art, science or architecture — and states that the term also denotes the place where the monument stands, human settlements or sites of special national or international value whether joined together or separately situated within one locality, the remains of ancient human settlements, the ruins of ancient monuments, and caves. Ruins, caves and the ground itself are therefore inside the definition, which matters where there is no intact building left to point at. The government may declare a protected monument area. The Act empowers the government to declare a place or area in which an ancient monument stands to be a protected monument area. The declaration is the thing to ask for by name and date, because everything that follows depends on whether the ground in question falls inside one. Inside that area, even repairing a house needs the department's approval. A Supreme Court judgment applying the Act records that the same section requires the approval of the archaeology department to be obtained even when constructing, repairing, adding to or reconstructing a house or building within the protection area — in a case in which a metropolitan city and a ward office were the respondents. Where a project or an authority asserts that a municipal permit is sufficient, that is the provision to cite, and the department's written approval is a separate document from the municipal one. Where the texts are, and what to ask for. The Act of 2013 in the local calendar is supplemented by preservation rules of 2046, both published by the law commission and by the archaeology department, which administers them alongside a monument preservation and palace maintenance office. Ask for two documents rather than one: the declaration notice for the protected monument area, and the department's written approval for the works. Read this with the public interest litigators, the local level annual planning cycle, the land revenue and survey offices and the information commission entries already recorded for this country.

trackers.name: वातावरण संरक्षण नियमावली — which schedule a project sits in decides the depth of study, and the schedules keep changing
trackers.desc: Three tiers, and the schedule decides which one applies. The environment protection rules of 2077 in the local calendar, made under the environment protection act of 2076 and published by the forests and environment ministry, require a proponent to carry out a brief environmental study for proposals listed in the first schedule, an initial environmental examination for those in the second, and a full environmental impact assessment for those in the third. The first question about any project is therefore which schedule it has been placed in, because that single classification decides how much study is required, how long it takes and how much of it is published — and a project sorted into the lightest tier has effectively been decided before any assessment begins. The schedules are amended, so the version matters. The ministry publishes changes to the schedules of these rules separately from the rules themselves. Checking the amended schedule rather than the original text is therefore part of checking the classification, and a proponent relying on an older listing is relying on something that may have moved. Scoping comes before the report, in a prescribed form. Before preparing an impact assessment report the proponent must carry out scoping and prepare the scoping report in the format prescribed by the rules' fifth schedule, stating the impacts including those on the environment, and submit it to the body specified for the type of development work or project concerned. The scoping report is the earliest document in the sequence and the one that fixes what the later assessment will and will not examine. The notice mechanics to ask about. Under the rules that preceded these, the proponent preparing a report had to give public notice by posting it at the local body offices, the school, the hospital and the health centre in the area where the proposal would be implemented, preparing an attested record of having done so, and by publishing notice in a national daily newspaper, with a period for written opinions and suggestions from the local bodies and concerned persons or institutions, and a further public notice in a national daily giving thirty days for members of the public to copy or study the report. Those mechanics were replaced by the 2077 rules and should be checked against the current text, but they are the right questions to put to a proponent: where was the notice posted, is there an attested record of the posting, in which newspaper did it appear, and on what date.
