NOW THE LEVER, AND IT IS THE MOST USEFUL SENTENCE IN THIS ENTRY: THE AGRICULTURAL AUTHORITY IS OBLIGED, AS SOON AS IT LEARNS OF THE OFFENCE — EVEN THROUGH A REPORT BY MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC — TO PURSUE IT AND FILE A COMPLAINT. A resident's report is not a request for a favour; it starts a duty. AND THE ELECTED COUNCIL HOLDS THE PURSE: revenue from the fees charged under these provisions is spent on the village's public affairs UNDER THE SUPERVISION OF THE VILLAGE COUNCIL — so the council can be asked what was collected on a development and what became of it. THE LIMITS: these are state and quasi-state bodies, not allies; the source reached is a ministry guidance text for village administrators hosted on a third-party site, so confirm current wording; and in this country any approach identifies you — a question about whether a permit exists is far safer than a stated objection to a project.

trackers.name: Heritage-friends associations and the harim — the perimeter that stops building
trackers.desc: THE MOST POWERFUL THING IN THIS COUNTRY'S LAND LAW FOR SOMEONE TRYING TO STOP CONSTRUCTION IS THE HARIM — THE PROTECTIVE PERIMETER AROUND A HISTORIC WORK. ANY CONSTRUCTION WITHIN IT REQUIRES A PERMIT FROM THE CULTURAL HERITAGE AUTHORITY, and permits for projects inside the harim of nationally registered works must issue through official systems that cover construction, exploitation AND PHYSICAL CHANGES to the site. AND THE DECISIVE ADMINISTRATIVE ACT IS THE ONE MOST PEOPLE NEVER THINK TO ASK ABOUT: DETERMINING THE SITE'S EXTENT AND ITS HARIM. Campaigners fighting for a five-thousand-year-old mound on the western edge of the capital put it exactly right — that determination is NOT MERELY AN ADMINISTRATIVE STEP BUT THE LAST CHANCE TO PROTECT THE SITE. Until the perimeter is fixed, there is nothing to enforce. THE BODIES THAT DO THIS WORK ARE HERITAGE-FRIENDS ASSOCIATIONS, AND THEY ARE REGISTERED NON-GOVERNMENTAL ORGANISATIONS — NON-PROFIT, NON-COMMERCIAL AND NON-POLITICAL. One has operated officially since 2000 in an ancient southern city, working to safeguard historic works, make them known, and research them. That legal form matters here: an association constituted on those three terms is doing something the state recognises, which is a different position from an informal group. FIND WHETHER ONE EXISTS FOR YOUR CITY, AND IF NONE DOES, THE MODEL FOR FOUNDING ONE IS ESTABLISHED. THEIR ASKS ARE THE TEMPLATE TO COPY, AND THE SECOND IS CLEVERER THAN THE FIRST: STOP NEW CONSTRUCTION IN THE HARIM; AND INSTALL PROPER SEWAGE NETWORKS IN AREAS ALREADY BUILT UP, SO THAT DESTRUCTIVE UNAUTHORISED DIGGING CANNOT BE CARRIED OUT UNDER THE PRETEXT OF LAYING SEWERS. That second demand converts a protection argument into an infrastructure request an authority can actually deliver — and removes the excuse under which damage happens. THE PRECEDENT IS WORTH CARRYING TO ANY MEETING. A MUNICIPALITY DIGGING TO INSTALL A FUEL TANK STRUCK GRAVES FROM THE ACHAEMENID PERIOD AND THE WORK WAS STOPPED; a provincial heritage director then stated that no permit would thereafter issue without heritage review, and that excavation and construction permits already granted would be halted. WHAT IS UNDER THE GROUND CAN STOP WHAT IS PLANNED ABOVE IT. AND THE ROLE IS OFFICIALLY ACKNOWLEDGED: a police official has said publicly that protecting cultural heritage requires the cooperation of all agencies, HERITAGE ASSOCIATIONS AND POPULAR GROUPS. THE LIMITS. The anchor is news coverage of a live campaign rather than an association's own page, so a local association must be found locally. Association capacity varies hugely by city. Registration and heritage decisions rest with state bodies. AND IN THIS COUNTRY ANY PUBLIC CAMPAIGN IDENTIFIES ITS PARTICIPANTS — a request to determine a site's perimeter is an administrative ask and a far safer one than a protest.

trackers.name: Registering a people's organisation — the provincial door, the statute that binds you, and the field that lets you in
trackers.desc: THIS FILE RECORDS FUNDING AND LEGAL ROUTES ACROSS TWENTY-THREE COUNTRIES THAT ALL REQUIRE ONE THING FIRST: THAT YOU ARE A LEGAL PERSON. HERE IS HOW TO BECOME ONE IN THIS COUNTRY, AND THE FIRST FACT SAVES A WASTED JOURNEY — THESE ORGANISATIONS ARE LOCAL OR AT MOST PROVINCIAL, SO THE APPLICATION IS PURSUED AT THE COUNTY OR PROVINCIAL GOVERNOR'S OFFICE, NOT IN THE CAPITAL. Permits are issued as either provincial or national, and a group whose concern is one valley should be asking for the provincial one. ENVIRONMENT AND NATURAL RESOURCES IS ONE OF THE LISTED FIELDS OF ACTIVITY — as are development and construction, citizens' rights, women, children, youth and the prevention of social harm. A body formed to look after a stretch of land is applying within a recognised category rather than asking for an exception, and CHOOSING THE FIELD IS THE FIRST STRATEGIC DECISION: it defines what you may lawfully do afterwards. THE STEPS ARE PUBLISHED. Complete the application form on the ministry's portal and take the TRACKING CODE. Assemble identity and education documents for the founders, their photographs, the minutes of the general assembly and of the board — AND THE STATUTE. The request is examined by the SUPERVISORY BOARD ON NON-GOVERNMENTAL ORGANISATIONS within a few working days AND MUST ALSO BE CONFIRMED BY THE COMPETENT AUTHORITIES. A permit then issues, with an introduction letter to the documents and property registration organisation, and is delivered after publication in the official gazette. NOW THE PART THAT MATTERS FOR YEARS AFTERWARDS AND THAT ALMOST EVERYONE TREATS AS A FORMALITY: THE ORGANISATION MUST OPERATE IN ACCORDANCE WITH ITS STATUTE, OR IT IS IN VIOLATION. Every activity you may later want — receiving donations, holding property, commissioning studies, appearing in proceedings, working with a university — MUST BE INSIDE THE OBJECTS YOU WRITE NOW. This payload has recorded funders in several countries that require a programme to fall within the applicant's own stated objects; a narrow statute closes those doors permanently, and amending one is far harder than drafting it. THE LIMITS, AND THE SECOND IS SERIOUS. THE PERMIT DEPENDS NOT ONLY ON THE SUPERVISORY BOARD BUT ON CONFIRMATION BY THE COMPETENT AUTHORITIES, WHICH IS A VETTING STEP AND NOT A FORMALITY. AND REGISTERING NAMES YOUR FOUNDERS, THEIR ADDRESSES AND THEIR DOCUMENTS TO THE STATE — in this country that is a decision to take deliberately, not by default. Read it with the digital security guidance recorded separately here, and with the heritage associations entry, which shows the legal form already being used for site protection.

trackers.name: Rural cooperative organisation — the member-owned structure villages already hold assets through, and the union that grows saplings
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HAS RECORDED THE COOPERATIVE AS A LAND AND ASSET VEHICLE IN FOUR OTHER COUNTRIES. HERE IS THE STRUCTURE BEHIND IT IN THIS ONE, AND ITS OWNERSHIP IS THE FIRST THING WORTH KNOWING: the national rural cooperative organisation, founded in 1963 under the agriculture ministry, is a joint-stock body that is 78.2 PER CENT STATE-OWNED AND 21.8 PER CENT OWNED BY THE RURAL AND AGRICULTURAL COOPERATIVES THEMSELVES. THE COOPERATIVES OWN A FIFTH OF THE BODY THAT EXISTS TO SERVE THEM — which is a shareholding, and shareholders may ask questions that petitioners may not. ITS STATUTORY TASK IS RURAL AND AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT THROUGH COOPERATIVES AND MEMBER ORGANISATIONS. That is the phrase to quote: development here is legally supposed to run THROUGH village bodies, not around them. THE CONDITIONS OF MEMBERSHIP ARE FEW AND WORTH KNOWING BEFORE ANYONE IS TURNED AWAY: be a national of the country; not be legally incapacitated; be under no legal prohibition; AND NOT ALREADY BELONG TO A SIMILAR COOPERATIVE. That last one matters — check what your household is already enrolled in before founding anything, because duplicate membership will block it. AND THE RANGE OF PEOPLE WHO MAY FORM AN AGRICULTURAL COOPERATIVE IS WIDER THAN MOST VILLAGES REALISE: farmers, ORCHARDISTS, livestock keepers, silkworm and BEE keepers, FISH FARMERS, villagers working in local and rural industries, AND AGRICULTURAL WORKERS — so people with no land of their own are inside the category. A community whose members are mostly labourers or herders can still constitute itself here. THE PIECE THAT JOINS THIS TO THE PLANTING WORK RECORDED ACROSS THIS REGION: among the national unions under this organisation is A UNION OF AGRICULTURAL COOPERATIVES PRODUCING FLOWERS, PLANTS, SEEDS AND SAPLINGS. THAT IS A MEMBER-OWNED NURSERY SUPPLY CHAIN — the answer to the question this file has asked in five countries about where restoration plants come from, and here it is owned by cooperatives rather than by a ministry. There is also a RURAL COOPERATIVE FUND COMPANY and a national medicinal plants association. KNOW WHERE THE SUPPORT GOES BEFORE CHOOSING YOUR FORM: IN ALL COOPERATIVE SUPPORT, PRIORITY GOES TO PRODUCTION COOPERATIVES. Distribution cooperatives supplying villagers' and nomads' needs get priority in commodity quotas and in government and banking support — and the stated reason is that rural cooperatives REDUCE MIGRATION FROM VILLAGES TO CITIES. A COMMUNITY THAT FRAMES ITS PROPOSAL AS KEEPING PEOPLE ON THE LAND IS SPEAKING TO THE STATE'S OWN STATED PRIORITY. THE LIMITS: this is a state-majority organisation under a ministry, and cooperatives here operate within an administrative system rather than against it — nothing in it will oppose a project. Its history includes compulsory membership after land reform, so older villagers may distrust the form. And this entry describes the national structure; the useful counterpart is the provincial office and the specific union for your activity.

trackers.name: Licensed crowdfunding platforms — the lawful way to raise money from the public, with the environment a named field
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY HAD THE FEWEST FUNDING ENTRIES IN THE WHOLE MAP, AND THE MISSING PIECE WAS THE MOST BASIC ONE: A LAWFUL WAY TO ASK THE PUBLIC FOR MONEY. CROWDFUNDING HERE IS REGULATED — EVERY PLATFORM MUST HOLD A LICENCE FROM THE OVER-THE-COUNTER EXCHANGE, A SUBSIDIARY OF THE SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE ORGANISATION — AND A LIST OF THE LICENSED PLATFORMS IS PUBLISHED AND UPDATED BY SEASON. THAT REGULATION IS THE PROTECTION, NOT THE OBSTACLE. This file recorded in another country that collecting donations without permission is an offence and that funds raised can be confiscated. HERE THE LICENCE SITS WITH THE PLATFORM RATHER THAN WITH YOU, SO RAISING MONEY THROUGH A LISTED PLATFORM IS ITSELF THE COMPLIANCE STEP — and running a private collection instead is the risk. AND THE ELIGIBLE FIELDS ARE NAMED EXPLICITLY, WITH THE ENVIRONMENT AMONG THEM: alongside small and medium businesses, startups, knowledge-based schemes, urban services, tourism, medicine, education and content, THE ENVIRONMENT IS A CATEGORY THESE PLATFORMS ARE PERMITTED TO FINANCE. A project to survey, restore, plant or protect is inside the licensed scope rather than an awkward fit. CHOOSE THE MODEL DELIBERATELY. DONATION-BASED FUNDING SUITS ANYTHING WITH A CHARITABLE OR PUBLIC-BENEFIT CHARACTER: contributors receive NO FINANCIAL REPAYMENT, though they may be given symbolic rewards that increase with the size of their contribution — which is how a village names its donors on a plaque or in a record without promising anything it cannot deliver. REWARD-BASED FUNDING SUITS A SMALL ENTERPRISE, such as a nursery or a cooperative product. AND SOCIAL INVESTMENT POOLS CAPITAL FROM PEOPLE WHO WANT TO BACK SOCIAL OR ENVIRONMENTAL PROJECTS, which is a different audience from donors and worth approaching differently. THE SECTOR'S OWN WARNINGS ARE THE HONEST PART AND EVERY COMMUNITY SHOULD READ THEM BEFORE STARTING: WINNING PEOPLE'S TRUST IS THE HARD PART; SETTING A REALISTIC AND ACHIEVABLE TARGET IS DIFFICULT AND MATTERS MORE THAN AMBITION; A PROJECT CAN STILL FAIL AFTER THE MONEY IS RAISED; AND THE PLATFORM'S FEES MUST BE BUDGETED FOR. Ask the fee percentage before choosing a platform, and set a target you can actually reach — a campaign that stalls in public damages the next one. THE LIMITS: these are regulated financial platforms, and the licensing sits under the capital-markets authority, so campaigns are visible and attributable — A PUBLIC APPEAL NAMES ITS ORGANISERS. Platforms take fees and apply their own approval criteria. And this entry describes the licensed system rather than endorsing any single platform: check the current published list, because it changes. Use it with the registration route and the rural cooperative structure recorded separately for this country, since a constituted body raises more easily than an individual.

trackers.name: National heritage registration — anyone may report a site, and a listed buffer zone blocks the building permit
trackers.desc: THE ENTRY POINT HERE IS STRONGER THAN ANYTHING COMPARABLE IN THIS MAP, BECAUSE IT IS FRAMED AS A DUTY RATHER THAN A REQUEST: ANY OWNER OR OCCUPIER OF A QUALIFYING HISTORIC OR CULTURAL SITE — AND ANYONE WHO MERELY KNOWS OF THE EXISTENCE OF SUCH A SITE — MUST REPORT IT AS SOON AS POSSIBLE TO THE NEAREST ADMINISTRATIVE UNIT OF THE HERITAGE ORGANISATION, which then studies it and enters it in the national list if the conditions are met. THAT MEANS A NEIGHBOUR, A TEACHER OR A PASSER-BY CAN START THE PROCESS. You do not need to own the ground, hold a legal form, or have standing of any kind — and refusing to report is itself contrary to the rule. THE NATIONAL LIST ALREADY HOLDS ABOUT THIRTY-NINE THOUSAND WORKS under a registration law dating from 1930. NOW THE PART THAT ACTUALLY STOPS MACHINERY, AND IT IS ABOUT THE LAND AROUND THE BUILDING AS MUCH AS THE BUILDING: REGISTRATION FIXES A PROTECTED FOOTPRINT AND A BUFFER ZONE, AND MUNICIPALITIES REQUIRE A HERITAGE CLEARANCE BEFORE ISSUING A BUILDING PERMIT INSIDE THOSE AREAS. Demolition, facade alteration, additions, EXCAVATION and even certain repairs need the heritage organisation's agreement, and unauthorised work is prosecutable. SO THE QUESTION FOR ANY THREATENED SITE IS NOT ONLY WHETHER THE BUILDING IS LISTED BUT WHETHER THE GROUND A DEVELOPER WANTS FALLS INSIDE A REGISTERED SITE'S BUFFER ZONE. THAT IS A DOCUMENTARY FACT, CHECKABLE BEFORE ANYTHING IS BOUGHT OR BUILT, AND IT IS THE SINGLE MOST USEFUL ENQUIRY IN THIS ENTRY. OWNERS FEAR LISTING FOR THE WRONG REASON, AND THIS IS WORTH SAYING TO THEM PLAINLY: REGISTRATION DOES NOT TAKE OWNERSHIP AWAY. The owner remains the owner and may sell, lease and bequeath the property; what changes is the right to intervene in it. AND REGISTERED BUILDINGS AND SITES ARE EXEMPT FROM ALL MUNICIPAL CHARGES under a single-article law, with incentive mechanisms available for valuable buildings — so listing carries a financial benefit, not only a restriction. The government is also obliged to prepare and implement protection programmes for registered works. AND NOTE WHICH OFFICE HOLDS THIS: THE DIRECTORATE COVERS REGISTRATION AND BUFFER ZONES OF WORKS TOGETHER WITH THE PRESERVATION AND REVIVAL OF INTANGIBLE AND NATURAL HERITAGE. NATURAL SITES ARE HANDLED BY THE SAME OFFICE — so a spring, a grove or a landscape feature is not outside its scope, which is unusual and worth testing. THE LIMITS: registration is decided by the organisation on its own assessment, and the body that hears a private owner's objection is that same organisation. Listing restricts what may be done to a site; IT DOES NOT PREVENT A DECISION TAKEN AT A HIGHER LEVEL, and this file has recorded elsewhere that major schemes proceed despite designations. The process is also slow, so report early rather than when machinery is on site. Read it with the endowment and cooperative routes recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Ramsar's Montreux Record — the duty bites when a site is LIKELY to change, which is before the project is built
trackers.desc: THE WORDS THAT MATTER ARE IS LIKELY TO CHANGE. Article 3.2 of the Convention obliges the state to arrange to be informed at the earliest possible time if the ecological character of any listed wetland in its territory has changed, is changing, OR IS LIKELY TO CHANGE as a result of technological developments, pollution or other human interference. Every other international designation route in this file responds to damage already done. This one is engaged by a scheme that would probably cause the damage, which is the difference between a remedy and a defence. If a proposed dam, diversion, road or industrial project would likely alter a listed wetland, that is the provision to cite. WHAT HAPPENS NEXT IS CONCRETE: a site whose character is threatened can be placed on the MONTREUX RECORD, a register of listed wetlands where such change has occurred, is occurring or is likely to occur. Listing triggers a monitoring and advisory process — the Convention's secretariat sends a RAMSAR ADVISORY MISSION, a technical mission that analyses the situation on site and, with the state, identifies the measures needed to restore it. The site stays on the Record until the ecological character has improved. An outside technical team on the ground, producing a published assessment, is a rare thing to be able to trigger. IRAN HAS ALREADY RECEIVED ONE — an advisory mission under the management guidance procedure was conducted to the country and its report is published by the Convention. AND DELISTING IS DELIBERATELY EXPENSIVE, WHICH IS WHY THIS DESIGNATION IS STURDIER THAN MOST: under Article 4.2, if a state deletes or restricts a listed site it SHALL COMPENSATE FOR THE LOSS OF WETLAND RESOURCES BY CREATING ADDITIONAL RESERVES, in the same area or elsewhere. Compensation in kind, not in money. The Convention's own account notes that no site has ever been completely deleted for change in ecological character and that partial excisions are extremely rare. Compare that with the heritage listings this file records being struck by a single ministerial decree. THE SCALE IN IRAN: the Convention was signed at Ramsar in Iran in 1971; the country has around 105 wetlands covering some three million hectares, with 25 Sites of International Importance. Several are already on the Montreux Record — the Anzali wetland of 15,000 hectares since June 1993, listed for excessive hunting, invasive species, water level change, sedimentation and pollution, and three northern lakes added the same year. Anzali's own site documentation records that areas are rented to groups of local people for fishing and hunting in winter, so listed status and local use coexist there. THE LIMITS, PLAINLY: this runs between the Convention and the state. Reports of likely change come through the national authority — for Iran the relevant desk sits in a ministry in Tehran — and a community cannot place a site on the Record itself. What a community can do is document the likely change and put it in front of the authority that carries the reporting duty, and know that the duty exists and is anticipatory. It applies only to designated Ramsar Sites, so establish first whether your wetland is one of the twenty-five.

trackers.name: Provincial building engineering organisation and its disciplinary council — the supervisor who must report violations, and how to complain when they don't
trackers.desc: START WITH THE DUTY, BECAUSE IT MEANS SOMEONE IS ALREADY OBLIGED TO ACT ON WHAT YOU ARE WATCHING: THE SUPERVISING ENGINEER ON A BUILDING SITE MUST FORMALLY REPORT ANY BUILDING VIOLATION TO THE MUNICIPALITY, AND WHERE DEFECTS CREATE DANGER TO LIFE MUST NOTIFY BOTH THE MUNICIPALITY AND THE EMPLOYER IN WRITING. THAT IS AN OBLIGATION, NOT A DISCRETION — and an engineer who stays silent while unlawful work proceeds is committing a disciplinary offence of their own. SO THE FIRST QUESTION ABOUT ANY CONSTRUCTION NEAR YOU IS NOT WHAT THE DEVELOPER IS DOING BUT WHO THE SUPERVISING ENGINEER IS, AND WHETHER THEY HAVE FILED A REPORT. The name is on the permit paperwork. An engineer reminded in writing that they have a reporting duty behaves differently from one nobody has asked. WHEN THEY DO NOT ACT, THERE IS A FORUM: THE PROVINCIAL DISCIPLINARY COUNCIL OF THE BUILDING ENGINEERING ORGANISATION HEARS COMPLAINTS ABOUT PROFESSIONAL AND DISCIPLINARY VIOLATIONS BY ENGINEERS AND TECHNICIANS WHO ARE MEMBERS OF THE PROVINCIAL ORGANISATION OR HOLD A PRACTICE LICENCE. AND THE LIST OF WHO MAY COMPLAIN IS WIDE: ALL NATURAL AND LEGAL PERSONS — the harmed client, government and non-governmental bodies, public institutions, MUNICIPALITIES THEMSELVES, AND GENERALLY ANY PERSON WITH A COMPLAINT ABOUT A MEMBER. BUT READ THE ROUTE CAREFULLY, BECAUSE A NEIGHBOUR IS NOT THE PRINCIPAL INTERESTED PARTY: WHERE THE COMPLAINANT IS NOT THE MAIN AFFECTED PARTY, THE COMPLAINT GOES FIRST TO A BODY SUCH AS THE PROVINCIAL ROADS AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT DIRECTORATE-GENERAL, WHICH EXAMINES IT AND, IF IT FINDS THE COMPLAINT WELL FOUNDED, FORWARDS IT TO THE DISCIPLINARY COUNCIL. Sending it straight to the council risks it being bounced; sending it to the directorate puts a state body's assessment behind it. HOW TO FILE: A WRITTEN COMPLAINT, WITH DOCUMENTS AND A DESCRIPTION OF THE VIOLATION, TO THE SECRETARIAT OF THE PROVINCIAL DISCIPLINARY COUNCIL. The council reviews the documents, OBTAINS AN EXPERT OPINION, and must issue a REASONED AND DOCUMENTED RULING WHICH ITSELF STATES HOW TO OBJECT, TO WHICH BODY, AND WITHIN WHAT PERIOD — so even an adverse decision hands you the next step in writing. WHY THIS IS WORTH USING AT ALL: IT ATTACKES THE PROFESSIONAL WHOSE SIGNATURE THE PROJECT DEPENDS ON, NOT THE DEVELOPER'S POLITICS. Penalties vary with the seriousness of the violation, and a supervising engineer facing a disciplinary file has a strong personal interest in the site complying. The organisation has a branch in every province, so this is a local forum rather than a capital-city one. THE LIMITS: this is a professional regulator, NOT AN ALLY AND NOT A ROUTE TO STOPPING A LAWFUL PROJECT — it addresses the conduct of engineers, so it bites only where there is a breach of permit, code or duty. It will not consider whether a scheme should exist. Complaints identify the complainant. Procedures differ between provinces, and this entry rests on one provincial organisation's published account of the council's duties plus ministry and legal-practice sources; CONFIRM THE PROCEDURE WITH YOUR OWN PROVINCIAL ORGANISATION. Read it with the free legal assistance office and the complaints commission recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Registered popular organisations and Environment Houses — and the seat they hold on the provincial planning council
trackers.desc: THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT FACT IN THIS ENTRY IS WHERE THESE GROUPS SIT. REGISTERED POPULAR ORGANISATIONS TAKE PART IN OFFICIAL GOVERNMENT DECISION-MAKING MEETINGS AS REPRESENTATIVES OF THE PEOPLE — INCLUDING THE PROVINCIAL PLANNING COUNCIL AND THE WASTE MANAGEMENT WORKING GROUP. THE PROVINCIAL PLANNING COUNCIL IS WHERE DEVELOPMENT DECISIONS ARE MADE. A COMMUNITY THAT REGISTERS AN ORGANISATION IS NOT MERELY GAINING A LETTERHEAD; IT IS GAINING ELIGIBILITY TO BE IN THE ROOM WHERE THE SCHEME IT FEARS WILL BE DISCUSSED. That is a stronger reason to constitute than any this file has recorded elsewhere. AND THE ECOSYSTEM IS FAR LARGER THAN OUTSIDERS ASSUME: OFFICIALS DESCRIBE NEARLY 1,050 REGISTERED POPULAR VOLUNTEER GROUPS, SOME WITH UP TO FOUR DECADES OF HISTORY, ALONGSIDE 1,360 ENVIRONMENT HOUSES OPERATING IN SCHOOLS, VILLAGE ADMINISTRATIONS, LIBRARIES AND AGRICULTURAL CENTRES. THE VILLAGE ADMINISTRATION AND THE LIBRARY ARE THE POINTS TO ASK AT — there may already be one in your district. WHAT THOSE GROUPS ACTUALLY DO IS ALSO USEFUL TO KNOW BEFORE APPROACHING: PARTICIPATORY PROTECTION OF PROTECTED AREAS, WILDLIFE WORK, CENSUSES, AND EDUCATION AND OUTREACH IN SCHOOLS, VILLAGES AND MOSQUES. A COMMUNITY OFFERING TO HOST A CENSUS OR A SURVEY IS OFFERING WORK THE SYSTEM ALREADY WANTS DONE — and a census produces exactly the dated record of what lives on a site that a later objection needs. THE ROUTE TO FORMING ONE IS VISIBLE IN A RECENT EXAMPLE WORTH COPYING EXACTLY: A NEW ASSOCIATION'S LICENCE WAS UNVEILED PUBLICLY, AND AT THE SAME CEREMONY IT SIGNED MEMORANDA OF COOPERATION WITH THE UNIVERSITY, THE EDUCATION DEPARTMENT, THE WATER AND WASTEWATER COMPANY, THE NATURAL RESOURCES OFFICE AND THE ENVIRONMENT OFFICE. THE LICENCE AND THE AGREEMENTS ON THE SAME DAY. A new group that leaves the ceremony holding five institutional relationships is in a wholly different position from one that leaves holding a certificate. THERE IS ALSO A STATE OFFER THAT IS GENUINELY UNUSUAL AND SHOULD BE TAKEN UP: A PROVINCIAL NATURAL RESOURCES AND WATERSHED DIRECTORATE PROMOTES A HOUSE OF ORGANISATIONS AS A BRIDGE BETWEEN GOVERNMENT AND PEOPLE, NAMES EMPOWERING THESE GROUPS AS A PRIORITY, AND LISTS ITS TRAINING THEMES AS TRAINING IN CORRECT DEMAND-MAKING, UNDERSTANDING CONFLICTS, AND AWARENESS OF UPSTREAM LAWS. A GOVERNMENT OFFICE OFFERING TO TEACH PEOPLE HOW TO MAKE DEMANDS ON THE STATE IS AN OFFER TO ACCEPT, NOT TO ANALYSE. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE REAL. THESE ARE LICENSED ORGANISATIONS OPERATING INSIDE A STATE FRAMEWORK: registration brings visibility as well as access, participation is consultative, and environmental activists in this country have faced serious consequences — the protection and digital-security routes recorded separately here should be read alongside this. The figures come from official statements and were not independently verified, and the seat on planning councils is described in general terms rather than as a guaranteed entitlement. A NATIONAL ENVIRONMENT FUND ALSO EXISTS AS AN INDEPENDENT PUBLIC INSTITUTION AND IS WORTH ASKING ABOUT; this file has not yet examined it.

trackers.name: National environment fund — project finance, and insurance for livestock and crops lost to protected wildlife
trackers.desc: ONE THING THIS FUND IS PART OF MATTERS MORE TO A VILLAGE THAN EVERYTHING ELSE IN ITS PORTFOLIO: A TRIPARTITE MEMORANDUM ON WILDLIFE DAMAGE COMPENSATION INSURANCE, SIGNED BETWEEN THE ENVIRONMENT AUTHORITY, THIS FUND AND THE AGRICULTURAL INSURANCE FUND, WITH THE STATED AIMS OF SUPPORTING BIODIVERSITY AND REDUCING CONFLICT BETWEEN PEOPLE AND WILDLIFE. INSURANCE THAT PAYS FOR LIVESTOCK AND CROPS LOST TO PROTECTED ANIMALS ANSWERS THE SINGLE COMMONEST REASON RURAL COMMUNITIES TURN AGAINST CONSERVATION. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED PROTECTED AREAS, SPECIES FUNDS AND RANGER SCHEMES IN TWENTY-THREE COUNTRIES AND HAS NOT UNTIL NOW FOUND A NAMED FINANCIAL ANSWER TO THE HERDER WHOSE SHEEP WERE TAKEN. Ask the agricultural insurance body and the environment office whether the scheme is operating in your province and what it covers. THE FUND ITSELF IS CONSTITUTED AS A NON-GOVERNMENTAL PUBLIC INSTITUTION WITH ITS OWN INDEPENDENCE, UNDER A PUBLISHED STATUTE — which means its objects, governance and permitted uses are documents you can read before approaching it, rather than matters of discretion described over a counter. WHAT IT ACTUALLY DISBURSES IS ON THE RECORD: ITS MANAGING DIRECTOR STATED THAT 38 ENVIRONMENTAL PROJECTS RECEIVED FINANCIAL FACILITIES TOTALLING MORE THAN TWO THOUSAND BILLION RIALS IN A SINGLE REPORTING PERIOD, AND THAT THE FUND PAID THE CONSTRUCTION COST OF SEVENTEEN SOLAR POWER PLANTS UNDER THE CLEAN AIR LAW. READ THAT CAREFULLY, BECAUSE IT TELLS YOU WHAT THIS FUND IS FOR: IT PROVIDES FACILITIES — CREDIT AND PROJECT FINANCE — AND ITS NAMED BENEFICIARIES ARE LARGELY INDUSTRIAL AND ENERGY COMPLIANCE SCHEMES. IT IS NOT A GRANT-MAKER FOR VILLAGES, and a community approaching it for a campaign will be disappointed. WHERE IT DOES FIT A COMMUNITY IS WHERE THERE IS A PROJECT WITH A REVENUE OR A SAVING BEHIND IT — a solar installation, a waste or effluent treatment scheme, an efficiency retrofit — or where a local body is willing to borrow against one. THE REGISTERED ORGANISATIONS AND ENVIRONMENT HOUSES RECORDED SEPARATELY FOR THIS COUNTRY ARE THE VEHICLES THAT COULD HOLD SUCH A FACILITY; an unconstituted group cannot. THE LIMITS: this is finance, not funding — facilities are repaid. The compensation insurance is recorded as A MEMORANDUM BETWEEN THREE BODIES, AND ITS OPERATING RULES, COVERAGE, PREMIUMS AND CLAIMS PROCEDURE WERE NOT VERIFIED; treat it as something to enquire about, not something to rely on. Figures come from official statements in a particular period. And the general cautions recorded for this country apply: approaching state bodies is visible, and the protection routes recorded separately should be read alongside.ONE SIDE OF THIS FUND WAS NOT RECORDED HERE, AND IT IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS WHERE A COMMUNITY HAS NO CREDIT: THE FUND DESCRIBES ITSELF AS THE ONLY OFFICIAL AND ACCREDITED FINANCIAL INSTITUTION WHICH, UNDER ITS STATUTE, RECEIVES PUBLIC CONTRIBUTIONS FROM NATURAL AND LEGAL PERSONS AND FROM PHILANTHROPISTS — SPENT ACCORDING TO THE DONOR'S PURPOSE, WITHIN AN INTERNATIONAL SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY STANDARD AND THE ENVIRONMENT ORGANISATION'S OWN GUIDELINE. SO THERE IS A LAWFUL CHANNEL BY WHICH SOMEBODY WEALTHY CAN PAY FOR A SPECIFIC PIECE OF ENVIRONMENTAL WORK WITH THE PURPOSE ATTACHED — WHICH MATTERS IN A COUNTRY WHERE RAISING MONEY OUTSIDE THE STATE IS DIFFICULT AND FOREIGN FUNDING IS DANGEROUS. AND THE CLAUSE THAT TURNS A DONATION INTO LEVERAGE: ALL DONORS AND CONTRIBUTORS MAY SUPERVISE HOW THE FUNDS ARE SPENT, AND THE RESULTS ARE PLACED AT THE DISPOSAL OF THE PUBLIC. A LOCAL BENEFACTOR WHO GIVES FOR A NAMED PURPOSE IS THEREFORE ENTITLED TO ASK QUESTIONS RESIDENTS ALONE CANNOT. FIND THE DONOR, THEN USE THE ENTITLEMENT. TWO PRACTICAL NOTES ON THE LENDING SIDE. THE REQUEST WINDOW IS DESCRIBED AS BEING FOR PROJECTS THAT REDUCE ENVIRONMENTAL POLLUTION AND PREVENT ENVIRONMENTAL DESTRUCTION — PREVENTION IS INSIDE THE STATED MANDATE, SO FRAME THE PROPOSAL IN THOSE WORDS. AND THE FUND HAS PUBLICLY NARROWED ITSELF: ITS MANAGING DIRECTOR ORDERED A HALT TO LENDING OUTSIDE ITS MISSION, INCLUDING SOLAR POWER PLANTS, TO PREVENT BUDGET DIVERSION AND REDIRECT RESOURCES TO WASTE AND POLLUTANT REDUCTION. A PROPOSAL IN A CATEGORY THE FUND HAS JUST ABANDONED WASTES A CYCLE.

trackers.name: National electronic procurement and auction system — where land is sold, and where the contracts to build are awarded
trackers.desc: ONE NATIONAL PLATFORM CARRIES BOTH HALVES OF WHAT THIS MAP TRACKS. IT CONDUCTS ALL GOVERNMENT TENDERS AND EVALUATION CALLS — THE CONTRACTS BY WHICH PROJECTS GET BUILT — AND ALL AUCTIONS OF MOVABLE AND IMMOVABLE PROPERTY, THE ROUTE BY WHICH STATE LAND IS SOLD AND LEASED. THE AUCTION SIDE RUNS END TO END IN PUBLIC: REGISTRATION AND PUBLICATION OF THE AUCTION, SUBMISSION OF PRICE BIDS LOT BY LOT, OPENING, DETERMINATION OF THE WINNER, CONCLUSION OF THE CONTRACT WITH ELECTRONIC SIGNATURE, PAYMENT AND ISSUE OF THE RELEASE ORDER. Auctions are divided into movable and immovable property and cover the sale of state property, real-estate auctions, and leases and other contracts — with listing categories that name LAND, houses, apartments, towers and villas explicitly. SO STATE LAND IN THIS COUNTRY IS SOLD AND LEASED THROUGH ONE ONLINE, PUBLIC SYSTEM, AND ANYONE CAN SEE WHAT IS COMING UP. THAT IS BOTH A WARNING SYSTEM AND, FOR A FUNDED COMMUNITY BODY, A ROUTE TO ACQUIRING GROUND RATHER THAN ONLY OBJECTING TO WHOEVER ELSE DOES. THE TENDER SIDE MATTERS JUST AS MUCH AND IS USUALLY IGNORED. THE SAME SYSTEM PUBLISHES THE PROCUREMENT CALLS BY WHICH AUTHORITIES COMMISSION DESIGN, SURVEY, SUPERVISION AND CONSTRUCTION WORK — WHICH MEANS A SCHEME'S EXISTENCE, ITS SCOPE AND ITS TIMETABLE OFTEN APPEAR IN A TENDER NOTICE BEFORE ANYTHING IS ANNOUNCED LOCALLY. WATCHING TENDERS IS WATCHING PROJECTS BEING BORN. NOW THE PRACTICAL BARRIER, AND IT IS THE ONE THAT STOPS PEOPLE: BOTH THE AUCTIONEER AND THE BIDDER MUST BE REGISTERED IN THE SYSTEM, AND A DIGITAL SIGNATURE TOKEN IS MANDATORY IN ORDER TO TAKE PART IN THE AUCTION DOCUMENTS, PRECISELY BECAUSE A DIGITAL SIGNATURE CANNOT BE FORGED. THE TOKEN MUST BE OBTAINED IN ADVANCE. IT CANNOT BE ARRANGED IN THE DAYS BETWEEN A NOTICE APPEARING AND AN AUCTION CLOSING — which is the same lesson this file recorded about guarantee deposits and powers of attorney in three other countries: THE APPARATUS FOR ACTING MUST EXIST BEFORE THERE IS ANYTHING TO ACT ON. AND THERE IS A WAY TO WATCH WITHOUT REGISTERING AT ALL: COMMERCIAL AGGREGATORS COLLECT AUCTION AND TENDER ANNOUNCEMENTS FROM NEWSPAPERS, FROM THE AUCTIONEERS' OWN WEBSITES AND DIRECTLY, AND PUBLISH THEM BY CATEGORY AND BY DAY. A COMMUNITY THAT ONLY WANTS EARLY WARNING CAN MONITOR THOSE LISTINGS WITHOUT A TOKEN, WITHOUT REGISTRATION, AND WITHOUT DECLARING ANY INTEREST. THE LIMITS: this is the machinery of state disposal and procurement — it is not an ally, and nothing in it creates a right to object to a sale or a contract. Aggregators are commercial services and their coverage is their own claim. Bidding requires money, registration and the token, and sanctions and banking constraints affect what outside supporters can contribute here. Approaching state systems in this country is visible. Read it with the registered popular organisations and the free legal routes recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Bar associations and lawyer search — two licensing systems, twenty-five registers, and the licence date to ask for
trackers.desc: BEFORE LOOKING FOR A LAWYER IN THIS COUNTRY, ESTABLISH WHICH OF TWO SYSTEMS LICENSED THEM. THE BAR ASSOCIATIONS ARE INDEPENDENT BODIES THAT ISSUE ADVOCACY LICENCES AND SUPERVISE THEIR OWN MEMBERS, WHO ARE KNOWN AS JUSTICE ADVOCATES. SEPARATELY, A CENTRE FOR LAWYERS, OFFICIAL EXPERTS AND FAMILY COUNSELLORS OPERATES DIRECTLY UNDER THE JUDICIARY, AND ITS LAWYERS ARE LICENSED BY IT. BOTH PROVIDE LEGAL SERVICES, BUT VERIFICATION AND SUPERVISION RUN THROUGH DIFFERENT REGISTERS — SO THE FIRST QUESTION TO A PROSPECTIVE LAWYER IS WHICH BODY ISSUED THE LICENCE, because that determines where to check them and who disciplines them. HOW TO SEARCH DIFFERS BETWEEN THE TWO, AND THIS IS THE PRACTICAL POINT: TWENTY-FIVE BAR ASSOCIATIONS BELONG TO THE NATIONAL UNION AND EACH RUNS ITS OWN SEPARATE LAWYER-SEARCH WEBSITE, WHILE THE JUDICIARY'S CENTRE HAS ONE UNIFIED ONLINE SEARCH SYSTEM AND A SINGLE LAWYER DATABASE. SO THERE IS NO ONE NATIONAL LIST ON THE BAR SIDE. GO TO THE BAR ASSOCIATION OF YOUR OWN PROVINCE FIRST — its register is the one that will contain the lawyers practising where your case will be heard. THE SEARCH FIELDS ARE WORTH KNOWING BECAUSE THEY DECIDE WHAT YOU CAN FILTER FOR: NAME, SURNAME, LICENCE NUMBER, GENDER, THE PROVINCE AND CITY OF THE LAWYER'S OFFICE, TELEPHONE AND ADDRESS. SEARCHING BY PROVINCE AND CITY IS HOW YOU FIND COUNSEL NEAR THE COURT THAT WILL ACTUALLY HEAR THE MATTER, which this file recorded as the decisive advantage of a bar directory in another country. A LAWYER IN THE RIGHT CITY BEATS A BETTER-KNOWN ONE IN THE CAPITAL for a land dispute heard locally. VERIFICATION IS AVAILABLE AND SHOULD BE USED: YOU CAN CHECK WHETHER A GIVEN LAWYER IS ACTUALLY A MEMBER OF THE BAR RATHER THAN TAKING THE CLAIM ON TRUST. AND ONE DETAIL MAKES THAT CHECK SHARPER THAN A SIMPLE YES OR NO: AN ADVOCACY LICENCE IS VALID FOR THREE YEARS, AND ITS RENEWAL DEPENDS ON THE HOLDER APPLYING FOR IT. WHERE A LAWYER IS FOUND TO LACK ONE OF THE REQUIRED CONDITIONS, THE BAR MUST REFER THE MATTER TO THE LAWYERS' DISCIPLINARY COURT, WHICH DECIDES ON RENEWAL OR REFUSAL — AND THE LICENCE REMAINS VALID UNTIL A FINAL RULING UNLESS THE COURT ORDERS SUSPENSION. SO ASK FOR THE DATE OF THE LICENCE, NOT ONLY ITS NUMBER. A THREE-YEAR TERM MEANS A LICENCE CAN LAPSE QUIETLY, AND A LAWYER WITH A PENDING DISCIPLINARY REFERRAL STILL HOLDS A VALID LICENCE UNTIL THE COURT RULES — both are things a client is entitled to know and neither appears from a number alone. THE LIMITS: these are professional registers, not legal aid — THEY TELL YOU WHO IS LICENSED AND WHERE, NOT WHO WILL TAKE AN ENVIRONMENTAL OR LAND CASE OR AT WHAT COST. Whether the bar operates a duty-counsel or judicial-assistance scheme, and on what terms, WAS NOT VERIFIED in this round and is the next thing to ask a provincial bar directly. Approaching institutions in this country is visible, and sanctions and banking constraints affect payment from outside. Read it with the provincial engineering disciplinary route, the registered popular organisations and the environment fund recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Registered popular groups and environment houses — 1,360 of them in villages and schools, with seats on the provincial planning council
trackers.desc: ONE SENTENCE FROM THE HEAD OF THE STATE ENVIRONMENT ORGANISATION'S PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OFFICE MATTERS MORE THAN ANYTHING ELSE IN THIS ENTRY: POPULAR ORGANISATIONS TAKE PART IN OFFICIAL GOVERNMENT DECISION-MAKING MEETINGS, IN THE PROVINCIAL PLANNING COUNCIL AND IN THE WASTE MANAGEMENT WORKING GROUP, AS REPRESENTATIVES OF THE PEOPLE. THE PROVINCIAL PLANNING COUNCIL IS WHERE DEVELOPMENT PLANS ARE APPROVED. A REGISTERED POPULAR ORGANISATION HAS A SEAT AT THAT TABLE. THIS FILE HAS SAID REPEATEDLY THAT THE ROUTE FROM A LOCAL OBSERVATION TO AN OFFICIAL AGENDA RUNS THROUGH WHOEVER HOLDS THE SEAT — HERE THE SEAT IS NAMED, AND IT BELONGS TO CIVIL GROUPS. SO THE QUESTION FOR A COMMUNITY IS NOT HOW TO GET HEARD BY THE PROVINCE, BUT WHICH REGISTERED ORGANISATION SITS ON ITS PROVINCE'S COUNCIL, AND HOW TO REACH THE PERSON WHO GOES. THE SCALE IS LARGER THAN ANYTHING ELSE RECORDED IN THIS COUNTRY: NEARLY ONE THOUSAND AND FIFTY REGISTERED POPULAR VOLUNTEER GROUPS, SOME WITH HISTORIES OF UP TO FOUR DECADES, AND ONE THOUSAND THREE HUNDRED AND SIXTY ENVIRONMENT HOUSES. AND WHERE THOSE HOUSES ARE IS THE PART TO NOTICE: IN SCHOOLS, IN VILLAGE ADMINISTRATIONS, IN LIBRARIES AND IN AGRICULTURAL CENTRES. NOT IN THE CAPITAL AND NOT IN UNIVERSITIES — IN THE BUILDINGS RURAL PEOPLE ALREADY WALK INTO. A VILLAGE THAT THINKS IT HAS NO ENVIRONMENTAL ORGANISATION MAY HAVE ONE INSIDE ITS OWN COUNCIL OFFICE OR ITS AGRICULTURAL CENTRE. WHAT THEY DO IS PRACTICAL AND ALREADY ESTABLISHED: PARTICIPATORY PROTECTION OF PROTECTED AREAS, WILDLIFE WORK, CENSUSES, AND EDUCATION AND INFORMATION IN SCHOOLS, VILLAGES AND MOSQUES. THE CENSUS WORK IS THE MOST TRANSFERABLE — A GROUP THAT ALREADY COUNTS WILDLIFE FOR THE STATE HAS BOTH THE METHOD AND THE STANDING TO RECORD WHAT IS ON THREATENED GROUND. AND MOSQUES APPEAR IN THAT LIST ALONGSIDE SCHOOLS AND VILLAGES. WHERE ENVIRONMENTAL EDUCATION IS ALREADY DELIVERED THROUGH A PLACE OF WORSHIP, THAT IS AN EXISTING AND UNCONTROVERSIAL CHANNEL FOR REACHING EVERYONE IN A SETTLEMENT AT ONCE. ONE PIECE OF CONTEXT, FLAGGED AS SUCH: SCHOLARLY ANALYSIS OF THIS COUNTRY'S SYSTEM DESCRIBES ENVIRONMENTAL ORGANISATIONS AS HAVING RECOGNISED ROLES IN REGULATION, IN LITIGATION AND IN MONITORING — WHILE NOTING SHORTCOMINGS, AND THE POSSIBILITY FOR OFFICIALS TO REMOVE OR MODIFY THE LIST OF ACTIVE ORGANISATIONS. THAT LAST POINT IS THE WARNING: REGISTRATION IS WHAT GIVES A GROUP ITS SEAT, AND REGISTRATION CAN BE WITHDRAWN. THE LIMITS: these groups are REGISTERED WITH AND COORDINATED BY THE STATE ENVIRONMENT ORGANISATION, and the figures come from that office's own director — THEY DESCRIBE A SYSTEM AS ITS ADMINISTRATOR SEES IT. Participation in an official council is not a power to refuse a scheme, and A GROUP WHOSE STANDING DEPENDS ON A LIST WILL BE CAREFUL. WHICH ORGANISATION HOLDS THE SEAT IN ANY GIVEN PROVINCE, AND HOW IT IS CHOSEN, WERE NOT VERIFIED. Approaching institutions in this country is visible. Read it with the bar associations and lawyer search, the provincial engineering discipline route and the environment fund recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Women's association against environmental pollution — sustained letters to three tiers of government about one named place
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HAS RECORDED BIG INSTITUTIONS, EXPENSIVE INSTRUMENTS AND INTERNATIONAL COMMITTEES. HERE IS THE PLAINEST METHOD IN IT, AND THE ONE A SMALL GROUP CAN ACTUALLY RUN: SERIOUS, SUSTAINED FOLLOW-UP AND REPEATED LETTER-WRITING TO CITY, PROVINCIAL AND NATIONAL OFFICIALS FOR THE REVIVAL OF ONE NAMED ORCHARD. THREE TIERS OF GOVERNMENT, ONE SPECIFIC PLACE, KEPT UP OVER YEARS. THAT IS THE WHOLE TECHNIQUE. IT NEEDS NO LAWYER, NO LABORATORY AND NO FUNDING — ONLY PERSISTENCE AND A FILE OF COPIES, AND IT PRODUCES A DOCUMENTARY TRAIL SHOWING THAT EVERY LEVEL OF AUTHORITY WAS TOLD, AND WHEN. THE ASSOCIATION BEHIND IT WAS FOUNDED IN 1993 BY A RETIRED UNIVERSITY LIBRARIAN AND AN EXPERT ON ENVIRONMENTAL LAW — A NON-GOVERNMENTAL BODY FOR WOMEN'S AND ENVIRONMENTAL RIGHTS. A LIBRARIAN AND A LAWYER: THE TWO SKILLS A CAMPAIGN ACTUALLY NEEDS, WHICH IS RECORD-KEEPING AND KNOWING WHAT MAY BE DEMANDED. ITS OTHER RECORDED WORK SHOWS THE RANGE A SMALL ASSOCIATION CAN COVER: PROPOSING A CITY TRAFFIC SCHEME AND BACKING ANY MEASURE THAT REDUCES VEHICLE MOVEMENT, AND CARRYING OUT SYMBOLIC CLEAN-UPS OF A NAMED MOUNTAIN ROAD ON VARIOUS OCCASIONS. SYMBOLIC CLEAN-UPS ARE WORTH UNDERSTANDING PROPERLY. THEY DO NOT SOLVE THE PROBLEM AND ARE NOT MEANT TO: THEY PUT PEOPLE ON A NAMED STRETCH OF GROUND ON A DATE, WITH PHOTOGRAPHS, IN A FORM NOBODY CAN CALL PROTEST — WHICH THIS FILE HAS FOUND TO BE THE SAFEST AVAILABLE ACT IN SEVERAL CONSTRAINED COUNTRIES. AND ONE RECENT OFFICIAL STATEMENT OPENS A DOOR WORTH WALKING THROUGH. THE HEAD OF THE STATE ENVIRONMENT ORGANISATION SAID THAT RURAL WOMEN ARE THE FIRST RING OF ENVIRONMENTAL EDUCATION; THAT REDUCED USE OF PESTICIDES AND CHEMICAL FERTILISERS AND ORGANIC PRODUCTION ARE THE SUSTAINABLE BEHAVIOUR PATTERNS OF RURAL AND NOMADIC WOMEN, HELPING TO CUT WATER AND SOIL POLLUTION; AND THAT RECORDING AND DOCUMENTING RURAL WOMEN'S NARRATIVES FOR PROTECTING THE ENVIRONMENT CAN PROMOTE SUCH WORK — ADDING THAT THE ORGANISATION SUPPORTS THIS STORYTELLING. THAT IS AN OFFICIAL INVITATION TO DOCUMENT AND SUBMIT RURAL WOMEN'S ACCOUNTS OF PROTECTING LAND AND WATER. IT IS A SANCTIONED FORM FOR A RECORD THAT WOULD OTHERWISE READ AS A COMPLAINT — AND A NARRATIVE ABOUT A SPRING, A PASTURE OR AN ORCHARD, GATHERED FROM THE WOMEN WHO USE IT, IS BOTH EVIDENCE AND SOMETHING THE STATE HAS SAID IT WANTS. SO THE COMBINATION TO USE HERE IS: GATHER THE NARRATIVES AS DOCUMENTATION THE AUTHORITIES HAVE ASKED FOR, AND SEND THE LETTERS TO ALL THREE TIERS ABOUT THE PARTICULAR PLACE. NEITHER STEP IS CONFRONTATIONAL, AND TOGETHER THEY BUILD A DATED RECORD THAT A LATER DECISION HAS TO CONTEND WITH. THE LIMITS: THE ACCOUNT OF THIS ASSOCIATION'S WORK COMES FROM AN INTERVIEW SEVERAL YEARS OLD, AND WHETHER IT REMAINS ACTIVE, AND WITH WHAT CAPACITY, WAS NOT VERIFIED — nor was the outcome of the orchard campaign. It is AN AWARENESS AND ADVOCACY ASSOCIATION, NOT A LITIGATOR, and registration is what gives such groups standing in this country, as recorded elsewhere in this file. Approaching institutions here is visible. Read it with the registered popular groups and environment houses, the bar associations and the provincial engineering route recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Natural resources and watershed organisation — protection units that remove encroachments, a service desk, and a charter that puts customary users first
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE BODY THAT ACTUALLY HOLDS THE GROUND. IT EXERCISES SOVEREIGNTY AND MANAGEMENT OVER THE COUNTRY'S NATURAL-RESOURCE LANDS — THE NATIONAL LANDS — AND IS RESPONSIBLE FOR THEIR PRESERVATION, REVIVAL, DEVELOPMENT AND SUSTAINABLE USE, AS AN INDEPENDENT EXECUTIVE ORGANISATION AT DEPUTY-MINISTRY LEVEL. SO THE FIRST QUESTION ABOUT ANY DISPUTED GROUND HERE IS WHETHER IT IS NATIONAL LAND. IF IT IS, THE OCCUPIER IS NOT A NEIGHBOUR WITH A TITLE ARGUMENT BUT SOMEBODY USING LAND THAT BELONGS TO THE PUBLIC — AND THERE IS A UNIT WHOSE JOB IS TO REMOVE THEM. THOSE UNITS WORK AND PUBLICISE IT. DISTRICT PROTECTION UNIT COMMANDERS ANNOUNCE THE REMOVAL OF ENCROACHMENT ON NATIONAL LANDS: IN ONE CASE MORE THAN FIFTEEN HECTARES OF A RIVERSIDE AREA THAT HAD BEEN ILLEGALLY OCCUPIED, IN ANOTHER TEN HECTARES WITH A STATED VALUE. RIVERSIDE LAND ILLEGALLY OCCUPIED AND THEN CLEARED IS EXACTLY THE PATTERN COMMUNITIES REPORT AND ARE TOLD NOTHING CAN BE DONE ABOUT. REPORT TO THE DISTRICT NATURAL RESOURCES OFFICE'S PROTECTION UNIT, NAME THE PARCEL, AND ASK WHETHER IT IS REGISTERED AS NATIONAL LAND — THAT SINGLE QUESTION DECIDES WHICH BODY CAN ACT. THERE ARE TWO PRACTICAL ACCESS POINTS. THE ORGANISATION RUNS A SERVICE DESK PORTAL WITH ELECTRONIC SERVICES; AND A SINGLE WINDOW FOR LAND SECRETARIAT HAS BEEN OPENED IN AT LEAST ONE PROVINCE TO SPEED THE HANDLING OF REQUESTS, EXPLICITLY IN RESPONSE TO THE LARGE VOLUME OF REGISTERED REQUESTS. A SINGLE-WINDOW SECRETARIAT CREATED BECAUSE OF REQUEST VOLUME TELLS YOU TWO THINGS: PEOPLE ARE USING THESE ROUTES IN LARGE NUMBERS, AND THERE IS NOW ONE PLACE TO LODGE AND TRACK A REQUEST RATHER THAN SEVERAL. ASK WHETHER YOUR PROVINCE HAS ONE. THE MOST USEFUL DOCUMENT IS THE CHARTER ON MAKING NATURAL RESOURCE ACTIVITIES POPULAR. IT AIMS TO IMPROVE THE PARTICIPATION OF RANGELAND USERS IN IMPLEMENTING COMBINED RANGELAND MANAGEMENT PLANS, TO RAISE THE ECONOMIC CAPACITY OF LOCAL COMMUNITIES AND CUSTOMARY USERS, AND TO GIVE PRIORITY TO HOLDERS OF GRAZING PERMITS AND TO CUSTOMARY FOREST AND RANGELAND USERS IN APPROVED MANAGEMENT PLANS — WITH TECHNICAL TRAINING FOR THOSE WHO IMPLEMENT THEM. PRIORITY TO CUSTOMARY USERS, WRITTEN INTO THE ORGANISATION'S OWN CHARTER, IS THE SENTENCE A HERDING OR FOREST-EDGE COMMUNITY SHOULD QUOTE. IT MEANS THE PEOPLE WHO ALREADY USE THE GROUND ARE THE INTENDED IMPLEMENTERS OF PLANS ON IT — NOT AN OBSTACLE TO THEM. AND THE PLAN TYPES ARE NAMED, WHICH TELLS YOU WHAT CAN BE ASKED FOR: FOREST PARKS, WATERSHED PARKS, VILLAGE GARDENS, NURSERIES AND RESERVES. A COMMUNITY WANTING ITS LOCAL WOOD PROTECTED HAS A CATEGORY TO APPLY UNDER RATHER THAN A GENERAL PLEA — AND A NURSERY OR VILLAGE GARDEN IS A MODEST, GRANTABLE FIRST REQUEST. ONE TECHNICAL TERM IS WORTH LEARNING: GRAZING CAPACITY IS THE NUMBER OF ANIMAL UNITS THAT MAY GRAZE ON ONE HECTARE OF RANGELAND IN A SEASON UNDER A GRAZING PERMIT OR RANGELAND PLAN. IT IS THE NUMBER ARGUMENTS ABOUT OVERGRAZING AND ABOUT LOST PASTURE ARE SETTLED WITH. THE LIMITS: this is THE STATE BODY THAT OWNS AND ALLOCATES THE LAND, WHICH MAKES IT BOTH THE REMEDY AND, OFTEN, THE COUNTERPARTY — IT ISSUES THE PERMITS AND APPROVES THE PLANS A COMMUNITY MAY BE OBJECTING TO, and national-land classification has itself been contested by villagers in many places. IT WILL NOT OPPOSE A STATE PROJECT. WHETHER REPORTS FROM THE PUBLIC ARE ACCEPTED BY PROTECTION UNITS, AND THROUGH WHICH CHANNEL, WAS NOT VERIFIED, and the charter provisions come from a published organisational document rather than a service page. Read it with the bar assistance office, the registered popular groups and environment houses, and the provincial engineering organisation recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Agricultural and natural resources engineering organisation — licence lookup, a soil-science expert pool, expert reports, and a disciplinary complaints board
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HAS TOLD COMMUNITIES OVER AND OVER TO GET A QUALIFIED EXPERT AND HAS RARELY BEEN ABLE TO SAY HOW TO FIND ONE OR HOW TO CHECK THEM. THIS SYSTEM DOES BOTH: IT PROVIDES VERIFICATION OF MEMBERSHIP VALIDITY AND OF PRACTICE LICENCES, FOR NATURAL AND LEGAL PERSONS ALIKE, ALONGSIDE A DATABASE OF TECHNICAL AGENTS AND VERIFICATION OF RANKING AND QUALIFICATION CERTIFICATES. SO BEFORE PAYING ANY AGRICULTURAL OR SOIL EXPERT HERE, CHECK THE LICENCE NUMBER AND THE RANKING CERTIFICATE ON THE ORGANISATION'S OWN SYSTEM. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED FAKE-PROFESSIONAL WARNINGS IN FOUR COUNTRIES; HERE THE CHECK IS A PUBLIC LOOKUP RATHER THAN A FAVOUR. AND THE SAME SYSTEM CARRIES A COMPLAINTS ROUTE: REGISTRATION AND HANDLING OF COMPLAINTS BEFORE THE PRIMARY AND HIGH DISCIPLINARY BOARDS. AN EXPERT WHOSE REPORT IS DISHONEST OR WHOSE SUPERVISION WAS NOMINAL CAN BE COMPLAINED OF TO HIS OWN PROFESSION — WHICH IS THE ONLY REAL LEVER OVER A PAID PROFESSIONAL, AND IT WORKS ONLY IF YOU KEPT THE PAPERWORK. THE MEMBERSHIP IS THE ASSET. THE ORGANISATION DESCRIBES ITSELF AS THE PROFESSIONAL BODY AND SPECIALIST REFERENCE AUTHORITY IN AGRICULTURE AND NATURAL RESOURCES, WITH THOUSANDS OF QUALIFIED MEMBERS IN AGRICULTURAL ENGINEERING, SOIL SCIENCE, HORTICULTURE AND PLANT PROTECTION. SOIL SCIENCE IS THE SPECIALISM TO ASK FOR BY NAME. WHERE THE HARM IS SALINISATION, COMPACTION, CONTAMINATION OR EROSION, A SOIL SCIENTIST'S REPORT IS THE DOCUMENT THAT DESCRIBES IT IN TERMS AN AUTHORITY MUST ANSWER — AND PLANT PROTECTION IS THE ONE TO ASK FOR WHERE SPRAYING OR DRIFT HAS DAMAGED A CROP. ITS SERVICES INCLUDE DESIGN AND SUPERVISION OF CONSTRUCTION AND PRODUCTION PROJECTS, TECHNICAL AND ENGINEERING CONSULTANCY, THE ISSUING AND RENEWAL OF PRACTICE LICENCES, THE REFERRAL OF WORK TO QUALIFIED MEMBERS, AND SUPERVISION OF THE PROPER EXECUTION OF PROJECTS — WITH PROVINCIAL ORGANISATIONS PROVIDING EXPERT REPORTS ON AGRICULTURAL PROJECTS. THE REFERRAL SERVICE IS THE PRACTICAL ONE: THE ORGANISATION ITSELF ASSIGNS WORK TO QUALIFIED MEMBERS. A COMMUNITY THAT ASKS THE PROVINCIAL ORGANISATION TO REFER AN EXPERT GETS SOMEBODY VETTED AND ON RECORD, RATHER THAN WHOEVER IS RECOMMENDED LOCALLY — AND THE REFERRAL ITSELF CREATES A FILE. AND SUPERVISION CUTS BOTH WAYS, WHICH IS THE MOST USEFUL POINT HERE. IF A PROJECT NEAR YOU REQUIRED A SUPERVISING ENGINEER FROM THIS ORGANISATION, THEN A NAMED, LICENSED PROFESSIONAL IS ANSWERABLE FOR WHETHER IT WAS BUILT AS APPROVED — ASK WHO SUPERVISED IT, CHECK THEIR LICENCE ON THE SYSTEM, AND IF THE WORKS DEPART FROM THE DESIGN, THE DISCIPLINARY BOARD IS AN ADDRESS THAT NO PLANNING OFFICE CAN IGNORE. GO TO THE PROVINCIAL ORGANISATION, NOT THE CAPITAL: EACH PROVINCE HAS ITS OWN BODY WITH ITS OWN SITE, MEMBERSHIP AND SERVICES, AND THAT IS WHERE A LOCAL EXPERT AND A LOCAL FILE WILL BE. THE LIMITS: this is A LICENSING AND PROFESSIONAL BODY, NOT AN ADVOCATE — its members work for developers, ministries and farmers alike, IT WILL NOT TAKE A SIDE, and an expert report must be paid for. WHETHER MEMBERS ACCEPT INSTRUCTIONS FROM RESIDENTS RATHER THAN FROM PROJECT OWNERS, AND AT WHAT COST, WAS NOT VERIFIED. The organisation sits within the agriculture ministry's system, so it is not independent of the state; and approaching institutions in this country is visible. Read it with the natural resources and watershed organisation, the bar assistance office and the provincial construction engineering organisation recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Agricultural insurance fund — a one-week claim deadline, expert damage assessment, and compensation now paid weekly
trackers.desc: ONE RULE IN THIS FUND'S OWN GUIDANCE IS WORTH MORE THAN EVERYTHING ELSE ON THE PAGE, AND ALMOST NOBODY LEARNS IT UNTIL IT IS TOO LATE: WHEN DAMAGE OCCURS, THE FARMER MUST GO AT THE FIRST OPPORTUNITY — BEFORE THE TRACES OF THE DAMAGE DISAPPEAR, AND AT MOST ONE WEEK AFTER IT HAPPENS — TO THE NEAREST INSURANCE SERVICES AGENCY OR AGRICULTURAL BANK BRANCH, AND SUBMIT A DAMAGE ASSESSMENT REQUEST FORM. A CLAIM CAN ALSO BE DECLARED THROUGH A SHORT MOBILE CODE. BEFORE THE TRACES DISAPPEAR IS THE PHRASE TO REMEMBER. HAIL BRUISES HEAL, FROSTED LEAVES DROP, FLOOD SILT IS PLOUGHED IN — AND A LOSS THAT CANNOT BE SEEN CANNOT BE ASSESSED. PHOTOGRAPH THE FIELD THE SAME DAY, WITH THE DATE, AND LODGE THE FORM WITHIN THE WEEK EVEN IF NOBODY HAS COME TO LOOK. THE SECOND PIECE OF THE FUND'S OWN ADVICE IS EQUALLY PRACTICAL: READ THE ANNEXED FORM LISTING THE COVERED RISK FACTORS AT THE TIME YOU BUY THE POLICY, SO YOU KNOW EXACTLY WHICH RISKS ARE COVERED FOR EACH CROP. COVER IS PER CROP AND PER RISK, NOT GENERAL. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED FAMILIES ACROSS THE REGION DISCOVERING AFTER A LOSS THAT THEIR PARTICULAR PERIL WAS NEVER INCLUDED — THE ANNEX IS WHERE THAT IS SETTLED, AND IT IS HANDED OVER AT PURCHASE. THE FUND IS SUPPORTIVE RATHER THAN COMMERCIAL: GOVERNMENT PARTICIPATION REDUCES THE PREMIUM, AND ITS DUTIES ARE ISSUING POLICIES, ASSESSING DAMAGE, PAYING COMPENSATION, AND DESIGNING NEW COVERAGE FOR THE SECTOR. RISKS COVERED INCLUDE FLOOD, HAIL, FROST AND DROUGHT FOR CROPS AND ORCHARDS, AND DISEASE IN LIVESTOCK AND POULTRY. DROUGHT COVER IS THE ONE THIS FILE HAS RARELY FOUND ANYWHERE. IN A COUNTRY WHERE THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED FARMERS PROTESTING OVER WATER RIGHTS, AN INSURANCE PRODUCT THAT PAYS WHEN THE WATER DOES NOT COME IS A REAL BUFFER — AND A HOUSEHOLD THAT SURVIVES A DRY YEAR KEEPS ITS LAND. PAYMENT TIMING HAS CHANGED IN A WAY WORTH KNOWING BEFORE YOU CHASE: COMPENSATION HAS MOVED FROM AN OCCASIONAL BASIS TO A REGULAR WEEKLY PROCESS, SO THAT A FARMER WHOSE LOSS HAS BEEN ASSESSED AND APPROVED SHOULD NOT WAIT LONG. SO IF YOUR ASSESSMENT WAS COMPLETED AND APPROVED AND NOTHING HAS ARRIVED AFTER SEVERAL WEEKS, THAT IS NOW OUT OF LINE WITH THE FUND'S OWN STATED PROCESS — WHICH IS A CONCRETE THING TO PUT IN A LETTER RATHER THAN A GENERAL COMPLAINT ABOUT DELAY. THE SCALE SHOWS IT IS OPERATING RATHER THAN NOMINAL: COMPENSATION FOR ONE CROP YEAR EXCEEDED A HUNDRED AND FORTY THOUSAND BILLION RIALS, MORE THAN DOUBLE THE PREVIOUS YEAR, DAMAGE ASSESSMENT WAS CARRIED OUT IN OVER NINETY-FIVE PER CENT OF PROVINCES, AND PAYMENTS CONTINUED THROUGH A PERIOD OF WAR. AND ONE DISPUTE PATTERN IS WORTH CARRYING: WHERE A POLICY WAS APPROVED AND ISSUED, THE DOCUMENTS WERE BY DEFINITION COMPLETE, SO A LATER REFUSAL ON THE GROUND OF A MISSING DOCUMENT IS CONTESTABLE — AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED THE BAR ASSISTANCE OFFICE AND THE PROVINCIAL ENGINEERING ORGANISATION SEPARATELY FOR THIS COUNTRY AS THE PLACES TO TAKE SUCH A REFUSAL. THE LIMITS: this is INSURANCE, NOT COMPENSATION FOR LAND TAKEN OR DAMAGED BY A PROJECT — it pays for natural perils named in a policy, NOT FOR POLLUTION, CONSTRUCTION DAMAGE OR EXPROPRIATION, and it requires a premium paid in advance. UNINSURED HOUSEHOLDS GET NOTHING, WHICH IS MOST OF THE POOREST. PAYMENT FIGURES AND THE WEEKLY SCHEDULE COME FROM FUND OFFICIALS QUOTED IN THE PRESS, AND WHETHER TENANTS AND INFORMAL CULTIVATORS CAN INSURE LAND THEY DO NOT OWN WAS NOT VERIFIED. Read it with the natural resources and watershed organisation, the agricultural engineering organisation's licence lookup and the bar assistance office recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Farmer-shareholder development funds — provincial, county, commodity and rural women's funds paying short-term interest-free credit
trackers.desc: THE STRUCTURE IS THE POINT: THESE ARE NON-GOVERNMENTAL FUNDS WHOSE SHAREHOLDERS ARE THE PRODUCERS THEMSELVES, ORGANISED AS A FUND IN EACH PROVINCE, FUNDS AT COUNTY LEVEL, COMMODITY FUNDS SUCH AS ONE FOR BEEKEEPING, AND FUNDS FOR THE AGRICULTURAL ACTIVITIES OF RURAL WOMEN — ALL UNDER A PARENT SPECIALISED COMPANY. A FUND OWNED BY ITS BORROWERS BEHAVES DIFFERENTLY FROM A BANK. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED STATE LENDERS ACROSS THE REGION WHERE THE FARMER IS A SUPPLICANT; HERE THE FARMER IS A SHAREHOLDER, AND THE FUND'S PURPOSE IS TO MEET SHAREHOLDERS' NEEDS RATHER THAN TO PRICE THEIR RISK. AND IT PAYS SHORT-TERM INTEREST-FREE FACILITIES BASED ON SHAREHOLDERS' NEEDS — ONE PROVINCIAL FUND REPORTING SIX HUNDRED AND THIRTY BILLION RIALS PAID IN SUCH FACILITIES, AND ANOTHER EIGHTY BILLION IN CONTRACT-FARMING FACILITIES. INTEREST-FREE SHORT-TERM CREDIT IS THE MONEY THAT KEEPS A SEASON ALIVE: SEED, FERTILISER, A PUMP REPAIR, A HARVEST WAGE. IT IS ALSO THE CREDIT THAT MONEYLENDERS OTHERWISE SUPPLY AT RUINOUS RATES, AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED DEBT AS A COMMON ROUTE BY WHICH FAMILIES LOSE LAND. THE WOMEN'S FUNDS ARE THE MOST STRIKING PART. ONE COUNTY FUND WAS FOUNDED WITH INITIAL CAPITAL OF MORE THAN TWENTY BILLION RIALS AND FIVE HUNDRED AND TWENTY-SEVEN SHAREHOLDERS, ORGANISED IN NINETEEN RURAL WOMEN'S MICROCREDIT FUNDS. NINETEEN VILLAGE-LEVEL MICROCREDIT GROUPS FEEDING ONE COUNTY FUND IS A MODEL WORTH COPYING ANYWHERE: THE SMALL GROUPS HOLD THE TRUST AND THE LOCAL KNOWLEDGE, THE LARGER FUND HOLDS THE CAPITAL AND THE LEGAL STANDING — AND MEMBERSHIP OF THE SMALL GROUP IS THE ROUTE INTO THE BIG ONE. ONE WORKED EXAMPLE SHOWS WHAT COLLECTIVE FINANCE CAN DO THAT INDIVIDUAL CREDIT CANNOT: TIMELY CREDIT FROM A FUND ALLOWED A WHOLE PROVINCE'S FERTILISER QUOTA TO BE BOUGHT IN A SINGLE PURCHASE THROUGH THE RURAL COOPERATIVE UNION, WHICH STABILISED THE PRICE AND PUSHED MIDDLEMEN OUT OF THE PROVINCE. THAT IS THE ARGUMENT FOR JOINING RATHER THAN BORROWING ALONE. A GROUP THAT BUYS INPUTS TOGETHER CHANGES THE PRICE EVERYONE PAYS — AND PRICE, THIS FILE HAS FOUND REPEATEDLY, IS WHAT DECIDES WHETHER A HOLDING SURVIVES. THE FUNDS ARE ALSO EXPANDING THEIR SHAREHOLDER BASE DELIBERATELY: ONE PROVINCIAL FUND'S STATED PLAN WAS TO MAKE ALL PRODUCTION ORGANISATIONS SHAREHOLDERS — LIVESTOCK, POULTRY, CROPS, HORTICULTURE, PROCESSING INDUSTRIES, FISHERIES AND NATURAL RESOURCES. SO A COOPERATIVE THAT ASKS TO BUY SHARES IS OFFERING SOMETHING THE FUND WANTS. PRACTICALLY: FIND THE FUND FOR YOUR OWN PROVINCE — EACH HAS ITS OWN SITE AND SEVERAL PUBLISH THE DOCUMENTS REQUIRED TO RECEIVE FACILITIES — AND ASK TWO QUESTIONS: WHAT DOES SHAREHOLDING COST A COOPERATIVE OF OUR SIZE, AND WHAT IS THE SHORTEST ROUTE TO AN INTEREST-FREE SEASONAL FACILITY. THE LIMITS: SHAREHOLDING COSTS MONEY, WHICH IS THE BARRIER FOR THE POOREST, AND FACILITIES FLOW TO SHAREHOLDERS — A HOUSEHOLD OUTSIDE ANY ORGANISATION IS OUTSIDE THIS SYSTEM. THESE ARE PRODUCTION FINANCE BODIES, NOT CONSERVATION OR LEGAL FUNDS, AND THEY WILL NOT OPPOSE A PROJECT. SEVERAL FIGURES AND PLANS QUOTED COME FROM FUND ANNOUNCEMENTS OF EARLIER YEARS, RIAL AMOUNTS ARE DIFFICULT TO COMPARE ACROSS TIME GIVEN INFLATION, and current terms must be checked with the provincial fund. Read it with the agricultural insurance fund's claim deadline, the natural resources organisation, the agricultural engineering organisation's licence lookup and the bar assistance office recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Getting a deed for land held on an ordinary sale paper — the claim system, what disqualifies a plot, and the survey map it starts with
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HAS TOLD PEOPLE IN EVERY COUNTRY TO PRODUCE THEIR PAPERS. HERE IS THE COUNTRY WHERE THAT ADVICE MEETS ITS HARDEST WALL: REGISTRATION ORGANISATION ESTIMATES PUT ABOUT TWENTY MILLION PROPERTIES AND PLOTS WITHOUT FORMAL TITLE, INCLUDING AGRICULTURAL LAND AND RURAL PROPERTY. SO THE FIRST RESOURCE IS NOT A FUND OR A LAWYER BUT THE ROUTE OUT OF THAT CONDITION. UNDER THE LAW ON COMPULSORY FORMAL REGISTRATION OF IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TRANSACTIONS, DEFINED GROUPS OF OWNERS AND POSSESSORS MUST REGISTER THEIR OWNERSHIP CLAIM IN A NAMED ELECTRONIC SYSTEM — AND THE LARGEST GROUP IS PRECISELY THOSE WHO BOUGHT WITH AN ORDINARY SALE PAPER RATHER THAN A DEED. THAT MEANS THE FAMILY HOLDING A HANDWRITTEN AGREEMENT FOR AN ORCHARD OR A FIELD IS NOT AN EXCEPTION TO THE SYSTEM — IT IS THE CATEGORY THE SYSTEM WAS BUILT FOR, AND REGISTERING THE CLAIM IS NOW AN OBLIGATION RATHER THAN AN OPTION. A SEPARATE, OLDER LAW ON DETERMINING THE REGISTRATION STATUS OF LANDS AND BUILDINGS LACKING TITLE LETS SOMEONE WHO BOUGHT ALL OR PART OF A PROPERTY INFORMALLY REQUEST A TITLE DEED — BUT ONLY IF THE PROPERTY HAS A REGISTRATION HISTORY IN SOMEBODY'S NAME. KNOW WHAT DISQUALIFIES A PLOT BEFORE SPENDING ANYTHING, BECAUSE THE EXCLUSIONS ARE WIDE: NATIONAL LANDS; DEAD OR UNRECLAIMED LANDS, DEFINED AS HAVING NO KNOWN PRIVATE OWNERSHIP HISTORY, NOT BEING UNDER CULTIVATION OR BUILDINGS, AND HAVING NO CURRENT OWNER; STATE PROPERTY; PROPERTIES WITH NO REGISTRATION HISTORY AT ALL; PROPERTIES WITHOUT BUILDINGS, ENCLOSED OR NOT; AND CASES WHERE THE FORMAL OWNER IS ALIVE AND REACHABLE TO SIGN A PROPER TRANSFER. THAT LAST EXCLUSION IS THE ONE TO ACT ON IMMEDIATELY. IF THE PERSON WHO SOLD YOU THE LAND IS STILL ALIVE, THE LAW EXPECTS A PROPER TRANSFER RATHER THAN A CLAIM — SO THE CHEAPEST AND FASTEST FIX IS TO FIND THEM AND EXECUTE THE DEED NOW, BEFORE DEATH TURNS A SIMPLE SIGNATURE INTO AN INHERITANCE CASE INVOLVING EVERY HEIR. AND THE DEAD-LANDS DEFINITION CUTS THE OTHER WAY, WHICH MATTERS FOR ANYONE FARMING GROUND WITHOUT PAPERS: ONE OF ITS THREE TESTS IS THAT THE LAND IS NOT CURRENTLY UNDER CULTIVATION OR BUILDINGS. LAND THAT IS VISIBLY WORKED IS HARDER TO CLASSIFY AS DEAD LAND — SO CONTINUING TO CULTIVATE, AND BEING ABLE TO SHOW IT, IS ITSELF PART OF THE DEFENCE. THE PROCESS BEGINS WITH A DOCUMENT THIS FILE KEEPS RECOMMENDING FOR OTHER REASONS: A COORDINATE-BASED SURVEY MAP AND COORDINATE FORMS PREPARED BY A LICENSED REGISTRATION EXPERT. THE CLAIM IS THEN FILED, A CASE NUMBER IS ISSUED, AND THE APPLICANT CAN CHECK THE STATUS AT ANY TIME WITH THAT NUMBER AND A NATIONAL IDENTITY NUMBER; AFTER THE LEGAL STAGES AND THE PUBLICATION OF NOTICES, THE DEED IS ISSUED. THE PUBLISHED NOTICE STAGE IS WHERE OBJECTIONS ARRIVE, SO EXPECT IT AND PREPARE FOR IT — NEIGHBOURS, HEIRS AND STATE BODIES ALL READ THOSE NOTICES, AND A CLAIM THAT SURVIVES THEM IS FAR STRONGER AFTERWARDS THAN ANY INFORMAL AGREEMENT COULD EVER BE. TWO EASINGS ARE WORTH KNOWING: SINGLE-SHEET DEEDS ARE NOW ISSUED FOR AGRICULTURAL LAND AT ANY AREA WITH THE AGRICULTURAL USE NOTED, THE EARLIER ANTI-FRAGMENTATION RESTRICTIONS NO LONGER BARRING ISSUANCE; AND FOR INHERITED LAND THE ROUTE IS TO COMPLETE THE DOCUMENTS, STARTING WITH THE CERTIFICATE OF INHERITANCE. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A REGISTRATION ROUTE, NOT A GUARANTEE - A CLAIM CAN BE REFUSED, AND THE EXCLUSIONS ABOVE PUT MUCH RANGELAND, UNCULTIVATED GROUND AND ANYTHING CLASSIFIED AS NATIONAL LAND OUTSIDE IT ENTIRELY, WHICH IS EXACTLY THE LAND THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED AS MOST CONTESTED IN THIS COUNTRY. SURVEYS, EXPERTS AND FEES COST MONEY UP FRONT. REGISTERING ALSO MAKES A HOLDING VISIBLE TO THE STATE, WITH THE TAX AND INHERITANCE CONSEQUENCES THAT FOLLOW. THE PROCEDURE AND EXCLUSIONS COME FROM A JUDICIARY NEWS EXPLAINER AND FROM LAW FIRM AND PRESS SUMMARIES OF THE LEGISLATION, SOME SEVERAL YEARS OLD AND ONE DESCRIBING A SYSTEM RENAMED SINCE - take legal advice on the current system name, deadlines and your own category before filing. Read it with the natural resources and watershed organisation's customary-user priority, the agricultural insurance fund's claim deadline, the farmer-shareholder funds and the agricultural engineering organisation's licence lookup recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Environmental justice atlas — where a community can put its own conflict on a permanent public record, with the investors named
trackers.desc: ONE THING ALMOST EVERY COMMUNITY IN THIS FILE LACKS IS A PERMANENT, PUBLIC, SOURCED RECORD OF WHAT HAPPENED TO IT. THIS ATLAS IS THAT RECORD: MORE THAN THREE THOUSAND DOCUMENTED CONFLICTS SINCE 2012, BUILT BY HUNDREDS OF COLLABORATORS — ACADEMICS, CONCERNED CITIZENS, INFORMAL COMMITTEES, ORGANISATIONS AND ACTIVIST GROUPS. AND IT IS OPEN: ANYONE CAN SET UP AN ACCOUNT AND CONTACT THE EDITORIAL TEAM TO CONTRIBUTE TO THE DATABASE OR TO FLAG UP AGITATIONS HAPPENING AROUND THE WORLD, WITH A PUBLIC COMMENTING FACILITY ON EVERY CONFLICT PAGE. NO REGISTRATION AS AN ORGANISATION, NO LAWYER, NO FEE — AN INFORMAL COMMITTEE IS NAMED AMONG THE CONTRIBUTOR TYPES. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED SCORES OF DOORS CLOSED TO UNREGISTERED GROUPS; THIS ONE IS NOT ONE OF THEM. WHAT THE FORM ASKS FOR IS ITSELF A CHECKLIST OF WHAT A COMMUNITY SHOULD BE COLLECTING ANYWAY: THE NAME AND GEO-LOCATION OF THE CONFLICT, A DESCRIPTION, THE COMMODITIES IN QUESTION, THE ENVIRONMENTAL, HEALTH AND SOCIO-ECONOMIC IMPACTS, THE SOCIAL ACTORS AND THEIR FORMS OF MOBILISATION, THE OUTCOMES, THE SOURCES AND REFERENCES, AND LINKS TO PHOTOGRAPHS OF PROTAGONISTS AND THEIR BANNERS, SLOGANS AND SONGS, AND VIDEOS. PRINT THAT LIST AND FILL IT IN LOCALLY EVEN IF YOU NEVER SUBMIT IT. A GROUP THAT CAN NAME THE COMMODITY, THE ACTORS, THE IMPACTS AND THE DATES IS READY FOR EVERY OTHER FORUM IN THIS PAYLOAD — THE COMPLAINT OFFICES, THE FUNDERS AND THE LAWYERS ALL ASK FOR THE SAME THINGS. THE DATABASE ALSO HOLDS WHAT IS HARDEST TO FIND LOCALLY: INFORMATION ON THE INVESTORS, THE DRIVERS FOR THESE DEALS AND THEIR IMPACTS, PROJECT DETAILS, REFERENCES TO LEGISLATION AND ACADEMIC RESEARCH. SO BEFORE DOCUMENTING YOUR OWN CASE, SEARCH FOR THE COMPANY, THE COMMODITY OR THE PROJECT TYPE. SOMEBODY ELSEWHERE HAS FACED THE SAME OPERATOR OR THE SAME KIND OF SCHEME, AND THEIR PAGE LISTS WHAT WAS TRIED AND WHAT THE OUTCOME WAS. THE MODERATION IS REAL RATHER THAN NOMINAL: DATA ARE DOUBLE-CHECKED AND HOMOGENISED BY AN EDITORIAL TEAM BEFORE A CASE IS APPROVED AND PUBLISHED, AND CASES ARE USUALLY SIGNED BY THE INDIVIDUALS WHO FIRST RESEARCHED AND WROTE THEM. A SIGNED, MODERATED ENTRY CARRIES MORE WEIGHT WITH A JOURNALIST OR AN INTERNATIONAL BODY THAN A SOCIAL MEDIA POST — BUT THE SIGNATURE ALSO MEANS A NAME ATTACHED TO A CONFLICT, WHICH IN SEVERAL COUNTRIES IN THIS PAYLOAD IS A RISK TO WEIGH BEFORE PUBLISHING. THE TEAM'S OWN CAVEATS ARE UNUSUALLY HONEST AND WORTH REPEATING: SOME CASES ARE NOT FULLY UPDATED BECAUSE SITUATIONS CHANGE AND THE MAPPING DEPENDS ON VOLUNTEER TIME; THE CONTEXTUALISATION OF A CASE MAY BE CONTROVERSIAL — ONE EXAMPLE BEING WHEN CONSERVATION CLASHES WITH THE RIGHT OF COMMUNITIES TO UNDERTAKE LIVELIHOOD ACTIVITIES; AND GLOBAL COVERAGE IS UNEVEN, REFLECTING WHERE ITS PARTNERS WORK. THAT LAST POINT IS AN INVITATION RATHER THAN A WARNING FOR THIS REGION, WHICH IS THINLY COVERED: THE BLANK SPACE ON THE MAP IS THE ARGUMENT FOR ADDING YOUR CASE, AND USERS ARE URGED TO CHECK THE LAST UPDATE FIELD AND TO EDIT CASES AS NEW EVENTS OCCUR, OR TO EMAIL UPDATES IF THEY HAVE NO ACCOUNT. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A DOCUMENTATION PROJECT, NOT AN ADVOCATE, A FUNDER OR A REGULATOR - IT CANNOT STOP A PROJECT, PAY A LAWYER OR INTERVENE, AND PUBLICATION ALONE HAS NEVER HALTED ANYTHING. INCLUSION DEPENDS ON COMMUNITY MOBILISATION AND ON HOW CLAIMS ARE FRAMED, SO A DISPUTE WITH NO ORGANISED PUBLIC SIDE MAY NOT QUALIFY. CASES ARE SIGNED AND PUBLIC, WHICH IN SEVERAL COUNTRIES RECORDED HERE CARRIES REAL PERSONAL RISK, AND THE PLATFORM IS HOSTED ABROAD AND MAY BE INACCESSIBLE OR MONITORED IN SOME OF THEM. ENTRIES DEPEND ON VOLUNTEER TIME AND MAY BE OUT OF DATE. THE ACCOUNT COMES FROM THE ATLAS'S OWN ABOUT AND FAQ PAGES ALONGSIDE ACADEMIC AND TOOLKIT DESCRIPTIONS OF VARIOUS YEARS. Read it with the national environment fund's donations channel, the untitled land registration route, the natural resources organisation's customary-user priority and the agricultural insurance claim deadline recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Soil and water research institute and the national laboratory network — published analysis tariffs, provincial centres, and a directory of instruments
trackers.desc: THE PREVIOUS ROUND FOUND REGIONAL LABORATORIES IN ANOTHER COUNTRY BUT COULD NOT ESTABLISH WHETHER A VILLAGE COULD USE THEM OR WHAT THEY CHARGED. HERE BOTH ARE PUBLISHED: THE SOIL AND WATER RESEARCH INSTITUTE PUTS A TARIFF OF ITS TECHNICAL AND LABORATORY SERVICES ON ITS OWN SITE, AND PROVINCIAL AGRICULTURAL RESEARCH CENTRES PUBLISH THEIR OWN SOIL AND WATER LABORATORY TARIFF PAGES. A PUBLISHED PRICE LIST TURNS A FAVOUR INTO A TRANSACTION. A COMMUNITY THAT KNOWS WHAT AN ANALYSIS COSTS CAN BUDGET FOR IT, SPLIT IT BETWEEN HOUSEHOLDS, AND ASK FOR IT WITHOUT NEGOTIATING ACCESS OR OWING ANYBODY A FAVOUR — WHICH IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A RESOURCE AND A RUMOUR OF ONE. THE SECOND FIND IS BIGGER THAN THE INSTITUTE: ITS SOIL AND WATER LABORATORY IS LISTED ON A NATIONAL LABORATORY NETWORK OF STRATEGIC TECHNOLOGIES, WHICH PUBLISHES THE CONTACT INFORMATION AND THE INSTRUMENTS OF EACH LISTED LABORATORY. A DIRECTORY THAT LISTS INSTRUMENTS IS HOW YOU FIND THE MACHINE YOU NEED RATHER THAN THE INSTITUTION YOU HAVE HEARD OF. IF THE QUESTION IS HEAVY METALS, YOU LOOK FOR THE SPECTROMETER; IF IT IS PESTICIDE RESIDUE, THE CHROMATOGRAPH — AND THE DIRECTORY TELLS YOU WHICH BUILDING IN WHICH CITY HAS IT AND WHO ANSWERS THE PHONE. THAT MATTERS MOST WHERE THE OBVIOUS LABORATORY IS THE WRONG ONE TO ASK. A UNIVERSITY OR A NETWORK-LISTED PRIVATE LABORATORY MAY BE ABLE TO RUN A SAMPLE THAT AN AGRICULTURE MINISTRY LABORATORY WOULD RATHER NOT, AND THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED THAT PROBLEM ACROSS THE REGION WITHOUT BEING ABLE TO OFFER A WAY ROUND IT UNTIL NOW. THE INSTITUTIONAL PARENT IS AN AGRICULTURAL RESEARCH, EDUCATION AND EXTENSION ORGANISATION ESTABLISHED BY ACT OF PARLIAMENT IN 1974, WHOSE MANDATE IS TO DEVELOP AND MANAGE ALL RESEARCH ACTIVITIES OF AGRICULTURE AND NATURAL RESOURCES WITHIN THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY, WITH INSTITUTES CLUSTERED BY SUBJECT AND CENTRES IN THE PROVINCES. THE PROVINCIAL CENTRES ARE THE PRACTICAL DOOR. EACH RUNS ITS OWN SITE AND ITS OWN LABORATORY PAGES, WHICH MEANS THE PLACE TO WRITE IS THE PROVINCE'S RESEARCH CENTRE RATHER THAN THE NATIONAL INSTITUTE — SHORTER QUEUE, CLOSER SAMPLES, AND SOMEBODY WHO KNOWS THE LOCAL SOILS. WHAT TO ASK FOR, IN THE ORDER THAT WORKS: THE CURRENT TARIFF, WHICH ANALYSES ARE OFFERED ON WHICH MATRICES — SOIL, WATER, PLANT TISSUE — WHAT SAMPLING AND CONTAINER RULES APPLY, HOW LONG RESULTS TAKE, AND WHAT FORM THE RESULT IS ISSUED IN. THE LAST ONE DECIDES WHETHER THE MONEY WAS WORTH SPENDING. A NUMBER ON A SLIP IS NOT EVIDENCE; A SIGNED, DATED REPORT NAMING THE METHOD, THE INSTRUMENT AND THE SAMPLE IDENTIFIER IS. THE LIMITS: THESE ARE STATE RESEARCH INSTITUTIONS INSIDE THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY'S RESEARCH ORGANISATION - THEY SERVE AGRICULTURE POLICY, EXTENSION AND FARMERS' PRODUCTION QUESTIONS, NOT LITIGATION AGAINST STATE OR INVESTOR PROJECTS, AND NOTHING SUGGESTS THEY WILL TAKE A POSITION IN A DISPUTE. WHETHER AN INDIVIDUAL OR A VILLAGE MAY SUBMIT SAMPLES DIRECTLY, WHETHER RESULTS ARE ISSUED IN A FORM USABLE AS EVIDENCE, AND WHAT THE CURRENT PRICES ARE WERE NOT ESTABLISHED - THE TARIFF PAGES WERE SEEN TO EXIST BUT THEIR CONTENTS WERE NOT READ. SANCTIONS, EQUIPMENT SHORTAGES AND REAGENT SUPPLY AFFECT LABORATORY CAPACITY IN THIS COUNTRY, AND TESTING GROUND NEAR AN OFFICIAL PROJECT CARRIES THE SAME RISKS RECORDED FOR IT ELSEWHERE IN THIS PAYLOAD. Read it with the national environment fund's donations channel, the untitled land registration route, the natural resources organisation's customary-user priority and the environmental justice atlas recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Charity atlas of people's organisations — environmental associations listed province by province, and the public fund that defends rangers
trackers.desc: THE COMMONEST QUESTION IN THIS ENTIRE FILE IS WHO IS ALREADY DOING THIS NEAR ME, AND THIS COUNTRY HAS A DIRECTORY THAT ANSWERS IT: A CHARITY ATLAS WHOSE DATABASE OF PEOPLE'S ORGANISATIONS IS ORGANISED BY AXES OF ACTIVITY, ONE OF WHICH IS THE ENVIRONMENT AND ANIMALS. IT LISTS NAMED LOCAL ASSOCIATIONS WITH THE YEAR EACH BEGAN AND THE PURPOSE IT BEGAN WITH — SUPPORTERS OF ANCIENT HERITAGE, FRIENDS OF GREEN NATURE, AN ENVIRONMENTAL ASSOCIATION FOR ADAPTATION WITH NATURE, A TOURISM ASSOCIATION OF PROTECTORS OF DESERT NATURE, SUPPORTERS OF CULTURAL HERITAGE — SEVERAL OF THEM FOUNDED IN A SINGLE DESERT PROVINCE ACROSS A DECADE. SMALL, LOCAL AND SPECIFIC IS EXACTLY WHAT A COMMUNITY NEEDS. THESE ARE NOT NATIONAL BODIES BUT DISTRICT ASSOCIATIONS WITH REGISTRATION, A NAME AND A HISTORY — WHICH MEANS THEY CAN HOLD A BANK ACCOUNT, SIGN THINGS AND APPLY FOR THE FUNDS THIS FILE HAS RECORDED, ALL OF WHICH A VILLAGE COMMITTEE CANNOT DO ALONE. THE PRACTICAL MOVE IS TO FIND THE NEAREST ONE BY PROVINCE AND ASK WHETHER IT WILL BE THE REGISTERED PARTNER FOR YOUR SITE. THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED FUND AFTER FUND WHOSE ONLY REAL BARRIER WAS THE ABSENCE OF A REGISTERED LOCAL ORGANISATION — THE DIRECTORY IS WHERE ONE IS FOUND. THE SECOND FIND IS RARER AND SAYS SOMETHING ABOUT WHAT PROTECTING LAND COSTS HERE: A FUND SET UP BY YOUNG PEOPLE WHO MET THROUGH ENVIRONMENTAL ORGANISATIONS, ADMINISTERED THROUGH POPULAR SUPPORT, WHOSE WORK IS SUPPORTING RANGERS AND FOREST GUARDS AND SMALL ENVIRONMENTAL SCHEMES. ITS MEMBERS SCATTER SEED FOR BIRDS ON FROZEN WETLANDS AND WATCH FOR FODDER SHORTAGES IN WILDLIFE AREAS — AND THEY GATHER WHENEVER THEY HEAR THAT SOMEONE FROM THE ENVIRONMENTAL COMMUNITY HAS BEEN DETAINED. THAT LAST SENTENCE IS THE ONE TO SIT WITH. IN THIS COUNTRY THE PEOPLE GUARDING PROTECTED LAND ARE THEMSELVES AT RISK OF PROSECUTION AND IMPRISONMENT, AND A FUND EXISTS BECAUSE OF IT. THEY RAISE THE MONEY THROUGH COLLECTIVE GIVING EVENTS — A TRADITIONAL FORM OF POOLED PUBLIC FUNDRAISING — INCLUDING ONE HELD TO SECURE THE RELEASE OF DETAINED RANGERS. THAT FORM IS THE TRANSFERABLE PART. A POOLED GIVING EVENT NEEDS NO REGISTRATION, NO FOREIGN DONOR AND NO PERMISSION FROM ANYONE, AND IT IS HOW MONEY GETS RAISED FOR A LEGAL DEFENCE, A FENCE, A WATER PIPE OR A SURVEY IN A PLACE WHERE FORMAL FUNDING IS CLOSED. ALONGSIDE BOTH SITS THE STATE CHANNEL RECORDED SEPARATELY IN THIS PAYLOAD: THE NATIONAL ENVIRONMENT FUND MAINTAINS A PEOPLE'S CONTRIBUTIONS PAGE, WHICH IS THE OFFICIAL ROUTE FOR DONATIONS AND THE ONE TO USE WHEN A DONOR NEEDS A RECEIPT. THE LIMITS: THE DIRECTORY IS A CHARITY DATABASE, NOT A CONSERVATION NETWORK - MANY LISTED BODIES ARE HERITAGE, WELFARE OR TOURISM ASSOCIATIONS RATHER THAN LAND DEFENDERS, THE ENTRIES SEEN GAVE FOUNDING YEARS AND STATED PURPOSES BUT NOT CONTACT DETAILS OR CURRENT STATUS, AND WHETHER THE LISTINGS ARE MAINTAINED WAS NOT ESTABLISHED. THE SOLIDARITY FUND IS DESCRIBED IN A DIASPORA NEWS FEATURE RATHER THAN BY ITSELF; ITS CURRENT EXISTENCE, ITS SIZE AND HOW TO REACH IT WERE NOT ESTABLISHED, AND FOR OBVIOUS REASONS SUCH A FUND MAY NOT WANT TO BE EASILY REACHABLE. ASSOCIATION WITH DETAINED ENVIRONMENTALISTS CARRIES SERIOUS RISK IN THIS COUNTRY, WHICH THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED ELSEWHERE. A PROMINENT WILDLIFE FOUNDATION WAS ALSO REVIEWED THIS ROUND AND LEFT OUT: PUBLISHED CRITICISM ACCUSES IT OF SELLING AND DEVELOPING TROPHY HUNTING ALONGSIDE ITS CONSERVATION WORK, WHICH IS NOT A BODY THIS FILE WILL RECOMMEND WITHOUT MORE. Read it with the national environment fund's donations channel, the untitled land registration route, the soil and water laboratories' tariffs and the environmental justice atlas recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Village administration — a village-level legal person that buys, leases and mortgages property and issues subdivision permits
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE SMALLEST BODY IN THIS ENTIRE PAYLOAD THAT CAN OWN AND TRADE LAND IN ITS OWN NAME. UNDER A SINGLE-ARTICLE LAW OF 1998 THE INTERIOR MINISTRY MAY ESTABLISH IN VILLAGES AN ORGANISATION CALLED A DEHYARI - ACCORDING TO THE LOCAL SITUATION, AT THE REQUEST OF THE INHABITANTS, SELF-SUFFICIENT, AND WITH INDEPENDENT LEGAL PERSONALITY. AT THE REQUEST OF THE INHABITANTS IS THE PHRASE THAT MAKES IT A RESOURCE RATHER THAN AN IMPOSITION: THE VILLAGE ASKS FOR IT, AND WHAT IT GETS IS RANKED EQUIVALENT IN STATUS TO THE MUNICIPALITY IN CITIES. ITS CHARACTER IS UNUSUAL AND WORTH READING TWICE: A PUBLIC NON-GOVERNMENTAL INSTITUTION WHOSE SELF-SUFFICIENT NATURE GIVES IT A POSITION INDEPENDENT OF THE GOVERNMENT, RELATIVE TO THE COUNTRY'S OTHER EXECUTIVE AGENCIES WHICH ARE GOVERNMENTAL AND GOVERNMENT-APPOINTED. THE POWERS THAT MATTER TO ANYONE DEFENDING GROUND COME FIRST: CARRYING OUT VILLAGE TRANSACTIONS INCLUDING THE PURCHASE AND SALE OF MOVABLE AND IMMOVABLE PROPERTY, MORTGAGE AND LEASE. A VILLAGE BODY THAT MAY BUY AND LEASE LAND IS THE THING THIS FILE HAS SPENT HUNDREDS OF ROUNDS LOOKING FOR ELSEWHERE. WHERE A PARCEL MUST NOT PASS TO A DEVELOPER, THE QUESTION IS WHETHER THE VILLAGE'S OWN ADMINISTRATION CAN TAKE IT INSTEAD. THE SECOND SET OF POWERS DECIDES WHAT IS BUILT: ISSUING BUILDING PERMITS AND PERMITS FOR THE SUBDIVISION OF LAND, ALONGSIDE WASTE MANAGEMENT, SAFETY AND FIREFIGHTING, CEMETERY MANAGEMENT, IMPLEMENTING THE RESOLUTIONS OF THE VILLAGE ISLAMIC COUNCIL AND COLLECTING APPROVED LEVIES. SUBDIVISION PERMITS ARE HOW FARMLAND BECOMES PLOTS. THAT THE PERMIT SITS WITH THE VILLAGE'S OWN ADMINISTRATION RATHER THAN A DISTANT OFFICE IS THE MOST IMPORTANT SINGLE FACT ABOUT LAND CONVERSION IN RURAL PARTS OF THIS COUNTRY - AND IT MEANS THE PEOPLE WHO ISSUE IT LIVE AMONG THOSE AFFECTED. ONE DUTY IS A MONEY ROUTE MOST COMMUNITIES OVERLOOK: FOLLOWING UP AND ASSISTING IN THE CREATION OF CHARITABLE INSTITUTIONS, INTEREST-FREE LOAN FUNDS AND CULTURAL INSTITUTIONS. AN INTEREST-FREE LOAN FUND ESTABLISHED WITH THE VILLAGE ADMINISTRATION'S HELP IS LOCAL CAPITAL UNDER LOCAL CONTROL - WHICH IS HOW A COMMUNITY BUYS A WELL, A PUMP OR A PIECE OF GROUND WITHOUT WAITING FOR A DONOR. TWO MORE DUTIES ARE PRACTICAL: COOPERATING IN THE MAINTENANCE AND LEVELLING OF ROADS WITHIN THE BOUNDARY OF THE VILLAGE'S LANDS THROUGH THE SELF-HELP OF THE INHABITANTS, AND ASSISTING FARMERS IN PRESENTING THE VILLAGE'S AGRICULTURAL, INDUSTRIAL AND HANDICRAFT PRODUCTS IN URBAN CENTRES AND EXHIBITIONS. AND IT ANSWERS TO THE ELECTED COUNCIL IN WRITING: A MONTHLY REPORT OF ITS ACTIVITIES TO THE COUNCIL WITH A COPY TO THE DISTRICT GOVERNOR, REQUESTED REPORTS WITHIN THE APPOINTED TIME, AND ATTENDANCE TO ANSWER QUESTIONS WHENEVER THE COUNCIL ASKS. A MONTHLY WRITTEN REPORT IS A DOCUMENT THAT EXISTS WHETHER OR NOT ANYONE READS IT. ASKING THE COUNCIL FOR IT IS THE CHEAPEST WAY TO LEARN WHAT PERMITS WERE ISSUED AND WHAT WAS BOUGHT OR LEASED IN YOUR VILLAGE THIS MONTH. THE GUIDANCE FOR THE POST DESCRIBES A METHOD WORTH HOLDING THE HOLDER TO: HE MUST KNOW THE VILLAGE'S INCOME SOURCES AND ACTIVITIES, KNOW ITS PROBLEMS AND NEEDS, PRIORITISE THEM BY CONSULTING AND SEEKING THE OPINION OF THE PEOPLE, AND FIND WORKABLE SOLUTIONS THROUGH COMMITTEES MADE UP OF THE PEOPLE AND THE OFFICIALS. THE LIMITS: THE ADMINISTRATION IS ESTABLISHED BY THE INTERIOR MINISTRY AND ITS HEAD IS APPOINTED ON THE PROPOSAL OF THE VILLAGE COUNCIL, NOT DIRECTLY ELECTED - SELF-SUFFICIENT ALSO MEANS SELF-FINANCING, SO SMALL VILLAGES OFTEN HAVE LITTLE MONEY AND DEPEND ON LEVIES AND TRANSFERS. THE SAME BODY THAT COULD BUY LAND TO PROTECT IT IS THE BODY THAT ISSUES THE SUBDIVISION PERMITS THAT DESTROY IT, AND THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS ELSEWHERE THAT RURAL LAND CONVERSION IN THIS COUNTRY IS WIDESPREAD AND CONTESTED. WHETHER A VILLAGE CAN COMPEL THE CREATION OF AN ADMINISTRATION, HOW MANY EXIST, WHAT THE HEAD IS PAID AND WHETHER RESIDENTS MAY SEE THE MONTHLY REPORTS WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED. THE DUTIES COME FROM AN ARTICLE OF THE DEHYARI STATUTE REPRODUCED ON A PROVINCIAL VILLAGE SITE, A COMMERCIAL RURAL-SOFTWARE COMPANY'S GUIDE AND A STATE BROADCASTER'S EXPLAINER OF 2021, NOT FROM THE MINISTRY'S OWN CURRENT PUBLICATION. Read it with the endowments organisation where a single tree can be endowed, the charity atlas of people's organisations, the soil and water laboratories' tariffs and the environmental justice atlas recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Provincial networks of environmental organisations — seats in the planning council, a legal working group for lawsuits, and environment houses in village administrations
trackers.desc: THE STRONGEST FACT IN THIS ROUND IS ABOUT WHERE THESE ORGANISATIONS SIT: POPULAR ORGANISATIONS TAKE PART AS REPRESENTATIVES OF THE PEOPLE EVEN IN OFFICIAL GOVERNMENT DECISION-MAKING MEETINGS, IN THE PROVINCIAL PLANNING COUNCIL AND IN THE WASTE MANAGEMENT WORKING GROUP. THE PROVINCIAL PLANNING COUNCIL IS WHERE A PROVINCE'S PROJECTS AND BUDGETS ARE SETTLED. A COMMUNITY THAT CANNOT GET INTO THAT ROOM CAN REACH SOMEONE WHO IS ALREADY IN IT - AND THE ROUTE IS THE PROVINCE'S NETWORK OF ENVIRONMENTAL ORGANISATIONS.
