THE ACTUAL PERMITTING REGIME — THE ONE A DEVELOPER MUST PASS THROUGH — WAS NOT RECORDED AT ALL. EVERYTHING STARTS WITH ONE DOCUMENT: AN ENVIRONMENTAL CLASSIFICATION FORM, SUBMITTED TO THE NATIONAL CENTRE TO DETERMINE HOW THE PROPOSED ACTIVITY IS CLASSIFIED AND WHETHER IT REQUIRES AN IMPACT ASSESSMENT AT ALL. THE FIRST QUESTION ABOUT ANY SCHEME IS THEREFORE WHICH CATEGORY IT WAS PLACED IN, because that single decision determines whether a study is ever written. CATEGORY TWO ACTIVITIES REQUIRE THE CENTRE'S APPROVAL OF AN IMPACT ASSESSMENT. AND FOR CATEGORY THREE — THE LIGHTER CLASS — THE CENTRE MAY STILL REQUIRE AN ASSESSMENT IF IT SEES THE NEED. THAT DISCRETION IS THE OPENING: A COMMUNITY CAN ASK THE CENTRE TO REQUIRE AN ASSESSMENT FOR A SCHEME CLASSIFIED TOO LIGHTLY, rather than arguing about a study that was never commissioned. TWO PERMITS EXIST, NOT ONE: AN ENVIRONMENTAL PERMIT TO CONSTRUCT, AND AN ENVIRONMENTAL PERMIT TO OPERATE, THE LATTER GRANTED ONLY AFTER CONSTRUCTION IS COMPLETE AND THE APPLICANT HAS COMPLIED WITH ALL THE PERMIT'S REQUIREMENTS. SO A BUILT FACILITY IS NOT YET A LAWFUL ONE. AND A NEW PERMIT IS REQUIRED BEFORE ANY MODIFICATION TO THE TYPE OR SIZE OF THE ACTIVITY — which is the provision to raise when a plant quietly expands, changes process, or increases throughput beyond what was assessed. THE ENFORCEMENT HOOK IS EXPLICIT: WHERE THE CENTRE APPROVES THE ASSESSMENT AND ISSUES THE CONSTRUCTION PERMIT, THE APPLICANT UNDERTAKES TO IMPLEMENT THE STUDY'S RESULTS AND RECOMMENDATIONS. THE MITIGATION MEASURES IN THE STUDY ARE NOT ASPIRATIONS — THEY ARE UNDERTAKINGS, and non-implementation is a breach to report rather than a disappointment to absorb. THERE IS ALSO A CLOCK WORTH KNOWING: THE CENTRE REVIEWS THE ASSESSMENT'S SCOPE REPORT AND EITHER APPROVES IT OR PROVIDES COMMENTS WITHIN FIFTEEN WORKING DAYS OF RECEIPT. THE SCOPE REPORT DECIDES WHAT THE STUDY WILL AND WILL NOT EXAMINE, so it is the stage at which an omitted receptor — a spring, a grazing route, a settlement — can still be added. AND WHO MAY WRITE THE STUDY IS TIGHTLY DEFINED, WHICH GIVES A CHECKABLE OBJECTION: THE PREPARING BODY MUST NAME THE STAFF WHO WILL PREPARE THE ASSESSMENT INSIDE THE NON-TECHNICAL SUMMARY, WITH QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE MATCHING THE NATURE OF THE STUDY, AND MUST PROVE COOPERATION WITH QUALIFIED ENTITIES FOR SPECIALISED WORK IT CANNOT DO ITSELF. FOR HOUSES OF EXPERTISE, ALL MEMBERS MUST HOLD AT LEAST ASSISTANT PROFESSOR RANK IN ENVIRONMENTAL FIELDS, with three faculty members including a named principal who is directly responsible, and foreign firms must show completion certificates for at least five projects over ten years. SO READ THE NON-TECHNICAL SUMMARY FIRST — IT MUST NAME THE AUTHORS. If the study covers hydrology, ecology and air quality but the named team has no such qualifications, and no cooperating specialist is evidenced, that is a defect in the submission itself. THE LIMITS: this is the regulator that issues the permits, not an ally — it approves schemes as well as assessing them, and nothing here obliges it to refuse one. Public consultation and third-party objection arrangements were NOT VERIFIED in this round, and this entry rests on the regulation and the centre's published consultant requirements rather than on observed practice. Read it with the research laboratories and the legal routes recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Unified procurement platform — the list of competitions not yet issued, open to anyone who visits
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE EARLIEST WARNING RECORDED ANYWHERE IN THIS PAYLOAD. THE PLATFORM CARRIES A FUTURE COMPETITIONS SERVICE — A PUBLISHED LIST OF THE COMPETITIONS GOVERNMENT ENTITIES PLAN TO RUN, BEFORE THEY HAVE BEEN ISSUED. EARLIER THAN A PREQUALIFICATION NOTICE, EARLIER THAN A TENDER: THE INTENTION TO PROCURE, PUBLISHED IN ADVANCE. A COMMUNITY THAT READS THAT LIST LEARNS WHAT AN AUTHORITY MEANS TO BUILD, SURVEY OR DEMOLISH WHILE THE DECISION IS STILL AT THE PLANNING STAGE. AND IT IS NOT RESERVED FOR CONTRACTORS. THE SERVICE FOR VIEWING ANNOUNCED COMPETITIONS IS OPEN TO REGISTERED SUPPLIERS, TO GOVERNMENT ENTITIES, AND TO INDIVIDUAL VISITORS TO THE SYSTEM — GIVING THE DETAILS OF A SPECIFIC COMPETITION WITHOUT ANY NEED TO APPROACH THE ENTITY CONCERNED. THAT LAST CLAUSE IS WORTH DWELLING ON. A RESIDENT CAN READ WHAT AN AUTHORITY IS COMMISSIONING WITHOUT ASKING IT ANYTHING, WITHOUT EXPLAINING WHY, AND WITHOUT LEAVING A TRACE OF INTEREST — which in this region is often the difference between finding out and being noticed finding out. THE RESULTS SIDE IS SEARCHABLE TOO: COMPETITIONS CAN BE FILTERED BY STATUS, INCLUDING AWARDED. SO THE SAME PLATFORM ANSWERS BOTH QUESTIONS — WHAT IS COMING, AND WHO GOT IT. IF A LOCAL BODY WANTS TO BID RATHER THAN ONLY WATCH, THE COSTS ARE MODEST AND PUBLISHED: REGISTRATION AND PREQUALIFICATION ARE FREE, AND FEES ARISE ONLY ON THE CONDITIONS AND SPECIFICATIONS BOOKLET, WHICH VARIES, AND ON GUARANTEES TIED TO THE VALUE OF THE BID. PREQUALIFICATION TAKES ONE TO THREE WEEKS, RISING TO ABOUT SIX FOR COMPLEX ACTIVITIES SUCH AS MAJOR CONSTRUCTION. SO PREQUALIFY BEFORE THERE IS ANYTHING TO BID FOR. IT COSTS NOTHING, IT TAKES WEEKS RATHER THAN DAYS, AND IT IS THE SAME LESSON THIS FILE HAS NOW RECORDED FOUR TIMES OVER — deposits, tokens, powers of attorney, prequalification: THE APPARATUS FOR ACTING MUST EXIST BEFORE THERE IS ANYTHING TO ACT ON. THERE IS NO LIMIT ON HOW MANY COMPETITIONS A SUPPLIER MAY ENTER, THOUGH EACH WIN CARRIES AN OPERATIONAL COMMITMENT AND A FINAL GUARANTEE OF ABOUT FIVE PER CENT — so a small cooperative should bid for what it can actually deliver. AND SET THE ALERTS: A REGISTERED USER CAN RECEIVE A NOTIFICATION THE MOMENT A COMPETITION IS PUBLISHED IN THEIR FIELD. A STANDING ALERT ON CONSTRUCTION, SURVEY OR ENVIRONMENTAL WORK IS A FREE MONITORING SERVICE FOR A WHOLE REGION. THE LIMITS: this is a purchasing platform — it exists to buy, and NOTHING IN IT CREATES A RIGHT TO OBJECT to a contract or a project. Some services and alerts require registration through the national identity system. The cost and timing figures come from a commercial guide rather than the platform itself and should be confirmed. Read it with the environmental permitting regime, the heritage society and the free legal routes recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Vegetation cover centre — the body for ordinary ground outside the reserves, with a reporting line and seed banks
trackers.desc: READ THE REMIT CAREFULLY, BECAUSE ONE PHRASE IN IT IS WHY THIS ENTRY EXISTS: THIS CENTRE SUPERVISES RANGELAND, FOREST AND NATIONAL PARK LANDS AND CONSERVES PLANT GENETIC RESOURCES AND VEGETATION COVER OUTSIDE THE PROTECTED AREAS, IN ALL ENVIRONMENTS, AND COMBATS DESERTIFICATION. OUTSIDE THE PROTECTED AREAS IS ORDINARY GROUND — THE LAND WITH NO RESERVE STATUS, WHICH IN MOST COUNTRIES HAS NO INSTITUTIONAL DEFENDER AT ALL. ALMOST EVERY CONSERVATION BODY IN THIS FILE PROTECTS DESIGNATED SITES; THIS ONE IS RESPONSIBLE FOR THE REST. THERE IS A PUBLISHED LINE FOR ENQUIRIES AND REPORTS, AND A PAGE SETTING OUT VIOLATIONS AND WHAT FOLLOWS FROM THEM: THE VIOLATOR IS REQUIRED TO REMOVE THE VIOLATION, REPAIR THE DAMAGE AND PAY COMPENSATION. THE LISTED VIOLATIONS INCLUDE GRAZING CAMELS AND CATTLE INSIDE RANGELAND RESERVES WITHOUT A LICENCE AND THE ENTRY OF VEHICLES INTO PROTECTED WILD MEADOWS AND DEPRESSIONS, INCLUDING VEHICLES NOT COVERED BY A GRAZING PERMIT. REMOVAL, REPAIR AND COMPENSATION TOGETHER ARE MORE THAN A FINE. A REPORT THAT LEADS TO A REQUIREMENT TO RESTORE THE DAMAGED GROUND IS WORTH MAKING, AND VEHICLE DAMAGE TO WILD MEADOWS IS THE KIND OF HARM COMMUNITIES SEE CONSTANTLY AND ASSUME NOBODY RECORDS. WHAT THE CENTRE HOLDS IS EQUALLY USABLE: NURSERIES, HERBARIA AND SEED BANKS PRODUCING SEEDLINGS OF WILD AND COASTAL PLANTS — INCLUDING SALT-TOLERANT SPECIES AND MANGROVES — ALONGSIDE SEED MULTIPLICATION CENTRES. A COMMUNITY REPLANTING DEGRADED GROUND CAN ASK THE STATE BODY THAT GROWS NATIVE STOCK FOR THAT STOCK, rather than buying ornamentals that will not survive. GRAZING IS PLANNED BY NUMBERS: ANNUAL GRAZING PLANS ARE SET ACCORDING TO CARRYING-CAPACITY STUDIES FOR EACH REGION. A PUBLISHED STOCKING FIGURE IS A MEASURABLE STANDARD — ASK FOR THE CARRYING-CAPACITY STUDY FOR YOUR REGION, because it states what the land can bear, and any use that exceeds it is arguable on the state's own figures. ENCROACHMENT IS ADDRESSED DIRECTLY: THERE ARE PROCEDURES AND CONTROLS FOR REMOVING ENCROACHMENTS FROM VEGETATION-COVER LANDS AND REQUIREMENTS FOR THEIR REHABILITATION AFTERWARDS. REMOVAL WITHOUT REHABILITATION LEAVES BARE GROUND THAT IS TAKEN AGAIN; the rehabilitation requirement is the half worth insisting on. AND PLANTING ON THESE LANDS IS LICENSED ON EVIDENCE: A TECHNICAL STUDY MUST DETAIL THE SITE, THE SPECIES AND NUMBER OF TREES OR SHRUBS, THE EQUIPMENT, THE DURATION, THE IRRIGATION METHOD, THE MEANS OF SUSTAINING THE COVER AND THE ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT. THAT IS ALSO A CHECKLIST FOR TESTING SOMEONE ELSE'S GREENING SCHEME — ask which species, how many, watered how, and sustained by whom. THE LIMITS: this is a state centre that both PROTECTS AND INVESTS — it manages the commercial exploitation of rangelands and parks as well as their conservation, and licences camping, environmental contracting and firewood trading on the same lands. NOTHING HERE CREATES A RIGHT TO STOP A PROJECT, and whether a report from a member of the public is acted on WAS NOT VERIFIED. Read it with the accredited environmental associations, the environmental permitting regime and the procurement platform recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Reserve nursery and seed bank — a million native seedlings, 70 projects supplied, and the pipeline set out step by step
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HAS NOW RECORDED SEED BANKS AND NATIVE NURSERIES IN FOUR COUNTRIES. THIS ONE IS DIFFERENT BECAUSE ITS OUTPUT IS COUNTED AND ITS PIPELINE IS PUBLISHED, WHICH MAKES IT THE MODEL TO POINT AT WHEN SOMEBODY SAYS NATIVE PLANTING IS NOT PRACTICAL AT SCALE. A REGIONAL COMMISSION'S NURSERY AND SEED BANK FOR THE PLANTS OF ITS NATURE RESERVES HAS PRODUCED ONE MILLION SEEDLINGS SINCE IT BEGAN IN OCTOBER 2021 — EXPANDING FROM SEVEN LOCAL PLANT SPECIES TO ABOUT ONE HUNDRED, COVERING TREES, SHRUBS AND GROUND COVER ADAPTED TO THE LOCAL ENVIRONMENT. SEVEN SPECIES TO A HUNDRED IN UNDER FIVE YEARS. A COMMUNITY OR MUNICIPALITY TOLD THAT ONLY A HANDFUL OF NATIVE SPECIES CAN BE PROPAGATED HAS A COUNTER-EXAMPLE WITH DATES ATTACHED — and the growth came from working through species one at a time, not from a single decision. MORE THAN SIX HUNDRED AND FIFTY THOUSAND OF THOSE SEEDLINGS HAVE GONE TO MORE THAN SEVENTY PROJECTS, COVERING BOTH SITE LANDSCAPING AND ECOLOGICAL RESTORATION. SEVENTY PROJECTS SUPPLIED FROM ONE NURSERY IS WHAT A WORKING NATIVE-PLANT SUPPLY CHAIN LOOKS LIKE, AND IT IS THE NUMBER TO CITE WHEN A DEVELOPER CLAIMS NATIVE STOCK IS UNAVAILABLE AND ORNAMENTALS MUST BE USED INSTEAD. THE SEED BANK BEHIND IT COLLECTS AND CONSERVES THE SEEDS OF ONE HUNDRED AND SIXTY-THREE LOCAL PLANT SPECIES, GATHERED FROM MULTIPLE SITES ACROSS THE GOVERNORATE AND ITS RESERVES — SO THE MATERIAL IS PROVENANCED BY PLACE, NOT MERELY BY SPECIES, which is what makes replanting genetically appropriate rather than merely green. AND THE PIPELINE IS SET OUT STEP BY STEP, WHICH IS THE PART WORTH COPYING ANYWHERE: FIELD SEED COLLECTION; DRYING AND PROCESSING; GERMINATION VIABILITY TESTING; STORAGE IN THE SEED BANK; PROPAGATION INSIDE GREENHOUSES; AND PREPARATION FOR USE IN ECOLOGICAL RESTORATION PROJECTS — ALL SUPPORTED BY DIGITAL SYSTEMS AND AUTOMATED CONTROL FOR QUALITY AND RESOURCE EFFICIENCY. NOTE THE THIRD STEP IN PARTICULAR. GERMINATION VIABILITY TESTING IS THE ONE MOST COMMUNITY PLANTING EFFORTS SKIP, AND IT IS WHY SO MANY OF THEM FAIL: SEED THAT WAS NEVER TESTED IS PLANTED, NOTHING COMES UP, AND THE CONCLUSION DRAWN IS THAT RESTORATION DOES NOT WORK. ASK ANY NURSERY YOU DEAL WITH WHETHER IT TESTS VIABILITY, AND ASK FOR THE RATE. THE LIMITS: this is a REGIONAL COMMISSION'S OWN FACILITY SERVING ITS OWN RESERVES AND PROJECTS — WHETHER IT SUPPLIES SEEDLINGS OUTSIDE THAT AREA, OR TO COMMUNITY GROUPS RATHER THAN COMMISSION PROJECTS, WAS NOT VERIFIED, and the figures come from press coverage rather than a services page. Producing seedlings creates NO RIGHT TO OBJECT to anything, and a landscaped site is not a protected one. Read it with the national vegetation cover centre, the accredited environmental associations and the environmental permitting regime recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: National wildlife centre — where to report, what the reserves must file monthly, and the power to close a species to hunting
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE BODY THAT SUPERVISES AND MANAGES THE PROTECTED AREAS, PROTECTS TERRESTRIAL AND MARINE WILDLIFE INCLUDING PLANTS, AND WORKS TO RETURN ENDANGERED SPECIES TO THEIR NATURAL HABITATS. IT WAS ESTABLISHED BY COUNCIL OF MINISTERS APPROVAL IN MARCH 2019 AND SITS INSIDE THE ENVIRONMENT MINISTRY SYSTEM. ITS PUBLIC ANSWERS ARE UNUSUALLY DIRECT, AND TWO OF THEM ARE USABLE IMMEDIATELY. NETTING MIGRATORY BIRDS ON PRIVATE OR RENTED FARMS IS A VIOLATION AND OVERHUNTING, CARRYING HEAVY PENALTIES. AND ON A PROVEN VIOLATION, THE SEIZED CREATURES AND ALL THE TOOLS USED ARE HELD AT THE VIOLATOR'S OWN EXPENSE, WITH THE CENTRE FREE TO DISPOSE OF THEM. THAT THE OFFENCE APPLIES ON PRIVATE AND RENTED FARMLAND IS THE POINT WORTH CARRYING. A FENCE DOES NOT MAKE WHAT HAPPENS INSIDE IT PRIVATE WHERE PROTECTED SPECIES ARE CONCERNED — SO NETTING ON A LEASED HOLDING NEXT DOOR IS REPORTABLE, NOT SOMEBODY ELSE'S BUSINESS. IT ALSO PUBLISHES THE LINE BETWEEN LAWFUL AND UNLAWFUL IN A FORM ANYONE CAN CHECK: ABOUT TWENTY-NINE BIRD SPECIES ARE LISTED AS PERMITTED TO HUNT IN A HUNTER'S BOOKLET PUBLISHED ON ITS PLATFORM. A SPECIES THAT IS NOT ON THAT LIST IS NOT HUNTABLE — WHICH TURNS AN ARGUMENT ABOUT WHAT IS ALLOWED INTO A CHECK AGAINST A PUBLISHED DOCUMENT. AND THE CENTRE'S REASONING ON MIGRATORY BIRDS IS WORTH BORROWING WHOLESALE, BECAUSE IT CONNECTS WILDLIFE TO FARMING: DECLINING NUMBERS CAUSE ENVIRONMENTAL HARM AND UPSET THE ECOLOGICAL BALANCE, INCREASING THE INSECTS THAT DAMAGE VEGETATION COVER. THAT IS THE ARGUMENT THAT PERSUADES FARMERS WHO CARE NOTHING FOR BIRDS. NOW THE RECORDS TRAIL, WHICH IS THE MOST USEFUL THING HERE. A LICENSEE HOLDING A PRIVATE HUNTING RESERVE MUST APPOINT MONITORS AND SUPERVISORS TO ENSURE HUNTING STAYS WITHIN ITS BOUNDARIES AND THAT NO PROHIBITED METHODS OR CLOSED SEASONS ARE BREACHED, MUST INFORM THE CENTRE OF ANY VIOLATIONS OCCURRING INSIDE IT — AND MUST SUBMIT MONTHLY REPORTS GIVING THE HUNTERS' NAMES AND LICENCE NUMBERS AND THE NUMBER OF EACH SPECIES HUNTED OR FOUND DEAD. MONTHLY RETURNS NAMING HUNTERS AND COUNTING EVERY ANIMAL TAKEN OR FOUND DEAD ARE A DOCUMENTARY SERIES ABOUT A PARTICULAR PIECE OF GROUND, HELD BY THE REGULATOR. THIS FILE HAS SAID REPEATEDLY THAT THE PARTY WITH THE EARLIER MEASUREMENT WINS THE ARGUMENT ABOUT CHANGE — ASK WHETHER THOSE RETURNS EXIST FOR THE RESERVE NEAR YOU, AND WHAT THEY SHOW OVER TIME. AND THE CENTRE HOLDS A POWER WORTH KNOWING ABOUT: IT MAINTAINS THE LISTS OF SPECIES PROHIBITED AND PERMITTED TO HUNT, INCLUDING MIGRATORY BIRDS, AND MAY ISSUE DECISIONS TO BAN HUNTING OF ANY SPECIES — TEMPORARILY OR PERMANENTLY — THAT IT CONSIDERS IMPORTANT FOR ECOLOGICAL BALANCE. IT ALSO COORDINATES WITH THE VEGETATION COVER CENTRE ALREADY RECORDED IN THIS FILE, AND OPERATES A VIOLATIONS COMMITTEE AND INSPECTORS. SO WHERE A SPECIES ON YOUR GROUND IS BEING TAKEN, THE ASK IS NOT ONLY ENFORCEMENT BUT A LISTING DECISION — AND THE ARGUMENT THAT WINS IT IS ECOLOGICAL BALANCE, WHICH IS THE CENTRE'S OWN STATED TEST. THE LIMITS: this is A REGULATOR OF WILDLIFE AND PROTECTED AREAS, NOT A PLANNING BODY — it does not decide whether land is built on, and nothing here creates a right to object to a development. ITS SERVICES ARE LARGELY LICENSING for individuals, business and government, and WHETHER THE MONTHLY RESERVE REPORTS ARE OBTAINABLE BY THE PUBLIC WAS NOT VERIFIED — that is the question on which the most useful part of this entry depends. Read it with the vegetation cover centre, the reserve nursery and seed bank, the accredited associations directory and the environmental permitting routes recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Rural agricultural support programme — monthly cash, free or subsidised inputs, and the name-mismatch that kills most applications
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HAS ARGUED IN A DOZEN COUNTRIES THAT INCOME IS WHAT KEEPS PEOPLE ON LAND. HERE IS A STATE PROGRAMME THAT PAYS IT MONTHLY: DIRECT CASH TO COVER OPERATING COSTS AND LIVING CONDITIONS, PAID FROM THE FIRST TO THE TENTH OF EACH MONTH STRAIGHT INTO THE BENEFICIARY'S BANK ACCOUNT. WHO IT IS FOR IS DEFINED BY SMALLNESS, WHICH IS UNUSUAL AND USEFUL: SMALL FARMERS HOLDING SMALL AREAS WHO DEPEND ON FARMING AS THEIR MAIN INCOME; LIVESTOCK KEEPERS WITH LIMITED NUMBERS OF ANIMALS; FISH PRODUCERS WITH SMALL OR MEDIUM FARMS; RURAL FAMILIES; AND YOUNG PEOPLE STARTING OUT — WITH RURAL WOMEN EXPLICITLY SUPPORTED FOR AGRICULTURAL AND CRAFT PROJECTS. AND IT GIVES FOUR DIFFERENT THINGS, NOT ONE: DIRECT CASH; SOFT FINANCING AND LOANS WITH FLEXIBLE TERMS AND GRACE PERIODS; TRAINING IN MODERN AGRICULTURE, FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT AND MARKETING; AND PRODUCTION INPUTS — SEEDS, FERTILISERS, TOOLS, FEED, LIVESTOCK AND BEEKEEPING EQUIPMENT — AT SUBSIDISED PRICES OR FREE TO THOSE ENTITLED. FREE OR SUBSIDISED SEED, FEED AND HIVES IS THE PART TO ASK FOR FIRST. IT REQUIRES NO REPAYMENT, IT ARRIVES AS GOODS RATHER THAN MONEY, AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED THAT INPUT SUPPORT IS THE EASIEST FORM OF HELP FOR ANY AGENCY TO GRANT AND THE HARDEST FOR A HOUSEHOLD TO REPLACE. KNOW THE CEILINGS BEFORE PLANNING AROUND IT: A MAXIMUM OF THREE PROGRAMMES A YEAR, AND ANNUAL SUPPORT NOT EXCEEDING FIFTY-FOUR THOUSAND RIYALS. THAT IS A REAL SUM FOR A SMALLHOLDING AND A CEILING WORTH DESIGNING AN APPLICATION AROUND — THREE WELL-CHOSEN PROGRAMMES BEAT ONE AMBITIOUS ONE. THE DOCUMENT LIST IS LONG BUT KNOWABLE: NATIONAL IDENTITY DOCUMENT; FOR SOME CATEGORIES A DECLARATION OF NOT OWNING AGRICULTURAL LAND; A PROFESSIONAL PRACTICE LICENCE; A FEASIBILITY STUDY; CURRICULUM VITAE AND ANY TRAINING CERTIFICATES; DECLARATIONS OF RESIDENCE AND WORK AND OF NOT RECEIVING OTHER GOVERNMENT SUPPORT; REGISTRATION ON THE JOBSEEKER PLATFORM; A PRODUCTIVE-FAMILIES REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE FOR THAT CATEGORY; AND PHOTOGRAPHS OF THE ACTUAL ACTIVITY — THE FARM, THE BEEHIVES, THE PRODUCTION SITE. PHOTOGRAPH THE ACTIVITY PROPERLY AND EARLY. DATED PICTURES OF HIVES, ANIMALS AND PLOTS SERVE TWICE OVER: THEY SATISFY THIS APPLICATION, AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED IN EVERY COUNTRY THAT THEY ARE ALSO THE EVIDENCE OF WHAT EXISTED BEFORE ANY PROJECT TOOK THE GROUND. NOW THE SINGLE MOST USEFUL SENTENCE IN THIS ENTRY, BECAUSE IT IS THE COMMONEST REASON DESERVING APPLICATIONS FAIL: ANY MISMATCH BETWEEN THE APPLICANT'S NAME ON THE IDENTITY DOCUMENT, ON THE AGRICULTURAL REGISTER AND ON THE BANK ACCOUNT STOPS THE APPLICATION IMMEDIATELY. SO CHECK THE THREE NAMES AGAINST EACH OTHER BEFORE APPLYING, AND FIX THE REGISTER OR THE ACCOUNT FIRST. A HOUSEHOLD REJECTED FOR A SPELLING DIFFERENCE USUALLY BELIEVES IT WAS REJECTED ON MERIT AND DOES NOT APPLY AGAIN — WHICH IS HOW ENTITLEMENTS GO UNCLAIMED. THE LIMITS: this is A PRODUCTION AND INCOME SUBSIDY, NOT A LAND-TENURE OR CONSERVATION PROGRAMME — it will not defend a holding, and note that SOME CATEGORIES REQUIRE A DECLARATION OF NOT OWNING AGRICULTURAL LAND, so eligibility may cut against landholders. NATIONALITY CONDITIONS APPLY. THE FIGURES, SCHEDULE AND DOCUMENT LIST COME FROM GUIDANCE SITES AND SERVICE BROKERS RATHER THAN THE PROGRAMME'S OWN PAGES AND MAY BE WRONG OR OUT OF DATE — verify every requirement on the official portal before relying on it, and be wary of paid intermediaries. Read it with the accredited associations directory, the reserve nursery and seed bank, the wildlife centre and the vegetation cover centre recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Environmental compliance centre — a three-digit reporting line and app service, published response volumes, and a public air quality index
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY HAS A NATIONAL ENVIRONMENTAL REPORTING CHANNEL THAT ANY RESIDENT CAN USE WITHOUT INTRODUCTION, AND IT PUBLISHES WHAT IT DOES WITH THE REPORTS. THE SERVICE RUNS THROUGH THE NATIONAL GOVERNMENT APPLICATION MOST PEOPLE ALREADY HAVE ON THEIR PHONE, ENABLING ANYONE TO REPORT IMMEDIATELY ANY PRACTICES OR VIOLATIONS HARMING THE ENVIRONMENTAL MEDIA — SUCH AS POLLUTION OR THE UNLAWFUL DISPOSAL OF WASTE OF ALL KINDS — ALONGSIDE A THREE-DIGIT REPORTING NUMBER AND A SEPARATE CUSTOMER SERVICE LINE. A REPORT MADE FROM THE PHONE AT THE MOMENT SOMETHING IS HAPPENING CARRIES ITS OWN TIME AND PLACE. THIS FILE HAS SAID IN EVERY COUNTRY THAT EVIDENCE GATHERED AT THE TIME BEATS ANY ACCOUNT GIVEN AFTERWARDS — AND WHERE THE CHANNEL IS THE STATE'S OWN APP, THE RECORD SITS IN A GOVERNMENT SYSTEM RATHER THAN IN YOUR GALLERY. AND THE CENTRE PUBLISHES ITS WORKLOAD, WHICH IS RARE: IN THE FIRST HALF OF 2025 IT RESPONDED TO MORE THAN FOUR THOUSAND TWO HUNDRED ENVIRONMENTAL REPORTS, MOST OF THEM RELATING TO TRANSGRESSIONS OR PRACTICES POTENTIALLY AFFECTING AIR, WATER OR SOIL QUALITY ACROSS THE COUNTRY'S REGIONS. FOUR THOUSAND REPORTS RESPONDED TO IN SIX MONTHS MEANS THE LINE IS WORKED, NOT ORNAMENTAL. A COMMUNITY REPORTING A TIPPING SITE OR A DISCHARGE IS JOINING A QUEUE THAT MOVES. THE CENTRE ALSO PUBLISHES THE SHAPE OF WHAT IT FINDS: IN THE FIRST HALF OF 2026, AIR, SOIL AND NOISE VIOLATIONS TOGETHER ACCOUNTED FOR ABOUT TWENTY PER CENT OF THE ENVIRONMENTAL VIOLATIONS DETECTED. NOISE APPEARING AS A RECORDED CATEGORY IS WORTH KNOWING. CRUSHING, PILING AND NIGHT HAULAGE ARE THE COMPLAINTS COMMUNITIES ARE TOLD TO TOLERATE — HERE THEY BELONG TO A CATEGORY THE REGULATOR COUNTS AND ACTS ON, SO SAY NOISE VIOLATION RATHER THAN DESCRIBING DISTURBANCE. FOR AIR THERE IS PUBLIC DATA TOO: AN AIR QUALITY INDEX BUILT FROM MONITORING AND OBSERVATION STATIONS, CONVERTING POLLUTANT CONCENTRATIONS INTO SIMPLE NUMBERS DISPLAYED AS COLOURS, COVERING THE MAIN POLLUTANTS. AN OFFICIAL INDEX IS AN OFFICIAL BASELINE. CHECK WHETHER A MONITORING STATION EXISTS NEAR YOUR GROUND, RECORD WHAT IT SHOWS BEFORE A PROJECT STARTS, AND ASK FOR THE UNDERLYING STATION READINGS RATHER THAN THE COLOUR — THE INDEX SIMPLIFIES, AND THE CONCENTRATIONS ARE WHAT AN EXPERT WILL WANT. THE CENTRE ALSO ADMINISTERS ENVIRONMENTAL PERMITS AND RUNS TECHNICAL WORKSHOPS FOR INDUSTRY — ONE RECENT SESSION COVERED APPLYING DUST CONTROL PROCEDURES TO CONSTRUCTION PROJECTS IN THE CAPITAL. THAT TELLS YOU DUST FROM CONSTRUCTION IS A REGULATED SUBJECT WITH WRITTEN PROCEDURES, NOT AN UNAVOIDABLE NUISANCE. THE LIMITS: this is A COMPLIANCE REGULATOR, NOT AN ADVOCATE OR A PLANNING BODY — IT ENFORCES ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS AGAINST OPERATORS, IT DOES NOT DECIDE WHETHER A PROJECT SHOULD EXIST, and nothing here creates a right to object. USING THE NATIONAL APP REQUIRES A REGISTERED DIGITAL IDENTITY, WHICH TIES A REPORT TO THE PERSON MAKING IT — anonymity should not be assumed, and reporting a powerful operator carries risk this entry cannot assess. THE REPORT AND VIOLATION FIGURES COME FROM THE CENTRE'S OWN ANNOUNCEMENTS, AND RESPONDED TO IS NOT THE SAME AS RESOLVED. Read it with the wildlife centre's reporting routes, the accredited associations directory, the rural support programme and the bar's verification services recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Agricultural development fund — the surveyed plan with coordinates it demands, and the surety rule that disqualifies people who never borrowed
trackers.desc: THE MOST USEFUL THING IN THIS FUND'S CONDITIONS IS NOT THE MONEY BUT A DOCUMENT: A SURVEYED PLAN OF THE PROJECT LAND, PREPARED BY AN ACCREDITED ENGINEERING OFFICE AND SHOWING THE COORDINATES. GET THAT PLAN WHETHER OR NOT YOU EVER BORROW. THIS FILE HAS SAID IN EVERY COUNTRY THAT A BOUNDARY DISPUTE IS WON BY WHOEVER HOLDS A MEASURED, DATED, PROFESSIONALLY PREPARED DESCRIPTION OF THE GROUND — AND COORDINATES ARE THE VERSION THAT CANNOT BE ARGUED WITH LATER, BECAUSE THEY DO NOT DEPEND ON A WALL, A TREE OR A NEIGHBOUR'S MEMORY. THE OTHER CONDITIONS ARE WORTH KNOWING IN ORDER: AN AGRICULTURAL REGISTRY ISSUED BY THE ENVIRONMENT, WATER AND AGRICULTURE MINISTRY; A COPY OF THE NATIONAL IDENTITY DOCUMENT; AND THE BORROWER BEING AT LEAST TWENTY-ONE. THE AGRICULTURAL REGISTRY IS THE GATE, AND IT IS ALSO AN ASSET IN ITS OWN RIGHT: IT IS THE STATE'S OWN RECORD THAT YOU FARM. THIS FILE RECORDED SEPARATELY THAT THIS COUNTRY'S RURAL SUPPORT PROGRAMME REJECTS APPLICATIONS WHERE THE NAME ON THE IDENTITY DOCUMENT, THE AGRICULTURAL REGISTER AND THE BANK ACCOUNT DO NOT MATCH — SO THE REGISTRY IS WORTH OBTAINING AND CHECKING BEFORE ANY OF THESE DOORS IS APPROACHED. THE FUND IS A GOVERNMENTAL CREDIT INSTITUTION SPECIALISED IN FINANCING THE VARIOUS FIELDS OF AGRICULTURAL ACTIVITY, CREATED BY A COUNCIL OF MINISTERS DECISION, WITH CAPITAL OF UP TO TWENTY BILLION RIYALS AND PROVISION FOR INCREASE — SO IT IS A PERMANENT INSTITUTION RATHER THAN A PROGRAMME THAT WILL CLOSE. SECURITY IS WHERE MOST APPLICATIONS STOP: THE FUND TAKES A BANK GUARANTEE, A REAL ESTATE GUARANTEE, OR A PERSONAL SURETY. A PERSONAL SURETY IS THE ROUTE OPEN TO PEOPLE WITHOUT MORTGAGEABLE PROPERTY, AND IT IS ALSO THE MOST DANGEROUS. WHICH BRINGS THE ONE WARNING THIS ENTRY EXISTS TO CARRY: WHERE THERE HAS BEEN PREVIOUS DEALING WITH THE FUND, IT CHECKS REPAYMENT OF INSTALMENTS DUE FROM THE APPLICANT — OR FROM THOSE THEY HAVE STOOD SURETY FOR. THAT MEANS A FARMER WHO NEVER BORROWED A RIYAL CAN BE REFUSED BECAUSE SOMEBODY THEY GUARANTEED YEARS AGO FELL BEHIND. BEFORE SIGNING AS SURETY FOR A RELATIVE OR A NEIGHBOUR, UNDERSTAND THAT IT MORTGAGES YOUR OWN FUTURE ACCESS TO AGRICULTURAL CREDIT — AND BEFORE APPLYING, ASK THE FUND WHETHER ANYTHING STANDS AGAINST YOUR NAME FROM AN OLD SURETY. THAT SAME CHECK IS ALSO A REMEDY. IF A REFUSAL COMES WITHOUT EXPLANATION, AN OLD SURETY IS ONE OF THE FEW CAUSES THAT CAN BE IDENTIFIED AND SOMETIMES SETTLED — AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED IN THREE NEIGHBOURING COUNTRIES THAT UNEXPLAINED CREDIT REFUSALS ARE USUALLY ADMINISTRATIVE RATHER THAN SUBSTANTIVE. THE LIMITS: this is CREDIT FOR AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTION, NOT A GRANT, A CONSERVATION FUND OR A LEGAL FUND — IT MUST BE REPAID AND IT WILL NOT FINANCE AN OBJECTION, A LAWYER OR A PROTECTIVE PURCHASE. CONDITIONS REQUIRE NATIONAL IDENTITY DOCUMENTS, EXCLUDING NON-CITIZENS WHO WORK MUCH OF THE FARMLAND. THE CONDITIONS AND FIGURES CITED COME FROM AN ENTREPRENEURSHIP INSTITUTE'S SUMMARY AND A BUSINESS DIRECTORY RATHER THAN THE FUND'S CURRENT SERVICE PAGES, AND THIS ENTRY WAS BUILT WITHOUT A FRESH SEARCH from material that surfaced in earlier rounds - so verify every requirement, ceiling and rate directly before relying on it. Read it with the rural support programme and its name-matching rule, the environmental compliance centre's reporting line, the bar association's verification services and the wildlife centre recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Environmental security force — a confidential reporting line with no liability on the reporter, and seizure of soil-scraping equipment
trackers.desc: ONE SENTENCE MAKES THIS THE MOST USABLE REPORTING ROUTE IN THE WHOLE FILE FOR A FRIGHTENED PERSON: ALL REPORTS ARE TREATED IN COMPLETE CONFIDENTIALITY, WITH NO LIABILITY WHATSOEVER ON THE PERSON REPORTING. THIS FILE HAS FLAGGED IN COUNTRY AFTER COUNTRY THAT REPORTING AN ENVIRONMENTAL BREACH EXPOSES THE PERSON WHO REPORTS — THAT THE COMPLAINT ITSELF IDENTIFIES THEM, THAT APP-BASED SYSTEMS TIE IT TO A DIGITAL IDENTITY. HERE THE ENFORCING FORCE STATES CONFIDENTIALITY AND NO LIABILITY IN ITS OWN PUBLIC APPEALS. THAT IS THE ASSURANCE COMMUNITIES ASK FOR AND ALMOST NEVER GET IN WRITING. THE LINES ARE THE ORDINARY EMERGENCY NUMBERS: NINE-ONE-ONE IN FOUR NAMED REGIONS, AND NINE-NINE-NINE AND NINE-NINE-SIX IN THE REST OF THE COUNTRY — SO REPORTING NEEDS NO APPLICATION, NO PORTAL AND NO ACCOUNT. WHAT THE FORCE ACTUALLY ACTS ON IS THE PART THAT MATTERS FOR LAND. ITS RECENT CASES INCLUDE THE EXPLOITATION OF DEPOSITS — SAND AND GRAVEL TAKING — WITH THE EQUIPMENT USED FOR SCRAPING AND TRANSPORTING SOIL SEIZED, IN ONE CASE FOUR MACHINES AT ONCE. SOIL SCRAPING AND UNLICENSED AGGREGATE EXTRACTION ARE AMONG THE COMMONEST DESTRUCTIVE ACTIVITIES THIS FILE RECORDS ANYWHERE, AND THEY ARE USUALLY MET WITH A SHRUG. A FORCE THAT SEIZES THE EXCAVATOR IS DOING THE ONE THING THAT ACTUALLY STOPS IT — EQUIPMENT SEIZURE COSTS AN OPERATOR MORE THAN ANY FINE. ITS OTHER ROUTINE CASES ARE PRICED PUBLICLY: GRAZING IN PROHIBITED LOCATIONS INSIDE ROYAL RESERVES AT FIVE HUNDRED RIYALS PER HEAD OF CAMEL; LIGHTING FIRES OUTSIDE DESIGNATED PLACES AT UP TO THREE THOUSAND RIYALS; CAMPING WITHOUT A LICENCE INSIDE A RESERVE AT UP TO THREE THOUSAND; AND THE TRANSPORT OF LOCAL FIREWOOD. THE FIREWOOD OFFENCE IS THE ONE TO USE WHERE NATIVE TREES ARE BEING CUT. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED WOOD-CUTTING AS A SLOW DESTROYER OF ARID LANDSCAPES ACROSS THE REGION; HERE MOVING LOCAL FIREWOOD IS ITSELF AN OFFENCE, WHICH MEANS THE TRUCK CAN BE STOPPED EVEN WHEN NOBODY SAW THE TREE FALL. AND THE PUBLISHED FINE SCHEDULE IS USEFUL BEYOND THIS COUNTRY: KNOWING THAT A SINGLE HERD IN A PROHIBITED AREA COSTS FIVE HUNDRED RIYALS PER ANIMAL TELLS A COMMUNITY WHAT ENFORCEMENT LOOKS LIKE WHEN IT IS REAL, AND GIVES A YARDSTICK TO HOLD OTHER AUTHORITIES TO. ONE HONEST NOTE ON WHO GETS CAUGHT: THE PUBLISHED CASES INCLUDE BOTH CITIZENS AND RESIDENT WORKERS OF VARIOUS NATIONALITIES, THE LATTER TYPICALLY OPERATING THE MACHINERY. A COMMUNITY REPORTING SOIL EXTRACTION SHOULD UNDERSTAND THAT THE PEOPLE DETAINED MAY BE EMPLOYEES RATHER THAN THE PERSON WHO PROFITS — AND SHOULD REPORT THE EQUIPMENT AND THE SITE, NOT ONLY THE MEN. THE LIMITS: this is AN ARMED ENFORCEMENT BODY, NOT AN ADVOCATE OR A PLANNING AUTHORITY — IT POLICES BREACHES OF ENVIRONMENTAL RULES AND WILL NOT STOP A LICENSED PROJECT, HOWEVER DAMAGING. ITS ENFORCEMENT IS CONCENTRATED IN RESERVES AND ON RANGELAND OFFENCES, SO GRAZING FAMILIES ARE AS LIKELY TO BE ITS TARGETS AS ITS BENEFICIARIES - a herding community should weigh that before inviting patrols. THE CONFIDENTIALITY ASSURANCE AND THE FINE FIGURES COME FROM THE FORCE'S OWN STATEMENTS REPORTED IN THE PRESS RATHER THAN FROM PUBLISHED REGULATIONS, and no appeal route for a person wrongly fined was identified. Read it with the environmental compliance centre's reporting line and air index, the wildlife centre, the rural support programme and the vegetation cover centre recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Species conservation fund — grants to individuals as well as organisations, for work on the animal, its habitat or its ecosystem
trackers.desc: THE ELIGIBILITY LINE IS WHY THIS IS RECORDED: THE FUNDING IS INTENDED FOR INDIVIDUALS AND ORGANISATIONS THAT SUPPORT THE FUND'S OBJECTIVES, AND ITS OWN ANNOUNCEMENTS INVITE RESEARCHERS AND INDIVIDUALS INTERESTED IN CONSERVATION PROJECTS FOR THE SPECIES GLOBALLY. AN INDIVIDUAL CAN HOLD THIS GRANT. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED WINDOW AFTER WINDOW CLOSED TO ANYONE WITHOUT A REGISTERED ORGANISATION — A NATURALIST, A HERDER WHO KNOWS THE WADI, A TEACHER WITH CAMERA TRAPS CAN APPLY HERE IN THEIR OWN NAME. THE AMOUNTS ARE STATED AND MODEST: THE REQUIRED FUNDING SHOULD NOT EXCEED FIVE THOUSAND DOLLARS FOR A SINGLE INITIATIVE AND TWENTY-FIVE THOUSAND FOR RESEARCH, WITH GRANTS OFFERING FULL OR PARTIAL COVERAGE AND ELIGIBLE PROJECTS FUNDED FOR ONE YEAR. FIVE THOUSAND DOLLARS BUYS CAMERA TRAPS, FUEL AND A SEASON OF FIELDWORK. THAT IS ENOUGH TO ESTABLISH WHETHER A PROTECTED ANIMAL USES A VALLEY — WHICH, AS THIS FILE HAS ARGUED THROUGHOUT, IS THE SINGLE MOST USEFUL FACT A COMMUNITY CAN PUT IN FRONT OF A DEVELOPER OR A REGULATOR. THE SCOPE IS WIDER THAN THE ANIMAL: A PROPOSAL MUST HAVE TANGIBLE, MEASURABLE IMPACTS ON THE SPECIES, ITS HABITAT OR ITS ECOSYSTEM. HABITAT AND ECOSYSTEM ARE THE WORDS TO BUILD ON. WORK ON THE PREY POPULATIONS, THE WATER SOURCES, THE VEGETATION OR THE GRAZING PRESSURE OF A VALLEY WHERE THE SPECIES MIGHT RANGE IS INSIDE THE FUND'S OWN DEFINITION — SO THIS IS NOT ONLY MONEY FOR PEOPLE WHO CAN FIND THE ANIMAL. THE OTHER REQUIREMENTS ARE PLAIN AND WORTH MEETING EXACTLY: ALIGNMENT WITH THE FUND'S OBJECTIVES, A CLEAR SCOPE OF WORK, A CLEAR BUDGET FOR COSTS, APPLICATIONS IN ENGLISH ONLY, AND ASSESSMENT BY THE FUND'S TECHNICAL ADVISORY COMMITTEE. ENGLISH ONLY IS THE BARRIER MOST LOCAL APPLICANTS WILL HIT. IT IS ALSO THE EASIEST TO SOLVE — A STUDENT, A TEACHER OR A DIASPORA RELATIVE CAN TRANSLATE A PROPOSAL, AND THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED FREE TRANSLATION SERVICES IN THREE COUNTRIES OF THIS REGION. THE TIMING IS CURRENT: APPLICATIONS OPENED IN AUGUST 2026 AND THE PROGRAMME IS TO RUN THROUGH TWO ROUNDS DURING THE YEAR, THE CURRENT ONE REMAINING OPEN INTO OCTOBER — SO A MISSED ROUND IS NOT A MISSED YEAR. AND THE BACKING IS SERIOUS RATHER THAN SYMBOLIC: THE FUND WAS ESTABLISHED UNDER A NATIONAL DEVELOPMENT VISION BY A ROYAL COMMISSION, WITH AN INITIAL ENDOWMENT REPORTED AT TWENTY-FIVE MILLION DOLLARS, AND IT ALSO RUNS A SCHOLARSHIP PROGRAMME AND TRAINING PARTNERSHIPS WITH A CONSERVATION ACADEMY ABROAD AND A BREEDING CENTRE AT HOME. THE TRAINING SIDE IS THE LONGER GAME FOR A COMMUNITY: SOMEBODY LOCAL WHO COMPLETES A CONSERVATION COURSE BECOMES THE PERSON WHO CAN WRITE THE NEXT APPLICATION, RUN THE NEXT SURVEY AND SPEAK AT THE NEXT HEARING — WHICH IS WORTH MORE OVER TEN YEARS THAN ONE GRANT. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A SPECIES FUND, NOT A LAND FUND - EVERYTHING MUST BE TIED TO ONE CRITICALLY ENDANGERED ANIMAL, ITS HABITAT OR ITS ECOSYSTEM, SO A COMMUNITY WHOSE GROUND HAS NO CONNECTION TO IT HAS NOTHING TO APPLY FOR. IT IS ESTABLISHED BY A ROYAL COMMISSION THAT IS ITSELF A MAJOR DEVELOPER OF THE REGION IT WORKS IN, AND IT WILL NOT FUND OPPOSITION TO A GOVERNMENT PROJECT. THE GRANT IS SMALL AND LASTS A YEAR. THE FIGURES COME FROM THE FUND'S OWN GRANTS PAGE AND FROM NEWS COVERAGE OF THE 2026 OPENING - the exact deadline, the application form and whether fieldwork inside protected areas needs separate permission were not established, and a permit is likely to be required for any survey work. Read it with the environmental security force's confidential reporting line, the associations support fund's premises grant, the rural support programme and the agricultural development fund recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Environment Friends Society — a licensed civil association with its own services, and the directory of the others
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HOLDS FEW NAMED NON-STATE BODIES FOR THIS COUNTRY, SO THE BASIC FACTS ARE THE POINT: A NON-PROFIT CIVIL SOCIETY BASED IN THE EASTERN PROVINCE AND HEADQUARTERED IN DAMMAM, FOUNDED IN 2016, WORKING UNDER THE SUPERVISION OF THE HUMAN RESOURCES AND SOCIAL DEVELOPMENT MINISTRY AND REGISTERED WITH IT UNDER LICENCE NUMBER 764, WITH ITS OWN WEBSITE AND SERVICES PAGE MAINTAINED INTO 2026. A LICENCE NUMBER IS WORTH RECORDING BECAUSE IT IS WHAT MAKES A BODY REAL IN THIS SYSTEM. AN ASSOCIATION WITH A REGISTRATION NUMBER CAN HOLD A BANK ACCOUNT, SIGN AN AGREEMENT, RECEIVE DONATIONS AND SPEAK TO A MINISTRY — AND THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED ACROSS THE GULF THAT UNREGISTERED GROUPS CAN DO NONE OF THOSE THINGS. ITS STATED AIM IS MODEST AND WORTH TAKING AT FACE VALUE: TO RAISE AWARENESS OF ENVIRONMENTAL ISSUES AMONG MEMBERS OF SOCIETY. THAT IS AN EDUCATION AND VOLUNTEERING BODY, NOT A CAMPAIGNING ONE — SO APPROACH IT FOR PARTNERSHIP, TRAINING AND A PLATFORM, NOT FOR OPPOSITION. THE MORE USEFUL DISCOVERY IS THAT THE SECTOR IS MAPPED: THE AGRICULTURE AND ENVIRONMENT MINISTRY LISTS ENVIRONMENTAL CIVIL ASSOCIATIONS ON ITS OWN PAGES, AND A UNIVERSITY BIOLOGICAL SOCIETY PUBLISHES A GUIDE TO ASSOCIATIONS AND VOLUNTARY BODIES IN THE ENVIRONMENT. SO A COMMUNITY DOES NOT HAVE TO GUESS WHO EXISTS. READ THE MINISTRY'S LIST AND THE PUBLISHED GUIDE, FIND THE SOCIETY NEAREST YOUR PROVINCE OR CLOSEST TO YOUR SUBJECT, AND APPROACH THAT ONE — THIS FILE HAS RECORDED IN A DOZEN COUNTRIES THAT THE FIRST ORGANISATION PEOPLE FIND IS RARELY THE RIGHT ONE. AND IF NONE FITS, THE ROUTE TO CREATING ONE IS PUBLISHED ON THE SAME MINISTRY'S NON-PROFIT PAGES: ELECTRONIC SERVICES FOR ESTABLISHING NON-PROFIT ORGANISATIONS, INCLUDING A REQUEST TO FOUND A CIVIL ASSOCIATION BY A GROUP OF FOUNDERS FOR SOCIAL OR DEVELOPMENTAL AIMS, AND A REQUEST TO FOUND A NON-PROFIT FOUNDATION ON THE INITIATIVE OF A SINGLE PERSON OR BODY TO FINANCE AND CARRY OUT PROJECTS WITH SOCIAL IMPACT. THE SINGLE-FOUNDER FOUNDATION IS THE ONE TO NOTICE. WHERE A COMMUNITY CANNOT ASSEMBLE THE FOUNDERS A CIVIL ASSOCIATION NEEDS, ONE PERSON OR ONE FAMILY WITH MEANS CAN ESTABLISH A FOUNDATION TO FUND AND RUN THE WORK — WHICH IS THE SAME LOGIC AS THE ENDOWMENT ROUTES RECORDED FOR THIS COUNTRY'S NEIGHBOURS. THE MINISTRY ALSO RUNS A VOLUNTEERING PLATFORM DESCRIBED AS CARRYING THOUSANDS OF OPPORTUNITIES, AND OFFERS TO HELP AN ORGANISATION BUILD A VOLUNTEER UNIT TO THE NATIONAL STANDARD — SO A SOCIETY THAT TAKES ON A LOCAL PROJECT CAN RESOURCE IT WITH PEOPLE RATHER THAN MONEY. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A LICENSED AWARENESS SOCIETY IN A SYSTEM WHERE ASSOCIATIONS OPERATE UNDER MINISTRY SUPERVISION - IT WILL NOT OPPOSE A STATE OR ROYAL PROJECT, TAKE A LEGAL CASE OR CRITICISE A DEVELOPMENT, AND ITS LICENCE DEPENDS ON STAYING INSIDE ITS STATED PURPOSE. IT IS A REGIONAL BODY IN ONE PROVINCE, NOT A NATIONAL ONE. WHAT ITS SERVICES PAGE ACTUALLY OFFERS, WHETHER IT ACCEPTS MEMBERS OR PARTNERS FROM OUTSIDE ITS PROVINCE, AND WHAT IT HAS DELIVERED WERE NOT ESTABLISHED - the page was seen only as a footer and a listing. THE LICENCE NUMBER AND FOUNDING DETAILS COME FROM A NATIONAL ENCYCLOPAEDIA ENTRY AND THE SOCIETY'S OWN SOCIAL MEDIA PROFILES, AND THE DIRECTORY GUIDE IS A UNIVERSITY-HOSTED PDF OF UNKNOWN DATE. Read it with the species conservation fund's grants to individuals, the associations support fund's premises grant, the environmental security force's confidential reporting line and the agricultural development fund recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: National water authority's central laboratories — accredited analysis services including an environment laboratory and a mobile laboratory
trackers.desc: THE LABORATORIES OF THE BODY THAT SUPPLIES THE WATER ARE AN ODD PLACE TO LOOK FOR HELP, AND THAT IS EXACTLY WHY THEY ARE WORTH RECORDING: THEY STATE THAT THEIR RESPONSIBILITY IS NOT LIMITED TO PRODUCING WATER BUT EXTENDS TO ITS QUALITY AS A PRODUCT FIT FOR USE, IN LINE WITH APPROVED LOCAL AND GLOBAL QUALITY SPECIFICATIONS. THAT SENTENCE IS A COMMITMENT YOU CAN HOLD THEM TO. A COMPLAINT THAT SUPPLIED WATER FAILS A SPECIFICATION IS A COMPLAINT ABOUT THEIR OWN STATED RESPONSIBILITY, NOT AN ACCUSATION FROM OUTSIDE. THE ACCREDITATION IS THE PART THAT MAKES A RESULT USABLE: THEY HAVE OBTAINED ACCREDITATION TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF THE INTERNATIONAL TESTING AND CALIBRATION LABORATORY STANDARD FROM BOTH LOCAL AND INTERNATIONAL ACCREDITATION BODIES. AND THEY SELL ANALYSIS: THE CENTRAL LABORATORIES PROVIDE MANY ANALYSIS SERVICES TO CLIENTS, THROUGH A CHEMISTRY AND QUALITY LABORATORY; AN ENVIRONMENT AND BIOLOGY LABORATORY; AN ADVANCED MATERIALS AND CORROSION LABORATORY; A REVERSE OSMOSIS LABORATORY; A THERMAL ANALYSIS LABORATORY; AND A MOBILE LABORATORY. TWO ITEMS IN THAT LIST MATTER TO A COMMUNITY. THE ENVIRONMENT AND BIOLOGY LABORATORY IS WHERE A SAMPLE GOES WHEN THE QUESTION IS CONTAMINATION RATHER THAN TASTE — AND THE MOBILE LABORATORY IS THE SECOND ONE THIS FILE HAS FOUND IN THE REGION, AFTER A CENTRAL ASIAN SOIL SERVICE, WHICH MEANS TESTING CAN COME TO A VILLAGE INSTEAD OF THE VILLAGE CARRYING SAMPLES TO A CITY. THE OTHER ROUTE IS COMMERCIAL AND EXPLICIT ABOUT WHAT IT IS FOR: A PRIVATE ENVIRONMENTAL LABORATORY OFFERS ACCREDITED ANALYSES OF WATER, SOIL AND PLANTS TO THE INTERNATIONAL TESTING STANDARD AND TO THE STANDARDS OF THE NATIONAL ENVIRONMENTAL COMPLIANCE CENTRE AND A FOREIGN ENVIRONMENTAL AGENCY, AIMED AT COMPANIES AND INDUSTRY FOR ENVIRONMENTAL COMPLIANCE. TESTING TO THE COMPLIANCE CENTRE'S OWN STANDARDS IS THE POINT. IF A RESULT IS PRODUCED AGAINST THE SAME METHODS THE REGULATOR USES, THE REGULATOR CANNOT DISMISS IT AS THE WRONG TEST — AND THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS THAT COMPLIANCE CENTRE SEPARATELY AS THE BODY THAT RECEIVES ENVIRONMENTAL VIOLATION REPORTS IN THIS COUNTRY. SO THE SEQUENCE HERE IS UNUSUALLY COMPLETE FOR THIS REGION: A LABORATORY ACCREDITED TO THE REGULATOR'S METHODS, A REGULATOR THAT TAKES REPORTS, AND A WATER AUTHORITY THAT HAS PUT ITS QUALITY OBLIGATION IN WRITING. NEITHER LABORATORY IS NEUTRAL — ONE BELONGS TO THE BODY THAT SUPPLIES THE WATER, THE OTHER SELLS COMPLIANCE TESTING TO INDUSTRY. BUT BETWEEN THEM THEY ANSWER THE TWO QUESTIONS A COMMUNITY ACTUALLY ASKS: IS WHAT WE ARE GIVEN SAFE, AND IS WHAT THEY ARE DOING LAWFUL. THE LIMITS: THE CENTRAL LABORATORIES BELONG TO THE WATER AUTHORITY ITSELF, SO ASKING THEM TO TEST THEIR OWN SUPPLY IS ASKING A PARTY TO JUDGE ITS OWN PRODUCT - AN INDEPENDENT LABORATORY IS THE SAFER CHOICE WHERE THE DISPUTE IS WITH THE SUPPLIER. WHETHER INDIVIDUALS OR COMMUNITY GROUPS COUNT AS CLIENTS, WHAT ANALYSES COST, TURNAROUND TIMES AND WHETHER REPORTS NAME THE ACCREDITATION SCOPE WERE NOT ESTABLISHED, NOR WAS WHETHER THE MOBILE LABORATORY CAN BE REQUESTED. THE PRIVATE LABORATORY IS A COMMERCIAL SUPPLIER RECORDED FROM ITS OWN MARKETING DESCRIPTION AND IS NOT AN ENDORSEMENT; ITS PRICES, INDEPENDENCE AND CLIENT LIST ARE UNKNOWN. THE INTENDED TARGET OF THIS ROUND WAS A NEIGHBOURING COUNTRY'S LABORATORIES, WHICH DID NOT SURFACE AND REMAIN UNRECORDED. Read it with the environmental compliance centre's reporting route, the vegetation cover centre, the environment friends society and the agricultural development fund recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: General Authority for Endowments — the national registry for land held permanently for a purpose, with published deed templates and a reporting line
trackers.desc: EVERY ROUND OF THIS CORRECTION HAS BEEN LOOKING FOR BODIES THAT HOLD LAND OUT OF THE MARKET. THIS REGION INVENTED ONE, AND THIS IS ITS NATIONAL REGISTRY: A GENERAL AUTHORITY FOR ENDOWMENTS ESTABLISHED BY ROYAL DECREE, A PUBLIC BODY WITH AN INDEPENDENT LEGAL PERSONALITY, FINANCIAL AND ADMINISTRATIVE INDEPENDENCE, AND A REPORTING LINE DIRECT TO THE PRIME MINISTER. ITS PURPOSE IS STATED IN TERMS THAT MATTER TO ANYONE TRYING TO KEEP GROUND INTACT: TO ORGANISE ENDOWMENTS, PRESERVE THEM, DEVELOP THEM AND GROW THEM IN A WAY THAT FULFILS THE CONDITIONS OF THOSE WHO ENDOWED THEM. THE CONDITIONS OF THOSE WHO ENDOWED THEM IS THE WHOLE POINT. A PROPERTY GIVEN FOR A STATED PURPOSE IS HELD TO THAT PURPOSE BY AN AUTHORITY WHOSE JOB IS PRESERVING IT — WHICH IS WHAT A LAND TRUST DOES ELSEWHERE, THROUGH AN INSTITUTION THIS REGION ALREADY HAS AND ALREADY RESPECTS. THE SERVICES IT LISTS ARE FEW AND CONCRETE: REGISTERING A NEW ENDOWMENT; REGISTERING A NEW ENDOWMENT INVESTMENT FUND; REGISTERING ENDOWMENT INVESTMENT PORTFOLIOS; SUBMITTING A REPORT ABOUT AN UNKNOWN ENDOWMENT; AND SUBMITTING A REPORT ABOUT ENDOWMENTS OR THEIR TRUSTEES. THE REPORT ABOUT AN UNKNOWN ENDOWMENT IS THE ONE ALMOST NOBODY USES AND THE ONE THIS FILE HAS BEEN LOOKING FOR. OLD ENDOWED GROUND EXISTS ALL OVER THIS REGION WITH ITS PAPERS LOST — A GRAVEYARD, A WELL, A GROVE, A SCHOOL YARD. IF THE LAND A DEVELOPER WANTS WAS ONCE ENDOWED, REPORTING IT PUTS A NATIONAL AUTHORITY BETWEEN THE BULLDOZER AND THE GROUND. THE REPORT ABOUT TRUSTEES IS THE COMPANION: WHERE AN ENDOWMENT IS KNOWN BUT ITS TRUSTEE IS SELLING, NEGLECTING OR DIVERTING IT, THERE IS A NAMED CHANNEL FOR SAYING SO. REGISTRATION ITSELF IS DELIBERATELY EASY: AN ELECTRONIC SERVICE ALLOWS BENEFICIARIES TO REGISTER ENDOWMENTS FORMALLY WITH THE AUTHORITY SO THEY CAN USE ITS SERVICES AND OBTAIN WHAT THEY NEED TO CARRY OUT THEIR ACTIVITIES, WITHOUT VISITING ITS PREMISES. AND THE AUTHORITY PUBLISHES ENDOWMENT DEED TEMPLATES ON ITS OWN SITE — WHICH IS THE DOCUMENT A FAMILY OR A GROUP WOULD OTHERWISE PAY A LAWYER TO INVENT. THE DEED IS WHERE THE PROTECTION IS WRITTEN. A COMMERCIAL SERVICES GUIDE DESCRIBES THE CURRENT ROUTE AS ENTERING THE NATIONAL JUSTICE PORTAL THROUGH THE UNIFIED NATIONAL ACCESS AND CHOOSING THE DOCUMENTING AN ENDOWMENT SERVICE FROM THE NOTARY LIST; THE DEED NAMES THE TRUSTEE WHO MANAGES AND PRESERVES THE ENDOWMENT AND SETS HOW SUCCESSORS ARE APPOINTED; A CHARITABLE ENDOWMENT DIRECTS ITS BENEFIT TO A CONTINUING CHARITABLE PURPOSE; AND A NO-OBJECTION CERTIFICATE FROM THE MUNICIPALITY IS REQUIRED IF THE PROPERTY IS MORTGAGED. NAMING THE TRUSTEE AND THE SUCCESSION MECHANISM IS THE PART TO GET RIGHT, BECAUSE IT DECIDES WHO SPEAKS FOR THE LAND IN FIFTY YEARS — AND THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED ENDOWED PROPERTY ELSEWHERE IN THE GULF LOST THROUGH TRUSTEES NOBODY COULD IDENTIFY. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A REGISTRY AND REGULATOR OF ENDOWMENTS, NOT A CONSERVATION BODY - IT WILL NOT BUY LAND, FUND A PURCHASE OR JUDGE A DEVELOPMENT, AND WHETHER AN ENDOWMENT MAY BE MADE FOR AN ENVIRONMENTAL OR CONSERVATION PURPOSE, AND HOW SUCH A PURPOSE WOULD BE DESCRIBED IN A DEED, WERE NOT ESTABLISHED. ENDOWED LAND IS NOT ABSOLUTELY SAFE EITHER: THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS THAT ENDOWMENT PROPERTY IN A NEIGHBOURING COUNTRY CARRIES AN EXPROPRIATION EXPOSURE, AND ENDOWMENTS CAN BE DEVELOPED, INVESTED, EXCHANGED OR MERGED UNDER STATE SUPERVISION. THE DEED PROCEDURE IS DESCRIBED FROM A COMMERCIAL SERVICES OFFICE'S GUIDE OF 2026 RATHER THAN FROM THE AUTHORITY OR THE NOTARY SERVICE ITSELF, AND SHOULD BE CONFIRMED BEFORE ANY DOCUMENT IS SIGNED - THE AUTHORITY'S OWN PAGES WERE SEEN AS SERVICE MENUS AND TEMPLATE LISTINGS RATHER THAN READ IN FULL. Read it with the environmental compliance centre's reporting route, the vegetation cover centre, the water authority's laboratories and the environment friends society recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Royal reserve authorities — seasonal grazing licences for the local community, and local community advisory teams in four regions
trackers.desc: THE LAST ROUND RECORDED A FOUNDATION THAT LEASES VILLAGE LAND. THIS ONE RECORDS THE OTHER SIDE OF THE SAME QUESTION: WHAT A COMMUNITY GETS WHEN THE STATE PROTECTS THE GROUND IT ALREADY USES. HERE THERE ARE TWO NAMED ANSWERS, BOTH FROM 2026. THE FIRST IS A LICENCE: A ROYAL RESERVE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY HAS MADE AVAILABLE THE ISSUING OF SEASONAL GRAZING LICENCES TO THE LOCAL COMMUNITY INSIDE THE RESERVE'S BOUNDARIES, STARTING FROM THE FIFTEENTH OF JUNE 2026. A LICENCE IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A HERDER WHO IS TOLERATED AND ONE WHO IS PERMITTED. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED PROTECTION EXCLUDING EXISTING USERS ACROSS THE WHOLE REGION — GRAZING, FIREWOOD AND ACCESS QUIETLY LOST WHEN A BOUNDARY IS DRAWN. A DATED, NAMED LICENSING ROUTE INSIDE A RESERVE IS THE OPPOSITE OF THAT, AND IT IS WORTH ASKING EVERY RESERVE AUTHORITY WHETHER IT HAS ONE. SEASONAL IS THE WORD TO PIN DOWN WHEN ASKING: WHICH SEASON, HOW MANY ANIMALS, WHICH ZONES, AND WHAT HAPPENS TO A HERDER WHO WAS THERE BEFORE THE RESERVE EXISTED. THOSE FOUR QUESTIONS DECIDE WHETHER A LICENCE IS A RIGHT OR A RATION. THE SECOND ANSWER IS STRUCTURAL: ANOTHER ROYAL RESERVE AUTHORITY ANNOUNCED IN JUNE 2026 THE ACTIVATION OF LOCAL COMMUNITY ADVISORY TEAMS IN FOUR NAMED REGIONS - THE NORTHERN BORDERS, AL-JOUF, TABUK AND HAIL. THE AUTHORITY'S OWN ACCOUNT OF WHAT THEY DO IS THE LANGUAGE TO USE WHEN ASKING TO JOIN ONE: RESULTS CONFIRMING THE TEAMS' PIVOTAL ROLE IN EMPOWERING MEMBERS OF THE LOCAL COMMUNITY AND SUPPORTING THE LOCAL ECONOMY, ACHIEVING WIDER COMMUNITY PARTICIPATION, GREATER OPPORTUNITIES AND A STRONGER AND MORE SUSTAINABLE LOCAL ECONOMY. AN ADVISORY TEAM IS A SEAT AT A TABLE THAT ALREADY EXISTS. FOR A COMMUNITY INSIDE OR BESIDE A RESERVE, THE QUESTIONS ARE WHO SITS ON THE TEAM FOR THIS AREA, HOW MEMBERS ARE CHOSEN, HOW OFTEN IT MEETS AND WHAT IT HAS ACTUALLY CHANGED — AND THOSE ARE ANSWERABLE BECAUSE THE AUTHORITY PUBLICISES THE TEAMS ITSELF. FOUR REGIONS NAMED IN ONE ANNOUNCEMENT ALSO TELLS A COMMUNITY IN A FIFTH REGION WHAT TO ASK FOR: THE SAME THING, BY NAME, CITING WHERE IT ALREADY EXISTS. THERE IS A PREDICTABLE MOMENT FOR RAISING ANY OF THIS: A NATIONAL ENVIRONMENT WEEK RAN IN MAY 2026 UNDER A GREEN-IMPACT SLOGAN ACROSS THE PROVINCES OF ONE REGION, PRESENTED AS PART OF THE ENVIRONMENT, WATER AND AGRICULTURE MINISTRY'S EFFORTS TO RAISE AWARENESS AND STRENGTHEN COMMUNITY PARTICIPATION - AND THE RESERVE AUTHORITIES EXHIBITED AT IT. AN AWARENESS WEEK IS WHEN OFFICIALS ARE STAFFING STANDS AND EXPECTING THE PUBLIC. IT IS THE CHEAPEST MEETING A COMMUNITY WILL EVER GET WITH THE BODY THAT CONTROLS ITS GRAZING LAND. THE LIMITS: THESE ARE STATE RESERVE AUTHORITIES CREATED BY ROYAL ORDER TO DEVELOP AND MANAGE LARGE PROTECTED AREAS, NOT COMMUNITY BODIES - THE LICENCES AND THE ADVISORY TEAMS ARE THINGS THEY GRANT AND CAN WITHDRAW, NOT RIGHTS A COMMUNITY HOLDS, AND NOTHING HERE SUGGESTS EITHER AUTHORITY WILL ACT AGAINST A STATE DEVELOPMENT. THE LICENCE ANNOUNCEMENT WAS SEEN AS A HEADLINE ON THE AUTHORITY'S MEDIA PAGE RATHER THAN AS A PUBLISHED PROCEDURE - CONDITIONS, FEES, DURATION, ANIMAL NUMBERS AND WHO QUALIFIES AS LOCAL COMMUNITY WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED, AND THOSE TERMS ARE WHERE SUCH SCHEMES ARE WON OR LOST. THE ADVISORY-TEAM ACCOUNT COMES FROM A STATE NEWS AGENCY ITEM REPUBLISHED ON A FOREIGN NEWS PORTAL, WITH NO MEMBERSHIP LIST OR MEETING RECORD SEEN. RESERVE DESIGNATION IN THIS COUNTRY HAS ELSEWHERE MEANT REMOVAL OF GRAZING AND RESETTLEMENT, WHICH THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS SEPARATELY. Read it with the vegetation cover centre, the environmental compliance centre's reporting route, the endowments authority's unknown-endowment report and the water authority's laboratories recorded separately for this country.TWO PRACTICAL DETAILS BELONG WITH THIS ENTRY. THE FIRST IS THE DATE THE GRAZING LICENCES ACTUALLY OPENED: THE AUTHORITY BEGAN ISSUING SEASONAL GRAZING LICENCES TO THE LOCAL COMMUNITY INSIDE ITS RESERVE FROM THE FIFTEENTH OF JUNE 2026, UNDER REGULATORY AND ENVIRONMENTAL CONTROLS AND CONDITIONS INTENDED TO BALANCE USE OF THE NATURAL RESOURCES WITH THEIR SUSTAINABILITY. A LICENCE THAT OPENS ON A FIXED DATE IS SOMETHING A HERDING FAMILY CAN PLAN AROUND AND ASK ABOUT BY NAME - AND THE QUESTIONS THAT FOLLOW ARE WHO MAY APPLY, HOW MANY ANIMALS ARE PERMITTED, FOR HOW LONG, AND WHAT HAPPENS TO THOSE WHO GRAZED THERE BEFORE THE RESERVE EXISTED. THE SECOND IS A SMALL THING WORTH COPYING ANYWHERE: THE AUTHORITY RUNS A MOBILE VOLUNTEERING NURSERY, WHICH LET VISITORS PLANT SEEDS THEMSELVES IN A PRACTICAL EXPERIENCE INTENDED TO TURN SUSTAINABILITY CONCEPTS INTO A COMMUNITY PRACTICE THAT STRENGTHENS ATTACHMENT TO NATURE. A NURSERY THAT TRAVELS TO PEOPLE, RATHER THAN WAITING FOR THEM TO REACH IT, IS THE CHEAPEST WAY TO PUT NATIVE SEEDLINGS AND THE HABIT OF PLANTING THEM INTO VILLAGES THAT HAVE NEITHER — AND IT WAS SHOWN AT A NATIONAL ENVIRONMENT WEEK IN 2026 ALONGSIDE THE AUTHORITY'S WORK ON CONSERVING NATURAL RESOURCES, DEVELOPING VEGETATION COVER AND PROTECTING WILDLIFE ACROSS TWO NAMED ROYAL RESERVES.

trackers.name: Agricultural cooperative societies and their national council — member-owned bodies a farmer can join, or found with twelve people
trackers.desc: THE BRIEF IS ORGANISATIONS, NOT PROGRAMMES. THIS IS ONE A FARMER CAN JOIN THIS WEEK, OR START: AN AGRICULTURAL COOPERATIVE SOCIETY, MEMBER-OWNED, WITH A GENERAL ASSEMBLY - AND THE NATIONAL COUNCIL THAT CONVENES SUCH SOCIETIES STATES THE ENTRY PRICE PLAINLY: NOT FEWER THAN TWELVE INDIVIDUALS MUST SUBMIT THE APPLICATION TO ESTABLISH ONE, AND IN EXCEPTIONAL CASES ASSESSED BY THE MINISTER IT MAY BE ESTABLISHED WITH NOT FEWER THAN FIVE MEMBERS. TWELVE PEOPLE, OR FIVE IN AN EXCEPTIONAL CASE. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED FUND AFTER FUND WHOSE REAL BARRIER WAS THE ABSENCE OF A REGISTERED LOCAL ORGANISATION WITH A BANK ACCOUNT - IN THIS COUNTRY THAT BARRIER IS TWELVE NEIGHBOURS AND AN APPLICATION. WHAT ONE LOOKS LIKE IN PRACTICE IS PUBLISHED BY A GOVERNORATE SOCIETY ON ITS OWN SITE: THE MINUTES OF ITS GENERAL ASSEMBLY MEETING OF THE TWENTY-SIXTH OF APRIL 2026, RECORDING THAT THE LEGAL QUORUM WAS NOT COMPLETED; THE FIRST ANNOUNCEMENT CONVENING THE ASSEMBLY; THE DISBURSEMENT PROCEDURES FOR ITS PROGRAMMES AND ACTIVITIES; AND THE NAMES AND DETAILS OF THE MEMBERS OF ITS GENERAL ASSEMBLY. A PUBLISHED MEMBER LIST IS THE MOST USEFUL DOCUMENT A COMMUNITY CAN FIND IN A GULF STATE. IT NAMES THE FARMERS OF A GOVERNORATE WHO HAVE ALREADY ORGANISED THEMSELVES, WHICH IS THE LIST OF PEOPLE TO TALK TO BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE. THE QUORUM FAILURE IS WORTH NOTICING TOO, NOT MOCKING: AN ASSEMBLY THAT CANNOT MUSTER ITS MEMBERS IS AN ORGANISATION WAITING FOR PEOPLE WHO WILL TURN UP. A GROUP OF FARMERS WITH A CONCRETE PROBLEM WALKING INTO A HALF-EMPTY GENERAL ASSEMBLY IS NOT AN INTRUSION, IT IS THE QUORUM. THE PURPOSE THESE SOCIETIES SET THEMSELVES IS BROADER THAN FARMING: OPENING FACTORIES AND ACTIVITIES THAT MEET THE NEEDS OF THE FARMERS AND RESIDENTS OF THE GOVERNORATE, UNDER STATED VALUES INCLUDING COOPERATION, TRANSPARENCY, BUILDING DISTINGUISHED PARTNERSHIPS AND SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY. AND THE OF THE GOVERNORATE'S RESIDENTS PART MATTERS: A COOPERATIVE THAT DEFINES ITS BENEFICIARIES AS RESIDENTS, NOT ONLY MEMBERS, IS ONE WHOSE MANDATE ALREADY COVERS THE VILLAGE NEXT DOOR. WHAT THE NATIONAL COUNCIL ACTUALLY DOES FOR THEM IS VISIBLE IN ONE EXAMPLE: A REGIONAL AGRICULTURAL COOPERATIVE HELD A WORKSHOP FOR FARMERS AND PRODUCERS ATTENDED BY MORE THAN NINETY DATE FARMERS, INTRODUCING THE PROGRAMMES OF THE NATIONAL PALMS AND DATES CENTRE, THE TRACKS FOR PALM CARE AND THE PURCHASE OF PALM OFFSHOOTS, COOPERATION BETWEEN THE CENTRE AND COOPERATIVE SOCIETIES, AND EXPORT AND FOOD MANUFACTURING - WITH PARTICIPANTS DISCUSSING THE CHALLENGES FACING FARMERS AND SEEKING PRACTICAL TRACKS BETWEEN THE SOCIETY AND THE CENTRE. NINETY FARMERS IN ONE ROOM, CONVENED BY A COOPERATIVE, DISCUSSING WHAT THEY CANNOT SOLVE ALONE - AND THE PURCHASE OF PALM OFFSHOOTS IS PLANTING STOCK, WHICH THIS FILE HAS SPENT MANY ROUNDS CHASING IN OTHER COUNTRIES. THE PRACTICAL SEQUENCE IS SHORT: FIND WHETHER A COOPERATIVE SOCIETY ALREADY COVERS YOUR GOVERNORATE, READ ITS PUBLISHED MEMBER LIST AND ASSEMBLY NOTICES, ATTEND, AND IF THERE IS NONE, FIND TWELVE NEIGHBOURS. THE LIMITS: A COOPERATIVE IS A COMMERCIAL AND AGRICULTURAL BODY, NOT AN ADVOCATE - IT EXISTS TO SERVE ITS MEMBERS' PRODUCTION AND INCOMES, NOT TO OPPOSE A PROJECT, AND ITS SOCIETIES ARE LICENSED AND SUPERVISED BY A MINISTRY THAT CAN ALSO REFUSE OR DISSOLVE THEM. FOUNDING ONE REQUIRES A MINISTERIAL ROUTE THAT WAS NOT ESTABLISHED HERE BEYOND THE MEMBER MINIMUM - FEES, CAPITAL, PREMISES AND TIMESCALE WERE NOT SEEN, NOR WAS WHETHER NON-CITIZENS OR WOMEN-ONLY GROUPS MAY FOUND ONE. THE PUBLISHED MINUTES AND MEMBER LIST COME FROM A SINGLE GOVERNORATE SOCIETY'S SITE AND OTHER SOCIETIES MAY PUBLISH NOTHING; THE FOUNDING NUMBERS AND THE WORKSHOP COME FROM THE COUNCIL'S OWN PAGES, AND THE COOPERATIVE SOCIETIES LAW ITSELF WAS SEEN ONLY AS A LISTING IN THE NATIONAL LAWS DATABASE. Read it with the royal reserve authorities' grazing licences and advisory teams, the endowments authority's unknown-endowment report, the vegetation cover centre and the water authority's laboratories recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Governorate fishermen's cooperative societies — boats, workshops, ice and net factories, and in one region boats and refrigerated trucks to rent
trackers.desc: THESE ARE THE MOST CONCRETE LOCAL ORGANISATIONS THIS FILE HAS FOUND IN THE COUNTRY: FISHERMEN'S COOPERATIVE SOCIETIES ORGANISED BY GOVERNORATE AND BY REGION, EACH WITH ITS OWN WEBSITE, AND WITH A LIST OF SERVICES THAT IS ALL EQUIPMENT AND NO RHETORIC. ONE SOCIETY LISTS THEM PLAINLY: SECURING THE REQUIREMENTS OF FISHERMEN - BOATS, TOOLS, MAINTENANCE AND SPARE PARTS; ESTABLISHING MAINTENANCE WORKSHOPS FOR FISHING BOATS AND MACHINERY; ESTABLISHING ICE AND NET FACTORIES; PRACTISING FISHING ACTIVITY AND MARKETING THE CATCH; TRAINING AND ASSISTING YOUNG PEOPLE IN SUPPORT SERVICES; AND ANY SERVICES FALLING WITHIN THE SOCIETY'S COMPETENCE. ICE AND NET FACTORIES ARE THE DETAIL THAT SHOWS THIS IS A REAL ECONOMIC BODY RATHER THAN A COMMITTEE. A COASTAL COMMUNITY WHOSE CATCH SPOILS BEFORE IT REACHES A BUYER LOSES ITS INCOME AND THEN ITS ARGUMENT FOR STAYING ON THE SHORE - ICE IS WHAT KEEPS BOTH. ANOTHER SOCIETY GOES FURTHER AND RENTS OUT THE MEANS OF WORK ITSELF: ON THE BASIS OF A USUFRUCT MINUTE SIGNED WITH THE ENVIRONMENT, WATER AND AGRICULTURE MINISTRY CONCERNING THE INITIATIVE TO LOCALISE THE FISHING PROFESSION, IT RENTS SMALL AND LARGE FISHING BOATS AND LARGE AND SMALL REFRIGERATED VEHICLES IN SUPPORT OF FISHERMEN. A BOAT AND A REFRIGERATED TRUCK ON RENTAL FROM A LOCAL SOCIETY IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A YOUNG FISHERMAN WITH NOTHING AND ONE WORKING THIS SEASON. IT ALSO MEANS THE SOCIETY HOLDS ASSETS OBTAINED FROM A MINISTRY - WHICH IS WORTH KNOWING WHEN ASKING WHAT ELSE IT COULD ASK FOR ON THE COMMUNITY'S BEHALF. ITS STATED MISSION IS BROADER THAN ITS MEMBERS: PROVIDING THE SERVICES THAT CONTRIBUTING MEMBERS NEED AND SERVING THE FISHERMEN'S COMMUNITY IN THE GOVERNORATE, AND MAKING VARIED PARTNERSHIPS WITH GOVERNMENT BODIES AND AUTHORITIES TO IMPROVE THE QUALITY OF SERVICES PROVIDED TO FISHERMEN. SERVING THE FISHERMEN'S COMMUNITY OF THE GOVERNORATE, NOT ONLY ITS SUBSCRIBERS, IS THE PHRASE TO QUOTE WHEN A NON-MEMBER FAMILY ASKS FOR HELP - AND MAKING PARTNERSHIPS WITH GOVERNMENT BODIES IS THE SENTENCE THAT MAKES IT A ROUTE TO OFFICIALS RATHER THAN A DEAD END. THEY ARE NOT ISOLATED: SEPARATE SOCIETIES PUBLISH THEIR OWN SITES FOR ANOTHER REGION AND FOR A THIRD GOVERNORATE, THE LATTER UNDER THE LINE THAT THEY ARE TOGETHER TO EMPOWER FISHERMEN AND DEVELOP THE FUTURE OF THE PROFESSION. SO THE PRACTICAL STEP FOR ANY COASTAL COMMUNITY HERE IS TO FIND WHETHER ITS GOVERNORATE HAS ONE, JOIN IT, AND PUT THE SHORE PROBLEM - RECLAMATION, DISCHARGE, A CLOSED LANDING PLACE - THROUGH A BODY THAT ALREADY MEETS THE MINISTRY ABOUT BOATS. FOR COMPARISON, THIS PAYLOAD ALREADY RECORDS THE NEIGHBOURING COUNTRY WHERE ONE EMIRATE'S FIVE FISHERMEN'S SOCIETIES COMPRISE ABOUT TWELVE HUNDRED AND FORTY-ONE FISHERMEN UNDER A FEDERAL COOPERATIVES LAW - THE SAME MODEL, WITH PUBLISHED MEMBERSHIP NUMBERS, WHICH IS THE FIGURE TO ASK THESE SOCIETIES FOR TOO. THE LIMITS: THESE ARE PRODUCER COOPERATIVES FOCUSED ON EQUIPMENT, MARKETING AND THE PROFESSION'S SURVIVAL - NOT ADVOCACY BODIES, AND NOTHING RECORDED HERE SHOWS ANY OF THEM OPPOSING A RECLAMATION, A PORT OR A DISCHARGE, WHICH ARE THE THINGS MOST OFTEN DESTROYING THE FISHERIES THIS PAYLOAD DOCUMENTS. MEMBERSHIP, FEES, WHETHER NON-CITIZEN CREWS CAN JOIN, AND WHETHER THE RENTAL SCHEME EXISTS OUTSIDE THE ONE REGION WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED. THE SERVICE LISTS COME FROM THE SOCIETIES' OWN SITES, ONE OF WHICH IS BUILT ON A FREE WEBSITE PLATFORM AND CARRIES NO DATE, AND NO MEMBERSHIP FIGURES OR CONTACT ROUTES WERE SEEN FOR ANY OF THEM. Read it with the agricultural cooperative societies and their national council, the royal reserve authorities' grazing licences, the environmental compliance centre's reporting route and the water authority's laboratories recorded separately for this country.THIS ENTRY ORIGINALLY RECORDED THAT NO MEMBERSHIP FIGURES COULD BE FOUND FOR ANY OF THESE SOCIETIES. ONE HAS SINCE BEEN FOUND: A FISHERMEN'S COOPERATIVE SOCIETY IN ONE REGION WAS FOUNDED IN 1430 OF THE HIJRI CALENDAR AND WITHIN A FEW YEARS ITS MEMBERSHIP REACHED THREE HUNDRED AND SIXTEEN MEMBERS FROM THE DIFFERENT AREAS OF THAT REGION. THREE HUNDRED AND SIXTEEN MEMBERS DRAWN FROM ACROSS A WHOLE REGION IS THE SCALE TO EXPECT — LARGE ENOUGH TO SPEAK FOR A COAST, SMALL ENOUGH THAT A DOZEN FISHERMEN JOINING TOGETHER ARE A VISIBLE BLOC INSIDE IT. ITS BACKERS ARE NAMED TOO, WHICH TELLS A COMMUNITY WHERE SUCH A SOCIETY'S MONEY AND PROTECTION COME FROM: A HOLDING COMPANY, THE LABOUR AND SOCIAL DEVELOPMENT MINISTRY, AND THE ENVIRONMENT, WATER AND AGRICULTURE MINISTRY. A CORPORATE SPONSOR SITTING ALONGSIDE TWO MINISTRIES IS WORTH KNOWING BEFORE ASKING A SOCIETY TO RAISE SOMETHING AWKWARD ABOUT A COASTAL PROJECT — AND EQUALLY WORTH KNOWING WHEN ASKING IT TO FUND A BOAT, A WORKSHOP OR AN ICE STORE. ONE MODEL FROM A NEIGHBOURING COUNTRY BELONGS BESIDE THIS: THERE, A CITY MUNICIPALITY BUILT THE FISHERMEN'S ASSOCIATION FACILITY ITSELF AS ONE OF ITS VITAL PROJECTS SERVING THE FISHERMEN SECTOR - A TWO-FLOOR ADMINISTRATION BUILDING WITH VARIOUS DEPARTMENTS AND AN ICE FACTORY PROVIDING ICE TO ALL THE FISHERMEN. SO THE ICE PLANT THAT KEEPS A CATCH SALEABLE CAN COME EITHER FROM THE COOPERATIVE'S OWN SERVICES OR FROM THE MUNICIPALITY AS A PUBLIC WORK. A COASTAL COMMUNITY SHOULD ASK BOTH, AND POINT EACH AT THE OTHER'S EXAMPLE.

trackers.name: Federal Competitiveness & Statistics Centre
trackers.desc: United Arab Emirates's national statistical office, publishing official national accounts and government-finance statistics — government revenue, expenditure, deficit and public debt. HOW THIS DIFFERS: this gives AGGREGATE national totals, not project-level detail — use it for the big picture, not to see who won a specific contract (use the procurement portal) or what one project cost. Here you can trace how the public budget is allocated and spent in the United Arab Emirates.

trackers.desc: Federal Ministry of Justice portal with judicial services and a published judgments collection. · Find here: the UAE Ministry of Justice — federal court services and legal information.

trackers.name: Kuwait Regional Convention (ROPME) — and its Judicial Commission
trackers.desc: THE ONE BINDING ENVIRONMENTAL INSTRUMENT COVERING ALL EIGHT GULF STATES. The Kuwait Regional Convention for Cooperation on the Protection of the Marine Environment from Pollution was signed 24 April 1978 and entered into force 1 July 1979 — 30 articles, described as the basic legal instrument binding the eight States of the Region. ALL EIGHT ARE FULL PARTIES: ROPME records ‘no signatories without ratification, acceptance, approval or accession’, so unlike some regional instruments there is no signed-but-unratified state to argue about. ARTICLE II fixes the Sea Area by coordinates, from Ras Dharbat Ali (16°39'N, 53°3'30"E) to Ras Al Fasteh (25°04'N, 61°25'E) — a treaty boundary you can check a project location against. Use the term ‘ROPME Sea Area’: it was coined by the Plenipotentiaries to achieve unanimity, cooperating in spite of existing geopolitical boundaries, and it is the name all eight accepted. THE ORGAN MOST PEOPLE DO NOT KNOW EXISTS: alongside the Council and Secretariat, ROPME has a Judicial Commission, established March 1989, of 6 nationals of Member States highly qualified in international law. In a region with almost no environmental litigation route, a standing judicial commission under a ratified convention is the most significant legal fact available — though this entry does not assert that individuals may petition it; establish who may seise it first. AN EVIDENCE SOURCE THAT NEEDS NO SITE ACCESS: ROPME's scientific bodies include a Remote Sensing Unit, alongside RIIS and MEMAC. WHICH PROTOCOL FITS YOUR ISSUE: oil-spill emergency response; land-based sources of pollution — the limb for a coastal development, discharge or reclamation; and transboundary movement of hazardous wastes. Development is named as a stressor in ROPME's own statement of purpose. At stake: over 20 species of dolphin and whale, all five subtropical turtle species, and more than 1,000 fish species, most endemic.

trackers.name: MBZ Species Conservation Fund — frame it as species work, not climate
trackers.desc: DO NOT DRESS A SPECIES PROJECT UP AS A CLIMATE PROJECT HERE — which is the opposite of the advice that fits almost every other fund in this map. The MBZ Fund was established on the basis that direct species conservation has lost out to wider concerns such as climate change, sustainability and poverty alleviation, and is now seen as a by-product of larger issues, leaving underfunded field biologists and wardens. It exists to correct that displacement, so frame the work as direct, field-based species conservation. A philanthropic endowment announced at the World Conservation Congress in Barcelona, October 2008, taking applications since March 2009; managing director Razan Khalifa Al Mubarak, also President of IUCN. By end-2010 it had disbursed just over US$5 million to about 380 projects in almost 100 countries; awards run up to US$25,000. TWO UNUSUAL ELIGIBILITY POINTS: it covers all animal, plant AND FUNGI species — fungi are named, which almost no other fund in this map does — and its focus includes data-deficient species, so you need not prove the species is threatened; where the problem is that nobody knows, that is itself a qualifying category. Individual conservationists may apply, and priority goes to projects supporting young conservationists. Funding is for direct conservation impact rather than administrative costs. HOW IT RUNS: three rounds a year, March, June and October; the Fund forwards recommendations to an independent body, so its staff are not the final decision-makers; and late submissions are automatically moved to the next round — missing a deadline costs a cycle, not the application. Apply online in English; the form requires a budget, references and permits, so have your permissions in order before applying. READ THE PROJECTS DATABASE FIRST — searchable by species, IUCN classification, continent and year, it shows what has been funded for comparable species in comparable places. NOTE: THIS FUND IS GLOBAL, NOT REGIONAL — it is recorded here because this country holds no other funding entry, not because Gulf applicants receive any preference.

trackers.name: Emirates Nature-WWF — read the board list before you approach it: the regulators and economic authorities sit on it
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE UAE'S PRINCIPAL ENVIRONMENTAL CHARITY AND IT IS NOT AN ADVERSARIAL BODY — CHECK WHO SITS ON THE BOARD BEFORE YOU PLAN AROUND IT. Its published board includes the Vice Chairman of the Environment Agency – Abu Dhabi, the Chairwoman of the Environment and Protected Areas Authority, the Minister of Economy, a Minister of State, the Director General of Fujairah Municipality and the Director General of Dubai's Department of Economy and Tourism. The regulator you would be objecting to and the authority promoting the development are represented in the same room. That is not a criticism of its conservation work; it is the fact that determines what you can realistically ask it for. WHAT IT CAN GIVE YOU: data and volunteer capacity. Its Leaders of Change programme reports more than 10,000 participants, 40,000 volunteer hours and 100,000 data points collected for science, and the organisation works on Hajar mountain range conservation and on building a network of protected areas and ecological corridors across the emirates. Founded 2001; contact via the Contact Us page on its own site. WHAT NO ONE IN THE UAE APPEARS TO OFFER: this search found no independent public-interest environmental law practice, no land trust, and no community objection fund in the country. Land protection runs through the state — the Zayed Protected Areas Network is managed by the Environment Agency – Abu Dhabi, and reserve designations are made by leadership direction rather than by petition. A resident's realistic route is therefore evidentiary and administrative: assemble species and habitat evidence for the site, use the citizen-science channels above to generate a record, and address the relevant emirate-level environment authority directly. Record this as an established absence rather than an unfinished search.

trackers.name: Emirates Natural History Group — its volunteers found a mammal two official government surveys had missed
trackers.desc: THE SINGLE MOST USEFUL FACT ABOUT THIS GROUP IS WHAT IT FOUND: in March 1997 ENHG members on a birdwatching outing rediscovered the Arabian tahr on Jebel Hafit, a mammal considered extinct in the UAE, unseen for over fifteen years and NOT RECORDED BY TWO EXTENSIVE OFFICIAL SURVEYS IN 1986 AND 1990. If a developer's assessment reports that nothing of note lives on your site, that precedent is the answer — absence from an official survey is not evidence of absence, and it has been demonstrated here in the clearest possible way. Ask this group what its members have recorded at your location before accepting anyone's baseline. IT HOLDS THE RECORD ITSELF: Tribulus, established 1991 and still published, is the journal of record for UAE natural history and the only peer-reviewed English-language scientific journal of its kind in the country, carrying species occurrence records and species new to science; back issues sit on the group's own site. Members also get access to its natural history and archaeology library by arrangement, and the group runs expert-led field trips including survey work and mangrove visits. AND IT GIVES MONEY, WHICH ALMOST NOTHING ELSE IN THIS COUNTRY DOES: it has funded field research, including a grant that let the UAE Dolphin Project buy equipment for a survey around Saadiyat Island, and in 2014 it funded production of a shark and ray identification guide. The sums are small and the purpose is research rather than campaigning, but in a country where this file has found no community objection fund at all, a body that pays for a survey is worth knowing. WHAT IT IS: described on its own chapter pages as the oldest non-governmental organisation dealing with environmental topics in the United Arab Emirates, and identified in its own journal as a non-governmental member of IUCN. Founded in Abu Dhabi in the mid-1970s, with chapters since established in Al Ain, Dubai, Fujairah and Ras Al Khaimah, so there is a chapter near most of the country. Membership is inexpensive and open to individuals and families; the group does not meet in July and August. THE LIMITS, PLAINLY: this is a natural history society, not a campaign. It will not object to a scheme, litigate or hold land, its membership is largely amateur naturalists and long-term expatriate residents, and it operates comfortably within UAE establishment structures. Use it for records, for the journal, for the library and for a small research grant — and read it alongside the Emirates Nature-WWF entry in this file, whose board includes the regulators and economic authorities a project would be argued in front of. Two small notes: founding is given as both 1976 and 1977 across sources, and the Abu Dhabi chapter runs its membership through a separate hosted platform rather than the main domain.

trackers.name: Rufford Small Grants — the UAE is named eligible, and it funds a person rather than an institution
trackers.desc: THE UNITED ARAB EMIRATES APPEARS ON THIS FOUNDATION'S ELIGIBLE COUNTRY LIST, WHICH IS THE FIRST OPEN FUNDING ROUTE THIS FILE HAS FOUND FOR THE COUNTRY. Searching the UAE previously established that no independent public-interest environmental law practice, land trust or community objection fund could be found, and that its principal environmental charity has the regulators and economic authorities on its own board. A foreign funder taking applications from individuals sidesteps all of that. NO DEADLINES — apply at any time of year. Applicants are individuals and small groups, with the focus on people early in a conservation career, particularly current or recent MSc and PhD students; undergraduates are not funded. CHECK THE SPECIES TEST FIRST: work on any species not listed as Least Concern globally on the IUCN Red List qualifies, as does work on species not yet assessed but thought to be globally threatened. Habitat work, human-wildlife conflict and community education qualify without a species focus. STAGED FUNDING from up to £7,000 to about £18,000 across four grants, each requiring the last to be completed and reported, with those reports published on the applicant's own page — a public, independent record of work done, which is worth something in itself where documentation is otherwise controlled. One application per twelve months; twelve months after a rejection before reapplying; the foundation covers half to all of a project and wants evidence of any co-funding; no pure research without conservation benefit, no self-fundraised expeditions. Pair with the natural history society recorded here, whose members' records established that an official survey had missed a mammal thought extinct — an application resting on that kind of prior record is stronger than one starting from nothing.

trackers.name: Accountability Counsel — the UAE is not among the Gulf states from which nobody has ever complained
trackers.desc: THIS ORGANISATION'S OWN RESEARCH NAMES EIGHT MIDDLE EASTERN COUNTRIES AS PLACES FROM WHICH NO COMMUNITY COMPLAINT HAS EVER REACHED A DEVELOPMENT BANK'S ACCOUNTABILITY OFFICE — INCLUDING BAHRAIN, KUWAIT, OMAN, QATAR AND SAUDI ARABIA. THE UAE IS NOT AMONG THEM. Of fourteen Middle Eastern countries counted, thirty complaints had been submitted from six. That does not tell you a complaint from the UAE will succeed, but it does mean this route is not untried here in the way it is next door — and it is worth asking this organisation what has been filed before you start. WHAT IT DOES: at the request of communities it assists people in using accountability offices to defend their rights and remedy harm caused by internationally financed projects. An accountability office sits inside the lending institution, operates independently of it, reports to its highest leadership, and can conduct compliance investigations or convene dispute resolution — entirely outside the national courts, which matters in a country where this file could find no independent public-interest environmental law practice at all. THE SUPPORT SCALES TO WHAT YOU CAN USE: from multi-year accompaniment through a whole complaint down to a limited review of your key documents — so a community that needs someone qualified to read a financing agreement and say whether an accountability office applies can ask for exactly that and nothing more. It is expert in the mechanisms of the World Bank Group, regional development banks, export credit agencies and OECD National Contact Points, and it partners with local lawyers to run the international complaint alongside a domestic strategy rather than instead of one. ITS DATABASE OF EVERY COMPLAINT EVER FILED TO EVERY ACCOUNTABILITY OFFICE IS FREE AND PUBLIC, so checking what has been filed against your project's lender, or from this country, costs nothing. THE DECIDING QUESTION IS WHO IS FINANCING THE PROJECT: no international public or development finance means no accountability office and no route here. Founded 2009, having worked with communities in fifty countries, headquartered in the United States with a regional presence in Asia; no casework of its own in the UAE could be established. This is the first entry for this country offering legal representation of any kind.

trackers.name: United Arab Emirates University — decade-by-decade coastline change, and conservation scenarios modelled with and without dredging
trackers.desc: ITS RESEARCHERS PUBLISHED WORK IDENTIFYING COASTAL AND MARINE PRIORITY AREAS FOR CONSERVATION IN THE COUNTRY, AND MODELLED IT AS EIGHT PLANNING SCENARIOS — varying the conservation targets, whether existing marine protected areas were counted, and WHETHER DREDGING WAS TAKEN INTO ACCOUNT, dredging being identified in that work as an activity linked with coastal development. A community objecting to a coastal scheme is almost always told there is no alternative. This is published, peer-reviewed work that models several, produced with the national environment agency and an overseas university — which makes it hard to dismiss as advocacy. AND ITS GEOGRAPHY DEPARTMENT PUBLISHED THE SPATIOTEMPORAL VARIATION OF THE COUNTRY'S COASTLINE FOR EACH DECADE FROM 1991 TO 2021. A decade-by-decade record of where the shoreline actually was is the single most useful document for anyone contesting reclamation or arguing that a coast has already absorbed enough — this file has repeatedly found that communities lack a before-record, and here one exists for an entire national coast. THE WIDER LITERATURE IS OPEN ACCESS AND SAYS WHAT A DEVELOPER'S ASSESSMENT WILL NOT: a systematic review of fifty years of Gulf coastal urbanisation, by researchers at another university in the country, records that development accelerated in the early 2000s with large-scale coastal MEGA-PROJECTS and produced significant habitat modification and land-cover change. It also notes that remote sensing research has concentrated on the southern and western Gulf coasts and that the northern Gulf is far less studied — so a reader in Kuwait or Iraq should expect thinner published evidence than one in the Emirates. HOW TO USE A UNIVERSITY RATHER THAN AN ORGANISATION: find the published work first, then the named department. The relevant work here sits in biology and in a department of geography and urban sustainability, and the country's universities are described in the literature as a principal source of environmental data for researchers and government departments alike. THE LIMITS: this is a state university and it will not campaign; there is no community request route, only research collaboration; and the priority-areas work was produced WITH the national environment agency, which is also the regulator — useful for credibility, but it means the analysis was not designed to oppose anything. Take the data and the scenarios; take the objection elsewhere.

trackers.name: Dubai's voluntary legal services portal — free lawyers, chosen by the area of law they volunteer in
trackers.desc: THE PORTAL IS OPEN TO ALL MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC SEEKING FREE LEGAL SERVICES, and it works by connecting them to volunteering advocates and legal consultancy firms in the emirate. An individual registers with a few basic personal details; participating firms register their own details and SPECIFY THE AREAS OF LAW IN WHICH THEY ARE QUALIFIED TO VOLUNTEER, and those firm details are then made available to the public. THAT LAST POINT IS THE USABLE ONE: YOU CAN SEE WHICH FIRMS VOLUNTEER IN WHICH FIELD AND APPROACH ONE WHOSE PRACTICE MATCHES A PROPERTY, PLANNING OR ADMINISTRATIVE DISPUTE, rather than taking whoever is assigned. This file has recorded across the region that framing a land dispute as a property or administrative matter, not an environmental one, is what gets it taken seriously; here you can choose a lawyer on exactly that basis. It is reachable through the department's website and through an application on the main mobile stores. THE SAME DEPARTMENT PUBLISHES A DIRECTORY OF ALL ADVOCATES AND LEGAL CONSULTANTS REGISTERED WITH IT, including the licensed firms they work in, with a published address, telephone number and separate email addresses for advocates and for legal consultants. Use it to confirm that anyone you are about to instruct is licensed — the Saudi bar publishes an equivalent register, and this file recorded in R158 that verifying a lawyer is real is the first practical step. NOW THE CONFLICT, AND IT IS STRUCTURAL RATHER THAN INCIDENTAL: THE DEPARTMENT RUNNING THIS PORTAL IS THE GOVERNMENT'S OWN LAWYER. Its functions include representing the government and government entities in proceedings brought by or against them, and receiving complaints and claims against government entities with a view to settling them amicably. If your dispute is with a government entity or a state-linked developer, the body operating the free legal channel is the body that would defend the other side.
