WHETHER SEEDLINGS ARE AVAILABLE ON REQUEST OUTSIDE CAMPAIGN WEEKS, WHETHER THERE IS A LIMIT PER HOUSEHOLD, AND WHETHER ANY MUNICIPALITY WILL SUPPLY TREES FOR PRIVATE OR COMMUNITY LAND RATHER THAN PUBLIC SPACE WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED - THOSE ARE THE THREE QUESTIONS FOR THE AGRICULTURE AND PUBLIC GARDENS DEPARTMENT. THE FIGURES COME FROM NEWSPAPER REPORTS OF MAY 2026 AND MUNICIPAL PRESS RELEASES OF 2023, 2024 AND 2026, EACH ABOUT A DIFFERENT EMIRATE, SO NOTHING HERE IS A NATIONAL ENTITLEMENT. Read it with the fishermen's cooperative societies and their workshop, the species conservation fund's grants to individuals, the legal aid and judicial department cost coverage and the emirate protected areas authority recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Endowment authorities — federal, emirate and city bodies that hold, maintain and develop endowed property
trackers.desc: A TAG SCAN OF THE WHOLE PAYLOAD SHOWED THIS COUNTRY WITH ONLY ONE ENTRY ANYWHERE ABOUT ACQUIRING OR HOLDING LAND - THE FEWEST OF ALL TWENTY-THREE. THIS IS THE SECOND, AND IT USES THE REGION'S OWN INSTRUMENT: THREE LEVELS OF ENDOWMENT BODIES THAT HOLD PROPERTY OUT OF THE MARKET. AT THE TOP IS A FEDERAL GENERAL AUTHORITY OF ISLAMIC AFFAIRS, ENDOWMENTS AND ZAKAT, FOUNDED IN 2006, WHICH REGULATES AND MANAGES MOSQUE, ZAKAT AND ENDOWMENT AFFAIRS AND PROVIDES WHAT IT CALLS SUSTAINABLE ENDOWMENT DEVELOPMENT - AND WHICH IN MARCH 2025 ADOPTED A SINGLE NATIONAL IDENTITY FOR ENDOWMENT INITIATIVES. A UNIFIED NATIONAL IDENTITY FOR ENDOWMENTS MEANS THERE IS NOW ONE NAME TO ASK ABOUT AND ONE PROGRAMME TO ASK TO JOIN, RATHER THAN A SCATTER OF SEPARATE SCHEMES - WHICH IS THE KIND OF SIMPLIFICATION THAT MAKES A FIRST APPROACH POSSIBLE. AT EMIRATE LEVEL SITS AN ENDOWMENTS AUTHORITY - FOR ENDOWMENTS AND THE MANAGEMENT OF MINORS' FUNDS - ESTABLISHED ON THE DIRECTION OF THE HEAD OF STATE AS THE SUPREME BODY RESPONSIBLE FOR MANAGING THAT EMIRATE'S ENDOWMENTS, WORKING UNDER THE SUPERVISION OF THE EXECUTIVE COUNCIL, AND UNDERTAKING TO ORGANISE, MAINTAIN AND DEVELOP ENDOWED ASSETS AND ENSURE THE DISTRIBUTION OF THEIR RETURNS. ORGANISE, MAINTAIN AND DEVELOP IS A DUTY OWED TO THE ASSET ITSELF. WHERE A PIECE OF GROUND IS ENDOWED, THAT DUTY IS THE THING A COMMUNITY CAN INVOKE WHEN IT IS NEGLECTED, BUILT OVER OR QUIETLY EXCHANGED. THE AUTHORITY'S STATED PURPOSE IS ALSO USEFULLY LONG-TERM: ACHIEVING A POSITIVE SOCIAL AND ECONOMIC EFFECT FOR PRESENT AND FUTURE GENERATIONS, AND SUSTAINABLE VALUE FOR THE EMIRATE AND ITS RESIDENTS. FOR ITS RESIDENTS, NOT ITS CITIZENS. IN A COUNTRY WHERE MOST PEOPLE HOLD NO CITIZENSHIP, THAT WORD IS WORTH NOTING WHEREVER IT APPEARS. IN THE OTHER MAIN CITY, ENDOWMENTS HAVE THEIR OWN DEPARTMENT FOUNDED ON THE TWENTY-FOURTH OF OCTOBER 1969 - ORIGINALLY THE DEPARTMENT OF ENDOWMENTS, LATER TAKING ON ISLAMIC AFFAIRS - ALONGSIDE AN ENDOWMENTS AND MINORS' AFFAIRS FOUNDATION THAT PUBLISHES ITS LAWS AND LEGISLATION, ITS ORGANISATIONAL STRUCTURE, ITS BUILDINGS AND CENTRES, AND A SERVICES SECTION INCLUDING SERVICES FOR INDIVIDUALS. SERVICES FOR INDIVIDUALS IS WHERE TO START. A DEPARTMENT WITH A PUBLISHED LIST OF BUILDINGS AND CENTRES AND A SERVICES MENU FOR INDIVIDUALS IS ONE A PERSON CAN WALK INTO WITH A QUESTION ABOUT A PARTICULAR PLOT. THE MOST INSTRUCTIVE DETAIL IS THAT THE EMIRATE AUTHORITY RUNS NAMED THEMATIC ENDOWMENTS - ONE AIMED AT STRENGTHENING COMMUNITY WELLBEING BY PROVIDING FREE MEDICAL CARE. AN ENDOWMENT ORGANISED AROUND A STATED PUBLIC PURPOSE, RATHER THAN AROUND A MOSQUE OR A BUILDING, IS THE PRECEDENT THAT MATTERS FOR LAND. IF HEALTH CAN BE THE PURPOSE, SO CAN WATER, TREES, GRAZING OR A SHORE - AND THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED IN A NEIGHBOURING COUNTRY THAT THE ENDOWER DETERMINES THE PURPOSES. THE LIMITS: THESE ARE STATE RELIGIOUS AND ASSET-MANAGEMENT BODIES, NOT CONSERVATION ORGANISATIONS - THEIR PURPOSE INCLUDES DEVELOPING ENDOWED ASSETS AND DISTRIBUTING RETURNS, WHICH IN PRACTICE MEANS INVESTING AND BUILDING ON PROPERTY AS WELL AS PRESERVING IT, AND NOTHING RECORDED HERE SHOWS ONE PROTECTING LAND FOR ENVIRONMENTAL REASONS. WHETHER A NEW ENDOWMENT CAN BE CREATED BY ORDINARY RESIDENTS, WHETHER NON-CITIZENS MAY ENDOW PROPERTY, WHETHER ANY REGISTER OF ENDOWED LAND IS SEARCHABLE, AND WHAT THE INDIVIDUAL SERVICES ACTUALLY COVER WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED - THOSE ARE THE FOUR QUESTIONS FOR THE COUNTER. THE ACCOUNT COMES FROM THE EMIRATE AUTHORITY'S OWN HOMEPAGE, A GOVERNMENT MEDIA OFFICE ANNOUNCEMENT OF MARCH 2025, A NATIONAL PORTAL DESCRIPTION AND AN ENCYCLOPAEDIA ENTRY FOR THE CITY DEPARTMENT - NOT FROM A SERVICE CATALOGUE OR A LAND REGISTER. Read it with the fishermen's cooperative societies and their workshop, the municipal nurseries and planting week, the species conservation fund's grants to individuals and the legal aid and judicial department cost coverage recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: PERAC Principles — protected zones when domestic machinery has stopped
trackers.desc: AN INSTRUMENT WRITTEN FOR EXACTLY THIS SITUATION, AND IT NAMES NO ONE. The Principles on Protection of the Environment in Relation to Armed Conflicts — 28 principles adopted by the International Law Commission on second reading on 27 May 2022 and welcomed by the UN General Assembly in A/RES/77/104 of 7 December 2022, adopted without vote — cover the whole arc: before, during and after armed conflict, and situations of occupation. BE HONEST ABOUT THEIR STATUS: they are nonbinding — but ILC documents are recorded as increasingly interpreted by tribunals, courts and governments as ‘reflections of customary international law’. Cite them as that, not as treaty obligations. PRINCIPLE 4 IS THE DESIGNATION ROUTE WHEN DOMESTIC MACHINERY HAS STOPPED: States should designate, by agreement or otherwise, areas of environmental importance as protected zones in the event of an armed conflict, including where those areas are of cultural importance — cultural importance is an express qualifying ground. PRINCIPLE 5 requires States, international organisations AND other relevant actors to protect the environment of the lands and territories that indigenous peoples inhabit or traditionally use, and where conflict has harmed it, to consult and cooperate with indigenous peoples on remedial measures — note that the addressees are not only States, which reaches bodies operating where a government cannot or will not act. PRINCIPLE 3 requires effective legislative, administrative, judicial and other measures. AND THE STRUCTURAL POINT: the ILC chose not to differentiate between international and non-international armed conflicts, so the environment-related conduct of non-state armed groups also comes within their purview — which matters where harm is done by armed groups rather than a state army. The distinctions sit in the commentaries, which should be read together with the principles. CITE ALONGSIDE: the 2020 ICRC Guidelines on protection of the natural environment in armed conflict, UNEA resolution 2/15 (27 May 2016), the 2019 Geneva List of Principles on the Protection of Water Infrastructure, and victim-assistance provisions in the Mine Ban Treaty and the Convention on Cluster Munitions.

trackers.name: ICCA Registry and Protected Planet — and registration is not a precondition
trackers.desc: CHECK WHETHER YOUR SITE IS ALREADY IN A REGISTRY BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE — it may carry a designation nobody locally mentioned. The World Database on Protected and Conserved Areas at protectedplanet.net is a joint UNEP and IUCN product managed by UNEP-WCMC, drawing on almost 500 data providers in 245 countries, updated monthly and downloadable; it underpins the UN List of Protected Areas. THE OECM ROUTE IS THE ONE MOST COMMUNITIES MISS: a site qualifies as an other effective area-based conservation measure if it delivers sustained, positive conservation outcomes EVEN THOUGH IT MAY BE MANAGED PRIMARILY FOR OTHER REASONS — so a grazing commons, a sacred site or a watershed managed for water supply can qualify without being managed primarily for conservation. Land that is worked rather than preserved is not excluded. But note the exclusivity: a site can be a protected area or an OECM — it is not possible to meet both, so ask which is being proposed. THE ICCA REGISTRY IS THE ONE COMMUNITIES FILL IN THEMSELVES: at iccaregistry.org, communities themselves provide data, case studies, maps, photos and stories, and its operators state it is meant to be used to enhance advocacy and recognition — not merely as an inventory. Documenting a territory there creates a citable, third-party-hosted record. THE SENTENCE THAT MATTERS MOST: UNEP-WCMC states these territories must be recognised and respected ‘whether or not they have been reported to the ICCA Registry’ — registration is NOT a precondition of rights, and anyone arguing a claim is weaker for being unregistered is arguing against the registry operator's own position. AND USE THE SCALE FIGURE CAREFULLY: over 1,500 sites are reported under indigenous and community governance — just 1 percent of all recorded sites, with UNEP-WCMC adding that no one knows how many ICCAs exist globally. That 1 percent measures how little has been recorded, not how little communities conserve. Filter Protected Planet by governance type to find such sites; UNEP-WCMC's manual Global Databases to Support ICCAs gives guidance on contributing data.

trackers.name: Rufford Small Grants — Yemen is named eligible, and this is the first resource of any kind recorded for the country
trackers.desc: YEMEN IS LISTED AMONG THIS FOUNDATION'S ELIGIBLE COUNTRIES, AND IT IS NOT AMONG THE COUNTRIES IT CANNOT CURRENTLY CONSIDER — a list that does exist and that names Syria, Iran, Sudan, Afghanistan and others explicitly. Yemen is on the eligible side of that line. That is worth stating plainly because this map otherwise holds nothing for Yemen at all: no fund, no organisation, no legal body could be verified as open to Yemeni communities across four earlier rounds. THE APPLICANT CAN BE A PERSON. There are no deadlines and applications may be submitted at any time of year, which matters where conditions make planning around a funding calendar impossible. The focus is people early in a conservation career, especially current or recent postgraduate students, with others considered against the published criteria; undergraduates are excluded. THE ELIGIBILITY TEST FOR SPECIES WORK IS PUBLISHED AND CHECKABLE: any species not listed as Least Concern globally on the IUCN Red List qualifies, as do species not yet assessed but believed globally threatened. Work on threatened habitats, human-wildlife conflict or community education qualifies without a species focus. GRANTS ARE STAGED: up to £7,000 first, then a second, a Booster and a Completion Grant, reaching about £18,000, each requiring the previous to be finished and reported, with updates published on the applicant's page. CONSTRAINTS: one application per twelve months, twelve months' wait after a rejection, and the foundation expects to fund between half and all of the project with evidence of any co-funding. SAY THIS PLAINLY: formal eligibility is not the same as practical possibility, and nothing here establishes what is workable on the ground in Yemen. What it establishes is that a funder exists which has not closed its door to the country, and that a Yemeni applicant does not need an institution, a registration or a deadline to approach it.

trackers.name: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation — this country is eligible on two of its three priorities
trackers.desc: ITS STATED PRIORITY AREAS INCLUDE THE LEAST DEVELOPED COUNTRIES AS CLASSIFIED BY THE UNITED NATIONS, WHICH COVERS THIS ONE — and its three domains are climate change and renewable energy, BIODIVERSITY PROTECTION, and WATER RESOURCES AND DESERTIFICATION. Water and desertification are the frame most likely to fit here, and this country holds only one other entry besides a heritage route in this map. HOW IT WORKS: an annual call opening for one month in June, beginning with a SHORT ONLINE PRE-APPLICATION rather than a full proposal — which is a low cost to test whether an idea is of interest. NO MAXIMUM GRANT IS SET, BUT IT WILL FUND AT MOST HALF OF A PROJECT'S BUDGET. That co-funding requirement is the obstacle for a small organisation, and the practical answer this file has seen in the region is sequencing: a smaller fund starts the work, this foundation continues it. THE PRE-APPLICATION ACCEPTS ASSOCIATIONS, COMPANIES, PUBLIC BODIES AND INDIVIDUALS, and the call is reported not to restrict where the applicant comes from — which matters in a country where registering and banking are themselves obstacles, because a partner organisation abroad may be able to carry the application. THE LIMITS ARE REAL: no project here was found in what it publishes, conflict conditions make implementation and transfers difficult, and it funds conservation and water work rather than opposition to a scheme. Read its published project list before applying, as it advises, and confirm directly that it will consider proposals concerning this country.

trackers.name: RAED — the Arab environmental network, and its membership list names a coordinator in this country
trackers.desc: ITS MEMBERSHIP PAGE IS THE THING TO OPEN FIRST. The network states that environmental and sustainable development associations from across the Arab countries have joined it — this one among them — AND IT LISTS THE COORDINATOR ASSOCIATION FOR EACH COUNTRY. That is a named domestic contact point in a country where this map otherwise records only foreign bodies. This file has repeatedly failed to find local associations by searching for them; here is a register kept by people who already work with them. IT IS LARGE AND OLD: more than two hundred and fifty member organisations across the Arab countries of North Africa and West Asia, established in 1990 during preparations for the Rio Earth Summit, headquartered in Egypt and registered with that country's social solidarity ministry since 2007. AND IT SITS WHERE ARAB ENVIRONMENTAL POLICY IS ACTUALLY MADE, WHICH MATTERS FOR A COMMUNITY WITH NO DOMESTIC ROUTE AT ALL: the League of Arab States recognised it in 1995 as an observer in the COUNCIL OF ARAB MINISTERS RESPONSIBLE FOR THE ENVIRONMENT, attending its meetings, and it has held United Nations Economic and Social Council consultative status since 1996. A grievance carried by a member association can reach a regional ministerial table that no individual can approach. IT DOES CARRY SUCH THINGS: it submitted a statement of Arab civil society organisations to the presidency of the desertification convention's conference in Riyadh in December 2024, expressing concern about worsening DESERTIFICATION, DROUGHT AND LAND DEGRADATION and calling for urgent collective action. Land degradation is the frame most likely to fit a case here. IT ALSO PUBLISHES A MONTHLY NEWSLETTER sent to environmental associations, civil society organisations and specialists across all Arab countries, supported by a Mediterranean capacity building programme and a global small grants programme — which makes it a way to find out what is happening and who is funding it without any local infrastructure. Its stated priorities include water scarcity, biodiversity conservation, sustainable natural resource management and EMPOWERING LOCAL COMMUNITIES through community-based solutions. THE LIMITS: it is a network and a policy platform, not an objector, a funder or a law practice. It will not take up a project, and its work runs at ministerial and convention level rather than at the level of a single site. Use it to find the association in your own country, then work through that association.

trackers.name: GBIF — three billion species records, searchable by place, and citable with a permanent identifier
trackers.desc: SEARCH YOUR OWN DISTRICT AND SEE WHAT HAS BEEN RECORDED THERE. It holds more than three billion species occurrence records, drawn from natural history museums, HERBARIA, government inventories, research surveys and citizen science, published by institutions in over a hundred countries — filterable by country, by area and by year, and free. Each record carries the scientific name, coordinates, the DATE, the source, and flags describing the data's provenance and locational accuracy, so you can judge how solid it is. THE FEATURE THAT MATTERS MOST IS THE ONE NOTHING ELSE IN THIS FILE OFFERS: WHEN YOU DOWNLOAD A SET OF RECORDS IT GENERATES A PERMANENT IDENTIFIER, MAKING YOUR EXACT EXTRACTION CITABLE AND REPRODUCIBLE, and single records carry their own citation strings. An impact assessment can brush aside a villager's claim that a bird nests on a hillside. It cannot as easily brush aside a citation with a permanent reference that anyone can re-download and verify. This file has recorded across the region that evidence which survives scrutiny is what changes outcomes. THIS MATTERS PARTICULARLY HERE. This country holds globally significant endemic species, and this map records no domestic body that could supply a species list — its other entries are a heritage instrument, two foreign funds and a regional network. The specimens collected here over a century by museums and herbaria abroad are in this database, and they are free to consult. DOWNLOADS COME AS COORDINATES IN A SPREADSHEET, which can be imported straight into mapping tools — including the free satellite imagery browser and the offline community mapping application recorded elsewhere in this file. Together they let a community show WHAT was recorded, WHERE, and HOW THE PLACE HAS CHANGED. Access is free and the data carries open licences; a free account is needed to make a download. THE LIMIT IS SERIOUS AND CUTS BOTH WAYS: IT RECORDS WHAT HAS BEEN OBSERVED AND PUBLISHED, NOT WHAT EXISTS. An under-surveyed district looks empty — and a developer can cite that emptiness as readily as you cite a record. If your area shows nothing, that is a reason to survey it, not evidence that nothing lives there; and a survey you conduct can itself be published into this system.

trackers.name: The land coalition's member in this country — an address in the capital, and a signed test for any scheme
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY HAS A MEMBER OF THE GLOBAL LAND-RIGHTS COALITION, AND IT HAS A STREET ADDRESS IN THE CAPITAL. Every other entry recorded here for this country is a foreign fund, a regional network or a global database. This one is domestic, listed on the coalition's own regional site under the country's name, with a published address and coordinates. WHAT MEMBERSHIP MEANS IN PRACTICE IS THE PART TO USE. Every member has signed a commitment that LARGE-SCALE INITIATIVES INVOLVING LAND, WATER AND OTHER NATURAL RESOURCES must comply with human rights and environmental obligations and be based on FOUR THINGS: the FREE, PRIOR AND INFORMED CONSENT of existing land users; a THOROUGH ASSESSMENT OF ECONOMIC, SOCIAL, CULTURAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACTS with respect to BOTH WOMEN AND MEN; DEMOCRATIC PLANNING AND INDEPENDENT OVERSIGHT; and TRANSPARENT CONTRACTS. THAT IS FOUR QUESTIONS TO PUT TO ANY SCHEME, AND A SIGNATORY ORGANISATION IS COMMITTED TO EACH OF THEM. Was consent obtained from the people already using the land? Does the assessment cover social and cultural impacts, not only environmental ones, and does it treat women's and men's losses separately? Is there independent oversight, or only the developer's own? Is the contract public? A community that asks those four in writing has framed its objection in terms the scheme's own backers claim to accept. MEMBERS HAVE ALSO SIGNED COMMITMENTS ON WOMEN AND LAND THAT MATTER PARTICULARLY HERE: enhancing the ability of women to DEFEND THEIR LAND RIGHTS and take equal part in decision-making, and ensuring that control over land and the benefits derived from it are equal between women and men — INCLUDING THE RIGHT TO INHERIT AND BEQUEATH TENURE RIGHTS. This file has recorded across the region that women who work land are routinely absent from the decisions about it. AND ON DEFENDERS: members pledge to defend land and environmental defenders who are CRIMINALISED, INTIMIDATED AND MARGINALISED for advocating change. THE HONEST LIMIT, AND IT IS SIGNIFICANT: the coalition's page for this organisation carries its address and the coalition's commitments, BUT NOT THE ORGANISATION'S OWN ACCOUNT OF WHAT IT DOES. Its name indicates a youth body. Approach it, or the coalition's regional office, to establish its current activity and capacity before relying on it — and note that in a country in this condition, an organisation's capacity can change quickly. THE REGIONAL PLATFORM'S OWN STATED PRIORITIES INCLUDE PASTORALISM RIGHTS — pastoralist communities whose mobile livelihoods depend on secure access to rangelands and who face land grabbing and restrictive policies — alongside food security, women's tenure, and youth access to land. If your land is rangeland, that is the frame the coalition already works in.

trackers.name: Socotra Wildlife Society — a local society on the islands, working inside the protected areas
trackers.desc: IT IS A YEMENI NON-PROFIT WORKING TO PROTECT THE BIOLOGICAL DIVERSITY OF THE SOCOTRA ARCHIPELAGO, and it is the first domestic environmental organisation this map has been able to record for this country. Everything else here is a foreign fund, a regional network, a heritage instrument or a global database. IT HAS ACCESS AND STANDING WHERE IT MATTERS: it implemented a campaign INSIDE A NAMED PROTECTED AREA under the patronage of the archipelago's governor, and it takes part in conferences on climate change alongside the deputy governor. A local body that works inside a reserve, with the provincial authority's backing, is one that can get onto the ground and be heard afterwards — which this file has recorded as the two things communities most often lack. IT DOES NOT WORK ALONE: it has organised joint scientific work with A SECOND SOCOTRAN ASSOCIATION DEDICATED TO ENDANGERED PLANTS, delivering a lecture on the islands' rare plants. So there are at least two local environmental associations on the archipelago, and each is a route to the other. WHY THIS MATTERS BEYOND THE ISLANDS THEMSELVES: this file recorded that this country holds globally significant endemic species, and that the specimens documenting them sit in museums abroad, collected over the past century. A LOCAL SOCIETY IS WHO CAN ESTABLISH WHAT IS STILL PRESENT NOW — and the difference between a hundred-year-old herbarium sheet and a current record is the difference between an assessment that can dismiss a species and one that cannot. Pair it with the species occurrence database recorded separately for this country: the database says what was recorded, this society can say what remains. IT ALSO BUILDS ITS OWN PEOPLE: it runs capacity development and empowerment work for its members, particularly young people. In a country where organisations are scarce and staff scarcer, a body that trains its own members is one that survives. THE LIMITS, PLAINLY: its work is the archipelago, not the mainland, so it is no help to a community in the highlands or the interior. It is a conservation and awareness organisation, not an objector or a law practice, and nothing found shows it opposing a project. Its scale, funding and current capacity were not established, and it operates in a country in prolonged conflict — confirm it is active before relying on it.THE SOCIETY IS STILL SPEAKING, AND WHAT IT SAID IN 2026 IS CITABLE: ON A NAMED INTERNATIONAL DAY IN JULY 2026 IT STATED THAT MANGROVE TREES REPRESENT ONE OF THE MOST IMPORTANT COASTAL ECOSYSTEMS, AND CALLED FOR INTENSIFYING EFFORTS TO PROTECT THEM FROM CLIMATE CHANGE. A DATED POSITION ON A NAMED HABITAT, FROM PEOPLE WHO LIVE ON THAT COAST, IS WORTH MORE IN AN OBJECTION THAN A DISTANT PROGRAMME'S COMMITMENTS — AND THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS MANGROVE PROGRAMMES IN FOUR OTHER COUNTRIES OF THE REGION THAT COULD BE HELD TO THE SAME STANDARD. THE OTHER ADDITION IS ABOUT WHOSE EXPERTISE COUNTS ON THESE ISLANDS. A CONSERVATION ACCOUNT RECORDS THAT ENVIRONMENTAL WORK THERE HAS NEVER BEEN PRACTISED BETTER THAN BY THE ISLANDERS THEMSELVES OVER CENTURIES — AND THAT THEIR KNOWLEDGE OF THE QUALITY OF FRANKINCENSE RESIN AND THE TIMING OF ITS FLOWERING LED RESEARCHERS TO NEW HYBRID VARIETIES. OUTSIDE SCIENTISTS FINDING NEW VARIETIES BECAUSE ISLANDERS TOLD THEM WHERE TO LOOK IS THE PLAINEST ANSWER IN THIS FILE TO A COMMUNITY BEING TOLD ITS OBJECTIONS ARE UNSCIENTIFIC. AND THE PRACTICAL HEART OF IT IS ONE PERSON: THE NURSERY OF YOUNG FRANKINCENSE TREES IS CARED FOR BY AN ELDERLY ISLAND WOMAN WITH THE INHERITED SKILL OF TENDING SUCH SEEDLINGS. WHERE THERE ARE NO INSTITUTIONS, THAT IS WHAT CONSERVATION LOOKS LIKE — AND THE TRANSFERABLE ASK ANYWHERE IS NARROW: WHO HERE ALREADY KNOWS HOW TO RAISE THE LOCAL SPECIES, AND WHAT WOULD THEY NEED TO RAISE MORE.

trackers.name: Socotra Dragon Blood Tree Association — community nurseries that also pipe water to the villages
trackers.desc: THE THING TO COPY IS IN THE DESIGN: EACH NEW NURSERY IS EQUIPPED WITH PIPELINES THAT, AS WELL AS IRRIGATING THE SEEDLINGS, CARRY WATER TO THE SURROUNDING VILLAGES — improving health and living conditions in isolated communities, with a stated medium-term plan to extend that water infrastructure further. This file has recorded across the region that protection fails when it costs a community and gives nothing back: a designation that dispossessed a Jordanian village, a reserve whose managers left the local tribe out of its own land, rangelands nationalised and then overgrazed. THIS IS THAT LOGIC REVERSED — the conservation work is also the water supply, so the village has a reason to defend it. THE ORGANISATION WAS FOUNDED IN 2022 BY FRENCH AND SOCOTRI CITIZENS TOGETHER, and runs a programme built on REFORESTATION THROUGH COMMUNITY NURSERIES and SUSTAINABLE APIFORESTRY in partnership with a named local association — beekeeping and trees managed as one system, which gives the trees an income rather than only a cost. Its stated aim for the next phase is a model of conservation and local development designed WITH local communities, using simple, scalable technical solutions suited to the island. WHAT IS AT STAKE IS NOT REPLACEABLE: the archipelago is a world heritage site with 37 per cent of its plants, 90 per cent of its reptiles and 95 per cent of its land snails found nowhere else, and 157 PLANT SPECIES ARE CLASSIFIED AS VULNERABLE, ENDANGERED OR CRITICALLY ENDANGERED. The emblematic tree survives in numbers but the survivors are mostly very old, and young ones rarely make it — killed by intensifying storms and by grazing. THE COMMUNITY EFFORT HERE IS OLDER THAN ANY ORGANISATION: a resident began a nursery in his own backyard some twenty-seven years ago, the first community initiative on the archipelago to preserve endemic and endangered plants; other initiatives followed, one growing 600 SAPLINGS OVER TWENTY YEARS; and saplings are protected with MAKESHIFT FENCES OF WOOD AND WIRE. Fencing has now appeared in three countries in this file as the first protective act a community takes. AND THERE IS A SPECIFIC, FUNDABLE NEED STATED IN THEIR OWN WORDS: they are waiting for support to MOVE SEEDLINGS FROM THE NURSERIES UP TO THE MOUNTAIN HABITAT WHERE THEY BELONG, which requires transport and equipment they do not have. That is exactly the kind of small, costed request the species and small-grant funds recorded elsewhere in this file exist to meet. THE LIMITS: the association is young, founded in 2022, and partly foreign; its work is islands-specific and will not help on the mainland; it is a conservation and development body, not a legal or land-holding one; and it operates in a country of war and deep poverty where national support for conservation has fallen away, leaving the work largely to Socotrans with scarce resources.

trackers.name: Community and mahjur reserves — the category already exists in this country's own protected area list
trackers.desc: YOU DO NOT HAVE TO INVENT A CATEGORY. THIS COUNTRY'S PROTECTED AREA SYSTEM ALREADY CONTAINS ONE COMMUNITY PROTECTED AREA AND ONE MAHJUR TRADITIONAL RESERVE, BOTH LISTED ALONGSIDE THE NATIONAL PARKS AND MARINE RESERVES. Mahjur is the customary word here for a protected place — the local counterpart of the hima recorded elsewhere in this file for four neighbouring countries. A community asking for its grazing ground or forest to be recognised is asking for a designation that already exists in the national list and has already been granted twice. THAT IS A FAR STRONGER POSITION THAN ASKING FOR SOMETHING NEW: the precedent is domestic, the name is the community's own, and the two existing examples — one in the western mountains, one on the montane plains — can be pointed to. THE LEGAL FRAME EXISTS TOO: an environment protection council from 1990, an environment protection law of 1995 with executive regulations in 2000, and a general environment protection authority from 2001, alongside this country's accession to the conventions on biological diversity, desertification, climate change and migratory species. Those conventions matter because they are commitments the state has made that a community can hold it to — this file has recorded across the region that an objection framed against a state's own commitments travels further than one framed against a company. AND CUSTOMARY GOVERNANCE HERE IS DOCUMENTED IN THE DESIGN OF CURRENT INTERNATIONAL PROJECTS RATHER THAN ONLY IN ETHNOGRAPHY: on the archipelago, traditional customs are recorded as having GOVERNED THE USE OF WATER, RANGELAND, FISHERIES, LIVESTOCK AND FOREST RESOURCES, sustaining both the communities and the endemic species over thousands of years, through a semi-nomadic life alternating between pastoralism and fishing. A funder that writes that into a project document has already accepted that the community governs. THE TIMING IS UNUSUALLY GOOD AND WILL NOT REPEAT: the United Nations has declared 2026 THE INTERNATIONAL YEAR OF RANGELANDS AND PASTORALISTS. A rangeland claim made this year meets an international audience already primed for it. THE LIMITS ARE HEAVY AND SHOULD SHAPE EXPECTATIONS. Recognition is granted by the state. On the mainland, protected area coverage and enforcement are recorded as constrained by limited funding and prolonged conflict, while the best-developed framework is on the archipelago. NO ORGANISATION COULD BE FOUND THAT HELPS COMMUNITIES SEEK THESE DESIGNATIONS — approach it through the island society and the tree association recorded separately here, through the regional Arab environmental network, or through the international association of community-conserved territories recorded in this file, whose membership expressly does not require state recognition.

trackers.name: The bar's duty to assign counsel — it covers any case where a poor person is a party
trackers.desc: THE LAW USES THE WORD MUST. Under the profession law, the syndicate council OR THE BRANCH COUNCIL IS OBLIGED TO ASSIGN ONE OF THE LAWYERS TO DEFEND THOSE IN NEED — THE INSOLVENT AND THE POOR — after their consent, IN THE CASES IN WHICH THEY ARE A PARTY. This country was the last in this map with no route to a lawyer at all. It had one in statute the whole time. AND THE WORDING IS WIDER THAN THE EQUIVALENT PROVISIONS THIS FILE FOUND IN TWO NEIGHBOURING COUNTRIES. The duty is not confined to criminal defence — the courts' own power to assign counsel in serious crimes is preserved separately, and this obligation runs to ANY CASE IN WHICH THE NEEDY PERSON IS A PARTY. On its face that includes civil and administrative proceedings, which is where a dispute over a plot, a boundary, an inheritance or a compensation award sits. Put the request in those terms. THE DOOR IS LOCAL, NOT NATIONAL: THE BRANCH COUNCIL MAY MAKE THE ASSIGNMENT, so approach the syndicate branch in your own governorate rather than the capital — which matters in a country where travel is costly and often impossible. ASK FOR ONE DOCUMENT BY NAME: THE SYNDICATE'S BASIC STATUTE, which the law says determines the organisation of judicial aid, ITS CASES, AND THE SYSTEM OF ASSIGNMENT. That statute is what says who qualifies, for which kinds of case, and how a lawyer is chosen — and asking for it by name signals that you know the duty exists rather than requesting a favour. ONE CONDITION IS BUILT IN: THE ASSIGNMENT REQUIRES THE PERSON'S CONSENT. You are not handed a lawyer; you agree to one, which also means you may ask about who is being proposed. AND THE INSTITUTION ITSELF HAS A PROTECTION WORTH KNOWING: the premises of the syndicate and its branches MAY NOT BE SEARCHED except under the law, by judicial order, and in the presence of a member of the public prosecution together with the head of the syndicate or of the branch. A body with statutory protection for its own premises is a safer place to bring a file than most. THE LIMITS, PLAINLY. This rests on the statute rather than on evidence that assignments are currently being made; the syndicate has operated through years of war and division, and capacity in any given governorate cannot be assumed. Means are a condition — the duty runs to the insolvent and the poor. And an assigned lawyer is a lawyer, not a specialist: pair the assignment with the island societies and the regional environmental network recorded separately for this country, which hold the subject knowledge.

trackers.name: Legal Empowerment Fund — money to keep a legal-help organisation alive between cases
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY'S ROUTE TO A LAWYER, RECORDED SEPARATELY IN THIS FILE, IS A STATUTORY DUTY ON THE BAR TO ASSIGN COUNSEL TO THE POOR. WHAT IT LACKS IS ANY ORGANISATION ABLE TO HELP PEOPLE USE THAT DUTY — to find the branch, prepare the file, and press when nothing happens. THIS FUND EXISTS TO PAY FOR EXACTLY THAT KIND OF BODY. It is the first grantmaking initiative created solely to support grassroots legal empowerment, established in 2021 and hosted by an international human rights fund, and it supports ADVOCACY, EDUCATION AND LITIGATION by groups helping communities know, use and shape the law. THE MONEY IS THE RARE KIND: FLEXIBLE, RENEWABLE, LONG-TERM CORE FUNDING, not project money. In a country where organisations survive on short humanitarian cycles, funding that pays salaries and keeps a door open for two years at a time is a different proposition. THE ODDS ARE PUBLISHED AND YOU SHOULD KNOW THEM: a recent round funded FORTY-TWO GROUPS ACROSS TWENTY-FOUR COUNTRIES with one and a half million dollars in two-year grants, from APPLICATIONS RECEIVED FROM ONE HUNDRED AND FIFTY-THREE COUNTRIES SEEKING MORE THAN TWO HUNDRED AND THIRTY-THREE MILLION. That is roughly one hundred and fifty times more demand than money. AND ANONYMITY IS POSSIBLE, WHICH MATTERS HERE: two grantees were left off a published grantee list because of the sensitive nature of their work. WATCH FOR THEMATIC CALLS AS WELL AS OPEN ROUNDS — it has run one specifically for groups working at the intersection of legal empowerment and LAND AND ENVIRONMENTAL JUSTICE in another region. THE LIMITS. It funds ORGANISATIONS, so the applicant must be a constituted body — the island societies, the tree association and the land coalition member recorded separately for this country are the plausible candidates rather than a village committee. Grants are modest. And a foreign fund is a foreign association, which in a divided country is a consideration to weigh before applying rather than after.

trackers.name: Holm Akhdar — the mainland research body, and the law number to cite
trackers.desc: EVERY OTHER DOMESTIC ORGANISATION RECORDED FOR THIS COUNTRY IS ON ONE ISLAND. THIS ONE IS BASED IN THE TEMPORARY CAPITAL AND HAS BRANCHES AND CONTACT POINTS IN REGIONS OF THE COUNTRY. It began in 2012 as a platform investigating environmental and climate questions and has become an institution with three functions: PRODUCING ENVIRONMENTAL AND CLIMATE REPORTS AND STUDIES LOCALLY, raising public awareness, and running a CONSULTANCY AND RESEARCH ARM. THAT THIRD FUNCTION IS THE ONE TO USE. This file has found in almost every country that a community can describe harm and cannot afford to prove it; a domestic body that produces studies is where the proof is commissioned, in the country, in the language, at local cost. AND IT NAMES THE STATUTE, WHICH NOTHING ELSE RECORDED FOR THIS COUNTRY DOES: ENVIRONMENT PROTECTION LAW NUMBER 26 OF 1995. Its published recommendations call for environmental and climate policies containing measures that SUPPORT THE IMPLEMENTATION OF THAT LAW. An objection that cites the country's own environmental statute by number is a different document from one that appeals to concern, and until now this map could not tell a Yemeni reader which law to name. ITS PUBLISHED RECOMMENDATIONS CARRY THREE MORE THINGS A COMMUNITY CAN USE. IT CALLS FOR RISK ASSESSMENT REPORTS FOR FLOODWATER COLLECTION AREAS, ESPECIALLY THOSE NEAR POPULATION CENTRES — which is the flood-risk argument, and in this country the strongest single objection to building on a wadi or blocking a watercourse. IT CALLS FOR AFFORESTATION AT DISPLACEMENT SITES AND IN DESERTIFIED AREAS, and for SUPPORTING CREATIVE COMMUNITY-LED INITIATIVES that reduce climate vulnerability in frontline communities. It also calls for strengthening the environment authority's role in preparing those risk assessments, which tells you which official body to address. ITS PURPOSE IS STATED AS BEING THE VOICE OF THE ENVIRONMENT IN THIS COUNTRY, through knowledge production and innovating solutions, aimed at local communities, COMPANIES and POLICYMAKERS. THE LIMITS: it is research, consultancy and publishing rather than litigation, land-holding or funding — it will not represent you or buy anything. It works with government authorities and international partners, so it is not an adversary of official schemes. And in a divided country a body headquartered in one capital will not have equal reach everywhere — ask which contact point covers your governorate. Use it with the bar's duty to assign counsel and the legal empowerment fund recorded separately here: this supplies the evidence, those supply the lawyer and the money.

trackers.name: Yemeni civil society directory — find who exists in your governorate, then check they still do
trackers.desc: ORGANISATIONS IN THIS COUNTRY RARELY HAVE THEIR OWN WEBSITES, WHICH IS WHY THIS MAP HELD ALMOST NOTHING DOMESTIC HERE FOR SO LONG. This directory lists them BY GOVERNORATE, with each body's OBJECTIVES, its activities, and its list of current and completed projects. It is how a community finds what already exists near it rather than assuming nothing does. SEARCH ON THE OBJECTIVES, NOT THE NAMES. One organisation listed here states among its aims ASSESSING THE ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT OF VARIOUS PROJECTS AND ACTIVITIES, raising environmental awareness AT BOTH OFFICIAL AND POPULAR LEVEL, and improving livelihoods and reducing unemployment through sustainable projects. An organisation that has written impact assessment into its own objectives is the one to approach about a scheme — and that phrase is searchable in a way that an organisation's name is not. THE PROJECT LISTS ARE EQUALLY USEFUL BECAUSE THEY NAME PLACES AND METHODS: RAINWATER HARVESTING PROJECTS, A BARRIER ON A NAMED WADI IN A NAMED DISTRICT, school environmental education including a locally written book on the country's water situation, an environmental library, and annual agricultural and environmental festivals in named governorates. A community wanting a water-harvesting structure, or evidence that one was built nearby, has both the method and the precedent. NOW THE WARNING, AND IT COMES FROM TESTING THIS DIRECTORY RATHER THAN FROM DOUBT. ITS ENTRIES ARE UNDATED AND USE RELATIVE TIME — one records that an office stayed open for more than twelve years without saying which twelve. A DIRECT CHECK OF ITS BEST-CREDENTIALED ENVIRONMENTAL ENTRY, AN ORGANISATION RECOGNISED BY THE UNITED NATIONS DESERTIFICATION CONVENTION AND THE ONLY ONE FROM THE ARABIAN PENINSULA AT THE 2002 SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT SUMMIT, COULD NOT CONFIRM ANY ACTIVITY AFTER THE EARLY 2000s. TREAT THIS AS A LIST OF NAMES TO VERIFY, NOT A LIST OF LIVE ORGANISATIONS. Telephone before travelling, and expect a proportion to be dormant after years of war. ONE MORE THING WORTH KNOWING FROM THE SAME SEARCH: the national environment authority maintains a working site with current activity, including cooperation with international agencies on climate. This file recorded a round earlier that this authority is the body which should be preparing risk assessments for floodwater collection areas near population centres — so it is reachable, and that is the request to put to it. THE LIMIT OF THIS ENTRY: a directory is not a resource in itself. It will not act, fund or advise. It is a finding tool, and in a country where the alternative is having no way to find anyone, that is worth having.

trackers.name: National hydrological committee — a named coordinator, and a seat civil society is supposed to have
trackers.desc: WATER IS THIS COUNTRY'S DEFINING RESOURCE CONFLICT AND THIS MAP HAD NO WATER-SCIENCE CONTACT FOR IT AT ALL. THE NATIONAL COMMITTEE FOR THE INTERGOVERNMENTAL HYDROLOGICAL PROGRAMME PUBLISHES A NAMED INTERNATIONAL COORDINATOR — who is also Secretary-General of the national commission — WITH TWO TELEPHONE NUMBERS. AND THE DESIGN RULE IS WHY A COMMUNITY ORGANISATION SHOULD WRITE. THE PROGRAMME'S COUNCIL RECOMMENDS THAT THESE NATIONAL COMMITTEES BE MULTI-STAKEHOLDER IN MEMBERSHIP, INCLUDING NOT ONLY SCIENTISTS AND WATER MANAGERS BUT GOVERNMENT BODIES, PROFESSIONAL ASSOCIATIONS AND CIVIL SOCIETY — NAMING NON-GOVERNMENTAL ORGANISATIONS AND THE PRIVATE SECTOR. Asking to be included, or asking which civil society bodies already sit on it, is asking for something the programme itself says should be there. That is a far stronger opening than a request for help. WHAT THE COMMITTEE IS FOR: national committees are described as the backbone of the programme and are fundamental to a country's participation in it, implementing the international water-science programme domestically. Their composition varies with each country's institutional structure for hydrological studies and water resources management — so the committee is also the map of who in this country actually does hydrology. THAT IS THE PRACTICAL ASK. A community facing a well field, a dam, a diversion or a contaminated aquifer needs to know WHICH INSTITUTION HOLDS THE HYDROLOGICAL DATA AND WHO CAN READ IT. The committee's membership answers that question in one call, and this file has recorded for this country a mainland research institution and a floodwater risk-assessment recommendation that both depend on exactly such data. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE REAL. COMMITTEES ARE CONSTITUTED AND RUN UNDER THE AUTHORITY OF NATIONAL GOVERNMENTS, so this is not an independent body. It is a contact point and a coordinating structure, not a service — nobody there will survey your aquifer. AND IN A COUNTRY DIVIDED BY CONFLICT, PUBLISHED CONTACT DETAILS MAY BE OUT OF DATE OR MAY REACH ONLY ONE ADMINISTRATION; verify before relying on them, and ask which parts of the country the committee currently covers.

trackers.name: Women's union legal department and its neighbourhood lawyers — trained locals who settle disputes
trackers.desc: SAY THE LIMIT FIRST, BECAUSE IT DECIDES WHETHER THIS IS ANY USE TO YOU: THIS NETWORK WORKS ON DIVORCE, ALIMONY AND CUSTODY, AND HELPS SETTLE THOSE AMICABLY. LAND DISPUTES ARE NOT ITS SUBJECT. What it offers a community facing land loss is a working legal department that can be approached, and a model of building legal capacity that costs almost nothing. THE MODEL: between 2000 and 2002 the national women's union, with donor support, trained LEADING WOMEN FROM THE LOCAL COMMUNITY in law and in DISPUTE-RESOLUTION MECHANISMS, in two coastal cities, and enabled them to act for their neighbours. They are known as popular lawyers, and they are not qualified advocates — they are respected local people trained to handle disputes. THE SELECTION CRITERIA WERE PUBLISHED BY THE UNION'S LEGAL DEPARTMENT AND THEY ARE THE PART WORTH COPYING: SOCIAL ACCEPTANCE; INTEGRITY; TRUSTWORTHINESS; AN EDUCATIONAL LEVEL SUFFICIENT TO BE TRAINED; AND THE ABILITY TO KEEP PEOPLE'S CASES CONFIDENTIAL. UNION MEMBERSHIP WAS NOT REQUIRED — THE PROGRAMME WAS OPEN TO ANY ACTIVE WOMAN IN THE COMMUNITY. A community anywhere in this file that cannot afford lawyers has, in those five criteria, a written specification for choosing the people it should train instead. AND THE REASON IT WORKED IS AS INSTRUCTIVE AS THE TRAINING: the social fabric of the target areas was cohesive enough that a woman from the same neighbourhood intervening in a dispute was accepted — AND THE ROLE WAS EMBRACED AS A SOURCE OF TRUST AND BALANCE WITHIN THE NEIGHBOURHOOD. Proximity was the qualification, not a barrier. WHAT TO DO WITH IT: approach the UNION'S LEGAL DEPARTMENT, which has a head at governorate level and is the body that trains and hosts this network. Ask what it handles beyond personal status, whether its trained women take property or inheritance questions — INHERITANCE IS OFTEN WHERE LAND AND PERSONAL STATUS MEET — and whether it will train people from your area. That last request is the realistic one: a legal department that has run a training programme for twenty-five years knows how to run another. THE LIMITS, PLAINLY. The documented programme covers two cities of one governorate, so presence elsewhere must be checked. The account reached is a news report rather than the union's own page, SO CONTACT DETAILS MUST BE SOUGHT LOCALLY. These are trained community members, not licensed advocates — for court work this file records the bar's duty to serve poor litigants separately for this country. And conditions here vary sharply between regions and change quickly.

trackers.name: Social Fund for Development — it pays for terraces, water harvesting and land reclamation, and the community holds the contract
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE LARGEST SOURCE OF MONEY IN THIS COUNTRY FOR THE PHYSICAL WORK OF HOLDING LAND AND WATER. Established by law in 1997 and now in its fourth phase, it finances labour-intensive works in RAINWATER HARVESTING, THE REHABILITATION OF AGRICULTURAL TERRACES, THE RECLAMATION OF AGRICULTURAL LAND, WATERSHED MANAGEMENT, soil conservation and forests, rural roads to villages, and drinking water — ACCORDING TO THE NEEDS OF EACH LOCAL COMMUNITY. Its stated purpose in doing so is that communities INCREASE THEIR PRODUCTIVE ASSETS and their capacity to withstand future shocks. TERRACES AND WATERSHEDS ARE NOT DECORATION IN THIS COUNTRY: a terrace that collapses takes the soil with it, and land that cannot be farmed is land that can be taken. Repairing them is both livelihood and tenure. WHO CAN APPLY IS THE PART THAT MATTERS MOST, AND IT IS UNUSUALLY OPEN. Sub-projects are prepared and implemented WITH OR BY GROUPS OF SMALL RURAL PRODUCERS FROM THE SAME COMMUNITY — and also by NETWORKS OF SUCH GROUPS FROM DIFFERENT COMMUNITIES IN THE SAME DISTRICT which have successful experience of working collectively and wish to pool their efforts and resources. A producers' group is a recognised applicant here. This file has said in country after country that communities are blocked because they are not a registered organisation; THIS FUND WORKS THROUGH GROUPS, AND REWARDS GROUPS THAT HAVE ALREADY WORKED TOGETHER — which is an argument for starting small and documenting what you achieve. AND THE COMMUNITY CAN HOLD THE CONTRACT ITSELF. THE FUND OPERATES COMMUNITY CONTRACTING — the concluding and managing of contracts to procure and implement works and services with contractors and service providers, including consultants and builders. That places the community on the paying side of the relationship rather than the receiving side, which changes who answers to whom. IT ALSO STAYS: it continues with the poorest areas for up to three years to produce a longer-term effect, and runs a separate urban version for pockets of city poverty. TO SEE WHAT IT ACTUALLY BUYS, READ ITS TENDERS — they are published. Recent ones include modern drip irrigation networks for 167 farmers in one governorate and 83 in another; A STORAGE BARRIER WITH SEDIMENTATION BARRIERS, VALVE AND STILLING CHAMBERS; city water supply systems; beehives and beekeeping equipment; and a technical study to RESCUE A HISTORIC BRIDGE. The tender list is the fastest way to judge whether your kind of work is fundable and what scale it is funded at. THE LIMITS: it is a state-established fund financed largely by external donors, it works through its own procedures, appraisal and tendering, and it builds assets rather than opposing schemes — nothing here will fight a project for you. In a country divided by conflict its coverage varies sharply by governorate, so confirm what is operating where you are. Use it with the women's union legal department and the mainland environmental body recorded separately for this country.ONE FEATURE OF THIS FUND IS UNLIKE ANYTHING ELSE IN THIS FILE, AND IT WAS NOT RECORDED HERE. THE CONTRACTS TO PURCHASE AND EXECUTE THE WORKS AND SERVICES — WITH CONTRACTORS, CONSULTANTS, BUILDERS, DRIVERS AND OTHER PROFESSIONALS — ARE CONCLUDED AND MANAGED BY THE BENEFICIARY COMMUNITY ITSELF, THROUGH REPRESENTATIVES IT CHOOSES OR THROUGH A COMMUNITY PROJECT COMMITTEE. THE COMMUNITY IS THE CONTRACTING PARTY. NOT CONSULTED, NOT REPRESENTED, NOT A BENEFICIARY OF SOMEBODY ELSE'S CONTRACT — THE ONE WHO SIGNS, PAYS AND HOLDS THE CONTRACTOR TO THE TERMS. IN TWENTY-THREE COUNTRIES THIS FILE HAS FOUND NO OTHER ARRANGEMENT LIKE IT. THAT CHANGES WHAT A VILLAGE SHOULD ASK FOR. FORM THE COMMITTEE FIRST AND ASK TO CONTRACT DIRECTLY, RATHER THAN ASKING FOR A PROJECT TO BE DONE FOR YOU: THE COMMITTEE THAT HOLDS THE CONTRACT ALSO CONTROLS THE SPECIFICATION, THE SEQUENCE AND THE MONEY — AND IT SURVIVES AS A STRUCTURE AFTER THE WORKS FINISH. THE AGRICULTURE WINDOW WORKS THE SAME WAY UPWARDS: SUB-PROJECTS ARE PREPARED AND IMPLEMENTED WITH OR BY NETWORKS OF SMALL RURAL PRODUCER GROUPS DRAWN FROM DIFFERENT COMMUNITIES IN THE SAME DISTRICT — GROUPS WITH SUCCESSFUL EXPERIENCE OF COLLECTIVE WORK, WILLING TO PUT IN THEIR OWN EFFORT AND RESOURCES. SO NEIGHBOURING VILLAGES THAT COMBINE ARE A BETTER APPLICANT THAN ONE VILLAGE ALONE, AND A DEMONSTRABLE HISTORY OF WORKING TOGETHER IS PART OF WHAT QUALIFIES THEM. THE FUND ALSO STAYS WITH THE POOREST AREAS FOR UP TO THREE YEARS, WHICH MEANS A FIRST SMALL PROJECT CAN BE THE START OF A RELATIONSHIP RATHER THAN A ONE-OFF. NOW THE FACT THAT MUST BE READ WITH ALL OF THE ABOVE, AND IT IS CURRENT: DESPITE FUNDING BEING AVAILABLE FOR A FULL YEAR, ABOUT ONE THOUSAND OF THE FUND'S SUSTAINABLE PROJECTS IN RURAL COMMUNITIES HAVE STOPPED — RAINWATER TANKS, INFRASTRUCTURE THAT LETS FARMERS DOUBLE THEIR CROPS, AND PAVED ROADS CARRYING CHILDREN TO SCHOOL AND THE SICK TO HOSPITAL. THE MONEY EXISTS AND THE WORK HAS HALTED. THAT IS A POLITICAL BLOCKAGE, NOT A FUNDING GAP, AND IT MEANS A COMMUNITY APPROACHING THIS FUND TODAY MAY JOIN A QUEUE RATHER THAN A PROGRAMME. ASK FIRST WHETHER THE BRANCH COVERING YOUR DISTRICT IS OPERATING AT ALL — the fund has branches with their own directors, and this file has recorded branch-level handovers to communities in one governorate.

trackers.name: Agricultural cooperative union — the model statute to download, and the cooperative form that can buy land and transfer it to members
trackers.desc: THE LAST THREE ROUNDS OF THIS FILE ESTABLISHED THAT THE STATUTE IS THE APPLICATION — that registration, funding eligibility and even survival turn on how a community's founding document is written. THIS UNION PUBLISHES A MODEL STATUTE FOR AGRICULTURAL COOPERATIVE SOCIETIES, IN ITS COOPERATIVE LIBRARY OF GUIDES AND FORMS, AVAILABLE TO DOWNLOAD. A group that has never drafted one is not starting from a blank page, and a model issued by the sector's own union is far likelier to pass registration than something improvised. START THERE, THEN WIDEN THE OBJECTS TO COVER WHAT YOU WILL NEED LATER. AND THE COOPERATIVE FORM ITSELF CAN ACQUIRE LAND. Under the cooperative societies and unions law, a HOUSING cooperative's functions expressly include WORKING TO PROVIDE LAND FOR BUILDING HOMES THROUGH THE SUPPORT AND CARE THE STATE GIVES UNDER THAT LAW, and WORKING TO BUY LAND AND ERECT BUILDINGS ON IT IN ORDER TO TRANSFER OWNERSHIP TO ITS MEMBERS, or to let at prices suited to those of limited income — coordinating with the competent ministry to FACILITATE THE OWNERSHIP TRANSFER, THE PLANNING AND THE DISTRIBUTION. READ THAT CAREFULLY, BECAUSE IT IS THE FULL SEQUENCE A COMMUNITY NEEDS: A VEHICLE THAT OBTAINS LAND WITH STATUTORY STATE SUPPORT, BUYS MORE, BUILDS, AND THEN PUTS THE OWNERSHIP INTO THE MEMBERS' OWN HANDS. Most cooperative forms in this file hold land collectively and stop there; this one is designed to end in individual title. The same law covers agricultural cooperatives, whose functions run to improving production by organising members' efforts, RAISING THEIR CAPACITY TO USE MODERN AGRICULTURAL METHODS, and carrying out agricultural projects. WHAT TO ASK THE UNION FOR, IN ORDER: the model statute and the registration forms; which society already covers your area, since cooperatives are organised by locality and a second one of the same type in the same area is not ordinarily permitted; and what support exists for obtaining land under the law's own provisions. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE HEAVY IN THIS COUNTRY. THE LAW DATES FROM 1998 AND THE STATE THAT ADMINISTERS IT IS DIVIDED — which ministry, and which authority's support, depends entirely on where you are, and both should be confirmed locally before anything is filed. A cooperative is also a body you put your land into: this file recorded in a neighbouring country that a cooperative regulation can affect members' individual rights over their own plots, SO ESTABLISH THE EXIT TERMS AND WHO VOTES BEFORE SUBSCRIBING. Use it with the social fund and the women's union legal department recorded separately here.WHAT THE UNION ACTUALLY DOES FOR ITS SOCIETIES WAS NOT RECORDED HERE, AND ONE ITEM IN ITS OWN NEWS IS THE MOST DIRECTLY USEFUL THING THIS FILE HAS FOUND FOR THIS COUNTRY: A MEMBER COOPERATIVE SOCIETY ESTABLISHED A NATURE RESERVE AND ACTIVATED THE TRIBAL DOCUMENT TO PROTECT IT, IN AN UZLAH OF ONE GOVERNORATE. A FARMING COOPERATIVE DECLARING A RESERVE AND SECURING IT BY CUSTOMARY AGREEMENT IS PROTECTION THAT DOES NOT WAIT FOR A MINISTRY. STATE DESIGNATION IS SLOW, CONTESTED AND OFTEN NEVER COMES; A TRIBAL DOCUMENT BINDS THE PEOPLE WHO ACTUALLY USE THE GROUND — AND WHERE STATE AUTHORITY IS DIVIDED IT MAY BE THE ONLY PROTECTION THAT HOLDS. SO ASK WHETHER THE CUSTOMARY DOCUMENT COVERING YOUR RANGE OR WOODLAND HAS EVER BEEN WRITTEN DOWN AND ACTIVATED. SECOND, THE SERVICE THAT UNLOCKS CREDIT: THE UNION PREPARED THE TECHNICAL AND FINANCIAL STUDIES FOR A HUNDRED AND THIRTY-EIGHT LOAN PROJECTS. THE FEASIBILITY STUDY IS THE DOCUMENT THAT STOPS MOST SMALL BORROWERS — LENDERS ACROSS THIS REGION DEMAND ONE AND ALMOST NO INSTITUTION OFFERS TO WRITE IT. A FEDERATION THAT WRITES IT FOR ITS SOCIETIES IS WORTH MORE TO A VILLAGE THAN A BETTER INTEREST RATE. THIRD, IT SUPPLIES WHAT FARMERS CANNOT PAY FOR UP FRONT: IMPROVED SEEDS AND COMMUNITY PLOUGHING, DELIVERED AS CONCESSIONAL LOANS IN NAMED DISTRICTS, WHICH IT REPORTS LOWERED CULTIVATION COSTS AND EXPANDED THE AREA PLANTED. ONE SET OF TRACTORS SERVING A DISTRICT ON CREDIT RESTORES GROUND NO SINGLE HOUSEHOLD COULD AFFORD TO PREPARE — AND CULTIVATED LAND IS DEFENDED LAND. FOURTH, AFTER THE HARVEST: A PARTNERSHIP WITH AN AGRICULTURAL PROJECTS AND INITIATIVE SUPPORT FUND PROVIDED DATE DRYING HOUSES WITHIN AN INTEGRATED MARKETING SYSTEM, AND THE UNION ACCOMPANIED SIX SOCIETIES IN ONE GOVERNORATE TO PRODUCE TWO HUNDRED AND FORTY-NINE TONNES OF COTTON. DRYING IS THE CHEAPEST POST-HARVEST INTERVENTION THERE IS, BECAUSE FRUIT THAT SPOILS IS SOLD AT WHATEVER THE FIRST BUYER OFFERS. IT ALSO PUBLISHES TECHNICAL GUIDANCE, INCLUDING ON CONTROLLING AND MANAGING MESQUITE — THE INVASIVE RECORDED SEPARATELY IN THIS FILE AS TAKING GROUNDWATER, CROWDING OUT NATIVE TREES AND RUINING GRAZING. ONE CAUTION ON ALL OF IT: THIS REPORTING COMES FROM THE UNION'S OWN MEDIA OFFICE AND IS FRAMED IN THE POLITICAL LANGUAGE OF THE AUTHORITY CONTROLLING ITS AREA, SO WHICH SERVICES REACH A GIVEN GOVERNORATE MUST BE CHECKED LOCALLY — AND THE INPUTS, PLOUGHING AND LOAN STUDIES ARE CREDIT THAT MUST BE REPAID.THE UNION'S OWN NEWS CARRIES THE SINGLE MOST ON-BRIEF ITEM THIS FILE HAS FOUND IN THIS COUNTRY, AND IT WAS NOT RECORDED HERE: ONE MEMBER ASSOCIATION ESTABLISHED A NATURE RESERVE AND ACTIVATED THE TRIBAL DOCUMENT TO PROTECT IT, IN A NAMED SUB-DISTRICT OF A NORTHERN GOVERNORATE. A VILLAGE COOPERATIVE CREATING A PROTECTED AREA AND BACKING IT WITH CUSTOMARY TRIBAL LAW IS THE EXACT COMBINATION THIS PAYLOAD HAS SEARCHED FOR ACROSS TWENTY-THREE COUNTRIES: A LOCAL BODY, GROUND TAKEN INTO PROTECTION, AND AN ENFORCEMENT INSTRUMENT THAT NEEDS NEITHER A COURT NOR A MINISTRY NOR A DONOR. ASK THE UNION FOR THAT CASE BY NAME - WHICH ASSOCIATION, WHAT THE DOCUMENT SAYS, WHO SIGNED IT, AND HOW THE BOUNDARY WAS AGREED. WHAT THE UNION DELIVERS TO MEMBERS IS ALSO COUNTABLE, AND ANSWERS THE COMMONEST OBSTACLE TO CREDIT IN THIS FILE: IT PREPARED THE TECHNICAL AND FINANCIAL STUDIES FOR A HUNDRED AND THIRTY-EIGHT LOAN PROJECTS, ACCOMPANIED SIX COOPERATIVE SOCIETIES IN ONE COASTAL GOVERNORATE TO PRODUCE TWO HUNDRED AND FORTY-NINE TONNES OF COTTON, SIGNED A PARTNERSHIP FOR DATE-DRYING HOUSES WITH AN AGRICULTURAL PROJECTS AND INITIATIVES SUPPORT FUND, AND SUPPLIED IMPROVED SEEDS AND COMMUNITY PLOUGHING AS SOFT LOANS IN NAMED DISTRICTS, CUTTING CULTIVATION COSTS AND INCREASING PLANTED AREA. IT ALSO PUBLISHES A DIRECTORY OF THE SOCIETIES THEMSELVES, INCLUDING SPECIALISED ONES NAMED BY CROP - GRAIN PRODUCERS' SOCIETIES AMONG THEM - SO A COMMUNITY CAN FIND WHICH ASSOCIATION ALREADY COVERS ITS DISTRICT BEFORE FOUNDING ANYTHING. AND ITS NEWS SHOWS THE SOCIETIES MEETING AND ACCOUNTING: PERIODIC MEETINGS APPROVING PROCEDURES AND RECOMMENDATIONS, AN EXPANDED MEETING TO EVALUATE ONE SOCIETY'S FINANCIAL, ADMINISTRATIVE AND TECHNICAL PERFORMANCE, FINAL ARRANGEMENTS FOR DECLARING A NEW SOCIETY, AND A COOPERATIVE SERVICES CENTRE PRESENTED AS AN INSTITUTIONAL MODEL FOR RURAL AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT. A SOCIETY THAT AUDITS ITSELF IN AN OPEN MEETING IS ONE WHOSE ACCOUNTS CAN BE ASKED ABOUT — RARE ANYWHERE IN THIS PAYLOAD, AND ALMOST UNHEARD OF IN A WAR.

trackers.name: International legal representation — for cases no domestic court here can take
trackers.desc: IN A COUNTRY WHOSE COURTS AND ADMINISTRATION ARE DIVIDED BY CONFLICT, THE QUESTION IS OFTEN NOT WHICH DOMESTIC REMEDY TO USE BUT WHETHER ANY EXISTS. THIS ORGANISATION REPRESENTS INDIVIDUALS SUBJECTED TO SEVERE HUMAN RIGHTS VIOLATIONS BEFORE INTERNATIONAL PROTECTION MECHANISMS — UNITED NATIONS SPECIAL PROCEDURES AND TREATY BODIES — which are reachable regardless of which authority controls the ground you live on. IT IS A GENEVA-BASED LEGAL ADVOCACY ORGANISATION founded in 2018, and it works directly with VICTIMS, THEIR FAMILIES AND THEIR LAWYERS: documenting cases, PROVIDING LEGAL ASSISTANCE, and analysing the patterns behind violations rather than treating each as isolated. THE PRACTICAL POINT FOR THIS COUNTRY: THE APPROACH CAN COME FROM A LAWYER OR A LOCAL ORGANISATION RATHER THAN FROM THE PERSON AT RISK. This file records here a women's union legal department with neighbourhood lawyers, free legal offices and the bar's duty to assign counsel; ANY OF THOSE COULD CARRY A CASE OUTWARD, which matters where the person concerned may be detained, displaced or unreachable. IT ALSO DOCUMENTS TRANSNATIONAL REPRESSION AND POLITICALLY MOTIVATED EXTRADITION arising from warrants circulated through regional channels — relevant in a country from which very many people have left, because leaving is not always the end of the risk. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE REAL HERE. IT ADDRESSES SEVERE VIOLATIONS AGAINST PEOPLE, NOT LAND OR PLANNING DECISIONS. International mechanisms are slow and produce findings and pressure rather than remedies on the ground. Communications about a divided country face contested facts and multiple de facto authorities. AND SUBMITTING A CASE PUBLICLY NAMES PEOPLE — ask first what can be done without publication. Use it with the legal and humanitarian routes recorded separately here.

trackers.name: Conservation action fund — up to fifty thousand euros for habitat work, and it deliberately looks for underfunded places
trackers.desc: THE SELECTION CRITERION IS THE REASON THIS BELONGS IN THIS COUNTRY'S LISTING RATHER THAN A RICHER ONE: THE FUND FOCUSES ON UNDERFUNDED SPECIES AND CONSERVATION LEADERS. Being in a place where almost no conservation money reaches is not a weakness in this application — IT IS WHAT THE FUND SAYS IT IS LOOKING FOR. WHAT IT PAYS FOR: LOCALLY LED, SCIENCE-BASED ACTION AND RESEARCH TO PROTECT THREATENED ANIMAL SPECIES AND THE HABITATS THEY DEPEND ON, across a list of regions that expressly includes the Middle East. TWO GRANT SIZES: CONSERVATION ACTION GRANTS OF UP TO FIFTY THOUSAND EUROS for on-the-ground work improving the status of threatened species and their habitats, AND RESEARCH SUPPORT GRANTS OF UP TO SEVEN THOUSAND EUROS for young scientists. THE SMALLER GRANT IS THE ONE MOST COMMUNITIES SHOULD LOOK AT FIRST. Seven thousand euros for a young researcher to establish what lives on a threatened area is a modest, winnable sum — and this file has argued repeatedly that documentation is the missing step and that nobody funds it. HERE IS A GRANT WHOSE WHOLE PURPOSE IS TO PAY A YOUNG SCIENTIST TO PRODUCE IT. Pair the application with a university department: the researcher applies, the community provides the site, the access and the local knowledge. THE FOUNDATION'S OWN PRIORITIES REACH BEYOND SINGLE SPECIES AND ARE WORTH QUOTING IN AN APPLICATION: CRITICAL HABITAT PROTECTION — maintaining, restoring and protecting critical habitats and functional ecosystems — and SUSTAINABLE RESOURCE USE COVERING FORESTS, WATER AND RANGELANDS. RANGELANDS AND WATER ARE NAMED, which is precisely what this country's land disputes are about. TWO WARNINGS ABOUT TIMING, AND BOTH MATTER BEFORE ANYONE PLANS AROUND THIS. THE FUND IS A FIVE-YEAR INITIATIVE RUNNING TO 2026, SO ITS CONTINUATION BEYOND THAT IS UNKNOWN AND MUST BE CHECKED. AND DIRECT APPLICATIONS TO THE FOUNDATION ARE REPORTED AS PAUSED UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE — the working route is the FIXED-DEADLINE CALLS run by the species programme that co-manages the fund, so watch that programme's calls rather than writing to the foundation. THE OTHER LIMITS: IT FUNDS THREATENED ANIMAL SPECIES AND THEIR HABITATS — a site with no qualifying species does not qualify, however valuable, and plant-only work belongs to the tree fund recorded elsewhere in this map. Applicants must be civil society organisations rather than individuals or government bodies. And in a country divided by conflict, a grant agreement requires a body that can receive and account for funds; the social fund and the cooperative union recorded separately here are the kind of partner that can.

trackers.name: The lands, survey and planning authority — the register, the maps, and a published complaints line
trackers.desc: LAND DISPUTES ARE AMONG THE COMMONEST CAUSES OF VIOLENCE IN THIS COUNTRY, AND THIS FILE HAD RECORDED COOPERATIVES, A SOCIAL FUND AND LEGAL ROUTES WITHOUT EVER NAMING THE BODY THAT REGISTERS LAND. ONE OF THIS AUTHORITY'S FOUR MAIN SECTORS IS LAND ADMINISTRATION AND THE REAL ESTATE REGISTER — REGISTERING LAND, ISSUING OWNERSHIP DOCUMENTS, AND SUPERVISING SALES, PURCHASES AND LEASES. IT ALSO HOLDS THE MAPS, AND THAT IS THE PART COMMUNITIES OVERLOOK: IT CONDUCTS TOPOGRAPHIC AND CADASTRAL SURVEYS, PREPARES MAPS, AND DRAWS UP THE STRUCTURAL AND DETAILED PLANS FOR CITIES AND AREAS. THE PLAN THAT DECIDES WHETHER YOUR LAND IS MARKED FOR BUILDING, ROAD OR OPEN SPACE IS MADE HERE — ask to see the structural and detailed plan covering your area before you argue about anything else, because everything downstream follows from it. IT IS ALSO THE BODY THAT DEFINES WHICH LAND IS STATE LAND AND WHICH IS PRIVATE, and it is charged with RESOLVING REAL ESTATE DISPUTES and contributing to STABILITY IN LAND OWNERSHIP. WHERE A COMMUNITY IS TOLD ITS GROUND IS STATE LAND, THIS IS THE AUTHORITY WHOSE RECORD SUPPORTS OR CONTRADICTS THAT CLAIM. AND IT PUBLISHES A COMPLAINTS LINE — TWO NUMBERS FOR COMPLAINTS OPERATIONS — alongside its website and official channels, and it maintains a team for DEVELOPING SERVICES AND SIMPLIFYING PROCEDURES for citizens. A PUBLISHED COMPLAINTS NUMBER IS A SMALL THING THAT MATTERS: it gives a villager a route that is not a personal favour, and a call that can be repeated and referred to. THE PRACTICAL SEQUENCE: ASK WHAT IS REGISTERED FOR YOUR PARCEL; ASK FOR THE PLAN COVERING YOUR AREA; ASK WHETHER ANY PART OF IT IS RECORDED AS STATE LAND; AND GATHER YOUR OWN EVIDENCE BEFORE ANY OF THOSE CONVERSATIONS. This file recorded in two neighbouring countries that TAX RECEIPTS, UTILITY BILLS, BUILDING PERMITS AND WITNESS STATEMENTS are treated as proof where no deed exists — assemble those first. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE SERIOUS AND MUST BE UNDERSTOOD BEFORE ANYONE ACTS. AUTHORITY OVER LAND IN THIS COUNTRY IS DIVIDED, AND PARALLEL INSTITUTIONS OPERATE IN DIFFERENT AREAS: A DOCUMENT ISSUED BY ONE IS NOT NECESSARILY HONOURED BY ANOTHER, AND REGISTERING WITH THE WRONG BODY CAN CREATE A RECORD THAT IS USELESS OR WORSE WHERE YOU LIVE. Establish which institution actually administers land in your district before submitting anything, and take local legal advice — the bar's duty to assign counsel, the women's union legal department and the free legal offices recorded separately here are where to get it. Its current operational reach was not verified in this round.ONE THING ABOUT THIS AUTHORITY'S PURPOSE WAS NOT RECORDED HERE, AND IT CHANGES HOW A LETTER TO IT SHOULD BE WRITTEN: IT WAS ESTABLISHED WITH THE AIM OF PROTECTING PUBLIC AND PRIVATE LANDS AND PROPERTY, AND OF REGULATING LAND USE TO SERVE SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT AND THE PUBLIC INTEREST. PROTECTING PUBLIC PROPERTY IS PART OF THE MANDATE, NOT ONLY PRIVATE TITLE. SO A COMMUNITY DEFENDING COMMON GROUND, A WATERCOURSE, A TRACK OR A VILLAGE COMMONS IS RAISING SOMETHING SQUARELY INSIDE THIS BODY'S STATED JOB RATHER THAN A PRIVATE GRIEVANCE — AND THAT IS THE FRAMING TO USE IN THE FIRST SENTENCE. THE SECOND POINT IS STRUCTURAL: THE SAME AUTHORITY COVERS LANDS, SURVEY AND URBAN PLANNING TOGETHER. WHERE A DISPUTE INVOLVES A BOUNDARY, A DOCUMENT AND A PROPOSED USE AT ONCE, ONE INSTITUTION HOLDS ALL THREE THREADS — SO ASK FOR THE SURVEY POSITION, THE REGISTER POSITION AND THE PLANNING POSITION IN A SINGLE REQUEST RATHER THAN CHASING THREE OFFICES. AND ONE CAUTION TO CARRY WITH THE COMPLAINTS LINE ALREADY RECORDED ABOVE: SEIZURES HERE ARE OFTEN CARRIED OUT BY ARMED OR POLITICALLY PROTECTED ACTORS, AND AN OFFICIAL CALL NAMES THE CALLER TO AN INSTITUTION THAT MAY NOT BE ABLE TO PROTECT THEM. DECIDE THAT DELIBERATELY RATHER THAN IN THE MOMENT.

trackers.name: ARC-WH — it has worked on Socotra, and it trains people to assess what a development project would do to a protected site
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE SECOND RESOURCE EVER RECORDED FOR YEMEN IN THIS MAP, AND UNLIKE THE FIRST IT IS TIED TO A SPECIFIC YEMENI PLACE: the centre's own annual reporting documents work on the SOCOTRA ARCHIPELAGO, including its endemic dragon blood tree and a deployed team. Socotra is a natural World Heritage property and one of the most significant island ecosystems in the world; a body with a working relationship to it is a real point of contact where almost nothing else exists. WHAT MAKES IT USEFUL RATHER THAN MERELY OFFICIAL: it runs training on IMPACT ASSESSMENT IN A WORLD HERITAGE CONTEXT — a regional workshop delivered with the international conservation and restoration bodies supported twenty-three site managers, coordinators, heritage professionals and other stakeholders from fifteen member states in IDENTIFYING, EVALUATING AND MITIGATING POTENTIAL NEGATIVE IMPACTS OF DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS on World Heritage properties. That is the exact skill a community needs when a scheme is proposed beside a protected place, taught at regional level and open to site managers and stakeholders rather than governments alone. WHAT IT IS: a Category 2 Centre under the auspices of UNESCO, established by Bahrain as an autonomous and independent legal entity, based in Manama and assisting nineteen Arab States Parties to implement the 1972 World Heritage Convention, with three declared functions — information, assistance, and LOGISTICAL AND FINANCIAL support. It also works on inventories and TENTATIVE LISTS toward balanced representation of cultural and NATURAL sites; the Tentative List is a national decision and a far more achievable first step than inscription. THE LIMIT IS UNCHANGED AND SERIOUS: it serves States Parties, not communities, and a village cannot commission it. The route in is through a national heritage authority or a body that already works with the centre. In a country where this file could verify no domestic organisation at all, that is a thin route — but it is a named one, attached to a named place, which Yemen otherwise does not have.

trackers.name: Historic cities restoration — EU-funded cash-for-work on heritage houses, and the authority that counts what has been demolished
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE RARE KIND OF MONEY: FUNDING THAT REPAIRS A BUILDING AND PAYS LOCAL WAGES AT THE SAME TIME. THE SOCIAL DEVELOPMENT FUND APPROVED THE RESTORATION OF HUNDREDS OF DAMAGED HISTORIC HOUSES AND MONUMENTS ACROSS FOUR NAMED CITIES — THE OLD CAPITAL, A WALLED DESERT CITY, A COASTAL HERITAGE CITY AND A SOUTHERN PORT DISTRICT — IN PARTNERSHIP WITH THE UN CULTURAL AGENCY AND FUNDED BY THE EUROPEAN UNION, WITHIN A PROJECT WHOSE STATED PURPOSE IS BOTH PRESERVING HERITAGE AND CREATING JOBS FOR YOUNG PEOPLE. IT IS A CASH-FOR-WORK PROGRAMME. FOR A COMMUNITY WHOSE OLD QUARTER IS DECAYING AND WHOSE YOUNG PEOPLE HAVE NO WORK, THAT IS ONE APPLICATION ANSWERING TWO PROBLEMS — and it is delivered on the ground by named implementing bodies, including a public works project working in all four cities, rather than by a distant office. THE NATIONAL PARTNER IS A GENERAL ORGANISATION FOR THE PRESERVATION OF HISTORIC CITIES, WHICH RUNS THE DAMAGE ASSESSMENTS WITH THOSE PARTNERS. AND ITS OWN PUBLISHED FIGURES ARE THE MOST USEFUL THING IN THIS ENTRY: IN ONE WORLD HERITAGE CITY IT RECORDS TWELVE THOUSAND HOUSES, OF WHICH 4,962 ARE HISTORIC BUILDINGS — AND IT STATES THAT THIS IS THE TOTAL THAT HAS NOT BEEN TAMPERED WITH OR DEMOLISHED — ALONGSIDE 27 SCHOLARLY SCHOOLS AMONG 86 HISTORIC MOSQUES AND RELIGIOUS SCHOOLS. AN AUTHORITY THAT PUBLISHES HOW MANY BUILDINGS SURVIVE UNTOUCHED IS PUBLISHING A DEMOLITION COUNT. ASK IT FOR THE FIGURE FOR YOUR OWN QUARTER, AND ASK WHEN IT WAS LAST UPDATED — two numbers a year apart are evidence of loss that no photograph can match. HOW BUILDINGS GET CHOSEN IS ALSO KNOWABLE, WHICH MATTERS IF YOURS IS NOT ON THE LIST: A DAMAGE ASSESSMENT IDENTIFIED 129 BUILDINGS NEEDING INTERVENTION IN THE OLD CAPITAL, STRICT SELECTION CRITERIA WERE SET WITH LOCAL PARTNERS, AND THE PLAN RAN IN THREE PHASES, THE FIRST OF WHICH PROTECTED 40 BUILDINGS FROM COLLAPSE. ASK WHAT THE CRITERIA ARE AND WHAT PUTS A BUILDING ON THE ASSESSMENT — the criteria were set with local partners, which means local bodies can influence them. AND NOTE WHAT TRIGGERED THE PROGRAMME: FLOOD AND STORM DAMAGE TO HISTORIC HOUSES, ASSESSED BUILDING BY BUILDING. WHERE WEATHER HAS DAMAGED AN OLD QUARTER, THAT DAMAGE IS THE ENTRY POINT TO INTERNATIONAL HERITAGE FUNDING — document it immediately, with dates, because the assessments follow the events. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE HEAVY. THIS IS A RESTORATION AND LIVELIHOODS PROGRAMME, NOT A PROTECTION AUTHORITY THAT WILL STOP A DEVELOPMENT: it repairs what is damaged, and nothing here prevents an owner or an authority demolishing a building. Access depends on which bodies operate in a given area, and this country's institutions are divided. Funding rounds close; the figures and phases described here are from the reporting available and were not re-verified for currency. Read it with the lands and survey authority and the legal routes recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Directory of agricultural institutions — and the list of works that funders here actually pay for
trackers.desc: A SEARCH FOR NAMED LOCAL ENVIRONMENTAL AND WATER-USER ASSOCIATIONS IN THIS COUNTRY RETURNED RELIEF REPORTING AND BODIES FROM NEIGHBOURING STATES. WHAT IT DID RETURN IS MORE USEFUL THAN A SINGLE ORGANISATION: A NATIONAL INFORMATION CENTRE MAINTAINS A PUBLISHED LISTING OF AGRICULTURAL INSTITUTIONS AND BODIES — AN INDEX OF WHO EXISTS IN THE SECTOR, which is where to start when no organisation's name is known. AND ALONGSIDE IT, AN AGENCY ACCOUNT OF ITS OWN PROGRAMME HERE SETS OUT EXACTLY WHICH WORKS GET FUNDED AND HAVE WORKED. THAT LIST IS THE MOST PRACTICAL THING IN THIS ENTRY, BECAUSE A PROPOSAL THAT MATCHES IT IS ASKING FOR SOMETHING ALREADY PROVEN AND ALREADY BUDGETED FOR. THE WORKS ARE: REHABILITATION AND CONSTRUCTION OF NEW AGRICULTURAL TERRACES; REHABILITATION OF ON-FARM WATER STORAGE FOR SUPPLEMENTARY IRRIGATION OF EXISTING TERRACES; ON-FARM WATER COLLECTION THROUGH UNDERGROUND CISTERNS AND OPEN WADI PITS; CONSERVATION OF WADI SOIL AND EROSION CONTROL; REHABILITATION OF SHALLOW WELLS AND SPRINGS; PROTECTED AGRICULTURE USING GREENHOUSES; AND SPATE IRRIGATION THROUGH SMALL FLOOD-DIVERSION WORKS, POND DIGGING AND WATER-CONTROL STRUCTURES AND CHANNELS. NOTICE WHAT IS ON THAT LIST: TERRACES, CISTERNS, SPRINGS AND WADI SOIL. THESE ARE REPAIRS TO WORKS THAT ALREADY EXIST AND THAT COMMUNITIES ALREADY OWN OR HOLD IN COMMON — not new infrastructure requiring new land. A COMMUNITY WHOSE TERRACES ARE COLLAPSING IS ASKING FOR THE SINGLE MOST FUNDABLE THING IN THIS COUNTRY. AND THE POINT THAT CONNECTS THIS TO DEFENDING LAND: TERRACES, CISTERNS AND DIVERSION WORKS ARE PHYSICAL, DATED EVIDENCE OF USE AND MANAGEMENT. This file recorded elsewhere that land shown to be used and maintained is far harder to reallocate than land that looks idle — REHABILITATING A TERRACE SYSTEM BOTH FEEDS A VILLAGE AND DOCUMENTS ITS PRESENCE, and the works are recorded, photographed and reported by the funder. THE CLAIMED RESULT IS MODEST AND CREDIBLE: FARMERS BECAME ABLE TO GROW A VARIETY OF CROPS SUSTAINABLY ON SMALL HOLDINGS FOR THEIR OWN CONSUMPTION AND TO SELL THE SURPLUS. ONE FIGURE FRAMES EVERY WATER ARGUMENT MADE HERE AND SHOULD BE IN ANY SUBMISSION: THIS IS THE POOREST COUNTRY IN THE WORLD IN WATER RESOURCES, WITH A PER-CAPITA SHARE OF EIGHTY-THREE CUBIC METRES A YEAR. ANY SCHEME THAT TAKES, DIVERTS OR CONTAMINATES WATER IS DOING SO IN THAT CONTEXT, and stating the national figure alongside the local loss is stronger than describing the local loss alone. THE LIMITS: a directory tells you who exists, NOT WHO IS FUNCTIONING — in a country whose institutions are divided and whose staff are often unpaid, entries may be dormant, and the listing's currency was not verified. The funded-works list comes from one agency's account of its own programme and is not an open call; ASK WHICH ORGANISATIONS ARE DELIVERING SUCH WORK IN YOUR GOVERNORATE NOW. Read it with the lands and survey authority, the cooperative route and the heritage restoration programme recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: High authority for oversight of tenders and auctions — the body that watches the buying, not the one that buys
trackers.desc: EVERY PROCUREMENT BODY RECORDED IN THIS FILE SO FAR BUYS OR SELLS. THIS ONE WATCHES THE BUYING. IT IS A HIGH AUTHORITY FOR OVERSIGHT OF TENDERS AND AUCTIONS, A GOVERNMENT BODY WHOSE FUNCTION IS SUPERVISING GOVERNMENT TENDER AND AUCTION ACTIVITY — AND IT REPORTS TO THE HEAD OF STATE RATHER THAN TO ANY PURCHASING MINISTRY. THAT SEPARATION IS THE WHOLE POINT. A COMPLAINT THAT A TENDER WAS STEERED, THAT A CONTRACT WAS SPLIT TO AVOID COMPETITION, OR THAT A WINNER WAS DECIDED BEFORE THE BIDS WERE OPENED HAS NOWHERE USEFUL TO GO INSIDE THE MINISTRY THAT RAN IT. IT GOES TO THE SUPERVISORY BODY — and this payload had not recorded one in any of the twenty-two countries examined before this. ITS STANDING IS FORMAL: THE 2007 TENDERS AND AUCTIONS LAW PROVIDED FOR AN INDEPENDENT HIGH AUTHORITY OF THIS NAME, A PRESIDENTIAL DECISION OF AUGUST 2009 APPOINTED ITS BOARD, AND A FURTHER PRESIDENTIAL DECISION FOLLOWED IN SEPTEMBER 2013. SO THE FIRST QUESTION TO ASK IN ANY COUNTRY IS NOT WHERE TENDERS ARE PUBLISHED BUT WHO SUPERVISES THEM — AND WHETHER THAT SUPERVISOR SITS OUTSIDE THE BODIES IT SUPERVISES. A REGULATOR THAT REPORTS TO THE PURCHASER IS NOT A ROUTE; ONE THAT REPORTS ELSEWHERE MIGHT BE. THERE IS ALSO A PUBLISHED EXECUTIVE REGULATION ON TENDERS, AUCTIONS AND GOVERNMENT STORES SETTING OUT THE PROCEDURES PURCHASING BODIES MUST FOLLOW. A COMPLAINT THAT NAMES THE PROCEDURE THAT WAS NOT FOLLOWED IS WORTH MORE THAN ONE THAT ALLEGES UNFAIRNESS IN GENERAL, and the procedure is written down. THE PRACTICAL CHANNEL IS MODEST AND WORTH USING AS IT IS: THE AUTHORITY MAINTAINS A PUBLIC PRESENCE IN THE CAPITAL WITH A FOLLOWING IN THE THOUSANDS. IN A COUNTRY WHOSE INSTITUTIONS ARE DIVIDED AND WHOSE OFFICIAL WEBSITES ARE OFTEN UNREACHABLE, A MAINTAINED PUBLIC PAGE MAY BE THE ONLY WORKING WAY TO REACH A BODY — this file has recorded the same thing about ministries and associations in three other countries. NOW THE HONEST LIMITS, AND THEY ARE HEAVY. THE SOURCES DESCRIBING THIS AUTHORITY ARE OLDER, AND ITS CURRENT FUNCTIONING ACROSS A DIVIDED COUNTRY WAS NOT VERIFIED — whether it operates, where, and under whose authority are open questions a reader must answer locally before relying on it. Parallel institutions exist in different areas of control, as this file recorded of the lands authority. It is a state supervisory body, not an ally of objectors, and nothing here creates a right to stop a contract. Read it with the lands and survey authority, the cooperatives route and the historic cities programme recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Public works rural programme — protection of agricultural land and irrigation, built by local contractors on community-set priorities
trackers.desc: THIS FILE ALREADY RECORDS THIS BODY'S HERITAGE WORK AND, SEPARATELY, THE SOCIAL FUND THAT PAYS FOR TERRACES AND WATER HARVESTING. WHAT IS RECORDED HERE IS THE SAME BODY'S RURAL INFRASTRUCTURE PROGRAMME, AND ONE ITEM ON ITS LIST IS MORE DIRECTLY ABOUT DEFENDING LAND THAN ANYTHING ELSE IN THIS COUNTRY'S ENTRIES. IT CREATES COMMUNITY ASSETS AND SHORT-TERM JOBS AT THE SAME TIME, THROUGH SMALL LABOUR-INTENSIVE INFRASTRUCTURE WORKS — AND THE WORKS NAMED INCLUDE RAINWATER HARVESTING, THE PROTECTION OF AGRICULTURAL LAND AND IRRIGATION, THE STONE PAVING OF ROADS AND STREETS LEADING TO VILLAGES, WATER SUPPLY, SANITATION AND THE REHABILITATION OF SCHOOLS. PROTECTION OF AGRICULTURAL LAND IS A FUNDED CATEGORY IN ITS OWN RIGHT. NOT RESTORATION AFTER LOSS, NOT PRODUCTION SUPPORT — PROTECTION. A COMMUNITY WHOSE FIELDS ARE BEING UNDERCUT BY A WADI, A ROAD CUTTING OR RUNOFF CAN ASK FOR PROTECTIVE WORKS AS THE THING ITSELF, and this file has found that category named this plainly in only one other country. THE SELECTION RULE IS THE PART TO ACT ON: THE PROJECTS ARE CHOSEN ACCORDING TO PRIORITY NEEDS IDENTIFIED BY THE TARGETED LOCAL COMMUNITY.
