SO THE COMMUNITY'S OWN STATEMENT OF PRIORITIES IS THE DOCUMENT THAT DECIDES WHAT GETS BUILT — WRITE IT, AGREE IT AND SUBMIT IT BEFORE ANYONE ELSE DEFINES THE NEED FOR YOU. AND THE DELIVERY MODEL PUTS MONEY INTO LOCAL HANDS TWICE OVER: THE WORKS ARE IMPLEMENTED THROUGH CONTRACTS WITH LOCAL PRIVATE-SECTOR CONTRACTORS, WHILE THE LABOUR ITSELF PROVIDES SHORT-TERM EMPLOYMENT. A LOCAL CONTRACTOR WITH A CONTRACT AND VILLAGERS WITH WAGES ARE BOTH CONSTITUENCIES FOR THE ASSET SURVIVING. THE PROGRAMME RUNS UNDER SEVERAL FUNDING STREAMS AT ONCE — AN EMERGENCY HUMANITARIAN CRISIS RESPONSE PROJECT, ISLAMIC BANK PROJECTS FOR RURAL DEVELOPMENT AND YOUTH SUPPORT, DEVELOPMENT AGENCY PROJECTS AND AN URBAN SERVICES PROJECT — WHICH MATTERS BECAUSE A REQUEST REFUSED UNDER ONE STREAM MAY FIT ANOTHER. ASK WHICH STREAM YOUR NEED FALLS UNDER RATHER THAN ASKING THE BODY IN GENERAL. THE LIMITS: this is a state-linked implementing body operating in a country with divided authorities and severe funding shortages — access, security and finance govern what actually happens, and this file recorded elsewhere that projects here proceed despite fuel scarcity and critical security conditions. IT BUILDS AND PROTECTS; IT DOES NOT ADJUDICATE OWNERSHIP OR STOP A SCHEME. Whether communities may apply directly, and through which office, WAS NOT VERIFIED. Read it with the social fund, the agricultural institutions directory and the historic cities programme recorded separately for this country.THREE THINGS WERE NOT RECORDED HERE, AND THE FIRST DECIDES EVERYTHING ELSE: THE PROJECTS ARE CARRIED OUT BASED ON THE PRIORITY OF NEEDS DETERMINED BY THE TARGETED LOCAL COMMUNITY. NEEDS DETERMINED BY THE COMMUNITY, NOT BY THE DONOR OR THE CONTRACTOR, IS THE ARRANGEMENT EVERY COMMUNITY IN THIS PAYLOAD WANTS — SO THE WORK FOR A VILLAGE IS TO ARRIVE WITH ITS PRIORITY ALREADY AGREED AND WRITTEN DOWN, AND TO ASK WHO VERIFIES THAT A STATED PRIORITY CAME FROM RESIDENTS RATHER THAN FROM A LOCAL NOTABLE. CAPTURE IS THE COMMON FAILURE OF COMMUNITY-PRIORITISED PROGRAMMES. THE SECOND IS THE PROJECT'S AGE AND ITS PUBLISHED SHORTFALL: LAUNCHED IN 1996 TO GIVE THE UNEMPLOYED SHORT-TERM JOBS BUILDING SCHOOLS, HOSPITALS, WATER AND SANITATION SYSTEMS AND LOCAL ROADS, IT DELIVERED SIXTY-SIX THOUSAND WORK-MONTHS AGAINST A TARGET OF BETWEEN SEVENTY-FIVE AND NINETY-SIX THOUSAND - PARTLY BECAUSE THE MONITORING PROCESS OVERLOOKED A LARGE NUMBER OF WORK-MONTHS IN THE EARLY PHASES. A PROGRAMME THAT PUBLISHES ITS SHORTFALL AND THE MEASUREMENT FAULT BEHIND IT IS ONE WHOSE FIGURES CAN BE ARGUED WITH — AND ITS RECORD IS SAID TO HAVE DRAWN INCREASED DONOR FUNDING AND FURTHER PUBLIC WORKS. THE THIRD IS THAT IT NOW DRAWS ON FOUR STREAMS AT ONCE: AN EMERGENCY HUMANITARIAN CRISIS RESPONSE PROJECT, AN ISLAMIC DEVELOPMENT BANK'S RURAL DEVELOPMENT AND YOUTH PROJECTS, A DEVELOPMENT AGENCY'S PROJECTS, AND A GREEN SERVICES PROJECT — FOUR SETS OF ELIGIBILITY RULES, AND FOUR CHANCES THAT ONE FITS A PARTICULAR VILLAGE. THE QUESTION IS WHICH STREAM IS OPEN IN THIS GOVERNORATE NOW.

trackers.name: Bar association branches — governorate councils still meeting and publishing in 2026, and the committees an advocate may enter
trackers.desc: IN A COUNTRY SPLIT BY WAR, THE FIRST QUESTION ABOUT ANY INSTITUTION IS WHETHER IT STILL FUNCTIONS. THIS ONE DOES, VISIBLY: THE BAR COUNCIL MET IN LATE JANUARY 2026 AND ISSUED A PRESS STATEMENT THE FOLLOWING DAY, AND BRANCH COUNCILS IN A SOUTHERN GOVERNORATE AND IN TWO CENTRAL GOVERNORATES EACH PUBLISHED THEIR OWN ENDORSEMENTS OF IT. BRANCH COUNCILS IN THE GOVERNORATES, MEETING AND PUBLISHING IN THEIR OWN NAMES, ACROSS AREAS UNDER DIFFERENT CONTROL. THAT IS A LOCAL DOOR THAT STILL OPENS — AND THIS FILE HAS REPEATEDLY FOUND THAT THE BRANCH NEAREST THE COURT WHICH WILL HEAR A MATTER IS THE ONE TO APPROACH, NOT THE HEADQUARTERS. WHERE ADVOCATES MAY APPEAR IS THE PART THAT MATTERS FOR LAND. THEY REPRESENT NATURAL AND LEGAL PERSONS TO CLAIM AND DEFEND RIGHTS BEFORE ALL COURTS, THE PROSECUTION, POLICE AND INVESTIGATION DEPARTMENTS, JUDICIAL AND ADMINISTRATIVE COMMITTEES, AND ALL OTHER LEGAL BODIES. ADMINISTRATIVE COMMITTEES ARE NAMED ALONGSIDE COURTS. LAND QUESTIONS IN THIS COUNTRY OFTEN GO TO COMMITTEES RATHER THAN JUDGES — THIS FILE RECORDED A LANDS AND SURVEY AUTHORITY AND PARALLEL INSTITUTIONS IN DIFFERENT AREAS OF CONTROL — AND AN ADVOCATE MAY APPEAR BEFORE THOSE COMMITTEES. ASK COUNSEL SPECIFICALLY WHETHER THEY HAVE APPEARED BEFORE THE COMMITTEE THAT WILL DECIDE YOUR MATTER. THE ASSOCIATION'S OWN OBJECTS INCLUDE TRAINING ITS MEMBERS AND PROVIDING SERVICES TO THEM, ARRANGING OLD-AGE, DISABILITY AND DEATH PENSIONS, AND COOPERATING WITH PROFESSIONAL SYNDICATES AND SIMILAR ORGANISATIONS AT HOME AND ABROAD. THAT LAST OBJECT IS THE ONE TO USE FROM OUTSIDE: A BAR THAT COOPERATES WITH SIMILAR ORGANISATIONS ABROAD IS REACHABLE THROUGH THEM, WHICH MATTERS WHERE COMMUNICATION INSIDE THE COUNTRY IS DIFFICULT AND WHERE AN INTERNATIONAL PROFESSIONAL BODY CAN ASK A QUESTION THAT A RESIDENT CANNOT. TWO PROTECTIONS ARE WORTH KNOWING WHEN DECIDING WHERE TO MEET AND WHAT TO HAND OVER. THE PREMISES OF THE BAR AND ITS BRANCHES MAY NOT BE SEARCHED EXCEPT BY LAW, BY JUDICIAL ORDER, AND IN THE PRESENCE OF A PROSECUTOR AND THE HEAD OF THE BAR OR OF THE BRANCH. AND ASSAULTING A LAWYER IN THE COURSE OF THEIR WORK CARRIES A PENALTY. A BRANCH OFFICE IS THEREFORE A SAFER PLACE TO HAND OVER DOCUMENTS THAN A PRIVATE ONE, AND SAFER THAN A HOME. IN A CONFLICT COUNTRY THAT IS NOT A TECHNICALITY. NOW THE CONTEXT THAT MUST BE READ WITH ALL OF IT: AS THIS IS RECORDED, THE BAR COUNCIL IS PUBLICLY CONTESTING A CIRCULAR OF THE JUDICIAL INSPECTION AUTHORITY WHICH IT SAYS TOUCHES THE ESSENCE OF THE PROFESSION AND THE RIGHT OF DEFENCE. THE BAR IS IN CONFLICT WITH PART OF THE JUDICIAL APPARATUS — WHICH TELLS YOU BOTH THAT IT IS WILLING TO FIGHT AND THAT ITS POSITION IS UNDER PRESSURE. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A PROFESSIONAL BODY, NOT A LEGAL AID SCHEME — NO FREE REPRESENTATION FOR CITIZENS WAS FOUND, and the services described are for members. The entry is anchored to ONE BRANCH'S SITE; WHICH BRANCHES ARE REACHABLE, AND UNDER WHOSE AUTHORITY THEY OPERATE IN DIFFERENT AREAS OF CONTROL, WAS NOT VERIFIED. Institutions are divided between authorities, as recorded elsewhere in this file. Read it with the lands and survey authority, the public works rural programme and the tender oversight body recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Published project register and grievance route — who is funding what, where, until when, and where to complain when it goes wrong
trackers.desc: A COMMUNITY IN A COUNTRY THIS BROKEN USUALLY HAS NO IDEA WHICH PROGRAMMES ARE OPERATING NEAR IT. THIS PAGE IS A PUBLIC REGISTER: EVERY ACTIVE PROJECT WITH ITS CODE, ITS TITLE, ITS START AND END YEAR, AND ITS TOTAL BUDGET. AND THE ENTRIES ARE SPECIFIC ENOUGH TO ACT ON. A SUSTAINABLE WATERSHED MANAGEMENT PROJECT THROUGH REINFORCED GOVERNANCE, RESILIENCE AND REGENERATIVE AGRICULTURE RUNS FROM 2022 TO 2027 AT SOME NINETEEN MILLION DOLLARS. TWO CLIMATE ADAPTATION PROJECTS ADDRESSING BIODIVERSITY THROUGH INTEGRATED LAND AND WATER MANAGEMENT RUN TO 2029. FOOD SECURITY AND RESILIENCE PROJECTS APPEAR AT SEVENTY-NINE, THIRTY-NINE AND TWENTY-TWO MILLION DOLLARS. SMALLER ONES NAME THE EXACT DISTRICTS THEY COVER. SO THE FIRST QUESTION IS NO LONGER WHETHER HELP EXISTS BUT WHETHER YOUR DISTRICT IS INSIDE A PROJECT THAT IS ALREADY FUNDED AND STILL RUNNING. A PROJECT WITH AN END YEAR IN 2027 OR 2029 HAS MONEY COMMITTED AND YEARS LEFT — WHICH IS A COMPLETELY DIFFERENT CONVERSATION FROM ASKING SOMEONE TO START SOMETHING. WATERSHED MANAGEMENT AND INTEGRATED LAND AND WATER ARE THE TITLES TO NOTICE. THOSE ARE PROGRAMMES ABOUT TERRACES, CATCHMENTS, FLOOD PROTECTION AND THE GROUND ITSELF — EXACTLY WHAT THIS FILE HAS RECORDED COMMUNITIES HERE NEEDING, AND THEY NAME GOVERNANCE AS PART OF THEIR PURPOSE, WHICH MEANS LOCAL STRUCTURES ARE MEANT TO BE INVOLVED. NOW THE PART THAT IS RARE ANYWHERE IN THIS FILE: THE SAME PAGE PUBLISHES WHERE TO COMPLAIN. A GRIEVANCE OR SUGGESTION ABOUT A PROJECT GOES FIRST TO THAT PROJECT'S OWN GRIEVANCE MECHANISM OR TO THE DECENTRALISED OFFICE — AND IF IT CANNOT BE RESOLVED AT PROJECT MANAGEMENT OR TECHNICAL LEVEL, IT GOES TO THE OFFICE OF THE INSPECTOR GENERAL, INVESTIGATIONS. AN ESCALATION PATH THAT ENDS AT AN INSPECTOR GENERAL IS A REAL ONE. WHERE AID WORK ITSELF CAUSES HARM — A ROAD CUT THROUGH TERRACES, A WELL SITED TO ONE FAMILY'S BENEFIT, A DISTRIBUTION CAPTURED BY WHOEVER CONTROLS THE AREA — THE COMPLAINT DOES NOT HAVE TO STOP WITH THE PEOPLE WHO CAUSED IT. AND IT IS OPEN TO PEOPLE WHO ARE NOT PARTICIPANTS. PUT THE PROJECT CODE IN THE COMPLAINT. THE REGISTER GIVES EVERY PROJECT A CODE, AND A GRIEVANCE THAT CITES IT CANNOT BE MISFILED OR ATTRIBUTED TO A DIFFERENT PROGRAMME. ONE MORE PATTERN CONFIRMED HERE, INDEPENDENTLY OF THE SOCIAL FUND RECORDED ELSEWHERE IN THIS FILE: A RURAL LIVELIHOODS PROJECT USED COMMUNITY CONTRACTING AND CLIMATE-RESILIENT INFRASTRUCTURE TO IMPROVE ACCESS TO CLEAN WATER, IRRIGATION AND FLOOD PROTECTION WHILE STRENGTHENING LOCAL GOVERNANCE AND SOCIAL COHESION, REACHING OVER EIGHTY-FOUR THOUSAND PARTICIPANTS, WITH A FOCUS ON WOMEN-HEADED AND YOUTH-LED HOUSEHOLDS. TWO SEPARATE FUNDERS USING COMMUNITY CONTRACTING IN THE SAME COUNTRY MEANS IT IS THE NORMAL WAY OF WORKING HERE, NOT AN EXPERIMENT. A VILLAGE THAT ASKS TO HOLD THE CONTRACT IS ASKING FOR THE STANDARD ARRANGEMENT. THE LIMITS: this is A REGISTER AND A COMPLAINT ROUTE, NOT A FUNDER YOU CAN APPLY TO DIRECTLY — projects are agreed between agencies and authorities, and listing does not mean a community can join. BUDGET FIGURES ARE TOTAL COMMITMENTS, NOT MONEY AVAILABLE NOW, AND THE LIST IS AS AT ITS OWN DATE. ACCESS IN THIS COUNTRY IS GOVERNED BY WHOEVER CONTROLS THE AREA, and this file has recorded a thousand funded projects halted elsewhere despite available money. COMPLAINING ABOUT A PROJECT CONTROLLED BY AN ARMED PARTY CARRIES RISK THIS ENTRY CANNOT ASSESS. Read it with the social fund, the public works project, the bar branches and the lands authority recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Production promotion fund, cooperative credit bank, and the directorate charged with protecting terraces and mapping farmland
trackers.desc: THREE THINGS SIT INSIDE THIS MINISTRY'S STRUCTURE THAT A FARMING COMMUNITY CAN ACTUALLY USE, AND THE FIRST IS MONEY FOR EQUIPMENT. AN AGRICULTURAL AND FISHERIES PRODUCTION PROMOTION FUND OPERATES UNDER MINISTERIAL SUPERVISION, AND IT FINANCED THE BUILDING OF A PROTOTYPE LOCAL SIEVE FOR GRAIN AND PULSES BY A DOMESTIC MANUFACTURER. THE PROTOTYPE WORKED, SO THE MANUFACTURER OPENED A PRODUCTION LINE FOR SIEVES, WITH FURTHER LINES PLANNED FOR HARVESTERS AND FIVE MODELS OF MULTI-PURPOSE AGRICULTURAL MACHINES — SO THAT FARMERS AND ASSOCIATIONS IN VARIOUS GOVERNORATES CAN OBTAIN THE EQUIPMENT THEY NEED EASILY. A FUND THAT PAYS A LOCAL WORKSHOP TO BUILD A MACHINE, RATHER THAN IMPORTING ONE, IS THE RIGHT SHAPE FOR A COUNTRY UNDER BLOCKADE AND SHORTAGE. AND NOTE WHO THE END USERS ARE: FARMERS AND ASSOCIATIONS. AN ASSOCIATION CAN ACQUIRE EQUIPMENT A HOUSEHOLD CANNOT, WHICH IS ONE MORE REASON THIS FILE KEEPS SAYING TO CONSTITUTE THE GROUP BEFORE YOU NEED IT. THE SECOND IS CREDIT: A COOPERATIVE AGRICULTURAL CREDIT BANK SITS UNDER THE SAME SUPERVISION. WHERE COMMERCIAL LENDING IS UNAVAILABLE, A COOPERATIVE AGRICULTURAL BANK IS THE ONLY LENDER LIKELY TO UNDERSTAND A SEASONAL FARMING INCOME — ASK IT, AND ASK THE FUND, BEFORE ASSUMING NOTHING CAN BE FINANCED. THE THIRD IS THE MOST DIRECTLY RELEVANT TO LAND UNDER THREAT. THE MINISTRY'S OWN DUTIES INCLUDE PRESERVING AGRICULTURAL LAND AND PROTECTING IT FROM FLOODS AND OTHER NATURAL FACTORS, AND PROTECTING AGRICULTURAL TERRACES AND VALLEYS FROM EROSION. PROTECTING TERRACES IS A WRITTEN MINISTERIAL DUTY, NOT A FAVOUR. IN A COUNTRY WHOSE MOUNTAIN AGRICULTURE IS BUILT ON TERRACES THAT COLLAPSE WHEN UNMAINTAINED, A VILLAGE ASKING FOR TERRACE PROTECTION IS ASKING THE MINISTRY TO DO ITS OWN STATED JOB — AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED A SOCIAL FUND THAT PAYS FOR EXACTLY THAT WORK THROUGH COMMUNITY CONTRACTING. THE SAME DUTIES INCLUDE INVENTORYING AND CLASSIFYING AGRICULTURAL LAND, CARRYING OUT TOPOGRAPHIC SURVEYS AND PRODUCING MAPS, FOR OPTIMAL USE AND FOR PROTECTION FROM EROSION AND DESERTIFICATION. THAT MEANS SOMEBODY IS SUPPOSED TO HOLD AN INVENTORY AND MAPS OF AGRICULTURAL LAND. ASK WHAT EXISTS FOR YOUR DISTRICT: A CLASSIFICATION SHOWING GROUND AS AGRICULTURAL IS THE DOCUMENT THAT MAKES ITS CONVERSION TO SOMETHING ELSE ARGUABLE, AND A TOPOGRAPHIC SURVEY IS THE BASELINE NOBODY ELSE WILL HAVE. AND THE DUTIES ALSO COVER CONSTRUCTING, OPERATING AND MAINTAINING IRRIGATION FACILITIES, AND ENCOURAGING RECLAMATION AND LEVELLING TO INCREASE THE CULTIVATED AREA — THE HEADINGS UNDER WHICH A REQUEST FOR A CHANNEL, A BARRIER OR A REHABILITATED PLOT SHOULD BE FRAMED. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE THE USUAL ONES FOR THIS COUNTRY: INSTITUTIONS ARE DIVIDED BETWEEN AUTHORITIES AND A MINISTRY PAGE DESCRIBES ONE OF THEM — which body actually operates where you are is the first thing to establish. THE FUND'S CURRENT ACTIVITY, ITS APPLICATION ROUTE AND WHETHER IT FINANCES INDIVIDUALS OR ONLY ENTERPRISES AND ASSOCIATIONS WERE NOT VERIFIED, and the machinery example comes from press coverage. THE MINISTERIAL DUTIES COME FROM AN ORGANISATIONAL REGULATION and describe what the ministry is charged with, not an entitlement you hold. Read it with the social fund's community contracting, the project register and grievance route, the bar branches and the lands authority recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Private foundation agriculture and water programme — barren land reclaimed, a water barrier built, and a collective crop-substitution project funded
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HAS RECORDED STATE FUNDS AND INTERNATIONAL PROGRAMMES FOR THIS COUNTRY, BOTH OF WHICH MOVE SLOWLY AND STOP OFTEN. THIS IS A PRIVATE FOUNDATION THAT PAYS FOR LAND WORKS DIRECTLY, AND WHAT IT HAS FUNDED IS THE USEFUL PART. IT RECLAIMED BARREN LAND FOR FARMERS IN A SOUTHERN GOVERNORATE AND PROVIDED COMPREHENSIVE AGRICULTURAL SERVICES, ENABLING THEM TO RETURN TO LAND THAT HAD LAIN BARREN FOR YEARS AND TO BUILD PRODUCTIVE SOURCES OF INCOME OF THEIR OWN. RETURNING PEOPLE TO LAND THAT WENT OUT OF USE IS A DIFFERENT PROPOSITION FROM DEFENDING LAND STILL FARMED, AND IT IS THE ONE THIS FILE HAS FOUND HARDEST TO FUND. GROUND THAT LIES UNUSED IS THE GROUND MOST EASILY RECLASSIFIED AND TAKEN — SO RECLAMATION IS A DEFENCE, NOT ONLY A DEVELOPMENT. IT BUILT A WATER BARRIER IN A RURAL DISTRICT TO SUPPORT PRODUCTIVE AGRICULTURAL ACTIVITY FOR SEVERAL VILLAGES, DESCRIBED AS HELPING PEOPLE CREATE THEIR OWN WORK IN PLACE OF WHAT THEY HAD LOST. AND IT BUILT A WATER PROJECT REACHING TWO THOUSAND PEOPLE IN A SOUTHERN DISTRICT, AIMED AT THE POOREST AND MOST MARGINALISED. A WATER BARRIER SERVING SEVERAL VILLAGES IS EXACTLY THE UNIT THIS FILE KEEPS RECOMMENDING: SMALL ENOUGH TO BE FUNDED, LARGE ENOUGH TO CHANGE WHETHER A VALLEY CAN BE FARMED. IT IS ALSO THE KIND OF STRUCTURE THAT SURVIVES A CHANGE OF DONOR, BECAUSE ONCE BUILT IT KEEPS WORKING. IT RESCUED FARMS IN A VALLEY FROM AGRICULTURAL AND INSECT PESTS AND FROM THE DRYING OF THE WATER ON WHICH TRADITIONAL IRRIGATION DEPENDS — A REMINDER THAT THE THREAT TO LAND HERE IS OFTEN BIOLOGICAL AND HYDROLOGICAL BEFORE IT IS LEGAL. AND IT FUNDED A COLLECTIVE PROJECT WITH FARMERS IN A CENTRAL GOVERNORATE TO UPROOT A CASH CROP AND PLANT ALMONDS AND OTHER ALTERNATIVES IN ITS PLACE. NOTE THE WORD COLLECTIVE. A CROP SUBSTITUTION THAT ONE HOUSEHOLD ATTEMPTS ALONE FAILS ON PRICE AND ON WATER; A GROUP OF FARMERS SWITCHING TOGETHER CHANGES WHAT THE LOCAL MARKET AND THE IRRIGATION SCHEDULE LOOK LIKE. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED IN FIVE COUNTRIES THAT THE FUNDED UNIT IS THE GROUP, NOT THE FARM — AND HERE IS THE SAME LESSON IN A COUNTRY WHERE ALMOST NOTHING ELSE IS FUNDED. SO THE APPROACH THAT FITS THIS FUNDER IS A NAMED GROUP OF FARMERS, A SPECIFIC PIECE OF GROUND, AND ONE OF THE FOUR THINGS IT HAS ALREADY PAID FOR: RECLAMATION, A WATER STRUCTURE, PEST AND DROUGHT RESCUE, OR A SWITCH OF CROP. ASKING FOR SOMETHING AN ORGANISATION HAS DONE BEFORE IS ALWAYS THE EASIEST ASK. THE LIMITS: this is A PRIVATE FOUNDATION SETTING ITS OWN PRIORITIES, NOT AN ENTITLEMENT PROGRAMME — there is no application right, no published criteria in what was found, and NO INDICATION OF HOW REQUESTS ARE RECEIVED OR SELECTED. THE PROJECTS DESCRIBED COME FROM THE FOUNDATION'S OWN PROGRAMME PAGE, AN INTERESTED SOURCE ON ITS OWN ACHIEVEMENTS, and their dates and current status were not verified. IT IS ASSOCIATED WITH A PROMINENT PUBLIC FIGURE, which in this country carries political associations a community should weigh before approaching it, AND ACCESS DEPENDS ON WHICH AUTHORITY CONTROLS THE AREA. Read it with the social fund's community contracting, the production promotion fund and credit bank, the project register and grievance route, and the bar branches recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Rural water projects authority — the service that provides a village water scheme, and the handover to beneficiary committees
trackers.desc: THERE IS A GOVERNMENT BODY WHOSE PUBLISHED SERVICE IS, IN ITS OWN WORDS, PROVIDING A RURAL WATER PROJECT — AND IT IS RESPONSIBLE FOR THE WATER AND SANITATION SECTOR IN RURAL AREAS AND THE ISLANDS, WITH BRANCHES IN THE GOVERNORATES AND A FORMS PAGE. A NAMED SERVICE WITH A FORM IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN HOPING AND APPLYING. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED VILLAGES ACROSS THIS COUNTRY WAITING FOR WATER WITHOUT KNOWING WHICH BODY IS SUPPOSED TO PROVIDE IT — START AT THE GOVERNORATE BRANCH, ASK FOR THE FORM FOR PROVIDING A RURAL WATER PROJECT, AND LODGE IT. THE MODEL IT USES IS THE ONE THAT LASTS: A COMPLETED VILLAGE SCHEME WAS HANDED OVER TO THE BENEFICIARIES' COMMITTEE TO MANAGE AND OPERATE. HANDOVER TO A BENEFICIARIES' COMMITTEE IS THE WHOLE ARGUMENT FOR FORMING ONE BEFORE THE PROJECT ARRIVES. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED COMMUNITY CONTRACTING AS THE STANDARD METHOD OF TWO SEPARATE FUNDERS IN THIS COUNTRY — AND HERE IS THE STATE WATER AUTHORITY DOING THE SAME. THE VILLAGE THAT ALREADY HAS A CONSTITUTED COMMITTEE IS THE VILLAGE THAT CAN RECEIVE A SCHEME. THE EXAMPLE IS WORTH THE DETAIL: A COMPLETE SOLAR SYSTEM COSTING THIRTY-SIX THOUSAND DOLLARS, FUNDED BY AN INTERNATIONAL CHILDREN'S AGENCY, SERVING MORE THAN THREE THOUSAND FIVE HUNDRED PEOPLE. THIRTY-SIX THOUSAND DOLLARS FOR THREE AND A HALF THOUSAND PEOPLE IS ABOUT TEN DOLLARS A HEAD. THAT IS THE FIGURE TO CARRY INTO ANY CONVERSATION WITH A FUNDER, BECAUSE IT MAKES A VILLAGE WATER SCHEME ONE OF THE CHEAPEST INTERVENTIONS IN THIS ENTIRE FILE. AND THE POWER SOURCE IS DELIBERATE: THE AUTHORITY STATES AN ORIENTATION TOWARD USING SOLAR POWER TO RUN WATER PROJECTS, REDUCING COSTS AND ENSURING THE SUSTAINABILITY OF THE SERVICE. SOLAR PUMPING IS WHAT KEEPS A SCHEME ALIVE WHERE FUEL IS SCARCE AND EXPENSIVE — A DIESEL PUMP STOPS WHEN THE VILLAGE CANNOT AFFORD FUEL, AND A COMMITTEE THAT INHERITS A DIESEL SYSTEM INHERITS A BILL IT CANNOT PAY. ASK FOR SOLAR EXPLICITLY, AND ASK WHO MAINTAINS THE PANELS. THE AUTHORITY ALSO PUBLISHES ITS TENDERS — FOR REHABILITATING AND OPERATING WELLS AND TRANSMISSION LINES, AND FOR DRILLING WELLS UNDER EXTERNALLY FUNDED WATER SECURITY PROJECTS — WITH ENVELOPES OPENED IN THE PRESENCE OF BIDDERS OR THEIR REPRESENTATIVES AND OF THE DISTRICT DIRECTOR. PUBLISHED TENDERS ARE HOW A COMMUNITY LEARNS THAT WORK IS COMING TO ITS AREA BEFORE THE MACHINERY ARRIVES — AND THE DISTRICT DIRECTOR ATTENDING THE OPENING IS THE LOCAL OFFICIAL WHO CAN BE ASKED WHAT WAS AWARDED AND TO WHOM. THE LIMITS: this is A STATE AUTHORITY IN A COUNTRY WHOSE INSTITUTIONS ARE DIVIDED BETWEEN AUTHORITIES — THE SAME BODY EXISTS ON BOTH SIDES AND WHICH ONE OPERATES WHERE A COMMUNITY LIVES IS THE FIRST THING TO ESTABLISH. IT DEPENDS HEAVILY ON EXTERNAL FUNDING: THE PROJECTS DESCRIBED WERE PAID FOR BY FOREIGN AGENCIES AND A FOREIGN DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMME, so its capacity rises and falls with donors rather than with need. WHETHER APPLICATIONS FROM VILLAGES ARE ACCEPTED DIRECTLY, AND ON WHAT CRITERIA SCHEMES ARE PRIORITISED, WERE NOT VERIFIED - and that is what decides whether the form is worth lodging. Read it with the social fund's community contracting, the production fund and credit bank, the private foundation's water barriers and the project register and grievance route recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Free housing, land and property legal assistance — eviction negotiation, representation in courts and departments, and post-eviction support
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE CLOSEST THING IN THIS PAYLOAD TO A FREE LAWYER FOR SOMEBODY ABOUT TO LOSE THEIR HOME OR LAND, AND THE ORGANISATION SAYS SO PLAINLY: WE ALWAYS PROVIDE SERVICES FREE OF CHARGE. WHAT THE TEAM DOES HERE IS UNUSUALLY CONCRETE. IT PROVIDES LEGAL ASSISTANCE ON HOUSING, LAND AND PROPERTY RIGHTS THROUGH NEGOTIATION WITH AUTHORITIES AND LANDOWNERS TO REDUCE EVICTIONS — AND WHERE THE EVICTION HAPPENS ANYWAY, IT PROVIDES POST-EVICTION SUPPORT. NEGOTIATION WITH THE LANDOWNER IS THE INTERVENTION THAT ACTUALLY STOPS THINGS. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED COMPLAINT LINES, COURTS AND COMMITTEES ACROSS TWENTY-THREE COUNTRIES; VERY FEW OF THEM PUT A TRAINED PERSON IN THE ROOM WITH THE MAN WHO WANTS THE LAND BACK, BEFORE THE TRUCKS ARRIVE. ITS OTHER WORK IS THE PAPERWORK THAT DECIDES CASES: LEGAL COUNSELLING AND ASSISTANCE TO OBTAIN CRITICAL LEGAL AND CIVIL DOCUMENTATION, ALONGSIDE AWARENESS-RAISING ON CIVIL DOCUMENTATION AND PROPERTY RIGHTS. DOCUMENTS ARE THE WHOLE FIGHT FOR A DISPLACED FAMILY. THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED THAT REGISTRIES ACCEPT ELECTRICITY RECEIPTS, OLD LEASES AND SETTLEMENT RECORDS AS PROOF — BUT SOMEBODY HAS TO KNOW WHICH DOCUMENT TO CHASE AND HOW TO REPLACE WHAT BURNED, AND THAT IS WHAT THIS SERVICE SUPPLIES. ELIGIBILITY IS BROADER THAN THE WORD DISPLACED SUGGESTS: FIELD ROLES DESCRIBE PROVIDING FREE LEGAL INFORMATION, COUNSELLING AND ASSISTANCE TO REFUGEES, RETURNEES, DISPLACED PEOPLE AND THE HOST COMMUNITY — AND PROVIDING LEGAL COUNSELLING TO CLIENTS AND OR REPRESENTING THEM IN COURTS OR RELEVANT DEPARTMENTS. HOST COMMUNITY MEANS LOCAL FAMILIES WHO NEVER FLED CAN ALSO BE HELPED, AND REPRESENTATION IN RELEVANT DEPARTMENTS MEANS THE HELP REACHES THE ADMINISTRATIVE STAGE RATHER THAN ONLY THE COURTROOM — WHICH IS WHERE LAND MATTERS ARE USUALLY DECIDED. IT ALSO WORKS THROUGH WHICHEVER FORUM ACTUALLY GOVERNS THE GROUND: A RANGE OF JUSTICE MECHANISMS — TRADITIONAL, RELIGIOUS AND STATUTORY — INCLUDING JUDICIAL OR ADMINISTRATIVE REMEDIES, CUSTOMARY OR RELIGIOUS MECHANISMS, COLLABORATIVE DISPUTE RESOLUTION AND TRANSITIONAL JUSTICE. THAT MATTERS IN A COUNTRY WHERE THIS FILE HAS ALREADY RECORDED A COOPERATIVE PROTECTING A RESERVE THROUGH A TRIBAL DOCUMENT. A LEGAL AID SERVICE WILLING TO WORK INSIDE CUSTOMARY MECHANISMS IS ONE THAT CAN ACT WHERE THE STATE CANNOT REACH. AND ITS WORK HAS A SPECIFIC FOCUS ON DISPLACED WOMEN'S RIGHTS, BECAUSE LAND AND PROPERTY OWNERSHIP REMAINS LARGELY RESTRICTED TO MEN BY BOTH TRADITION AND LAW — SO A WIDOW OR A DAUGHTER FACING RELATIVES OVER AN INHERITED PLOT IS EXACTLY WHO THIS PROGRAMME EXISTS FOR. THERE IS A SECOND PROVIDER WORTH ASKING FOR BY NAME: THE REFUGEE AGENCY IN THE SAME COUNTRY OFFERS COUNSELLING, DOCUMENTATION SUPPORT AND MEDIATION TO RESOLVE DISPUTES PARTICULARLY THOSE RELATING TO HOUSING, LAND AND PROPERTY, WITH LAWYERS RUNNING INFORMATION SESSIONS ON ACCESS TO RIGHTS. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE REAL: THIS IS HUMANITARIAN LEGAL AID TIED TO DISPLACEMENT AND FUNDED PROJECT BY PROJECT - IT OPERATES IN THE GOVERNORATES WHERE IT HAS PROGRAMMES AND FUNDING, NOT NATIONWIDE, AND SERVICES CAN CLOSE WHEN A GRANT ENDS. IT IS AIMED AT PEOPLE WHO HAVE FLED OR WHO HOST THEM, SO A COMMUNITY OPPOSING A DEVELOPMENT PROJECT WITHOUT A DISPLACEMENT DIMENSION MAY NOT QUALIFY - ASK BEFORE RELYING ON IT. THE COUNTRY DESCRIPTION COMES FROM THE ORGANISATION'S OWN FACT SHEETS OF EARLIER YEARS AND THE SERVICE DETAIL PARTLY FROM A JOB ADVERTISEMENT, WHICH DESCRIBES WHAT STAFF ARE ASKED TO DO RATHER THAN WHAT EVERY OFFICE DELIVERS - confirm current coverage and intake locally. Read it with the lands, survey and planning authority's complaints line, the agricultural cooperative union's reserve case, the rural water projects authority and the social fund's community contracting recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Enterprise development agency — matching grants up to ten thousand dollars for productive farming associations in named value chains
trackers.desc: THIS IS AN AGENCY OF THE NATIONAL SOCIAL FUND, ESTABLISHED IN 2006, WHOSE WORK IS BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT THROUGH VALUE CHAIN ANALYSIS — AND ITS MOST CONCRETE OFFER IS A MATCHING GRANT OF UP TO TEN THOUSAND DOLLARS, TO WHICH THE ENTERPRISE CONTRIBUTES HALF, THE GRANT PORTION BEING NON-REFUNDABLE. MATCHING AT FIFTY PER CENT IS THE HARD PART AND THE HONEST PART. A GROUP THAT CANNOT FIND FIVE THOUSAND DOLLARS CANNOT USE THIS — BUT AN ASSOCIATION WITH STORED CROP, EQUIPMENT OR MEMBERS' SUBSCRIPTIONS OFTEN CAN, AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED THAT ASKING WHICH CONTRIBUTIONS COUNT IN KIND IS THE QUESTION THAT DECIDES WHETHER A POOR APPLICANT QUALIFIES. WHAT THE MONEY IS FOR IS SPECIFIC: IMPROVING THE ENTERPRISE'S PERFORMANCE AND REHABILITATING OR REPLACING ITS ASSETS SO IT CAN REACH EXTERNAL MARKETS. REHABILITATING ASSETS IS THE PHRASE THAT MATTERS IN A COUNTRY WHERE WAR DESTROYED PRESSES, STORES AND COLD ROOMS. THIS IS MONEY TO PUT A BROKEN FACILITY BACK INTO USE RATHER THAN TO START SOMETHING NEW — AND A COOPERATIVE'S DAMAGED STORE IS EXACTLY THE KIND OF ASSET IT DESCRIBES. WHO QUALIFIES IS NARROW AND SHOULD BE CHECKED FIRST: PRODUCTIVE AGRICULTURAL ASSOCIATIONS WORKING IN COFFEE, HONEY AND ONION; COMPANIES IN THOSE VALUE CHAINS; EXPORTERS AND TESTING LABORATORIES FOR THOSE CROPS; AND LARGE ONION FARMERS — WITH THE APPLICANT ASSOCIATION REQUIRED TO BE A PRODUCTIVE OR DEVELOPMENTAL ONE IN COFFEE, HONEY OR ONION. THREE CROPS ONLY. THAT IS A REAL LIMIT, BUT TWO OF THEM — COFFEE AND HONEY — ARE EXACTLY THE HIGH-VALUE PRODUCTS THAT MAKE MOUNTAIN AND TERRACE LAND WORTH KEEPING, AND THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED SEPARATELY THAT TERRACE PROTECTION IS A WRITTEN MINISTERIAL DUTY IN THIS COUNTRY. SO A TERRACE-FARMING COMMUNITY WITH COFFEE OR HIVES HAS A FUNDED ROUTE TO KEEPING ITS GROUND PRODUCTIVE — AND HIVES, AS THIS FILE HAS NOTED ELSEWHERE, NEED ALMOST NO LAND AND NO IRRIGATION. THE AGENCY'S STATED GOAL IS BROADER THAN ITS CURRENT WINDOWS AND WORTH QUOTING IN ANY APPROACH: DOUBLING THE AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTIVITY AND INCOMES OF SMALL FOOD PRODUCERS — PARTICULARLY WOMEN, INDIGENOUS PEOPLES, FARMING FAMILIES, LIVESTOCK KEEPERS AND FISHERS — INCLUDING ENSURING THEIR EQUAL ACCESS TO LAND AND TO OTHER PRODUCTIVE RESOURCES, INPUTS, KNOWLEDGE, FINANCIAL SERVICES AND MARKETS. EQUAL ACCESS TO LAND APPEARING IN AN ENTERPRISE AGENCY'S OWN OBJECTIVES IS UNUSUAL AND USABLE: IT MEANS A PROPOSAL ABOUT SECURING WOMEN'S OR TENANTS' ACCESS TO GROUND IS INSIDE ITS STATED PURPOSE RATHER THAN OUTSIDE IT. ONE PARALLEL PROGRAMME SHOWS WHAT ELSE IS MOVING: A DONOR-FUNDED SMALLHOLDER VALUE CHAIN PROJECT LAUNCHED IN 2026 ACROSS THREE GOVERNORATES TARGETS ABOUT TWO THOUSAND THREE HUNDRED HOUSEHOLDS AND INCLUDES SUPPORT FOR AGRICULTURAL INPUTS, DEVELOPMENT OF IRRIGATION TECHNIQUES, CAPACITY BUILDING, PROCESSING AND PACKING GROUPS, AND MARKET LINKAGE. ASK WHICH PROJECTS ARE RUNNING IN YOUR GOVERNORATE THIS YEAR RATHER THAN WHETHER THE AGENCY HAS A PERMANENT SCHEME. IN THIS COUNTRY ALMOST EVERYTHING IS DELIVERED AS TIME-LIMITED DONOR PROJECTS, AND THE ONLY RELIABLE QUESTION IS WHAT IS OPEN NOW AND WHERE. THE LIMITS: THIS IS ENTERPRISE DEVELOPMENT, NOT LAND DEFENCE - IT FUNDS BUSINESSES AND ASSOCIATIONS TO TRADE BETTER, AND WILL NOT PAY FOR AN OBJECTION, A LAWYER OR A LAND PURCHASE. THE MATCHING REQUIREMENT EXCLUDES THE POOREST, THE CROP LIST IS NARROW, AND THE WINDOW DESCRIBED BELONGS TO ONE PROGRAMME WHOSE CURRENT STATUS WAS NOT VERIFIED. THE AGENCY SITS UNDER A NATIONAL FUND IN A COUNTRY WHOSE INSTITUTIONS ARE DIVIDED BETWEEN AUTHORITIES, SO WHICH GOVERNORATES IT REACHES MUST BE CHECKED LOCALLY. THE GRANT TERMS COME FROM A PROGRAMME LOGIN PAGE AND THE STATED GOALS FROM A SUB-SITE OF THE AGENCY, NOT FROM A PUBLISHED CALL DOCUMENT. Read it with the lands, survey and planning authority's complaints line, the agricultural cooperative union's reserve case and loan studies, the rural water projects authority and the housing, land and property legal assistance recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: World Bank Accountability Mechanism — an inspection panel that investigates and a dispute resolution service that mediates
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE THIRD DEVELOPMENT BANK COMPLAINT OFFICE RECORDED IN THIS FILE, AND ITS STRUCTURE IS DIFFERENT AGAIN: ONE MECHANISM HOUSING TWO PARALLEL ENTITIES THAT BOTH REPORT INDEPENDENTLY TO THE BOARD — AN INSPECTION PANEL CREATED IN 1993, AND A DISPUTE RESOLUTION SERVICE OPERATIONAL SINCE 2021 — FOR PEOPLE AND COMMUNITIES WHO BELIEVE THEY HAVE BEEN, OR ARE LIKELY TO BE, HARMED BY A BANK-FUNDED PROJECT. LIKELY TO BE HARMED IS THE PHRASE TO NOTICE. A COMPLAINT CAN COME BEFORE THE DAMAGE, WHICH IS THE ONLY POINT AT WHICH ANYTHING CAN STILL BE CHANGED — THIS FILE HAS RECORDED DOZENS OF FORUMS THAT ONLY OPEN AFTER THE HARM IS DONE. THE GROUNDS ARE WIDER THAN THEY LOOK: THE POLICIES A COMPLAINT CAN INVOKE INCLUDE NOT ONLY THE BANK'S ENVIRONMENTAL AND SOCIAL POLICIES BUT ALL OTHER POLICIES AND PROCEDURES APPLICABLE TO THE DESIGN, APPRAISAL AND IMPLEMENTATION OF A BANK-FINANCED PROJECT. SO PROCUREMENT, DISCLOSURE, CONSULTATION AND APPRAISAL FAILURES ARE ALL ARGUABLE, NOT JUST POLLUTION AND RESETTLEMENT. THAT MATTERS WHERE THE REAL COMPLAINT IS THAT NOBODY WAS TOLD OR NOBODY WAS ASKED. THE PANEL ITSELF IS THREE MEMBERS APPOINTED BY AND REPORTING DIRECTLY TO THE BOARD FOR FIVE-YEAR NON-RENEWABLE TERMS, CHOSEN FOR THEIR ABILITY TO DEAL THOROUGHLY AND FAIRLY WITH COMPLAINTS, THEIR INTEGRITY AND THEIR INDEPENDENCE. NON-RENEWABLE TERMS ARE A REAL SAFEGUARD: A PANEL MEMBER WITH NO SECOND TERM TO PROTECT HAS LESS REASON TO SOFTEN A FINDING. THE TIMETABLE IS PUBLISHED AND SHORT AT THE START: AFTER REGISTRATION, MANAGEMENT IS GIVEN TWENTY-ONE BUSINESS DAYS TO RESPOND TO THE CLAIMS, AND THE PANEL THEN HAS A FURTHER TWENTY-ONE BUSINESS DAYS TO DECIDE ELIGIBILITY — THOUGH AN INVESTIGATION CAN PROCEED ONLY AFTER THE BOARD APPROVES THE PANEL'S RECOMMENDATION. SO A COMMUNITY KNOWS ROUGHLY WHEN TO EXPECT THE FIRST TWO ANSWERS, AND CAN CHASE THEM. THE BOARD APPROVAL STEP IS THE POLITICAL ONE, AND IT IS WHERE A CASE CAN DIE QUIETLY — WHICH IS A REASON TO MAKE THE REQUEST PUBLIC LOCALLY AND TO TELL ANYONE WHO WILL LISTEN THAT IT IS PENDING. THE MEDIATION ROUTE IS THE PART MOST COMMUNITIES SHOULD UNDERSTAND BEFORE FILING: IF THE PANEL FINDS THE CASE ELIGIBLE AND THE BOARD APPROVES, THE MECHANISM'S SECRETARY OFFERS DISPUTE RESOLUTION TO THE REQUESTERS AND THE BORROWER — AND IF BOTH AGREE, THE COMPLIANCE INVESTIGATION IS PUT ON HOLD WHILE THE PARTIES SELECT A MEDIATOR FROM A POOL AND AGREE OBJECTIVES, SCOPE, STAGES, PARTICIPANTS AND TIMELINES. AND IF THEY REACH AGREEMENT, THE PANEL DOES NOT INVESTIGATE AT ALL. THAT IS THE TRADE: A NEGOTIATED FIX INSTEAD OF A PUBLIC FINDING OF FAULT. FOR A VILLAGE THAT WANTS ITS WATER BACK, THE TRADE IS USUALLY WORTH IT — FOR ONE THAT WANTS THE PROJECT STOPPED OR THE RECORD SET STRAIGHT, IT IS NOT. THE METHODS ON OFFER ARE BROADER THAN MEDIATION ALONE: CONSULTATIVE DIALOGUE, INFORMATION SHARING, JOINT FACT-FINDING, MEDIATION AND CONCILIATION — AND JOINT FACT-FINDING IS THE ONE TO ASK FOR WHERE THE DISPUTE IS ABOUT WHAT IS ACTUALLY HAPPENING TO THE WATER, THE DUST OR THE LAND. THE CLOCK IS ONE YEAR, EXTENDABLE BY SIX MONTHS IF BOTH PARTIES AGREE, WHICH KEEPS A NEGOTIATION FROM BECOMING A WAY OF WAITING A COMMUNITY OUT. AND THE MECHANISM STATES THAT IT DOES NOT TOLERATE THREATS OR ACTS OF RETALIATION AGAINST REQUESTERS OR ANY OTHER PERSON OR ENTITY CONNECTED WITH A REQUEST — A COMMITMENT WORTH CITING IN THE REQUEST ITSELF. THE LIMITS: THIS REACHES ONLY PROJECTS FINANCED BY THIS PARTICULAR BANK, AND IT JUDGES THE BANK'S COMPLIANCE - NOT THE GOVERNMENT, THE CONTRACTOR OR THE ARMED ACTORS WHO MAY BE THE REAL PROBLEM IN THIS COUNTRY. AN INVESTIGATION HAPPENS ONLY IF THE BOARD APPROVES IT, AND THE PANEL RECOMMENDS RATHER THAN ORDERS. THE STRUCTURE WAS CHANGED BY A RESOLUTION APPROVED IN MARCH 2025 AND THE PANEL'S OPERATING PROCEDURES WERE REISSUED IN NOVEMBER 2025, SO PROCEDURAL DETAIL SHOULD BE CHECKED AGAINST THE CURRENT DOCUMENTS. IN A COUNTRY AT WAR, WHETHER A BANK-FINANCED PROJECT EXISTS TO COMPLAIN ABOUT, AND WHETHER FILING IS SAFE, ARE PRIOR QUESTIONS THIS ENTRY CANNOT ANSWER. Read it with the housing, land and property legal assistance, the lands and survey authority's complaints line, the enterprise development agency's matching grants and the rural water projects authority recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Country humanitarian pooled fund — the largest direct funder of national organisations, entered through a capacity assessment
trackers.desc: THIS FILE RECORDED NO WAY OF RAISING MONEY IN THIS COUNTRY AT ALL. THIS IS THE LARGEST ONE THERE IS FOR LOCAL BODIES: A POOLED FUND THAT ALLOCATED TWENTY-SIX POINT SEVEN MILLION DOLLARS DIRECTLY TO NATIONAL NGOs IN A SINGLE YEAR AND TWO HUNDRED AND TWENTY-ONE MILLION SINCE 2015, WITH NATIONAL ACTORS TAKING ALMOST A QUARTER OF ALL ITS FUNDING THAT YEAR. DIRECTLY IS THE WORD THAT MATTERS. MOST INTERNATIONAL MONEY IN THIS COUNTRY REACHES LOCAL ORGANISATIONS AS A SUB-CONTRACT FROM A FOREIGN AGENCY, ON THAT AGENCY'S TERMS — THIS FUND CONTRACTS WITH NATIONAL ORGANISATIONS ITSELF. WHO IS ELIGIBLE IS SHORT: NATIONAL AND INTERNATIONAL NON-GOVERNMENTAL ORGANISATIONS, RED CRESCENT SOCIETY PARTNERS AND UN AGENCIES. BUT THE REAL GATE IS NOT THE PROPOSAL — IT IS THE ASSESSMENT THAT COMES BEFORE ANY PROPOSAL. AN ORGANISATION MUST HAVE PASSED THE FUND'S CAPACITY ASSESSMENT, HAVE ITS DUE DILIGENCE STATUS APPROVED IN THE GRANT MANAGEMENT SYSTEM, AND HAVE NO OUTSTANDING OVERSIGHT OR COMPLIANCE ISSUES. SO THE WORK STARTS LONG BEFORE A CALL OPENS: REGISTER AN ORGANISATION PROFILE IN THE UN PARTNER PORTAL, GET IT VERIFIED, THEN CREATE A PROFILE ON THE FUND'S OWN GRANTS SYSTEM — AND WATCH FOR THE OPEN CALL THROUGH WHICH THE CAPACITY ASSESSMENT ITSELF IS RUN, WHICH BEGINS WITH A PRELIMINARY SCREENING AGAINST BASIC AND MINIMUM STANDARDS. AN ORGANISATION THAT DOES THAT PAPERWORK IN A QUIET MONTH IS ELIGIBLE WHEN A CRISIS COMES. ONE THAT WAITS UNTIL THE CALL IS PUBLISHED IS NOT, AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED THE SAME PATTERN IN EVERY MAJOR FUNDING SYSTEM IT HAS EXAMINED. THERE ARE TWO WAYS MONEY COMES OUT: A STANDARD ALLOCATION HELD ONCE OR TWICE A YEAR THROUGH A CALL FOR PROPOSALS FOR COLLECTIVELY IDENTIFIED NEEDS, AND RESERVE ALLOCATIONS LAUNCHED AS NEEDED IN RESPONSE TO SUDDEN ONSET NEEDS AND SPECIFIC CRISES. THE RESERVE WINDOW IS THE ONE TO REMEMBER WHEN SOMETHING HAPPENS FAST — A FLOOD, A DISPLACEMENT, A COLLAPSE — AND IT IS ALSO THE WINDOW MOST LIKELY TO REACH A COMMUNITY WHOSE LAND OR WATER HAS JUST BEEN TAKEN OUT OF USE. YOUR ASSESSMENT SCORE THEN SHAPES EVERYTHING ELSE: THE FUNDING CEILING, THE NUMBER OF TRANCHES, THE REPORTING FREQUENCY AND THE MONITORING METHOD ARE ALL SET BY THE PARTNER'S RISK LEVEL, DERIVED FROM A CAPACITY ASSESSMENT SCORE OF LOW, MEDIUM OR HIGH. SO INVESTING IN FINANCIAL SYSTEMS AND RECORD-KEEPING IS NOT BUREAUCRACY FOR ITS OWN SAKE — IT DIRECTLY RAISES HOW MUCH MONEY AN ORGANISATION CAN HOLD AND HOW FEW HOOPS IT MUST JUMP THROUGH LATER. TWO MORE THINGS ARE WORTH KNOWING. THE FUND'S ADVISORY BOARD INCLUDES REPRESENTATIVES OF NATIONAL AS WELL AS INTERNATIONAL NGOs ALONGSIDE DONORS AND UN AGENCIES — SO THERE ARE NATIONAL VOICES IN THE ROOM WHERE PRIORITIES ARE SET, AND FINDING WHICH ORGANISATIONS HOLD THOSE SEATS IS WORTH AN AFTERNOON. AND ONE OF ITS STATED OBJECTIVES IS EXPANDING THE DELIVERY OF ASSISTANCE IN HARD-TO-REACH AREAS BY PARTNERING WITH NGOs — WHICH IS THE ARGUMENT A REMOTE DISTRICT'S OWN ORGANISATION SHOULD MAKE ABOUT ITSELF: IT CAN REACH WHERE OTHERS CANNOT. THE LIMITS: THIS IS HUMANITARIAN FUNDING FOR LIFE-SAVING AND LIFE-SUSTAINING ACTIVITIES UNDER A HUMANITARIAN RESPONSE PLAN - IT PAYS FOR WATER, SHELTER, FOOD, HEALTH AND PROTECTION, NOT FOR STOPPING A DEVELOPMENT, BUYING LAND OR FUNDING LITIGATION, AND A PROPOSAL FRAMED AS OPPOSITION WILL NOT QUALIFY. ONLY REGISTERED ORGANISATIONS THAT HAVE PASSED CAPACITY ASSESSMENT ARE ELIGIBLE, WHICH EXCLUDES VILLAGE COMMITTEES ENTIRELY. IN EARLIER PERIODS ALL NGO PARTNERS WERE TREATED AS HIGH RISK UNDER STRICT MODALITIES - TRANCHED DISBURSEMENT, FREQUENT REPORTING, MANDATORY AUDITING - AND OPERATING CONDITIONS AND AUTHORITY CONTROLS DIFFER SHARPLY BETWEEN AREAS OF THE COUNTRY. THE FIGURES CITED COME FROM THE FUND'S OWN PAGES AND REPORT ARCHIVES AND THE MOST SPECIFIC ONES DATE FROM 2021 - check current allocation papers. Read it with the enterprise development agency's matching grants, the housing land and property legal assistance, the lands and survey authority and the agricultural cooperative union recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Standards and quality authority — empowered to test in any suitable laboratory at home or abroad, and to validate other laboratories' results
trackers.desc: IN A COUNTRY WHERE LABORATORIES HAVE BEEN DAMAGED, LOOTED OR CUT OFF BY WAR, ONE PROVISION IN THIS AUTHORITY'S LAW MATTERS MORE THAN ANY BUILDING: IT MAY CARRY OUT ANY EXAMINATIONS, TESTS AND ANALYSIS OF ANY MATERIAL, COMMODITY OR ARTICLE IT SEES NECESSARY TO VERIFY CONFORMITY WITH THE APPROVED STANDARD SPECIFICATIONS, IN ANY LABORATORIES IT DEEMS SUITABLE INSIDE OR OUTSIDE THE COUNTRY. INSIDE OR OUTSIDE THE COUNTRY IS THE PHRASE. IT MEANS THE ABSENCE OF A WORKING LABORATORY NEARBY IS NOT A LEGAL BAR TO TESTING — THE AUTHORITY IS EMPOWERED TO SEND THE SAMPLE ABROAD, AND A REQUEST CAN BE FRAMED AROUND THAT POWER RATHER THAN AROUND WHAT IS AVAILABLE LOCALLY. THE SECOND POWER IS THE ONE TO USE WHEN SOMEBODY ELSE HAS ALREADY TESTED: IT MAY ACCREDIT AND VALIDATE THE RESULTS OF EXAMINATION AND TESTING LABORATORIES SUBMITTED TO IT FROM CENTRES SIMILAR TO ITS OWN LABORATORIES. SO A RESULT OBTAINED FROM AN AID AGENCY'S LABORATORY, A UNIVERSITY OR A LABORATORY IN A NEIGHBOURING COUNTRY CAN BE BROUGHT HERE FOR VALIDATION RATHER THAN DISCARDED AS UNOFFICIAL — WHICH IS OFTEN THE ONLY ROUTE LEFT WHEN THE TESTING WAS DONE BY WHOEVER COULD DO IT. IT ALSO OWES ADVICE: IT PROVIDES TECHNICAL ADVICE IN STANDARDS, METROLOGY, QUALITY CONTROL AND CALIBRATION TO MANUFACTURERS, IMPORTERS AND EXPORTERS, AND PREPARES STUDIES AND RESEARCH AND HOLDS TRAINING COURSES AND SEMINARS. AND IT IS REACHABLE IN THE SIMPLEST WAY THIS FILE KEEPS LOOKING FOR: IT PUBLISHES A FREE TELEPHONE NUMBER, AND MAINTAINS GENERAL OFFICES IN BOTH OF THE COUNTRY'S PRINCIPAL CITIES — WHICH MATTERS IN A DIVIDED ADMINISTRATION, BECAUSE IT MEANS THERE IS A COUNTERPART ON WHICHEVER SIDE OF THE LINE YOU LIVE. ITS ROUTINE WORK IS ALSO THE KIND ORDINARY PEOPLE CAN USE: IT CALIBRATES WEIGHING, VOLUME AND MEASURING DEVICES IN CENTRES, SHOPS AND MARKETS AND ON GAS-STATION AND FUEL-PUMP SCALES ACROSS ALL GOVERNORATES, AND INSPECTS CONSIGNMENTS ARRIVING THROUGH PORTS AND ENTRY POINTS FOR CONFORMITY. MEASURING DEVICES SOUND UNRELATED TO LAND UNTIL A WATER TANKER, A FUEL DELIVERY OR A TRUCKLOAD OF FILL IS BEING SOLD BY VOLUME. A CALIBRATION COMPLAINT IS A CHEAP, ROUTINE, NON-POLITICAL WAY TO PUT AN OFFICIAL BODY ONTO A SITE. IT PUBLISHES TOO: A PERIODICAL BULLETIN ON STANDARDS AND METROLOGY, A STANDARDS MAGAZINE, AND A QUALITY GUIDE PRODUCED WITH A NEWSPAPER INSTITUTION CARRYING GUIDANCE, SPECIFICATIONS AND CONSUMER AWARENESS MATERIAL — WHICH IS WHERE THE APPLICABLE SPECIFICATION FOR DRINKING WATER OR A BUILDING MATERIAL WILL BE NAMED. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE HEAVY IN THIS COUNTRY: THIS IS A CONSUMER AND TRADE STANDARDS BODY, NOT AN ENVIRONMENTAL REGULATOR - ITS POWERS RUN TO CONFORMITY OF MATERIALS, COMMODITIES AND MEASURING DEVICES, NOT TO LAND DISPUTES OR PROJECT APPROVALS. THE AUTHORITY IS SPLIT BETWEEN TWO ADMINISTRATIONS IN A DIVIDED COUNTRY AND WHICH OFFICE HAS AUTHORITY WHERE IS CONTESTED; THE FREEPHONE NUMBER RECORDED HERE COMES FROM ONE SIDE'S OFFICIAL CHANNEL. WHETHER IT WILL TEST FOR A PRIVATE CITIZEN, WHAT IT CHARGES, AND WHETHER THE POWER TO TEST ABROAD IS EXERCISED IN PRACTICE WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED - THE LAW SAYS IT MAY, NOT THAT IT WILL. THE LAW TEXT WAS READ ON ANOTHER STATE BODY'S WEBSITE AND THE ACTIVITY LIST ON AN UNOFFICIAL BLOG REPRODUCING AUTHORITY MATERIAL, SOME OF IT TWO DECADES OLD. Read it with the enterprise development agency's matching grants, the humanitarian pooled fund, the housing land and property assistance and the lands and survey authority recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Endowments ministry and authority — governorate offices that hold endowed land and issue leasing contracts, on both sides of the division
trackers.desc: IN A COUNTRY WHERE THE STATE IS SPLIT, ENDOWED LAND IS HELD BY TWO PARALLEL BODIES, AND BOTH HAVE OFFICES IN THE GOVERNORATES. THE MINISTRY OF ENDOWMENTS AND GUIDANCE EXISTS TO PRESERVE AND SUPERVISE ALL ENDOWED FUNDS AND PROPERTIES, TO MANAGE AND INVEST THEM, AND TO CARRY OUT GUIDANCE DUTIES. THE SERVICE THAT MATTERS FOR GROUND IS LISTED PLAINLY AMONG ITS SERVICES: ISSUING CONTRACTS FOR THE LEASING OF ENDOWMENT LANDS AND BUILDINGS. A LEASE CONTRACT FROM THE ENDOWMENTS OFFICE IS A PIECE OF PAPER THAT SAYS WHO MAY BE ON THAT GROUND. FOR A FAMILY OR A COOPERATIVE ALREADY FARMING ENDOWED LAND WITHOUT ONE, GETTING IT IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A TENANT AND A TRESPASSER — AND THIS PAYLOAD RECORDED IN A NEIGHBOURING COUNTRY THAT OCCUPYING ENDOWED LAND WITHOUT A DOCUMENTED CONTRACT MAKES YOU A TRESPASSER BY DEFINITION. IT IS FINDABLE IN PERSON, WHICH MATTERS MORE THAN A WEBSITE HERE: THE MINISTRY PUBLISHES BRANCH OFFICES BY GOVERNORATE WITH STREET-LEVEL ADDRESSES — ONE IN A HADRAMAWT TOWN ON A NAMED STREET IN A GOVERNMENT COMPLEX, ONE IN MARIB BESIDE A NAMED MARKET, ONE IN A LAHJ DISTRICT IN A NAMED QUARTER. ON THE OTHER SIDE OF THE DIVISION A GENERAL AUTHORITY FOR ENDOWMENTS AND GUIDANCE RUNS ITS OWN GOVERNORATE OFFICES, HOLDING MEETINGS ON THEIR PERFORMANCE, INSPECTING MOSQUE MAINTENANCE, AND IMPLEMENTING A FACILITATION INITIATIVE AIMED AT DISCIPLINE AND AT SPEEDING UP THE COMPLETION OF BENEFICIARIES' TRANSACTIONS. SO WHICHEVER SIDE OF THE LINE YOU LIVE ON, THERE IS AN ENDOWMENTS OFFICE WITH A COUNTER — AND ONE OF THEM IS PUBLICLY COMMITTED TO SPEEDING UP BENEFICIARIES' TRANSACTIONS, WHICH IS A COMMITMENT WORTH QUOTING WHEN A FILE SITS UNTOUCHED. THE MOST USEFUL SENTENCE COMES FROM THAT AUTHORITY'S OWN SLOGAN: THE ENDOWMENT IS GIVING AND CHARITY AND BENEFICENCE, AND ITS GOOD WORKS AND ITS CHANNELS OF DISBURSEMENT ARE DETERMINED BY YOU — THE PERSON MAKING THE ENDOWMENT. IF THE ENDOWER DETERMINES THE PURPOSES, THE PURPOSE CAN BE THE LAND ITSELF: ITS TREES, ITS WATER, ITS SOIL, ITS GRAZING. THIS FILE RECORDS A NEIGHBOURING COUNTRY WHERE A SINGLE TREE CAN BE ENDOWED AND SEVERAL PEOPLE CAN ENDOW TOGETHER — THE SAME LOGIC IS AVAILABLE HERE, AND IT TURNS A PLOT INTO SOMETHING WITH A NAMED PURPOSE AND AN INSTITUTIONAL GUARDIAN. FOR A COMMUNITY THAT CANNOT BUY LAND AND CANNOT REGISTER AN ORGANISATION, THIS IS THE CHEAPEST ROUTE IN THIS PAYLOAD TO PUTTING GROUND BEYOND SALE: SEVERAL HOUSEHOLDS ENDOWING TOGETHER, WITH THE PURPOSE WRITTEN THE WAY THEY WANT IT AND AN EXISTING OFFICE OBLIGED TO PRESERVE AND SUPERVISE IT. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE HEAVY: THESE ARE STATE RELIGIOUS ADMINISTRATIONS IN A COUNTRY AT WAR AND UNDER TWO GOVERNMENTS - ENDOWMENT REVENUES HAVE BEEN A CONTESTED RESOURCE, AND WHICH BODY CONTROLS WHICH PROPERTY IS DISPUTED IN PLACES. THEIR PURPOSE IS PRESERVING, MANAGING AND INVESTING ENDOWED PROPERTY, NOT CONSERVATION, AND INVESTMENT CAN MEAN BUILDING ON IT. WHETHER A NEW ENDOWMENT CAN BE REGISTERED FOR AN ENVIRONMENTAL OR AGRICULTURAL PURPOSE, WHAT IT COSTS, WHETHER LEASE CONTRACTS ARE ISSUED TO EXISTING OCCUPIERS AND HOW THEY ARE PRICED WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED - THOSE ARE THE QUESTIONS FOR THE GOVERNORATE OFFICE. THE MINISTRY'S SERVICE LIST COMES FROM A NATIONAL INFORMATION CENTRE PAGE THAT MAY PREDATE THE WAR, AND THE TWO BODIES' SITES WERE SEEN AS NEWS AND BRANCH LISTINGS RATHER THAN SERVICE CATALOGUES. Read it with the standards authority's power to test abroad, the humanitarian pooled fund, the enterprise development agency's matching grants and the lands and survey authority recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Laos — State Audit Organization (SAO) [official Facebook]
trackers.desc: National public-finance watchdog; the State Audit Organization of Lao PDR (ASEANSAI/ASOSAI member) audits state institutions, budget use, SOEs & public projects (financial, compliance & performance audit). The SAO has no standalone website; this is its official social-media presence, Laos.

trackers.name: Laos — Ministry of Finance
trackers.desc: National budget authority; the Ministry of Finance manages public finances, prepares & executes the state budget, public debt & revenue and publishes fiscal data, Lao PDR. Here you can trace how the public budget is allocated and spent in Laos.

trackers.name: Laos — Department of Enterprise Registration & Management (MOIC)
trackers.desc: National corporate registry; the Enterprise Registration Office / Department of Enterprise Registration & Management under the Ministry of Industry & Commerce registers enterprises & issues the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC), with a National Enterprise Database, Laos. — Holds to account: state firms & government-linked companies — find their registration, directors and filings.

trackers.name: Articles 47–49 — be at the demarcation, and put customary use in writing
trackers.desc: THE MOMENT WITH A STATUTORY HOOK. Under the Forestry Law No. 64/NA of 13 June 2019, natural forest is the property of the Lao Nation and the State manages it centrally — but expressly ‘with the participation of all organisations and the people’. Articles 47–49 give local people formal opportunities to participate in forest boundary demarcation at village level. DEMARCATION IS WHERE CUSTOMARY ACCESS IS WON OR LOST: legal analysis records that past demarcation limited customary access, and that the provisions do not account for customary access, resource use, management, exclusion and governance — so the right to attend exists but the categories are narrower than customary practice. Attend, and record customary use in writing on the day. Across Laos, Cambodia, Myanmar and Vietnam the power to set community forest boundaries sits with state agencies, which analysis says often restricts the size of customary land. AND CUSTOMARY USE IS BOUNDED: it is granted for all forest land excluding protection forests and conservation forests — the two categories most likely to cover a high-biodiversity site.

trackers.name: Carbon income, guardian villages, and timber for your own school
trackers.desc: THREE RIGHTS WORTH KNOWING BY NAME. 1. CARBON IS IN THE STATUTE: participating villagers have the right to benefits from sale of planted trees and NTFPs and income generated from trade in forest carbon credits, as defined in the Forestry Law 2019, with forest carbon separately defined as CO2 absorbed by forests measured in tonnes per hectare. That places Laos with Liberia here as a country where community carbon rights are stated in law rather than left to contract. 2. GUARDIAN VILLAGES: Conservation Forest is the official Lao term for Protected Area, and the revised Protected Area Decree (No. 219) was written to clearly describe the rights and obligations of guardian villages — a defined status for villages attached to a protected area. Establish which zone you are in: the regime names a Total Protection Zone, a Controlled Use Zone and a Corridor Zone, and permitted use differs by zone. Co-management models are being built in three areas including Nam Et-Phou Louey National Park under an EU/AFD/WCS partnership. 3. TIMBER FOR VILLAGE PUBLIC USE: timber for schools, health centres, meeting halls, temples and bridges may be taken from the allocated village use forest only, with logging approved by the Provincial Agriculture and Forestry Office under the annual provincial plan — a lawful village route that does not need a commercial operator. NOTE: no PSFM logging quotas have been issued since 2013 under the logging ban, so village forest management is the main route in practice.

trackers.name: ICCA Registry and Protected Planet — and registration is not a precondition
trackers.desc: CHECK WHETHER YOUR SITE IS ALREADY IN A REGISTRY BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE — it may carry a designation nobody locally mentioned. The World Database on Protected and Conserved Areas at protectedplanet.net is a joint UNEP and IUCN product managed by UNEP-WCMC, drawing on almost 500 data providers in 245 countries, updated monthly and downloadable; it underpins the UN List of Protected Areas. THE OECM ROUTE IS THE ONE MOST COMMUNITIES MISS: a site qualifies as an other effective area-based conservation measure if it delivers sustained, positive conservation outcomes EVEN THOUGH IT MAY BE MANAGED PRIMARILY FOR OTHER REASONS — so a grazing commons, a sacred site or a watershed managed for water supply can qualify without being managed primarily for conservation. Land that is worked rather than preserved is not excluded. But note the exclusivity: a site can be a protected area or an OECM — it is not possible to meet both, so ask which is being proposed. THE ICCA REGISTRY IS THE ONE COMMUNITIES FILL IN THEMSELVES: at iccaregistry.org, communities themselves provide data, case studies, maps, photos and stories, and its operators state it is meant to be used to enhance advocacy and recognition — not merely as an inventory. Documenting a territory there creates a citable, third-party-hosted record. THE SENTENCE THAT MATTERS MOST: UNEP-WCMC states these territories must be recognised and respected ‘whether or not they have been reported to the ICCA Registry’ — registration is NOT a precondition of rights, and anyone arguing a claim is weaker for being unregistered is arguing against the registry operator's own position. AND USE THE SCALE FIGURE CAREFULLY: over 1,500 sites are reported under indigenous and community governance — just 1 percent of all recorded sites, with UNEP-WCMC adding that no one knows how many ICCAs exist globally. That 1 percent measures how little has been recorded, not how little communities conserve. Filter Protected Planet by governance type to find such sites; UNEP-WCMC's manual Global Databases to Support ICCAs gives guidance on contributing data.

trackers.name: Australian Embassy small grants, Laos — up to A$50,000, and advocacy is named as eligible
trackers.desc: Almost no fund in this file will pay for advocacy; this one names it. The Embassy's small grants programme for Laos lists eligible activities as including community health, schools and education, small-scale infrastructure, women's empowerment, indigenous groups and vulnerable minority groups including people with disabilities, governance, human rights, the environment, and proposals with a strong advocacy component. For a Lao community that has found the national routes closed to it, that last clause is the reason to read the guidelines. The figures are simple and the ceiling is real. The maximum grant is A$50,000 with no minimum; the maximum grant period is twelve months, and the activity must be completed within twelve months of starting unless the grant agreement says otherwise. The activity must be implemented fully in Laos and funds may be spent only on the eligible activities defined in the agreement. Applications run through an open competitive process against published criteria, the first of which requires the activity to support poverty reduction or sustainable development. Overseas travel is excluded unless there is good justification tied directly to development in Laos, and activities presenting a high child protection risk are excluded outright. Read the guidelines before drafting, because the Embassy states that an application not meeting every eligibility criterion will not be considered. That is a pass-fail screen rather than a scoring exercise. Be clear what this is and is not. It is a foreign mission's country programme, not a Lao national fund, so it answers to the embassy's own priorities and calendar rather than to Lao environmental policy, and it is small money for a defined twelve-month activity rather than core funding. Other embassies in Vientiane run comparable direct aid schemes on their own terms, which is worth checking rather than assuming this is the only one. This research could not verify any independent Lao environmental legal or campaigning organisation on its own domain, so a community here is assembling support from funds and from the provincial natural resources office rather than from a national civil society network.

trackers.name: MRC prior consultation (PNPCA) — the six-month window on any Mekong mainstream project
trackers.desc: Any project proposed for the Mekong mainstream triggers a six-month prior consultation across all four member countries, and there are regional and national stakeholder forums inside it. Cambodia, Laos, Thailand and Vietnam are the members. The process begins when the proposing country's National Mekong Committee submits to the Commission, and the clock starts on the day the last Joint Committee member receives the submission forwarded by the Secretariat. Xayaburi started on 22 October 2010 and ran six months to a decision; Pak Beng's six-month milestone was marked in June 2017. Your entry point is your own National Mekong Committee, not the Secretariat in Vientiane. Each member country has one, it is the body that submits and receives, and it is the route by which a riverside community's evidence reaches the process. Inside the six months the Secretariat produces a Technical Review Report, external expert groups on fisheries and on sediments contribute analysis, the project is compared against the Commission's Preliminary Design Guidance, and regional and national stakeholder forums are held whose outcomes the Joint Committee considers alongside the technical review. Know the difference between the mainstream and a tributary, because it decides which process applies. A tributary hydropower project requires notification to the Joint Committee only; a mainstream project requires the full prior consultation with consensus sought among the four members. Twenty-eight tributary notifications had been received by June 2009, before any mainstream submission existed. And know what prior consultation is not. It is an inter-governmental process aimed at consensus on whether a project should proceed and under what conditions. It is not a veto and it has not stopped a mainstream dam. What Pak Beng produced was a Joint Committee statement calling on the Government of Lao PDR to make all reasonable efforts to address potential adverse transboundary impacts, and a Joint Action Plan for the period after the six months. Treat the six months as the window in which independent evidence enters an official record that outlives the decision, and plan the rest of the campaign around what that record enables. PNPCA is one of five sets of Commission procedural rules made under the 1995 Mekong Agreement, alongside those on water quality, data sharing, water use monitoring and water flow maintenance.

trackers.name: Environment Protection Fund (ກປສ) — a state fund whose sub-grants have reached community groups
trackers.desc: A government fund, and its own statement of purpose is broad enough to matter. The fund describes itself as a state fund established to mobilise funds of different kinds from internal and external sources in support of natural resources management and environmental protection, effectively and sustainably. Published country profiles date its establishment to 2005 as a financially autonomous body covering environmental protection, sustainable natural resource management, biodiversity conservation and community development, with capital drawn from domestic and foreign grants and loans, the government budget, development projects and contributions from businesses. Community groups have actually received sub-grants through it, which is the fact that matters. Under a donor-financed programme run through the fund, sub-grants financed studies, surveys, training workshops and monitoring and assessment programmes developed not only by national, provincial and district government agencies but also by community groups, mass-based organisations and civil society, with a dedicated component supporting conservation practice and livelihood activities in and around protected areas. The question to put to the fund is therefore which window is currently open to non-government applicants, not whether such applicants are eligible in principle. The windows are the map, so match the request to one before drafting. Published descriptions record priority funding windows covering policy, biodiversity, pollution control, water and land management, and climate change, with climate change treated as both a dedicated window and a cross-cutting priority; the establishing decree sets the mandate, governance, the windows through which sub-projects are implemented and the sources of finance. Reported recent awards include multi-year catchment protection work and village and school level environment programmes across several provinces. Two practical cautions. Published descriptions record that all revenues and expenditures pass through the national treasury accounting system with expenditure against an annual plan and regular inspection, so expect planning cycles rather than rolling decisions. And this fund's web address differs by a single letter from a similarly named one; earlier research for this file could not tell them apart, so confirm the site and the contact details before sending documents or money anywhere.

trackers.name: Legal aid in Lao PDR — the ministry's own service, the statutory definition, and the Bar Association clinics
trackers.desc: There is a legal aid service run by the justice ministry, with its own public site. The ministry maintains a dedicated site for legal aid services in the country, which answers the first question a community usually cannot answer — whether legal aid exists at all — and gives somewhere to start that is neither a private firm nor a foreign organisation. The statutory definition is broader than criminal defence, and it is worth quoting. The law on lawyers defines legal aid as the provision of free legal services to the poor and disadvantaged, through the Bar Association and lawyers, in order to promote access to law and judicial procedures. The purpose named is access to law and to judicial procedures generally. A land, resettlement or environmental matter is therefore not excluded by the definition itself, which is more than can be said for several of the schemes recorded elsewhere in this file. The Bar Association is the delivery channel, and clinics have been opened. Legal aid is provided through the Bar Association and its lawyers, and a first legal aid clinic was opened at the association's Vientiane Province office at a ceremony attended by the Minister of Justice, the provincial vice governor and more than eighty representatives of the association, ministry officials and lawyers. Ask the provincial Bar Association office whether a clinic operates in your province before assuming the service exists only in the capital. Know what is paid, and know the confidentiality duty. Charges for legal services are compensation paid by a client as agreed in the contract between client and lawyer, so the fee agreement is a document to read before signing rather than after; expenses for lawyers appointed by the people's court in the gravest cases are governed by ministry regulations; and lawyers and legal enterprises are required to keep information communicated by a client confidential. That last duty is statutory, which matters where a community's concern is that its position will be relayed to the other side before it is ready.

trackers.name: Lao land information network — where a title application goes, and Lao-language explanations of the land law
trackers.desc: The application for a land title goes to the district office, not to a ministry. The network's Lao-language explanations of the amended land law record that registration on request is made by submitting an application for issuance of a land title to the natural resources and environment office of the place where the land is situated. For a community trying to establish what it holds before a project arrives, that is the address, and it is a short journey rather than a trip to the capital. Systematic registration has a public phase, and it is announced. Where titling is carried out systematically rather than on request, the preparation described includes notifying the public, publicising the exercise, and making appointments with the occupants and users of the land. A community that knows this is coming knows that the notification period is the moment to assert possession, in front of neighbours who can confirm it, rather than after a boundary has been drawn. The materials are in Lao and written for people who are not lawyers. The network publishes a legal calendar series working through provisions of the 2019 amended land law, video explanations of how title registration works, and a weekly roundup of land and natural resource news, alongside accounts of community legal awareness work in the provinces including volunteers bringing legal knowledge into their own districts. Across this research, government pages for this country have repeatedly proved unreachable; a land-focused network publishing in the national language is the practical substitute, and it is based in Vientiane. Read it for what it is. This is a civil society information network rather than a government body, and it is recorded here on that footing: the authority for any procedure remains the land law itself and the district office that administers it, and anything read here should be checked against those before it is relied on. Read this with the legal aid and environment protection fund entries already recorded for this country.

trackers.name: National Assembly hotline 156 — the petition line, and the constitutional duty to examine and resolve
trackers.desc: The legislature publishes a direct number. The National Assembly states on its own contact page that it can be reached directly on hotline 156. In a country where this research has repeatedly failed to reach executive agencies through their own websites, the fact that the legislature publishes a single number and invites contact on it is worth recording on its own account. The constitutional right covers the public interest, not only personal loss. The constitution provides that Lao citizens have the right to lodge complaints and petitions and to propose ideas to the relevant state organisations in connection with issues pertaining to the public interest or to their own rights and interests. A community objecting to a project therefore does not have to dress its objection as a private grievance: the public interest is named in the text, and a petition can be written in those terms. And the duty runs the other way. The same provision requires that the complaints, petitions and ideas of citizens be examined and resolved as provided by the laws. That is an obligation placed on the state rather than a courtesy extended to the petitioner, and it is the sentence to put at the head of a petition before setting out the facts. Use it where the local channel has gone quiet, and keep your own copy. This file already records for this country the office where a land title application is lodged, the ministry's legal aid service, the state environment fund and the six-month consultation window on Mekong mainstream projects. The hotline is for the case that has stalled or that nobody will own. As with everything recorded here for Laos, put in writing whatever is said by telephone and keep the copy: across this country's entries, documents have proved more reachable than offices.

trackers.name: Water testing in Laos — the monthly reports the supplier already files, and who pays for independent analysis
trackers.desc: The supplier's own monitoring already exists, and it is monthly. The national decision on water quality standards for drinking and domestic use requires water service providers to submit monitoring reports to the department of hygiene and health promotion and to the water supply regulatory office by the end of the first month following the month in which the samples were collected. Those reports must compare the monitoring results against the permissible limits and describe the corrective actions taken or proposed where a limit is exceeded, and other incidents of non-compliance must be reported promptly. Before a community pays for any testing of its own, the reports on its own supply have already been written and filed with two named offices. And the cost of independent analysis falls on the provider. The same decision provides that the cost of analysis by the independent laboratory is to be borne by the water service providers. Where independent testing is required under the scheme it is the utility that pays for it, which is worth knowing before anybody is told that a test is unaffordable. Independent laboratories do operate in the capital. At least one commercial environmental laboratory in Vientiane advertises analysis of soil and sediment, drinking, surface and ground water, sewage and effluents, and stack, ambient and workplace air, stating that the purpose is to check whether a project's environmental quality indicators comply with national and international guidelines, and offering training in laboratory testing alongside impact assessment work. This is recorded as a private service on the strength of the provider's own material rather than a state guarantee: ask what it is accredited for, which tests fall inside that accreditation, and for the measurement uncertainty to be reported with each figure. Know which body owns your water. Rural water services and the promotion of environmental health and hygiene sit with the national centre under the health ministry, while implementation and operation of public supply systems are decentralised to provincial water utilities. Where the supply is rural, the centre is the addressee; where it is piped by a provincial utility, that utility is the body holding the monthly reports. Read this with the legal aid, environment protection fund and national assembly petition line entries already recorded for this country.

trackers.name: Enterprise registration and the licence inventory — existence in one database, permission in another
trackers.desc: Two databases, answering two different questions. The industry and commerce ministry runs a national enterprise database recording enterprise registration — the legal existence of a company and its corporate particulars — and, separately, an inventory of business operating licences setting out the sector permits and the formalities for each. A registration certificate proves that a company exists; it does not prove that the company may lawfully operate in a regulated sector. A community told that a project is authorised should therefore ask which of the two documents is being relied on, and check the other. The decision that governs registration also carries the sanctions. Under the 2019 decision on enterprise registration, in addition to the measures against violators set out in its own articles, offenders may be subjected to further penalties including the suspension or revocation of enterprise registration and prohibition of business activities in the country. Suspension of a registration is a sanction with a name and a legal basis, and naming it in a complaint is different from asking generally for something to be done. Know what the free search layer leaves out. Published guidance on using these databases records that beneficial ownership information is held in the registration files and appears in certified extracts rather than in the free public search; that some data may not be current and an entity may appear more than once; and that district and provincial records may lag those of the capital. Where the ownership behind a company actually matters, ask for a certified extract rather than relying on the public layer. And check whether the project sits in a special economic zone. The same guidance notes that entities inside special economic zones may be licensed by the zone authority in addition to, or instead of, ordinary enterprise registration, so the source of a registration has to be checked rather than assumed. Read this with the land title office, the national assembly petition line and the environment protection fund entries already recorded for this country.

trackers.name: Public procurement in Laos — tendering is the rule, and the lender's procurement plan is often the only published account
trackers.desc: The rule is that procurement must be tendered. The government procurement decree states that any public procurement of goods, works and services shall be duly tendered in full accordance with the regulations, and that procurement through direct contracting must comply with the article which governs it. The decree's stated purpose is efficiency, transparency and economy in government procurement and equality among all economic sectors. For a community, the first question about a project is therefore which route was used — competitive tender or direct contracting — because the rules treat the second as the exception that has to be justified. A reference list of enterprises exists. The finance ministry is entrusted to issue a list of companies and legal entities, including foreign firms with capacity, to serve as the reference for assessing bidders' qualifications. Whether the contractor working on the ground appears on that list is a question with an answer, and it is a narrower question than whether the award was proper. The regulator is a named division. Published guidance records the public procurement management division of the finance ministry as the central regulatory body, approving median prices, monitoring annual procurement plans and reviewing thresholds, under the 2017 law on public procurement and its 2019 implementing instruction. That gives a community an addressee above the procuring agency itself. The honest limit, and where notices actually appear. Published assessments describe procurement in this country as opaque, with government purchases not typically advertised in advance and open bidding not the norm; where a contract is donor financed it is often advertised in the local English language newspaper and the state news agency, and the multilateral lenders publish procurement plans for the projects they fund. For a village facing a road, a dam or a water scheme paid for by a lender, that lender's published procurement plan is frequently the only account of what is to be bought and when. Read this with the land title office, the water quality reporting duty, the environment fund and the national assembly petition line entries already recorded for this country.

trackers.name: State Inspection and Anti-Corruption Authority — where land complaints already go
trackers.desc: Land is the leading subject of complaints to this authority. Regional reporting of the authority's own figures records that in a recent period it received more than a thousand requests to deal with issues and dozens of requests to investigate, completing consideration of several hundred, and that the main causes of contention concern land use and ownership, houses, business operations, dissatisfaction with court judgments, and the rules governing officials and party members. A community bringing a land complaint to this body is therefore not making an unusual request; it is joining the largest category of what the authority already handles. What the body is. The state inspection and anti-corruption authority is described in a paper written by one of its own officers as a ministerial level government agency mandated to conduct inspections, to prevent and combat corruption, and to investigate corruption cases and complaints within its scope of rights and duties, supervising that work throughout the country, with the anti-corruption function dating back to 1982. It sits above the line ministries rather than inside them. Officials declare assets and income. The same account records a decree on the declaration of assets and income under which all public officials are required to submit declarations, with rounds completed since the requirement was enacted, alongside measures on thriftiness and on monitoring the job performance of public officials. Where an official's part in a land decision looks wrong, a declaration regime exists to be asked about. Read the limits with it. The account of the mandate here comes from a paper by one of the authority's own officers and from regional reporting rather than from a published Lao language service page, and the caseload figures are reported rather than issued as a public register. This file's entries for this country have repeatedly found published procedure thin, and the practical instruction is the same one recorded there: ask the authority directly what a complaint must contain and in what form, and write the answer down. Read this with the national assembly petition line, the environment protection fund, the land title office and the procurement entries already recorded for this country.

trackers.name: State Audit Organization — loan and grant funded projects are inside the mandate, and the report goes to the Assembly
trackers.desc: Projects funded by loans and grants are inside the audit mandate. Published descriptions of the state audit organisation record a mandate to study the economy, efficiency and effectiveness of the bodies it audits, among them state institutions, mass organisations and other organisations that manage and use public funds, organisations under the supervision of the armed forces, state enterprises, and public projects funded by the local budget, by loan, or by government contribution or grant from domestic and overseas organisations. For a village facing a road, a dam or a water scheme financed by a lender rather than from the national budget, the audit body's remit already covers it, which is not obvious from the outside. The report goes to the National Assembly. The same descriptions record that audit reports on the use of the annual state budget must be submitted to the National Assembly and the prime minister, and that annual reports on the organisation's own audit activity go to the Assembly's standing committee and the prime minister; the Assembly's economic committee examines the audit report and may put questions to the organisation about it. This file already records the Assembly's petition line for this country, and it is the same body that receives the audit — so the two routes point at one addressee. Who asked for the audit decides who sees it. An audit report produced at the request of an organisation is submitted to the audited entity, and a spontaneous audit is sent to the body which set forth the request. That makes the origin of an audit worth asking about before assuming a report will surface publicly. The limits, stated as in this file's other entries for this country. This description rests on a regional audit organisation's membership page and a development bank's document rather than on a published Lao-language service page; the governing audit law dates from 2007 with a 2012 amendment restricting it to public audit; and no public register of audit reports was found. Ask the Assembly's economic committee what has been submitted, and write the answer down. Read this with the national assembly petition line, the state inspection and anti-corruption authority, the procurement rules and the water monitoring entries already recorded for this country.

trackers.name: Decree 84 and the district resettlement committee — payment before the machinery, and maps villagers must validate
trackers.desc: Restriction of access is compensable, not only outright taking. The decree on compensation and resettlement management in development projects, issued in 2016 in place of an earlier decree, sets out principles, rules and measures to mitigate adverse social impacts and to compensate for damage resulting from involuntary land acquisition or repossession of land and of fixed or movable assets — including changes in land use and restriction of access — with the stated aim that affected people are compensated, resettled and assisted with permanent livelihood alternatives so that their living conditions are better than, or at least the same as, before. A household that keeps its land but loses the track to it is inside the decree's scope, which is not obvious to anyone reading only about expropriation. Payment comes before the machinery. Compensation frameworks prepared under the decree for lender-financed projects record that full compensation for asset loss, at replacement cost and following an entitlement matrix, is to be paid to all affected households before civil works commence, and that replacement land is to have been provided before implementation of the project begins. Whether payment has been made is therefore a question about the legality of starting work, not a matter of courtesy. The cut-off date decides who counts. Eligibility is fixed by a cut-off date established in the resettlement plan, normally coinciding with the census of affected persons or the date of public notification of the works that would cause displacement. The date of that census is therefore the date to write down, to check against the notice, and to contest if households present on the land were left out of it. The maps must be validated by villagers, and the complaint route must be free. The documentation required includes a siting map and field measurements validated by villagers, detailed enough to allow verification, together with signed statements by affected owners confirming that the arrangements are satisfactory; and the grievance procedure must be explained to affected people, with the district natural resources office and the project management unit assisting a person to process a complaint without any cost. A signature is the thing to withhold until the map is right, and the district resettlement committee is the named local body that has to get it right. Read this with the land information network, the national assembly petition line, the inspection authority and the audit entries already recorded for this country.

trackers.name: The Law on Lawyers and the bar association — provincial legal aid clinics, and the articles governing fees, ethics and independence
trackers.desc: The statute sets out what a lawyer owes a client, article by article.
