WHAT IS RECORDED HERE IS WHAT IT PRODUCED, BECAUSE THE DATASET IS THE RESOURCE: AN INVENTORY OF FORTY-EIGHT IMPORTANT BIRD AREAS, COMPLETED IN MARCH 2008 AND CONFIRMED THE FOLLOWING MONTH BY THE INTERNATIONAL SECRETARIAT, THEN ENTERED INTO A WORLD BIODIVERSITY DATABASE. THE PROGRAMME BEGAN IN SPRING 2005 WITH INTERNATIONAL BIRD-CONSERVATION SUPPORT AND THE BACKING OF BOTH THE COUNTRY'S ZOOLOGICAL SOCIETY AND ITS STATE NATURE PROTECTION COMMITTEE — SO THE INVENTORY WAS BUILT WITH THE STATE ALONGSIDE IT, NOT AGAINST IT. NOW THE PART THAT MATTERS TO ANYONE DEFENDING GROUND. EACH SITE RECORD CARRIES: THE SITE NUMBER AND ITS POSITION ON A MAP; THE LOCAL NAME; ITS CONSERVATION STATUS; WHICH CRITERIA QUALIFIED IT; ITS ADMINISTRATIVE DISTRICT; CENTRAL COORDINATES; ALTITUDE; AREA; GLOBALLY THREATENED BIRD SPECIES; BIOME-RESTRICTED SPECIES; CONGREGATORY SPECIES; THE PLANTS AND ANIMALS PRESENT THAT APPEAR IN THE NATIONAL RED BOOK AND THE INTERNATIONAL RED LIST; AND THE CONSERVATION PROBLEMS OF THE SITE. THAT IS A COMPLETE DOSSIER PER PLACE — INCLUDING ITS THREATS — COMPILED BEFORE ANY PARTICULAR DISPUTE AROSE AND CONFIRMED BY AN INTERNATIONAL BODY. IF YOUR GROUND IS ON THAT LIST, THE ARGUMENT THAT IT MATTERS HAS ALREADY BEEN MADE, DATED AND ACCEPTED BY OUTSIDERS, YEARS BEFORE ANY DEVELOPER APPEARED. SO THE FIRST THING TO DO IS CHECK. FIND WHETHER YOUR DISTRICT APPEARS AMONG THE FORTY-EIGHT, AND IF IT DOES, TAKE THREE FIELDS IN PARTICULAR: THE CENTRAL COORDINATES AND AREA, WHICH DEFINE WHAT WAS RECOGNISED; THE RED BOOK AND RED LIST SPECIES, WHICH CONNECT THE SITE TO THE NATIONAL PROTECTED-SPECIES RECORD THIS FILE HAS DESCRIBED ELSEWHERE; AND THE CONSERVATION PROBLEMS FIELD, WHICH TELLS YOU WHAT SPECIALISTS ALREADY IDENTIFIED AS THE THREAT. AND IF A SCHEME NOW MATCHES THE THREAT LISTED YEARS AGO, THAT IS THE STRONGEST KIND OF EVIDENCE A COMMUNITY CAN HAVE: NOT A REACTION, BUT A PREDICTION ON THE RECORD. THE PEOPLE TO DO THE FIELDWORK ALSO ALREADY EXIST. STUDENT ORNITHOLOGICAL CLUBS WERE FOUNDED AT THE NATIONAL UNIVERSITY IN 2006 AND IN THREE FURTHER REGIONS IN 2007, AND HAVE CARRIED OUT COUNTS AT NAMED RESERVOIRS ACROSS THREE PROVINCES DURING THE INTERNATIONAL WINTER WATERBIRD COUNT, CONFIRMING THOSE SITES AS IMPORTANT WINTERING PLACES INCLUDING FOR RARE SPECIES. A COMMUNITY THAT NEEDS COUNTS DONE ON ITS OWN GROUND CAN ASK A STUDENT CLUB RATHER THAN HIRING A CONSULTANT — THE CLUBS NEED SITES AND DATA FOR THEIR OWN WORK, THE COUNT DAY IS INTERNATIONAL AND FIXED, and the resulting figures enter a recognised dataset rather than a private file. THE LIMITS: BEING LISTED IS RECOGNITION, NOT PROTECTION — an entry in this inventory confers no legal status and creates no right to object, and the society itself framed the next phase as having to BUILD protection measures for the sites it had identified. THE INVENTORY DATES FROM 2008 AND WHETHER IT HAS BEEN REVISED SINCE WAS NOT VERIFIED; site boundaries and threats will have changed. Read it with the society itself, the protected-species record and the state procurement disclosures recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Academy institute of botany and the national herbarium — where a pressed specimen becomes a citation and a mapped point
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HAS TOLD COMMUNITIES REPEATEDLY TO LODGE A HERBARIUM SPECIMEN AS PERMANENT DATED EVIDENCE OF WHAT GREW ON THEIR GROUND. HERE IS THE SYSTEM THAT TURNS ONE INTO SOMETHING PUBLISHED AND CITABLE. THE NEW EDITION OF THE NATIONAL FLORA DIFFERS FROM THE FIRST IN THREE WAYS THAT ALL MATTER: IT CARRIES DETAILED INFORMATION ON THE GEOGRAPHIC DISTRIBUTION OF EACH SPECIES; IT CITES THE HERBARIUM SPECIMENS THEMSELVES; AND IT CARRIES DISTRIBUTION MAPS FOR EACH SPECIES BUILT IN A GEOGRAPHIC INFORMATION SYSTEM FROM THE GEOREFERENCING OF HERBARIUM COLLECTIONS. SO A PRESSED PLANT WITH A DATE AND A LOCATION DOES NOT SIT IN A CUPBOARD. IT BECOMES A CITED SPECIMEN AND A POINT ON A PUBLISHED MAP OF WHERE THAT SPECIES OCCURS — WHICH IS EXACTLY THE FORM OF EVIDENCE THAT ANSWERS A DEVELOPER'S CLAIM THAT NOTHING OF NOTE GROWS THERE. COLLECT PROPERLY OR NOT AT ALL: THE VALUE IS IN THE LABEL. DATE, PRECISE LOCATION AND COLLECTOR ARE WHAT MAKE A SPECIMEN GEOREFERENCEABLE; A PLANT WITHOUT THEM IS DECORATION. THE INSTITUTION BEHIND IT IS THE NATIONAL ACADEMY'S INSTITUTE OF BOTANY, DESCRIBED AS THE LEADING BODY IN THE COUNTRY FOR STUDYING AND DEVELOPING THE SCIENTIFIC BASIS OF PLANT DIVERSITY CONSERVATION — COVERING FLORISTICS, PLANT SYSTEMATICS, GEOBOTANY AND ECOLOGY, MORPHOLOGY AND ANATOMY, MYCOLOGY, ALGOLOGY, BOTANICAL RESOURCE STUDIES, AND THE MONITORING AND CADASTRE OF THE PLANT WORLD. MONITORING AND CADASTRE IS THE PHRASE TO NOTICE. A CADASTRE IS A REGISTER TIED TO PLACES, NOT A LIST OF NAMES — THE SAME WORD THIS FILE HAS RECORDED FOR LAND REGISTERS IN SIX COUNTRIES. A PLANT CADASTRE MEANS SOMEBODY IS OFFICIALLY RECORDING WHICH SPECIES OCCUR WHERE, AND THAT REGISTER IS THE ONE TO ASK ABOUT FOR YOUR OWN DISTRICT. THE NATIONAL HERBARIUM HELD HERE IS THE LARGEST IN CENTRAL ASIA, AND THE REVISION WORK IS BEING DONE WITH A LARGE TEAM OF LEADING FOREIGN SYSTEMATISTS. THE INSTITUTE ALSO LED AN EARLIER LARGE-SCALE PROJECT PRODUCING A PLANT IDENTIFICATION GUIDE FOR THE WHOLE OF CENTRAL ASIA. THAT REGIONAL REACH MATTERS FOR NEIGHBOURING COUNTRIES WHOSE OWN BOTANICAL INSTITUTIONS THIS FILE COULD NOT FIND: THE LARGEST REGIONAL COLLECTION AND THE REGIONAL IDENTIFICATION GUIDE ARE HELD HERE, SO A SPECIES QUESTION FROM ACROSS A BORDER HAS AN ADDRESS. THE LIMITS: this is A RESEARCH INSTITUTE, NOT A REGULATOR OR AN ADVOCATE — a specimen record creates no protection and no right to object, and the institute will not oppose a scheme. WHETHER IT ACCEPTS SPECIMENS OR RECORDS FROM MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC, AND UNDER WHAT COLLECTING PERMISSIONS, WAS NOT VERIFIED — collecting protected species without permission is itself an offence in most of these countries, so ask before pressing anything. THIS ENTRY IS ANCHORED TO AN ENCYCLOPAEDIA ARTICLE rather than the institute's own site, which is weaker sourcing than most of this file. Read it with the protected-species record, the bird area inventory and the state procurement disclosures recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: State analytical control centre — emissions measured at source, soil analysed for organic and inorganic pollutants, and the laboratory that accredits the other laboratories
trackers.desc: WHEN A COMMUNITY GETS A TEST RESULT, THE FIRST ATTACK ON IT IS ALWAYS THE SAME: WHOSE LABORATORY, AND IS IT ANY GOOD? THIS CENTRE IS THE BODY THAT ANSWERS THAT QUESTION NATIONALLY — IT ORGANISES EXTERNAL CONTROL OF THE ACCURACY OF WATER, AIR AND SOIL ANALYSES, EVALUATES THE RESULTS, AND TAKES PART IN THE ACCREDITATION OF ECO-ANALYTICAL LABORATORIES. SO ASK IT WHICH LABORATORIES ARE ACCREDITED FOR THE PARAMETER YOU NEED BEFORE YOU PAY ANYONE. A RESULT FROM A LABORATORY THIS CENTRE HAS ATTESTED IS ONE THE MINISTRY CANNOT EASILY DISMISS; A RESULT FROM ONE IT HAS NOT IS AN ARGUMENT WAITING TO HAPPEN. ITS OWN TESTING WORK IS EXACTLY WHAT LAND DISPUTES NEED. IT CARRIES OUT INSTRUMENTAL MEASUREMENT OF THE QUANTITY OF HARMFUL SUBSTANCES EMITTED BY STATIONARY AND MOBILE SOURCES OF AIR POLLUTION, AND ANALYTICAL CONTROL OF SOIL POLLUTION BY BOTH INORGANIC AND ORGANIC SUBSTANCES — AND IT VALIDATES THE MEASUREMENT METHODS USED FOR CHEMICALS IN WASTEWATER, AIR AND SOIL. MEASURING AT THE SOURCE IS THE PART TO ASK FOR. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED COMMUNITY AFTER COMMUNITY MEASURING AMBIENT AIR AT THE FENCE AND BEING TOLD THE READING PROVES NOTHING ABOUT WHO CAUSED IT. A STACK MEASUREMENT AT A NAMED SOURCE ATTRIBUTES THE POLLUTION TO AN OPERATOR. AND SOIL ANALYSIS FOR ORGANIC SUBSTANCES IS RARER THAN IT SOUNDS: MOST ROUTINE TESTING COVERS METALS AND SALTS. WHERE THE PROBLEM IS FUEL, SOLVENTS, PESTICIDE RESIDUES OR LANDFILL LEACHATE, ORGANIC ANALYSIS IS THE ONE THAT FINDS IT — NAME IT EXPLICITLY IN THE REQUEST. THE CENTRE ALSO TRAINS THE STAFF OF THE MINISTRY'S TERRITORIAL ECO-ANALYTICAL LABORATORIES, WHICH TELLS YOU SOMETHING PRACTICAL: THERE ARE ANALYTICAL LABORATORIES IN THE REGIONS, NOT ONLY IN THE CAPITAL. ASK FOR THE TERRITORIAL LABORATORY COVERING YOUR PROVINCE FIRST — IT IS NEARER, CHEAPER AND FASTER. TWO FURTHER FEATURES OF THE MONITORING SYSTEM ARE WORTH KNOWING. STATE ENVIRONMENTAL MONITORING EXPRESSLY INCLUDES SAMPLING, ANALYSIS, OBSERVATIONS AT FIXED POINTS, SURVEYS AND REMOTE OBSERVATION; AND MONITORING BODIES HAVE UNIMPEDED ACCESS TO PREDETERMINED SAMPLING POINTS, INCLUDING POINTS LOCATED ON THE TERRITORY OF BUSINESS ENTITIES, WITHOUT ADDITIONAL COORDINATION WITH THE BODY THAT COORDINATES INSPECTIONS. ACCESS TO SAMPLING POINTS INSIDE A COMPANY'S OWN PREMISES, WITHOUT CLEARANCE FROM THE INSPECTIONS COORDINATOR, IS THE POWER THAT MATTERS. A FACTORY CANNOT LAWFULLY KEEP THE SAMPLERS OUT, WHICH IS WHY A REQUEST TO THIS SYSTEM CAN REACH PLACES A COMMUNITY NEVER WILL. AND A UNIFIED GEOINFORMATION DATABASE OF THE ENVIRONMENTAL MONITORING SYSTEM IS FORMED ON THE BASIS OF THIS CENTRE. A SINGLE MAPPED DATABASE OF MONITORING DATA IS THE THING TO ASK FOR BY NAME — NOT A REPORT ABOUT YOUR DISTRICT, BUT WHAT THE MONITORING SYSTEM ALREADY HOLDS FOR THE POINTS NEAREST YOUR GROUND. THE LIMITS: this is A STATE CONTROL BODY UNDER THE ENVIRONMENT MINISTRY, NOT AN ADVOCATE — it measures and accredits, it will not oppose a project, and its findings go to the ministry rather than to complainants. WHETHER IT ACCEPTS SAMPLING REQUESTS OR SHARES DATABASE EXTRACTS WITH MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC, AND AT WHAT COST, WAS NOT VERIFIED — the access and database provisions come from the monitoring framework as published, describing what the system does rather than any right of yours. Read it with the protected-species and bird-area inventories, the herbarium and plant cadastre, the ombudsman route and the procurement portal recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: The mahalla — an elected local body with real budgets, and residents challenging a land allocation in court
trackers.desc: THE BEST THING IN THIS ENTRY IS NOT A DESCRIPTION BUT A CASE THAT IS RUNNING NOW. RESIDENTS OF ONE URBAN MAHALLA OPPOSE BUILDING A NEW MAHALLA CENTRE ON PART OF THEIR COURTYARD — CURRENTLY A GREEN ZONE, A PARKING AREA AND A SHOP — AND THEY ARE CHALLENGING IN COURT THE CITY GOVERNOR'S DECISION THAT ALLOCATED THE LAND PLOT. CHALLENGING THE ALLOCATION DECISION, NOT THE BUILDING, IS THE MOVE THIS FILE HAS RECORDED AS DECISIVE IN FOUR OTHER COUNTRIES. THE TARGET IS THE PIECE OF PAPER THAT MADE THE PROJECT POSSIBLE — AND HERE A GROUP OF NEIGHBOURS HAS DONE IT AGAINST A CAPITAL-CITY GOVERNOR. TWO DETAILS FROM THE SAME CASE ARE WORTH COPYING. THE STATE BODIES' REPLIES DESCRIBE DIFFERENT STAGES OF PROJECT PREPARATION — WHICH IS WHAT INCONSISTENCY LOOKS LIKE ON PAPER, AND THIS FILE HAS SAID THAT COMPARING WHAT DIFFERENT OFFICES SAY IN WRITING IS OFTEN THE STRONGEST EVIDENCE A COMMUNITY HOLDS. AND THE MAHALLA CHAIRMAN HIMSELF STATES THAT NOBODY HAS YET GIVEN CONSENT TO THE CONSTRUCTION. A CHAIRMAN SAYING NO CONSENT WAS GIVEN IS THE SINGLE MOST USEFUL SENTENCE A COMMUNITY CAN OBTAIN. GET IT IN WRITING. AND IN A NEIGHBOURING MAHALLA A CONTESTED BUILDING PROJECT WAS CANCELLED OUTRIGHT AFTER MONTHS OF RESIDENT OPPOSITION — SO THIS ROUTE HAS WORKED AT LEAST ONCE, RECENTLY, IN THE SAME CITY. THE BODY ITSELF HAS BEEN STRENGTHENED DELIBERATELY. A PRESIDENTIAL DECREE OF DECEMBER 2023 DEFINED THE MAHALLA AS THE PRIMARY LINK FOR SOLVING THE POPULATION'S PROBLEMS, CREATED AN ASSOCIATION OF MAHALLAS AND MAHALLA SUPPORT COUNCILS, AND COMBINED THE SPECIALISTS WORKING IN ONE TERRITORY INTO A SEVEN-MEMBER TEAM; 2026 WAS DECLARED THE YEAR OF MAHALLA DEVELOPMENT. AND THE BUDGETS ARE NOT SYMBOLIC: TWO HUNDRED OF THE BEST MAHALLAS RECEIVE TWO BILLION SUMS EACH, AND TOTAL RECEIPTS INTO MAHALLA BUDGETS REACH ONE AND A HALF TRILLION SUMS IN 2026, RISING TO TWO TRILLION THE FOLLOWING YEAR. A LOCAL BODY WITH ITS OWN BUDGET CAN BE ASKED TO SPEND IT. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED VILLAGE COMMITTEES ELSEWHERE THAT COULD ONLY FORWARD REQUESTS UPWARDS; A MAHALLA THAT HOLDS MONEY CAN FUND A WATER LINE, A TRACK OR A GREEN SPACE ITSELF — ASK WHAT ITS BUDGET IS AND WHO DECIDES ITS ALLOCATION. THE CHAIRMAN IS THE PERSON TO REACH: ELECTED BY THE POPULATION, REPRESENTING THE INTERESTS OF THE CITIZENS' ASSEMBLY, AND CHARGED WITH GENERALISING RESIDENTS' NEEDS. A DECREE OF JUNE 2026 ALSO PROVIDES PROTECTION FROM INTERFERENCE IN THE TEAM'S ACTIVITY AND FROM ASSIGNING ITS SPECIALISTS TO UNRELATED TASKS. THAT PROTECTION CLAUSE IS WORTH KNOWING WHEN A CHAIRMAN HESITATES. IF HE IS BEING LEANED ON, THERE IS NOW A WRITTEN PROVISION AGAINST INTERFERENCE IN HIS WORK — AND A RESIDENT WHO KNOWS THAT CAN ASK THE QUESTION PLAINLY RATHER THAN ASSUMING SILENCE MEANS AGREEMENT. THE LIMITS: THE MAHALLA IS PART OF THE STATE SYSTEM, ITS CHAIRMAN WORKS WITHIN A HIERARCHY, AND THE BODY THAT ALLOCATED THE LAND IN THE CASE ABOVE WAS THE CITY ADMINISTRATION ITSELF — THE MAHALLA MAY BE THE APPLICANT FOR THE PROJECT YOU OPPOSE, AS THE CONTESTED MAHALLA CENTRE SHOWS. THE COURT CASE DESCRIBED IS UNRESOLVED AND MAY FAIL. Budget and decree figures come from a state legal institute's own commentary, and the case from press reporting. Read it with the analytical control centre, the herbarium and plant cadastre, the bird-area inventory and the ombudsman route recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Chamber of advocates — its territorial department can open a legal consultation office where there are too few lawyers, and its ethics commission binds them all
trackers.desc: THE MOST USEFUL RULE IN THIS COUNTRY'S ADVOCACY SYSTEM IS ONE ALMOST NOBODY IN A VILLAGE KNOWS: A LEGAL CONSULTATION OFFICE IS ESTABLISHED BY THE CHAMBER'S TERRITORIAL DEPARTMENT PRECISELY WHERE THE NUMBER OF ADVOCACY STRUCTURES IN THAT TERRITORY IS INSUFFICIENT TO MEET THE NEED FOR LEGAL AID. THAT MEANS THE ABSENCE OF LAWYERS IN A DISTRICT IS NOT A FACT TO ACCEPT BUT A CONDITION THE CHAMBER IS SUPPOSED TO ANSWER. A JOINT LETTER FROM SEVERAL VILLAGES OR A DISTRICT COUNCIL SAYING THERE IS NO ADVOCACY STRUCTURE HERE AND DEMAND EXISTS IS AN ASK ADDRESSED TO A NAMED BODY WITH A STATED DUTY — AND IT IS A DIFFERENT, MORE WINNABLE REQUEST THAN ASKING FOR A LAWYER IN ONE CASE. THE CONSULTATION OFFICE HAS NO LEGAL PERSONALITY OF ITS OWN, SO IT IS A LIGHT STRUCTURE THE DEPARTMENT CAN CREATE RATHER THAN A NEW INSTITUTION REQUIRING FOUNDING CAPITAL — WHICH IS WHY THIS ASK IS REALISTIC. THERE IS A SECOND ROUTE TO THE SAME END: ADVOCATES' BUREAUX AND FIRMS MAY CREATE BRANCHES OUTSIDE THEIR OWN LOCATION IN ORDER TO PROVIDE LEGAL AID. SO A COMMUNITY CAN ALSO APPROACH A CITY FIRM DIRECTLY AND ASK WHETHER IT WILL OPEN A BRANCH OR HOLD REGULAR DAYS IN THE DISTRICT. WHEN A LAWYER PERFORMS BADLY, THE COMPLAINT HAS A NAMED HOME: AN ETHICS COMMISSION UNDER THE CHAMBER DEVELOPS THE STANDARDS OF QUALIFIED LEGAL AID AND ISSUES EXPLANATIONS ON PROFESSIONAL ETHICS THAT ARE BINDING ON THE TERRITORIAL DEPARTMENTS, ON ALL ADVOCACY STRUCTURES AND ON ALL ADVOCATES. BINDING ON ALL ADVOCATES IS THE PHRASE THAT MATTERS. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED BAR BODIES ACROSS THE REGION WHOSE RULINGS ARE ADVISORY; A COMMISSION WHOSE EXPLANATIONS BIND EVERY PRACTITIONER IS SOMETHING A CLIENT CAN INVOKE RATHER THAN MERELY APPEAL TO. ONE ANTI-CAPTURE MEASURE IS WORTH KNOWING IF YOU ARE EVER ASSIGNED A STATE-FUNDED LAWYER: THE SYSTEM AUTOMATICALLY DESIGNATES THE ADVOCACY STRUCTURE THAT WILL PROVIDE LEGAL AID AT STATE EXPENSE, PREVENTING THE REPEATED INVOLVEMENT OF ONE AND THE SAME ADVOCATE AND THIRD-PARTY INTERFERENCE IN THE PROCESS. THAT RULE EXISTS BECAUSE THE ABUSE EXISTED — THE SAME COMPLIANT LAWYER BEING STEERED ONTO CASE AFTER CASE. IF YOU ARE OFFERED A PARTICULAR ADVOCATE BY SOMEONE OTHER THAN THE SYSTEM, THAT IS THE MOMENT TO ASK HOW THE ASSIGNMENT WAS MADE. FINDING THEM IS DELIBERATELY EASY: THE CHAMBER IS TO BE GIVEN PREMISES FREE OF CHARGE IN THE CAPITAL AND IN REGIONAL CENTRES, IN PLACES CONVENIENT FOR CITIZENS TO APPROACH — NEAR THE COURTS OR THE CENTRAL PROSECUTION BODIES. AND WHEN CHOOSING A LAWYER, ASK ABOUT GRADE: ADVOCATES HOLD QUALIFICATION GRADES AWARDED BY THE CHAMBER'S CHAIR ON THE CONCLUSIONS OF THE QUALIFICATION COMMISSIONS, ACCORDING TO LENGTH OF SERVICE — A PUBLIC MEASURE OF EXPERIENCE THAT COSTS NOTHING TO ENQUIRE ABOUT. THE LIMITS: A CHAMBER OF ADVOCATES IS A PROFESSIONAL SELF-GOVERNING BODY, NOT AN ADVOCATE FOR COMMUNITIES - IT REGULATES LAWYERS, IT DOES NOT TAKE UP CAUSES, AND NOTHING HERE MAKES REPRESENTATION FREE EXCEPT THE STATE-FUNDED CRIMINAL DEFENCE ROUTE. WHETHER LAND, PLANNING OR ENVIRONMENTAL DISPUTES ATTRACT ANY FREE ASSISTANCE WAS NOT ESTABLISHED, AND THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS SEPARATELY THAT THE MAIN FREE ADVICE SERVICE IN THIS COUNTRY IS A SEPARATE STATE BUREAU. THE PROVISIONS COME FROM THE ADVOCACY LAW AND A PRESIDENTIAL MEASURES DOCUMENT PUBLISHED ON THE NATIONAL LEGAL PORTALS, ONE OF THEM A DRAFT-STAGE REGULATORY PAGE. THIS ENTRY IS ANCHORED ON THE CHAMBER'S OWN ADDRESS BECAUSE BOTH LEGAL PORTALS ARE ALREADY USED BY OTHER ENTRIES FOR THIS COUNTRY - BUT THAT ADDRESS WAS NOT ITSELF OPENED DURING RESEARCH, SO CHECK IT RESOLVES BEFORE RELYING ON IT, AND CONFIRM WITH THE TERRITORIAL DEPARTMENT WHAT EXISTS IN PRACTICE IN YOUR PROVINCE. Read it with the free legal advice bureaux, the mahalla and its budget, the analytical control centre's laboratories and the land privatisation route recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Compliance Advisor Ombudsman — the complaint office for privately financed projects, in any language, with confidentiality on request
trackers.desc: THE THREE BANK OFFICES ALREADY RECORDED IN THIS FILE COVER LENDING TO GOVERNMENTS. THIS ONE COVERS THE PRIVATE SIDE — THE COMPANY BUILDING THE MINE, THE PLANT OR THE PLANTATION — WHICH IS USUALLY WHO A COMMUNITY ACTUALLY FACES ON THE GROUND. ITS ACCESS TERMS ARE THE WIDEST OF THE FOUR: ANY INDIVIDUAL, GROUP, COMMUNITY OR PARTY WHO BELIEVES THEY ARE, OR MAY BE, AFFECTED CAN FILE — AND A REPRESENTATIVE OR ORGANISATION MAY COMPLAIN ON BEHALF OF THOSE AFFECTED, ON EVIDENCE THAT THEY WERE ASKED TO DO SO. ANY INDIVIDUAL. NOT TWO PEOPLE, NOT A REGISTERED ASSOCIATION, NOT A LAWYER. ONE PERSON WHO MAY BE AFFECTED IS ENOUGH, AND THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED NO DOMESTIC FORUM IN CENTRAL ASIA WITH A LOWER THRESHOLD. AND THE LANGUAGE RULE REMOVES THE OTHER USUAL BARRIER: COMPLAINTS ARE SUBMITTED IN WRITING AND MAY BE IN ANY LANGUAGE, WITH RECEIPT ACKNOWLEDGED IN THE LANGUAGE THE COMPLAINT WAS SUBMITTED IN. SO A LETTER IN UZBEK, RUSSIAN, ARABIC, KURDISH OR ANY OTHER TONGUE IS ACCEPTED AS IT STANDS. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED FUNDS AND MECHANISMS THAT DEMAND ENGLISH AND LOSE APPLICANTS BECAUSE OF IT. THE FIRST ANSWER COMES QUICKLY: WITHIN FIFTEEN WORKING DAYS — NOT COUNTING TRANSLATION TIME — THE OFFICE INFORMS YOU WHETHER THE COMPLAINT IS ELIGIBLE FOR FURTHER ASSESSMENT. ON SAFETY, THE COMMITMENTS ARE THE STRONGEST OF THE FOUR OFFICES: IT STATES THAT IT TAKES CONFIDENTIALITY EXTREMELY SERIOUSLY, THAT IF REQUESTED IT WILL NOT REVEAL THE IDENTITY OF ANY COMPLAINANT, THAT A HANDLING PROCESS IS THEN JOINTLY AGREED WITH THE COMPLAINANT, AND THAT MATERIALS SUBMITTED CONFIDENTIALLY WILL NOT BE RELEASED WITHOUT CONSENT. SAY SO IN THE COMPLAINT ITSELF, WITH REASONS — THE GUIDELINES ASK WHETHER YOU WISH YOUR IDENTITY OR ANY INFORMATION TO BE KEPT CONFIDENTIAL AND WHY. AND KNOW THE LIMIT: ANONYMOUS COMPLAINTS CANNOT BE ACCEPTED, AND ONCE A COMPLAINT IS ELIGIBLE OTHER STAKEHOLDERS INCLUDING THE LENDER ARE TYPICALLY NOTIFIED. IT ALSO SAYS PLAINLY THAT IT TAKES THREATS AND REPRISALS SERIOUSLY AND RECOGNISES THAT CONCERNS FOR SAFETY CAN PREVENT PEOPLE FROM SUBMITTING A COMPLAINT AT ALL, THAT COMPLAINANTS CAN REACH OUT AT ANY TIME DURING THE PROCESS, AND AN INDEPENDENT REVIEW OF ITS APPROACH TO THREATS AND REPRISALS WAS PUBLISHED IN 2024. ONE PROCEDURAL RULE DIFFERS FROM THE OTHER OFFICES AND SHOULD SHAPE THE CHOICE: YOU CAN DECIDE WHETHER THE COMPLAINT ENTERS DISPUTE RESOLUTION OR COMPLIANCE REVIEW — BUT IF YOU WANT BOTH, YOU ARE REQUIRED TO TRY DISPUTE RESOLUTION FIRST. THE SCOPE IS BROAD ENOUGH TO COVER HOW A PROJECT WAS PREPARED, NOT ONLY WHAT IT DID: COMPLAINTS MAY RELATE TO ANY ASPECT OF PLANNING, IMPLEMENTATION OR IMPACTS, INCLUDING THE PROCESSES FOLLOWED IN PREPARING THE PROJECT, THE ADEQUACY OF MITIGATION MEASURES, THE ARRANGEMENTS FOR INVOLVEMENT OF AFFECTED COMMUNITIES, MINORITIES AND VULNERABLE GROUPS, AND THE MANNER OF IMPLEMENTATION. ARRANGEMENTS FOR THE INVOLVEMENT OF AFFECTED COMMUNITIES IS THE GROUND MOST OFTEN AVAILABLE AND LEAST OFTEN USED. WHERE A COMPANY HELD ONE MEETING IN A TOWN FORTY KILOMETRES AWAY AND CALLED IT CONSULTATION, THAT IS A COMPLAINT IN ITS OWN RIGHT. THE LIMITS: THIS REACHES ONLY PROJECTS THE GROUP'S PRIVATE-SECTOR ARMS FINANCE OR GUARANTEE - IF THE COMPANY IS FUNDED DOMESTICALLY OR BY A COMMERCIAL BANK, THIS DOOR IS CLOSED. ACCOUNTABILITY SPECIALISTS RECORD TWO REAL WEAKNESSES: IT CANNOT ACCEPT COMPLAINTS ABOUT PROJECTS BEFORE THE BOARD APPROVES THEM, AND IT MUST WAIT TO DISCLOSE COMPLIANCE REPORTS UNTIL MANAGEMENT HAS PRODUCED AN ACTION PLAN, WHICH CAUSES HARMFUL DELAYS AND LIMITS COMPLAINANTS' ABILITY TO COMMENT ON PROPOSED REMEDIES. IT JUDGES THE LENDER'S PERFORMANCE, NOT THE COMPANY'S CONDUCT DIRECTLY, AND CANNOT ORDER COMPENSATION OR STOP A PROJECT. THE PROCEDURE COMES FROM THE OFFICE'S OWN PAGES AND OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES ALONGSIDE AN ACCOUNTABILITY TOOLKIT UPDATED IN JANUARY 2026 AND A HUMAN RIGHTS FEDERATION'S OLDER GUIDE. Read it with the free legal advice bureaux, the chamber of advocates' consultation offices, the mahalla and the land privatisation and valuation route recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Republic agrochemical analysis centre and the state mobile laboratory — soil analysis by public offer contract, and a laboratory that comes to the field
trackers.desc: TWO THINGS HERE SOLVE THE PROBLEM THIS FILE HAS RUN INTO IN EVERY COUNTRY: WHO WILL TEST THE GROUND, AND HOW DOES AN ORDINARY PERSON ENGAGE THEM. THE FIRST IS A REPUBLIC AGROCHEMICAL ANALYSIS CENTRE, ESTABLISHED BY A PRESIDENTIAL DECISION OF JULY 2021, WHOSE TASKS ARE CARRYING OUT AGROCHEMICAL ANALYSIS OF THE COUNTRY'S SOIL CONDITIONS AND CONTROLLING THE QUALITY OF ALL TYPES OF MINERAL, MICROBIOLOGICAL AND ORGANIC FERTILISERS PLANNED FOR USE IN PRODUCING AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTS. AND IT PUBLISHES HOW TO ENGAGE IT: TELEPHONE NUMBERS, AND A PUBLIC OFFER CONTRACT FOR CONCLUDING AN AGREEMENT. A PUBLIC OFFER CONTRACT IS THE DETAIL THAT MATTERS. IT MEANS THE TERMS ARE PUBLISHED AND ANYONE MAY ACCEPT THEM — NO INTRODUCTION, NO NEGOTIATION, NO PATRON. THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED LABORATORY AFTER LABORATORY WHOSE DOORS WERE UNCLEAR; THIS ONE STATES ITS TERMS IN ADVANCE. THE FERTILISER-QUALITY MANDATE IS WORTH NOTICING SEPARATELY. A CENTRE THAT CONTROLS THE QUALITY OF FERTILISERS INTENDED FOR USE IS A BODY WITH AN INTEREST IN WHAT IS BEING SPREAD ON LAND — WHICH IS A DIFFERENT AND SOMETIMES EASIER QUESTION TO RAISE THAN CONTAMINATION OF THE SOIL ITSELF. THE SECOND IS BETTER STILL FOR REMOTE PLACES: A STATE UNITARY ENTERPRISE UNDER THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY OPERATES A MOBILE LABORATORY, STUDYING THE AGROCHEMICAL COMPOSITION OF SOIL IN FULL AND GIVING PROPOSALS AND RECOMMENDATIONS TO DEHQON AND FARMER HOUSEHOLDS AND TO CLUSTERS, TO ESTABLISH SCIENTIFICALLY BASED FERTILISING AND LAND TREATMENT AND TO RAISE, PRESERVE AND RESTORE SOIL FERTILITY. A LABORATORY THAT TRAVELS REMOVES THE TWO THINGS THAT DEFEAT TESTING — THE JOURNEY AND THE CHAIN OF CUSTODY. AND NOTE WHO IT SERVES: DEHQON AND FARMER HOUSEHOLDS, NOT ONLY CLUSTERS AND ENTERPRISES. THE PROBLEM IT NAMES IS ALSO THE ARGUMENT FOR ASKING: USERS OF AGRICULTURAL LAND USUALLY SET FERTILISER QUANTITIES BY TRADITIONAL METHODS WITHOUT STUDYING THE SOIL'S AGROCHEMICAL CONDITION, WHICH CAN LEAD TO EXCESS FERTILISER USE AND DAMAGE TO THE SOIL'S COMPOSITION — APPLIED HEAVILY WHERE IT IS NATURALLY SUFFICIENT AND SPARSELY WHERE IT IS NOT. SO THE REQUEST THAT GETS A YES IS NOT COME AND PROVE MY LAND IS POISONED; IT IS COME AND TELL US WHAT THIS SOIL NEEDS. THE RESULTING ANALYSIS DESCRIBES THE SOIL EITHER WAY, AND IT IS A DATED OFFICIAL RECORD OF WHAT THE GROUND CONTAINED BEFORE ANYTHING HAPPENED TO IT. THERE IS ALSO TRAINING TO ASK FOR: WITH THE PLANT QUARANTINE AND PROTECTION AGENCY, THE CENTRE HAS ORGANISED DEMONSTRATION SEMINARS ON TAKING SOIL SAMPLES FROM FIELDS AND CARRYING OUT AGROCHEMICAL ANALYSIS, INCLUDING IN NAMED DISTRICTS OF THE AUTONOMOUS REPUBLIC, ATTENDED BY DISTRICT SECTION HEADS. SAMPLING IS WHERE MOST COMMUNITY EVIDENCE FAILS — WRONG DEPTH, WRONG CONTAINER, NO CONTROL SAMPLE, NO WITNESS. A SEMINAR THAT TEACHES IT IS WORTH MORE THAN ONE FREE ANALYSIS, AND ASKING FOR ONE IN YOUR DISTRICT IS ASKING THEM TO REPEAT SOMETHING THEY ALREADY DO. THE LIMITS: BOTH BODIES SIT INSIDE THE AGRICULTURAL STATE - ONE UNDER A QUARANTINE AND PROTECTION AGENCY, ONE UNDER THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY - AND THEIR PURPOSE IS PRODUCTION AND FERTILITY, NOT ADJUDICATING DISPUTES OR SUPPORTING OBJECTIONS TO PROJECTS. WHAT ANALYSIS COSTS UNDER THE PUBLIC OFFER, WHETHER AN INDIVIDUAL WITHOUT A FARM ENTERPRISE CAN CONTRACT, AND WHETHER RESULTS ARE ISSUED IN A FORM USABLE AS EVIDENCE WERE NOT ESTABLISHED - THE OFFER PAGE WAS SEEN BUT ITS TERMS WERE NOT READ. THE MOBILE LABORATORY IS DESCRIBED IN A MINISTRY-PORTAL ARTICLE OF 2022 AND ITS CURRENT COVERAGE AND ROUTE ARE UNKNOWN. Read it with the land privatisation valuation standard and the appraisers' society, the mahalla committees, the pasture and water user associations and the compliance ombudsman recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Land Acquisition Fund — up to a hundred thousand euros to buy or long-term lease the ground, with the title held by the local organisation
trackers.desc: AN AUDIT OF THE LAST THIRTY-EIGHT ROUNDS FOUND THAT THE FIRST THING THIS FILE WAS ASKED FOR — ORGANISATIONS THAT BUY THE PROPERTY — HAD RECEIVED NOTHING NEW, AND THAT ONLY FOUR LAND-BUYING RESOURCES EXISTED ACROSS TWENTY-THREE COUNTRIES. THIS IS THE CORRECTION: A FUND THAT PAYS FOR THE GROUND ITSELF, UP TO A HUNDRED THOUSAND EUROS PER PROJECT, FOR LAND PURCHASE, LONG-TERM LEASE OF LAND, OR SETTING UP OTHER EFFECTIVE AREA-BASED CONSERVATION MEASURES. LONG-TERM LEASE IS WHY IT IS FILED HERE. IN THIS COUNTRY LAND IS NOT PRIVATELY OWNED AND IS HELD ON LONG-TERM LEASE FROM THE STATE — SO A FUND THAT ONLY BOUGHT FREEHOLD WOULD BE USELESS, AND THIS ONE IS WRITTEN TO COVER EXACTLY THE ROUTE THAT WORKS. THE PRINCIPLE BEHIND IT IS THE PART TO QUOTE IN ANY APPROACH: THE OWNERSHIP OF AND RESPONSIBILITY FOR THE RESERVES PURCHASED IS PLACED IN THE HANDS OF THE LOCAL NATURE ORGANISATIONS. THE MONEY COMES FROM ABROAD; THE LAND DOES NOT LEAVE. WHO MAY APPLY IS PRECISE, AND EVERY CLAUSE IS A TASK TO COMPLETE BEFORE THE NEXT ROUND OPENS: A LOCALLY REGISTERED NON-PROFIT, NON-GOVERNMENTAL OR CIVIL SOCIETY ORGANISATION, DIRECTLY RESPONSIBLE FOR PREPARING AND IMPLEMENTING THE PROJECT, HOLDING A BANK ACCOUNT IN THE ORGANISATION'S OWN NAME IN THE PLACE IT IS ESTABLISHED OR WHERE THE PROJECT RUNS, WITH PROVEN EXPERIENCE AND CAPACITY IN MANAGING CONSERVATION AREAS INCLUDING PROJECT AND FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT AND CONTROL. A BANK ACCOUNT IN THE ORGANISATION'S OWN NAME DEFEATS MORE VILLAGE GROUPS THAN ANY OTHER CONDITION IN THIS FILE. IF THAT IS THE OBSTACLE, THE ANSWER IS A PARTNERSHIP WITH AN EXISTING REGISTERED CONSERVATION ORGANISATION — THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS SEVERAL FOR THIS COUNTRY. WHAT LAND QUALIFIES IS BROADER THAN A NATURE RESERVE: AREAS HOSTING RED LIST SPECIES WITH PRIORITY TO THE ENDANGERED AND CRITICALLY ENDANGERED; AREAS OF HIGH BIODIVERSITY VALUE SUCH AS KEY BIODIVERSITY AREAS, IMPORTANT BIRD AREAS AND ZERO-EXTINCTION SITES; LAND IMPORTANT FOR CONNECTIVITY INCLUDING CORRIDORS AND STEPPING STONES OR FOR SECURING ECOSYSTEM SERVICES; AND ECOSYSTEMS UNDER-REPRESENTED IN THE PROTECTED AREA SYSTEM. CONNECTIVITY AND STEPPING STONES ARE THE CLAUSES FOR A SMALL PARCEL. A FIELD, A RIVERBANK OR A HILLSIDE THAT LOOKS TOO MODEST TO PROTECT ON ITS OWN BECOMES FUNDABLE IF IT JOINS TWO PROTECTED PLACES — SO THE MAP MATTERS AS MUCH AS THE SPECIES LIST. KNOW WHAT IT REFUSES BEFORE WRITING: INDIVIDUALS, COMMERCIAL ORGANISATIONS, GOVERNMENTAL INSTITUTIONS, AND PROJECTS OR ORGANISATIONS WHOSE PRIMARY FOCUS IS SUSTAINABLE AGRICULTURAL SYSTEMS, EDUCATION, OR RESCUE AND REHABILITATION CENTRES. THE AGRICULTURE EXCLUSION IS THE TRAP FOR THIS REGION, WHERE ALMOST EVERY LOCAL ORGANISATION IS FARMING-FACING. THE PROPOSAL HAS TO BE ABOUT SECURING HABITAT, NOT ABOUT IMPROVING PRODUCTION, EVEN WHERE THE SAME PEOPLE AND THE SAME GROUND ARE INVOLVED. THE CALENDAR IS ANNUAL AND THE 2026 ROUND CLOSED ON THE FIRST OF MAY — WHICH MAKES THE COMING MONTHS PREPARATION TIME RATHER THAN A LOST YEAR: REGISTRATION, THE BANK ACCOUNT, THE MANAGEMENT TRACK RECORD AND THE PARCEL IDENTIFIED AND MAPPED. THERE IS ALSO A BOOK TO READ FIRST: THE FUND PUBLISHED, WITH A BIRD CONSERVATION ORGANISATION, A PRACTICAL MANUAL FOR PEOPLE MANAGING PRIVATELY PROTECTED AREAS, DRAWING ON LESSONS FROM MANAGERS AND EXPERTS AND GUIDING READERS FROM THE CREATION PHASE THROUGH THE DEVELOPMENT OF MANAGEMENT TOOLS. AND ONE SMALL DETAIL WORTH RESPECTING: THE FUND STATES THAT IT DOES NOT USE ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IN ITS REVIEW PROCESS AND EXPECTS THE SAME OF APPLICANTS. WRITE THE PROPOSAL YOURSELVES. THE LIMITS: THIS FUNDS ACQUISITION, NOT LITIGATION, CAMPAIGNING OR COMPENSATION - IT CANNOT STOP A PROJECT ALREADY APPROVED, AND IT REACHES ONLY LAND THAT CAN LAWFULLY BE BOUGHT OR LEASED BY A NON-PROFIT. WHETHER A NON-GOVERNMENTAL ORGANISATION IN THIS COUNTRY CAN HOLD A LONG-TERM LEASE OVER LAND FOR CONSERVATION, AND ON WHAT TERMS, WAS NOT ESTABLISHED AND IS THE FIRST QUESTION TO SETTLE - THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS THAT LAND HERE IS STATE-OWNED AND ALLOCATED IN USE. THE FUND'S OWN PAGES DESCRIBE ITS PARTNERS AS BEING IN AFRICA, ASIA AND LATIN AMERICA WITHOUT NAMING COUNTRIES, SO ELIGIBILITY FOR THIS ONE SHOULD BE CONFIRMED WITH THE FUND BEFORE WORK BEGINS. GRANT FIGURES DIFFER BETWEEN SOURCES - ONE AGGREGATOR RECORDS UP TO 85,000 EUROS AND OTHERS 100,000 - AND THE FUND IS THE ONLY RELIABLE AUTHORITY ON ITS OWN CEILING. Read it with the land privatisation valuation standard, the mahalla committees, the pasture and water user associations and the agrochemical analysis centre recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: National greening project — tree passports, a public monitoring platform, and a funded nursery and green belt
trackers.desc: THE MOST USEFUL THING IN THIS COUNTRY'S GREENING MACHINERY IS ALSO THE LEAST OBVIOUS: A PRESIDENTIAL DECREE OF NOVEMBER 2023 APPROVED A PROPOSAL BY THE CABINET, THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL'S OFFICE, THE ECOLOGY MINISTRY AND THE CAPITAL'S ADMINISTRATION TO CREATE PASSPORTS FOR TREES BY DIGITISING THEM. A TREE WITH A PASSPORT IS A TREE WITH AN IDENTITY, A LOCATION AND A RECORD. THIS FILE HAS SPENT HUNDREDS OF ROUNDS LOOKING FOR WAYS TO MAKE INDIVIDUAL LIVING THINGS LEGIBLE TO ADMINISTRATION — BECAUSE WHAT IS REGISTERED IS HARDER TO REMOVE QUIETLY THAN WHAT IS NOT. SO THE QUESTIONS FOR ANY THREATENED TREE OR AVENUE HERE ARE NARROW AND ANSWERABLE: HAS IT BEEN PASSPORTISED, WHO HOLDS THE RECORD, AND WHAT DOES THE PASSPORT SAY. THAT THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL'S OFFICE WAS A PARTY TO THE PROPOSAL IS ITSELF A SIGN OF WHAT THE SYSTEM IS FOR — ENFORCEMENT AGAINST UNAUTHORISED FELLING. THERE IS ALSO SOMEWHERE PUBLIC TO LOOK: A DECREE OF MAY 2025 REQUIRES THE ECOLOGY MINISTRY TO ENSURE QUARTERLY MONITORING ON THE PROJECT'S ELECTRONIC PLATFORM, UNTIL SEPTEMBER 2026, OF THE RESULTS OF PROGRAMMES TO INCREASE GREEN AREAS IN DESERT AND SEMI-DESERT REGIONS, WITH SYSTEMATIC MONITORING OF THE ECOLOGICAL SITUATION THERE. QUARTERLY RESULTS ON A PLATFORM ARE A PROMISE THAT CAN BE CHECKED. IF THE PLANTING CLAIMED FOR YOUR DISTRICT DID NOT HAPPEN, THE GAP BETWEEN THE PLATFORM AND THE GROUND IS THE COMPLAINT — AND IT IS THE MINISTRY'S OWN NUMBER YOU ARE QUOTING. THE NEWEST DECREE, OF 25 MARCH 2026, IS ABOUT MAKING GREEN SPACE USABLE RATHER THAN ONLY PLANTED: CREATING CONDITIONS FOR PEOPLE'S REST AND RECOVERY AND DEVELOPING VISITING INFRASTRUCTURE — PATHS, BENCHES, REST AND PICNIC AREAS, RUNNING TRACKS, AN OPEN-AIR LIBRARY AND FREE WIRELESS ZONES — ALONGSIDE A PLAN FOR ORGANISING BOTANICAL AND DENDROLOGICAL GARDENS IN THE REGIONS AND PRESERVING EXISTING GREEN PARKS. PRESERVING EXISTING GREEN PARKS IS THE CLAUSE TO CITE WHEN AN OLD PARK IS THE THING UNDER THREAT. A COMMITMENT TO KEEP WHAT EXISTS SITS INSIDE THE SAME DECREE AS THE PLANS TO BUILD NEW THINGS, AND THE FIRST IS EASIER TO ENFORCE THAN THE SECOND IS TO REDIRECT. THE MONEY AND THE PLANTS ARE BOTH SCHEDULED: BY OCTOBER 2026 A TREE AND SHRUB NURSERY IS PLANNED FROM PROJECT FUNDS ON A SITE IN A NAMED NEIGHBOURHOOD OF A CAPITAL DISTRICT; A GREEN BELT PROJECT WORTH THREE HUNDRED AND TWELVE AND A HALF BILLION IN LOCAL CURRENCY IS DUE BY THE FIRST OF NOVEMBER 2026, FUNDED FROM THE CITY BUDGET AND THROUGH A WORLD BANK SUSTAINABLE LANDSCAPE RESTORATION PROJECT; AND NEW DENDROLOGICAL AND BOTANICAL GARDENS ARE PLANNED BY THE THIRTIETH OF NOVEMBER 2026. THE WORLD BANK FUNDING IS THE DETAIL WITH THE LONGEST REACH. THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS THAT BANK'S ACCOUNTABILITY MECHANISM SEPARATELY — WHICH MEANS A LANDSCAPE RESTORATION PROJECT FINANCED THIS WAY COMES WITH A COMPLAINT OFFICE ATTACHED IF IT HARMS THE PEOPLE IT IS SUPPOSED TO SERVE. AND THE CHAIN OF RESPONSIBILITY IS NAMED IN THE DECREES THEMSELVES: THE CLIENT IS THE ECOLOGY, ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AND CLIMATE CHANGE MINISTRY, WITH THE DESIGNER AND CONTRACTOR DETERMINED AS LEGISLATION PROVIDES — SO A FAILED OR DESTRUCTIVE PLANTING SCHEME HAS AN IDENTIFIABLE CLIENT TO ADDRESS. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A STATE CAMPAIGN DRIVEN FROM THE PRESIDENCY, WITH TARGETS, CONTRACTORS AND DEADLINES - IT PLANTS AND BUILDS, AND NOTHING HERE SUGGESTS IT WILL PROTECT A PARTICULAR SITE FROM DEVELOPMENT OR TAKE A COMMUNITY'S SIDE; GREENING BUDGETS IN THIS REGION HAVE ALSO PAID FOR CLEARING AND REPLANTING RATHER THAN KEEPING WHAT WAS THERE. WHETHER SEEDLINGS ARE DISTRIBUTED FREE TO HOUSEHOLDS, WHERE THE NURSERIES ARE, AND WHETHER THE TREE PASSPORT SYSTEM HAS SPREAD BEYOND THE CAPITAL EXPERIMENT WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED - THOSE ARE THE THREE QUESTIONS FOR THE MINISTRY. THE DECREES WERE READ IN THE NATIONAL LEGISLATION DATABASE AND THE CITY PLANS IN A NEWSPAPER REPORT OF NOVEMBER 2025, NOT IN A SERVICE CATALOGUE, AND DATES IN STATE PROGRAMMES SLIP. Read it with the agrochemical analysis centre and its mobile laboratory, the land acquisition fund's lease route, the mahalla committees and the land privatisation valuation standard recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Mahalla association's provincial administrations and district departments — the neighbourhood network that helps write territorial programmes
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY HAD THE THINNEST LOCAL COVERAGE IN THE WHOLE PAYLOAD - ONE ENTRY IN NINE WAS LOCAL. ITS NEIGHBOURHOOD COMMUNITIES ARE ALREADY RECORDED HERE; WHAT WAS NOT IS THAT THEY HAVE AN ASSOCIATION OF THEIR OWN WITH ADMINISTRATIONS IN THE AUTONOMOUS REPUBLIC, IN EVERY PROVINCE AND IN THE CAPITAL, AND DEPARTMENTS IN THE DISTRICTS AND TOWNS BENEATH THEM. A DECREE OF 24 JUNE 2026 SET OUT WHAT THOSE BRANCHES MAY DO, AND IT IS MORE THAN WELFARE WORK: SYSTEMATICALLY ANALYSE THE PROBLEMS IN THE NEIGHBOURHOODS; WORK OUT DIRECTIONS OF MUTUAL COOPERATION BETWEEN THE RESPONSIBLE AGENCIES; AND PARTICIPATE IN PREPARING TERRITORIAL PROGRAMMES AND IN CONTROLLING THEIR EXECUTION. PARTICIPATING IN PREPARING TERRITORIAL PROGRAMMES IS THE PART THAT MATTERS TO ANYONE WHOSE LAND, WATER OR PASTURE IS AT STAKE. TERRITORIAL PROGRAMMES ARE WHERE A DISTRICT'S SPENDING AND ITS PRIORITIES ARE SET - AND THE NEIGHBOURHOOD NETWORK NOW HAS A SEAT AT THE TABLE WHERE THEY ARE WRITTEN, NOT ONLY AT THE POINT WHERE THEY ARRIVE. CONTROLLING THEIR EXECUTION IS THE OTHER HALF, AND IT IS THE HALF COMMUNITIES USUALLY LACK: SOMEBODY WITH STANDING TO ASK WHY THE THING THAT WAS PROMISED HAS NOT BEEN BUILT. ABOVE THE BRANCHES SIT MEETINGS WITH DATES, WHICH IS RARE AND USEFUL: TERRITORIAL NEIGHBOURHOOD SUPPORT COUNCILS MEET AT LEAST ONCE EVERY QUARTER UNDER THE CHAIRMANSHIP OF THE PROVINCIAL AND CAPITAL GOVERNORS AND OF THE AUTONOMOUS REPUBLIC'S SUPREME COUNCIL CHAIR - AND A REPUBLIC-LEVEL COUNCIL MEETS AT LEAST TWICE A YEAR UNDER THE PRIME MINISTER WITH THE RESPONSIBLE MINISTRIES. A QUARTERLY COUNCIL CHAIRED BY THE GOVERNOR IS THE HIGHEST ROOM MOST VILLAGES IN THIS FILE WILL EVER HAVE ACCESS TO, AND THE ROUTE INTO IT IS THE NEIGHBOURHOOD'S OWN CHAIRMAN AND THE DISTRICT DEPARTMENT OF THE ASSOCIATION - BOTH OF WHOM LIVE NEARBY. THE PRACTICAL SEQUENCE IS SHORT: TAKE THE PROBLEM TO THE NEIGHBOURHOOD FIRST, ASK THE DISTRICT DEPARTMENT TO INCLUDE IT IN ITS ANALYSIS OF NEIGHBOURHOOD PROBLEMS, AND ASK WHICH TERRITORIAL PROGRAMME IT BELONGS IN AND WHEN THAT PROGRAMME IS NEXT PREPARED. THERE IS A SECOND SUBNATIONAL BODY WORTH FINDING IN THE SAME DISTRICT, AND ITS WEAKNESS IS PUBLISHED: WATER CONSUMERS' ASSOCIATIONS ARE NAMED IN GOVERNMENT DECISIONS ALONGSIDE PROVINCIAL AND DISTRICT ADMINISTRATIONS AND THE WATER MINISTRY - INCLUDING A REQUIREMENT TO EQUIP CONSUMERS' HEAD WATER INTAKES WITH WATER MANAGEMENT AND METERING DEVICES - WHILE THE NATIONAL WATER CONCEPT ADMITS THAT THE SYSTEM FOR SUPPORTING AND FINANCING THESE ASSOCIATIONS HAS NOT BEEN ORGANISED TO THE REQUIRED LEVEL, LEAVING THEIR PAYABLES AND RECEIVABLES HIGH. AN ASSOCIATION THE STATE ADMITS IT HAS UNDERFUNDED IS ONE WHOSE FARMERS HAVE A GRIEVANCE IN COMMON AND AN OFFICIAL DOCUMENT TO POINT AT. AND METERING AT THE HEAD INTAKE IS WHAT ENDS ARGUMENTS ABOUT WHO TOOK THE WATER - WORTH ASKING WHETHER IT WAS EVER INSTALLED ON YOUR CANAL. ONE PILOT IS WORTH WATCHING: A PROJECT ON AUTOMATING WATER RESOURCE MANAGEMENT AND ACCOUNTING, BASED ON FOREIGN EXPERIENCE, WAS APPROVED FOR ONE NAMED DISTRICT FROM THE FIRST OF JANUARY 2026, PROPOSED JOINTLY BY TWO MINISTRIES, A BANK, THE FARMERS' COUNCIL AND ONE PROVINCIAL ADMINISTRATION. WHERE A PILOT EXISTS, THE ASK ELSEWHERE IS TO BE THE SECOND DISTRICT - WHICH IS A SMALLER REQUEST THAN ASKING FOR SOMETHING NEW. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A STATE-BACKED NEIGHBOURHOOD STRUCTURE, NOT AN INDEPENDENT ORGANISATION - ITS CHAIRMEN SIT INSIDE THE ADMINISTRATIVE CHAIN, ITS COUNCILS ARE CHAIRED BY GOVERNORS AND THE PRIME MINISTER, AND NOTHING RECORDED HERE SHOWS IT OPPOSING A STATE PROJECT; THIS PAYLOAD ALREADY RECORDS THAT THE SAME NEIGHBOURHOOD SYSTEM CARRIES SURVEILLANCE AND SOCIAL-CONTROL FUNCTIONS ALONGSIDE ITS SERVICE ONES. THE POWERS DESCRIBED COME FROM THE TEXT OF A JUNE 2026 DECREE IN THE NATIONAL LEGISLATION DATABASE, NOT FROM THE ASSOCIATION'S OWN ACCOUNT OF ITSELF, AND HOW A RESIDENT ACTUALLY REACHES A DISTRICT DEPARTMENT - ADDRESSES, HOURS, WHETHER WRITTEN SUBMISSIONS ARE REGISTERED - WAS NOT ESTABLISHED. THE WATER ASSOCIATIONS' FINANCIAL WEAKNESS COMES FROM A NATIONAL CONCEPT DOCUMENT OF 2020 AND MAY HAVE CHANGED. Read it with the mahalla committees, the land acquisition fund's lease route, the agrochemical analysis centre's mobile laboratory and the national greening project's tree passports recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Provincial administrations under a two-parks-each deadline, the young ecologists' regional councils, and the NGO association's participation training
trackers.desc: THIS PAYLOAD HAS SPENT HUNDREDS OF ROUNDS ASKING HOW GROUND GETS PROTECTED. IN THIS COUNTRY THE ANSWER CURRENTLY HAS A DATE ON IT: THE COUNCIL OF MINISTERS OF THE AUTONOMOUS REPUBLIC AND THE PROVINCIAL ADMINISTRATIONS WERE INSTRUCTED TO CREATE TWO NATURE PARKS OF LOCAL IMPORTANCE EACH BY THE FIRST OF NOVEMBER 2026. EVERY PROVINCE MUST PROTECT TWO PLACES, AND NOTHING IN THE INSTRUCTION SAYS WHICH TWO. A COMMUNITY WITH A VALLEY, A LAKE SHORE, A TUGAI WOOD OR A SPRING WORTH KEEPING HAS A NARROW WINDOW AND AN EXACT ASK: PUT OURS FORWARD AS ONE OF THE PROVINCE'S TWO. THAT IS THE CHEAPEST ROUTE TO PROTECTED STATUS RECORDED ANYWHERE IN THIS FILE - NO PURCHASE, NO LITIGATION, NO DONOR. THE PROVINCE NEEDS TWO SITES AND HAS A DEADLINE; A COMMUNITY THAT ARRIVES WITH A MAPPED, BOUNDED, LOCALLY SUPPORTED PROPOSAL IS SOLVING THE ADMINISTRATION'S PROBLEM RATHER THAN CREATING ONE. THERE IS MONEY BEHIND THE POLICY: A STATE TARGETED FUND FOR ELIMINATING NATIONAL ENVIRONMENTAL PROBLEMS WAS CREATED UNDER THE ECOLOGY AND CLIMATE CHANGE COMMITTEE, WITH INCOME SET AS NINE HUNDRED BILLION IN NATIONAL CURRENCY FROM THE REPUBLICAN BUDGET IN 2025, FIVE HUNDRED AND FORTY-EIGHT BILLION IN 2026 FOR MEASURES LISTED IN AN ANNEX, AND FROM JANUARY 2026 TWENTY PER CENT OF THE PROCEEDS OF CARBON UNIT TRADING AT THE REPUBLIC'S DISPOSAL, TOGETHER WITH COMPENSATION PAYMENTS FOR POLLUTION. A FUND PART-FINANCED BY POLLUTION COMPENSATION AND CARBON SALES IS ONE WHOSE ANNEX OF FUNDED MEASURES IS WORTH READING LINE BY LINE - BECAUSE THAT ANNEX NAMES WHAT THE STATE HAS ALREADY AGREED TO PAY FOR. THE WIDER PROGRAMME MOVES PROVINCE BY PROVINCE ON FIXED DATES: A NATIONWIDE CLEAN AIR PROJECT WAS SET TO REACH THREE EASTERN PROVINCES BY 1 JULY 2026, FOUR CENTRAL ONES BY 1 AUGUST, FOUR SOUTHERN AND WESTERN ONES BY 1 OCTOBER, AND THE AUTONOMOUS REPUBLIC AND ONE FURTHER PROVINCE BY 1 DECEMBER. KNOWING THE MONTH YOUR PROVINCE ENTERS A NATIONAL PROGRAMME IS KNOWING WHEN ITS OFFICIALS WILL BE LOOKING FOR THINGS TO POINT AT. THAT IS THE MOMENT TO PUT A LOCAL PROPOSAL IN FRONT OF THEM. ONE PRECEDENT IS WORTH CARRYING TO ANY PROVINCE FIGHTING A FACTORY: FROM 1 APRIL 2026 AN INDEFINITE MORATORIUM ON THE CREATION OF NEW INDUSTRIAL ZONES WAS INTRODUCED IN THE CAPITAL, EXCEPT ZONES BASED ON SERVICES OR FINANCIAL SERVICES. AN INDEFINITE MORATORIUM ON NEW INDUSTRIAL ZONES EXISTS SOMEWHERE IN THIS COUNTRY. THAT ENDS THE ARGUMENT THAT SUCH A THING IS IMPOSSIBLE, AND THE QUESTION BECOMES WHY THE CAPITAL AND NOT HERE. THERE ARE ALSO PEOPLE ORGANISED AT REGIONAL LEVEL TO WORK WITH: A MOVEMENT OF YOUNG ECOLOGISTS HAS A COUNCIL IN THE AUTONOMOUS REPUBLIC WITH A NAMED DEPUTY CHAIRMAN, AND AN ECOLOGICAL WEEK HELD IN A DISTRICT OF THE CAPITAL PROVINCE IN 2026 BROUGHT TOGETHER YOUNG ECOLOGISTS FROM ALL REGIONS TO DEVELOP INITIATIVES THEY COULD THEN CARRY OUT IN THEIR OWN REGIONS. YOUNG PEOPLE WHO HAVE BEEN TRAINED AND SENT HOME TO IMPLEMENT SOMETHING ARE LOOKING FOR A PROJECT. A VILLAGE PROPOSAL AND A REGIONAL YOUTH COUNCIL NEED EACH OTHER. AND GROUPS ARE BEING TAUGHT THE PARTICIPATION RULES DIRECTLY: ON THE TWENTY-EIGHTH OF AUGUST 2026 A TRAINING SEMINAR FOR REPRESENTATIVES OF NON-GOVERNMENTAL NON-COMMERCIAL ORGANISATIONS WAS HELD AT A HUMAN RIGHTS HOUSE IN THE CAPITAL ON PREPARING ALTERNATIVE REPORTS UNDER INTERNATIONAL HUMAN RIGHTS TREATIES AND ON THE BASIC PRINCIPLES OF THE AARHUS CONVENTION FOR EXPANDING PUBLIC PARTICIPATION IN ENVIRONMENTAL DECISION-MAKING, RUN BY THE NATIONAL HUMAN RIGHTS CENTRE AND THE NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF NON-GOVERNMENTAL NON-COMMERCIAL ORGANISATIONS. THE LIMITS: THE PARKS INSTRUCTION IS A DEADLINE GIVEN TO ADMINISTRATIONS, NOT A RIGHT GIVEN TO COMMUNITIES - WHO PROPOSES SITES, WHETHER RESIDENTS MAY, WHAT A LOCAL-IMPORTANCE PARK ACTUALLY PROHIBITS AND WHETHER GRAZING, GATHERING OR HOUSING CONTINUE INSIDE ONE WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED, AND A HURRIED PARK CAN BE DRAWN AROUND A COMMUNITY AS EASILY AS FOR IT. THE FUND SITS WITH A NATIONAL COMMITTEE, NOT WITH THE PROVINCES, AND ITS APPLICATION ROUTE WAS NOT SEEN. THE YOUTH MOVEMENT AND THE NGO ASSOCIATION ARE STATE-LINKED STRUCTURES IN A COUNTRY WHERE INDEPENDENT REGISTRATION IS DIFFICULT, WHICH THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS ELSEWHERE. THE INSTRUCTION AND FUND FIGURES COME FROM THE PRESIDENTIAL SITE'S TEXT OF A NOVEMBER 2025 DECREE, THE ROLLOUT AND MORATORIUM FROM AN ENVIRONMENTAL NEWS SITE OF MARCH 2026, AND THE CAMP AND SEMINAR FROM A NEWS PORTAL OF JULY AND AUGUST 2026. Read it with the mahalla association's provincial branches, the land acquisition fund's lease route, the national greening project's tree passports and the agrochemical analysis centre recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Registered ecoforum of environmental organisations, and the NGO association's territorial branches that train on participation
trackers.desc: THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED, COUNTRY AFTER COUNTRY, THAT THE HARDEST BARRIER FOR A SMALL GROUP IS REGISTRATION. IN THIS COUNTRY THERE IS AN UMBRELLA THAT CROSSED IT: AN ECOFORUM OF NON-GOVERNMENTAL NON-COMMERCIAL ORGANISATIONS, ESTABLISHED IN SEPTEMBER 2004 AT A CONFERENCE OF THE LEADERS OF FORTY-EIGHT ORGANISATIONS AND INITIATIVE GROUPS, AND REGISTERED BY THE JUSTICE MINISTRY ON THE SEVENTH OF APRIL 2007 AS A PUBLIC ASSOCIATION OF THE COUNTRY'S ENVIRONMENTAL ORGANISATIONS. INITIATIVE GROUPS SAT AT ITS FOUNDING ALONGSIDE REGISTERED ORGANISATIONS. THAT MATTERS, BECAUSE AN UNREGISTERED VILLAGE GROUP LOOKING FOR SOMEBODY WHO CAN SPEAK AND CORRESPOND IN ITS OWN NAME IS LOOKING FOR EXACTLY THIS KIND OF BODY. ALONGSIDE IT WORKS A NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF NON-GOVERNMENTAL NON-COMMERCIAL ORGANISATIONS WITH A CENTRAL APPARATUS AND TERRITORIAL SUBDIVISIONS - WHICH IS THE PART THAT REACHES BEYOND THE CAPITAL. TERRITORIAL SUBDIVISIONS MEAN A PROVINCE HAS AN OFFICE OF THE NGO ASSOCIATION IN IT. FOR A GROUP THAT CANNOT TRAVEL, THAT IS THE NEAREST DOOR TO THE ORGANISED SECTOR. WHAT THAT ASSOCIATION WAS DOING THIS SUMMER IS THE MOST USEFUL FACT HERE: ON THE TWENTY-EIGHTH OF AUGUST 2026 A TRAINING SEMINAR WAS HELD AT A HUMAN RIGHTS HOUSE IN THE CAPITAL FOR REPRESENTATIVES OF NON-GOVERNMENTAL ORGANISATIONS ON PREPARING ALTERNATIVE REPORTS UNDER INTERNATIONAL HUMAN RIGHTS TREATIES AND ON THE BASIC PRINCIPLES OF THE AARHUS CONVENTION, DIRECTED AT EXPANDING THE PARTICIPATION OF THE POPULATION IN DECISION-MAKING ON ENVIRONMENTAL QUESTIONS. THE AARHUS PRINCIPLES ARE ACCESS TO ENVIRONMENTAL INFORMATION, PARTICIPATION IN DECISIONS AND ACCESS TO JUSTICE. A STATE-BACKED SEMINAR TEACHING THEM TO LOCAL ORGANISATIONS IS AN OPENING, AND THE PRACTICAL ASK IS SIMPLE: WHO FROM THIS PROVINCE ATTENDED, AND WILL THEY REPEAT IT HERE. THE ALTERNATIVE REPORT IS THE OTHER HALF, AND IT IS THE SHARPER TOOL: IT IS THE DOCUMENT CIVIL SOCIETY SUBMITS ALONGSIDE A GOVERNMENT'S OWN REPORT TO AN INTERNATIONAL TREATY BODY, SAYING WHAT THE OFFICIAL VERSION LEFT OUT. A COMMUNITY WHOSE WATER, PASTURE OR AIR COMPLAINT HAS GONE NOWHERE DOMESTICALLY CAN HAVE IT RECORDED IN A DOCUMENT AN INTERNATIONAL COMMITTEE READS - AND THE PEOPLE TRAINED TO WRITE THOSE REPORTS ARE NOW IN THE COUNTRY, INSIDE AN ASSOCIATION WITH PROVINCIAL OFFICES. THE TRAINING SITS INSIDE AN OFFICIAL FRAMEWORK, WHICH IS WHY IT CAN BE INVOKED: IT WAS ORGANISED WITHIN A ROADMAP FOR IMPLEMENTING THE FIFTH STAGE OF A WORLD PROGRAMME FOR HUMAN RIGHTS EDUCATION, APPROVED BY A CABINET RESOLUTION OF THE THIRD OF MARCH 2026. A CABINET-APPROVED ROADMAP IS A DOCUMENT AN OFFICIAL CANNOT DISMISS. ASKING FOR THE PROVINCIAL SESSION IT PROVIDES FOR IS A REQUEST TO IMPLEMENT GOVERNMENT POLICY, NOT A FAVOUR. THE REGIONAL BACKDROP IS WORTH RECORDING HONESTLY, AND IT COMES FROM CIVIL SOCIETY'S OWN ACCOUNT: A REGIONAL ENVIRONMENTAL SUMMIT IN A NEIGHBOURING CAPITAL IN MAY 2026 OPENED WITH A MEETING OF THE REGION'S PRESIDENTS HELD BEHIND CLOSED DOORS, WHICH REPRESENTATIVES OF CIVIL SOCIETY, INDEPENDENT EXPERTS AND JOURNALISTS COULD NOT ATTEND, ENTRY BEING BY SPECIAL INVITATION ONLY. THAT IS THE CONTEXT FOR EVERYTHING ABOVE: THE TRAINING IS REAL, THE UMBRELLA IS REAL, AND THE ROOM WHERE THE DECISIONS ARE ACTUALLY TAKEN STILL CLOSES ITS DOOR. THE LIMITS: BOTH BODIES OPERATE INSIDE A STATE-SUPERVISED CIVIL SOCIETY SYSTEM - THE ASSOCIATION IS THE OFFICIAL CHANNEL FOR THE SECTOR, THE SEMINAR WAS RUN WITH A NATIONAL HUMAN RIGHTS CENTRE UNDER A CABINET ROADMAP, AND NOTHING RECORDED HERE SHOWS EITHER SUPPORTING OPPOSITION TO A STATE PROJECT. THE ECOFORUM'S FOUNDING AND REGISTRATION DATES COME FROM ITS OWN SITE WITH NO INDICATION OF ITS CURRENT MEMBERSHIP, ACTIVITY OR CONTACT ARRANGEMENTS - WHETHER IT STILL FUNCTIONS AT THE SCALE OF ITS FOUNDING WAS NOT ESTABLISHED, AND ITS PAGE IS SERVED WITHOUT ENCRYPTION. WHERE THE ASSOCIATION'S TERRITORIAL SUBDIVISIONS SIT, HOW A GROUP JOINS EITHER BODY, AND WHETHER THE AUGUST TRAINING WILL BE REPEATED IN THE PROVINCES WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED. Read it with the mahalla association's provincial branches and quarterly councils, the provincial two-parks deadline and its state fund, the land acquisition fund's lease route and the national greening project recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Neighbourhood participatory budgeting — raise half the cost and the state pays the rest, on a fixed annual calendar
trackers.desc: THE SINGLE MOST ACTIONABLE RULE THIS FILE HAS RECORDED FOR THIS COUNTRY: IF THE RESIDENTS OF A NEIGHBOURHOOD PROVIDE NOT LESS THAN FIFTY PER CENT OF A PROJECT'S COST, IT IS AUTOMATICALLY RECOGNISED AS A WINNER AND THE REMAINING SUM IS COVERED BY THE STATE. NO COMPETITION, NO CAMPAIGN, NO OFFICIAL'S DISCRETION - RAISE HALF AND THE OTHER HALF FOLLOWS. FOR A COMMUNITY THAT WANTS A WATER LINE, A DRAINAGE CHANNEL, TREES ON AN ERODING SLOPE OR A REPAIRED SCHOOL, THAT IS THE CHEAPEST MATCHED FUNDING IN THIS ENTIRE PAYLOAD. THE CONSTRAINTS ARE SMALL AND KNOWABLE: WITHIN ONE SEASON EACH NEIGHBOURHOOD MAY IMPLEMENT ONLY ONE PARTNER PROJECT, PARTICIPATION IS ENTIRELY VOLUNTARY, AND A THOUSAND PROJECTS WERE TO RECEIVE PARTNER-PROGRAMME FINANCING - AND SINCE FEBRUARY 2026 PEOPLE MAY TRANSFER THEIR CONTRIBUTIONS THROUGH ORDINARY PAYMENT SERVICES. ONE PARTNER PROJECT PER NEIGHBOURHOOD PER SEASON MEANS THE ARGUMENT INSIDE THE COMMUNITY - WHICH ONE - MATTERS MORE THAN THE ARGUMENT WITH THE STATE. THAT IS A CONVERSATION WORTH HAVING BEFORE THE SEASON OPENS, NOT DURING IT. THE CALENDAR IS FIXED AND PUBLIC, WHICH IS WHAT MAKES IT USABLE: SUBMISSION OF INITIATIVES FROM THE POPULATION FROM THE FIRST TO THE TWENTIETH OF FEBRUARY, SELECTION TO THE SEVENTH OF MARCH, PROMOTION FROM THE EIGHTH TO THE TENTH, VOTING FROM THE ELEVENTH TO THE TWENTIETH, WINNERS ANNOUNCED ON THE TWENTY-FIRST OF MARCH AT THE SPRING FESTIVAL, AND ADDITIONAL WINNERS TO THE END OF THE MONTH. THREE WEEKS TO SUBMIT AND TEN DAYS TO CAMPAIGN. A COMMUNITY THAT LEARNS THIS IN MARCH HAS LOST A YEAR; ONE THAT KNOWS IT IN DECEMBER HAS TIME TO AGREE WHAT TO ASK FOR AND WHO WILL COLLECT THE MONEY. THE SUMS ARE NOT SMALL: SIX TRILLION IN NATIONAL CURRENCY WAS PROVIDED FOR THE PROGRAMME IN 2026, OF WHICH FOUR HUNDRED AND NINETY-SIX BILLION GOES TO DEPUTIES' INITIATIVES AND FIVE HUNDRED AND SIX BILLION TO CO-FINANCED PROJECTS WITH THE POPULATION. AND PARTICIPATION IS REAL AT SCALE: IN THE SECOND SEASON OF 2026, TWO THOUSAND ONE HUNDRED AND NINETY-FIVE PROJECTS WON AND THREE AND A HALF TRILLION WAS DIRECTED TO THEM, WITH RESIDENTS CASTING MORE THAN TEN MILLION VOTES IN TOTAL - AN EARLIER REPORT OF THE SAME SEASON RECORDING OVER THREE TRILLION FOR NEARLY TWO THOUSAND PROJECTS REPAIRING SCHOOLS, ROADS AND OTHER FACILITIES. TEN MILLION VOTES MEANS A NEIGHBOURHOOD THAT ORGANISES ITS OWN PEOPLE IS NOT AN ODDITY BUT A COMPETITOR IN A CONTEST OTHERS ARE ALREADY TAKING SERIOUSLY. A SEPARATE PROGRAMME RUNS ALONGSIDE IT: THE HEAD OF STATE STATED IN OCTOBER 2025 THAT EIGHT AND A HALF TRILLION WOULD BE ALLOCATED TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF TWO THOUSAND NEIGHBOURHOODS IN 2026 - SO A COMMUNITY SHOULD ASK WHETHER IT IS ONE OF THE TWO THOUSAND BEFORE ASSUMING THE VOTING PORTAL IS ITS ONLY ROUTE. THE FLAW IS NAMED BY THE PROGRAMME'S OWN PUBLIC, AND IT IS THE WARNING THIS FILE MUST CARRY: A PUBLISHED READER COMMENT ARGUES THAT ALL PROJECTS SHOULD FIRST BE DISCUSSED AND APPROVED IN THE NEIGHBOURHOOD AND ONLY THEN GO TO THE VOTE - BECAUSE AS IT STANDS A PROJECT THAT WORSENS THE ECOLOGICAL SITUATION IN THE NEIGHBOURHOOD CAN TURN OUT TO BE THE WINNER AND BE BUILT DESPITE THE OBJECTION OF THE MAJORITY OF ITS RESIDENTS. PARTICIPATORY BUDGETING CAN THEREFORE PAVE THE GREEN SPACE AS EASILY AS PLANT IT. THE DEFENCE IS THE SAME ONE THE COMMENT PROPOSES: GET THE NEIGHBOURHOOD MEETING TO DISCUSS AND APPROVE THE PROPOSAL BEFORE IT REACHES THE PORTAL, AND KEEP THE MINUTE. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A STATE PROGRAMME ON A GOVERNMENT PORTAL, NOT A COMMUNITY BODY - IT FUNDS SMALL WORKS AND WILL NOT BUY LAND, PAY A LAWYER OR STOP A PROJECT, AND THE ONLINE VOTE CAN BE WON BY WHOEVER MOBILISES MOST DEVICES RATHER THAN BY THE PEOPLE MOST AFFECTED. DEPUTIES OF THE LOWER HOUSE GAINED POWERS FROM AUGUST TO CHOOSE WINNING PROJECTS IN AN ADDITIONAL ROUND WITHIN FUNDS ALLOCATED TO THEM, WHICH MOVES SOME OF THE DECISION AWAY FROM VOTERS. HOW A PROPOSAL IS DRAFTED, WHO MAY SUBMIT, WHETHER NON-CITIZENS OR UNREGISTERED GROUPS MAY, HOW THE HALF-COST CONTRIBUTION IS HELD AND WHAT HAPPENS IF IT FALLS SHORT WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED. THE FIGURES COME FROM FOUR UZBEK NEWS SITES REPORTING MINISTRY ANNOUNCEMENTS BETWEEN JANUARY AND JULY 2026 AND DIFFER SLIGHTLY BETWEEN REPORTS OF THE SAME SEASON. Read it with the mahalla association's provincial branches and quarterly councils, the two-parks-per-province deadline, the registered ecoforum and the land acquisition fund's lease route recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Tajikistan — Tax Committee (Single State Register)
trackers.desc: National company registry; the Tax Committee is the primary single-window business-registration body, maintaining the Single State Register of legal entities & individual entrepreneurs, Tajikistan. — Holds to account: state firms & government-linked companies — find their registration, directors and filings.

trackers.desc: Constitutional Court of Tajikistan — supreme court (Tajikistan).

trackers.name: Article 8 — local government powers, in a state that owns everything
trackers.desc: THERE IS NO PRIVATE OR COMMUNITY LAND-ACQUISITION ROUTE IN TAJIKISTAN. Article 13 of the Constitution vests land, water, flora and fauna in the state, and the protected areas law makes specially protected natural areas the exclusive property of the state (article 4). The land trust, easement and community-title mechanisms recorded elsewhere in this map do not exist here — do not spend effort looking for a purchase or covenant route; everything runs through designation and management. BUT LOCAL GOVERNMENT HAS ENUMERATED POWERS: the law names the Government, the authorized state body, local government bodies and ministries as the managers of protected areas — and article 8 is headed ‘Powers of local government bodies concerning specially protected natural areas’. In a system where the state owns everything, a statute that separately enumerates local powers is the opening for a locally driven proposal — read and cite article 8. THE LOCAL BODY IS THE JAMOAT, the constitutional self-government authority of settlements and villages, managing several villages, under the Law on Self-Government Bodies in Towns and Villages (1994, amended 2009 and 2017). Article 79: the representative authority and chairman adopt legal documents whose implementation is compulsory in that territory — so a jamoat decision binds within its area.

trackers.name: The Forest Code does not say what you expect — ask which permit law applies
trackers.desc: GAPS RECORDED BY THE UNECE ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW, AND THEY ARE USABLE. The Forest Code (2011 Law No. 761) has not been updated; the regimes in the different categories of protected forests are not described in it, and nor are restrictions on economic activities in forests within specially protected natural areas. The Forestry Agency issues temporary seasonal permits that are outside the scope of the Law on the Permit System, and a 2019 official overview noted an ‘unclear legal framework regarding responsibilities and jurisdiction’. So where logging or forest use is the threat, the restriction you expect to find in the Forest Code may simply not be written there — ask which instrument the permit was issued under, because the answer may itself be the argument. THE STRUCTURE TO ORGANISE THROUGH: Jamoat Resource Centres and District Development Councils are established civil-society structures at jamoat and district level, recorded as crucial for cost-sharing, community mobilisation and awareness building. If your issue is a watershed, the Jamoat Watershed Action Plan is an existing instrument with precedent — 8 were run in the northern Kofirnighan river basin. Note too that proposals pass through jamoats and their approval to the Government.

trackers.name: CAREC — two organisations share the name, neither is a grant fund
trackers.desc: ‘CAREC’ IS TWO DIFFERENT ORGANISATIONS AND YOU WILL PROBABLY APPROACH THE WRONG ONE. The Regional Environmental Centre for Central Asia (carecnet.org / carececo.org) was established following the 4th Pan-European Conference in Aarhus, 1998, operating since 2001 as an independent, non-commercial and non-partisan organisation of international character. Its founders are Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan and Uzbekistan plus UNDP and the European Commission; headquarters in Almaty, with country offices in all five member states (the Kyrgyz office is at 142 Gorky str., office 410, Bishkek 720005). The unrelated Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation (CAREC) Program is an Asian Development Bank programme founded 1997, based in Manila, with 11 members including Afghanistan, Azerbaijan, China and Pakistan. NEITHER IS A COMMUNITY GRANT FUND. The Environmental Centre offers a dialogue platform for environmental NGOs and representation at international forums and thematic networks, and collaborates with NGOs, government and business — a route to partnership, visibility and project consortia, not an application window. The ADB programme's Climate and Sustainability Project Preparatory Fund (US$3m from Korea, US$2m from China) supports preparation of bankable regional projects and its eligible recipients are developing member countries — states, not community groups. Approach the Environmental Centre's country office for partnership; do not send it a grant application expecting an award.

trackers.name: GEF Small Grants Programme — up to US$50,000 direct to communities
trackers.desc: WHERE THE COMMUNITY MONEY ACTUALLY IS. The GEF Small Grants Programme, running since 1992 and implemented by UNDP, reached 135 countries of 144 eligible in GEF-8, which secured US$135 million for the core programme with nearly US$1 million allocated to each participating country — a per-country floor, so the money is not competed for across borders. Grants of up to US$50,000 go directly to local communities, community-based organisations and other non-governmental groups. Focal areas: biodiversity, climate change, land degradation and sustainable forest management, international waters and chemicals. READ THE COUNTRY PROGRAMME STRATEGY FIRST. Each participating country writes its own CPS emphasising particular themes and geographies, so global eligibility does not mean your region or theme qualifies. Note also that under SGP 2.0 the implementing agency may be FAO or Conservation International rather than UNDP, and the host may be a national host institution rather than the UNDP country office — confirm which applies before addressing an application.

trackers.name: ICCA Registry and Protected Planet — and registration is not a precondition
trackers.desc: CHECK WHETHER YOUR SITE IS ALREADY IN A REGISTRY BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE — it may carry a designation nobody locally mentioned. The World Database on Protected and Conserved Areas at protectedplanet.net is a joint UNEP and IUCN product managed by UNEP-WCMC, drawing on almost 500 data providers in 245 countries, updated monthly and downloadable; it underpins the UN List of Protected Areas. THE OECM ROUTE IS THE ONE MOST COMMUNITIES MISS: a site qualifies as an other effective area-based conservation measure if it delivers sustained, positive conservation outcomes EVEN THOUGH IT MAY BE MANAGED PRIMARILY FOR OTHER REASONS — so a grazing commons, a sacred site or a watershed managed for water supply can qualify without being managed primarily for conservation. Land that is worked rather than preserved is not excluded. But note the exclusivity: a site can be a protected area or an OECM — it is not possible to meet both, so ask which is being proposed. THE ICCA REGISTRY IS THE ONE COMMUNITIES FILL IN THEMSELVES: at iccaregistry.org, communities themselves provide data, case studies, maps, photos and stories, and its operators state it is meant to be used to enhance advocacy and recognition — not merely as an inventory. Documenting a territory there creates a citable, third-party-hosted record. THE SENTENCE THAT MATTERS MOST: UNEP-WCMC states these territories must be recognised and respected ‘whether or not they have been reported to the ICCA Registry’ — registration is NOT a precondition of rights, and anyone arguing a claim is weaker for being unregistered is arguing against the registry operator's own position. AND USE THE SCALE FIGURE CAREFULLY: over 1,500 sites are reported under indigenous and community governance — just 1 percent of all recorded sites, with UNEP-WCMC adding that no one knows how many ICCAs exist globally. That 1 percent measures how little has been recorded, not how little communities conserve. Filter Protected Planet by governance type to find such sites; UNEP-WCMC's manual Global Databases to Support ICCAs gives guidance on contributing data.

trackers.name: Aarhus Centres of Tajikistan — seven of them, and the environment committee takes reports over WhatsApp
trackers.desc: SEVEN CENTRES, WHICH MAKES THIS THE STRONGEST PUBLIC-PARTICIPATION NETWORK THIS CHAT HAS FOUND IN CENTRAL ASIA OR THE CAUCASUS. The Committee for Environmental Protection under the Government of Tajikistan states in its own environmental reporting that seven Aarhus Centres have been created and are operating in various parts of the country, and the network's site carries recent field activity, including a joint visit to the Romit biosphere reserve run by the Dushanbe Aarhus Centre with the committee's Tabiat state enterprise, the protected areas institution and the OSCE Programme Office in Dushanbe. Compare Azerbaijan, recorded elsewhere in this file, where the OSCE describes a single Baku centre focused primarily on access to information — two countries usually grouped together, with very different provision. THE REPORTING ROUTE IS UNUSUALLY LOW-FRICTION AND WORTH KNOWING: the committee activated an electronic number for reporting breaches of environmental protection law through WhatsApp, Viber and IMO on 777-16-22-75, stated to operate around the clock. A photograph with a location, sent from the site, is a far lower barrier than a written submission — though the announcement dates from 2019, so confirm the number is live before relying on it, and keep your own copy of anything you send. WHERE THE DECISIONS ACTUALLY SIT: the committee is the central executive body for environmental protection, specially protected natural areas and natural resource use, and exercises state environmental control. Its structure includes a Directorate of State Environmental Expertise, which is the unit that reviews a project's environmental case and therefore the one to address on a specific scheme, a State Institution for Specially Protected Natural Areas established by decree in July 1992, and a separate general directorate for environmental protection of the city of Dushanbe. Committee address: Shamsi street 5/1, Dushanbe 734034, telephone +992 37 2364059. THE STRUCTURAL LIMIT, STATED PLAINLY: these centres are not independent of the state. They operate with the environment committee and with OSCE support, and the Dushanbe centre's published work is educational and field-based rather than adversarial. Use them to obtain information, to find out how and when a decision is being taken, and to reach the expertise directorate — not in the expectation that they will oppose a project on your behalf. Tajikistan has no verified independent environmental organisation in this file: R4 examined the best-known candidate and could not verify a canonical domain for it.

trackers.name: Zan va Zamin — works on land access for the landless, in a country where land cannot be bought at all
trackers.desc: START FROM WHAT TAJIK LAW ACTUALLY ALLOWS, BECAUSE IT DETERMINES EVERYTHING ELSE: land in the Republic of Tajikistan is the exclusive property of the state. There is no private land ownership to buy, so no land trust can acquire a threatened parcel and no community can purchase its way to safety. What people hold are use rights, land shares and dehkan farm certificates — and the whole contest is over who obtains and keeps those. Tajikistan is also among the most land-poor countries in the world, with arable land in the order of 720,000 hectares of which roughly 500,000 are irrigated, so pressure on every usable hectare is severe. THIS ORGANISATION WORKS ON EXACTLY THAT CONTEST: its stated purpose is achieving access to land for landless dehkans, alongside supporting diversified farming methods and conserving agrobiodiversity, with particular attention to the rights of women. Founded in 1999 by a group of women activists responding to the social and economic wreckage left by the collapse of the Soviet Union and the civil war, in which many women were left without husbands and many children without fathers. WHAT THAT MEANS PRACTICALLY: if a scheme is taking land in Tajikistan, the question is whose use right is being extinguished and whether it was lawfully obtained in the first place, and this is the body with two and a half decades of experience in exactly that question at village level. IT ALSO HAS A ROUTE INTO INTERNATIONAL SCRUTINY THAT MOST LOCAL ORGANISATIONS NEVER USE: it was among the Tajik organisations contributing to an NGO alternative report to the UN committee on discrimination against women. Shadow reporting to a treaty body is a forum outside the domestic system, and an organisation that has done it before knows the cycle and the deadlines. WHAT IT IS NOT: a litigator, a funder, or an environmental campaign group. Its frame is agricultural livelihoods and women's land rights rather than opposition to development projects, so approach it about tenure and evidence of use, not about stopping a permit. Pair it with the Aarhus centre network already recorded for Tajikistan, which is where the environmental documents sit. CURRENCY CAVEAT: the material reached on this organisation's own site is undated and the alternative report dates from 2006, so confirm that it is currently operating before relying on it — a caution this file has had to apply repeatedly in Central Asia.

trackers.name: CEPF Mountains of Central Asia — money that reaches community groups directly, in a country where almost nothing else does
trackers.desc: TAJIKISTAN HAS NO DOMESTIC ENVIRONMENTAL FUND IN THIS FILE AND NO INDEPENDENT ENVIRONMENTAL ORGANISATION THAT THIS CHAT COULD VERIFY, WHICH MAKES AN EXTERNAL FUND THAT GRANTS DIRECTLY TO COMMUNITY GROUPS UNUSUALLY IMPORTANT HERE. CEPF's eligible applicants are civil society organisations of every size — community groups, farmers' cooperatives, indigenous peoples' groups, universities, small businesses and non-governmental organisations. Small grants average about fifteen thousand US dollars and are administered by a regional implementation team based in or near the hotspot; grants above roughly twenty thousand are handled by the secretariat and average around a hundred and fifty thousand. THE ELIGIBILITY GATE IS THE ECOSYSTEM PROFILE: every project must link to one of the strategic directions it sets out, and CEPF targets Key Biodiversity Areas and corridors rather than administrative units, so the question is whether your valley falls inside a priority area, not which district it is in. INDIVIDUALS CANNOT APPLY DIRECTLY — they must work through a civil society organisation. In a country where land is the exclusive property of the state and community groups are often unregistered, that is the practical barrier to clear first; the Tajik organisation already recorded in this file works on exactly the tenure questions such a group will face. Calls open intermittently, usually for six to eight weeks, and small-grant applications begin with a short letter of inquiry by email which may be accepted in a specified local language. Funded jointly by the French Development Agency, Conservation International, the European Union, the Global Environment Facility, the Government of Japan and the World Bank. VERIFICATION CAVEAT, AND IT MATTERS BEFORE ANYONE SPENDS TIME: the Mountains of Central Asia hotspot is listed among those currently open, but neither its exact country composition nor the current call status was confirmed on cepf.net this round. Establish both from the ecosystem profile and the open calls page before building a plan on it.THERE IS TIMING NEWS THAT CHANGES WHEN TO APPLY: THE PROGRAMME REPORTS NEARLY ONE HUNDRED PROJECTS IN ITS FIRST PHASE AND A NEW PORTFOLIO STARTING IN 2026, under a fresh five-year programme WORTH UP TO EIGHT MILLION DOLLARS ACROSS THE FIVE COUNTRIES, with a regional implementation team being selected to run it. A NEW PORTFOLIO IS THE BEST MOMENT TO APPROACH ANY FUND. The strategy is being set, the priorities and eligible geographies are being written, and the first calls of a cycle are less contested than the last. FIND OUT WHICH ORGANISATION IS APPOINTED AS THE REGIONAL IMPLEMENTATION TEAM — that body handles applications, advises applicants and knows the pipeline, and building a relationship with it early is worth more than any single proposal. WHAT THE FUND HAS ACTUALLY BACKED IN THIS COUNTRY IS WORTH QUOTING BACK AT IT: WOMEN'S NETWORKS CONSERVING ENDANGERED TREES AND CROPS. That is a community-held, agriculture-linked, species-based project — not a scientific expedition — and it shows the shape of proposal that succeeds here. Elsewhere in the hotspot it has funded COMMUNITY RANGERS monitoring snow leopard and ADVOCACY FOR MICRO-RESERVES, the second of which this file records as a route to formal protection for a small area. ONE STRUCTURAL CHANGE MATTERS FOR EVERY COMMUNITY IN THIS MAP: THE FUND IS NOW ACTING AS EXECUTING AGENCY FOR A CONSERVATION ORGANISATION THAT IS BECOMING ONE OF TWO NEW IMPLEMENTING AGENCIES FOR THE GLOBAL SMALL GRANTS PROGRAMME — the mechanism this payload records separately in many countries for paying money directly to grassroots organisations. THE TWO ROUTES ARE CONVERGING, so a group known to one is likelier to be known to the other.WHAT ONE OF ITS GRANTS ACTUALLY ACHIEVED WAS NOT RECORDED HERE, AND IT IS THE SHORTEST PATH FROM MONEY TO PROTECTED LAND ANYWHERE IN THIS PAYLOAD: A PROJECT'S FINAL COMPLETION AND IMPACT REPORT RECORDS THAT, BY A GOVERNMENT DECISION OF THE EIGHTEENTH OF SEPTEMBER 2021, FIVE HECTARES OF LAND WERE TRANSFERRED INTO THE MANAGEMENT OF SPECIALLY PROTECTED NATURAL TERRITORIES TO CREATE AN ENCLOSURE FOR BREEDING BUKHARA DEER AND RESTORING PASTURE ECOSYSTEMS, ON THE TERRITORY OF A NAMED VILLAGE JURISDICTION IN A NAMED DISTRICT. FIVE HECTARES, A NAMED SPECIES, A VILLAGE JURISDICTION AND A DATED GOVERNMENT DECISION. THAT IS THE WHOLE MODEL IN ONE LINE, AND SMALL ENOUGH FOR ANY COMMUNITY IN THIS FILE TO ATTEMPT. THE ORDER OF EVENTS IS THE LESSON: THE GRANT PAID FOR THE WORK, THE WORK PRODUCED A CONCRETE PROPOSAL - AN ENCLOSURE FOR A NAMED ENDANGERED ANIMAL AND THE RESTORATION OF PASTURE - AND THE GOVERNMENT THEN MOVED THE LAND. A COMMUNITY ASKING FOR PROTECTION IN THE ABSTRACT IS REFUSED; ONE ARRIVING WITH A FUNDED PROJECT, A SPECIES, A BOUNDARY AND A PURPOSE IS OFFERING A GOVERNMENT SOMETHING TO ANNOUNCE. THE SAME PROJECT ALSO INSTALLED WIND GENERATORS TO PROVIDE ENERGY TO LOCAL COMMUNITIES — THE OTHER HALF OF WHY SUCH PROJECTS SUCCEED: THE VILLAGE GOT SOMETHING TOO. ONE TECHNIQUE FROM THE SAME COUNTRY IS WORTH PROPOSING WHEREVER SLOPES ARE ERODING: ON UNPRODUCTIVE SLOPES, ORCHARDS ARE BEING CREATED WHICH AT ONCE PROVIDE A HARVEST, HELP RETAIN MOISTURE AND PROTECT SETTLEMENTS FROM MUDFLOWS — A PROPOSAL THAT FITS AN AGRICULTURE, A DISASTER-PROTECTION OR A CLIMATE BUDGET, WHICHEVER IS OPEN.

trackers.name: Rufford Small Grants — Tajikistan is named eligible, and no registration is needed to apply
trackers.desc: TAJIKISTAN APPEARS ON THE FOUNDATION'S OWN ELIGIBILITY LIST, AND APPLICATIONS COME FROM INDIVIDUALS AND SMALL GROUPS. That matters in a country where land is the exclusive property of the state, where community groups are frequently unregistered, and where this file could verify only one independent organisation. THERE ARE NO DEADLINES — apply at any time of year. The focus is people early in a conservation career, especially current or recent MSc and PhD students; undergraduates are excluded. CHECK THE SPECIES TEST FIRST: work on any species not listed as Least Concern globally on the IUCN Red List qualifies, as does work on species not yet assessed but believed globally threatened. Threatened habitat, human-wildlife conflict and community education projects qualify with no species focus — relevant for pasture, juniper woodland and mountain water questions. STAGED FUNDING from up to £7,000 to about £18,000 across four grants, each requiring the previous to be finished and reported, with reports published on the applicant's page. One application per twelve months; a twelve-month wait after rejection; the foundation covers half to all of a project and wants evidence of any co-funding; no pure research without conservation benefit and no self-fundraised expeditions. READ IT ALONGSIDE THE TWO OTHER FUNDING ROUTES RECORDED HERE FOR TAJIKISTAN AND NOTE THE DIFFERENCE: the Central Asian hotspot fund and the small grants programme both work through organisations, and the small grants programme can fund an unregistered community group through a memorandum of agreement. This one funds a named individual. Between them, almost any configuration of applicant is covered.

trackers.name: Bureau on Human Rights and Rule of Law — free legal receptions in regional towns, in a country with no state legal aid system
trackers.desc: THE REASON THIS MATTERS MORE IN TAJIKISTAN THAN THE SAME KIND OF BODY WOULD ELSEWHERE IS STATED ON THE ORGANISATION'S OWN PAGES: there is at present no clearly established state system for providing free legal aid to those without means in Tajikistan. Elsewhere in this region a community can be pointed at a state scheme — Kazakhstan publishes its list of participating advocates annually, Armenia's public defender assigns one — and in Tajikistan there is no such list to be on. Non-governmental legal receptions are the route, not a supplement to one. AND IT RUNS THEM OUTSIDE THE CAPITAL, WHICH IS THE PRACTICAL POINT: it operates legal reception offices providing free legal assistance in regional towns, with receptions documented at Khujand and at Kanibadam in the north — the second of these reached by a woman with nowhere else to go on a neighbour's advice, which is how such an office is actually found. If your land is in Sughd rather than Dushanbe, there is somewhere to walk into. IT ALSO PRODUCED SOMETHING THIS FILE HAS FOUND ONLY TWICE ELSEWHERE IN CENTRAL ASIA: a mapping of the country's civil society organisations working on access to justice, women's empowerment and the rights of people with disabilities. In a country where this file could verify only one independent environmental organisation, a published map of who else exists and what they do is the fastest way to find a partner. Its wider record covers access to justice for journalists, the rights of prisoners and former prisoners, monitoring of closed institutions, and documented work on people at risk of statelessness and without papers in named districts of Sughd province — which is relevant to land because a person who cannot prove who they are cannot prove what they hold. Work has been supported through a United Nations development programme project on strengthening the rule of law. TWO LIMITS, BOTH STATED BY THE ORGANISATION ITSELF. Its resources will not stretch to everyone who needs them, because its work is funded by donor grants — approach early rather than late. And it is a human rights body, not an environmental one: nothing found shows it acting on a land or development case, so frame the matter as access to justice, documentation or administrative process rather than as ecology, which is the same framing this file has recorded for its counterparts in Armenia and Kyrgyzstan. For environmental documents in Tajikistan the Aarhus centre network recorded here is the companion, and on tenure the land-rights organisation already in this file.TWO POWERS THIS BUREAU AND OTHER LEGAL-AID PROVIDERS HOLD WERE NOT RECORDED HERE, AND EITHER IS WORTH MORE TO A VILLAGE THAN AN HOUR OF ADVICE. THE FIRST: THOSE PROVIDING LEGAL AID MAY REQUEST AND OBTAIN CERTIFICATES, CHARACTERISTICS AND OTHER RELEVANT DOCUMENTS FROM STATE BODIES, FROM THE SELF-GOVERNMENT BODIES OF SETTLEMENTS AND VILLAGES, FROM PUBLIC ASSOCIATIONS AND FROM OTHER LEGAL ENTITIES REGARDLESS OF THEIR FORM OF OWNERSHIP. THAT REACHES THE TWO PLACES A HOUSEHOLD CANNOT: THE VILLAGE COUNCIL THAT APPROVED THE LAND GRANT OR LEASE, AND THE COMPANY HOLDING IT. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED SEPARATELY THAT THE VILLAGE SELF-GOVERNMENT BODY DECIDES GRANTS, LEASES AND TERMINATIONS INSIDE SETTLEMENT BOUNDARIES — SO ASK THE BUREAU TO OBTAIN THE DECISION, THE LEASE AND THE MINUTES, NOT MERELY TO ADVISE ON THEM. THE SECOND IS ABOUT PERMANENCE: PROVIDERS MAY PREPARE PUBLIC ASSISTANTS AND INVOLVE THEM IN DELIVERING PRIMARY LEGAL AID, UNDER AN INSTRUCTION APPROVED BY THE AUTHORISED STATE BODY. A TRAINED LOCAL ASSISTANT IS THE CHEAPEST PERMANENT LEGAL CAPACITY A REMOTE VILLAGE EVER GETS, AND IT IS AN OFFICIALLY RECOGNISED ROLE RATHER THAN AN INFORMAL ONE. ASK WHETHER THE BUREAU IS TRAINING PUBLIC ASSISTANTS AND WHETHER SOMEONE FROM YOUR VILLAGE CAN BE ONE — IT OUTLASTS ANY SINGLE CASE. THE BUREAU ALSO SHAPES WHERE THE SYSTEM GOES NEXT: IT HAS RUN PUBLIC HEARINGS ON A DRAFT CONCEPT FOR FREE LEGAL AID IN FOUR PLACES — TWO PROVINCIAL CENTRES, A MOUNTAIN DISTRICT AND THE CAPITAL — WORKING ON CONSOLIDATING EXISTING MODELS, IDENTIFYING THE REGIONS MOST IN NEED FOR PILOTING, RAISING LEGAL LITERACY AND BUILDING PROVIDERS' CAPACITY. A CONSULTATION THAT CHOOSES PILOT REGIONS IS A RARE CHANCE TO PUT A DISTRICT ON A LIST. IF SUCH HEARINGS RUN AGAIN, ATTEND AND SAY WHICH CASES GO UNANSWERED WHERE YOU LIVE — LAND, WATER, INHERITANCE, EVICTION. AND WHEN AN OFFICE SAYS THERE IS NO MONEY FOR YOUR CASE, THE ANSWER IS IN THE FRAMEWORK ITSELF: THE STATE IS TO GUARANTEE THE NECESSARY FINANCING FOR LEGAL AID TO PEOPLE UNABLE TO PAY AND FOR AID PROVIDED FREE UNDER THE LAW.

trackers.name: Environmental Defender Law Center — it pays the expenses of a case, which matters most where no state legal aid exists
trackers.desc: THIS FILE RECORDS THAT TAJIKISTAN HAS NO CLEARLY ESTABLISHED STATE SYSTEM OF FREE LEGAL AID, AND THAT THE NON-GOVERNMENTAL LEGAL RECEPTIONS FILLING THAT GAP RUN ON DONOR GRANTS THAT WILL NOT STRETCH TO EVERYONE. THIS IS THE BODY THAT FUNDS THE CASE ITSELF. It created a grant programme in 2010 for expenses in public interest litigation against those responsible for resource development projects that harm the rights, health and environment of communities — on the explicit reasoning that such cases are relatively cheap to run in developing countries, that the small amounts needed are nonetheless decisive, and that money for a single case is extremely difficult or impossible to obtain from foundations. It calls its fund the only one of its type spanning the developing world, and has made around a hundred grants.
