ITS SUPPORT ALSO MAKES THE CASE POSSIBLE IN OTHER WAYS: it enlists law firms internationally to act without charge, screening cases from a lawyer's perspective first; it has access to expert networks and has obtained scientific assistance repeatedly; and it prepares briefs on the international human rights dimension designed to work alongside local lawyers arguing domestic law. Its stated objective is to help defenders influence or stop development projects that threaten a community's health, way of life and environment. USE IT WITH THE TAJIK BODIES ALREADY RECORDED HERE: the human rights bureau runs the legal receptions in the regions, and this can pay for what a case then costs. THE LIMITS: its remit is developing countries; it selects cases of international significance where a legal strategy can be replicated; and no work of its own in Tajikistan or this region could be established. Approach it as an untested route rather than an established one.

trackers.name: ANCOT — community conservancies that hold the land themselves, pay their own rangers from it, and federated when outsiders came for it
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE CLOSEST THING IN CENTRAL ASIA TO COMMUNITIES SIMPLY HOLDING THEIR OWN LAND. Since 2008, wildlife management areas have been established that are held and protected by LOCAL FAMILIES OR ASSOCIATIONS OF LOCAL HUNTERS themselves, and this association is the umbrella those conservancies formed. Its stated work is supporting conservancy managers in the conservation and sustainable use of their wildlife, PASTURES, FORESTS, MOUNTAINS and other natural resources — not a wildlife project bolted onto a village but the village holding the ground. THE MONEY MODEL IS THE PART THAT MAKES IT LAST, AND IT REQUIRES NO DONOR: revenue from guided hiking, wildlife watching, photography and strictly regulated hunting PAYS THE LOCAL RANGERS AND GUIDES, and surpluses go into local development projects. A conservancy funds its own enforcement out of its own ground. AND IT USES THE SAME CONVERSION THIS FILE RECORDED ON THE TURKISH COAST: local EX-HUNTERS are the ones who stop poaching, by community members and outsiders alike. The people best placed to take the wildlife are the people paid to protect it. NOW THE WARNING, AND IT IS WHY THE UMBRELLA EXISTS AT ALL: these conservancies were not threatened by a government or a developer but BY THEIR OWN SUCCESS. Economically powerful holders of hunting concessions elsewhere in the country, together with international marketing agents, moved in on community conservation as a lucrative business — diverting the economic benefit away from the rural families who had built it, and putting the traditional management system at risk. Small family businesses could not resist that alone, so the conservancies grouped to create a stronger front. If your community arrangement starts working, expect people with more money to arrive wanting to run it, and federate before they do. WHY IT EXISTS RATHER THAN THE STATE DOING THIS: research on the region records that protected areas, national parks and the forestry committee lack the resources for adequate wildlife management, so communities carry it. Management combines traditional hunters with scientific experts, with yearly surveys of mountain ungulates. It also advises non-governmental organisations, small family businesses and communities on GOVERNANCE AND INSTITUTIONAL QUESTIONS, including how to invest proceeds — which is precisely the skill a community that suddenly has income needs. THE LIMITS, INCLUDING ONE FROM INSIDE: it is built around regulated hunting and tourism revenue, which some readers will reject outright; it works in the Pamirs and mountain districts rather than nationally; and independent research on these conservancies records real internal governance problems, including a leader who gave unclear direction and favoured a few rangers over others. A community joining this model should ask how each conservancy is governed, not assume the model guarantees fairness. Renamed from an earlier acronym in January 2019.

trackers.name: ProtectDefenders.eu — urgent protection money where there is no state legal aid to fall back on
trackers.desc: ONE OF ITS THREE CRITERIA IS THAT LACK OF ACCESS TO ALTERNATIVE SOURCES OF SUPPORT IS EXPRESSLY TAKEN INTO ACCOUNT — which is the strongest thing a Tajik applicant has to say, because this file records that Tajikistan has no clearly established state system of free legal aid at all, and that the non-governmental legal receptions filling that gap run on donor grants that will not stretch to everyone. Say that plainly in the request. The other two criteria are that you are a defender working for human rights consistent with the United Nations declaration, and that you face risk because of that work. A PERSON CAN ASK ALONE: there are separate request channels for individuals and for organisations, so no registered body is needed behind an individual applicant — and correspondence is accepted officially in Russian as well as English, French, Spanish and Arabic, through a 24/7 helpline and an encrypted contact form. THE SUMS ARE MODEST AND FAST RATHER THAN LARGE: emergency grants up to €10,000, averaging around €3,000, rolling with no deadline, covering urgent protection measures — for organisations, capacity building, psychosocial support, security, advocacy training and emergency relocation, with scope to propose other measures. BEFORE ACCEPTING ANYTHING, NOTE ITS OWN WARNING: payment may come by bank transfer or Western Union and WILL SHOW ProtectDefenders.eu AS THE SOURCE, and the mechanism asks recipients to consider the security implications of that and raise them with the secretariat. In a country where independent legal help is scarce and donor funding is visible, that is not a formality. ITS RELOCATION PROGRAMME PREFERS MOVING A DEFENDER WITHIN THEIR OWN COUNTRY OR SUB-REGION where possible, so they can continue working, paying a host organisation to implement it for up to a year and never the full cost. THE LIMITS: the mechanism states it cannot support every defender in need and points elsewhere for those it cannot; its secretariat routes requests to partner organisations rather than assessing grant forms itself; and no case of its own in Tajikistan could be established. Use it with the human rights bureau recorded here, which runs the regional legal receptions and would be the local body able to corroborate a request.

trackers.name: Little Earth — it works with unregistered initiative groups, not only with registered organisations
trackers.desc: THE PHRASE THAT MATTERS IS INITIATIVE GROUPS. It states that it cooperates with public organisations AND INITIATIVE GROUPS and supplies environmental information to the wider public, with the declared aim of increasing the role and degree of public participation in environmental questions. In a country where this file has established that there is no clearly established state system of free legal aid, that land is the exclusive property of the state, and that only one independent conservation organisation could be verified, a body that will work with a group of villagers who have registered nothing is a scarce thing. IT GOES TO THE PLACES THAT ARE HARDEST TO REACH: more than twenty-five years of work on education, energy and climate with the most remote and vulnerable communities, including villages inside the buffer zone of a nature reserve, where it has demonstrated resource-saving equipment to residents. Buffer-zone villages are exactly the population this file has recorded elsewhere as deciding whether a protected area holds. AND IT SPREADS METHOD RATHER THAN HOLDING IT: by its own account dozens of organisations have taken up not only its publications, consultations and assistance but its ideas, running similar projects and adopting the equipment it distributes and the practices it introduces — so a community that cannot get its direct involvement can still ask for the publications and the approach. VOLUNTEERING IS OPEN TO ANYONE regardless of sex, age, nationality or religious belief, which is the practical way in for a person with time rather than money. Founded by a group of young activists, based in Dushanbe, a member of an international socio-ecological union, with a named senior adviser. Its work with women in a remote valley was recognised by an international climate award in 2024, and it took a national civil society prize the same year in an education category. THE LIMIT, STATED PLAINLY: THIS IS NOT AN OBJECTOR. Nothing found shows it opposing a project, bringing a case or representing a community against a scheme. Approach it for environmental information, for participation support, for practical equipment and methods, and because it will engage with an unregistered group — and use the Aarhus centres recorded here for formal environmental information requests, the land-rights organisation for tenure, and the human rights bureau for a lawyer.A CORRECTION BELONGS HERE, BECAUSE THIS FILE GOT SOMETHING WRONG ABOUT THIS COUNTRY. A LATER ROUND RECORDED THAT NO INDEPENDENT ENVIRONMENTAL OR LEGAL-AID ORGANISATION COULD BE FOUND HERE. THAT WAS FALSE TWICE OVER: ONE EXISTS, AND IT WAS ALREADY IN THIS FILE — THIS ENTRY. THE SEARCH THAT FAILED LOOKED BY CATEGORY; A SEARCH BY NAME FOUND IT AT ONCE. WHAT THE ORIGINAL ENTRY DID NOT RECORD IS HOW LONG THIS BODY HAS LASTED AND WHAT IT IS RECOGNISED FOR. IT HAS SPENT MORE THAN TWENTY-FIVE YEARS INTRODUCING SUSTAINABLE AND INCLUSIVE SOLUTIONS AND PRACTICES IN EDUCATION, ENERGY AND CLIMATE, WORKING WITH THE MOST REMOTE AND VULNERABLE COMMUNITIES IN THE COUNTRY. TWENTY-FIVE YEARS IN A PLACE WHERE INDEPENDENT ORGANISING IS DIFFICULT IS THE MEASURE THAT MATTERS. AN ORGANISATION THAT HAS SURVIVED THAT LONG KNOWS WHAT CAN AND CANNOT BE DONE, AND A COMMUNITY IS SAFER TAKING ITS ADVICE ON HOW TO PROCEED THAN GUESSING. IT HAS BEEN RECOGNISED TWICE RECENTLY AND BOTH AWARDS TELL YOU SOMETHING USABLE. IT WON THE FIRST 3ZERO AWARD EVER HELD IN THE COUNTRY, IN THE EDUCATION FOR ALL CATEGORY, AT A CEREMONY IN THE CAPITAL IN MAY 2024 ATTENDED BY CIVIL SOCIETY, THE PRIVATE SECTOR AND INTERNATIONAL ORGANISATIONS. AND IT WON THE GENDER JUST CLIMATE SOLUTIONS AWARD FOR 2024, PRESENTED AT THE UNITED NATIONS CLIMATE CONFERENCE THAT NOVEMBER, FOR A PROJECT WITH THE WOMEN OF A NAMED MOUNTAIN VALLEY — AN AWARD GIVEN TO GROUPS FIGHTING THE EFFECTS OF CLIMATE CHANGE WHILE ADVANCING GENDER EQUALITY. THE SECOND AWARD IS THE MORE USEFUL ONE TO KNOW ABOUT. A PROJECT BUILT AROUND THE WOMEN OF ONE VALLEY WON INTERNATIONAL RECOGNITION — WHICH MEANS THE ORGANISATION HAS A PROVEN ROUTE FOR TURNING WHAT HAPPENS IN A SINGLE REMOTE VALLEY INTO SOMETHING VISIBLE FAR BEYOND IT. FOR A COMMUNITY THAT NOBODY IS LISTENING TO, THAT IS THE CAPABILITY WORTH ASKING FOR. IT KEEPS A PHYSICAL PRESENCE IN THE CAPITAL WITH PUBLISHED CONTACT DETAILS AND WORKING HOURS, AND ITS OWN SITE STATES PLAINLY THAT VOLUNTEER LABOUR IS A PRICELESS CONTRIBUTION TO ENVIRONMENTAL WORK AND INVITES READERS TO JOIN ITS ACTIONS AND CAMPAIGNS. ONE FURTHER LEAD, UNVERIFIED: A YOUTH ECOLOGICAL CENTRE WITH ITS OWN SITE ALSO EXISTS IN THIS COUNTRY. THIS FILE HAS NOT CHECKED IT, AND IT IS NOTED ONLY SO THAT THE NEXT PERSON DOES NOT REPEAT THE MISTAKE OF CONCLUDING THAT NOTHING IS HERE.

trackers.name: Youth Ecological Centre — it builds rural communities' capacity on land, water and energy use
trackers.desc: ITS SUBJECT IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS MOST HERE: it works with RURAL COMMUNITIES, NATURAL RESOURCE USERS, FARMERS, young people and teachers, and promotes building the capacity of rural communities in the SUSTAINABLE USE OF LAND, WATER AND ENERGY RESOURCES. This file has established that all land in Tajikistan is the exclusive property of the state and that the contest is therefore over use rights rather than ownership — which makes a body whose stated work is the capacity of resource users to manage land and water the most directly relevant Tajik organisation recorded so far. IT IS ALSO OLD AND CONSTITUTED, WHICH MATTERS IN A COUNTRY WITH ALMOST NO INDEPENDENT ORGANISATIONS: founded in 1997 by teachers, scientists and students as a republican public socio-ecological organisation, with a published address and a working news feed. IT RUNS A YOUTH ARM PRODUCING MATERIAL FOR SCHOOLCHILDREN whose stated purpose is to strengthen the position and influence of the environmental movement — a body thinking in terms of movement-building rather than projects is one worth a long relationship. USE IT WITH THE OTHER TAJIK ENTRIES RATHER THAN INSTEAD OF THEM: the Aarhus centres for formal environmental information, the land rights organisation for tenure and dehkan certificates, the community conservancy federation for land actually held by families, the human rights bureau for a lawyer, and the environmental organisation recorded alongside this one for work with unregistered initiative groups. Between them those five cover information, tenure, holding, legal help and organising. THE LIMIT: nothing found shows it opposing a project, bringing a case or representing a community against a scheme. It is a capacity and education body; approach it for the practical management questions that decide whether a use right is defensible, not for a fight. DOMAIN NOTE: an older site on a free hosting service still describes itself as this organisation's official site. Use the address given here; the older one appears to be a legacy.

trackers.name: Whitley Fund for Nature — £50,000 to a named leader, then up to £100,000 more if it works
trackers.desc: IT FUNDS A PERSON, NOT AN ORGANISATION, AND IT IS THE LARGEST SUCH ROUTE IN THIS FILE. An award is worth £50,000 in project funding over one year, and the application must SPECIFY A LEADER OF THE TEAM who would receive it. That matters here because this payload has recorded that Tajik community conservancies are held by families and hunters' associations and turn on named individuals — and because the other funds recorded for this country are small grants, typically under twenty thousand dollars. This is the tier above them. AND IT IS LADDERED RATHER THAN ONE-OFF: previous winners who completed their grant may apply for CONTINUATION FUNDING OF UP TO £100,000 over one or two years, and a further award worth £60,000 exists for outstanding past winners. Around fifty-five per cent of previous award winners have gone on to win continuation funding. A single successful application can therefore be the start of several years of support, which is what a conservancy needs and almost nothing else offers. WHO QUALIFIES: mid-career conservationists who are NATIONALS OF THE COUNTRY WHERE THEY WORK, leading grassroots projects, working for or leading a LOCALLY INCORPORATED ORGANISATION — expressly not in-country staff of a body headquartered in a developed country. Eligible countries are those not classified as high-income economies, which includes this one. TWO REQUIREMENTS DECIDE MOST APPLICATIONS AND ARE WORTH PREPARING FOR EARLY. The project must involve communities at grassroots level and deliver practical action FOUNDED ON SCIENCE — so the survey and monitoring work this file records elsewhere is not a separate task but part of the application. And the fund expects to supply a SIGNIFICANT SHARE OF THE PROJECT COST, around thirty per cent or more, so a realistic total budget matters as much as the request. It also asks applicants to have thought carefully about the INDICATORS that will evidence impact. THE PROCESS IS SLOW AND SERIOUS: annual competitive rounds closing in the autumn, screening by an expert academic panel, international reference checks, and interviews with finalists before selection. Since 1993 it has given around £23 million to some two hundred leaders across eighty countries. THE LIMITS: it funds wildlife and ecosystem conservation, not opposition — it will not pay for a campaign, a lawyer or an objection, and a project framed as stopping a development will not fit. Frame the conservation work; the protection follows from it.

trackers.name: Ferghana Valley community adaptation grants — Sughd organisations eligible, applications in Tajik
trackers.desc: ORGANISATIONS REGISTERED IN SUGHD PROVINCE ARE NAMED AS ELIGIBLE. A regional water body's scientific centre has published terms of reference to select EIGHT LOCAL NON-GOVERNMENTAL NON-PROFIT ORGANISATIONS to plan and deliver sub-projects on LOCAL ADAPTATION TO CLIMATE CHANGE WITH LOCAL COMMUNITIES in the Ferghana Valley, open to bodies registered in Sughd alongside named provinces of two neighbouring countries. This file has recorded that this country's community land holding runs through conservancies and family-held rights in the mountains; this is a funding route addressed to the northern valley instead, and it is province-specific rather than national. APPLICATIONS ARE ACCEPTED IN TAJIK, RUSSIAN, UZBEK OR KYRGYZ — NOT ENGLISH, which removes the barrier that quietly excludes local bodies from most international funding. THE BAR IS HIGHER THAN REGISTRATION: at least THREE COMPLETED environment or climate projects at local or community level in the past ten years, and experience developing training programmes, materials or guides. A CONSORTIUM OF TWO ORGANISATIONS IS ALLOWED PROVIDED THE LEAD IS REGISTERED IN AN ELIGIBLE PROVINCE — so a community group without a track record should partner with an established organisation rather than apply alone. IT ALSO TELLS YOU WHAT A FUNDED PROPOSAL CONTAINS: a design and methodology covering how target groups and beneficiaries are selected and how BASELINE AND FINAL ASSESSMENTS are conducted, plus a monitoring and evaluation plan submitted for approval. That is the standard most serious funders apply without stating it. THE LIMITS: an interstate water coordination body's scientific centre is not an advocate and will not oppose a scheme; its subject is water and adaptation. THE CURRENT STATUS OF THIS PARTICULAR CALL WAS NOT ESTABLISHED, so treat the mechanism as the finding — the body publishes its tender and grant documents on its own releases pages, which is where the next round will appear.

trackers.name: Mapeo — offline mapping that turns community rangers into a monitoring system
trackers.desc: THIS FILE RECORDED THAT COMMUNITY CONSERVANCIES HERE HOLD THE LAND THEMSELVES AND FUND THEIR OWN RANGERS. THIS IS WHAT PUTS A RECORD IN THOSE RANGERS' HANDS. A free offline app on which one button captures a GPS POINT, A PHOTOGRAPH AND A NOTE — no internet, no special hardware, and data synchronised DIRECTLY BETWEEN PHONES rather than through any server. A ranger who walks a boundary anyway becomes, with a phone, a monitoring system producing dated georeferenced evidence of incursion, cutting, grazing or construction. THE COMMUNITY OWNS EVERYTHING IT COLLECTS. Storage is decentralised on the devices, and a version built with a United Nations conservation centre and a forest peoples' organisation lets custodian communities submit records to global conservation registries ONLY VOLUNTARILY AND ONLY AFTER THEIR OWN FREE, PRIOR AND INFORMED CONSENT PROCESS. For a body that holds land without a title deed, a self-owned record is the asset. ITS STATED PURPOSES ARE THIS MAP'S PURPOSES: documenting so that a community can act, REPORT INFORMATION TO AUTHORITIES, FILE LAWSUITS, run media campaigns, or MAKE MAPS FOR LAND CLAIMS. An indigenous nation in South America used it over four years to build the territorial evidence with which they defeated an oil development in court. IT IS LEARNABLE IN HOURS by someone who has never used a smartphone; the desktop version produces PRINTED AND PDF REPORTS and exports to standard mapping formats, so the record can go to a lawyer, a ministry or a court in a form they accept. THE LIMITS: it is software rather than an organisation, customisation with your own categories and offline maps requires technical support, and its listed interface languages do not currently include Russian, Tajik or others of this region — although it can be translated into any language. The organisation behind it now appears under a changed name; verify the current source before downloading. Pair it with the satellite tools recorded elsewhere in this file: those show what changed from above, this records what is there on the ground.

trackers.name: Commissioner for Human Rights — an online reception and an address, and little else established
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE THINNEST ENTRY IN THIS COUNTRY'S LISTING AND YOU SHOULD KNOW THAT BEFORE RELYING ON IT. Three separate searches established two things: the office exists with A STREET ADDRESS IN THE CAPITAL, and it operates an INTERNET RECEPTION — an online channel for submitting an appeal — both published through a regional alliance of ombudsman institutions. WHAT AN ONLINE RECEPTION IS WORTH: it removes the journey to the capital, which for a mountain district is the practical barrier rather than the law. This file has recorded for this country conservancies, a women's land organisation, a rights bureau offering free receptions and an environmental network; none of them is a state institution able to look at an administrative decision. WHAT IS NOT ESTABLISHED, AND IT IS ALMOST EVERYTHING: whether it can go to court, whether an organisation may complain for an affected household, whether the complainant's name is protected, whether it reaches violations that predate it, whether it has representatives outside the capital, and what it may demand from a state body. Those six questions were answered for the equivalent institutions in three neighbouring countries recorded in this file, and the answers differed sharply — one can obtain documents from state bodies and other organisations and convene joint meetings with officials present; another can propose disciplinary or criminal proceedings against an official. ASK THIS OFFICE THE SAME QUESTIONS BEFORE DECIDING WHAT TO SEND IT, and note that the regional alliance page is a directory of state institutions rather than an endorsement of any of them. THE HONEST SUMMARY: an address and an online form, in a country where this map otherwise offers no domestic institution that examines administrative decisions. That is worth something and it is not worth much. Pair it with the rights bureau and the free legal reception recorded separately here, which are the bodies that can help draft what you send.

trackers.name: Lifeline — the grant to seek before trouble starts, and the one for when it has
trackers.desc: ASK FOR THE PREVENTIVE GRANT FIRST. Its RESILIENCY grants exist to help organisations at high risk avoid or reduce the threats they face, and the eligible activities include MAPPING AND COORDINATING CIVIL SOCIETY ACCESS TO PRO BONO SERVICES, developing protection networks and local support mechanisms, joint protection strategies and contingency plans, organisational risk assessments, protection training and LEGAL TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE. This file has recorded for this country conservancies, a women's land organisation, a rights bureau and an ombudsman reachable only through an online form. WHAT IT HAS NEVER RECORDED IS MONEY TO BUILD THE LIST OF LAWYERS WHO WOULD ACT, BEFORE ANYONE NEEDS ONE. That is exactly what this window pays for. AND IF SOMETHING HAS ALREADY HAPPENED, THE EMERGENCY GRANT COVERS LEGAL REPRESENTATION, TRIAL MONITORING, PRISON VISITS, medical expenses, security, temporary relocation and equipment replacement. THE QUALIFYING TEST IS BROAD ENOUGH TO REACH LAND DISPUTES: need, urgency, and whether the organisation faces significant security risks, loss of property or equipment, injury or imprisonment of staff, OR PROSECUTION OR OTHER LEGAL PROCEEDINGS. A THIRD WINDOW, RAPID RESPONSE ADVOCACY, CAN FUND STRATEGIC LITIGATION, coalition building and campaigns — which is a different and rarer thing from a project grant. Requests are handled through a consortium of seven international organisations, with two of them receiving emergency applications directly and a third forwarding them on. THE LIMITS. IT FUNDS ORGANISATIONS RATHER THAN INDIVIDUALS OR INFORMAL GROUPS, so a village committee without registration will usually need an established organisation to apply alongside it — the pasture committees, the women's land organisation and the environmental network recorded separately for this country are the obvious candidates. It excludes core costs, programme costs, long-term support and financial hardship. And it is financed by donor governments, which in some settings makes the association itself a consideration — weigh that before applying.

trackers.name: Accountability Console — every complaint ever filed about internationally financed projects, and what came of them
trackers.desc: BEFORE COMPLAINING ABOUT A FINANCED PROJECT, READ WHAT HAPPENED TO EVERYONE WHO ALREADY DID. This database holds EVERY COMPLAINT EVER FILED to the accountability offices of bilateral and multilateral development finance institutions, searchable and comparable ACROSS INSTITUTIONS, SECTORS AND REGIONS. Large infrastructure here is financed internationally, and every one of those financiers maintains an office that receives complaints from affected people. IT ANSWERS THE QUESTION THIS MAP KEEPS RAISING WITHOUT SETTLING: WHAT CAN A COMPLAINT ACTUALLY ACHIEVE? It sets out achievable outcomes, the limitations, and how the process differs between mechanisms — and it gives access to DOCUMENTS FROM COMPLAINTS THAT LED TO RESULTS, and to WHICH GROUPS TO CONSULT FOR ADVICE. AND THE WARNING SITS IN ITS OWN DATA, WHICH IS WHY IT IS WORTH READING FIRST: TOO FEW COMPLAINTS GET THROUGH THE SYSTEM AND ACHIEVE A RESULT, AND A HIGH NUMBER ARE CLOSED WITHOUT ANY OUTCOME BECAUSE THEY WERE RULED INELIGIBLE. Its creators call that the eligibility bottleneck. MOST CASES DIE AT THE DOOR RATHER THAN ON THE MERITS — so the effort goes into meeting the eligibility rules of the specific mechanism, and the database lets you compare those rules side by side and produce a comparison. START WITH ITS COMPLAINT PATHFINDER, which walks through the options and helps build a strategy before committing to a route. THE COST IS ARRANGED SO THAT MONEY IS NOT THE BARRIER: any member of the public may view the complaints list and the mechanisms' policies, and premium access is charged ON A SLIDING SCALE WITH THE FEE WAIVED FOR USERS ON A LIMITED BUDGET — but you have to ask for the waiver. THE LIMITS: it covers INTERNATIONALLY FINANCED projects, so a scheme funded wholly from domestic or state sources falls outside it; and it is a research and strategy tool rather than representation — nobody there files for you. Its own creators put it best: it is a tool for filing complaints, and possibly a tool for avoiding the need to file one. Use it with the emergency and legal empowerment funds recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Land Acquisition Fund — it pays local organisations to buy or lease land, and to get community rights recognised
trackers.desc: IT PAYS FOR LAND TO BE SECURED, WHICH IS THE FIRST THING THIS MAP IS ASKED FOR AND THE THING IT CAN OFFER LEAST OFTEN. The fund enables local nature organisations to secure important habitat BY PURCHASE OR LONG-TERM LEASE, it has safeguarded more than SIXTY-FOUR THOUSAND HECTARES since 2001, and it CALLS ON LOCAL CONSERVATION ORGANISATIONS WORLDWIDE TO SUBMIT PROPOSALS. AND ITS RECENT WORK INCLUDES EXACTLY THE SITUATION THIS COUNTRY IS IN. It supported a snow leopard conservation organisation to help TWO HERDING COMMUNITIES RECOGNISE AND MANAGE OVER THIRTY THOUSAND HECTARES — giving those communities THE RIGHTS THEY NEED to protect the biodiversity and natural resources of those areas. That is not a purchase; it is a fund for acquiring land paying instead for COMMUNITY RIGHTS TO BE RECOGNISED over pasture. This file has recorded here pasture users, conservancies, a women's land organisation and mountain communities whose problem is precisely that their use of high ground is not secured in law. THIS IS A FUNDER THAT HAS PAID FOR THAT ELSEWHERE. ITS ARGUMENT FOR SMALL SITES IS WORTH BORROWING WHEN YOU WRITE: the strategic acquisition of SMALL PATCHES of land is targeted and cost-effective, because A FEW HECTARES CAN CREATE A CORRIDOR between two isolated areas. Almost every other conservation funder recorded in this payload is oriented to large landscapes and thirty-per-cent targets; this one says explicitly that smaller projects at crucial locations are not to be overlooked, and that they sit on the frontline. HOW IT WORKS: proposals are invited from local NGOs and civil society organisations, new land purchase and long-term lease projects are selected each year through a stated selection procedure, and the fund is supported by private donors. It has entered new countries recently, so absence of a previous project here is not a bar. It has also produced, with a bird conservation partner, practical guidelines for people MANAGING privately protected reserves — which is the part communities usually discover too late, after the land is secured and nobody has planned who maintains it. THE LIMITS. IT FUNDS ORGANISATIONS, NOT INDIVIDUALS OR UNREGISTERED COMMITTEES — the applicant must be a local conservation NGO or CSO, so a community here would apply through the conservancies association or an environmental organisation recorded separately in this file. Selection is annual and competitive. Its purpose is BIODIVERSITY HABITAT, so a case must be made in terms of species and ecosystems rather than livelihood alone — though the herding-communities project shows the two can be argued together.

trackers.name: Small Grants Programme — money paid straight to a community organisation, decided in your own country
trackers.desc: THIS PAYLOAD HOLDS MORE THAN NINETY FUNDING ENTRIES AND ALMOST ALL OF THEM PAY AN ESTABLISHED ORGANISATION TO WORK WITH A COMMUNITY. THIS ONE MAKES GRANTS DIRECTLY TO COMMUNITY-BASED ORGANISATIONS AND NGOs — the money goes to the group itself. Regular grants run UP TO SEVENTY-FIVE THOUSAND DOLLARS, strategic projects UP TO ONE HUNDRED AND FIFTY THOUSAND, and the usual range is twenty-five to fifty thousand. ITS FOCAL AREAS PUT LAND AND WATER AT THE CENTRE: biodiversity; climate change mitigation and adaptation; LAND DEGRADATION AND SUSTAINABLE FOREST MANAGEMENT; INTERNATIONAL WATERS; and chemicals. A proposal about pasture degradation, a threatened forest, a shared river or a contaminated site is squarely inside the programme rather than a stretch. AND IT IS DECIDED WHERE YOU LIVE. The programme runs through a NATIONAL COORDINATOR and a multistakeholder NATIONAL STEERING COMMITTEE: applications are screened for eligibility, reviewed technically, shortlisted, and then considered by that committee, which recommends; selected applicants are invited to submit full proposals. The people deciding are in the country, they can be met, and the committee's composition is worth knowing before you write. THE TRACK RECORD IS THE ANSWER TO ANYONE WHO SAYS THIS IS UNREALISTIC: over eight hundred and thirty-eight million dollars to MORE THAN THIRTY THOUSAND COMMUNITY-LED INITIATIVES ACROSS 127 COUNTRIES, with a further nine hundred and ninety million mobilised as co-finance. IT ALSO GIVES SPECIAL CONSIDERATION TO INDIGENOUS PEOPLES, WOMEN, YOUTH AND PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES, and delivers a dedicated initiative supporting INDIGENOUS AND COMMUNITY-CONSERVED TERRITORIES — which is the funding counterpart to the community-conserved area route recorded separately in this file. TIMING MATTERS RIGHT NOW: in this region the programme is being executed for 2026 to 2028 by a regional conservation fund already recorded in this country's listing, with AT LEAST ONE CALL FOR PROPOSALS PER COUNTRY IN 2026 AND IN 2027. Find the country programme and the coordinator before the call opens, not after. THE LIMITS. THE APPLICANT MUST BE AN ORGANISATION — a community-based organisation counts, which is broader than most funders allow, but an unconstituted group of neighbours does not. CO-FINANCING IS NORMALLY EXPECTED, often around half, THOUGH IT MAY BE IN KIND — labour, land access, materials and volunteer time can count, and that is the difference between impossible and possible. The framing must be environmental: a proposal that reads as opposition to one project will not fit, while one that reads as protecting a pasture, forest or watershed will.

trackers.name: Regional directory of conservation organisations — find the domestic body that already works on your landscape
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY'S LISTING IN THIS MAP HELD EIGHTEEN ENTRIES — FUNDING WINDOWS, LEGAL AID, MAPPING TOOLS, HUMAN RIGHTS OFFICES, COMMUNITY CONSERVANCIES — AND NOT ONE NAMED DOMESTIC CONSERVATION ORGANISATION. This directory lists them BY COUNTRY across five Central Asian states, all five of which appear in this map and all five of which are thinly covered in it. THE BODY IT LEADS TO HERE IS A NATURE FOUNDATION WHOSE STATED MISSION IS THE ONE A COMMUNITY WANTS TO HEAR: to advance conservation BY STRENGTHENING THE LINK BETWEEN NATURE AND LOCAL LIVELIHOODS, AND BY EXPANDING COMMUNITIES' CAPACITY TO USE THEIR OWN NATURAL RESOURCES RATIONALLY — conserving wildlife and WILD LANDSCAPES for future generations. That is conservation defined through the people who live there rather than against them, which is the difference between an organisation that will work with a village and one that will fence it out. WHAT IT ACTUALLY DOES: WILDLIFE PROTECTION, RESEARCH, MONITORING, WORK WITH PROTECTED AREAS, AND ENVIRONMENTAL EDUCATION, focused on named mountain sheep. AND IT RAN A PROGRAMME ON SUPPORTING PRIVATE SECTOR AND COMMUNITY CONSERVATION FROM 2020 TO 2024, funded through a major ecosystem partnership fund — so it has experience of putting money and management into community hands rather than only studying animals. WHY THE DIRECTORY MATTERS MORE THAN ANY SINGLE ENTRY IN IT: THE FIRST PROBLEM A COMMUNITY IN THIS REGION FACES IS NOT ARGUMENT OR MONEY BUT KNOWING WHO EXISTS. A list of domestic organisations, arranged by country and describing what each works on, answers the question this file has struggled to answer for five countries at once. WORK THROUGH IT FOR THE ONE THAT ALREADY WORKS ON YOUR SPECIES, YOUR VALLEY OR YOUR PROTECTED AREA, because an organisation with an existing programme where you live is worth more than a larger one elsewhere. AND THERE IS EVIDENCE THAT THIS APPROACH WORKS AT SCALE: a regional review records conservation work at named key biodiversity sites across three countries which STRENGTHENED THE CAPACITY OF SIX LOCAL ORGANISATIONS, produced management plans and improved local knowledge of valuable species. The same review states that the role of civil organisations IN ENVIRONMENTAL ASSESSMENTS, IMPACT ASSESSMENT AND PUBLIC HEARINGS ON INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECTS is important and is underpinned by the Aarhus treaty — which this map records as being in force across the region. THE LIMITS: a directory is only as current as its last update, and entries here describe missions rather than confirming activity this year — verify before relying on any listing. The organisations are conservation bodies, not lawyers or land buyers; they will survey, monitor, train and sometimes co-manage, but they will not litigate. And civil society in this country operates under tight registration requirements, so approach through an existing programme rather than proposing something new.

trackers.name: Farmer household land rights — lifetime inheritable use, obtainable without forming a company
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY'S LISTING HELD CONSERVATION GROUPS, FUNDS, LEGAL AID AND A MAPPING TOOL AND NEVER EXPLAINED HOW A FAMILY ACTUALLY HOLDS LAND. THE ANSWER IS THE FARMER HOUSEHOLD, AND THE RIGHT IT CARRIES IS STRONGER THAN MOST PEOPLE REALISE: LAND IS GRANTED FOR IT IN LIFETIME INHERITABLE USE, BY DECISION OF THE DISTRICT EXECUTIVE BODY, ON THE CITIZENS' OWN APPLICATION. IT PASSES TO THE CHILDREN. AND IT REQUIRES NO COMPANY. CITIZENS MAY CREATE A FARMER HOUSEHOLD WITHOUT FORMING A LEGAL PERSON AT ALL — by one person, by one family, or by a group of persons — and any legally capable citizen may create one. THIS FILE HAS SPENT HUNDREDS OF ENTRIES ON THE PROBLEM THAT COMMUNITIES CANNOT HOLD ANYTHING WITHOUT INCORPORATING. HERE THEY CAN. THE APPLICATION IS SPECIFIC AND SHOULD BE PREPARED CAREFULLY, BECAUSE WHAT YOU WRITE FIXES WHAT YOU GET: IT MUST STATE THE PURPOSE OF USE, THE INTENDED SIZE AND LOCATION OF THE PLOT, THE TOTAL NUMBER OF FAMILY MEMBERS, AND, WHERE THE LAND IS LEASED, THE TERM. It goes to the district or city executive body where the plot lies. AND THE LAW EXPRESSLY COVERS PEOPLE MOVING IN FROM OTHER DISTRICTS FOR PERMANENT RESIDENCE — so a returning or relocating family is inside the scheme, not outside it. WHO COUNTS AS A MEMBER MATTERS FOR WHAT EACH PERSON ENDS UP HOLDING: parents, spouses, children and other able-bodied people working jointly are members, BUT SOMEONE WORKING AS A HIRED EMPLOYEE UNDER AN EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT IS NOT. And where the household has no legal personality, THE REGISTRATION DOCUMENTS MUST SHOW EACH MEMBER'S LAND SHARE IN THE COMMON PLOT, with a joint-activity contract setting out rights and duties. GET THE SHARES WRITTEN DOWN AT THE START — that document is what protects a daughter, a widow or a departing brother years later. AND HERE IS THE PROTECTION PEOPLE LOSE SIMPLY BY NOT KNOWING IT EXISTS: CITIZENS WHO RECEIVE A PLOT FOR A FARMER HOUSEHOLD AND WHO HAVE A DWELLING IN A RURAL SETTLEMENT RETAIN THEIR HOMESTEAD PLOT AT THE HOUSE. Taking farm land does not cost you the garden plot by the house — if anyone tells a family otherwise, that is the provision to point at. THERE IS ALSO A PUBLISHED CITIZEN POCKET BOOK ON RIGHTS TO LAND AND LAND USE, WRITTEN AS NUMBERED QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS — including how plots are granted to farmer households. ITS PUBLISHER IS ALREADY RECORDED SEPARATELY IN THIS COUNTRY'S LISTING; ask that organisation for the handbook by name, because a plain-language answer key is worth more to a village than the statute. THE LIMITS: this is a USE right, not ownership — land here remains state property, and use rights can be reallocated or withdrawn under conditions set by law, which is precisely why the paperwork matters. Allocation is decided by the district executive body, so it is an administrative decision with all that implies. And this entry rests on the law and a legal database; CONFIRM CURRENT PROCEDURE LOCALLY, since land legislation here has been amended repeatedly.

trackers.name: Mountain communities development programme — the farmer-group network that already reaches remote valleys
trackers.desc: FOR A VILLAGE IN A REMOTE MOUNTAIN DISTRICT, THE PRACTICAL QUESTION IS NOT WHICH INTERNATIONAL FUND EXISTS BUT WHICH ORGANISATION ALREADY COMES TO THE VALLEY. IN THIS COUNTRY A DEVELOPMENT FOUNDATION AND ITS MOUNTAIN SOCIETIES DEVELOPMENT SUPPORT PROGRAMME WORK DIRECTLY WITH RURAL COMMUNITIES LIVING IN MOUNTAIN DISTRICTS WITH SCARCE RESOURCES, and their stated areas are FOOD SECURITY, AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT AND THE PROPER MANAGEMENT OF NATURAL RESOURCES. THAT THIRD HEADING IS THE DOOR. NATURAL RESOURCE MANAGEMENT COVERS PASTURE, WATER, SOIL AND TREES — the things a community is usually trying to protect — AND IT IS ALREADY IN THEIR MANDATE, so a request framed that way is inside their programme rather than outside it. THEY WORK THROUGH FARMER GROUPS: SUPPLYING EQUIPMENT, SPREADING TECHNIQUES, AND GETTING PRODUCE TO MARKET. TOGETHER WITH THE MOUNTAIN PROGRAMME THEY ARE TEACHING THREE HUNDRED THOUSAND FARMERS TO WORK UNDER A CHANGING CLIMATE. THREE HUNDRED THOUSAND FARMERS IS A NETWORK, NOT A PROJECT. A COMMUNITY THAT JOINS IT SITS INSIDE A STRUCTURE THAT ALREADY REACHES ITS VALLEY, with staff who travel there, budgets that already cover the district, and relationships with local authorities — all of which take a new organisation years to build. SO THE APPROACH TO MAKE IS SPECIFIC: ASK WHICH FARMER GROUPS OR COMMUNITY INSTITUTIONS THEY ALREADY WORK WITH IN YOUR DISTRICT, AND JOIN ONE, RATHER THAN PROPOSING SOMETHING NEW. This file recorded in a neighbouring country that joining an existing structure beats founding one; here the structure is unusually large and already funded. THE SAME FOUNDATION OPERATES ACROSS THE REGION WITH REMOTE AND MARGINALISED COMMUNITIES ON A LONG-TERM, COMMUNITY-BASED APPROACH, giving particular attention to women and girls — and in one neighbouring country a PUBLISHED DONOR DIRECTORY LISTS THE AGENCIES OPERATING THERE, which is the fastest way to find out who else already funds work in a given district. NOW THE CAUTION, AND IT DECIDES HOW THIS RESOURCE SHOULD BE USED. THIS FOUNDATION WORKS CLOSELY WITH THE GOVERNMENT — ONE SOURCE NOTES REGULAR BILATERAL MEETINGS BETWEEN ITS HEAD AND THE HEAD OF STATE OVER MANY YEARS. IT IS A DEVELOPMENT PARTNER OF THE STATE, NOT AN OPPONENT OF STATE PROJECTS. IT WILL NOT CAMPAIGN AGAINST A DAM, A MINE OR A ROAD. WHAT IT CAN DO IS STRENGTHEN THE COMMUNITY INSTITUTIONS THAT OUTLAST ANY SINGLE DISPUTE, FUND THE PASTURE AND WATER WORK THAT DEMONSTRATES A PLACE IS USED AND MANAGED, AND PUT TRAINED PEOPLE AND WRITTEN RECORDS INTO A VILLAGE THAT WOULD OTHERWISE HAVE NEITHER. Use it for capacity and evidence; use the legal aid and defender routes recorded separately for this country for anything adversarial. THE OTHER LIMITS: programmes and geographic coverage change, and district presence was not verified in this round — ask which districts are currently covered before planning around it. Its work is concentrated in particular regions rather than nationwide.A CALL WITH DAYS LEFT ON IT BELONGS HERE, BECAUSE IT FUNDS EXACTLY WHAT THIS PROGRAMME'S COMMUNITIES NEED: A MOUNTAIN CLIMATE ADAPTATION PROGRAMME IS ACCEPTING PROJECT PROPOSALS UNTIL THE FIFTEENTH OF SEPTEMBER 2026, COVERING ECOSYSTEM RESTORATION, WATER COLLECTION AND STORAGE, CLIMATE-RESILIENT AGRICULTURE AND FOOD SECURITY, DISASTER PREPAREDNESS, EXPANDING AND DIVERSIFYING AGRICULTURAL SOURCES OF INCOME, AND IMPROVING HEALTH AND QUALITY OF LIFE. ECOSYSTEM RESTORATION AND WATER STORAGE ARE THE HEADINGS UNDER WHICH A COMMUNITY DEFENDING PASTURE, SPRINGS OR TERRACES CAN ASK FOR MONEY WITHOUT ARGUING WITH ANYBODY. THE APPLICANT MUST BE A FORMALLY REGISTERED ORGANISATION WORKING AT LOCAL LEVEL IN MOUNTAIN AREAS WITH EXPERIENCE OF WORKING DIRECTLY WITH LOCAL MOUNTAIN COMMUNITIES, AND THE MEASURE MUST ADDRESS A SPECIFIC PROBLEM OR REDUCE A CLIMATE-RELATED VULNERABILITY. THREE THINGS ABOUT THE PROGRAMME ITSELF WERE ALSO MISSING HERE. ITS STATED NICHE IS A LONG-TERM COMMITMENT TO INSTITUTIONAL CAPACITY BUILDING, GENDER EMPOWERMENT AND COMMUNITY-DRIVEN APPROACHES — WHICH MEANS IT EXISTS PARTLY TO CREATE THE LOCAL ORGANISATIONS OTHER FUNDERS DEMAND. A VILLAGE WITH NO REGISTERED BODY SHOULD ASK ABOUT THAT FIRST, NOT ABOUT A GRANT. SECOND, ITS RECORD IS PHYSICAL: OVER SIX YEARS IT ERECTED OR RESTORED SIXTEEN HUNDRED RURAL INFRASTRUCTURE OBJECTS, IMPROVING FOOD SECURITY AND MARKET ACCESS IN SOME OF THE MOST REMOTE MOUNTAIN COMMUNITIES — AND IT STIMULATES INVESTMENT IN LOCAL AND CROSS-BORDER RURAL INFRASTRUCTURE THAT COMMUNITIES THEMSELVES PRIORITISE. SO THE QUESTION TO ASK IS HOW A COMMUNITY'S PRIORITY GETS INTO THEIR PLANNING. THIRD, IT HELPS FARMERS DIVERSIFY THROUGH HORTICULTURE — THE QUIET LAND-DEFENCE ARGUMENT, SINCE GROUND PRODUCING FRUIT WORTH SELLING IS HARDER TO CALL IDLE, AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED IDLE-LAND RULES USED TO REALLOCATE LAND IN FOUR COUNTRIES OF THIS REGION.

trackers.name: Electronic procurement portal — prequalification notices, supplier manuals in three languages, and the register of who bids
trackers.desc: THE PREVIOUS ROUND ESTABLISHED THAT TWENTY OF TWENTY-THREE COUNTRIES IN THIS MAP HAD NO PROCUREMENT ROUTE RECORDED, AND THAT A PROJECT SHOWS UP IN A TENDER NOTICE BEFORE IT IS ANNOUNCED LOCALLY. HERE THE SYSTEM IS UNUSUALLY COMPLETE: A GOVERNMENT PROCUREMENT AGENCY RUNS AN ELECTRONIC PORTAL WITH SEARCHABLE ANNOUNCEMENT PAGES, OPERATED WITH A STATE ELECTRONIC-FINANCE COMPANY. THE MOST IMPORTANT THING IT PUBLISHES IS THE EARLIEST THING: INVITATIONS TO PREQUALIFICATION FOR MAJOR CONTRACTS — the recorded example covering design, working documentation, supply, installation and commissioning of systems at a named large site. A PREQUALIFICATION NOTICE APPEARS BEFORE THE MAIN CONTRACT IS EVEN TENDERED, WHICH MAKES IT THE FIRST PUBLIC TRACE OF A LARGE PROJECT ANYWHERE IN THE RECORD. SO THE HABIT TO BUILD IS SIMPLE: READ THE PREQUALIFICATION AND TENDER NOTICES FOR YOUR REGION MONTHLY. THE SCOPE, THE SITE AND THE TIMETABLE ARE IN THEM, MONTHS BEFORE ANY LOCAL ANNOUNCEMENT. THE SECOND USEFUL FEATURE IS THE MANUALS. THE PORTAL PUBLISHES INSTRUCTION GUIDES FOR SUPPLIERS AND FOR ORGANISERS IN ENGLISH, TAJIK AND RUSSIAN, TOGETHER WITH SEPARATE REGISTRATION GUIDES. A COMMUNITY COOPERATIVE THAT WANTS TO BID FOR WORK DOES NOT HAVE TO GUESS THE PROCEDURE OR PAY SOMEONE TO EXPLAIN IT — it is published, in its own language, at no cost. AND THE PORTAL CARRIES INFORMATION ON THE REGISTERED POTENTIAL SUPPLIERS. THAT IS A LIST OF WHO COMPETES FOR PUBLIC WORK IN THIS COUNTRY — useful when a contractor appears in your valley and nobody knows who they are. WHY A COMMUNITY SHOULD CARE ABOUT BIDDING AND NOT ONLY WATCHING: INDEPENDENT RESEARCH ON THIS COUNTRY'S SYSTEM STATES PLAINLY THAT PUBLIC PROCUREMENT IS THE LARGEST MARKET, AND THAT SMALL AND MEDIUM BUSINESSES — INCLUDING WOMEN-OWNED ENTERPRISES — CAN USE IT TO TAKE A GREATER ROLE AS SUPPLIERS AND IMPROVE THEIR ECONOMIC RESILIENCE. WHERE WORK IS GOING TO HAPPEN ON LOCAL GROUND ANYWAY, LOCAL PEOPLE DOING IT CHANGES HOW IT IS DONE. THE PROCEDURE ITSELF IS DOCUMENTED RATHER THAN INFORMAL: THE STAGES ARE SET OUT IN A PUBLISHED REGULATION WITH ANNEXES AND INSTRUCTIONS ON THE AGENCY'S SITE, AND THE PERMITTED PROCUREMENT METHODS WERE EXPANDED FROM SIX TO EIGHT — SO ASK WHICH METHOD WAS USED FOR A GIVEN CONTRACT, because the method determines how open the competition had to be. THERE IS ALSO A SEPARATE UNIFIED INFORMATION PORTAL LISTING TENDERS FROM INTERNATIONAL ORGANISATIONS OPERATING IN THE COUNTRY, WITH SUBMISSION DEADLINES — which is where the aid and development contracts appear, including the water, land and restoration work a community may want to be part of. THE LIMITS: this is the state's purchasing machinery — it exists to buy, not to consult, and NOTHING IN IT CREATES A RIGHT TO OBJECT TO A CONTRACT OR A PROJECT. Bidding requires registration, capacity and usually guarantees. Whether notices are searchable by location, and how far in advance they must be published, WERE NOT VERIFIED. Read it with the farmer household route, the mountain development programme and the legal aid routes recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Environment committee — the directorate that receives land complaints, and the one that holds the monitoring data
trackers.desc: THIS ROUND LOOKED FOR WHAT THE PREVIOUS ONE FOUND ELSEWHERE — AN ORGANISATION HOLDING LAWYERS, PLANNERS AND SCIENTISTS TOGETHER — AND DID NOT FIND ONE HERE. THE SEARCH RETURNED STATUTES, WHICH ARE LEFT OUT, AND THE STATE REGULATOR. WHAT IS RECORDED IS THEREFORE SMALLER AND MORE PRACTICAL: THE NAMES OF THAT REGULATOR'S DIRECTORATES. THAT SOUNDS MINOR AND IS NOT. A LETTER ADDRESSED TO A COMMITTEE GOES INTO A REGISTRY; A LETTER ADDRESSED TO THE DIRECTORATE WHOSE JOB IT IS GOES TO A DESK. THE COMMITTEE FOR ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION PUBLISHES ITS STRUCTURE, AND TWO OF ITS DIRECTORATES MATTER FOR LAND. THE FIRST IS THE DIRECTORATE OF STATE CONTROL OF THE USE AND PROTECTION OF LAND, MINERAL RESOURCES AND WASTE MANAGEMENT. THAT IS THE ADDRESSEE FOR A REPORT ABOUT LAND BEING TAKEN, DUG, QUARRIED OR DUMPED ON — all three of those subjects sit in one directorate, which means a single complaint can cover the excavation, the extraction and the waste rather than being split between offices. THE SECOND IS THE DIRECTORATE OF MONITORING, ENVIRONMENTAL POLICY, HYDROMETEOROLOGY AND CADASTRE. IT HOLDS THE MONITORING DATA AND THE CADASTRE — WHICH IS WHERE THE BASELINE FIGURES FOR AN AREA LIVE. A COMMUNITY THAT WANTS TO SHOW A CHANGE MUST FIRST ESTABLISH WHAT WAS THERE BEFORE, AND THIS IS THE DIRECTORATE THAT HOLDS THAT RECORD. ASK IT FOR THE MONITORING DATA FOR YOUR DISTRICT BEFORE THE ARGUMENT STARTS, NOT AFTER. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED IN SEVERAL COUNTRIES THAT THE PARTY WITH THE EARLIER MEASUREMENT WINS THE ARGUMENT ABOUT WHAT CHANGED, and hydrometeorological and monitoring services are usually willing to supply figures as a technical matter. A THIRD DIRECTORATE COVERS THE USE AND PROTECTION OF FLORA, FAUNA AND FISH STOCKS — the addressee where the loss is trees, grazing, wildlife or a river's fish rather than the ground itself. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE SUBSTANTIAL. THIS IS A GOVERNMENT COMMITTEE, NOT AN ALLY: IT REGULATES AND IT ALSO APPROVES, AND NOTHING HERE OBLIGES IT TO ACT ON A COMPLAINT. NO INDEPENDENT ENVIRONMENTAL OR LEGAL-AID ORGANISATION WAS FOUND FOR THIS COUNTRY IN THIS ROUND, which is itself the finding — a community here has fewer independent options than in most of the map and should lean on the development networks and legal routes recorded separately. Whether the monitoring data and cadastre are released on request WAS NOT VERIFIED. Read it with the mountain development programme, the farmer household route and the procurement portal recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: State legal assistance centre — free state lawyers, and civil cases covered since January 2025
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HAS RECORDED THIS COUNTRY AS ONE OF THE THINNEST IN THE MAP FOR LEGAL HELP. HERE IS A STATE SERVICE THAT PROVIDES FREE LAWYERS — AND ONE DATE CHANGES WHAT IT IS WORTH. SECONDARY LEGAL AID USED TO COVER ONLY CRIMINAL CASES. FROM THE FIRST OF JANUARY 2025 IT ALSO COVERS ADMINISTRATIVE OFFENCES AND CIVIL CASES. A LAND DISPUTE IS A CIVIL CASE. UNTIL 2025 THIS ROUTE WAS CLOSED TO IT; IT IS NOT NOW. ANY GUIDANCE WRITTEN BEFORE THAT DATE — INCLUDING ADVICE FROM PEOPLE WHO TRIED AND WERE TURNED AWAY — IS OUT OF DATE, WHICH IS EXACTLY THE KIND OF STALE KNOWLEDGE THAT KEEPS COMMUNITIES FROM ASKING TWICE. THE SERVICE IS A STATE INSTITUTION CENTRE FOR LEGAL ASSISTANCE UNDER THE JUSTICE MINISTRY, STAFFED BY STATE LAWYERS, WITH CONTACTS PUBLISHED ON ITS OWN WEBSITE AND WORKING HOURS FROM MONDAY TO FRIDAY, EIGHT IN THE MORNING TO FIVE IN THE AFTERNOON. ORDINARY OFFICE HOURS AND A PUBLISHED ADDRESS LIST — THIS IS A COUNTER, NOT A CAMPAIGN. THE PRIMARY TIER IS WHERE MOST COMMUNITIES SHOULD START, BECAUSE OF WHAT IT INCLUDES: CONSULTATIONS AND EXPLANATIONS ON LEGAL QUESTIONS; EXPLANATION AND USE OF PRE-COURT SETTLEMENT MEASURES; AND THE DRAFTING OF APPLICATIONS, COMPLAINTS AND PROCEDURAL DOCUMENTS. DRAFTING OF APPLICATIONS AND COMPLAINTS IS NAMED AS A SERVICE. THAT IS THE THING A VILLAGE NEEDS MOST AND CAN LEAST BUY — THIS FILE HAS RECORDED OBJECTION AFTER OBJECTION FAILING ON FORM RATHER THAN SUBSTANCE, AND HERE SOMEBODY WILL WRITE THE DOCUMENT. PRIMARY HELP ALSO INCLUDES ASSISTING PEOPLE TO OBTAIN ACCESS TO SECONDARY LEGAL AID, AND IS DISTRIBUTED THROUGH PUBLIC ASSISTANTS — SO THE FIRST VISIT CAN BE ABOUT GETTING INTO THE SYSTEM RATHER THAN ABOUT THE CASE ITSELF. ON GEOGRAPHY, BE REALISTIC. STATE LAWYERS WERE FIRST PLACED IN NINE LOCATIONS — THE CAPITAL, THREE OTHER NAMED CITIES AND FIVE DISTRICTS — WITH A PLAN TO ESTABLISH THEM IN THE REMAINING THIRTY-FOUR CITIES AND DISTRICTS. SECONDARY AID WAS PILOTED IN TWO PROVINCES BEFORE EXTENDING TO THE CAPITAL, THE DISTRICTS OF REPUBLICAN SUBORDINATION AND THE AUTONOMOUS REGION. SO CHECK WHETHER A STATE LAWYER IS ACTUALLY PLACED IN YOUR DISTRICT BEFORE TRAVELLING, AND IF NOT, ASK WHICH NEIGHBOURING DISTRICT COVERS YOU — the rollout was planned rather than completed, and a plan is not a presence. THE LIMITS: this is A STATE SERVICE UNDER THE JUSTICE MINISTRY. IT WILL NOT CAMPAIGN, AND A CASE AGAINST A STATE-BACKED PROJECT PUTS A STATE LAWYER IN AN AWKWARD POSITION — expect help with documents, procedure and pre-court settlement rather than with confrontation. ELIGIBILITY CONDITIONS FOR SECONDARY AID, AND WHETHER A COMMUNITY GROUP RATHER THAN AN INDIVIDUAL CAN RECEIVE IT, WERE NOT VERIFIED. The rollout figures date from the ministry's own page and may have advanced. Read it with the environment committee directorates, the mountain development programme and the environmental organisation recorded separately for this country.ONE MECHANISM WAS NOT RECORDED HERE, AND IT MANUFACTURES EVIDENCE FOR FREE: PRIMARY LEGAL AID IS REGISTERED BY THE STATE LAWYER WHO PROVIDED IT, IN A REGISTRATION BOOK AND IN AN ELECTRONIC DATABASE — RECORDING THE APPLICANT'S NAME, AGE, SEX AND ADDRESS, THE QUESTION ON WHICH AID WAS SOUGHT, AND A SHORT SUMMARY OF THE CONSULTATION GIVEN. SO A VISIT TO A STATE LAWYER PRODUCES A DATED OFFICIAL RECORD THAT YOU RAISED THIS PROBLEM ON THIS DAY. THIS FILE KEEPS TELLING COMMUNITIES TO CREATE SUCH RECORDS; HERE THE STATE MAKES ONE AUTOMATICALLY, AND IT COSTS A CONSULTATION. WHERE THE REQUEST WAS ORAL, THE APPLICANT SIGNS THE BOOK TO CONFIRM THE AID WAS PROVIDED — SO ASK TO READ WHAT WAS WRITTEN BEFORE SIGNING, BECAUSE THAT SUMMARY IS THE ONLY ACCOUNT OF THE CONSULTATION THAT WILL SURVIVE. ON COVERAGE, THE ROLLOUT PLAN PUT STATE LAWYERS IN THE REMAINING THIRTY-FOUR CITIES AND DISTRICTS, AFTER SECONDARY AID WAS PILOTED IN TWO PROVINCES AND THEN EXTENDED TO THE CAPITAL, THE DISTRICTS OF REPUBLICAN SUBORDINATION AND THE AUTONOMOUS PROVINCE — SO THE ANSWER TO WHETHER A STATE LAWYER SERVES YOUR DISTRICT SHOULD NOW BE YES, AND ASKING FOR THE POST BY THAT EXACT TITLE IS WHAT GETS A NAME RATHER THAN A REFUSAL. AND ONE POLICY DOOR IS STILL OPEN: PUBLIC HEARINGS ON A DRAFT CONCEPT FOR FREE LEGAL AID WERE HELD IN THE REGIONS, ADDRESSING THE CONSOLIDATION OF EXISTING MODELS, THE IDENTIFICATION OF THE REGIONS MOST IN NEED OF PILOTS, LEGAL LITERACY AND CAPACITY BUILDING FOR AID PROVIDERS. A DISTRICT WITH NO LAWYER SHOULD SAY SO ON THE RECORD AT SUCH A HEARING — IDENTIFYING THE NEEDIEST REGIONS IS PRECISELY WHAT THEY EXIST TO DO.

trackers.name: Village self-government body and its mahalla committees — the local council that approves land grants, leases and terminations
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HAS SPENT MANY ROUNDS LOOKING FOR THE BODY THAT ACTUALLY DECIDES ABOUT LAND AT VILLAGE LEVEL IN THIS COUNTRY. IT IS THE JAMOAT, THE SELF-GOVERNMENT BODY OF SETTLEMENTS AND VILLAGES, THROUGH WHICH RESIDENTS ACT EITHER DIRECTLY OR THROUGH THEIR OWN BODIES TO RESOLVE SOCIAL, ECONOMIC AND CULTURAL MATTERS OF LOCAL SIGNIFICANCE. AND WHAT IT DECIDES IS THE POINT. THE JAMOAT APPROVES ITS CHAIRMAN'S PROPOSALS ON THE LAND PLOTS ALLOCATED FOR PERSONAL SUBSIDIARY FARMING, AND TAKES DECISIONS ON GRANTING LAND INTO POSSESSION, USE OR LEASE TO ENTERPRISES, INSTITUTIONS AND CITIZENS — ON THE TERMINATION OF THOSE RIGHTS — AND ON THE WITHDRAWAL OF LANDS WITHIN THE BOUNDARIES OF SETTLEMENTS AND RURAL LOCALITIES THAT DO NOT FORM PART OF AGRICULTURAL OR FORESTRY ENTERPRISE HOLDINGS. GRANTING, LEASING, TERMINATING AND WITHDRAWING LAND INSIDE THE VILLAGE BOUNDARY, DECIDED BY A BODY IN THE VILLAGE. THAT IS AS CLOSE AS THIS FILE HAS COME ANYWHERE IN CENTRAL ASIA TO A LOCAL AUTHORITY WITH REAL LAND POWERS — AND IT MEANS THE FIRST QUESTION ABOUT ANY SCHEME ON VILLAGE LAND IS WHETHER THE JAMOAT DECIDED IT, AND WHEN. ASK FOR THE DECISION ITSELF. A GRANT OR A LEASE APPROVED HERE EXISTS AS A RECORDED ACT WITH A DATE; IF NO SUCH DECISION EXISTS FOR THE GROUND BEING TAKEN, THAT ABSENCE IS THE STRONGEST FACT A COMMUNITY CAN HOLD, AND IT IS AVAILABLE WITHOUT A LAWYER. NOTE ALSO WHAT IS EXCLUDED: LANDS FORMING PART OF AGRICULTURAL AND FORESTRY ENTERPRISE HOLDINGS FALL OUTSIDE THIS COMPETENCE. SO ESTABLISH FIRST WHICH CATEGORY YOUR GROUND IS IN — IT DETERMINES WHETHER THE VILLAGE BODY OR A HIGHER ONE IS THE PLACE TO GO, AND COMMUNITIES WASTE MONTHS PETITIONING THE WRONG LEVEL. THE JAMOAT WORKS THROUGH SMALLER STRUCTURES THAT ARE EASIER STILL TO REACH: MICRODISTRICT COUNCILS, MAHALLA COUNCILS AND VILLAGE COMMITTEES. THESE ARE THE KEY LINKS THROUGH WHICH IT DEALS WITH THE POPULATION, AND THE STATED PRINCIPLE IS THAT PEOPLE SHOULD THEMSELVES COMBINE TO RESOLVE MATTERS OF LOCAL SIGNIFICANCE — SO A MAHALLA COUNCIL RAISING AN ISSUE IS THE SYSTEM WORKING AS DESIGNED, NOT AN INTRUSION INTO IT. THERE IS A SECOND MEMBERSHIP VEHICLE WORTH JOINING FOR ANYONE WITH IRRIGATED LAND: THE WATER USERS' ASSOCIATION — A NON-COMMERCIAL, SELF-GOVERNING, MEMBERSHIP-BASED ORGANISATION CREATED VOLUNTARILY ON A DEFINED TERRITORY FOR THE COLLECTIVE USE AND MAINTENANCE OF THE IRRIGATION SYSTEM IN ITS SERVICE ZONE, FOR SECURING IRRIGATION WATER, AND FOR REPRESENTING AND DEFENDING ITS MEMBERS' COMMON INTERESTS. REPRESENTING AND DEFENDING COMMON INTERESTS IS WRITTEN INTO WHAT THESE ASSOCIATIONS ARE FOR. MEMBERSHIP IS OPEN TO WATER USERS HOLDING LAND-USE RIGHTS IN THE SERVED ZONE WHO ACCEPT THE CHARTER — SO A GROUP OF NEIGHBOURING FARMERS ALREADY QUALIFIES, AND AN ASSOCIATION SPEAKS WITH A STANDING THAT INDIVIDUAL IRRIGATORS DO NOT HAVE. THE LIMITS: these are LOCAL STATE AND MEMBERSHIP STRUCTURES, NOT ADVOCATES — a jamoat may itself be the body that granted the land you object to, and chairmen are appointed within a hierarchy that this file has repeatedly found to be centralised. THE COMPETENCES DESCRIBED COME FROM THE SELF-GOVERNMENT FRAMEWORK AS DOCUMENTED IN AN INTERNATIONAL LAND-RIGHTS DATABASE AND ACADEMIC WRITING, NOT FROM A SERVICE PAGE, and how much independence any particular jamoat exercises WAS NOT VERIFIED. Read it with the state legal aid centre, the Aarhus centre, the environmental organisation and the procurement portal recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Land management and geodesy committee — the cadastre, the registration book, and the three places a land right is written down
trackers.desc: A COMMUNITY DEFENDING LAND HERE NEEDS TO KNOW WHERE ITS RIGHT IS WRITTEN DOWN, AND THERE ARE THREE PLACES: THE STATE LAND CADASTRE; THE LAND REGISTRATION BOOK; AND THE DECISIONS OF THE EXECUTIVE AUTHORITIES BY WHICH THE LAND WAS GRANTED. THREE SEPARATE RECORDS MEANS THREE CHANCES TO PROVE A RIGHT AND THREE PLACES A MISTAKE CAN HIDE. CHECK ALL THREE, AND CHECK THEM AGAINST EACH OTHER: THIS FILE HAS RECORDED IN SEVERAL COUNTRIES THAT DISCREPANCIES BETWEEN REGISTERS ARE WHERE LAND QUIETLY CHANGES HANDS. THE BODY THAT KEEPS THEM IS A STATE COMMITTEE ON LAND MANAGEMENT AND GEODESY. IT CONDUCTS THE STATE LAND CADASTRE AND LAND MONITORING, CARRIES OUT TOPOGRAPHIC, GEODETIC, AEROSPACE, CARTOGRAPHIC AND CADASTRAL WORKS, PERFORMS THE STATE REGISTRATION OF IMMOVABLE PROPERTY AND OF RIGHTS TO IT, AND EXERCISES STATE CONTROL OVER THE USE AND PROTECTION OF LAND. STATE CONTROL OVER THE USE AND PROTECTION OF LAND IS THE FUNCTION TO INVOKE WHEN GROUND IS BEING DAMAGED RATHER THAN TAKEN. IT IS A DIFFERENT COMPLAINT FROM A DISPUTE ABOUT OWNERSHIP, AND IT GOES TO A BODY WITH INSPECTORS RATHER THAN TO A COURT. THE COMMITTEE ALSO ACTS AS STATE CUSTOMER AND EXECUTOR FOR DESIGN, SURVEY AND RESEARCH WORK CONNECTED WITH LAND REFORM AND LAND MANAGEMENT, AND PUBLISHES A LIST OF THE ENTERPRISES AND INSTITUTIONS IN ITS SYSTEM. THAT PUBLISHED LIST IS QUIETLY USEFUL: IT NAMES THE SURVEYING AND CADASTRAL ORGANISATIONS THAT ACTUALLY DO THE FIELDWORK. IF A MEASUREMENT IS NEEDED — A BOUNDARY, AN AREA, A LEVEL — THESE ARE THE BODIES QUALIFIED TO PRODUCE ONE THE STATE WILL ACCEPT. LOCALLY, REGULATION SITS WITH THE CITY AND DISTRICT LAND MANAGEMENT COMMITTEES TOGETHER WITH THE VILLAGE SELF-GOVERNMENT BODIES RECORDED SEPARATELY IN THIS FILE. SO THE DISTRICT LAND COMMITTEE, NOT THE CAPITAL, IS WHERE MOST QUESTIONS ABOUT A PARTICULAR PLOT ARE ANSWERED. ONE RULE IS WORTH KNOWING BEFORE ANY ARGUMENT ABOUT HILLSIDE GROUND: THE USE OF LAND WITH A SLOPE OF MORE THAN FIFTEEN DEGREES IS TO BE PROHIBITED, AND CITIZENS HOLDING SUCH PLOTS ARE RECOMMENDED TO PLANT PERENNIAL CROPS — WITH HOLDERS OF LAND SHARES ENTITLED TO ORGANISE ORCHARD AND VINEYARD FARMS ON THEM. THAT IS BOTH A WARNING AND AN OPENING. A COMMUNITY FARMING STEEP GROUND MAY FIND ITS CULTIVATION RESTRICTED — BUT THE SAME RULE POINTS TO ORCHARDS AND VINES AS THE SANCTIONED USE, WHICH IS ALSO THE USE THAT HOLDS SOIL ON A SLOPE. PLANTING PERENNIALS IS THEREFORE THE RARE MOVE THAT SATISFIES THE AUTHORITIES AND PROTECTS THE HILLSIDE AT THE SAME TIME. THE LIMITS: this is THE STATE LAND ADMINISTRATOR, WHICH MAKES IT BOTH THE RECORD-KEEPER AND THE BODY WHOSE DECISIONS A COMMUNITY MAY BE CONTESTING — it registers the grant to a developer as readily as the right of a household. IT WILL NOT ADVISE OR ADVOCATE. WHETHER EXTRACTS FROM THE CADASTRE AND REGISTRATION BOOK ARE ISSUED TO ANYONE ON REQUEST, AT WHAT COST AND WITH WHAT PROOF OF INTEREST, WAS NOT VERIFIED - that is the question to ask first. The slope rule and the three records come from published land-law materials rather than a service page. Read it with the village self-government body, the state legal assistance centre, the human rights bureau and the procurement portal recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Landscape restoration programme in the mountain districts — pasture rotation, temporary fencing, water supply and vegetation cover, with ten hectares of new orchards
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HAS RECOMMENDED PASTURE RESTORATION IN SEVERAL COUNTRIES WITHOUT BEING ABLE TO SAY WHAT IT ACTUALLY CONSISTS OF. HERE THE TECHNIQUES ARE NAMED, BECAUSE A WORKING GROUP WENT AND MEASURED WHETHER THEY WORKED. IN JULY 2026 THE GROUP MONITORED THE CONDITION AND PRODUCTIVITY OF PASTURES IN THREE NAMED MOUNTAIN DISTRICTS AND THE RESULTS OF THE RESTORATION MEASURES, CONCENTRATING ON FOUR THINGS: THE EFFECTIVENESS OF PASTURE ROTATION, THE TEMPORARY FENCING OF PLOTS, THE IMPROVEMENT OF WATER SUPPLY, AND THE RESTORATION OF VEGETATION COVER. THOSE FOUR ARE THE WHOLE METHOD, AND THREE OF THEM COST ALMOST NOTHING. ROTATION IS AN AGREEMENT ABOUT WHEN ANIMALS GRAZE WHERE. TEMPORARY FENCING IS POSTS AND WIRE MOVED EACH SEASON, NOT A PERMANENT ENCLOSURE. VEGETATION RECOVERS BY ITSELF IF THE FIRST TWO HOLD. ONLY THE WATER SUPPLY NEEDS REAL MONEY. AND WATER IS THE ONE THIS FILE HAS RECORDED AS DECISIVE ELSEWHERE: IN A NEIGHBOURING COUNTRY SCIENTISTS FOUND THAT PASTURE WENT UNUSED FOR WANT OF WATERING POINTS RATHER THAN FOR WANT OF GRASS. THE SAME REMEDY APPEARS HERE AS ONE OF FOUR MEASURES BEING TESTED TOGETHER — SO A COMMUNITY ASKING FOR A WATERING POINT SHOULD ASK FOR THE ROTATION AGREEMENT AND THE SEASONAL FENCING IN THE SAME BREATH, BECAUSE THE WATER ALONE WILL SIMPLY CONCENTRATE THE DAMAGE. THE PROGRAMME ALSO CREATED TEN HECTARES OF NEW ORCHARDS IN THE SAME DISTRICTS, ALONGSIDE THE RESTORED PASTURE. ORCHARDS ON RESTORED SLOPES ARE THE COMBINATION THAT HOLDS GROUND AND FEEDS PEOPLE AT ONCE — AND THIS FILE RECORDED SEPARATELY THAT ON STEEP LAND IN THIS COUNTRY PERENNIAL PLANTING IS THE SANCTIONED USE, WHICH MEANS AN ORCHARD SATISFIES THE AUTHORITIES AND STABILISES THE HILLSIDE AT THE SAME TIME. THE PRACTICAL VALUE OF KNOWING THIS PROGRAMME EXISTS IS SIMPLE: IT IS OPERATING IN NAMED DISTRICTS, WITH A WORKING GROUP THAT VISITS AND MEASURES. A VILLAGE INSIDE OR BESIDE THOSE DISTRICTS CAN ASK TO BE INCLUDED IN THE NEXT PHASE; ONE FURTHER AWAY CAN ASK FOR THE MONITORING FINDINGS AND COPY THE METHOD WITHOUT ANY FUNDING AT ALL, SINCE ROTATION AND SEASONAL FENCING ARE AGREEMENTS RATHER THAN PURCHASES. ASK THE PASTURE USERS' BODY IN YOUR OWN DISTRICT WHETHER IT HAS A ROTATION PLAN AND WHERE THE FENCING WOULD GO. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED PASTURE USER ASSOCIATIONS AND VILLAGE SELF-GOVERNMENT BODIES SEPARATELY FOR THIS COUNTRY — THEY ARE THE BODIES THAT WOULD HOLD SUCH A PLAN. THE LIMITS: this is A DONOR-FUNDED PROJECT, NOT A PERMANENT INSTITUTION — IT HAS AN END DATE, ITS DISTRICTS ARE FIXED, AND IT CANNOT BE APPLIED TO LIKE A FUND. IT WILL NOT OPPOSE ANY DEVELOPMENT and creates no rights. WHETHER COMMUNITIES CAN JOIN, AND THROUGH WHICH LOCAL PARTNER, WAS NOT VERIFIED, AND THE ACCOUNT COMES FROM A SINGLE NEWS REPORT OF A MONITORING VISIT rather than from programme documents; the reported results are the programme's own. Read it with the village self-government body, the land management and geodesy committee, the state legal assistance centre and the human rights bureau recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Agribusiness association — it defends members' rights and admits dehkan farms, and the livestock adaptation grant aimed at small keepers
trackers.desc: THE PHRASE THAT MAKES THIS WORTH RECORDING IS IN THE ASSOCIATION'S OWN DESCRIPTION: IT PROTECTS THE RIGHTS AND INTERESTS OF ITS MEMBERS. THIS FILE HAS SPENT THE WHOLE REGION LOOKING FOR BODIES THAT SAY THAT AND MEAN IT STRUCTURALLY — IT IS RARE, AND IT IS THE REASON A SMALL FARM SHOULD CARE ABOUT A TRADE BODY. ITS OTHER PURPOSE IS PRACTICAL: PROMOTING LEGAL BUSINESS AND BUILDING LINKS BETWEEN PRODUCERS, SUPPLIERS AND THE SELLERS OF AGRICULTURAL INPUTS — WHICH IS THE CHAIN A SMALLHOLDER IS USUALLY AT THE WRONG END OF. AND THE MEMBERSHIP SHOWS IT IS NOT ONLY FOR COMPANIES: AGRO-DEALERS, PROCESSORS AND EXPORTERS OF FRESH AND DRIED FRUIT SIT ALONGSIDE OTHER ASSOCIATIONS AND DEHKAN FARMS FROM A DOZEN NAMED DISTRICTS AND TWO CITIES OF ONE PROVINCE. DEHKAN FARMS IN MEMBERSHIP BESIDE EXPORTERS IS THE USEFUL FACT. IT MEANS A FARM CAN SIT IN THE SAME ROOM AS THE PEOPLE WHO BUY, PROCESS AND EXPORT WHAT IT GROWS — AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED REPEATEDLY THAT PRICE, NOT YIELD, IS WHAT DECIDES WHETHER A HOUSEHOLD CAN AFFORD TO KEEP FARMING. ASK TWO THINGS BEFORE JOINING ANYTHING LIKE IT: WHAT DEFENDING MEMBERS' INTERESTS HAS MEANT IN PRACTICE IN THE LAST YEAR, AND WHETHER A SINGLE FARM'S PROBLEM WITH AN INPUT SUPPLIER OR A BUYER HAS EVER BEEN TAKEN UP BY THE ASSOCIATION. THE ANSWER SEPARATES A REAL MEMBERSHIP BODY FROM A LETTERHEAD. SEPARATELY, THERE IS NEW MONEY AIMED AT EXACTLY THE PEOPLE THIS MAP IS FOR: AN INTERNATIONAL AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT FUND HAS GRANTED NEARLY TWENTY MILLION DOLLARS FOR A PROJECT ON ACCESS TO MARKETS AND LIVESTOCK ADAPTATION, SUPPORTING RURAL HOUSEHOLDS AND MODERNISING THE LIVESTOCK SECTOR. THE STATED FOCUS IS SMALL LIVESTOCK KEEPERS — DESCRIBED AS THE BASIS OF AGRICULTURE IN MANY REGIONS AND THE PEOPLE MOST EXPOSED TO CLIMATE CHANGE, WATER SCARCITY AND RISING PRODUCTION COSTS. A PROJECT THAT NAMES SMALL KEEPERS AS ITS CENTRE, RATHER THAN AS BENEFICIARIES OF SOMETHING BUILT FOR LARGER PRODUCERS, IS ONE TO ASK ABOUT BY NAME AT THE DISTRICT AGRICULTURE OFFICE. AND ACCESS TO MARKETS IN THE PROJECT TITLE MATTERS AS MUCH AS THE LIVESTOCK. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED THE PASTURE COMMITTEES, THE WATER USERS' ASSOCIATIONS AND THE VILLAGE SELF-GOVERNMENT BODIES FOR THIS COUNTRY — WHAT NONE OF THEM SOLVES IS THE PRICE A HERDER GETS, AND THAT IS WHAT THIS PROJECT SAYS IT IS FOR. ONE PROTECTIVE FACT IS WORTH CARRYING INTO ANY CONVERSATION ABOUT JOINING GROUPS HERE: ASSOCIATIONS OF DEHKAN FARMS ARE NON-COMMERCIAL ORGANISATIONS, MEMBER FARMS KEEP THEIR INDEPENDENCE AND THEIR LAND-USE RIGHTS, AND FORCED INCLUSION OF DEHKAN FARMS INTO ASSOCIATIONS OR OTHER ORGANISATIONS IS PROHIBITED. THAT LAST CLAUSE ANSWERS A REAL FEAR. FAMILIES WHO REMEMBER COLLECTIVISATION HESITATE TO JOIN ANYTHING — AND A FARM CANNOT BE COMPELLED INTO AN ASSOCIATION, NOR DOES JOINING ONE SURRENDER ITS LAND-USE RIGHT. THE LIMITS: this is A TRADE ASSOCIATION, NOT AN ADVOCATE, A FUNDER OR A LITIGATOR — IT WILL NOT OPPOSE A DEVELOPMENT, and its membership is concentrated in one province, so it may be irrelevant elsewhere in the country. ITS DESCRIPTION COMES FROM A CONSULTANCY DIRECTORY PAGE RATHER THAN THE ASSOCIATION'S OWN SITE, AND MEMBERSHIP TERMS, FEES AND CURRENT ACTIVITY WERE NOT VERIFIED. The livestock grant is A SIGNED AGREEMENT REPORTED IN THE PRESS, NOT AN OPEN APPLICATION WINDOW - how households enter it was not established. Read it with the pasture and landscape restoration programme, the village self-government body, the land management committee and the human rights bureau recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Protected areas law — the designation categories to ask for, including ecological-ethnographic zones and cultural protection zones inside parks
trackers.desc: A COMMUNITY ASKING FOR GROUND TO BE PROTECTED HAS TO NAME A CATEGORY, AND THIS LAW LISTS THEM: STATE NATURE RESERVES, NATIONAL AND PROVINCIAL NATURE PARKS, STATE AND PRIVATE NATURE SANCTUARIES, ZOOLOGICAL PARKS, AND — IN A CHAPTER OF THEIR OWN — STATE NATURAL MONUMENTS AND ECOLOGICAL-ETHNOGRAPHIC ZONES. ECOLOGICAL-ETHNOGRAPHIC ZONE IS THE CATEGORY WORTH THE WHOLE ENTRY. IT IS THE ONLY DESIGNATION THIS FILE HAS FOUND IN THE REGION THAT NAMES THE PEOPLE AND THEIR WAY OF LIFE ALONGSIDE THE LANDSCAPE — SO A VALLEY WHOSE CASE RESTS ON PASTURE, SHRINES, TERRACES AND THE FAMILIES WHO MAINTAIN THEM HAS A CATEGORY THAT FITS RATHER THAN ONE THAT FORCES IT TO ARGUE PURELY ABOUT WILDLIFE. THE PARKS THEMSELVES ARE ZONED, AND ONE ZONE IS CULTURAL: A NATIONAL PARK'S TERRITORY MAY BE DIVIDED INTO SANCTUARY ZONES, PROTECTION ZONES OF HISTORICAL-CULTURAL OBJECTS, AND RECREATIONAL, ECONOMIC AND OTHER USE ZONES IN WHICH ACTIVITY NOT CONTRADICTING THE PARK'S TASKS IS CARRIED OUT. AND THE TASKS ARE WIDER THAN NATURE: THEY INCLUDE THE PRESERVATION OF CULTURAL HERITAGE — OBJECTS OF ETHNOGRAPHY, ARCHAEOLOGY AND HISTORY, AND HISTORICAL AND CULTURAL LANDSCAPES — ALONGSIDE ECOLOGICAL EDUCATION OF THE POPULATION AND CONDITIONS FOR REGULATED TOURISM. SO IN THIS COUNTRY THE CULTURAL ARGUMENT AND THE ENVIRONMENTAL ONE BELONG IN THE SAME APPLICATION. A PROPOSAL THAT DESCRIBES THE SHRINE, THE OLD IRRIGATION SYSTEM AND THE PASTURE TOGETHER FITS THE STATUTE BETTER THAN TWO SEPARATE ONES. THE PROTECTION ITSELF RESTS ON A LAND RULE THAT IS SHORT AND HARD: LANDS OF SPECIALLY PROTECTED NATURAL TERRITORIES BELONG TO THE CATEGORY OF STATE FOREST FUND LANDS AND LANDS OF NATURE-PROTECTION, HEALTH, RECREATIONAL AND HISTORICAL-CULTURAL PURPOSE — AND ON THOSE LANDS, ACTIVITY CONTRADICTING THEIR TARGET PURPOSE IS PROHIBITED. THAT IS THE SENTENCE TO QUOTE WHEN A QUARRY, A ROAD OR A RESORT IS PROPOSED INSIDE OR BESIDE A DESIGNATED AREA. THE QUESTION BECOMES WHETHER THE ACTIVITY CONTRADICTS THE TARGET PURPOSE OF THE LAND — A NARROWER AND MORE ANSWERABLE QUESTION THAN WHETHER THE PROJECT IS GOOD FOR THE COUNTRY. KNOW HOW A DESIGNATION IS MADE BEFORE ASKING FOR ONE: THE DECISION TO FORM NATIONAL NATURE PARKS AND APPROVE THEIR STATUTE IS TAKEN BY THE GOVERNMENT ON THE PROPOSAL OF THE AUTHORISED STATE BODY, WHILE PROVINCIAL PARKS ARE DETERMINED BY THE SPECIALLY EMPOWERED STATE BODIES IN THE FIELD OF NATURE PROTECTION. SO THE TARGET OF A COMMUNITY'S REQUEST IS THE AUTHORISED NATURE PROTECTION BODY, NOT THE GOVERNMENT — IT IS THAT BODY'S PROPOSAL THAT REACHES THE CABINET, AND A PROVINCIAL PARK IS A SMALLER ASK THAN A NATIONAL ONE, DECIDED CLOSER TO HOME. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A DESIGNATION LAW, NOT A SERVICE - IT IS RECORDED FOR THE CATEGORIES IT NAMES AND THE BODY A REQUEST GOES TO, AND NOTHING IN IT OBLIGES ANYONE TO ACT ON A COMMUNITY'S PROPOSAL. DESIGNATION ALSO CUTS BOTH WAYS: A PROTECTED AREA CAN RESTRICT GRAZING, FUELWOOD AND ACCESS FOR THE VERY PEOPLE WHO ASKED FOR IT, AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED THAT RISK IN THREE OTHER COUNTRIES - ASK WHAT THE ZONE FORBIDS BEFORE WELCOMING IT. THE COUNTRY'S HERITAGE LAW ITSELF DID NOT SURFACE IN THIS SEARCH AND IS NOT RECORDED HERE. THE TEXT WAS READ ON THE PRESIDENTIAL LEGISLATION CENTRE'S SITE AND A COMMERCIAL LEGAL DATABASE, IN VERSIONS AMENDED AS RECENTLY AS 2023 - check the current wording. Read it with the state legal aid and its consultation register, the extractive transparency licence registers, the agribusiness association and the land management committee recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Development bank accountability office — a free, confidential complaint route for people harmed by a bank-financed project
trackers.desc: WHERE THE PROJECT IS FINANCED BY A DEVELOPMENT BANK, THE BANK HAS ITS OWN COMPLAINT OFFICE, AND ITS TERMS ARE BETTER THAN ANY DOMESTIC ROUTE RECORDED FOR THIS COUNTRY: SUBMITTING A COMPLAINT IS FREE, STRAIGHTFORWARD AND CONFIDENTIAL UPON REQUEST, AND ANY GROUP OF TWO OR MORE PEOPLE, OR A REPRESENTATIVE, MAY BRING ONE. TWO PEOPLE. NO REGISTRATION, NO LAWYER, NO ASSOCIATION, NO FEE — AND THE OFFICER ENSURES THE CONFIDENTIALITY OF COMPLAINANT IDENTITIES IF ASKED. THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED THE OPPOSITE CONDITIONS IN EVERY DOMESTIC FORUM ACROSS CENTRAL ASIA. THERE IS A NAMED OFFICE TO WRITE TO: A COMPLAINT RECEIVING OFFICER AT A PUBLISHED POSTAL ADDRESS, WHO IS THE SINGLE POINT OF ENTRY AND REPORTS BOTH TO THE SPECIAL PROJECT FACILITATOR AND TO THE CHAIR OF THE COMPLIANCE REVIEW PANEL. AFTER FILING THERE ARE TWO TRACKS, AND THE CHOICE MATTERS: A PROBLEM-SOLVING FUNCTION THAT HELPS EVERYONE INVOLVED EXPLORE POSSIBLE SOLUTIONS AND AGREE WHAT NEEDS TO BE DONE, AND A COMPLIANCE REVIEW FUNCTION THAT EXAMINES WHETHER THE BANK BROKE ITS OWN RULES. PROBLEM-SOLVING IS FOR A COMMUNITY THAT WANTS THE ROAD MOVED, THE WATER RESTORED OR THE COMPENSATION RECALCULATED. COMPLIANCE REVIEW IS FOR ONE THAT WANTS THE BANK FOUND AT FAULT. THEY LEAD TO DIFFERENT PLACES AND SHOULD BE CHOSEN DELIBERATELY. THE GROUNDS ARE NARROW AND WORTH GETTING RIGHT: A COMPLAINT MUST DEMONSTRATE THAT THE BANK FAILED TO COMPLY WITH ITS OWN POLICIES OR PROCEDURES, RESULTING IN DIRECT, MATERIAL HARM — AND THE SAFEGUARD POLICY STATEMENT AND ACCESS TO INFORMATION POLICY CAN BE CITED, WITH A NEW ENVIRONMENTAL AND SOCIAL FRAMEWORK APPLYING TO PROJECTS APPROVED AFTER JANUARY 2026. SO THE COMPLAINT IS NOT THAT THE PROJECT IS BAD BUT THAT THE BANK BROKE ITS OWN RULE AND YOU WERE HARMED BY IT. NAME THE POLICY, NAME THE BREACH, NAME THE HARM — AND CHECK WHICH FRAMEWORK APPLIES, BECAUSE PROJECTS APPROVED FROM 2026 ARE JUDGED AGAINST DIFFERENT RULES FROM OLDER ONES. ONE PROCEDURAL TRAP TO PLAN FOR: THE MECHANISM IS A LAST RESORT, SO COMPLAINANTS MUST FIRST CONTACT THE CONCERNED OPERATIONS DEPARTMENT AND TRY TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE, AND MAY FILE ONLY IF NOT SATISFIED WITH WHAT IS OFFERED. THAT MEANS THE FIRST LETTER TO THE BANK'S PROJECT TEAM IS NOT WASTED EFFORT — IT IS THE STEP THAT UNLOCKS THE MECHANISM. WRITE IT EARLY, KEEP IT, AND KEEP THE REPLY. THE HONEST WEAKNESSES ARE PUBLISHED BY ACCOUNTABILITY SPECIALISTS AND SHOULD SHAPE EXPECTATIONS: THE COMPLIANCE REVIEW PANEL HAS NO EXPLICIT PROVISIONS EMPOWERING IT TO RECOMMEND CORRECTIVE MEASURES AND NO EXPLICIT MANDATE TO RECOMMEND REMEDY FOR COMMUNITIES; THE PROBLEM-SOLVING FUNCTION IS NOT INDEPENDENT OF MANAGEMENT; AND THE REQUIREMENT TO GO TO OPERATIONS FIRST IS ITSELF CRITICISED AS FALLING SHORT OF GOOD PRACTICE. SO A FINDING IN YOUR FAVOUR MAY NOT COME WITH AN ORDER TO FIX ANYTHING. TREAT THE MECHANISM AS LEVERAGE AND AS A PUBLIC RECORD RATHER THAN AS A COURT — AND NOTE THAT SPECIALISTS ALSO SAY COMPLAINANTS SHOULD BE ABLE TO CHOOSE THEIR REPRESENTATIVES WITHOUT LIMITATIONS, WHICH IS WORTH INSISTING ON IF ANYONE SUGGESTS OTHERWISE. BEFORE WRITING, READ THE PUBLIC COMPLAINTS REGISTRY OF COMPLAINTS RECEIVED AND REGISTERED — IT SHOWS WHAT SUCCEEDED, WHAT WAS FOUND INELIGIBLE AND HOW OTHER COMMUNITIES FRAMED THE SAME KIND OF HARM. THE LIMITS: THIS IS THE ACCOUNTABILITY OFFICE OF ONE DEVELOPMENT BANK AND REACHES ONLY PROJECTS THAT BANK FINANCES - OTHER LENDERS HAVE THEIR OWN MECHANISMS WITH DIFFERENT RULES, AND A PROJECT FUNDED DOMESTICALLY OR BY A BILATERAL LENDER MAY HAVE NONE. IT JUDGES THE BANK, NOT THE GOVERNMENT OR THE COMPANY, AND CANNOT ORDER A PROJECT STOPPED. COMPLAINING ABOUT A STATE-BACKED PROJECT CARRIES RISK FOR RESIDENTS IN THE COUNTRIES THIS FILE COVERS, WHICH IS WHY THE CONFIDENTIALITY OPTION MATTERS AND SHOULD BE REQUESTED EXPLICITLY IN WRITING. THE PROCEDURE COMES FROM THE BANK'S OWN PAGES AND THE CRITICISM FROM AN INDEPENDENT ACCOUNTABILITY TOOLKIT UPDATED IN FEBRUARY 2026. Read it with the state legal aid and its consultation register, the extractive transparency licence registers, the protected areas designation categories and the agribusiness association recorded separately for this country.A CORRECTION TO WHAT THIS ENTRY SAYS ABOVE, BECAUSE THE BANK'S OWN PAGES DISAGREE WITH EACH OTHER. THE HOW-TO-FILE PAGE PRESENTS CONTACTING THE OPERATIONS DEPARTMENT FIRST AS MANDATORY. THE MECHANISM'S OVERVIEW PAGE SAYS: WE ENCOURAGE COMPLAINANTS TO ENGAGE FIRST WITH THE OPERATIONS TEAM OR PROJECT-LEVEL GRIEVANCE REDRESS MECHANISMS, BUT THIS IS NOT A MANDATORY STEP. AN INDEPENDENT ACCOUNTABILITY TOOLKIT READS THE REQUIREMENT AS ONE OF GOOD FAITH EFFORTS. SO DO NOT LET A REFUSAL TO ENGAGE WITH MANAGEMENT BE TREATED AS A BAR. QUOTE THE OVERVIEW PAGE IF TOLD OTHERWISE, AND IN EVERY CASE KEEP EVIDENCE OF THE EFFORTS YOU DID MAKE — COPIES OF CORRESPONDENCE EVEN IF UNANSWERED, MEETING NOTES, AND ANY REPLIES RECEIVED. AND THERE IS AN EXPLICIT SAFETY SHORTCUT THAT THIS ENTRY LACKED: IF YOU FEAR THAT ENGAGING WITH THE BANK COULD LEAD TO RETALIATION OR ENDANGER YOU OR YOUR COMMUNITY'S SAFETY, YOU MAY PROCEED STRAIGHT TO FILING — EXPLAINING THE SAFETY RISKS CLEARLY IN THE COMPLAINT DOCUMENT. THE BANK HAS STATED IT HAS NO TOLERANCE FOR RETALIATION. FOUR MORE PRACTICAL RULES BELONG HERE. FIRST, LANGUAGE: COMPLAINTS MAY BE SUBMITTED IN ANY OF THE OFFICIAL OR NATIONAL LANGUAGES OF THE BANK'S DEVELOPING MEMBER COUNTRIES, THOUGH THE MECHANISM'S WORKING LANGUAGE IS ENGLISH AND TRANSLATION ADDS TIME — AND COMPLAINANTS MAY WRITE IN THEIR OWN WORDS WITHOUT FOLLOWING ANY SAMPLE LETTER OR FORM. SECOND, THE DEADLINE: A COMPLAINT MUST BE FILED WITHIN TWO YEARS OF THE LOAN OR GRANT CLOSING DATE — BUT THE MECHANISM DOES NOT REQUIRE THE BANK TO STILL HAVE A FINANCIAL INTEREST IN THE PROJECT, SO A FINISHED PROJECT IS STILL REACHABLE INSIDE THAT WINDOW. THIRD, WHAT IS EXCLUDED: DECISIONS ON THE PROCUREMENT OF GOODS AND SERVICES INCLUDING CONSULTING SERVICES; MATTERS FOR THE BANK'S APPEALS COMMITTEE OR ADMINISTRATIVE TRIBUNAL OR ITS PERSONNEL; ACTIONS NOT RELATED TO SOMETHING THE BANK DID OR FAILED TO DO; AND ANYTHING MORE THAN TWO YEARS AFTER CLOSING. PROCUREMENT BEING EXCLUDED MATTERS: A COMPLAINT THAT THE WRONG CONTRACTOR WAS CHOSEN WILL BE REFUSED, WHILE THE SAME FACTS FRAMED AS FAILURE TO ASSESS OR MITIGATE HARM MAY BE HEARD. FOURTH, WHO DECIDES: THE COMPLIANCE REVIEW PANEL CONSISTS OF THREE MEMBERS AND REPORTS ITS FINDINGS DIRECTLY TO THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS, WHICH IS THE SAME BOARD THAT MUST AUTHORISE AN INVESTIGATION.

trackers.name: National accreditation centre — which laboratories count here, and the international membership that carries their results abroad
trackers.desc: THREE ROUNDS AGO THIS FILE STOPPED SEARCHING FOR LABORATORIES AND STARTED SEARCHING FOR THE BODIES THAT ACCREDIT THEM. IT WORKS: HERE IS A STATE NATIONAL CENTRE FOR ACCREDITATION THAT HAS BEEN A FULL MEMBER OF THE INTERNATIONAL LABORATORY ACCREDITATION ORGANISATION SINCE 2016, WITH AN ACCREDITATION COUNCIL THAT MEETS IN THE STANDARDS AGENCY BUILDING. INTERNATIONAL MEMBERSHIP IS NOT CEREMONY. IT IS THE MECHANISM BY WHICH A RESULT PRODUCED IN THIS COUNTRY IS RECOGNISED ELSEWHERE — WHICH MATTERS WHERE EVIDENCE MAY TRAVEL TO A LENDER, A BUYER, OR ONE OF THE DEVELOPMENT BANK COMPLAINT OFFICES THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS, INCLUDING THE ONE FILED FOR THIS COUNTRY. BEHIND IT SITS AN AGENCY FOR STANDARDISATION, METROLOGY, CERTIFICATION AND TRADE INSPECTION UNDER THE GOVERNMENT, ESTABLISHED BY A GOVERNMENT RESOLUTION OF DECEMBER 2006 AND OPERATING UNDER A LAW ON THE NATIONAL CERTIFICATION SYSTEM.
