ITS ACCREDITATION TASKS ARE STATED PRECISELY, AND ONE WORD IN THEM CHANGES WHAT YOU SHOULD ASK: ACCREDITING CERTIFICATION BODIES AND TESTING LABORATORIES OR CENTRES AND ISSUING THEM PERMITS FOR THE RIGHT TO CARRY OUT PARTICULAR KINDS OF WORK, AND ESTABLISHING THE PROCEDURE FOR ACCREDITATION AND FOR ISSUING THOSE PERMITS. PERMITS FOR PARTICULAR KINDS OF WORK MEANS ACCREDITED IS NOT A YES OR NO. A LABORATORY MAY HOLD A PERMIT FOR FOOD TESTING AND NOT FOR WATER, OR FOR ONE METHOD AND NOT ANOTHER — SO THE QUESTION TO PUT TO THE CENTRE IS WHICH KINDS OF WORK A GIVEN LABORATORY'S PERMIT COVERS. THAT IS ALSO THE QUESTION THAT DEFEATS A BAD REPORT FROM THE OTHER SIDE. IF A DEVELOPER'S ASSESSMENT RESTS ON ANALYSES FROM A LABORATORY WHOSE PERMIT DOES NOT COVER THAT WORK, THE ACCREDITATION BODY IS THE PLACE THAT CAN CONFIRM IT — AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED ACROSS THE REGION THAT ASSESSMENTS ARE RARELY CHECKED AT ALL. THE PRACTICAL SEQUENCE IN THIS COUNTRY IS THEREFORE SHORT: ASK THE ACCREDITATION CENTRE WHICH LABORATORIES HOLD PERMITS FOR WATER, SOIL OR AIR WORK; ASK THOSE LABORATORIES WHAT THEY CHARGE AND WHAT FORM THE REPORT TAKES; AND KEEP THE ACCREDITATION REFERENCE ON THE REPORT ITSELF. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A QUALITY-INFRASTRUCTURE BODY SERVING CERTIFICATION AND TRADE - IT ACCREDITS AND PERMITS, IT DOES NOT TEST, INVESTIGATE OR TAKE SIDES, AND NOTHING HERE SUGGESTS IT WILL ASSIST A COMMUNITY IN A DISPUTE BEYOND CONFIRMING STATUS. THE REGISTER OF ACCREDITED BODIES WAS NOT SEEN IN THIS ROUND: HOW MANY LABORATORIES ARE ACCREDITED, WHETHER ANY COVER ENVIRONMENTAL MATRICES, AND WHETHER THE LIST IS PUBLISHED ONLINE WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED. THE CENTRE'S OWN SITE CARRIES DATED NEWS ITEMS AND PLACEHOLDER TEXT, WHICH SUGGESTS IT IS NOT ACTIVELY MAINTAINED, AND THE DESCRIPTION OF THE AGENCY'S ACCREDITATION TASKS COMES FROM AN ACADEMIC COURSE DOCUMENT REPRODUCING THE LEGAL PROVISIONS RATHER THAN FROM THE AGENCY ITSELF - BOTH SHOULD BE CONFIRMED BEFORE RELYING ON THEM. Read it with the state legal aid and its consultation register, the extractive transparency licence registers, the mountain development programme and the development bank accountability office recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Foundation for support of civil initiatives — a thirty-year-old environmental organisation whose mission is helping other groups exist
trackers.desc: THE LAST TWO ROUNDS OF THIS FILE RECORDED DECREES AND VALUATION MACHINERY. THIS ONE IS A PLAIN ORGANISATION: A PUBLIC ENVIRONMENTAL ORGANISATION CREATED BY A GROUP OF ENTHUSIASTS AT THE BEGINNING OF 1995 — IN THE DIFFICULT PERIOD OF CIVIL CONFRONTATION — AND GRANTED LEGAL STATUS ON THE FIRST OF JUNE THAT YEAR. AN ORGANISATION THAT REGISTERED ITSELF DURING A CIVIL WAR AND IS STILL RUNNING THIRTY YEARS LATER HAS SURVIVED EVERY POLITICAL WEATHER THIS COUNTRY HAS HAD. THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED HOW FEW SUCH BODIES EXIST IN CENTRAL ASIA, AND HOW MUCH THAT KIND OF LONGEVITY IS WORTH WHEN JUDGING WHAT CAN SAFELY BE ATTEMPTED. ITS MISSION IS THE PART A COMMUNITY SHOULD READ TWICE: SUPPORTING THE DEVELOPMENT OF THE COUNTRY'S CIVIL SECTOR THROUGH THE IMPLEMENTATION OF ENVIRONMENTAL INITIATIVES DIRECTED AT PROTECTION OF THE ENVIRONMENT, THE GREEN ECONOMY, SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT, AND THE DESIGN AND IMPLEMENTATION OF NATURAL RESOURCE MANAGEMENT PROGRAMMES. SUPPORTING THE DEVELOPMENT OF THE CIVIL SECTOR MEANS HELPING OTHER GROUPS EXIST, NOT ONLY RUNNING ITS OWN PROJECTS. THAT IS EXACTLY WHAT A VILLAGE WITH NO REGISTERED BODY NEEDS — AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED, FUND AFTER FUND, THAT THE ABSENCE OF A REGISTERED LOCAL ORGANISATION IS THE COMMONEST REASON MONEY CANNOT REACH A COMMUNITY. SO THE FIRST ASK IS NOT FOR A GRANT. IT IS: WILL YOU HELP US FORM AND REGISTER A LOCAL ORGANISATION, OR ACT AS THE REGISTERED PARTNER WHILE WE DO. THE SECOND ASK FOLLOWS FROM THE LAST CLAUSE OF THE MISSION: THE DESIGN AND IMPLEMENTATION OF NATURAL RESOURCE MANAGEMENT PROGRAMMES. THAT IS THE LANGUAGE IN WHICH PASTURE, WATER, FOREST AND IRRIGATION DISPUTES CAN BE PUT TO AN ORGANISATION IN THIS COUNTRY WITHOUT FRAMING THEM AS OPPOSITION TO ANYBODY. IT IS NOT ALONE IN THE FIELD: A SECOND NON-COMMERCIAL ORGANISATION CREATED BY YOUNG ACTIVISTS, A MEMBER OF AN INTERNATIONAL SOCIAL-ECOLOGICAL UNION, IS ALREADY RECORDED SEPARATELY IN THIS PAYLOAD, AND A PUBLIC GUIDE LISTS BOTH AMONG THE COUNTRY'S ENVIRONMENTAL INITIATIVES ALONGSIDE THE STATE PROGRAMMES. TWO INDEPENDENT ORGANISATIONS, ONE THIRTY YEARS OLD AND ONE YOUNGER, IS A SMALL FIELD BUT A REAL ONE — AND APPROACHING BOTH COSTS NOTHING AND DOUBLES THE CHANCE THAT ONE HAS CAPACITY THIS YEAR. THE STATE BACKDROP IS WORTH KNOWING FOR TONE: THE PRESIDENT REGULARLY RAISES ECOLOGY AND CLIMATE CHANGE AT THE UNITED NATIONS AND IN OTHER INTERNATIONAL BODIES, AND THE COUNTRY IS DESCRIBED AS ACTIVELY PROMOTING ENVIRONMENTAL INITIATIVES ALONGSIDE PUBLIC ORGANISATIONS AND YOUTH PROJECTS. WHERE A HEAD OF STATE HAS MADE CLIMATE AND WATER A NATIONAL SIGNATURE, A LOCAL PROPOSAL PHRASED IN THOSE TERMS IS EASIER TO CARRY THAN ONE PHRASED AS A COMPLAINT — AND THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED THE SAME PATTERN IN EVERY CENTRAL ASIAN COUNTRY IT COVERS. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A DEVELOPMENT AND ENVIRONMENTAL ORGANISATION, NOT AN ADVOCATE OR A LAWYER - IT WILL NOT LITIGATE, BUY LAND OR OPPOSE A STATE PROJECT, AND ITS OWN SURVIVAL IN A CLOSED SYSTEM DEPENDS ON NOT DOING SO. WHAT IT CURRENTLY RUNS, WHETHER IT TAKES REQUESTS FROM VILLAGES, WHETHER IT HAS OFFICES OUTSIDE THE CAPITAL AND WHETHER IT STILL HELPS OTHERS REGISTER WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED - THE DESCRIPTION COMES FROM ITS OWN SITE REPRODUCING A NATIONAL GREEN ECONOMY REVIEW AND FROM A CONSUMER GUIDE'S ROUND-UP OF ENVIRONMENTAL INITIATIVES, SOME OF IT MORE THAN A DECADE OLD. FOREIGN-FUNDED CIVIL ORGANISATIONS IN THIS COUNTRY OPERATE UNDER REGISTRATION AND REPORTING PRESSURE THAT THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED ELSEWHERE. Read it with the mountain development programme and its adaptation call, the state legal aid and its consultation register, the national accreditation centre and the development bank accountability office recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Small grants for individuals — money for a person's training rather than a project, by nomination, with the 2026 call open
trackers.desc: EVERY FUND THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED PAYS AN ORGANISATION FOR A PROJECT. THIS ONE PAYS FOR A PERSON: SMALL GRANTS TO INDIVIDUALS TO EXPAND THEIR KNOWLEDGE, EXPERIENCE AND TRAINING, DESCRIBED AS AN ACCESSIBLE AND TAILORED SMALL GRANT FOR THE EDUCATION AND TRAINING OF INDIVIDUALS NOMINATED BY THEIR ORGANISATION AS POTENTIAL FUTURE LEADERS. WHAT IT BUYS IS SPECIFIC: COURSES OR TRAINING TO ADVANCE KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS, OR INTERNSHIPS, EXPOSURE AND EXCHANGE TRAVEL, OR PARTICIPATION IN CONFERENCES AND HIGH-LEVEL MEETINGS - AND IT IS CRUCIAL THAT THE ACTIVITIES ARE EXCLUSIVELY FOR PERSONAL DEVELOPMENT AND NOT PART OF A LARGER ORGANISATIONAL PROJECT. THAT RESTRICTION IS THE OPPOSITE OF EVERY OTHER FUND HERE, AND IT SOLVES A PROBLEM THIS FILE KEEPS RECORDING: A VILLAGE ORGANISATION CAN OFTEN FIND PROJECT MONEY BUT NEVER MONEY TO SEND ITS BEST PERSON TO LEARN SOMETHING. THIS IS THAT MONEY. THE ENTRY RULE IS UNUSUAL AND MUST BE PLANNED FOR: THE INITIATIVE WORKS WITH A NOMINATION PROCESS - PARTICIPANTS DO NOT APPLY THEMSELVES BUT ARE NOMINATED BY ANOTHER INDIVIDUAL, WITH STATED RESPONSIBILITIES AND CREDIBILITY REQUIREMENTS FOR NOMINATORS. SO THE FIRST TASK IS NOT WRITING AN APPLICATION BUT FINDING A CREDIBLE NOMINATOR - WHICH IS WHERE THE NETWORKS THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS EARN THEIR KEEP: A MEMBER OF A CONSERVATION UNION, A PARALEGAL NETWORK OR A REGIONAL ENVIRONMENTAL BODY IS EXACTLY THE KIND OF PERSON WHOSE NOMINATION CARRIES. WHO QUALIFIES IS BROAD: YOUNG WOMEN AND MEN, PREFERABLY UNDER THIRTY-FIVE, WORKING FOR OR AFFILIATED WITH ENVIRONMENTAL CIVIL SOCIETY ORGANISATIONS IN DEVELOPING AND EMERGING ECONOMIES, WORKING WITH OR LINKED TO LOCAL COMMUNITIES OR COMMUNITY-BASED ORGANISATIONS, AND SHOWING POTENTIAL AND AMBITION TO BE INNOVATIVE AND CREATIVE. AFFILIATED WITH MATTERS AS MUCH AS EMPLOYED BY. SOMEBODY WHO VOLUNTEERS FOR A VILLAGE ASSOCIATION IS INSIDE THE DESCRIPTION, WHICH IS RARE IN FUNDING CRITERIA. AND THE INITIATIVE SAYS PLAINLY WHOM IT IS TRYING TO REACH: THROUGH ITS NETWORK OF LOCAL PARTNERS IT IDENTIFIES YOUNG LEADERS WHO WOULD OTHERWISE REMAIN OUT OF SIGHT - YOUNG AND TALENTED PEOPLE FROM INDIGENOUS COMMUNITIES, PEOPLE WITH LITTLE FORMAL EDUCATION BUT GREAT AMBITIONS, AND ESPECIALLY YOUNG WOMEN. PEOPLE WITH LITTLE FORMAL EDUCATION BUT GREAT AMBITIONS IS A PHRASE ALMOST NO FUNDER WRITES DOWN. IT MEANS THE ABSENCE OF A DEGREE IS NOT A DISQUALIFICATION HERE, WHICH IT QUIETLY IS ALMOST EVERYWHERE ELSE IN THIS FILE. THE CALENDAR IS ONE DEADLINE A YEAR, AND THE CURRENT ONE IS LIVE: THE 2026 CALL OPENED ON THE FIRST OF JULY AND APPLICATIONS CLOSE AT THE END OF AUGUST 2026, WITH AN AGGREGATOR RECORDING THE GRANT AS UP TO SEVEN THOUSAND EUROS. THE PARENT ORGANISATION IS WORTH KNOWING SEPARATELY: AN INDEPENDENT NETHERLANDS BODY WORKING ON CLIMATE, WATER, LAND AND CAPITAL, WHICH SUPPORTS ORGANISATIONS IN DEVELOPING COUNTRIES THROUGH ADVOCACY, POLICY WORK, TRAINING AND CAPACITY BUILDING. IT ALSO PROMOTES A NAMED METHOD THIS FILE HAS BEEN CIRCLING FOR HUNDREDS OF ROUNDS: A NEGOTIATED APPROACH, ENVISAGING THE MEANINGFUL AND LONG-TERM PARTICIPATION OF COMMUNITIES IN ALL ASPECTS OF MANAGING THE WATER AND OTHER NATURAL RESOURCES ON WHICH THEIR LIVES DEPEND, SEEKING HEALTHY ECOSYSTEMS AND EQUITABLE SHARING OF BENEFITS AMONG ALL STAKEHOLDERS WITHIN A RIVER BASIN. IN A COUNTRY WHOSE WATER DECISIONS ARE TAKEN UPSTREAM AND DOWNSTREAM OF ITS BORDERS, A NAMED BASIN-WIDE PARTICIPATION METHOD WITH AN ORGANISATION BEHIND IT IS WORTH ASKING ABOUT BY NAME. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A PERSONAL DEVELOPMENT GRANT, NOT PROJECT, LEGAL OR LAND FUNDING - IT WILL NOT PAY FOR A LAWYER, A SURVEY OR A HECTARE, AND BY DESIGN IT WILL NOT FUND ANYTHING THAT IS PART OF AN ORGANISATIONAL PROJECT. IT IS FOR YOUNGER PEOPLE, WITH A STATED PREFERENCE UNDER THIRTY-FIVE, AND IT CANNOT BE APPLIED FOR DIRECTLY - WITHOUT A NOMINATOR THERE IS NO ROUTE IN. THE GRANT CEILING AND THE 2026 DATES COME FROM OPPORTUNITY AGGREGATORS RATHER THAN THE INITIATIVE'S OWN PAGE, WHICH SHOULD BE CHECKED BEFORE RELYING ON THEM, AND WHETHER THE COUNTRY THIS IS FILED UNDER IS WITHIN ITS ELIGIBLE LIST WAS NOT ESTABLISHED - ITS PARTNER NETWORK IS CONCENTRATED ELSEWHERE, AND SELECTION RUNS THROUGH THAT NETWORK. Read it with the foundation for support of civil initiatives, the mountain development programme's adaptation call, the national accreditation centre and the development bank accountability office recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Village self-government body and its mahalla and village committees — elected locally, responsible for water sources, and obliged to meet twice a year
trackers.desc: THE SMALLEST ELECTED BODY IN THIS COUNTRY IS ALSO THE ONE THAT ANSWERS FOR THE THING VILLAGES FIGHT OVER MOST: IT DECIDES QUESTIONS OF LOCAL SIGNIFICANCE SUCH AS THE MAINTENANCE OF WATER SUPPLY SOURCES, THE IMPROVEMENT OF ROADS, STREETS AND SQUARES, AND KEEPING THE LOCALITY CLEAR OF RUBBISH. IT ALSO HAS A DUTY TOWARDS WHAT PEOPLE BRING IT: IT CONSIDERS CITIZENS' APPEALS AND, WITHIN ITS POWERS, TAKES CORRESPONDING MEASURES TO RESOLVE THEM. A BODY WITH A LEGAL DUTY TO CONSIDER APPEALS IS ONE THAT CAN BE WRITTEN TO, AND WHOSE SILENCE IS ITSELF A FACT. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED, ACROSS TWENTY-THREE COUNTRIES, THAT THE FIRST DATED PIECE OF PAPER IS WHAT EVERY LATER STEP RESTS ON - AND HERE THE FIRST ONE GOES TO AN OFFICE IN THE VILLAGE. IT IS ELECTED, WHICH MATTERS: IT IS THE SELF-GOVERNMENT BODY OF SETTLEMENTS AND VILLAGES, ELECTED BY THEIR VOTERS, AND SELF-GOVERNMENT IS DEFINED AS THE ACTIVITY OF THE POPULATION, DIRECTLY OR THROUGH THEIR BODIES, UNDER THEIR OWN RESPONSIBILITY, TO RESOLVE SOCIAL, ECONOMIC AND CULTURAL QUESTIONS OF LOCAL SIGNIFICANCE, TAKING ACCOUNT OF NATIONAL TRADITIONS AND LOCAL SPECIFICITY. ITS PARTS ARE WORTH KNOWING BEFORE APPROACHING IT: AN ASSEMBLY, WHICH IS THE MAIN FORM OF ITS ACTIVITY AND WHERE ITS QUESTIONS ARE DECIDED; A COUNCIL, WHICH IS ITS COLLEGIAL ORGAN; A CHAIRMAN ELECTED BY ITS DEPUTIES; AND DEPUTIES ELECTED AS THE LAW PROVIDES. THE CHAIRMAN IS ELECTED BY THE DEPUTIES, NOT APPOINTED FROM ABOVE - SO THE DEPUTIES ARE THE PEOPLE TO PERSUADE, AND THEY LIVE IN THE VILLAGE. PARTICIPATION IS OPEN BY LAW: CITIZENS AGED EIGHTEEN AND OVER LIVING ON THE TERRITORY HAVE THE RIGHT TO PARTICIPATE IN THE ORGANISATION AND ACTIVITY OF THE SELF-GOVERNMENT BODIES. BENEATH IT SITS THE LAYER THAT ACTUALLY TOUCHES HOUSEHOLDS: THE MICRODISTRICT COUNCILS, THE MAHALLA COUNCILS AND THE VILLAGE COMMITTEES, WHOSE REPRESENTATIVES ARE ALL ELECTED AT GENERAL MEETINGS OF THEIR VILLAGES BY OPEN VOTING - AND THE TERM FOR WHICH A REPRESENTATIVE IS ELECTED DEPENDS ON THE WILL OF THAT VILLAGE'S CITIZENS. A REPRESENTATIVE WHOSE TERM LASTS AS LONG AS THE VILLAGE WANTS IT TO IS AN UNUSUALLY DIRECT ARRANGEMENT, AND IT IS THE LEVER A COMMUNITY HAS WHEN ITS OWN REPRESENTATIVE SIDES WITH A PROJECT. AND THERE IS A MEETING THAT MUST HAPPEN WHETHER OR NOT ANYONE ASKS: THE BASIC FORM OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT IS THE ASSEMBLY OF REPRESENTATIVES, CONVENED BY THE CHAIRMAN AS NEEDED BUT NOT LESS THAN TWICE A YEAR, WITH DECISIONS TAKEN BY OPEN VOTING AND SIMPLE MAJORITY OF THOSE PRESENT. TWICE A YEAR, IN THE OPEN, BY SIMPLE MAJORITY. THAT IS TWO FIXED CHANCES EVERY YEAR TO PUT A WATER SOURCE, A ROAD OR A DUMPING PROBLEM IN FRONT OF EVERY REPRESENTATIVE AT ONCE - AND OPEN VOTING MEANS EVERYONE SEES WHO STOOD WHERE. ONE MORE PRACTICAL POINT: SEPARATE STATE POWERS PLACED ON THESE BODIES MAY INCLUDE THE REGISTRATION OF CIVIL STATUS ACTS AND THE ISSUE TO CITIZENS OF DOCUMENTS CONFIRMING THEIR PLACE OF RESIDENCE AND THEIR FAMILY AND OTHER STATUS. THE DOCUMENT CONFIRMING WHERE YOU LIVE IS OFTEN THE PAPER A LAND CLAIM, A GRANT APPLICATION OR A COMPENSATION FILE STANDS OR FALLS ON - AND IT IS ISSUED IN THE VILLAGE, BY THIS BODY. THE LIMITS: THIS IS THE STATE'S LOWEST ADMINISTRATIVE TIER AS WELL AS THE VILLAGE'S OWN BODY - IN PRACTICE IT SITS UNDER DISTRICT AUTHORITIES AND DEPENDS ON THEM FOR MONEY, ITS POWERS ARE CONFINED TO QUESTIONS OF LOCAL SIGNIFICANCE, AND NOTHING RECORDED HERE SHOWS ONE OPPOSING A STATE OR INVESTOR PROJECT; THIS PAYLOAD ALREADY RECORDS THE POLITICAL CONSTRAINTS ON CIVIC ACTIVITY IN THIS COUNTRY. WHETHER THE ASSEMBLIES ARE HELD IN PRACTICE, WHETHER MINUTES EXIST, WHAT BUDGET THE BODY CONTROLS AND WHETHER IT HAS ANY SAY OVER LAND ALLOCATION WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED - THE LAST IS THE QUESTION THAT MATTERS MOST AND WAS NOT ANSWERED. THE DESCRIPTION COMES FROM A UNITED NATIONS AGENCY'S LAND-RIGHTS COUNTRY PROFILE, THE TEXT OF THE 2009 LAW ON A NATIONAL LEGISLATION CENTRE'S SITE, AND AN ACADEMIC ARTICLE - NOT FROM ANY BODY'S OWN PUBLICATION, AND THE SUB-VILLAGE DETAIL COMES FROM THAT ARTICLE ALONE. Read it with the foundation for support of civil initiatives, the mountain development programme's adaptation call, the state legal aid and its consultation register and the individual small grants recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Social investment fund with a public subproject map — money to jamoats and communities, and a training programme they are measured on
trackers.desc: THE FOURTH ROUND RUNNING ON BODIES THAT FINANCE WHAT COMMUNITIES THEMSELVES PLAN, AND THIS ONE PUBLISHES ITS WORK ON A MAP: THE FUND RUNS A MANAGEMENT INFORMATION SYSTEM ON WHICH FILTERS DISPLAY THE REQUIRED SUBPROJECTS ON A MAP AND WHICH REPORTS THE TOTAL VOLUME OF APPROVED INVESTMENTS UNDER THE SUBPROJECTS. A PUBLIC MAP OF EVERY FUNDED SUBPROJECT IS THE MOST USEFUL SINGLE ARTEFACT A COMMUNITY CAN HAVE WHEN ASKING FOR MONEY: IT SHOWS WHAT WAS FUNDED, WHERE, AND WHETHER ANYTHING HAS EVER BEEN BUILT IN ITS OWN DISTRICT - AND IT ANSWERS THE QUESTION EVERY OFFICIAL DEFLECTS, WHICH IS WHY THE NEIGHBOURING VILLAGE GOT SOMETHING AND THIS ONE DID NOT. ITS PUBLISHED INDICATORS SHOW WHAT IT IS ACTUALLY TRYING TO CHANGE, AND ONE IS UNUSUAL: THE PERCENTAGE OF TARGET JAMOATS THAT COMPLETED THE AGREED LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT TRAINING PROGRAMME. A FUND THAT MEASURES ITSELF ON HOW MANY VILLAGE ADMINISTRATIONS FINISHED THEIR TRAINING IS A FUND WITH A TRAINING PROGRAMME TO ASK FOR. THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS SEPARATELY THAT THIS COUNTRY'S VILLAGE SELF-GOVERNMENT BODIES DECIDE WATER SOURCES, ROADS AND RUBBISH - THEY ARE EXACTLY WHO SHOULD BE TRAINED. THE SECOND INDICATOR IS RARER STILL: THE PERCENTAGE OF BENEFICIARIES IN TARGET COMMUNITIES WHO REPORT INCREASED TRUST IN LOCAL INSTITUTIONS AS A RESULT OF SPECIFICALLY IDENTIFIED PROJECT ACTIVITIES. SOMEBODY IS SURVEYING RESIDENTS ABOUT WHETHER THEY TRUST THEIR OWN LOCAL INSTITUTIONS MORE THAN BEFORE. THAT SURVEY IS A DOCUMENT, AND A COMMUNITY THAT WANTS ITS EXPERIENCE ON RECORD SHOULD ASK TO BE IN IT. ONE OF ITS PROGRAMMES EXISTS BECAUSE OF SOMETHING THIS FILE DOCUMENTS CONSTANTLY - A LARGE PROJECT CROSSING PEOPLE'S LAND: TO ENSURE BENEFIT FOR THE COMMUNITIES LYING WITHIN THE PATH OF A POWER TRANSMISSION LINE, A DEVELOPMENT BANK INITIATED COMMUNITY SUPPORT PROJECTS IN ALL FOUR PARTICIPATING COUNTRIES BY INVESTING IN THE IMPROVEMENT OF INFRASTRUCTURE AT LOCAL LEVEL, WITH THIS COUNTRY'S HUNDRED AND SEVENTY KILOMETRE SECTION RUNNING FROM A NORTHERN PROVINCE TO A SOUTHERN ONE. THAT IS THE MODEL EVERY COMMUNITY ON THE ROUTE OF A LINE, A PIPE OR A ROAD SHOULD DEMAND BY NAME: NOT COMPENSATION FOR A PYLON, BUT A FUNDED COMMUNITY SUPPORT PROGRAMME ALONG THE WHOLE CORRIDOR, PAID FOR BY THE FINANCIER OF THE LINE. THE MONEY IS CURRENT: IN 2025 THE GOVERNMENT RECEIVED A GRANT OF TWENTY-FIVE MILLION DOLLARS IN ADDITIONAL FINANCING FOR A PROJECT TO STRENGTHEN SOCIO-ECONOMIC RESILIENCE, WHICH EXPANDS AND DEEPENS THE APPROACHES OF THE MAIN PROJECT AND INCLUDES NEW GEOGRAPHIC AREAS. NEW GEOGRAPHIC AREAS IS THE PHRASE TO CHASE. A DISTRICT NOT PREVIOUSLY COVERED HAS A REASON TO ASK NOW, WHILE THE MAP IS BEING REDRAWN. AND THE CHAIN IT WORKS THROUGH REACHES ALL THE WAY DOWN: THE FUND COOPERATES WITH EIGHT NAMED MINISTRIES AND COMMITTEES - INCLUDING THOSE FOR INVESTMENTS AND PROPERTY MANAGEMENT, FOR WOMEN AND FAMILY AFFAIRS AND FOR ARCHITECTURE AND CONSTRUCTION - AND WITH THE LOCAL EXECUTIVE BODIES OF ONE PROVINCE AND ONE AUTONOMOUS PROVINCE, THE DISTRICTS, THE JAMOATS, AND THE COMMUNITIES THEMSELVES. THE COMMUNITIES THEMSELVES BEING NAMED AT THE END OF THAT CHAIN, ALONGSIDE MINISTRIES, IS THE WHOLE POINT - AND IT IS CONTACTABLE IN THE ORDINARY WAY, WITH A PUBLISHED STREET ADDRESS DOWN TO THE BUILDING AND FLOOR, THREE TELEPHONE NUMBERS AND THREE E-MAIL ADDRESSES, ONE GENERAL AND TWO FOR NAMED PROJECTS. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A GOVERNMENT FUND IMPLEMENTING FOREIGN-FINANCED PROJECTS, NOT AN ADVOCATE - IT BUILDS SOCIAL AND ECONOMIC INFRASTRUCTURE WHERE PROGRAMMES DIRECT, AND NOTHING RECORDED HERE SHOWS IT DEFENDING LAND, FUNDING A LEGAL CASE OR OPPOSING ANY SCHEME; THE COMMUNITY SUPPORT PROGRAMME ALONG THE TRANSMISSION LINE EXISTS TO MAKE THAT LINE ACCEPTABLE, NOT TO QUESTION IT. WHICH DISTRICTS AND JAMOATS ARE TARGETED, HOW A COMMUNITY APPLIES, WHAT CO-FINANCING IS REQUIRED AND WHETHER RESIDENTS OR ONLY OFFICIALS TAKE PART IN THE TRAINING WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED - AND THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS SEPARATELY THAT CIVIC ACTIVITY IN THIS COUNTRY IS TIGHTLY CONSTRAINED, SO THE TRUST SURVEY SHOULD BE READ WITH THAT IN MIND. THE ACCOUNT COMES FROM THE FUND'S OWN INFORMATION SYSTEM AND PROJECT PAGES, WITH THE 2025 GRANT DESCRIBED ON ITS OWN PROJECT SITE. Read it with the village self-government body and its twice-yearly assembly, the five-hectare protected transfer and the mountain societies programme, the foundation for support of civil initiatives and the state legal aid recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Water user associations — self-governing membership bodies with an elected chairman, an audit commission and their own dispute resolution commission
trackers.desc: THE DEFINITION IS THE ENTRY. A WATER USERS' ASSOCIATION IS A NON-COMMERCIAL AND SELF-GOVERNING ORGANISATION OF WATER USERS, BASED ON MEMBERSHIP, CREATED VOLUNTARILY ON A DEFINED TERRITORY, FOR THE COLLECTIVE USE AND MAINTENANCE OF THE RECLAMATION SYSTEM OF THE SERVICE ZONE, THE PROVISION OF IRRIGATION WATER, THE COORDINATION OF ACTIVITY, AND THE REPRESENTATION AND DEFENCE OF THEIR COMMON INTERESTS. REPRESENTATION AND DEFENCE OF COMMON INTERESTS SITS IN THE LEGAL DEFINITION, NOT IN A MISSION STATEMENT. AN IRRIGATION BODY THAT IS ALSO, BY LAW, A DEFENDER OF ITS MEMBERS' INTERESTS IS THE MOST USEFUL VILLAGE INSTITUTION THIS FILE HAS FOUND IN THIS COUNTRY. WHO BELONGS IS EQUALLY PRECISE: WATER USERS POSSESSING THE RIGHT OF LAND USE, LOCATED IN THE ZONE SERVED, WHO RECOGNISE ITS STATUTE AND HAVE VOLUNTARILY JOINED. THE RIGHT OF LAND USE, NOT OWNERSHIP, IS THE QUALIFICATION - WHICH IN A COUNTRY WHERE LAND IS HELD BY USE CERTIFICATE RATHER THAN TITLE MEANS ORDINARY FARMING HOUSEHOLDS QUALIFY. WHAT MAKES IT SELF-GOVERNING IS THE ASSEMBLY AND WHAT IT CONTROLS: THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY IS THE HIGHEST ORGAN OF MANAGEMENT AND IS CONVENED NOT LESS THAN ONCE A YEAR, WITH POWER TO APPROVE THE STATUTE AND AMEND IT, TO ELECT THE CHAIRMAN AND HIS DEPUTY, AND TO ESTABLISH THE COUNCIL, THE AUDIT COMMISSION AND THE COMMISSION FOR THE RESOLUTION OF DISPUTES AND ELECT THEIR MEMBERS. A DISPUTE RESOLUTION COMMISSION ELECTED BY THE WATER USERS THEMSELVES IS THE PART TO SEIZE ON. EVERY IRRIGATION QUARREL IN THIS FILE - WHO TAKES WATER WHEN, WHOSE FIELD DRIES, WHOSE PUMP RUNS AT NIGHT - HAS A FORUM HERE THAT IS NEITHER A COURT NOR AN OFFICIAL, AND ITS MEMBERS ARE NEIGHBOURS WHO CAN BE VOTED OUT. AN AUDIT COMMISSION ELECTED THE SAME WAY IS THE OTHER HALF: THE MONEY THE ASSOCIATION COLLECTS IS CHECKED BY PEOPLE THE MEMBERS CHOSE, AND THE ASSEMBLY APPROVES THE REGULATIONS GOVERNING ALL THREE BODIES. AND AN EXTRAORDINARY GENERAL ASSEMBLY IS CONVENED ON THE INITIATIVE OF THE COUNCIL - SO A PROBLEM ARRIVING IN JULY NEED NOT WAIT FOR THE ANNUAL MEETING. THE STATUTE MUST SET OUT, AMONG OTHER THINGS, THE CONDITIONS AND PROCEDURE FOR ADMISSION TO MEMBERSHIP AND WITHDRAWAL FROM IT AS WELL AS EXCLUSION, AND THE STRUCTURE, COMPOSITION AND COMPETENCE OF THE GOVERNING ORGANS. EXCLUSION BEING WRITTEN INTO THE STATUTE CUTS BOTH WAYS, AND A MEMBER SHOULD READ THAT CLAUSE FIRST: THE POWER TO EXPEL A FARMER FROM THE BODY THAT ALLOCATES HIS WATER IS THE SHARPEST POWER IN THE VILLAGE. THE DUTIES ARE HEAVY AND WORTH KNOWING BEFORE JOINING: MEMBERS MUST SUBMIT AT THE END OF EACH YEAR APPLICATIONS FOR THE VOLUME OF WATER TO BE RECEIVED, DRAWN UP IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE STRUCTURE OF SOWING OF IRRIGATED CROPS AND THE IRRIGATION NORMS; PAY MEMBERSHIP DUES INTO THE ASSOCIATION'S ACCOUNT AND WATER-SUPPLY SERVICE CHARGES INTO THE ACCOUNT OF THE LOCAL STRUCTURE OF THE AUTHORISED STATE BODY; OBSERVE THE SCHEDULE OF WATER DISTRIBUTION BETWEEN MEMBERS AND OTHER USERS; KEEP THE RECLAMATION SYSTEM AND HYDRAULIC STRUCTURES IN WORKING CONDITION AND NOT ALLOW THE DETERIORATION OF THE RECLAMATION STATE OF THE LANDS; AND COMPENSATE DAMAGE THEY CAUSE. THE ANNUAL WATER APPLICATION IS THE DOCUMENT THAT MATTERS MOST. IT TIES A HOUSEHOLD'S WATER TO WHAT IT PLANTS, WHICH MEANS THE CROPPING DECISION AND THE WATER DECISION ARE THE SAME DECISION - AND A COMMUNITY SHIFTING TO LESS THIRSTY CROPS HAS A PLACE TO RECORD IT AND A REASON TO EXPECT SOMETHING BACK. TWO PAYMENTS GOING TO TWO DIFFERENT ACCOUNTS IS ALSO WORTH NOTING: DUES TO THE ASSOCIATION, SERVICE CHARGES TO THE STATE BODY. A FARMER TOLD HE OWES ONE SHOULD ASK WHICH, AND SEE THE ACCOUNT. THE ASSOCIATION IS REGISTERED AS A LEGAL PERSON UNDER THE LAW ON THE STATE REGISTRATION OF LEGAL PERSONS AND INDIVIDUAL ENTREPRENEURS - SO IT CAN HOLD AN ACCOUNT, SIGN AND SUE. THE LIMITS: THIS ENTRY DESCRIBES WHAT THE LAW PROVIDES, NOT WHAT EXISTS IN ANY PARTICULAR VALLEY - HOW MANY ASSOCIATIONS FUNCTION, WHETHER THEIR ASSEMBLIES ACTUALLY MEET, WHETHER THE DISPUTE COMMISSIONS ARE USED AND WHETHER CHAIRMEN ARE GENUINELY ELECTED WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED, AND THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS ELSEWHERE IN THE REGION THAT SUCH ASSOCIATIONS ARE OFTEN UNDERFUNDED AND DOMINATED BY LARGER FARMS. MEMBERSHIP REQUIRES THE RIGHT OF LAND USE, SO LANDLESS LABOURERS AND WOMEN WITHOUT A CERTIFICATE IN THEIR OWN NAME ARE OUTSIDE IT. THE ASSOCIATION ALLOCATES WATER AND MAINTAINS CANALS - IT IS NOT A CONSERVATION OR LEGAL BODY AND WILL NOT OPPOSE A DAM OR A DIVERSION UPSTREAM. THE TEXT READ IS A LEGAL DATABASE COPY OF THE LAW HOSTED BY AN INTERNATIONAL AGRICULTURE ORGANISATION, WITH SUPPORTING TEXT FROM A NATIONAL LEGISLATION CENTRE AND TWO REGIONAL LEGAL LIBRARIES; WHETHER THE LAW HAS SINCE BEEN AMENDED WAS NOT ESTABLISHED. Read it with the village self-government body and its twice-yearly assembly, the social investment fund's subproject map, the five-hectare protected transfer and the mountain societies programme recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Répertoire du Commerce et de l’Industrie
trackers.desc: National — Monaco business / trade and industry register. — Holds to account: state firms & government-linked companies — find their registration, directors and filings.

trackers.name: Monaco — Direction du Budget et du Trésor (Département des Finances)
trackers.desc: National budget authority; the Budget & Treasury Directorate prepares & executes the State budget, Principality of Monaco. Here you can trace how the public budget is allocated and spent in MCO.

trackers.name: Monaco — Commission Supérieure des Comptes
trackers.desc: National public-finance watchdog; the Commission Supérieure des Comptes (Art. 42 of the Constitution) is Monaco’s Supreme Audit Institution (INTOSAI/EUROSAI member), auditing the accounts & financial management of the State, commune & public bodies and publishing an annual public report, Monaco.

trackers.name: Volunteers created the reserve in 1976 — and still manage it
trackers.desc: THE SEQUENCE IS THE LESSON: VOLUNTEERS FIRST, INSTRUMENT SECOND, MANAGEMENT CONTRACT THIRD. In 1976 the volunteers of the Association Monégasque pour la Protection de la Nature, chaired by Eugène Debernardi, created the Larvotto underwater reserve to preserve the only Posidonia meadow in Monaco, established by ordonnance souveraine of Prince Rainier III. Faced with the success of that approach a second reserve followed in 1986 — the Tombant des Spélugues, protecting the only coralligenous drop-off in the Principality. Nearly 50 years on the same association is still the manager. Larvotto is described as the world's first urban marine protected area. A small association identified a single irreplaceable habitat, obtained an instrument for it, then kept the job. THE GOVERNANCE IS WORTH COPYING TOO — THREE TIERS: a national monitoring committee setting guidelines, whose members include the Government, the Prince Albert II Foundation, the Institute of Oceanography, the Monaco Scientific Centre and the Departments of Environment and Maritime Affairs; a Marine Protected Areas Coordination Group implementing them; and a manager, AMPN, doing the daily work. The scientific institutions sit on the committee alongside government, so the science is not something the association must fight to have heard.

trackers.name: Inventories are decision support for planning — and the honest tension
trackers.desc: THE GOVERNMENT SAYS ITS OWN INVENTORIES FEED PLANNING DECISIONS. Species and habitat inventories are described as tools of knowledge and awareness but also of decision support for the State in implementing its territorial planning policy and its marine biodiversity surveillance and protection strategy, with time-series monitoring and indicators of species and environments tracking ecosystem health. So the monitoring record is relevant evidence in a planning argument, not merely scientific interest. THE FACTS: Larvotto covers 33.6 ha on the official figure, running from the shore to about 600 m offshore from the eastern frontier with France — note that secondary sources say ‘approximately 50 hectares’; this entry uses the figure published by gouv.mc. Fishing, anchoring and sailing are strictly prohibited, and the reserve is actively patrolled, scientifically monitored and legally enforced. It holds artificial reefs, the last placed in 2004, sheltering large sponges, gorgonians and red coral; it is a Ramsar wetland of international importance; and it sits above the Pelagos Sanctuary for marine mammals. Monaco has only 7.5 km of coastline. THE HONEST TENSION: Monaco is the world's most densely built principality and has expanded its territory by building out into the sea. A rigorously protected marine reserve here has not prevented major coastal construction, and the terrestrial Larvotto area has itself seen significant works — worth knowing before citing Monaco as a model outcome rather than a model mechanism.

trackers.name: Fondation Prince Albert II — 50 percent maximum, and it funds far beyond Monaco
trackers.desc: A MONACO-BASED FUNDER WHOSE REACH COVERS MUCH OF THIS MAP. Established 2006, the Fondation Prince Albert II de Monaco works in three fields — climate change and renewable energies, biodiversity protection, and water resources and desertification — across three priority geographies: the Mediterranean Basin, the Polar Regions, and countries on the UN list of Least Developed Countries. That puts the entire Mediterranean rim and every LDC in scope — so a reader in Lebanon, Morocco, Tunisia, Albania, Malawi, Nepal, Liberia or Kiribati can apply to it, which is why this entry matters well beyond Monaco. It funds civil society organisations, foundations, public and international organisations, private enterprises and government bodies. THE CONSTRAINT TO PLAN FOR: no maximum grant is specified, but requested funding cannot exceed 50 percent of the total project budget — you must have the other half identified before applying; this is a co-financing funder, not a sole funder. AND DO NOT START EARLY: recorded grounds for refusal include projects outside the three domains, projects outside the priority geographies, and activities starting before the designated funding year — retrospective work is excluded. Applications are made online against an annual call for projects.

trackers.name: Eurosite / ELCN — who already holds land near you, and the easement route
trackers.desc: A DIRECTORY OF THE PEOPLE WHO ALREADY HOLD AND MANAGE LAND IN YOUR COUNTRY — which is who you need when the answer to a development is getting the land into protective hands. Eurosite, established 1989, is one of the largest pan-European organisations bringing together NGOs, governmental organisations and private bodies, with members from the Atlantic islands to the Black Sea and from Scandinavia to the Mediterranean. ITS ELCN STRAND IS ABOUT PRIVATE LAND SPECIFICALLY: the European Land Conservation Network was built to support private landowners — non-public bodies or individuals — willing to engage in conservation ON AT LEAST PART OF THEIR LAND. That last phrase is the opening: a landowner who will not sell may still protect a portion, and there is a European network built to make that happen. The three tools it promotes are conservation easements, privately protected areas, and land stewardship agreements. AND A FUNDING ROUTE IS ATTACHED: ELCN and the ILCN have run sessions on using EU LIFE funding for private land conservation, aimed at landowners and conservationists preparing a LIFE project proposal; in November 2025 Eurosite-ELCN launched a working group on nature finance and land stewardship focused on finance mechanisms that mobilise private investment, co-chaired by the former head of the EU LIFE Programme. IF YOUR FIGHT IS A QUARRY, ASK FOR THIS BY NAME: Eurosite and partners published work on project selection criteria for conservation easements to protect nature in European quarries — a published European method for putting an easement over one. The network also co-hosts meetings of the Commission's Expert Group on the Nature Directives (NADEG) on tools and incentives for private land conservation — the most important working-level platform between the Commission, member states and interest groups. IF EUROSITE DOES NOT REACH YOUR COUNTRY, the International Land Conservation Network (founded 2014, the first global network of private land conservation practitioners) is the wider net, active from Canada to Australia to Latin America. BE PRECISE ABOUT WHAT THESE ARE: networks of practitioners — they connect you to the organisation that can act; they do not buy land themselves. Ask the network who operates in your country; membership is not asserted here.

trackers.name: Fondation Prince Albert II de Monaco — funds projects, but read the rules first
trackers.desc: WHAT IT IS: a Monaco-based environmental foundation created in 2006, funding work on climate change and renewable energy, biodiversity, and water resources and desertification. More than 750 projects funded since 2006, roughly 40 to 50 a year, with representative offices in France, the UK, Switzerland, the United States, Canada, Germany, Italy, Singapore and Spain. Monaco itself had no ally of any kind in this file before this. THE FOUR RULES THAT DECIDE WHETHER IT IS WORTH APPLYING, and each one has ended applications: the project must sit in one of its priority areas — the Mediterranean Basin, the polar regions, or countries on the UN list of Least Developed Countries. Requested funding cannot exceed 50% of the project budget, so you need the other half already. Applications run in an annual window, typically through June, and fund activities starting roughly two years later — a 2025 application is for a 2027 start, with decisions notified by the following March. And no project can be submitted directly: only files entered through a call for projects are considered. ONE MECHANICAL DETAIL THAT REJECTS APPLICATIONS OUTRIGHT: files must be sent in the original editable format. Anything scanned or saved as a non-editable PDF is automatically rejected. WHO CAN APPLY: civil society organisations, foundations, public regional and international organisations, private enterprises and government bodies; its pre-application form has also allowed individuals. It runs themed calls alongside the general one, including forests and communities — with an explicit strand on forest conservation through the action of indigenous peoples and local communities — polar work, and coastal resilience. BE REALISTIC: this is a two-year-lead research and programme funder, not emergency money. It cannot help a community facing a decision this season. Use it to build the long work that follows a win, and use the funders in this file with open rounds for the fight itself.

trackers.name: AMPN — volunteers created Monaco's marine reserves, and still manage them
trackers.desc: WHY THIS MATTERS BEYOND MONACO: Monaco had one ally in this file, a funder. This is the association — and its history is the most compressed demonstration in 198 candidates that a group of volunteers can create a protected area and end up as its statutory manager. WHAT HAPPENED: founded 22 October 1975 by a team of Monegasque volunteers, statutes approved by ministerial order the following month. By April 1976 the volunteers had created Monaco's first underwater reserve at Larvotto — 33 hectares protecting the Principality's only Posidonia meadow. The results led them to create a second in 1986: the 2-hectare Tombant des Spélugues, protecting the Principality's only coralligenous drop-off. Eleven months from founding an association to designating a reserve. AMPN has managed both since their creation and has been their official manager since 2018. WHAT IT DOES NOW: scientific monitoring of marine ecosystems, particularly Posidonia meadows and coralligenous reefs; ecological restoration projects including artificial reefs and the reintroduction of threatened species — a programme of concrete-block reefs begun in the early 1980s, ancestors of the 3D-printed reefs sunk in Monegasque waters since 2017; research on marine biodiversity and human impacts; and the Aire Marine Éducative launched in 2018 for schools. THE HONEST SCALE: it worked entirely on volunteers until the board authorised employing staff in 2016; there are now three, all scientists. Expect a small, expert, largely voluntary body — and note that in a jurisdiction this small, three resident scientists monitoring the coastline is the national capability. IT WORKS WITH THE STATE RATHER THAN AGAINST IT: in collaboration with the princely government, state services, institutions and socio-economic actors, with the support of the Prince and his foundation — the funder already filed for Monaco. Read that as it is: this is a conservation manager, not a body that will litigate against a Monegasque development.

trackers.name: Monaco's assistance judiciaire — the State pays the lawyer, and they cannot refuse the case
trackers.desc: THE HARD REQUIREMENT FIRST: a recourse to the Tribunal Suprême must be presented by an avocat-défenseur registered with the Ordre des avocats of the Principality, or it cannot be examined at all. A foreign lawyer may draft the requête, but it must be signed by the Monegasque avocat-défenseur, who carries all the procedural formalities. The recourse must be in French, reasoned, and accompanied by all useful documents. So in Monaco the first and unavoidable step is finding a local avocat-défenseur; the Ordre publishes the annuaire. AND THE STATE WILL PAY FOR ONE: for a natural person without the resources to obtain the assistance of an avocat-défenseur, where assistance judiciaire is granted by the bureau de l'assistance judiciaire, all the costs required by the proceedings, notably the avocat-défenseur's remuneration, are borne by the State. It opens the right to an avocat-défenseur, an avocat or avocat stagiaire, and to all officiers ministériels, designated in turn by the bureau. THE DETAIL THAT DISTINGUISHES MONACO FROM ANDORRA, filed last round: avocats-défenseurs, avocats and avocats-stagiaires are designated in turn under the codes of civil and criminal procedure to represent parties benefiting from assistance judiciaire, and THEY CANNOT REFUSE THEIR MINISTRY. Andorra's duty roster is voluntary and its lawyers say they may stop; Monaco's is compulsory. Lawyers who serve receive an indemnity from the State on a published scale of unit values and coefficients. TWO PRACTICAL LIMITS: avocats-stagiaires may plead before all jurisdictions except the Tribunal Suprême and the Cour de Révision, so at the top court you need a full avocat-défenseur. And the bureau is presided by a sitting magistrate, with the avocat-défenseur designated by the bâtonnier. Where the opposing party is ordered to pay costs, the State recovers what it advanced. WHO TO CONTACT: the Ordre des Avocats-Défenseurs, Avocats et Avocats-Stagiaires de la Principauté, ordredesavocats@monaco.mc, +377 97 77 23 32 — which has civil legal personality and exists to defend the collective interest of lawyers and of justiciables.

trackers.name: MC2D — the federation that pulls Monaco's environmental associations together
trackers.desc: WHAT IT IS: created in July 2004 to bring together the various Monegasque associations dedicated to protecting and improving environmental quality in different fields, so as to collaborate and coordinate their efforts, improving the overall effectiveness of their actions. Its work focuses on raising the awareness of the population AND OF THE PUBLIC AUTHORITIES on environmental questions. Monaco's bucket held a princely foundation, a marine volunteer association and the legal aid route — but nothing that federates. WHY A FEDERATION IS THE RIGHT RESOURCE IN A STATE THIS SIZE: this file has recorded across eighteen countries that the most useful free artefact is a membership list. In Monaco, where the whole environmental sector is a handful of associations, the federation IS the list — and its named members include an association working since 1998 to support sustainable development of the Principality and promote social, cultural and economic behaviours in its favour. IT ALSO RUNS A PUBLIC EVENT: since 2006 MC2D has organised an annual environmental exhibition in Monaco. A recurring public forum is where a community meets the authorities without asking for a meeting.

trackers.name: Tribunal Suprême decisions — the Monegasque record of who challenged a building permit and on what
trackers.desc: WHAT IT IS: the Tribunal Suprême publishes its decisions, and its urbanisme docket is a worked record of the grounds on which Monegasque building permits and planning ordinances have been challenged. Monaco had one legal entry — the state-paid assistance judiciaire — and nothing showing what a case looks like. THE GROUNDS THAT HAVE BEEN RUN, taken from its published decisions: that the real nature and intended use of a projected building remained undefined or equivocal; that the technical commission on hygiene, safety and environmental protection had not been consulted as the environment code required; that the permit application lacked a technical study of sub-surface works required by the urbanism regulation where parking and garage access were involved; and, from the other side, that an urbanism ordinance was adopted without sufficient procedural guarantees such as a prior public inquiry allowing any interested person to give an opinion. Failure to consult the environmental commission, and a missing technical study, are the two recurring defects — check both in your own file. AND THE PRACTICAL POINTS: associations do litigate here — the reports name an association seeking withdrawal of a Sovereign Ordinance on urbanism after a recours gracieux was rejected, and multiple residents jointly challenging a modified planning authorisation. The sequence is recours gracieux or hiérarchique first, then the Tribunal Suprême, and parties appear through an avocat-défenseur.

trackers.name: LGU — Liechtensteinische Gesellschaft für Umweltschutz
trackers.desc: WHO TO ENLIST: Liechtenstein's environmental association, founded in 1973 out of the fight against an oil refinery and a nuclear plant across the Rhine, and the holder of what it calls its statutory right of participation and objection in the enforcement of the environmental laws. It uses it: it lodged a Beschwerde against a zoning-plan change at Steg, files Stellungnahmen on impact assessments for road schemes, and with the Verkehrs-Club took a complaint to the Staatsgerichtshof after a court ruling gutted the association right of appeal in EIA cases — arguing, pointedly, that the government was both promoter and decision-maker on the road in question. WHO IT SUITS: anyone in Liechtenstein facing a zoning change or a road. Be realistic about the register it works in: it says plainly that these rights are exercised mainly through consultation rather than formal objection, and it is a small office of a few staff with around 400 members. SINCE 1991 THE LGU OFFICE HAS ALSO RUN CIPRA LIECHTENSTEIN, A NETWORK OF TEN ASSOCIATIONS working in nature, nature conservation and environmental protection, in which member organisations find an opportunity for cooperation, information and joint appearances. So one approach reaches ten organisations, and a joint appearance is an express function of the network — which matters in a country of 41,000 people and eleven communes, covering 160 km², two thirds of it mountains, where a single association's voice would carry little. CIPRA is the Alpine Convention's civil-society counterpart, so a Liechtenstein issue can be raised in an Alpine-wide forum through this route. It is among the largest Liechtenstein associations — 561 members in 1973, 690 in 2009 — financed by membership contributions, donations and state subsidies. Contact: Kirchstrasse 5, FL-9494 Schaan; tel 00423 232 52 62. Stated aims: a careful use of natural resources and a participatory environmental policy. RECORDED HONESTLY: no domestic environmental grant window was found for Liechtenstein. That LGU receives state subsidies indicates such support exists for associations, but the scheme was not located on a canonical source and is not asserted here.

trackers.name: Liechtenstein — National Audit Office (Finanzkontrolle)
trackers.desc: Supreme audit institution; supreme financial supervisory body operating under the Finanzkontrollgesetz, supporting Parliament’s Audit Commission, Liechtenstein.

trackers.name: Liechtenstein — Commercial Register (Handelsregister, Amt für Justiz)
trackers.desc: National company registry; the Office of Justice’s public Commercial Register records all legal entities & trusts (40,000+ entries) with an online company-index search, Liechtenstein. — Holds to account: state firms & government-linked companies — find their registration, directors and filings.

trackers.name: Liechtenstein — Ministry of General Government Affairs & Finance
trackers.desc: National budget authority; prepares the national budget and publishes national financial statements & accounts, Principality of Liechtenstein. Here you can trace how the public budget is allocated and spent in LIE.

trackers.name: Industrial Emissions Portal — what the facility actually releases
trackers.desc: IT ANSWERS ‘WHAT IS THIS FACILITY RELEASING, AND HOW MUCH’ — with named sites and quantities, not a description of a regulator. The Industrial Emissions Portal gives public access to environmental data from industrial facilities across EU Member States, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, Switzerland, Serbia and the UK. The Industrial Emissions Portal Regulation (IEPR) replaces the earlier E-PRTR Regulation and implements the Kyiv Protocol on Pollutant Release and Transfer Registers — binding since 8 October 2009, the only legally binding international instrument on PRTRs, and a protocol to the Aarhus Convention. THE MECHANISM IS REPUTATIONAL, AND THE UNECE SAYS SO OPENLY: though it regulates information about pollution rather than pollution directly, it is expected to exert downward pressure ‘as no company will want to be identified as among the biggest polluters’. That is the campaign use — the register produces a ranked, official, quotable list. THE MOST IMPORTANT CAVEAT, AND IT PREVENTS A FALSE CONCLUSION: an installation not shown on a PRTR is either not an industrial activity covered by it, OR has not reached the stated pollutant-specific thresholds. Absence from the register is NOT evidence of no pollution — check the activity list and thresholds before relying on an absence. TWO DEFINITIONS THAT HELP: ‘the public’ includes natural or legal persons and their associations, organizations or groups, so an unincorporated community group qualifies; and a ‘facility’ is installations on the same site OR ON ADJOINING SITES under one operator — which matters where a plant has been split across parcels. As a scale example the UK register covers 91 pollutants back to 2007. IF YOU NEED ANOTHER COUNTRY: prtr.unece.org keeps a PRTR Global list of national registers, maintained by the OECD Working Party on PRTRs with UNECE, alongside CEC Taking Stock for North America and the NGO-built Blue Map Database in China — where a government has not built a register, that is the precedent for one built anyway.

trackers.name: KVU — your cantonal environment office, and the regional conference above it
trackers.desc: THE REGIONAL CONFERENCE IS A LEVER A SINGLE CANTONAL OFFICE IS NOT. KVU (Konferenz der Vorsteher der Umweltschutzämter, Haus der Kantone, Speichergasse 6, 3001 Bern) publishes a per-canton address directory — this link — and coordinates three regional conferences: CREPE for French-speaking Switzerland, USK Nordwestschweiz, and the Zentralschweizerische Konferenz, whose stated purpose includes harmonising enforcement across the region, producing joint position statements (gemeinsame Stellungnahmen), and carrying out joint actions, monitoring and controls. Where a development crosses cantonal boundaries, or one canton is more willing than its neighbours, that is the level to address. KVU also runs a named contact point for basic water-protection controls outside agriculture. WHAT THE CANTONAL OFFICE IS: cantonal ordinances implementing the federal USG define the Amt für Umwelt as the kantonale Umweltschutzfachstelle im Sinne des Bundesrechts, tasked with controlling the environmental measures of the canton, the municipalities, private parties and other obliged persons — it controls private parties, not only public bodies. THE ACCESS PROVISION IS WORTH CITING BY NAME: Nidwalden's ordinance states ‘alle Umweltdaten sind öffentlich, sofern nicht überwiegende Interessen entgegenstehen’ — all environmental data are public unless overriding interests oppose — with results held in Kataster, Inventare, Kartenwerke oder Berichte. Ask for the Kataster by name; a presumption of publicity with named document types beats a general information request. BUT THAT WORDING IS NIDWALDEN'S — each canton has its own implementing law and the wording differs, so check your own canton's kUSV. NAME THE RIGHT FEDERAL ORDINANCE: noise (LSV), air (LRV), soil (VBBo), contaminated sites (AltlV), major accidents (StFV), waste (TVA, VeVA), non-ionising radiation (NISV) and impact assessment (UVPV) each have their own instrument — naming the right one beats a general environmental objection. WHY THIS IS IN THE LIECHTENSTEIN ENTRY: KVU states that its members are the heads of the environmental offices of the Swiss cantons and of the Principality of Liechtenstein. Liechtenstein's environment office sits inside the Swiss cantonal network — a materially larger technical and enforcement community than a state of 41,000 people and eleven communes has domestically, and a route this map previously recorded only through civil society.

trackers.name: Aarhus Compliance Committee — one person may bring the State itself
trackers.desc: THE ONLY ROUTE IN THIS MAP BY WHICH ONE PERSON CAN BRING A STATE ITSELF BEFORE AN INTERNATIONAL BODY over environmental decision-making. Under Decision I/7 (2002), paragraphs 18–24, communications may be brought by one or more members of the public concerning any Party's compliance — no organisation, no accreditation, no minimum number. The ACCC is a quasi-judicial body reporting to the Meeting of the Parties. THE MOST MISUNDERSTOOD PART: YOU DO NOT HAVE TO EXHAUST DOMESTIC REMEDIES. Paragraph 21 says the Committee takes account of any available domestic remedy unless its application is unreasonably prolonged or obviously ineffective. What you must do is state whether steps have been taken and, if not, why not — a section of the form, not a bar to entry. WHAT MAKES IT INADMISSIBLE: anonymity, abuse of the right, being manifestly unreasonable including de minimis, incompatibility, or concerning a non-Party or a State that opted out — and no State has opted out. The only one most people risk is ‘de minimis’: frame it as a systemic failure of information, participation or access to justice, not a complaint about one permit. PRACTICALITIES THAT DECIDE WHETHER IT LANDS: there is a required format, and cut-off dates tied to meetings — as a worked example, communications received by 4 May 2026 were for the 15 and 18 June 2026 meeting, provided they were complete, in format, and needed no translation. Check the current cut-off; missing it costs a cycle. Submit in English, French or Russian — the secretariat translates, but needing translation can push you past a cut-off. Send copies, not originals. AND KNOW THIS BEFORE YOU FILE: once preliminary admissibility is determined the case gets a number and BECOMES PUBLIC — there is a confidentiality section on the form. The process runs receipt → admissibility → response by the Party → draft findings → public hearing → final findings and recommendations. Address: Aarhus Convention Secretariat, UNECE, Palais des Nations, Geneva. CONFIRM YOUR STATE IS A PARTY before relying on this — this entry is recorded here on the basis that the state is bound by the Kyiv Protocol to the Convention, which implies but does not prove Party status.

trackers.name: EIA Directive — ask for the screening determination
trackers.desc: IF A PROJECT NEAR YOU IS PROCEEDING WITHOUT AN EIA, THERE IS A PUBLISHED, REASONED DOCUMENT EXPLAINING WHY — AND ALMOST NOBODY ASKS FOR IT. Annex I projects get mandatory EIA; Annex II projects — the far larger category — go through a screening procedure using the Annex III criteria. Under Directive 2014/52/EU the developer supplies specified Annex IIA information, and that determination SHALL be made available to the public and must be duly motivated. Ask for the screening determination: it is the most useful document in the procedure and the one people do not know exists. TIMING: determinations must be made within 90 days of complete information, unless the authority extends the period giving reasons in exceptional cases and informs the developer. BUT BE REALISTIC ABOUT THE LIMIT: proposals to require public participation during screening were dropped from the 2014 text as impractical — you have a right to the determination, not a right to be heard before it is made. THREE MORE THINGS THE 2014 AMENDMENT GIVES YOU: reports must be more understandable to the public, especially on the current state of the environment and alternatives; competent authorities must prove their objectivity to avoid conflicts of interest — making a conflict a ground of challenge, not a complaint; and the grounds for consent decisions must be clear and transparent. ASK ALSO WHETHER A SCOPING OPINION HAS BEEN REQUESTED — it fixes what the assessment is required to look at. Reports must carry a non-technical summary (Annex IV), and information must be provided as early as possible, electronically, by public notice or bill posting, or in local newspapers. THE DIRECTIVE IS A FLOOR, NOT A CEILING: Member States may lay down more stringent conditions and fix penalties — check the national transposition before assuming the EU minimum applies. The regime is Directive 2011/92/EU (applying since 17 February 2012) as amended by 2014/52/EU, codifying rules in force since 1988 and aligned to the Espoo and Aarhus Conventions. ONE PATTERN TO WATCH: the legislative history records concern that formal screening could become a ‘mini-EIA’ before the full EIA — an unusually detailed screening determination is itself an argument that full assessment was warranted.

trackers.name: Eurosite / ELCN — who already holds land near you, and the easement route
trackers.desc: A DIRECTORY OF THE PEOPLE WHO ALREADY HOLD AND MANAGE LAND IN YOUR COUNTRY — which is who you need when the answer to a development is getting the land into protective hands. Eurosite, established 1989, is one of the largest pan-European organisations bringing together NGOs, governmental organisations and private bodies, with members from the Atlantic islands to the Black Sea and from Scandinavia to the Mediterranean. ITS ELCN STRAND IS ABOUT PRIVATE LAND SPECIFICALLY: the European Land Conservation Network was built to support private landowners — non-public bodies or individuals — willing to engage in conservation ON AT LEAST PART OF THEIR LAND. That last phrase is the opening: a landowner who will not sell may still protect a portion, and there is a European network built to make that happen. The three tools it promotes are conservation easements, privately protected areas, and land stewardship agreements. AND A FUNDING ROUTE IS ATTACHED: ELCN and the ILCN have run sessions on using EU LIFE funding for private land conservation, aimed at landowners and conservationists preparing a LIFE project proposal; in November 2025 Eurosite-ELCN launched a working group on nature finance and land stewardship focused on finance mechanisms that mobilise private investment, co-chaired by the former head of the EU LIFE Programme. IF YOUR FIGHT IS A QUARRY, ASK FOR THIS BY NAME: Eurosite and partners published work on project selection criteria for conservation easements to protect nature in European quarries — a published European method for putting an easement over one. The network also co-hosts meetings of the Commission's Expert Group on the Nature Directives (NADEG) on tools and incentives for private land conservation — the most important working-level platform between the Commission, member states and interest groups. IF EUROSITE DOES NOT REACH YOUR COUNTRY, the International Land Conservation Network (founded 2014, the first global network of private land conservation practitioners) is the wider net, active from Canada to Australia to Latin America. BE PRECISE ABOUT WHAT THESE ARE: networks of practitioners — they connect you to the organisation that can act; they do not buy land themselves. Ask the network who operates in your country; membership is not asserted here.

trackers.name: BZG — the society that holds the record, and the LGU's land-buying since 1973 (Liechtenstein)
trackers.desc: WHO TO ENLIST: the Botanisch-Zoologische Gesellschaft Liechtenstein-Sarganserland-Werdenberg, founded in 1970 in the first European Conservation Year. Its stated aims include researching the region botanically and zoologically, preventing damage to natural assets, promoting biotope and landscape protection, and creating and maintaining habitats and protected areas for animals and plants. It publishes the BZG-Bericht, runs excursions and lectures, supports and supervises research projects, and maintains working groups on bats and crayfish and a botanical information service, with a named committee including a water ecologist and a geologist. WHY IT MATTERS FOR A LIECHTENSTEIN CASE: this is the country's naturalist record. On the Ruggeller Riet it commissioned an expert opinion on the site's worthiness of protection from a vegetation scientist at ETH Zurich, producing the first vegetation map in 1972, which confirmed the object's international significance; regular floristic and zoological observation followed, and by 1990 some 1,631 animal and 448 vascular plant species had been described and recorded in a natural history monograph, making it the best-studied area in the country. If your ground needs its value demonstrated, this is who has done that before, and the sequence — independent expert opinion, then vegetation map, then designation — is the model. AND THE LAND-BUYING, which is the fact this file lacked: since 1973 the Liechtensteinische Gesellschaft für Umweltschutz has been acquiring and leasing ground for exchange purposes, and the greater part of the area it acquired was transferred to the State of Liechtenstein, which owns around a third of the Ruggeller Riet. Liechtenstein does have a body that buys land — it buys to swap and hand on rather than to hold. WHAT THE TWO DO TOGETHER: BZG and LGU were jointly decisive in establishing the Ruggeller Riet as a protected area in 1978, and when drainage and a falling water table degraded it they pressed until partial re-wetting projects were carried out. They still name what is missing: buffer strips protecting the parts of the reserve that adjoin intensively farmed land from fertiliser and pesticide input, and better connection of valuable habitats to others. LGU also holds the Verbandsbeschwerderecht — the association right of appeal — since 1996, which is the standing that matters here.

trackers.name: CIPRA Liechtenstein — ten societies that file objections together, coordinated by the LGU
trackers.desc: WHAT IT IS: a network of ten associations working in the fields of nature, nature protection and environmental protection, in which the member organisations find an opportunity for cooperation, information and joint appearances. The care of the network lies in the hands of the LGU, already in this file, based in Schaan. Liechtenstein had five entries and two allies; this is the country's federation, and it is small enough to be complete. WHAT JOINT APPEARANCES MEAN IN PRACTICE: when the municipality of Eschen planned the 'Verfüllung Täli' as an extension of the Rheinau landfill, the LGU and five further organisations of CIPRA Liechtenstein stated that realising the project would have far-reaching consequences for nature and landscape and for the development possibilities of the Alpine Rhine. Six organisations, one position, on a single municipal landfill extension. In a country this size that is most of the sector. AND THE LGU'S OWN RECORD, which tells you what the network can do: it campaigned for the protection of the Ruggeller Riet from 1974 to 1978 and against the Rhine power stations from 1981 to 1992; it holds a seat on the government's Naturschutzkommission; it obtained the Verbandsklagerecht in 1996 under its own pressure; and it takes part in Vernehmlassungen — the formal consultation rounds — to influence executive and legislature. Its four work areas are environmental policy, Umweltanwaltschaft, environmental education and practical measures. TWO MORE THINGS A LIECHTENSTEIN COMMUNITY CAN USE: the LGU argues, in its own words, that the effects of a project must be shown transparently and comprehensively, and that this knowledge must exist before decisions are taken — the position it took publicly on a planned suspension bridge, opposing steering more visitors into a wildlife corridor. And there are Naturwächterinnen und Naturwächter — nature wardens who watch that rules of conduct are observed in their own districts.

trackers.name: Kommission für Natur- und Landschaftsschutz — three seats reserved for private conservation bodies
trackers.desc: WHAT IT IS: the standing commission that advises the government on fundamental questions of nature and landscape protection, in particular in drafting implementing ordinances and developing concepts. Liechtenstein is small enough that this one body is where the sector meets the state. ITS COMPOSITION, WHICH IS THE RESOURCE: a representative of the Office for the Environment as chair, one representative each of the GEMEINDE and of the BÜRGERGENOSSENSCHAFTEN, THREE REPRESENTATIVES OF PRIVATE NATURE PROTECTION ORGANISATIONS, one of agriculture, and a landscape planner. Three of roughly seven seats belong to private conservation organisations — the LGU, BZG and CIPRA Liechtenstein already filed here are the bodies that hold them. A community reaching one of those three is reaching a seat at the table where ordinances are drafted. AND THE SEAT NOBODY OUTSIDE THE ALPS EXPECTS: the Bürgergenossenschaften — the citizens' cooperatives — have their own representative. These are the historic communal landholding bodies of the Alpine states, and this file has already recorded the same shape in Italy's domini collettivi and Andorra's comuns. Where common land exists, its holders sit on the conservation commission.

trackers.name: Liechtenstein's state payments for ecological and landscape services
trackers.desc: WHAT IT IS: Liechtenstein pays compensation for ecological and animal-friendly services to reward farmers for services that are not remunerated by the market and are demanded by society. The stated purposes include that new habitats are to be created for plants and animals in agricultural areas and that the networking of habitats should be achieved in the long term. Liechtenstein had no funder filed at all; this is the state money that actually reaches land. WHY IT MATTERS TO A COMMUNITY RATHER THAN A FARMER: the recipient is the landholder, so this is what you offer an owner who is being courted by a developer — a standing public payment for keeping and improving habitat, rather than a one-off purchase price. The same logic runs through France's bail rural environnemental and Ukraine's protection obligation, already in this file. WHAT ELSE THE STATE FUNDS: management of alpine pastures, paid as an alpine pasture cost contribution to THE OWNER of the alp; and Alpine infrastructures, promoted expressly taking into account the interests of environmental, nature and landscape protection. AN HONEST NOTE: I searched for a dedicated Liechtenstein nature or landscape fund and did not find one; what exists is the agricultural payment system above and the commission route. For cross-border projects, Swiss foundation directories list funds whose reach includes the neighbouring cantons.

trackers.name: San Marino — Trade Register (Chamber of Commerce)
trackers.desc: National corporate registry; the Chamber of Commerce Trade Register (Registro delle Imprese, Art.5 Law 71/2004) automatically records all licensed economic operators, with downloadable company certificates & balance sheets via an online desk, San Marino. — Holds to account: state firms & government-linked companies — find their registration, directors and filings.

trackers.name: San Marino — Segreteria di Stato per le Finanze e il Bilancio
trackers.desc: National budget authority; prepares the State budget (leggi di bilancio) & economic programme and manages public debt, Republic of San Marino. Here you can trace how the public budget is allocated and spent in SMR.

trackers.name: Legge 126/1995 — fragility and spectacularity are statutory criteria
trackers.desc: CHOOSE THE CATEGORY DELIBERATELY, BECAUSE THE PROTECTION FOLLOWS IT. The Legge quadro per la tutela dell'ambiente e la salvaguardia del paesaggio, della vegetazione e della flora (16 November 1995 n.126) governs the conservation, il recupero and safeguarding of landscape and natural environment — recovery is a statutory purpose, so restoring a degraded site is within the law's object. Article 2 classifies protected areas as: (a) aree naturalistiche tutelate — parts of the territory of landscape and/or environmental significance with characteristics of naturalness and/or conservation integration, where the ‘and/or’ does real work: landscape significance alone qualifies; (b) aree a parco — zones of general public interest for the community, organised with preeminent regard to protecting nature, for cultural, recreational and agroforestry uses fostering the cultural, social and economic growth of the community, so a working landscape can be a park and community economic benefit is a stated purpose, not a concession; (c) riserve naturali — which beyond (a) must show diversità, rappresentatività, fragilità e spettacolarità; and (d) riserve naturali integrali, of particular naturalistic and scientific interest. FRAGILITY AND SPECTACULARITY ARE NAMED STATUTORY CRITERIA — an argument resting on how easily a site is damaged, or how striking it is, stands on the text rather than on sentiment.

trackers.name: AccessInfo.hk — FOI requests (HKG)
trackers.desc: You CAN get: information held by Hong Kong government bureaux and departments, and by the public agencies listed at Annex A of the Code on Access to Information — requested through this volunteer-run platform, which files on your behalf and publishes every request and reply openly, so past answers are searchable before you ask. Anyone may request, resident or not, and requests can be oral or written. Land-relevant precedent exists: the Lands Department has answered requests about specific land grants here. You CAN'T get: a legal right. HONG KONG HAS NO FREEDOM-OF-INFORMATION STATUTE — the Code is an administrative instrument only, with no legal protection of the right, and the Ombudsman has criticised departments for refusing on grounds the Code does not contain. It does not reach the many statutory and advisory bodies that decide policy. Refusal grounds are broad — security, external affairs, administration of justice — subject to a public-interest test the department applies itself. For activists: if refused, ask for internal review, then complain to the Ombudsman. But note the limit that bites hardest on a development fight — the Ombudsman is statutorily barred from investigating the imposition or variation of LAND GRANT CONDITIONS, and will not take a complaint more than two years old.

trackers.name: Hong Kong — The Budget (Financial Services & the Treasury Bureau)
trackers.desc: National budget-transparency portal; the official HKSAR Budget site publishes the annual Financial Secretary’s Budget, detailed revenue & expenditure estimates by head, and supporting fiscal data, Hong Kong. Here you can trace how the public budget is allocated and spent in Hong Kong.

trackers.name: Companies Registry
trackers.desc: National company registry. — Holds to account: state firms & government-linked companies — find their registration, directors and filings.

trackers.name: Hong Kong Companies Registry
trackers.desc: Hong Kong's official company registry. Here you can trace companies, their directors and filings registered in Hong Kong.

trackers.name: HKLII
trackers.desc: Hong Kong Legal Information Institute: free judgments and legislation. · Find here: free Hong Kong legislation and the judgments of its courts (HKLII).

trackers.name: Hong Kong Judiciary
trackers.desc: Official judgments and legal-reference system of the HK courts. · Find here: the judgments of the Hong Kong Judiciary across all court levels.

trackers.name: Cap. 208 s.11 — 60 days to object, with a guaranteed hearing
trackers.desc: A FULLY SPECIFIED OBJECTION ROUTE. Under the Country Parks Ordinance (Cap. 208), the Authority publishes a draft map in the Gazette for a new country park (s.8) and makes it available for inspection (s.9(1)) — and under section 11 any person aggrieved may, within the 60-day inspection period from gazettal, send a written statement of objection to both the Authority and the Secretary of the Board. The Board SHALL arrange a hearing, and submits the draft map with a schedule of objections and representations to the Chief Executive in Council. 60 days, in writing, to two addressees, with a guaranteed hearing and a schedule that goes up to the decision-maker — so an objection cannot simply be lost. The Board may reject it or direct the Authority to amend the draft map. BUT READ WHAT CAN STILL HAPPEN INSIDE A PARK: the Director of AFCD may approve overhead power cables proposed by utilities and recreational facilities by the private sector, and small house development may be considered subject to Lands Department approval. A USEFUL PRINCIPLE: the 2011 review confirmed that the mere existence of private land will not be automatically taken as a determining factor for exclusion from a country park boundary. SCALE: 24 country parks and 22 special areas, 44,300 ha or 40 percent of land area, holding over 98 percent of all flora and fauna species. Judicial review is available — see Chan Ka Lam v Country and Marine Parks Authority (CACV 150/2017).

trackers.name: If your site is an enclave, Cap. 208 is the wrong instrument
trackers.desc: THE DISTINCTION THAT DECIDES WHICH LAW APPLIES. Country park enclaves are sites surrounded by or adjacent to country parks but NOT part of them, mostly a mix of private and government land — and control on development there relies on the land lease terms, the Buildings Ordinance (Cap. 123) and, if available, Development Permission Area plans or Outline Zoning Plans under the Town Planning Ordinance. So if your site is an enclave, the Country Parks Ordinance is not your instrument. Section 16(1)(d) of the Buildings Ordinance may be invoked to reject plans. WHY THIS EXISTS: the Sai Wan incident of June 2010 — unauthorised excavation on private and government land in an enclave — led the Government to undertake to either bring enclaves into country parks or determine their uses through statutory planning. THE FUNDING ROUTE IS THE MANAGEMENT AGREEMENT SCHEME: funding is granted to enable competent non-profit making organisations to enter into management agreements with landowners, giving landowners financial incentives in exchange for management rights over their land or cooperation in conservation — covering private land in enclaves and within country parks. That is a funded, voluntary, contractual route over private land — the closest thing here to the conservation-easement model recorded elsewhere in this map. OTHER INSTRUMENTS: the Town Planning Ordinance (Cap. 131) designates coastal protection areas, SSSIs, Conservation Areas and Green Belt through the Town Planning Board — a separate route with a different decision-maker; Cap. 96 prohibits felling and cutting on Government land; and EIA reports must undergo statutory public inspection and consideration by the Advisory Council on the Environment.

trackers.name: ICCA Registry and Protected Planet — and registration is not a precondition
trackers.desc: CHECK WHETHER YOUR SITE IS ALREADY IN A REGISTRY BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE — it may carry a designation nobody locally mentioned. The World Database on Protected and Conserved Areas at protectedplanet.net is a joint UNEP and IUCN product managed by UNEP-WCMC, drawing on almost 500 data providers in 245 countries, updated monthly and downloadable; it underpins the UN List of Protected Areas. THE OECM ROUTE IS THE ONE MOST COMMUNITIES MISS: a site qualifies as an other effective area-based conservation measure if it delivers sustained, positive conservation outcomes EVEN THOUGH IT MAY BE MANAGED PRIMARILY FOR OTHER REASONS — so a grazing commons, a sacred site or a watershed managed for water supply can qualify without being managed primarily for conservation. Land that is worked rather than preserved is not excluded. But note the exclusivity: a site can be a protected area or an OECM — it is not possible to meet both, so ask which is being proposed. THE ICCA REGISTRY IS THE ONE COMMUNITIES FILL IN THEMSELVES: at iccaregistry.org, communities themselves provide data, case studies, maps, photos and stories, and its operators state it is meant to be used to enhance advocacy and recognition — not merely as an inventory. Documenting a territory there creates a citable, third-party-hosted record. THE SENTENCE THAT MATTERS MOST: UNEP-WCMC states these territories must be recognised and respected ‘whether or not they have been reported to the ICCA Registry’ — registration is NOT a precondition of rights, and anyone arguing a claim is weaker for being unregistered is arguing against the registry operator's own position. AND USE THE SCALE FIGURE CAREFULLY: over 1,500 sites are reported under indigenous and community governance — just 1 percent of all recorded sites, with UNEP-WCMC adding that no one knows how many ICCAs exist globally. That 1 percent measures how little has been recorded, not how little communities conserve. Filter Protected Planet by governance type to find such sites; UNEP-WCMC's manual Global Databases to Support ICCAs gives guidance on contributing data.

trackers.name: Countryside Conservation Funding Scheme — HK$500m in the pot, and Lantau is excluded
trackers.desc: Real money, and the cap is high enough to change what a community can attempt: the government earmarked HK$1 billion for the Countryside Conservation Office, of which HK$500 million goes through this scheme to non-profit organisations and villagers. The nature conservation part of a Nature Conservation Management Agreement project carries a funding cap of HK$13 million per application, with up to HK$2 million more available for architectural or cultural enhancement elements. Five project types: management agreements, formulating proposals to restore built heritage, cultural rehabilitation and revitalisation, research on countryside conservation, and Proactive Conservation, added in February 2023. A project runs for at most three years; management agreement and cultural rehabilitation projects must run at least twelve months, and management agreements can be renewed. Lantau Island is excluded from the whole scheme. Also outside it: the architectural and cultural aspects of historical buildings graded by the Antiquities Advisory Board, and intangible items on the official Hong Kong inventories. Resolve this tension before drafting anything. The scheme is publicly described as funding villagers, but the eligibility rule is that the applicant and any co-organiser must be a local tax-exempt charity with legal personality, a locally registered non-profit-making company, or a local non-profit post-secondary institution — so a village group needs such a body to apply with or through, and constituting one takes longer than a funding round lasts. Two practical traps. Where the site is government land, apply for a short-term tenancy of that land before applying for funding, not after. And the Secretariat reserves the right to stop processing an incomplete or wrongly-formatted application: it wants an original hard copy signed by the person-in-charge and stamped with the organisation's chop, plus a soft copy, and underpaid post is refused outright. Cut-off dates are announced round by round. Secretariat: 22/F, Chinachem Exchange Square, 1 Hoi Wan Street, Quarry Bay. What a management agreement actually buys. The scheme's own description of that category is an agreement between a local non-profit and the land owner and/or the owner's tenants, under which the non-profit offers economic incentives in exchange for land management rights, or to secure the owner's cooperation, in order to strengthen conservation at priority sites, at country park enclaves and on private land lying inside country parks. Where buying a parcel outright is impossible, paying its owner for the right to manage it is the arrangement the government itself funds, and it reaches exactly the land that development pressure concentrates on. And there is a charitable vehicle able to hold land. A countryside foundation established in 2011 is registered as a company limited by guarantee without share capital and recognised as a charity, and states its method as holding and managing natural assets together with the related land and funds for the long-term benefit of the public. From 2017 it worked with a long-established conservation association on a management agreement at a village enclave, funded by the environment and conservation fund, farming with local villagers by nature-friendly methods, with village houses restored under separate charitable funding as a base for education. A worked example with named partners and named money is what convinces a landowner who has never heard of the arrangement.

trackers.name: 長春社 The Conservancy Association — runs the management agreements that keep private farmland conserved
trackers.desc: Hong Kong's route for conserving ecologically important land that is privately owned runs through management agreements, and this is the body that has actually run one for twenty years. After the 2000 Lok Ma Chau Spur Line case turned Long Valley from anonymous farmland into a known bird site, the government's New Nature Conservation Policy of November 2004 set out to conserve ecologically important places on private land, named 12 priority sites and invited non-governmental bodies to run management agreement pilot schemes on them. From late 2005 the Conservancy Association, funded by the Environment and Conservation Fund and working with the Hong Kong Bird Watching Society, has held management cooperation agreements with Long Valley's landowners and farmers, paying for and directing habitat management on working farmland. It worked, and the measure is on the record: bird species recorded at Long Valley rose from 228 in 2005 to 299 in 2014 across successive phases of the scheme. Settle the eligibility question first. The management agreement route was built for those 12 priority sites; if your land is not among them this is not the door, and the Countryside Conservation Funding Scheme's own management agreement window is what to read instead. The second income route is worth copying anywhere farmland is at stake.
