Four times the tree loss outside indigenous-held land than inside it. When a ministry or a conservation body argues that a territory must be taken into state protection to save the forest, that comparison is the answer — measured across 130 million hectares. THE OVERLAP FIGURE: 100% OF THEIR PARTNERSHIP SETTINGS OVERLAP WITH KEY BIODIVERSITY AREAS OR OTHER RECOGNIZED MEASURES OF GLOBAL BIODIVERSITY SIGNIFICANCE. AGREEMENTS rather than grant conditions — a document with two parties. Ask to see one before signing anything, and compare it against what your own funders offer. AND THE STORYTELLING PROGRAMME: STORYTELLING THAT BUILDS COMMUNITY, CREATIVE PARTNERSHIPS, FELLOWSHIPS, GRANT MAKING, MEDIA TRAINING AND COMMUNICATIONS — SUPPORTING AND AMPLIFYING INDIGENOUS STORYTELLERS, WITH AN OVERARCHING NETWORK OF GLOBAL INDIGENOUS CREATIVES. FELLOWSHIPS and MEDIA TRAINING for storytellers from the communities themselves — which is what turns a documented eviction into something the world sees, and pairs with the youth storyteller programme filed under Togo. trackers.name: Protection grants up to €7,500 for physical and digital security, legal fees under judicial harassment, medical costs after an attack, and family assistance for the imprisoned — applied for on an encrypted form, with instructions on contacting them safely

IF YOU FEEL THAT CONTACT MAY PUT YOU AT RISK WE SUGGEST THAT AT MINIMUM YOU USE A SECURE COMPUTER, SAFE INTERNET CONNECTION AND OPEN A SEPARATE, NEW EMAIL ACCOUNT AND PROVIDE THIS ADDRESS IN THE APPLICATION INSTEAD — WITH TWO NAMED EXTERNAL GUIDES ON PRIVATE COMMUNICATION LINKED. The application itself can be the thing that exposes you. A funder that says so on its own form, and tells you to open a fresh account before writing, has thought about the person rather than the paperwork — and this file has recorded applications, surveys and consultations becoming targeting lists. THE FORM: THE APPLICATION CAN BE SUBMITTED ONLINE BY ANSWERING THE QUESTIONS IN THE BOXES PROVIDED, SENT DIRECTLY TO THE ORGANISATION — ENSURING THE PRIVACY AND SECURITY OF YOUR DATA IS OUR PRIORITY AND THIS FORM IS FULLY ENCRYPTED. WHAT THE MONEY MAY BUY, LISTED SPECIFICALLY: IMPROVING PHYSICAL SECURITY OF AN ORGANISATION OR INDIVIDUAL; DIGITAL SECURITY AND COMMUNICATION SECURITY; LEGAL FEES FOR DEFENDERS WHO ARE BEING JUDICIALLY HARASSED; MEDICAL FEES FOR DEFENDERS WHO HAVE BEEN ATTACKED OR WHO HAVE SUFFERED A MEDICAL CONDITION AS A RESULT OF THEIR PEACEFUL HUMAN RIGHTS ACTIVITIES; AND FAMILY ASSISTANCE FOR IMPRISONED DEFENDERS OR FAMILY MEMBERS WHO ARE AT RISK BECAUSE OF A DEFENDER'S ACTIVITIES. FAMILY ASSISTANCE FOR IMPRISONED DEFENDERS. When a land defender is jailed, the household loses its income and the campaign loses its organiser at once. This file has recorded that as the pressure point that ends resistance; here it is a named eligible cost. And JUDICIAL HARASSMENT legal fees cover the fabricated case rather than the land case itself. THE CEILING AND THE MATCH RULE: GRANTS ARE FOR AMOUNTS UP TO A MAXIMUM OF €7,500 UNDER A PROGRAMME RUNNING SINCE 2001 — AND GRANTS ARE GENERALLY NOT AWARDED FOR 100% OF THE PROPOSED BUDGET. Expect a share, not the whole. Budget accordingly, and line up a second contributor before applying. THE RESPONSE POLICY AND THE LOBBYING RULE: LOBBYING IN SUPPORT OF APPLICATIONS IS NOT ENCOURAGED, AND ALL APPLICANTS WILL RECEIVE A WRITTEN RESPONSE WHETHER OR NOT THEIR APPLICATION IS SUCCESSFUL. Every applicant gets an answer, and pulling strings does not help. Rare on both counts — an organisation without international contacts is not disadvantaged, and silence is not the outcome. An imperfect first application is not fatal; somebody will ask. Not the campaign, the danger to the people running it. Frame the application around the threat, the incident and the specific protection needed — not around the land case, however strong it is. REGISTERED is the gate here. An unregistered village committee should look to the funds this file records as waiving registration — or apply through a registered ally. WHAT FIRST-TIME APPLICANTS MUST SUPPLY: CONTACT DETAILS OF AT LEAST TWO REFEREES WELL KNOWN WITHIN THE HUMAN RIGHTS COMMUNITY IN THE APPLICANT'S COUNTRY OR INTERNATIONALLY, WHO KNOW THE APPLICANT'S WORK AND THE RISKS AND THREATS THEY FACE. Two referees who can vouch for the danger. Identify them now, while there is time — the moment you need this grant is not the moment to start building those relationships, which is an argument for joining the networks filed throughout this list before anything happens. WHAT ELSE THE APPLICATION ASKS: FULL CONTACT DETAILS AND THE NAME OF THE PERSON ACCOUNTABLE; A CONCISE OUTLINE OF THE GROUP — AIMS, PREVIOUS ACTIVITIES, MEMBERSHIP, ORGANISATIONAL STRUCTURE, FINANCIAL STRUCTURE, AND WORK WITH OTHER GROUPS OR NETWORKS; AND THE SECURITY RISK BEING FACED AND THE REASON BEHIND IT. Write that outline once and keep it current. It is the same material every funder in this file asks for, and having it ready is the difference between applying in a week and applying in a day. THE OTHER CHANNELS ON RECORD: A 24-HOUR EMERGENCY CONTACT ROUTE, AND APPLICATIONS CONSIDERED ON A QUARTERLY BASIS BY THE BOARD. Quarterly for the grant, 24 hours for the emergency. Know which you need: a quarterly cycle is no use tonight, and the emergency line is not a funding application. AND THE AWARD IT RUNS: AN ANNUAL AWARD FOR HUMAN RIGHTS DEFENDERS AT RISK CARRYING FINANCIAL GRANTS, ADVOCACY VISIBILITY, LOCAL EVENTS, ATTENDANCE AT A CEREMONY, AND SECURITY CONSULTATION — WITH NOMINATIONS OPEN. Nominations, not applications. A community can put its own defender forward — and visibility is itself protection. CAVEATS: REGISTERED ORGANISATIONS ONLY, €7,500 CEILING, RARELY THE FULL BUDGET, QUARTERLY DECISIONS, AND NOT FOR THOSE ALREADY IN EXILE — use the emergency route for anything immediate. For the 24-hour helpline and the protection cluster, Benin's and Morocco's entries; for grants that can be repurposed for security without asking, Guinea-Bissau's entry.

A community whose case is about food and livelihood must lead with the habitat and the species, not the fields. WHAT THE SITE MUST HOLD: PRIORITY IS GIVEN TO SITES HOSTING RED LIST SPECIES CLASSIFIED AS CRITICALLY ENDANGERED OR ENDANGERED, WITH URGENT CONSERVATION OPPORTUNITIES WHERE BIODIVERSITY IS AT RISK PRIORITISED. A stated condition, which cuts both ways: it is protection against a purchase that displaces people, and it is a requirement the applicant must evidence. Document the community's agreement before applying, not after. THE DEADLINE AND THE CADENCE: AN ANNUAL CALL, WITH A PUBLISHED APPLICATION DEADLINE OF 1 MAY. One date a year. Unlike the no-deadline funder in this file's Angola entry, missing it costs twelve months — so identify the parcel and the seller well ahead. THE RECORD IT PUBLISHES: MANAGED FOR OVER 20 YEARS, AND SINCE 2001 IT HAS FUNDED OVER 167 PROJECTS IN 43 COUNTRIES AND PROTECTED APPROXIMATELY 61,000 HECTARES. Sixty-one thousand hectares actually bought and held. That is a working precedent to put in front of any funder that says buying land is not something they do. WHY IT WORKS THROUGH LOCAL BODIES, IN ITS OWN WORDS: OUR LOCAL PARTNERS ARE FAMILIAR WITH THE LOCAL CONTEXT AND INVOLVE THE LOCAL COMMUNITIES; BEING WELL-EMBEDDED LOCALLY CONTRIBUTES TO EFFECTIVE MANAGEMENT AND PROTECTION OF THE RESERVES THEY CREATE. AND THE STRATEGIC LOGIC: BY PURCHASING LAND IN STRATEGIC PLACES WE CAN RECONNECT SEPARATE PARTS OF THE HABITAT. RECONNECT SEPARATE PARTS is the strongest framing for a small parcel: a narrow strip between two protected blocks is worth more to this fund than a large isolated one. Map what your ground joins before describing it. AND THE FREE MANUAL PLUS ONE UNUSUAL RULE: WITH A NAMED BIRD CONSERVATION BODY IT DEVELOPED PRACTICAL GUIDELINES FOR PEOPLE MANAGING PRIVATELY PROTECTED AREAS, NINE PRAGMATIC STEPS FROM CREATION TO MANAGEMENT TOOLS, IN ENGLISH, SPANISH AND PORTUGUESE — AND THE FUND DOES NOT USE ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IN THE REVIEW PROCESS AND EXPECTS APPLICANTS TO DEVELOP THEIR PROPOSALS WITHOUT AI ASSISTANCE, ASKING THAT ANY USE BE DISCLOSED. A free nine-step manual on setting up and running a private reserve, which is the operating knowledge a first-time buyer lacks. And the AI rule is recorded because it is a live condition of applying: write it yourself, or disclose.
