ASSET BUILDING is named as a target in its own right. A group whose aim is to acquire and hold something — land, a building, a fund — is inside the stated purpose rather than stretching it. THE FOUR THINGS IT DOES: CAPACITY STRENGTHENING AND GRANT SUPPORT; ADVOCACY AND POLICY INFLUENCING TO HELP COMMUNITIES INFLUENCE DECISION-MAKING AND POLICIES; ENDOWMENTS AND ASSET DEVELOPMENT BUILDING LONG-TERM ASSETS THAT GENERATE RESOURCES FOR SUSTAINABILITY; AND SOCIAL INVESTMENT AND RESOURCE MOBILISATION. THE PRINCIPLE IT STATES: SHIFTING POWER TO COMMUNITIES — SUSTAINABLE CHANGE IS POSSIBLE WHEN COMMUNITIES ARE AT THE CENTRE OF THEIR OWN DEVELOPMENT AND IN CHARGE OF FINDING SOLUTIONS. THE TRADITION IT INVOKES: A NATIONAL SPIRIT OF COLLECTIVE SELF-HELP, IN WHICH IT BELIEVES RAPID AND ENDURING POSITIVE CHANGE IS POSSIBLE WHEN COMMUNITIES ARE ABLE TO CONTRIBUTE TO AND INITIATE THEIR OWN DEVELOPMENT. Worth naming because it is the fundraising argument a community makes at home: money raised locally, however small, is what an outside funder is asked to match. HOW IT HANDLES DONORS, WHICH IS THE SECOND FIND: DONORS SUPPORT IT THROUGH RESTRICTED AND UNRESTRICTED FUNDING AND THROUGH ITS COMMUNITY ENDOWMENT FUND — BUT IT IS NOT DRIVEN ENTIRELY BY FUNDER INTERESTS, INSTEAD ASSISTING IN PROVIDING FUNDER FOCUS ON CRITICAL NEEDS IDENTIFIED THROUGH ITS OWN ANALYSIS. A domestic intermediary that sets its own priorities rather than passing through a foreign agenda. That is the practical value of a national foundation over a direct international grant: the questions it asks are about your context. WHAT ITS DIRECTOR SAYS THE MODEL IS: SYSTEMIC AND SUSTAINABLE CHANGE IS POSSIBLE WHEN COMMUNITIES INITIATE AND DRIVE THEIR DEVELOPMENT AGENDA, WORK WITH GOVERNMENTS AND OTHER ACTORS TO ACCESS BASIC RIGHTS AND SERVICES, AND HARNESS AND GROW THEIR OWN RESOURCES. THE SCALE OF ITS CURRENT ORGANISATIONAL WORK: WORKING WITH OVER TWENTY-EIGHT CIVIL SOCIETY ORGANISATIONS IN AREAS INCLUDING EDUCATION, CLIMATE CHANGE AND CIVIC SPACE, WITH A PLAN TO WORK WITH AT LEAST ONE HUNDRED TO STRENGTHEN THEIR CAPACITY AND HELP THEM BUILD STRONG FINANCIAL MECHANISMS THAT ENSURE RESILIENCE. AND WHAT IT ADDS BESIDES MONEY: A CONTEXTUAL UNDERSTANDING OF NATIONAL DEVELOPMENT ISSUES AND ACCESS TO LOCAL STAKEHOLDERS, WITH SIGNIFICANT EFFORT INVESTED OVER TWO DECADES IN IDENTIFYING ORGANISATIONS AND ALIGNING STRATEGIES. WHO IT SUITS: community organisations that want to hold their own money rather than reapply every year, and coalitions in other countries looking for the shape of a national community foundation to build. CAVEATS: ONE COUNTRY, AND A GENERAL DEVELOPMENT FOUNDATION RATHER THAN A LAND OR ENVIRONMENTAL ONE — ITS NAMED AREAS ARE EDUCATION, CLIMATE CHANGE AND CIVIC SPACE, SO A LAND FIGHT MUST BE FRAMED WITHIN THOSE; ENDOWMENT BUILDING IS SLOW BY DESIGN AND WILL NOT FUND AN URGENT CASE. For an activist-decided fund open to unregistered groups, South Africa's EJF entry; for a fund with no application form at all, Cameroon's entry.

trackers.name: Syrian Investigative Reporting for Accountability Journalism (SIRAJ)
trackers.desc: Syrian investigative outlet focused on accountability, corruption and illicit finance.

trackers.name: Syria — Ministry of Finance
trackers.desc: National budget authority; the Ministry of Finance prepares the state budget & financial policies, collects public revenue, supervises state expenditure and manages public debt, Syria. Here you can trace how the public budget is allocated and spent in Syria.

trackers.name: PERAC Principles — protected zones when domestic machinery has stopped
trackers.desc: AN INSTRUMENT WRITTEN FOR EXACTLY THIS SITUATION, AND IT NAMES NO ONE. The Principles on Protection of the Environment in Relation to Armed Conflicts — 28 principles adopted by the International Law Commission on second reading on 27 May 2022 and welcomed by the UN General Assembly in A/RES/77/104 of 7 December 2022, adopted without vote — cover the whole arc: before, during and after armed conflict, and situations of occupation. BE HONEST ABOUT THEIR STATUS: they are nonbinding — but ILC documents are recorded as increasingly interpreted by tribunals, courts and governments as ‘reflections of customary international law’. Cite them as that, not as treaty obligations. PRINCIPLE 4 IS THE DESIGNATION ROUTE WHEN DOMESTIC MACHINERY HAS STOPPED: States should designate, by agreement or otherwise, areas of environmental importance as protected zones in the event of an armed conflict, including where those areas are of cultural importance — cultural importance is an express qualifying ground. PRINCIPLE 5 requires States, international organisations AND other relevant actors to protect the environment of the lands and territories that indigenous peoples inhabit or traditionally use, and where conflict has harmed it, to consult and cooperate with indigenous peoples on remedial measures — note that the addressees are not only States, which reaches bodies operating where a government cannot or will not act. PRINCIPLE 3 requires effective legislative, administrative, judicial and other measures. AND THE STRUCTURAL POINT: the ILC chose not to differentiate between international and non-international armed conflicts, so the environment-related conduct of non-state armed groups also comes within their purview — which matters where harm is done by armed groups rather than a state army. The distinctions sit in the commentaries, which should be read together with the principles. CITE ALONGSIDE: the 2020 ICRC Guidelines on protection of the natural environment in armed conflict, UNEA resolution 2/15 (27 May 2016), the 2019 Geneva List of Principles on the Protection of Water Infrastructure, and victim-assistance provisions in the Mine Ban Treaty and the Convention on Cluster Munitions.

trackers.name: ICCA Registry and Protected Planet — and registration is not a precondition
trackers.desc: CHECK WHETHER YOUR SITE IS ALREADY IN A REGISTRY BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE — it may carry a designation nobody locally mentioned. The World Database on Protected and Conserved Areas at protectedplanet.net is a joint UNEP and IUCN product managed by UNEP-WCMC, drawing on almost 500 data providers in 245 countries, updated monthly and downloadable; it underpins the UN List of Protected Areas. THE OECM ROUTE IS THE ONE MOST COMMUNITIES MISS: a site qualifies as an other effective area-based conservation measure if it delivers sustained, positive conservation outcomes EVEN THOUGH IT MAY BE MANAGED PRIMARILY FOR OTHER REASONS — so a grazing commons, a sacred site or a watershed managed for water supply can qualify without being managed primarily for conservation. Land that is worked rather than preserved is not excluded. But note the exclusivity: a site can be a protected area or an OECM — it is not possible to meet both, so ask which is being proposed. THE ICCA REGISTRY IS THE ONE COMMUNITIES FILL IN THEMSELVES: at iccaregistry.org, communities themselves provide data, case studies, maps, photos and stories, and its operators state it is meant to be used to enhance advocacy and recognition — not merely as an inventory. Documenting a territory there creates a citable, third-party-hosted record. THE SENTENCE THAT MATTERS MOST: UNEP-WCMC states these territories must be recognised and respected ‘whether or not they have been reported to the ICCA Registry’ — registration is NOT a precondition of rights, and anyone arguing a claim is weaker for being unregistered is arguing against the registry operator's own position. AND USE THE SCALE FIGURE CAREFULLY: over 1,500 sites are reported under indigenous and community governance — just 1 percent of all recorded sites, with UNEP-WCMC adding that no one knows how many ICCAs exist globally. That 1 percent measures how little has been recorded, not how little communities conserve. Filter Protected Planet by governance type to find such sites; UNEP-WCMC's manual Global Databases to Support ICCAs gives guidance on contributing data.

trackers.name: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation — an annual open call that reaches this country's region
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY HAS ONE OTHER ENTRY IN THIS ENTIRE MAP, SO START WITH WHAT THIS ONE IS: an annual open call for project proposals from a foundation whose FIRST STATED GEOGRAPHIC PRIORITY IS THE MEDITERRANEAN BASIN, which includes this country. Its three domains are limiting climate change and promoting renewable energy, PROTECTING BIODIVERSITY, and MANAGING WATER RESOURCES AND COMBATING DESERTIFICATION — the last two being where land and water disputes sit. THE CALL OPENS ONCE A YEAR FOR ONE MONTH IN JUNE and begins with a short pre-application submitted online, not a full proposal. IT SETS NO MAXIMUM GRANT, WHICH IS UNUSUAL — BUT IT WILL NOT PROVIDE MORE THAN HALF OF A PROJECT'S BUDGET, and that is the real barrier. You must already have, or be able to raise, the other half. This file recorded a case in the region where this foundation continued work that a different fund had started, which is how the fifty per cent condition is met in practice: one funder begins it, another matches. ITS PRE-APPLICATION FORM ACCEPTS ASSOCIATIONS, COMPANIES, PUBLIC ORGANISATIONS AND INDIVIDUALS, and reporting on the call indicates it does not restrict the applicant's country of origin — so a diaspora organisation or a foreign partner working on this country's ecosystems may be able to apply where a body inside the country cannot. That is worth knowing here more than anywhere in this map. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE SERIOUS FOR THIS COUNTRY: nothing found shows the foundation operating here, conditions make project implementation and fund transfer difficult, and it funds environmental projects rather than objections, litigation or advocacy. Treat it as the open door it is on paper, verify current eligibility with the foundation directly, and read its published list of funded projects first — it advises grant seekers to use that list as the guide to what it will actually support.

trackers.name: MedPAN — this country is named on its eligible list, which almost nothing else in this map is
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY APPEARS BY NAME ON THE PUBLISHED ELIGIBLE-COUNTRY LIST FOR ITS CALLS FOR SMALL PROJECTS — which is rare enough to be the reason this entry exists. Almost every funder recorded in this payload either excludes it or has no route to it. Grants run to around twenty-five thousand euros for work on a single marine protected area, or up to around forty-five thousand where several areas cooperate on one project. AND THE CALLS ARE OPEN NOT ONLY TO WHOEVER MANAGES THE AREA BUT TO OTHER ORGANISATIONS — NGOs, scientific institutions and companies — WORKING WITH THE RESPONSIBLE AUTHORITY. That widens who can realistically apply. IT IS ALSO A MEMBERSHIP NETWORK OF AROUND EIGHTY TO A HUNDRED ORGANISATIONS ACROSS THE MEDITERRANEAN THAT MANAGE OR ARE CREATING PROTECTED AREAS, AND MEMBERSHIP IS OPEN TO BODIES CONTRIBUTING TO THE CREATION OF ONE rather than only to established managers. For a country with almost no recorded civil society infrastructure, a route into a regional community of practitioners — with training courses for managers and regional workshops — may be worth more than the money. IT MANAGES A MEDITERRANEAN PROTECTED-AREAS DATABASE AND PUBLISHES A STATUS REPORT EVERY FOUR YEARS, which is a way to establish what is recorded about this coast without needing anything domestic. THE LIMITS ARE SUBSTANTIAL HERE: marine and coastal only; a matching contribution of roughly a quarter has been required in past calls; applications go through a secretariat by email with supporting documents, which assumes a functioning organisation; and nothing found shows a project in this country. Being on an eligible list is not the same as having been funded — ask the secretariat directly before building anything on it.

trackers.name: RAED — a regional network listing a coordinator association for this country
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY HAS ALMOST NOTHING DOMESTIC IN THIS MAP, AND THIS NETWORK'S MEMBERSHIP PAGE NAMES A COORDINATOR ASSOCIATION FOR IT. The network states that associations concerned with environment and sustainable development from this and most other Arab countries have joined since 1990, and it lists the coordinating association in each. Every other route this chat tried — searching for organisations, for federations, for grantees — produced nothing here. A regional register kept by a body that works with those associations is a different kind of source, and it costs nothing to read. IT IS SUBSTANTIAL: more than two hundred and fifty member organisations across the Arab countries, founded in 1990 in the run-up to the Rio Earth Summit, based in Egypt and registered there since 2007, with UNITED NATIONS ECONOMIC AND SOCIAL COUNCIL CONSULTATIVE STATUS SINCE 1996 and recognition by the League of Arab States as an OBSERVER IN THE COUNCIL OF ARAB MINISTERS RESPONSIBLE FOR THE ENVIRONMENT. THAT REGIONAL STANDING IS THE POINT FOR A COUNTRY IN THIS SITUATION: where domestic institutions cannot be approached, a regional network with a seat at Arab ministerial meetings and consultative status at the United Nations is a channel that exists outside them. It used that channel in December 2024, submitting an Arab civil society statement to the presidency of the desertification convention's conference on worsening DESERTIFICATION, DROUGHT AND LAND DEGRADATION. ITS MONTHLY NEWSLETTER GOES TO ENVIRONMENTAL ASSOCIATIONS AND SPECIALISTS ACROSS ALL ARAB COUNTRIES, supported by a Mediterranean capacity programme and a global small grants programme — a way to see who is active and who is funding, from outside. Its priorities include water scarcity, biodiversity, sustainable resource management and empowering local communities. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE SHARP HERE: it is a network and policy platform, not an objector, funder or lawyer; it operates from another country; and the standing of any particular member association here, after years of conflict, cannot be assumed from a membership list. Verify that the named association still functions before relying on it.

trackers.name: Digital Security Helpline — free emergency help in Arabic when accounts or devices are compromised
trackers.desc: FREE, TWENTY-FOUR HOURS A DAY, ANSWERED WITHIN TWO HOURS, WITH SUPPORT IN ARABIC among ten languages. It serves civil society worldwide — activists, community groups, journalists and human rights defenders. THIS MATTERS PARTICULARLY WHERE ORGANISATIONS ARE BEING REBUILT. Groups forming now are creating accounts, websites and contact lists for the first time, and the decisions taken in the first weeks determine what can be taken from them later. This helpline exists for exactly that moment: before anything happens it walks a group through ASSESSING THE RISKS ITS WORK CREATES and deciding what to secure first. IF YOU ARE ALREADY UNDER ATTACK it provides RAPID-RESPONSE EMERGENCY ASSISTANCE, and it helps ANALYSE, DOCUMENT AND EXPOSE advanced attacks such as SPYWARE and targeted phishing — which converts an intrusion into documented evidence rather than a suspicion. IT SECURES INFRASTRUCTURE, WEBSITES AND SOCIAL MEDIA ACCOUNTS, supplies guidance materials and training, and refers onward to others who can help. CONTACT IS BY EMAIL TO A PUBLISHED ADDRESS. It is an accredited member of a civil society computer emergency response body and publishes a data usage policy and terms of service — read them first, and consider which device and connection you use. THE LIMITS: digital security only. It will not take up an environmental or land case, fund anything or represent anyone. Use it alongside the regional Arab environmental network and the Mediterranean routes recorded separately for this country — and note that this file has now established that domestic environmental associations do exist here, so a group forming or reconnecting with them should secure its communications before, not after, it becomes visible.

trackers.name: Syrian Environment Protection Society — engineers and lawyers in one body, founded to stop urban encroachment
trackers.desc: ITS FOUNDING BOARD IS MADE UP OF PROFESSIONALS IN ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCES, ENGINEERING — AGRICULTURAL, ARCHITECTURAL AND CIVIL — MEDICINE, DENTISTRY, LAW AND EDUCATION. Civil and architectural engineers sitting alongside lawyers in one constituted body is exactly what a planning objection requires, and it is a combination this map has almost never found assembled anywhere. AND ITS PUBLISHED OBJECTIVES ARE DIRECTLY ABOUT STOPPING DEVELOPMENT ON THE WRONG GROUND: ACTIVATING THE LAWS ON CITY AND VILLAGE PLANNING IN ORDER TO STOP THE ENCROACHMENT OF URBAN DEVELOPMENT ON BIODIVERSITY HABITATS, and DEFENDING THE REMAINING NATURAL AREAS of topographic and biological richness SO THAT THEY MAY BE TREATED AS RESERVES preserved for future generations. Its own statement of aims speaks of shaping the natural AND URBAN environment and COMBATING THREATS against it. Very few bodies in this entire payload state opposition to encroachment as a founding purpose. IT IS THE COUNTRY'S FIRST: described as a leading non-governmental organisation and THE FIRST ENVIRONMENTAL MOVEMENT FOUNDED AND PUBLICLY DECLARED IN SYRIA, established in 1992 by a founder together with professors, experts and specialists, independent, non-governmental, non-profit and of public benefit, based in the capital with activities covering different regions of the country. ITS SUBJECTS ARE THE ONES THAT MATTER FOR LAND: biodiversity loss caused by OVER-EXPLOITATION OF NATURAL RESOURCES, POLLUTION AND CLIMATE CHANGE; protection of terrestrial, COASTAL AND WETLAND ecosystems under serious threat; protecting what remains of forests and threatened species; and supporting local communities through projects in awareness and natural resource management. Among its aims is establishing a NATIONAL HERBARIUM alongside botanical gardens and natural history collections — a plant record for the country, which is the kind of baseline this file has repeatedly found communities lack. THE WEAKNESSES ARE REAL AND YOU SHOULD KNOW THEM BEFORE RELYING ON IT. NO WEBSITE OF ITS OWN COULD BE FOUND: this entry points at an Arab non-governmental organisation directory page that carries the association's own first-person statement of its vision and aims. And much of the published material about it is old — an academic citation from 2006, a directory entry from 2019, an encyclopaedia article little edited since 2009. Syria's civil society has passed through more than a decade of war since most of that was written. VERIFY THAT IT IS STILL OPERATING BEFORE BUILDING ANYTHING ON IT — and note that this file has separately recorded a regional Arab environmental network whose membership page names a coordinating association for this country, which is the obvious way to check.

trackers.name: SSCW — the wildlife society that publishes the species data, and makes representations about power lines
trackers.desc: IT CAN ACTUALLY BE REACHED, WHICH THIS COUNTRY'S OTHER RECORDED ORGANISATION COULD NOT. It has its own website, an address in Damascus, a published email address and two named contact people, it is a member of the international conservation union, and it is this country's national partner in the global bird conservation partnership — a listing updated in 2026. IT PUBLISHES SPECIES RECORDS INTO THE GLOBAL BIODIVERSITY DATABASE RECORDED SEPARATELY IN THIS FILE. That matters more than it sounds: this map warned that an under-surveyed country looks empty in that database and that a developer can cite the emptiness as readily as a community cites a record. HERE IS THE ORGANISATION THAT PUTS SYRIAN RECORDS IN IT — so ask it what has been recorded on your ground, and ask it to publish what you find. AND IT ALREADY DOES INFRASTRUCTURE WORK, WHICH IS THE PART TO USE: it assesses the threats facing migratory birds from illegal killing, hunting, poisoning and ELECTROCUTION FROM POWER LINES, AND MAKES REPRESENTATIONS ABOUT THEM. A body that already writes to authorities about the impact of transmission lines is a body that can be asked about a road, a quarry or a dam. It organises counts of soaring birds on the migration route and has surveyed for threatened species using historical records and LOCAL KNOWLEDGE OF THE AREA. IT OFFERS A ROUTE TO PROTECTED STATUS: among its stated objectives is PARTICIPATING IN NATIONAL PROGRAMMES TO RUN PROTECTED AREAS, INCLUDING PRIVATE INITIATIVES, and its toolkit includes nature reserves, genetic banks, in-situ and ex-situ conservation, ecotourism and clean energy. Private protected initiatives are the tenure route this file recorded in the Caucasus and could not find in the Arab countries. IT WORKS WITH RURAL PEOPLE RATHER THAN AROUND THEM, AND THE PROOF IS IN A COMMUNITY MEMBER'S OWN ACCOUNT: after the society's activities at a wetland that is both an important bird area and a Ramsar site, he described how he and others were inspired to SHOOT BIRDS WITH CAMERAS INSTEAD OF RIFLES and to take up birdwatching tourism. It also takes a leading national role in ORGANISING HUNTING AND FISHING through hunting clubs, which is how it reaches rural communities — and is worth knowing if your community's dispute involves hunters. THE LIMITS: it is a conservation organisation, not a law practice or a land-holding body, and it works IN CLOSE COOPERATION WITH NATIONAL ENVIRONMENTAL AUTHORITIES rather than against them. It grew out of a United Nations led study of biodiversity and protected areas, so its orientation is scientific and institutional. And conditions in this country make any assumption about current capacity unsafe — write first.

trackers.name: Global Fund for Community Foundations — support for building a local giving institution while civil society re-forms
trackers.desc: IT FUNDS THE BUILDING OF LOCAL FUNDS RATHER THAN INDIVIDUAL PROJECTS, WHICH MATTERS MOST WHERE ORGANISATIONS ARE BEING REBUILT. It gives small grants and technical support to community philanthropy organisations — community foundations, WOMEN'S FUNDS, ENVIRONMENTAL FUNDS, grassroots grantmakers and national public foundations — aimed at their GRANTMAKING SYSTEMS, GOVERNANCE AND MANAGEMENT STRUCTURES, FUND DEVELOPMENT AND SUSTAINABILITY, and communications platforms. A group forming now, deciding how it will hold money and who will decide, is at exactly the moment this fund exists to support. ITS PRIORITY RULE FAVOURS THIS COUNTRY: PRIORITY IS GIVEN TO THOSE COUNTRIES WHERE ACCESS TO OTHER FUNDING OPPORTUNITIES IS LIMITED. AND WHAT IT WILL BACK INCLUDES THE HARD SUBJECTS: strengthening such bodies to respond to complex, sensitive or apparently intractable issues at community level — ENVIRONMENTAL ISSUES ARE NAMED, alongside SOCIAL COHESION AND OTHER COMMUNITY DIVISIONS, women's, youth and minority rights, and marginalised communities. This file recorded for this country large afforestation campaigns under way and an environmental society whose founding purpose was stopping urban encroachment on habitats; a local fund able to grant money to communities doing that work would be the missing piece. ITS RATIONALE IS WORTH QUOTING WHEN ARGUING FOR LOCAL GIVING: community philanthropy BUILDS ON ASSETS THAT ALREADY EXIST WITHIN COMMUNITIES rather than depending only on what comes from outside — and when local resources are brought to the table, A FLATTER POWER DYNAMIC IS CREATED and traditional donor-beneficiary imbalances are challenged. Where outside money is scarce and conditional, that argument is practical rather than ideological. HOW TO APPROACH IT: through a concept note, against published eligibility guidelines; grants are small, normally for an initial year, with follow-on possible. CHECK ITS OWN GUIDELINES FOR CURRENT FIGURES — the only sources quoting an amount were aggregators this file does not use. THE LIMITS, AND ONE IS ACUTE HERE: applicants must be bodies that make grants or mobilise local resources rather than a single community group; it funds neither land purchase nor litigation; and sanctions and banking restrictions may affect transfers regardless of the fund's willingness — raise that question early rather than after an application succeeds.

trackers.name: The bar's Judicial Aid Committee — it can assign you a lawyer who is not allowed to refuse
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY HAD NO ROUTE TO A LAWYER IN THIS MAP. HERE IS ONE, AND IT IS STRONGER THAN IT SOUNDS. Under the law organising the legal profession, a lawyer is free to accept or refuse a case — EXCEPT WHERE HE IS ASSIGNED BY A DECISION OF THE JUDICIAL AID COMMITTEE, or by a criminal court, an investigating judge or a juvenile court. That single exception is the whole point: the committee's decision creates an obligation on the lawyer, and once a case is accepted the law places on him the duty of carrying it through to the end. A COMMITTEE THAT CAN APPOINT COUNSEL IS A DIFFERENT THING FROM A LIST OF FIRMS WHO MIGHT AGREE TO HELP. AND THERE IS SOMEWHERE TO GO. The bar is a single national syndicate seated in the capital WITH BRANCHES IN ALL GOVERNORATES, unified by law in 1972 and now governed by the profession law of 1981 — and a branch is established wherever at least THIRTY registered practising and trainee lawyers are on the roll. Ask your governorate branch for the judicial aid committee by name; that is the body with the power, not the individual lawyer you happen to reach. THE SYNDICATE ALSO MAINTAINS COOPERATIVE COMMITTEES AND AN EMERGENCY-AID COMMITTEE alongside its internal, financial and accounting regulations, so the structures for assisting people exist within the profession rather than only outside it. WHAT YOU MUST ESTABLISH BEFORE RELYING ON IT, BECAUSE THIS FILE COULD NOT: WHETHER THE COMMITTEE'S ASSIGNMENTS EXTEND TO CIVIL AND ADMINISTRATIVE MATTERS — which is where a land, property or permit dispute sits — OR WHETHER IN PRACTICE THEY RUN MOSTLY TO CRIMINAL CASES, where the courts themselves also assign counsel. Ask that question first, in those words, at the branch. AND KNOW THE MOMENT YOU ARE IN: AN INTERIM CONSTITUTIONAL DECLARATION WAS RATIFIED IN MARCH 2025 ESTABLISHING A FIVE-YEAR TRANSITION, with a new framework for the judiciary. Rules governing the profession, the courts and legal aid may change during it, so confirm what applies now rather than relying on the older statute alone. THE OTHER LIMITS: the syndicate is a professional body regulating lawyers, not an advocacy organisation — it will not take a position on a scheme. Assignment produces a lawyer, not necessarily one experienced in land or environmental matters. Use it with the environmental protection society and the wildlife society recorded separately for this country, which hold the subject knowledge a assigned lawyer will not.

trackers.name: Waqf property — 37,000 holdings that cannot be taken by long occupation
trackers.desc: FIRST, FIND OUT WHETHER THE GROUND YOU ARE DEFENDING IS ENDOWED, BECAUSE A GREAT DEAL OF THIS COUNTRY IS. Estimates run to THIRTY-SEVEN THOUSAND WAQF PROPERTIES — around nineteen thousand in Aleppo and eight and a half thousand in Damascus — and the ministry is currently reviewing rents and valuations for some thirty-four thousand of them. THE LAW DEFINES WAQF PROPERTY AS FUNDS DEDICATED TO PUBLIC BENEFIT WHICH ARE NEITHER STATE PROPERTY NOR PRIVATE PROPERTY, and the category expressly includes mosques, takiyas, schools, libraries, CEMETERIES, shrines and maqams. This file has argued elsewhere that an endowment keeps land outside the market; here that is not an argument but the statutory definition. AND FOUR PROTECTIONS FOLLOW THAT ARE STRONGER THAN ANYTHING ELSE RECORDED IN THIS MAP. NO RIGHT MAY BE ACQUIRED BY PRESCRIPTION OVER WAQF PROPERTY — no matter how many years someone has occupied, possession does not ripen into title. ANYONE OCCUPYING OR EXPLOITING WAQF LAND WITHOUT A VALID CONTRACT DOCUMENTED WITH THE MINISTRY IS A TRESPASSER, HOWEVER LONG THE OCCUPATION HAS RUN — and the fact that a directorate has been taking occupancy payments from them DOES NOT AMOUNT TO A CONTRACT. THE WAQF'S FINANCIAL CLAIMS AGAINST OTHERS DO NOT PRESCRIBE EITHER, and rank as a privileged debt collected under the law on gathering public funds. AND IF WAQF LAND IS EXPROPRIATED FOR PUBLIC BENEFIT AND THE PUBLIC-BENEFIT CHARACTER LATER LAPSES, THE PROPERTY IS RE-REGISTERED BACK. A reversion right on expropriation is rare anywhere and this file has found it nowhere else. THAT MATTERS BECAUSE OF WHAT WAS DONE TO THESE ASSETS. Waqf property was sold for money, waqf land was seized by influence, investment contracts were handed directly to associates, and ownership was transferred and re-registered during land delimitation procedures in favour of parties connected to the authorities. Recovery is now under way and named properties have been returned, including a major commercial complex and the ground of the old international fair — so an endowment property lost in that period is not necessarily lost for good, and the non-prescription rule is the reason. WHAT TO DO WITH THIS: establish whether the plot, the grove, the cemetery or the spring in question is registered as waqf, and if it is, the counterparty is the endowment administration and the terms of the original endowment — not a purchaser's title. THE LIMITS. The administration is a ministry, and this payload records state bodies with that caveat: the endowment authorities are landlords who lease, and their stated direction is developing investment of waqf property. A community cannot endow land it does not own. The framework sits in a 2018 law under a transitional government, so confirm what currently applies. And self-administered areas of the country operate their own endowment law with similar provisions but separate administration — ask which applies where you are.THE SAME PORTAL IS A STRUCTURED PROPERTY-RIGHTS REFERENCE LIBRARY, AND IT IS WORTH USING FOR FAR MORE THAN ENDOWMENTS. It runs a series of explainers covering THE TYPES OF OWNERSHIP DOCUMENT RANKED BY THEIR LEGAL STRENGTH, COMPENSATION FOR EXPROPRIATION, BUILDING PERMITS, the property directorates and the property page, and LICENSING TO BUILD ON LAND HELD IN COMMON — alongside a LAWS SECTION CARRYING FULL TEXTS and investigative reporting on how property is actually taken. THE MOST USEFUL SINGLE FACT IS ABOUT THE REGISTER ITSELF: IT ALLOWS THE STATE OF A PROPERTY TO BE ESTABLISHED FROM ITS NUMBER, REGARDLESS OF THE OWNER'S NAME — and NO DOCUMENT CONCERNING A PROPERTY COUNTS AS CONCLUSIVE PROOF UNLESS IT IS ENTERED IN THE PROPERTY DIRECTORATES' REGISTERS. The system dates from 1926 and is deliberately strict, requiring extensive proof before a change is recorded; the directorate was created in 1947, was attached to the local administration ministry under a 2010 law, and operates fourteen sub-directorates in city centres. FOR ANYONE WHO SOLD UNDER PRESSURE, THE PORTAL RECORDS SOMETHING PRACTICAL: A SALE MADE UNDER DURESS CAN BE ANNULLED IF THE DURESS IS PROVED, AND DURESS CAN BE SHOWN BY COMPARING THE PRICE PAID WITH THE PREVAILING VALUES AT THE TIME. Such sales are formally recorded in the registers but lack consent. Its reporting describes networks of brokers, property-office owners and sometimes lawyers exploiting displaced people who had lost their personal and property documents. TWO COST AND PROCEDURE FACTS FOR ANYONE BUILDING OR DEFENDING GROUND: BUILDING LICENCE FEES ARE PAYABLE IN THREE INSTALMENTS — forty per cent on issue, thirty per cent at the end of the first year and thirty per cent at the end of the second — and the licence is only complete once registered with the temporary register department. AND WHERE LAND IS HELD IN COMMON, A COMMITTEE CHAIRED BY A JUDGE NAMED BY THE JUSTICE MINISTER, with a representative of the administrative body and a first-degree representative of the property directorates, CAN REMOVE THE COMMON OWNERSHIP — which is how consolidated title is produced from shared land, and therefore how shared land is made developable. ITS CURRENT REPORTING NAMES THE MECHANISM TO WATCH: reconstruction proposals for districts east of the capital advancing A MODEL OF PROPERTY DEDUCTION COMBINED WITH COMPANY FINANCING, alongside expansion of organisational plans and legal battles to recover usurped property south of the capital. CURRENCY, AND IT MATTERS: A NOTICE DATED 14 APRIL 2026 STATES THAT THE SITE WILL BE UPDATED LESS FREQUENTLY, with the focus moving to A FREE QUARTERLY MAGAZINE offering fuller analysis, ITS FIRST ISSUE DUE AT THE END OF THE SECOND QUARTER OF 2026. The archive and the explainers remain, but treat dated items as history and look to the magazine for what is current.

trackers.name: Syria Forest Foundation — it backs the cooperative and the credit, not just the trees
trackers.desc: ITS STATED WORK INCLUDES SUPPORTING AGRICULTURAL COOPERATIVES AND MICROFINANCE SYSTEMS, WHICH IS BOTH HALVES OF WHAT A COMMUNITY DEFENDING LAND ACTUALLY NEEDS. This file has found across twenty-three countries that a cooperative is the vehicle through which people hold and defend ground, and that money is what they cannot get. ONE ORGANISATION HERE BACKS BOTH. IT IS A NON-PROFIT CONCERNED WITH REVIVING THE COUNTRY'S AGRICULTURAL HERITAGE AND SUPPORTING LOCAL COMMUNITIES, and its team spans AGRICULTURE, ECONOMICS, FORESTRY AND GOVERNANCE — that last field is the unusual one, and it is the difference between an organisation that plants and one that can help a community deal with the rules, the registration and the institutions. IT DEVELOPS FARMING METHODS SUITED TO A DRY CLIMATE and promotes NATURE-BASED SOLUTIONS, alongside comprehensive capacity building, sustainability and FINANCIAL EMPOWERMENT, including training future leaders. AND IT IS BUILT TO REACH THE DIASPORA: it states that it unites Syrians everywhere and works with international partners. This payload recorded elsewhere that a standing local fund is the most durable way to pay for defending land, and that the money for it usually exists abroad rather than at home; an organisation whose premise is joining those two is the right shape for that. WHAT TO ASK IT FOR, CONCRETELY: help constituting or strengthening an agricultural cooperative in your area, access to its microfinance work, dry-climate planting advice for ground you want to keep in visible use, and the governance expertise to deal with the endowment administration or the land registry. THE LIMITS: it is young, operating in a country in transition under an interim framework, and nothing found shows it opposing a development scheme — its work is building and restoring rather than objecting. Its reach across the country's divided administrations is unestablished. Ask what it currently runs in your governorate before relying on it.

trackers.name: Ilana — volunteers replanting what the war burned, and a partner who can convene the ministry
trackers.desc: A VOLUNTARY NON-PROFIT WHOSE PURPOSE IS REFORESTING SYRIAN LAND AND REVIVING THE GREEN SPACES DAMAGED DURING THE WAR YEARS, working toward a target of FIFTY MILLION TREES. THE PART THAT MATTERS FOR A COMMUNITY IS HOW IT WORKS: THROUGH STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIPS WITH GOVERNMENT BODIES, COMPANIES AND CIVIL SOCIETY. An organisation that already sits with ministries and companies can bring them to a place — which is a different capability from planting, and the harder one to obtain. WHY PLANTING IS MORE THAN PLANTING HERE. This file recorded in a neighbouring country that land services identify UNUSED LAND as a ground for reallocation, and advised communities to keep dated evidence that ground is in use — cultivation, grazing, planting, repair. A documented planting programme on land a community wants to keep is exactly that evidence: dated, photographed, witnessed by an outside body, and expensive for anyone to argue away. IT ALSO SITS INSIDE A WIDER WAVE. Volunteer campaigns launched by activists and young people have targeted fire-damaged areas in the coastal governorates and the countryside of Homs and Hama, working to restore damaged ecosystems, build environmental awareness AND RAISE FUNDING FOR PLANTING — and the agriculture ministry has run its own campaigns, distributing around two hundred thousand olive seedlings in one governorate. Seedlings are being given away at scale; the question for a community is who will help it get them and plant them on ground it wants held. THE LIMITS: it is a volunteer organisation with volunteer capacity, its focus is restoration rather than opposition, and its partnerships with government and companies mean it is unlikely to take a position against a scheme those partners support. Approach it for trees, for the record of planting, and for its ability to bring officials to a site — and take an objection to the bar's judicial aid committee and the endowment route recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Environment Syria — who else is already doing this, named, placed and dated
trackers.desc: ITS INITIATIVES SECTION IS THE USEFUL PART: IT RECORDS COMMUNITY AND OFFICIAL ENVIRONMENTAL EFFORTS BY NAME, PLACE AND DATE. A coastal governorate campaign launched on 6 February 2026 to plant more than fourteen thousand; a campaign run with the emergency and disaster management ministry targeting the AFFORESTATION OF TWELVE SITES in another governorate; a planting campaign on a named highway attended by the agriculture minister and a provincial governor; a cycling union ride with more than eight hundred riders. THIS FILE HAS TOLD READERS IN EVERY COUNTRY TO FIND OUT WHO ELSE IS ALREADY DOING THIS BEFORE STARTING ANYTHING. HERE THAT IS A PAGE. AND IT IS THE PLACE A COMMUNITY'S OWN WORK CAN BE PUT ON RECORD. The platform's stated goal is to raise awareness of environmental and climate issues, TO SUPPORT LOCAL CIVIL AND GOVERNMENTAL INITIATIVES, and to encourage community participation — and its declared mission is turning knowledge into awareness and awareness into effective behaviour. A planting programme or a defence of a stretch of ground that appears in a national environmental record, with a date and a place, is documented in a way a village's own photographs are not — and this file recorded a round earlier that dated, witnessed evidence of land in use is what answers a finding that land is unused. ITS COVERAGE ALSO NAMES HARMS THAT NOTHING ELSE IN THIS COUNTRY'S LISTING ADDRESSES: POLLUTION FROM LANDMINES, WAR REMNANTS AND MUNITIONS; the continuing expansion of drought; groundwater depletion; the collapse of the olive sector on the coast since 2011 and the thousands of families that depended on it; and the water situation in a named governorate. Contamination by war remnants is a land-use constraint particular to this country, and a community planning to work ground needs it named before it plants. THE LIMITS, AND THEY MATTER. IT IS A KNOWLEDGE AND MEDIA PLATFORM, NOT AN ORGANISATION THAT ACTS — nobody there will attend a hearing, fund anything or represent you. It reports ministry campaigns approvingly and describes its role as supporting governmental as well as civil initiatives, so it is not an opponent of official schemes. And appearing in it is publicity, which is a choice. Use it to find allies, to see what is being funded and where, and to have your own work recorded — and use the bar's judicial aid committee, the endowment route and the two organisations recorded separately for this country for everything else.

trackers.name: Order of Engineers — the register of licensed offices, and the engineer named on every building
trackers.desc: EVERY BUILDING PROJECT IN THIS COUNTRY MUST HAVE A NAMED SUPERVISING ENGINEER, AND THAT ENGINEER IS REGISTERED WITH THIS SYNDICATE. Under a 2023 decision and its amendments, a supervising engineer is named for residential, commercial, industrial, tourism and educational properties, across four specialisms, with supervision fees published per square metre. That means a scheme going up beside you is not anonymous: THERE IS A NAMED PROFESSIONAL RESPONSIBLE FOR SUPERVISING IT, they hold a registration that can be checked, and they answer to a professional body with disciplinary powers. Ask who the supervising engineer is before you ask anything else. SECOND, THE SYNDICATE HOLDS THE REGISTER OF LICENSED ENGINEERING OFFICES BY GOVERNORATE. An engineer registers at the branch of the governorate where they intend to work, and CONSULTING ENGINEERING OFFICES AND COMPANIES — domestic and foreign — ARE THEMSELVES REGISTERED WITH THE SYNDICATE AS LEGAL PERSONS, with the signatory named and their professional standing recorded. That is how a community finds a licensed professional NEAR IT to survey a boundary, measure an encroachment or assess whether a structure is sound — and how it checks that the person offering to do so is actually licensed. THIRD, AND NEW: THE SYNDICATE IS RUNNING COURSES ON REAL ESTATE VALUATION ACROSS ALL ITS GOVERNORATE BRANCHES. This file recorded valuation bodies in three neighbouring countries and found none here; valuation capacity is now being built inside the engineering profession, which is where a community will find someone able to put a defensible figure on land or on damage. FOURTH, THE BRANCHES ARE THE PRACTICAL DOOR. Governorate branches run their own ENGINEERING OFFICES COMMITTEES, publish work rules and answer common questions, and set supervision rates including for ROAD SUPERVISION by offices licensed in that speciality — which is directly relevant where a road is the project being resisted. THE LIMITS. IT IS A PROFESSIONAL BODY THAT REGULATES ENGINEERS, NOT AN ADVOCATE FOR RESIDENTS: it will confirm a licence, receive a complaint about professional conduct, and set fees — it will not oppose a project. Engaging an engineer costs money, and the syndicate publishes the scales precisely so that it does. Membership is tied to nationality, so this is a domestic professional route. And the framework is being rewritten — the syndicate has announced work on new laws and regulations covering returning engineers and reconstruction — so confirm the current rules before relying on any figure. Use it with the endowment route and the bar's judicial aid committee recorded separately here: the engineer measures, the endowment may hold the ground, and the bar supplies the lawyer.

trackers.name: Returning owners' property guidance — what to gather, what never to do, and when to go to court
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE MOST PRACTICAL PROPERTY GUIDANCE THIS FILE HAS FOUND FOR THIS COUNTRY, AND IT IS WRITTEN FOR PEOPLE GOING BACK TO GROUND THEY MAY NO LONGER BE ABLE TO PROVE IS THEIRS. It covers protecting ownership rights, securing shelter, and handling claims, documents and disputes on return. THE INSTRUCTIONS THAT MATTER MOST ARE THE ONES ABOUT EVIDENCE. Gather civil status documents — death, marriage and birth certificates. WHERE ANY DOCUMENT IS LOST, CONSULT A LAWYER TO APPLY FOR A REPLACEMENT COPY, and where inheritance is involved, to prepare an INHERITANCE INVENTORY THROUGH THE COURTS. DO NOT DIVIDE AN INHERITANCE INFORMALLY WITHOUT DOCUMENTATION. REQUEST SURVEY MAPS FROM THE PROPERTY DIRECTORATES OR THE LAND REGISTER WHERE AVAILABLE. USE WITNESS TESTIMONY AND THE CERTIFICATE OF THE LOCAL HEADMAN AS INTERIM EVIDENCE. AND GATHER PROOF OF LONG-TERM USE, SUCH AS UTILITY BILLS. That last instruction is the one to act on first, because utility bills accumulate whether or not anyone is arguing, and they establish occupation across years. THEN THE WARNING, AND IT IS THE OPPOSITE OF WHAT MOST PEOPLE'S INSTINCT WOULD BE: DO NOT MAKE ANY PHYSICAL CHANGES TO THE LAND UNTIL THE DISPUTE IS RESOLVED. Building, clearing or fencing while a claim is unsettled damages the claim rather than strengthening it. ON WHAT TO DO IF SOMEONE ELSE IS LIVING THERE: first establish the situation on the ground — is the property damaged, occupied, or disputed. IF OCCUPIED, TRY MEDIATION FIRST, AND NOTE THAT A TEMPORARY OCCUPANCY AGREEMENT OR A LEASE CAN AVOID CONFLICT WHILE PRESERVING YOUR CLAIM as the administrative process continues. IF MEDIATION FAILS, FILE A FORMAL CASE WITH THE COMPETENT AUTHORITY OR COURT, SUCH AS THE PROPERTY COURT OR THE OFFICIAL CONCILIATION MECHANISMS. An interim agreement that records who owns and who occupies is worth more than an eviction attempt that fails. WHY THIS APPLIES BEYOND RETURNING FAMILIES: a community facing a scheme on ground it has used for generations faces the same evidential problem — possession without paper. The document hierarchy, the interim evidence, the long-use proof and the warning against altering the ground apply equally. THE LIMITS: it is guidance and a signposting service, not a law firm — it tells you when to consult a lawyer rather than providing one; it addresses returning displaced people, so some content will not fit other situations; and property administration in this country is being rebuilt, with documents actively being reconstituted, so procedures may change between reading and acting. Read it with the bar's judicial aid route and the endowment and engineering entries recorded separately for this country.THE SAME GUIDANCE CARRIES A SAFETY WARNING THAT THIS ENTRY DID NOT RECORD AND THAT NOTHING ELSE IN THIS MAP SAYS AT ALL: IF A PROPERTY HAS BEEN ABANDONED FOR A LONG TIME, DO NOT ENTER IT IMMEDIATELY. CHECK MINE RISK FIRST AND CONFIRM WHETHER THE COMMUNITY OR THE AUTHORITIES HAVE SURVEYED OR CLEARED THE AREA. MANY INCIDENTS OCCUR DURING RUBBLE REMOVAL AND AGRICULTURAL WORK — the very acts by which people take their land back. Where destruction is heavy there is also a risk of structural collapse, and the advice is to REQUEST A BASIC STRUCTURAL ASSESSMENT FROM QUALIFIED TECHNICIANS WHERE POSSIBLE. THE EVIDENCE LIST IS ALSO WIDER THAN THIS ENTRY FIRST RECORDED. Alongside civil documents and witness statements it names PROPERTY TAX RECEIPTS, PHOTOGRAPHS OF THE PROPERTY, SITE MAPS OR SKETCHES, COURT RULINGS, NOTARISED AGREEMENTS, AGENCY ATTESTATIONS AND BUILDING PERMITS. PHOTOGRAPHS AND A HAND-DRAWN SITE SKETCH COST NOTHING AND COUNT AS EVIDENCE — make them before anything changes on the ground, not after. AND CHECK THE STATUS OF THE OFFICES BEFORE TRAVELLING. After December 2024 some services were suspended INCLUDING CIVIL REGISTRIES AND CADASTRAL OFFICES. Between January and June 2025 only limited services ran — civil records, family statements for events registered earlier, AND REAL ESTATE RECORDS FROM CADASTRAL OFFICES. Registration of events that had occurred abroad resumed at the end of May, and ADVOCACY LED TO SERVICES RESUMING IN MID-2025. ONE DETAIL FROM THAT PERIOD IS WORTH ASKING ABOUT WHEREVER YOU GO: LEGAL PARTNERS WERE STATIONED INSIDE CIVIL AFFAIRS OFFICES TO GIVE ON-THE-SPOT ASSISTANCE. ASK WHETHER A LEGAL PARTNER IS PRESENT AT THE OFFICE YOU ARE TRAVELLING TO — free help at the counter is worth more than advice obtained days earlier somewhere else.

trackers.name: Free legal offices and hotlines — consultation AND representation, through partner organisations
trackers.desc: THE WORD THAT MATTERS HERE IS REPRESENTATION. Free legal consultations AND REPRESENTATION BEFORE COURTS OR ADMINISTRATIVE AUTHORITIES are provided through legal partner organisations, according to individual need — and this file records many services that will advise and very few that will actually appear for someone. THERE ARE TWO WAYS IN, AND BOTH ARE ORDINARY: VISIT ONE OF THE LEGAL OFFICES, OR TELEPHONE ANY HOTLINE RUN BY THE LEGAL PARTNERS OPERATING IN THE COUNTRY. The contact details are published on a support-centre site, so the offices and numbers can be found before travelling. A hotline matters particularly where a person cannot safely or affordably cross the country to ask a question. THE ENTRY POINT IS CIVIL DOCUMENTS, AND THAT IS THE OPENING RATHER THAN THE LIMIT. The service is described around obtaining identity cards and other civil documents — which is exactly where a property claim starts in this country, because this file has already recorded that proving ownership here depends on civil status papers, an inheritance inventory obtained through the courts, and survey maps from the property directorates. A household that cannot replace a lost identity card cannot begin an inheritance claim, and cannot begin a land claim either. ASK WHETHER THE PARTNER HANDLING YOUR DOCUMENTS ALSO TAKES PROPERTY AND INHERITANCE MATTERS — the partners are separate organisations with different specialisms, so the answer varies by office. THE LIMITS, PLAINLY. THIS IS AN INTERNATIONAL AGENCY'S SERVICE DELIVERED BY PARTNER ORGANISATIONS, and its stated audience is displaced people, returnees, refugees and asylum seekers rather than the general population — eligibility should be checked at the first call rather than assumed. The partners change over time and coverage is uneven between governorates. And it is not a substitute for the bar's own judicial aid committee, which this file records separately for this country and which can assign an advocate. USE BOTH: the hotline to find out what is possible and to get documents moving, and the bar's committee for an assigned advocate in a contested case. Take with you everything this file's returning-owners guidance lists — civil documents, witness statements, the local headman's certificate and proof of long use such as utility bills.THREE THINGS ABOUT THIS SERVICE WERE NOT RECORDED HERE, AND THE FIRST IS THE ONE THAT DECIDES PROPERTY CASES: ADMINISTRATIVE INTERVENTIONS ON HOUSING, LAND AND PROPERTY MAY INCLUDE ASSISTING PEOPLE TO ISSUE BASIC CADASTRAL DOCUMENTS — REPLACEMENTS OF LOST OR DAMAGED CADASTRAL DOCUMENTS AND OWNERSHIP DEEDS, OR COPIES OF A POWER OF ATTORNEY OR A RATIFIED SALE CONTRACT. A REPLACEMENT DEED IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A CLAIM AND A CASE. THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS SEPARATELY THAT REGISTERS ARE BEING REBUILT AND OWNERSHIP FIXED DURING DELIMITATION — A FAMILY WITHOUT PAPERS AT THAT MOMENT LOSES BY DEFAULT, SO THE REPLACEMENT SHOULD BE SOUGHT BEFORE THE SURVEY TEAM ARRIVES, NOT AFTER. SECOND, WHO DELIVERS IT AND WHERE: THE AID IS PROVIDED THROUGH TWO NAMED LOCAL PARTNERS — A NATIONAL RED CRESCENT SOCIETY AND A SYRIAN DEVELOPMENT ORGANISATION — IN ALL GOVERNORATES, THROUGH LEGAL TEAMS IN LEGAL AND COMMUNITY CENTRES OR THROUGH MOBILE ACTIVITIES IN THE AREAS WHERE PEOPLE ACTUALLY ARE, AND IT COVERS DISPLACED PEOPLE, RETURNEES AND HOST COMMUNITIES ALIKE. ASK THE NEAREST COMMUNITY CENTRE WHEN THE LEGAL TEAM NEXT VISITS RATHER THAN ASSUMING A JOURNEY TO A CITY IS NEEDED. THE TEAMS ARE EXPERIENCED LAWYERS SUPPORTED BY LEGAL OUTREACH VOLUNTEERS WHO ARE LAW STUDENTS OR RETIRED LAWYERS. THIRD, THE CIVIL REGISTRATION SIDE IS PROPERTY WORK IN DISGUISE: INTERVENTION BEFORE CIVIL REGISTRIES FOR IDENTITY CARDS AND FAMILY BOOKLETS, AND BEFORE THE COURTS AND THE DEPARTMENT OF CIVIL AFFAIRS TO REGISTER MARRIAGES, DIVORCES OR DEATHS THAT TOOK PLACE WITHOUT EVER BEING RECORDED. IF A DEATH WAS NEVER REGISTERED, THE LAND CANNOT PASS. THAT IS WHY INHERITANCE CLAIMS FAIL MORE OFTEN THAN OWNERSHIP CLAIMS — AND WHY REGISTERING THOSE EVENTS IS THE FIRST STEP FOR A FAMILY WHOSE ELDER DIED IN DISPLACEMENT. ONE CAUTION FROM THE SERVICE'S OWN WORDING: PARTNERS PROVIDE PROPERTY-RELATED SERVICES UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS, SO WHAT IS AVAILABLE VARIES BY AREA AND BY CASE, AND A CONTESTED OR POLITICALLY SENSITIVE CLAIM MAY FALL OUTSIDE IT.

trackers.name: Peasant cooperative societies and their union — a body that can buy land without paying registration fees, and what it costs you in control
trackers.desc: A PEASANT COOPERATIVE PRODUCTION SOCIETY ACQUIRES LEGAL PERSONALITY FROM THE DATE IT IS REGISTERED WITH THE GENERAL UNION OF PEASANTS, AND THAT PERSONALITY LETS IT OWN MOVABLE AND IMMOVABLE PROPERTY. AND BECAUSE IT HAS IT, THE SOCIETY IS EXEMPT FROM ALL FEES ON REAL ESTATE REGISTRATION ARISING FROM PROPERTY SALES, AND FROM THE PROPERTY AND VACANT-LAND REVENUE TAX. Of every land-holding vehicle recorded across twenty-three countries in this file, THIS IS THE ONLY ONE THAT BUYS AND REGISTERS LAND WITHOUT PAYING THE REGISTRATION FEES — which for a group pooling small sums is often the difference between completing a purchase and abandoning it. WHAT IT TAKES TO FORM ONE: AT LEAST THIRTY MEMBERS. Each member subscribes for shares in proportion to the land they hold in the society's area — for irrigated and tree-planted land, ONE SHARE PER HECTARE where holdings are under eight hectares, and TWO SHARES FOR EACH ADDITIONAL HECTARE ABOVE THAT. The internal regulation was issued by ministerial decision in May 2023 and extends the peasant organisation law of 1947 and its amendments, so this is an old structure recently restated rather than an experiment. NOW THE PART TO READ TWICE BEFORE JOINING ANYTHING. THE SAME REGULATION IS DESCRIBED AS FOCUSING ON COLLECTIVE COOPERATION TO IMPROVE PRODUCTION WHILE AFFECTING MEMBERS' INDIVIDUAL RIGHTS TO USE AND HOLD THEIR OWN LAND — the explainer that sets it out is framed around the acquisition of members' lands. A COOPERATIVE THAT CAN HOLD LAND CHEAPLY IS ALSO A COOPERATIVE THAT HOLDS LAND YOU PUT INTO IT. Before subscribing, establish exactly what happens to your plot, what rights of use you keep, what the exit terms are, and who decides. The share formula above rewards larger holders with proportionally more votes, so ask who will control the society before you are inside it. THE UNION ITSELF IS THE OTHER HALF OF THIS ENTRY, AND IT IS A REAL FORUM. It is a popular organisation with legal personality and financial and administrative independence; it SUPERVISES the peasant organisations, REPRESENTS PEASANTS IN ALL COUNCILS, COMMITTEES, BODIES AND CONFERENCES concerning their affairs and their agriculture, and PARTICIPATES IN DRAWING UP AGRICULTURAL POLICY. A body that sits where agricultural policy is written is a body worth putting a land problem in front of. IT ALSO STATES THAT IT CARES FOR THE INTERESTS OF PEASANTS WHO ARE NOT MEMBERS AND SEEKS TO ORGANISE THEM — so an unaffiliated farmer is within its stated remit. Its practical work runs to agricultural training institutes and courses in the governorates, machinery repair stations, fuel and agricultural-medicine outlets, supplying societies with machinery, and COOPERATIVE MARKETING OF CROPS. THE LIMITS: it is a state-linked popular organisation of long standing rather than an independent union, and the country's institutions are being restructured, so confirm the current position before relying on any of it. The share and land provisions are the ones to take legal advice on — this file records the bar's judicial aid committee and free legal offices separately for this country.

trackers.name: Heritage award now open here — funding for safeguarding heritage, newly extended to this country
trackers.desc: IN FEBRUARY 2026 A REGIONAL HERITAGE AWARD WAS EXPANDED TO INCLUDE THIS COUNTRY FOR THE FIRST TIME. In a place where heritage has been damaged on an enormous scale and where almost every funding route recorded in this file is humanitarian rather than cultural, THAT IS A NEW DOOR. WHAT IT FUNDS: INNOVATIVE PROJECTS CONTRIBUTING TO THE SAFEGUARDING OF TANGIBLE AND INTANGIBLE CULTURAL HERITAGE, with the aim of promoting best practice. It is run by the region's oldest national heritage organisation, a non-governmental non-profit founded in 1989, IN PARTNERSHIP WITH THE EUROPEAN UNION'S DELEGATION, two banks and a private donor — so the money is not from a single state source. EARLIER EDITIONS IN 2024 AND 2025 RECOGNISED COMPLETED HERITAGE WORK, AND THE 2025 ROUND CARRIED A PUBLISHED DEADLINE EXTENDED INTO LATE JULY. Expect an annual cycle with a fixed closing date. THE FIRST ROUND OPEN TO THIS COUNTRY IS THE ONE WITH THE FEWEST COMPETING APPLICATIONS — that is an argument for preparing now rather than waiting to see how it goes. INTANGIBLE HERITAGE IS EXPRESSLY INCLUDED. Crafts, building techniques, agricultural terracing, water practices and oral knowledge are within scope — which suits a country where much of what survives is knowledge rather than intact structures, and where the people who hold it are dispersed. USE IT WITH WHAT IS ALREADY RECORDED HERE: the property-records guidance for returning owners, the free legal offices, and the cooperative societies that can hold property without paying registration fees. A CONSTITUTED BODY THAT CAN RECEIVE FUNDS IS THE PRECONDITION — establish that first, because an award cycle will not wait while you form one. THE LIMITS: it is decided competitively by an organisation in another country; it funds safeguarding rather than opposition to any scheme; and eligibility rules for applicants here are new and unverified. Confirm the current cycle and who may apply before relying on it.

trackers.name: Threatened tree species fund — money for the trees themselves, and it favours places where other funding is scarce
trackers.desc: THIS FILE OPENED A THREAD AT R400 ABOUT TREES THAT BELONG TO NO FOREST AND ENJOY NO PROTECTION. HERE IS A FUND WHOSE ENTIRE PURPOSE IS THREATENED TREES: a private foundation established in 2005 that exists to preserve threatened tree species, prevent their extinction and improve their conservation status. AND ITS STATED PREFERENCE IS THE REASON IT IS RECORDED HERE RATHER THAN IN A RICHER COUNTRY: IT FUNDS PROJECTS ANYWHERE IN THE WORLD BUT FAVOURS AREAS OF HIGH BIOLOGICAL DIVERSITY AND AREAS WHERE NEEDS ARE IMPORTANT AND FUNDING OPPORTUNITIES ARE LIMITED. A country whose conservation funding has largely collapsed is not disadvantaged in this competition — it is the kind of place the fund says it is looking for. THE ELIGIBILITY TEST IS SPECIES-BASED AND STRICT, SO CHECK IT FIRST: ONLY PROJECTS IMPROVING THE CONSERVATION STATUS OF GLOBALLY THREATENED TREE SPECIES LISTED ON THE INTERNATIONAL RED LIST AS VULNERABLE, ENDANGERED OR CRITICALLY ENDANGERED QUALIFY, WITH PRIORITY TO THE LAST TWO. Look up your species before writing anything. AND THERE IS A DOOR FOR SPECIES NOBODY HAS ASSESSED YET: IF A TREE IS THREATENED BUT ITS ASSESSMENT IS NOT YET PUBLISHED, DETAILED INFORMATION JUSTIFYING THAT STATUS MAY BE SUBMITTED INSTEAD. In a country whose flora has gone largely unsurveyed for years, that is the provision to use — and it turns botanical documentation into the first step of a funding application. KNOW THE DEFINITION BEFORE YOU ARGUE: THE FUND TREATS A TREE AS A PLANT SPECIES PRESENTING A SINGLE TRUNK AT LEAST TWO METRES HIGH. A multi-stemmed shrub, however ancient and however threatened, is outside it. THE TERMS: PROJECTS MUST BE CONCRETE ON-THE-GROUND CONSERVATION ACTIONS, MAY RUN UP TO THREE YEARS, AND A RECENT REGIONAL CALL REQUIRED CO-FUNDING OF BETWEEN TWENTY AND FIFTY PER CENT — so identify a second contributor before applying; this file has recorded elsewhere that in-kind contributions and volunteer labour often count. APPLICANTS MUST BE ORGANISATIONS — INDIVIDUALS CANNOT APPLY — AND EACH ORGANISATION MAY SUBMIT ONLY ONE PROPOSAL, so a coalition must decide who holds the pen. ONE MORE THING SHAPES YOUR CHANCES: WHERE SEVERAL PROJECTS FALL IN THE SAME AREA THE FOUNDATION WANTS TO SEE CONCRETE COLLABORATION BETWEEN THE ORGANISATIONS WORKING THERE, ESPECIALLY THOSE IT ALREADY SUPPORTS. Find out who it funds nearby and approach them before you approach it. THE LIMITS: it is a species fund, not a land fund — IT WILL NOT BUY GROUND OR FIGHT A PERMIT, and a project must be justified by the tree rather than by the community. Its calls are regional and periodic rather than continuous, so the current call and its geography must be checked. And it expects scientific competence: projects are judged on being scientifically sound, feasible, reasonably costed and measurably effective, which realistically means partnering with botanists or a university.

trackers.name: Environmental associations and the new rules for constituting one — including the lighter 'team' form
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY'S LISTING HELD PROPERTY GUIDANCE, LEGAL AID, A COOPERATIVE VEHICLE AND A TREE FUND — AND NOT ONE ENVIRONMENTAL ORGANISATION SOMEONE COULD JOIN. THERE ARE AT LEAST TWO. THE FIRST PUBLISHES ITS ORGANISATIONAL STRUCTURE AND ITS STANDING COMMITTEES, AND RUNS ACTIVITIES, PROJECTS, WORKSHOPS, LECTURES AND AN ENVIRONMENTAL COMPETITION — the marks of a body that actually meets, rather than a name on a register. THE SECOND IS OLDER AND HEAVIER: AN INDEPENDENT, NON-GOVERNMENTAL, NON-PROFIT PUBLIC-BENEFIT ASSOCIATION FOUNDED IN 1992 BY A NAMED FOUNDER TOGETHER WITH ACADEMICS, EXPERTS AND SPECIALISTS IN ENVIRONMENT AND ENVIRONMENTAL DEVELOPMENT, concerned with protecting the environment and conserving natural resources, described as one of the leading environmental non-governmental organisations in the country and based in the capital. IT WORKS THROUGH PROJECTS AND AWARENESS WORK IN COOPERATION WITH OTHER BODIES — which is the phrase to use when approaching it, because a community with a site is offering it exactly that. AND THE GROUND HAS SHIFTED FOR ANYONE WANTING TO CONSTITUTE THEMSELVES. THE SOCIAL AFFAIRS AND LABOUR MINISTRY HAS SET OUT NEW CONDITIONS FOR FOUNDING NON-GOVERNMENTAL ORGANISATIONS — WHETHER AN ASSOCIATION, A FOUNDATION, OR A TEAM. NOTE THAT THIRD FORM. A TEAM IS A RECOGNISED VEHICLE, LIGHTER THAN AN ASSOCIATION, and for a group of neighbours who want to act together without building an institution it is the form to ask about first — this file has repeatedly found that unconstituted groups are locked out of funding and standing, and here is a recognised middle step. THE PROCEDURE HAS TWO PARTS THAT PEOPLE MISS. FIRST, ORGANISATIONS LICENSED UNDER THE PREVIOUS ARRANGEMENTS MUST APPLY FOR A TEMPORARY LICENCE RENEWAL with the required papers — SO AN OLD REGISTRATION IS NOT ENOUGH, and a community relying on a long-standing local association should check that it has renewed. SECOND, ONCE THE DECLARATION DECISION IS ISSUED THE BODY MAY BEGIN ACTIVITIES IMMEDIATELY, in coordination with the humanitarian coordination office and the social affairs and labour directorate in the governorate where it is based. AND THE REQUIREMENT THAT CATCHES ENVIRONMENTAL GROUPS: A SEPARATE LICENCE MUST BE OBTAINED FROM THE TECHNICAL BODY RESPONSIBLE FOR THE ACTIVITY — health for health work, education for education work. AN ENVIRONMENTAL GROUP THEREFORE NEEDS THE ENVIRONMENT AUTHORITY'S SIGN-OFF AS WELL AS THE SOCIAL AFFAIRS ONE, and finding that out at the start saves months. THE LIMITS: the older association dates from long before the present arrangements AND ITS CURRENT STATUS, LEADERSHIP AND ACTIVITY COULD NOT BE VERIFIED IN THIS ROUND — confirm both bodies are operating before relying on either. Registration rules in this country are in flux and were announced by a caretaker administration, so check the current requirements rather than these. AND NEITHER ORGANISATION IS RECORDED AS OPPOSING ANY DEVELOPMENT; they are scientific and awareness bodies. Read this with the property guidance and legal routes recorded separately here.

trackers.name: International Assistance from the World Heritage Fund — it has actually paid out for Syrian sites, including from the emergency window
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE FIRST RESOURCE RECORDED FOR SYRIA IN THIS MAP, AND IT IS RECORDED BECAUSE IT HAS ACTUALLY PAID OUT HERE. Two international assistance requests were approved on the World Heritage Committee's own record: one for the Ancient City of Bosra in December 2018 UNDER THE EMERGENCY WORLD HERITAGE FUND, and one for Crac des Chevaliers and Qal'at Salah El-Din in February 2019. Every other funding route this file examined for Syria was closed — the Mediterranean hotspot fund does not list the country, the small grants programme's country programme is recorded as closed in the funder's own manual, and the small grants foundation places Syria on its ineligible list. Those findings stand and all concern money for non-governmental applicants. THIS ONE RUNS THROUGH THE STATE PARTY AND IT HAS NOT CLOSED. UNDERSTAND WHAT THE DANGER LIST IS ACTUALLY FOR, BECAUSE IT IS ROUTINELY MISREAD AS A VERDICT. In the words of the decision that placed all six Syrian properties on it in 2013: THE DANGER LISTING IS INTENDED TO MOBILISE ALL POSSIBLE SUPPORT for the safeguarding of these properties. It is a mobilisation device with a defined route out, and this file records elsewhere that a property in the region was successfully removed from that list in 2019. All six Syrian properties — Damascus, Bosra, Palmyra, Aleppo, the two Crusader castles, and the Ancient Villages of Northern Syria — have been listed since 2013. WHAT ELSE HAS FLOWED THROUGH THIS CHANNEL, WHICH INDICATES WHAT CAN BE ASKED FOR: a technical assistance workshop convened at a UNESCO office in the region gave national restoration staff direct support on surveys, drawings and projects for three named properties; a bilateral funds-in-trust project of two hundred thousand euros for heritage protection was endorsed by the national authorities; and a regional community of heritage professionals from Syria and neighbouring countries was established to carry out ON-SITE DAMAGE ASSESSMENT when conditions allow. Technical support, emergency money, and damage assessment capacity are all things that have moved. THE LIMITS ARE SEVERE AND MUST BE STATED. Requests are made by the State Party, through its antiquities directorate — NOT BY COMMUNITIES, and not by organisations. A person in Syria cannot apply. What this entry offers is the knowledge that the channel exists, that it has functioned recently, and that the route in is the national authority responsible for the site. It also concerns designated World Heritage properties, so it reaches six places rather than the country's land generally. Nothing here should be read as suggesting that ordinary land defence resources exist in Syria; this file searched for them across five rounds and found none.

trackers.name: Syrians for Truth and Justice — it records what happened to the land, in the field
trackers.desc: IT DOCUMENTS HOUSING, LAND AND PROPERTY VIOLATIONS BY GOING AND ASKING. One of its reports rests on research running from MAY 2024 TO JULY 2025, with THIRTY-NINE INTERVIEWS across the seven sub-districts of a single area, conducted with direct victims and with relatives of victims, recording patterns that include the LOOTING OF PROPERTY. This file has said in almost every country that a community must document what is being done to it. Here is a body that does the documenting, in Arabic, on the ground, and publishes it. ITS OWN STATED RECOMMENDATION IS THE ONE A COMMUNITY SHOULD READ TWICE: ADEQUATE SUPPORT FOR RIGHTS ORGANISATIONS WORKING TO DOCUMENT VIOLATIONS AND TO PROVIDE LEGAL AWARENESS TO VICTIMS. That is an organisation asking for the resources to do exactly what people in a land dispute need, which also tells you what to ask it for: a record, and an explanation of rights. NOW THE PART TO ACT ON TODAY, WHOEVER YOU ARE. A returnee guidance platform for this country sets out what to collect and keep safely in order to prove ownership or use: TITLE DEEDS, SALE AND PURCHASE CONTRACTS, UTILITY BILLS, PROPERTY TAX RECEIPTS, COURT JUDGMENTS, WITNESS STATEMENTS, PHOTOGRAPHS OF THE PROPERTY, MAPS OR SITE DRAWINGS, AND CERTIFICATES FROM COMPETENT AUTHORITIES. Utility bills and tax receipts are the items people throw away and the ones that prove continuous use when a deed is lost. Photograph the property now, dated, from fixed points. AND THE WARNING THAT MUST TRAVEL WITH ALL OF THIS: RETURNEES HAVE FOUND THEIR PROPERTY SOLD OR SEIZED UNDER FORGED CONTRACTS OR UNDER SECURITY PRESSURE DURING THEIR ABSENCE, BY NETWORKS OF BROKERS, REAL ESTATE OFFICE OWNERS AND SOMETIMES LAWYERS. This map tells people to find a lawyer in twenty-three countries. In this one it must also tell them to CHECK the lawyer — against the bar's roll, through the syndicate branch recorded separately here, and by asking who else they act for. THE LIMITS: this is a documentation and advocacy organisation, not a legal representative and not a claims service. Its work concerns violations in contested areas rather than planning or development schemes, and a report is evidence rather than a remedy. Use it to get the violation recorded and the pattern published; use the bar's judicial aid committee and the endowment rules recorded separately for this country to act on it.

trackers.name: Cadastral affairs directorate — the property register, and the law for reconstituting records that were destroyed
trackers.desc: FOR A FAMILY RETURNING TO A HOUSE OR A FIELD HERE, THE FIRST QUESTION IS WHETHER THE RECORD OF IT STILL EXISTS. THERE IS A STATUTE FOR EXACTLY THAT CASE: A 2017 LAW REGULATING THE RECONSTITUTION OF A PROPERTY DOCUMENT THAT IS LOST OR PARTLY OR WHOLLY DAMAGED, PASSED BECAUSE PROPERTY DOCUMENTS IN SEVERAL DIRECTORATES HAD BEEN DAMAGED OR LOST AND THE LAND REGISTRY LAW DID NOT COVER SUCH CASES. A DESTROYED REGISTER IS NOT THE END OF A CLAIM HERE; IT IS A DEFINED ADMINISTRATIVE PROCEDURE WITH ITS OWN LAW. AND IT IS BEING APPLIED AREA BY NAMED AREA, WHICH MAKES IT A SPECIFIC QUESTION RATHER THAN A GENERAL HOPE: RECONSTITUTION OF DAMAGED AND LOST PROPERTY RECORDS HAS BEEN COMPLETED IN ALEPPO, DEIR EZ-ZOR, HOMS AND RURAL DAMASCUS; the property service is now OPEN for administratively reconstituted records in FOUR NAMED CADASTRAL AREAS, AND WORK IS UNDER WAY ON THREE MORE. ASK WHETHER YOUR CADASTRAL AREA HAS BEEN RECONSTITUTED, AND IF NOT, WHEN IT IS SCHEDULED. THE DIRECTORATE IS LARGE AND LOCAL: 63 LAND REGISTRY DEPARTMENTS ACROSS THE GOVERNORATES, 126 REAL-ESTATE DOCUMENTATION OFFICES AND 14 SURVEY DEPARTMENTS, with a published street address in the capital. THE DOCUMENTATION OFFICE IS USUALLY NEARER THAN THE REGISTRY, AND IT IS WHERE CONTRACTS ARE ATTESTED. ONE FIGURE MATTERS MORE THAN ANY OTHER FOR ANYONE WATCHING LAND CHANGE HANDS: DOCUMENTATION OF OWNERSHIP-TRANSFER CONTRACTS RESUMED FROM THE EIGHTH MONTH OF 2025, AND MORE THAN 240,000 PROPERTY CONTRACTS WERE COMPLETED IN THE YEAR, WITHIN OVER A MILLION PROPERTY SERVICES. TRANSFERS ARE BEING REGISTERED AGAIN AT SCALE — WHICH IS PRECISELY THE PERIOD IN WHICH ABSENT OWNERS LOSE GROUND ON PAPER. Check what is recorded against your parcel now, not when you return. THE SYSTEM IS ALSO DIGITISING: AN ELECTRONIC PLATFORM AND APPLICATION FOR THE PROPERTY REGISTRATION RECORD ALREADY SERVES DAMASCUS, DARAA AND QUNEITRA AMONG OTHERS, and an archiving project is taking CONTRACTS FIRST AND THEN THE REGISTER ITSELF over six to seven months in the capital, with stated aims of efficiency, lower cost, TRANSPARENCY AND ACCOUNTABILITY. A RECORD OBTAINABLE REMOTELY MATTERS ENORMOUSLY TO PEOPLE WHO CANNOT SAFELY TRAVEL TO THEIR OWN DISTRICT — ask which governorates the application covers now. THE SURVEY BACKGROUND IS WORTH KNOWING TOO: DETERMINATION AND DELIMITATION OF MORE THAN TEN MILLION HECTARES ACROSS ALL GOVERNORATES IS REPORTED AT 99.61 PER CENT COMPLETE, and the reconstitution work is supported by international partnerships supplying equipment, SOLAR POWER SYSTEMS AND STAFF TRAINING. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE SERIOUS. THIS IS THE REGISTRAR, NOT AN ADVOCATE: it records rights and will not adjudicate a competing claim, which is court work. RECONSTITUTION IS ADMINISTRATIVE, AND AN ADMINISTRATIVE RECONSTITUTION CARRIED OUT WHILE OWNERS WERE DISPLACED CAN ENTRENCH A WRONG ENTRY — which is why checking your own area's record now matters more than the procedure existing at all. Fees, current coverage of the application and the position in areas outside the directorate's operational reach were not verified. Read it with the property guidance for returning owners and the legal offices recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Environmental protection law and the responsible ministry — and the review of that law happening now
trackers.desc: THE TIMING IS THE WHOLE REASON THIS ENTRY EXISTS. THE COUNTRY'S ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION LAW — NUMBER 12 OF 2012 — IS BEING STUDIED AND REVIEWED RIGHT NOW BY THE MINISTRY OF LOCAL ADMINISTRATION AND ENVIRONMENT, EXPRESSLY TO KEEP PACE WITH SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT, AND IN THE SAME BREATH AS RECONSTRUCTION AND INVESTMENT PROJECTS. THE ENVIRONMENTAL LAW IS BEING REWRITTEN AT PRECISELY THE MOMENT RECONSTRUCTION INVESTMENT IS BEING SOUGHT. WHATEVER ASSESSMENT AND PUBLIC-PARTICIPATION DUTIES SURVIVE INTO THE REVISED TEXT WILL GOVERN THE NEXT DECADE OF BUILDING IN THIS COUNTRY — and revisions made to attract investment do not usually strengthen those duties unless someone asks. SO THE ACTION IS NOW AND IT IS SPECIFIC: ASK THE MINISTRY WHO IS CONDUCTING THE REVIEW, WHETHER THERE IS A CONSULTATION ON THE DRAFT, AND WHETHER WRITTEN SUBMISSIONS ARE BEING RECEIVED. This file has recorded elsewhere that professional bodies and umbrellas commission their own draft text and arrive with it rather than with a complaint; a country rewriting its environmental law is the one moment when that costs least and achieves most. WHAT TO ASK FOR BY NAME, BECAUSE STATUTES ACROSS THIS REGION SHARE A COMMON SHAPE AND THESE ARE THE PROVISIONS THAT MATTER: A PROHIBITION ON BEGINNING ANY PROJECT, MAKING ANY MODIFICATION OR EXPANSION TO AN EXISTING ACTIVITY, OR OBTAINING ANY LICENCE FOR IT, UNTIL THE ASSESSMENT STUDY HAS BEEN DONE. A REQUIREMENT THAT CONSULTANCIES, CENTRES AND LABORATORIES HOLD THE AUTHORITY'S APPROVAL BEFORE PRACTISING ANY ENVIRONMENTAL WORK OR CONSULTANCY. A SEPARATE ENVIRONMENTAL AUDIT, CARRIED OUT BY SPECIALISED OFFICES, TO IDENTIFY GAPS IN A FACILITY'S COMPLIANCE SYSTEM. AND A DISTINCTION BETWEEN THE LICENCE TO ESTABLISH AND OPERATE AND A SEPARATE PERMIT TO ACTUALLY BEGIN OPERATING ONCE THE LICENCE CONDITIONS ARE MET. EACH OF THOSE FOUR IS A LEVER THIS FILE HAS SEEN USED IN NEIGHBOURING COUNTRIES: THE MODIFICATION CLAUSE CATCHES QUIET EXPANSION, THE CONSULTANT APPROVAL MAKES A STUDY'S AUTHOR CHALLENGEABLE, THE AUDIT PRODUCES A COMPLIANCE RECORD, AND THE SEPARATE OPERATING PERMIT CREATES A SECOND DECISION POINT AFTER A BUILDING EXISTS. NOW THE HONEST PART, AND IT IS SUBSTANTIAL. THE PROCEDURAL DETAIL OF THIS COUNTRY'S OWN ASSESSMENT SYSTEM DID NOT SURFACE: WHICH PROJECTS REQUIRE A STUDY, WHO REVIEWS IT, WHETHER STUDIES ARE PUBLISHED, AND WHETHER THE PUBLIC MAY OBJECT ARE ALL UNKNOWN TO THIS FILE. A COMMUNITY SHOULD ASSUME NOTHING AND ASK THE MINISTRY DIRECTLY FOR THE IMPLEMENTING REGULATION AND THE LIST OF ACTIVITIES REQUIRING ASSESSMENT. THE OTHER LIMITS: institutions here are divided and the ministry's reach varies by area; a law under review is a law in flux, so anything learned today may change; and this entry rests on state reporting of a ministerial review rather than on the implementing rules themselves. Read it with the cadastral directorate, the environmental associations and the legal offices recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Tender aggregators — construction and restoration contracts listed by governorate, in a country with no reachable state portal
