WHAT EXISTS INSTEAD IS PRIVATE AGGREGATION: PLATFORMS COLLECTING TENDER ANNOUNCEMENTS FROM GOVERNMENT BODIES, INTERNATIONAL ORGANISATIONS AND THE PRIVATE SECTOR INTO ONE PLACE. ONE OF THEM STATES THAT IT CARRIES MORE THAN A THOUSAND TENDERS, THAT EVERY ANNOUNCEMENT IS REVIEWED BEFORE PUBLICATION, THAT ALERTS ARE AVAILABLE FOR NEW OPPORTUNITIES, AND THAT EACH BID SHOWS A CLEAR CLOSING DATE. AND IT BREAKS THEM DOWN THE TWO WAYS A COMMUNITY ACTUALLY NEEDS. BY SECTOR: CONSTRUCTION AND CIVIL CONTRACTING, WATER AND SANITATION EQUIPMENT, AND RESTORATION AND REHABILITATION SERVICES EACH HAVE THEIR OWN CATEGORY WITH DOZENS OR HUNDREDS OF LISTINGS. AND BY GOVERNORATE — ALL THIRTEEN, FROM DAMASCUS AND ALEPPO TO RAQQA, HASAKAH, SUWAYDA AND QUNEITRA. SO SOMEONE IN A GIVEN GOVERNORATE CAN SEE THE CONSTRUCTION AND RESTORATION WORK BEING TENDERED IN THEIR OWN PROVINCE, WITH CLOSING DATES. IN A COUNTRY WHERE RECONSTRUCTION MONEY IS ARRIVING FASTER THAN INSTITUTIONS ARE REBUILDING, THAT IS THE EARLIEST PUBLIC SIGN OF WHAT WILL BE BUILT AND WHERE. THE RESTORATION AND REHABILITATION CATEGORY DESERVES PARTICULAR ATTENTION HERE: THIS FILE RECORDED SEPARATELY THAT THE COUNTRY'S ENVIRONMENTAL LAW IS BEING REWRITTEN ALONGSIDE RECONSTRUCTION INVESTMENT. THE TENDERS IN THAT CATEGORY ARE THE PHYSICAL EXPRESSION OF THAT SAME MONEY, AND THEY NAME THE SITES. A SECOND PLATFORM PRESENTS ITSELF AS A UNIFIED CHANNEL FOR GOVERNMENT TENDER ANNOUNCEMENTS FROM MINISTRIES, GOVERNORATES AND ORGANISATIONS, PUBLISHED DAILY, WITH ACCOUNTS FOR COMPANIES, A ROUTE FOR PUBLIC BODIES TO PUBLISH, AND REPORTS AND STATISTICS ON TENDER ACTIVITY — so where one platform's coverage is thin, the other can be checked against it. USE TWO SOURCES, NOT ONE. WHERE AGGREGATION IS PRIVATE, COVERAGE IS A COMMERCIAL CHOICE RATHER THAN A DUTY, AND THE ONLY WAY TO ESTIMATE WHAT IS MISSING IS TO COMPARE. NOW THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE THE POINT OF THIS ENTRY AS MUCH AS THE PLATFORMS ARE. THESE ARE COMMERCIAL SERVICES, NOT OFFICIAL REGISTERS: THEIR COVERAGE, ACCURACY AND COMPLETENESS ARE THEIR OWN CLAIMS, NOT VERIFIED HERE, AND SOME FEATURES MAY REQUIRE PAID ACCOUNTS. NO STATE PROCUREMENT PORTAL SURFACED FOR THIS COUNTRY, so nothing here can be treated as the authoritative record, and a tender absent from these platforms has not necessarily been absent from the world. Institutions and control differ between areas of the country. Read it with the environment ministry review, the cadastral directorate and the associations route recorded separately here.

trackers.name: Agriculture ministry channel and the cooperative layer — where proposed rural projects are named, and the bodies farmers belong to
trackers.desc: THIS FILE RECORDED THAT NO STATE PROCUREMENT PORTAL COULD BE REACHED FOR THIS COUNTRY, AND THAT TENDERS HAVE TO BE READ THROUGH PRIVATE AGGREGATORS. THERE IS ONE MORE PLACE WHERE PLANNED WORK BECOMES VISIBLE, AND IT IS ORDINARY: THE AGRICULTURE MINISTRY'S OWN HEAVILY FOLLOWED PUBLIC PAGE. ON IT, AMONG ROUTINE MATERIAL, A DELEGATION OF AN INTERNATIONAL HUMANITARIAN COMMITTEE IS RECORDED DISCUSSING PROPOSED AGRICULTURAL PROJECTS IN A NAMED RURAL DISTRICT. PROPOSED PROJECTS, DISCUSSED IN PUBLIC, WITH THE DISTRICT NAMED — THAT IS AN EARLY WARNING AND A LIST OF WHO IS FUNDING WHAT, POSTED BY THE MINISTRY ITSELF. SO WATCH THE MINISTRY'S PAGE THE WAY YOU WOULD WATCH A TENDER FEED. THIS FILE HAS NOW FOUND IN FIVE COUNTRIES THAT WHERE OFFICIAL SITES ARE UNREACHABLE OR EMPTY, THE MAINTAINED PUBLIC PAGE IS THE WORKING RECORD — and here it names both the district and the visiting funder, which is more than most tender notices do. BEHIND IT SITS THE OLDER STRUCTURE A FARMER BELONGS TO: A GENERAL UNION OF PEASANTS, DESCRIBED AS A POPULAR SYNDICAL AND ECONOMIC ORGANISATION WORKING IN BOTH AGRICULTURAL SYNDICALISM AND AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTION, ABOVE A LAYER OF AGRICULTURAL COOPERATIVE SOCIETIES. ITS ORIGIN IS THE PART WORTH CARRYING ANYWHERE. ORGANISING BEGAN IN 1943 WHEN THE FARMERS OF ONE VILLAGE IN THE COUNTRYSIDE OF THE CAPITAL CAME TOGETHER OUT OF THE NEED TO SECURE DRINKING WATER AND IRRIGATION FOR THEIR LAND, AND FOUNDED THE COUNTRY'S FIRST AGRICULTURAL COOPERATIVE SOCIETY. WATER WAS THE ORGANISING QUESTION — NOT POLITICS, NOT PRICES. THIS PAYLOAD HAS NOW RECORDED WATER AS THE FOUNDING GRIEVANCE OF FARMER ORGANISATION IN FOUR SEPARATE COUNTRIES, AND IT IS STILL THE THING THAT WILL BRING NEIGHBOURS TO A MEETING WHEN NOTHING ELSE WILL. START THERE. NOW THE CAVEAT, AND IT IS HEAVIER THAN USUAL. THE UNION IS AN INSTITUTION OF THE FORMER POLITICAL ORDER. WHETHER IT, ITS COOPERATIVE SOCIETIES AND THEIR MEMBERSHIP CONTINUE TO FUNCTION AFTER THE CHANGE OF GOVERNMENT WAS NOT VERIFIED, AND ITS DESCRIPTION HERE COMES FROM AN ENCYCLOPEDIA ENTRY RATHER THAN A LIVE ORGANISATION. TREAT THE COOPERATIVE LAYER AS SOMETHING TO ASK ABOUT LOCALLY — WHETHER THE VILLAGE SOCIETY STILL MEETS, WHO HOLDS ITS RECORDS, AND WHETHER IT IS BEING RECONSTITUTED — RATHER THAN AS A STANDING BODY TO JOIN. THE OTHER LIMITS: a ministry page is a broadcast channel, NOT A CONSULTATION — nothing on it creates any right to object, and what is posted is chosen by the ministry. Institutions and control differ between areas of the country, and the environmental law is being rewritten alongside reconstruction investment, as recorded separately here. Read it with the tender aggregators, the environment ministry review and the cadastral directorate recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Environmental studies laboratory — a mobile air-monitoring vehicle, stack emissions testing, and accreditation being sought
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HAS RECORDED POLLUTION COMPLAINTS FAILING FOR WANT OF MEASUREMENT IN A DOZEN COUNTRIES. THE MOST POWERFUL INSTRUMENT RECORDED ANYWHERE IN IT IS HERE, IN THE COUNTRY WITH THE LEAST OF EVERYTHING ELSE: AN AIR POLLUTION LABORATORY CONTAINING A MOBILE VEHICLE FOR CONTINUOUS MONITORING. A VEHICLE THAT CAN BE PARKED BESIDE A SOURCE AND LEFT RUNNING PRODUCES SOMETHING NO SINGLE SAMPLE CAN: A CONTINUOUS RECORD OVER HOURS AND DAYS, INCLUDING THE NIGHTS AND WEEKENDS WHEN OPERATORS BEHAVE DIFFERENTLY. THAT IS WHAT ANSWERS THE STANDARD DEFENCE THAT AN EXCEEDANCE WAS A ONE-OFF. THE LABORATORY'S PUBLISHED WORK COVERS FOUR THINGS BEYOND AIR. DETERMINING A WIDE SPECTRUM OF POLLUTANTS IN SURFACE WATER, GROUNDWATER AND THE MARINE ENVIRONMENT. DETERMINING POLLUTANTS IN STACK EMISSIONS, IN INDUSTRIAL WASTEWATER AND IN INDUSTRIAL SOLID WASTE. ANALYSING RESIDUAL POLLUTANTS SUCH AS HEAVY METALS AND CHLORINATED PESTICIDES IN SEWAGE SLUDGE AND MUNICIPAL SOLID WASTE. AND QUALIFYING ITS OWN LABORATORIES FOR ACCREDITATION UNDER THE INTERNATIONAL STANDARD FOR TESTING AND CALIBRATION LABORATORIES. STACK EMISSIONS BEING NAMED IS UNUSUAL AND WORTH USING. MOST LABORATORIES TEST WATER, BECAUSE WATER CAN BE COLLECTED IN A BOTTLE BY ANYONE; TESTING WHAT LEAVES A CHIMNEY REQUIRES DIFFERENT EQUIPMENT AND PHYSICAL ACCESS TO THE STACK. WHERE A FACTORY OR AN INCINERATOR IS THE PROBLEM, ASK SPECIFICALLY WHETHER A LABORATORY DOES STACK WORK — MOST DO NOT. SEWAGE SLUDGE AND MUNICIPAL SOLID WASTE ARE ALSO NAMED, WITH HEAVY METALS AND CHLORINATED PESTICIDES AS THE ANALYTES. THAT IS EXACTLY THE TESTING NEEDED WHERE SLUDGE IS SPREAD ON FARMLAND OR WHERE A DUMP IS PROPOSED NEXT TO FIELDS — AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED SLUDGE-TO-LAND AS A RECURRING THREAT. AND ACCREDITATION IS THE POINT THAT MATTERS MOST FOR EVIDENCE. THE PREVIOUS ROUND FLAGGED, FOR A NEIGHBOURING COUNTRY, THAT WHETHER A LABORATORY HOLDS ACCREDITATION MAY MATTER MORE THAN ITS EQUIPMENT. HERE ACCREDITATION UNDER THE INTERNATIONAL TESTING STANDARD IS NAMED AS SOMETHING THE INSTITUTE IS WORKING TOWARDS — SO ASK WHICH SPECIFIC TESTS ARE ACCREDITED AND WHICH ARE NOT, BECAUSE ACCREDITATION IS ALWAYS PER-METHOD, NEVER BLANKET. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE SUBSTANTIAL. THIS IS A STATE HIGHER INSTITUTE, NOT A PUBLIC TESTING SERVICE: WHETHER IT ACCEPTS SAMPLES OR MONITORING REQUESTS FROM COMMUNITIES, ASSOCIATIONS OR MUNICIPALITIES, AND AT WHAT COST, WAS NOT ESTABLISHED, and a request to monitor a state-linked facility may not be welcome. THE DESCRIPTION COMES FROM THE INSTITUTE'S OWN LABORATORY PAGE; whether the mobile vehicle and each capability are currently operational after years of conflict WAS NOT VERIFIED. Institutions and control differ between areas of the country. Read it with the environment ministry review, the tender aggregators and the agriculture ministry channel recorded separately for this country.

AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED IN SIX COUNTRIES THAT PLANTING IS THE SAFEST PHYSICAL ACT AVAILABLE, WHICH MATTERS MORE HERE THAN ANYWHERE. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE SEVERE. THIS IS A STATE STRUCTURE IN A COUNTRY IN TRANSITION AND STILL IN CONFLICT: INSTITUTIONS, CONTROL AND PERSONNEL DIFFER BETWEEN AREAS AND ARE CHANGING, AND A DIRECTORATE'S REACH IN ONE GOVERNORATE SAYS NOTHING ABOUT ANOTHER. trackers.name: Bar association and its branches — functioning in 2026, and the judicial mediation route it is helping build

trackers.name: New farming cooperatives and water users' associations — plus soft financing for irrigation and a loan repayment extension

THE SAME IS HAPPENING WITH WATER: TWENTY-NINE WATER USERS' ASSOCIATIONS WERE FORMED IN ONE COASTAL GOVERNORATE, EXPRESSLY TO ACHIEVE JUSTICE IN WATER DISTRIBUTION. JUSTICE IN DISTRIBUTION IS THE PHRASE TO REPEAT. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED THE SAME FORMULA IN THREE OTHER COUNTRIES AS THE ONE THAT MOVES AN AUTHORITY — A TAIL-END VILLAGE SAYING ITS SHARE DOES NOT ARRIVE IS INVOKING THE STATED PURPOSE OF THE ASSOCIATION ITSELF, NOT COMPLAINING ABOUT A NEIGHBOUR. ON MONEY, THREE THINGS WERE UNDER GOVERNMENT DISCUSSION IN AUGUST 2026 AND ARE WORTH ASKING ABOUT BY NAME. THE REPAYMENT DEADLINE FOR DEFAULTED AGRICULTURAL LOANS WAS TO BE EXTENDED BY THREE MONTHS UNDER A DECREE OF THIS YEAR. SOFT FINANCING WAS TO BE EXPANDED FOR MODERN IRRIGATION, SOLAR ENERGY AND AGRICULTURAL MACHINERY PROJECTS. AND THE CREATION OF AN AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT FUND WAS UNDER CONSIDERATION ALONGSIDE A REVIEW OF THE EXISTING NATIONAL FUNDS. A DEFAULTED LOAN IS WHY MANY FAMILIES CANNOT BORROW AGAIN, AND AN EXTENSION IS THE CHEAPEST RELIEF A GOVERNMENT EVER GRANTS. IF YOUR HOUSEHOLD OR YOUR COOPERATIVE IS IN ARREARS, ASK THE AGRICULTURAL LENDER WHETHER THE EXTENSION APPLIES TO YOU AND GET THE ANSWER IN WRITING — EXTENSIONS ARE ANNOUNCED CENTRALLY AND APPLIED UNEVENLY. SOLAR ENERGY SITTING INSIDE AGRICULTURAL SOFT FINANCING IS THE DETAIL TO ACT ON. WHERE THE GRID IS BROKEN AND FUEL IS SCARCE, A SOLAR PUMP IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN AN IRRIGATED FIELD AND AN ABANDONED ONE — AND IT IS FINANCED HERE AS AGRICULTURE RATHER THAN AS ENERGY. THE RECOVERY MEASURES ALREADY RUNNING NAME WHAT CAN BE REQUESTED: REHABILITATION OF MAIN IRRIGATION CANALS, DISTRIBUTION OF SUBSIDISED SEED AND FERTILISER, AND TRAINING IN DROUGHT-RESISTANT FARMING TECHNIQUES — WITH AGREEMENTS WITH AN INTERNATIONAL FOOD AGENCY RUNNING TO THE END OF 2026 TO REHABILITATE THOUSANDS OF HECTARES OF AGRICULTURAL LAND AND RAISE THE PRODUCTIVITY OF IRRIGATED AREAS. AN AGREEMENT WITH AN END DATE IS A DEADLINE FOR ASKING. WORK PROMISED UNDER A PROGRAMME THAT EXPIRES AT THE END OF THE YEAR IS BEING ALLOCATED NOW — SO A VILLAGE WANTING ITS CANAL OR ITS HECTARES INCLUDED SHOULD APPLY WHILE THE MONEY IS STILL BEING SPENT, NOT WHEN THE RESULTS ARE ANNOUNCED. THE LIMITS: this is A STATE AND UNION STRUCTURE IN A COUNTRY IN TRANSITION — INSTITUTIONS DIFFER BETWEEN AREAS OF CONTROL AND ARE BEING REBUILT, AND THE UNION'S COOPERATIVE COUNT IS ITS OWN CLAIM REPORTED THROUGH THE STATE AGENCY. THE FINANCE MEASURES WERE UNDER DISCUSSION BETWEEN TWO MINISTRIES RATHER THAN CONFIRMED AS DELIVERED, AND WHETHER THE LOAN EXTENSION AND SOFT FINANCING ARE ACTUALLY AVAILABLE, TO WHOM AND THROUGH WHICH BANK WAS NOT VERIFIED. Read it with the governorate environment directorates, the bar and its mediation work, the environmental studies laboratory and the tender aggregators recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Agricultural cooperative bank — what it accepts as security, one farmers' organisation guaranteeing another, and lending given in kind
trackers.desc: SECURITY IS WHERE FARM LENDING STOPS, SO START WITH WHAT THIS BANK ACCEPTS: IN-KIND GUARANTEES, WHETHER REAL ESTATE OR NOT — MACHINERY AND EQUIPMENT COUNT — OR A BANK GUARANTEE, OR A PERSONAL SURETY. MACHINERY COUNTING AS SECURITY MATTERS IN A COUNTRY WHERE LAND TITLE IS DAMAGED, CONTESTED OR SIMPLY MISSING. A TRACTOR OR A PUMP CAN SECURE A LOAN THAT A DISPUTED DEED CANNOT — AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED REPEATEDLY THAT WAR AND DISPLACEMENT LEAVE FAMILIES ASSET-RICH AND PAPER-POOR. THE RULE MOST WORTH KNOWING IS ABOUT ORGANISATIONS GUARANTEEING EACH OTHER: THE GUARANTEE OF THE HIGHER FARMERS' ORGANISATION IS ACCEPTED FOR THE LOWER FARMERS' ORGANISATION, ON THE SHORT-TERM LOANS IT NEEDS IN ITS CORPORATE CAPACITY, ACCORDING TO ITS PRODUCTION AND INVESTMENT PLAN AND ITS ESTIMATED BUDGET — WHATEVER THE AMOUNT OF THE LOAN. WHATEVER THE AMOUNT IS AN EXTRAORDINARY PHRASE TO FIND IN A LENDING RULE. IT MEANS A VILLAGE COOPERATIVE WITH NO COLLATERAL AT ALL CAN BORROW AGAINST THE STANDING OF THE FEDERATION ABOVE IT — SO THE PRACTICAL QUESTION IS NOT WHAT YOUR GROUP OWNS BUT WHETHER IT IS AFFILIATED, AND WHETHER THE BODY ABOVE IT WILL SIGN. AND IT PUTS A PRICE ON THE PRODUCTION PLAN: THE GUARANTEE FOLLOWS THE PLAN AND THE ESTIMATED BUDGET, SO A COOPERATIVE THAT KEEPS A REAL PLAN AND A REAL BUDGET IS BORROWABLE AND ONE THAT DOES NOT IS NOT. FOR AN INDIVIDUAL MEMBER THE CEILING IS STATED: A PERSONAL SURETY IS ACCEPTED FOR SHORT-TERM LOANS UP TO FIVE MILLION POUNDS, AND PREVIOUS OUTSTANDING BALANCES COUNT INSIDE THAT CEILING — SO CHECK WHAT YOU ALREADY OWE BEFORE ASKING, BECAUSE OLD DEBT REDUCES THE NEW LOAN RATHER THAN SITTING BESIDE IT. THE BANK'S OWN POLICY EXPLAINS WHY IT LENDS THE WAY IT DOES: IT FINANCES AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTION IN KIND WHEREVER POSSIBLE, WITH SUPERVISION BEFORE AND AFTER TO ENSURE LOANS ARE USED FOR THE PURPOSES GRANTED. IN-KIND LENDING MEANS SEED, FERTILISER OR EQUIPMENT RATHER THAN CASH. IN AN ECONOMY WITH A COLLAPSING CURRENCY THAT IS OFTEN BETTER FOR THE BORROWER THAN MONEY, BECAUSE THE VALUE CANNOT EVAPORATE BETWEEN DISBURSEMENT AND PLANTING — BUT IT ALSO MEANS THE BANK CHOOSES THE SUPPLIER, SO ASK WHAT IS SUPPLIED AND AT WHAT PRICE IT IS COSTED AGAINST THE LOAN. ITS STATED PURPOSE INCLUDES FULL SUPPORT TO THE COOPERATIVE SECTOR TO OVERCOME THE FRAGMENTATION OF AGRICULTURAL OWNERSHIP, SO THAT MECHANISATION AND THE ADVANTAGES OF LARGER PRODUCTION CAN BE USED — WHICH IS THE INSTITUTIONAL REASON A GROUP GETS BETTER TERMS THAN A HOUSEHOLD HERE. AND ITS SCOPE IS WIDER THAN FARMING: IT SERVES THE PROFESSIONS, CRAFTS, INDUSTRIES AND SERVICES CONNECTED TO AGRICULTURE OR ITS PRODUCTS. A MILL, A PRESS, A DRYING SHED OR A WORKSHOP REPAIRING FARM EQUIPMENT IS INSIDE ITS REMIT. ON NEW MONEY: MINISTERS AGREED IN 2026 TO STRENGTHEN THE BANK'S ROLE THROUGH CONCESSIONAL LOANS FOR MODERN IRRIGATION TECHNIQUES, THE PURCHASE OF AGRICULTURAL MACHINERY AND SOLAR ENERGY PROJECTS, THROUGH A DEDICATED FACILITY IN WHICH SEVERAL FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS PARTICIPATE — ASK THE BRANCH WHETHER THAT FACILITY HAS OPENED AND UNDER WHAT NAME. THE LIMITS: this is CREDIT IN A COUNTRY WHERE INSTITUTIONS ARE DIVIDED BETWEEN AUTHORITIES AND BEING REBUILT — WHICH BRANCHES OPERATE WHERE A COMMUNITY LIVES IS THE FIRST THING TO ESTABLISH, and the bank's own tender notices show branch buildings and warehouses still being rehabilitated. THE GUARANTEE RULES AND THE FIVE MILLION CEILING COME FROM THE BANK'S PUBLISHED SERVICE PAGE AND MAY PREDATE THE CURRENCY'S COLLAPSE, so the ceiling may be worth far less than it appears; the 2026 facility was AGREED BETWEEN MINISTERS RATHER THAN CONFIRMED AS OPERATING. Debt must be repaid, and this payload has recorded defaulted agricultural loans locking families out of later borrowing. Read it with the new cooperatives and water users' associations, the bar and its mediation work, the governorate environment directorates and the tender aggregators recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Cadastral directorate — it fixes ownership during delimitation, and hears objections while rights are being created
trackers.desc: IN A COUNTRY WHERE MILLIONS WERE DISPLACED AND RECORDS WERE DESTROYED, THE MOST CONSEQUENTIAL THING HAPPENING TO LAND IS NOT A DEVELOPMENT BUT A PROCESS: THE CADASTRAL SURVEY AND THE FIXING OF OWNERSHIP FOR LANDS SUBJECT TO DELIMITATION AND LIBERATION WORKS, TOGETHER WITH THE ORGANISATION OF THEIR MAPS. WHEN THAT PROCESS REACHES A VILLAGE, WHAT IS WRITTEN INTO THE REGISTER BECOMES THE TRUTH FOR A GENERATION. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED ACROSS THE REGION THAT REGISTERS OUTLIVE ARGUMENTS — SO THE WEEKS WHEN A SURVEY TEAM IS WORKING ARE WORTH MORE THAN YEARS OF COMPLAINT AFTERWARDS. AND THE DIRECTORATE'S OWN FUNCTIONS INCLUDE THE OPENING: IT ADJUDICATES LAWSUITS AND OBJECTIONS ON THE CREATION OF OWNERSHIP AND REAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. OBJECTIONS ARE THEREFORE PART OF THE PROCEDURE, NOT AN INTERRUPTION OF IT. A FAMILY THAT BELIEVES A NEIGHBOUR, AN ABSENTEE CLAIMANT OR AN INSTITUTION IS BEING RECORDED OVER ITS GROUND SHOULD LODGE THE OBJECTION WHILE THE RIGHTS ARE BEING CREATED — THAT IS THE CHEAPEST MOMENT THERE WILL EVER BE. THE BODY SITS UNDER THE MINISTRY OF LOCAL ADMINISTRATION AND ENVIRONMENT, AND ITS STATED MISSION IS FIXING AND DOCUMENTING REAL PROPERTY OWNERSHIP, PROVIDING ADVANCED CADASTRAL SERVICES AND ESTABLISHING A NATIONAL CADASTRAL INFORMATION SYSTEM. IT EVEN DEFINES ITS OWN TERM: CADASTRAL MEANS A REGISTRATION SYSTEM BASED ON REGISTERS AND OWNERSHIP MAPS SHOWING THE RIGHTS IN REM OVER LAND. THAT PHRASE — REGISTERS AND MAPS TOGETHER — IS THE PRACTICAL POINT: A NAME IN A REGISTER WITHOUT A MAP, OR A MAP WITHOUT A NAME, IS HALF A RIGHT. SO ASK FOR BOTH WHEN YOU ATTEND: THE REGISTER ENTRY AND THE OWNERSHIP MAP FOR THE PARCEL. THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED IN OTHER COUNTRIES THAT FAMILIES HOLD ONE AND ASSUME THEY HOLD THE OTHER, AND DISCOVER THE GAP ONLY WHEN A BOUNDARY IS DISPUTED. THE GENERAL DIRECTORATE HAS ALSO ANNOUNCED A SERVICE FOR PROVIDING REAL ESTATE DATA ELECTRONICALLY — WHICH MATTERS ENORMOUSLY FOR THE DISPLACED, BECAUSE IT IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A CLAIM THAT REQUIRES TRAVELLING BACK TO A DIRECTORATE AND ONE THAT CAN BEGIN FROM WHEREVER A FAMILY NOW LIVES. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE HEAVY: THIS IS A STATE CADASTRAL AUTHORITY IN A COUNTRY EMERGING FROM WAR, WHERE DISPLACEMENT, DESTROYED AND ALTERED RECORDS, ABSENTEE OWNERS, WARTIME TRANSFERS AND CONTESTED CONFISCATIONS MAKE OWNERSHIP THE MOST DANGEROUS SUBJECT THERE IS - AND THIS ENTRY RECORDS THE INSTITUTION, NOT A JUDGEMENT ABOUT ANY CLAIM. WHICH AREAS ARE UNDER DELIMITATION, WHETHER THE DISPLACED CAN OBJECT REMOTELY OR THROUGH A REPRESENTATIVE, AND WHAT DEADLINES APPLY WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED - those are the three questions to put before relying on this route. THE DESCRIPTION COMES FROM THE MINISTRY'S OWN INSTITUTIONAL PAGE AND AN OFFICIAL SOCIAL MEDIA ANNOUNCEMENT, NOT FROM PUBLISHED PROCEDURES OR CURRENT SCHEDULES, and institutions in this country are being restructured. NOTE ALSO THAT THIS MINISTRY'S PORTAL ALREADY CARRIES ANOTHER ENTRY IN THIS PAYLOAD - THE GOVERNORATE ENVIRONMENT DIRECTORATES - SO TWO DIFFERENT INSTITUTIONS HERE REST ON ONE OFFICIAL SOURCE, AND IF THAT PORTAL GOES DOWN OR IS RESTRUCTURED BOTH ENTRIES LOSE THEIR ANCHOR. Read it with the agricultural cooperative bank's guarantee rules, the new cooperatives and water users' associations, the bar association and the governorate environment directorates recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Antiquities authority and the planning-approval rule — a plan cannot be approved, or later amended, without its consent
trackers.desc: THIS IS THE THIRD COUNTRY IN THREE ROUNDS WHERE THE ANTIQUITIES LAW, NOT THE ENVIRONMENTAL LAW, HOLDS THE STRONGEST GRIP ON A DEVELOPMENT PLAN. HERE THE RULE IS THAT ARCHAEOLOGICAL AREAS AND BUILDINGS MUST BE PRESERVED WHEN CITY AND VILLAGE PLANNING PROJECTS ARE DRAWN UP, AND THAT SUCH PROJECTS MAY NOT BE APPROVED BEFORE THE ANTIQUITIES AUTHORITIES' APPROVAL IS OBTAINED. THE SECOND HALF OF THE SAME PROVISION IS THE ONE PEOPLE MISS, AND IT IS THE MORE USEFUL: THE PLANS MAY NOT BE AMENDED AFTER APPROVAL EXCEPT FOLLOWING THE ANTIQUITIES AUTHORITIES' APPROVAL. THAT CLOSES THE ROUTE BY WHICH A CLEAN PLAN BECOMES A DAMAGING ONE ONCE THE SCRUTINY HAS PASSED. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED THE SAME MANOEUVRE ACROSS THE REGION — A SCHEME APPROVED IN ONE SHAPE AND BUILT IN ANOTHER — AND HERE THE AMENDMENT ITSELF REQUIRES FRESH CONSENT. SO THERE ARE TWO QUESTIONS TO PUT IN WRITING ABOUT ANY PLAN AFFECTING OLD GROUND: WAS THE ANTIQUITIES AUTHORITIES' APPROVAL OBTAINED BEFORE THE PLAN WAS APPROVED, AND HAS THE PLAN BEEN AMENDED SINCE — AND IF SO, WAS FRESH APPROVAL OBTAINED FOR THE AMENDMENT. IN A COUNTRY REBUILDING AFTER WAR, THOSE QUESTIONS ARE NOT ACADEMIC. RECONSTRUCTION PLANS, ROAD WIDENINGS AND NEW SUBDIVISIONS ARE BEING DRAWN OVER SOME OF THE OLDEST INHABITED GROUND ON EARTH, AND THIS PAYLOAD HAS ALREADY RECORDED THAT OWNERSHIP HERE IS BEING FIXED THROUGH CADASTRAL DELIMITATION AT THE SAME TIME — THE TWO PROCESSES RUN TOGETHER AND SHOULD BE WATCHED TOGETHER. NOW THE CRITICISM, WHICH IS PUBLISHED AND SHOULD BE CARRIED WITH THE PROVISION RATHER THAN HIDDEN BEHIND IT: INDEPENDENT ANALYSIS OF THE SAME LAW ARGUES THAT IT DOES NOT OBLIGE THE STATE TO EXCAVATE OR TO ORGANISE SCIENTIFIC MISSIONS TO UNCOVER ANTIQUITIES, AND THAT MANY ARCHAEOLOGICAL FEATURES HAVE INSTEAD BEEN OBSCURED BY THE AUTHORITIES AND LEFT HIDDEN AND SUBMERGED. A LAW THAT PROTECTS WHAT IS REGISTERED, IN A SYSTEM THAT HAS REASONS NOT TO REGISTER, PROTECTS LESS THAN IT APPEARS TO. THAT IS WHY THE PRACTICAL STEP FOR A COMMUNITY IS TO CREATE ITS OWN RECORD FIRST — PHOTOGRAPH WHAT STANDS, DATE IT, NOTE WHERE IT IS — AND THEN ASK THE AUTHORITY WHETHER IT IS REGISTERED, BECAUSE THE QUESTION ITSELF PUTS THE FEATURE ON PAPER. THE SAME ANALYSIS MAKES AN ARGUMENT WORTH BORROWING WHEN WRITING TO ANY OFFICIAL: THAT THESE ANTIQUITIES ARE A NATIONAL AND HUMAN WEALTH AND A SUBSTANTIAL TOURISM AND ECONOMIC RESOURCE THAT WOULD REVIVE TOWNS AND VILLAGES — WHICH IS A CASE FOR PRESERVATION IN THE STATE'S OWN INTEREST RATHER THAN AGAINST IT. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE SERIOUS: THIS RECORDS A STATUTORY REQUIREMENT AND THE BODY BEHIND IT, NOT A FUNCTIONING SERVICE - THE COUNTRY IS IN TRANSITION, ITS INSTITUTIONS ARE BEING RESTRUCTURED, AND STRIKES AND CLASHES CONTINUED THROUGH 2026 INCLUDING NEAR A WORLD HERITAGE SITE. THE ANTIQUITIES DIRECTORATE IS A STATE BODY THAT WILL NOT OPPOSE A STATE RECONSTRUCTION PROJECT. THE PROVISION IS CITED FROM AN INDEPENDENT OUTLET'S SUMMARY OF THE LAW PUBLISHED SEVERAL YEARS AGO RATHER THAN FROM THE CURRENT STATUTE OR THE DIRECTORATE'S OWN PAGES, AND WHETHER THE LAW HAS BEEN AMENDED SINCE THE POLITICAL CHANGE WAS NOT ESTABLISHED - verify the current text and the current authority before relying on it. Read it with the cadastral directorate and its objection stage, the free legal aid partners and their cadastral document replacement, the agricultural cooperative bank and the governorate environment directorates recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Arab centre for arid zones research and the national agricultural policy centre — the technical expertise for an argument about soil, water and grazing
trackers.desc: THIS FILE RECORDS FOR THIS COUNTRY A CADASTRAL SYSTEM, AN ANTIQUITIES RULE AND FREE LEGAL OFFICES, BUT NO SOURCE OF AGRICULTURAL AND LAND SCIENCE — WHICH IS WHAT AN ARGUMENT ABOUT SOIL, WATER OR GRAZING ACTUALLY NEEDS. THE REGION'S OLDEST SUCH BODY IS HEADQUARTERED HERE: AN ARAB CENTRE FOR THE STUDIES OF ARID ZONES AND DRY LANDS, ESTABLISHED IN 1968 BY A DECISION OF THE ARAB LEAGUE. ITS PURPOSE IS STATED IN TERMS A COMMUNITY CAN USE: TO UNIFY NATIONAL EFFORTS TO DEVELOP AGRICULTURAL SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH IN ARID AND SEMI-ARID ZONES, AND TO EXCHANGE INFORMATION AND EXPERTISE SO THAT MODERN AGRICULTURAL TECHNIQUES CAN BE TRANSFERRED, DEVELOPED AND LOCALISED TO INCREASE PRODUCTION. EXCHANGE OF INFORMATION AND EXPERTISE IS THE PHRASE TO QUOTE. A REQUEST FOR PUBLISHED WORK ON A PARTICULAR RANGELAND, AQUIFER OR SOIL TYPE IS ASKING THE CENTRE TO DO WHAT IT WAS FOUNDED FOR, AND IT COSTS THEM NOTHING BUT AN EMAIL. IT ALSO WORKS THROUGH PROFESSIONAL BODIES RATHER THAN ONLY GOVERNMENTS: IN MARCH 2025 IT SIGNED A MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING AT ITS HEADQUARTERS WITH THIS COUNTRY'S AGRICULTURAL ENGINEERS' SYNDICATE, AIMED AT DEVELOPING ARAB AGRICULTURE GENERALLY AND THIS COUNTRY'S IN PARTICULAR, IN BOTH ITS PLANT AND ANIMAL BRANCHES, SIGNED BY THE CENTRE'S DIRECTOR GENERAL AND THE SYNDICATE HEAD. SO THE PRACTICAL ROUTE IS THE SAME ONE THIS FILE FOUND IN TWO NEIGHBOURING COUNTRIES: GO TO THE SYNDICATE, AND LET THE SYNDICATE'S EXISTING AGREEMENT CARRY THE QUESTION TO THE RESEARCH CENTRE. A VILLAGE WRITING COLD TO A REGIONAL INSTITUTE IS EASY TO IGNORE; A MEMBER ORGANISATION WITH A SIGNED MEMORANDUM IS NOT. THE SECOND BODY IS THE ONE THAT HOLDS NUMBERS RATHER THAN SCIENCE: A NATIONAL AGRICULTURAL POLICY CENTRE ESTABLISHED IN 2000 THROUGH A UNITED NATIONS FOOD AND AGRICULTURE PROJECT FUNDED BY A EUROPEAN GOVERNMENT, SITTING INSIDE THE AGRICULTURE AND AGRARIAN REFORM MINISTRY, WHICH HAS PUBLISHED A NATIONAL AGRICULTURE DATABASE AND PERIODICAL REPORTS. A NATIONAL AGRICULTURE DATABASE IS WHERE PRODUCTION, AREA AND CROPPING FIGURES LIVE. WHEN AN AUTHORITY CLAIMS GROUND IS UNPRODUCTIVE OR MARGINAL, THE STATE'S OWN PUBLISHED SERIES FOR THAT DISTRICT IS THE CHEAPEST CONTRADICTION AVAILABLE — AND THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED IDLE-LAND AND MARGINAL-LAND ARGUMENTS USED TO JUSTIFY TAKING GROUND IN FOUR COUNTRIES. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE SERIOUS IN THIS COUNTRY: BOTH BODIES ARE INSTITUTIONAL RATHER THAN COMMUNITY-FACING - THE REGIONAL CENTRE SERVES MEMBER STATES AND THEIR MINISTRIES, THE POLICY CENTRE SITS INSIDE A MINISTRY, AND NEITHER WILL TAKE A POSITION ON A PARTICULAR PROJECT OR ADVOCATE FOR A VILLAGE. THE COUNTRY HAS BEEN THROUGH WAR AND A CHANGE OF GOVERNMENT, AND WHETHER EITHER BODY IS CURRENTLY FUNCTIONING AT NORMAL CAPACITY, WHAT ITS PRESENT LEADERSHIP IS, AND WHETHER ITS PUBLICATIONS ARE BEING UPDATED WERE NOT ESTABLISHED - THE POLICY CENTRE'S DATABASE AND REPORTS ARE DESCRIBED FROM AN ENCYCLOPAEDIA ENTRY CITING ARCHIVED PAGES, WHICH IS WEAK SOURCING AND MAY DESCRIBE A DEFUNCT SERVICE. THE SYNDICATE MEMORANDUM DATES FROM MARCH 2025 AND WAS REPORTED BY A REGIONAL FEDERATION RATHER THAN BY EITHER PARTY DIRECTLY. Read it with the cadastral directorate and its objection stage, the antiquities planning rule, the free legal offices and their document replacement, and the governorate environment directorates recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Endowments ministry and its property inventory — the body rebuilding the register of endowed land from the Ottoman archive
trackers.desc: THIS COUNTRY HAD NO BODY RECORDED THAT HOLDS LAND OUT OF THE MARKET, AND IT HAS ONE OF THE LARGEST LANDHOLDERS IN THE REGION: AN ENDOWMENTS MINISTRY THAT HAS BEGUN AN INVENTORY OF WAQF PROPERTIES IN THE TWO LARGEST CITIES RELYING ON THE OTTOMAN ARCHIVE, REVIEWING HISTORICAL DOCUMENTS AND REGISTERS TO BUILD AN ACCURATE DATABASE OF THE COUNTRY'S ENDOWMENTS AND DETERMINE THEIR GEOGRAPHIC SCOPE AND NUMBERS ACROSS THE GOVERNORATES. RE-DOCUMENTING HISTORIC PROPERTY AFTER DECADES OF OVERLAP IN REGISTRATION AND ADMINISTRATION IS THE STATED PURPOSE, AND IT IS THE MOMENT THAT MATTERS. A REGISTER BEING REBUILT IS A REGISTER YOU CAN ASK TO BE INCLUDED IN, CORRECTED, OR SEARCHED FOR A PARTICULAR PLOT. THE SCALE OF WHAT IS BEING FOUND IS THE REASON TO ASK: THE COUNT IS NOT FIXED BUT CONTINUALLY RISING, WITH MORE THAN ELEVEN HUNDRED NEW ENDOWMENT PROPERTIES REGISTERED SINCE DECEMBER 2024 — SOME NEWLY BUILT AND NEWLY ENDOWED, AND SOME DISCOVERED PROPERTIES THAT EXISTED BEFORE. DISCOVERED PROPERTIES THAT EXISTED BEFORE IS THE PHRASE A COMMUNITY SHOULD HOLD ONTO. GROUND THAT LOOKS OWNERLESS, OR THAT SOMEBODY HAS BEGUN TO BUILD ON, MAY ALREADY BE ENDOWED AND SIMPLY UNRECORDED — AND THERE IS NOW A MINISTRY ACTIVELY LOOKING FOR EXACTLY THAT. WHAT SUCH A CLAIM LOOKS LIKE WHEN IT IS MADE IS INSTRUCTIVE: IN ONE PUBLISHED DISPUTE A DIRECTORATE STATED THAT A NUMBERED PROPERTY IN A NAMED CADASTRAL ZONE WAS AN ENDOWMENT PROPERTY RATHER THAN A FAMILY ENDOWMENT, DOCUMENTED BY A CONTRACT OF 1933, WITH OWNERSHIP PROVED IN THE NAME OF THE ENDOWMENTS BY AN OFFICIAL TITLE DEED, AND THAT THE OCCUPYING FAMILY HELD IT WITHOUT LEGAL STATUS. THAT CUTS BOTH WAYS AND MUST BE SAID PLAINLY: THE SAME INVENTORY THAT CAN PROTECT GROUND FROM A DEVELOPER CAN ALSO DISPOSSESS FAMILIES WHO HAVE LIVED ON ENDOWED LAND FOR GENERATIONS. ANYONE OCCUPYING GROUND WITHOUT A WRITTEN CONTRACT SHOULD FIND OUT NOW WHETHER IT IS ENDOWED, RATHER THAN LEARN IT FROM A NOTICE. THE LEGAL POSITION DIFFERS BY AREA, AND THE DIFFERENCE IS STARK. A LAW OF 2023 APPLIED IN THE SELF-ADMINISTRATION AREAS PROVIDES THAT ENDOWMENTS MAY NOT BE SOLD, CEDED, INHERITED, MORTGAGED OR INSURED; THAT NO RIGHT IS ACQUIRED OVER THEM BY PRESCRIPTION; THAT ANYONE OCCUPYING OR EXPLOITING ONE WITHOUT A VALID CONTRACT DOCUMENTED WITH THE ENDOWMENTS DEPARTMENT IS A TRESPASSER; AND THAT LEASING MAY ONLY BE BY AUCTION. A LAW OF 2018 APPLIED IN THE FORMER GOVERNMENT-CONTROLLED AREAS WENT THE OTHER WAY, ALLOWING THE MINISTRY AND THE CENTRAL ENDOWMENTS COUNCIL TO SELL, MORTGAGE OR EXCHANGE ENDOWMENT PROPERTIES — WHICH COMMENTATORS TREATED AS CONTRARY TO THE BASIC PRINCIPLE THAT ENDOWMENT ASSETS MAY NOT BE DEALT WITH OUTSIDE THEIR PURPOSE. SO WHETHER ENDOWMENT STATUS PROTECTS A PLOT OR MERELY CHANGES WHO CAN SELL IT DEPENDS ON WHICH LAW RUNS WHERE YOU ARE. THAT IS THE FIRST THING TO ESTABLISH, AND IT IS ANSWERABLE: ASK THE GOVERNORATE ENDOWMENTS DIRECTORATE WHICH LAW IT APPLIES. LEASING ONLY BY AUCTION IS ALSO WORTH KNOWING FOR ANYONE ALREADY FARMING OR TRADING ON ENDOWED GROUND — A PRIVATE ARRANGEMENT WITH AN OFFICIAL IS NOT A CONTRACT, AND THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED ELSEWHERE HOW QUICKLY SUCH ARRANGEMENTS COLLAPSE WHEN THE OFFICIAL CHANGES. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A STATE RELIGIOUS MINISTRY IN A COUNTRY THAT HAS JUST CHANGED GOVERNMENT AND IS STILL DIVIDED IN PRACTICE - IT ADMINISTERS AND INVESTS ENDOWED PROPERTY, INCLUDING BUILDING ON IT, AND NOTHING RECORDED HERE SHOWS IT PROTECTING LAND FOR ENVIRONMENTAL REASONS; ITS MINISTER HAS LAID FOUNDATION STONES FOR NEW CONSTRUCTION ON ENDOWMENT LAND. THE INVENTORY IS CONTESTED: RELYING ON OTTOMAN-ERA RECORDS TO REOPEN MODERN OWNERSHIP HAS DRAWN PUBLIC CONTROVERSY AND AFFECTS FAMILIES IN OCCUPATION. WHETHER A MEMBER OF THE PUBLIC CAN SEARCH THE REGISTER, WHETHER NEW ENDOWMENTS CAN BE MADE FOR CONSERVATION PURPOSES, AND WHAT THE GOVERNORATE DIRECTORATES OFFER WERE NOT ESTABLISHED. THE ACCOUNT COMES FROM PRESS REPORTING OF APRIL AND JULY 2026 AND A HOUSING AND LAND RIGHTS ANALYSIS OF THE TWO ENDOWMENT LAWS, NOT FROM THE MINISTRY'S OWN PUBLICATIONS. Read it with the cadastral directorate and its objection stage, the antiquities planning rule, the free legal offices and the arid zones research centre recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: State forest nurseries — 32 across the governorates, 1.4 million seedlings a season, planted with local communities
trackers.desc: PLANTING IS THE CHEAPEST WAY A COMMUNITY MAKES GROUND VISIBLY ITS OWN, AND THE HARDEST PART IS GETTING THE PLANTS. HERE THEY EXIST IN BULK: THE FORESTRY DIRECTORATE'S PRODUCTION PLAN FOR THE 2025-2026 SEASON COVERS ABOUT 1.4 MILLION FOREST SEEDLINGS RAISED IN THIRTY-TWO NURSERIES DISTRIBUTED ACROSS THE GOVERNORATES, PRODUCING MORE THAN FIFTY KINDS SUITED TO DIFFERENT PLANTING SITES. THIRTY-TWO NURSERIES MEANS ONE IS PROBABLY WITHIN REACH. THE PRACTICAL QUESTION IS NOT WHETHER SEEDLINGS EXIST BUT WHICH NURSERY SERVES YOUR DISTRICT, WHAT IT IS RAISING THIS SEASON AND ON WHAT TERMS IT RELEASES STOCK. THE SPECIES LIST TELLS YOU WHAT CAN ACTUALLY BE ASKED FOR: PINE, CYPRESS, LAUREL, FIR, ROBINIA, ACACIA, CHESTNUT, ATLANTIC PISTACHIO, BITTER ALMOND, WILD ALMOND AND PALM, AMONG OTHERS MATCHED TO THE COUNTRY'S VARIED ENVIRONMENTS. THE SENTENCE THAT MATTERS MOST TO A VILLAGE IS THE ONE ABOUT WHO DOES THE PLANTING: THE MINISTRY PLANTED MORE THAN A HUNDRED AND FIFTY-TWO THOUSAND SEEDLINGS DURING THE CURRENT YEAR IN COOPERATION WITH LOCAL COMMUNITIES, AND LOCAL AND INTERNATIONAL ORGANISATIONS TAKE PART IN AFFORESTATION AND TECHNICAL TRAINING PROGRAMMES. IN COOPERATION WITH LOCAL COMMUNITIES IS AN EXISTING ARRANGEMENT, NOT A FAVOUR TO BE INVENTED — SO THE ASK IS TO BE THE COMMUNITY IT COOPERATES WITH NEXT SEASON, ON GROUND YOU CHOOSE. AND TECHNICAL TRAINING IS PART OF THE PACKAGE, WHICH IS WHAT KEEPS SEEDLINGS ALIVE AFTER THE PHOTOGRAPHS. THE NEED IS DOCUMENTED IN NUMBERS THAT ALSO MAKE THE CASE FOR ANY PARTICULAR HILLSIDE: NATURAL REGENERATION IN SOME DAMAGED SITES CAME OUT LOW, FORCING THEM INTO THE ANNUAL AFFORESTATION PLAN, WITH ABOUT A THOUSAND HECTARES DUE FOR TREATMENT IN THE COMING SEASON. AND THE SCALE OF THE LOSS BEHIND IT: FIRES IN TWO COASTAL GOVERNORATES IN JULY 2025 HARMED ABOUT FIFTY THOUSAND PEOPLE AND MORE THAN A HUNDRED AND TWENTY-SEVEN VILLAGES, DAMAGED MORE THAN EIGHTEEN THOUSAND HECTARES OF FARMLAND AND FOREST, AND HARMED A HUNDRED AND SEVENTEEN IRRIGATION SYSTEMS AND TWO HUNDRED AND TWO BEEHIVES, WITH MORE THAN A HUNDRED AND FIFTY THOUSAND TREES LOST. THOSE ARE THE FIGURES TO QUOTE IN AN APPLICATION. A DISTRICT THAT CAN SHOW ITS SITE IS INSIDE THAT DAMAGE AND THAT REGENERATION IS LOW IS ARGUING INSIDE THE PLAN RATHER THAN AGAINST IT. THE VOLUNTEER SIDE IS ALREADY ORGANISED AND WORTH JOINING RATHER THAN DUPLICATING: CAMPAIGNS LAUNCHED BY ACTIVISTS AND YOUNG PEOPLE TARGET THE DAMAGED COASTAL AREAS AND TWO INLAND COUNTRYSIDES, SEEKING TO REPAIR DAMAGED ECOSYSTEMS, STRENGTHEN ENVIRONMENTAL AWARENESS AND RAISE FUNDING TO SUPPORT PLANTING — AND ONE MINISTRY CAMPAIGN WITH A SINGLE GOVERNORATE DISTRIBUTED ABOUT TWO HUNDRED THOUSAND OLIVE SEEDLINGS. OLIVE SEEDLINGS DISTRIBUTED IN BULK ARE THE MOST USEFUL THING IN THIS ENTRY FOR A HOUSEHOLD: A TREE THAT PRODUCES INCOME MAKES LAND VISIBLY PRODUCTIVE, AND THIS FILE HAS RECORDED IDLE-LAND CLASSIFICATIONS USED TO REALLOCATE GROUND ACROSS THIS REGION. PLANTING IS SUPERVISED BY MANY HANDS — MINISTRIES, GOVERNORATES AND DIRECTORATES ALONGSIDE CIVIL ORGANISATIONS, ASSOCIATIONS, VOLUNTEER TEAMS AND COMMUNITY INITIATIVES — CONCENTRATED ON FOREST AREAS, TOWN ENTRANCES AND ROAD MEDIANS, WHICH IS ALSO A HINT ABOUT WHERE STOCK GOES FIRST AND WHAT A REMOTE VILLAGE MUST ARGUE AGAINST. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A STATE FORESTRY PROGRAMME IN A COUNTRY REBUILDING ITS ADMINISTRATION - WHETHER SEEDLINGS ARE GIVEN FREE, SOLD, OR RELEASED ONLY TO OFFICIAL CAMPAIGNS, AND WHO MAY REQUEST THEM, WERE NOT ESTABLISHED, AND THE NURSERY LOCATIONS WERE NOT LISTED IN WHAT WAS SEEN. PLANTING ON LAND YOU DO NOT HOLD DOCUMENTED RIGHTS OVER CAN CREATE ITS OWN DISPUTE, PARTICULARLY WHERE THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS OVERLAPPING CADASTRAL AND ENDOWMENT CLAIMS. THE FIGURES COME FROM A FORESTRY DIRECTOR'S STATEMENT TO THE STATE NEWS AGENCY REPUBLISHED BY COMMERCIAL OUTLETS IN NOVEMBER AND DECEMBER 2025 AND FROM A JANUARY 2026 PRESS ANALYSIS OF PLANTING CAMPAIGNS - NOT FROM A MINISTRY SERVICE PAGE, AND THE SAME ANALYSIS QUESTIONS HOW MUCH OF THE PLANTING SURVIVES. Read it with the cadastral directorate and its objection stage, the endowments ministry's property inventory, the arid zones research centre and the free legal offices recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Grassroots Justice Network and the community paralegal model — open membership, training, and a guide to negotiating with investors
trackers.desc: THIS FILE HAS SPENT HUNDREDS OF ROUNDS LOOKING FOR LAWYERS. THIS ENTRY IS THE OTHER ANSWER: TRAIN PEOPLE FROM THE COMMUNITY ITSELF. THE METHOD IS TRAINING AND DEPLOYING COMMUNITY PARALEGALS - GRASSROOTS LEGAL ADVOCATES TRAINED IN BASIC LAW AND IN SKILLS LIKE MEDIATION, ORGANISING, EDUCATION AND ADVOCACY - WHO TRACK DATA ON THE PROCESS AND RESULTS OF EVERY CASE. TRACKING EVERY CASE IS THE PART THAT SEPARATES THIS FROM GOODWILL. A VILLAGE WITH TWO TRAINED PARALEGALS AND A CASE LOG CAN SHOW A PATTERN ACROSS FIFTY HOUSEHOLDS — AND A PATTERN IS WHAT CHANGES A RULE, WHILE A SINGLE COMPLAINT CHANGES ONE FILE. THE NETWORK BEHIND IT IS OPEN AND LARGE: A GLOBAL GRASSROOTS JUSTICE NETWORK DESCRIBED IN ITS CURRENT MATERIAL AS MORE THAN TWENTY THOUSAND JUSTICE DEFENDERS FROM OVER A HUNDRED AND NINETY COUNTRIES, WITH A PUBLISHED DIRECTORY OF MEMBER ORGANISATIONS AND AN OPEN JOIN PAGE. A PUBLISHED MEMBER DIRECTORY IS THE FASTEST WAY TO FIND WHO ELSE IN OR NEAR YOUR COUNTRY ALREADY DOES THIS — THE QUESTION THIS PAYLOAD HAS HAD TO ANSWER COUNTRY BY COUNTRY, ANSWERED IN ONE LIST. ITS LAND STRAND EXISTS FOR EXACTLY THE SITUATION THIS FILE DESCRIBES: IT STATES THAT INVESTMENT INTEREST IN LAND AND NATURAL RESOURCES IS ON THE RISE AND THAT MINING, AGRIBUSINESS, INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AND OTHER PRIVATE AND PUBLIC PROJECTS ARE DAMAGING THE ENVIRONMENT AND ENDANGERING THE LIVELIHOODS OF LOCAL COMMUNITIES. AND IT HAS A RECORD TO POINT AT: IN ONE COUNTRY, PARALEGALS AND COMMUNITIES TACKLED MORE THAN FIVE HUNDRED LAND AND ENVIRONMENTAL INJUSTICES - LAND GRABS, POLLUTION, DESTRUCTION - LEADING TO TWO OF THE WORLD'S MOST PROGRESSIVE LAND AND CLIMATE JUSTICE LAWS. THE SINGLE MOST USEFUL DOCUMENT IT PUBLISHES IS ALSO THE RAREST THING IN THIS ENTIRE PAYLOAD: A GUIDE TO SUPPORT COMMUNITIES AND PARALEGALS AS THEY NEGOTIATE CONTRACTS WITH INVESTORS - COVERING CONTRACTS BETWEEN COMMUNITIES AND INVESTORS, CONSERVATION CONTRACTS, AND CONTRACTS BETWEEN DIFFERENT COMMUNITIES. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED TWO CASES WHERE THE CONTRACT WAS THE THING THAT DECIDED EVERYTHING — A DAM CANCELLED AFTER A MINISTRY FOUND THE LIABILITIES ALL SAT WITH THE STATE, AND A VILLAGE THAT REFUSED A MINING COMPANY'S LEASE OFFER AND DONATED ITS LAND INSTEAD. A GUIDE WRITTEN FOR COMMUNITIES SITTING ACROSS THE TABLE FROM AN INVESTOR IS WHAT BOTH OF THOSE NEEDED BEFOREHAND. CONSERVATION CONTRACTS BEING COVERED MATTERS TOO, BECAUSE THIS PAYLOAD RECORDS FOUNDATIONS THAT LEASE VILLAGE LAND AND PAY INTO COMMUNITY BUDGETS — A COMMUNITY SIGNING ONE OF THOSE IS ALSO SIGNING A CONTRACT, AND SHOULD READ IT WITH THE SAME EYES. THERE IS ALSO TEACHING: A NETWORK ACADEMY WHOSE INAUGURAL COURSE, AN INTRODUCTION TO CARBON JUSTICE, OPENED FOR ENROLMENT AND LAUNCHED IN JULY 2026 - RELEVANT WHEREVER CARBON PROJECTS ARE ARRIVING ON COMMUNITY LAND. AND THE NETWORK'S OWN RESEARCH CARRIES THE WARNING THIS ENTRY MUST REPEAT: PARALEGAL WORK IS EMBEDDED IN THE LOCAL CONTEXT AND INCLUDES FACT-FINDING AND COMPILING EVIDENCE IN COMMUNITIES, WHICH MEANS PARALEGALS HAVE TO WORK IN HIGH-RISK AREAS - AND SECURITY FORCES HAVE THREATENED MEMBERS OF PARALEGAL NETWORKS WITH ARREST UNDER SPECIAL LAWS WITHOUT SUFFICIENT EVIDENCE. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A NETWORK AND A METHOD, NOT A SERVICE PROVIDER - IT TRAINS AND DEPLOYS PARALEGALS DIRECTLY IN ONLY A HANDFUL OF COUNTRIES, NONE OF THEM IN THIS REGION, AND MEMBERSHIP BRINGS PEER LEARNING, RESOURCES AND CONVENING RATHER THAN A LAWYER OR A GRANT. ITS OWN EVALUATION NOTES THAT ONLY A FEW MEMBERS HAVE BEEN CONNECTED TO THE TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE OR FUNDING NEEDED TO CARRY OUT PLANS MADE AT ITS MEETINGS. THE IMPACT FIGURES ARE THE ORGANISATION'S OWN CLAIMS. IN THE COUNTRY THIS IS FILED UNDER, WHERE ASSOCIATIONS ARE STILL BEING RE-REGISTERED AFTER A CHANGE OF GOVERNMENT AND LAND CLAIMS OVERLAP BETWEEN CADASTRE, ENDOWMENT AND OCCUPATION, PARALEGAL WORK WOULD BE BOTH VALUABLE AND EXPOSED - AND WHETHER ANY MEMBER ORGANISATION OPERATES THERE WAS NOT ESTABLISHED. Read it with the cadastral directorate and its objection stage, the endowments ministry's property inventory, the free legal offices and the state forest nurseries recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Governorate chambers of agriculture and their union — the farmers' structure that outlived the dissolved peasants' union
trackers.desc: THIS PAYLOAD ALREADY RECORDS THAT THE COUNTRY'S GENERAL PEASANTS' UNION - THE SINGLE FARMERS' ORGANISATION UNDER THE OLD SYSTEM, FOUNDED IN 1964 - WAS DISSOLVED IN JANUARY 2025. THAT LEFT A QUESTION THIS ENTRY ANSWERS: WHAT FARMER-FACING STRUCTURE REMAINS. THE ANSWER IS THE CHAMBERS OF AGRICULTURE, ORGANISED BY GOVERNORATE, EACH WITH ITS OWN BOARD OF DIRECTORS AND CHAIRMAN, UNDER A UNION WITH A NAMED PRESIDENT. THE UNION IS FUNCTIONING AFTER THE CHANGE OF GOVERNMENT: ITS PRESIDENT WAS RECORDED IN 2026 HOLDING TALKS WITH A FOREIGN CHARGE D'AFFAIRES, WHICH MEANS IT IS RECEIVING DIPLOMATIC COUNTERPARTS AND IS THE BODY OUTSIDERS ARE DIRECTED TO WHEN THEY ASK ABOUT AGRICULTURE. FOR A VILLAGE, THE GOVERNORATE CHAMBER IS THE REACHABLE PART. THIS FILE HAS RECORDED, COUNTRY AFTER COUNTRY, THAT A FARMER ALONE IS INVISIBLE AND A FARMER INSIDE A CHAMBER HAS A CHAIRMAN WHO SPEAKS TO MINISTRIES - AND HERE THE CHAMBERS SURVIVED A CHANGE OF REGIME THAT DISSOLVED THE UNION ABOVE THEM. WHAT A CHAMBER KNOWS IS THE MOST USEFUL THING ABOUT IT. THE CHAIRMAN OF ONE CAPITAL-AREA CHAMBER PUBLICLY REPORTED THE VALUE OF THE AGRICULTURAL EXPORTS HIS CHAMBER ISSUED IN A SINGLE YEAR AT A HUNDRED AND NINETY-EIGHT AND A HALF MILLION DOLLARS, OF WHICH TWENTY-ONE AND A HALF MILLION WENT TO ONE NEIGHBOURING STATE AND ABOUT FORTY-ONE MILLION TO ANOTHER. A CHAMBER THAT ISSUES EXPORT PAPERWORK KNOWS WHAT LEAVES ITS GOVERNORATE, IN WHAT QUANTITY AND TO WHERE. NO MINISTRY PUBLISHES THAT AT GOVERNORATE LEVEL, AND IT BEARS DIRECTLY ON WHO IS FARMING WHAT AND ON WHICH LAND - WHICH IS EXACTLY THE EVIDENCE A COMMUNITY NEEDS WHEN ITS GROUND IS CALLED UNUSED. THE HISTORY IS WORTH CARRYING TOO, BECAUSE IT IS A MODEL: THE ORGANISED FARMER MOVEMENT HERE BEGAN IN 1943, WHEN THE FARMERS OF ONE VILLAGE IN THE CAPITAL'S COUNTRYSIDE CAME TOGETHER OUT OF THE NEED TO SECURE DRINKING WATER AND WATER TO IRRIGATE THEIR LAND, AND FOUNDED THE FIRST AGRICULTURAL COOPERATIVE SOCIETY IN THE COUNTRY. AND WHEN THEY FOUND THAT NO LAW THEN ALLOWED THE FORMATION OF ASSOCIATIONS, THEY REGISTERED IT UNDER THE COMPANIES LAW INSTEAD. THAT IS THE OLDEST AND BEST PIECE OF ADVICE IN THIS ENTIRE PAYLOAD FOR ANYONE IN A COUNTRY WHERE ASSOCIATIONS CANNOT BE REGISTERED: IF THE ASSOCIATION ROUTE IS CLOSED, LOOK AT THE COMPANY ROUTE. A COMPANY CAN HOLD A BANK ACCOUNT, SIGN A LEASE AND OWN A PUMP - AND EIGHTY YEARS AGO IN THIS COUNTRY THAT IS EXACTLY HOW VILLAGERS SOLVED IT. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE HEAVY: VERIFICATION HERE IS THINNER THAN THIS FILE PREFERS. THE CHAMBERS' CURRENT STRUCTURE, HOW MANY EXIST, WHETHER THEIR BOARDS HAVE BEEN RECONSTITUTED SINCE THE CHANGE OF GOVERNMENT, WHAT MEMBERSHIP COSTS AND WHAT SERVICES THEY OFFER FARMERS TODAY WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED. THE EXPORT FIGURE COMES FROM A RESEARCH CENTRE'S DIGEST OF STATEMENTS MADE UNDER THE PREVIOUS GOVERNMENT AND IS SEVERAL YEARS OLD; THE UNION PRESIDENT'S 2026 MEETING COMES FROM A STATE NEWS AGENCY'S SOCIAL MEDIA POST; AND THE 1943 ACCOUNT COMES FROM AN ENCYCLOPAEDIA ENTRY ABOUT THE NOW-DISSOLVED PEASANTS' UNION. CHAMBERS OF AGRICULTURE ARE TRADE BODIES SERVING PRODUCERS AND EXPORTERS, NOT ADVOCATES - NOTHING RECORDED SHOWS ONE DEFENDING A COMMUNITY'S LAND, AND UNDER THE OLD SYSTEM SUCH BODIES WERE CLOSE TO THE STATE. Read it with the cadastral directorate and its objection stage, the endowments ministry's property inventory, the state forest nurseries and the free legal offices recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Volunteer civil defence with local centres — forest and farm fires, wells, rivers and rubble, and the crew that founded it by defying an order
trackers.desc: THE FOUNDING STORY IS THE REASON THIS ENTRY EXISTS. IN 2012 REGIME FORCES PREVENTED A GOVERNMENT FIRE TEAM IN ONE CITY FROM RESPONDING TO A FIRE IN A RESIDENTIAL DISTRICT ON THE GROUNDS THAT IT LAY OUTSIDE THEIR CONTROL. THE TEAM DEFIED THEIR COMMANDERS, WENT AND PUT THE FIRE OUT, AND ON THE SAME DAY ESTABLISHED AN EMERGENCY RESPONSE CENTRE TO SERVE ALL SYRIANS. A CREW THAT ANSWERED A CALL IT WAS FORBIDDEN TO ANSWER, AND FOUNDED AN INSTITUTION BEFORE THE DAY WAS OUT, IS THE PLAINEST EXAMPLE IN THIS ENTIRE PAYLOAD OF WHAT ORDINARY PEOPLE WITH EQUIPMENT AND A DECISION CAN CREATE. WHAT GREW FROM IT IS A HUMANITARIAN INSTITUTION BEGUN IN 2013, WHEN VOLUNTEERS OF ALL AFFILIATIONS CAME TOGETHER TO RESPOND TO BOMBARDMENT AND TO FILL THE GAPS CAUSED BY THE WITHDRAWAL OF BASIC GOVERNMENT SERVICES SUCH AS FIREFIGHTING AND HEALTH CARE - NOW AROUND THREE THOUSAND THREE HUNDRED VOLUNTEERS, WOMEN AND MEN, IN ALL THE AREAS WHERE IT WORKS. FILLING THE GAP LEFT BY WITHDRAWN SERVICES IS EXACTLY THE SITUATION THIS FILE RECORDS IN COUNTRY AFTER COUNTRY, USUALLY WITH NOBODY FILLING IT. HERE THE GAP WAS FILLED BY A VOLUNTEER BODY WITH CENTRES IN THE DISTRICTS THEMSELVES. WHAT IT ANSWERS IS THE LIST OF THINGS THAT ACTUALLY HAPPEN TO RURAL COMMUNITIES: ON RECEIVING ANY ALARM OR DISTRESS MESSAGE IT MOVES TO SEARCH FOR AND RESCUE PEOPLE TRAPPED UNDER RUBBLE, AND ITS WORK ALSO INCLUDES RESCUING PEOPLE TRAPPED INSIDE WELLS AND SAVING CIVILIANS FROM DROWNING IN RIVERS. PEOPLE FALL INTO WELLS AND ARE SWEPT INTO RIVERS IN EVERY COUNTRY IN THIS PAYLOAD, AND IN MOST OF THEM NOBODY IS TRAINED TO GO IN AFTER THEM. THAT CAPABILITY IS WORTH KNOWING THE LOCATION OF BEFORE IT IS NEEDED. THE FIRE WORK IS THE PART CLOSEST TO THIS FILE'S SUBJECT: IT RESPONDS TO ALL TYPES OF FIRE - THOSE CAUSED BY SHELLING, HOUSE FIRES, AND FIRES IN INDUSTRIAL, AGRICULTURAL AND FOREST AREAS. THE NUMBERS SHOW WHAT THAT MEANS IN PRACTICE: IN ONE YEAR ITS FIRE TEAMS EXTINGUISHED MORE THAN TWO THOUSAND SIX HUNDRED FIRES, INCLUDING ABOUT A HUNDRED AND FORTY IN CAMPS AND ABOUT FOUR HUNDRED AND FIFTY IN CIVILIANS' HOMES, AND IN ANOTHER MORE THAN TWO THOUSAND IN THE NORTH-WEST ALONE. THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED FORESTS BURNING IN THIS COUNTRY - EIGHTEEN THOUSAND HECTARES DAMAGED, A HUNDRED AND TWENTY-SEVEN VILLAGES AFFECTED, A HUNDRED AND FIFTY THOUSAND TREES LOST IN ONE SEASON. THE ORGANISATION THAT TURNS OUT TO THOSE FIRES IS THIS ONE. ITS CURRENT WORK CONFIRMS IT: ITS TEAMS HAVE WORKED WITH FIRE BRIGADES AND WITH VOLUNTEERS FROM RESIDENTS AND HUMANITARIAN ASSOCIATIONS TO EXTINGUISH FIRES IN ONE COASTAL GOVERNORATE'S COUNTRYSIDE, AND HAVE FOUGHT LARGE FOREST FIRES IN ITS NORTH-EASTERN COUNTRYSIDE IN DIFFICULT CONDITIONS BECAUSE NO ROADS LEAD TO THE AREAS WHERE THE FLAMES SPREAD. NO ROADS TO THE FIRE IS A PLANNING FACT AS MUCH AS AN EMERGENCY ONE. A COMMUNITY THAT WANTS ITS FOREST DEFENDED SHOULD BE ASKING FOR FIREBREAKS AND ACCESS TRACKS IN THE SAME BREATH AS IT ASKS FOR PROTECTION. THE OTHER TWO CURRENT JOBS SHOW THE BREADTH: A RESPONSE IN THE CAPITAL TO A REPORT OF BODIES AND SKELETAL REMAINS AND FOUL SMELLS COMING FROM A SEWAGE SYSTEM, AND THE START OF RUBBLE REMOVAL FROM A MUNICIPAL STADIUM IN ONE CITY. THE LIMITS, AND THEY ARE HEAVY: THIS IS AN EMERGENCY RESPONSE ORGANISATION, NOT A LAND, LEGAL OR CONSERVATION ONE - IT PUTS OUT FIRES AND PULLS PEOPLE OUT OF RUBBLE, AND NOTHING RECORDED HERE SHOWS IT OPPOSING A PROJECT, DOCUMENTING LAND LOSS OR SUPPORTING A COMMUNITY IN A DISPUTE. IT GREW UP IN AREAS OUTSIDE FORMER GOVERNMENT CONTROL AND ITS COVERAGE ACROSS THE WHOLE COUNTRY AFTER THE CHANGE OF GOVERNMENT, ITS RELATIONSHIP WITH THE NEW AUTHORITIES AND WHETHER ITS CENTRES NOW OPERATE IN EVERY GOVERNORATE WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED. IT HAS BEEN THE SUBJECT OF SUSTAINED POLITICAL CONTESTATION AND DISINFORMATION BY PARTIES TO THE CONFLICT, WHICH IS PART OF THE CONTEXT ANY OUTSIDER APPROACHING IT SHOULD UNDERSTAND. THE FIRE FIGURES ARE THE ORGANISATION'S OWN AND DATE FROM 2020 AND AN UNSTATED LATER YEAR; THE CURRENT ACTIVITIES COME FROM A REGIONAL NEWSPAPER'S TAG PAGE AND A STATE NEWS AGENCY'S SOCIAL MEDIA POST. Read it with the state forest nurseries and the 2025 fire losses, the cadastral directorate's objection stage, the endowments ministry's property inventory and the free legal offices recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Founding an association at the governorate sub-directorate — the papers required, and the six-month temporary licence before permanent registration
trackers.desc: THIS PAYLOAD HAS RECORDED FOR THIS COUNTRY THE CIVIL DEFENCE, THE CHAMBERS OF AGRICULTURE, THE STATE FOREST NURSERIES AND THE CADASTRAL OBJECTION STAGE. WHAT IT HAD NOT RECORDED IS THE COUNTER AT WHICH A VILLAGE GROUP BECOMES A LEGAL PERSON - AND THAT COUNTER IS NOT IN THE CAPITAL: THE FOUNDING APPLICATION, SIGNED BY THE FOUNDERS AND INCLUDING THE PROPOSED NAME OF THE ORGANISATION, IS SUBMITTED TO THE SUB-DIRECTORATE OF SOCIAL AFFAIRS AND LABOUR IN THE GOVERNORATE OF THE HEADQUARTERS. A GOVERNORATE OFFICE RATHER THAN A MINISTRY IN DAMASCUS IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A RURAL GROUP THAT CAN REGISTER AND ONE THAT CANNOT - AND IN A COUNTRY WHERE MOVEMENT BETWEEN PROVINCES HAS BEEN DIFFICULT AND EXPENSIVE FOR YEARS, THAT IS NOT A SMALL POINT. THE RULES ARE RECENT: THE SOCIAL AFFAIRS AND LABOUR MINISTRY ANNOUNCED NEW CONDITIONS FOR FOUNDING NON-GOVERNMENTAL ORGANISATIONS - WHETHER AN ASSOCIATION, A FOUNDATION OR A TEAM - WITH THE AIM OF ORGANISING THE WORK OF ORGANISATIONS, IN A DECISION PUBLISHED ON THE THIRTIETH OF DECEMBER 2024. THAT A TEAM IS NAMED ALONGSIDE AN ASSOCIATION AND A FOUNDATION MATTERS. THE VOLUNTEER GROUPS THIS FILE KEEPS FINDING - THE PEOPLE WHO CLEAR RUBBLE, FIGHT FIRES OR REPLANT A SLOPE WITHOUT ANY PAPERWORK - HAVE A CATEGORY OF THEIR OWN TO REGISTER UNDER. THE PAPERS ARE FEW AND KNOWABLE: A DOCUMENT AUTHORISING A DELEGATE TO FOLLOW UP THE FOUNDING PROCEDURES; MINUTES OF THE ELECTION OF A BOARD OF DIRECTORS; AN INTERNAL OR BASIC STATUTE ACCORDING TO THE APPROVED MODEL; AND A RECENTLY DATED EXTRACT FROM THE JUDICIAL RECORD FOR EACH FOUNDING MEMBER. TWO OF THOSE FOUR ARE WORTH PREPARING BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE. A STATUTE ACCORDING TO THE APPROVED MODEL MEANS THERE IS A TEMPLATE TO ASK FOR RATHER THAN A DOCUMENT TO DRAFT - AND MINUTES OF AN ELECTION MEAN THE GROUP MUST ACTUALLY HOLD ONE AND WRITE IT DOWN, WHICH IS ALSO THE MOMENT TO DECIDE WHO SPEAKS FOR IT. ONE MEMBER BEING NAMED AS THE DELEGATE IS THE PRACTICAL DETAIL THAT SAVES A GROUP MONTHS: ONE PERSON WITH THE AUTHORISATION DOCUMENT CAN CHASE THE FILE, RATHER THAN ALL THE FOUNDERS ATTENDING EVERY TIME. AND THE RECORD EXTRACT IS THE ONE THAT EXPIRES - IT MUST BE RECENTLY DATED, SO IT SHOULD BE COLLECTED LAST, AFTER THE STATUTE AND THE ELECTION MINUTES ARE READY. THE LICENCE THAT FOLLOWS IS PROVISIONAL, AND A GROUP SHOULD PLAN FOR IT: AFTER THE REQUIRED PAPERS ARE COMPLETED THE BODY IS GRANTED A TEMPORARY LICENCE FOR SIX MONTHS, AFTER WHICH ITS WORK IS EVALUATED AND ITS LICENCE RENEWED PERMANENTLY. SIX MONTHS UNDER EVALUATION MEANS THE FIRST HALF-YEAR IS THE AUDITION. A GROUP THAT SPENDS IT DOING SOMETHING VISIBLE AND DOCUMENTED - A PLANTING, A CLEAN-UP, A SURVEY, WITH MINUTES AND PHOTOGRAPHS - IS PREPARING THE FILE ITS PERMANENT LICENCE WILL BE JUDGED ON. THE OLDER DEBATE ABOUT THIS LAW IS WORTH KNOWING BECAUSE IT NAMES THE AMBITION: A LAWYERS' FORUM DISCUSSION RECORDS A STATE PLANNING CHIEF DESCRIBING A DRAFT AMENDMENT INTENDED TO ACTIVATE THE LOCAL CIVIL COMMUNITY IN ORDER TO STRENGTHEN PEOPLE'S PARTICIPATION IN DEVELOPMENT AND CARRY IT TO GROUPS AND AREAS THE STATE'S HEAVY MACHINERY CANNOT REACH EFFICIENTLY. THE SAME ACCOUNT RECORDS THE INTENTION TO ALLOW EXTERNAL FUNDING UNDER THE MINISTRY'S SUPERVISION, TO DEVELOP THE ROLE OF ASSOCIATIONS FROM CHARITABLE TO DEVELOPMENTAL, AND THE STRESS ON THE IMPORTANCE OF ISSUING LICENCES IN EVERY TOWN. A LICENCE IN EVERY TOWN IS THE SENTENCE TO QUOTE WHEN A GOVERNORATE OFFICE SUGGESTS THAT A VILLAGE DOES NOT NEED ITS OWN ORGANISATION. THE LIMITS: THIS IS A LICENSING REGIME, NOT AN ALLY - THE SAME MINISTRY THAT REGISTERS CAN REFUSE, AND A LICENCE GRANTED FOR SIX MONTHS AND THEN EVALUATED IS A LICENCE THAT CAN BE WITHHELD. WHAT THE EVALUATION MEASURES, WHETHER REFUSAL CAN BE APPEALED, WHAT REGISTRATION COSTS, HOW MANY FOUNDERS ARE REQUIRED AND WHETHER AN ENVIRONMENTAL OR LAND PURPOSE IS ACCEPTED WERE ALL NOT ESTABLISHED - THOSE SHOULD BE ASKED AT THE GOVERNORATE SUB-DIRECTORATE BEFORE ANYTHING IS SIGNED. THE RULES WERE ISSUED BY A CARETAKER ADMINISTRATION IN DECEMBER 2024 AND THIS FILE COULD NOT ESTABLISH WHETHER THEY HAVE SINCE BEEN REPLACED, SO THEY MUST BE CHECKED AGAINST WHAT THE OFFICE APPLIES TODAY. THE ACCOUNT COMES FROM AN INDEPENDENT SYRIAN NEWS OUTLET'S REPORT OF THE MINISTERIAL DECISION, AND THE LAW DEBATE FROM A BAR ASSOCIATION FORUM THREAD THAT PREDATES THE WAR. Read it with the civil defence and its founding story, the chambers of agriculture and their union, the state forest nurseries and the cadastral directorate's objection stage recorded separately for this country.

trackers.name: Nauru — Ministry of Finance
trackers.desc: National budget authority; oversees public financial management and prepares the annual budget, Republic of Nauru. Here you can trace how the public budget is allocated and spent in Nauru.

trackers.name: SPREP — three conventions, and 26 members is not 12 parties
trackers.desc: THE REGIONAL BODY FOR PACIFIC ENVIRONMENT, AND IT IS SECRETARIAT TO THREE CONVENTIONS. SPREP is an independent intergovernmental organisation, autonomous since the Agreement Establishing SPREP was signed at Apia on 16 June 1993, with the Article 2 purpose of providing assistance to protect and improve the environment and ensure sustainable development for present and future generations. It has 26 members — 14 Pacific island countries, 7 territories and 5 metropolitan states — and is headquartered in Apia, Samoa. ESTABLISH WHICH CONVENTION FITS YOUR ISSUE: the Noumea Convention (1986, in force 1990), described by UNEP as the only comprehensive multilateral umbrella agreement for protection of natural resources and environment in the region; the Waigani Convention on hazardous and radioactive waste imports; and the Apia Convention on nature conservation. THE NOUMEA CONVENTION IS UNDER ACTIVE REVIEW — WHICH IS AN OPENING: a 2021 Review produced recommendations now being implemented through a Noumea Workplan and Budget whose stated aim is to elevate the work of the Convention and enhance awareness and implementation, with a Communications Plan and a Finance Strategy named as critical. BUT CHECK WHETHER YOUR STATE IS A PARTY: SPREP has 26 members while the Noumea Convention has only 12 contracting parties — membership and party status are different things, and this entry does not assert the latter. GOVERNANCE POINT WORTH KNOWING: the SPREP Meeting is the plenary decision-making body; the Executive Board (established 2015) is subordinate to it and has no power to make decisions requiring input of all Members — so a decision affecting all members must go to the Meeting. IF YOUR ISSUE IS SEABED MINING: UNEP records deep sea mining as an emerging contentious issue the region is dealing with — the regional body has already named it. SPREP is also developing a portal for protected areas managers. YOUR STATE IS RECORDED AS A NOUMEA CONVENTION PARTY: it was among those represented at the 18th Conference of the Parties, Apia, 5 September 2025 — so the Convention's obligations and its Workplan apply here.

trackers.name: Pacific Development and Conservation Trust — citizens may apply
trackers.desc: AN INDIVIDUAL CAN APPLY, AND THE FIRST DOCUMENT IS SHORT. The Pacific Development and Conservation Trust, administered through the New Zealand government's Community Matters service with requests assessed by Advisory Trustees, states that ‘citizens or organisations’ from eligible Pacific places may request funding — so no incorporated body is required, which removes the commonest barrier recorded across this map. THE PROCESS IS TWO-STAGE: submit an Expression of Interest; only successful applicants are invited to submit a full project application. Do not prepare a full proposal before the EOI is accepted — wasted work, and expensive wasted work where drafting means travelling. Applications must be on the current form with all sections completed, submitted online where connection allows. READ THE PUBLISHED GRANT RECORD BEFORE DRAFTING: the Trust publishes records of grants by round — 2020/21, 2021/22, 2022/23 (two rounds), 2023/24 and 2024/25 — showing what the Trustees have actually funded, at what size and in which countries. That is better evidence of what will succeed than any guidance note. UNDP SUPPORT HERE IS COUNTRY-LEVEL: UNDP's Pacific Office provides country support to this state, so an in-country office is a realistic second route alongside the Trust.

trackers.name: SPREP EIA and SEA guidelines — intervene at scoping, not after
trackers.desc: SCOPING IS WHERE STAKEHOLDER CONCERNS BECOME TERMS OF REFERENCE — and the guidelines say so themselves. Assessments must be individually customised to the aspects most relevant to stakeholders, and ‘customisation usually occurs during the scoping phase and results in the preparation of terms of reference’. Intervene at scoping and the assessment is required to examine your issue; intervene later and you are commenting on an assessment that was never asked to look. SPREP's Strengthening Environmental Impact Assessment: Guidelines for Pacific Island Countries and Territories (60pp, English and French) is the regional practice standard, SPREP having been mandated on EIA capacity since the 1990s. KNOW WHICH INSTRUMENT YOUR FIGHT NEEDS: EIA assesses a project; the companion Strategic Environmental Assessment guidelines (developed 2018–2020) assess a policy, plan or programme and are addressed to environment agencies, national planning offices, development control agencies, municipal authorities and provincial administrations — so if the problem is a tourism plan or a zoning programme rather than one hotel, SEA is the instrument and the municipal or provincial authority is the addressee. There is also a sector guideline for coastal tourism development, made with the South Pacific Tourism Organisation. THE HONEST PART, FROM A REGULATOR'S OWN ACCOUNT: Vanuatu's Principal EIA Officer publicly described her department's challenges as lack of staff, lack of political support, weaknesses in public consultation, and low capacity in monitoring and enforcement. Expect to supply evidence the agency cannot gather itself, and expect post-consent monitoring to be weak unless someone outside government does it — it is also a citable admission when arguing that a condition needs an independent monitoring mechanism attached. CHECK YOUR OWN ENVIRONMENT ACT FIRST: many Pacific countries have EIA mandated under their Environment Acts and EIA Regulations, and these guidelines support the implementation of current legal requirements rather than replacing them — the practice standard, not the obligation. SPREP runs in-country EIA training workshops, and the Pacific Environment Portal carries regional and national data.

trackers.name: Waigani Convention — radioactive waste, and 200 miles not 12
trackers.desc: IT REACHES WHERE BASEL CANNOT — and for island states that is the whole point. The Waigani Convention is modelled on Basel and is the regional implementation of the hazardous waste regime, but differs in two decisive ways: it also covers radioactive wastes, and its territorial coverage includes each Party's Exclusive Economic Zone — 200 nautical miles — rather than stopping at the 12 nautical mile territorial sea as Basel does. That makes it the instrument for dumping, transhipment and seabed disposal cases Basel cannot touch. It is annex-driven: obligations extend to all wastes in Annex I or those possessing the listed characteristics — check Annex I first; if the substance is listed the obligations attach automatically, and if not, the argument runs through the hazard characteristics instead. It is closely tied to the London Convention on dumping at sea. THE BODY TO CONTACT: the Pacific Regional Centre for the Waigani and Basel Conventions, based at SPREP in Samoa, which has developed a model law implementing all four waste conventions (Basel, Rotterdam, Stockholm, Waigani) with a worked Tonga project — so where a national statute is missing or fragmented, the model already exists and a government can be pointed at it. AND A CONSULTATION WINDOW IS OPEN NOW: Cleaner Pacific 2025, the regional waste and pollution strategy built with 21 member countries around four goals and 15 strategic actions, is being replaced — the successor CP2036 was endorsed at the 31st SPREP Meeting (September 2023) with consultation in Suva, 21–22 July 2025. Priorities for the next decade are being set now. Ask whether your country has a national waste and pollution policy written against the regional strategy — it is the document your government is measured against. Delivery vehicles include PacWaste Plus (EUR 16.5 million, 72 months, EU-funded, across eight waste streams). THE HONEST LIMIT, FROM SPREP'S OWN REVIEW: Australia's reporting capability far exceeds that of most Pacific island countries, relying on weighbridge data requiring infrastructure that is not available — so do not assume an absence of data means an absence of a problem, and community-gathered data may be the best evidence there is. Watch the Clean Pacific Roundtable and CIRCLE EXPO, held alternately for an annual meeting of countries, industry and civil society — named as a participant category, not an observer.

trackers.name: Right to information — what your country actually has
trackers.desc: ASK EVEN WHERE THERE IS NO STATUTE — UNESCO's 2022 report on SDG 16.10.2 records that even Pacific states without access-to-information laws have an environment ‘generally favourable to the public's exercising of their right to information’. The absence of a law is not, on the region's own evidence, a reason to expect refusal. AND THERE IS A COMMITMENT TO CITE WHERE NO LAW EXISTS: the Boe Declaration on Regional Security (2018) Action Plan includes the adoption and implementation of constitutional, statutory and/or policy guarantees for public access to information as a measure for success — a government that signed Boe has already agreed that access to information is a measure of its own success. The Pacific Plan 2005 and the UN Pacific Strategy urge the same. The underlying right sits in article 19 of the ICCPR and of the Universal Declaration. REGIONAL POSITION: only four Pacific island countries have adopted RTI laws — Cook Islands (2008), Palau (2014), Vanuatu (2016) and Fiji (2018) — with several others drafting. A SOURCING WARNING FROM VANUATU'S OWN RTI UNIT, which applies region-wide: its site carries the notice ‘beware of fake websites pretending to be official’ — verify the domain before submitting anything containing your identity and your concern. IN NAURU: it was proposed in 2009 to appoint an Ombudsman to oversee development of an RTI regime.

trackers.name: ELAW — free attorneys and scientists who will critique the developer's EIA
trackers.desc: IT WILL READ THE DEVELOPER'S EIA AND TELL YOU WHAT IS WRONG WITH IT — which is the thing a community cannot produce alone and usually cannot afford. ELAW is a global alliance of attorneys, scientists and other advocates, founded 1989 in Eugene, Oregon by public interest lawyers from ten countries, that provides legal and scientific support to grassroots advocates to challenge destructive projects. FOUR CONCRETE FORMS OF HELP: legal support to local public interest lawyers; scientific support, including critiquing environmental assessments; economic insights on projects; and security expertise — ‘ELAW helps environmental lawyers improve their security so they can work without fear. When our partners are targeted, we act quickly to help defend and protect them.’ That last one is a named function, not an aspiration, and ELAW co-founded the Alliance for Land, Indigenous and Environmental Defenders. HOW TO USE IT — THROUGH A LAWYER, NOT AS A CLIENT: ELAW works through more than 300 public interest advocates in its network, and its stated strategy is ‘locating strong lawyers who are committed to protecting the environment in their home countries’. You can approach ELAW directly, but the leverage is greatest when a local advocate is the conduit — that is how the network is built. It has hosted nearly 300 advocates from more than 65 countries as Fellows and provided support on thousands of cases; several partners have won the Goldman Environmental Prize. Focus areas include biodiversity, fossil fuels — expressly assisting advocates in contesting fossil fuel development projects — plastic pollution, and work with coastal communities. It publishes guidebooks, including one to give communities sufficient understanding to challenge oil and gas projects, and clause-level summaries of national EIA law — so its site is also a route to learning exactly what your own EIA law requires. ASK WHETHER ELAW HAS A PARTNER IN YOUR COUNTRY: the network is described as spanning 70 to 80 countries but the member list is not published country by country, so this entry does not assert a presence in yours.

trackers.name: Pacific Development and Conservation Trust — individuals can apply
trackers.desc: INDIVIDUALS CAN APPLY, NOT JUST ORGANISATIONS — the third fund in this file with that feature, and consistently the thing local groups do not realise. New Zealand's Pacific Development and Conservation Trust distributes up to $250,000 a year in grants to groups and individuals for conservation, cultural heritage, development and goodwill, prioritising community projects including those involving representative, endangered, threatened or unique habitats and species. Cook Islands, Niue, Nauru, Tuvalu and Samoa are all expressly on its eligible list, alongside every other Pacific state and territory. TWO OF ITS FUNDING CRITERIA ARE UNUSUALLY USEFUL: it funds projects that ‘improve legal access to facilities or resources necessary for social, cultural and economic sufficiency’ — broad enough to cover securing a community's access to land and water, which is not how most conservation funds are written — and projects that develop local capacities, particularly for indigenous ecological knowledge development. So documenting customary knowledge of a threatened site is itself a fundable project, and that documentation is often exactly the evidence an objection needs. The Trust is committed to communities working in partnership with iwi, hapū, aiga and local indigenous people — a proposal led by a customary group is what it is looking for, not an exception it tolerates. Apply via New Zealand's communitymatters service. THE OTHER REGIONAL FUNDER, WITH ITS LIMITS STATED: the Critical Ecosystem Partnership Fund invested in the Polynesia-Micronesia hotspot — backed by AFD, Conservation International, the EU, the GEF, Japan, the MacArthur Foundation and the World Bank, run through CI's team in Apia with SPREP support — funding over 90 projects in 13 countries, including 58 community-based projects. That five-year programme ran 2008–2013 and this entry does NOT assert an open window — check CEPF directly. A RESULT WORTH CITING: in Fiji the National Trust of Fiji, Pacific Invasives Initiative, BirdLife and the local community eradicated goats and rats on Monuriki, creating a haven for the Critically Endangered Fiji crested iguana. AND A FIGURE THAT STRENGTHENS ANY APPLICATION FROM HERE: only 21 percent of the region's original vegetation remains pristine, across a hotspot of 4,500 islands whose total land area is about the size of Switzerland.

trackers.name: Central African Republic — Ministère des Finances et du Budget
trackers.desc: National budget authority; mobilises public revenue, manages expenditure & prepares the finance law (loi de finances), Central African Republic. Here you can trace how the public budget is allocated and spent in the Central African Republic.

trackers.name: Urgent Action Fund–Africa (rapid response grants)
trackers.desc: RAPID MONEY WHEN SOMETHING SUDDEN HAPPENS — and it is open all year. UAF-Africa is a pan-African feminist rapid response fund, founded 2001 in Nairobi, with geographical presence in Africa's 54 countries and over 6,000 grants resourced. BE CLEAR ON SCOPE: it supports women, girls and gender-diverse people and women's rights organisations — it is not a general environmental fund. It belongs in this map because it fits a specific and recurring situation: women land and environmental defenders facing threats, harassment or security risks. NO FUNDING CYCLE — apply as soon as an urgent situation requires it, to proposals@uaf-africa.org. THREE GRANT TYPES: rapid response, protection grants up to USD 15,000, and advocacy and alliance building up to USD 30,000. FOUR CRITERIA, ALL REQUIRED: strategic (tied to a plan for structural change), unanticipated (could not have been foreseen), time urgent (must happen within 3 months or the opportunity is lost), and sustainable. The ‘unanticipated’ test is what disqualifies most applications — planned programme work does not qualify, by design. Applications may be written in French, English, Swahili or Arabic. Both registered and informal groups may apply; individuals are not funded.

trackers.name: African Convention on Nature — check WHICH version binds your state
trackers.desc: THERE ARE TWO AFRICAN CONVENTIONS OF THIS NAME, AND CITING THE WRONG ONE IS THE AVOIDABLE ERROR HERE. The Algiers Convention was signed 15 September 1968, in force 16 June 1969. The revised Maputo Convention was adopted by the Assembly of the Union in Maputo on 11 July 2003 and entered into force 23 July 2016 — thirteen years later. THE OPERATIVE RULE: the 1968 Convention remains in force for those countries that have not ratified the 2003 revisions, so the two coexist and which binds your state depends on its ratification status. Commentary records only about 30 percent of African states had ratified Maputo. This entry does not assert which binds your state — the African Union publishes a Status List alongside the treaty text at au.int. Check it first. WHY THE DELAY IS AN ARGUMENT FOR IT: commentary attributes the thirteen years to the revised text containing strong provisions that could create accountability and also slow down social and economic development — a treaty resisted for creating accountability is one worth invoking where it applies. PROVISIONS TO KNOW: article XXXIX — no reservation may be made to this Convention, so a ratifying state takes all of it; article XL — withdrawal takes effect only one year after written notification; and no instrument of accession to the 1968 Algiers Convention may be deposited any longer, so the older text is closed to new entrants. THE OBJECTIVES ARE BROADER THAN USUAL: conservation, utilisation and development of soil, water, flora and fauna for present and future welfare, from an economic, nutritional, scientific, educational, cultural and aesthetic point of view — so a claim resting on cultural or aesthetic value has a treaty basis. BUT IF THE 1968 TEXT IS WHAT BINDS YOU, EXPECT LITTLE: parties were encouraged to cooperate but were not required to submit regular reports on implementation, and there were no financial mechanisms — no reporting trail, no funding attached. Article XLI also provides for interim secretariat arrangements, so check current institutional capacity. IUCN publishes a commentary on each provision in English and French.

trackers.name: MEFP — the Central African organisation that works for Aka forest communities, and commissioned the study of whether the law matches the treaty
trackers.desc: WHO TO ENLIST: the Maison de l'Enfant et de la Femme Pygmées, a Central African organisation working for the social, economic and cultural wellbeing of the Aka (Bayaka) forest people, and one of the very few bodies of any kind operating in this space in the country. THE LEGAL FOUNDATION IT WORKS ON IS UNUSUALLY STRONG, AND MOST PEOPLE DO NOT KNOW IT: the Central African Republic was in 2010 the first African state to ratify ILO Convention 169 on indigenous and tribal peoples, which carries binding standards on land and territorial rights, participation and free, prior and informed consent. MEFP, with indigenous representatives, commissioned an international jurist to study whether Central African legislation and its implementing machinery actually comply with that convention, and to recommend the legislative and administrative changes needed — so the gap between the treaty and the law has been mapped, and the document exists to be cited. WHAT IT DOES ON THE GROUND: it takes part in independent external observation missions in logging permit areas of the south-western forest massif, around Ngotto and Balé-Loko, alongside a Central African environmental information centre and other partners, on the strength of its knowledge of the forest sector and of local and indigenous community rights; it works on forest livelihoods, including reintroducing Gnetum africanum; and it publicly documents violence against Aka communities, as at Bayanga. It sits alongside REPALCA, the national arm of the Central African forest peoples' network, and Bayaka associations including ADIBAC and the Bayaka association of Balé-Loko. WHO IT SUITS: Aka and other forest communities in south-western CAR facing logging permits, conservation displacement or violence. CAVEATS: NO ORGANISATIONAL WEBSITE WAS FOUND — this entry points at a third-party directory record and should be treated as a pointer to the organisation, not as its own publication. It is an advocacy and community organisation, not a law firm, and the Central African Republic is a conflict state in which none of this can be assumed to be reachable at any given moment.

trackers.name: The Lomba community forest — three villages took 15,000 ha INSIDE a logging concession, the first such grant in the Congo Basin
trackers.desc: WHAT TO APPLY FOR, AND THE PRECEDENT THAT MAKES IT POSSIBLE: the villages of Moloukou, Moale and Lokombe applied JOINTLY and were granted almost 15,000 hectares of the Lomba forest — the first official community forest allocated in the Central African Republic, and reported as the first in the Congo Basin to be granted WITHIN THE WORKING AREA OF A CONCESSION ALREADY ALLOCATED TO AN INDUSTRIAL LOGGING COMPANY, where until recently it was legally impossible. If you have been told your forest cannot be claimed because a company already holds the permit over it, this is the case to cite. THE LEGAL BASIS AND THE ROUTE: since 2015 there has been a legal framework allowing local and indigenous communities to obtain a community forest by submitting an APPLICATION FILE to the forest administration — described as the only legal option for communities to secure rights over the resources they depend on in a country where a reported 80 per cent of the rainforest has been handed to logging companies. Three villages applied together rather than separately. THE SIZE TRAP, DOCUMENTED IN THE SAME WORK: the procedure's 5,000-hectare unit is far smaller than most customary territories, which cover hunting and gathering grounds — subdividing them arbitrarily generates conflict and undermines viability, which is why the joint application over a single large block matters. Support came from local Central African organisations working with an international rainforest organisation, which has also published lessons from the pilot allocations and recommendations for reforming the attribution procedure manual. WHO IT SUITS: Central African forest and indigenous communities — including those whose forest lies inside an existing logging concession — and communities elsewhere in the Congo Basin facing the same objection. CAVEATS: THIS IS A CASE AND A ROUTE, NOT A LOCAL SERVICE DESK — the supporting organisation is international and the local partners are not separately verified here; CAR's security situation constrains everything, the attribution file is demanding, and co-management inside a live concession is untested ground. For the Aka/Bayaka communities, CAR's MEFP entry.

trackers.name: Central African Republic — assistance judiciaire is financed by international cooperation, advocates rarely leave Bangui, and the Tribunal de Grande Instance publishes its phone numbers
trackers.desc: WHAT EXISTS AND WHERE, STATED AS THE RESEARCH STATES IT: in the Central African Republic the profession of advocate is exercised FIRST AND FOREMOST IN BANGUI; because of persistent insecurity and the weak deployment of state institutions across the territory, advocates RARELY TRAVEL TO THE PROVINCES, and mainly to the west, in the more or less pacified sub-prefectures. Central African advocates are few in number and live essentially on relatively lucrative files handled in Bangui AND ON ASSISTANCE JUDICIAIRE FINANCED BY INTERNATIONAL COOPERATION. That last clause is the practical key: free representation in CAR exists because a donor programme is paying for it, so the question to ask is WHICH PROGRAMME IS CURRENTLY FUNDING ASSISTANCE JUDICIAIRE AND WHICH TRIBUNALS IT COVERS — not whether a permanent scheme exists. The same research records the consequence honestly: the small number of practising advocates cannot meet the population's substantial justice needs, which is part of why, IN THE INTERIOR, CONFLICTS ARE RESOLVED OUTSIDE THE FORMAL COURTS. If you are in the interior, expect the dispute to be settled locally — so put your effort into the customary process and into getting whatever it decides written down, rather than waiting for a court that will not come. WHERE THE FORMAL DOOR IS: the justice ministry publishes contacts for the TRIBUNAL DE GRANDE INSTANCE DE BANGUI, Rue Joseph Degrain, +236 75 72 32 44 and +236 72 73 92 21, alongside the ministry itself on the same street. An international lawyers' organisation has worked in CAR since 2015 in partnership with local associations. WHO IT SUITS: Central Africans needing representation or a court contact, and anyone deciding whether to pursue a formal or customary route. CAVEATS: THIN AND CONDITIONAL — no permanent national legal aid scheme could be verified; what is recorded is donor-financed assistance, a Bangui-centred bar and a published court contact. For the community forest granted INSIDE a logging concession — the precedent to cite — CAR's Lomba entry; for Aka/Bayaka communities, MEFP.

trackers.name: The Plateforme de la société civile GDRNE — 30+ Central African NGOs federated in one body that sits in every forest-sector decision, up from fewer than five a decade earlier
trackers.desc: THE UMBRELLA THAT SITS IN THE ROOM: the PLATEFORME DE LA SOCIÉTÉ CIVILE DE GESTION DURABLE DES RESSOURCES NATURELLES ET DE L'ENVIRONNEMENT, established APRIL 2011, is the federating body that PARTICIPATES IN ALL DECISION-MAKING PROCESSES IN THE FOREST SECTOR in the Central African Republic. THE CHANGE IT REPRESENTS, IN THE NUMBERS PRACTITIONERS GIVE: ten years earlier Central African civil society was NEITHER VISIBLE NOR WELL ORGANISED on forest and environmental questions, with FEWER THAN FIVE NGOs fully playing their role; today there are MORE THAN THIRTY AT NATIONAL LEVEL, GATHERED IN THAT SINGLE NATIONAL PLATFORM. One federated body with a seat in every forest decision is worth more to a village than thirty separate organisations — approach the platform rather than hunting for the right NGO, and ask which member covers your préfecture.
